DEFINITION: The first letter of the Greek alphabet, used figuratively in the New Testament along with the last letter (omega) to indicate the eternity, totality, and sovereignty of God.
SENSES: 1. The first element of a series, symbolizing divine eternity and sovereignty (Rev 1:8; 21:6; 22:13).

THAYER.pt: A primeira letra do alfabeto grego, usada figuradamente no Novo Testamento junto com a última letra (ômega) para indicar a eternidade, totalidade e soberania de Deus. 1. O primeiro elemento de uma série, simbolizando a eternidade e soberania divina (Ap 1.8; 21.6; 22.13).
THAYER.en: The first letter of the Greek alphabet, used figuratively in the New Testament along with the last letter (omega) to indicate the eternity, totality, and sovereignty of God. 1. The first element of a series, symbolizing divine eternity and sovereignty (Rev 1:8; 21:6; 22:13).

DEFINITION: Proper name designating Aaron, the brother of Moses and first high priest of Israel according to the Law.
SENSES: 1. Aaron, the biblical patriarch and high priest (Luke 1:5; Heb 5:4).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio que designa Arão, o irmão de Moisés e primeiro sumo sacerdote de Israel segundo a Lei. 1. Arão, o patriarca e sumo sacerdote bíblico (Lc 1.5; Hb 5.4).
THAYER.en: Proper name designating Aaron, the brother of Moses and first high priest of Israel according to the Law. 1. Aaron, the biblical patriarch and high priest (Luke 1:5; Heb 5:4).

DEFINITION: Transliterated Hebrew term meaning 'destruction' or 'perdition', used as the name of the angel of the abyss.
SENSES: 1. The angel of the abyss or place of destruction (Rev 9:11).

THAYER.pt: Termo hebraico transliterado que significa 'destruição' ou 'perdição', usado como nome do anjo do abismo. 1. O anjo do abismo ou lugar de destruição (Ap 9:11).
THAYER.en: Transliterated Hebrew term meaning 'destruction' or 'perdition', used as the name of the angel of the abyss. 1. The angel of the abyss or place of destruction (Rev 9:11).

DEFINITION: That which does not constitute a financial burden or onerous weight for someone.
SENSES: 1. Exempt from being a financial burden to others (2Cor 11:9).

THAYER.pt: Que não constitui um peso financeiro ou fardo oneroso para alguém. 1. Isento de ser um fardo financeiro para outros (2Co 11:9).
THAYER.en: That which does not constitute a financial burden or onerous weight for someone. 1. Exempt from being a financial burden to others (2Cor 11:9).

DEFINITION: Affectionate and reverent Aramaic term for "Father," preserved in the New Testament to express the believer's filial intimacy with God.
SENSES: 1. Invocatory title of God as loving Father (Mark 14:36; Rom 8:15; Gal 4:6).

THAYER.pt: Termo aramaico afetuoso e reverente para "Pai", preservado no Novo Testamento para expressar a intimidade filial do crente com Deus. 1. Título invocatório de Deus como Pai amoroso (Mc 14.36; Rm 8.15; Gl 4.6).
THAYER.en: Affectionate and reverent Aramaic term for "Father," preserved in the New Testament to express the believer's filial intimacy with God. 1. Invocatory title of God as loving Father (Mark 14:36; Rom 8:15; Gal 4:6).

DEFINITION: Proper name designating the second son of Adam and Eve, known for offering an acceptable sacrifice to God and being martyred by his brother Cain.
SENSES: 1. Abel, the patriarch and righteous offerer mentioned as a model of faith (Matt 23:35; Luke 11:51; Heb 11:4).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio que designa o segundo filho de Adão e Eva, conhecido por oferecer um sacrifício aceitável a Deus e ser martirizado por seu irmão Caim. 1. Abel, o patriarca e justo sacrificador mencionado como modelo de fé (Mt 23.35; Lc 11.51; Hb 11.4).
THAYER.en: Proper name designating the second son of Adam and Eve, known for offering an acceptable sacrifice to God and being martyred by his brother Cain. 1. Abel, the patriarch and righteous offerer mentioned as a model of faith (Matt 23:35; Luke 11:51; Heb 11:4).

DEFINITION: Hebrew proper name corresponding to Abijah, appearing in the genealogies of Jesus and in Old Testament references.
SENSES: 1. Abijah, an ancestor and priestly or royal figure in the genealogies (Matt 1:7; Luke 1:5).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio hebraico correspondente a Abias, figurando nas genealogias de Jesus e em referências veterotestamentárias. 1. Abias, ancestral e figura sacerdotal ou real nas genealogias (Mt 1.7; Lc 1.5).
THAYER.en: Hebrew proper name corresponding to Abijah, appearing in the genealogies of Jesus and in Old Testament references. 1. Abijah, an ancestor and priestly or royal figure in the genealogies (Matt 1:7; Luke 1:5).

DEFINITION: Proper name of a prominent high priest during the reign of David.
SENSES: 1. The high priest Abiathar (Mark 2:26).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio de um sumo sacerdote proeminente durante o reinado de Davi. 1. O sumo sacerdote Abiatar (Mc 2:26).
THAYER.en: Proper name of a prominent high priest during the reign of David. 1. The high priest Abiathar (Mark 2:26).

DEFINITION: Tetrarchy region located on the eastern slope of Anti-Lebanon, governed by Lysanias.
SENSES: 1. Region of Abilene in Palestine (Luke 3:1).

THAYER.pt: Região tetrarquia localizada na encosta oriental do Antilíbano, governada por Lisânias. 1. Região de Abilene na Palestina (Lc 3:1).
THAYER.en: Tetrarchy region located on the eastern slope of Anti-Lebanon, governed by Lysanias. 1. Region of Abilene in Palestine (Luke 3:1).

DEFINITION: Proper name of one of the descendants in the earthly genealogy of Jesus Christ.
SENSES: 1. Abiud, ancestor of Jesus in Matthew's lineage (Matt 1:13).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio de um dos descendentes na genealogia terrena de Jesus Cristo. 1. Abiúde, ancestral de Jesus na linhagem de Mateus (Mt 1.13).
THAYER.en: Proper name of one of the descendants in the earthly genealogy of Jesus Christ. 1. Abiud, ancestor of Jesus in Matthew's lineage (Matt 1:13).

DEFINITION: The founding patriarch of the nation of Israel, the supreme example of faith and obedience to God in the Old and New Testament Scriptures.
SENSES: 1. Abraham, the historical patriarch and ancestor of the Jewish people (Matt 1:1; John 8:39).
2. Spiritual archetype of the faith that justifies before God (Rom 4:1; Gal 3:6).

THAYER.pt: O patriarca fundador da nação de Israel, supremo exemplo de fé e obediência a Deus nas Escrituras do Antigo e do Novo Testamento. 1. Abraão, o patriarca histórico e ancestral do povo judeu (Mt 1.1; Jo 8.39). | 2. Arquétipo espiritual da fé que justifica diante de Deus (Rm 4.1; Gl 3.6).
THAYER.en: The founding patriarch of the nation of Israel, the supreme example of faith and obedience to God in the Old and New Testament Scriptures. 1. Abraham, the historical patriarch and ancestor of the Jewish people (Matt 1:1; John 8:39). | 2. Spiritual archetype of the faith that justifies before God (Rom 4:1; Gal 3:6).

DEFINITION: Space of immense depth, associated in the New Testament with the subterranean world, dwelling place of the dead, and prison of rebel spirits.
SENSES: 1. Immense depth or cosmic abyss (Rom 10:7).
2. The underworld, dwelling place of demons and eschatological prison of Satan (Luke 8:31; Rev 20:3).

THAYER.pt: Espaço de imensa profundidade, associado no Novo Testamento ao mundo subterrâneo, morada dos mortos e prisão de espíritos rebeldes. 1. Profundeza imensa ou abismo cósmico (Rm 10.7). | 2. O submundo, morada de demônios e prisão escatológica de Satanás (Lc 8.31; Ap 20.3).
THAYER.en: Space of immense depth, associated in the New Testament with the subterranean world, dwelling place of the dead, and prison of rebel spirits. 1. Immense depth or cosmic abyss (Rom 10:7). | 2. The underworld, dwelling place of demons and eschatological prison of Satan (Luke 8:31; Rev 20:3).

DEFINITION: Agabus was a Christian prophet from Judea who predicted a great famine and also the imprisonments of the apostle Paul.
SENSES: 1. Christian prophet who predicted a global famine during the reign of Claudius (Acts 11:28).
2. Prophet who prophesied about the bonds and imprisonment of Paul in Jerusalem (Acts 21:10).

THAYER.pt: Ágabo foi um profeta cristão da Judeia que previu uma grande fome e também as prisões do apóstolo Paulo. 1. Profeta cristão que predisse uma fome global durante o reinado de Cláudio (At 11.28). | 2. Profeta que profetizou sobre as amarras e a prisão de Paulo em Jerusalém (At 21.10).
THAYER.en: Agabus was a Christian prophet from Judea who predicted a great famine and also the imprisonments of the apostle Paul. 1. Christian prophet who predicted a global famine during the reign of Claudius (Acts 11:28). | 2. Prophet who prophesied about the bonds and imprisonment of Paul in Jerusalem (Acts 21:10).

DEFINITION: To practice actions that bring practical benefits and help to others, demonstrating generosity and active kindness.
SENSES: 1. To practice good and be rich in good works in the Christian life (1Tim 6:18).
2. God's generosity in granting rains and sustenance to humanity (Acts 14:17).

THAYER.pt: Praticar ações que trazem benefícios práticos e auxílio aos outros, demonstrando generosidade e bondade ativa. 1. Praticar o bem e ser rico em boas obras na vida cristã (1Tm 6.18). | 2. A generosidade de Deus em conceder chuvas e sustento aos homens (At 14.17).
THAYER.en: To practice actions that bring practical benefits and help to others, demonstrating generosity and active kindness. 1. To practice good and be rich in good works in the Christian life (1Tim 6:18). | 2. God's generosity in granting rains and sustenance to humanity (Acts 14:17).

DEFINITION: Describes the ethical conduct of performing beneficial, useful, and correct actions in favor of one's neighbor, reflecting a virtuous character.
SENSES: 1. To practice beneficial actions or demonstrate generosity toward others (Luke 6:33).
2. To act correctly and blamelessly according to God's will (1Pet 2:15).

THAYER.pt: Descreve a conduta ética de realizar ações benéficas, úteis e corretas em favor do próximo, refletindo um caráter virtuoso. 1. Praticar ações benéficas ou demonstrar generosidade para com outros (Lc 6.33). | 2. Agir de maneira correta e irrepreensível segundo a vontade de Deus (1Pe 2.15).
THAYER.en: Describes the ethical conduct of performing beneficial, useful, and correct actions in favor of one's neighbor, reflecting a virtuous character. 1. To practice beneficial actions or demonstrate generosity toward others (Luke 6:33). | 2. To act correctly and blamelessly according to God's will (1Pet 2:15).

DEFINITION: The action of doing good or engaging in morally correct and benefic conduct.
SENSES: 1. The constant practice of good works and virtues (1Pet 4:19).

THAYER.pt: A ação de praticar o bem ou envolver-se em condutas moralmente corretas e beneficentes. 1. A prática constante de boas obras e virtudes (1Pe 4:19).
THAYER.en: The action of doing good or engaging in morally correct and benefic conduct. 1. The constant practice of good works and virtues (1Pet 4:19).

DEFINITION: Person who practices good, acts with uprightness, and brings benefits to others.
SENSES: 1. One who does good or acts as a benefactor (1Pet 2:14).

THAYER.pt: Pessoa que pratica o bem, age com retidão e traz benefícios aos outros. 1. Aquele que faz o bem ou atua como benfeitor (1Pe 2:14).
THAYER.en: Person who practices good, acts with uprightness, and brings benefits to others. 1. One who does good or acts as a benefactor (1Pet 2:14).

DEFINITION: Describes that or one which attains a moral standard of virtue and excellence, producing benefits or demonstrating genuine benevolence. Applies par excellence to God's own generous and holy character.
SENSES: 1. Morally upright, virtuous, and integral (Matt 12:35; Luke 23:50).
2. Beneficial, useful, profitable, or fertile (Matt 7:17; Luke 8:8).
3. Substantivized in the neuter: the good, good works, earthly goods or possessions (Luke 12:18; Rom 8:28; Gal 6:10).

THAYER.pt: Descreve aquilo ou aquele que atinge um padrão moral de virtude e excelência, que produz benefícios ou demonstra benevolência genuína. Aplica-se por excelência ao próprio caráter generoso e santo de Deus. 1. Moralmente reto, virtuoso e íntegro (Mt 12.35; Lc 23.50). | 2. Benéfico, útil, proveitoso ou fértil (Mt 7.17; Lc 8.8). | 3. Substantivado no neutro: o bem, obras boas, bens ou possessões terrenas (Lc 12.18; Rm 8.28; Gl 6.10).
THAYER.en: Describes that or one which attains a moral standard of virtue and excellence, producing benefits or demonstrating genuine benevolence. Applies par excellence to God's own generous and holy character. 1. Morally upright, virtuous, and integral (Matt 12:35; Luke 23:50). | 2. Beneficial, useful, profitable, or fertile (Matt 7:17; Luke 8:8). | 3. Substantivized in the neuter: the good, good works, earthly goods or possessions (Luke 12:18; Rom 8:28; Gal 6:10).

DEFINITION: Positive moral quality manifested in an active interest in the well-being of others, expressing character uprightness and practical generosity.
SENSES: 1. Moral goodness and integrity of character (Rom 15:14; Eph 5:9).
2. Generosity and beneficence demonstrated as fruit of the Spirit (Gal 5:22; 2Thess 1:11).

THAYER.pt: Qualidade moral positiva que se manifesta no interesse ativo pelo bem-estar dos outros, expressando retidão de caráter e generosidade prática. 1. Bondade moral e integridade de caráter (Rm 15.14; Ef 5.9). | 2. Generosidade e beneficência demonstrada como fruto do Espírito (Gl 5.22; 2Ts 1.11).
THAYER.en: Positive moral quality manifested in an active interest in the well-being of others, expressing character uprightness and practical generosity. 1. Moral goodness and integrity of character (Rom 15:14; Eph 5:9). | 2. Generosity and beneficence demonstrated as fruit of the Spirit (Gal 5:22; 2Thess 1:11).

DEFINITION: A state of intense joy and exultation, frequently accompanied by verbal expressions or bodily celebration movements.
SENSES: 1. Extreme joy or spiritual jubilation (Luke 1:44; Heb 1:9).

THAYER.pt: Um estado de intensa alegria e exultação, frequentemente acompanhado de expressões verbais ou movimentos corporais de celebração. 1. Alegria extrema ou júbilo espiritual (Lc 1.44; Hb 1.9).
THAYER.en: A state of intense joy and exultation, frequently accompanied by verbal expressions or bodily celebration movements. 1. Extreme joy or spiritual jubilation (Luke 1:44; Heb 1:9).

DEFINITION: To experience and express a state of extreme joy, jubilation, and deep contentment, frequently accompanied by visible manifestations.
SENSES: 1. To rejoice greatly or exult with joy (Acts 2:26; 1Pet 4:13).
2. To manifest intense spiritual jubilation before God's salvation (Luke 1:47; John 8:56).

THAYER.pt: Experimentar e expressar um estado de extrema alegria, jubilo e contentamento profundo, frequentemente acompanhado de manifestações visíveis. 1. Regozijar-se grandemente ou exultar de alegria (At 2.26; 1Pe 4.13). | 2. Manifestar júbilo espiritual intenso diante da salvação de Deus (Lc 1.47; Jo 8.56).
THAYER.en: To experience and express a state of extreme joy, jubilation, and deep contentment, frequently accompanied by visible manifestations. 1. To rejoice greatly or exult with joy (Acts 2:26; 1Pet 4:13). | 2. To manifest intense spiritual jubilation before God's salvation (Luke 1:47; John 8:56).

DEFINITION: Indicates a person who has not married or who is in a state of widowhood or temporary separation, without a spouse.
SENSES: 1. Single or widowed person in the context of marriage instructions (1Cor 7:8, 11, 34).

THAYER.pt: Indica uma pessoa que não se casou ou que se encontra em estado de viuvez ou separação temporária, sem um cônjuge. 1. Pessoa solteira ou viúva no contexto das orientações sobre o matrimônio (1Co 7.8, 11, 34).
THAYER.en: Indicates a person who has not married or who is in a state of widowhood or temporary separation, without a spouse. 1. Single or widowed person in the context of marriage instructions (1Cor 7:8, 11, 34).

DEFINITION: To experience a strong feeling of displeasure, irritation, or indignation over what is considered unjust or improper.
SENSES: 1. To feel indignation or deep anger at a situation (Mark 14:4; Matt 20:24).

THAYER.pt: Experimentar forte sentimento de desprazer, irritação ou indignação diante do que se considera injusto ou impróprio. 1. Sentir indignação ou ira profunda perante uma situação (Mc 14.4; Mt 20.24).
THAYER.en: To experience a strong feeling of displeasure, irritation, or indignation over what is considered unjust or improper. 1. To feel indignation or deep anger at a situation (Mark 14:4; Matt 20:24).

DEFINITION: An emotional state of strong displeasure, opposition, and indignation against something considered unjust or wrong.
SENSES: 1. Intense indignation or moral furor (2Cor 7:11).

THAYER.pt: Um estado emocional de forte desagrado, oposição e indignação contra algo considerado injusto ou errado. 1. Indignação intensa ou furor moral (2Co 7:11).
THAYER.en: An emotional state of strong displeasure, opposition, and indignation against something considered unjust or wrong. 1. Intense indignation or moral furor (2Cor 7:11).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: ἀγαπήσω, Aor: ἠγάπησα, Perf: ἠγάπηκα
DEFINITION: Expresses conscious, altruistic, deliberate, and sacrificial love characterized by the active pursuit of another's good. In the New Testament, describes God's supreme love expressed on the cross and the central commandment guiding Christian life.
SENSES: 1. The gracious, sacrificial, and undeserved love of God and Christ (John 3:16; Eph 5:2).
2. The Christian commandment to love one's neighbor, brethren, and enemies (Matt 5:44; 1John 4:11).
3. Loving God with all heart and soul (Matt 22:37; Rom 8:28).
4. Loving the world or sinful values in an illegitimate way (John 3:19; 1John 2:15).

THAYER.pt: Expressa o amor consciente, altruísta, deliberado e sacrificial caracterizado pela busca ativa do bem alheio. No Novo Testamento, descreve o amor supremo de Deus expresso na cruz e o mandamento central que orienta a vida cristã. 1. O amor gracioso, sacrificial e imerecido de Deus e de Cristo (Jo 3.16; Ef 5.2). | 2. O mandamento cristão de amar ao próximo, aos irmãos e aos inimigos (Mt 5.44; 1Jo 4.11). | 3. Amor a Deus de todo o coração e alma (Mt 22.37; Rm 8.28). | 4. Amar o mundo ou valores pecaminosos de modo ilegítimo (Jo 3.19; 1Jo 2.15).
THAYER.en: Expresses conscious, altruistic, deliberate, and sacrificial love characterized by the active pursuit of another's good. In the New Testament, describes God's supreme love expressed on the cross and the central commandment guiding Christian life. 1. The gracious, sacrificial, and undeserved love of God and Christ (John 3:16; Eph 5:2). | 2. The Christian commandment to love one's neighbor, brethren, and enemies (Matt 5:44; 1John 4:11). | 3. Loving God with all heart and soul (Matt 22:37; Rom 8:28). | 4. Loving the world or sinful values in an illegitimate way (John 3:19; 1John 2:15).

DEFINITION: Feeling of sublime, disinterested, and sacrificial esteem; represents the very nature of the divine character demonstrated on the cross and practiced among brethren.
SENSES: 1. Altruistic, benevolent, and loyal love exercised among neighbors and within the community (John 13:35; Rom 13:10; 1Cor 13:4).
2. Sovereign, unconditional, and sacrificial love of God and Christ (Rom 5:8; Eph 2:4; 1John 4:8).
3. Fraternal community meal celebrated by early Christians (Jude 12).

THAYER.pt: Sentimento de estima sublime, desinteressado e sacrificial; representa a própria natureza do caráter divino demonstrado na cruz e praticado entre os irmãos. 1. Amor altruísta, benevolente e leal exercido entre o próximo e na comunidade (Jo 13.35; Rm 13.10; 1Co 13.4). | 2. Amor soberano, incondicional e sacrificial de Deus e de Cristo (Rm 5.8; Ef 2.4; 1Jo 4.8). | 3. Refeição fraternal comunitária celebrada pelos cristãos primitivos (Jd 12).
THAYER.en: Feeling of sublime, disinterested, and sacrificial esteem; represents the very nature of the divine character demonstrated on the cross and practiced among brethren. 1. Altruistic, benevolent, and loyal love exercised among neighbors and within the community (John 13:35; Rom 13:10; 1Cor 13:4). | 2. Sovereign, unconditional, and sacrificial love of God and Christ (Rom 5:8; Eph 2:4; 1John 4:8). | 3. Fraternal community meal celebrated by early Christians (Jude 12).

DEFINITION: Describes someone who is the object of deep affection, special appreciation, or devoted love, being widely applied to believers among themselves and to Christ as the beloved Son of God.
SENSES: 1. Reference to an only child or someone in a singular and intimate relationship, the beloved (Matt 3:17).
2. Someone richly esteemed and loved by brethren in the faith, dear (Rom 12:19; 3John 1:2).

THAYER.pt: Descreve alguém que é objeto de profundo afeto, apreço especial ou amor devotado, sendo amplamente aplicado aos crentes entre si e a Cristo como o Filho amado de Deus. 1. Referência a um filho único ou a alguém em relação singular e íntima, o amado (Mt 3.17). | 2. Alguém ricamente estimado e amado pelos irmãos na fé, querido (Rm 12.19; 3Jo 1.2).
THAYER.en: Describes someone who is the object of deep affection, special appreciation, or devoted love, being widely applied to believers among themselves and to Christ as the beloved Son of God. 1. Reference to an only child or someone in a singular and intimate relationship, the beloved (Matt 3:17). | 2. Someone richly esteemed and loved by brethren in the faith, dear (Rom 12:19; 3John 1:2).

DEFINITION: Hagar was the Egyptian servant of Sarah, concubine of Abraham, and mother of Ishmael, used allegorically by Paul to illustrate the old covenant.
SENSES: 1. Historical Old Testament character, servant and concubine of Abraham (Gal 4:25).
2. Allegorical symbol of the covenant from Mount Sinai and earthly Jerusalem (Gal 4:25).

THAYER.pt: Hagar foi a serva egípcia de Sara, concubina de Abraão e mãe de Ismael, usada alegoricamente por Paulo para ilustrar a antiga aliança. 1. Personagem histórico do Antigo Testamento, serva e concubina de Abraão (Gl 4.25). | 2. Símbolo alegórico da aliança do monte Sinai e da Jerusalém terrenal (Gl 4.25).
THAYER.en: Hagar was the Egyptian servant of Sarah, concubine of Abraham, and mother of Ishmael, used allegorically by Paul to illustrate the old covenant. 1. Historical Old Testament character, servant and concubine of Abraham (Gal 4:25). | 2. Allegorical symbol of the covenant from Mount Sinai and earthly Jerusalem (Gal 4:25).

DEFINITION: Designates the act of requisitioning by authority (originally the Persian courier service) or compelling someone to render forced service, such as carrying a load.
SENSES: 1. To compel or force someone to render service or carry a load (Matt 5:41; 27:32).

THAYER.pt: Designa o ato de requisitar por autoridade (originalmente o serviço de correio persa) ou obrigar alguém a prestar um serviço forçado, como carregar uma carga. 1. Compelir ou forçar alguém a prestar serviço ou carregar carga (Mt 5.41; 27.32).
THAYER.en: Designates the act of requisitioning by authority (originally the Persian courier service) or compelling someone to render forced service, such as carrying a load. 1. To compel or force someone to render service or carry a load (Matt 5:41; 27:32).

DEFINITION: Any recipient or vessel designed to contain substances, especially liquids such as olive oil or water.
SENSES: 1. Vessels or jars used by the prudent virgins to carry extra oil (Matt 25:4).
2. Receptacles for sorting good and bad fish in the parable of the net (Matt 13:48).

THAYER.pt: Qualquer recipiente ou vasilha projetada para conter substâncias, especialmente líquidos como a azeite ou água. 1. Vasos ou vasilhas usados pelas virgens prudentes para levar azeite extra (Mt 25.4). | 2. Recipientes para separar peixes bons e ruins na parábola da rede (Mt 13.48).
THAYER.en: Any recipient or vessel designed to contain substances, especially liquids such as olive oil or water. 1. Vessels or jars used by the prudent virgins to carry extra oil (Matt 25:4). | 2. Receptacles for sorting good and bad fish in the parable of the net (Matt 13:48).

DEFINITION: The content of a proclamation or solemn instruction transmitted by someone, often referring to Christian doctrine.
SENSES: 1. The essential message of the Gospel proclaimed by Christ (1Jn 1:5).
2. The moral instruction or commandment to love one another (1Jn 3:11).

THAYER.pt: O conteúdo de uma proclamação ou instrução solene transmitida por alguém, referindo-se frequentemente à doutrina cristã. 1. A mensagem essencial do Evangelho proclamada por Cristo (1Jo 1.5). | 2. A instrução ou mandamento moral de amar uns aos outros (1Jo 3.11).
THAYER.en: The content of a proclamation or solemn instruction transmitted by someone, often referring to Christian doctrine. 1. The essential message of the Gospel proclaimed by Christ (1Jn 1:5). | 2. The moral instruction or commandment to love one another (1Jn 3:11).

DEFINITION: One charged with proclaiming news or carrying messages in the name of another. In New Testament literature, it primarily designates celestial spiritual beings ordered by God to minister to humans and execute His providential designs.
SENSES: 1. Celestial messenger, spiritual entity in the service of God (Mt 1:20; Lk 1:11; Heb 1:14).
2. Human emissary bearing an earthly mission (Lk 7:24; Jas 2:25).
3. Terrestrial divine messenger, such as John the Baptist or church leaders (Mt 11:10; Rev 1:20).

THAYER.pt: Aquele encarregado de proclamar notícias ou levar recados em nome de outrem. Na literatura neotestamentária, designa primordialmente seres espirituais celestiais ordenados por Deus para ministrar aos humanos e executar os Seus desígnios providentes. 1. Mensageiro celestial, entidade espiritual a serviço de Deus (Mt 1.20; Lc 1.11; Hb 1.14). | 2. Emissário humano portador de uma missão terrestre (Lc 7.24; Tg 2.25). | 3. Mensageiro divino terreno, como João Batista ou líderes da igreja (Mt 11.10; Ap 1.20).
THAYER.en: One charged with proclaiming news or carrying messages in the name of another. In New Testament literature, it primarily designates celestial spiritual beings ordered by God to minister to humans and execute His providential designs. 1. Celestial messenger, spiritual entity in the service of God (Mt 1:20; Lk 1:11; Heb 1:14). | 2. Human emissary bearing an earthly mission (Lk 7:24; Jas 2:25). | 3. Terrestrial divine messenger, such as John the Baptist or church leaders (Mt 11:10; Rev 1:20).

DEFINITION: An interjection used to incite, draw attention to, or exhort someone to immediate action.
SENSES: 1. Expression of exhortation or appeal: 'Come now!' or 'Well!' (Jas 5:1).

THAYER.pt: Interjeição usada para incitar, chamar a atenção ou exortar alguém a uma ação imediata. 1. Expressão de exortação ou apelo: 'Vamos!' ou 'Ora!' (Tg 5.1).
THAYER.en: An interjection used to incite, draw attention to, or exhort someone to immediate action. 1. Expression of exhortation or appeal: 'Come now!' or 'Well!' (Jas 5:1).

DEFINITION: A collective term used to designate a group of animals of the same species grazing or living together.
SENSES: 1. Herd or drove, especially of pigs (Mt 8:30; Mk 5:11).

THAYER.pt: Termo coletivo usado para designar um grupo de animais da mesma espécie pastando ou vivendo juntos. 1. Rebanho ou manada, especialmente de porcos (Mt 8.30; Mc 5.11).
THAYER.en: A collective term used to designate a group of animals of the same species grazing or living together. 1. Herd or drove, especially of pigs (Mt 8:30; Mk 5:11).

DEFINITION: Lacking a record of ancestors or documented ancestral lineage.
SENSES: 1. Void of an official genealogical record, applied to Melchizedek (Heb 7:3).

THAYER.pt: Que não possui registro de antepassados ou linhagem ancestral documentada. 1. Desprovido de registro genealógico oficial, aplicado a Melquisedeque (Hb 7:3).
THAYER.en: Lacking a record of ancestors or documented ancestral lineage. 1. Void of an official genealogical record, applied to Melchizedek (Heb 7:3).

DEFINITION: Possessing low social position, without nobility of birth, insignificant in the eyes of the world.
SENSES: 1. Of low social class or considered insignificant (1Co 1:28).

THAYER.pt: Que possui baixa posição social, sem nobreza de nascimento, insignificante aos olhos do mundo. 1. De classe social baixa ou considerado insignificante (1Co 1:28).
THAYER.en: Possessing low social position, without nobility of birth, insignificant in the eyes of the world. 1. Of low social class or considered insignificant (1Co 1:28).

DEFINITION: To separate something or someone from common use to dedicate it exclusively to God, making it holy and pure.
SENSES: 1. To consecrate or dedicate something for sacred use (Mt 23:17).
2. To make spiritually holy or purify the believer (Eph 5:26; Heb 13:12).
3. To treat as holy or reverence God (Mt 6:9; 1Pe 3:15).

THAYER.pt: Separar algo ou alguém do uso comum para dedicá-lo exclusivamente a Deus, tornando-o santo e puro. 1. Consagrar ou dedicar algo para uso sagrado (Mt 23:17). | 2. Tornar santo espiritualmente ou purificar o crente (Ef 5:26; Hb 13:12). | 3. Tratar como santo ou reverenciar a Deus (Mt 6:9; 1Pe 3:15).
THAYER.en: To separate something or someone from common use to dedicate it exclusively to God, making it holy and pure. 1. To consecrate or dedicate something for sacred use (Mt 23:17). | 2. To make spiritually holy or purify the believer (Eph 5:26; Heb 13:12). | 3. To treat as holy or reverence God (Mt 6:9; 1Pe 3:15).

DEFINITION: Indicates the process or state of exclusive dedication to God, whereby the believer is separated from sin and transformed morally and spiritually into the image of Christ.
SENSES: 1. The continuous process of consecration and moral purity of the believer (Rom 6:19; 1Th 4:3).
2. The divine work of setting a person apart for His service (2Th 2:13).

THAYER.pt: Indica o processo ou o estado de dedicação exclusiva a Deus, pelo qual o crente é separado do pecado e transformado moral e espiritualmente à imagem de Cristo. 1. O processo contínuo de consagração e pureza moral do crente (Rm 6.19; 1Ts 4.3). | 2. A obra divina de separar a pessoa para o seu serviço (2Ts 2.13).
THAYER.en: Indicates the process or state of exclusive dedication to God, whereby the believer is separated from sin and transformed morally and spiritually into the image of Christ. 1. The continuous process of consecration and moral purity of the believer (Rom 6:19; 1Th 4:3). | 2. The divine work of setting a person apart for His service (2Th 2:13).

DEFINITION: Designates a consecrated space set apart for divine worship, such as the tabernacle or the temple in Jerusalem.
SENSES: 1. The sanctuary or holy place in the context of Israelite worship.

THAYER.pt: Designa um espaço consagrado ou apartado para o culto divino, como o tabernáculo ou o templo em Jerusalém. 1. O santuário ou lugar santo no contexto do culto israelita.
THAYER.en: Designates a consecrated space set apart for divine worship, such as the tabernacle or the temple in Jerusalem. 1. The sanctuary or holy place in the context of Israelite worship.

DEFINITION: Fundamental property of that which belongs to the divine sphere, set apart from all profane use and endowed with pure moral excellence. It applies to God Himself, His sanctifying presence, and believers redeemed for exclusive service.
SENSES: 1. Attribute of the transcendence and purity of God and His Spirit (Lk 1:49; Jn 17:11; Acts 1:8).
2. Place, temple, or thing set apart for sacred cult and worship (Mt 24:15; Acts 7:33).
3. Regenerated believers consecrated as God's priestly people: 'the saints' (Acts 9:13; Rom 1:7).

THAYER.pt: Propriedade fundamental daquilo que pertence à esfera divina, apartado de todo uso profano e dotado de pura excelência moral. Aplica-se ao próprio Deus, à Sua presença santificadora e aos crentes redimidos para servidão exclusiva. 1. Atributo da transcendência e pureza de Deus e de Seu Espírito (Lc 1.49; Jo 17.11; At 1.8). | 2. Lugar, templo ou coisa separada para o culto e culto sagrado (Mt 24.15; At 7.33). | 3. Os crentes regenerados, consagrados como povo sacerdotal de Deus: 'os santos' (At 9.13; Rm 1.7).
THAYER.en: Fundamental property of that which belongs to the divine sphere, set apart from all profane use and endowed with pure moral excellence. It applies to God Himself, His sanctifying presence, and believers redeemed for exclusive service. 1. Attribute of the transcendence and purity of God and His Spirit (Lk 1:49; Jn 17:11; Acts 1:8). | 2. Place, temple, or thing set apart for sacred cult and worship (Mt 24:15; Acts 7:33). | 3. Regenerated believers consecrated as God's priestly people: 'the saints' (Acts 9:13; Rom 1:7).

DEFINITION: The quality or state of being holy, reflecting moral and divine character in contrast to human nature.
SENSES: 1. Holiness as an expression of God's character (Heb 12:10).

THAYER.pt: A qualidade ou estado de ser santo, refletindo o caráter moral e divino em contraste com a natureza humana. 1. A santidade como expressão do caráter de Deus (Hb 12:10).
THAYER.en: The quality or state of being holy, reflecting moral and divine character in contrast to human nature. 1. Holiness as an expression of God's character (Heb 12:10).

DEFINITION: Denotes the quality of holiness, especially as a divine attribute reflected in the moral and spiritual sphere of believers.
SENSES: 1. The quality of holiness as an expression of the divine character (Rom 1:4; 2Co 7:1; 1Th 3:13).

THAYER.pt: Denota a qualidade de santidade, especialmente como um atributo divino refletido na esfera moral e espiritual dos crentes. 1. A qualidade da santidade como expressão do caráter divino (Rm 1.4; 2Co 7.1; 1Ts 3.13).
THAYER.en: Denotes the quality of holiness, especially as a divine attribute reflected in the moral and spiritual sphere of believers. 1. The quality of holiness as an expression of the divine character (Rom 1:4; 2Co 7:1; 1Th 3:13).

DEFINITION: The bent or curved arm, in a position conducive to embracing, carrying, or cradling someone.
SENSES: 1. The arms bent to hold a child (Lk 2:28).

THAYER.pt: O braço dobrado ou curvo, em posição propícia para abraçar, carregar ou aconchegar alguém. 1. Os braços dobrados para segurar uma criança (Lc 2:28).
THAYER.en: The bent or curved arm, in a position conducive to embracing, carrying, or cradling someone. 1. The arms bent to hold a child (Lk 2:28).

DEFINITION: A barbed metal instrument used at the end of a line to catch fish.
SENSES: 1. Fishing hook (Mt 17:27).

THAYER.pt: Instrumento de metal farpado usado na extremidade de uma linha para pescar peixes. 1. Anzol de pesca (Mt 17:27).
THAYER.en: A barbed metal instrument used at the end of a line to catch fish. 1. Fishing hook (Mt 17:27).

DEFINITION: A heavy device dropped to the bottom of the waters to immobilize a vessel, used in the New Testament both in the literal nautical sense and as a metaphor for firm Christian hope.
SENSES: 1. Literal anchor used in navigation and shipwrecks (Acts 27:29, 30).
2. Metaphor for the firm and secure hope of the soul in God (Heb 6:19).

THAYER.pt: Dispositivo pesado lançado ao fundo das águas para imobilizar uma embarcação, utilizado no Novo Testamento tanto no sentido literal náutico quanto como metáfora da firme esperança cristã. 1. Âncora literal usada em navegações e naufrágios (At 27.29, 30). | 2. Metáfora para a esperança firme e segura da alma em Deus (Hb 6.19).
THAYER.en: A heavy device dropped to the bottom of the waters to immobilize a vessel, used in the New Testament both in the literal nautical sense and as a metaphor for firm Christian hope. 1. Literal anchor used in navigation and shipwrecks (Acts 27:29, 30). | 2. Metaphor for the firm and secure hope of the soul in God (Heb 6:19).

DEFINITION: Refers to a piece of new cloth that has not yet gone through the washing and shrinking process.
SENSES: 1. New cloth put as a patch on an old garment, which upon shrinking tears the fabric (Mt 9:16).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se a um pedaço de tecido novo que ainda não passou pelo processo de lavagem e encolhimento. 1. Pano novo colocado como remendo em uma roupa velha, que ao encolher rasga o tecido (Mt 9.16).
THAYER.en: Refers to a piece of new cloth that has not yet gone through the washing and shrinking process. 1. New cloth put as a patch on an old garment, which upon shrinking tears the fabric (Mt 9:16).

DEFINITION: The quality of moral purity, inner uprightness, and absence of ethical or sexual contamination.
SENSES: 1. The purity of life and conduct that a Christian leader must demonstrate and encourage (1Tm 5:2).

THAYER.pt: A qualidade de pureza moral, retidão interior e ausência de contaminação ética ou sexual. 1. A pureza de vida e conduta que o líder cristão deve demonstrar e incentivar (1Tm 5.2).
THAYER.en: The quality of moral purity, inner uprightness, and absence of ethical or sexual contamination. 1. The purity of life and conduct that a Christian leader must demonstrate and encourage (1Tm 5:2).

DEFINITION: To perform purification rituals to make something or someone acceptable in sacred worship, or to promote inner moral purity.
SENSES: 1. To practice ritual or ceremonial purification rites (Jn 11:55; Acts 21:24).
2. To morally purify the heart and conduct before God (Jas 4:8; 1Jn 3:3).

THAYER.pt: Realizar rituais de purificação para tornar algo ou alguém aceitável no culto sagrado, ou promover a pureza moral interior. 1. Praticar ritos de purificação ritual ou cerimonial (Jo 11.55; At 21.24). | 2. Purificar moralmente o coração e a conduta perante Deus (Tg 4.8; 1Jo 3.3).
THAYER.en: To perform purification rituals to make something or someone acceptable in sacred worship, or to promote inner moral purity. 1. To practice ritual or ceremonial purification rites (Jn 11:55; Acts 21:24). | 2. To morally purify the heart and conduct before God (Jas 4:8; 1Jn 3:3).

DEFINITION: The ritual process of purifying and cleansing someone to make them acceptable in sacred worship.
SENSES: 1. Jewish cultic purification ritual (Acts 21:26).

THAYER.pt: O processo ritual de purificar e limpar alguém para torná-lo aceitável em cultos sagrados. 1. Ritual de purificação cultual judaica (At 21:26).
THAYER.en: The ritual process of purifying and cleansing someone to make them acceptable in sacred worship. 1. Jewish cultic purification ritual (Acts 21:26).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: ἀγνοήσω, Aor: ἠγνόησα, Perf: ἠγνόηκα
DEFINITION: To be uninformed about something, lack discernment, or fail to understand. May imply mere lack of factual news or moral and spiritual blindness.
SENSES: 1. Not to know, be unaware, be uninformed (Rom 1:13; 2Co 2:11).
2. Not to understand, fail to discern the meaning (Mk 9:32; Lk 9:45).
3. To act in culpable ignorance or sin inadvertently (Acts 17:23; 1Tm 1:13).

THAYER.pt: Estar desinformado sobre algo, carecer de discernimento ou não compreender. Pode implicar mera falta de notícia factual ou cegueira moral e espiritual. 1. Não saber, desconhecer, estar desinformado (Rm 1.13; 2Co 2.11). | 2. Não compreender, falhar em discernir o sentido (Mc 9.32; Lc 9.45). | 3. Agir em ignorância culposa ou pecar por inadvertência (At 17.23; 1Tm 1.13).
THAYER.en: To be uninformed about something, lack discernment, or fail to understand. May imply mere lack of factual news or moral and spiritual blindness. 1. Not to know, be unaware, be uninformed (Rom 1:13; 2Co 2:11). | 2. Not to understand, fail to discern the meaning (Mk 9:32; Lk 9:45). | 3. To act in culpable ignorance or sin inadvertently (Acts 17:23; 1Tm 1:13).

DEFINITION: A sinful act or fault committed out of lack of knowledge, without conscious malicious intent.
SENSES: 1. Sin committed through ignorance or inadvertence (Heb 9:7).

THAYER.pt: Ato pecaminoso ou falta cometida por falta de conhecimento, sem intenção maliciosa consciente. 1. Pecado cometido por ignorância ou inadvertência (Hb 9:7).
THAYER.en: A sinful act or fault committed out of lack of knowledge, without conscious malicious intent. 1. Sin committed through ignorance or inadvertence (Heb 9:7).

DEFINITION: Absence of knowledge or lack of information about a fact, moral, or spiritual truth, often mitigating culpability for actions committed without full discernment.
SENSES: 1. Lack of knowledge or spiritual discernment (Acts 3:17; Eph 4:18; 1Pe 1:14).

THAYER.pt: Ausência de conhecimento ou falta de informação acerca de um fato, verdade moral ou espiritual, muitas vezes atenuando a culpabilidade por ações cometidas sem discernimento pleno. 1. Falta de conhecimento ou discernimento espiritual (At 3.17; Ef 4.18; 1Pe 1.14).
THAYER.en: Absence of knowledge or lack of information about a fact, moral, or spiritual truth, often mitigating culpability for actions committed without full discernment. 1. Lack of knowledge or spiritual discernment (Acts 3:17; Eph 4:18; 1Pe 1:14).

DEFINITION: Describes that which is free from moral contamination, being pure, chaste, and consecrated to God.
SENSES: 1. Morally pure, chaste, or spotless (2Co 7:11; 1Tm 5:22).
2. Sacred, pure, or reverent (Php 4:8; 1Pe 3:2).

THAYER.pt: Descreve aquilo que está livre de contaminação moral, sendo puro, casto e consagrado a Deus. 1. Puro moralmente, casto ou sem mancha (2Co 7.11; 1Tm 5.22). | 2. Sagrado, puro ou reverente (Fp 4.8; 1Pe 3.2).
THAYER.en: Describes that which is free from moral contamination, being pure, chaste, and consecrated to God. 1. Morally pure, chaste, or spotless (2Co 7:11; 1Tm 5:22). | 2. Sacred, pure, or reverent (Php 4:8; 1Pe 3:2).

DEFINITION: The condition of being pure, upright, and sincere, especially in motivations and character.
SENSES: 1. The sincerity of heart and purity demonstrated by the ministers of the gospel (2Co 6:6).

THAYER.pt: A condição de ser puro, íntegro e sincero, especialmente nas motivações e no caráter. 1. A sinceridade de coração e pureza demonstrada pelos ministros do evangelho (2Co 6.6).
THAYER.en: The condition of being pure, upright, and sincere, especially in motivations and character. 1. The sincerity of heart and purity demonstrated by the ministers of the gospel (2Co 6:6).

DEFINITION: In a pure, honest manner motivated by upright and irreproachable intentions.
SENSES: 1. With pure motives and sincerity (Php 1:17).

THAYER.pt: De maneira pura, honesta e motivada por intenções retas e irrepreensíveis. 1. Com pureza de motivos e sinceridade (Fp 1:17).
THAYER.en: In a pure, honest manner motivated by upright and irreproachable intentions. 1. With pure motives and sincerity (Php 1:17).

DEFINITION: The state of absence of knowledge, spiritual discernment, or understanding concerning God.
SENSES: 1. Spiritual ignorance that leads to sin and lack of knowledge of God (1Co 15:34).
2. The willful ignorance of foolish people which is silenced by uprightness (1Pe 2:15).

THAYER.pt: O estado de ausência de conhecimento, discernimento espiritual ou entendimento acerca de Deus. 1. A ignorância espiritual que leva ao pecado e à falta de conhecimento de Deus (1Co 15.34). | 2. A ignorância voluntária de insensatos que é silenciada pela retidão (1Pe 2.15).
THAYER.en: The state of absence of knowledge, spiritual discernment, or understanding concerning God. 1. Spiritual ignorance that leads to sin and lack of knowledge of God (1Co 15:34). | 2. The willful ignorance of foolish people which is silenced by uprightness (1Pe 2:15).

DEFINITION: That which is not known, understood, or identified by someone.
SENSES: 1. Unknown or unidentified, referred to in inscriptions (Acts 17:23).

THAYER.pt: Que não é conhecido, compreendido ou identificado por alguém. 1. Desconhecido ou não identificado, referido em inscrições (At 17:23).
THAYER.en: That which is not known, understood, or identified by someone. 1. Unknown or unidentified, referred to in inscriptions (Acts 17:23).

DEFINITION: The central square of a city or the public market, serving as a commercial center, site of civic meetings, and meeting point.
SENSES: 1. The public market or commercial center of a city (Mk 7:4; Acts 16:19).
2. Public square where people gathered for debates and business (Mt 20:3; Acts 17:17).

THAYER.pt: A praça central de uma cidade ou o mercado público, servindo como centro comercial, local de reuniões cívicas e ponto de encontro. 1. O mercado público ou centro comercial de uma cidade (Mc 7.4; At 16.19). | 2. Praça pública onde as pessoas se reuniam para debates e negócios (Mt 20.3; At 17.17).
THAYER.en: The central square of a city or the public market, serving as a commercial center, site of civic meetings, and meeting point. 1. The public market or commercial center of a city (Mk 7:4; Acts 16:19). | 2. Public square where people gathered for debates and business (Mt 20:3; Acts 17:17).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Impf: ἠγόραζον, Aor: ἠγόρασα, Pass: ἠγοράσθην
DEFINITION: To acquire goods, services, or persons through the payment of a stipulated price or value in the market.
SENSES: 1. To buy or acquire goods and provisions in exchange for money (Mt 14:15; Mk 6:37).
2. To acquire possession of someone by paying a ransom; used soteriologically for Christ's blood (1Co 6:20; Rev 5:9).

THAYER.pt: Adquirir bens, serviços ou pessoas mediante o pagamento de um preço ou valor estipulado no mercado. 1. Comprar ou adquirir mercadorias e provisões em troca de dinheiro (Mt 14.15; Mc 6.37). | 2. Adquirir a posse de alguém pagando um resgate; usado soteriologicamente para o sangue de Cristo (1Co 6.20; Ap 5.9).
THAYER.en: To acquire goods, services, or persons through the payment of a stipulated price or value in the market. 1. To buy or acquire goods and provisions in exchange for money (Mt 14:15; Mk 6:37). | 2. To acquire possession of someone by paying a ransom; used soteriologically for Christ's blood (1Co 6:20; Rev 5:9).

DEFINITION: That which pertains to the public square (agora), referring to vagrants who frequent the market or court days.
SENSES: 1. Idle men who wander through the public square and cause riots (Acts 17:5).
2. Days of court sessions or judicial hearings (Acts 19:38).

THAYER.pt: Aquilo que pertence à praça pública (ágora), referindo-se a vagabundos que frequentam o mercado ou a dias de tribunais. 1. Homens ociosos que vagueiam pela praça pública e causam tumultos (At 17.5). | 2. Dias de sessões de tribunais ou audiências judiciais (At 19.38).
THAYER.en: That which pertains to the public square (agora), referring to vagrants who frequent the market or court days. 1. Idle men who wander through the public square and cause riots (Acts 17:5). | 2. Days of court sessions or judicial hearings (Acts 19:38).

DEFINITION: The act of hunting or fishing, as well as the result of this activity, namely the animals captured.
SENSES: 1. The action of casting nets to fish (Lk 5.4).
2. The great quantity of fish caught in the miraculous catch (Lk 5.9).

THAYER.pt: O ato de caçar ou pescar, bem como o resultado dessa atividade, ou seja, os animais capturados. 1. A ação de lançar as redes para pescar (Lc 5.4). | 2. A grande quantidade de peixes capturados na pesca miraculosa (Lc 5.9).
THAYER.en: The act of hunting or fishing, as well as the result of this activity, namely the animals captured. 1. The action of casting nets to fish (Lk 5.4). | 2. The great quantity of fish caught in the miraculous catch (Lk 5.9).

DEFINITION: Refers to someone lacking formal education or conventional literary instruction, often seen without academic erudition in the eyes of society.
SENSES: 1. Lacking formal instruction or illiterate (Ac 4.13).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se a alguém que carece de educação formal ou instrução literária convencional, sendo visto frequentemente sem erudição acadêmica aos olhos da sociedade. 1. Destituído de instrução formal ou analfabeto (Ac 4.13).
THAYER.en: Refers to someone lacking formal education or conventional literary instruction, often seen without academic erudition in the eyes of society. 1. Lacking formal instruction or illiterate (Ac 4.13).

SHORT_GLOSS: live in the fields, stay out
DEFINITION: To live or spend the night in the open air in the fields, a term classically associated with the lifestyle of shepherds guarding their flocks at night.
SENSES: 1. To live or remain in the open air during the night (Lk 2.8).
USAGE: live in the fields, stay out

THAYER.pt: Significa viver ou passar a noite ao ar livre nos campos, termo classicamente associado ao estilo de vida de pastores que vigiam seus rebanhos à noite. 1. Viver ou permanecer ao ar livre durante a noite (Lc 2.8).
THAYER.en: To live or spend the night in the open air in the fields, a term classically associated with the lifestyle of shepherds guarding their flocks at night. 1. To live or remain in the open air during the night (Lk 2.8).

DEFINITION: Originally used for hunting animals, in the New Testament it appears in a figurative sense to denote the action of catching someone unawares or at fault through verbal trickery.
SENSES: 1. To capture or catch someone in a discursive trap (Mk 12.13).

THAYER.pt: Originalmente usado para a caça de animais, no Novo Testamento aparece em sentido figurado para denotar a ação de apanhar alguém desprevenido ou em falta por meio de artimanhas verbais. 1. Capturar ou apanhar alguém numa armadilha discursiva (Mc 12.13).
THAYER.en: Originally used for hunting animals, in the New Testament it appears in a figurative sense to denote the action of catching someone unawares or at fault through verbal trickery. 1. To capture or catch someone in a discursive trap (Mk 12.13).

DEFINITION: The wild olive tree, whose branches were used metaphorically to represent the Gentiles grafted into the people of God.
SENSES: 1. The wild olive tree whose branches were grafted onto the cultivated olive tree (Rm 11.24).

THAYER.pt: A oliveira silvestre, cujos ramos eram usados metaforicamente para representar os gentios enxertados no povo de Deus. 1. A oliveira brava cujos ramos foram enxertados na oliveira culta (Rm 11.24).
THAYER.en: The wild olive tree, whose branches were used metaphorically to represent the Gentiles grafted into the people of God. 1. The wild olive tree whose branches were grafted onto the cultivated olive tree (Rm 11.24).

DEFINITION: Describes that which belongs to a natural, wild, undisciplined, or fierce state, applied both to elements of nature and to behaviors.
SENSES: 1. Natural or wild state, like wild honey (Mt 3.4).
2. Figurative for that which is indomitable, fierce, or tempestuous (Jd 13).

THAYER.pt: Descreve aquilo que pertence ao estado natural, selvagem, indisciplinado ou feroz, aplicado tanto a elementos da natureza quanto a comportamentos. 1. Estado natural ou selvagem, como mel silvestre (Mt 3.4). | 2. Figurado para o que é indomável, feroz ou tempestuoso (Jd 13).
THAYER.en: Describes that which belongs to a natural, wild, undisciplined, or fierce state, applied both to elements of nature and to behaviors. 1. Natural or wild state, like wild honey (Mt 3.4). | 2. Figurative for that which is indomitable, fierce, or tempestuous (Jd 13).

DEFINITION: Proper name referring to the monarchs of the Herodian dynasty mentioned in the book of Acts, specifically Herod Agrippa I and Herod Agrippa II.
SENSES: 1. Herod Agrippa I, grandson of Herod the Great (Ac 12.1).
2. Herod Agrippa II, before whom Paul defended his faith (Ac 25.13).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio que se refere aos monarcas da dinastia herodiana mencionados no livro de Atos, especificamente Herodes Agripa I e Herodes Agripa II. 1. Herodes Agripa I, neto de Herodes o Grande (At 12.1). | 2. Herodes Agripa II, perante quem Paulo defendeu a sua fé (At 25.13).
THAYER.en: Proper name referring to the monarchs of the Herodian dynasty mentioned in the book of Acts, specifically Herod Agrippa I and Herod Agrippa II. 1. Herod Agrippa I, grandson of Herod the Great (Ac 12.1). | 2. Herod Agrippa II, before whom Paul defended his faith (Ac 25.13).

DEFINITION: Refers to the open field as opposed to the city, or a rural property intended for agriculture and cultivation.
SENSES: 1. Open field or rural region outside villages and cities (Mt 24.18; Mk 15.21).
2. Agricultural property or farm used for cultivation (Mk 5.14; Mt 27.7).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se ao campo aberto em oposição à cidade, ou a uma propriedade rural destinada à agricultura e ao cultivo. 1. Campo aberto ou região rural fora das vilas e cidades (Mt 24.18; Mc 15.21). | 2. Propriedade agrícola ou fazenda usada para cultivo (Mk 5.14; Mt 27.7).
THAYER.en: Refers to the open field as opposed to the city, or a rural property intended for agriculture and cultivation. 1. Open field or rural region outside villages and cities (Mt 24.18; Mk 15.21). | 2. Agricultural property or farm used for cultivation (Mk 5.14; Mt 27.7).

DEFINITION: To stay awake and vigilant to avoid potential dangers, demonstrating constant zeal and attentive care over something or someone.
SENSES: 1. To be spiritually alert and vigilant facing imminent dangers (Mk 13.33; Eph 6.18).
2. To care with diligence and vigilance for souls as a leader (Heb 13.17).

THAYER.pt: Manter-se acordado e vigilante para evitar perigos potenciais, demonstrando zelo constante e cuidado atento sobre algo ou alguém. 1. Estar espiritualmente alerta e vigilante diante de perigos iminentes (Mc 13.33; Ef 6.18). | 2. Cuidar com diligência e vigilância de almas como líder (Hb 13.17).
THAYER.en: To stay awake and vigilant to avoid potential dangers, demonstrating constant zeal and attentive care over something or someone. 1. To be spiritually alert and vigilant facing imminent dangers (Mk 13.33; Eph 6.18). | 2. To care with diligence and vigilance for souls as a leader (Heb 13.17).

DEFINITION: The state of remaining awake due to the inability to sleep, whether because of worries, afflictions, or duties.
SENSES: 1. Nights of watchfulness and sleeplessness endured by the apostles in their tribulations (2Co 6.5).

THAYER.pt: O estado de permanecer acordado devido à incapacidade de dormir, seja por preocupações, aflições ou deveres. 1. Noites de vigília e insônia suportadas pelos apóstolos em suas tribulações (2Co 6.5).
THAYER.en: The state of remaining awake due to the inability to sleep, whether because of worries, afflictions, or duties. 1. Nights of watchfulness and sleeplessness endured by the apostles in their tribulations (2Co 6.5).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: ἄξω, Aor: ἤγαγον, Aor. Pass: ἤχθην
DEFINITION: To exercise control over the movement of someone or something, taking them from one place to another, whether physically, legally, or morally.
SENSES: 1. To lead, guide, or physically bring someone or something (Mt 21.7; Ac 8.32).
2. To take prisoner or under custody for trial (Ac 9.2; 23.32).
3. To guide or motivate morally and spiritually (Rm 8.14; 2Tm 4.11).

THAYER.pt: Significa exercer controle sobre o movimento de alguém ou algo, levando de um lugar para outro, seja de forma física, jurídica ou moral. 1. Conduzir, guiar ou trazer fisicamente alguém ou algo (Mt 21.7; At 8.32). | 2. Levar preso ou sob custódia para julgamento (At 9.2; 23.32). | 3. Guiar ou motivar moral e espiritualmente (Rm 8.14; 2Tm 4.11).
THAYER.en: To exercise control over the movement of someone or something, taking them from one place to another, whether physically, legally, or morally. 1. To lead, guide, or physically bring someone or something (Mt 21.7; Ac 8.32). | 2. To take prisoner or under custody for trial (Ac 9.2; 23.32). | 3. To guide or motivate morally and spiritually (Rm 8.14; 2Tm 4.11).

DEFINITION: Describes the general direction of a person's life, encompassing their habits, moral principles, and the practical pattern of their daily conduct.
SENSES: 1. Way of life, conduct, or moral pattern followed by someone (2Tm 3.10).

THAYER.pt: Descreve a direção geral da vida de uma pessoa, abrangendo seus hábitos, princípios morais e o padrão prático de sua conduta diária. 1. Modo de vida, conduta ou padrão moral seguido por alguém (2Tm 3.10).
THAYER.en: Describes the general direction of a person's life, encompassing their habits, moral principles, and the practical pattern of their daily conduct. 1. Way of life, conduct, or moral pattern followed by someone (2Tm 3.10).

DEFINITION: Originally used for athletic competitions, the term is used metaphorically in the New Testament to describe intense spiritual struggles, tribulations, or deep anxieties for the cause of the gospel.
SENSES: 1. Athletic competition or race used as a spiritual metaphor (Heb 12.1).
2. Intense struggle or conflict against strong opposition (Php 1.30; Col 2.1).

THAYER.pt: Originalmente usado para competições atléticas, o termo é empregado metaforicamente no Novo Testamento para descrever lutas espirituais intensas, tribulações ou profundas ansiedades pela causa do evangelho. 1. Competição ou corrida atlética usada como metáfora espiritual (Hb 12.1). | 2. Luta intensa ou conflito contra forte oposição (Fp 1.30; Cl 2.1).
THAYER.en: Originally used for athletic competitions, the term is used metaphorically in the New Testament to describe intense spiritual struggles, tribulations, or deep anxieties for the cause of the gospel. 1. Athletic competition or race used as a spiritual metaphor (Heb 12.1). | 2. Intense struggle or conflict against strong opposition (Php 1.30; Col 2.1).

DEFINITION: Designates a deep state of mental tension, anxiety, and intense distress, commonly faced in the face of severe crises or imminent suffering.
SENSES: 1. Deep mental anguish and extreme emotional distress (Lk 22.44).

THAYER.pt: Designa um estado profundo de tensão mental, ansiedade e aflição intensa, comumente enfrentado diante de crises severas ou do sofrimento iminente. 1. Profunda angústia mental e aflição emocional extrema (Lc 22.44).
THAYER.en: Designates a deep state of mental tension, anxiety, and intense distress, commonly faced in the face of severe crises or imminent suffering. 1. Deep mental anguish and extreme emotional distress (Lk 22.44).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Middle deponent, Fut: ἀγωνίσομαι, Aor: ἠγωνισάμην
DEFINITION: To engage in intense athletic competition or arduous struggle, requiring great effort and perseverance.
SENSES: 1. To compete in a game or athletic contest (1Co 9.25).
2. To strive intensely, struggle, or battle spiritually (Lk 13.24; Col 1.29).

THAYER.pt: Envolver-se em intensa competição atlética ou luta árdua, exigindo grande esforço e perseverança. 1. Competir em um jogo ou contenda atlética (1Co 9.25). | 2. Esforçar-se intensamente, lutar ou batalhar espiritualmente (Lc 13.24; Cl 1.29).
THAYER.en: To engage in intense athletic competition or arduous struggle, requiring great effort and perseverance. 1. To compete in a game or athletic contest (1Co 9.25). | 2. To strive intensely, struggle, or battle spiritually (Lk 13.24; Col 1.29).

DEFINITION: The first human being created by God, whose disobedience introduced sin into the world and whose figure contrasts with Christ in the Pauline epistles.
SENSES: 1. Adam, the first man and ancestor of the human race (1Tm 2.13; Rm 5.14).

THAYER.pt: O primeiro ser humano criado por Deus, cuja desobediência introduziu o pecado no mundo e cuja figura contrasta com Cristo nas cartas paulinas. 1. Adão, o primeiro homem e ancestral da raça humana (1Tm 2.13; Rm 5.14).
THAYER.en: The first human being created by God, whose disobedience introduced sin into the world and whose figure contrasts with Christ in the Pauline epistles. 1. Adam, the first man and ancestor of the human race (1Tm 2.13; Rm 5.14).

DEFINITION: Pertaining to something offered or performed entirely free of charge, without incurring any type of expense or financial burden for the beneficiary.
SENSES: 1. Exempt from costs or provided without financial charges (1Co 9.18).

THAYER.pt: Pertencente a algo que é oferecido ou realizado de forma inteiramente gratuita, sem acarretar qualquer tipo de gasto ou ônus financeiro para o beneficiário. 1. Isento de custos ou fornecido sem encargos financeiros (1Co 9.18).
THAYER.en: Pertaining to something offered or performed entirely free of charge, without incurring any type of expense or financial burden for the beneficiary. 1. Exempt from costs or provided without financial charges (1Co 9.18).

DEFINITION: Proper name of an ancestor in the earthly genealogy of Jesus Christ recorded in the Gospel of Luke.
SENSES: 1. Character in the ancestral line of Jesus according to Luke's genealogy (Lk 3.28).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio de um antepassado na genealogia terrena de Jesus Cristo registrada no Evangelho de Lucas. 1. Personagem na linha ancestral de Jesus segundo a genealogia de Lucas (Lc 3.28).
THAYER.en: Proper name of an ancestor in the earthly genealogy of Jesus Christ recorded in the Gospel of Luke. 1. Character in the ancestral line of Jesus according to Luke's genealogy (Lk 3.28).

DEFINITION: A woman who shares the same parents or, by spiritual extension, a fellow member in the community of the Christian faith.
SENSES: 1. Blood sister, born of the same parents (Mt 19.29).
2. Woman who shares the same Christian faith, spiritual sister (Rm 16.1).

THAYER.pt: Mulher que partilha dos mesmos pais ou, por extensão espiritual, uma co-membro na comunidade da fé cristã. 1. Irmã de sangue, nascida dos mesmos pais (Mt 19.29). | 2. Mulher que partilha da mesma fé cristã, irmã espiritual (Rm 16.1).
THAYER.en: A woman who shares the same parents or, by spiritual extension, a fellow member in the community of the Christian faith. 1. Blood sister, born of the same parents (Mt 19.29). | 2. Woman who shares the same Christian faith, spiritual sister (Rm 16.1).

DEFINITION: Primarily refers to a blood brother or member of the same biological family group. In the New Testament, it expands profoundly to designate fellow countrymen and, above all, fellow Christians as members of God's family.
SENSES: 1. Biological brother of the same father or mother (Mt 4.18; Jn 1.41).
2. Spiritual brother or fellow Christian in the faith in Jesus (Rm 8.29; 1Co 5.11).
3. Jewish compatriot or member of the same ethnicity and religion (Ac 2.29; Rm 9.3).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se primariamente a um irmão de sangue ou membro do mesmo grupo familiar biológico. No Novo Testamento, expande-se profundamente para designar companheiros compatriotas e, sobretudo, concristãos como membros da família de Deus. 1. Irmão biológico de mesmo pai ou mesma mãe (Mt 4.18; Jo 1.41). | 2. Irmão espiritual ou concristão na fé em Jesus (Rm 8.29; 1Co 5.11). | 3. Compatriota judeu ou membro da mesma etnia e religião (At 2.29; Rm 9.3).
THAYER.en: Primarily refers to a blood brother or member of the same biological family group. In the New Testament, it expands profoundly to designate fellow countrymen and, above all, fellow Christians as members of God's family. 1. Biological brother of the same father or mother (Mt 4.18; Jn 1.41). | 2. Spiritual brother or fellow Christian in the faith in Jesus (Rm 8.29; 1Co 5.11). | 3. Jewish compatriot or member of the same ethnicity and religion (Ac 2.29; Rm 9.3).

DEFINITION: The body of believers united by a strong fraternal bond, or the feeling of mutual affection among brothers in the faith.
SENSES: 1. The global community of brothers in Christ, the Christian brotherhood (1Pe 2.17).

THAYER.pt: O corpo de crentes unidos por forte laço fraternal, ou o sentimento de afeição mútua entre irmãos na fé. 1. A comunidade global de irmãos em Cristo, a fraternidade cristã (1Pe 2.17).
THAYER.en: The body of believers united by a strong fraternal bond, or the feeling of mutual affection among brothers in the faith. 1. The global community of brothers in Christ, the Christian brotherhood (1Pe 2.17).

DEFINITION: That which is not clearly perceptible, remaining hidden or difficult to discern at first glance.
SENSES: 1. Unseen tombs that people walk over without realizing (Lk 11.44).

THAYER.pt: Aquilo que não é claramente perceptível, que permanece oculto ou difícil de discernir à primeira vista. 1. Sepulcros invisíveis que as pessoas pisam sem perceber (Lc 11.44).
THAYER.en: That which is not clearly perceptible, remaining hidden or difficult to discern at first glance. 1. Unseen tombs that people walk over without realizing (Lk 11.44).

DEFINITION: Condition of that which lacks firmness, predictability, or clarity, denoting the ephemeral or doubtful nature of certain earthly realities.
SENSES: 1. The uncertain and transient character of possessions or situations (1Tm 6.17).

THAYER.pt: Condição daquilo que carece de firmeza, previsibilidade ou clareza, denotando a natureza efêmera ou duvidosa de certas realidades terrenas. 1. O caráter incerto e passageiro de bens ou situações (1Tm 6.17).
THAYER.en: Condition of that which lacks firmness, predictability, or clarity, denoting the ephemeral or doubtful nature of certain earthly realities. 1. The uncertain and transient character of possessions or situations (1Tm 6.17).

DEFINITION: Describes an action performed without clarity of direction, defined purpose, or precise target.
SENSES: 1. In an uncertain manner or without a clearly determined goal (1Co 9.26).

THAYER.pt: Descreve uma ação realizada sem clareza de direção, propósito definido ou alvo preciso. 1. De maneira incerta ou sem um objetivo claramente determinado (1Co 9.26).
THAYER.en: Describes an action performed without clarity of direction, defined purpose, or precise target. 1. In an uncertain manner or without a clearly determined goal (1Co 9.26).

DEFINITION: Expresses a state of deep anguish, affliction, and intense emotional disturbance facing oppressive circumstances.
SENSES: 1. To be deeply distressed or afflicted (Mt 26.37; Mk 14.33; Php 2.26).

THAYER.pt: Expressa um estado de profunda angústia, aflição e perturbação emocional intensa diante de circunstâncias opressivas. 1. Estar profundamente angustiado ou aflito (Mt 26.37; Mc 14.33; Fp 2.26).
THAYER.en: Expresses a state of deep anguish, affliction, and intense emotional disturbance facing oppressive circumstances. 1. To be deeply distressed or afflicted (Mt 26.37; Mk 14.33; Php 2.26).

SHORT_GLOSS: Hades, hell, world of the dead
DEFINITION: Designates in mythology and biblical thought the realm of the dead, the subterranean dwelling where souls await final judgment.
SENSES: 1. The domain or dwelling of the dead, equivalent to the Hebrew term Sheol (Mt 16.18; Rev 20.13).
USAGE: Hades, hell, world of the dead

THAYER.pt: Designa na mitologia e no pensamento bíblico o reino dos mortos, a habitação subterrânea onde as almas aguardam o julgamento final. 1. O domínio ou morada dos mortos, equivalente ao termo hebraico Seol (Mt 16.18; Ap 20.13).
THAYER.en: Designates in mythology and biblical thought the realm of the dead, the subterranean dwelling where souls await final judgment. 1. The domain or dwelling of the dead, equivalent to the Hebrew term Sheol (Mt 16.18; Rev 20.13).

DEFINITION: Moral quality denoting freedom from favoritism, prejudice, or duplicity, reflecting integrity and uprightness of judgment.
SENSES: 1. Free from partiality or without hypocrisy (Jas 3.17).

THAYER.pt: Qualidade moral que denota isenção de favoritismo, preconceito ou duplicidade, refletindo integridade e retidão de julgamento. 1. Livre de parcialidade ou sem hipocrisia (Tg 3.17).
THAYER.en: Moral quality denoting freedom from favoritism, prejudice, or duplicity, reflecting integrity and uprightness of judgment. 1. Free from partiality or without hypocrisy (Jas 3.17).

DEFINITION: That which occurs in a constant manner, without interruption or pauses.
SENSES: 1. Continuous pain and unceasing sorrow in the heart because of unbelief (Rm 9.2).
2. Constant remembrance and uninterrupted prayers for the brothers (2Tm 1.3).

THAYER.pt: Que ocorre de maneira constante, sem interrupção ou pausas. 1. Dor contínua e tristeza incessante no coração por causa da incredulidade (Rm 9.2). | 2. Lembrança constante e orações ininterruptas pelos irmãos (2Tm 1.3).
THAYER.en: That which occurs in a constant manner, without interruption or pauses. 1. Continuous pain and unceasing sorrow in the heart because of unbelief (Rm 9.2). | 2. Constant remembrance and uninterrupted prayers for the brothers (2Tm 1.3).

DEFINITION: Describes a continuous action that occurs without interruption or pauses, characterizing a persistent practice, such as constant prayer.
SENSES: 1. In an uninterrupted and continuous manner, without ceasing (Rm 1.9; 1Th 1.3; 5.17).

THAYER.pt: Descreve uma ação contínua que ocorre sem interrupção ou pausas, caracterizando uma prática persistente, como a oração constante. 1. De maneira ininterrupta e contínua, sem cessar (Rm 1.9; 1Ts 1.3; 5.17).
THAYER.en: Describes a continuous action that occurs without interruption or pauses, characterizing a persistent practice, such as constant prayer. 1. In an uninterrupted and continuous manner, without ceasing (Rm 1.9; 1Th 1.3; 5.17).

DEFINITION: State of being incorrupt, maintaining moral purity, uprightness, and integrity of character without contamination.
SENSES: 1. Moral and spiritual integrity or incorruptibility.

THAYER.pt: Estado de ser incorrupto, mantendo a pureza moral, a retidão e a integridade de caráter sem contaminação. 1. Integridade ou incorruptibilidade moral e espiritual.
THAYER.en: State of being incorrupt, maintaining moral purity, uprightness, and integrity of character without contamination. 1. Moral and spiritual integrity or incorruptibility.

DEFINITION: To practice acts contrary to justice, causing damage, injury, or offense to another.
SENSES: 1. To act unjustly or commit transgression (Rev 22:11).
2. To cause physical or moral harm, or mistreat someone (Acts 7:24; Rev 6:6).

THAYER.pt: Praticar atos contrários à justiça, causando dano, prejuízo ou ofensa a outrem. 1. Agir injustamente ou cometer transgressão (Ap 22:11). | 2. Causar dano físico, moral ou maltratar alguém (At 7:24; Ap 6:6).
THAYER.en: To practice acts contrary to justice, causing damage, injury, or offense to another. 1. To act unjustly or commit transgression (Rev 22:11). | 2. To cause physical or moral harm, or mistreat someone (Acts 7:24; Rev 6:6).

DEFINITION: Refers to an act that violates the norms of justice, constituting an offense, crime, or harmful action against another.
SENSES: 1. Violation of the norms of justice, crime, or wrongdoing (Acts 18:14; 24:20; Rev 18:5).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se a um ato que viola as normas da justiça, constituindo uma ofensa, crime ou ação prejudicial contra outrem. 1. Violação das normas de justiça, crime ou delito (At 18.14; 24.20; Ap 18.5).
THAYER.en: Refers to an act that violates the norms of justice, constituting an offense, crime, or harmful action against another. 1. Violation of the norms of justice, crime, or wrongdoing (Acts 18:14; 24:20; Rev 18:5).

DEFINITION: Quality or act that violates moral standards of justice and uprightness, characterizing wickedness or sin.
SENSES: 1. An unjust and transgressive act or behavior (2 Cor 12:13; Heb 8:12).
2. The state or quality of injustice and impiety (Rom 1:18; 1 John 5:17).

THAYER.pt: Qualidade ou ato que viola os padrões morais da justiça e da retidão, caracterizando a maldade ou o pecado. 1. Ato ou comportamento injusto e transgressor (2Co 12.13; Hb 8.12). | 2. O estado ou qualidade de injustiça e impiedade (Rm 1.18; 1Jo 5.17).
THAYER.en: Quality or act that violates moral standards of justice and uprightness, characterizing wickedness or sin. 1. An unjust and transgressive act or behavior (2 Cor 12:13; Heb 8:12). | 2. The state or quality of injustice and impiety (Rom 1:18; 1 John 5:17).

DEFINITION: Acting contrary to what is right, just, or morally correct before God and humanity.
SENSES: 1. One who acts unjustly or contrary to righteousness (Matt 5:45; Luke 16:10).
2. Associated with injustice or unrighteousness (Luke 16:9).

THAYER.pt: Que age contrariamente ao que é reto, justo ou moralmente correto diante de Deus e dos homens. 1. Aquele que age de maneira injusta ou contrária à retidão (Mt 5.45; Lc 16.10). | 2. Associado à injustiça ou à iniquidade (Lc 16.9).
THAYER.en: Acting contrary to what is right, just, or morally correct before God and humanity. 1. One who acts unjustly or contrary to righteousness (Matt 5:45; Luke 16:10). | 2. Associated with injustice or unrighteousness (Luke 16:9).

DEFINITION: Indicates the occurrence of an action contrary to justice, inflicted upon someone without real guilt or desert.
SENSES: 1. In an unjust manner or without deserving it (1 Pet 2:19).

THAYER.pt: Indica a ocorrência de uma ação contrária à justiça, infligida a alguém sem que haja culpa ou merecimento real. 1. De modo injusto ou sem merecimento (1Pe 2.19).
THAYER.en: Indicates the occurrence of an action contrary to justice, inflicted upon someone without real guilt or desert. 1. In an unjust manner or without deserving it (1 Pet 2:19).

DEFINITION: The quality of that which fails a test, being considered worthless, disqualified, or rejected.
SENSES: 1. Disqualified, worthless, or reprobate after a test (1 Cor 9:27; 2 Tim 3:8).
2. Incapable of producing what is good, unfit (Heb 6:8).

THAYER.pt: Qualidade daquilo que falha em um teste, sendo considerado sem valor, reprovado ou desqualificado. 1. Desqualificado, sem valor ou reprovado após um teste (1Co 9.27; 2Tm 3.8). | 2. Incapaz de produzir o que é bom, imprestável (Hb 6.8).
THAYER.en: The quality of that which fails a test, being considered worthless, disqualified, or rejected. 1. Disqualified, worthless, or reprobate after a test (1 Cor 9:27; 2 Tim 3:8). | 2. Incapable of producing what is good, unfit (Heb 6:8).

DEFINITION: Refers to something that has not suffered fraudulent mixing or corruption, being genuine, authentic, and free of malice.
SENSES: 1. Pure and free of deceit or guile, applied to the word (1 Pet 2:2).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se a algo que não sofreu mistura fraudulenta ou corrupção, sendo genuíno, autêntico e livre de malícia. 1. Puro e livre de falsidade ou dolo, aplicado à palavra (1Pe 2.2).
THAYER.en: Refers to something that has not suffered fraudulent mixing or corruption, being genuine, authentic, and free of malice. 1. Pure and free of deceit or guile, applied to the word (1 Pet 2:2).

DEFINITION: Relating or belonging to the port city of Adramyttium, located in the region of Mysia in Asia Minor.
SENSES: 1. Originating or coming from the city of Adramyttium (Acts 27:2).

THAYER.pt: Relativo ou pertencente à cidade portuária de Adramítio, localizada na região de Mísia, na Ásia Menor. 1. Originário ou proveniente da cidade de Adramítio (Ac 27.2).
THAYER.en: Relating or belonging to the port city of Adramyttium, located in the region of Mysia in Asia Minor. 1. Originating or coming from the city of Adramyttium (Acts 27:2).

DEFINITION: Ancient designation that covered not only the gulf between Italy and the Balkans, but also the open waters of the central Mediterranean Sea where Paul faced the storm.
SENSES: 1. The Adriatic Sea in the Greco-Roman period (Acts 27:27).

THAYER.pt: Designação antiga que abrangia não apenas o golfo entre a Itália e os Bálcãs, mas também as águas abertas do mar Mediterrâneo central onde Paulo enfrentou a tempestade. 1. O Mar Adriático na época greco-romana (Ac 27.27).
THAYER.en: Ancient designation that covered not only the gulf between Italy and the Balkans, but also the open waters of the central Mediterranean Sea where Paul faced the storm. 1. The Adriatic Sea in the Greco-Roman period (Acts 27:27).

DEFINITION: Expresses a rich provision or a generous and voluminous offering intended to meet material needs amply.
SENSES: 1. Abundance of resources expressed in a generous contribution (2 Cor 8:20).

THAYER.pt: Expressa uma provisão farta ou uma oferta generosa e volumosa destinada a suprir necessidades materiais com largueza. 1. Abundância de recursos expressa em generosa contribuição (2Co 8.20).
THAYER.en: Expresses a rich provision or a generous and voluminous offering intended to meet material needs amply. 1. Abundance of resources expressed in a generous contribution (2 Cor 8:20).

DEFINITION: To be devoid of capacity or power to accomplish something; to be impossible.
SENSES: 1. Human impossibility before the faith that moves mountains (Matt 17:20).
2. The truth that no word from God is impossible or fails (Luke 1:37).

THAYER.pt: Estar desprovido de capacidade ou poder para realizar algo; ser impossível. 1. A impossibilidade humana diante da fé que move montanhas (Mt 17.20). | 2. A verdade de que nenhuma palavra de Deus é impossível ou falha (Lc 1.37).
THAYER.en: To be devoid of capacity or power to accomplish something; to be impossible. 1. Human impossibility before the faith that moves mountains (Matt 17:20). | 2. The truth that no word from God is impossible or fails (Luke 1:37).

DEFINITION: Qualifies that which has no power to perform an action or events that are entirely impossible to happen by human strength.
SENSES: 1. Incapable of performing an action or physically debilitated (Acts 14:8; Rom 15:1).
2. That which is impossible to happen or be fulfilled by human means (Matt 19:26; Heb 6:4).

THAYER.pt: Qualifica aquilo que não tem poder para realizar algo ou eventos que são inteiramente impossíveis de acontecer por força humana. 1. Incapaz de realizar uma ação ou fisicamente debilitado (At 14.8; Rm 15.1). | 2. O que é impossível de suceder ou de ser cumprido por meios humanos (Mt 19.26; Hb 6.4).
THAYER.en: Qualifies that which has no power to perform an action or events that are entirely impossible to happen by human strength. 1. Incapable of performing an action or physically debilitated (Acts 14:8; Rom 15:1). | 2. That which is impossible to happen or be fulfilled by human means (Matt 19:26; Heb 6:4).

DEFINITION: The act of uttering words in a melodic pattern, especially in the context of praise and worship to God.
SENSES: 1. To sing hymns or spiritual songs (Eph 5:19; Rev 5:9).

THAYER.pt: Ato de proferir palavras em padrão melódico, especialmente no contexto de louvor e adoração a Deus. 1. Cantar hinos ou cânticos espirituais (Ef 5.19; Ap 5.9).
THAYER.en: The act of uttering words in a melodic pattern, especially in the context of praise and worship to God. 1. To sing hymns or spiritual songs (Eph 5:19; Rev 5:9).

DEFINITION: Indicates continuous duration of time, either uninterruptedly or through constantly repeating actions.
SENSES: 1. Perpetually or continually, always (2 Cor 6:10; 1 Pet 3:15).
2. Constantly or recurrently, from time to time (Acts 7:51; 2 Cor 4:11).

THAYER.pt: Indica duração contínua de tempo, seja de forma ininterrupta ou por meio de ações que se repetem constantemente. 1. De maneira perpétua ou contínua, sempre (2Co 6.10; 1Pe 3.15). | 2. De forma constante ou recorrente, de tempos em tempos (At 7.51; 2Co 4.11).
THAYER.en: Indicates continuous duration of time, either uninterruptedly or through constantly repeating actions. 1. Perpetually or continually, always (2 Cor 6:10; 1 Pet 3:15). | 2. Constantly or recurrently, from time to time (Acts 7:51; 2 Cor 4:11).

DEFINITION: Large bird of prey known for its swift flight and sharp sense of vision.
SENSES: 1. Eagle, symbol of swiftness and judgment (Matt 24:28; Rev 12:14).

THAYER.pt: Ave de rapina de grande porte conhecida por seu voo veloz e agudo senso de visão. 1. Águia, símbolo de velocidade e juízo (Mt 24.28; Ap 12.14).
THAYER.en: Large bird of prey known for its swift flight and sharp sense of vision. 1. Eagle, symbol of swiftness and judgment (Matt 24:28; Rev 12:14).

DEFINITION: Containing no yeast (leaven). In the NT, refers both to unleavened bread and the associated Jewish feast.
SENSES: 1. Bread prepared without yeast, unleavened (1 Cor 5:7).
2. The Feast of Unleavened Bread (Luke 22:1; Acts 12:3).

THAYER.pt: Que não contém fermento (levedura). No NT, refere-se tanto ao pão não fermentado quanto à festa judaica associada. 1. Pão preparado sem fermento, ázimo (1Co 5.7). | 2. A Festa dos Pães Ázimos (Lc 22.1; Ac 12.3).
