THAYER.en: Containing no yeast (leaven). In the NT, refers both to unleavened bread and the associated Jewish feast. 1. Bread prepared without yeast, unleavened (1 Cor 5:7). | 2. The Feast of Unleavened Bread (Luke 22:1; Acts 12:3).

DEFINITION: An ancestor of Jesus cited in the genealogy recorded in the Gospel of Matthew.
SENSES: 1. Descendant of Zerubbabel and ancestor of Joseph, the legal father of Jesus (Matt 1:13).

THAYER.pt: Antecessor de Jesus citado na genealogia registrada no Evangelho de Mateus. 1. Descendente de Zorobabel e antepassado de José, pai legal de Jesus (Mt 1.13).
THAYER.en: An ancestor of Jesus cited in the genealogy recorded in the Gospel of Matthew. 1. Descendant of Zerubbabel and ancestor of Joseph, the legal father of Jesus (Matt 1:13).

DEFINITION: Ancient Philistine city situated on the southern coastal plain of Palestine, known in the Old Testament as Ashdod.
SENSES: 1. The coastal city of Azotus, where Philip appeared after preaching to the eunuch (Acts 8:40).

THAYER.pt: Antiga cidade filisteia situada na planície costeira do sul da Palestina, conhecida no Antigo Testamento como Asdode. 1. A cidade costeira de Azoto, onde Filipe apareceu após pregar ao eunuco (Ac 8.40).
THAYER.en: Ancient Philistine city situated on the southern coastal plain of Palestine, known in the Old Testament as Ashdod. 1. The coastal city of Azotus, where Philip appeared after preaching to the eunuch (Acts 8:40).

DEFINITION: Refers to the atmospheric air surrounding the earth's surface, also associated with the upper air space.
SENSES: 1. The atmosphere or breathable air close to the earth (Acts 22:3; 1 Thess 4:17).
2. The airspace as the domain of spiritual powers (Eph 2:2).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se ao ar atmosférico que envolve a superfície da terra, sendo também associado ao espaço aéreo superior. 1. A atmosfera ou o ar respirável próximo à terra (At 22.3; 1Ts 4.17). | 2. O espaço aéreo como domínio de potestades espirituais (Ef 2.2).
THAYER.en: Refers to the atmospheric air surrounding the earth's surface, also associated with the upper air space. 1. The atmosphere or breathable air close to the earth (Acts 22:3; 1 Thess 4:17). | 2. The airspace as the domain of spiritual powers (Eph 2:2).

DEFINITION: Describes the condition of not being subject to death, the quality of incorruptible life that transcends physical mortality.
SENSES: 1. The condition of immortality or incorruptibility (1 Cor 15:53; 1 Tim 6:16).

THAYER.pt: Descreve a condição de não estar sujeito à morte, a qualidade da vida incorruptível que transcende a mortalidade física. 1. A condição de imortalidade ou incorruptibilidade (1Co 15.53; 1Tm 6.16).
THAYER.en: Describes the condition of not being subject to death, the quality of incorruptible life that transcends physical mortality. 1. The condition of immortality or incorruptibility (1 Cor 15:53; 1 Tim 6:16).

DEFINITION: That which violates divine or social laws, being considered abominable, forbidden, or indecent.
SENSES: 1. The practice prohibited by ritual law for a Jew to associate with foreigners (Acts 10:28).
2. Depraved, licentious behaviors contrary to decency (1 Pet 4:3).

THAYER.pt: Aquilo que viola leis divinas ou sociais, sendo considerado abominável, proibido ou indecente. 1. A prática proibida por lei ritual de um judeu se associar a estrangeiros (At 10.28). | 2. Comportamentos depravados, lascivos e contrários à decência (1Pe 4.3).
THAYER.en: That which violates divine or social laws, being considered abominable, forbidden, or indecent. 1. The practice prohibited by ritual law for a Jew to associate with foreigners (Acts 10:28). | 2. Depraved, licentious behaviors contrary to decency (1 Pet 4:3).

DEFINITION: Describes the condition of being devoid of fellowship, knowledge, or saving relationship with the true God.
SENSES: 1. Living without a relationship or fellowship with God (Eph 2:12).

THAYER.pt: Descreve a condição de estar desprovido de comunhão, conhecimento ou relacionamento salvífico com o verdadeiro Deus. 1. Viver sem relacionamento ou comunhão com Deus (Ef 2.12).
THAYER.en: Describes the condition of being devoid of fellowship, knowledge, or saving relationship with the true God. 1. Living without a relationship or fellowship with God (Eph 2:12).

DEFINITION: A person who rejects moral and legal norms, living in an unrestrained manner contrary to righteousness.
SENSES: 1. Ungodly men who live in debauchery and cause deep grief to the righteous (2 Pet 2:7).

THAYER.pt: Pessoa que rejeita as normas morais e legais, vivendo de forma desenfreada e contrária à retidão. 1. Homens ímpios que vivem na devassidão e causam profundo desgosto aos justos (2Pe 2.7).
THAYER.en: A person who rejects moral and legal norms, living in an unrestrained manner contrary to righteousness. 1. Ungodly men who live in debauchery and cause deep grief to the righteous (2 Pet 2:7).

DEFINITION: To declare something invalid, reject an authority, or invalidate a covenant or instruction.
SENSES: 1. To reject or declare something invalid, to annul (Gal 3:15; Mark 7:9).
2. To reject a person or legitimate authority by disobeying (Luke 10:16; 1 Thess 4:8).

THAYER.pt: Significa declarar algo inválido, rejeitar uma autoridade ou invalidar uma aliança ou instrução. 1. Rejeitar ou declarar algo como inválido, anular (Gl 3.15; Mc 7.9). | 2. Rejeitar uma pessoa ou autoridade legítima, desobedecendo (Lc 10.16; 1Ts 4.8).
THAYER.en: To declare something invalid, reject an authority, or invalidate a covenant or instruction. 1. To reject or declare something invalid, to annul (Gal 3:15; Mark 7:9). | 2. To reject a person or legitimate authority by disobeying (Luke 10:16; 1 Thess 4:8).

DEFINITION: The action of revoking, invalidating, or setting aside a previous agreement, law, or system.
SENSES: 1. The annulment of the former commandment because of its weakness and uselessness (Heb 7:18).
2. The abolition and final removal of sin through Christ's sacrifice (Heb 9:26).

THAYER.pt: A ação de revogar, invalidar ou anular um acordo, lei ou sistema anterior. 1. A anulação do mandamento anterior devido à sua fraqueza e inutilidade (Hb 7.18). | 2. A abolição e remoção definitiva do pecado mediante o sacrifício de Cristo (Hb 9.26).
THAYER.en: The action of revoking, invalidating, or setting aside a previous agreement, law, or system. 1. The annulment of the former commandment because of its weakness and uselessness (Heb 7:18). | 2. The abolition and final removal of sin through Christ's sacrifice (Heb 9:26).

DEFINITION: Famous city and capital of Attica in ancient Greece, known for its rich philosophical, cultural, and political heritage, visited by the apostle Paul on his missionary journeys.
SENSES: 1. The city of Athens, where Paul preached on the Areopagus (Acts 17:15, 16; 1 Thess 3:1).

THAYER.pt: Famosa cidade e capital da Ática, na Grécia antiga, conhecida por sua rica herencia filosófica, cultural e política, visitada pelo apóstolo Paulo em suas viagens missionárias. 1. A cidade de Atenas, onde Paulo pregou no Areópago (At 17.15, 16; 1Ts 3.1).
THAYER.en: Famous city and capital of Attica in ancient Greece, known for its rich philosophical, cultural, and political heritage, visited by the apostle Paul on his missionary journeys. 1. The city of Athens, where Paul preached on the Areopagus (Acts 17:15, 16; 1 Thess 3:1).

DEFINITION: Relating to the city of Athens, or a native inhabitant of this Greek city.
SENSES: 1. The inhabitants and resident foreigners in Athens who spent their time discussing novelties (Acts 17:21).

THAYER.pt: Relativo à cidade de Atenas, ou habitante nativo dessa cidade grega. 1. Os habitantes e estrangeiros residentes em Atenas que passavam o tempo discutindo novidades (At 17.21).
THAYER.en: Relating to the city of Athens, or a native inhabitant of this Greek city. 1. The inhabitants and resident foreigners in Athens who spent their time discussing novelties (Acts 17:21).

DEFINITION: To participate in a public athletic competition in the games, striving for victory according to the rules.
SENSES: 1. The athlete who competes in public games and must obey the rules to be crowned (2 Tim 2:5).

THAYER.pt: Participar de uma competição atlética pública nos jogos, lutando pela vitória conforme as regras. 1. O atleta que compete em jogos públicos e precisa obedecer às regras para ser coroado (2Tm 2.5).
THAYER.en: To participate in a public athletic competition in the games, striving for victory according to the rules. 1. The athlete who competes in public games and must obey the rules to be crowned (2 Tim 2:5).

DEFINITION: Metaphorically used to describe the arduous effort, endurance, and spiritual conflict faced by believers amidst trials and persecutions.
SENSES: 1. Severe conflict or intense struggle against afflictions and opposition (Heb 10:32).

THAYER.pt: Metaforicamente empregada para descrever o árduo esforço, a resistência e o conflito espiritual enfrentados pelos crentes em meio a provações e perseguições. 1. Conflito severo ou luta intensa contra aflições e oposições (Hb 10.32).
THAYER.en: Metaphorically used to describe the arduous effort, endurance, and spiritual conflict faced by believers amidst trials and persecutions. 1. Severe conflict or intense struggle against afflictions and opposition (Heb 10:32).

DEFINITION: To lose courage, motivation, or hope in the face of prolonged difficulties or crushing pressures.
SENSES: 1. To become discouraged or lose heart in the face of adversities (Col 3:21).

THAYER.pt: Significa perder a coragem, a motivação ou a esperança diante de dificuldades prolongadas ou pressões esmagadoras. 1. Ficar desanimado ou perder o ânimo perante adversidades (Cl 3.21).
THAYER.en: To lose courage, motivation, or hope in the face of prolonged difficulties or crushing pressures. 1. To become discouraged or lose heart in the face of adversities (Col 3:21).

DEFINITION: Being free from guilt, exempt from legal or moral responsibility for a crime.
SENSES: 1. Judas's confession that he had betrayed innocent blood (Mt 27:4).

THAYER.pt: Que está livre de culpa, isento de responsabilidade penal ou moral por um delito. 1. A confissão de Judas de que havia traído sangue inocente (Mt 27.4).
THAYER.en: Being free from guilt, exempt from legal or moral responsibility for a crime. 1. Judas's confession that he had betrayed innocent blood (Mt 27:4).

DEFINITION: An adjective qualifying that which comes from goats or is made from them.
SENSES: 1. Relating to goats, generally used in reference to skins (Heb 11:37).

THAYER.pt: Adjetivo que qualifica aquilo que provém de cabras ou que é feito a partir delas. 1. Relativo a cabras, geralmente usado em referência a peles (Hb 11.37).
THAYER.en: An adjective qualifying that which comes from goats or is made from them. 1. Relating to goats, generally used in reference to skins (Heb 11:37).

DEFINITION: Indicates the strip of land bordering a body of water, such as the sea or a lake, which slopes gradually into the water.
SENSES: 1. The beach or sandy shore by the sea or lake (Mt 13:2; Jn 21:4).

THAYER.pt: Indica a faixa de terra que margeia um corpo de água, como o mar ou um lago, e que declina gradualmente para dentro da água. 1. A praia ou margem arenosa junto ao mar ou lago (Mt 13.2; Jo 21.4).
THAYER.en: Indicates the strip of land bordering a body of water, such as the sea or a lake, which slopes gradually into the water. 1. The beach or sandy shore by the sea or lake (Mt 13:2; Jn 21:4).

DEFINITION: An adjective or noun referring to the land of Egypt or a person native to that country.
SENSES: 1. A native or inhabitant of Egypt (Acts 7:24).

THAYER.pt: Adjetivo ou substantivo que se refere à terra do Egito ou a uma pessoa nativa daquele país. 1. Natural ou habitante do Egito (At 7.24).
THAYER.en: An adjective or noun referring to the land of Egypt or a person native to that country. 1. A native or inhabitant of Egypt (Acts 7:24).

DEFINITION: A geographical proper noun designating the African nation bathed by the Nile River, historically associated with the slavery of Israel.
SENSES: 1. The land of Egypt mentioned in biblical narratives (Mt 2:13; Heb 11:26).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio geográfico que designa a nação africana banhada pelo rio Nilo, historicamente associada à escravidão de Israel. 1. A terra do Egito mencionada nas narrativas bíblicas (Mt 2.13; Hb 11.26).
THAYER.en: A geographical proper noun designating the African nation bathed by the Nile River, historically associated with the slavery of Israel. 1. The land of Egypt mentioned in biblical narratives (Mt 2:13; Heb 11:26).

DEFINITION: Existing without beginning or end; possessing unlimited duration throughout eternity.
SENSES: 1. The eternal power and divinity of God visible through creation (Rom 1:20).
2. The eternal chains reserved for the fallen angels who sinned (Jude 1:6).

THAYER.pt: Que existe sem começo e sem fim; que possui duração ilimitada por toda a eternidade. 1. O poder eterno e a divindade de Deus visíveis através da criação (Rm 1.20). | 2. As prisões eternas reservadas aos anjos caídos que pecaram (Jd 1.6).
THAYER.en: Existing without beginning or end; possessing unlimited duration throughout eternity. 1. The eternal power and divinity of God visible through creation (Rom 1:20). | 2. The eternal chains reserved for the fallen angels who sinned (Jude 1:6).

DEFINITION: A moral attitude characterized by deep respect for others and the boundaries of decency, expressing modesty in conduct and reverence before the sacred.
SENSES: 1. Modesty and decency in appearance and behavior (1 Tim 2:9); 2. Reverence and holy fear (Heb 12:28).

THAYER.pt: Atitude moral caracterizada pelo respeito profundo aos outros e pelos limites da decência, expressando modéstia na conduta e reverência diante do sagrado. 1. Modéstia e decência na aparência e comportamento (1Tm 2.9); 2. Reverência e santo temor (Hb 12.28).
THAYER.en: A moral attitude characterized by deep respect for others and the boundaries of decency, expressing modesty in conduct and reverence before the sacred. 1. Modesty and decency in appearance and behavior (1 Tim 2:9); 2. Reverence and holy fear (Heb 12:28).

DEFINITION: Designates a person native to Ethiopia, a region south of Egypt mentioned in the New Testament in connection with the eunuch evangelized by Philip.
SENSES: 1. An inhabitant or native of Ethiopia (Acts 8:27).

THAYER.pt: Designa uma pessoa nativa da Etiópia, região ao sul do Egito mencionada no Novo Testamento em conexão com o eunuco que foi evangelizado por Filipe. 1. Um habitante ou nativo da Etiópia (Ac 8.27).
THAYER.en: Designates a person native to Ethiopia, a region south of Egypt mentioned in the New Testament in connection with the eunuch evangelized by Philip. 1. An inhabitant or native of Ethiopia (Acts 8:27).

DEFINITION: The vital fluid of the animal and human body; in the biblical sacrificial context, it symbolizes the life itself given in atonement, pointing ultimately to the vicarious redemptive death of Jesus Christ on the cross.
SENSES: 1. Physical blood in circulation or shed biologically (Mk 5:25; Jn 19:34).
2. Violent death suffered by homicide, execution, or judgment (Mt 27:24; Acts 20:26).
3. The sacrificial blood of Christ as the basis of reconciliation and the New Covenant (Mt 26:28; Rom 5:9; Heb 9:14).

THAYER.pt: Fluido vital do corpo animal e humano; no contexto sacrifical bíblico, simboliza a própria vida entregue em expiação, apontando culminantemente para a morte vicária redentora de Jesus Cristo na cruz. 1. Sangue físico em circulação ou derramado biologicamente (Mc 5.25; Jo 19.34). | 2. Morte violenta sofrida por homicídio, execução ou juízo (Mt 27.24; At 20.26). | 3. O sangue sacrifical de Cristo como base da reconciliação e da Nova Aliança (Mt 26.28; Rm 5.9; Hb 9.14).
THAYER.en: The vital fluid of the animal and human body; in the biblical sacrificial context, it symbolizes the life itself given in atonement, pointing ultimately to the vicarious redemptive death of Jesus Christ on the cross. 1. Physical blood in circulation or shed biologically (Mk 5:25; Jn 19:34). | 2. Violent death suffered by homicide, execution, or judgment (Mt 27:24; Acts 20:26). | 3. The sacrificial blood of Christ as the basis of reconciliation and the New Covenant (Mt 26:28; Rom 5:9; Heb 9:14).

DEFINITION: A theological term describing the violent and sacrificial shedding of blood in the context of atonement rituals and the redemptive death of Christ.
SENSES: 1. The literal and sacrificial shedding of blood for remission (Heb 9:22).

THAYER.pt: Termo teológico que descreve o derramamento violento e sacrificial de sangue no contexto de rituais de expiação e da morte redentora de Cristo. 1. O derramamento literal e sacrificial de sangue para remissão (Hb 9.22).
THAYER.en: A theological term describing the violent and sacrificial shedding of blood in the context of atonement rituals and the redemptive death of Christ. 1. The literal and sacrificial shedding of blood for remission (Heb 9:22).

DEFINITION: Describes the physical condition of suffering from a continuous or chronic flow of blood loss due to an illness.
SENSES: 1. To suffer from a hemorrhage or chronic flow of blood (Mt 9:20).

THAYER.pt: Descreve a condição física de sofrer com um fluxo contínuo ou crônico de perda de sangue devido a uma enfermidade. 1. Sofrer de hemorragia ou fluxo crônico de sangue (Mt 9.20).
THAYER.en: Describes the physical condition of suffering from a continuous or chronic flow of blood loss due to an illness. 1. To suffer from a hemorrhage or chronic flow of blood (Mt 9:20).

DEFINITION: A masculine proper noun of a man residing in Lydda who suffered from paralysis and was miraculously healed by the apostle Peter.
SENSES: 1. A paralyzed man healed by Peter in Lydda (Acts 9:33).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio masculino de um homem residente em Lida que sofria de paralisia e foi milagrosamente curado pelo apóstolo Pedro. 1. Homem paralítico curado por Pedro em Lida (Ac 9.33).
THAYER.en: A masculine proper noun of a man residing in Lydda who suffered from paralysis and was miraculously healed by the apostle Peter. 1. A paralyzed man healed by Peter in Lydda (Acts 9:33).

DEFINITION: A verbal expression of exaltation, gratitude, and recognition directed toward the greatness and wonderful deeds of God.
SENSES: 1. An offering of praise and exaltation given to God (Heb 13:15).

THAYER.pt: Expressão verbal de exaltação, gratidão e reconhecimento dirigida à grandeza e aos feitos maravilhosos de Deus. 1. Oferta de louvor e exaltação prestada a Deus (Hb 13.15).
THAYER.en: A verbal expression of exaltation, gratitude, and recognition directed toward the greatness and wonderful deeds of God. 1. An offering of praise and exaltation given to God (Heb 13:15).

SHORT_GLOSS: I praised, I praise, I exalt
DEFINITION: To express verbally the praise, glory, and excellence of God.
SENSES: 1. To praise and glorify God for His acts and character (Lk 2:13; Acts 2:47; Rom 15:11).
USAGE: I praised, I praise, I exalt

THAYER.pt: Expressar verbalmente o louvor, a glória e a excelência de Deus. 1. Louvar e glorificar a Deus por seus atos e caráter (Lc 2.13; At 2.47; Rm 15.11).
THAYER.en: To express verbally the praise, glory, and excellence of God. 1. To praise and glorify God for His acts and character (Lk 2:13; Acts 2:47; Rom 15:11).

DEFINITION: Refers to an obscure statement, symbol, or indirect reflection that requires special discernment to be fully understood.
SENSES: 1. An indirect reflection or obscure and enigmatic vision of future reality (1 Cor 13:12).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se a uma declaração obscura, símbolo ou reflexo indireto que requer discernimento especial para ser plenamente compreendido. 1. Um reflexo indireto ou visão obscura e enigmática da realidade futura (1Co 13.12).
THAYER.en: Refers to an obscure statement, symbol, or indirect reflection that requires special discernment to be fully understood. 1. An indirect reflection or obscure and enigmatic vision of future reality (1 Cor 13:12).

DEFINITION: A verbal expression of honor, exaltation, and recognition directed toward God, usually in response to great deeds or miracles.
SENSES: 1. The act of praising or glorifying God (Lk 18:43).

THAYER.pt: Expressão verbal de honra, exaltação e reconhecimento dirigida a Deus, geralmente em resposta a grandes feitos ou milagres. 1. Ato de louvar ou glorificar a Deus (Lc 18.43).
THAYER.en: A verbal expression of honor, exaltation, and recognition directed toward God, usually in response to great deeds or miracles. 1. The act of praising or glorifying God (Lk 18:43).

DEFINITION: A toponym designating a location where John the Baptist performed baptisms due to the abundance of water in the area.
SENSES: 1. The name of the place where John the Baptist was baptizing near Salim (Jn 3:23).

THAYER.pt: Topônimo que designa uma localidade onde João Batista realizava batismos devido à abundância de água no local. 1. Nome do local onde João Batista batizava perto de Salém (Jo 3.23).
THAYER.en: A toponym designating a location where John the Baptist performed baptisms due to the abundance of water in the area. 1. The name of the place where John the Baptist was baptizing near Salim (Jn 3:23).

DEFINITION: To make a decision for something or someone after deliberation, selecting an option among several.
SENSES: 1. To choose or select by an act of will (2 Thess 2:13).

THAYER.pt: Significa tomar uma decisão por algo ou alguém após deliberação, selecionando uma opção entre várias. 1. Escolher ou selecionar por ato de vontade (2Ts 2.13).
THAYER.en: To make a decision for something or someone after deliberation, selecting an option among several. 1. To choose or select by an act of will (2 Thess 2:13).

DEFINITION: A group or faction characterized by distinct doctrinal opinions, which may denote social divisions, religious groups, or false teachings.
SENSES: 1. A party, faction, or organized religious group (Acts 5:17; 15:5).
2. Distorted opinions or false doctrines that cause division, heresy (2 Pet 2:1).

THAYER.pt: Grupo ou facção caracterizado por opiniões doutrinárias distintas, podendo denotar divisões sociais, religiosas ou ensinos falsos. 1. Um partido, facção ou grupo religioso organizado (Ac 5.17; 15.5). | 2. Opiniões distorcidas ou doutrinas falsas que causam divisão, heresia (2Pe 2.1).
THAYER.en: A group or faction characterized by distinct doctrinal opinions, which may denote social divisions, religious groups, or false teachings. 1. A party, faction, or organized religious group (Acts 5:17; 15:5). | 2. Distorted opinions or false doctrines that cause division, heresy (2 Pet 2:1).

SHORT_GLOSS: I choose, I select, I adopt
DEFINITION: To choose or select someone for the purpose of demonstrating special favor or affection.
SENSES: 1. To choose or select someone to grant favor or grace (Mt 12:18).
USAGE: I choose, I select, I adopt

THAYER.pt: Significa escolher ou selecionar alguém com o propósito de demonstrar favor ou afeto especial. 1. Escolher ou selecionar alguém para conceder favor ou graça (Mt 12.18).
THAYER.en: To choose or select someone for the purpose of demonstrating special favor or affection. 1. To choose or select someone to grant favor or grace (Mt 12:18).

DEFINITION: Describes a person who promotes divisions, factions, or dissensions within the faith community.
SENSES: 1. One who causes divisions or promotes parties contrary to unity (Titus 3:10).

THAYER.pt: Descreve uma pessoa que promove divisões, facções ou dissensões na comunidade de fé. 1. Aquele que causa divisões ou promove partidos contrários à unidade (Tt 3.10).
THAYER.en: Describes a person who promotes divisions, factions, or dissensions within the faith community. 1. One who causes divisions or promotes parties contrary to unity (Titus 3:10).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: ἀρῶ, Aor: ἦρα, Perf: ἦρκα, Aor Pass: ἤρθην
DEFINITION: To raise from the ground to support, suspend, or carry; by extension, to remove, take away, or eliminate someone or something from its original place.
SENSES: 1. To lift from the ground or suspend in the air (Matt 14:20; John 8:59).
2. To carry with oneself, to take upon oneself a burden or load (Matt 16:24; Mark 2:9).
3. To take away, remove, or cast off categorically (John 1:29; 11:39).

THAYER.pt: Erguer do chão para sustentar, suspender ou carregar; por extensão, remover, afastar ou eliminar alguém ou algo de seu lugar original. 1. Levantar do chão ou suspender no ar (Mt 14.20; Jo 8.59). | 2. Carregar consigo, tomar sobre si um encargo ou fardo (Mt 16.24; Mc 2.9). | 3. Tirar, remover, afastar de modo categórico (Jo 1.29; 11.39).
THAYER.en: To raise from the ground to support, suspend, or carry; by extension, to remove, take away, or eliminate someone or something from its original place. 1. To lift from the ground or suspend in the air (Matt 14:20; John 8:59). | 2. To carry with oneself, to take upon oneself a burden or load (Matt 16:24; Mark 2:9). | 3. To take away, remove, or cast off categorically (John 1:29; 11:39).

DEFINITION: To have the capacity to grasp something through physical senses or to discern and understand a situation deeply.
SENSES: 1. To perceive or notice something sensorially (Luke 11:8).
2. To understand or discern the meaning of something (Luke 9:45).

THAYER.pt: Ter a capacidade de captar algo através dos sentidos físicos ou de discernir e compreender profundamente uma situação. 1. Perceber ou notar algo sensorialmente (Lc 11.8). | 2. Compreender ou discernir o sentido de algo (Lc 9.45).
THAYER.en: To have the capacity to grasp something through physical senses or to discern and understand a situation deeply. 1. To perceive or notice something sensorially (Luke 11:8). | 2. To understand or discern the meaning of something (Luke 9:45).

DEFINITION: The capacity for sensitive perception or, in a figurative sense, moral and spiritual discernment.
SENSES: 1. Capacity for moral discernment and perception (Phil 1:9).

THAYER.pt: Capacidade de percepção sensível ou, em sentido figurado, discernimento moral e espiritual. 1. Capacidade de discernimento e percepção moral (Fp 1.9).
THAYER.en: The capacity for sensitive perception or, in a figurative sense, moral and spiritual discernment. 1. Capacity for moral discernment and perception (Phil 1:9).

DEFINITION: Literally a sense organ, it refers figuratively to the spiritual faculty for discerning between good and evil.
SENSES: 1. Faculty of spiritual and moral discernment (Heb 5:14).

THAYER.pt: Literalmente órgão de sentido, refere-se figuradamente à faculdade espiritual para discernir entre o bem e o mal. 1. Faculdade de discernimento espiritual e moral (Hb 5.14).
THAYER.en: Literally a sense organ, it refers figuratively to the spiritual faculty for discerning between good and evil. 1. Faculty of spiritual and moral discernment (Heb 5:14).

DEFINITION: Characterizes someone who seeks to obtain material profit or advantage in a dishonest, shameful, or ambitious manner.
SENSES: 1. Greedy for shameful or dishonest gain (1 Tim 3:8).

THAYER.pt: Caracteriza alguém que busca obter lucro ou vantagem material de maneira desonesta, vergonzosa ou ambiciosa. 1. Ganancioso por lucros vergonhosos ou desonestos (1Tm 3.8).
THAYER.en: Characterizes someone who seeks to obtain material profit or advantage in a dishonest, shameful, or ambitious manner. 1. Greedy for shameful or dishonest gain (1 Tim 3:8).

DEFINITION: A mode of acting motivated by the shameful desire for dishonest gain or material greed.
SENSES: 1. To act with shameful greed for material gain (1 Pet 5:2).

THAYER.pt: Modo de agir motivado pelo desejo vergonhoso de lucro desonesto ou ganância material. 1. Agir com ganância vergonhosa por lucro material (1Pe 5.2).
THAYER.en: A mode of acting motivated by the shameful desire for dishonest gain or material greed. 1. To act with shameful greed for material gain (1 Pet 5:2).

DEFINITION: The use of vulgar, obscene, or low-class language that violates acceptable moral standards.
SENSES: 1. Obscene language or filthy talk (Col 3:8).

THAYER.pt: Uso de linguagem vulgar, obscena ou de baixo calão que viola os padrões morais aceitáveis. 1. Linguagem obscena ou conversa torpe (Cl 3.8).
THAYER.en: The use of vulgar, obscene, or low-class language that violates acceptable moral standards. 1. Obscene language or filthy talk (Col 3:8).

DEFINITION: That which is morally shameful, indecent, or reprehensible according to ethical and social standards.
SENSES: 1. Actions or behaviors considered shameful or improper.

THAYER.pt: Aquilo que é moralmente vergonhoso, indecente ou reprovável perante os padrões éticos e sociais. 1. Ações ou comportamentos considerados vergonhosos ou impróprios.
THAYER.en: That which is morally shameful, indecent, or reprehensible according to ethical and social standards. 1. Actions or behaviors considered shameful or improper.

DEFINITION: Refers to that which is socially or morally unacceptable, degrading, or shameful in light of the ethical standards of the community and the Christian faith.
SENSES: 1. Morally shameful or unworthy behavior (1 Cor 11:6; Titus 1:11).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se ao que é social ou moralmente inaceitável, degradante ou vergonhoso à luz dos padrões éticos da comunidade e da fé cristã. 1. Comportamento moralmente vergonhoso ou indigno (1Co 11.6; Tt 1.11).
THAYER.en: Refers to that which is socially or morally unacceptable, degrading, or shameful in light of the ethical standards of the community and the Christian faith. 1. Morally shameful or unworthy behavior (1 Cor 11:6; Titus 1:11).

DEFINITION: Shameful behavior that defies established moral and social standards.
SENSES: 1. Indecent and shameful actions or words (Eph 5:4).

THAYER.pt: Comportamento vergonhoso que desafia os padrões morais e sociais estabelecidos. 1. Ações ou palavras indecentes e vergonhosas (Ef 5.4).
THAYER.en: Shameful behavior that defies established moral and social standards. 1. Indecent and shameful actions or words (Eph 5:4).

DEFINITION: Describes both the subjective feeling of shame or modesty in the face of possible dishonor and the objective condition of public ignominy and disgrace.
SENSES: 1. A sense of modesty or revulsion at shameful practices (2Co 4:2).
2. The experience or state of disgrace and humiliation (Php 3:19; Heb 12:2).

THAYER.pt: Descreve tanto o sentimento subjetivo de vergonha ou pudor diante da possibilidade de desonra quanto a condição objetiva de ignomínia e desgraça pública. 1. Senso de modéstia ou repulsa a práticas vergonhosas (2Co 4.2). | 2. Experiência ou estado de desgraça e humilhação (Fp 3.19; Hb 12.2).
THAYER.en: Describes both the subjective feeling of shame or modesty in the face of possible dishonor and the objective condition of public ignominy and disgrace. 1. A sense of modesty or revulsion at shameful practices (2Co 4:2). | 2. The experience or state of disgrace and humiliation (Php 3:19; Heb 12:2).

DEFINITION: To experience a feeling of shame or dishonor due to improper conduct or conduct contrary to dignity.
SENSES: 1. To feel shame or embarrassment (Php 1:20).

THAYER.pt: Experimentar sentimento de vergonha ou desonra devido a uma conduta imprópria ou contrária à dignidade. 1. Sentir vergonha ou constrangimento (Fp 1.20).
THAYER.en: To experience a feeling of shame or dishonor due to improper conduct or conduct contrary to dignity. 1. To feel shame or embarrassment (Php 1:20).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: αἰτήσω, Aor: ᾔτησα, Perf: ᾔτηκα
DEFINITION: Expresses the act of making a request, generally from an inferior to a superior or from someone in need seeking help insistently.
SENSES: 1. To ask someone for something, as in human petitions or prayers to God (Mt 7:7; Jn 15:7).
2. To demand or claim something firmly (Mt 27:58; Ac 3:14).

THAYER.pt: Expressa o ato de fazer um pedido, geralmente de um inferior para um superior ou de alguém necessitado que busca auxílio de forma insistente. 1. Pedir algo a alguém, como em petições humanas ou orações a Deus (Mt 7.7; Jo 15.7). | 2. Exigir ou reclamar algo com firmeza (Mt 27.58; At 3.14).
THAYER.en: Expresses the act of making a request, generally from an inferior to a superior or from someone in need seeking help insistently. 1. To ask someone for something, as in human petitions or prayers to God (Mt 7:7; Jn 15:7). | 2. To demand or claim something firmly (Mt 27:58; Ac 3:14).

DEFINITION: Designates the content of what is requested or demanded in the form of a petition, especially in prayer.
SENSES: 1. That which is requested or demanded in prayer or petition (Lk 23:24; Php 4:6; 1Jn 5:15).

THAYER.pt: Designa o conteúdo daquilo que é solicitado ou demandado em forma de petição, especialmente em oração. 1. Aquilo que é pedido ou demandado em oração ou solicitação (Lc 23.24; Fp 4.6; 1Jo 5.15).
THAYER.en: Designates the content of what is requested or demanded in the form of a petition, especially in prayer. 1. That which is requested or demanded in prayer or petition (Lk 23:24; Php 4:6; 1Jn 5:15).

DEFINITION: Designates that which is responsible for a state of affairs, serving both as a cause or motive and as a legal basis for a formal accusation.
SENSES: 1. The cause, motive, or reason for an event or condition (Lk 8:47; Ac 28:20).
2. Formal accusation or legal basis for a judicial process (Jn 18:38; Ac 25:27).

THAYER.pt: Designa aquilo que é responsável por um estado de coisas, servindo tanto como causa ou motivo quanto como fundamento legal para uma acusação formal. 1. A causa, motivo ou razão de um acontecimento ou condição (Lc 8.47; At 28.20). | 2. Acusação formal ou base jurídica para um processo judicial (Jo 18.38; At 25.27).
THAYER.en: Designates that which is responsible for a state of affairs, serving both as a cause or motive and as a legal basis for a formal accusation. 1. The cause, motive, or reason for an event or condition (Lk 8:47; Ac 28:20). | 2. Formal accusation or legal basis for a judicial process (Jn 18:38; Ac 25:27).

DEFINITION: The formal content of an accusation or complaint brought against someone in a legal context.
SENSES: 1. A formal accusation or complaint of a legal nature (Ac 25:7).

THAYER.pt: O conteúdo formal de uma acusação ou queixa apresentada contra alguém em um contexto legal. 1. Acusação ou queixa formal de natureza jurídica (At 25.7).
THAYER.en: The formal content of an accusation or complaint brought against someone in a legal context. 1. A formal accusation or complaint of a legal nature (Ac 25:7).

DEFINITION: The foundation, origin, or motive why an event occurs or a state manifests.
SENSES: 1. The underlying reason or cause for an event.

THAYER.pt: O fundamento, origem ou motivo pelo qual um evento ocorre ou um estado se manifesta. 1. A razão ou causa subjacente a um acontecimento.
THAYER.en: The foundation, origin, or motive why an event occurs or a state manifests. 1. The underlying reason or cause for an event.

DEFINITION: That which or he who produces an effect, serving as a source, motive, or legal basis for an action.
SENSES: 1. One who is the cause or source of something (Heb 5:9).
2. Motive, reason, or legal foundation (Ac 19:40).

THAYER.pt: Aquilo ou aquele que produz um efeito, servindo como fonte, motivo ou base legal para uma ação. 1. Aquele que é a causa ou fonte de algo (Hb 5.9). | 2. Motivo, razão ou fundamento jurídico (At 19.40).
THAYER.en: That which or he who produces an effect, serving as a source, motive, or legal basis for an action. 1. One who is the cause or source of something (Heb 5:9). | 2. Motive, reason, or legal foundation (Ac 19:40).

DEFINITION: Describes something that happens unexpectedly and in an extremely short space of time, without prior warning.
SENSES: 1. Occurring suddenly, unexpectedly, or unforeseen (Lk 21:34; 1Th 5:3).

THAYER.pt: Descreve algo que acontece de forma inesperada e em um espaço de tempo extremamente curto, sem aviso prévio. 1. Que ocorre de repente, de forma súbita ou imprevista (Lc 21.34; 1Ts 5.3).
THAYER.en: Describes something that happens unexpectedly and in an extremely short space of time, without prior warning. 1. Occurring suddenly, unexpectedly, or unforeseen (Lk 21:34; 1Th 5:3).

DEFINITION: Refers to the state of subjection as a prisoner of war or, by metonymy, to the group of people taken captive.
SENSES: 1. The state of captivity in wartime (Rev 13:10).
2. A group of captives or prisoners of war (Eph 4:8).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se ao estado de sujeição como prisioneiro de guerra ou, por metonímia, ao grupo de pessoas levadas cativas. 1. O estado de cativeiro em tempo de guerra (Ap 13.10). | 2. Um grupo de cativos ou prisioneiros de guerra (Ef 4.8).
THAYER.en: Refers to the state of subjection as a prisoner of war or, by metonymy, to the group of people taken captive. 1. The state of captivity in wartime (Rev 13:10). | 2. A group of captives or prisoners of war (Eph 4:8).

DEFINITION: The act of capturing enemies in war or taking prisoners.
SENSES: 1. To lead captive or take prisoners in a context of war or conflict (Eph 4:8).

THAYER.pt: O ato de capturar inimigos em guerra ou fazer prisioneiros. 1. Levar cativo ou fazer prisioneiros em contexto de guerra ou conflito (Ef 4.8).
THAYER.en: The act of capturing enemies in war or taking prisoners. 1. To lead captive or take prisoners in a context of war or conflict (Eph 4:8).

DEFINITION: To lead someone away as a prisoner of war or, in a figurative sense, to subjugate and dominate minds, thoughts, or wills.
SENSES: 1. To make a prisoner or lead captive in a context of war (Lk 21:24).
2. To subjugate thoughts or people under the power of sin or truth (Ro 7:23; 2Co 10:5; 2Ti 3:6).

THAYER.pt: Conduzir alguém como prisioneiro de guerra ou, em sentido figurado, subjugar e dominar mentes, pensamentos ou vontades. 1. Fazer prisioneiro ou levar cativo em contexto de guerra (Lc 21.24). | 2. Subjugar pensamentos ou pessoas sob o poder do pecado ou da verdade (Rm 7.23; 2Co 10.5; 2Tm 3.6).
THAYER.en: To lead someone away as a prisoner of war or, in a figurative sense, to subjugate and dominate minds, thoughts, or wills. 1. To make a prisoner or lead captive in a context of war (Lk 21:24). | 2. To subjugate thoughts or people under the power of sin or truth (Ro 7:23; 2Co 10:5; 2Ti 3:6).

DEFINITION: A person who has been captured and made a prisoner in combat.
SENSES: 1. Prisoner of war or captive (Lk 4:18).

THAYER.pt: Pessoa que foi capturada e feita prisioneira em combate. 1. Prisioneiro de guerra ou cativo (Lc 4.18).
THAYER.en: A person who has been captured and made a prisoner in combat. 1. Prisoner of war or captive (Lk 4:18).

DEFINITION: Denotes an indefinite or very long period of time, a historical epoch of the plan of redemption, the world in its transitory characteristics, or eternity itself.
SENSES: 1. An age, epoch, or specific period of human history (Mt 12:32; 1Co 1:20).
2. The system of the temporal and fallen world in contrast with the divine Kingdom (Ro 12:2; 2Co 4:4).
3. Perpetual duration, infinite time, eternity (Jn 6:51; Eph 3:21).

THAYER.pt: Denota um período de tempo indefinido ou muito longo, uma época histórica do plano da redenção, o mundo em suas características transitórias ou a própria eternidade. 1. Uma era, época ou período específico da história humana (Mt 12.32; 1Co 1.20). | 2. O sistema do mundo temporal e caído em contraste com o Reino divino (Rm 12.2; 2Co 4.4). | 3. Duração perpétua, infinito de tempo, eternidade (Jo 6.51; Ef 3.21).
THAYER.en: Denotes an indefinite or very long period of time, a historical epoch of the plan of redemption, the world in its transitory characteristics, or eternity itself. 1. An age, epoch, or specific period of human history (Mt 12:32; 1Co 1:20). | 2. The system of the temporal and fallen world in contrast with the divine Kingdom (Ro 12:2; 2Co 4:4). | 3. Perpetual duration, infinite time, eternity (Jn 6:51; Eph 3:21).

DEFINITION: Qualifies that which belongs to an unlimited duration, without beginning or end, essentially describing the very nature of God and the life granted to believers.
SENSES: 1. That which existed from the remote past or in pre-temporal plans (Ro 16:25; 2Ti 1:9).
2. Eternal, endless, applied to the state of God or future salvation (Mt 25:46; Ro 6:23).

THAYER.pt: Qualifica o que pertence a uma duração ilimitada, sem começo ou sem fim, descrevendo essencialmente a própria natureza de Deus e a vida concedida aos crentes. 1. O que existiu desde a antiguidade remota ou nos planos pré-temporais (Rm 16.25; 2Tm 1.9). | 2. Eterno, sem fim, aplicados ao estado de Deus ou à salvação futura (Mt 25.46; Rm 6.23).
THAYER.en: Qualifies that which belongs to an unlimited duration, without beginning or end, essentially describing the very nature of God and the life granted to believers. 1. That which existed from the remote past or in pre-temporal plans (Ro 16:25; 2Ti 1:9). | 2. Eternal, endless, applied to the state of God or future salvation (Mt 25:46; Ro 6:23).

DEFINITION: Refers to moral or physical impurity, especially associated with illicit sexual practices and depravity that corrupts character before God.
SENSES: 1. Physical uncleanness or literal dirt (Mt 23:27).
2. Moral corruption, sensuality, and sexual perversion (Ro 1:24; Eph 4:19).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se à impureza moral ou física, especialmente associada a práticas sexuais ilícitas e à depravação que corrompe o caráter diante de Deus. 1. Imundície física ou sujeira literal (Mt 23.27). | 2. Corrupção moral, lascívia e perversão sexual (Rm 1.24; Ef 4.19).
THAYER.en: Refers to moral or physical impurity, especially associated with illicit sexual practices and depravity that corrupts character before God. 1. Physical uncleanness or literal dirt (Mt 23:27). | 2. Moral corruption, sensuality, and sexual perversion (Ro 1:24; Eph 4:19).

DEFINITION: Quality or condition of being impure, whether in a ritual, physical, or moral sense (Rev 17:4).
SENSES: 1. Condition of moral impurity or uncleanness (Rev 17:4).

THAYER.pt: Qualidade ou condição de ser impuro, seja no sentido ritual, físico ou moral (Ap 17:4). 1. Condição de impureza ou imundície moral (Ap 17.4).
THAYER.en: Quality or condition of being impure, whether in a ritual, physical, or moral sense (Rev 17:4). 1. Condition of moral impurity or uncleanness (Rev 17:4).

DEFINITION: That which is ritually unacceptable for divine worship or morally corrupted, also applying to evil spirits.
SENSES: 1. Ritually impure or contaminated according to ceremonial law (Ac 10:14).
2. Morally corrupted or spiritually evil, like demons (Mt 10:1).

THAYER.pt: Que é ritualmente inaceitável para o culto divino ou moralmente corrompido, aplicando-se também a espíritos malignos. 1. Ritualmente impuro ou contaminado segundo a lei ceremonial (At 10.14). | 2. Moralmente corrompido ou espiritualmente maligno, como os demônios (Mt 10.1).
THAYER.en: That which is ritually unacceptable for divine worship or morally corrupted, also applying to evil spirits. 1. Ritually impure or contaminated according to ceremonial law (Ac 10:14). | 2. Morally corrupted or spiritually evil, like demons (Mt 10:1).

DEFINITION: To lack a favorable opportunity or adequate time to perform a certain action.
SENSES: 1. To lack opportunity or propitious time to act (Php 4:10).

THAYER.pt: Carecer de uma oportunidade favorável ou de tempo adequado para realizar determinada ação. 1. Faltar oportunidade ou tempo propício para agir (Fp 4.10).
THAYER.en: To lack a favorable opportunity or adequate time to perform a certain action. 1. To lack opportunity or propitious time to act (Php 4:10).

DEFINITION: In an inopportune manner, when the moment is not the most favorable or adequate.
SENSES: 1. At times considered inappropriate or outside the propitious occasion (2Ti 4:2).

THAYER.pt: De maneira inoportuna, quando o momento não é o mais favorável ou adequado. 1. Em momentos considerados inadequados ou fora da ocasião propícia (2Tm 4.2).
THAYER.en: In an inopportune manner, when the moment is not the most favorable or adequate. 1. At times considered inappropriate or outside the propitious occasion (2Ti 4:2).

DEFINITION: A person who is free from malice, craftiness, or guilt, characterized by simplicity and having no ulterior motives.
SENSES: 1. Free from malice or harmless regarding evil (Ro 16:18; Php 2:15).

THAYER.pt: Pessoa que é livre de malícia, astúcia ou culpa, caracterizando-se pela simplicidade e por não ter segundas intenções. 1. Livre de malícia ou inofensivo em relação ao mal (Rm 16.18; Fp 2.15).
THAYER.en: A person who is free from malice, craftiness, or guilt, characterized by simplicity and having no ulterior motives. 1. Free from malice or harmless regarding evil (Ro 16:18; Php 2:15).

DEFINITION: A thorny plant or weed with thorns, a symbol of unfruitful soil or suffering.
SENSES: 1. A plant endowed with thorns that grows in uncultivated fields (Mt 7:16; 27:29).

THAYER.pt: Planta espinhosa ou erva daninha com espinhos, símbolo de solo infrutífero ou sofrimento. 1. Planta dotada de espinhos que cresce em campos incultos (Mt 7.16; 27.29).
THAYER.en: A thorny plant or weed with thorns, a symbol of unfruitful soil or suffering. 1. A plant endowed with thorns that grows in uncultivated fields (Mt 7:16; 27:29).

DEFINITION: Made of thorns or composed of thorny vegetation, used in the New Testament to describe the crown placed on Jesus.
SENSES: 1. Made of thorns (Mk 15:17).

THAYER.pt: Feito de espinhos ou composto por vegetação espinhosa, usado no Novo Testamento para descrever a coroa colocada sobre Jesus. 1. Feito de espinhos (Mc 15.17).
THAYER.en: Made of thorns or composed of thorny vegetation, used in the New Testament to describe the crown placed on Jesus. 1. Made of thorns (Mk 15:17).

DEFINITION: Pertains to plants that do not produce fruit, or, figuratively, to actions, words, and people that do not generate productive results.
SENSES: 1. Incapable of producing fruit or harvest (Jude 12).
2. Useless, unproductive, or without spiritual profit (Eph 5:11; 1Co 14:14).

THAYER.pt: Diz respeito a plantas que não produzem frutos, ou, figurativamente, a ações, palavras e pessoas que não geram resultados produtivos. 1. Incapaz de produzir frutos ou colheita (Jd 12). | 2. Inútil, improdutivo ou sem proveito espiritual (Ef 5.11; 1Co 14.14).
THAYER.en: Pertains to plants that do not produce fruit, or, figuratively, to actions, words, and people that do not generate productive results. 1. Incapable of producing fruit or harvest (Jude 12). | 2. Useless, unproductive, or without spiritual profit (Eph 5:11; 1Co 14:14).

DEFINITION: That which cannot be justly censured, blamed, or condemned; beyond any criticism.
SENSES: 1. Blameless conduct above any legitimate criticism (Tit 2:8).

THAYER.pt: Que não pode ser justamente censurado, culpado ou condenado; além de qualquer crítica. 1. Conduta irrepreensível e acima de qualquer crítica legítima (Tt 2.8).
THAYER.en: That which cannot be justly censured, blamed, or condemned; beyond any criticism. 1. Blameless conduct above any legitimate criticism (Tit 2:8).

DEFINITION: Refers to something or someone not covered, especially applied to hair or the head without the use of a veil in specific cultural contexts.
SENSES: 1. Uncovered, without the use of a veil or head covering (1Co 11:5).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se a algo ou alguém que não está coberto, especialmente aplicado ao cabelo ou à cabeça sem o uso de véu em contextos culturais específicos. 1. Descoberto, sem o uso de véu ou cobertura na cabeça (1Co 11.5).
THAYER.en: Refers to something or someone not covered, especially applied to hair or the head without the use of a veil in specific cultural contexts. 1. Uncovered, without the use of a veil or head covering (1Co 11:5).

DEFINITION: Describes a person who suffered penalties or judgment without undergoing a proper legal process or without having their guilt formally proven.
SENSES: 1. One who has not been legally judged or condemned (Ac 16:37).

THAYER.pt: Descreve uma pessoa que sofreu penalidades ou julgamento sem passar por um processo legal adequado ou sem ter sua culpa formalmente provada. 1. Que não foi julgado ou condenado legalmente (Ac 16.37).
THAYER.en: Describes a person who suffered penalties or judgment without undergoing a proper legal process or without having their guilt formally proven. 1. One who has not been legally judged or condemned (Ac 16:37).

DEFINITION: That which cannot be destroyed, dissolved, or brought to an end.
SENSES: 1. Indestructible or of permanent and perpetual nature (Heb 7:16).

THAYER.pt: Que não pode ser destruído, dissolvido ou levado ao fim. 1. Indestrutível ou de natureza permanente e perpétua (Hb 7.16).
THAYER.en: That which cannot be destroyed, dissolved, or brought to an end. 1. Indestructible or of permanent and perpetual nature (Heb 7:16).

DEFINITION: That which does not cease, which does not stop performing an activity or movement.
SENSES: 1. Incapable of stopping or ceasing to sin or act (2Pe 2:14).

THAYER.pt: Que não cessa, que não para de realizar uma atividade ou movimento. 1. Incapaz de parar ou cessar de pecar ou agir (2Pe 2.14).
THAYER.en: That which does not cease, which does not stop performing an activity or movement. 1. Incapable of stopping or ceasing to sin or act (2Pe 2:14).

DEFINITION: A state of agitation, social tumult, or disorderly opposition to established authority.
SENSES: 1. Disturbance or state of instability (2 Cor 6:5).
2. Rebellion or public disorder (1 Cor 14:33; Luke 21:9).

THAYER.pt: Estado de agitação, tumulto social ou oposição desordenada à autoridade estabelecida. 1. Distúrbio ou estado de instabilidade (2Co 6.5). | 2. Rebelião ou desordem pública (1Co 14.33; Lc 21.9).
THAYER.en: A state of agitation, social tumult, or disorderly opposition to established authority. 1. Disturbance or state of instability (2 Cor 6:5). | 2. Rebellion or public disorder (1 Cor 14:33; Luke 21:9).

DEFINITION: Indicates a lack of firmness or control, describing inconstant, wavering people or agitated and disorderly situations.
SENSES: 1. Unstable or inconstant in behavior and decisions (Jas 1.8; 3.8).

THAYER.pt: Indica falta de firmeza ou controle, descrevendo pessoas inconstantes, vacilantes ou situações agitadas e desordenadas. 1. Instável ou inconstante no comportamento e nas decisões (Tg 1.8; 3.8).
THAYER.en: Indicates a lack of firmness or control, describing inconstant, wavering people or agitated and disorderly situations. 1. Unstable or inconstant in behavior and decisions (Jas 1.8; 3.8).

DEFINITION: That which cannot be contained, restrained, or controlled by common means.
SENSES: 1. Referring to impulses or attitudes that escape control.

THAYER.pt: Que não pode ser contido, refreado ou controlado por meios comuns. 1. Referente a impulsos ou atitudes que escapam ao controle.
THAYER.en: That which cannot be contained, restrained, or controlled by common means. 1. Referring to impulses or attitudes that escape control.

DEFINITION: Term of Aramaic origin meaning 'Field of Blood', a name given to the plot of land bought with Judas's betrayal money.
SENSES: 1. Aramaic name for the Field of Blood in Jerusalem (Ac 1.19).

THAYER.pt: Termo de origem aramaica que significa 'Campo de Sangue', nome atribuído ao terreno comprado com o dinheiro da traição de Judas. 1. Nome aramaico para o Campo de Sangue em Jerusalém (At 1.19).
THAYER.en: Term of Aramaic origin meaning 'Field of Blood', a name given to the plot of land bought with Judas's betrayal money. 1. Aramaic name for the Field of Blood in Jerusalem (Ac 1.19).

DEFINITION: Literally unmixed; in the New Testament it describes moral purity free from malice, deceit, or corruption.
SENSES: 1. Morally pure, innocent, and free from evil (Mt 10.16; Rom 16.19; Phil 2.15).

THAYER.pt: Literalmente sem mistura; no Novo Testamento descreve uma pureza moral isenta de malícia, engano ou corrupção. 1. Moralmente puro, inocente e livre de maldade (Mt 10.16; Rm 16.19; Fp 2.15).
THAYER.en: Literally unmixed; in the New Testament it describes moral purity free from malice, deceit, or corruption. 1. Morally pure, innocent, and free from evil (Mt 10.16; Rom 16.19; Phil 2.15).

DEFINITION: That which does not lean to the sides, remaining firm, constant, and unwavering.
SENSES: 1. Firm and unwavering in the confession of faith (Heb 10.23).

THAYER.pt: Que não se inclina para os lados, mantendo-se firme, constante e sem vacilar. 1. Firme e sem vacilar na confissão da fé (Hb 10.23).
THAYER.en: That which does not lean to the sides, remaining firm, constant, and unwavering. 1. Firm and unwavering in the confession of faith (Heb 10.23).

DEFINITION: To reach the peak of development, flowering, or ripening.
SENSES: 1. To be ripe or at the height of development, referred to the fruits of the earth (Rev 14.18).

THAYER.pt: Atingir o ponto máximo de desenvolvimento, floração ou amadurecimento. 1. Estar maduro ou no auge do desenvolvimento, referido aos frutos da terra (Ap 14.18).
THAYER.en: To reach the peak of development, flowering, or ripening. 1. To be ripe or at the height of development, referred to the fruits of the earth (Rev 14.18).

DEFINITION: Indicates the extension of time up to the present moment or beyond an expected point.
SENSES: 1. Expression of temporal continuity meaning 'still' or 'until now' (Matt 15:16).

THAYER.pt: Indica a extensão do tempo até o momento presente ou além de um ponto esperado. 1. Expressão de continuidade temporal significando 'ainda' ou 'até agora' (Mt 15.16).
THAYER.en: Indicates the extension of time up to the present moment or beyond an expected point. 1. Expression of temporal continuity meaning 'still' or 'until now' (Matt 15:16).

DEFINITION: Refers both to the physical faculty of hearing and the organ of the ear, as well as the message or news that is heard.
SENSES: 1. The capacity or act of hearing (1 Cor 12:17; Gal 3:2).
2. The auditory organ, the ear (Mark 7:35).
3. News, rumor, or a proclaimed message (Matt 4:24; John 12:38).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se tanto à faculdade física da audição e ao órgão do ouvido quanto à mensagem ou notícia que é ouvida. 1. A capacidade ou o ato de ouvir (1Co 12.17; Gl 3.2). | 2. O órgão auditivo, o ouvido (Mc 7.35). | 3. Uma notícia, rumor ou mensagem proclamada (Mt 4.24; Jo 12.38).
THAYER.en: Refers both to the physical faculty of hearing and the organ of the ear, as well as the message or news that is heard. 1. The capacity or act of hearing (1 Cor 12:17; Gal 3:2). | 2. The auditory organ, the ear (Mark 7:35). | 3. News, rumor, or a proclaimed message (Matt 4:24; John 12:38).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: ἀκολουθήσω, Aor: ἠκολούθησα, Perf: ἠκολούθηκα
DEFINITION: To move physically behind someone going ahead. In Jesus' ministry, it assumes the primary theological technical sense of discipleship: faithfully committing oneself to His teachings, path, and sacrifice.
SENSES: 1. To follow in physical tracks, go behind, or accompany (Mt 21.9; Jn 18.15; 20.6).
2. To follow as a committed disciple, adhering to the cause of Christ (Mt 4.20; 9.9; Mk 8.34).
3. To come as a consequence of, succeed events (Rev 14.8, 13).

THAYER.pt: Deslocar-se fisicamente atrás de alguém que vai à frente. No ministério de Jesus, assume o sentido técnico teológico primordial do discipulado: comprometer-se fielmente com os Seus ensinos, caminho e sacrifício. 1. Seguir no rastro físico, ir atrás ou acompanhar (Mt 21.9; Jo 18.15; 20.6). | 2. Seguir como discípulo comprometido, aderindo à causa de Cristo (Mt 4.20; 9.9; Mc 8.34). | 3. Vir em consequência de, suceder a eventos (Ap 14.8, 13).
THAYER.en: To move physically behind someone going ahead. In Jesus' ministry, it assumes the primary theological technical sense of discipleship: faithfully committing oneself to His teachings, path, and sacrifice. 1. To follow in physical tracks, go behind, or accompany (Mt 21.9; Jn 18.15; 20.6). | 2. To follow as a committed disciple, adhering to the cause of Christ (Mt 4.20; 9.9; Mk 8.34). | 3. To come as a consequence of, succeed events (Rev 14.8, 13).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: ἀκούσω / ἀκούσομαι, Aor: ἤκουσα, Perf: ἀκήκοα
DEFINITION: The biological capacity to hear sounds and the moral attitude of listening attentively and obediently to a communicated instruction or message.
SENSES: 1. To perceive aurally through the sensory apparatus; to hear (Mt 11.5; 13.16).
2. To give ear, receive a message, obey commands (Mt 17.5; Jn 8.47).
3. To take cognizance, learn by report or public news (Mt 14.13; Rom 10.14).

THAYER.pt: Capacidade biológica de ouvir sons e a atitude moral de escutar atenta e obedientemente uma instrução ou mensagem comunicada. 1. Perceber auditivamente pelo aparelho sensorial; ouvir (Mt 11.5; 13.16). | 2. Dar ouvidos, acolher uma mensagem, obedecer a ordens (Mt 17.5; Jo 8.47). | 3. Tomar conhecimento, saber mediante relato ou notícia pública (Mt 14.13; Rm 10.14).
THAYER.en: The biological capacity to hear sounds and the moral attitude of listening attentively and obediently to a communicated instruction or message. 1. To perceive aurally through the sensory apparatus; to hear (Mt 11.5; 13.16). | 2. To give ear, receive a message, obey commands (Mt 17.5; Jn 8.47). | 3. To take cognizance, learn by report or public news (Mt 14.13; Rom 10.14).

DEFINITION: Inability or failure to exercise mastery over one's own desires, impulses, and passions.
SENSES: 1. Lack of self-control or excessive indulgence (1 Cor 7:5).

THAYER.pt: Incapacidade ou falha em exercer domínio sobre os próprios desejos, impulsos e paixões. 1. Falta de autocontrole ou indulgência excessiva (1Co 7.5).
THAYER.en: Inability or failure to exercise mastery over one's own desires, impulses, and passions. 1. Lack of self-control or excessive indulgence (1 Cor 7:5).

DEFINITION: Lacking self-control over one's own impulses, passions, or desires.
SENSES: 1. Destitute of moral self-control (2Tm 3.3).

THAYER.pt: Que carece de autocontrole sobre os próprios impulsos, paixões ou desejos. 1. Desprovido de autocontrole moral (2Tm 3.3).
THAYER.en: Lacking self-control over one's own impulses, passions, or desires. 1. Destitute of moral self-control (2Tm 3.3).

DEFINITION: Refers to liquid substances, especially wine, that have not been diluted, maintaining full strength.
SENSES: 1. Pure and unmixed wine, or divine wrath in its full strength (Rev 14.10).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se a substâncias líquidas, especialmente o vinho, que não foram diluídas, mantendo a força plena. 1. Vinho puro e sem mistura, ou a ira divina em sua força total (Ap 14.10).
THAYER.en: Refers to liquid substances, especially wine, that have not been diluted, maintaining full strength. 1. Pure and unmixed wine, or divine wrath in its full strength (Rev 14.10).

DEFINITION: Strict conformity to a norm, standard, or detail with exactness and rigor.
SENSES: 1. Rigor, exactness, and strict conformity to a standard of teaching or law (Acts 22:3).

THAYER.pt: Conformidade estrita a uma norma, padrão ou detalhe com exatidão e rigor. 1. Rigor, exatidão e conformidade estrita a um padrão de ensino ou lei (At 22.3).
THAYER.en: Strict conformity to a norm, standard, or detail with exactness and rigor. 1. Rigor, exactness, and strict conformity to a standard of teaching or law (Acts 22:3).

DEFINITION: Superlative denoting the highest degree of rigor, precision, or severity regarding a rule or sect.
SENSES: 1. The most rigorous or strict standard or religious group (Ac 26.5).

THAYER.pt: Superlativo que denota o mais alto grau de rigor, precisão ou severidade em relação a uma regra ou seita. 1. O mais rigoroso ou estrito padrão ou grupo religioso (At 26.5).
THAYER.en: Superlative denoting the highest degree of rigor, precision, or severity regarding a rule or sect. 1. The most rigorous or strict standard or religious group (Ac 26.5).

DEFINITION: Comparative form indicating a greater degree of exactness, rigor, or detail regarding something.
SENSES: 1. In a more exact, precise, or detailed manner.

THAYER.pt: Forma comparativa que indica um grau maior de exatidão, rigor ou detalhamento em relação a algo. 1. De maneira mais exata, precisa ou detalhada.
THAYER.en: Comparative form indicating a greater degree of exactness, rigor, or detail regarding something. 1. In a more exact, precise, or detailed manner.

DEFINITION: To seek detailed and exact information about a matter, investigating with precision.
SENSES: 1. To discover or ascertain with precision and details (Mt 2.7).

THAYER.pt: Buscar informações detalhadas e exatas sobre um assunto, investigando com precisão. 1. Descobrir ou averiguar com precisão e detalhes (Mt 2.7).
THAYER.en: To seek detailed and exact information about a matter, investigating with precision. 1. To discover or ascertain with precision and details (Mt 2.7).

DEFINITION: In a rigorous, careful manner and in strict conformity with facts or a required standard.
SENSES: 1. In an exact, diligent, and accurate way (Lk 1.3; Eph 5.15).

THAYER.pt: De maneira rigorosa, cuidadosa e em estrita conformidade com os fatos ou com um padrão exigido. 1. De forma exata, diligente e acurada (Lc 1.3; Ef 5.15).
THAYER.en: In a rigorous, careful manner and in strict conformity with facts or a required standard. 1. In an exact, diligent, and accurate way (Lk 1.3; Eph 5.15).

DEFINITION: A migratory insect found in desert regions, whose species form large swarms and served as food in the ancient Middle East.
SENSES: 1. The locust insect consumed by John the Baptist in the desert (Matt 3:4; Mark 1:6).

THAYER.pt: Inseto migratório encontrado em regiões desérticas, cujas espécies formam grandes nuvens e serviam de alimento no Oriente Médio antigo. 1. O inseto gafanhoto consumido por João Batista no deserto (Mt 3.4; Mc 1.6).
THAYER.en: A migratory insect found in desert regions, whose species form large swarms and served as food in the ancient Middle East. 1. The locust insect consumed by John the Baptist in the desert (Matt 3:4; Mark 1:6).

DEFINITION: Designates the location or hearing room where official authorities, such as the Roman procurator, heard legal cases and dispensed justice.
SENSES: 1. Hearing room or tribunal where cases were judged (Acts 25:23).

THAYER.pt: Designa o local ou sala de audiências onde autoridades oficiais, como o procurador romano, ouviam causas judiciais e dispensavam justiça. 1. Sala de audiências ou tribunal onde processos eram julgados (Ac 25.23).
THAYER.en: Designates the location or hearing room where official authorities, such as the Roman procurator, heard legal cases and dispensed justice. 1. Hearing room or tribunal where cases were judged (Acts 25:23).

DEFINITION: One who merely listens to a message or speech, often contrasted in the New Testament with the active doer of the word.
SENSES: 1. One who hears the word or instruction without necessarily applying it (Rom 2:13; Jas 1:22, 23, 25).

THAYER.pt: Aquele que apenas escuta uma mensagem ou discurso, frequentemente contrastado no Novo Testamento com o praticante ativo da palavra. 1. Aquele que ouve a palavra ou instrução sem necessariamente aplicá-la (Rm 2.13; Tg 1.22, 23, 25).
THAYER.en: One who merely listens to a message or speech, often contrasted in the New Testament with the active doer of the word. 1. One who hears the word or instruction without necessarily applying it (Rom 2:13; Jas 1:22, 23, 25).

DEFINITION: Literally refers to the foreskin, but in the New Testament it is widely used to denote the condition of uncircumcision and, by extension, as a metonym for Gentiles who do not belong to the Jewish covenant.
SENSES: 1. The physical condition of not being circumcised (Rom 4:11).
2. The Gentiles or non-Jewish peoples in contrast to the circumcised (Gal 2:7; Eph 2:11).

THAYER.pt: Literalmente refere-se ao prepúcio, mas no Novo Testamento é amplamente empregado para denotar a condição de incircuncisão e, por extensão, como metonímia para os gentios que não pertencem à aliança judaica. 1. A condição física de não ser circuncidado (Rm 4.11). | 2. Os gentios ou povos não-judeus em contraste com os circuncisos (Gl 2.7; Ef 2.11).
THAYER.en: Literally refers to the foreskin, but in the New Testament it is widely used to denote the condition of uncircumcision and, by extension, as a metonym for Gentiles who do not belong to the Jewish covenant. 1. The physical condition of not being circumcised (Rom 4:11). | 2. The Gentiles or non-Jewish peoples in contrast to the circumcised (Gal 2:7; Eph 2:11).

DEFINITION: Located at the extremity of a building, serving as the main stone that unites and supports the walls.
SENSES: 1. Cornerstone or principal stone of a building, essential to the structure (Eph 2.20).

THAYER.pt: Localizado na extremidade de uma construção, servindo como a pedra principal que une e sustenta os muros. 1. Pedra angular ou principal de um edifício, essencial à estrutura (Ef 2.20).
THAYER.en: Located at the extremity of a building, serving as the main stone that unites and supports the walls. 1. Cornerstone or principal stone of a building, essential to the structure (Eph 2.20).

DEFINITION: Originally the first and best part of the spoils of war offered to the gods, it came to mean generally the spoils or booty taken in battle.
SENSES: 1. Booty or spoils conquered in battle, used in the NT to illustrate the value of the patriarch Abraham giving the best of the spoils (Heb 7:4).

THAYER.pt: Originalmente a primeira e melhor parte dos despojos de guerra oferecida aos deuses, passou a significar de forma geral os despojos ou espólios tomados na batalha. 1. Espólio ou despojos conquistados em batalha, usados no NT para ilustrar o valor do patriarca Abraão ao dar o melhor dos despojos (Hb 7.4).
THAYER.en: Originally the first and best part of the spoils of war offered to the gods, it came to mean generally the spoils or booty taken in battle. 1. Booty or spoils conquered in battle, used in the NT to illustrate the value of the patriarch Abraham giving the best of the spoils (Heb 7:4).

DEFINITION: Refers to the highest point of an object or the final extremity and outer limit of a space.
SENSES: 1. The highest point or top of something (Heb 11:21).
2. The extreme limit or extremity of an area (Matt 24:31).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se ao ponto mais alto de um objeto ou à extremidade final e limite extremo de um espaço. 1. O ponto mais alto ou topo de algo (Hb 11.21). | 2. O limite extremo ou a extremidade de uma área (Mt 24.31).
THAYER.en: Refers to the highest point of an object or the final extremity and outer limit of a space. 1. The highest point or top of something (Heb 11:21). | 2. The extreme limit or extremity of an area (Matt 24:31).

DEFINITION: Proper name of a Jew native of Pontus, tentmaker, husband of Priscilla, and esteemed coworker of the apostle Paul.
SENSES: 1. Aquila, friend and co-worker of Paul (Ac 18.2, 26).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio de um judeu nativo do Ponto, artesão de tendas, marido de Priscila e estimado colaborador do apóstolo Paulo. 1. Áquila, amigo e cooperador de Paulo (At 18.2, 26).
THAYER.en: Proper name of a Jew native of Pontus, tentmaker, husband of Priscilla, and esteemed coworker of the apostle Paul. 1. Aquila, friend and co-worker of Paul (Ac 18.2, 26).

DEFINITION: To deprive something of its legal force or authority, rendering a law, precept, or promise ineffective.
SENSES: 1. To invalidate the authority of a norm or tradition (Mt 15.6; Mk 7.13; Gal 3.17).

THAYER.pt: Significa privar algo de sua força legal ou autoridade, tornando uma lei, preceito ou promessa ineficaz. 1. Invalidar a autoridade de uma norma ou tradição (Mt 15.6; Mc 7.13; Gl 3.17).
THAYER.en: To deprive something of its legal force or authority, rendering a law, precept, or promise ineffective. 1. To invalidate the authority of a norm or tradition (Mt 15.6; Mk 7.13; Gal 3.17).

DEFINITION: Indicates an action that occurs in an unimpeded manner, without obstacles or legal or physical restrictions.
SENSES: 1. In a free manner and without any impediment or prohibition (Ac 28.31).

THAYER.pt: Indica uma ação que ocorre de maneira desimpedida, sem obstáculos ou restrições legais ou físicas. 1. De maneira livre e sem qualquer impedimento ou proibição (Ac 28.31).
THAYER.en: Indicates an action that occurs in an unimpeded manner, without obstacles or legal or physical restrictions. 1. In a free manner and without any impediment or prohibition (Ac 28.31).

DEFINITION: Describes an action performed without spontaneous consent or by coercion, going against one's own will.
SENSES: 1. Acting against one's own will or by imposition, without free choice (1Co 9.17).

THAYER.pt: Descreve uma ação realizada sem consentimento espontâneo ou por coação, contrariando a própria vontade. 1. Agir contra a própria vontade ou por imposição, sem livre escolha (1Co 9.17).
THAYER.en: Describes an action performed without spontaneous consent or by coercion, going against one's own will. 1. Acting against one's own will or by imposition, without free choice (1Co 9.17).

DEFINITION: A small flask or vase carved from alabaster stone, frequently used to store precious perfumes and aromatic oils.
SENSES: 1. An alabaster jar containing expensive perfume (Mt 26:7; Mk 14:3; Lk 7:37).

THAYER.pt: Pequeno frasco ou vaso esculpido em pedra de alabastro, frequentemente usado para armazenar perfumes preciosos e óleos aromáticos. 1. Vaso de alabastro contendo perfume caro (Mt 26.7; Mc 14.3; Lc 7.37).
THAYER.en: A small flask or vase carved from alabaster stone, frequently used to store precious perfumes and aromatic oils. 1. An alabaster jar containing expensive perfume (Mt 26:7; Mk 14:3; Lk 7:37).

DEFINITION: An attitude of excessive pride and unfounded pretense, characterized by boastfulness and ostentation in words or actions.
SENSES: 1. Pretentious pride and unfounded arrogance (Jas 4:16; 1Jn 2:16).

THAYER.pt: Atitude de orgulho excessivo e pretensão infundada, caracterizada por vanglória e ostentação nas palavras ou ações. 1. Orgulho pretensioso e arrogância infundada (Tg 4.16; 1Jo 2.16).
THAYER.en: An attitude of excessive pride and unfounded pretense, characterized by boastfulness and ostentation in words or actions. 1. Pretentious pride and unfounded arrogance (Jas 4:16; 1Jn 2:16).

DEFINITION: An individual who boasts pretentiously and displays a false superiority with no real basis.
SENSES: 1. A proud person who brags about their supposed qualities (Rom 1:30).

THAYER.pt: Indivíduo que se gaba pretensiosamente e exibe uma falsa superioridade sem base real. 1. Pessoa orgulhosa que se gaba de suas supostas qualidades (Rm 1.30).
THAYER.en: An individual who boasts pretentiously and displays a false superiority with no real basis. 1. A proud person who brags about their supposed qualities (Rom 1:30).

DEFINITION: To emit a loud and piercing sound, either through cries of mourning at funerals or strident metallic noises.
SENSES: 1. To wail or loudly lament someone's death (Mk 5:38).
2. To produce a strident or metallic sound (1Co 13:1).

THAYER.pt: Emitir um som alto e penetrante, seja através de gritos de luto em funerais ou de ruídos metálicos estridentes. 1. Prantear ou lamentar ruidosamente a morte de alguém (Mc 5.38). | 2. Produzir um som estridente ou metálico (1Co 13.1).
THAYER.en: To emit a loud and piercing sound, either through cries of mourning at funerals or strident metallic noises. 1. To wail or loudly lament someone's death (Mk 5:38). | 2. To produce a strident or metallic sound (1Co 13:1).

DEFINITION: Refers to that which transcends the capacity of human language to express or articulate in words.
SENSES: 1. That which cannot be expressed in words or articulated by human speech (Rom 8:26).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se àquilo que transcende a capacidade da linguagem humana de expressar ou articular em palavras. 1. Aquilo que não pode ser expresso em palavras ou articulado pela fala humana (Rm 8.26).
THAYER.en: Refers to that which transcends the capacity of human language to express or articulate in words. 1. That which cannot be expressed in words or articulated by human speech (Rom 8:26).

DEFINITION: Describes the physical inability to utter articulated sounds or to speak, characterizing mute persons.
SENSES: 1. Incapable of speaking, mute (Mk 7:37; 9:17, 25).

THAYER.pt: Descreve a incapacidade física de emitir sons articulados ou de falar, caracterizando pessoas mudas. 1. Incapaz de falar, mudo (Mc 7.37; 9.17, 25).
THAYER.en: Describes the physical inability to utter articulated sounds or to speak, characterizing mute persons. 1. Incapable of speaking, mute (Mk 7:37; 9:17, 25).

DEFINITION: Essential mineral used as a seasoning, preservative, and symbol of spiritual purity and preservation.
SENSES: 1. Salt used for seasoning and preserving food (Mt 5:13; Col 4:6).

THAYER.pt: Submineral essencial usado como tempero, conservante e símbolo de pureza e preservação espiritual. 1. Sal usado para temperar e preservar alimentos (Mt 5.13; Cl 4.6).
THAYER.en: Essential mineral used as a seasoning, preservative, and symbol of spiritual purity and preservation. 1. Salt used for seasoning and preserving food (Mt 5:13; Col 4:6).

SEMANTIC_FIELD: Touch, Physical Contact, and Application of Liquids
DEFINITION: Means to apply a liquid, such as oil or perfume, onto the surface of the body or an object, whether for cosmetic, medicinal, or ritual reasons.
SENSES: 1. To anoint the body with oil or perfume in acts of care, hospitality, or burial (Lk 7:38; Mt 6:17).

THAYER.pt: Significa aplicar um líquido, como óleo ou perfume, sobre a superfície do corpo ou de um objeto, seja por motivos cosméticos, medicinais ou rituais. 1. Ungir o corpo com óleo ou perfume em atos de cuidado, hospitalidade ou sepultamento (Lc 7.38; Mt 6.17).
THAYER.en: Means to apply a liquid, such as oil or perfume, onto the surface of the body or an object, whether for cosmetic, medicinal, or ritual reasons. 1. To anoint the body with oil or perfume in acts of care, hospitality, or burial (Lk 7:38; Mt 6:17).

DEFINITION: Term denoting the exact moment of the rooster's crow, also corresponding to the third Roman night watch (between midnight and three in the morning).
SENSES: 1. The crowing of the rooster or the early morning period associated with this sound (Mk 13:35).

THAYER.pt: Termo que denota o momento exato do canto do galo, correspondendo também à terceira vigília da noite romana (entre a meia-noite e as três horas da manhã). 1. O canto do galo ou o período da madrugada associado a este som (Mc 13.35).
THAYER.en: Term denoting the exact moment of the rooster's crow, also corresponding to the third Roman night watch (between midnight and three in the morning). 1. The crowing of the rooster or the early morning period associated with this sound (Mk 13:35).

DEFINITION: Male domestic bird, famous for its morning crowing.
SENSES: 1. The rooster, whose crows served as a prophetic sign in Peter's denial (Mt 26:34).

THAYER.pt: Ave doméstica do sexo masculino, famosa por seu canto matutino. 1. O galo, cujos cantos serviram de sinal profético na negação de Pedro (Mt 26.34).
THAYER.en: Male domestic bird, famous for its morning crowing. 1. The rooster, whose crows served as a prophetic sign in Peter's denial (Mt 26:34).

DEFINITION: Designates an inhabitant or native of the important city of Alexandria in Egypt.
SENSES: 1. A native or inhabitant of the city of Alexandria (Ac 18:24).

THAYER.pt: Designa um habitante ou nativo da importante cidade de Alexandria, no Egito. 1. Natural ou habitante da cidade de Alexandria (Ac 18.24).
THAYER.en: Designates an inhabitant or native of the important city of Alexandria in Egypt. 1. A native or inhabitant of the city of Alexandria (Ac 18:24).

DEFINITION: Pertaining to or originating from the Egyptian city of Alexandria.
SENSES: 1. Relating to Alexandria, originating from there (Ac 27:6).

THAYER.pt: Pertinente ou originário da cidade egípcia de Alexandria. 1. Relativo a Alexandria, originário de lá (Ac 27.6).
THAYER.en: Pertaining to or originating from the Egyptian city of Alexandria. 1. Relating to Alexandria, originating from there (Ac 27:6).

DEFINITION: Common male proper name in the New Testament period, referring to different individuals mentioned in the apostolic narrative.
SENSES: 1. Alexander, son of Simon of Cyrene (Mk 15:21).
2. Alexander, a Jewish opponent or leader in Ephesus and false teacher (Ac 19:33; 1Tm 1:20).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio masculino comum no período neotestamentário, referente a diferentes indivíduos citados na narrativa apostólica. 1. Alexandre, filho de Simão de Cirene (Mc 15.21). | 2. Alexandre, opositor ou líder judaico em Éfeso e falso mestre (At 19.33; 1Tm 1.20).
THAYER.en: Common male proper name in the New Testament period, referring to different individuals mentioned in the apostolic narrative. 1. Alexander, son of Simon of Cyrene (Mk 15:21). | 2. Alexander, a Jewish opponent or leader in Ephesus and false teacher (Ac 19:33; 1Tm 1:20).

DEFINITION: Fine flour obtained from grinding wheat, used fundamentally for making bread.
SENSES: 1. Wheat flour used in the preparation of food (Mt 13:33).

THAYER.pt: Farinha fina obtida a partir da moagem do trigo, utilizada fundamentalmente para a fabricação de pão. 1. Farinha de trigo usada na preparação de alimentos (Mt 13.33).
THAYER.en: Fine flour obtained from grinding wheat, used fundamentally for making bread. 1. Wheat flour used in the preparation of food (Mt 13:33).

DEFINITION: Designates reality as opposed to illusion, falsehood, or mere appearance; expresses moral fidelity and reliability. In the NT, it frequently refers to supreme divine revelation personified in Christ and manifested in the gospel.
SENSES: 1. The content of that which is real and trustworthy; the revealed truth (Jn 8:32; Eph 1:13).
2. Quality of integrity, veracity, and uprightness of conduct (2Co 7:14; 1Jn 3:18).
3. Factual reality in contrast to deceptive appearance (Rom 2:2; Col 1:6).

THAYER.pt: Designa a realidade em oposição à ilusão, à falsidade ou à mera aparência; expressa fidelidade e confiabilidade moral. No NT, refere-se com frequência à suprema revelação divina personificada em Cristo e manifesta no evangelho. 1. O conteúdo daquilo que é real e fidedigno; a verdade revelada (Jo 8.32; Ef 1.13). | 2. Qualidade de integridade, veracidade e retidão de conduta (2Co 7.14; 1Jo 3.18). | 3. Realidade factual em contraste com aparência enganosa (Rm 2.2; Cl 1.6).
THAYER.en: Designates reality as opposed to illusion, falsehood, or mere appearance; expresses moral fidelity and reliability. In the NT, it frequently refers to supreme divine revelation personified in Christ and manifested in the gospel. 1. The content of that which is real and trustworthy; the revealed truth (Jn 8:32; Eph 1:13). | 2. Quality of integrity, veracity, and uprightness of conduct (2Co 7:14; 1Jn 3:18). | 3. Factual reality in contrast to deceptive appearance (Rom 2:2; Col 1:6).

DEFINITION: To act or speak in accordance with the truth, communicating correct and authentic facts.
SENSES: 1. To speak the truth or act with sincerity (Gal 4:16; Eph 4:15).

THAYER.pt: Agir ou falar de acordo com a verdade, comunicando fatos corretos e autênticos. 1. Falar a verdade ou agir com sinceridade (Gl 4.16; Ef 4.15).
THAYER.en: To act or speak in accordance with the truth, communicating correct and authentic facts. 1. To speak the truth or act with sincerity (Gal 4:16; Eph 4:15).

DEFINITION: Characteristic of that which is in strict conformity with facts, reality, or moral probity, being completely trustworthy.
SENSES: 1. Acting with frankness and honesty, true and upright (Mt 22:16).
2. In perfect conformity with the facts, true (Jn 4:18).
