THAYER.pt: Característica daquilo que está em estrita conformidade com os factos, a realidade ou a probidade moral, sendo totalmente confiável. 1. Que procede com franqueza e honestidade, verdadeiro e íntegro (Mt 22.16). | 2. Em perfeita conformidade com os fatos, verdadeiro (Jo 4.18).
THAYER.en: Characteristic of that which is in strict conformity with facts, reality, or moral probity, being completely trustworthy. 1. Acting with frankness and honesty, true and upright (Mt 22:16). | 2. In perfect conformity with the facts, true (Jn 4:18).

DEFINITION: That which is in full conformity with reality, being genuine, authentic, and reliable in contrast to what is false or illusory.
SENSES: 1. Trustworthy and true in its essence (Heb 10:22).
2. In agreement with real historical facts (Jn 4:37).
3. Genuine and authentic, corresponding to the supreme standard (Jn 1:9; 15:1).

THAYER.pt: Que está em plena conformidade com a realidade, sendo genuíno, autêntico e fidedigno em contraste com o que é falso ou ilusório. 1. Confiável e verdadeiro em sua essência (Hb 10:22). | 2. Em acordo com fatos históricos reais (Jo 4:37). | 3. Genuíno e autêntico, correspondendo ao padrão supremo (Jo 1:9; 15:1).
THAYER.en: That which is in full conformity with reality, being genuine, authentic, and reliable in contrast to what is false or illusory. 1. Trustworthy and true in its essence (Heb 10:22). | 2. In agreement with real historical facts (Jn 4:37). | 3. Genuine and authentic, corresponding to the supreme standard (Jn 1:9; 15:1).

DEFINITION: To process grains, reducing them to powder or flour by means of a mill.
SENSES: 1. To grind grain in a mill (Mt 24:41).

THAYER.pt: Processar grãos, reduzindo-os a pó ou farinha por meio de um moinho. 1. Moer grãos em um moinho (Mt 24.41).
THAYER.en: To process grains, reducing them to powder or flour by means of a mill. 1. To grind grain in a mill (Mt 24:41).

DEFINITION: Indicates that something fully corresponds to reality, without falsehood or illusion, in a true manner.
SENSES: 1. Truly, really, demonstrating the full veracity of a fact or confession (Mt 14:33; 1Th 2:13).

THAYER.pt: Indica que algo corresponde plenamente à realidade, sem falsidade ou ilusão, de modo verdadeiro. 1. Em verdade, realmente, demonstrando a plena veracidade de um fato ou confissão (Mt 14.33; 1Ts 2.13).
THAYER.en: Indicates that something fully corresponds to reality, without falsehood or illusion, in a true manner. 1. Truly, really, demonstrating the full veracity of a fact or confession (Mt 14:33; 1Th 2:13).

DEFINITION: A person whose professional occupation is catching fish, generally in lakes or seas.
SENSES: 1. A fisherman by trade (Mt 4:19; Jn 21:3).

THAYER.pt: Pessoa cuja ocupação profissional é a captura de peixes, geralmente em lagos ou mares. 1. Pescador de profissão (Mt 4.19; Jo 21.3).
THAYER.en: A person whose professional occupation is catching fish, generally in lakes or seas. 1. A fisherman by trade (Mt 4:19; Jn 21:3).

DEFINITION: The act of practicing the profession of a fisherman or catching fish using nets, hooks, or other methods.
SENSES: 1. To practice fishing or engage in fishing activity (Jn 21:3).

THAYER.pt: Ato de exercer a profissão de pescador ou de capturar peixes utilizando redes, anzóis ou outros métodos. 1. Praticar a pesca ou dedicar-se à atividade pesqueira (Jo 21.3).
THAYER.en: The act of practicing the profession of a fisherman or catching fish using nets, hooks, or other methods. 1. To practice fishing or engage in fishing activity (Jn 21:3).

DEFINITION: Means to apply salt to something in order to preserve, season, or give flavor.
SENSES: 1. To apply salt to something or restore the flavor of salt (Mt 5:13; Mk 9:49; Lk 14:34).

THAYER.pt: Significa aplicar sal a algo para preservar, temperar ou dar sabor. 1. Aplicar sal a algo ou restaurar o sabor do sal (Mt 5.13; Mc 9.49; Lc 14.34).
THAYER.en: Means to apply salt to something in order to preserve, season, or give flavor. 1. To apply salt to something or restore the flavor of salt (Mt 5:13; Mk 9:49; Lk 14:34).

DEFINITION: Refers to something that has been ceremonially contaminated or rendered impure, especially in contexts of dietary and ritual laws.
SENSES: 1. That which is considered impure or contaminated according to ritual precepts (Ac 15:20).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se a algo que foi cerimonialmente contaminado ou impuro, especialmente em contextos de leis alimentares e rituais. 1. Aquilo que é considerado impuro ou contaminado segundo preceitos rituais (Ac 15.20).
THAYER.en: Refers to something that has been ceremonially contaminated or rendered impure, especially in contexts of dietary and ritual laws. 1. That which is considered impure or contaminated according to ritual precepts (Ac 15:20).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Adversative coordinating conjunction; elided to ἀλλ’ before a vowel
DEFINITION: A strongly adversative conjunction used to establish a decisive opposition to a previous idea, commonly following a negation.
SENSES: 1. Empathetic opposition or antithetical correction after a negative: not this, but that (Mt 5:17; Rom 6:14).
2. Discourse transition to a new topic or contrasting aspect (Jn 16:7; 1Co 4:15).
3. Empathetic connective use in responses and conclusions: rather, on the contrary (Lk 12:51; 2Co 7:11).

THAYER.pt: Conjunção fortemente adversativa empregada para estabelecer oposição taxativa em relação a uma ideia anterior, comumente após uma negação. 1. Oposição enfática ou correção antitética após negativa: não isto, mas aquilo (Mt 5.17; Rm 6.14). | 2. Transição discursiva para um novo tópico ou aspecto contrastante (Jo 16.7; 1Co 4.15). | 3. Uso conectivo enfático em respostas e conclusões: antes, pelo contrário (Lc 12.51; 2Co 7.11).
THAYER.en: A strongly adversative conjunction used to establish a decisive opposition to a previous idea, commonly following a negation. 1. Empathetic opposition or antithetical correction after a negative: not this, but that (Mt 5:17; Rom 6:14). | 2. Discourse transition to a new topic or contrasting aspect (Jn 16:7; 1Co 4:15). | 3. Empathetic connective use in responses and conclusions: rather, on the contrary (Lk 12:51; 2Co 7:11).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: ἀλλάξω, Aor: ἤλλαξα, Pass: ἀλλαγήσομαι
DEFINITION: Means to modify the nature or form of something, or to carry out the exchange of one item for another.
SENSES: 1. To change or alter the condition or appearance of something (Ac 6:14; Gal 4:20).
2. To exchange or substitute one thing for another (Rom 1:23).

THAYER.pt: Significa modificar a natureza ou a forma de algo, ou realizar a troca de um item por outro. 1. Mudar ou alterar a condição ou aparência de algo (At 6.14; Gl 4.20). | 2. Trocar ou substituir uma coisa por outra (Rm 1.23).
THAYER.en: Means to modify the nature or form of something, or to carry out the exchange of one item for another. 1. To change or alter the condition or appearance of something (Ac 6:14; Gal 4:20). | 2. To exchange or substitute one thing for another (Rom 1:23).

DEFINITION: Indicates the origin from a different source or direction, coming from another point.
SENSES: 1. From elsewhere, from some other place or by another way (Jn 10:1).

THAYER.pt: Indica a procedência de uma fonte ou direção diferente, vindo de outro ponto. 1. De outra parte, de algum outro lugar ou por outro caminho (Jo 10.1).
THAYER.en: Indicates the origin from a different source or direction, coming from another point. 1. From elsewhere, from some other place or by another way (Jn 10:1).

DEFINITION: To employ figurative or analogical language where historical or literal facts possess a deeper spiritual or hidden meaning.
SENSES: 1. To interpret or express something through allegories and analogies (Gal 4:24).

THAYER.pt: Empregar uma linguagem figurada ou analógica onde fatos históricos ou literais possuem um sentido espiritual ou oculto mais profundo. 1. Interpretar ou expressar algo por meio de alegorias e analogias (Gl 4.24).
THAYER.en: To employ figurative or analogical language where historical or literal facts possess a deeper spiritual or hidden meaning. 1. To interpret or express something through allegories and analogies (Gal 4:24).

DEFINITION: Liturgical expression of Hebrew origin meaning 'Praise Yahweh', used in worship assemblies to exalt the greatness of God.
SENSES: 1. Liturgical exclamation of praise to God in heavenly and cultic contexts (Rev 19:1, 3, 4, 6).

THAYER.pt: Expressão litúrgica de origem hebraica que significa 'Louvai a Javé', usada nas assembleias de adoração para exaltar a grandeza de Deus. 1. Exclamação litúrgica de louvor a Deus no contexto celestial e cultual (Ap 19.1, 3, 4, 6).
THAYER.en: Liturgical expression of Hebrew origin meaning 'Praise Yahweh', used in worship assemblies to exalt the greatness of God. 1. Liturgical exclamation of praise to God in heavenly and cultic contexts (Rev 19:1, 3, 4, 6).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Reciprocal pronoun, genitive plural (lacks nominative and singular)
DEFINITION: Reciprocal pronoun denoting bilateral exchange or mutual interpersonal community relationship between two or more parties.
SENSES: 1. Reciprocal action or obligation among members of the body and the church (Jn 13:34; Gal 6:2).
2. Mutual relationship of general attitudes, interactions, or feelings (Lk 24:32; Rom 1:27).

THAYER.pt: Pronome recíproco que denota troca bilateral ou relação interpessoal comunitária mútua entre duas ou mais partes. 1. Ação ou obrigação recíproca entre membros do corpo e da igreja (Jo 13.34; Gl 6.2). | 2. Relação mútua de atitudes, interações ou sentimentos gerais (Lc 24.32; Rm 1.27).
THAYER.en: Reciprocal pronoun denoting bilateral exchange or mutual interpersonal community relationship between two or more parties. 1. Reciprocal action or obligation among members of the body and the church (Jn 13:34; Gal 6:2). | 2. Mutual relationship of general attitudes, interactions, or feelings (Lk 24:32; Rom 1:27).

DEFINITION: Describes someone who belongs to a nation, ethnicity, or group different from the reference group, lacking common kinship ties.
SENSES: 1. A person belonging to another people or nation, a foreigner (Luke 17:18).

THAYER.pt: Descreve alguém que pertence a uma nação, etnia ou grupo diferente daquele de referência, sem laços de parentesco comum. 1. Pessoa pertencente a outro povo ou nação, um estrangeiro (Lc 17.18).
THAYER.en: Describes someone who belongs to a nation, ethnicity, or group different from the reference group, lacking common kinship ties. 1. A person belonging to another people or nation, a foreigner (Luke 17:18).

DEFINITION: Describes a rapid upward movement, whether leaping with the body or figuratively with liquids springing forth.
SENSES: 1. To leap or jump with the body (Acts 3:8; 14:10).
2. To bubble or gush forth, referring to water springs (John 4:14).

THAYER.pt: Descreve um movimento rápido para cima, seja saltando com o corpo ou figuradamente com líquidos brotando. 1. Dar saltos ou pular com o corpo (At 3.8; 14.10). | 2. Borbulhar ou jorrar, referindo-se a fontes de água (Jo 4.14).
THAYER.en: Describes a rapid upward movement, whether leaping with the body or figuratively with liquids springing forth. 1. To leap or jump with the body (Acts 3:8; 14:10). | 2. To bubble or gush forth, referring to water springs (John 4:14).

DEFINITION: Denotes an additional or distinct entity in relation to one previously mentioned. While often indicating numerical distinction of the same class, in Hellenistic Greek it may alternate in meaning with heteros.
SENSES: 1. Another numerically, one more of the same kind (John 14:16; Matt 27:42).
2. Another of a different nature, distinct in quality (1 Cor 15:39; Gal 1:7).

THAYER.pt: Denota uma entidade adicional ou distinta em relação a outra previamente mencionada. Embora frequentemente indique distinção numérica da mesma classe, pode no grego helenístico alternar de sentido com heteros. 1. Outro numericamente, mais um da mesma espécie (Jo 14.16; Mt 27.42). | 2. Outro de natureza diferente, distinto em qualidade (1Co 15.39; Gl 1.7).
THAYER.en: Denotes an additional or distinct entity in relation to one previously mentioned. While often indicating numerical distinction of the same class, in Hellenistic Greek it may alternate in meaning with heteros. 1. Another numerically, one more of the same kind (John 14:16; Matt 27:42). | 2. Another of a different nature, distinct in quality (1 Cor 15:39; Gal 1:7).

DEFINITION: One who meddles in the affairs of others or who assumes the role of overseeing the lives of other people inappropriately.
SENSES: 1. Someone who interferes or meddles in the business of others without authorization (1 Pet 4:15).

THAYER.pt: Aquele que se intromete em assuntos alheios ou que assume o papel de fiscalizar a vida de outras pessoas de forma indevida. 1. Alguém que interfere ou se mete nos negócios dos outros sem autorização (1Pe 4.15).
THAYER.en: One who meddles in the affairs of others or who assumes the role of overseeing the lives of other people inappropriately. 1. Someone who interferes or meddles in the business of others without authorization (1 Pet 4:15).

DEFINITION: That which belongs to another person, is outside the group, or is considered hostile.
SENSES: 1. Belonging to another, not one's own or personal (Luke 16:12; John 10:5).
2. Foreign, hostile, or strange to local customs (Heb 11:34).

THAYER.pt: Que pertence a outra pessoa, que é de fora do grupo ou considerado hostil. 1. Que pertence a outrem, não sendo próprio ou pessoal (Lc 16.12; Jo 10.5). | 2. Estrangeiro, hostil ou estranho aos costumes locais (Hb 11.34).
THAYER.en: That which belongs to another person, is outside the group, or is considered hostile. 1. Belonging to another, not one's own or personal (Luke 16:12; John 10:5). | 2. Foreign, hostile, or strange to local customs (Heb 11:34).

DEFINITION: A term used from the Jewish perspective to designate those who do not belong to the people of Israel, referring to Gentiles or pagans.
SENSES: 1. An individual of another nation or culture, a foreigner or Gentile (Acts 10:28).

THAYER.pt: Termo usado na perspectiva judaica para designar quem não pertence ao povo de Israel, referindo-se aos gentios ou pagãos. 1. Indivíduo de outra nação ou cultura, estrangeiro ou gentio (Ac 10.28).
THAYER.en: A term used from the Jewish perspective to designate those who do not belong to the people of Israel, referring to Gentiles or pagans. 1. An individual of another nation or culture, a foreigner or Gentile (Acts 10:28).

DEFINITION: Indicates a difference in the manner, condition, or method of performing something in contrast to the standard.
SENSES: 1. In a diverse manner, otherwise, or by other means (1 Tim 5:25).

THAYER.pt: Indica uma diferença na maneira, condição ou método de realizar algo em contraste com o padrão. 1. De maneira diversa, de outra forma ou por outros meios (1Tm 5.25).
THAYER.en: Indicates a difference in the manner, condition, or method of performing something in contrast to the standard. 1. In a diverse manner, otherwise, or by other means (1 Tim 5:25).

DEFINITION: Describes the agricultural activity of separating grain from chaff, either by treading with animals or beating the stalks.
SENSES: 1. To thresh grain or tread out wheat (1 Cor 9:9, 10; 1 Tim 5:18).

THAYER.pt: Descreve a atividade agrícola de separar o grão da palha, seja pisando com animais ou batendo nas espigas. 1. Debulhar grãos ou pisar o trigo (1Co 9.9, 10; 1Tm 5.18).
THAYER.en: Describes the agricultural activity of separating grain from chaff, either by treading with animals or beating the stalks. 1. To thresh grain or tread out wheat (1 Cor 9:9, 10; 1 Tim 5:18).

DEFINITION: Describes that which lacks the capacity for reasoning or is contrarily irrational and absurd.
SENSES: 1. Devoid of rational capacity, irrational (2 Pet 2:12; Jude 10).
2. Contrary to reason or without foundation, absurd (Acts 25:27).

THAYER.pt: Descreve aquilo que carece de capacidade de raciocínio ou que é contrariamente irracional e absurdo. 1. Desprovido de capacidade racional, irracional (2Pe 2.12; Jd 10). | 2. Contrário à razão ou sem fundamento, absurdo (At 25.27).
THAYER.en: Describes that which lacks the capacity for reasoning or is contrarily irrational and absurd. 1. Devoid of rational capacity, irrational (2 Pet 2:12; Jude 10). | 2. Contrary to reason or without foundation, absurd (Acts 25:27).

DEFINITION: An aromatic resin extracted from plants, widely used in the ancient world along with spices for the embalming of bodies.
SENSES: 1. An aromatic plant substance used in funeral rituals (John 19:39).

THAYER.pt: Resina aromática extraída de plantas, amplamente utilizada no mundo antigo juntamente com especiarias para o embalsamamento de corpos. 1. Substância aromática vegetal usada em rituais funerários (Jo 19.39).
THAYER.en: An aromatic resin extracted from plants, widely used in the ancient world along with spices for the embalming of bodies. 1. An aromatic plant substance used in funeral rituals (John 19:39).

DEFINITION: A mineral substance essential in antiquity for seasoning food, preserving meat, and symbolizing covenants and purity.
SENSES: 1. Mineral salt used as a seasoning or preservative in cooking and in spiritual metaphors (Matt 5:13; Col 4:6).

THAYER.pt: Substância mineral essencial usada na antiguidade para temperar alimentos, preservar carnes e simbolizar alianças e pureza. 1. O sal mineral usado como tempero ou conservante na culinária e em metáforas espirituais (Mt 5.13; Cl 4.6).
THAYER.en: A mineral substance essential in antiquity for seasoning food, preserving meat, and symbolizing covenants and purity. 1. Mineral salt used as a seasoning or preservative in cooking and in spiritual metaphors (Matt 5:13; Col 4:6).

DEFINITION: That which possesses the taste or properties characteristic of salt.
SENSES: 1. Having the taste of salt or containing salt in its composition (Jas 3:12).

THAYER.pt: Que possui o sabor ou as propriedades características do sal. 1. Que tem gosto de sal ou contém sal em sua composição (Tg 3.12).
THAYER.en: That which possesses the taste or properties characteristic of salt. 1. Having the taste of salt or containing salt in its composition (Jas 3:12).

DEFINITION: The state of someone who is free from excessive worries, sorrows, or anxieties.
SENSES: 1. Free from afflictions or anguish, providing tranquility (Phil 2:28).

THAYER.pt: Estado de alguém que está livre de preocupações, tristezas ou ansiedades excessivas. 1. Livre de aflições ou angústias, proporcionando tranquilidade (Fp 2.28).
THAYER.en: The state of someone who is free from excessive worries, sorrows, or anxieties. 1. Free from afflictions or anguish, providing tranquility (Phil 2:28).

DEFINITION: A metal instrument composed of links used to bind prisoners, also representing, by extension, the state of captivity itself.
SENSES: 1. A metal chain or shackle to immobilize prisoners (Mark 5:3; Acts 21:33).
2. A state of imprisonment or physical restriction (Eph 6:20; 2 Tim 1:16).

THAYER.pt: Um instrumento metálico composto de elos usado para prender prisioneiros, representando também, por extensão, o próprio estado de cativeiro. 1. Corrente ou algema de metal para imobilizar prisioneiros (Mc 5.3; At 21.33). | 2. Estado de aprisionamento ou restrição física (Ef 6.20; 2Tm 1.16).
THAYER.en: A metal instrument composed of links used to bind prisoners, also representing, by extension, the state of captivity itself. 1. A metal chain or shackle to immobilize prisoners (Mark 5:3; Acts 21:33). | 2. A state of imprisonment or physical restriction (Eph 6:20; 2 Tim 1:16).

DEFINITION: Refers to something that brings no profit, advantage, or benefit, and may result in harm or loss.
SENSES: 1. That which brings no benefit or is spiritually disadvantageous (Heb 13:17).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se a algo que não traz nenhum proveito, vantagem ou benefício, podendo resultar em dano ou prejuízo. 1. O que não traz nenhum benefício ou é espiritualmente desvantajoso (Hb 13.17).
THAYER.en: Refers to something that brings no profit, advantage, or benefit, and may result in harm or loss. 1. That which brings no benefit or is spiritually disadvantageous (Heb 13:17).

DEFINITION: A man's proper name, mentioned in the New Testament as the father of some disciples.
SENSES: 1. Alphaeus, father of James and Levi/Matthew (Matt 10:3; Mark 2:14).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio de homem, mencionado no Novo Testamento como pai de alguns discípulos. 1. Alfeu, pai de Tiago e de Levi/Mateus (Mt 10.3; Mc 2.14).
THAYER.en: A man's proper name, mentioned in the New Testament as the father of some disciples. 1. Alphaeus, father of James and Levi/Matthew (Matt 10:3; Mark 2:14).

DEFINITION: A flat area with a hard floor where cereal bundles were threshed to separate grain from chaff, also referring to the harvested cereal itself.
SENSES: 1. Threshing floor, the space prepared for threshing grain.
2. The wheat or grain itself heaped on the threshing floor for threshing.

THAYER.pt: Área plana de piso duro onde os feixes de cereais eram debulhados para separar o grão da palha, referindo-se também ao próprio cereal colhido. 1. Eira, o espaço preparado para debulhar grãos. | 2. O próprio trigo ou grão amontoado na eira para a debulha.
THAYER.en: A flat area with a hard floor where cereal bundles were threshed to separate grain from chaff, also referring to the harvested cereal itself. 1. Threshing floor, the space prepared for threshing grain. | 2. The wheat or grain itself heaped on the threshing floor for threshing.

DEFINITION: Designates the mammal known for its cunning, also used metaphorically in the New Testament.
SENSES: 1. The animal fox (Matt 8:20; Luke 9:58).
2. Metaphorically for a cunning and treacherous person (Luke 13:32).

THAYER.pt: Designa o animal mamífero conhecido por sua astúcia, sendo usado também de forma metafórica no Novo Testamento. 1. O animal raposa (Mt 8.20; Lc 9.58). | 2. Metaforicamente para uma pessoa astuta e traiçoeira (Lc 13.32).
THAYER.en: Designates the mammal known for its cunning, also used metaphorically in the New Testament. 1. The animal fox (Matt 8:20; Luke 9:58). | 2. Metaphorically for a cunning and treacherous person (Luke 13:32).

DEFINITION: The action of hunting, capturing, or seizing animals or living beings, frequently used in metaphors regarding destruction.
SENSES: 1. The act of capturing animals for slaughter or imprisonment (2 Pet 2:12).

THAYER.pt: A ação de caçar, capturar ou apurar animais ou seres vivos, frequentemente usada em metáforas sobre destruição. 1. O ato de capturar animais para o abate ou aprisionamento (2Pe 2.12).
THAYER.en: The action of hunting, capturing, or seizing animals or living beings, frequently used in metaphors regarding destruction. 1. The act of capturing animals for slaughter or imprisonment (2 Pet 2:12).

SHORT_GLOSS: at the same time, together with
DEFINITION: Used to indicate temporal simultaneity between two events or close association between persons and things.
SENSES: 1. At the same instant, simultaneously (Acts 24:26).
2. In company with, together with, accompanied by (Matt 13:29; 1 Thess 4:17).
USAGE: at the same time, together with

THAYER.pt: Utilizado para indicar simultaneidade temporal entre dois eventos ou associação próxima entre pessoas e coisas. 1. No mesmo instante, simultaneamente (At 24.26). | 2. Em companhia de, junto com, acompanhado por (Mt 13.29; 1Ts 4.17).
THAYER.en: Used to indicate temporal simultaneity between two events or close association between persons and things. 1. At the same instant, simultaneously (Acts 24:26). | 2. In company with, together with, accompanied by (Matt 13:29; 1 Thess 4:17).

DEFINITION: One who lacks formal instruction or deep knowledge, potentially denoting a lack of discernment.
SENSES: 1. A person without formal education or ignorant regarding specific teachings (2 Pet 3:16).

THAYER.pt: Aquele que carece de instrução formal ou conhecimento profundo, podendo denotar falta de discernimento. 1. Pessoa sem instrução formal ou ignorante em relação a determinados ensinamentos (2Pe 3.16).
THAYER.en: One who lacks formal instruction or deep knowledge, potentially denoting a lack of discernment. 1. A person without formal education or ignorant regarding specific teachings (2 Pet 3:16).

DEFINITION: Made of or resembling the amaranth, a mythical flower that never withers; used to describe eternal glory or reward.
SENSES: 1. That which does not lose its luster or beauty, incorruptible and eternal (1 Pet 5:4).

THAYER.pt: Feito de ou semelhante ao amaranto, uma flor mítica que nunca murcha; usado para descrever glória ou galardão eterno. 1. Que não perde o seu brilho ou beleza, incorruptível e eterno (1Pe 5.4).
THAYER.en: Made of or resembling the amaranth, a mythical flower that never withers; used to describe eternal glory or reward. 1. That which does not lose its luster or beauty, incorruptible and eternal (1 Pet 5:4).

DEFINITION: The quality of that which remains perennial, without decaying, corrupting, or losing its original purity.
SENSES: 1. An attribute of the heavenly inheritance that never loses its value or deteriorates (1 Pet 1:4).

THAYER.pt: Qualidade daquilo que permanece perene, sem decair, corromper-se ou perder a sua pureza original. 1. Atributo da herança celestial que jamais perde o seu valor ou se deteriora (1Pe 1.4).
THAYER.en: The quality of that which remains perennial, without decaying, corrupting, or losing its original purity. 1. An attribute of the heavenly inheritance that never loses its value or deteriorates (1 Pet 1:4).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: ἁμαρτήσω; Aor: ἥμαρτον; Perf: ἡμάρτηκα
SHORT_GLOSS: to sin, to err, to commit a fault
DEFINITION: To act in disagreement with the will, law, or character of God, failing morally or missing the divine mark.
SENSES: 1. To commit a transgression or sin against God or neighbor (Matt 18:15; Rom 3:23).
2. To perform a morally wrong action that violates divine precepts or established laws (1 Cor 6:18; 1 John 5:16).
USAGE: to sin, to err, to commit a fault

THAYER.pt: Agir em desacordo com a vontade, a lei ou o caráter de Deus, falhando moralmente ou errando o alvo divino. 1. Cometer uma transgressão ou pecado contra Deus ou contra o próximo (Mt 18.15; Rm 3.23). | 2. Praticar uma ação moralmente errada que viola preceitos divinos ou leis estabelecidas (1Co 6.18; 1Jo 5.16).
THAYER.en: To act in disagreement with the will, law, or character of God, failing morally or missing the divine mark. 1. To commit a transgression or sin against God or neighbor (Matt 18:15; Rom 3:23). | 2. To perform a morally wrong action that violates divine precepts or established laws (1 Cor 6:18; 1 John 5:16).

DEFINITION: A specific act of violation of divine law or moral deviation, representing a concrete action contrary to the holy will of God.
SENSES: 1. A specific sinful action or transgression (Mark 3:29; Rom 3:25; 5:16).

THAYER.pt: Ato específico de violação da lei divina ou desvio moral, representando uma ação concreta contrária à vontade santa de Deus. 1. Uma ação pecaminosa específica ou transgressão (Mc 3.29; Rm 3.25; 5.16).
THAYER.en: A specific act of violation of divine law or moral deviation, representing a concrete action contrary to the holy will of God. 1. A specific sinful action or transgression (Mark 3:29; Rom 3:25; 5:16).

DEFINITION: Etymologically 'to miss the mark.' In the biblical context, it denotes the deviation from God's holy precepts, constituting moral rebellion and voluntary transgression. Paul often personifies it as a universal tyrannical power that enslaves humanity without Christ.
SENSES: 1. An act of deliberate moral disobedience against the divine will (Matt 26:28; 1 John 3:4).
2. An existential condition of inherent depravity or culpability (John 9:41; Rom 3:9).
3. A force or power almost personified that dominates the fallen human being (Rom 5:12; Rom 7:8).

THAYER.pt: Etimologicamente 'errar o alvo'. No contexto bíblico, denota o desvio dos preceitos santos de Deus, constituindo rebelião moral e transgressão voluntária. Paulo a personifica amiúde como um poder tirânico universal que escraviza a humanidade sem Cristo. 1. Ato de desobediência moral deliberada contra a vontade divina (Mt 26.28; 1Jo 3.4). | 2. Condição existencial de depravação ou culpabilidade inerente (Jo 9.41; Rm 3.9). | 3. Força ou poder quase personificado que domina o ser humano caído (Rm 5.12; Rm 7.8).
THAYER.en: Etymologically 'to miss the mark.' In the biblical context, it denotes the deviation from God's holy precepts, constituting moral rebellion and voluntary transgression. Paul often personifies it as a universal tyrannical power that enslaves humanity without Christ. 1. An act of deliberate moral disobedience against the divine will (Matt 26:28; 1 John 3:4). | 2. An existential condition of inherent depravity or culpability (John 9:41; Rom 3:9). | 3. A force or power almost personified that dominates the fallen human being (Rom 5:12; Rom 7:8).

DEFINITION: Lacking witnesses or evidence that proves a fact.
SENSES: 1. Devoid of witness or visible external evidence (Acts 14:17).

THAYER.pt: Que carece de testemunhas ou de evidências que comprovem um fato. 1. Desprovido de testemunho ou evidência externa visível (Ac 14.17).
THAYER.en: Lacking witnesses or evidence that proves a fact. 1. Devoid of witness or visible external evidence (Acts 14:17).

DEFINITION: Indicates one who lives in patent disagreement with the will or Law of God, transgressing moral precepts. It is widely used as a noun to designate marginalized individuals or notorious religious and social transgressors.
SENSES: 1. As an adjective: living in sin, guilty before God (Rom 7:13; Mark 8:38).
2. As a noun: a habitually sinful person, a transgressor of the Law (Luke 5:8; 1 Tim 1:15).
3. In a Jewish socio-religious sense: outsiders, tax collectors, and pagans considered impure or indifferent to tradition (Matt 9:10; Gal 2:15).

THAYER.pt: Indica quem vive em desacordo patente com a vontade ou Lei de Deus, transgredindo preceitos morais. É amplamente empregado como substantivo para designar indivíduos marginalizados ou notórios transgressores religiosos e sociais. 1. Como adjetivo: que vive no pecado, culpado perante Deus (Rm 7.13; Mc 8.38). | 2. Como substantivo: pessoa habitualmente pecadora, transgressora da Lei (Lc 5.8; 1Tm 1.15). | 3. Em sentido sociorreligioso judaico: forasteiros, publicanos e pagãos tidos como impuros ou indiferentes à tradição (Mt 9.10; Gl 2.15).
THAYER.en: Indicates one who lives in patent disagreement with the will or Law of God, transgressing moral precepts. It is widely used as a noun to designate marginalized individuals or notorious religious and social transgressors. 1. As an adjective: living in sin, guilty before God (Rom 7:13; Mark 8:38). | 2. As a noun: a habitually sinful person, a transgressor of the Law (Luke 5:8; 1 Tim 1:15). | 3. In a Jewish socio-religious sense: outsiders, tax collectors, and pagans considered impure or indifferent to tradition (Matt 9:10; Gal 2:15).

DEFINITION: One who avoids fights, contentions, and disputes, characterized by a peaceful stance.
SENSES: 1. Peaceable, avoiding fights and contentions (Titus 3:2).

THAYER.pt: Que evita brigas, contendas e disputas, caracterizando-se por uma postura pacífica. 1. Pacíficos, que evitam brigas e contendas (Tt 3.2).
THAYER.en: One who avoids fights, contentions, and disputes, characterized by a peaceful stance. 1. Peaceable, avoiding fights and contentions (Titus 3:2).

DEFINITION: The act of cutting grass, wheat, or cereals in fields using sickles during the harvest season.
SENSES: 1. To reap or harvest wheat and other agricultural crops (James 5:4).

THAYER.pt: Ato de cortar capim, trigo ou cereais nos campos utilizando foices durante a época da colheita. 1. Ceifar ou colher o trigo e outras plantações agrícolas (Tg 5.4).
THAYER.en: The act of cutting grass, wheat, or cereals in fields using sickles during the harvest season. 1. To reap or harvest wheat and other agricultural crops (James 5:4).

DEFINITION: A precious stone of violet or purple color, famous in antiquity and mentioned in the description of the foundations of the New Jerusalem.
SENSES: 1. Amethyst, a purplish precious stone used in jewelry and ornaments (Rev 21:20).

THAYER.pt: Pedra preciosa de coloração violeta ou púrpura, famosa na antiguidade e mencionada na descrição dos fundamentos da Nova Jerusalém. 1. Ametista, pedra preciosa de tom arroxeado usada em joias e ornamentos (Ap 21.20).
THAYER.en: A precious stone of violet or purple color, famous in antiquity and mentioned in the description of the foundations of the New Jerusalem. 1. Amethyst, a purplish precious stone used in jewelry and ornaments (Rev 21:20).

DEFINITION: To demonstrate a lack of care, disinterest, or disregard for something important, failing to give due attention to obligations or privileges.
SENSES: 1. To neglect or be careless of something or someone (1 Tim 4:14; Heb 2:3; 8:9).

THAYER.pt: Demonstrar falta de cuidado, desinteresse ou desconsideração por algo importante, deixando de dar a devida atenção a obrigações ou privilégios. 1. Negligenciar ou descuidar de algo ou alguém (1Tm 4.14; Hb 2.3; 8.9).
THAYER.en: To demonstrate a lack of care, disinterest, or disregard for something important, failing to give due attention to obligations or privileges. 1. To neglect or be careless of something or someone (1 Tim 4:14; Heb 2:3; 8:9).

DEFINITION: The quality of someone who lives without guilt or moral defect before God and men.
SENSES: 1. Exempt from guilt or reproach, irreproachable (Luke 1:6; Phil 3:6).

THAYER.pt: Qualidade de alguém que vive sem culpa ou defeito moral perante Deus e os homens. 1. Isento de culpa ou repreensão, irrepreensível (Lc 1.6; Fp 3.6).
THAYER.en: The quality of someone who lives without guilt or moral defect before God and men. 1. Exempt from guilt or reproach, irreproachable (Luke 1:6; Phil 3:6).

DEFINITION: In an irreproachable manner, without any fault, guilt, or legitimate accusation to be made.
SENSES: 1. In an irreproachable manner and without guilt before God or men (1 Thess 2:10; 5:23).

THAYER.pt: De maneira irrepreensível, sem que haja qualquer falha, culpa ou acusação legítima a fazer. 1. De maneira irrepreensível e sem culpa perante Deus ou os homens (1Ts 2.10; 5.23).
THAYER.en: In an irreproachable manner, without any fault, guilt, or legitimate accusation to be made. 1. In an irreproachable manner and without guilt before God or men (1 Thess 2:10; 5:23).

DEFINITION: Describes a state of freedom from anxiety, worry, or fear, potentially denoting both legitimate tranquility and careless false security.
SENSES: 1. Free from excessive anxieties or worries regarding earthly affairs (1 Cor 7:32).
2. To be without fear or unconcerned in the face of imminent dangers (Matt 28:14).

THAYER.pt: Descreve um estado de isenção de ansiedade, preocupação ou temor, podendo denotar tanto uma tranquilidade legítima quanto uma falsa segurança descuidada. 1. Livre de ansiedades ou preocupações excessivas quanto aos afazeres terrenos (1Co 7.32). | 2. Estar sem temor ou despreocupado diante de perigos iminentes (Mt 28.14).
THAYER.en: Describes a state of freedom from anxiety, worry, or fear, potentially denoting both legitimate tranquility and careless false security. 1. Free from excessive anxieties or worries regarding earthly affairs (1 Cor 7:32). | 2. To be without fear or unconcerned in the face of imminent dangers (Matt 28:14).

DEFINITION: Refers to that which cannot be changed, altered, or revoked, remaining firm and constant in its purpose or original state.
SENSES: 1. The unalterable character and absolute firmness of a divine promise or decree (Heb 6:17, 18).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se àquilo que não pode ser mudado, alterado ou revogado, mantendo-se firme e constante em seu propósito ou estado original. 1. Caráter inalterável e firmeza absoluta de uma promessa ou decreto divino (Hb 6.17, 18).
THAYER.en: Refers to that which cannot be changed, altered, or revoked, remaining firm and constant in its purpose or original state. 1. The unalterable character and absolute firmness of a divine promise or decree (Heb 6:17, 18).

DEFINITION: Describes something or someone that cannot be moved, remaining absolutely firm and constant in their position or conviction.
SENSES: 1. Unshakable and firm in the Christian faith and the work of the Lord (1 Cor 15:58).

THAYER.pt: Descreve algo ou alguém que não pode ser movido, permanecendo absolutamente firme e constante em sua posição ou convicção. 1. Inabalável e firme na fé cristã e na obra do Senhor (1Co 15.58).
THAYER.en: Describes something or someone that cannot be moved, remaining absolutely firm and constant in their position or conviction. 1. Unshakable and firm in the Christian faith and the work of the Lord (1 Cor 15:58).

DEFINITION: Indicates something that does not bring subsequent regret or that cannot be revoked by the one who granted it, expressing definitiveness.
SENSES: 1. Divine gifts and callings that are granted irrevocably, without change of purpose (Rom 11:29).
2. A godly sorrow that produces salvation of which one never laments or repents (2 Cor 7:10).

THAYER.pt: Indica algo que não traz arrependimento posterior ou que não pode ser revogado por quem o concedeu, expressando definitividade. 1. Dons e chamados divinos que são concedidos de forma irrevogável, sem mudança de propósito (Rm 11.29). | 2. Uma tristeza segundo Deus que produz salvação da qual jamais se lamenta ou arrepende (2Co 7.10).
THAYER.en: Indicates something that does not bring subsequent regret or that cannot be revoked by the one who granted it, expressing definitiveness. 1. Divine gifts and callings that are granted irrevocably, without change of purpose (Rom 11:29). | 2. A godly sorrow that produces salvation of which one never laments or repents (2 Cor 7:10).

DEFINITION: Refers to a person who stubbornly refuses to repent of their sins, thus storing up wrath for the day of judgment.
SENSES: 1. One who refuses to repent and turn to God (Rom 2:5).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se a uma pessoa que recusa obstinadamente arrepender-se de seus pecados, acumulando assim ira para o dia do juízo. 1. Que se recusa a arrepender-se e voltar-se para Deus (Rm 2.5).
THAYER.en: Refers to a person who stubbornly refuses to repent of their sins, thus storing up wrath for the day of judgment. 1. One who refuses to repent and turn to God (Rom 2:5).

DEFINITION: That which exceeds the normal limits of measurement or cannot be measured by human standards.
SENSES: 1. Scope or measure that exceeds established or imaginable limits (2 Cor 10:13).

THAYER.pt: Aquilo que ultrapassa os limites normais de medição ou que não pode ser mensurado por padrões humanos. 1. Alcance ou medida que excede os limites estabelecidos ou imagináveis (2Co 10.13).
THAYER.en: That which exceeds the normal limits of measurement or cannot be measured by human standards. 1. Scope or measure that exceeds established or imaginable limits (2 Cor 10:13).

DEFINITION: A transliterated Hebrew word expressing firm certainty, convinced approval, and faith. Used liturgically as an affirmative agreement at the end of prayers and, on the lips of Jesus in the Gospels, to introduce solemn and authoritative declarations.
SENSES: 1. Congregational or liturgical response of confirmation ('so be it') (1 Cor 14:16; Rev 5:14).
2. Solemn introduction to the declaration of truth ('truly I say to you') (Matt 5:18; John 3:3).
3. Christological title referring to Christ as the faithful witness and consummation of truth (Rev 3:14).

THAYER.pt: Palavra hebraica transliterada que expressa firme certeza, aprovação convicta e fé. Utilizada litúrgicamente como concordância afirmativa ao final de orações e, nos lábios de Jesus nos Evangelhos, para introduzir declarações solenes e autoritativas. 1. Resposta congregacional ou litúrgica de confirmação ('assim seja') (1Co 14.16; Ap 5.14). | 2. Introdução solene à declaração da verdade ('em verdade vos digo') (Mt 5.18; Jo 3.3). | 3. Título cristológico referente a Cristo como a testemunha fiel e consumação da verdade (Ap 3.14).
THAYER.en: A transliterated Hebrew word expressing firm certainty, convinced approval, and faith. Used liturgically as an affirmative agreement at the end of prayers and, on the lips of Jesus in the Gospels, to introduce solemn and authoritative declarations. 1. Congregational or liturgical response of confirmation ('so be it') (1 Cor 14:16; Rev 5:14). | 2. Solemn introduction to the declaration of truth ('truly I say to you') (Matt 5:18; John 3:3). | 3. Christological title referring to Christ as the faithful witness and consummation of truth (Rev 3:14).

DEFINITION: A term indicating the absence of a genealogical record of a mother, applied in the New Testament figuratively and theologically to the priesthood of Melchizedek.
SENSES: 1. Devoid of a record of a mother, in a typological and eternal sense (Heb 7:3).

THAYER.pt: Termo que indica a ausência de registro genealógico de mãe, aplicado no Novo Testamento de forma figurada e teológica ao sacerdócio de Melquisedeque. 1. Desprovido de registro de mãe, em sentido tipológico e eterno (Hb 7.3).
THAYER.en: A term indicating the absence of a genealogical record of a mother, applied in the New Testament figuratively and theologically to the priesthood of Melchizedek. 1. Devoid of a record of a mother, in a typological and eternal sense (Heb 7:3).

DEFINITION: Describes something or someone who is free from moral, religious, or physical contamination, remaining pure and untouched by evil.
SENSES: 1. Inviolable moral and spiritual purity of persons or things (Heb 7:26; 13:4; Jas 1:27; 1 Pet 1:4).

THAYER.pt: Descreve algo ou alguém que está livre de contaminação moral, religiosa ou física, mantendo-se puro e intocado pelo mal. 1. Pureza moral e espiritual inviolável de pessoas ou coisas (Hb 7.26; 13.4; Tg 1.27; 1Pe 1.4).
THAYER.en: Describes something or someone who is free from moral, religious, or physical contamination, remaining pure and untouched by evil. 1. Inviolable moral and spiritual purity of persons or things (Heb 7:26; 13:4; Jas 1:27; 1 Pet 1:4).

DEFINITION: Proper name of an ancestral patriarch in the genealogy of Jesus according to the New Testament.
SENSES: 1. Amminadab, an ancestor in the messianic lineage (Matt 1:4; Luke 3:33).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio de um patriarca ancestral na genealogia de Jesus segundo o Novo Testamento. 1. Aminadab, ancestral na linhagem messiânica (Mt 1.4; Lc 3.33).
THAYER.en: Proper name of an ancestral patriarch in the genealogy of Jesus according to the New Testament. 1. Amminadab, an ancestor in the messianic lineage (Matt 1:4; Luke 3:33).

DEFINITION: Fine grains of rock found on beaches or in deserts, frequently used in the NT to denote a great multitude or uncountable vastness.
SENSES: 1. Sand of the seashore or the sea (Rom 9:27; Rev 12:18).

THAYER.pt: Grãos finos de rocha encontrados nas praias ou desertos, frequentemente usados no NT para denotar grande multidão ou imensidão incontável. 1. Areia da praia ou do mar (Rm 9.27; Ap 12.18).
THAYER.en: Fine grains of rock found on beaches or in deserts, frequently used in the NT to denote a great multitude or uncountable vastness. 1. Sand of the seashore or the sea (Rom 9:27; Rev 12:18).

DEFINITION: A young sheep, used widely in the Old Testament as a sacrificial animal and applied Christologically to Christ as the perfect sacrifice for sins.
SENSES: 1. Literal lamb as a sacrificial animal (Acts 8:32).
2. Christological title for Christ as the Lamb of God (John 1:29, 36; 1 Pet 1:19).

THAYER.pt: Filhote de ovelha, utilizado amplamente no Antigo Testamento como animal sacrificial e aplicado cristologicamente a Cristo como o sacrifício perfeito pelos pecados. 1. Cordeiro literal como animal de sacrifício (At 8.32). | 2. Título cristológico para Cristo como o Cordeiro de Deus (Jo 1.29, 36; 1Pe 1.19).
THAYER.en: A young sheep, used widely in the Old Testament as a sacrificial animal and applied Christologically to Christ as the perfect sacrifice for sins. 1. Literal lamb as a sacrificial animal (Acts 8:32). | 2. Christological title for Christ as the Lamb of God (John 1:29, 36; 1 Pet 1:19).

DEFINITION: That which is given as payment, retribution, or return for a favor received, especially the care provided to parents.
SENSES: 1. Retribution or recompense due to parents and family members (1 Tim 5:4).

THAYER.pt: Aquilo que é dado como pagamento, retribuição ou devolução de um favor recebido, especialmente o cuidado prestado aos pais. 1. Retribuição ou recompensa devida aos pais e familiares (1Tm 5.4).
THAYER.en: That which is given as payment, retribution, or return for a favor received, especially the care provided to parents. 1. Retribution or recompense due to parents and family members (1 Tim 5:4).

DEFINITION: Refers to the grapevine that produces grapes, frequently used in the New Testament as an agricultural and spiritual metaphor to describe the vital union between Christ and his disciples.
SENSES: 1. The literal grapevine, a plant cultivated for the production of grapes (Rev 14:18).
2. Metaphorical use of Christ as the true vine and believers as the branches (John 15:1).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se à planta da videira que produz uvas, frequentemente usada no Novo Testamento como metáfora agrícola e espiritual para descrever a união vital entre Cristo e seus discípulos. 1. A videira literal, planta cultivada para a produção de uvas (Ap 14.18). | 2. Uso metafórico de Cristo como a videira verdadeira e os crentes como os ramos (Jo 15.1).
THAYER.en: Refers to the grapevine that produces grapes, frequently used in the New Testament as an agricultural and spiritual metaphor to describe the vital union between Christ and his disciples. 1. The literal grapevine, a plant cultivated for the production of grapes (Rev 14:18). | 2. Metaphorical use of Christ as the true vine and believers as the branches (John 15:1).

DEFINITION: An agricultural worker specialized in the cultivation, pruning, and care of a vineyard.
SENSES: 1. The cultivator or worker in charge of tending a vineyard (Luke 13:7).

THAYER.pt: Trabalhador agrícola especializado no cultivo, poda e cuidado de uma vinha ou parreiral. 1. O cultivador ou trabalhador encarregado de cuidar de uma vinha (Lc 13.7).
THAYER.en: An agricultural worker specialized in the cultivation, pruning, and care of a vineyard. 1. The cultivator or worker in charge of tending a vineyard (Luke 13:7).

DEFINITION: Designates an area of land cultivated with grapevines for the production of grapes and wine. It is widely used in parables in the New Testament to illustrate the Kingdom of God and the responsibility of Israel.
SENSES: 1. A plot of land cultivated with grapevines, a vineyard (Matt 20:1; Mark 12:1).

THAYER.pt: Designa uma área de terra cultivada com videiras para a produção de uvas e vinho. É amplamente utilizado em parábolas no Novo Testamento para ilustrar o Reino de Deus e a responsabilidade de Israel. 1. Um terreno cultivado com videiras, vinhedo (Mt 20.1; Mc 12.1).
THAYER.en: Designates an area of land cultivated with grapevines for the production of grapes and wine. It is widely used in parables in the New Testament to illustrate the Kingdom of God and the responsibility of Israel. 1. A plot of land cultivated with grapevines, a vineyard (Matt 20:1; Mark 12:1).

DEFINITION: Proper name of a Christian greeted by the apostle Paul in his letter to the Romans.
SENSES: 1. Name of a believer in the community of Rome (Rom 16:8).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio de um cristão saudado pelo apóstolo Paulo em sua carta aos Romanos. 1. Nome de um crente na comunidade de Roma (Rm 16.8).
THAYER.en: Proper name of a Christian greeted by the apostle Paul in his letter to the Romans. 1. Name of a believer in the community of Rome (Rom 16:8).

DEFINITION: To intervene on behalf of someone to provide aid, protect, or defend against an aggression or danger.
SENSES: 1. To defend or assist someone who is suffering oppression (Acts 7:24).

THAYER.pt: Intervir em favor de alguém para prestar auxílio, proteger ou defender contra uma agressão ou perigo. 1. Defender ou socorrer alguém que sofre opressão (At 7.24).
THAYER.en: To intervene on behalf of someone to provide aid, protect, or defend against an aggression or danger. 1. To defend or assist someone who is suffering oppression (Acts 7:24).

DEFINITION: A circular and conical fishing net that fishermen would cast into the water to surround fish.
SENSES: 1. Circular casting net used in fishing (Matt 4:18).

THAYER.pt: Uma rede de pesca circular e cônica que os pescadores lançavam à água para cercar os peixes. 1. Rede circular de arremesso usada na pesca (Mt 4.18).
THAYER.en: A circular and conical fishing net that fishermen would cast into the water to surround fish. 1. Circular casting net used in fishing (Matt 4:18).

DEFINITION: To cover the body with garments, to dress or adorn with clothes, used both for daily care and to illustrate divine providence.
SENSES: 1. To clothe or provide clothes for someone (Matt 6:30; 11:8; Luke 7:25; 12:28).

THAYER.pt: Cobrir o corpo com vestimentas, vestir ou adornar com roupas, sendo usado tanto para cuidados diários quanto para ilustrar a providência divina. 1. Vestir ou prover roupas a alguém (Mt 6.30; 11.8; Lc 7.25; 12.28).
THAYER.en: To cover the body with garments, to dress or adorn with clothes, used both for daily care and to illustrate divine providence. 1. To clothe or provide clothes for someone (Matt 6:30; 11:8; Luke 7:25; 12:28).

DEFINITION: Important city and capital of southeastern Macedonia, situated strategically on the route of the Via Egnatia.
SENSES: 1. Macedonian city through which Paul passed on his missionary journey (Acts 17:1).

THAYER.pt: Importante cidade e capital do sudeste da Macedônia, situada estrategicamente na rota da Via Egnácia. 1. Cidade macedônica por onde Paulo passou em sua viagem missionária (At 17.1).
THAYER.en: Important city and capital of southeastern Macedonia, situated strategically on the route of the Via Egnatia. 1. Macedonian city through which Paul passed on his missionary journey (Acts 17:1).

DEFINITION: Designates a public urban thoroughfare or a block surrounded by streets within a city.
SENSES: 1. Street or urban sector where paths or blocks converge (Mark 11:4; Acts 19:28).

THAYER.pt: Designa uma via pública urbana ou um quarteirão cercado por ruas dentro de uma cidade. 1. Rua ou setor urbano onde convergem caminhos ou quarteirões (Mc 11.4; At 19.28).
THAYER.en: Designates a public urban thoroughfare or a block surrounded by streets within a city. 1. Street or urban sector where paths or blocks converge (Mark 11:4; Acts 19:28).

DEFINITION: Adjectival pronoun that indicates the totality of two people or things considered together.
SENSES: 1. Both, the two together without distinction (Matt 9:17; Luke 1:6).

THAYER.pt: Pronome adjetivo que indica a totalidade de duas pessoas ou coisas consideradas juntas. 1. Ambos, os dois em conjunto sem distinção (Mt 9.17; Lc 1.6).
THAYER.en: Adjectival pronoun that indicates the totality of two people or things considered together. 1. Both, the two together without distinction (Matt 9:17; Luke 1:6).

DEFINITION: Moral quality of someone who is not subject to censure, being pure and blameless before God and men.
SENSES: 1. One who lives in a blameless and morally unspotted manner (2 Pet 3:14).

THAYER.pt: Qualidade moral de alguém que não está sujeito a censura, sendo puro e irrepreensível perante Deus e os homens. 1. Que vive de maneira irrepreensível e sem mancha moral (2Pe 3.14).
THAYER.en: Moral quality of someone who is not subject to censure, being pure and blameless before God and men. 1. One who lives in a blameless and morally unspotted manner (2 Pet 3:14).

DEFINITION: Describes something or someone who is free from defects, spots, or moral guilt, being widely used both to describe perfect sacrificial animals and the ethical purity of believers.
SENSES: 1. Without physical defect or spot, applied to ritual sacrifices (1 Pet 1:19; Heb 9:14).
2. Morally blameless and pure before God (Phil 2:15; Rev 14:5).

THAYER.pt: Descreve algo ou alguém que está livre de defeitos, manchas ou culpa moral, sendo amplamente empregado tanto para descrever animais sacrificiais perfeitos quanto a pureza ética dos crentes. 1. Sem defeito físico ou mancha, aplicado a sacrifícios rituais (1Pe 1.19; Hb 9.14). | 2. Moralmente irrepreensível e puro diante de Deus (Fp 2.15; Ap 14.5).
THAYER.en: Describes something or someone who is free from defects, spots, or moral guilt, being widely used both to describe perfect sacrificial animals and the ethical purity of believers. 1. Without physical defect or spot, applied to ritual sacrifices (1 Pet 1:19; Heb 9:14). | 2. Morally blameless and pure before God (Phil 2:15; Rev 14:5).

DEFINITION: An Old Testament figure included in the earthly genealogy of Jesus Christ as the son of Manasseh and the father of Josiah.
SENSES: 1. Amon, an ancestor of Jesus in the lineage of Matthew (Mt 1:10).

THAYER.pt: Personagem veterotestamentário inserido na genealogia terrena de Jesus Cristo como filho de Manassés e pai de Josias. 1. Amom, ancestral de Jesus na linhagem de Mateus (Mt 1.10).
THAYER.en: An Old Testament figure included in the earthly genealogy of Jesus Christ as the son of Manasseh and the father of Josiah. 1. Amon, an ancestor of Jesus in the lineage of Matthew (Mt 1:10).

DEFINITION: Male proper name present in the genealogies in the Gospels of Luke and Matthew.
SENSES: 1. A person in the genealogy of Jesus (Mt 1:10; Lk 3:25).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio masculino presente nas genealogias do Evangelho de Lucas e Mateus. 1. Personagem na genealogia de Jesus (Mt 1.10; Lc 3.25).
THAYER.en: Male proper name present in the genealogies in the Gospels of Luke and Matthew. 1. A person in the genealogy of Jesus (Mt 1:10; Lk 3:25).

DEFINITION: A particle untranslatable literally in isolation; it introduces a nuance of contingency, potentiality, or generalization to the verb it is associated with. In relative constructions joined with pronouns, it equates to the suffix '-soever' (whoever).
SENSES: 1. With pronouns or relative conjunctions (ὅς ἄν, ὅπου ἄν): indefinite generalization ('whoever', 'wherever') (Mt 10:33; Mk 6:56).
2. In contrary-to-fact conditional clauses (with past indicative): potentiality ('would have', 'might have') (Lk 7:39; Jn 11:21).

THAYER.pt: Partícula intraduzível de maneira literal isolada; introduz uma nuança de contingência, potencialidade ou generalização no verbo a que se associa. Em construções relativas unida a pronomes equivale ao sufixo português '-quer que' (quem quer que). 1. Com pronomes ou conjunções relativas (ὅς ἄν, ὅπου ἄν): generalização indeterminada ('quem quer que', 'onde quer que') (Mt 10.33; Mc 6.56). | 2. Em orações condicionais de irrealidade (com indicativo no passado): potencialidade ('teria', 'haveria de') (Lc 7.39; Jo 11.21).
THAYER.en: A particle untranslatable literally in isolation; it introduces a nuance of contingency, potentiality, or generalization to the verb it is associated with. In relative constructions joined with pronouns, it equates to the suffix '-soever' (whoever). 1. With pronouns or relative conjunctions (ὅς ἄν, ὅπου ἄν): indefinite generalization ('whoever', 'wherever') (Mt 10:33; Mk 6:56). | 2. In contrary-to-fact conditional clauses (with past indicative): potentiality ('would have', 'might have') (Lk 7:39; Jn 11:21).

DEFINITION: Preposition primarily indicating upward movement or intermediate position, often assuming a distributive sense with numerals.
SENSES: 1. Amidst, among, or within a space (Mt 13:25).
2. In a distributive sense, indicating proportion or sequence, such as 'each' or 'by' (Mt 20:9; Lk 10:1).

THAYER.pt: Preposição que primariamente indica movimento para cima ou posição intermediária, assumindo frequentemente sentido distributivo com numerais. 1. Em meio a, entre ou no interior de um espaço (Mt 13.25). | 2. Em sentido distributivo, indicando proporção ou sequência, como 'cada' ou 'por' (Mt 20.9; Lk 10.1).
THAYER.en: Preposition primarily indicating upward movement or intermediate position, often assuming a distributive sense with numerals. 1. Amidst, among, or within a space (Mt 13:25). | 2. In a distributive sense, indicating proportion or sequence, such as 'each' or 'by' (Mt 20:9; Lk 10:1).

DEFINITION: Refers to a single step or a series of steps forming a staircase for access to elevated buildings.
SENSES: 1. The steps or stairway leading from the temple court to the Antonia fortress (Acts 21:35, 40).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se a um único degrau ou a uma série de degraus que formam uma escadaria para acesso a edificações elevadas. 1. Os degraus ou a escadaria que davam acesso da praça do templo à torre Antonia (At 21.35, 40).
THAYER.en: Refers to a single step or a series of steps forming a staircase for access to elevated buildings. 1. The steps or stairway leading from the temple court to the Antonia fortress (Acts 21:35, 40).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: ἀναβήσομαι, Aor2: ἀνέβην, Perf: ἀναβέβηκα
DEFINITION: To move physically from a lower plane to a higher one, whether climbing mountains, going up to Jerusalem, ascending to the heavens, or sprouting as a plant.
SENSES: 1. Go up to a high place, hill, or mountain (Mt 5:1; Lk 19:4).
2. Go up to Jerusalem for religious feasts (Mt 20:17; Jn 7:8).
3. Ascend into heaven or heavenly spheres (Jn 1:51; Acts 2:34; Eph 4:8-10).
4. Sprout or grow (used for vegetation) (Mt 13:7); figuratively, thoughts arising in the heart (Lk 24:38; 1Co 2:9).

THAYER.pt: Deslocar-se fisicamente de um plano inferior para um superior, seja escalando montanhas, subindo a Jerusalém, ascendendo aos céus ou brotando como planta. 1. Subir a um local elevado, colina ou monte (Mt 5.1; Lk 19.4). | 2. Subir a Jerusalém para as festas religiosas (Mt 20.17; Jo 7.8). | 3. Ascender aos céus ou a esferas celestiais (Jo 1.51; At 2.34; Ef 4.8-10). | 4. Brotar ou crescer (usado para vegetação) (Mt 13.7); figuradamente, pensamentos que surgem no coração (Lc 24.38; 1Co 2.9).
THAYER.en: To move physically from a lower plane to a higher one, whether climbing mountains, going up to Jerusalem, ascending to the heavens, or sprouting as a plant. 1. Go up to a high place, hill, or mountain (Mt 5:1; Lk 19:4). | 2. Go up to Jerusalem for religious feasts (Mt 20:17; Jn 7:8). | 3. Ascend into heaven or heavenly spheres (Jn 1:51; Acts 2:34; Eph 4:8-10). | 4. Sprout or grow (used for vegetation) (Mt 13:7); figuratively, thoughts arising in the heart (Lk 24:38; 1Co 2:9).

DEFINITION: The act of delaying a procedure, trial, or legal decision to a later date.
SENSES: 1. Adjourn a legal hearing or trial (Acts 24:22).

THAYER.pt: Ato de adiar um procedimento, julgamento ou decisão legal para uma data posterior. 1. Adiar uma audiência ou julgamento legal (At 24.22).
THAYER.en: The act of delaying a procedure, trial, or legal decision to a later date. 1. Adjourn a legal hearing or trial (Acts 24:22).

DEFINITION: The action of pulling or leading something from below upwards, especially hauling a fishing net ashore.
SENSES: 1. Pull a net full of fish to the shore (Mt 13:48).

THAYER.pt: Ação de puxar ou conduzir algo debaixo para cima, especialmente recolhendo uma rede de pesca para a praia. 1. Puxar uma rede cheia de peixes para a margem (Mt 13.48).
THAYER.en: The action of pulling or leading something from below upwards, especially hauling a fishing net ashore. 1. Pull a net full of fish to the shore (Mt 13:48).

DEFINITION: To direct the gaze upwards or to recover the physical ability to see.
SENSES: 1. Lift the eyes upwards (Acts 22:13).
2. Recover physical sight (Mt 20:34; Lk 7:22).

THAYER.pt: Dirigir o olhar para o alto ou recuperar a capacidade física de enxergar. 1. Levantar os olhos para cima (At 22.13). | 2. Recuperar a visão física (Mt 20.34; Lc 7.22).
THAYER.en: To direct the gaze upwards or to recover the physical ability to see. 1. Lift the eyes upwards (Acts 22:13). | 2. Recover physical sight (Mt 20:34; Lk 7:22).

DEFINITION: The act or event of recovering visual capacity, either in a physical sense or as a spiritual metaphor.
SENSES: 1. The restoration or granting of physical sight (Lk 4:18).

THAYER.pt: O ato ou o evento de recuperar a capacidade visual, seja em sentido físico ou como metáfora espiritual. 1. A restauração ou concessão da visão física (Lc 4.18).
THAYER.en: The act or event of recovering visual capacity, either in a physical sense or as a spiritual metaphor. 1. The restoration or granting of physical sight (Lk 4:18).

DEFINITION: To emit a vocal sound of high volume, exclaiming or shouting due to strong emotion or anguish.
SENSES: 1. Utter a loud cry or exclaim publicly (Mt 27:46).

THAYER.pt: Emitir um som vocal de grande volume, exclamando ou bradando devido a forte emoção ou angústia. 1. Dar um grito forte ou exclamar publicamente (Mt 27.46).
THAYER.en: To emit a vocal sound of high volume, exclaiming or shouting due to strong emotion or anguish. 1. Utter a loud cry or exclaim publicly (Mt 27:46).

DEFINITION: The action of extending a deadline or postponing the progress of an official or judicial event.
SENSES: 1. Postponement or delay of legal proceedings (Acts 25:17).

THAYER.pt: Ação de estender um prazo ou postergar o andamento de um evento oficial ou judicial. 1. Postergação ou adiamento de procedimentos legais (At 25.17).
THAYER.en: The action of extending a deadline or postponing the progress of an official or judicial event. 1. Postponement or delay of legal proceedings (Acts 25:17).

DEFINITION: To bring back information, report details, or proclaim a message publicly.
SENSES: 1. Report facts or bring detailed news of an event (2Co 7:7).
2. Proclaim, reveal, or teach divine truths (Jn 16:13).

THAYER.pt: Trazer de volta uma informação, relatar detalhes ou proclamar uma mensagem publicamente. 1. Reportar fatos ou trazer notícias detalhadas de um acontecimento (2Co 7.7). | 2. Proclamar, revelar ou ensinar verdades divinas (Jo 16.13).
THAYER.en: To bring back information, report details, or proclaim a message publicly. 1. Report facts or bring detailed news of an event (2Co 7:7). | 2. Proclaim, reveal, or teach divine truths (Jn 16:13).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: ἀναγεννήσω, Aor: ἀνεγέννησα, Pass: ἀνεγεννήθην
DEFINITION: To act by granting a new life of spiritual nature, operating a divine rebirth in those who believe.
SENSES: 1. The sovereign act of God in granting a new spiritual birth to believers through the resurrection of Christ (1Pe 1:3).

THAYER.pt: Agir concedendo uma nova vida de natureza espiritual, operando um renascimento divino naqueles que creem. 1. O ato soberano de Deus em conceder um novo nascimento espiritual aos crentes por meio da ressurreição de Cristo (1Pe 1.3).
THAYER.en: To act by granting a new life of spiritual nature, operating a divine rebirth in those who believe. 1. The sovereign act of God in granting a new spiritual birth to believers through the resurrection of Christ (1Pe 1:3).

DEFINITION: To examine and articulate aloud or mentally the content of a written text.
SENSES: 1. Read a written text, commonly aloud in public or private contexts (Lk 4:16; Acts 8:28).

THAYER.pt: Examinar e articular em voz alta ou mentalmente o conteúdo de um texto escrito. 1. Ler um texto escrito, comumente em voz alta em contextos públicos ou privados (Lc 4.16; At 8.28).
THAYER.en: To examine and articulate aloud or mentally the content of a written text. 1. Read a written text, commonly aloud in public or private contexts (Lk 4:16; Acts 8:28).

DEFINITION: Indicates the action of exerting strong pressure, internal or external, to oblige someone to take a certain attitude or follow a specific path.
SENSES: 1. Compel or force someone to act against or in favor of their will (Acts 26:11; Gal 2:3).
2. Strongly urge or persuade with vehemence (Mt 14:22).

THAYER.pt: Indica a ação de exercer forte pressão, interna ou externa, para obrigar alguém a tomar determinada atitude ou seguir um caminho específico. 1. Compelir ou forçar alguém a agir contra ou a favor de sua vontade (At 26.11; Gl 2.3). | 2. Insistir fortemente ou persuadir com veemência (Mt 14.22).
THAYER.en: Indicates the action of exerting strong pressure, internal or external, to oblige someone to take a certain attitude or follow a specific path. 1. Compel or force someone to act against or in favor of their will (Acts 26:11; Gal 2:3). | 2. Strongly urge or persuade with vehemence (Mt 14:22).

DEFINITION: Describes that which is necessary, inevitable, or of vital importance, and can also refer to close ties of kinship or intimate friendship.
SENSES: 1. Necessary or indispensable to meet a need (1Co 12:22; Tit 3:14).
2. Related to close interpersonal bonds, such as close friends or family members (Acts 10:24).

THAYER.pt: Descreve aquilo que é necessário, inevitável ou de importância vital, podendo também referir-se a laços estreitos de parentesco ou amizade íntima. 1. Necessário ou indispensável para atender a uma necessidade (1Co 12.22; Tt 3.14). | 2. Relacionado a vínculos interpessoais íntimos, como amigos chegados ou familiares (At 10.24).
THAYER.en: Describes that which is necessary, inevitable, or of vital importance, and can also refer to close ties of kinship or intimate friendship. 1. Necessary or indispensable to meet a need (1Co 12:22; Tit 3:14). | 2. Related to close interpersonal bonds, such as close friends or family members (Acts 10:24).

DEFINITION: A manner of acting not voluntarily, but motivated by external imposition, coercion, or a strict sense of mandatory duty.
SENSES: 1. Acting under coercion or by obligation rather than spontaneously (1Pe 5:2).

THAYER.pt: Modo de agir não voluntário, mas motivado por imposição externa, coerção ou estrito senso de dever obrigatório. 1. Agir sob coação ou por obrigação e não espontaneamente (1Pe 5.2).
THAYER.en: A manner of acting not voluntarily, but motivated by external imposition, coercion, or a strict sense of mandatory duty. 1. Acting under coercion or by obligation rather than spontaneously (1Pe 5:2).

DEFINITION: Inescapable force, external pressure, or imposition of circumstances that compel action or generate great affliction.
SENSES: 1. Unavoidable necessity imposed by duty, commandment, or the nature of things (Rom 13:5; Heb 9:16).
2. State of great affliction, calamity, distress, or hardship (Lk 21:23; 1Co 7:26).

THAYER.pt: Força inelutável, pressão externa ou imposição de circunstâncias que obrigam a uma ação ou geram grande aflição. 1. Necessidade inafastável imposta por dever, mandamento ou pela natureza das coisas (Rm 13.5; Hb 9.16). | 2. Estado de grande aflição, calamidade, angústia ou aperto (Lc 21.23; 1Co 7.26).
THAYER.en: Inescapable force, external pressure, or imposition of circumstances that compel action or generate great affliction. 1. Unavoidable necessity imposed by duty, commandment, or the nature of things (Rom 13:5; Heb 9:16). | 2. State of great affliction, calamity, distress, or hardship (Lk 21:23; 1Co 7:26).

DEFINITION: To know someone again after a period of separation, or to be fully recognized in one's identity.
SENSES: 1. To be recognized by someone after a certain time (Acts 7:13).

THAYER.pt: Tornar a conhecer alguém após um período de separação, ou ser plenamente reconhecido em sua identidade. 1. Ser reconhecido por alguém após certo tempo (At 7.13).
THAYER.en: To know someone again after a period of separation, or to be fully recognized in one's identity. 1. To be recognized by someone after a certain time (Acts 7:13).

DEFINITION: Refers to the act of reading written texts, especially audibly in the context of the liturgical assembly.
SENSES: 1. The act or process of public reading of sacred texts (Acts 13:15; 2Co 3:14; 1Tm 4:13).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se ao ato de ler textos escritos, especialmente de forma audível no contexto da assembleia litúrgica. 1. O ato ou processo de leitura pública de textos sagrados (At 13.15; 2Co 3.14; 1Tm 4.13).
THAYER.en: Refers to the act of reading written texts, especially audibly in the context of the liturgical assembly. 1. The act or process of public reading of sacred texts (Acts 13:15; 2Co 3:14; 1Tm 4:13).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Compound of ἀνά and ἄγω; Aor: ἀνήγαγον
DEFINITION: Means to guide or take someone or something from a lower point to a higher one. In the middle or passive voice, it became the technical nautical term for untying moorings and departing on a sea voyage.
SENSES: 1. Lead or take up (Mt 17:1).
2. Nautical term: set sail, put out to sea, depart by boat (Acts 13:13).

THAYER.pt: Significa guiar ou levar alguém ou algo de um ponto inferior para um superior. Na voz média ou passiva, tornou-se o termo náutico técnico para desatar as amarras e partir em viagem marítima. 1. Conduzir ou levar para cima (Mt 17.1). | 2. Termo náutico: zarpar, navegar mar adentro, partir de barco (At 13.13).
THAYER.en: Means to guide or take someone or something from a lower point to a higher one. In the middle or passive voice, it became the technical nautical term for untying moorings and departing on a sea voyage. 1. Lead or take up (Mt 17:1). | 2. Nautical term: set sail, put out to sea, depart by boat (Acts 13:13).

DEFINITION: To make something or someone clearly visible, manifest, or publicly designated for a specific role.
SENSES: 1. Clearly show or indicate the choice of someone for a task or leadership position (Acts 1:24; Lk 10:1).

THAYER.pt: Tornar algo ou alguém claramente visível, manifesto ou publicamente designado para uma função específica. 1. Mostrar ou indicar claramente a escolha de alguém para uma tarefa ou posição de liderança (At 1.24; Lc 10.1).
THAYER.en: To make something or someone clearly visible, manifest, or publicly designated for a specific role. 1. Clearly show or indicate the choice of someone for a task or leadership position (Acts 1:24; Lk 10:1).

DEFINITION: The act of making public, manifesting, or officially commissioning someone for a sacred function.
SENSES: 1. Public revelation or official designation to ministry (Lk 1:80).

THAYER.pt: Ato de tornar público, manifestar ou comissionar oficialmente alguém para uma função sagrada. 1. A revelação pública ou a designação oficial ao ministério (Lc 1.80).
THAYER.en: The act of making public, manifesting, or officially commissioning someone for a sacred function. 1. Public revelation or official designation to ministry (Lk 1:80).

DEFINITION: To willingly accept someone's presence, take on a responsibility, or extend generous hospitality.
SENSES: 1. Welcome or receive someone with hospitality (Acts 28:7).
2. Accept and bear a heavy responsibility or trial (Heb 11:17).

THAYER.pt: Aceitar com boa vontade a presença de alguém, assumir uma responsabilidade ou estender hospitalidade generosa. 1. Acolher ou receber alguém com hospitalidade (At 28.7). | 2. Aceitar e carregar uma responsabilidade ou provação pesada (Hb 11.17).
THAYER.en: To willingly accept someone's presence, take on a responsibility, or extend generous hospitality. 1. Welcome or receive someone with hospitality (Acts 28:7). | 2. Accept and bear a heavy responsibility or trial (Heb 11:17).

DEFINITION: The act of formally delivering a document, letter, or message into the hands of the recipient.
SENSES: 1. Deliver a letter or official document (Acts 23:33).

THAYER.pt: Ato de entregar formalmente um documento, carta ou mensagem nas mãos do destinatário. 1. Entregar uma carta ou documento oficial (At 23.33).
THAYER.en: The act of formally delivering a document, letter, or message into the hands of the recipient. 1. Deliver a letter or official document (Acts 23:33).

SHORT_GLOSS: come to life, revive, live again
DEFINITION: To return to a state of life after physical death or to undergo an intense vital renewal after a period of inactivity.
SENSES: 1. Return to physical life after death or through resurrection (Lk 15:24; Rev 20:5).
2. Awaken to moral or spiritual activity after a state of inertia or spiritual death (Rom 7:9).
USAGE: come to life, revive, live again

THAYER.pt: Retornar ao estado de vida após a morte física ou passar por uma renovação vital intensa após um período de inatividade. 1. Retornar à vida física após a morte ou por meio da ressurreição (Lc 15.24; Ap 20.5). | 2. Despertar para a atividade moral ou espiritual após um estado de inércia ou morte espiritual (Rm 7.9).
THAYER.en: To return to a state of life after physical death or to undergo an intense vital renewal after a period of inactivity. 1. Return to physical life after death or through resurrection (Lk 15:24; Rev 20:5). | 2. Awaken to moral or spiritual activity after a state of inertia or spiritual death (Rom 7:9).

DEFINITION: Means to undertake a diligent search to find or locate someone or something.
SENSES: 1. Diligently seek or attempt to locate something (Lk 2:44; Acts 11:25).

THAYER.pt: Significa empreender uma busca diligente para encontrar ou localizar alguém ou algo. 1. Procurar diligentemente ou tentar localizar algo (Lc 2.44; At 11.25).
THAYER.en: Means to undertake a diligent search to find or locate someone or something. 1. Diligently seek or attempt to locate something (Lk 2:44; Acts 11:25).

DEFINITION: To fasten a tunic with a belt to facilitate quick movement or heavy work; used metaphorically for mental readiness.
SENSES: 1. Gird up the loins, preparing oneself spiritually for action (1Pe 1:13).

THAYER.pt: Apertar a túnica com um cinto para facilitar o movimento rápido ou o trabalho pesado; usado metaforicamente para a prontidão mental. 1. Cingir os lombos, preparando-se espiritualmente para a ação (1Pe 1.13).
THAYER.en: To fasten a tunic with a belt to facilitate quick movement or heavy work; used metaphorically for mental readiness. 1. Gird up the loins, preparing oneself spiritually for action (1Pe 1:13).

DEFINITION: The act of reviving or rekindling a fire that was dying down, figuratively stimulating spiritual gifts.
SENSES: 1. Revive or rekindle a dormant spiritual gift (2Tm 1:6).

THAYER.pt: Ato de avivar ou reacender o fogo que estava moribundo, figuradamente estimulando dons espirituais. 1. Reavivar ou rekindle um dom espiritual adormecido (2Tm 1.6).
THAYER.en: The act of reviving or rekindling a fire that was dying down, figuratively stimulating spiritual gifts. 1. Revive or rekindle a dormant spiritual gift (2Tm 1:6).

DEFINITION: To return to a previous state of vigor, sprout, or bloom again after a period of stagnation.
SENSES: 1. Revive or flourish again on behalf of someone (Phil 4:10).

THAYER.pt: Retornar a um estado anterior de vigor, brotar ou florescer novamente após um período de estagnação. 1. Reviver ou florescer novamente em favor de alguém (Fp 4.10).
THAYER.en: To return to a previous state of vigor, sprout, or bloom again after a period of stagnation. 1. Revive or flourish again on behalf of someone (Phil 4:10).

DEFINITION: A term denoting something separated and dedicated to a deity—either as a votive offering in a temple or, in the New Testament context, that which is under divine curse and set apart for destruction.
SENSES: 1. A votive offering dedicated and placed in a temple (Lk 21:5).
2. That which is under a curse or banned from communion with God (Gal 1:8; 1 Cor 12:3).

THAYER.pt: Termo que denota algo separado e dedicado a uma divindade — podendo ser uma oferta votiva em templo ou, no contexto neotestamentário, aquilo que está sob maldição divina e separado para a perdição. 1. Oferta votiva dedicada e colocada em um templo (Lc 21.5). | 2. Aquilo que está sob maldição ou banido da comunhão com Deus (Gl 1.8; 1Co 12.3).
THAYER.en: A term denoting something separated and dedicated to a deity—either as a votive offering in a temple or, in the New Testament context, that which is under divine curse and set apart for destruction. 1. A votive offering dedicated and placed in a temple (Lk 21:5). | 2. That which is under a curse or banned from communion with God (Gal 1:8; 1 Cor 12:3).

DEFINITION: To invoke a curse or divine judgment upon oneself or others if a statement is false or if a vow is broken.
SENSES: 1. To place under a curse or a solemn vow of condemnation (Acts 23:14).
2. To swear with the self-imposition of a curse (Mk 14:71).

THAYER.pt: Invocar maldição ou julgamento divino sobre si mesmo ou sobre outros caso uma afirmação seja falsa ou caso um voto seja quebrado. 1. Colocar sob maldição ou voto solene de condenação (At 23.14). | 2. Jurar com autoimposição de maldição (Mc 14.71).
THAYER.en: To invoke a curse or divine judgment upon oneself or others if a statement is false or if a vow is broken. 1. To place under a curse or a solemn vow of condemnation (Acts 23:14). | 2. To swear with the self-imposition of a curse (Mk 14:71).

DEFINITION: To look at something with deep attention, examining it minutely and pondering its significance.
SENSES: 1. To examine with care and attention elements of worship or the environment (Acts 17:23).
2. To reflect deeply on the example and outcome of the conduct of spiritual leaders (Heb 13:7).

THAYER.pt: Olhar para algo com profunda atenção, examinando minuciosamente e ponderando sobre o seu significado. 1. Examinar com cuidado e atenção elementos do culto ou do ambiente (At 17.23). | 2. Refletir profundamente sobre o exemplo e o resultado da conduta de líderes espirituais (Hb 13.7).
THAYER.en: To look at something with deep attention, examining it minutely and pondering its significance. 1. To examine with care and attention elements of worship or the environment (Acts 17:23). | 2. To reflect deeply on the example and outcome of the conduct of spiritual leaders (Heb 13:7).

DEFINITION: A precious object dedicated and consecrated to a deity or to the temple as an offering of gratitude.
SENSES: 1. An offering or consecrated gift displayed in the temple (Lk 21:5).

THAYER.pt: Objeto precioso dedicado e consagrado a uma divindade ou ao templo como oferta de gratidão. 1. Oferta ou dádiva consagrada exposta no templo (Lc 21.5).
THAYER.en: A precious object dedicated and consecrated to a deity or to the temple as an offering of gratitude. 1. An offering or consecrated gift displayed in the temple (Lk 21:5).

DEFINITION: A lack of social shame or persistent insistence that disregards conventions to achieve an urgent goal.
SENSES: 1. Audacious insistence and prayerful persistence (Lk 11:8).

THAYER.pt: Falta de pudor social ou insistência persistente que desconsidera as convenções para alcançar um objetivo urgente. 1. Insistência audaciosa e persistência oracional (Lc 11.8).
THAYER.en: A lack of social shame or persistent insistence that disregards conventions to achieve an urgent goal. 1. Audacious insistence and prayerful persistence (Lk 11:8).

DEFINITION: Refers to the act of taking someone's life, often associated with murder or violent execution in the New Testament context.
SENSES: 1. The act of killing or murder, as in the context of the death of Stephen (Acts 8:1).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se ao ato de tirar a vida de alguém, frequentemente associado a um assassinato ou execução violenta no contexto do Novo Testamento. 1. Ato de matar ou assassinato, conforme o contexto da morte de Estêvão (At 8.1).
THAYER.en: Refers to the act of taking someone's life, often associated with murder or violent execution in the New Testament context. 1. The act of killing or murder, as in the context of the death of Stephen (Acts 8:1).

DEFINITION: To take someone's life through violence or execution, as well as to remove or annul something.
SENSES: 1. To execute, murder, or kill violently (Mt 2:16; Acts 12:2).
2. To abolish, annul, or remove a law or precept (Heb 10:9).
