THAYER.pt: Significa retirar a vida de alguém por violência ou execução, bem como remover ou anular algo. 1. Executar, assassinar ou matar violentamente (Mt 2.16; At 12.2). | 2. Abolir, anular ou remover uma lei ou preceito (Hb 10.9).
THAYER.en: To take someone's life through violence or execution, as well as to remove or annul something. 1. To execute, murder, or kill violently (Mt 2:16; Acts 12:2). | 2. To abolish, annul, or remove a law or precept (Heb 10:9).

DEFINITION: A person who is free from any guilt, transgression, or responsibility for a wrong act.
SENSES: 1. To be exempt from guilt or responsibility regarding an accusation or commandment (Mt 12:5).

THAYER.pt: Pessoa que está livre de qualquer culpa, transgressão ou responsabilidade por um ato incorreto. 1. Estar isento de culpa ou responsabilidade em relação a uma acusação ou mandamento (Mt 12.5).
THAYER.en: A person who is free from any guilt, transgression, or responsibility for a wrong act. 1. To be exempt from guilt or responsibility regarding an accusation or commandment (Mt 12:5).

DEFINITION: To change body posture from a lying or reclining position to a sitting position.
SENSES: 1. To rise and sit up from a lying position (Lk 7:15).

THAYER.pt: Mudar a postura corporal de uma posição deitada ou reclinada para a posição sentada. 1. Erguer-se e sentar-se a partir de uma posição deitada (Lc 7.15).
THAYER.en: To change body posture from a lying or reclining position to a sitting position. 1. To rise and sit up from a lying position (Lk 7:15).

DEFINITION: To bring back to a previous state of freshness or integrity, promoting spiritual or physical renewal.
SENSES: 1. To restore or renew spiritually, especially in the sense of re-establishing a condition of communion with God (Heb 6:6).

THAYER.pt: Significa trazer de volta a um estado anterior de frescor ou integridade, promovendo uma renovação espiritual ou física. 1. Restaurar ou renovar espiritualmente, especialmente no sentido de reatar uma condição de comunhão com Deus (Hb 6.6).
THAYER.en: To bring back to a previous state of freshness or integrity, promoting spiritual or physical renewal. 1. To restore or renew spiritually, especially in the sense of re-establishing a condition of communion with God (Heb 6:6).

DEFINITION: To operate a profound transformation that restores something to its ideal state or makes it superior and spiritually new.
SENSES: 1. The continuous renewal of the believer's inner and spiritual man by divine work (2 Cor 4:16).

THAYER.pt: Operar uma transformação profunda que restaura algo ao seu estado ideal ou o torna superior e espiritualmente novo. 1. A renovação contínua do homem interior e espiritual do crente por obra divina (2Co 4.16).
THAYER.en: To operate a profound transformation that restores something to its ideal state or makes it superior and spiritually new. 1. The continuous renewal of the believer's inner and spiritual man by divine work (2 Cor 4:16).

DEFINITION: The process or result of making something new and different, elevating it to a higher standard of existence.
SENSES: 1. The spiritual renewal of the mind and life operated by the Holy Spirit (Rom 12:2; Tit 3:5).

THAYER.pt: O processo ou o resultado de tornar algo novo e diferente, elevando-o a um padrão superior de existência. 1. A renovação espiritual da mente e da vida operada pelo Espírito Santo (Rm 12.2; Tt 3.5).
THAYER.en: The process or result of making something new and different, elevating it to a higher standard of existence. 1. The spiritual renewal of the mind and life operated by the Holy Spirit (Rom 12:2; Tit 3:5).

DEFINITION: To remove the covering or veil that was hiding something, making it fully visible and manifest.
SENSES: 1. To remove the figurative veil to contemplate openly the glory of the Lord (2 Cor 3:18).

THAYER.pt: Remover a cobertura ou o véu que ocultava algo, tornando-o plenamente visível e manifesto. 1. Retirar o véu figurativo para contemplar abertamente a glória do Senhor (2Co 3.18).
THAYER.en: To remove the covering or veil that was hiding something, making it fully visible and manifest. 1. To remove the figurative veil to contemplate openly the glory of the Lord (2 Cor 3:18).

DEFINITION: To undertake a journey back to the starting point or to return to a previous state of behavior.
SENSES: 1. To return physically to a place of origin (Mt 2:12; Lk 10:6; Acts 18:21; Heb 11:15).
2. To return to a previous behavior or path (2 Pet 2:21).

THAYER.pt: Empreender uma viagem de volta ao ponto de partida ou retornar a um estado anterior de comportamento. 1. Retornar fisicamente a um lugar de origem (Mt 2.12; Lc 10.6; At 18.21; Hb 11.15). | 2. Voltar a um comportamento ou caminho anterior (2Pe 2.21).
THAYER.en: To undertake a journey back to the starting point or to return to a previous state of behavior. 1. To return physically to a place of origin (Mt 2:12; Lk 10:6; Acts 18:21; Heb 11:15). | 2. To return to a previous behavior or path (2 Pet 2:21).

DEFINITION: To be in a reclining position, a Greco-Roman and Jewish custom adopted during formal meals.
SENSES: 1. To recline at the table to participate in a meal or banquet (Mt 9:10; Jn 13:23).

THAYER.pt: Estar em posição reclinada, costume grecorromano e judaico adotado durante as refeições formais. 1. Reclinar-se à mesa para participar de uma refeição ou banquete (Mt 9.10; Jo 13.23).
THAYER.en: To be in a reclining position, a Greco-Roman and Jewish custom adopted during formal meals. 1. To recline at the table to participate in a meal or banquet (Mt 9:10; Jn 13:23).

DEFINITION: To present a synthesis of various elements or to unify all things under a single principle or central head.
SENSES: 1. To gather and head up all things in Christ as the central point of the divine plan (Eph 1:10).
2. To summarize diverse commandments under a single comprehensive principle (Rom 13:9).

THAYER.pt: Apresentar uma síntese de vários elementos ou unificar todas as coisas sob um princípio ou cabeça central. 1. Reunir e encabeçar todas as coisas em Cristo como o ponto central do plano divino (Ef 1.10). | 2. Resumir diversos mandamentos sob um único princípio abrangente (Rm 13.9).
THAYER.en: To present a synthesis of various elements or to unify all things under a single principle or central head. 1. To gather and head up all things in Christ as the central point of the divine plan (Eph 1:10). | 2. To summarize diverse commandments under a single comprehensive principle (Rom 13:9).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: ἀνακλινῶ, Aor: ἀνέκλινα, Pass: ἀνεκλίθην
DEFINITION: To cause someone to lie down, whether for rest or to recline at the table during a meal.
SENSES: 1. To lay down or accommodate someone for sleep or rest (Lk 2:7).
2. To cause to recline at the table for a meal (Mt 14:19; Lk 12:37).

THAYER.pt: Significa fazer alguém deitar-se, seja para descansar ou para reclinar-se à mesa durante uma refeição. 1. Deitar ou acomodar alguém para dormir ou repousar (Lc 2.7). | 2. Fazer reclinar à mesa para uma refeição (Mt 14.19; Lc 12.37).
THAYER.en: To cause someone to lie down, whether for rest or to recline at the table during a meal. 1. To lay down or accommodate someone for sleep or rest (Lk 2:7). | 2. To cause to recline at the table for a meal (Mt 14:19; Lk 12:37).

DEFINITION: To interrupt the progress of someone or something, stopping or containing a movement or action.
SENSES: 1. To contain, stem, or restrain the advance of something.

THAYER.pt: Interromper o progresso de alguém ou de algo, detendo ou contendo um movimento ou ação. 1. Conter, estancar ou refrear o avanço de algo.
THAYER.en: To interrupt the progress of someone or something, stopping or containing a movement or action. 1. To contain, stem, or restrain the advance of something.

DEFINITION: To emit a loud and sharp sound with the voice, expressing strong emotion, fear, or spiritual possession.
SENSES: 1. To give a loud shout or exclaim (Mk 1:23; Lk 4:33).

THAYER.pt: Emitir um som forte e agudo com a voz, expressando forte emoção, medo ou possessão espiritual. 1. Dar um grito alto ou exclamar (Mc 1.23; Lc 4.33).
THAYER.en: To emit a loud and sharp sound with the voice, expressing strong emotion, fear, or spiritual possession. 1. To give a loud shout or exclaim (Mk 1:23; Lk 4:33).

DEFINITION: To engage in careful study, legal investigation, or profound discernment of a matter.
SENSES: 1. To examine or investigate a matter critically (Acts 17:11; 1 Cor 10:25).
2. To conduct a judicial hearing or interrogation (Acts 12:19; 24:8).
3. To judge or discern with spiritual criteria (1 Cor 2:15; 4:3).

THAYER.pt: Engajar-se em um estudo cuidadoso, investigação legal ou discernimento profundo de uma questão. 1. Examinar ou investigar criteriosamente uma questão (At 17.11; 1Co 10.25). | 2. Conduzir uma audiência ou interrogatório judicial (At 12.19; 24.8). | 3. Julgar ou discernir com critério espiritual (1Co 2.15; 4.3).
THAYER.en: To engage in careful study, legal investigation, or profound discernment of a matter. 1. To examine or investigate a matter critically (Acts 17:11; 1 Cor 10:25). | 2. To conduct a judicial hearing or interrogation (Acts 12:19; 24:8). | 3. To judge or discern with spiritual criteria (1 Cor 2:15; 4:3).

DEFINITION: Describes a judicial process or preliminary interrogation conducted to examine facts and evidence before an official decision.
SENSES: 1. A preliminary judicial hearing or investigation (Acts 25:26).

THAYER.pt: Descreve um processo judicial ou interrogatório preliminar conduzido para examinar fatos e evidências antes de uma decisão oficial. 1. Audiência ou investigação judicial de caráter preliminar (At 25.26).
THAYER.en: Describes a judicial process or preliminary interrogation conducted to examine facts and evidence before an official decision. 1. A preliminary judicial hearing or investigation (Acts 25:26).

DEFINITION: Describes the action of straightening the body from a bent position, or figuratively, lifting the head with expectation and hope in the face of imminent deliverance.
SENSES: 1. To straighten up physically from a bent or prostrate posture (Luke 13:11; John 8:7).
2. To lift the head with courage and expectation in view of redemption (Luke 21:28).

THAYER.pt: Descreve a ação de endireitar o corpo erguendo-se de uma posição curvada, ou figuradamente de levantar a cabeça com expectativa e esperança diante de um livramento iminente. 1. Endireitar-se fisicamente de uma postura curvada ou prostrada (Lc 13.11; Jo 8.7). | 2. Erguer a cabeça com ânimo e expectativa em vista da redenção (Lc 21.28).
THAYER.en: Describes the action of straightening the body from a bent position, or figuratively, lifting the head with expectation and hope in the face of imminent deliverance. 1. To straighten up physically from a bent or prostrate posture (Luke 13:11; John 8:7). | 2. To lift the head with courage and expectation in view of redemption (Luke 21:28).

DEFINITION: To take something or someone for oneself, lifting, welcoming, or integrating into a journey or task.
SENSES: 1. To lift and carry something with oneself, to take up (Acts 7:43; Eph 6:13).
2. To receive up or welcome, as in the ascension of Christ (Mark 16:19; 1 Tim 3:16).

THAYER.pt: Pegar algo ou alguém para si, levantando, acolhendo ou integrando em uma jornada ou tarefa. 1. Levantar e carregar algo consigo, erguer (At 7.43; Ef 6.13). | 2. Receber para cima ou acolher, como na ascensão de Cristo (Mc 16.19; 1Tm 3.16).
THAYER.en: To take something or someone for oneself, lifting, welcoming, or integrating into a journey or task. 1. To lift and carry something with oneself, to take up (Acts 7:43; Eph 6:13). | 2. To receive up or welcome, as in the ascension of Christ (Mark 16:19; 1 Tim 3:16).

DEFINITION: Designates the act of being elevated or received above, used in Christian literature to describe the ascension of Jesus to heaven.
SENSES: 1. The ascension of Christ back to heavenly glory (Luke 9:51).

THAYER.pt: Designa o ato de ser elevado ou recebido acima, sendo empregado na literatura cristã para descrever a ascensão de Jesus ao céu. 1. A ascensão de Cristo de volta à glória celestial (Lc 9.51).
THAYER.en: Designates the act of being elevated or received above, used in Christian literature to describe the ascension of Jesus to heaven. 1. The ascension of Christ back to heavenly glory (Luke 9:51).

DEFINITION: To spend, destroy, or completely annihilate something through excessive use, fire, or violent action.
SENSES: 1. To consume or destroy by means of fire or violent force (Luke 9:54).
2. To completely annihilate the final adversary (2 Thess 2:8).

THAYER.pt: Gastar, destruir ou aniquilar completamente algo pelo uso excessivo, pelo fogo ou por ação violenta. 1. Consumir ou destruir por meio de fogo ou força violenta (Lc 9.54). | 2. Aniquilar completamente o adversário final (2Ts 2.8).
THAYER.en: To spend, destroy, or completely annihilate something through excessive use, fire, or violent action. 1. To consume or destroy by means of fire or violent force (Luke 9:54). | 2. To completely annihilate the final adversary (2 Thess 2:8).

DEFINITION: Indicates a relationship of proportional correspondence between different elements or quantities.
SENSES: 1. Proportion or adequate measure in the practice of spiritual gifts (Rom 12:6).

THAYER.pt: Indica uma relação de correspondência proporcional entre diferentes elementos ou grandezas. 1. Proporção ou medida adequada na prática dos dons espirituais (Rm 12.6).
THAYER.en: Indicates a relationship of proportional correspondence between different elements or quantities. 1. Proportion or adequate measure in the practice of spiritual gifts (Rom 12:6).

DEFINITION: To reflect deeply and cautiously on a subject, weighing all aspects involved.
SENSES: 1. To consider with attention and deep reasoning the example of Christ's perseverance (Heb 12:3).

THAYER.pt: Significa refletir profundamente e com cautela sobre um assunto, ponderando todos os aspectos envolvidos. 1. Considerar com atenção e raciocínio profundo o exemplo de perseverança de Cristo (Hb 12.3).
THAYER.en: To reflect deeply and cautiously on a subject, weighing all aspects involved. 1. To consider with attention and deep reasoning the example of Christ's perseverance (Heb 12:3).

DEFINITION: Describes something that has lost its salt content or completely lacks the necessary condiment.
SENSES: 1. Literally saltless or deprived of its saline property (Mark 9:50).

THAYER.pt: Descreve algo que perdeu o seu teor de sal ou que carece totalmente do condimento necessário. 1. Literalmente sem sal ou privado de sua propriedade salina (Mc 9.50).
THAYER.en: Describes something that has lost its salt content or completely lacks the necessary condiment. 1. Literally saltless or deprived of its saline property (Mark 9:50).

DEFINITION: Originally denoted the unloosing of moorings or the striking of camps; it came to be used metaphorically for the departure from this life.
SENSES: 1. The departure from earthly life through physical death (2 Tim 4:6).

THAYER.pt: Originalmente denotava o desatar de amarras ou o desarmar de acampamentos; passou a ser usado metaforicamente para a partida desta vida. 1. A partida da vida terrena através da morte física (2Tm 4.6).
THAYER.en: Originally denoted the unloosing of moorings or the striking of camps; it came to be used metaphorically for the departure from this life. 1. The departure from earthly life through physical death (2 Tim 4:6).

DEFINITION: To cast off moorings, break camp, depart on a journey, or return to the point of origin.
SENSES: 1. To loosen moorings or open doors (Acts 16:26).
2. To depart from this life to return to the presence of Christ (Phil 1:23; Luke 12:36).

THAYER.pt: Desatar amarras, levantar acampamento, partir em viagem ou retornar ao ponto de origem. 1. Soltar amarras ou abrir portas (At 16.26). | 2. Partir desta vida para retornar à presença de Cristo (Fp 1.23; Lc 12.36).
THAYER.en: To cast off moorings, break camp, depart on a journey, or return to the point of origin. 1. To loosen moorings or open doors (Acts 16:26). | 2. To depart from this life to return to the presence of Christ (Phil 1:23; Luke 12:36).

DEFINITION: Qualifies one who has not committed sin or who is completely free from moral guilt.
SENSES: 1. Exempt from sin or free from personal guilt (John 8:7).

THAYER.pt: Qualifica aquele que não cometeu pecado ou que está completamente livre de culpa moral. 1. Isento de pecado ou livre de culpa pessoal (Jo 8.7).
THAYER.en: Qualifies one who has not committed sin or who is completely free from moral guilt. 1. Exempt from sin or free from personal guilt (John 8:7).

DEFINITION: To remain in a place or state with expectation directed toward a future event.
SENSES: 1. To actively and patiently await the coming or return of someone (1 Thess 1:10).

THAYER.pt: Significa permanecer em um lugar ou estado com expectativa voltada para um acontecimento futuro. 1. Aguardar ativamente e com paciência a vinda ou o retorno de alguém (1Ts 1.10).
THAYER.en: To remain in a place or state with expectation directed toward a future event. 1. To actively and patiently await the coming or return of someone (1 Thess 1:10).

DEFINITION: To bring to memory or cause someone to recall something from the past; can be used in the active (to remind) or passive (to remember).
SENSES: 1. To make someone remember something or recall a teaching (1 Cor 4:17; 2 Tim 1:6).
2. To remember something on one's own in the passive voice (Mark 14:72; Heb 10:32).

THAYER.pt: Trazer à memória ou fazer com que alguém recorde algo do passado, podendo ser usado na ativa (fazer lembrar) ou na passiva (lembrar-se). 1. Fazer alguém lembrar de algo ou recordar um ensinamento (1Co 4.17; 2Tm 1.6). | 2. Lembrar-se de algo por conta própria na voz passiva (Mc 14.72; Hb 10.32).
THAYER.en: To bring to memory or cause someone to recall something from the past; can be used in the active (to remind) or passive (to remember). 1. To make someone remember something or recall a teaching (1 Cor 4:17; 2 Tim 1:6). | 2. To remember something on one's own in the passive voice (Mark 14:72; Heb 10:32).

DEFINITION: Refers to the act or means of bringing something back to mind, serving as a reminder or memorial to keep the awareness of an event or person alive.
SENSES: 1. Cultic and commemorative recollection, especially in the Lord's Supper (1 Cor 11:24; Luke 22:19).
2. A calling to memory or reminder of sins (Heb 10:3).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se ao ato ou meio de trazer algo de volta à mente, servindo como lembrança ou memorial para manter viva a consciência de um evento ou pessoa. 1. Recordação ou lembrança cultual e comemorativa, especialmente na Ceia do Senhor (1Co 11.24; Lc 22.19). | 2. Chamada à memória ou lembrete de pecados (Hb 10.3).
THAYER.en: Refers to the act or means of bringing something back to mind, serving as a reminder or memorial to keep the awareness of an event or person alive. 1. Cultic and commemorative recollection, especially in the Lord's Supper (1 Cor 11:24; Luke 22:19). | 2. A calling to memory or reminder of sins (Heb 10:3).

DEFINITION: Indicates the action of transforming something into a new, superior, and reinvigorated state.
SENSES: 1. To deeply renew the spirit or mind in the process of sanctification (Eph 4:23).

THAYER.pt: Indica a ação de transformar algo para um estado novo, superior e revigorado. 1. Renovar profundamente o espírito ou a mente no processo de santificação (Ef 4.23).
THAYER.en: Indicates the action of transforming something into a new, superior, and reinvigorated state. 1. To deeply renew the spirit or mind in the process of sanctification (Eph 4:23).

DEFINITION: Describes the act of coming to one's senses, recovering mental sobriety and proper discernment after a state of stupor.
SENSES: 1. To return to good sense and free oneself from spiritual traps (2 Tim 2:26).

THAYER.pt: Descreve o ato de voltar a si, recuperando a sobriedade mental e o discernimento adequado após um estado de torpor. 1. Voltar ao bom senso e livrar-se das armadilhas espirituais (2Tm 2.26).
THAYER.en: Describes the act of coming to one's senses, recovering mental sobriety and proper discernment after a state of stupor. 1. To return to good sense and free oneself from spiritual traps (2 Tim 2:26).

DEFINITION: A Hebrew proper name used to identify different characters in the New Testament, including members of the primitive community and religious authorities.
SENSES: 1. Husband of Sapphira who lied to the Holy Spirit (Acts 5:1).
2. Disciple in Damascus who restored the sight of the apostle Paul (Acts 9:10).
3. Jewish high priest before whom Paul was tried (Acts 23:2).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio hebraico utilizado para identificar diferentes personagens no Novo Testamento, incluindo membros da comunidade primitiva e autoridades religiosas. 1. Marido de Safira que mentiu ao Espírito Santo (At 5.1). | 2. Discípulo em Damasco que restaurou a visão do apóstolo Paulo (At 9.10). | 3. Sumo sacerdote judaico perante quem Paulo foi julgado (At 23.2).
THAYER.en: A Hebrew proper name used to identify different characters in the New Testament, including members of the primitive community and religious authorities. 1. Husband of Sapphira who lied to the Holy Spirit (Acts 5:1). | 2. Disciple in Damascus who restored the sight of the apostle Paul (Acts 9:10). | 3. Jewish high priest before whom Paul was tried (Acts 23:2).

DEFINITION: Refers to something that cannot be refuted, contradicted, or be the object of objection.
SENSES: 1. A fact or statement that cannot be denied or contested (Acts 19:36).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se a algo que não pode ser refutado, contraditado ou objeto de objeção. 1. Fato ou afirmação que não pode ser negado ou contestado (At 19.36).
THAYER.en: Refers to something that cannot be refuted, contradicted, or be the object of objection. 1. A fact or statement that cannot be denied or contested (Acts 19:36).

DEFINITION: A mode of acting or responding that does not raise objections or oppositions.
SENSES: 1. To perform something without presenting opposition or objections (Acts 10:29).

THAYER.pt: Modo de agir ou responder que não levanta contestações ou oposições. 1. Realizar algo sem apresentar oposição ou objeções (At 10.29).
THAYER.en: A mode of acting or responding that does not raise objections or oppositions. 1. To perform something without presenting opposition or objections (Acts 10:29).

DEFINITION: Designates someone or something that lacks the merit, dignity, or suitability corresponding to a situation.
SENSES: 1. Lacking the proper value or qualification for a specific function (1Co 6:2).

THAYER.pt: Designa alguém ou algo que não possui o mérito, a dignidade ou a adequação correspondente a uma situação. 1. Que não possui o devido valor ou qualificação para determinada função (1Co 6.2).
THAYER.en: Designates someone or something that lacks the merit, dignity, or suitability corresponding to a situation. 1. Lacking the proper value or qualification for a specific function (1Co 6:2).

DEFINITION: Describes behavior that disregards the decorum, reverence, or value required by a sacred occasion.
SENSES: 1. Participating in sacred rites without due reverence or spiritual preparation (1Co 11:27).

THAYER.pt: Descreve um comportamento que desconsidera o decoro, a reverência ou o valor exigido por uma ocasião sagrada. 1. Participar de ritos sagrados sem a devida reverência ou preparo espiritual (1Co 11.27).
THAYER.en: Describes behavior that disregards the decorum, reverence, or value required by a sacred occasion. 1. Participating in sacred rites without due reverence or spiritual preparation (1Co 11:27).

DEFINITION: The cessation of laborious activity or the relief from burdens and worries, providing renewal.
SENSES: 1. Physical and spiritual rest or relief (Mt 11:29; Rev 4:8).

THAYER.pt: Cessação de atividade laboriosa ou alívio de fardos e preocupações, proporcionando renovação. 1. Descanso ou alívio físico e espiritual (Mt 11.29; Ap 4.8).
THAYER.en: The cessation of laborious activity or the relief from burdens and worries, providing renewal. 1. Physical and spiritual rest or relief (Mt 11:29; Rev 4:8).

DEFINITION: To provide relief from work or weariness, restoring physical or spiritual strength, or to enjoy a period of rest.
SENSES: 1. To give rest, refresh, or relieve someone from weariness or burdens (Mt 11:28; 1Co 16:18).
2. To take rest, to rest (Mt 26:45; Rev 14:13).

THAYER.pt: Prover alívio do trabalho ou do cansaço, restaurando as forças físicas ou espirituais, ou desfrutar de um período de descanso. 1. Dar descanso, refrescar ou aliviar alguém do cansaço ou fardo (Mt 11.28; 1Co 16.18). | 2. Tomar repouso, descansar (Mt 26.45; Ap 14.13).
THAYER.en: To provide relief from work or weariness, restoring physical or spiritual strength, or to enjoy a period of rest. 1. To give rest, refresh, or relieve someone from weariness or burdens (Mt 11:28; 1Co 16:18). | 2. To take rest, to rest (Mt 26:45; Rev 14:13).

DEFINITION: To move or influence someone to adopt a course of action through arguments.
SENSES: 1. To persuade or incite people to act in a certain way, sometimes with inappropriate motivations (Ac 18:13).

THAYER.pt: Significa mover ou influenciar alguém a adotar um ponto de curso de ação por meio de argumentos. 1. Persuadir ou incitar pessoas a agirem de determinada maneira, por vezes com motivações inadequadas (At 18.13).
THAYER.en: To move or influence someone to adopt a course of action through arguments. 1. To persuade or incite people to act in a certain way, sometimes with inappropriate motivations (Ac 18:13).

DEFINITION: To send someone back to a previous authority or to the place from which they came.
SENSES: 1. To forward to a higher authority (Lk 23:7; Ac 25:21).
2. To send back to the origin (Lk 23:11; Phm 12).

THAYER.pt: Enviar alguém de volta a uma autoridade anterior ou a um local de onde veio. 1. Encaminhar a uma autoridade superior (Lc 23.7; At 25.21). | 2. Enviar de volta à origem (Lc 23.11; Fm 12).
THAYER.en: To send someone back to a previous authority or to the place from which they came. 1. To forward to a higher authority (Lk 23:7; Ac 25:21). | 2. To send back to the origin (Lk 23:11; Phm 12).

DEFINITION: A person suffering from a severe physical disability, mutilation, or loss of bodily limbs.
SENSES: 1. Individuals suffering from physical disabilities or severe mutilations (Lk 14:13, 21).

THAYER.pt: Pessoa que sofre de alguma deficiência física severa, mutilação ou perda de membros corporais. 1. Indivíduos que sofrem de deficiências físicas ou mutilações graves (Lc 14.13, 21).
THAYER.en: A person suffering from a severe physical disability, mutilation, or loss of bodily limbs. 1. Individuals suffering from physical disabilities or severe mutilations (Lk 14:13, 21).

DEFINITION: To recline on a couch or seat, especially during a meal according to ancient custom, or to lean back.
SENSES: 1. To recline at the table to eat or dine (Lk 11:37; Jn 6:10).
2. To lean back while reclining (Jn 13:25).

THAYER.pt: Reclinar-se sobre um divã ou assento, especialmente durante uma refeição conforme o costume antigo, ou inclinar-se para trás. 1. Reclinar-se à mesa para comer ou cear (Lc 11.37; Jo 6.10). | 2. Inclinar-se para trás enquanto reclinado (Jo 13.25).
THAYER.en: To recline on a couch or seat, especially during a meal according to ancient custom, or to lean back. 1. To recline at the table to eat or dine (Lk 11:37; Jn 6:10). | 2. To lean back while reclining (Jn 13:25).

DEFINITION: To fill what is lacking to make something complete, to supply a need, or to fully carry out a prophecy or obligation.
SENSES: 1. To complete the quantity or supply what is lacking (1Co 16:17; Php 2:30).
2. To fulfill or fully carry out a promise, commandment, or prophecy (Mt 13:14; Gal 6:2).

THAYER.pt: Significa preencher o que falta para tornar algo completo, suprir uma necessidade ou cumprir cabalmente uma profecia ou obrigação. 1. Completar a quantidade ou suprir o que está faltando (1Co 16.17; Fp 2.30). | 2. Cumprir ou realizar plenamente uma promessa, mandamento ou profecia (Mt 13.14; Gl 6.2).
THAYER.en: To fill what is lacking to make something complete, to supply a need, or to fully carry out a prophecy or obligation. 1. To complete the quantity or supply what is lacking (1Co 16:17; Php 2:30). | 2. To fulfill or fully carry out a promise, commandment, or prophecy (Mt 13:14; Gal 6:2).

DEFINITION: Lacking any valid defense or justifiable argument to exempt oneself from guilt.
SENSES: 1. To be entirely without excuse or defense before the just judgment of God (Ro 1:20; 2:1).

THAYER.pt: Que não possui qualquer defesa válida ou argumento justificável para eximir-se da culpa. 1. Estar totalmente sem desculpa ou defesa diante do julgamento justo de Deus (Rm 1.20; 2.1).
THAYER.en: Lacking any valid defense or justifiable argument to exempt oneself from guilt. 1. To be entirely without excuse or defense before the just judgment of God (Ro 1:20; 2:1).

DEFINITION: Refers to the physical act of opening a scroll of papyrus or parchment for reading.
SENSES: 1. To unroll a book in scroll format to read its content (Lk 4:17).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se ao ato físico de abrir um rolo de papiro ou pergaminho para leitura. 1. Desenrolar um livro em formato de rolo para ler o seu conteúdo (Lc 4.17).
THAYER.en: Refers to the physical act of opening a scroll of papyrus or parchment for reading. 1. To unroll a book in scroll format to read its content (Lk 4:17).

SHORT_GLOSS: to light, kindle, set on fire
DEFINITION: To cause fire to begin burning by setting flames to an object or material.
SENSES: 1. To light a fire, torch, or start a blaze (Lk 12:49; Ac 28:2; Jas 3:5).
USAGE: to light, kindle, set on fire

THAYER.pt: Fazer com que o fogo comece a queimar, ateando chamas a um objeto ou material. 1. Acender uma fogueira, tocha ou iniciar um incêndio (Lc 12.49; At 28.2; Tg 3.5).
THAYER.en: To cause fire to begin burning by setting flames to an object or material. 1. To light a fire, torch, or start a blaze (Lk 12:49; Ac 28:2; Jas 3:5).

DEFINITION: Qualifies a quantity so vast that it exceeds any possibility of counting.
SENSES: 1. A multitude or set that cannot be counted due to its great volume (Heb 11:12).

THAYER.pt: Qualifica uma quantidade tão vasta que ultrapassa qualquer possibilidade de contagem. 1. Multidão ou conjunto que não pode ser contado devido ao seu grande volume (Hb 11.12).
THAYER.en: Qualifies a quantity so vast that it exceeds any possibility of counting. 1. A multitude or set that cannot be counted due to its great volume (Heb 11:12).

DEFINITION: To provoke agitation, excitement, or revolt among people through instigation.
SENSES: 1. To incite or stir up crowds against someone (Mk 15:11; Lk 23:5).

THAYER.pt: Provocar agitação, excitação ou revolta entre as pessoas por meio de instigação. 1. Incitar ou agitar multidões contra alguém (Mc 15.11; Lc 23.5).
THAYER.en: To provoke agitation, excitement, or revolt among people through instigation. 1. To incite or stir up crowds against someone (Mk 15:11; Lk 23:5).

DEFINITION: Indicates the action of causing mental confusion, distress, or instability in someone's mind.
SENSES: 1. To cause deep disturbance and destabilize the convictions of others (Ac 15:24).

THAYER.pt: Indica a ação de causar confusão mental, aflição ou instabilidade na mente de alguém. 1. Causar perturbação profunda e desestabilizar convicções alheias (At 15.24).
THAYER.en: Indicates the action of causing mental confusion, distress, or instability in someone's mind. 1. To cause deep disturbance and destabilize the convictions of others (Ac 15:24).

DEFINITION: To exert force to pull something from the depths to a higher level.
SENSES: 1. To pull an animal out of a pit or to lift an object (Lk 14:5; Ac 11:10).

THAYER.pt: Exercer força para puxar algo das profundezas para um nível superior. 1. Puxar um animal para fora de um poço ou erguer um objeto (Lc 14.5; At 11.10).
THAYER.en: To exert force to pull something from the depths to a higher level. 1. To pull an animal out of a pit or to lift an object (Lk 14:5; Ac 11:10).

DEFINITION: The act or process of returning to life after physical death, or a turning point toward a higher condition.
SENSES: 1. The bodily resurrection of the dead to a new existence (Ac 1:22; 1Co 15:12).
2. A change of status or rising to a better condition (Lk 2:34).

THAYER.pt: O ato ou processo de retornar à vida após a morte física, ou uma guinada para uma condição superior. 1. A ressurreição corpórea dos mortos para uma nova existência (At 1.22; 1Co 15.12). | 2. Mudança de status ou reerguimento para uma condição melhor (Lc 2.34).
THAYER.en: The act or process of returning to life after physical death, or a turning point toward a higher condition. 1. The bodily resurrection of the dead to a new existence (Ac 1:22; 1Co 15:12). | 2. A change of status or rising to a better condition (Lk 2:34).

DEFINITION: Describes the action of upsetting the stability of a community or inciting riots and rebellions.
SENSES: 1. To cause agitation, disturb, or incite social revolt (Ac 17:6; 21:38; Gal 5:12).

THAYER.pt: Descreve a ação de transtornar a estabilidade de uma comunidade ou incitar tumultos e rebeliões. 1. Causar agitação, perturbar ou incitar revolta social (At 17.6; 21.38; Gl 5.12).
THAYER.en: Describes the action of upsetting the stability of a community or inciting riots and rebellions. 1. To cause agitation, disturb, or incite social revolt (Ac 17:6; 21:38; Gal 5:12).

DEFINITION: To fix again to a cross; used in a figurative sense to denote the continuous rejection of Christ's sacrifice.
SENSES: 1. To crucify for a second time or to expose again to supreme dishonor (Heb 6:6).

THAYER.pt: Significa fixar novamente numa cruz, sendo empregado em sentido figurado para denotar a rejeição contínua do sacrifício de Cristo. 1. Crucificar pela segunda vez ou expor novamente à desonra suprema (Hb 6.6).
THAYER.en: To fix again to a cross; used in a figurative sense to denote the continuous rejection of Christ's sacrifice. 1. To crucify for a second time or to expose again to supreme dishonor (Heb 6:6).

DEFINITION: Describes the emission of a deep sigh or groan caused by strong anguish or frustration.
SENSES: 1. To give a deep sigh as a sign of sadness or indignation (Mk 8:12).

THAYER.pt: Descreve a emissão de um suspiro profundo ou gemido causado por forte angústia ou frustração. 1. Dar um suspiro profundo em sinal de tristeza ou indignação (Mk 8.12).
THAYER.en: Describes the emission of a deep sigh or groan caused by strong anguish or frustration. 1. To give a deep sigh as a sign of sadness or indignation (Mk 8:12).

DEFINITION: Originally denotes the act of turning around or returning, but in the New Testament it is widely used in a metaphorical sense to describe a person's ethical behavior and lifestyle.
SENSES: 1. To physically turn over or overturn objects (John 2:15).
2. To conduct oneself, behave, or live according to certain principles (Eph 2:3; 1 Tim 3:15).
3. To return or go back to a place (Acts 5:22).

THAYER.pt: Originalmente denota o ato de revirar ou retornar, mas no Novo Testamento é amplamente empregado no sentido metafórico para descrever o comportamento ético e o estilo de vida de uma pessoa. 1. Revirar ou overturnar fisicamente objetos (Jo 2.15). | 2. Conduzir-se, comportar-se ou viver de acordo com certos princípios (Ef 2.3; 1Tm 3.15). | 3. Retornar ou voltar a um lugar (At 5.22).
THAYER.en: Originally denotes the act of turning around or returning, but in the New Testament it is widely used in a metaphorical sense to describe a person's ethical behavior and lifestyle. 1. To physically turn over or overturn objects (John 2:15). | 2. To conduct oneself, behave, or live according to certain principles (Eph 2:3; 1 Tim 3:15). | 3. To return or go back to a place (Acts 5:22).

DEFINITION: A mode of living and behaving in society, reflecting the moral and ethical principles that govern a person's life.
SENSES: 1. Manner of life, moral conduct, or daily behavior (Gal 1:13; 1 Pet 3:2).

THAYER.pt: Modo de viver e se comportar na sociedade, refletindo os princípios morais e éticos que regem a vida de uma pessoa. 1. Maneira de viver, conduta moral ou comportamento diário (Gl 1.13; 1Pe 3.2).
THAYER.en: A mode of living and behaving in society, reflecting the moral and ethical principles that govern a person's life. 1. Manner of life, moral conduct, or daily behavior (Gal 1:13; 1 Pet 3:2).

DEFINITION: Refers to systematically organizing facts or reports for the composition of a written narrative.
SENSES: 1. To compile or organize a historical narrative in an orderly fashion (Luke 1:1).

THAYER.pt: Significa organizar sistematicamente fatos ou relatos para a composição de uma narrativa escrita. 1. Compilar ou organizar uma narrativa histórica de forma ordenada (Lc 1.1).
THAYER.en: Refers to systematically organizing facts or reports for the composition of a written narrative. 1. To compile or organize a historical narrative in an orderly fashion (Luke 1:1).

SHORT_GLOSS: to rise, dawn, spring up, sprout
DEFINITION: Describes the upward movement of celestial bodies like the sun and stars, or the emergence and sprouting of plants and descendants.
SENSES: 1. The rising or ascending of stars and light above the horizon (Matt 4:16; 2 Pet 1:19).
2. To cause to sprout or spring up from the earth (Matt 5:45).
3. To descend or arise as a lineage from a prominent figure (Heb 7:14).
USAGE: to rise, dawn, spring up, sprout

THAYER.pt: Descreve o movimento ascendente de corpos celestes como o sol e as estrelas, ou o surgimento e brotamento de plantas e descendentes. 1. O nascer ou elevar-se de astros e da luz sobre o horizonte (Mt 4.16; 2Pe 1.19). | 2. Fazer brotar ou surgir da terra (Mt 5.45). | 3. Descender ou surgir como linhagem de uma figura proeminente (Hb 7.14).
THAYER.en: Describes the upward movement of celestial bodies like the sun and stars, or the emergence and sprouting of plants and descendants. 1. The rising or ascending of stars and light above the horizon (Matt 4:16; 2 Pet 1:19). | 2. To cause to sprout or spring up from the earth (Matt 5:45). | 3. To descend or arise as a lineage from a prominent figure (Heb 7:14).

DEFINITION: To present a detailed matter to someone for consideration, consultation, or evaluation.
SENSES: 1. To set forth a case or report facts in detail to an authority or brothers (Acts 25:14; Gal 2:2).

THAYER.pt: Apresentar um assunto detalhado a alguém para consideração, consulta ou avaliação. 1. Expor um caso ou relatar fatos detalhadamente a uma autoridade ou irmãos (At 25.14; Gl 2.2).
THAYER.en: To present a detailed matter to someone for consideration, consultation, or evaluation. 1. To set forth a case or report facts in detail to an authority or brothers (Acts 25:14; Gal 2:2).

DEFINITION: Refers to the rising of celestial bodies, the cardinal direction of east, or, figuratively, the dawn and the dawning of a new era of salvation.
SENSES: 1. The rising of stars or celestial bodies in the firmament (Matt 2:2).
2. The cardinal direction of east (Matt 2:1; Rev 7:2).
3. The breaking of day, the dawn, or the coming of the Messiah as light (Luke 1:78).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se ao nascer dos corpos celestes, à direção cardeal leste ou, figuradamente, ao amanhecer e ao alvorecer de uma nova era de salvação. 1. O nascer de astros ou estrelas no firmamento (Mt 2.2). | 2. A direção cardeal leste ou o oriente (Mt 2.1; Ap 7.2). | 3. O raiar do dia, a alvorada ou a vinda messias como luz (Lc 1.78).
THAYER.en: Refers to the rising of celestial bodies, the cardinal direction of east, or, figuratively, the dawn and the dawning of a new era of salvation. 1. The rising of stars or celestial bodies in the firmament (Matt 2:2). | 2. The cardinal direction of east (Matt 2:1; Rev 7:2). | 3. The breaking of day, the dawn, or the coming of the Messiah as light (Luke 1:78).

DEFINITION: Means to turn something over completely or to ruin the moral and spiritual stability of individuals.
SENSES: 1. To physically overthrow or overturn (John 2:15).
2. To subvert faith or ruin the spiritual well-being of others (2 Tim 2:18; Titus 1:11).

THAYER.pt: Significa virar algo completamente ou arruinar a estabilidade moral e espiritual de indivíduos. 1. Derrubar ou revirar fisicamente (Jo 2.15). | 2. Subverter a fé ou arruinar o bem-estar espiritual (2Tm 2.18; Tt 1.11).
THAYER.en: Means to turn something over completely or to ruin the moral and spiritual stability of individuals. 1. To physically overthrow or overturn (John 2:15). | 2. To subvert faith or ruin the spiritual well-being of others (2 Tim 2:18; Titus 1:11).

DEFINITION: Refers to the act of nourishing, raising, and providing for the education and physical and mental development of a child.
SENSES: 1. To bring up, provide sustenance, and nourish physically (Acts 7:21).
2. To educate, train, and instruct in personal or spiritual development (Acts 22:3).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se ao ato de nutrir, criar e prover a educação e o desenvolvimento físico e mental de uma criança. 1. Criar, prover sustento e nutrir fisicamente (At 7.21). | 2. Educar, treinar e instruir no desenvolvimento pessoal ou espiritual (At 22.3).
THAYER.en: Refers to the act of nourishing, raising, and providing for the education and physical and mental development of a child. 1. To bring up, provide sustenance, and nourish physically (Acts 7:21). | 2. To educate, train, and instruct in personal or spiritual development (Acts 22:3).

DEFINITION: To become visible to the eye after being hidden, or to sight something from a distance.
SENSES: 1. To sight land or geographical contours during a voyage (Acts 21:3).
2. To become manifest or appear publicly (Luke 19:11).

THAYER.pt: Tornar-se visível à vista após estar oculto, ou avistar algo à distância. 1. Avistar terra ou contornos geográficos durante uma viagem (At 21.3). | 2. Tornar-se manifesto ou aparecer publicamente (Lc 19.11).
THAYER.en: To become visible to the eye after being hidden, or to sight something from a distance. 1. To sight land or geographical contours during a voyage (Acts 21:3). | 2. To become manifest or appear publicly (Luke 19:11).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: ἀνοίσω, Aor: ἀνήνεγκα, Perf: ἀνενήνοχα
DEFINITION: Describes the physical act of moving something from a lower position to a higher one, or, in a cultic context, presenting a sacrifice to God.
SENSES: 1. To lead or carry someone to a higher place (Matt 17:1; Luke 24:51).
2. To offer a sacrifice on the altar or to bear sins upon oneself (Heb 7:27; 1 Pet 2:24).

THAYER.pt: Descreve o ato físico de mover algo de uma posição inferior para uma superior, ou, em contexto cultual, apresentar um sacrifício a Deus. 1. Conduzir ou levar alguém para um lugar mais alto (Mt 17.1; Lc 24.51). | 2. Oferecer um sacrifício no altar ou levar pecados sobre si (Hb 7.27; 1Pe 2.24).
THAYER.en: Describes the physical act of moving something from a lower position to a higher one, or, in a cultic context, presenting a sacrifice to God. 1. To lead or carry someone to a higher place (Matt 17:1; Luke 24:51). | 2. To offer a sacrifice on the altar or to bear sins upon oneself (Heb 7:27; 1 Pet 2:24).

SHORT_GLOSS: to exclaim, cry out with a loud voice
DEFINITION: Indicates the act of emitting sound or speaking with great volume and vocal intensity.
SENSES: 1. To utter a cry or exclamation in a loud voice (Luke 1:42).
USAGE: to exclaim, cry out with a loud voice

THAYER.pt: Indica o ato de emitir som ou falar com grande volume e intensidade vocal. 1. Soltar um grito ou exclamação em voz alta (Lc 1.42).
THAYER.en: Indicates the act of emitting sound or speaking with great volume and vocal intensity. 1. To utter a cry or exclamation in a loud voice (Luke 1:42).

DEFINITION: Derived from the idea of overflowing or flooding, it is used metaphorically for excesses of reprehensible conduct.
SENSES: 1. To plunge into excesses of debauchery or moral corruption (1 Pet 4:4).

THAYER.pt: Derivado da ideia de transbordamento ou inundação, é usado metaforicamente para excessos de conduta reprovável. 1. Mergulhar em excessos de libertinagem ou corrupção moral (1Pe 4.4).
THAYER.en: Derived from the idea of overflowing or flooding, it is used metaphorically for excesses of reprehensible conduct. 1. To plunge into excesses of debauchery or moral corruption (1 Pet 4:4).

DEFINITION: To move away from a specific location to seek refuge, safety, or privacy.
SENSES: 1. To withdraw or move away from one place to another (Matt 2:13).
2. To return to a region from which one had departed (Matt 2:12).

THAYER.pt: Afastar-se de um local específico para buscar refúgio, segurança ou privacidade. 1. Retirar-se ou afastar-se de um lugar para outro (Mt 2.13). | 2. Retornar a uma região de onde se havia partido (Mt 2.12).
THAYER.en: To move away from a specific location to seek refuge, safety, or privacy. 1. To withdraw or move away from one place to another (Matt 2:13). | 2. To return to a region from which one had departed (Matt 2:12).

DEFINITION: Describes an experience of relief or rest after a period of difficulties or heavy burdens, with eschatological connotations of divine restoration.
SENSES: 1. A period of refreshment and spiritual restoration brought by the presence of the Lord (Acts 3:20).

THAYER.pt: Descreve uma experiência de alívio ou descanso após um período de dificuldades ou fardos pesados, com conotações escatológicas de restauração divina. 1. Período de refrigério e restauração espiritual trazido pela presença do Senhor (At 3.20).
THAYER.en: Describes an experience of relief or rest after a period of difficulties or heavy burdens, with eschatological connotations of divine restoration. 1. A period of refreshment and spiritual restoration brought by the presence of the Lord (Acts 3:20).

DEFINITION: Means to provide relief, revive, or restore the strength of someone who is exhausted, burdened, or under deep affliction.
SENSES: 1. To revive or console the spirit of someone amidst difficulties (2 Tim 1:16).
2. To experience personal relief or rest (Rom 15:32).

THAYER.pt: Significa proporcionar alívio, reanimar ou restaurar as forças de alguém que está exausto, sobrecarregado ou sob profunda aflição. 1. Reanimar ou consolar o espírito de alguém em meio às dificuldades (2Tm 1.16). | 2. Experimentar alívio ou descanso pessoal (Rm 15.32).
THAYER.en: Means to provide relief, revive, or restore the strength of someone who is exhausted, burdened, or under deep affliction. 1. To revive or console the spirit of someone amidst difficulties (2 Tim 1:16). | 2. To experience personal relief or rest (Rom 15:32).

DEFINITION: Refers to a person who kidnaps human beings to sell them as slaves or who operates in the illegal slave trade.
SENSES: 1. A slave trader or kidnapper, listed among the transgressors of the moral law (1 Tim 1:10).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se a uma pessoa que sequestra seres humanos para vendê-los como escravos ou que atua no comércio ilegal de escravos. 1. Traficante de escravos ou sequestrador, listado entre os transgressores da lei moral (1Tm 1.10).
THAYER.en: Refers to a person who kidnaps human beings to sell them as slaves or who operates in the illegal slave trade. 1. A slave trader or kidnapper, listed among the transgressors of the moral law (1 Tim 1:10).

DEFINITION: Apostle of Jesus, brother of Simon Peter, originally from Bethsaida and initially a disciple of John the Baptist.
SENSES: 1. The disciple and apostle Andrew (Matt 4:18; John 1:40).

THAYER.pt: Apóstolo de Jesus, irmão de Simão Pedro, originário de Betsaida e inicialmente discípulo de João Batista. 1. O discípulo e apóstolo André (Mt 4.18; Jo 1.40).
THAYER.en: Apostle of Jesus, brother of Simon Peter, originally from Bethsaida and initially a disciple of John the Baptist. 1. The disciple and apostle Andrew (Matt 4:18; John 1:40).

DEFINITION: An exhortation to act with bravery, firmness, and courage in the face of danger, opposition, or severe trials.
SENSES: 1. To demonstrate firmness and courage in times of trial or spiritual combat (1 Cor 16:13).

THAYER.pt: Exortação para agir com bravura, firmeza e coragem diante de perigos, oposição ou provações severas. 1. Demonstrar firmeza e coragem em tempos de provação ou combate espiritual (1Co 16.13).
THAYER.en: An exhortation to act with bravery, firmness, and courage in the face of danger, opposition, or severe trials. 1. To demonstrate firmness and courage in times of trial or spiritual combat (1 Cor 16:13).

DEFINITION: Name of a Jewish Christian or relative of the apostle Paul, mentioned in the final greetings of the Epistle to the Romans.
SENSES: 1. A fellow worker of Paul and a prisoner together with him (Rom 16:7).

THAYER.pt: Nome de um cristão judeu ou parente do apóstolo Paulo, mencionado nas saudações finais da carta aos Romanos. 1. Cooperador de Paulo e prisioneiro juntamente com ele (Rm 16.7).
THAYER.en: Name of a Jewish Christian or relative of the apostle Paul, mentioned in the final greetings of the Epistle to the Romans. 1. A fellow worker of Paul and a prisoner together with him (Rom 16:7).

DEFINITION: A compound term that literally designates a 'murderer of men,' someone who takes another person's life violently.
SENSES: 1. One who commits homicide or murder (1 Tim 1:9).

THAYER.pt: Termo composto que designa literalmente um 'assassino de homens', alguém que tira a vida de outra pessoa de forma violenta. 1. Aquele que comete homicídio ou assassinato (1Tm 1.9).
THAYER.en: A compound term that literally designates a 'murderer of men,' someone who takes another person's life violently. 1. One who commits homicide or murder (1 Tim 1:9).

DEFINITION: A person against whom no just accusation can be made; free from blame.
SENSES: 1. Blameless or irreproachable in conduct (1Co 1.8; Col 1.22).

THAYER.pt: Pessoa contra quem não se pode fazer nenhuma acusação justa; livre de culpa. 1. Inculpável ou irrepreensível na conduta (1Co 1.8; Cl 1.22).
THAYER.en: A person against whom no just accusation can be made; free from blame. 1. Blameless or irreproachable in conduct (1Co 1.8; Col 1.22).

DEFINITION: Refers to something so great or wonderful that it cannot be fully reported, described, or communicated in human words.
SENSES: 1. Attributed to the incomparable and indescribable gift of God's grace (2Co 9.15).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se a algo tão grandioso ou maravilhoso que não pode ser plenamente relatado, descrito ou comunicado com palavras humanas. 1. Atribuído à incomparável e indescritível dádiva da graça de Deus (2Co 9.15).
THAYER.en: Refers to something so great or wonderful that it cannot be fully reported, described, or communicated in human words. 1. Attributed to the incomparable and indescribable gift of God's grace (2Co 9.15).

DEFINITION: Designates that which transcends the capacity of human language to express or utter.
SENSES: 1. Referring to the inexpressible and glorious joy that believers experience in faith (1Pe 1.8).

THAYER.pt: Designa aquilo que transcende a capacidade da linguagem humana de expressar ou proferir. 1. Referente à indescritível e gloriosa alegria que os crentes experimentam na fé (1Pe 1.8).
THAYER.en: Designates that which transcends the capacity of human language to express or utter. 1. Referring to the inexpressible and glorious joy that believers experience in faith (1Pe 1.8).

DEFINITION: Pertaining to that which never ends, does not fail, is not exhausted, or remains permanently available.
SENSES: 1. Used to describe heavenly treasures that never run out (Lk 12.33).

THAYER.pt: Pertencente ao que nunca acaba, não falha, não se esgota ou permanece permanentemente disponível. 1. Utilizado para descrever tesouros celestiais que jamais se esgotam (Lc 12.33).
THAYER.en: Pertaining to that which never ends, does not fail, is not exhausted, or remains permanently available. 1. Used to describe heavenly treasures that never run out (Lk 12.33).

DEFINITION: Qualifies something that can be borne, tolerated, or resisted without total destruction.
SENSES: 1. Bearable or tolerable in terms of judgment or suffering (Mt 11.22).

THAYER.pt: Qualifica algo que pode ser suportado, tolerado ou resistido sem destruição total. 1. Suportável ou tolerável em termos de julgamento ou sofrimento (Mt 11.22).
THAYER.en: Qualifies something that can be borne, tolerated, or resisted without total destruction. 1. Bearable or tolerable in terms of judgment or suffering (Mt 11.22).

DEFINITION: Describes someone who demonstrates a complete absence of compassion or who refuses to extend mercy to those in need.
SENSES: 1. One who lacks mercy toward others (Rom 1.31).

THAYER.pt: Descreve alguém que demonstra completa ausência de compaixão ou que recusa estender misericórdia aos necessitados. 1. Aquele que carece de misericórdia para com o próximo (Rm 1.31).
THAYER.en: Describes someone who demonstrates a complete absence of compassion or who refuses to extend mercy to those in need. 1. One who lacks mercy toward others (Rom 1.31).

DEFINITION: Signifies being moved, blown, or driven by the force of the wind.
SENSES: 1. Metaphor for describing the instability of a person's mind agitated by circumstances (Jas 1.6).

THAYER.pt: Significa ser movido, soprado ou impulsionado pela força do vento. 1. Metáfora para descrever a instabilidade da mente de alguém agitada pelas circunstâncias (Tg 1.6).
THAYER.en: Signifies being moved, blown, or driven by the force of the wind. 1. Metaphor for describing the instability of a person's mind agitated by circumstances (Jas 1.6).

DEFINITION: Atmospheric phenomenon consisting of the movement of air in various directions; also used metaphorically for currents of teaching.
SENSES: 1. The physical movement of air or wind in the atmosphere (Mt 14.24; Rev 7.1).
2. The cardinal points or geographical directions from which the wind blows (Mt 24.31).
3. Passing and unstable doctrinal trends that divert faith (Eph 4.14).

THAYER.pt: Fenômeno atmosférico que consiste no movimento do ar em várias direções, podendo também ser usado metaforicamente para correntes de ensinamento. 1. O movimento físico do ar ou vento na atmosfera (Mt 14.24; Ap 7.1). | 2. Os pontos cardeais ou direções geográficas de onde sopra o vento (Mt 24.31). | 3. Tendências doutrinárias passageiras e instáveis que desviam a fé (Ef 4.14).

Passing and unstable doctrinal trends that divert faith (Eph 4.14).

DEFINITION: Indicates something that cannot happen, is totally unfeasible, or is incompatible with reality.

THAYER.en: Indicates something that cannot happen, is totally unfeasible, or is incompatible with reality. 1. Used to affirm that it is impossible for scandals and temptations to cease existing in the world (Lk 17.1).

THAYER.en: The quality of one who endures evil, offense, or opposition without showing resentment, anger, or retaliation. 1. A virtue required of the Lord's servant to endure evil without striking back (2Ti 2.24).

DEFINITION: Peremptory regarding something or someone who has no reason to be ashamed before God or men.
SENSES: 1. A worker who handles the word of truth well and has nothing to be ashamed of (2Ti 2.15).

THAYER.en: Peremptory regarding something or someone who has no reason to be ashamed before God or men. 1. A worker who handles the word of truth well and has nothing to be ashamed of (2Ti 2.15).

DEFINITION: Describes a person whose conduct is exemplary, giving no room for just accusations or censures.
SENSES: 1. That which cannot be censured; irreproachable in moral conduct (1Ti 3.2; 5.7; 6.14).

THAYER.en: Describes a person whose conduct is exemplary, giving no room for just accusations or censures. 1. That which cannot be censured; irreproachable in moral conduct (1Ti 3.2; 5.7; 6.14).

THAYER.en: Relaxation of tension, affliction, or restriction, resulting in relief and rest. 1. Relief from afflictions or tribulations (2Co 8.13; 2Th 1.7). | 2. Easing of restrictions or partial freedom (Ac 24.23).

DEFINITION: Describes something unfavorably situated or inadequate for the intended use.

THAYER.en: Describes something unfavorably situated or inadequate for the intended use. 1. A harbor considered inadequate or unfavorable for wintering (Ac 27.12).

THAYER.en: To locate something or someone after an intentional process of searching or investigation. 1. To find someone after a diligent search (Lk 2.16). | 2. To find a location or people on a journey (Ac 21.4).

THAYER.en: To bear patiently with people, difficult situations, or burdens, exercising tolerance and perseverance. 1. To bear or tolerate patiently difficult people or weaknesses (Eph 4:2; Col 3:13). | 2. To resist or endure painful circumstances and trials (2 Cor 11:1).

DEFINITION: A term designating the son of an uncle or aunt, that is, a blood cousin.
SENSES: 1. A degree of family relationship applied to Mark, the cousin of Barnabas (Col 4:10).

THAYER.pt: Termo que designa o filho do tio ou da tia, ou seja, um primo consanguíneo. 1. Grau de parentesco familiar aplicado a Marcos, primo de Barnabé (Cl 4.10).
THAYER.en: A term designating the son of an uncle or aunt, that is, a blood cousin. 1. A degree of family relationship applied to Mark, the cousin of Barnabas (Col 4:10).

DEFINITION: An herbaceous plant whose aromatic seeds and leaves were used as a condiment and medicinal herb.
SENSES: 1. An aromatic herb mentioned in the context of the Pharisees' payment of tithes (Matt 23:23).

THAYER.pt: Planta herbácea cujas sementes e folhas aromáticas eram usadas como condimento e erva medicinal. 1. Erva aromática mencionada no contexto do pagamento do dízimo pelos fariseus (Mt 23.23).
THAYER.en: An herbaceous plant whose aromatic seeds and leaves were used as a condiment and medicinal herb. 1. An aromatic herb mentioned in the context of the Pharisees' payment of tithes (Matt 23:23).

THAYER.en: Refers to an adult male human individual, in contrast to a woman or child. It is frequently used in the New Testament in the technical and relational sense of a spouse or husband. 1. Adult male human (Matt 14:21; 1 Cor 13:11). | 2. Legally constituted husband or spouse (Matt 1:16; John 4:18; Eph 5:25). | 3. Formal vocative of respect in public speeches ('men', 'gentlemen') (Acts 1:16; Acts 17:22).

THAYER.en: To place oneself in a position of active opposition against someone or to resist an external force. 1. To actively oppose a person or authority (Matt 5:39; Gal 2:11). | 2. To resist with firmness pressures, spiritual attacks, or evil (Eph 6:13).

THAYER.en: A piece of burning coal or glowing ember used for heating or cooking. 1. Burning coals used figuratively in proverbs regarding kindness toward an enemy (Rom 12:20).

THAYER.en: A person who seeks to please men to the detriment of obedience to God or moral principles. 1. An attitude of serving only to please humans, in contrast to the divine will (Eph 6:6).

THAYER.en: Belonging or relating to humanity, distinguishing itself from both the animal kingdom and the strictly divine dimension. 1. That which is inherent to the human condition or common to all men (Rom 6:19; 1 Cor 10:13). | 2. Opposed to that which is divine or superhuman (1 Cor 2:4).

THAYER.en: Adjective and noun that describes one who takes the life of another human being, a murderer or homicide. 1. One who commits murder or homicide (1 John 3:15).

Human being in a broad sense, encompassing man or woman (Matt 4:4; John 16:21). | 2. Individual of the male sex; adult man (Matt 19:3; 1 Cor 7:1). | 3. Indeterminate use equivalent to 'someone' or 'a person' (Matt 13:52; Luke 10:30).

THAYER.en: To exercise the office or function of proconsul, the Roman governor of a senatorial province. 1. To perform the administrative function of proconsul.

THAYER.en: Means to loosen moorings or physical chains, to set aside an attitude, or to abandon someone, ceasing assistance or control. 1. To loosen or release moorings and physical prisons (Acts 16:26; Acts 27:40). | 2. To set aside, soften, or cease a practice (Eph 6:9). | 3. To abandon or leave helpless (Heb 13:5).

SENSES: 1. Rigorous judgment reserved for those who have not shown mercy (Jas 2:13).

DEFINITION: To cause to stand or to rise; in intransitive senses and the second aorist, to stand up or arise. In a biblical context, it is one of the primary verbs used to describe the resurrection of the dead and the raising up of leaders by divine initiative.
SENSES: 1. To change to an upright position; to rise from bed or the ground (Mk 1:35; Acts 9:34).
2. To resurrect from the dead, in a transitive or intransitive sense (Jn 6:39; Acts 2:24).
3. To raise up, to cause a person to arise for a specific historical mission (Acts 3:22; Acts 7:18).

THAYER.pt: Fazer levantar ou pôr-se em pé; nos sentidos intransitivos e no aoristo segundo, levantar-se ou erguer-se. No âmbito bíblico, é um dos verbos principais para descrever a ressurreição dos mortos e a ascensão de líderes por iniciativa divina. 1. Mudar para a postura ereta; levantar-se da cama ou do chão (Mc 1.35; At 9.34). | 2. Ressuscitar dentre os mortos, em sentido transitivo ou intransitivo (Jo 6.39; At 2.24). | 3. Suscitar, fazer surgir uma pessoa para determinada missão histórica (At 3.22; At 7.18).
THAYER.en: To cause to stand or to rise; in intransitive senses and the second aorist, to stand up or arise. In a biblical context, it is one of the primary verbs used to describe the resurrection of the dead and the raising up of leaders by divine initiative. 1. To change to an upright position; to rise from bed or the ground (Mk 1:35; Acts 9:34). | 2. To resurrect from the dead, in a transitive or intransitive sense (Jn 6:39; Acts 2:24). | 3. To raise up, to cause a person to arise for a specific historical mission (Acts 3:22; Acts 7:18).

THAYER.en: A Hebrew-origin feminine proper name referring to a devout woman in the Temple. 1. An aged prophetess of the tribe of Asher who recognized the child Jesus in the Temple (Lk 2:36).

THAYER.en: The proper name of an influential Jewish high priest who held political and religious authority in Jerusalem during the first century, father-in-law of Caiaphas. 1. Annas, the former Jewish high priest before whom Jesus was initially brought (Lk 3:2; Jn 18:13, 24; Acts 4:6).

THAYER.en: Describes someone devoid of discernment or who refuses to use their mental faculties to understand moral and spiritual truth. 1. Foolish, senseless, or lacking spiritual understanding (Tit 3:3). | 2. Bound to foolish and irrational desires or actions (1 Tim 6:9).
