THAYER.pt: Ausência de entendimento racional, podendo denotar tanto tolice intelectual quanto fúria irracional. 1. Insensatez ou falta de discernimento moral e espiritual (2Tm 3.9). | 2. Estado de extrema fúria ou ira cega (Lc 6.11).
THAYER.en: The absence of rational understanding, which can denote either intellectual foolishness or irrational fury. 1. Foolishness or lack of moral and spiritual discernment (2 Tim 3:9). | 2. A state of extreme fury or blind rage (Lk 6:11).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: ἀνοίξω, Aor: ἤνοιξα / ἀνέῳξα, PerfPass: ἀνέῳγμαι
DEFINITION: To change something from a closed or obstructed position to an accessible one; applied to doors, the eyes of the blind, lips to begin speaking, or the revealing of the heavens.
SENSES: 1. To open doors, gates, tombs, or containers (Mt 2:11; Mt 27:52; Acts 5:19).
2. To cure blindness by opening the eyes (Mt 9:30; Jn 9:14).
3. Hebraism for initiating solemn discourse: to open the mouth (Mt 5:2; Acts 8:35).
4. To open the heavens for apocalyptic revelation and epiphany (Mt 3:16; Rev 19:11).

THAYER.pt: Mudar algo de uma posição fechada ou obstruída para acessível; aplicar-se a portas, olhos de cegos, lábios para começar a falar ou à revelação dos céus. 1. Abrir portas, portões, túmulos ou recipientes (Mt 2.11; Mt 27.52; At 5.19). | 2. Curar a cegueira abrindo os olhos (Mt 9.30; Jo 9.14). | 3. Idioma hebraico para iniciar discurso solene: abrir a boca (Mt 5.2; At 8.35). | 4. Abrir os céus para revelação apocalíptica e teofania (Mt 3.16; Ap 19.11).
THAYER.en: To change something from a closed or obstructed position to an accessible one; applied to doors, the eyes of the blind, lips to begin speaking, or the revealing of the heavens. 1. To open doors, gates, tombs, or containers (Mt 2:11; Mt 27:52; Acts 5:19). | 2. To cure blindness by opening the eyes (Mt 9:30; Jn 9:14). | 3. Hebraism for initiating solemn discourse: to open the mouth (Mt 5:2; Acts 8:35). | 4. To open the heavens for apocalyptic revelation and epiphany (Mt 3:16; Rev 19:11).

DEFINITION: To raise up or restore a structure that had been demolished or destroyed.
SENSES: 1. The prophetic rebuilding of the fallen tent of David (Acts 15:16).
2. Spiritual or community edification.

THAYER.pt: Reerguer ou restaurar uma estrutura que havia sido demolida ou destruída. 1. A reconstrução profética da tenda caída de Davi (At 15.16). | 2. Edificação espiritual ou comunitária.
THAYER.en: To raise up or restore a structure that had been demolished or destroyed. 1. The prophetic rebuilding of the fallen tent of David (Acts 15:16). | 2. Spiritual or community edification.

DEFINITION: The act of opening, especially applied metaphorically to the act of speaking boldly.
SENSES: 1. The opening of the mouth to boldly proclaim the gospel (Eph 6:19).

THAYER.pt: Ação de abrir, especialmente aplicada de forma metafórica ao ato de falar corajosamente. 1. Abertura da boca para proclamar corajosamente o evangelho (Ef 6.19).
THAYER.en: The act of opening, especially applied metaphorically to the act of speaking boldly. 1. The opening of the mouth to boldly proclaim the gospel (Eph 6:19).

DEFINITION: A state of rejection of law, lawless living, or active transgression of moral and divine commandments.
SENSES: 1. Conduct of rebellion or disrespect toward God's moral law, iniquity (1 Jn 3:4).
2. A specific sinful act or transgression of the law (Tit 2:14; Heb 10:17).

THAYER.pt: Estado de rejeição à lei, vida sem lei ou transgressão ativa dos mandamentos morais e divinos. 1. Conduta de rebeldia ou desrespeito à lei moral de Deus, iniquidade (1Jo 3.4). | 2. Ato pecaminoso específico ou transgressão da lei (Tt 2.14; Hb 10.17).
THAYER.en: A state of rejection of law, lawless living, or active transgression of moral and divine commandments. 1. Conduct of rebellion or disrespect toward God's moral law, iniquity (1 Jn 3:4). | 2. A specific sinful act or transgression of the law (Tit 2:14; Heb 10:17).

DEFINITION: Qualifies one who lives without law, whether through ignorance of the Mosaic law or through deliberate rejection of divine moral standards.
SENSES: 1. One who lives or acts in disobedience to moral or divine law (1 Tim 1:9).
2. Gentiles who do not possess the written Jewish law (1 Cor 9:21).

THAYER.pt: Qualifica aquele que vive sem lei, seja por ignorância da lei mosaica ou por rejeição deliberada dos padrões morais divinos. 1. Que vive ou age em desobediência à lei moral ou divina (1Tm 1.9). | 2. Gentios que não possuem a lei judaica escrita (1Co 9.21).
THAYER.en: Qualifies one who lives without law, whether through ignorance of the Mosaic law or through deliberate rejection of divine moral standards. 1. One who lives or acts in disobedience to moral or divine law (1 Tim 1:9). | 2. Gentiles who do not possess the written Jewish law (1 Cor 9:21).

DEFINITION: In a manner contrary to the law or without participation in a specific legal system.
SENSES: 1. Acting without the knowledge or jurisdiction of the Mosaic Law (Rom 2:12).

THAYER.pt: De maneira contrária à lei ou sem a participação em um sistema legal específico. 1. Agir sem o conhecimento ou a jurisdição da Lei mosaica (Rm 2.12).
THAYER.en: In a manner contrary to the law or without participation in a specific legal system. 1. Acting without the knowledge or jurisdiction of the Mosaic Law (Rom 2:12).

DEFINITION: Meaning to straighten someone who is bent, raise up what has fallen, or restore something that has been ruined.
SENSES: 1. To rebuild or restore something in ruins (Acts 15:16).
2. To straighten or lift the body from a bent position (Lk 13:13; Heb 12:12).

THAYER.pt: Significa endireitar alguém curvado, reerguer o que caiu ou restaurar algo que foi arruinado. 1. Reconstruir ou restaurar algo em ruínas (At 15.16). | 2. Endireitar ou levantar o corpo de uma posição encurvada (Lc 13.13; Hb 12.12).
THAYER.en: Meaning to straighten someone who is bent, raise up what has fallen, or restore something that has been ruined. 1. To rebuild or restore something in ruins (Acts 15:16). | 2. To straighten or lift the body from a bent position (Lk 13:13; Heb 12:12).

DEFINITION: That which is contrary to the holiness of God, devoid of moral consecration or respect for sacred things.
SENSES: 1. Ungodly persons devoid of the fear of God (1 Tim 1:9).

THAYER.pt: O que é contrpario à santidade de Deus, desprovido de consagração moral ou respeito pelas coisas sagradas. 1. Pessoas ímpias e desprovidas de temor a Deus (1Tm 1.9).
THAYER.en: That which is contrary to the holiness of God, devoid of moral consecration or respect for sacred things. 1. Ungodly persons devoid of the fear of God (1 Tim 1:9).

DEFINITION: The act of restraining oneself or temporarily suspending a judgment or punishment; patience and clemency.
SENSES: 1. Divine tolerance in suspending punishment for past sins (Rom 3:26).

THAYER.pt: Ato de conter-se ou suspender um julgamento ou punição temporariamente; paciência e clemência. 1. A tolerância divina ao suspender o castigo pelos pecados passados (Rm 3.26).
THAYER.en: The act of restraining oneself or temporarily suspending a judgment or punishment; patience and clemency. 1. Divine tolerance in suspending punishment for past sins (Rom 3:26).

DEFINITION: To engage in intense contention or struggle against opposition, actively resisting a contrary force.
SENSES: 1. Hard struggle against sin and the pressures of opposition (Heb 12:4).

THAYER.pt: Envolver-se em uma contenda ou luta intensa contra a oposição, resistindo ativamente a uma força contrária. 1. Luta árdua contra o pecado e as pressões da oposição (Hb 12.4).
THAYER.en: To engage in intense contention or struggle against opposition, actively resisting a contrary force. 1. Hard struggle against sin and the pressures of opposition (Heb 12:4).

DEFINITION: That which is given in exchange or as equivalent payment for something of great value.
SENSES: 1. The ransom price or equivalent given in exchange for the human soul (Mt 16:26).

THAYER.pt: Aquilo que é dado em troca ou como pagamento equivalente por algo de grande valor. 1. O preço de resgate ou equivalente dado em troca da alma humana (Mt 16.26).
THAYER.en: That which is given in exchange or as equivalent payment for something of great value. 1. The ransom price or equivalent given in exchange for the human soul (Mt 16:26).

DEFINITION: To complete something that is still lacking or to fulfill an obligation in exchange, filling an existing gap.
SENSES: 1. To complete what is lacking in Christ's tribulations for the Church (Col 1:24).

THAYER.pt: Completar algo que ainda falta ou cumprir uma obrigação em troca, preenchendo uma lacuna existente. 1. Completar o que falta nas tribulações de Cristo pela Igreja (Cl 1.24).
THAYER.en: To complete something that is still lacking or to fulfill an obligation in exchange, filling an existing gap. 1. To complete what is lacking in Christ's tribulations for the Church (Col 1:24).

DEFINITION: To practice reciprocity by paying a debt, offering a reward, or returning evil for evil or good for good.
SENSES: 1. To repay a favor or obligation with appropriate reward (Lk 14:14; 1 Thess 3:9).
2. To execute retribution or just punishment for evil deeds (2 Thess 1:6; Rom 12:19).

THAYER.pt: Praticar a reciprocidade pagando uma dívida, oferecendo recompensa ou retribuindo o mal com o mal ou o bem com o bem. 1. Retribuir um favor ou obrigação com recompensa adequada (Lc 14.14; 1Ts 3.9). | 2. Executar retribuição ou justa punição por atos maus (2Ts 1.6; Rm 12.19).
THAYER.en: To practice reciprocity by paying a debt, offering a reward, or returning evil for evil or good for good. 1. To repay a favor or obligation with appropriate reward (Lk 14:14; 1 Thess 3:9). | 2. To execute retribution or just punishment for evil deeds (2 Thess 1:6; Rom 12:19).

DEFINITION: Payment, retribution, or reward granted based on previous actions or services.
SENSES: 1. Material or social retribution for a favor rendered (Lk 14:12).
2. Just retribution for behavior (Rom 11:9).

THAYER.pt: Pagamento, retribuição ou recompensa concedida com base em ações ou serviços anteriores. 1. Retribuição material ou social por um favor prestado (Lc 14.12). | 2. Retribuição justa por comportamento (Rm 11.9).
THAYER.en: Payment, retribution, or reward granted based on previous actions or services. 1. Material or social retribution for a favor rendered (Lk 14:12). | 2. Just retribution for behavior (Rom 11:9).

DEFINITION: That which is given in return or exchange for an action performed, whether a positive reward or just retribution.
SENSES: 1. The reward granted by the Lord to the faithful for their deeds (Col 3:24).

THAYER.pt: Aquilo que é dado em retribuição ou troca por uma ação realizada, seja uma recompensa positiva ou retribuição justa. 1. A recompensa concedida pelo Senhor aos fiéis por suas obras (Cl 3.24).
THAYER.en: That which is given in return or exchange for an action performed, whether a positive reward or just retribution. 1. The reward granted by the Lord to the faithful for their deeds (Col 3:24).

DEFINITION: To respond to a statement or question with the purpose of refuting, contesting, or criticizing.
SENSES: 1. To give an irrefutable answer or silence an opponent (Lk 14:6).
2. To oppose verbally or question the justice of God (Rom 9:20).

THAYER.pt: Responder a uma declaração ou pergunta com o propósito de refutar, contestar ou criticar. 1. Dar uma resposta irrefutável ou calar o oponente (Lc 14.6). | 2. Opor-se verbalmente ou questionar a justiça de Deus (Rm 9.20).
THAYER.en: To respond to a statement or question with the purpose of refuting, contesting, or criticizing. 1. To give an irrefutable answer or silence an opponent (Lk 14:6). | 2. To oppose verbally or question the justice of God (Rom 9:20).

DEFINITION: To manifest opposition verbally, responding to a previous statement with contrary arguments.
SENSES: 1. To contradict or answer someone in a tone of opposition (Lk 21:15; Acts 4:14).

THAYER.pt: Manifestar oposição verbalmente, respondendo a uma declaração anterior com argumentos contrários. 1. Contradizer ou responder a alguém em tom de oposição (Lc 21.15; At 4.14).
THAYER.en: To manifest opposition verbally, responding to a previous statement with contrary arguments. 1. To contradict or answer someone in a tone of opposition (Lk 21:15; Acts 4:14).

SHORT_GLOSS: to cleave to, be loyal, help
DEFINITION: Meaning to hold firmly to something or maintain strong loyalty to a person, doctrine, or duty, and can also denote supporting the needy.
SENSES: 1. To hold firmly to faithful doctrines or teachings (Tit 1:9; 1 Thess 5:14).
2. To maintain loyalty or devotion to someone (Mt 6:24; Lk 16:13).
3. To render aid or sustenance to the needy (Acts 20:35).
USAGE: to cleave to, be loyal, help

THAYER.pt: Significa segurar-se firmemente a algo ou manter forte lealdade a uma pessoa, doutrina ou dever, também podendo denotar o suporte a necessitados. 1. Apegar-se firmemente a doutrinas ou ensinamentos fiéis (Tt 1.9; 1Ts 5.14). | 2. Manter lealdade ou devoção a alguém (Mt 6.24; Lc 16.13). | 3. Prestar auxílio ou sustento a necessitados (At 20.35).
THAYER.en: Meaning to hold firmly to something or maintain strong loyalty to a person, doctrine, or duty, and can also denote supporting the needy. 1. To hold firmly to faithful doctrines or teachings (Tit 1:9; 1 Thess 5:14). | 2. To maintain loyalty or devotion to someone (Mt 6:24; Lk 16:13). | 3. To render aid or sustenance to the needy (Acts 20:35).

SHORT_GLOSS: instead of, on behalf of, for
DEFINITION: Preposition expressing substitution, exchange, correspondence, or fundamental reason, indicating that one element takes the place or value of another.
SENSES: 1. In place of, instead of (Mt 2:22; Lk 11:11).
2. As a price of exchange, in ransom of (Mt 20:28; 1 Tim 2:6).
3. On account of, by virtue of (Eph 5:31; Heb 12:2).
USAGE: instead of, on behalf of, for

THAYER.pt: Preposição que expressa substituição, troca, correspondência ou razão fundamental, marcando que um elemento ocupa o lugar ou o valor de outro. 1. Em lugar de, em vez de (Mt 2.22; Lc 11.11). | 2. Como preço de troca, em resgate de (Mt 20.28; 1Tm 2.6). | 3. Por motivo de, em virtude de (Ef 5.31; Hb 12.2).
THAYER.en: Preposition expressing substitution, exchange, correspondence, or fundamental reason, indicating that one element takes the place or value of another. 1. In place of, instead of (Mt 2:22; Lk 11:11). | 2. As a price of exchange, in ransom of (Mt 20:28; 1 Tim 2:6). | 3. On account of, by virtue of (Eph 5:31; Heb 12:2).

DEFINITION: To exchange words or opinions, frequently involving divergent viewpoints or mutual discussion.
SENSES: 1. To exchange words or debate regarding recent events (Lk 24:17).

THAYER.pt: Trocar palavras ou opiniões, frequentemente envolvendo pontos de vista divergentes ou discussão mútua. 1. Trocar palavras ou debater sobre acontecimentos recentes (Lc 24.17).
THAYER.en: To exchange words or opinions, frequently involving divergent viewpoints or mutual discussion. 1. To exchange words or debate regarding recent events (Lk 24:17).

DEFINITION: To place oneself in opposition to someone, demonstrating an attitude and behavior of hostility or disagreement.
SENSES: 1. To oppose correct teachings or authority (2 Tim 2:25).

THAYER.pt: Colocar-se em oposição a alguém, demonstrando atitude e comportamento de hostilidade ou desacordo. 1. Opor-se a ensinamentos corretos ou à autoridade (2Tm 2.25).
THAYER.en: To place oneself in opposition to someone, demonstrating an attitude and behavior of hostility or disagreement. 1. To oppose correct teachings or authority (2 Tim 2:25).

DEFINITION: One who acts as an opponent in a legal proceeding or a constant enemy.
SENSES: 1. Accuser or opposing party in court (Mt 5:25).
2. The spiritual adversary or enemy (1 Pet 5:8).

THAYER.pt: Aquele que atua como opositor em um processo judicial ou um inimigo constante. 1. Acusador ou parte contrária em tribunal (Mt 5.25). | 2. O adversário espiritual ou inimigo (1Pe 5.8).
THAYER.en: One who acts as an opponent in a legal proceeding or a constant enemy. 1. Accuser or opposing party in court (Mt 5:25). | 2. The spiritual adversary or enemy (1 Pet 5:8).

DEFINITION: A statement or thesis involving logical contradiction or direct opposition to an established teaching.
SENSES: 1. Opposition of ideas or false doctrines contrary to the truth (1 Tim 6:20).

THAYER.pt: Declaração ou tese que envolve contradição lógica ou oposição direta a um ensinamento estabelecido. 1. Oposição de ideias ou falsas doutrinas contrárias à verdade (1Tm 6.20).
THAYER.en: A statement or thesis involving logical contradiction or direct opposition to an established teaching. 1. Opposition of ideas or false doctrines contrary to the truth (1 Tim 6:20).

DEFINITION: To actively resist pressure, opposition, or a hostile force, maintaining a firm position against the adversary.
SENSES: 1. To resist sin or hostile opposition in the Christian journey (Heb 12:4).

THAYER.pt: Resistir ativamente a uma pressão, oposição ou força hostil, mantendo firme posição contra o adversário. 1. Resistir ao pecado ou à oposição hostil na jornada cristã (Hb 12.4).
THAYER.en: To actively resist pressure, opposition, or a hostile force, maintaining a firm position against the adversary. 1. To resist sin or hostile opposition in the Christian journey (Heb 12:4).

DEFINITION: To invite someone in return for a previous invitation to a meal or act of hospitality.
SENSES: 1. To invite back those who have already invited you (Lk 14:12).

THAYER.pt: Convidar alguém em retribuição a um convite anterior para uma refeição ou ato de hospitalidade. 1. Convidar de volta aqueles que já lhe convidaram (Lc 14.12).
THAYER.en: To invite someone in return for a previous invitation to a meal or act of hospitality. 1. To invite back those who have already invited you (Lk 14:12).

DEFINITION: Meaning to stand in direct opposition to someone or something, involving both a hostile attitude and contrary actions.
SENSES: 1. To be in opposition or resist someone in attitude and conduct (Gal 5:17; 1 Tim 1:10).

THAYER.pt: Significa estar em oposição direta a alguém ou a algo, envolvendo tanto uma atitude hostil quanto ações contrárias. 1. Estar em oposição ou resistir a alguém em atitude e conduta (Gl 5.17; 1Tm 1.10).
THAYER.en: Meaning to stand in direct opposition to someone or something, involving both a hostile attitude and contrary actions. 1. To be in opposition or resist someone in attitude and conduct (Gal 5:17; 1 Tim 1:10).

DEFINITION: Indicates a spatial position directly opposite to something, in front of or facing.
SENSES: 1. A location situated directly in front of or opposite a reference point.

THAYER.pt: Indica posição espacial diretamente oposta a algo, em frente ou defronte. 1. Localização situada diretamente em frente ou defronte a um ponto de referência.
THAYER.en: Indicates a spatial position directly opposite to something, in front of or facing. 1. A location situated directly in front of or opposite a reference point.

DEFINITION: To take part in something to assist, extend a hand in help, or support someone in need.
SENSES: 1. To help or assist the needy and weak (Acts 20:35; Luke 1:54).

THAYER.pt: Tomar parte em algo para auxiliar, estender a mão em socorro ou apoiar alguém necessitado. 1. Auxiliar ou socorrer os necessitados e fracos (At 20.35; Lc 1.54).
THAYER.en: To take part in something to assist, extend a hand in help, or support someone in need. 1. To help or assist the needy and weak (Acts 20:35; Luke 1:54).

DEFINITION: To speak against a statement or person, expressing verbal opposition, contradiction, or refusal to accept authority or teaching.
SENSES: 1. To speak in opposition to someone or contradict a teaching (Acts 13:45; Titus 1:9).
2. To actively oppose or refuse to obey (Luke 2:34; Rom 10:21).

THAYER.pt: Falar contra uma declaração ou pessoa, expressando oposição verbal, contradição ou recusa em aceitar uma autoridade ou ensinamento. 1. Falar em oposição a alguém ou contradizer um ensinamento (At 13.45; Tt 1.9). | 2. Opor-se ativamente ou recusar-se a obedecer (Lc 2.34; Rm 10.21).
THAYER.en: To speak against a statement or person, expressing verbal opposition, contradiction, or refusal to accept authority or teaching. 1. To speak in opposition to someone or contradict a teaching (Acts 13:45; Titus 1:9). | 2. To actively oppose or refuse to obey (Luke 2:34; Rom 10:21).

DEFINITION: The act of extending help or support to those who need assistance or shelter.
SENSES: 1. The provision of help or assistance within the context of the church community (1 Cor 12:28).

THAYER.pt: Ato de estender auxílio ou suporte àqueles que necessitam de assistência ou amparo. 1. Prestação de socorro ou auxílio no contexto da comunidade eclesiástica (1Co 12.28).
THAYER.en: The act of extending help or support to those who need assistance or shelter. 1. The provision of help or assistance within the context of the church community (1 Cor 12:28).

DEFINITION: Designates a verbal debate, opposition of ideas, conflict of opinions, or open rebellion against established authority or truth.
SENSES: 1. Contradiction or verbal dispute (Heb 7:7; Heb 6:16).
2. Hostility, rebellion, or stubborn opposition against God (Heb 12:3; Jude 11).

THAYER.pt: Designa um debate verbal, oposição de ideias, conflito de opiniões ou rebeldia aberta contra uma autoridade ou verdade estabelecida. 1. Contradição ou disputa verbal (Hb 7.7; Hb 6.16). | 2. Hostilidade, rebelião ou oposição obstinada contra Deus (Hb 12.3; Jd 11).
THAYER.en: Designates a verbal debate, opposition of ideas, conflict of opinions, or open rebellion against established authority or truth. 1. Contradiction or verbal dispute (Heb 7:7; Heb 6:16). | 2. Hostility, rebellion, or stubborn opposition against God (Heb 12:3; Jude 11).

DEFINITION: To respond to insults, offenses, or slander with equally abusive words.
SENSES: 1. To repay insults with verbal offenses, an attitude avoided by Christ (1 Pet 2:23).

THAYER.pt: Responder a insultos, ofensas ou calúnias com palavras igualmente injuriosas. 1. Retribuir insultos com ofensas verbais, atitude evitada por Cristo (1Pe 2.23).
THAYER.en: To respond to insults, offenses, or slander with equally abusive words. 1. To repay insults with verbal offenses, an attitude avoided by Christ (1 Pet 2:23).

DEFINITION: The means or price paid to effect the liberation of slaves or prisoners, serving as a substitution.
SENSES: 1. The supreme ransom delivered by Christ on behalf of all (1 Tim 2:6).

THAYER.pt: O meio ou preço pago para efetuar a libertação de escivos ou prisioneiros, servindo como substituição. 1. O resgate supremo entregue por Cristo em favor de todos (1Tm 2.6).
THAYER.en: The means or price paid to effect the liberation of slaves or prisoners, serving as a substitution. 1. The supreme ransom delivered by Christ on behalf of all (1 Tim 2:6).

DEFINITION: To give or measure back an equivalent portion as payment or retribution for an action.
SENSES: 1. The measure of judgment or generosity that is returned to a person (Matt 7:2; Luke 6:38).

THAYER.pt: Dar ou medir de volta uma porção equivalente como pagamento ou retribuição por uma ação. 1. A medida de julgamento ou generosidade que é devolvida à pessoa (Mt 7.2; Lc 6.38).
THAYER.en: To give or measure back an equivalent portion as payment or retribution for an action. 1. The measure of judgment or generosity that is returned to a person (Matt 7:2; Luke 6:38).

DEFINITION: Mutual recompense or proportional retribution based on what is deserved, whether positive or negative.
SENSES: 1. The natural retribution or moral consequence of conduct (Rom 1:27).
2. Reciprocal reward or affective response (2 Cor 6:13).

THAYER.pt: Recompensa mútua ou retribuição proporcional com base no que é merecido, seja positivo ou negativo. 1. A retribuição natural ou consequência moral de uma conduta (Rm 1.27). | 2. Recompensa ou resposta afetiva recíproca (2Co 6.13).
THAYER.en: Mutual recompense or proportional retribution based on what is deserved, whether positive or negative. 1. The natural retribution or moral consequence of conduct (Rom 1:27). | 2. Reciprocal reward or affective response (2 Cor 6:13).

DEFINITION: Name of important cities in the Greco-Roman world mentioned in the book of Acts and the epistles.
SENSES: 1. Antioch of Syria, a major metropolis and Christian missionary center (Acts 11:19; Gal 2:11).
2. Antioch of Pisidia, a city in the region of Galatia visited by Paul (Acts 13:14).

THAYER.pt: Nome de importantes cidades do mundo greco-romano mencionadas no livro de Atos e nas epístolas. 1. Antioquia da Síria, grande metrópole e centro missionário cristão (At 11.19; Gl 2.11). | 2. Antioquia da Pisídia, cidade na região da Galácia visitada por Paulo (At 13.14).
THAYER.en: Name of important cities in the Greco-Roman world mentioned in the book of Acts and the epistles. 1. Antioch of Syria, a major metropolis and Christian missionary center (Acts 11:19; Gal 2:11). | 2. Antioch of Pisidia, a city in the region of Galatia visited by Paul (Acts 13:14).

DEFINITION: A native or inhabitant of the famous city of Antioch of Syria.
SENSES: 1. Designation of Nicolaus, originally from Antioch (Acts 6:5).

THAYER.pt: Natural ou habitante da célebre cidade de Antioquia da Síria. 1. Designação de Nicolau, originário de Antioquia (At 6.5).
THAYER.en: A native or inhabitant of the famous city of Antioch of Syria. 1. Designation of Nicolaus, originally from Antioch (Acts 6:5).

DEFINITION: To pass by someone or something while staying on the opposite side, often ignoring the need of another.
SENSES: 1. To pass by on the other side of the road without helping someone in need (Luke 10:31, 32).

THAYER.pt: Passar por alguém ou algo mantendo-se do lado opuesto, frequentemente ignorando a necessidade alheia. 1. Passar pelo outro lado da rua sem prestar socorro a um necessitado (Lc 10.31, 32).
THAYER.en: To pass by someone or something while staying on the opposite side, often ignoring the need of another. 1. To pass by on the other side of the road without helping someone in need (Luke 10:31, 32).

DEFINITION: Proper name of a Christian martyr of the early church in the city of Pergamum.
SENSES: 1. Antipas, the faithful witness martyred in Pergamum (Rev 2:13).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio de um mártir cristão da igreja primitiva na cidade de Pérgamo. 1. Antipas, a testemunha fiel martirizada em Pérgamo (Ap 2.13).
THAYER.en: Proper name of a Christian martyr of the early church in the city of Pergamum. 1. Antipas, the faithful witness martyred in Pergamum (Rev 2:13).

DEFINITION: A city located in Judea, built by Herod the Great in honor of his father Antipater.
SENSES: 1. The city of Antipatris, a stop on Paul's journey under escort (Acts 23:31).

THAYER.pt: Indica um momento muito próximo no tempo, seja imediatamente antes ou logo após o instante da fala. 1. Neste exato momento, logo agora (Jo 13.19).
THAYER.en: Indicates a moment very close in time, either immediately before or shortly after the instant of speech. 1. At this very moment, right now (John 13.19).

DEFINITION: Refers to the act of completing or finalizing an activity with the implication of a fully satisfactory result.
SENSES: 1. The successful completion or ending of a work or enterprise (Luke 14.28).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se ao ato de completar ou finalizar uma atividade com a implicação de um resultado plenamente satisfatório. 1. A conclusão ou o término bem-sucedido de uma obra ou empreendimento (Lc 14.28).
THAYER.en: Refers to the act of completing or finalizing an activity with the implication of a fully satisfactory result. 1. The successful completion or ending of a work or enterprise (Luke 14.28).

DEFINITION: Refers to the first portion of the harvest or earnings consecrated to God, also serving as a guarantee or anticipation of future blessings.
SENSES: 1. The firstfruits or first portion consecrated to God (Rom 11.16).
2. An anticipation or pledge of future spiritual blessings.

THAYER.pt: Refere-se à primeira porção da colheita ou dos ganhos consagrada a Deus, servindo também como garantia ou antecipação de bênçãos futuras. 1. As primícias ou a primeira porção consagrada a Deus (Rm 11.16). | 2. Uma antecipação ou penhor de futuras bênçãos espirituais.
THAYER.en: Refers to the first portion of the harvest or earnings consecrated to God, also serving as a guarantee or anticipation of future blessings. 1. The firstfruits or first portion consecrated to God (Rom 11.16). | 2. An anticipation or pledge of future spiritual blessings.

DEFINITION: Emphasizes the totality of a mass, group, or set of elements taken together as a complete unit.
SENSES: 1. The totality of a whole or object: entire, whole (Luke 3.21; 4.6).
2. In the plural, all collectively, each without exception (Acts 2.44).

THAYER.pt: Enfatiza a totalidade de uma massa, grupo ou conjunto de elementos tomados em conjunto como uma unidade completa. 1. A totalidade de um todo ou objeto: inteiro, todo (Lc 3.21; 4.6). | 2. No plural, todos coletivamente, cada um sem exceção (At 2.44).
THAYER.en: Emphasizes the totality of a mass, group, or set of elements taken together as a complete unit. 1. The totality of a whole or object: entire, whole (Luke 3.21; 4.6). | 2. In the plural, all collectively, each without exception (Acts 2.44).

DEFINITION: To lead someone into error or falsehood through deceitful artifices or fallacious reasoning.
SENSES: 1. To deceive or seduce with false arguments (Eph 5.6; 1 Tim 2.14).

THAYER.pt: Induzir alguém ao erro ou à falsidade por meio de artifícios mentirosos ou argumentação capciosa. 1. Enganar ou seduzir com falsos argumentos (Ef 5.6; 1Tm 2.14).
THAYER.en: To lead someone into error or falsehood through deceitful artifices or fallacious reasoning. 1. To deceive or seduce with false arguments (Eph 5.6; 1 Tim 2.14).

DEFINITION: Act or effect of deceiving, leading someone into error or falsehood through artifices or false appearances.
SENSES: 1. Deception, falsehood, or illusion that deviates from the truth (Col 2.8; Heb 3.13).

THAYER.pt: Ato ou efeito de enganar, induzindo alguém ao erro ou à falsidade por meio de artifícios ou falsas aparências. 1. Engano, falsidade ou ilusão que desvia da verdade (Cl 2.8; Hb 3.13).
THAYER.en: Act or effect of deceiving, leading someone into error or falsehood through artifices or false appearances. 1. Deception, falsehood, or illusion that deviates from the truth (Col 2.8; Heb 3.13).

DEFINITION: Designates a person for whom there is no record of an earthly father or who lacks a known paternal lineage, used theologically in a typological context.
SENSES: 1. Fatherless or without paternal genealogical record, applied figuratively to Melchizedek (Heb 7.3).

THAYER.pt: Designa uma pessoa para a qual não há registro de pai terreno ou que carece de linhagem paternal conhecida, usado teologicamente em contexto tipológico. 1. Sem pai ou sem registro genealógico paterno, aplicado figuradamente a Melquisedeque (Hb 7.3).
THAYER.en: Designates a person for whom there is no record of an earthly father or who lacks a known paternal lineage, used theologically in a typological context. 1. Fatherless or without paternal genealogical record, applied figuratively to Melchizedek (Heb 7.3).

DEFINITION: Indicates the radiation or brightness emanating from a light source, describing the perfect manifestation of divine glory in Christ.
SENSES: 1. The radiance or visible reflection of divine glory (Heb 1:3).

THAYER.pt: Indica a irradiação ou o brilho emanado de uma fonte luminosa, descrevendo a perfeita manifestação da glória divina em Cristo. 1. O resplendor ou reflexo visível da glória divina (Hb 1.3).
THAYER.en: Indicates the radiation or brightness emanating from a light source, describing the perfect manifestation of divine glory in Christ. 1. The radiance or visible reflection of divine glory (Heb 1:3).

DEFINITION: To direct one's gaze with attention toward a specific point, observing with clarity.
SENSES: 1. To stare at or contemplate with attention.

THAYER.pt: Dirigir o olhar com atenção para um ponto específico, observando com clareza. 1. Olhar fixamente ou contemplar com atenção.
THAYER.en: To direct one's gaze with attention toward a specific point, observing with clarity. 1. To stare at or contemplate with attention.

DEFINITION: Obstinate refusal to obey legitimate authority, frequently associated in the New Testament with the rejection of revelation and the will of God.
SENSES: 1. Deliberate disobedience or unbelief before God (Eph 2:2; Rom 11:30).

THAYER.pt: Recusa obstinada em obedecer à autoridade legítima, frequentemente associada no Novo Testamento à rejeição da revelação e da vontade de Deus. 1. Desobediência deliberada ou incredulidade perante Deus (Ef 2.2; Rm 11.30).
THAYER.en: Obstinate refusal to obey legitimate authority, frequently associated in the New Testament with the rejection of revelation and the will of God. 1. Deliberate disobedience or unbelief before God (Eph 2:2; Rom 11:30).

SHORT_GLOSS: to disobey, rebel, refuse to believe
DEFINITION: To refuse to conform to authority or revealed truth, manifesting active disobedience or disbelief, especially toward God and His message.
SENSES: 1. To refuse to obey or submit to divine commandments and guidance (Rom 2:8; 1Pe 4:17).
2. To refuse to believe the Christian message or the Gospel, rejecting faith (Jn 3:36; Acts 14:2).
USAGE: to disobey, rebel, refuse to believe

THAYER.pt: Significa recusar a conformar-se à autoridade ou à verdade revelada, manifestando desobediência ou descrença ativa, especialmente para com Deus e sua mensagem. 1. Recusar-se a obedecer ou submeter-se aos mandamentos e orientações divinas (Rm 2.8; 1Pe 4.17). | 2. Recusar-se a crer na mensagem cristã ou no Evangelho, rejeitando a fé (Jo 3.36; At 14.2).
THAYER.en: To refuse to conform to authority or revealed truth, manifesting active disobedience or disbelief, especially toward God and His message. 1. To refuse to obey or submit to divine commandments and guidance (Rom 2:8; 1Pe 4:17). | 2. To refuse to believe the Christian message or the Gospel, rejecting faith (Jn 3:36; Acts 14:2).

DEFINITION: Qualifies one who refuses to obey, who persists in an attitude of rebellion and refusal to persuasion or authority.
SENSES: 1. Disobedient to divine or human authority (Rom 1:30; 2Ti 3:2).

THAYER.pt: Qualifica aquele que se recusa a obedecer, que persiste em atitude de rebeldia e recusa à persuasão ou autoridade. 1. Desobediente à autoridade divina ou humana (Rm 1.30; 2Tm 3.2).
THAYER.en: Qualifies one who refuses to obey, who persists in an attitude of rebellion and refusal to persuasion or authority. 1. Disobedient to divine or human authority (Rom 1:30; 2Ti 3:2).

DEFINITION: To declare the intention to cause harm or punishment to someone if certain conditions are not met.
SENSES: 1. Threats made by religious authorities against the apostles (Acts 4:17).
2. The example of Christ who, even while suffering, did not utter threats (1Pe 2:23).

THAYER.pt: Declarar a intenção de causar dano ou punição a alguém caso certas condições não sejam cumpridas. 1. Ameaças feitas pelas autoridades religiosas contra os apóstolos (At 4.17). | 2. O exemplo de Cristo que, mesmo sofrendo, não proferiu ameaças (1Pe 2.23).
THAYER.en: To declare the intention to cause harm or punishment to someone if certain conditions are not met. 1. Threats made by religious authorities against the apostles (Acts 4:17). | 2. The example of Christ who, even while suffering, did not utter threats (1Pe 2:23).

DEFINITION: A verbal declaration of the intention to cause harm, punishment, or damage to someone.
SENSES: 1. Expression of hostility or verbal coercion (Acts 4:17; 9:1; Eph 6:9).

THAYER.pt: Declaração verbal de intenção de causar dano, punição ou prejuízo a alguém. 1. Expressão de hostilidade ou coação verbal (At 4.17; 9.1; Ef 6.9).
THAYER.en: A verbal declaration of the intention to cause harm, punishment, or damage to someone. 1. Expression of hostility or verbal coercion (Acts 4:17; 9:1; Eph 6:9).

SHORT_GLOSS: to be absent, to be away
DEFINITION: To be physically distant from a specific place or community at a given moment.
SENSES: 1. To be absent from a physical place or group of people (1Co 5:3; Col 2:5).
USAGE: to be absent, to be away

THAYER.pt: Estar fisicamente distante de um determinado lugar ou comunidade em um dado momento. 1. Encontrar-se ausente de um lugar físico ou grupo de pessoas (1Co 5.3; Cl 2.5).
THAYER.en: To be physically distant from a specific place or community at a given moment. 1. To be absent from a physical place or group of people (1Co 5:3; Col 2:5).

SHORT_GLOSS: to be absent, to be away
DEFINITION: To be in a place different from where one is expected to be, denoting physical absence.
SENSES: 1. To be absent from a location or a group of people (1Co 5:3; 2Co 10:11).
USAGE: to be absent, to be away

THAYER.pt: Significa estar em um lugar diferente daquele onde se espera que alguém esteja, denotando ausência física. 1. Estar ausente de um local ou de um grupo de pessoas (1Co 5.3; 2Co 10.11).
THAYER.en: To be in a place different from where one is expected to be, denoting physical absence. 1. To be absent from a location or a group of people (1Co 5:3; 2Co 10:11).

DEFINITION: The emphasis of the verb in the New Testament involves the vehement rejection of shameful practices or the renunciation of something.
SENSES: 1. To renounce or repudiate shameful or hidden practices (2Co 4:2).

THAYER.pt: A tônica do verbo no Novo Testamento envolve a rejeição veemente de práticas vergonhosas ou a renúncia a algo. 1. Renunciar ou repudiar práticas vergonhosas ou ocultas (2Co 4.2).
THAYER.en: The emphasis of the verb in the New Testament involves the vehement rejection of shameful practices or the renunciation of something. 1. To renounce or repudiate shameful or hidden practices (2Co 4:2).

DEFINITION: Refers to someone who cannot be tempted by evil due to their pure and holy nature.
SENSES: 1. Incapable of being tempted by evil, an attribute belonging to God (Jas 1:13).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se a alguém que não pode ser tentado pelo mal devido à sua natureza pura e santa. 1. Incapaz de ser tentado pelo mal, atributo pertencente a Deus (Tg 1.13).
THAYER.en: Refers to someone who cannot be tempted by evil due to their pure and holy nature. 1. Incapable of being tempted by evil, an attribute belonging to God (Jas 1:13).

DEFINITION: Describes the lack of practical knowledge or familiarity with a specific subject or skill.
SENSES: 1. Inexperienced or without familiarity with the word of righteousness (Heb 5:13).

THAYER.pt: Descreve a falta de conhecimento prático ou familiaridade com determinado assunto ou habilidade. 1. Inexperiente ou sem familiaridade com a palavra da justiça (Hb 5.13).
THAYER.en: Describes the lack of practical knowledge or familiarity with a specific subject or skill. 1. Inexperienced or without familiarity with the word of righteousness (Heb 5:13).

DEFINITION: To await the fulfillment of something with intense expectation, patience, and vivid longing for the future.
SENSES: 1. To wait anxiously and expectantly for a future event or intervention (Rom 8:19; Php 3:20).

THAYER.pt: Aguardar o cumprimento de algo com intensa expectativa, paciência e vivo anseio pelo futuro. 1. Aguardar ansiosa e expectantemente por um evento ou intervenção futura (Rm 8.19; Fp 3.20).
THAYER.en: To await the fulfillment of something with intense expectation, patience, and vivid longing for the future. 1. To wait anxiously and expectantly for a future event or intervention (Rom 8:19; Php 3:20).

DEFINITION: To strip off completely or to despoil someone; used in the New Testament in a figurative sense to indicate the renunciation of old practices or the disarming of spiritual powers.
SENSES: 1. To figuratively strip off or renounce old practices and the old nature (Col 3:9).
2. To despoil and disarm oppressive spiritual powers (Col 2:15).

THAYER.pt: Significa despir-se completamente ou despojar alguém, sendo usado no Novo Testamento em sentido figurado para indicar a renúncia de velhas práticas ou a desarmar de potestades espirituais. 1. Despir ou renunciar figuradamente a velhas práticas e à antiga natureza (Col 3:9). | 2. Despojar e desarmar os poderes espirituais opressores (Col 2:15).
THAYER.en: To strip off completely or to despoil someone; used in the New Testament in a figurative sense to indicate the renunciation of old practices or the disarming of spiritual powers. 1. To figuratively strip off or renounce old practices and the old nature (Col 3:9). | 2. To despoil and disarm oppressive spiritual powers (Col 2:15).

DEFINITION: Uses the metaphor of taking off clothes to describe the complete removal of a sinful lifestyle.
SENSES: 1. The stripping off or removal of the body of the flesh in spiritual baptism (Col 2:11).

THAYER.pt: Usa a metáfora de tirar a roupa para descrever a remoção completa do estilo de vida pecaminoso. 1. O despojamento ou a remoção do corpo da carne no batismo espiritual (Cl 2.11).
THAYER.en: Uses the metaphor of taking off clothes to describe the complete removal of a sinful lifestyle. 1. The stripping off or removal of the body of the flesh in spiritual baptism (Col 2:11).

DEFINITION: To force someone to move away from a location by means of coercion, threat, or authority.
SENSES: 1. To expel or force someone to withdraw from a place (Acts 18:16).

THAYER.pt: Significa forçar alguém a se afastar de um local por meio de coação, ameaça ou autoridade. 1. Expulsar ou obrigar alguém a se retirar de um lugar (At 18.16).
THAYER.en: To force someone to move away from a location by means of coercion, threat, or authority. 1. To expel or force someone to withdraw from a place (Acts 18:16).

DEFINITION: Designates a severe and well-founded criticism that exposes error or discredits questionable conduct.
SENSES: 1. The danger of discrediting or the ruin of a reputation or office (Acts 19:27).

THAYER.pt: Designa uma crítica severa e fundamentada que expõe o erro ou descredibiliza uma conduta questionável. 1. O perigo de descredibilização ou ruína de uma reputação ou ofício (At 19.27).
THAYER.en: Designates a severe and well-founded criticism that exposes error or discredits questionable conduct. 1. The danger of discrediting or the ruin of a reputation or office (Acts 19:27).

DEFINITION: Refers to a person who was previously a slave but has been legally emancipated and set free.
SENSES: 1. Someone who has been freed from slavery, used in a spiritual sense in Christ (1Co 7:22).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se a uma pessoa que anteriormente era escrava, mas que foi legalmente emancipada e libertada. 1. Alguém que foi libertado da escravidão, usado em sentido espiritual em Cristo (1Co 7.22).
THAYER.en: Refers to a person who was previously a slave but has been legally emancipated and set free. 1. Someone who has been freed from slavery, used in a spiritual sense in Christ (1Co 7:22).

DEFINITION: A proper name of a Christian greeted by the apostle Paul in his letter to the Romans.
SENSES: 1. A Christian approved in Christ in the church of Rome (Rom 16:10).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio de um cristão saudado pelo apóstolo Paulo em sua carta aos Romanos. 1. Um cristão aprovado em Cristo na igreja de Roma (Rm 16.10).
THAYER.en: A proper name of a Christian greeted by the apostle Paul in his letter to the Romans. 1. A Christian approved in Christ in the church of Rome (Rom 16:10).

DEFINITION: In the New Testament context, it can mean to await something with confidence or to expect to receive back without despairing.
SENSES: 1. To expect to receive something back or to maintain the expectation of a return (Luke 6:35).

THAYER.pt: No contexto neotestamentário, pode significar aguardar algo com confiança ou esperar receber de volta sem desanimar. 1. Esperar receber algo de volta ou manter a expectativa de retorno (Lc 6.35).
THAYER.en: In the New Testament context, it can mean to await something with confidence or to expect to receive back without despairing. 1. To expect to receive something back or to maintain the expectation of a return (Luke 6:35).

DEFINITION: In a frontal position to something, or denoting strong opposition and direct resistance.
SENSES: 1. In front of or in the presence of (Matt 27:61; Acts 3:16).
2. In the sense of opposition or against (Acts 17:7).

THAYER.pt: Em posição frontal a algo, ou denotando forte oposição e resistência direta. 1. Em frente ou na presença de (Mt 27.61; At 3.16). | 2. Em sentido de oposição ou contra (At 17.7).
THAYER.en: In a frontal position to something, or denoting strong opposition and direct resistance. 1. In front of or in the presence of (Matt 27:61; Acts 3:16). | 2. In the sense of opposition or against (Acts 17:7).

DEFINITION: Qualifies something that has no limits or whose extent and duration seem to have no end.
SENSES: 1. Relating to endless and fruitless genealogies that cause strife (1 Tim 1:4).

THAYER.pt: Qualifica algo que não possui limites ou cuja extensão e duração parecem não ter término. 1. Relativo a genealogias intermináveis e infrutíferas que causam contendas (1Tm 1.4).
THAYER.en: Qualifies something that has no limits or whose extent and duration seem to have no end. 1. Relating to endless and fruitless genealogies that cause strife (1 Tim 1:4).

DEFINITION: Describes an action performed in a focused manner, free from worries or interruptions that divert attention.
SENSES: 1. To devote oneself to the Lord in a concentrated manner without distractions (1 Cor 7:35).

THAYER.pt: Descreve uma ação realizada de maneira focada, livre de preocupações ou interrupções que desviem a atenção. 1. Devotar-se ao Senhor de maneira concentrada e sem distrações (1Co 7.35).
THAYER.en: Describes an action performed in a focused manner, free from worries or interruptions that divert attention. 1. To devote oneself to the Lord in a concentrated manner without distractions (1 Cor 7:35).

DEFINITION: Literally refers to the uncircumcised, but in the NT it is used metaphorically to describe hardness of heart and rebellion against God.
SENSES: 1. Uncircumcised in heart and ears, denoting spiritual obstinacy (Acts 7:51).

THAYER.pt: Literalmente refere-se aos não circuncidados, mas no NT é empregado metaforicamente para descrever dureza de coração e rebeldia contra Deus. 1. Incircunciso de coração e ouvidos, denotando obstinação espiritual (At 7.51).
THAYER.en: Literally refers to the uncircumcised, but in the NT it is used metaphorically to describe hardness of heart and rebellion against God. 1. Uncircumcised in heart and ears, denoting spiritual obstinacy (Acts 7:51).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: ἀπελεύσομαι, Aor: ἀπῆλθον, Perf: ἀπελήλυθα
DEFINITION: To move from a specific reference point, to depart, to withdraw from a presence, or to cease as a transitory state.
SENSES: 1. To depart, go away, withdraw from a place or company (Matt 8:21; Mark 1:35).
2. To follow someone or go in search of something (Mark 1:20; Jude 7).
3. To dissipate, disappear, cease (Mark 1:42; Rev 21:4).

THAYER.pt: Mover-se a partir de um determinado ponto de referência, afastar-se, retirar-se de uma presença ou extinguir-se como estado transitório. 1. Partir, afastar-se, retirar-se de um local ou companhia (Mt 8.21; Mc 1.35). | 2. Seguir a alguém ou ir em busca de algo (Mc 1.20; Jd 7). | 3. Dissipar-se, desaparecer, cessar (Mc 1.42; Ap 21.4).
THAYER.en: To move from a specific reference point, to depart, to withdraw from a presence, or to cease as a transitory state. 1. To depart, go away, withdraw from a place or company (Matt 8:21; Mark 1:35). | 2. To follow someone or go in search of something (Mark 1:20; Jude 7). | 3. To dissipate, disappear, cease (Mark 1:42; Rev 21:4).

SHORT_GLOSS: it is enough, it is sufficient
DEFINITION: An impersonal expression indicating that a quantity, situation, or condition has reached the necessary limit.
SENSES: 1. To indicate sufficiency, equivalent to 'it is enough' or 'it is sufficient'.
USAGE: it is enough, it is sufficient

THAYER.pt: Expressão impessoal que indica que uma quantidade, situação ou condição alcançou o limite necessário. 1. Indicar suficiência, equivalendo a 'basta' ou 'é o bastante'.
THAYER.en: An impersonal expression indicating that a quantity, situation, or condition has reached the necessary limit. 1. To indicate sufficiency, equivalent to 'it is enough' or 'it is sufficient'.

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Deponent middle, Fut: ἀπέξομαι, Aor: ἀπεσχόμην
DEFINITION: To keep oneself away from certain practices, desires, or behaviors for moral or disciplinary reasons.
SENSES: 1. To restrain oneself, avoid, or abstain from doing something.

THAYER.pt: Manter-se afastado de certas práticas, desejos ou comportamentos por motivos morais ou disciplinares. 1. Conter-se, evitar ou abster-se de realizar algo.
THAYER.en: To keep oneself away from certain practices, desires, or behaviors for moral or disciplinary reasons. 1. To restrain oneself, avoid, or abstain from doing something.

DEFINITION: A verb with multiple meanings ranging from being physically distant, receiving something in full, to abstaining from certain practices.
SENSES: 1. To receive payment or reward in full (Matt 6:2; Phil 4:18).
2. To be at a certain spatial distance (Luke 15:20).
3. To abstain or keep away from something (Acts 15:29; 1 Pet 2:11).

THAYER.pt: Verbo com múltiplos sentidos que vão desde estar fisicamente distante, receber algo integralmente, até abster-se de certas práticas. 1. Receber pagamento ou recompensa em sua totalidade (Mt 6.2; Fp 4.18). | 2. Estar a uma certa distância espacial (Lc 15.20). | 3. Abster-se ou afastar-se de algo (At 15.29; 1Pe 2.11).
THAYER.en: A verb with multiple meanings ranging from being physically distant, receiving something in full, to abstaining from certain practices. 1. To receive payment or reward in full (Matt 6:2; Phil 4:18). | 2. To be at a certain spatial distance (Luke 15:20). | 3. To abstain or keep away from something (Acts 15:29; 1 Pet 2:11).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Impf: ἠπίστουν, Aor: ἠπίστησα, Pass: ἠπιστήθην
DEFINITION: To refuse to believe the truth or to demonstrate unfaithfulness and lack of reliability regarding an obligation.
SENSES: 1. To refuse to believe or doubt a message or testimony (Luke 24:11; Acts 28:24).
2. To be unfaithful or fail in the loyalty owed to God (Rom 3:3; 2 Tim 2:13).

THAYER.pt: Recusar-se a crer na verdade ou demonstrar infidelidade e falta de confiabilidade diante de uma obrigação. 1. Recusar-se a crer ou duvidar de uma mensagem ou testemunho (Lc 24.11; At 28.24). | 2. Ser infiel ou faltar com a lealdade devida a Deus (Rm 3.3; 2Tm 2.13).
THAYER.en: To refuse to believe the truth or to demonstrate unfaithfulness and lack of reliability regarding an obligation. 1. To refuse to believe or doubt a message or testimony (Luke 24:11; Acts 28:24). | 2. To be unfaithful or fail in the loyalty owed to God (Rom 3:3; 2 Tim 2:13).

DEFINITION: The condition or attitude of refusing to believe, trust, or commit to God and His revealed word.
SENSES: 1. Inability or refusal to believe and trust in God (Matt 13:58; Rom 11:20).
2. Lack of faithfulness or breach of commitment in a covenant (Rom 3:3).

THAYER.pt: A condição ou atitude de recusar-se a crer, confiar ou comprometer-se com Deus e com a sua palavra revelada. 1. Incapacidade ou recusa de crer e confiar em Deus (Mt 13.58; Rm 11.20). | 2. Falta de fidelidade ou quebra de compromisso em um pacto (Rm 3.3).
THAYER.en: The condition or attitude of refusing to believe, trust, or commit to God and His revealed word. 1. Inability or refusal to believe and trust in God (Matt 13:58; Rom 11:20). | 2. Lack of faithfulness or breach of commitment in a covenant (Rom 3:3).

DEFINITION: Describes someone who does not possess faith in God or who refuses to believe the gospel message. It can also mean something unbelievable.
SENSES: 1. One who does not believe, unbelieving, faithless (John 20:27; 1 Cor 6:6).
2. Something that cannot be believed, incredible (Acts 26:8).

THAYER.pt: Descreve alguém que não possui fé em Deus ou que se recusa a crer na mensagem do evangelho. Pode significar também algo inacreditável. 1. Que não crê, incrédulo, descrente (Jo 20.27; 1Co 6.6). | 2. Algo que não pode ser crido, incrível (At 26.8).
THAYER.en: Describes someone who does not possess faith in God or who refuses to believe the gospel message. It can also mean something unbelievable. 1. One who does not believe, unbelieving, faithless (John 20:27; 1 Cor 6:6). | 2. Something that cannot be believed, incredible (Acts 26:8).

DEFINITION: The quality of personal integrity without ulterior motives, manifested both in the purity of motivations and in practical generosity.
SENSES: 1. Sincerity and purity of motivation in conduct (2 Cor 11:3; Eph 6:5).
2. Disinterested generosity and liberality in helping others (Rom 12:8).

THAYER.pt: Qualidade de integridade pessoal sem segundas intenções, manifestada tanto na pureza de motivações quanto na generosidade prática. 1. Sinceridade e pureza de motivação na conduta (2Co 11.3; Ef 6.5). | 2. Generosidade desinteressada e liberalidade no auxílio ao próximo (Rm 12.8).
THAYER.en: The quality of personal integrity without ulterior motives, manifested both in the purity of motivations and in practical generosity. 1. Sincerity and purity of motivation in conduct (2 Cor 11:3; Eph 6:5). | 2. Disinterested generosity and liberality in helping others (Rom 12:8).

DEFINITION: Describes that which is simple, without ulterior motives, upright, or generous in its disposition toward others.
SENSES: 1. Referring to the eye or the heart as upright, sincere, and without malice (Matt 6:22).

THAYER.pt: Descreve aquilo que é simples, sem segundas intenções, íntegro ou generoso em sua disposição para com os outros. 1. Referindo-se à visão ou ao coração como íntegro, sincero e sem malícia (Mt 6:22).
THAYER.en: Describes that which is simple, without ulterior motives, upright, or generous in its disposition toward others. 1. Referring to the eye or the heart as upright, sincere, and without malice (Matt 6:22).

DEFINITION: Indicates an attitude characterized by liberal generosity, frankness, and the absence of ulterior motives.
SENSES: 1. To give generously, without reservations or pretense (Jas 1:5).

THAYER.pt: Indica uma atitude caracterizada por generosidade liberal, franqueza e ausência de segundas intenções. 1. Dar de forma generosa, sem reservas ou fingimento (Tg 1.5).
THAYER.en: Indicates an attitude characterized by liberal generosity, frankness, and the absence of ulterior motives. 1. To give generously, without reservations or pretense (Jas 1:5).

DEFINITION: A preposition indicating spatial separation, departure from a starting point, initial time, or the originating source of something.
SENSES: 1. Spatial separation or physical departure away from something (Matt 3:16; 8:1).
2. Starting point in time: since, from (Matt 1:17; Rom 1:20).
3. Origin, source, author, or motivating cause (Matt 7:16; 1 John 1:5).

THAYER.pt: Preposição que indica separação espacial, afastamento de um ponto de partida, tempo inicial ou fonte originadora de algo. 1. Separação espacial ou afastamento físico para longe de algo (Mt 3.16; 8.1). | 2. Ponto de partida no tempo: desde, a partir de (Mt 1.17; Rm 1.20). | 3. Origem, fonte, autor ou causa motivadora (Mt 7.16; 1Jo 1.5).
THAYER.en: A preposition indicating spatial separation, departure from a starting point, initial time, or the originating source of something. 1. Spatial separation or physical departure away from something (Matt 3:16; 8:1). | 2. Starting point in time: since, from (Matt 1:17; Rom 1:20). | 3. Origin, source, author, or motivating cause (Matt 7:16; 1 John 1:5).

DEFINITION: Literally means to exit a vessel onto dry land, or figuratively to describe the outcome, course, or final result of a situation.
SENSES: 1. To disembark from a ship (Luke 5:2; John 21:9).
2. To end in a certain result or lead to an outcome (Luke 21:13; Phil 1:19).

THAYER.pt: Significa literalmente sair de uma embarcação para terra firme, ou figuradamente descrever o desfecho, rumo ou resultado final de uma situação. 1. Desembarcar de um navio (Lc 5.2; Jo 21.9). | 2. Terminar em certo resultado ou conduzir a um desfecho (Lc 21.13; Fp 1.19).
THAYER.en: Literally means to exit a vessel onto dry land, or figuratively to describe the outcome, course, or final result of a situation. 1. To disembark from a ship (Luke 5:2; John 21:9). | 2. To end in a certain result or lead to an outcome (Luke 21:13; Phil 1:19).

DEFINITION: Indicates the action of pushing away, discarding, or casting off something unwanted, or suffering the loss of something valuable.
SENSES: 1. To cast off quickly a garment or object (Mark 10:50).
2. To discard or lose something of great value and confidence (Heb 10:35).

THAYER.pt: Indica a ação de afastar, descartar ou lançar fora algo indesejado, ou de sofrer a perda de algo valioso. 1. Lançar fora rapidamente uma peça de vestuário ou objeto (Mc 10:50). | 2. Descartar ou perder algo de grande valor e confiança (Hb 10:35).
THAYER.en: Indicates the action of pushing away, discarding, or casting off something unwanted, or suffering the loss of something valuable. 1. To cast off quickly a garment or object (Mark 10:50). | 2. To discard or lose something of great value and confidence (Heb 10:35).

SHORT_GLOSS: to look to, fix one's eyes
DEFINITION: Means to turn one's gaze away from other things to fix attention firmly on a single target or goal.
SENSES: 1. To fix attention firmly on a reward or higher purpose (Heb 11:26).
USAGE: to look to, fix one's eyes

THAYER.pt: Significa desviar o olhar de outras coisas para fixar a atenção firmemente em um único alvo ou objetivo. 1. Fixar a atenção firmemente em uma recompensa ou propósito superior (Hb 11.26).
THAYER.en: Means to turn one's gaze away from other things to fix attention firmly on a single target or goal. 1. To fix attention firmly on a reward or higher purpose (Heb 11:26).

DEFINITION: Designates something that should be despised or rejected because it is considered unfit or impure.
SENSES: 1. Something that must be rejected or discarded as unfit (1Tm 4:4).

THAYER.pt: Designa algo que deve ser desprezado ou rejeitado por ser considerado impróprio ou impuro. 1. Algo que deve ser rejeitado ou descartado como impróprio (1Tm 4.4).
THAYER.en: Designates something that should be despised or rejected because it is considered unfit or impure. 1. Something that must be rejected or discarded as unfit (1Tm 4:4).

DEFINITION: Refers to the act or event of rejecting someone or to the material and existential loss of something.
SENSES: 1. The temporary rejection of Israel in God's redemptive plan (Rm 11:15).
2. The physical loss of goods or lives, as in a shipwreck (Ac 27:22).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se ao ato ou evento de rejeitar alguém ou à perda material e existencial de algo. 1. A rejeição temporária de Israel no plano redentor de Deus (Rm 11:15). | 2. A perda física de bens ou vidas, como em um naufrágio (At 27:22).
THAYER.en: Refers to the act or event of rejecting someone or to the material and existential loss of something. 1. The temporary rejection of Israel in God's redemptive plan (Rm 11:15). | 2. The physical loss of goods or lives, as in a shipwreck (Ac 27:22).

DEFINITION: In the New Testament context, it possesses the soteriological meaning of breaking with sin as if being dead to it.
SENSES: 1. To be dead to sin and live to righteousness (1Pe 2:24).

THAYER.pt: No contexto do Novo Testamento, possui o sentido soteriológico de romper com o pecado como se estivesse morto para ele. 1. Estar morto para o pecado e viver para a justiça (1Pe 2.24).
THAYER.en: In the New Testament context, it possesses the soteriological meaning of breaking with sin as if being dead to it. 1. To be dead to sin and live to righteousness (1Pe 2:24).

DEFINITION: Designates the official registration of citizens and their property for administrative purposes, such as Roman taxation.
SENSES: 1. The official census ordered by the Roman government (Lc 2:2; Ac 5:37).

THAYER.pt: Designa o registro oficial de cidadãos e de seus bens para fins administrativos, como a taxação romana. 1. O recenseamento oficial ordenado pelo governo romano (Lc 2:2; At 5:37).
THAYER.en: Designates the official registration of citizens and their property for administrative purposes, such as Roman taxation. 1. The official census ordered by the Roman government (Lc 2:2; Ac 5:37).

DEFINITION: Describes the act of recording names, censuses, or information in official lists, scrolls, or public registers.
SENSES: 1. To enroll or census citizens in public registers (Lc 2:1, 3, 5).
2. To register one's name in a heavenly record (Hb 12:23).

THAYER.pt: Descreve o ato de registrar nomes, censos ou informações em listas oficiais, rolos ou registros públicos. 1. Alistar ou recensear cidadãos em registros públicos (Lc 2.1, 3, 5). | 2. Inscrever o nome em um registro celestial (Hb 12.23).
THAYER.en: Describes the act of recording names, censuses, or information in official lists, scrolls, or public registers. 1. To enroll or census citizens in public registers (Lc 2:1, 3, 5). | 2. To register one's name in a heavenly record (Hb 12:23).

DEFINITION: Means to present convincing evidence to certify the truth of something, or to publicly designate someone for an official function.
SENSES: 1. To demonstrate or prove something with clear evidence (Ac 25:7; 2Th 2:4).
2. To publicly exhibit, appoint, or commission someone to a position (Ac 2:22; 1Co 4:9).

THAYER.pt: Significa apresentar evidências convincentes para certificar a veracidade de algo, ou designar publicamente alguém para uma função oficial. 1. Demonstrar ou provar algo com evidências claras (At 25.7; 2Ts 2.4). | 2. Exibir publicamente, designar ou comissionar alguém para um cargo (At 2.22; 1Co 4.9).
THAYER.en: Means to present convincing evidence to certify the truth of something, or to publicly designate someone for an official function. 1. To demonstrate or prove something with clear evidence (Ac 25:7; 2Th 2:4). | 2. To publicly exhibit, appoint, or commission someone to a position (Ac 2:22; 1Co 4:9).

DEFINITION: Indicates the means or convincing argument by which the truth of a fact or doctrine is proven.
SENSES: 1. Irrefutable demonstration or convincing proof of divine power (1Co 2:4).

THAYER.pt: Indica o meio ou argumento convincente pelo qual se comprova a veracidade de um fato ou doutrina. 1. Demonstração irrefutável ou prova convincente do poder divino (1Co 2.4).
THAYER.en: Indicates the means or convincing argument by which the truth of a fact or doctrine is proven. 1. Irrefutable demonstration or convincing proof of divine power (1Co 2:4).

DEFINITION: Refers to the practice of giving or collecting the tenth part of income or agricultural produce as a religious or legal obligation.
SENSES: 1. To pay the tenth part of earnings or produce (Mt 23:23; Lc 11:42).
2. To receive or collect the tithe from another (Hb 7:5).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se à prática de dar ou recolher a décima parte dos rendimentos ou produtos agrícolas como obrigação religiosa ou legal. 1. Pagar a décima parte dos ganhos ou produtos (Mt 23.23; Lc 11.42). | 2. Receber ou cobrar o dízimo de outrem (Hb 7.5).
THAYER.en: Refers to the practice of giving or collecting the tenth part of income or agricultural produce as a religious or legal obligation. 1. To pay the tenth part of earnings or produce (Mt 23:23; Lc 11:42). | 2. To receive or collect the tithe from another (Hb 7:5).

DEFINITION: Qualifies that which is well received, favorable, or fully acceptable before God or humans.
SENSES: 1. That which is pleasing and acceptable before God (1Tm 2:3).

THAYER.pt: Qualifica aquilo que é bem recebido, favorável ou plenamente aceitável diante de Deus ou dos homens. 1. Aquilo que é agradável e aceitável perante Deus (1Tm 2:3).
THAYER.en: Qualifies that which is well received, favorable, or fully acceptable before God or humans. 1. That which is pleasing and acceptable before God (1Tm 2:3).

DEFINITION: To receive someone with hospitality and pleasure, or to accept a message and attitude with approval and recognition.
SENSES: 1. To warmly welcome or receive someone (Lc 8:40).
2. To accept teachings or facts with conviction and approval (Ac 2:41; 24:3).

THAYER.pt: Receber alguém com hospitalidade e agrado, ou aceitar uma mensagem e atitude com aprovação e reconhecimento. 1. Acolher ou receber alguém calorosamente (Lc 8.40). | 2. Aceitar ensinamentos ou fatos com convicção e aprovação (At 2.41; 24.3).
THAYER.en: To receive someone with hospitality and pleasure, or to accept a message and attitude with approval and recognition. 1. To warmly welcome or receive someone (Lc 8:40). | 2. To accept teachings or facts with conviction and approval (Ac 2:41; 24:3).

SHORT_GLOSS: to go abroad, be away, travel
DEFINITION: Means to absent oneself from one's own country or residence for a prolonged period to undertake a journey.
SENSES: 1. To leave home for a long journey (Mt 25:14; Lc 15:13).
2. To be absent or distant from a place (2Co 5:6).
USAGE: to go abroad, be away, travel

THAYER.pt: Significa ausentar-se do próprio país ou residência por um período prolongado para realizar uma viagem. 1. Ausentar-se de casa para uma viagem longa (Mt 25.14; Lc 15.13). | 2. Estar ausente ou distante de um lugar (2Co 5.6).
THAYER.en: Means to absent oneself from one's own country or residence for a prolonged period to undertake a journey. 1. To leave home for a long journey (Mt 25:14; Lc 15:13). | 2. To be absent or distant from a place (2Co 5:6).

DEFINITION: Describes someone who is away from their habitual residence due to travel.
SENSES: 1. To be away from home on a trip or journey (Mk 13:34).

THAYER.pt: Descreve alguém que se encontra ausente de sua residência habitual por motivo de viagem. 1. Estar ausente de casa em uma viagem ou jornada (Mc 13.34).
THAYER.en: Describes someone who is away from their habitual residence due to travel. 1. To be away from home on a trip or journey (Mk 13:34).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: future: ἀποδώσω, aorist: ἀπέδωκα, middle aorist: ἀπεδόμην
DEFINITION: To give in response to a prior obligation, whether settling a debt, delivering what rightfully belongs to someone, rendering accounts, or bestowing rewards and punishments.
SENSES: 1. To pay a debt or fulfill a due obligation (Mt 5:26; Mt 18:25; Rm 13:7).
2. To return or restore what belongs to another (Lc 4:20; Lc 19:8; Mt 22:21).
3. To repay or reward according to actions and moral merit (Rm 2:6; 2Tm 4:14; Rv 22:12).
4. In the middle voice: to sell for a price (Ac 5:8; Hb 12:16).

THAYER.pt: Dar em resposta a uma obrigação prévia, seja liquidando uma dívida, entregando o que pertence a alguém de direito, prestando contas ou retribuindo recompensas e punições. 1. Pagar uma dívida ou cumprir obrigação devida (Mt 5.26; Mt 18.25; Rm 13.7). | 2. Devolver, restituir o que pertence a outro (Lc 4.20; Lc 19.8; Mt 22.21). | 3. Retribuir ou recompensar conforme as ações e o mérito moral (Rm 2.6; 2Tm 4.14; Ap 22.12). | 4. Na voz média: vender por um preço (At 5.8; Hb 12.16).
THAYER.en: To give in response to a prior obligation, whether settling a debt, delivering what rightfully belongs to someone, rendering accounts, or bestowing rewards and punishments. 1. To pay a debt or fulfill a due obligation (Mt 5:26; Mt 18:25; Rm 13:7). | 2. To return or restore what belongs to another (Lc 4:20; Lc 19:8; Mt 22:21). | 3. To repay or reward according to actions and moral merit (Rm 2:6; 2Tm 4:14; Rv 22:12). | 4. In the middle voice: to sell for a price (Ac 5:8; Hb 12:16).

DEFINITION: Means to promote ruptures, dissensions, or factional divisions among people, especially within a community context.
SENSES: 1. To cause sectarian divisions or separate oneself from fellowship (Jude 19).

THAYER.pt: Significa promover rupturas, dissensões ou divisões facciosas entre pessoas, especialmente no contexto comunitário. 1. Causar divisões sectárias ou separar-se da comunhão (Jd 19).
THAYER.en: Means to promote ruptures, dissensions, or factional divisions among people, especially within a community context. 1. To cause sectarian divisions or separate oneself from fellowship (Jude 19).

DEFINITION: Means to rigorously evaluate something or someone and consider them worthless, unworthy, or false, resulting in official rejection.
SENSES: 1. To reject after examination, judging it worthless or valueless (Mt 21:42; Mk 8:31).

THAYER.pt: Significa avaliar rigorosamente algo ou alguém e considerá-lo imprestável, indigno ou falso, resultando na sua rejeição oficial. 1. Rejeitar após exame por julgar imprestável ou sem valor (Mt 21.42; Mc 8.31).
THAYER.en: Means to rigorously evaluate something or someone and consider them worthless, unworthy, or false, resulting in official rejection. 1. To reject after examination, judging it worthless or valueless (Mt 21:42; Mk 8:31).

DEFINITION: The act of favorably welcoming a message, teaching, or person, recognizing their truth and value.
SENSES: 1. The full acceptance and welcoming of a trustworthy statement (1Tm 1:15).

THAYER.pt: O ato de acolher favoravelmente uma mensagem, ensino ou pessoa, reconhecendo sua veracidade e valor. 1. A plena aceitação e acolhimento de uma declaração digna de fé (1Tm 1:15).
THAYER.en: The act of favorably welcoming a message, teaching, or person, recognizing their truth and value. 1. The full acceptance and welcoming of a trustworthy statement (1Tm 1:15).

DEFINITION: Refers to the act of depositing, removing, or putting away something, also used as a euphemism for physical death.
SENSES: 1. The removal of moral impurity or baptism as the pledge of a good conscience (1Pe 3:21).
2. The departure from this life or physical death (2Pe 1:14).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se ao ato de depor, remover ou afastar algo, sendo usado também como eufemismo para a morte física. 1. A remoção da impureza moral ou o batismo como compromisso da boa consciência (1Pe 3:21). | 2. A partida desta vida ou morte física (2Pe 1:14).
THAYER.en: Refers to the act of depositing, removing, or putting away something, also used as a euphemism for physical death. 1. The removal of moral impurity or baptism as the pledge of a good conscience (1Pe 3:21). | 2. The departure from this life or physical death (2Pe 1:14).

DEFINITION: A building or enclosed space intended for storing agricultural provisions, grains, or harvests.
SENSES: 1. A barn or storehouse for keeping harvests and supplies (Mt 3:12).

THAYER.pt: Edifício ou recinto fechado destinado ao armazenamento de provisões agrícolas, grãos ou colheitas. 1. Celeiro ou depósito para guardar colheitas e mantimentos (Mt 3.12).
THAYER.en: A building or enclosed space intended for storing agricultural provisions, grains, or harvests. 1. A barn or storehouse for keeping harvests and supplies (Mt 3:12).

DEFINITION: Means to gather and safely store precious goods for future use, frequently with a metaphorical sense.
SENSES: 1. To accumulate a secure treasure as a foundation for the future (1Tm 6:19).

THAYER.pt: Significa ajuntar e guardar com segurança bens preciosos para uso futuro, frequentemente com sentido metafórico. 1. Acumular um tesouro seguro como fundamento para o futuro (1Tm 6.19).
THAYER.en: Means to gather and safely store precious goods for future use, frequently with a metaphorical sense. 1. To accumulate a secure treasure as a foundation for the future (1Tm 6:19).

DEFINITION: Means to exert strong physical pressure or compress, describing the act of crowding or pressing against someone.
SENSES: 1. To press or crowd tightly around, squeezing in the middle of a crowd (Lc 8:45).

THAYER.pt: Significa exercer forte pressão física ou comprimir, descrevendo o ato de apertar ou aglomerar-se contra alguém. 1. Pressionar ou apertar fortemente ao redor, comprimindo no meio da multidão (Lc 8.45).
THAYER.en: Means to exert strong physical pressure or compress, describing the act of crowding or pressing against someone. 1. To press or crowd tightly around, squeezing in the middle of a crowd (Lc 8:45).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: ἀποθανοῦμαι, Aor: ἀπέθανον, Perf: τέθνηκα
DEFINITION: To lose organic vital signs, to cease living physically; broadly used for the substitutionary death of Christ or for the believer's total renunciation of the dominion of sin.
SENSES: 1. To cease physical life, expire, pass away (Matt 9:24; John 11:14).
2. The sacrificial and redemptive death of Jesus on behalf of humanity (Rom 5:8; 1 Cor 15:3).
3. To die spiritually with respect to sin, the law, or the world (Rom 6:2; Gal 2:19; Col 3:3).

THAYER.pt: Perder os sinais vitais orgânicos, cessar de viver fisicamente; amplamente usado para a morte substitutiva de Cristo ou para a renúncia total do crente ao domínio do pecado. 1. Cessar a vida física, expirar, falecer (Mt 9.24; Jo 11.14). | 2. A morte sacrificial e redentora de Jesus em favor da humanidade (Rm 5.8; 1Co 15.3). | 3. Morrer espiritualmente com relação ao pecado, à lei ou ao mundo (Rm 6.2; Gl 2.19; Cl 3.3).
THAYER.en: To lose organic vital signs, to cease living physically; broadly used for the substitutionary death of Christ or for the believer's total renunciation of the dominion of sin. 1. To cease physical life, expire, pass away (Matt 9:24; John 11:14). | 2. The sacrificial and redemptive death of Jesus on behalf of humanity (Rom 5:8; 1 Cor 15:3). | 3. To die spiritually with respect to sin, the law, or the world (Rom 6:2; Gal 2:19; Col 3:3).

DEFINITION: To restore someone or something to a previous state of integrity, health, or function, or to reestablish an original condition.
SENSES: 1. To return something to a previous good or healthy state, to restore or heal (Matt 12:13; 17:11).
2. To reestablish relationships or lead someone back to a place (Heb 13:19).

THAYER.pt: Restaurar alguém ou algo ao seu estado anterior de integridade, saúde ou função, ou restabelecer uma condição original. 1. Retornar algo a um estado bom ou saudável anterior, restaurar ou curar (Mt 12.13; 17.11). | 2. Restabelecer relações ou conduzir alguém de volta a um lugar (Hb 13.19).
THAYER.en: To restore someone or something to a previous state of integrity, health, or function, or to reestablish an original condition. 1. To return something to a previous good or healthy state, to restore or heal (Matt 12:13; 17:11). | 2. To reestablish relationships or lead someone back to a place (Heb 13:19).

DEFINITION: To remove the veil covering something to make it fully visible and known, especially regarding divine mysteries.
SENSES: 1. To cause something hidden to be fully known, to reveal (Matt 10:26; Rom 1:17).

THAYER.pt: Retirar o véu que encobre algo para torná-lo plenamente visível e conhecido, especialmente no tocante aos mistérios divinos. 1. Fazer com que algo oculto seja plenamente conhecido, revelar (Mt 10.26; Rm 1.17).
THAYER.en: To remove the veil covering something to make it fully visible and known, especially regarding divine mysteries. 1. To cause something hidden to be fully known, to reveal (Matt 10:26; Rom 1:17).

DEFINITION: The act of removing the veil that covers something, bringing to light a divine truth or secret previously hidden.
SENSES: 1. The revelation or visible manifestation of divine truths or of Jesus Christ (Rom 16:25; Eph 1:17).

THAYER.pt: O ato de remover o véu que encobre algo, trazendo à luz uma verdade divina ou segredo antes oculto. 1. A revelação ou manifestação visível de verdades divinas ou de Jesus Cristo (Rm 16.25; Ef 1.17).
THAYER.en: The act of removing the veil that covers something, bringing to light a divine truth or secret previously hidden. 1. The revelation or visible manifestation of divine truths or of Jesus Christ (Rom 16:25; Eph 1:17).

DEFINITION: Describes the attitude of waiting for something with intense expectation, stretching the neck to see what is approaching.
SENSES: 1. The ardent and firm expectation of creation or of the believer for final redemption (Rom 8:19; Phil 1:20).

THAYER.pt: Descreve a atitude de aguardar algo com intensa expectativa, esticando o pescoço para ver o que se aproxima. 1. A ardente e firme expectativa da criação ou do crente pela redenção final (Rm 8:19; Fp 1:20).
THAYER.en: Describes the attitude of waiting for something with intense expectation, stretching the neck to see what is approaching. 1. The ardent and firm expectation of creation or of the believer for final redemption (Rom 8:19; Phil 1:20).

DEFINITION: To reestablish peace and fellowship in a relationship that had been broken or hostile.
SENSES: 1. To reconcile humanity to God through Christ (Eph 2:16; Col 1:20, 22).

THAYER.pt: Restabelecer a paz e a comunhão em um relacionamento que havia sido rompido ou hostilizado. 1. Reconciliar a humanidade com Deus através de Cristo (Ef 2.16; Cl 1.20, 22).
THAYER.en: To reestablish peace and fellowship in a relationship that had been broken or hostile. 1. To reconcile humanity to God through Christ (Eph 2:16; Col 1:20, 22).

DEFINITION: Refers to the act or process of restoring something to its previous or original state of excellence and order.
SENSES: 1. The restoration or reestablishment of all things predicted by the prophets (Acts 3:21).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se ao ato ou processo de restaurar algo ao seu estado anterior ou original de excelência e ordem. 1. A restauração ou o restabelecimento de todas as coisas preditas pelos profetas (At 3.21).
THAYER.en: Refers to the act or process of restoring something to its previous or original state of excellence and order. 1. The restoration or reestablishment of all things predicted by the prophets (Acts 3:21).

DEFINITION: Indicates something that has been safely kept for future use, or a reward and inevitable destiny that is reserved by divine providence.
SENSES: 1. To keep or store something for later use (Luke 19:20).
2. To be reserved as a reward or heavenly prize (Col 1:5; 2 Tim 4:8).
3. To be inevitably destined to happen (Heb 9:27).

THAYER.pt: Indica algo que foi guardado com segurança para uso futuro, ou uma recompensa e destino inevitável que está reservado por providência divina. 1. Guardar ou armazenar algo para uso posterior (Lc 19.20). | 2. Estar reservado como recompensa ou galardão celestial (Cl 1.5; 2Tm 4.8). | 3. Estar inevitavelmente destinado a acontecer (Hb 9.27).
THAYER.en: Indicates something that has been safely kept for future use, or a reward and inevitable destiny that is reserved by divine providence. 1. To keep or store something for later use (Luke 19:20). | 2. To be reserved as a reward or heavenly prize (Col 1:5; 2 Tim 4:8). | 3. To be inevitably destined to happen (Heb 9:27).

DEFINITION: Describes the violent act of executing a person by cutting off their head, commonly as capital punishment applied by rulers.
SENSES: 1. To behead or cut off someone's head (Matt 14:10; Mark 6:16; Luke 9:9).

THAYER.pt: Descreve o ato violento de executar uma pessoa cortando-lhe a cabeça, comumente como pena capital aplicada por governantes. 1. Decapitar ou cortar a cabeça de alguém (Mt 14.10; Mc 6.16; Lc 9.9).
THAYER.en: Describes the violent act of executing a person by cutting off their head, commonly as capital punishment applied by rulers. 1. To behead or cut off someone's head (Matt 14:10; Mark 6:16; Luke 9:9).

DEFINITION: Indicates the action of closing an entrance or door, blocking access and excluding those on the outside.
SENSES: 1. To close a door or entrance, preventing passage or the entry of people (Luke 13:25).
