THAYER.pt: Indica a ação de fechar uma entrada ou porta, bloqueando o acesso e excluindo quem está do lado de fora. 1. Fechar uma porta ou entrada, impedindo a passagem ou a entrada de pessoas (Lc 13.25).
THAYER.en: Indicates the action of closing an entrance or door, blocking access and excluding those on the outside. 1. To close a door or entrance, preventing passage or the entry of people (Luke 13:25).

DEFINITION: To cut a part of something so as to separate it completely from the rest, applied to body parts or objects.
SENSES: 1. To sever or cut off a part of the body (Mark 9:43).
2. To cut ropes or fastening elements (Acts 27:32).

THAYER.pt: Cortar uma parte de algo de modo a separá-la completamente do restante, aplicando-se a membros do corpo ou a objetos. 1. Decepar ou cortar uma parte do corpo (Mc 9.43). | 2. Cortar cordas ou elementos de fixação (At 27.32).
THAYER.en: To cut a part of something so as to separate it completely from the rest, applied to body parts or objects. 1. To sever or cut off a part of the body (Mark 9:43). | 2. To cut ropes or fastening elements (Acts 27:32).

DEFINITION: Designates an official decision, often of a legal nature or a definitive judicial verdict.
SENSES: 1. An irrevocable sentence or decision, indicating the certainty of condemnation or judgment (2 Cor 1:9).

THAYER.pt: Designa uma decisão oficial, frequentemente de natureza legal ou um veredicto judicial definitivo. 1. Uma sentença ou decisão irrevogável, indicando a certeza de condenação ou julgamento (2Co 1.9).
THAYER.en: Designates an official decision, often of a legal nature or a definitive judicial verdict. 1. An irrevocable sentence or decision, indicating the certainty of condemnation or judgment (2 Cor 1:9).

DEFINITION: To offer a verbal counterpart to a prior inquiry or to respond to challenging circumstances through speech. Under strong influence of biblical Hebrew, it typically introduces the formal continuation or solemn beginning of an expository speech.
SENSES: 1. To formally answer a question or inquiry (Matt 26:62; John 1:21).
2. To take the floor, continue a dialogue, or react verbally to a situation (Matt 17:4; 22:1).

THAYER.pt: Oferecer contrapartida verbal a uma indagação anterior ou responder a circunstâncias desafiadoras por meio do discurso. Sob forte influência do hebraico bíblico, costuma introduzir o prosseguimento formal ou início solene de uma fala expositiva. 1. Responder formalmente a uma pergunta ou questionamento (Mt 26.62; Jo 1.21). | 2. Tomar a palavra, prosseguir um diálogo ou reagir verbalmente a uma situação (Mt 17.4; 22.1).
THAYER.en: To offer a verbal counterpart to a prior inquiry or to respond to challenging circumstances through speech. Under strong influence of biblical Hebrew, it typically introduces the formal continuation or solemn beginning of an expository speech. 1. To formally answer a question or inquiry (Matt 26:62; John 1:21). | 2. To take the floor, continue a dialogue, or react verbally to a situation (Matt 17:4; 22:1).

DEFINITION: Refers to the statement, reply, or verbal pronouncement issued in response to a question, inquiry, or situation.
SENSES: 1. A verbal response to a question or argument (Luke 2:47; Luke 20:26; John 1:22).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se à declaração, réplica ou pronunciamento verbal emitido em resposta a uma pergunta, questionamento ou situação. 1. Uma resposta verbal a uma pergunta ou argumento (Lc 2.47; Lc 20.26; Jo 1.22).
THAYER.en: Refers to the statement, reply, or verbal pronouncement issued in response to a question, inquiry, or situation. 1. A verbal response to a question or argument (Luke 2:47; Luke 20:26; John 1:22).

DEFINITION: Means to hide something so as to make it inaccessible or to deliberately keep a truth hidden from public knowledge.
SENSES: 1. To physically conceal or hide something (Matt 25:25; Luke 19:42).
2. To keep something secret or hidden from human understanding (Matt 11:25; Luke 10:21; Eph 3:9).

THAYER.pt: Significa esconder algo de modo a torná-lo inacessível ou manter deliberadamente uma verdade oculta ao conhecimento público. 1. Ocultar fisicamente ou esconder algo (Mt 25.25; Lc 19.42). | 2. Manter algo em segredo ou oculto do entendimento humano (Mt 11.25; Lc 10.21; Ef 3.9).
THAYER.en: Means to hide something so as to make it inaccessible or to deliberately keep a truth hidden from public knowledge. 1. To physically conceal or hide something (Matt 25:25; Luke 19:42). | 2. To keep something secret or hidden from human understanding (Matt 11:25; Luke 10:21; Eph 3:9).

DEFINITION: That which is beyond the reach of sight or common knowledge; kept secret.
SENSES: 1. Treasures of wisdom hidden or concealed in Christ (Col 2:3; Luke 8:17).

THAYER.pt: Que está fora do alcance da visão ou do conhecimento comum; mantido em segredo. 1. Tesouros de sabedoria escondidos ou ocultos em Cristo (Cl 2.3; Lc 8.17).
THAYER.en: That which is beyond the reach of sight or common knowledge; kept secret. 1. Treasures of wisdom hidden or concealed in Christ (Col 2:3; Luke 8:17).

DEFINITION: Means to deprive someone of life violently, used in the New Testament both for literal homicides and for martyrdom and the end of abstract realities.
SENSES: 1. To cause the physical death of a living being or to murder (Matt 10:28; Mark 12:5).
2. To eliminate or annul something in a figurative sense (Eph 2:16).

THAYER.pt: Significa privar alguém da vida de modo violento, sendo usado no Novo Testamento tanto para homicídios literais quanto para o martírio e o fim de realidades abstratas. 1. Causar a morte física de um ser vivo ou assassinar (Mt 10.28; Mc 12.5). | 2. Eliminar ou anular algo em sentido figurado (Ef 2.16).
THAYER.en: Means to deprive someone of life violently, used in the New Testament both for literal homicides and for martyrdom and the end of abstract realities. 1. To cause the physical death of a living being or to murder (Matt 10:28; Mark 12:5). | 2. To eliminate or annul something in a figurative sense (Eph 2:16).

DEFINITION: Means to give birth, generate offspring, or, in a figurative sense, bring concepts or moral consequences into existence.
SENSES: 1. The act of generating or giving birth to a child.
2. The figurative process in which desire conceives and gives birth to sin (Jas 1:15).

THAYER.pt: Significa dar à luz, gerar descendência ou, em sentido figurado, trazer à existência conceitos ou consequências morais. 1. O ato de gerar ou dar à luz um filho. | 2. O processo figurado em que o desejo concebe e gera o pecado (Tg 1:15).
THAYER.en: Means to give birth, generate offspring, or, in a figurative sense, bring concepts or moral consequences into existence. 1. The act of generating or giving birth to a child. | 2. The figurative process in which desire conceives and gives birth to sin (Jas 1:15).

DEFINITION: Describes the action of rolling a heavy object, such as a large stone, away from its original position.
SENSES: 1. To roll a stone away from the entrance of a tomb (Matt 28:2; Mark 16:3; Luke 24:2).

THAYER.pt: Descreve a ação de fazer rolar um objeto pesado, como uma pedra grande, para longe de sua posição original. 1. Rolar uma pedra para longe da entrada de um sepulcro (Mt 28.2; Mc 16.3; Lc 24.2).
THAYER.en: Describes the action of rolling a heavy object, such as a large stone, away from its original position. 1. To roll a stone away from the entrance of a tomb (Matt 28:2; Mark 16:3; Luke 24:2).

DEFINITION: Means to obtain something due as payment or reward, or to recover possession of something that had been lost or given previously.
SENSES: 1. To receive what is due, reward, or consequence (Luke 16:25; Gal 4:5).
2. To receive back or recover something possessed (Luke 6:34; 15:27).

THAYER.pt: Significa obter algo devido como pagamento, recompensa ou recuperar a posse de algo que havia sido perdido ou entregue anteriormente. 1. Receber o que é devido, recompensa ou consequência (Lc 16.25; Gl 4.5). | 2. Receber de volta ou recuperar algo que se possuía (Lc 6.34; 15.27).
THAYER.en: Means to obtain something due as payment or reward, or to recover possession of something that had been lost or given previously. 1. To receive what is due, reward, or consequence (Luke 16:25; Gal 4:5). | 2. To receive back or recover something possessed (Luke 6:34; 15:27).

DEFINITION: Refers to the enjoyment of benefits, satisfactions, or joys that something provides.
SENSES: 1. The temporary pleasure provided by sin in contrast to eternal values (Heb 11:25).

THAYER.pt: Representa o desfrute dos benefícios, satisfações ou alegrias que algo proporciona. 1. O prazer temporário proporcionado pelo pecado em contraste com os valores eternos (Hb 11:25).
THAYER.en: Refers to the enjoyment of benefits, satisfactions, or joys that something provides. 1. The temporary pleasure provided by sin in contrast to eternal values (Heb 11:25).

DEFINITION: To leave something or someone behind when departing, or to cause something to remain reserved for the future.
SENSES: 1. To leave something behind in a location (2 Tim 4:13).
2. To be reserved or to remain for a future time (Heb 4:9).

THAYER.pt: Deixar algo ou alguém para trás ao partir, ou fazer com que permaneça reservado para o futuro. 1. Deixar algo para trás em um local (2Tm 4.13). | 2. Estar reservado ou restar para um momento futuro (Hb 4.9).
THAYER.en: To leave something or someone behind when departing, or to cause something to remain reserved for the future. 1. To leave something behind in a location (2 Tim 4:13). | 2. To be reserved or to remain for a future time (Heb 4:9).

DEFINITION: Describes the action of licking or passing the tongue over a surface to clean it or consume residues.
SENSES: 1. To lick wounds or food scraps, as the dogs did with Lazarus (Luke 16:21).

THAYER.pt: Descreve a ação de lamber ou passar a língua sobre uma superfície para limpá-la ou consumir resíduos. 1. Lamber feridas ou restos de comida, como faziam os cães com Lázaro (Lc 16.21).
THAYER.en: Describes the action of licking or passing the tongue over a surface to clean it or consume residues. 1. To lick wounds or food scraps, as the dogs did with Lazarus (Luke 16:21).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: ἀπολέσω, Aor: ἀπώλεσα, Perf: ἀπολώλεκα; Mid. Fut: ἀπολοῦμαι
DEFINITION: In the active voice, it means to ruin completely, kill, destroy, or misplace something one possessed. In the middle/passive voice, it expresses perishing, the terminal failure of life, or eschatological condemnation.
SENSES: 1. To destroy, exterminate, or bring to ruin (Matt 2:13; 10:28a; Rom 14:15).
2. To lose something of value or misplace (Matt 10:39, 42; Luke 15:4).
3. To perish, die, or be irrevocably ruined in eternity (John 3:16; 1 Cor 1:18; 2 Pet 3:9).

THAYER.pt: Na voz ativa, significa arruinar completamente, matar, destruir ou extraviar algo que se possuía. Na voz média/passiva, expressa a perdição, o fracasso terminal da vida ou a condenação escatológica. 1. Destruir, exterminar ou levar à ruína (Mt 2.13; 10.28a; Rm 14.15). | 2. Perder algo de valor ou extraviar (Mt 10.39, 42; Lc 15.4). | 3. Perecer, morrer ou estar irrevogavelmente arruinado na eternidade (Jo 3.16; 1Co 1.18; 2Pe 3.9).
THAYER.en: In the active voice, it means to ruin completely, kill, destroy, or misplace something one possessed. In the middle/passive voice, it expresses perishing, the terminal failure of life, or eschatological condemnation. 1. To destroy, exterminate, or bring to ruin (Matt 2:13; 10:28a; Rom 14:15). | 2. To lose something of value or misplace (Matt 10:39, 42; Luke 15:4). | 3. To perish, die, or be irrevocably ruined in eternity (John 3:16; 1 Cor 1:18; 2 Pet 3:9).

DEFINITION: A Greek proper name meaning 'The Destroyer', used to identify the angel of the abyss in Revelation.
SENSES: 1. The angel of the abyss, whose name in Greek is Apollyon and in Hebrew is Abaddon (Rev 9:11).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio grego que significa 'O Destruidor', utilizado para identificar o anjo do abismo no Apocalipse. 1. O anjo do abismo, cujo nome em grego é Apoliom e em hebraico Abadom (Ap 9.11).
THAYER.en: A Greek proper name meaning 'The Destroyer', used to identify the angel of the abyss in Revelation. 1. The angel of the abyss, whose name in Greek is Apollyon and in Hebrew is Abaddon (Rev 9:11).

DEFINITION: The name of an ancient city located in the Roman province of Macedonia.
SENSES: 1. Apollonia, a Macedonian city through which Paul passed on his missionary journey (Acts 17:1).

THAYER.pt: Nome de uma antiga cidade localizada na província romana da Macedônia. 1. Apolônia, cidade macedônica pela qual Paulo passou em sua viagem missionária (At 17.1).
THAYER.en: The name of an ancient city located in the Roman province of Macedonia. 1. Apollonia, a Macedonian city through which Paul passed on his missionary journey (Acts 17:1).

DEFINITION: The name of an Alexandrian Jew, eloquent and well-versed in the Scriptures, who played an important role in evangelism in Ephesus and Corinth.
SENSES: 1. The Christian evangelist and teacher Apollos (Acts 18:24; 1 Cor 1:12).

THAYER.pt: Nome de um judeu alexandrino, eloqüente e versado nas Escrituras, que desempenhou papel importante na evangelização em Éfeso e Corinto. 1. O evangelista e mestre cristão Apolo (At 18.24; 1Co 1.12).
THAYER.en: The name of an Alexandrian Jew, eloquent and well-versed in the Scriptures, who played an important role in evangelism in Ephesus and Corinth. 1. The Christian evangelist and teacher Apollos (Acts 18:24; 1 Cor 1:12).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Pres. deponent, Fut: ἀπολογήσομαι, Aor: ἀπελογησάμην
DEFINITION: Refers to the act of speaking in one's own defense against accusations or slander, presenting arguments to justify one's actions.
SENSES: 1. To make a verbal defense before authorities or opponents (Acts 26:1; Rom 2:15).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se ao ato de falar em sua própria defesa contra acusações ou calúnias, apresentando argumentos para justificar suas ações. 1. Fazer uma defesa verbal perante autoridades ou oponentes (At 26.1; Rm 2.15).
THAYER.en: Refers to the act of speaking in one's own defense against accusations or slander, presenting arguments to justify one's actions. 1. To make a verbal defense before authorities or opponents (Acts 26:1; Rom 2:15).

DEFINITION: A formal speech or act of defense in response to accusations or questions directed at someone.
SENSES: 1. A speech or argument in one's own defense against accusations (Acts 22:1).
2. The act of presenting a defense or justification (2 Tim 4:16).

THAYER.pt: Discurso ou ato formal de defesa em resposta a acusações ou questionamentos direcionados a alguém. 1. Um discurso ou argumento em defesa própria contra acusações (At 22.1). | 2. O ato de apresentar uma defesa ou justificativa (2Tm 4.16).
THAYER.en: A formal speech or act of defense in response to accusations or questions directed at someone. 1. A speech or argument in one's own defense against accusations (Acts 22:1). | 2. The act of presenting a defense or justification (2 Tim 4:16).

DEFINITION: To wash oneself or another completely, often used in a liturgical and spiritual context to denote moral purification.
SENSES: 1. The act of washing away sins in association with baptism and the invocation of the Lord's name (Acts 22:16).

THAYER.pt: Lavar completamente a si mesmo ou a outrem, frequentemente empregado em contexto litúrgico e espiritual para denotar purificação moral. 1. O ato de lavar os pecados em associação com o batismo e a invocação do nome do Senhor (At 22:16).
THAYER.en: To wash oneself or another completely, often used in a liturgical and spiritual context to denote moral purification. 1. The act of washing away sins in association with baptism and the invocation of the Lord's name (Acts 22:16).

DEFINITION: Describes the act of freeing someone through the payment of a ransom, especially applied in the New Testament to Christ's saving work on behalf of sinners.
SENSES: 1. Spiritual deliverance and forgiveness of sins through the blood of Christ (Rom 3:24; Eph 1:7).
2. The consummation of salvation and the final redemption of the body (Rom 8:23; Luke 21:28).

THAYER.pt: Descreve o ato de libertar alguém mediante o pagamento de um resgate, especialmente aplicado no Novo Testamento à obra salvífica de Cristo em favor dos pecadores. 1. Libertação espiritual e perdão dos pecados por meio do sangue de Cristo (Rm 3.24; Ef 1.7). | 2. A consumação da salvação e redenção final do corpo (Rm 8.23; Lc 21.28).
THAYER.en: Describes the act of freeing someone through the payment of a ransom, especially applied in the New Testament to Christ's saving work on behalf of sinners. 1. Spiritual deliverance and forgiveness of sins through the blood of Christ (Rom 3:24; Eph 1:7). | 2. The consummation of salvation and the final redemption of the body (Rom 8:23; Luke 21:28).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: ἀπολύσω, Aor: ἀπέλυσα, Aor. Pass: ἀπελύθην
DEFINITION: Means to release someone from prison, an obligation, a marital bond, or to grant permission to depart.
SENSES: 1. To release, set free, or absolve a prisoner (Matt 27:15; Luke 23:18).
2. To dismiss or send away a crowd or a person (Matt 14:15; Acts 15:33).
3. To dissolve the bond of marriage, to divorce (1 Cor 7:11).

THAYER.pt: Significa liberar alguém de uma prisão, obrigação, vínculo matrimonial ou conceder permissão para partir. 1. Soltar, libertar ou absolver um prisioneiro (Mt 27.15; Lc 23.18). | 2. Despedir ou mandar embora uma multidão ou pessoa (Mt 14.15; At 15.33). | 3. Dissolver o vínculo do matrimônio, divorciar-se (1Co 7.11).
THAYER.en: Means to release someone from prison, an obligation, a marital bond, or to grant permission to depart. 1. To release, set free, or absolve a prisoner (Matt 27:15; Luke 23:18). | 2. To dismiss or send away a crowd or a person (Matt 14:15; Acts 15:33). | 3. To dissolve the bond of marriage, to divorce (1 Cor 7:11).

DEFINITION: Means to clean or wipe something from a surface, often used in the sense of removing dust or residue.
SENSES: 1. To shake off or wipe the dust from one's feet as a testimony against a city (Luke 10:11).

THAYER.pt: Significa limpar ou enxugar algo de uma superfície, frequentemente usado no sentido de remover a poeira ou resíduos. 1. Sacudir ou limpar a poeira dos pés como testemunho contra uma cidade (Lc 10.11).
THAYER.en: Means to clean or wipe something from a surface, often used in the sense of removing dust or residue. 1. To shake off or wipe the dust from one's feet as a testimony against a city (Luke 10:11).

DEFINITION: Indicates the action of giving someone what is due, appropriate, or deserved by virtue of their position.
SENSES: 1. To grant the honor and consideration due to the wife as the weaker vessel (1 Pet 3:7).

THAYER.pt: Indica a ação de dar a alguém o que lhe é devido, apropriado ou merecido em virtude de sua posição. 1. Conceder honra e consideração devidas à esposa como vaso mais fraco (1Pe 3.7).
THAYER.en: Indicates the action of giving someone what is due, appropriate, or deserved by virtue of their position. 1. To grant the honor and consideration due to the wife as the weaker vessel (1 Pet 3:7).

DEFINITION: Means to wash a part of the body, especially the hands, often as a symbolic gesture of innocence.
SENSES: 1. To wash one's hands publicly to declare oneself innocent of guilt (Matt 27:24).

THAYER.pt: Significa lavar uma parte do corpo, especialmente as mãos, muitas vezes como gesto simbólico de inocência. 1. Lavar as mãos publicamente para declarar-se inocente de uma culpa (Mt 27.24).
THAYER.en: Means to wash a part of the body, especially the hands, often as a symbolic gesture of innocence. 1. To wash one's hands publicly to declare oneself innocent of guilt (Matt 27:24).

DEFINITION: Describes the physical action of falling or detaching from a specific point or location.
SENSES: 1. To fall from a point or surface, like scales that fell from Saul's eyes (Acts 9:18).

THAYER.pt: Descreve a ação física de cair ou desprender-se de um determinado ponto ou localidade. 1. Cair de um ponto ou superfície, como escamas que caíram dos olhos de Saulo (At 9.18).
THAYER.en: Describes the physical action of falling or detaching from a specific point or location. 1. To fall from a point or surface, like scales that fell from Saul's eyes (Acts 9:18).

DEFINITION: Means to cause someone to stray from the correct path, leading them into doctrinal or moral error.
SENSES: 1. The deviation promoted by false teachers to deceive the faithful (Mark 13:22).

THAYER.pt: Significa fazer alguém afastar-se do caminho correto, conduzindo-o ao erro doutrinário ou moral. 1. O desvio promovido por falsos mestres para enganar os fiéis (Mc 13:22).
THAYER.en: Means to cause someone to stray from the correct path, leading them into doctrinal or moral error. 1. The deviation promoted by false teachers to deceive the faithful (Mark 13:22).

SHORT_GLOSS: sail, set sail, depart by ship
DEFINITION: A nautical term indicating the action of weighing anchor and setting sail from a port or coast to begin a sea voyage.
SENSES: 1. To depart by sailing or to set sail from a port (Acts 13:4; Acts 14:26; Acts 20:15).
USAGE: sail, set sail, depart by ship

THAYER.pt: Termo náutico que indica a ação de levantar âncora e zarpar de um porto ou costa para iniciar uma viagem marítima. 1. Partir navegando ou zarpar de um porto (At 13.4; At 14.26; At 20.15).
THAYER.en: A nautical term indicating the action of weighing anchor and setting sail from a port or coast to begin a sea voyage. 1. To depart by sailing or to set sail from a port (Acts 13:4; Acts 14:26; Acts 20:15).

DEFINITION: To remove dirt or stains by means of water, washing a surface or object completely.
SENSES: 1. To wash completely, removing impurities (Luke 5:2 v.l.).

THAYER.pt: Remover sujeira ou manchas por meio de água, lavando completamente uma superfície ou objeto. 1. Lavar completamente, removendo impurezas (Lc 5.2 v.l.).
THAYER.en: To remove dirt or stains by means of water, washing a surface or object completely. 1. To wash completely, removing impurities (Luke 5:2 v.l.).

DEFINITION: To impede normal breathing by compression or suffocation, whether by strangling animals or stifling the growth of plants.
SENSES: 1. The choking of plants by thorns growing around them (Matt 13:7).
2. The drowning of animals in water (Luke 8:33).

THAYER.pt: Impedir a respiração normal por compressão ou sufocação, seja estrangulando animais ou abafando o crescimento de plantas. 1. O sufocamento de plantas pelos espinhos que crescem ao redor (Mt 13:7). | 2. O afogamento de animais na água (Lc 8:33).
THAYER.en: To impede normal breathing by compression or suffocation, whether by strangling animals or stifling the growth of plants. 1. The choking of plants by thorns growing around them (Matt 13:7). | 2. The drowning of animals in water (Luke 8:33).

SHORT_GLOSS: to be perplexed, to be in doubt
DEFINITION: To be in a state of mental confusion, uncertainty, or severe anxiety due to not knowing how to act or resolve a situation.
SENSES: 1. To be at a loss, perplexed, or in doubt (Mk 6:20; 2 Cor 4:8).
USAGE: to be perplexed, to be in doubt

THAYER.pt: Estar em um estado de confusão mental, incerteza ou grave ansiedade por não saber como agir ou resolver uma situação. 1. Estar sem saber o que fazer, perplexo ou em dúvida (Mc 6.20; 2Co 4.8).
THAYER.en: To be in a state of mental confusion, uncertainty, or severe anxiety due to not knowing how to act or resolve a situation. 1. To be at a loss, perplexed, or in doubt (Mk 6:20; 2 Cor 4:8).

DEFINITION: An emotional state of profound uncertainty, apprehension, or distress in the face of difficult situations or imminent dangers.
SENSES: 1. Extreme perplexity and distress among nations in the face of apocalyptic signs (Lk 21:25).

THAYER.pt: Estado emocional de profunda incerteza, apreensão ou angústia diante de situações difíceis ou perigos iminentes. 1. Perplexidade e angústia extrema entre as nações diante dos sinais apocalípticos (Lc 21.25).
THAYER.en: An emotional state of profound uncertainty, apprehension, or distress in the face of difficult situations or imminent dangers. 1. Extreme perplexity and distress among nations in the face of apocalyptic signs (Lk 21:25).

DEFINITION: To hurl or throw something away with force, discarding it.
SENSES: 1. To cast oneself or throw objects into the sea to lighten ships in danger (cf. Acts 27).

THAYER.pt: Significa arremessar ou lançar algo para longe com força, descartando-o. 1. Lançar-se ou atirar objetos ao mar para aliviar embarcações em perigo (cf. At 27).
THAYER.en: To hurl or throw something away with force, discarding it. 1. To cast oneself or throw objects into the sea to lighten ships in danger (cf. Acts 27).

SHORT_GLOSS: to deprive, to bereave, to orphan
DEFINITION: To deprive someone of their parents or protectors, causing emotional isolation and painful separation.
SENSES: 1. To be separated from someone like an orphan, describing longing and physical distance from a community (1 Thess 2:17).
USAGE: to deprive, to bereave, to orphan

THAYER.pt: Significa privar alguém de seus pais ou protetores, causando isolamento emocional e separação dolorosa. 1. Ser separado de alguém como um órfão, descrevendo a saudade e o afastamento físico de uma comunidade (1Ts 2.17).
THAYER.en: To deprive someone of their parents or protectors, causing emotional isolation and painful separation. 1. To be separated from someone like an orphan, describing longing and physical distance from a community (1 Thess 2:17).

DEFINITION: To prepare baggage, unload, or get belongings ready for a trip or move.
SENSES: 1. To pack baggage and prepare belongings for a journey (Acts 21:15).

THAYER.pt: Indica a ação de preparar a bagagem, descarregar ou aprontar os pertences para uma viagem ou mudança. 1. Arrumar a bagagem e preparar os pertences para uma jornada (At 21.15).
THAYER.en: To prepare baggage, unload, or get belongings ready for a trip or move. 1. To pack baggage and prepare belongings for a journey (Acts 21:15).

DEFINITION: Refers to the shadow cast by an object that blocks light, symbolizing transience or change.
SENSES: 1. A shifting shadow or transient projection, used metaphorically for the absolute constancy of God (Jas 1:17).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se à sombra projetada por um objeto que bloqueia a luz, simbolizando transitoriedade ou mudança. 1. Sombra mutável ou projeção passageira, usada metaforicamente para a constância absoluta de Deus (Tg 1.17).
THAYER.en: Refers to the shadow cast by an object that blocks light, symbolizing transience or change. 1. A shifting shadow or transient projection, used metaphorically for the absolute constancy of God (Jas 1:17).

SHORT_GLOSS: to pull away, to withdraw, to tear
DEFINITION: To pull something with force to separate it, or figuratively to draw people away from a group, truth, or loyalty.
SENSES: 1. To pull or tear something away with force, such as a sword from its sheath (Mt 26:51; Lk 22:41).
2. To draw disciples or followers away from sound doctrine (Acts 20:30).
3. To disengage or physically withdraw from someone (Acts 21:1).
USAGE: to pull away, to withdraw, to tear

THAYER.pt: Significa puxar algo com força para separá-lo, ou figuradamente afastar pessoas de um grupo, verdade ou lealdade. 1. Puxar ou arrancar algo com força, como uma espada da bainha (Mt 26.51; Lc 22.41). | 2. Afastar discípulos ou seguidores da sã doutrina (At 20.30). | 3. Desvencilhar-se ou afastar-se fisicamente de alguém (At 21.1).
THAYER.en: To pull something with force to separate it, or figuratively to draw people away from a group, truth, or loyalty. 1. To pull or tear something away with force, such as a sword from its sheath (Mt 26:51; Lk 22:41). | 2. To draw disciples or followers away from sound doctrine (Acts 20:30). | 3. To disengage or physically withdraw from someone (Acts 21:1).

DEFINITION: Describes the act of open rebellion against established authority or the deliberate abandonment of faith and truth.
SENSES: 1. The abandonment or subversion of traditional teachings (Acts 21:21).
2. The great eschatological rebellion or apostasy against God (2 Thess 2:3).

THAYER.pt: Descreve o ato de rebeldia aberta contra a autoridade estabelecida ou o abandono deliberado da fé e da verdade. 1. O abandono ou subversão dos ensinamentos tradicionais (At 21:21). | 2. A grande rebelião ou apostasia escatológica contra Deus (2Ts 2:3).
THAYER.en: Describes the act of open rebellion against established authority or the deliberate abandonment of faith and truth. 1. The abandonment or subversion of traditional teachings (Acts 21:21). | 2. The great eschatological rebellion or apostasy against God (2 Thess 2:3).

DEFINITION: A legal document formalizing the dissolution of a marriage, the certificate or act of divorce.
SENSES: 1. A certificate or legal document of divorce (Mt 5:31; 19:7; Mk 10:4).

THAYER.pt: Documento legal formalizando a dissolução de um casamento, a certidão ou ato de divórcio. 1. Certidão ou documento legal de divórcio (Mt 5.31; 19.7; Mc 10.4).
THAYER.en: A legal document formalizing the dissolution of a marriage, the certificate or act of divorce. 1. A certificate or legal document of divorce (Mt 5:31; 19:7; Mk 10:4).

SHORT_GLOSS: to unroof, to remove the roof
DEFINITION: To dismantle or remove the covering or roof of a building.
SENSES: 1. To remove the roof of a house to lower a paralytic before Jesus (Mk 2:4).
USAGE: to unroof, to remove the roof

THAYER.pt: Significa desmantelar ou remover a cobertura ou o telhado de uma edificação. 1. Remover o telhado de uma casa para descer um paralítico diante de Jesus (Mc 2.4).
THAYER.en: To dismantle or remove the covering or roof of a building. 1. To remove the roof of a house to lower a paralytic before Jesus (Mk 2:4).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: ἀποστελῶ, Aor: ἀπέστειλα, Perf: ἀπέσταλκα, Pass: ἀπέσταλμαι
SHORT_GLOSS: to send, to commission, to dispatch
DEFINITION: To dispatch or commission someone as an official emissary endowed with authority or a defined purpose; the term from which the theological root of apostle is derived.
SENSES: 1. To send someone with an official mission, mandate, or delegation of authority (Mt 10:5; Jn 20:21; 1 Jn 4:10).
2. To dispatch an order, instruction, message, or resource (Mt 2:16; Mk 6:17).
USAGE: to send, to commission, to dispatch

THAYER.pt: Despachar ou comissionar alguém como emissário oficial dotado de autoridade ou propósito definido, termo do qual deriva a raiz teológica de apóstolo. 1. Enviar alguém com uma missão oficial, mandato ou delegação de autoridade (Mt 10.5; Jo 20.21; 1Jo 4.10). | 2. Despachar uma ordem, instrução, mensagem ou recurso (Mt 2.16; Mc 6.17).
THAYER.en: To dispatch or commission someone as an official emissary endowed with authority or a defined purpose; the term from which the theological root of apostle is derived. 1. To send someone with an official mission, mandate, or delegation of authority (Mt 10:5; Jn 20:21; 1 Jn 4:10). | 2. To dispatch an order, instruction, message, or resource (Mt 2:16; Mk 6:17).

SHORT_GLOSS: to deprive, to defraud, to rob
DEFINITION: To cause loss to someone through fraud, unjust retention of goods, or illegitimate deprivation of something that belongs to them.
SENSES: 1. To deprive, defraud, or rob someone (1 Cor 6:8; Jas 5:4).
2. To deprive someone of a legitimate right or benefit (1 Cor 7:5).
USAGE: to deprive, to defraud, to rob

THAYER.pt: Causar prejuízo a alguém mediante fraude, retenção injusta de bens ou privação ilegítima de algo que lhe pertence. 1. Despojar, defraudar ou roubar alguém (1Co 6.8; Tg 5.4). | 2. Privar alguém de um direito ou benefício legítimo (1Co 7.5).
THAYER.en: To cause loss to someone through fraud, unjust retention of goods, or illegitimate deprivation of something that belongs to them. 1. To deprive, defraud, or rob someone (1 Cor 6:8; Jas 5:4). | 2. To deprive someone of a legitimate right or benefit (1 Cor 7:5).

DEFINITION: Designates the function, authority, or special commission conferred upon an emissary commissioned by Christ to preach the Gospel and lead the Church.
SENSES: 1. The office, function, or commission of an apostle (Acts 1:25; Rom 1:5; 1 Cor 9:2; Gal 2:8).

THAYER.pt: Designa a função, autoridade ou incumbência especial conferida a um emissário comissionado por Cristo para pregar o Evangelho e liderar a Igreja. 1. O ofício, função ou comissão de um apóstolo (At 1.25; Rm 1.5; 1Co 9.2; Gl 2.8).
THAYER.en: Designates the function, authority, or special commission conferred upon an emissary commissioned by Christ to preach the Gospel and lead the Church. 1. The office, function, or commission of an apostle (Acts 1:25; Rom 1:5; 1 Cor 9:2; Gal 2:8).

DEFINITION: A person commissioned and sent as an official representative invested with the authority of the one who dispatched them; technical term for the Twelve and other pioneer leaders of the Church.
SENSES: 1. Official messenger or emissary of a community (Jn 13:16; 2 Cor 8:23; Phil 2:25).
2. Apostle of Jesus Christ, endowed with a direct commission from the resurrected Lord (Mt 10:2; Gal 1:1; 1 Cor 9:1).
3. Christological title of Jesus as the supreme Envoy of the Father (Heb 3:1).

THAYER.pt: Pessoa comissionada e enviada como representante oficial investida da autoridade de quem a despachou; termo técnico para os doze e outros líderes pioneiros da Igreja. 1. Mensageiro oficial ou emissário de uma comunidade (Jo 13.16; 2Co 8.23; Fp 2.25). | 2. Apóstolo de Jesus Cristo, dotado de comissão direta do Senhor ressurreto (Mt 10.2; Gl 1.1; 1Co 9.1). | 3. Título cristológico de Jesus como o supremo Enviado do Pai (Hb 3.1).
THAYER.en: A person commissioned and sent as an official representative invested with the authority of the one who dispatched them; technical term for the Twelve and other pioneer leaders of the Church. 1. Official messenger or emissary of a community (Jn 13:16; 2 Cor 8:23; Phil 2:25). | 2. Apostle of Jesus Christ, endowed with a direct commission from the resurrected Lord (Mt 10:2; Gal 1:1; 1 Cor 9:1). | 3. Christological title of Jesus as the supreme Envoy of the Father (Heb 3:1).

DEFINITION: Describes the act of interrogating someone in an insistent and hostile manner to induce them to incriminate themselves.
SENSES: 1. To ask tricky and hostile questions with the intention of catching someone in a contradiction (Lk 11:53).

THAYER.pt: Descreve o ato de interrogar alguém de maneira insistente e hostil para induzi-lo a incriminar-se. 1. Fazer perguntas capciosas e hostis com a intenção de apanhá-lo em contradição (Lc 11.53).
THAYER.en: Describes the act of interrogating someone in an insistent and hostile manner to induce them to incriminate themselves. 1. To ask tricky and hostile questions with the intention of catching someone in a contradiction (Lk 11:53).

SEMANTIC_FIELD: Change of Direction, Rejection, and Return
SHORT_GLOSS: to turn away, to avert, to reject
DEFINITION: Indicates the action of making someone or something turn away from a direction, belief, or behavior, whether in the physical sense of averting the gaze or in the moral sense of rejection.
SENSES: 1. To physically turn away the gaze or attention (2 Tim 4:4).
2. To turn away from erroneous beliefs or to convert (Rom 11:26).
3. To reject or repudiate someone (2 Tim 1:15; Mt 5:42).
4. To return something to its place of origin (Mt 26:52).
USAGE: to turn away, to avert, to reject

THAYER.pt: Indica a ação de fazer alguém ou algo afastar-se de uma direção, crença ou comportamento, seja no sentido físico de desviar o olhar ou no sentido moral de rejeição. 1. Desviar fisicamente o olhar ou a atenção (2Tm 4.4). | 2. Afastar de crenças errôneas ou converter (Rm 11.26). | 3. Rejeitar ou repudiar alguém (2Tm 1.15; Mt 5.42). | 4. Devolver algo ao seu lugar de origem (Mt 26.52).
THAYER.en: Indicates the action of making someone or something turn away from a direction, belief, or behavior, whether in the physical sense of averting the gaze or in the moral sense of rejection. 1. To physically turn away the gaze or attention (2 Tim 4:4). | 2. To turn away from erroneous beliefs or to convert (Rom 11:26). | 3. To reject or repudiate someone (2 Tim 1:15; Mt 5:42). | 4. To return something to its place of origin (Mt 26:52).

SHORT_GLOSS: to hate, to abhor, to repel
DEFINITION: Expresses deep disgust, intense aversion, or moral repulsion toward evil.
SENSES: 1. To abhor evil intensely and cling firmly to what is good (Rom 12:9).
USAGE: to hate, to abhor, to repel

THAYER.pt: Expressa um desgosto profundo, aversão intensa ou repulsa moral em relação ao mal. 1. Abominar intensamente o mal e apegar-se firmemente ao que é bom (Rm 12.9).
THAYER.en: Expresses deep disgust, intense aversion, or moral repulsion toward evil. 1. To abhor evil intensely and cling firmly to what is good (Rom 12:9).

DEFINITION: The condition of someone who has been formally banned or excluded from the synagogue community.
SENSES: 1. Exclusion or excommunication from the Jewish community (Jn 9:22; 12:42; 16:2).

THAYER.pt: Condição de alguém que foi formalmente banido ou excluído da comunidade sinagogal. 1. Exclusão ou excomunhão da comunidade judaica (Jo 9.22; 12.42; 16.2).
THAYER.en: The condition of someone who has been formally banned or excluded from the synagogue community. 1. Exclusion or excommunication from the Jewish community (Jn 9:22; 12:42; 16:2).

DEFINITION: To formally express farewell upon departing or, by extension, to renounce and detach oneself from earthly possessions or ties.
SENSES: 1. To say goodbye or bid farewell to someone (Lk 9:61; Acts 18:18).
2. To renounce or voluntarily detach oneself from something (Lk 14:33).

THAYER.pt: Expressar formalmente a despedida ao partir ou, por extensão, renunciar e desapegar-se de posses ou laços terrenos. 1. Despedir-se ou dizer adeus a alguém (Lc 9.61; At 18.18). | 2. Renunciar ou desapegar-se voluntariamente de algo (Lc 14.33).
THAYER.en: To formally express farewell upon departing or, by extension, to renounce and detach oneself from earthly possessions or ties. 1. To say goodbye or bid farewell to someone (Lk 9:61; Acts 18:18). | 2. To renounce or voluntarily detach oneself from something (Lk 14:33).

SHORT_GLOSS: to complete, to finish, to fulfill
DEFINITION: To bring an activity or process to its complete realization, conclusion, or fulfillment.
SENSES: 1. To complete or consummate a work or the cycle of a process (Lk 13:32; Jas 1:15).
USAGE: to complete, to finish, to fulfill

THAYER.pt: Levar uma atividade ou processo à sua completa realização, conclusão ou cumprimento. 1. Completar ou consumar uma obra ou o ciclo de um processo (Lc 13:32; Tg 1:15).
THAYER.en: To bring an activity or process to its complete realization, conclusion, or fulfillment. 1. To complete or consummate a work or the cycle of a process (Lk 13:32; Jas 1:15).

SEMANTIC_FIELD: Removal, Physical Action, and Ethical Behavior
SHORT_GLOSS: to put off, lay aside, reject
DEFINITION: Literally means to put something aside or to take off a garment; used in the New Testament metaphorically for the abandonment of sinful practices.
SENSES: 1. To take off garments or to lay aside moral behaviors and sins (Rom 13:12; Col 3:8).
2. To store or keep for a specific purpose.
3. To physically remove and place elsewhere (Matt 14:3).
USAGE: to put off, lay aside, reject

THAYER.pt: Significa literalmente colocar algo de lado ou tirar uma vestimenta, sendo usado no Novo Testamento de forma metafórica para o abandono de práticas pecaminosas. 1. Despir vestes ou depor comportamentos e pecados morais (Rm 13.12; Cl 3.8). | 2. Guardar ou armazenar para um propósito específico. | 3. Remover fisicamente e colocar em outro lugar (Mt 14.3).
THAYER.en: Literally means to put something aside or to take off a garment; used in the New Testament metaphorically for the abandonment of sinful practices. 1. To take off garments or to lay aside moral behaviors and sins (Rom 13:12; Col 3:8). | 2. To store or keep for a specific purpose. | 3. To physically remove and place elsewhere (Matt 14:3).

DEFINITION: To shake vigorously in order to remove something that is stuck or adhering to a surface.
SENSES: 1. To shake off venomous animals from one's hands (Acts 28:5; Luke 9:5).

THAYER.pt: Agitar vigorosamente para remover algo que está preso ou aderido à superficíe. 1. Sacudir animais peçonhentos para longe das mãos (At 28:5; Lc 9:5).
THAYER.en: To shake vigorously in order to remove something that is stuck or adhering to a surface. 1. To shake off venomous animals from one's hands (Acts 28:5; Luke 9:5).

DEFINITION: A legal term denoting the payment of a debt, financial compensation, or repair of damages.
SENSES: 1. To pay a debt or make financial reparation for losses caused (Phlm 19).

THAYER.pt: Termo jurídico que denota o pagamento de uma dívida, compensação financeira ou reparação de danos. 1. Pagar uma dívida ou fazer reparação financeira por prejuízos causados (Fm 19).
THAYER.en: A legal term denoting the payment of a debt, financial compensation, or repair of damages. 1. To pay a debt or make financial reparation for losses caused (Phlm 19).

DEFINITION: Means to manifest great boldness, courage, or intrepidity in speaking or acting under difficult circumstances.
SENSES: 1. To have the boldness to speak courageously in God's name, even in the face of opposition (Rom 10:20).

THAYER.pt: Significa manifestar grande ousadia, coragem ou intrepidez ao falar ou agir em circunstâncias difíceis. 1. Ter a ousadia de falar corajosamente em nome de Deus, mesmo diante de oposição (Rm 10.20).
THAYER.en: Means to manifest great boldness, courage, or intrepidity in speaking or acting under difficult circumstances. 1. To have the boldness to speak courageously in God's name, even in the face of opposition (Rom 10:20).

DEFINITION: The quality of acting with extreme severity, uncompromising firmness, or moral rigor.
SENSES: 1. Divine severity and rigor in dealing with disobedience (Rom 11:22).

THAYER.pt: Qualidade de quem age com severidade extrema, firmeza intransigente ou rigor moral. 1. A severidade e o rigor divino no trato com a desobediência (Rm 11:22).
THAYER.en: The quality of acting with extreme severity, uncompromising firmness, or moral rigor. 1. Divine severity and rigor in dealing with disobedience (Rom 11:22).

DEFINITION: In a severe, energetic manner, or without concessions when dealing with faults and deviations.
SENSES: 1. To exhort or rebuke with firmness and severity (Tit 1:13; 2Cor 13:10).

THAYER.pt: De maneira severa, enérgica ou sem concessões ao lidar com faltas e desvios. 1. Exortar ou repreender com firmeza e severidade (Tt 1:13; 2Co 13:10).
THAYER.en: In a severe, energetic manner, or without concessions when dealing with faults and deviations. 1. To exhort or rebuke with firmness and severity (Tit 1:13; 2Cor 13:10).

DEFINITION: Indicates the action of deliberately turning away from someone or avoiding contact with corrupt behaviors.
SENSES: 1. To turn away from or avoid association with people of corrupt conduct (2Tim 3:5).

THAYER.pt: Indica a ação de afastar-se deliberadamente de alguém ou evitar o contato com comportamentos corruptos. 1. Desviar-se ou evitar a associação com pessoas de conduta corrupta (2Tm 3.5).
THAYER.en: Indicates the action of deliberately turning away from someone or avoiding contact with corrupt behaviors. 1. To turn away from or avoid association with people of corrupt conduct (2Tim 3:5).

DEFINITION: Describes the state or condition of not being present in a given place or time.
SENSES: 1. Someone's physical absence, in contrast to their presence (Phil 2:12).

THAYER.pt: Descreve o estado ou condição de não estar presente em determinado lugar ou momento. 1. A ausência física de alguém, em contraste com a sua presença (Fp 2.12).
THAYER.en: Describes the state or condition of not being present in a given place or time. 1. Someone's physical absence, in contrast to their presence (Phil 2:12).

DEFINITION: To transport or lead something or someone away from a point of origin toward another place.
SENSES: 1. To carry or bear away (Luke 16:22; Rev 17:3).
2. To lead or escort someone under custody (Mark 15:1).

THAYER.pt: Transportar ou conduzir algo ou alguém para longe de um ponto de origem em direção a outro lugar. 1. Levar ou carregar para longe (Lc 16.22; Ap 17.3). | 2. Conduzir ou escoltar alguém sob custódia (Mc 15.1).
THAYER.en: To transport or lead something or someone away from a point of origin toward another place. 1. To carry or bear away (Luke 16:22; Rev 17:3). | 2. To lead or escort someone under custody (Mark 15:1).

DEFINITION: To rid oneself of an imminent danger or avoid a harmful situation through flight or evasion.
SENSES: 1. To escape moral or physical dangers (2Pet 1:4; 2:18).

THAYER.pt: Livrar-se de um perigo iminente ou evitar uma situação nociva por meio da fuga ou esquiva. 1. Escapar de perigos morais ou físicos (2Pe 1.4; 2.18).
THAYER.en: To rid oneself of an imminent danger or avoid a harmful situation through flight or evasion. 1. To escape moral or physical dangers (2Pet 1:4; 2:18).

DEFINITION: To speak solemnly, to declare with clarity, force, or spiritual inspiration.
SENSES: 1. To utter inspired or solemn declarations (Acts 2:4, 14; 26:25).

THAYER.pt: Falar solenemente, declarar com clareza, força ou inspiração espiritual. 1. Pronunciar declarações inspiradas ou solenes (At 2.4, 14; 26.25).
THAYER.en: To speak solemnly, to declare with clarity, force, or spiritual inspiration. 1. To utter inspired or solemn declarations (Acts 2:4, 14; 26:25).

DEFINITION: Means to remove cargo or unload products transported by a boat or vehicle.
SENSES: 1. To unload a ship's cargo upon arriving at the port of destination (Acts 21:3).

THAYER.pt: Significa remover a carga ou descarregar os produtos transportados por uma embarcação ou veículo. 1. Descarregar a carga de um navio ao chegar ao porto de destino (At 21.3).
THAYER.en: Means to remove cargo or unload products transported by a boat or vehicle. 1. To unload a ship's cargo upon arriving at the port of destination (Acts 21:3).

DEFINITION: Refers to the act of consuming entirely or using something until its complete exhaustion.
SENSES: 1. The consumption or total use of perishable things that are destroyed by their very use (Col 2:22).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se ao ato de consumir integralmente ou usar algo até o seu completo esgotamento. 1. O consumo ou uso total de coisas perecíveis que se destroem com o próprio uso (Cl 2.22).
THAYER.en: Refers to the act of consuming entirely or using something until its complete exhaustion. 1. The consumption or total use of perishable things that are destroyed by their very use (Col 2:22).

DEFINITION: To move away from a point or place, withdrawing from someone's presence.
SENSES: 1. To physically withdraw or depart from a place or person (Matt 7:23; Acts 13:13).

THAYER.pt: Mudar-se para longe de um ponto ou lugar, retirando-se da presença de alguém. 1. Retirar-se ou afastar-se fisicamente de um local ou pessoa (Mt 7.23; At 13.13).
THAYER.en: To move away from a point or place, withdrawing from someone's presence. 1. To physically withdraw or depart from a place or person (Matt 7:23; Acts 13:13).

DEFINITION: To physically separate or remove something or someone from a previous companionship or union.
SENSES: 1. The physical separation between people or partners (Acts 15:39).

THAYER.pt: Separar ou afastar fisicamente algo ou alguém de uma companhia ou união prévia. 1. A separação física entre pessoas ou parceiros (At 15:39).
THAYER.en: To physically separate or remove something or someone from a previous companionship or union. 1. The physical separation between people or partners (Acts 15:39).

DEFINITION: Means to lose consciousness from terror or exhaustion, or literally to expire and die. In the New Testament, it describes men's dread in the face of eschatological events.
SENSES: 1. To lose one's senses or faint from fear (Luke 21:26).

THAYER.pt: Significa perder a consciência por terror ou exaustão, ou literalmente expirar e morrer. No Novo Testamento, descreve o pavor dos homens diante dos eventos escatológicos. 1. Perder os sentidos ou desmaiar de medo (Lc 21.26).
THAYER.en: Means to lose consciousness from terror or exhaustion, or literally to expire and die. In the New Testament, it describes men's dread in the face of eschatological events. 1. To lose one's senses or faint from fear (Luke 21:26).

DEFINITION: Masculine proper name associated with the geographical landmark known as 'Appii Forum' (Forum of Appius), a station on the Appian Way where Roman Christians came out to meet the apostle Paul.
SENSES: 1. Reference to Appius, a historical figure who gave his name to a locality on the route to Rome (Acts 28:15).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio masculino associado ao marco geográfico conhecido como 'Fórum de Ápio' (Appii Forum), uma estação na Via Ápia onde cristãos romanos saíram ao encontro do apóstolo Paulo. 1. Referência a Ápio, figura histórica que batizou uma localidade na rota para Roma (At 28.15).
THAYER.en: Masculine proper name associated with the geographical landmark known as 'Appii Forum' (Forum of Appius), a station on the Appian Way where Roman Christians came out to meet the apostle Paul. 1. Reference to Appius, a historical figure who gave his name to a locality on the route to Rome (Acts 28:15).

DEFINITION: Describes that which cannot be approached or reached. In the New Testament, it refers exclusively to the transcendent and inaccessible majesty of God.
SENSES: 1. Dwelling in unapproachable light, describing the glory of God (1Tim 6:16).

THAYER.pt: Descreve aquilo a que não se pode aproximar ou alcançar. No Novo Testamento, refere-se exclusivamente à majestade transcendente e inacessível de Deus. 1. Que habita em luz inacessível, descrevendo a glória de Deus (1Tm 6.16).
THAYER.en: Describes that which cannot be approached or reached. In the New Testament, it refers exclusively to the transcendent and inaccessible majesty of God. 1. Dwelling in unapproachable light, describing the glory of God (1Tim 6:16).

DEFINITION: That which does not cause a moral stumbling block to others and which lives in an unblameworthy and conscious manner.
SENSES: 1. To live without giving scandal or causing offense to others (Acts 24:16; Phil 1:10; 1Cor 10:32).

THAYER.pt: Que não causa tropeço moral aos outros e que vive de maneira inculpável e consciente. 1. Viver sem dar escândalo ou causar ofensa a outros (At 24.16; Fp 1.10; 1Co 10.32).
THAYER.en: That which does not cause a moral stumbling block to others and which lives in an unblameworthy and conscious manner. 1. To live without giving scandal or causing offense to others (Acts 24:16; Phil 1:10; 1Cor 10:32).

DEFINITION: Indicates an attitude or action performed without discrimination, favoritism, or human respect. Describes the impartiality with which God judges everyone.
SENSES: 1. To act or judge without showing partiality to persons (1Pet 1:17).

THAYER.pt: Indica uma atitude ou ação realizada sem discriminação, favoritismo ou respeito humano. Descreve a imparcialidade com que Deus julga a todos. 1. Agir ou julgar sem fazer acepção de pessoas (1Pe 1.17).
THAYER.en: Indicates an attitude or action performed without discrimination, favoritism, or human respect. Describes the impartiality with which God judges everyone. 1. To act or judge without showing partiality to persons (1Pet 1:17).

DEFINITION: Refers to the condition of being secure against moral or spiritual falls. Denotes divine preservation that keeps the believer from shipwrecking in the faith.
SENSES: 1. The one who is kept from stumbling or falling into sin (Jude 24).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se à condição de estar seguro contra quedas morais ou espirituais. Denota a preservação divina que impede o crente de naufragar na fé. 1. Aquele que é guardado de tropeçar ou cair no pecado (Jd 24).
THAYER.en: Refers to the condition of being secure against moral or spiritual falls. Denotes divine preservation that keeps the believer from shipwrecking in the faith. 1. The one who is kept from stumbling or falling into sin (Jude 24).

DEFINITION: To come into physical contact with something or someone, establishing a tactile connection or influence.
SENSES: 1. To physically touch someone or something, often seeking healing or fellowship (Matt 8:3; Mark 5:31).
2. To cause spiritual and moral damage or harm (1John 5:18).

THAYER.pt: Entrar em contato físico com algo ou alguém, estabelecendo uma conexão tátil ou influência. 1. Tocar fisicamente em alguém ou algo, muitas vezes buscando cura ou comunhão (Mt 8.3; Mc 5.31). | 2. Causar dano ou prejuízo espiritual e moral (1Jo 5.18).
THAYER.en: To come into physical contact with something or someone, establishing a tactile connection or influence. 1. To physically touch someone or something, often seeking healing or fellowship (Matt 8:3; Mark 5:31). | 2. To cause spiritual and moral damage or harm (1John 5:18).

DEFINITION: To cause combustion by lighting something, or to establish physical contact with an object or person.
SENSES: 1. To kindle or set on fire (Luke 8:16; Acts 28:2).
2. To touch or hold (Luke 7:39; John 20:17).
3. To cause harm or injure (1John 5:18).

THAYER.pt: Causar combustão acendendo algo, ou estabelecer contato físico com um objeto ou pessoa. 1. Acender ou incendiar (Lc 8.16; At 28.2). | 2. Tocar ou segurar (Lc 7.39; Jo 20.17). | 3. Causar dano ou ferir (1Jo 5.18).
THAYER.en: To cause combustion by lighting something, or to establish physical contact with an object or person. 1. To kindle or set on fire (Luke 8:16; Acts 28:2). | 2. To touch or hold (Luke 7:39; John 20:17). | 3. To cause harm or injure (1John 5:18).

DEFINITION: Feminine proper name of a Christian woman from the community of Colossae. She was probably Philemon's wife and a prominent member of the church that met in his house.
SENSES: 1. Name of a Christian woman greeted by Paul (Phlm 2).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio feminino de uma cristã da comunidade de Colossos. Provavelmente era esposa de Filemom e membro proeminente da igreja que se reunia na casa dele. 1. Nome de uma mulher cristã saudada por Paulo (Fm 2).
THAYER.en: Feminine proper name of a Christian woman from the community of Colossae. She was probably Philemon's wife and a prominent member of the church that met in his house. 1. Name of a Christian woman greeted by Paul (Phlm 2).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: ἀπ(ε)ώσομαι, Aor: ἀπ(ε)ωσάμην, Perf: ἀπῶσμαι
DEFINITION: Means to push away, reject, or repudiate someone, frequently with the connotation of a deliberate refusal of a message or authority.
SENSES: 1. To push or shove something physically (Acts 7:27).
2. To reject or repudiate spiritually or morally (Acts 13:46; Rom 11:1; 1Tim 1:19).

THAYER.pt: Significa empurrar para longe, rejeitar ou repudiar alguém, frequentemente com conotação de recusa deliberada de uma mensagem ou autoridade. 1. Afastar ou empurrar algo fisicamente (At 7:27). | 2. Rejeitar ou repudiar espiritualmente ou moralmente (At 13:46; Rm 11:1; 1Tm 1:19).
THAYER.en: Means to push away, reject, or repudiate someone, frequently with the connotation of a deliberate refusal of a message or authority. 1. To push or shove something physically (Acts 7:27). | 2. To reject or repudiate spiritually or morally (Acts 13:46; Rom 11:1; 1Tim 1:19).

DEFINITION: State or process of total ruin, waste, or eternal perdition, characterizing the absence of salvation.
SENSES: 1. Material waste or physical destruction of objects (Mark 14:4).
2. Spiritual perdition, ruin, and eternal condemnation in divine judgment (1Tim 6:9; 2Pet 3:16).

THAYER.pt: Estado ou processo de ruína total, desperdício ou perdição eterna, caracterizando a ausência de salvação. 1. Desperdício material ou destruição física de objetos (Mc 14.4). | 2. Perdição espiritual, ruína e condenação eterna no juízo divino (1Tm 6.9; 2Pe 3.16).
THAYER.en: State or process of total ruin, waste, or eternal perdition, characterizing the absence of salvation. 1. Material waste or physical destruction of objects (Mark 14:4). | 2. Spiritual perdition, ruin, and eternal condemnation in divine judgment (1Tim 6:9; 2Pet 3:16).

DEFINITION: Verbal expression of calamity or judgment pronounced upon someone. Can denote the content of a plague or condemnation.
SENSES: 1. Declaration of a curse or penalty (Rom 3:14).

THAYER.pt: Expressão verbal de calamidade ou juízo pronunciado sobre alguém. Pode denotar o conteúdo de uma praga ou condenação. 1. Declaração de maldição ou penalidade (Rm 3.14).
THAYER.en: Verbal expression of calamity or judgment pronounced upon someone. Can denote the content of a plague or condemnation. 1. Declaration of a curse or penalty (Rom 3:14).

DEFINITION: Particle that expresses a natural deduction or logical inference from the previous context. Can carry nuances of surprise, conclusive emphasis, or doubt in interrogative contexts.
SENSES: 1. Marker of logical inference: therefore, so, as a result of this (Rom 7:21; Rom 8:1; Gal 3:29).
2. In questions, emphasizes surprise or expectation of an answer: then who, after all? (Matt 18:1; Luke 8:25; Acts 12:18).

THAYER.pt: Partícula que expressa uma dedução natural ou inferência lógica a partir do contexto anterior. Pode carregar nuances de surpresa, ênfase conclusiva ou dúvida em contextos interrogativos. 1. Marcador de ilação lógica: portanto, logo, em decorrência disso (Rm 7.21; Rm 8.1; Gl 3.29). | 2. Em perguntas, enfatiza a surpresa ou expectativa de resposta: afinal, então quem? (Mt 18.1; Lc 8.25; At 12.18).
THAYER.en: Particle that expresses a natural deduction or logical inference from the previous context. Can carry nuances of surprise, conclusive emphasis, or doubt in interrogative contexts. 1. Marker of logical inference: therefore, so, as a result of this (Rom 7:21; Rom 8:1; Gal 3:29). | 2. In questions, emphasizes surprise or expectation of an answer: then who, after all? (Matt 18:1; Luke 8:25; Acts 12:18).

DEFINITION: Interrogative particle that introduces direct questions, frequently expressing surprise, doubt, impatience, or expectation on the part of the questioner.
SENSES: 1. Particle introducing a question with a tone of doubt or suspense (Luke 18:8; Gal 2:17).

THAYER.pt: Partícula interrogativa que introduz perguntas diretas, frequentemente expressando surpresa, dúvida, impaciência ou expectativa por parte de quem interroga. 1. Partícula que introduz uma pergunta com tom de dúvida ou suspense (Lc 18.8; Gl 2.17).
THAYER.en: Interrogative particle that introduces direct questions, frequently expressing surprise, doubt, impatience, or expectation on the part of the questioner. 1. Particle introducing a question with a tone of doubt or suspense (Luke 18:8; Gal 2:17).

DEFINITION: Geographical region extending to the east and south of Palestine, encompassing the Sinai Peninsula.
SENSES: 1. The region of Arabia where Paul withdrew after his conversion (Gal 1:17; 4:25).

THAYER.pt: Região geográfica que se estendia a leste e sul da Palestina, englobando a Península do Sinai. 1. A região da Arábia onde Paulo retirou-se após a sua conversão (Gl 1:17; 4:25).
THAYER.en: Geographical region extending to the east and south of Palestine, encompassing the Sinai Peninsula. 1. The region of Arabia where Paul withdrew after his conversion (Gal 1:17; 4:25).

DEFINITION: Proper name of a Hebrew patriarch cited in the human ancestry of Jesus Christ according to the genealogy in the Gospel of Matthew.
SENSES: 1. Aram, ancestor of Jesus in the lineage of David (Matt 1:3, 4; Luke 3:33).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio de um patriarca hebreu citado na ascendência humana de Jesus Cristo segundo a genealogia do Evangelho de Mateus. 1. Aram, ancestral de Jesus na linhagem de Davi (Mt 1.3, 4; Lc 3.33).
THAYER.en: Proper name of a Hebrew patriarch cited in the human ancestry of Jesus Christ according to the genealogy in the Gospel of Matthew. 1. Aram, ancestor of Jesus in the lineage of David (Matt 1:3, 4; Luke 3:33).

DEFINITION: Designates a native inhabitant of Arabia. In the New Testament, it appears in the list of those present in Jerusalem on the Day of Pentecost.
SENSES: 1. Native or inhabitant of the Arabian region (Acts 2:11).

THAYER.pt: Designa um habitante nativo da Arábia. No Novo Testamento, aparece na lista dos presentes em Jerusalém no Dia de Pentecostes. 1. Natural ou habitante da região arábica (At 2.11).
THAYER.en: Designates a native inhabitant of Arabia. In the New Testament, it appears in the list of those present in Jerusalem on the Day of Pentecost. 1. Native or inhabitant of the Arabian region (Acts 2:11).

DEFINITION: To stop functioning or remain inactive. In an eschatological context, it indicates that divine judgment is not idle or delayed, but actively operating.
SENSES: 1. To delay or not be inactive in fulfilling a decree (2Pe 2.3).

THAYER.pt: Parar de funcionar ou ficar inativo. No contexto escatológico, indica que o julgamento divino não está ocioso ou atrasado, mas operando ativamente. 1. Demorar ou não estar inativo no cumprimento de um decreto (2Pe 2.3).
THAYER.en: To stop functioning or remain inactive. In an eschatological context, it indicates that divine judgment is not idle or delayed, but actively operating. 1. To delay or not be inactive in fulfilling a decree (2Pe 2.3).

DEFINITION: Refers to the absence of work, productivity, or usefulness, and can describe both an unemployed person and empty words.
SENSES: 1. Unemployed, idle, or without work (Mt 20.3; 1Tm 5.13).
2. Useless, barren, or unproductive, producing no beneficial result (Mt 12.36; Jas 2.20).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se à ausência de trabalho, produtividade ou utilidade, podendo descrever tanto uma pessoa desocupada quanto palavras vazias. 1. Desocupado, ocioso ou sem trabalho (Mt 20.3; 1Tm 5.13). | 2. Inútil, estéril ou improdutivo, que não produz nenhum resultado benéfico (Mt 12.36; Tg 2.20).
THAYER.en: Refers to the absence of work, productivity, or usefulness, and can describe both an unemployed person and empty words. 1. Unemployed, idle, or without work (Mt 20.3; 1Tm 5.13). | 2. Useless, barren, or unproductive, producing no beneficial result (Mt 12.36; Jas 2.20).

DEFINITION: Made of the precious metal silver or constituted of this material.
SENSES: 1. Objects or utensils manufactured from silver (2Tm 2.20; Rev 9.20).

THAYER.pt: Feito do metal precioso prata ou constituído desse material. 1. Objetos ou utensílios fabricados de prata (2Tm 2.20; Ap 9.20).
THAYER.en: Made of the precious metal silver or constituted of this material. 1. Objects or utensils manufactured from silver (2Tm 2.20; Rev 9.20).

DEFINITION: Designates the precious metal silver and, by metonymic extension, coins minted in silver or money in general used in commercial transactions.
SENSES: 1. The precious metal silver (Ac 3.6; 1Pe 1.18).
2. Cash or specific coins, such as the silver coins paid to Judas (Mt 26.15; Ac 8.20).

THAYER.pt: Designa o metal precioso prata e, por extensão metonímica, moedas cunhadas em prata ou dinheiro em geral usado em transações comerciais. 1. O metal precioso prata (At 3.6; 1Pe 1.18). | 2. Dinheiro em espécie ou moedas específicas, como as moedas de prata pagas a Judas (Mt 26.15; At 8.20).
THAYER.en: Designates the precious metal silver and, by metonymic extension, coins minted in silver or money in general used in commercial transactions. 1. The precious metal silver (Ac 3.6; 1Pe 1.18). | 2. Cash or specific coins, such as the silver coins paid to Judas (Mt 26.15; Ac 8.20).

DEFINITION: An artisan specialized in working with silver, manufacturing decorative objects, fine utensils, or small religious shrines and idols.
SENSES: 1. A maker of silver artifacts, like Demetrius in Ephesus (Ac 19.24).

THAYER.pt: Artesão especializado em trabalhar com prata, fabricando objetos decorativos, utensílios finos ou pequenos santuários e ídolos religiosos. 1. Fabricante de artefatos de prata, como Demétrio em Éfeso (At 19.24).
THAYER.en: An artisan specialized in working with silver, manufacturing decorative objects, fine utensils, or small religious shrines and idols. 1. A maker of silver artifacts, like Demetrius in Ephesus (Ac 19.24).

DEFINITION: A white precious metal widely used in the ancient world as a store of value or converted into coins for commercial transactions.
SENSES: 1. Silver as a precious metal or raw material (Rev 18.12).
2. Money minted in silver, coins (Mt 10.9).

THAYER.pt: Metal precioso de cor branca, amplamente utilizado no mundo antigo como reserva de valor ou convertido em moedas para transações comerciais. 1. Prata como metal ou matéria-prima preciosa (Ap 18.12). | 2. Dinheiro cunhado em prata, moedas (Mt 10.9).
THAYER.en: A white precious metal widely used in the ancient world as a store of value or converted into coins for commercial transactions. 1. Silver as a precious metal or raw material (Rev 18.12). | 2. Money minted in silver, coins (Mt 10.9).

DEFINITION: Designates both the rocky hill in Athens and the supreme council or court of magistrates that met there to deliberate on philosophical, religious, and legal matters.
SENSES: 1. The hill of Ares in Athens (Ac 17.19).
2. The court or council that met on the Areopagus (Ac 17.22).

THAYER.pt: Designa tanto a colina rochosa em Atenas quanto o conselho supremo ou corte de magistrados que se reunia ali para deliberar sobre questões filosóficas, religiosas e legais. 1. A colina de Ares em Atenas (At 17.19). | 2. O tribunal ou conselho que se reunia no Areópago (At 17.22).
THAYER.en: Designates both the rocky hill in Athens and the supreme council or court of magistrates that met there to deliberate on philosophical, religious, and legal matters. 1. The hill of Ares in Athens (Ac 17.19). | 2. The court or council that met on the Areopagus (Ac 17.22).

DEFINITION: A member of the Areopagus, the supreme court and civic council of Athens that met on the hill of Ares.
SENSES: 1. A member of the council of the Areopagus (Ac 17.34).

THAYER.pt: Membro do Areópago, o tribunal supremo e conselho cívico de Atenas que se reunia na colina de Ares. 1. Integrante do conselho do Areópago (At 17.34).
THAYER.en: A member of the Areopagus, the supreme court and civic council of Athens that met on the hill of Ares. 1. A member of the council of the Areopagus (Ac 17.34).

DEFINITION: The action or disposition of seeking the satisfaction or approval of another. In a positive biblical usage, it refers to the effort to please God in every good work.
SENSES: 1. A sincere effort to please and satisfy the will of God (Col 1.10).

THAYER.pt: Ação ou disposição de buscar a satisfação ou aprovação de outrem. No uso bíblico positivo, refere-se ao esforço para agradar a Deus em toda boa obra. 1. Esforço sincero para agradar e satisfazer a vontade de Deus (Cl 1.10).
THAYER.en: The action or disposition of seeking the satisfaction or approval of another. In a positive biblical usage, it refers to the effort to please God in every good work. 1. A sincere effort to please and satisfy the will of God (Col 1.10).

DEFINITION: To cause satisfaction to someone or seek to obtain their approval and favor. In New Testament usage, it can describe both the legitimate pursuit of pleasing one's neighbor for edification and the improper attitude of trying to please men rather than God.
SENSES: 1. Seeking to please or gain the favor of people, sometimes with a connotation of flattery (Gal 1.10; 1Th 2.4).
2. Giving pleasure, satisfaction, or accommodating the needs of others (Ro 15.1; 1Co 10.33).

THAYER.pt: Significa causar satisfação a alguém ou buscar obter a sua aprovação e favor. No uso neotestamentário, pode descrever tanto a busca legítima por agradar ao próximo para edificação quanto a atitude imprópria de buscar agradar a homens em detrimento de Deus. 1. Buscar agradar ou obter o favor de pessoas, por vezes com conotação de bajulação (Gl 1.10; 1Ts 2.4). | 2. Dar prazer, satisfação ou acomodar-se às necessidades dos outros (Rm 15.1; 1Co 10.33).
THAYER.en: To cause satisfaction to someone or seek to obtain their approval and favor. In New Testament usage, it can describe both the legitimate pursuit of pleasing one's neighbor for edification and the improper attitude of trying to please men rather than God. 1. Seeking to please or gain the favor of people, sometimes with a connotation of flattery (Gal 1.10; 1Th 2.4). | 2. Giving pleasure, satisfaction, or accommodating the needs of others (Ro 15.1; 1Co 10.33).

DEFINITION: Refers to something or someone that is pleasing, that satisfies expectations, or that is appropriate and right before others.
SENSES: 1. That which pleases or brings satisfaction to someone (Jn 8.29; Ac 12.3).
2. What is considered proper, fair, or acceptable (Ac 6.2).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se a algo ou alguém que é agradável, que satisfaz as expectativas ou que é apropriado e correto diante de outros. 1. Aquilo que agrada ou traz satisfação a alguém (Jo 8.29; At 12.3). | 2. O que é considerado próprio, justo ou aceitável (At 6.2).
THAYER.en: Refers to something or someone that is pleasing, that satisfies expectations, or that is appropriate and right before others. 1. That which pleases or brings satisfaction to someone (Jn 8.29; Ac 12.3). | 2. What is considered proper, fair, or acceptable (Ac 6.2).

DEFINITION: A common royal name among the Nabatean monarchs of Arabia. Refers specifically to Aretas IV, whose ethnarch in Damascus tried to arrest the apostle Paul.
SENSES: 1. King of the Nabateans at the time of Paul's ministry (2Co 11.32).

THAYER.pt: Nome real comum entre os monarcas nabateus da Arábia. Refere-se especificamente a Aretas IV, cujo etnarca em Damasco tentou prender o apóstolo Paulo. 1. Rei dos nabateus na época do ministério paulino (2Co 11.32).
THAYER.en: A common royal name among the Nabatean monarchs of Arabia. Refers specifically to Aretas IV, whose ethnarch in Damascus tried to arrest the apostle Paul. 1. King of the Nabateans at the time of Paul's ministry (2Co 11.32).

DEFINITION: Quality of moral excellence and blameless character, which can also denote the glorious manifestation of divine power.
SENSES: 1. Moral excellence, virtue, and exemplary conduct (Php 4.8; 2Pe 1.5).
2. Extraordinary manifestation of divine power and glory (2Pe 1.3).

THAYER.pt: Qualidade de excelência moral e caráter irrepreensível, podendo também denotar a manifestação gloriosa do poder divino. 1. Excelência moral, virtude e conduta exemplar (Fp 4.8; 2Pe 1.5). | 2. Manifestação extraordinária do poder e glória divina (2Pe 1.3).
THAYER.en: Quality of moral excellence and blameless character, which can also denote the glorious manifestation of divine power. 1. Moral excellence, virtue, and exemplary conduct (Php 4.8; 2Pe 1.5). | 2. Extraordinary manifestation of divine power and glory (2Pe 1.3).

DEFINITION: A young sheep, commonly destined for slaughter or ritual sacrifice. In Jesus' teaching, it illustrates the vulnerability of disciples sent out into the world.
SENSES: 1. A lamb sent out in the midst of wolves (Lk 10.3).

THAYER.pt: Filhote de ovelha, comumente destinado ao abate ou sacrifício ritual. No ensino de Jesus, ilustra a vulnerabilidade dos discípulos enviados ao mundo. 1. Cordeiro enviado em meio a lobos (Lc 10.3).
THAYER.en: A young sheep, commonly destined for slaughter or ritual sacrifice. In Jesus' teaching, it illustrates the vulnerability of disciples sent out into the world. 1. A lamb sent out in the midst of wolves (Lk 10.3).

DEFINITION: To assign numbers to determine the exact quantity of items or people.
SENSES: 1. To count or enumerate elements (Mt 10.30; Rev 7.9).

THAYER.pt: Atribuir números para determinar a quantidade exata de itens ou pessoas. 1. Contar ou enumerar elementos (Mt 10.30; Ap 7.9).
THAYER.en: To assign numbers to determine the exact quantity of items or people. 1. To count or enumerate elements (Mt 10.30; Rev 7.9).

DEFINITION: Numerical sum or countable quantity of people or things in a group.
SENSES: 1. A specific cardinal number or counted quantity (Lk 22.3; Jn 6.10).
2. The numerical total of a group (Ac 6.7).

THAYER.pt: Soma numérica ou quantidade contável de pessoas ou coisas em um grupo. 1. Um número cardinal específico ou quantidade contada (Lc 22.3; Jo 6.10). | 2. O total numérico de um grupo (At 6.7).
THAYER.en: Numerical sum or countable quantity of people or things in a group. 1. A specific cardinal number or counted quantity (Lk 22.3; Jn 6.10). | 2. The numerical total of a group (Ac 6.7).

DEFINITION: Name of a city in Judea, mentioned in the Gospels as the hometown of Joseph, the disciple who buried the body of Jesus.
SENSES: 1. City of origin of Joseph of Arimathea (Mt 27.57).

THAYER.pt: Nome de uma cidade na Judeia, mencionada nos Evangelhos como a pátria de José, o discípulo que sepultou o corpo de Jesus. 1. Cidade de origem de José de Arimateia (Mt 27.57).
THAYER.en: Name of a city in Judea, mentioned in the Gospels as the hometown of Joseph, the disciple who buried the body of Jesus. 1. City of origin of Joseph of Arimathea (Mt 27.57).

DEFINITION: Name of a Macedonian Christian from Thessalonica who was a traveling companion and coworker of the apostle Paul.
SENSES: 1. Aristarchus, traveling companion of Paul originating from Thessalonica (Ac 27.2).

THAYER.pt: Nome de um cristão macedônio de Tessalônica que foi companheiro de viagens e colaborador do apóstolo Paulo. 1. Aristarco, companheiro de viagens de Paulo originário de Tessalônica (At 27.2).
THAYER.en: Name of a Macedonian Christian from Thessalonica who was a traveling companion and coworker of the apostle Paul. 1. Aristarchus, traveling companion of Paul originating from Thessalonica (Ac 27.2).

DEFINITION: To eat a main meal, either in the morning or at midday.
SENSES: 1. Morning meal or breakfast (Jn 21.12, 15).
2. To partake in a main meal or banquet (Lk 11.37).

THAYER.pt: Tomar uma refeição principal, seja pela manhã ou ao meio-dia. 1. Refeição matinal ou desjejum (Jo 21.12, 15). | 2. Participar de uma refeição principal ou banquete (Lc 11.37).
THAYER.en: To eat a main meal, either in the morning or at midday. 1. Morning meal or breakfast (Jn 21.12, 15). | 2. To partake in a main meal or banquet (Lk 11.37).

DEFINITION: Indicates the left side of the body or of a spatial reference point, as opposed to the right side.
SENSES: 1. The left side, whether in everyday directions or in geographical and metaphorical descriptions (Mt 6.3; 2Co 6.7).

THAYER.pt: Indica o lado esquerdo do corpo ou de um ponto de referência espacial, em oposição ao lado direito. 1. O lado esquerdo, seja em direções cotidianas ou em descrições geográficas e metafóricas (Mt 6.3; 2Co 6.7).
THAYER.en: Indicates the left side of the body or of a spatial reference point, as opposed to the right side. 1. The left side, whether in everyday directions or in geographical and metaphorical descriptions (Mt 6.3; 2Co 6.7).

DEFINITION: Masculine proper name of a Christian in whose house or family circle there were believers greeted by Paul in his epistle to the Romans.
SENSES: 1. Member of the Roman Christian community whose family members are greeted (Ro 16.10).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio masculino de um cristão em cuja casa ou círculo familiar havia crentes saudados por Paulo em sua epístola aos Romanos. 1. Membro da comunidade cristã romana cujos familiares são saudados (Rm 16.10).
THAYER.en: Masculine proper name of a Christian in whose house or family circle there were believers greeted by Paul in his epistle to the Romans. 1. Member of the Roman Christian community whose family members are greeted (Ro 16.10).

DEFINITION: The main meal of the day or the banquet offered to guests.
SENSES: 1. Banquet or large festive meal (Mt 22.4; Lk 14.12).

THAYER.pt: A refeição principal do dia ou o banquete oferecido aos convidados. 1. Banquete ou grande refeição festiva (Mt 22.4; Lc 14.12).
THAYER.en: The main meal of the day or the banquet offered to guests. 1. Banquet or large festive meal (Mt 22.4; Lk 14.12).

DEFINITION: That which reaches the necessary measure for a purpose, being sufficient or adequate.
SENSES: 1. Sufficient for the needs of a given moment (Mt 6.34; 10.25).

THAYER.pt: Que atinge a medida necessária para um propósito, sendo suficiente ou adequado. 1. Suficiente para as necessidades de determinado momento (Mt 6.34; 10.25).
THAYER.en: That which reaches the necessary measure for a purpose, being sufficient or adequate. 1. Sufficient for the needs of a given moment (Mt 6.34; 10.25).

DEFINITION: To be adequate or sufficient to supply a need, generating a state of satisfaction and contentment.
SENSES: 1. To be sufficient or adequate for a specific purpose (Mt 25.9; 2Co 12.9).
2. To be satisfied or content with what one has (Lk 3.14; Heb 13.5).

THAYER.pt: Ser adequado ou suficiente para suprir uma necessidade, gerando um estado de satisfação e contentamento. 1. Ser suficiente ou adequado para um propósito específico (Mt 25.9; 2Co 12.9). | 2. Estar satisfeito ou contente com o que se tem (Lc 3.14; Hb 13.5).
THAYER.en: To be adequate or sufficient to supply a need, generating a state of satisfaction and contentment. 1. To be sufficient or adequate for a specific purpose (Mt 25.9; 2Co 12.9). | 2. To be satisfied or content with what one has (Lk 3.14; Heb 13.5).

DEFINITION: Large mammalian animal, known for its strength and ferocity. Used in Revelation in symbolisms of oppressive empires.
SENSES: 1. Ferocious beast symbolizing persecuting empires (Rev 13.2).

THAYER.pt: Animal mamífero de grande porte, conhecido por sua força e ferocidade. Utilizado no Apocalipse em simbolismos de impérios opressores. 1. Besta feroz que simboliza impérios persecutórios (Ap 13.2).
THAYER.en: Large mammalian animal, known for its strength and ferocity. Used in Revelation in symbolisms of oppressive empires. 1. Ferocious beast symbolizing persecuting empires (Rev 13.2).

DEFINITION: A two- or four-wheeled vehicle pulled by horses, used in antiquity both for travel and military combat.
SENSES: 1. Travel carriage used by officials (Ac 8.28).
2. War chariot in symbolic or apocalyptic contexts (Rev 9.9).

THAYER.pt: Veículo de duas ou quatro rodas puxado por cavalos, utilizado na antiguidade tanto para viagens quanto para combates militares. 1. Carruagem de viagem utilizada por oficiais (At 8.28). | 2. Carro de guerra em contextos simbólicos ou apocalípticos (Ap 9.9).
THAYER.en: A two- or four-wheeled vehicle pulled by horses, used in antiquity both for travel and military combat. 1. Travel carriage used by officials (Ac 8.28). | 2. War chariot in symbolic or apocalyptic contexts (Rev 9.9).

DEFINITION: Symbolic and eschatological designation for the place where the forces of evil will gather for the final confrontation against the Lamb and His kingdom.
SENSES: 1. Symbolic location of the final eschatological battle (Rev 16.16).

THAYER.pt: Designação simbólica e escatológica para o local onde se concentrarão as forças do mal para o confronto final contra o Cordeiro e Seu reino. 1. Local simbólico da batalha final escatológica (Ap 16.16).
THAYER.en: Symbolic and eschatological designation for the place where the forces of evil will gather for the final confrontation against the Lamb and His kingdom. 1. Symbolic location of the final eschatological battle (Rev 16.16).

DEFINITION: To adjust parts to form a harmonious whole, or, in a relational sense, to promise in marriage and betroth someone.
SENSES: 1. To present or betroth a bride to a husband (2Co 11.2).

THAYER.pt: Ajustar partes para formar um todo harmonioso, ou, no sentido relacional, prometer em casamento e desposar alguém. 1. Apresentar ou desposar uma noiva a um esposo (2Co 11.2).
