THAYER.en: To adjust parts to form a harmonious whole, or, in a relational sense, to promise in marriage and betroth someone. 1. To present or betroth a bride to a husband (2Co 11.2).

DEFINITION: Point of union between bones or limbs of the human body. In New Testament literature, it serves as a metaphor for the internal structure and connection of the Word of God with the soul.
SENSES: 1. Articulation or joint of the human body (Heb 4.12).

THAYER.pt: Ponto de união entre ossos ou membros do corpo humano. Na literatura neotestamentária, serve como metáfora para a estrutura interna e conexão da Palavra de Deus com a alma. 1. Articulação ou junta do corpo humano (Hb 4.12).
THAYER.en: Point of union between bones or limbs of the human body. In New Testament literature, it serves as a metaphor for the internal structure and connection of the Word of God with the soul. 1. Articulation or joint of the human body (Heb 4.12).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: ἀρνήσομαι, Aor: ἠρνησάμην, Perf: ἤρνημαι
DEFINITION: To refuse consent, assert that something is not true, or publicly disassociate oneself from a person or cause.
SENSES: 1. To refuse or disdain something (Heb 11.24).
2. To deny the truth of a fact or statement (1Jn 2.22).
3. To repudiate or dishonor a person, authority, or the Christian faith (Mt 10.33; Tit 1.16).

THAYER.pt: Recusar consentimento, afirmar que algo não é verdade, ou desassociar-se publicamente de uma pessoa ou causa. 1. Recusar ou desdenhar algo (Hb 11.24). | 2. Negar a veracidade de um fato ou afirmação (1Jo 2.22). | 3. Repudiar ou desonrar uma pessoa, autoridade ou a fé cristã (Mt 10.33; Tt 1.16).
THAYER.en: To refuse consent, assert that something is not true, or publicly disassociate oneself from a person or cause. 1. To refuse or disdain something (Heb 11.24). | 2. To deny the truth of a fact or statement (1Jn 2.22). | 3. To repudiate or dishonor a person, authority, or the Christian faith (Mt 10.33; Tit 1.16).

DEFINITION: A lamb or young sheep, frequently employed in the New Testament as a symbol of innocence, sacrifice, and a messianic title for Christ.
SENSES: 1. A literal young sheep or lamb (Jn 21:15).
2. Christological title applied to Christ as the sacrificial Lamb of God (Rev 5:6; 13:8).

THAYER.pt: Um cordeiro ou ovelha jovem, frequentemente empregado no Novo Testamento como símbolo de inocência, sacrifício e título messiânico para Cristo. 1. Uma ovelha jovem ou cordeiro literal (Jo 21.15). | 2. Título cristológico aplicado a Cristo como o Cordeiro sacrificial de Deus (Ap 5.6; 13.8).
THAYER.en: A lamb or young sheep, frequently employed in the New Testament as a symbol of innocence, sacrifice, and a messianic title for Christ. 1. A literal young sheep or lamb (Jn 21:15). | 2. Christological title applied to Christ as the sacrificial Lamb of God (Rev 5:6; 13:8).

DEFINITION: To prepare the earth for planting by cutting furrows with a plow.
SENSES: 1. The agricultural work of plowing the soil (Lk 17:7; 1Cor 9:10).

THAYER.pt: Preparar a terra para o plantio abrindo sulcos com o arado. 1. O trabalho agrícola de arar o solo (Lc 17.7; 1Co 9.10).
THAYER.en: To prepare the earth for planting by cutting furrows with a plow. 1. The agricultural work of plowing the soil (Lk 17:7; 1Cor 9:10).

DEFINITION: Traditional agricultural tool pulled by animals to furrow and prepare the land for planting. Used by Jesus in parables about discipleship.
SENSES: 1. Agricultural tool used to plow the earth (Lk 9:62).

THAYER.pt: Instrumento agrícola tradicional tracionado por animais para sulcar e preparar a terra para o plantio. Usado por Jesus em parábolas sobre o discipulado. 1. Ferramenta agrícola usada para arar a terra (Lc 9.62).
THAYER.en: Traditional agricultural tool pulled by animals to furrow and prepare the land for planting. Used by Jesus in parables about discipleship. 1. Agricultural tool used to plow the earth (Lk 9:62).

DEFINITION: Describes the act of seizing or looting by force, which can refer both to goods obtained by violence and to the inner attitude of greed that motivates such action.
SENSES: 1. Act of stealing or despoiling another's goods (Heb 10:34).
2. The product of plunder or rapine (Mt 23:25).
3. Inner disposition marked by greed and extortion (Lk 11:39).

THAYER.pt: Descreve o ato de arrebatar ou saquear à força, podendo referir-se tanto aos bens obtidos por violência quanto à atitude interna de ganância que motiva tal ação. 1. Ato de roubar ou espoliar bens alheios (Hb 10.34). | 2. O produto de um saque ou rapina (Mt 23.25). | 3. Disposição interior marcada pela ganância e extorsão (Lc 11.39).
THAYER.en: Describes the act of seizing or looting by force, which can refer both to goods obtained by violence and to the inner attitude of greed that motivates such action. 1. Act of stealing or despoiling another's goods (Heb 10:34). | 2. The product of plunder or rapine (Mt 23:25). | 3. Inner disposition marked by greed and extortion (Lk 11:39).

DEFINITION: That which is taken by force or a precious good that one must zealously retain. In the famous text of Philippians, it describes equality with God which Christ did not consider as a selfish advantage to be grasped.
SENSES: 1. Prize or privilege to be zealously retained (Phil 2:6).

THAYER.pt: Aquilo que é tomado por força ou um bem precioso que se deve reter zelosamente. No célebre texto de Filipenses, descreve a igualdade com Deus que Cristo não considerou como vantagem egoísta a ser agarrada. 1. Prêmio ou privilégio a ser retido zelosamente (Fp 2.6).
THAYER.en: That which is taken by force or a precious good that one must zealously retain. In the famous text of Philippians, it describes equality with God which Christ did not consider as a selfish advantage to be grasped. 1. Prize or privilege to be zealously retained (Phil 2:6).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: ἁρπάσω, Aor: ἥρπασα, Pass: ἡρπάσθην
SHORT_GLOSS: to snatch, steal, seize by force
DEFINITION: Indicates the action of taking something or someone suddenly, energetically, or violently, whether for purposes of theft, rescue, or sudden transfer.
SENSES: 1. To steal or carry something away by force or sudden attack (Mt 12:29).
2. To snatch or remove someone with power and speed, including spiritual rapture (Jn 10:28; 1Th 4:17).
USAGE: to snatch, steal, seize by force

THAYER.pt: Indica a ação de tomar algo ou alguém de forma súbita, enérgica ou violenta, seja com propósitos de roubo, salvamento ou transferência repentina. 1. Roubar ou carregar algo embora pela força ou ataque súbito (Mt 12.29). | 2. Arrebatar ou remover alguém com poder e rapidez, incluindo o arrebatamento espiritual (Jo 10.28; 1Ts 4.17).
THAYER.en: Indicates the action of taking something or someone suddenly, energetically, or violently, whether for purposes of theft, rescue, or sudden transfer. 1. To steal or carry something away by force or sudden attack (Mt 12:29). | 2. To snatch or remove someone with power and speed, including spiritual rapture (Jn 10:28; 1Th 4:17).

DEFINITION: One who appropriates another's goods through violence, extortion, or destructive greed, acting dishonestly.
SENSES: 1. Animal or false prophet of a violent and voracious nature (Mt 7:15).
2. Person who steals, exploits, or extorts others (Lk 18:11).

THAYER.pt: Que se apropria de bens alheios por meio de violência, extorsão ou ganância destrutiva, agindo de forma desonesta. 1. Animal ou falso profeta de índole violenta e voraz (Mt 7.15). | 2. Pessoa que rouba, explora ou extorque os outros (Lc 18.11).
THAYER.en: One who appropriates another's goods through violence, extortion, or destructive greed, acting dishonestly. 1. Animal or false prophet of a violent and voracious nature (Mt 7:15). | 2. Person who steals, exploits, or extorts others (Lk 18:11).

DEFINITION: Represents the initial upfront payment or token that serves as a legal guarantee and commitment to the completion of an agreement or transaction.
SENSES: 1. Down payment or guarantee that ensures the fulfillment of a promise or contract, used figuratively for the Holy Spirit (2Cor 1:22; Eph 1:14).

THAYER.pt: Representa o pagamento inicial adiantado ou sinal que serve como garantia legal e compromisso da conclusão de um acordo ou transação. 1. Pagamento de sinal ou garantia que assegura o cumprimento de uma promessa ou contrato, usado figuradamente para o Espírito Santo (2Co 1.22; Ef 1.14).
THAYER.en: Represents the initial upfront payment or token that serves as a legal guarantee and commitment to the completion of an agreement or transaction. 1. Down payment or guarantee that ensures the fulfillment of a promise or contract, used figuratively for the Holy Spirit (2Cor 1:22; Eph 1:14).

DEFINITION: Describes a garment made entirely in a single piece, without seams or joins.
SENSES: 1. Woven tunic of high value without any seams (Jn 19:23).

THAYER.pt: Descreve uma peça de vestuário confeccionada inteiramente em uma única peça, sem costuras ou emendas. 1. Túnica tecida de alto valor sem nenhuma costura (Jo 19.23).
THAYER.en: Describes a garment made entirely in a single piece, without seams or joins. 1. Woven tunic of high value without any seams (Jn 19:23).

DEFINITION: Biological term designating the male sex in humans or animals.
SENSES: 1. The male gender of any living creature (Mt 19:4; Rom 1:27).
2. The firstborn male child.

THAYER.pt: Termo biológico que designa o sexo masculino em seres humanos ou animais. 1. O gênero masculino de qualquer criatura viva (Mt 19.4; Rm 1.27). | 2. O filho primogênito do sexo masculino.
THAYER.en: Biological term designating the male sex in humans or animals. 1. The male gender of any living creature (Mt 19:4; Rom 1:27). | 2. The firstborn male child.

DEFINITION: Refers to sublime or sacred realities that are beyond human expression or cannot be verbalized.
SENSES: 1. Unspeakable heavenly words heard by Paul in a vision (2Cor 12:4).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se a realidades sublimes ou sagradas que estão além da capacidade de expressão humana ou que não podem ser verbalizadas. 1. Palavras celestiais indizíveis ouvidas por Paulo em visão (2Co 12.4).
THAYER.en: Refers to sublime or sacred realities that are beyond human expression or cannot be verbalized. 1. Unspeakable heavenly words heard by Paul in a vision (2Cor 12:4).

DEFINITION: Literally without strength, describing a condition of physical weakness resulting from illness or disease.
SENSES: 1. Person physically debilitated by illness or disease (Mt 14:14; 1Cor 11:30).

THAYER.pt: Literalmente sem força, descrevendo uma condição de fraqueza física decorrente de enfermidade ou doença. 1. Pessoa fisicamente debilitada por doença ou enfermidade (Mt 14.14; 1Co 11.30).
THAYER.en: Literally without strength, describing a condition of physical weakness resulting from illness or disease. 1. Person physically debilitated by illness or disease (Mt 14:14; 1Cor 11:30).

DEFINITION: Term designating a man who practices sexual relations with another man, contrary to biblical moral order.
SENSES: 1. Man who commits homosexual acts (1Cor 6:9; 1Tim 1:10).

THAYER.pt: Termo que designa um homem que pratica relações sexuais com outro homem, em desacordo com a ordem moral bíblica. 1. Homem que comete atos homossexuais (1Co 6:9; 1Tm 1:10).
THAYER.en: Term designating a man who practices sexual relations with another man, contrary to biblical moral order. 1. Man who commits homosexual acts (1Cor 6:9; 1Tim 1:10).

DEFINITION: Masculine proper name of a Christian associated with the apostle Paul, mentioned in the pastoral epistles as someone sent to assist Titus.
SENSES: 1. Disciple and coworker of Paul (Tit 3:12).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio masculino de um cristão associado ao apóstolo Paulo, mencionado nas epístolas pastorais como alguém enviado para auxiliar Tito. 1. Discípulo e colaborador de Paulo (Tt 3.12).
THAYER.en: Masculine proper name of a Christian associated with the apostle Paul, mentioned in the pastoral epistles as someone sent to assist Titus. 1. Disciple and coworker of Paul (Tit 3:12).

DEFINITION: Greek goddess of fertility and the hunt, whose worship was widespread in Asia Minor and centered in Ephesus.
SENSES: 1. Artemis (or Diana in Roman tradition), goddess worshipped in Ephesus (Acts 19:24).

THAYER.pt: Deusa grega da fertilidade e da caça, cujo culto era amplamente difundido na Ásia Menor e centralizado em Éfeso. 1. Ártemis (ou Diana na tradição romana), deusa cultuada em Éfeso (At 19.24).
THAYER.en: Greek goddess of fertility and the hunt, whose worship was widespread in Asia Minor and centered in Ephesus. 1. Artemis (or Diana in Roman tradition), goddess worshipped in Ephesus (Acts 19:24).

DEFINITION: Foresail or mainsail used in ancient vessels to assist in maneuvering and propelling the ship during storms.
SENSES: 1. Sail hoisted to guide the ship in difficult maneuvers (Acts 27:40).

THAYER.pt: Vela de proa ou mestra utilizada em embarcações antigas para auxiliar na manobra e propulsão do navio durante tempestades. 1. Vela içada para guiar o navio em manobras difíceis (At 27.40).
THAYER.en: Foresail or mainsail used in ancient vessels to assist in maneuvering and propelling the ship during storms. 1. Sail hoisted to guide the ship in difficult maneuvers (Acts 27:40).

DEFINITION: Temporal adverb pointing to the immediate or present moment in a striking way.
SENSES: 1. Referring to the immediate past, exactly now, briefly (Mt 9:18; Rev 12:10).
2. At the present moment, right now (Mt 3:15; Jn 13:37).

THAYER.pt: Advérbio temporal que aponta para o momento imediato ou presente de forma marcante. 1. Referindo-se ao passado imediato, exatamente agora, por pouco tempo (Mt 9.18; Ap 12.10). | 2. No momento presente, agora mesmo (Mt 3.15; Jo 13.37).
THAYER.en: Temporal adverb pointing to the immediate or present moment in a striking way. 1. Referring to the immediate past, exactly now, briefly (Mt 9:18; Rev 12:10). | 2. At the present moment, right now (Mt 3:15; Jn 13:37).

DEFINITION: Describes something or someone born recently. In the New Testament, it is used metaphorically to exhort believers to desire pure spiritual milk.
SENSES: 1. Newborn, that has just been born (1Pet 2:2).

THAYER.pt: Descreve algo ou alguém que nasceu recentemente. No Novo Testamento, é usado metaforicamente para exortar os crentes a desejarem o leite espiritual puro. 1. Recém-nascido, que acabou de nascer (1Pe 2.2).
THAYER.en: Describes something or someone born recently. In the New Testament, it is used metaphorically to exhort believers to desire pure spiritual milk. 1. Newborn, that has just been born (1Pet 2:2).

DEFINITION: Refers to someone or something that is fully qualified and prepared to fulfill a function or requirement. Denotes completeness and sufficiency for a purpose.
SENSES: 1. Perfect, fit, and fully qualified for every good work (2Tim 3:17).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se a alguém ou algo que está plenamente qualificado e preparado para cumprir uma função ou exigência. Denota completude e suficiência para um propósito. 1. Perfeito, apto e plenamente qualificado para toda boa obra (2Tm 3.17).
THAYER.en: Refers to someone or something that is fully qualified and prepared to fulfill a function or requirement. Denotes completeness and sufficiency for a purpose. 1. Perfect, fit, and fully qualified for every good work (2Tim 3:17).

DEFINITION: Refers to baked bread, the staple food of the diet in the biblical world, frequently presented in round portions. In a broader sense, it designates food in general, daily sustenance, and, theologically, points to Christ as the bread of life and the elements of the Lord's Supper.
SENSES: 1. Bread in individual or basic baked portions (Mt 4:4; Mk 6:38).
2. Food or sustenance in general (Lk 15:17; 2Th 3:12).
3. Cultic and sacramental sense: the showbread and the Eucharistic bread (Mt 12:4; 1Cor 11:23-26; Jn 6:35).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se ao pão assado, alimento básico da dieta no mundo bíblico, frequentemente apresentado em porções redondas. Em sentido ampliado, designa o alimento em geral, o sustento diário e, teologicamente, aponta para Cristo como o pão da vida e os elementos da Ceia do Senhor. 1. Pão em porção individual ou assado básico (Mt 4.4; Mc 6.38). | 2. Alimento ou sustento em geral (Lc 15.17; 2Ts 3.12). | 3. Sentido cultual e sacramental: os pães da proposição e o pão eucarístico (Mt 12.4; 1Co 11.23-26; Jo 6.35).
THAYER.en: Refers to baked bread, the staple food of the diet in the biblical world, frequently presented in round portions. In a broader sense, it designates food in general, daily sustenance, and, theologically, points to Christ as the bread of life and the elements of the Lord's Supper. 1. Bread in individual or basic baked portions (Mt 4:4; Mk 6:38). | 2. Food or sustenance in general (Lk 15:17; 2Th 3:12). | 3. Cultic and sacramental sense: the showbread and the Eucharistic bread (Mt 12:4; 1Cor 11:23-26; Jn 6:35).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: ἀρτύσω, Pass. Aor: ἠρτύθην, Perf: ἤρτυμαι
DEFINITION: Means adding condiments or spices to flavor food, making it fit for consumption.
SENSES: 1. To add spices or seasonings to food (Mk 9:50).

THAYER.pt: Significa adicionar condimentos ou especiarias para conferir sabor a alimentos, tornando-os próprios para o consumo. 1. Adicionar temperos ou condimentos à comida (Mc 9.50).
THAYER.en: Means adding condiments or spices to flavor food, making it fit for consumption. 1. To add spices or seasonings to food (Mk 9:50).

DEFINITION: Masculine proper name of one of the patriarchs in the ancestral lineage of Jesus Christ, descendant of Shem.
SENSES: 1. Arphaxad, son of Shem and ancestor of Jesus (Lk 3:36).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio masculino de um dos patriarcas na linhagem ancestral de Jesus Cristo, descendente de Sem. 1. Arfaxade, filho de Sem e ancestral de Jesus (Lc 3.36).
THAYER.en: Masculine proper name of one of the patriarchs in the ancestral lineage of Jesus Christ, descendant of Shem. 1. Arphaxad, son of Shem and ancestor of Jesus (Lk 3:36).

DEFINITION: An angel of preeminent position or chief within the celestial hierarchy.
SENSES: 1. The chief among the heavenly angels (Jude 9; 1Th 4:16).

THAYER.pt: Um anjo de posição preeminente ou chefe dentro da hierarquia celestial. 1. O principal entre os anjos celestiais (Jd 9; 1Ts 4:16).
THAYER.en: An angel of preeminent position or chief within the celestial hierarchy. 1. The chief among the heavenly angels (Jude 9; 1Th 4:16).

DEFINITION: That which exists from remote times or belongs to a previous period of history, contrasting with what is new.
SENSES: 1. Existing from the beginning or for a long time (Acts 21:16; Rev 12:9).
2. Belonging to past eras or the former state of life (2Cor 5:17; 2Pet 2:5).

THAYER.pt: Aquilo que existe desde tempos remotos ou que pertence a um período anterior da história, contrapondo-se ao que é novo. 1. Que existe desde o princípio ou por um longo tempo (At 21.16; Ap 12.9). | 2. Pertencente a eras passadas ou ao estado anterior da vida (2Co 5.17; 2Pe 2.5).
THAYER.en: That which exists from remote times or belongs to a previous period of history, contrasting with what is new. 1. Existing from the beginning or for a long time (Acts 21:16; Rev 12:9). | 2. Belonging to past eras or the former state of life (2Cor 5:17; 2Pet 2:5).

DEFINITION: Name of a historical ruler, son of Herod I, who reigned as ethnarch over Judea, Idumea, and Samaria.
SENSES: 1. Archelaus, son of Herod the Great and ruler of Judea (Mt 2:22).

THAYER.pt: Nome de um governante histórico, filho de Herodes I, que reinou como etnarca sobre a Judeia, Idumeia e Samaria. 1. Arquelau, filho de Herodes o Grande e governante da Judeia (Mt 2.22).
THAYER.en: Name of a historical ruler, son of Herod I, who reigned as ethnarch over Judea, Idumea, and Samaria. 1. Archelaus, son of Herod the Great and ruler of Judea (Mt 2:22).

DEFINITION: Signifies the temporal starting point of a process or the sphere of power wielded by rulers and authorities.
SENSES: 1. The beginning or starting point in time (Mk 1:1; Jn 1:1).
2. The primary cause or fundamental origin (Col 1:18; Rev 3:14).
3. Sphere of power, dominion, or rulers and authorities (Lk 12:11; Rom 8:38).

THAYER.pt: Significa o ponto de partida temporal de um processo ou a esfera de poder exercida por governantes e autoridades. 1. O início ou ponto de partida no tempo (Mc 1.1; Jo 1.1). | 2. A primeira causa ou origem fundamental (Cl 1.18; Ap 3.14). | 3. Esfera de poder, domínio ou governantes e autoridades (Lc 12.11; Rm 8.38).
THAYER.en: Signifies the temporal starting point of a process or the sphere of power wielded by rulers and authorities. 1. The beginning or starting point in time (Mk 1:1; Jn 1:1). | 2. The primary cause or fundamental origin (Col 1:18; Rev 3:14). | 3. Sphere of power, dominion, or rulers and authorities (Lk 12:11; Rom 8:38).

DEFINITION: One who occupies a preeminent position as leader, pioneer, or initiator of a movement or path of salvation.
SENSES: 1. Supreme leader or ruler with authority granted by God (Acts 5:31).
2. The pioneer or originator who opens the path of faith and salvation (Heb 2:10; Heb 12:2).

THAYER.pt: Aquele que ocupa uma posição preeminente como líder, pioneiro ou iniciador de um movimento ou caminho de salvação. 1. Líder supremo ou governante com autoridade concedida por Deus (At 5.31). | 2. O pioneiro ou originador que abre o caminho da fé e da salvação (Hb 2.10; Hb 12.2).
THAYER.en: One who occupies a preeminent position as leader, pioneer, or initiator of a movement or path of salvation. 1. Supreme leader or ruler with authority granted by God (Acts 5:31). | 2. The pioneer or originator who opens the path of faith and salvation (Heb 2:10; Heb 12:2).

DEFINITION: Pertaining or relating to the high priest or his family of high priestly influence.
SENSES: 1. Relating to the high priest or the high-priestly lineage (Acts 4:6).

THAYER.pt: Pertencente ou relativo ao sumo sacerdote ou à sua família de alta influência sacerdotal. 1. Relativo ao sumo sacerdote ou à linhagem sumo-sacerdotal (At 4.6).
THAYER.en: Pertaining or relating to the high priest or his family of high priestly influence. 1. Relating to the high priest or the high-priestly lineage (Acts 4:6).

DEFINITION: The head of the Jewish priesthood and president of the Sanhedrin, holder of the supreme mediating role in the old covenant; figuratively applied to Christ as the eternal and definitive High Priest.
SENSES: 1. The high priest in office in the Jewish temple liturgy (Mt 26:57; Acts 4:6).
2. Title applied in a supreme and perfect way to Jesus Christ (Heb 2:17; 4:14; 9:11).
3. In the plural: the chief priests, leaders of priestly families, and aristocratic members of the Sanhedrin (Mt 2:4; Mk 14:1).

THAYER.pt: O chefe do sacerdócio judaico e presidente do Sinédrio, detentor do papel mediador supremo na antiga aliança; figuradamente aplicado a Cristo como o eterno e definitivo Sumo Sacerdote. 1. O sumo sacerdote em exercício na liturgia do templo judaico (Mt 26.57; At 4.6). | 2. Título aplicado de modo supremo e perfeito a Jesus Cristo (Hb 2.17; 4.14; 9.11). | 3. No plural: os principais sacerdotes, líderes das famílias sacerdotais e membros aristocráticos do Sinédrio (Mt 2.4; Mc 14.1).
THAYER.en: The head of the Jewish priesthood and president of the Sanhedrin, holder of the supreme mediating role in the old covenant; figuratively applied to Christ as the eternal and definitive High Priest. 1. The high priest in office in the Jewish temple liturgy (Mt 26:57; Acts 4:6). | 2. Title applied in a supreme and perfect way to Jesus Christ (Heb 2:17; 4:14; 9:11). | 3. In the plural: the chief priests, leaders of priestly families, and aristocratic members of the Sanhedrin (Mt 2:4; Mk 14:1).

DEFINITION: The principal shepherd who holds supreme authority and directs the activity of the other shepherds. It is applied to Christ as the maximum leader of the flock.
SENSES: 1. The chief shepherd, title applied to Christ (1Pet 5:4).

THAYER.pt: O pastor principal que detém autoridade suprema e dirige a atividade dos demais pastores. É aplicado a Cristo como o líder máximo do rebanho. 1. O supremo pastor, título aplicado a Cristo (1Pe 5.4).
THAYER.en: The principal shepherd who holds supreme authority and directs the activity of the other shepherds. It is applied to Christ as the maximum leader of the flock. 1. The chief shepherd, title applied to Christ (1Pet 5:4).

DEFINITION: Name of an early Christian resident in the city of Colossae, associated with the local community.
SENSES: 1. Colossian Christian mentioned by Paul in greetings (Col 4:17; Phlm 2).

THAYER.pt: Nome de um cristão primitivo residente na cidade de Colossos, associado à comunidade local. 1. Cristão colossense mencionado por Paulo nas saudações (Cl 4:17; Fm 2).
THAYER.en: Name of an early Christian resident in the city of Colossae, associated with the local community. 1. Colossian Christian mentioned by Paul in greetings (Col 4:17; Phlm 2).

DEFINITION: Official responsible for administrative supervision and organization of services and meetings in the Jewish synagogue.
SENSES: 1. The leader or superintendent who directed the affairs of the synagogue (Mark 5:22; Acts 13:15).

THAYER.pt: Oficial responsável pela supervisão administrativa e organização dos cultos e reuniões na sinagoga judaica. 1. O líder ou superintendente que dirigia os assuntos da sinagoga (Mc 5.22; At 13.15).
THAYER.en: Official responsible for administrative supervision and organization of services and meetings in the Jewish synagogue. 1. The leader or superintendent who directed the affairs of the synagogue (Mark 5:22; Acts 13:15).

DEFINITION: One who plans, supervises, and directs construction operations; the expert responsible for executing a work.
SENSES: 1. Chief builder, master builder, or architect (1 Cor 3:10).

THAYER.pt: Aquele que planeja, supervisiona e dirige operações de construção; o perito responsável pela execução de uma obra. 1. Construtor chefe, mestre de obras ou arquiteto (1Co 3.10).
THAYER.en: One who plans, supervises, and directs construction operations; the expert responsible for executing a work. 1. Chief builder, master builder, or architect (1 Cor 3:10).

DEFINITION: Public official tasked with heading tax collection, supervising other collectors.
SENSES: 1. Chief of the tax collectors or superintendent of tax gatherers (Luke 19:2).

THAYER.pt: Funcionário público encarregado de chefiar a arrecadação de impostos, supervisionando outros coletores. 1. Chefe dos publicanos ou superintendente de coletores de impostos (Lc 19.2).
THAYER.en: Public official tasked with heading tax collection, supervising other collectors. 1. Chief of the tax collectors or superintendent of tax gatherers (Luke 19:2).

DEFINITION: Designates the chief servant responsible for supervising the banquet, coordinating table service and the work of other employees.
SENSES: 1. The general manager or master of ceremonies of a banquet (John 2:9).

THAYER.en: Refers to the intense flash of light generated by an electrical discharge in the atmosphere during a storm, or, by extension, the brightness of a lamp. 1. Lightning that illuminates the sky (Matt 24:27; Rev 4:5). | 2. The intense brightness emitted by a light source (Luke 11:36).

DEFINITION: To emit intense flashes of light, like lightning or the dazzling brightness of garments.
SENSES: 1. The quick flash of lightning in the sky (Luke 17:24).
2. The dazzling and shimmering brightness of garments (Luke 24:4).

THAYER.en: To emit intense flashes of light, like lightning or the dazzling brightness of garments. 1. The quick flash of lightning in the sky (Luke 17:24). | 2. The dazzling and shimmering brightness of garments (Luke 24:4).

THAYER.en: A bright celestial body, an individual star, or a group of stars that make up a constellation in the firmament. 1. Celestial body or guiding star (Luke 21:25; Acts 27:20). | 2. Constellations or stellar groups (Acts 7:43).

SENSES: 1. Asyncritus, a Christian greeted by Paul in the Epistle to the Romans (Rom 16:14).

THAYER.en: Refers to a lack of harmony in sounds or, by extension, a divergence of opinions and an inability to reach an agreement. 1. In disagreement, discordant, unable to come into harmony or consensus (Acts 28:25).

THAYER.en: Lacking spiritual discernment or capacity for understanding, often associated with a mindset rebellious toward God. 1. A person devoid of spiritual discernment or understanding (Matt 15:16; Rom 1:21).

THAYER.pt: Indica o processo de tornar-se maior em tamanho, quantidade, extensão ou importância, tanto no sentido físico da natureza quanto no crescimento espiritual da igreja. 1. Causar o crescimento ou fazer aumentar (2Co 9.10). | 2. Crescer, desenvolver-se ou multiplicar-se intrinsecamente (Cl 1.6; 1Pe 2.2).
THAYER.en: Indicates the process of becoming greater in size, quantity, extent, or importance, both in the physical sense of nature and in the spiritual growth of the church. 1. To cause growth or make increase (2Co 9.10). | 2. To grow, develop, or multiply intrinsically (Col 1.6; 1Pe 2.2).

DEFINITION: The gradual process of development, expansion, or growth in size, maturity, or quantity.
SENSES: 1. Spiritual and organic growth of the church as the body of Christ (Eph 4.16; Col 2.19).

THAYER.pt: O processo gradual de desenvolvimento, expansão ou crescimento em tamanho, maturidade ou quantidade. 1. Crescimento espiritual e orgânico da igreja como corpo de Cristo (Ef 4.16; Cl 2.19).
THAYER.en: The gradual process of development, expansion, or growth in size, maturity, or quantity. 1. Spiritual and organic growth of the church as the body of Christ (Eph 4.16; Col 2.19).

DEFINITION: Indicates the day immediately following the present, or more broadly, the very near future.
SENSES: 1. The following day or tomorrow (Mt 6.34; Ac 25.22).

THAYER.pt: Indica o dia imediatamente posterior ao presente, ou de forma mais ampla, um futuro muito próximo. 1. O dia seguinte ou o dia de amanhã (Mt 6.34; At 25.22).
THAYER.en: Indicates the day immediately following the present, or more broadly, the very near future. 1. The following day or tomorrow (Mt 6.34; Ac 25.22).

DEFINITION: Applying rigid, severe demands or strict discipline.
SENSES: 1. A person or standard characterized by excessive rigor and severe demands (Lk 19.21, 22).

THAYER.pt: Que aplica exigências rígidas, severas ou disciplina estricta. 1. Pessoa ou padrão caracterizado por rigor excessivo e exigências severas (Lc 19.21, 22).
THAYER.en: Applying rigid, severe demands or strict discipline. 1. A person or standard characterized by excessive rigor and severe demands (Lk 19.21, 22).

DEFINITION: A state of inner sufficiency or contentment in which a person possesses what is needed regardless of external circumstances.
SENSES: 1. Material sufficiency or adequate provision to meet needs (2Co 9.8).
2. Spiritual contentment and independence from adverse circumstances (1Tm 6.6).

THAYER.pt: Estado de suficiência interna ou contentamento em que a pessoa possui o que é necessário independentemente das circunstâncias externas. 1. Suficiência material ou provisão adequada para suprir necessidades (2Co 9.8). | 2. Contentamento espiritual e independência das circunstâncias adversas (1Tm 6.6).
THAYER.en: A state of inner sufficiency or contentment in which a person possesses what is needed regardless of external circumstances. 1. Material sufficiency or adequate provision to meet needs (2Co 9.8). | 2. Spiritual contentment and independence from adverse circumstances (1Tm 6.6).

DEFINITION: The state of one who is independent of external circumstances, finding satisfaction and sufficiency in oneself or in God.
SENSES: 1. Being content and satisfied with present circumstances (Php 4.11).

THAYER.pt: Estado de quem é independente de circunstâncias externas, achando satisfação e suficiência em si mesmo ou em Deus. 1. Estar contente e satisfeito com as circunstâncias presentes (Fp 4.11).
THAYER.en: The state of one who is independent of external circumstances, finding satisfaction and sufficiency in oneself or in God. 1. Being content and satisfied with present circumstances (Php 4.11).

DEFINITION: Said of a person whose own conduct and persistence in error evidence and prove their own guilt and condemnation.
SENSES: 1. Someone who condemns themselves by their own obstinate actions (Tit 3.11).

THAYER.pt: Diz-se da pessoa cuja própria conduta e persistência no erro evidenciam e provam a sua própria culpa e condenação. 1. Alguém que se condena por suas próprias ações obstinadas (Tt 3.11).
THAYER.en: Said of a person whose own conduct and persistence in error evidence and prove their own guilt and condemnation. 1. Someone who condemns themselves by their own obstinate actions (Tit 3.11).

DEFINITION: Refers to something that happens by itself, without visible human intervention or apparent external cause.
SENSES: 1. Spontaneous movement or opening without visible external force (Ac 12.10).
2. Natural growth of plants without direct human cultivation (Mk 4.28).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se a algo que ocorre por si mesmo, sem intervenção humana visível ou causa externa aparente. 1. Movimento ou abertura espontânea sem força exterior visível (Ac 12.10). | 2. Crescimento natural de plantas sem cultivo humano direto (Mc 4.28).
THAYER.en: Refers to something that happens by itself, without visible human intervention or apparent external cause. 1. Spontaneous movement or opening without visible external force (Ac 12.10). | 2. Natural growth of plants without direct human cultivation (Mk 4.28).

DEFINITION: One who has personally witnessed an event with their own eyes, thus possessing direct and reliable knowledge.
SENSES: 1. An eyewitness who saw the reported facts (Lk 1.2).

THAYER.pt: Aquele que presenciou pessoalmente um evento com os próprios olhos, possuindo assim conhecimento direto e fidedigno. 1. Testemunha ocular que viu os fatos relatados (Lc 1.2).
THAYER.en: One who has personally witnessed an event with their own eyes, thus possessing direct and reliable knowledge. 1. An eyewitness who saw the reported facts (Lk 1.2).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Gen. αὐτοῦ, ῆς, οῦ; personal and intensive pronoun
DEFINITION: A polyvalent pronoun serving primarily as a third-person personal pronoun in oblique cases. With the article it denotes identity ('the same') and, in predicative position or with nouns, functions as an intensive ('very' or 'self').
SENSES: 1. 3rd person personal pronoun in oblique cases ('he', 'she', 'his', 'him') (Mt 1.21; Jn 1.3).
2. Emphatic intensive pronoun, generally in predicative position ('himself', 'very') (Jn 2.25; Ro 8.16).
3. Pronoun of identity when preceded by the article ('the same') (Heb 13.8; 1Co 12.4).

THAYER.pt: Pronome polivalente que serve primariamente como pronome pessoal de terceira pessoa nos casos oblíquos. Com o artigo denota identidade ('o mesmo') e, em posição predicativa ou com nomes, funciona como intensivo ('o próprio'). 1. Pronome pessoal de 3ª pessoa nos casos oblíquos ('ele', 'ela', 'dele', 'o') (Mt 1.21; Jo 1.3). | 2. Pronome intensivo enfático, geralmente em posição predicativa ('o próprio', 'ele mesmo') (Jo 2.25; Rm 8.16). | 3. Pronome de identidade quando precedido pelo artigo ('o mesmo') (Hb 13.8; 1Co 12.4).
THAYER.en: A polyvalent pronoun serving primarily as a third-person personal pronoun in oblique cases. With the article it denotes identity ('the same') and, in predicative position or with nouns, functions as an intensive ('very' or 'self'). 1. 3rd person personal pronoun in oblique cases ('he', 'she', 'his', 'him') (Mt 1.21; Jn 1.3). | 2. Emphatic intensive pronoun, generally in predicative position ('himself', 'very') (Jn 2.25; Ro 8.16). | 3. Pronoun of identity when preceded by the article ('the same') (Heb 13.8; 1Co 12.4).

DEFINITION: An adverb designating a static position, relatively near or far, equivalent to 'here' or 'there'.
SENSES: 1. Indication of a fixed place, here or there (Mt 26.36; Ac 18.19).

THAYER.pt: Advérbio que designa uma posição estática, relativamente próxima ou distante, equivalendo a 'aqui' ou 'ali'. 1. Indicação de lugar fixo, aqui ou ali (Mt 26.36; At 18.19).
THAYER.en: An adverb designating a static position, relatively near or far, equivalent to 'here' or 'there'. 1. Indication of a fixed place, here or there (Mt 26.36; Ac 18.19).

DEFINITION: A contracted form of the reflexive pronoun used to indicate reference back to the subject of the clause.
SENSES: 1. To oneself, of oneself, or what belongs to oneself (Mt 26.36).

THAYER.pt: Forma contraída do pronome reflexivo usada para indicar referência de volta ao sujeito da oração. 1. A si mesmo, de si próprio ou o que lhe pertence (Mt 26.36).
THAYER.en: A contracted form of the reflexive pronoun used to indicate reference back to the subject of the clause. 1. To oneself, of oneself, or what belongs to oneself (Mt 26.36).

DEFINITION: Describes an action performed directly by the person themselves, without intermediaries.
SENSES: 1. Participating directly in a manual action, such as casting cargo into the sea (Ac 27.19).

THAYER.pt: Descreve uma ação realizada diretamente pela própria pessoa, sem intermediários. 1. Participar diretamente de uma ação manual, como lançar a carga ao mar (At 27.19).
THAYER.en: Describes an action performed directly by the person themselves, without intermediaries. 1. Participating directly in a manual action, such as casting cargo into the sea (Ac 27.19).

DEFINITION: Originally dry or rough; used metaphorically to describe a dark, gloomy, or dreary environment.
SENSES: 1. A dark, gloomy, or desert-like place (2Pe 1.19).

THAYER.pt: Originalmente seco ou áspero; usado metaforicamente para descrever um ambiente escuro, sombrio ou lúgubre. 1. Um lugar escuro, sombrio ou desértico (2Pe 1.19).
THAYER.en: Originally dry or rough; used metaphorically to describe a dark, gloomy, or dreary environment. 1. A dark, gloomy, or desert-like place (2Pe 1.19).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: ἀφελῶ, Aor: ἀφεῖλον, Pass: ἀφῃρέθην
DEFINITION: Means to separate or remove something from its original position, either by physical force or by the cancellation of a condition.
SENSES: 1. To physically remove or cut off a body part or object (Mt 26.51; Lk 22.50).
2. To cause to cease, remove sins, or annul obligations (Heb 10.4; Rev 22.19).

THAYER.pt: Significa separar ou remover algo de sua posição original, seja por força física ou pelo cancelamento de uma condição. 1. Retirar ou cortar fisicamente uma parte do corpo ou objeto (Mt 26.51; Lc 22.50). | 2. Fazer cessar, remover pecados ou anular obrigações (Hb 10.4; Ap 22.19).
THAYER.en: Means to separate or remove something from its original position, either by physical force or by the cancellation of a condition. 1. To physically remove or cut off a body part or object (Mt 26.51; Lk 22.50). | 2. To cause to cease, remove sins, or annul obligations (Heb 10.4; Rev 22.19).

DEFINITION: That which cannot be seen, perceived, or that remains concealed from sight.
SENSES: 1. Creatures or realities hidden from the sight of God (Heb 4.13).

THAYER.pt: Aquilo que não pode ser visto, percebido ou que permanece encoberto à vista. 1. Criaturas ou realidades ocultas da vista de Deus (Hb 4.13).
THAYER.en: That which cannot be seen, perceived, or that remains concealed from sight. 1. Creatures or realities hidden from the sight of God (Heb 4.13).

DEFINITION: To make disappear, completely destroy the usefulness or appearance of something, or make it unrecognizable.
SENSES: 1. To destroy or consume material goods like moths and rust (Mt 6.19).
2. To disfigure the face to appear fasting to men (Mt 6.16).
3. To disappear or perish (Ac 13.41; Jas 4.14).

THAYER.pt: Fazer desaparecer, destruir completamente a utilidade ou aparência de algo, ou tornar irreconhecível. 1. Destruir ou consumir bens materiais como traças e ferrugem (Mt 6.19). | 2. Desfigurar o rosto para parecer jejuador aos homens (Mt 6.16). | 3. Desaparecer ou perecer (At 13.41; Tg 4.14).
THAYER.en: To make disappear, completely destroy the usefulness or appearance of something, or make it unrecognizable. 1. To destroy or consume material goods like moths and rust (Mt 6.19). | 2. To disfigure the face to appear fasting to men (Mt 6.16). | 3. To disappear or perish (Ac 13.41; Jas 4.14).

DEFINITION: The state or event of ceasing to exist, complete annihilation or disappearance.
SENSES: 1. The obsolescence, ruin, or disappearance of something becoming antiquated (Heb 8.13).

THAYER.pt: O estado ou evento de deixar de existir, aniquilação ou desaparecimento completo. 1. A obsolescência, ruína ou desaparecimento de algo que caduca (Hb 8.13).
THAYER.en: The state or event of ceasing to exist, complete annihilation or disappearance. 1. The obsolescence, ruin, or disappearance of something becoming antiquated (Heb 8.13).

DEFINITION: That which suddenly became invisible or slipped out of the field of vision.
SENSES: 1. The sudden disappearance of Jesus from the disciples' sight (Lk 24.31).

THAYER.pt: Que se tornou invisível de repente ou sumiu do campo de visão. 1. O desaparecimento repentino de Jesus da vista dos discípulos (Lc 24.31).
THAYER.en: That which suddenly became invisible or slipped out of the field of vision. 1. The sudden disappearance of Jesus from the disciples' sight (Lk 24.31).

DEFINITION: A place designated for bodily waste; a latrine or toilet.
SENSES: 1. A place for the elimination of bodily waste (Mt 15.17; Mk 7.19).

THAYER.pt: Local destinado para necessidades fisiológicas; latrina ou privada. 1. Lugar de eliminação de dejetos corporais (Mt 15.17; Mc 7.19).
THAYER.en: A place designated for bodily waste; a latrine or toilet. 1. A place for the elimination of bodily waste (Mt 15.17; Mk 7.19).

DEFINITION: Severe and rigorous treatment imposed on the body without sparing it, associated with ascetic practices.
SENSES: 1. Excessive rigor or mistreatment inflicted on the body by false asceticism (Col 2.23).

THAYER.pt: Tratamento severo e rigoroso imposto ao corpo, sem poupá-lo, associado a práticas ascéticas. 1. Rigor excessivo ou maus-tratos infligidos ao corpo por falso ascetismo (Cl 2.23).
THAYER.en: Severe and rigorous treatment imposed on the body without sparing it, associated with ascetic practices. 1. Excessive rigor or mistreatment inflicted on the body by false asceticism (Col 2.23).

DEFINITION: A quality of life characterized by humility, absence of pretense, and sincerity of heart.
SENSES: 1. Simplicity and affectionate sincerity in Christian fellowship (Ac 2.46).

THAYER.pt: Qualidade de vida caracterizada pela humildade, ausência de pretenção e sinceridade de coração. 1. A simplicidade e sinceridade afetuosa na convivência cristã (At 2.46).
THAYER.en: A quality of life characterized by humility, absence of pretense, and sincerity of heart. 1. Simplicity and affectionate sincerity in Christian fellowship (Ac 2.46).

DEFINITION: Denotes the act of releasing, freeing from captivity, or canceling a debt and obligation. In the New Testament, it is the central term for describing God's forgiveness of sins and absolution of moral guilt.
SENSES: 1. Release from captivity or relief from a condition of physical or social oppression (Lk 4.18).
2. Forgiveness, remission, or cancellation of the guilt and penalty of sins (Mt 26.28; Col 1.14).

THAYER.pt: Denota o ato de soltar, libertar de um cativeiro ou cancelar uma dívida e obrigação. No Novo Testamento, é o termo central para descrever o perdão divino dos pecados e a absolvição da culpa moral. 1. Libertação de um cativeiro ou alívio de uma condição de opressão física ou social (Lc 4.18). | 2. Perdão, remissão ou cancelamento da culpa e da pena dos pecados (Mt 26.28; Cl 1.14).
THAYER.en: Denotes the act of releasing, freeing from captivity, or canceling a debt and obligation. In the New Testament, it is the central term for describing God's forgiveness of sins and absolution of moral guilt. 1. Release from captivity or relief from a condition of physical or social oppression (Lk 4.18). | 2. Forgiveness, remission, or cancellation of the guilt and penalty of sins (Mt 26.28; Col 1.14).

DEFINITION: An anatomical connecting element, such as a joint or ligament that unites parts of the body.
SENSES: 1. A ligament or joint that unites body members (Col 2.19).
2. Structural connection sustaining the growth of the body and the church (Eph 4.16).

THAYER.pt: Elemento anatômico de ligação, como uma junta ou ligamento que une partes do corpo. 1. Ligamento ou junta que une os membros do corpo (Cl 2.19). | 2. Conexão estrutural que sustenta o crescimento do corpo e da igreja (Ef 4.16).
THAYER.en: An anatomical connecting element, such as a joint or ligament that unites parts of the body. 1. A ligament or joint that unites body members (Col 2.19). | 2. Structural connection sustaining the growth of the body and the church (Eph 4.16).

DEFINITION: The state of being free from corruption, physical decay, or death, denoting a quality of eternal permanence.
SENSES: 1. Incorruptibility and physical or spiritual immortality (1Co 15.42; 2Tm 1.10).

THAYER.pt: O estado de estar livre da corrupção, da decadência física ou da morte, denotando qualidade de permanência eterna. 1. Incorruptibilidade e imortalidade física ou espiritual (1Co 15.42; 2Tm 1.10).
THAYER.en: The state of being free from corruption, physical decay, or death, denoting a quality of eternal permanence. 1. Incorruptibility and physical or spiritual immortality (1Co 15.42; 2Tm 1.10).

DEFINITION: Not subject to corruption, decay, or death; immortal and eternal.
SENSES: 1. Imperishable and incorruptible, applied to God and the future transformed existence of believers (Ro 1.23; 1Tm 1.17).

THAYER.pt: Que não está sujeito à corrupção, à decadência ou à morte; imortal e eterno. 1. Imperessível e incorruptível, aplicado a Deus e à futura existência transformada dos crentes (Rm 1.23; 1Tm 1.17).
THAYER.en: Not subject to corruption, decay, or death; immortal and eternal. 1. Imperishable and incorruptible, applied to God and the future transformed existence of believers (Ro 1.23; 1Tm 1.17).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: ἀφήσω, Aor: ἀφῆκα, Perf: ἀφεῖκα, Pass. Aor: ἀφέθην
DEFINITION: Originally means to let go, push away, or distance. In the New Testament, it becomes the primary verb for the gracious cancellation of debts and the forgiveness of sins by God or among people.
SENSES: 1. To forgive sins, remit moral offenses, and legal debts (Mt 6.12; 1Jn 1.9).
2. To leave behind, abandon a place, person, or occupation (Mt 4.20; Mk 10.28).
3. To permit, tolerate, grant authorization (Mt 3.15; Mk 5.19).
4. To dismiss, send away, or release crowds (Mt 13.36).

THAYER.pt: Significa originalmente soltar, afastar ou distanciar. No Novo Testamento, torna-se o verbo primordial para o cancelamento gracioso de dívidas e o perdão dos pecados por Deus ou entre as pessoas. 1. Perdoar pecados, remeter ofensas morais e dívidas legais (Mt 6.12; 1Jo 1.9). | 2. Deixar para trás, abandonar um lugar, pessoa ou ocupação (Mt 4.20; Mc 10.28). | 3. Permitir, tolerar, dar autorização (Mt 3.15; Mc 5.19). | 4. Despedir, dispensar ou mandar embora multidões (Mt 13.36).
THAYER.en: Originally means to let go, push away, or distance. In the New Testament, it becomes the primary verb for the gracious cancellation of debts and the forgiveness of sins by God or among people. 1. To forgive sins, remit moral offenses, and legal debts (Mt 6.12; 1Jn 1.9). | 2. To leave behind, abandon a place, person, or occupation (Mt 4.20; Mk 10.28). | 3. To permit, tolerate, grant authorization (Mt 3.15; Mk 5.19). | 4. To dismiss, send away, or release crowds (Mt 13.36).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: ἀφίξεται, Aor: ἀφικόμην, Perf: ἀφῖκται
DEFINITION: To arrive at a destination or, figuratively, to cause news or information to reach other places.
SENSES: 1. The spreading of fame or the report about someone's obedience (Ro 16.19).

THAYER.pt: Chegar a um destino ou, no sentido figurado, fazer com que notícias ou informações alcancem outros lugares. 1. A propagação da fama ou do relatório sobre a obediência de alguém (Rm 16.19).
THAYER.en: To arrive at a destination or, figuratively, to cause news or information to reach other places. 1. The spreading of fame or the report about someone's obedience (Ro 16.19).

SHORT_GLOSS: enemy of good, loveless toward good
DEFINITION: A person who has no appreciation, love, or interest in what is morally good and beneficial for society.
SENSES: 1. Individuals who reject and hate virtue and goodness in the last days (2Tm 3.3).
USAGE: enemy of good, loveless toward good

THAYER.pt: Pessoa que não tem apreço, amor ou interesse pelo que é moralmente bom e benéfico para a sociedade. 1. Indivíduos que rejeitam e odeiam a virtude e o bem nos últimos dias (2Tm 3.3).
THAYER.en: A person who has no appreciation, love, or interest in what is morally good and beneficial for society. 1. Individuals who reject and hate virtue and goodness in the last days (2Tm 3.3).

DEFINITION: Not demonstrating excessive attachment or disordered love for money; free from avarice.
SENSES: 1. The virtue of not loving money or coveting material riches (1Tm 3.3; Heb 13.5).

THAYER.pt: Que não demonstra apego excessivo ou amor desordenado pelo dinheiro; livre da avareza. 1. Virtude de não amar o dinheiro ou cobiçar riquezas materiais (1Tm 3.3; Hb 13.5).
THAYER.en: Not demonstrating excessive attachment or disordered love for money; free from avarice. 1. The virtue of not loving money or coveting material riches (1Tm 3.3; Heb 13.5).

DEFINITION: The act of moving away or leaving a place; someone's departure.
SENSES: 1. Paul's departure or farewell from Ephesus (Ac 20.29).

THAYER.pt: O ato de afastar-se ou deixar um lugar; a partida de alguém. 1. A partida ou despedida de Paulo de Éfeso (At 20.29).
THAYER.en: The act of moving away or leaving a place; someone's departure. 1. Paul's departure or farewell from Ephesus (Ac 20.29).

DEFINITION: To cause someone to depart or to voluntarily withdraw from a person, place, or allegiance (as in apostasy).
SENSES: 1. To depart, to withdraw physically from a place or person (Lk 2.37; Ac 12.10).
2. To deviate from the true faith, abandon convictions, or commit apostasy (1Tm 4.1).

THAYER.pt: Causar o afastamento de alguém ou afastar-se voluntariamente de uma pessoa, lugar ou lealdade (como na apostasia). 1. Afastar-se, retirar-se fisicamente de um lugar ou pessoa (Lc 2.37; At 12.10). | 2. Desviar-se da fé verdadeira, abandonar convicções ou cometer apostasia (1Tm 4.1).
THAYER.en: To cause someone to depart or to voluntarily withdraw from a person, place, or allegiance (as in apostasy). 1. To depart, to withdraw physically from a place or person (Lk 2.37; Ac 12.10). | 2. To deviate from the true faith, abandon convictions, or commit apostasy (1Tm 4.1).

DEFINITION: Indicates an event that occurs abruptly, without prior warning or with minimal interval.
SENSES: 1. In a sudden or unexpected manner (Ac 2.2).

THAYER.pt: Indica um acontecimento que ocorre de forma abrupta, sem aviso prévio ou com intervalo mínimo. 1. De maneira súbita ou inesperada (At 2.2).
THAYER.en: Indicates an event that occurs abruptly, without prior warning or with minimal interval. 1. In a sudden or unexpected manner (Ac 2.2).

DEFINITION: A manner of acting characterized by the absence of fear, allowing the believer to serve God with boldness and confidence.
SENSES: 1. Acting without fear or with total confidence before dangers or threats (Lk 1.74; Php 1.14).

THAYER.pt: Modo de agir caracterizado pela ausência de medo, permitindo que o crente sirva a Deus com ousadia e confiança. 1. Agir sem medo ou com total confiança diante de perigos ou ameaças (Lc 1.74; Fp 1.14).
THAYER.en: A manner of acting characterized by the absence of fear, allowing the believer to serve God with boldness and confidence. 1. Acting without fear or with total confidence before dangers or threats (Lk 1.74; Php 1.14).

DEFINITION: To cause something to resemble something else, or to make someone similar to a model.
SENSES: 1. To be made similar to someone in characteristics or condition (Heb 7:3).

THAYER.pt: Fazer com que algo se pareça com outra coisa, ou tornar alguém semelhante a um modelo. 1. Ser feito semelhante a alguém em características ou condição (Hb 7.3).
THAYER.en: To cause something to resemble something else, or to make someone similar to a model. 1. To be made similar to someone in characteristics or condition (Heb 7:3).

SHORT_GLOSS: to pay attention, to fix the gaze
DEFINITION: Means to turn one's attention without distractions toward something or someone, fixing the eyes with firmness and confidence.
SENSES: 1. To fix the eyes with confidence and perseverance on Jesus (Heb 12:2).
2. To observe or determine something with future precision (Phil 2:23).
USAGE: to pay attention, to fix the gaze

THAYER.pt: Significa voltar a atenção sem distrações para algo ou alguém, fixando os olhos com firmeza e confiança. 1. Fixar os olhos com confiança e perseverança em Jesus (Hb 12.2). | 2. Observar ou determinar algo com precisão futura (Fp 2.23).
THAYER.en: Means to turn one's attention without distractions toward something or someone, fixing the eyes with firmness and confidence. 1. To fix the eyes with confidence and perseverance on Jesus (Heb 12:2). | 2. To observe or determine something with future precision (Phil 2:23).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: ἀφορίσω, Aor: ἀφώρισα, Pass: ἀφωρίσθην
SHORT_GLOSS: to separate, to set apart, to isolate
DEFINITION: Describes the action of separating someone or something from a group for a specific purpose or to mark distinction and exclusion.
SENSES: 1. To separate or divide people into distinct groups (Matt 25:32; Gal 2:12).
2. To set apart or consecrate someone for a special divine mission (Acts 13:2; Rom 1:1).
USAGE: to separate, to set apart, to isolate

THAYER.pt: Descreve a ação de separar alguém ou algo de um grupo para um propósito específico ou para marcar distinção e exclusão. 1. Separar ou dividir pessoas em grupos distintos (Mt 25.32; Gl 2.12). | 2. Apartar ou consagrar alguém para uma missão divina especial (At 13.2; Rm 1.1).
THAYER.en: Describes the action of separating someone or something from a group for a specific purpose or to mark distinction and exclusion. 1. To separate or divide people into distinct groups (Matt 25:32; Gal 2:12). | 2. To set apart or consecrate someone for a special divine mission (Acts 13:2; Rom 1:1).

DEFINITION: Designates a basis for action, a starting point, or a favorable circumstance for the realization of something, and can also denote an occasion or pretext for evil.
SENSES: 1. An opportunity or favorable basis for an action (2 Cor 11:12; 1 Tim 5:14).
2. An occasion or pretext seized by the flesh or by sin (Rom 7:8).

THAYER.pt: Designa uma base de atuação, ponto de partida ou circunstância favorável para a realização de algo, podendo também denotar uma ocasião ou pretexto para o mal. 1. Oportunidade ou base favorável para uma ação (2Co 11:12; 1Tm 5:14). | 2. Ocasião ou pretexto aproveitado pela carne ou pelo pecado (Rm 7:8).
THAYER.en: Designates a basis for action, a starting point, or a favorable circumstance for the realization of something, and can also denote an occasion or pretext for evil. 1. An opportunity or favorable basis for an action (2 Cor 11:12; 1 Tim 5:14). | 2. An occasion or pretext seized by the flesh or by sin (Rom 7:8).

DEFINITION: To produce foam, specifically referring to the act of foaming at the mouth during an attack or epileptic seizure.
SENSES: 1. To foam at the mouth due to a physical condition or possession (Mark 9:18).

THAYER.pt: Produzir espuma, especificamente referindo-se ao ato de espumar pela boca durante um ataque ou convulsão epiléptica. 1. Espumar pela boca devido a uma condição física ou possessão (Mc 9.18).
THAYER.en: To produce foam, specifically referring to the act of foaming at the mouth during an attack or epileptic seizure. 1. To foam at the mouth due to a physical condition or possession (Mark 9:18).

DEFINITION: Refers to the foamy mass or froth that may appear at the mouth, used in the New Testament in the context of symptoms of epileptic seizures.
SENSES: 1. Foam or froth expelled from the mouth during episodes of illness or seizure (Luke 9:39).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se à massa espumosa ou baba que pode aparecer na boca, sendo empregada no Novo Testamento no contexto de sintomas de convulsões epilépticas. 1. Espuma ou baba expelida pela boca em episódios de enfermidade ou convulsão (Lc 9.39).
THAYER.en: Refers to the foamy mass or froth that may appear at the mouth, used in the New Testament in the context of symptoms of epileptic seizures. 1. Foam or froth expelled from the mouth during episodes of illness or seizure (Luke 9:39).

DEFINITION: A state of lack of prudence, discernment, or common sense, encompassing both intellectual weakness and moral rebellion.
SENSES: 1. Foolishness or folly in thought and conduct (Mark 7:22).
2. Rhetorical madness or boasting devoid of good sense (2 Cor 11:1, 17).

THAYER.pt: Estado de falta de prudência, discernimento ou bom senso, abrangendo tanto a fraqueza intelectual quanto a rebeldia moral. 1. Insensatez ou tolice no pensamento e na conduta (Mc 7.22). | 2. Loucura retórica ou jactância tolhida de sensatez (2Co 11.1, 17).
THAYER.en: A state of lack of prudence, discernment, or common sense, encompassing both intellectual weakness and moral rebellion. 1. Foolishness or folly in thought and conduct (Mark 7:22). | 2. Rhetorical madness or boasting devoid of good sense (2 Cor 11:1, 17).

DEFINITION: A person who acts without discernment, prudence, or practical common sense, ignoring the divine perspective and will.
SENSES: 1. Devoid of practical wisdom or spiritual discernment (Luke 12:20; Eph 5:17).
2. One who demonstrates foolishness in their attitudes and judgments (Rom 2:20; 1 Pet 2:15).

THAYER.pt: Pessoa que age sem discernimento, prudência ou bom senso prático, ignorando a perspectiva e a vontade divina. 1. Desprovido de sabedoria prática ou discernimento espiritual (Lc 12.20; Ef 5.17). | 2. Que demonstra insensatez em suas atitudes e julgamentos (Rm 2.20; 1Pe 2.15).
THAYER.en: A person who acts without discernment, prudence, or practical common sense, ignoring the divine perspective and will. 1. Devoid of practical wisdom or spiritual discernment (Luke 12:20; Eph 5:17). | 2. One who demonstrates foolishness in their attitudes and judgments (Rom 2:20; 1 Pet 2:15).

DEFINITION: To enter into the state of sleep, to fall asleep, or to relax for rest.
SENSES: 1. To fall asleep or doze off, especially lying down to rest (Lk 8:23).

THAYER.pt: Significa entrar no estado de sono, adormecer ou relaxar para o descanso. 1. Adormecer ou pegar no sono, especialmente deitar-se para descansar (Lc 8.23).
THAYER.en: To enter into the state of sleep, to fall asleep, or to relax for rest. 1. To fall asleep or doze off, especially lying down to rest (Lk 8:23).

DEFINITION: Incapable of producing vocal sounds, speaking, or communicating meaning through articulated language.
SENSES: 1. Unable to speak, mute, or silent before oppressors (Acts 8:32).
2. Mute idols incapable of real communication (1 Cor 12:2).

THAYER.pt: Incapaz de emitir sons vocais, falar ou comunicar significado através de linguagem articulada. 1. Incapaz de falar, mudo ou silencioso diante de opressores (At 8.32). | 2. Ídolos mudos incapazes de comunicação real (1Co 12.2).
THAYER.en: Incapable of producing vocal sounds, speaking, or communicating meaning through articulated language. 1. Unable to speak, mute, or silent before oppressors (Acts 8:32). | 2. Mute idols incapable of real communication (1 Cor 12:2).

DEFINITION: A proper name referring to Ahaz, a king of Judah who appears in the genealogy of Jesus Christ according to the Gospel of Matthew.
SENSES: 1. King Ahaz, an ancestor in the earthly lineage of Jesus (Mt 1:9).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio que se refere a Acaz, um rei de Judá que figura na genealogia de Jesus Cristo segundo o Evangelho de Mateus. 1. O rei Acaz, ancestral na linhagem terrena de Jesus (Mt 1.9).
THAYER.en: A proper name referring to Ahaz, a king of Judah who appears in the genealogy of Jesus Christ according to the Gospel of Matthew. 1. King Ahaz, an ancestor in the earthly lineage of Jesus (Mt 1:9).

DEFINITION: The name of the Roman province that encompassed the southern part of Greece (including famous cities such as Corinth and Athens) during the New Testament period.
SENSES: 1. The Roman province of Achaia in Greece (Acts 18:12; Rom 15:26).

THAYER.pt: Nome da província romana que abrangia a parte sul da Grécia (incluindo cidades célebres como Corinto e Atenas) durante o período do Novo Testamento. 1. A província romana da Acaia na Grécia (At 18.12; Rm 15.26).
THAYER.en: The name of the Roman province that encompassed the southern part of Greece (including famous cities such as Corinth and Athens) during the New Testament period. 1. The Roman province of Achaia in Greece (Acts 18:12; Rom 15:26).

DEFINITION: A masculine proper name designating a Christian from the region of Achaia or the city of Corinth, mentioned in the Pauline epistles.
SENSES: 1. Achaicus, a Christian associated with the church in Corinth (1 Cor 16:17).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio masculino que designa um cristão da região da Acaia ou da cidade de Corinto, mencionado nas cartas paulinas. 1. Acaico, um cristão associado à igreja em Corinto (1Co 16.17).
THAYER.en: A masculine proper name designating a Christian from the region of Achaia or the city of Corinth, mentioned in the Pauline epistles. 1. Achaicus, a Christian associated with the church in Corinth (1 Cor 16:17).

DEFINITION: Describes a person who demonstrates a complete lack of gratitude or recognition for benefits received.
SENSES: 1. The lack of gratitude toward benefactors and toward God Himself (Lk 6:35).

THAYER.pt: Descreve uma pessoa que demonstra completa falta de gratidão ou reconhecimento pelos benefícios recebidos. 1. A falta de gratidão para com benfeitores e para com o próprio Deus (Lc 6.35).
THAYER.en: Describes a person who demonstrates a complete lack of gratitude or recognition for benefits received. 1. The lack of gratitude toward benefactors and toward God Himself (Lk 6:35).

DEFINITION: A masculine proper name of one of the ancestors in the genealogy of Jesus recorded in the New Testament.
SENSES: 1. Achim, a descendant of the Davidic line (Mt 1:14).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio masculino de um dos antepassados na genealogia de Jesus registrada no Novo Testamento. 1. Aquim, descendente da linhagem davídica (Mt 1.14).
THAYER.en: A masculine proper name of one of the ancestors in the genealogy of Jesus recorded in the New Testament. 1. Achim, a descendant of the Davidic line (Mt 1:14).

DEFINITION: Refers to something that was not produced by human effort or artifice, possessing a divine origin or nature.
SENSES: 1. That which is not made by human hands, denoting a transcendent origin (Col 2:11).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se a algo que não foi produzido por esforço ou artifício humano, possuindo origem ou natureza divina. 1. O que não é feito por mãos humanas, denotando origem transcendente (Cl 2.11).
THAYER.en: Refers to something that was not produced by human effort or artifice, possessing a divine origin or nature. 1. That which is not made by human hands, denoting a transcendent origin (Col 2:11).

DEFINITION: Refers to a dense mist that obscures vision or, figuratively, an obscuring of perception and understanding.
SENSES: 1. Dark mist or gloom that causes severe visual impairment or temporary blindness (Acts 13:11).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se a uma névoa densa que obscurece a visão ou, figuradamente, a um obscurecimento da percepção e entendimento. 1. Névoa escura ou penumbra que causa deficiência visual severa ou cegueira temporária (At 13.11).
THAYER.en: Refers to a dense mist that obscures vision or, figuratively, an obscuring of perception and understanding. 1. Dark mist or gloom that causes severe visual impairment or temporary blindness (Acts 13:11).

DEFINITION: Designates something or someone that has no practical utility, economic value, or that does not deserve praise.
SENSES: 1. Useless or worthless in the performance of spiritual duties (Mt 25:30).

THAYER.pt: Designa algo ou alguém que não tem utilidade prática, valor econômico ou que não merece louvor. 1. Inútil ou imprestável no desempenho de deveres espirituais (Mt 25.30).
THAYER.en: Designates something or someone that has no practical utility, economic value, or that does not deserve praise. 1. Useless or worthless in the performance of spiritual duties (Mt 25:30).

DEFINITION: To render something or someone useless, worthless, or morally depraved and devoid of social or spiritual value.
SENSES: 1. To become useless or morally corrupted, perverting the original purpose (Rom 3:12).

THAYER.pt: Tornar algo ou alguém inútil, imprestável ou moralmente depravado e sem valor social ou espiritual. 1. Tornar-se inútil ou moralmente corrompido, pervertendo o propósito original (Rm 3.12).
THAYER.en: To render something or someone useless, worthless, or morally depraved and devoid of social or spiritual value. 1. To become useless or morally corrupted, perverting the original purpose (Rom 3:12).

DEFINITION: Describes something or someone that does not serve a beneficial purpose or that lacks practical utility.
SENSES: 1. Useless or of no service for a specific function or task (Phlm 11).

THAYER.pt: Descreve algo ou alguém que não serve a um propósito benéfico ou que carece de utilidade prática. 1. Inútil ou sem préstimo para uma determinada função ou serviço (Fm 11).
THAYER.en: Describes something or someone that does not serve a beneficial purpose or that lacks practical utility. 1. Useless or of no service for a specific function or task (Phlm 11).

DEFINITION: Functions as a preposition of continuous limit or as a temporal conjunction, indicating the extreme point of time, space, or degree to which an action extends.
SENSES: 1. Temporal: until, up to a certain determined moment (Mt 24:38; Rom 5:13; Rev 2:26).
2. Spatial: as far as, up to the point of (Acts 11:5; Acts 28:15).
3. Degree or intensity: to the measure of (Heb 4:12; Rev 12:11).

THAYER.pt: Funciona como preposição de limite contínuo ou como conjunção temporal, indicando o ponto extremo de tempo, espaço ou grau a que uma ação se estende. 1. Temporal: até, até certo momento determinado (Mt 24.38; Rm 5.13; Ap 2.26). | 2. Espacial: tão longe quanto, até o ponto de (At 11.5; At 28.15). | 3. Grau ou intensidade: até a medida de (Hb 4.12; Ap 12.11).
THAYER.en: Functions as a preposition of continuous limit or as a temporal conjunction, indicating the extreme point of time, space, or degree to which an action extends. 1. Temporal: until, up to a certain determined moment (Mt 24:38; Rom 5:13; Rev 2:26). | 2. Spatial: as far as, up to the point of (Acts 11:5; Acts 28:15). | 3. Degree or intensity: to the measure of (Heb 4:12; Rev 12:11).

DEFINITION: The dry husks of cereal grains that are separated during threshing and commonly burned.
SENSES: 1. The light chaff separated from the wheat, used as a symbol of judgment (Mt 3:12).

THAYER.pt: As cascas secas dos grãos de cereais que são separadas durante a debulha e comumente queimadas. 1. A palha leve separada do trigo, usada como símbolo de julgamento (Mt 3.12).
THAYER.en: The dry husks of cereal grains that are separated during threshing and commonly burned. 1. The light chaff separated from the wheat, used as a symbol of judgment (Mt 3:12).

DEFINITION: Free from any deceit or falsehood; one who speaks the truth and is entirely reliable.
SENSES: 1. That which cannot lie, characterized by absolute truthfulness and reliability (Tit 1:2).

THAYER.pt: Livre de qualquer engano ou falsidade; aquele que diz a verdade e é inteiramente confiável. 1. Que não pode mentir, caracterizado pela absoluta veracidade e confiabilidade (Tt 1.2).
THAYER.en: Free from any deceit or falsehood; one who speaks the truth and is entirely reliable. 1. That which cannot lie, characterized by absolute truthfulness and reliability (Tit 1:2).

DEFINITION: An aromatic herb with an extremely bitter taste, used in antiquity for medicinal purposes and as a metaphor for judgment.
SENSES: 1. Wormwood as a medicinal herb of very bitter taste (Rev 8:11).

THAYER.pt: Erva aromática de sabor extremamente amargo, utilizada na antiguidade com fins medicinais e como metáfora de juízo. 1. O absinto como erva medicinal de sabor muito amargo (Ap 8.11).
THAYER.en: An aromatic herb with an extremely bitter taste, used in antiquity for medicinal purposes and as a metaphor for judgment. 1. Wormwood as a medicinal herb of very bitter taste (Rev 8:11).

DEFINITION: That which does not possess life, soul, or breath; refers to inanimate objects or musical instruments without vital breath.
SENSES: 1. Inanimate, devoid of biological life or consciousness (1 Cor 14:7).

THAYER.pt: Que não possui vida, alma ou respiração; refere-se a objetos inanimados ou instrumentos musicais sem sopro vital. 1. Inanimado, desprovido de vida biológica ou consciência (1Co 14.7).
THAYER.en: That which does not possess life, soul, or breath; refers to inanimate objects or musical instruments without vital breath. 1. Inanimate, devoid of biological life or consciousness (1 Cor 14:7).

DEFINITION: The principal deity worshipped by ancient Semitic peoples and neighbors of Israel, frequently associated with fertility.
SENSES: 1. Baal, a pagan deity worshipped in the Ancient Near East (Rom 11:4).

THAYER.pt: Deidade principal cultuada pelos povos semíticos antigos e povos vizinhos de Israel, frequentemente associada à fertilidade. 1. Baal, divindade pagã adorada no Antigo Oriente Próximo (Rm 11.4).
THAYER.en: The principal deity worshipped by ancient Semitic peoples and neighbors of Israel, frequently associated with fertility. 1. Baal, a pagan deity worshipped in the Ancient Near East (Rom 11:4).

DEFINITION: The ancient and famous capital of Babylon, used symbolically in the New Testament to represent oppressive and corrupt world power.
SENSES: 1. The historical city of Babylon (Mt 1:11).
2. A prophetic symbol of the world empire hostile to God (Rev 14:8).

THAYER.pt: Antiga e célebre capital da Babilônia, usada simbolicamente no Novo Testamento para representar o poder mundial opressor e corrupto. 1. A cidade histórica da Babilônia (Mt 1.11). | 2. Símbolo profético do império mundial apoplético e hostil a Deus (Ap 14.8).
THAYER.en: The ancient and famous capital of Babylon, used symbolically in the New Testament to represent oppressive and corrupt world power. 1. The historical city of Babylon (Mt 1:11). | 2. A prophetic symbol of the world empire hostile to God (Rev 14:8).

DEFINITION: Originally designates a step of a staircase and, by metaphorical extension, a position, stage, or level of spiritual or social progress.
SENSES: 1. A physical step or landing of a staircase (Acts 12:10).
2. A stage of progress, a position of honor, or spiritual maturity (1 Tim 3:13).

THAYER.pt: Designa originariamente um degrau de escada e, por extensão metafórica, uma posição, estágio ou nível de progresso espiritual ou social. 1. Degrau físico ou patamar de uma escada (At 12.10). | 2. Estágio de progresso, posição de honra ou maturidade espiritual (1Tm 3.13).
THAYER.en: Originally designates a step of a staircase and, by metaphorical extension, a position, stage, or level of spiritual or social progress. 1. A physical step or landing of a staircase (Acts 12:10). | 2. A stage of progress, a position of honor, or spiritual maturity (1 Tim 3:13).

DEFINITION: The vertical distance or space from a surface downward, or, figuratively, the unfathomable immensity of spiritual realities.
SENSES: 1. The physical depth of a place below the surface (Mt 13:5; Lk 5:4).
2. The immensity or unfathomable depth of divine wisdom, riches, or mysteries (Rom 11:33; Eph 3:18).

THAYER.pt: A distância ou espaço vertical de uma superfície para baixo, ou, figuradamente, a imensidão insondável de realidades espirituais. 1. A profundidade física de um lugar abaixo da superfície (Mt 13.5; Lc 5.4). | 2. A imensidão ou profundidade insondável de sabedoria, riquezas ou mistérios divinos (Rm 11.33; Ef 3.18).
THAYER.en: The vertical distance or space from a surface downward, or, figuratively, the unfathomable immensity of spiritual realities. 1. The physical depth of a place below the surface (Mt 13:5; Lk 5:4). | 2. The immensity or unfathomable depth of divine wisdom, riches, or mysteries (Rom 11:33; Eph 3:18).

DEFINITION: To cause something to become deep or to dig deep to reach lower layers.
SENSES: 1. To deepen or dig deep into the earth to establish solid foundations (Lk 6:48).

THAYER.pt: Fazer com que algo se torne profundo ou cavar fundo para atingir camadas mais inferiores. 1. Aprofundar ou cavar fundo na terra para estabelecer bases sólidas (Lc 6.48).
THAYER.en: To cause something to become deep or to dig deep to reach lower layers. 1. To deepen or dig deep into the earth to establish solid foundations (Lk 6:48).

DEFINITION: Extending far below the physical surface or reaching an extreme degree of intensity or temporal extent.
SENSES: 1. Great physical depth, as in wells (Jn 4:11).
2. Deep intensity or deep mysteries (Rev 2:24).
3. An advanced moment of the day or night, such as daybreak (Lk 24:1; Acts 20:9).

THAYER.pt: Que se estende profundamente abaixo da superfície física ou que atinge um grau extremo de intensidade ou extensão temporal. 1. Grande profundidade física, como em poços (Jo 4.11). | 2. Intensidade profunda ou mistérios profundos (Ap 2.24). | 3. Momento avançado do dia ou da noite, como o romper do dia (Lc 24.1; At 20.9).
THAYER.en: Extending far below the physical surface or reaching an extreme degree of intensity or temporal extent. 1. Great physical depth, as in wells (Jn 4:11). | 2. Deep intensity or deep mysteries (Rev 2:24). | 3. An advanced moment of the day or night, such as daybreak (Lk 24:1; Acts 20:9).

DEFINITION: A small branch or leaf of a palm tree, used festively in processions and triumphal receptions.
SENSES: 1. A palm branch cut for a festive reception (Jn 12:13).

THAYER.pt: Pequeno ramo ou folha de palmeira, utilizado festivamente em procissões e recepções triunfais. 1. Ramo de palmeira cortado para a recepção festiva (Jo 12.13).
THAYER.en: A small branch or leaf of a palm tree, used festively in processions and triumphal receptions. 1. A palm branch cut for a festive reception (Jn 12:13).

DEFINITION: Name of the Old Testament prophet frequently portrayed in the NT as a symbol of greed and false teaching.
SENSES: 1. Balaam, a seer and prophet associated with apostasy and spiritual deception (2 Pet 2:15; Jude 11; Rev 2:14).

THAYER.pt: Nome do profeta do Antigo Testamento frequentemente retratado no NT como símbolo de ganância e falso ensino. 1. Balaão, vidente e profeta associado à apostasia e ao engano espiritual (2Pe 2.15; Jd 11; Ap 2.14).
THAYER.en: Name of the Old Testament prophet frequently portrayed in the NT as a symbol of greed and false teaching. 1. Balaam, a seer and prophet associated with apostasy and spiritual deception (2 Pet 2:15; Jude 11; Rev 2:14).

DEFINITION: Name of an ancient king of the Moabites who attempted to hire the prophet Balaam to curse the Israelites.
SENSES: 1. Balak, king of Moab during the Exodus period (Rev 2:14).

THAYER.pt: Nome de um antigo rei dos moabitas que tentou contratar o profeta Balaão para amaldiçoar os israelitas. 1. Balaque, rei de Moabe no período do Êxodo (Ap 2.14).
THAYER.en: Name of an ancient king of the Moabites who attempted to hire the prophet Balaam to curse the Israelites. 1. Balak, king of Moab during the Exodus period (Rev 2:14).

DEFINITION: A small bag or sack used to store coins and money.
SENSES: 1. A purse for storing money or coins (Lk 10:4; Lk 12:33).

THAYER.pt: Pequena bolsa ou saco usado para guardar moedas e dinheiro. 1. Bolsa para guardar dinheiro ou moedas (Lc 10.4; Lc 12.33).
THAYER.en: A small bag or sack used to store coins and money. 1. A purse for storing money or coins (Lk 10:4; Lk 12:33).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: βαλῶ, Aor: ἔβαλον, Perf: βέβληκα, Pass Aor: ἐβλήθην
DEFINITION: To move something through space using impulsive force, to hurl, or simply to place and deposit in a specific location.
SENSES: 1. To hurl with force, to throw, to cast (Mt 3:10; Jn 8:7; Rev 12:9).
2. To place, deposit, or pour something into a location (Mt 9:17; Lk 13:8; Jn 13:5).

THAYER.pt: Mover algo pelo espaço através do uso de força impulsiva, arremessar ou simplesmente colocar e depositar em determinado lugar. 1. Arremessar com força, atirar, lançar (Mt 3.10; Jo 8.7; Ap 12.9). | 2. Colocar, depositar ou despejar algo em um local (Mt 9.17; Lc 13.8; Jo 13.5).
THAYER.en: To move something through space using impulsive force, to hurl, or simply to place and deposit in a specific location. 1. To hurl with force, to throw, to cast (Mt 3:10; Jn 8:7; Rev 12:9). | 2. To place, deposit, or pour something into a location (Mt 9:17; Lk 13:8; Jn 13:5).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: βαπτίσω, Aor: ἐβάπτισα, PerfPass: βεβάπτισμαι
DEFINITION: To immerse, dip, or wash; in the New Testament, it designates the sacred rite of purification, conversion, and incorporation into the community of the Messiah through water or the Spirit.
SENSES: 1. To wash ceremonially for the purpose of ritual purification (Mk 7:4; Lk 11:38).
2. To administer the sacrament or ordinance of water baptism (Mt 3:13-16; Mt 28:19; Acts 2:38).
3. Baptism in the Holy Spirit as a supernatural endowment (Mt 3:11; Acts 1:5).
4. A metaphor for submersion in deep suffering (Mk 10:38-39; Lk 12:50).

THAYER.pt: Imergir, mergulhar ou lavar; no Novo Testamento, designa o rito sagrado de purificação, conversão e incorporação à comunidade do Messias mediante a água ou o Espírito. 1. Lavar cerimonialmente com fins de purificação ritual (Mc 7.4; Lc 11.38). | 2. Administrar o sacramento ou ordenança do batismo em água (Mt 3.13-16; Mt 28.19; At 2.38). | 3. Batismo no Espírito Santo como revestimento sobrenatural (Mt 3.11; At 1.5). | 4. Metáfora de submersão em sofrimentos profundos (Mc 10.38-39; Lc 12.50).
THAYER.en: To immerse, dip, or wash; in the New Testament, it designates the sacred rite of purification, conversion, and incorporation into the community of the Messiah through water or the Spirit. 1. To wash ceremonially for the purpose of ritual purification (Mk 7:4; Lk 11:38). | 2. To administer the sacrament or ordinance of water baptism (Mt 3:13-16; Mt 28:19; Acts 2:38). | 3. Baptism in the Holy Spirit as a supernatural endowment (Mt 3:11; Acts 1:5). | 4. A metaphor for submersion in deep suffering (Mk 10:38-39; Lk 12:50).

DEFINITION: The sacred rite of immersion in water that symbolizes spiritual purification, repentance, and identification with a community of faith or with Christ himself.
SENSES: 1. The baptism of repentance administered by John the Baptist (Mk 1:4).
2. The rite of Christian initiation and identification with the death and resurrection of Christ (Rom 6:4).
3. A metaphorical sense to describe overwhelming suffering or extreme trial (Mk 10:38).

THAYER.pt: O rito sagrado da imersão em água que simboliza purificação espiritual, arrependimento e identificação com uma comunidade de fé ou com o próprio Cristo. 1. O batismo de arrependimento administrado por João Batista (Mc 1.4). | 2. O rito de iniciação cristã e identificação com a morte e ressurreição de Cristo (Rm 6.4). | 3. Sentido metafórico para descrever um sofrimento avassalador ou provação extrema (Mc 10.38).
THAYER.en: The sacred rite of immersion in water that symbolizes spiritual purification, repentance, and identification with a community of faith or with Christ himself. 1.
