The baptism of repentance administered by John the Baptist (Mk 1:4). | 2. The rite of Christian initiation and identification with the death and resurrection of Christ (Rom 6:4). | 3. A metaphorical sense to describe overwhelming suffering or extreme trial (Mk 10:38).

DEFINITION: The act of immersion or ablution with water for the purpose of ritual purification, consecration, or spiritual renewal.
SENSES: 1. Ritual washing of utensils or the body (Mk 7:4).
2. The rite of baptism and initiation into the Christian faith (Heb 6:2).

THAYER.pt: Ato de imersão ou ablução com água para fins de purificação ritual, consagração ou renovação espiritual. 1. Lavagem ritual de utensílios ou do corpo (Mc 7.4). | 2. Rito de batismo e iniciação na fé cristã (Hb 6.2).
THAYER.en: The act of immersion or ablution with water for the purpose of ritual purification, consecration, or spiritual renewal. 1. Ritual washing of utensils or the body (Mk 7:4). | 2. The rite of baptism and initiation into the Christian faith (Heb 6:2).

DEFINITION: One who performs the act of baptizing; a distinctive title associated specifically with John, the precursor of Jesus.
SENSES: 1. The Baptizer, an epithet for John the Baptist (Mt 3:1; 14:2).

THAYER.pt: Aquele que realiza o ato de batizar; título distintivo associado especificamente a João, o precursor de Jesus. 1. O Batizador, epíteto de João Batista (Mt 3.1; 14.2).
THAYER.en: One who performs the act of baptizing; a distinctive title associated specifically with John, the precursor of Jesus. 1. The Baptizer, an epithet for John the Baptist (Mt 3:1; 14:2).

DEFINITION: The act of submerging or dipping an object into a liquid, whether to dye it or to collect substances.
SENSES: 1. To dip something into a liquid (Jn 13:26; Lk 16:24; Rev 19:13).

THAYER.pt: Ato de submergir ou mergulhar um objeto em um líquido, seja para tingir, seja para recolher substâncias. 1. Mergulhar algo em um líquido (Jo 13.26; Lc 16.24; Ap 19.13).
THAYER.en: The act of submerging or dipping an object into a liquid, whether to dye it or to collect substances. 1. To dip something into a liquid (Jn 13:26; Lk 16:24; Rev 19:13).

DEFINITION: The proper name of a Jewish revolutionary prisoner who was released by Pontius Pilate in place of Jesus Christ during Passover.
SENSES: 1. The prisoner and insurrectionist released by the crowd instead of Jesus (Mt 27:17; Jn 18:40).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio de um prisioneiro judeu revolucionário que foi solto por Pôncio Pilatos em lugar de Jesus Cristo durante a Páscoa. 1. O prisioneiro e insurrecionista solto pela multidão em vez de Jesus (Mt 27.17; Jo 18.40).
THAYER.en: The proper name of a Jewish revolutionary prisoner who was released by Pontius Pilate in place of Jesus Christ during Passover. 1. The prisoner and insurrectionist released by the crowd instead of Jesus (Mt 27:17; Jn 18:40).

DEFINITION: Name of an Israelite military commander from the period of the Judges who led the victory against Sisera alongside Deborah.
SENSES: 1. Barak, an Israelite general and hero of faith (Heb 11:32).

THAYER.pt: Nome de um comandante militar israelita do período dos Juízes que liderou a vitória contra Sísera ao lado de Débora. 1. Baraque, general israelita e herói da fé (Hb 11.32).
THAYER.en: Name of an Israelite military commander from the period of the Judges who led the victory against Sisera alongside Deborah. 1. Barak, an Israelite general and hero of faith (Heb 11:32).

DEFINITION: A Hebrew masculine proper name meaning 'the Lord blesses,' identified as the father of a prophet or martyr mentioned in the Gospels.
SENSES: 1. Berechiah, father of Zechariah (Mt 23:35).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio masculino hebraico que significa 'o Senhor abençoa', identificado como pai de um profeta ou mártir mencionado nos Evangelhos. 1. Baraquias, pai de Zacarias (Mt 23.35).
THAYER.en: A Hebrew masculine proper name meaning 'the Lord blesses,' identified as the father of a prophet or martyr mentioned in the Gospels. 1. Berechiah, father of Zechariah (Mt 23:35).

DEFINITION: Originally designates someone who does not speak Greek or participate in Hellenic culture, being viewed by them as a foreigner or uncivilized.
SENSES: 1. One who speaks an incomprehensible or foreign language (1 Cor 14:11).
2. One who does not belong to Greco-Roman culture, a foreigner (Rom 1:14).

THAYER.pt: Designa originalmente alguém que não fala grego ou não participa da cultura helênica, sendo visto por estes como estrangeiro ou incivilizado. 1. Que fala uma língua incompreensível ou estrangeira (1Co 14:11). | 2. Aquele que não pertence à cultura greco-romana, estrangeiro (Rm 1:14).
THAYER.en: Originally designates someone who does not speak Greek or participate in Hellenic culture, being viewed by them as a foreigner or uncivilized. 1. One who speaks an incomprehensible or foreign language (1 Cor 14:11). | 2. One who does not belong to Greco-Roman culture, a foreigner (Rom 1:14).

DEFINITION: Indicates the action of pressing down as if with a great weight, overloading someone physically, mentally, or spiritually.
SENSES: 1. To physically overload or cause fatigue (Mt 26:43; Lk 9:32).
2. Mental or emotional oppression (Lk 21:34; 2 Cor 1:8).

THAYER.pt: Indica a ação de pressionar para baixo como se fosse com um grande peso, sobrecarregando física, mental ou espiritualmente. 1. Sobrecarregar fisicamente ou causar fadiga (Mt 26:43; Lc 9:32). | 2. Opressão mental ou emocional (Lc 21:34; 2Co 1:8).
THAYER.en: Indicates the action of pressing down as if with a great weight, overloading someone physically, mentally, or spiritually. 1. To physically overload or cause fatigue (Mt 26:43; Lk 9:32). | 2. Mental or emotional oppression (Lk 21:34; 2 Cor 1:8).

DEFINITION: An adverb that describes the painful or difficult manner of performing an action, especially hearing or understanding.
SENSES: 1. To hear with difficulty or spiritual apathy (Mt 13:15).

THAYER.pt: Advérbio que descreve a maneira penosa ou dificultosa de realizar uma ação, especialmente a audição ou compreensão. 1. Ouvir com dificuldade ou apatia espiritual (Mt 13.15).
THAYER.en: An adverb that describes the painful or difficult manner of performing an action, especially hearing or understanding. 1. To hear with difficulty or spiritual apathy (Mt 13:15).

DEFINITION: Name of one of the twelve apostles chosen by Jesus, frequently associated with Philip in the synoptic gospels.
SENSES: 1. Bartholomew, one of the twelve apostles of Christ (Mt 10:3).

THAYER.pt: Nome de um dos doze apóstolos escolhidos por Jesus, frequentemente associado a Filipe nos evangelhos sinóticos. 1. Bartolomeu, um dos doze apóstolos de Cristo (Mt 10.3).
THAYER.en: Name of one of the twelve apostles chosen by Jesus, frequently associated with Philip in the synoptic gospels. 1. Bartholomew, one of the twelve apostles of Christ (Mt 10:3).

DEFINITION: An Aramaic name meaning 'son of Jesus,' applied to a Jewish false prophet and magician in Cyprus.
SENSES: 1. Bar-Jesus, also known as Elymas the magician (Acts 13:6).

THAYER.pt: Nome aramaico que significa 'filho de Jesus', aplicado a um falso profeta judeu e mágico em Chipre. 1. Bar-Jesus, também conhecido como Elimas, o mago (At 13.6).
THAYER.en: An Aramaic name meaning 'son of Jesus,' applied to a Jewish false prophet and magician in Cyprus. 1. Bar-Jesus, also known as Elymas the magician (Acts 13:6).

DEFINITION: An Aramaic patronymic meaning 'son of Jonah,' a title or surname given to Simon Peter.
SENSES: 1. Bar-Jonah, a patronymic designation for Simon Peter (Matt 16:17).

THAYER.pt: Patronímico aramaico que significa 'filho de Jonas', título ou sobrenome dado a Simão Pedro. 1. Bar-jonas, designação patronímica de Simão Pedro (Mt 16.17).
THAYER.en: An Aramaic patronymic meaning 'son of Jonah,' a title or surname given to Simon Peter. 1. Bar-Jonah, a patronymic designation for Simon Peter (Matt 16:17).

DEFINITION: Barnabas, a Levite Jew from Cyprus and missionary companion of the apostle Paul, whose name means 'son of encouragement'.
SENSES: 1. The apostolic co-worker Barnabas (Acts 4:36; 13:2).

THAYER.pt: Barnabé, judeu levita originário de Chipre, companheiro missionário do apóstolo Paulo, cujo nome significa 'filho da consolação'. 1. O cooperador apostólico Barnabé (At 4:36; 13:2).
THAYER.en: Barnabas, a Levite Jew from Cyprus and missionary companion of the apostle Paul, whose name means 'son of encouragement'. 1. The apostolic co-worker Barnabas (Acts 4:36; 13:2).

DEFINITION: Refers to a physical weight or an oppressive, heavy load that causes difficulty and exhaustion; it can also denote importance or authority.
SENSES: 1. A burden or oppressive difficulty (Matt 20:12; Gal 6:2).
2. Importance or authority exercised (1 Thess 2:7).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se a um peso físico ou a uma carga pesada e opressiva que causa dificuldade e exaustão, podendo também denotar importância ou autoridade. 1. Fardo ou dificuldade opressiva (Mt 20:12; Gl 6:2). | 2. Importância ou autoridade exercida (1Ts 2:7).
THAYER.en: Refers to a physical weight or an oppressive, heavy load that causes difficulty and exhaustion; it can also denote importance or authority. 1. A burden or oppressive difficulty (Matt 20:12; Gal 6:2). | 2. Importance or authority exercised (1 Thess 2:7).

DEFINITION: A Hebrew/Aramaic surname or cognomen attributed to certain disciples in the apostolic period.
SENSES: 1. Joseph, called Barsabbas, a candidate for the apostleship (Acts 1:23).
2. Judas, surnamed Barsabbas, a prophet and church leader (Acts 15:22).

THAYER.pt: Sobrenome ou cognome hebraico/aramaico atribuído a certos discípulos no período apostólico. 1. José, chamado Barsabás, candidato ao apostolado (At 1.23). | 2. Judas, cognominado Barsabás, profeta e líder da igreja (At 15.22).
THAYER.en: A Hebrew/Aramaic surname or cognomen attributed to certain disciples in the apostolic period. 1. Joseph, called Barsabbas, a candidate for the apostleship (Acts 1:23). | 2. Judas, surnamed Barsabbas, a prophet and church leader (Acts 15:22).

DEFINITION: A proper name meaning 'son of Timaeus,' attributed to a blind beggar healed by Jesus in Jericho.
SENSES: 1. Bartimaeus, the blind man of Jericho (Mark 10:46).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio que significa 'filho de Timeu', atribuído a um mendigo cego curado por Jesus em Jericó. 1. Bartimeu, o cego de Jericó (Mc 10.46).
THAYER.en: A proper name meaning 'son of Timaeus,' attributed to a blind beggar healed by Jesus in Jericho. 1. Bartimaeus, the blind man of Jericho (Mark 10:46).

DEFINITION: To cause fatigue or oppression through physical or moral weight, weighing down upon someone.
SENSES: 1. To burden or cause dejection through excessive weight (Acts 3:14).

THAYER.pt: Causar fadiga ou opressão através do peso físico ou moral, pesando sobre alguém. 1. Sobrecarregar ou causar abatimento por meio de peso excessivo (At 3.14).
THAYER.en: To cause fatigue or oppression through physical or moral weight, weighing down upon someone. 1. To burden or cause dejection through excessive weight (Acts 3:14).

DEFINITION: Describes that which is heavy, whether literally or figuratively, imposing severe demands, difficulties, or appearing rigorous and important.
SENSES: 1. Heavy or rigorous in terms of rules and commandments (Matt 23:4).
2. Severe, grave, or difficult to endure (Acts 20:9; 2 Cor 10:10).

THAYER.pt: Descreve aquilo que é pesado, seja de forma literal ou figurada, impondo exigências severas, dificuldades ou mostrando-se rigoroso e importante. 1. Pesado ou rigoroso em termos de regras e mandamentos (Mt 23:4). | 2. Severo, grave ou de difícil suportar (At 20:9; 2Co 10:10).
THAYER.en: Describes that which is heavy, whether literally or figuratively, imposing severe demands, difficulties, or appearing rigorous and important. 1. Heavy or rigorous in terms of rules and commandments (Matt 23:4). | 2. Severe, grave, or difficult to endure (Acts 20:9; 2 Cor 10:10).

DEFINITION: Describes something that possesses extremely high financial value, being very costly or precious.
SENSES: 1. Of great economic value or estimated price, such as high-cost perfume (Matt 26:7).

THAYER.pt: Descreve algo que possui altíssimo valor financeiro, sendo extremamente custoso ou precioso. 1. De grande valor econômico ou estimado preço, como um perfume de alto custo (Mt 26.7).
THAYER.en: Describes something that possesses extremely high financial value, being very costly or precious. 1. Of great economic value or estimated price, such as high-cost perfume (Matt 26:7).

DEFINITION: To subject someone to severe physical, mental, or judicial suffering, whether through torture, acute illness, or deep anguish.
SENSES: 1. To subject to severe physical punishment or torture (Matt 18:34).
2. To cause great affliction, torment, or suffering through illness or storm (Matt 8:6; 14:24).

THAYER.pt: Submeter alguém a severo sofrimento físico, mental ou judicial, seja por meio de tortura, doenças agudas ou angústia profunda. 1. Submeter a castigo físico severo ou tortura (Mt 18.34). | 2. Causar grande aflição, tormento ou sofrimento por doença ou tempestade (Mt 8.6; 14.24).
THAYER.en: To subject someone to severe physical, mental, or judicial suffering, whether through torture, acute illness, or deep anguish. 1. To subject to severe physical punishment or torture (Matt 18:34). | 2. To cause great affliction, torment, or suffering through illness or storm (Matt 8:6; 14:24).

DEFINITION: Refers to the act of inflicting severe suffering, extreme pain associated with torture, or intense punishment.
SENSES: 1. Infliction of extreme pain or severe punishment (Rev 9:5; 18:10).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se ao ato de infligir sofrimento severo, dor extrema associada a tortura ou punição intensa. 1. Inflição de dor extrema ou castigo severo (Ap 9:5; Ap 18:10).
THAYER.en: Refers to the act of inflicting severe suffering, extreme pain associated with torture, or intense punishment. 1. Infliction of extreme pain or severe punishment (Rev 9:5; 18:10).

DEFINITION: A prison guard or executioner whose official duties included inflicting physical punishment and torture on prisoners.
SENSES: 1. An executioner or jailer charged with torturing debtors or prisoners (Matt 18:34).

THAYER.pt: Guarda de prisão ou carrasco cuja função oficial incluía infligir castigos físicos e tortura a prisioneiros. 1. Verdugo ou carcereiro encarregado de torturar devedores ou prisioneiros (Mt 18.34).
THAYER.en: A prison guard or executioner whose official duties included inflicting physical punishment and torture on prisoners. 1. An executioner or jailer charged with torturing debtors or prisoners (Matt 18:34).

DEFINITION: Severe and intense pain resulting from corporal punishment, torture, or extremely oppressive conditions.
SENSES: 1. Severe physical suffering resulting from torture or punishment (Luke 16:23, 28).
2. Intense pain or affliction of any nature (Matt 4:24).

THAYER.pt: Dor severa e intensa resultante de castigos corporais, tortura ou condições extremamente opressivas. 1. Sofrimento físico severo decorrente de tortura ou castigo (Lc 16.23, 28). | 2. Dor ou aflição intensa de qualquer natureza (Mt 4.24).
THAYER.en: Severe and intense pain resulting from corporal punishment, torture, or extremely oppressive conditions. 1. Severe physical suffering resulting from torture or punishment (Luke 16:23, 28). | 2. Intense pain or affliction of any nature (Matt 4:24).

DEFINITION: Primarily denotes sovereign authority, royal dignity, and the power to reign rather than the territory under control. The 'Kingdom of God' fundamentally expresses the dynamic implementation of the salvific government and divine sovereignty inaugurated by Jesus.
SENSES: 1. Royal sovereignty, authority, and the dynamic exercise of governing power (Luke 19:12; Rev 17:18).
2. The eschatological salvific domain of God ('Kingdom of God/Heaven') (Matt 3:2; 6:33; Mark 1:15).
3. Territorial domain under the jurisdiction of a monarch (Matt 4:8; Mark 6:23).

THAYER.pt: Denota primariamente a autoridade soberana, dignidade régia e poder de reinar antes do que o território sob controle. O 'Reino de Deus' expressa fundamentalmente a implantação dinâmica do governo salvífico e da soberania divina inaugurados por Jesus. 1. Soberania régia, autoridade e exercício dinâmico de poder governante (Lc 19.12; Ap 17.18). | 2. O domínio salvífico escatológico de Deus ('Reino de Deus/dos Céus') (Mt 3.2; Mt 6.33; Mc 1.15). | 3. Domínio territorial sob a jurisdição de um monarca (Mt 4.8; Mc 6.23).
THAYER.en: Primarily denotes sovereign authority, royal dignity, and the power to reign rather than the territory under control. The 'Kingdom of God' fundamentally expresses the dynamic implementation of the salvific government and divine sovereignty inaugurated by Jesus. 1. Royal sovereignty, authority, and the dynamic exercise of governing power (Luke 19:12; Rev 17:18). | 2. The eschatological salvific domain of God ('Kingdom of God/Heaven') (Matt 3:2; 6:33; Mark 1:15). | 3. Territorial domain under the jurisdiction of a monarch (Matt 4:8; Mark 6:23).

DEFINITION: The official dwelling or palace where a king, monarch, or supreme ruler resides.
SENSES: 1. The royal dwelling or palace of a sovereign.

THAYER.pt: A moradia oficial ou palácio onde habita um rei, monarca ou governante supremo. 1. A habitação ou o palácio real de um soberano.
THAYER.en: The official dwelling or palace where a king, monarch, or supreme ruler resides. 1. The royal dwelling or palace of a sovereign.

DEFINITION: Belonging or relating to a king; also used in the neuter plural to designate the royal palace.
SENSES: 1. Belonging to a king, with royal dignity (1 Pet 2:9).

THAYER.pt: Pertencente ou relativo a um rei; usado também no plural neutro para designar o palácio real. 1. Que pertence a um rei, com dignidade régia (1Pe 2.9).
THAYER.en: Belonging or relating to a king; also used in the neuter plural to designate the royal palace. 1. Belonging to a king, with royal dignity (1 Pet 2:9).

DEFINITION: One who exercises royal or supreme authority over a kingdom; widely used for God and the Messiah as the supreme and eschatological Sovereign.
SENSES: 1. Monarch, earthly sovereign endowed with leadership over a nation or empire (Matt 2:1; 17:25; 1 Pet 2:17).
2. Christ as the promised King of the Davidic line and Lord of the universe (Matt 2:2; John 18:37; Rev 19:16).
3. The transcendent and Almighty God (1 Tim 1:17; 6:15).

THAYER.pt: Aquele que exerce autoridade régia ou suprema sobre um reino; amplamente empregado para Deus e para o Messias como o Soberano supremo e escatológico. 1. Monarca, soberano terreno dotado de liderança sobre uma nação ou império (Mt 2.1; 17.25; 1Pe 2.17). | 2. Cristo como o Rei prometido da linhagem davídica e Senhor do universo (Mt 2.2; Jo 18.37; Ap 19.16). | 3. O Deus transcendente e Todo-Poderoso (1Tm 1.17; 6.15).
THAYER.en: One who exercises royal or supreme authority over a kingdom; widely used for God and the Messiah as the supreme and eschatological Sovereign. 1. Monarch, earthly sovereign endowed with leadership over a nation or empire (Matt 2:1; 17:25; 1 Pet 2:17). | 2. Christ as the promised King of the Davidic line and Lord of the universe (Matt 2:2; John 18:37; Rev 19:16). | 3. The transcendent and Almighty God (1 Tim 1:17; 6:15).

DEFINITION: To exercise sovereign authority as a king or supreme ruler; used both for earthly monarchs and, in the NT, for the reign of God and the figurative dominion of sin or grace.
SENSES: 1. To exercise government as a sovereign king (Matt 2:22; Rev 11:17).
2. In a figurative sense, to exercise moral or spiritual dominion, such as sin or grace (Rom 5:14, 21).

THAYER.pt: Exercer autoridade soberana como rei ou governante supremo, usado tanto para monarcas terrenos quanto, no NT, para o reinado de Deus e o domínio figurado do pecado ou da graça. 1. Exercer o governo como rei soberano (Mt 2.22; Ap 11.17). | 2. Em sentido figurado, exercer domínio moral ou espiritual, como o pecado ou a graça (Rm 5.14, 21).
THAYER.en: To exercise sovereign authority as a king or supreme ruler; used both for earthly monarchs and, in the NT, for the reign of God and the figurative dominion of sin or grace. 1. To exercise government as a sovereign king (Matt 2:22; Rev 11:17). | 2. In a figurative sense, to exercise moral or spiritual dominion, such as sin or grace (Rom 5:14, 21).

DEFINITION: Belonging to a king, or possessing royal dignity and authority derived from the crown.
SENSES: 1. Relating to a monarch or royal court (Acts 12:21; Jas 2:8).
2. Official or courtier in the service of a king (John 4:46).

THAYER.pt: Pertencente a um rei, ou que possui dignidade real e autoridade derivada da coroa. 1. Relativo a um monarca ou corte real (At 12.21; Tg 2.8). | 2. Oficial ou cortesão a serviço de um rei (Jo 4.46).
THAYER.en: Belonging to a king, or possessing royal dignity and authority derived from the crown. 1. Relating to a monarch or royal court (Acts 12:21; Jas 2:8). | 2. Official or courtier in the service of a king (John 4:46).

DEFINITION: A woman who exercises sovereign authority as a ruler or who holds the royal title alongside a monarch.
SENSES: 1. Sovereign or queen with governmental authority (Matt 12:42; Acts 8:27).

THAYER.pt: Mulher que exerce autoridade soberana como governante ou que detém o título real ao lado de um monarca. 1. Soberana ou rainha com autoridade governamental (Mt 12.42; At 8.27).
THAYER.en: A woman who exercises sovereign authority as a ruler or who holds the royal title alongside a monarch. 1. Sovereign or queen with governmental authority (Matt 12:42; Acts 8:27).

DEFINITION: The part of the body used for standing or walking, located below the ankle; the foot.
SENSES: 1. The sole of the foot or the human foot (Acts 3:7).

THAYER.pt: A parte do corpo com a qual se pisa, situada abaixo do tornozelo; o pé. 1. A planta do pé ou o pé humano (At 3.7).
THAYER.en: The part of the body used for standing or walking, located below the ankle; the foot. 1. The sole of the foot or the human foot (Acts 3:7).

DEFINITION: To exert malevolent influence through sorcery, the evil eye, or to seduce someone with cunning deception.
SENSES: 1. To practice sorcery or bewitch someone with spiritual deception (Gal 3:1).

THAYER.pt: Exercer influência maléfica por meio de feitiço, olhar maligno ou seduzir alguém com engano astuto. 1. Praticar feitiçaria ou enfeitiçar alguém com engano espiritual (Gl 3.1).
THAYER.en: To exert malevolent influence through sorcery, the evil eye, or to seduce someone with cunning deception. 1. To practice sorcery or bewitch someone with spiritual deception (Gal 3:1).

DEFINITION: To physically lift an object or sustain the weight of a burden, with metaphorical extensions for bearing trials and afflictions.
SENSES: 1. To physically lift or raise something to a higher position (John 10:31).
2. To carry a burden or endure painful circumstances and sufferings (Luke 14:27).
3. To remove or carry something away (John 20:15).

THAYER.pt: Erguer fisicamente um objeto ou sustentar o peso de um fardo, com extensões metafóricas para a suportação de provações e aflições. 1. Levantar ou erguer fisicamente algo para uma posição mais alta (Jo 10.31). | 2. Carregar um fardo ou suportar circunstâncias penosas e sofrimentos (Lc 14.27). | 3. Remover ou carregar algo para longe (Jo 20.15).
THAYER.en: To physically lift an object or sustain the weight of a burden, with metaphorical extensions for bearing trials and afflictions. 1. To physically lift or raise something to a higher position (John 10:31). | 2. To carry a burden or endure painful circumstances and sufferings (Luke 14:27). | 3. To remove or carry something away (John 20:15).

DEFINITION: A term designating both a thorny shrub and an ancient Hebrew unit of liquid measure.
SENSES: 1. A thorny shrub, bramble (Luke 20:37).
2. A unit of liquid measure, the bath (Luke 16:6).

THAYER.pt: Termo que designa tanto um arbusto espinhoso quanto uma antiga unidade de medida hebraica para líquidos. 1. Arbusto espinhoso, sarça (Lc 20.37). | 2. Unidade de medida de líquidos, o bato (Lc 16.6).
THAYER.en: A term designating both a thorny shrub and an ancient Hebrew unit of liquid measure. 1. A thorny shrub, bramble (Luke 20:37). | 2. A unit of liquid measure, the bath (Luke 16:6).

DEFINITION: A term with two meanings in the NT: a thorny plant (bramble) or an ancient Hebrew unit of liquid measure.
SENSES: 1. A thorny shrub or bramble (Luke 20:37).
2. A unit of capacity for liquids, equivalent to about 35 liters (Luke 16:6).

THAYER.pt: Termo com dois significados no NT: uma planta espinhosa (sarça) ou uma antiga unidade de medida hebraica para líquidos. 1. Arbusto espinhoso ou sarça (Lc 20.37). | 2. Unidade de medida de capacidade para líquidos, equivalente a cerca de 35 litros (Lc 16.6).
THAYER.en: A term with two meanings in the NT: a thorny plant (bramble) or an ancient Hebrew unit of liquid measure. 1. A thorny shrub or bramble (Luke 20:37). | 2. A unit of capacity for liquids, equivalent to about 35 liters (Luke 16:6).

DEFINITION: An anuran amphibian, mentioned in apocalyptic contexts as a symbol of spiritual impurity.
SENSES: 1. A frog, associated with visions of unclean spirits (Rev 16:13).

THAYER.pt: Animal anfíbio anuro, mencionado em contextos apocalípticos como símbolo de impureza espiritual. 1. Rã, associada a visões de espíritos impuros (Ap 16.13).
THAYER.en: An anuran amphibian, mentioned in apocalyptic contexts as a symbol of spiritual impurity. 1. A frog, associated with visions of unclean spirits (Rev 16:13).

DEFINITION: To multiply meaningless words or repeat mechanical and empty formulas in prayer.
SENSES: 1. To use vain repetitions or babble mechanically in prayers (Matt 6:7).

THAYER.pt: Multiplicar palavras sem sentido ou repetir fórmulas mecânicas e vazias em orações. 1. Usar de repetições vãs ou tagarelar mecanicamente nas orações (Mt 6.7).
THAYER.en: To multiply meaningless words or repeat mechanical and empty formulas in prayer. 1. To use vain repetitions or babble mechanically in prayers (Matt 6:7).

DEFINITION: Designates something totally repugnant, filthy, or detestable that causes extreme repulsion and provokes divine wrath.
SENSES: 1. Something detestable and morally repugnant (Luke 16:15; Rev 17:4).
2. An abomination that profanes the sanctuary or dishonors God (Matt 24:15).

THAYER.pt: Designa algo totalmente repugnante, imundo ou detestável que causa repulsa extrema e suscita a ira divina. 1. Algo detestável e moralmente repugnante (Lc 16:15; Ap 17:4). | 2. Abominação que profana o santuário ou desonra a Deus (Mt 24:15).
THAYER.en: Designates something totally repugnant, filthy, or detestable that causes extreme repulsion and provokes divine wrath. 1. Something detestable and morally repugnant (Luke 16:15; Rev 17:4). | 2. An abomination that profanes the sanctuary or dishonors God (Matt 24:15).

DEFINITION: That which causes repulsion, aversion, or moral and religious abomination; worthy of total rejection.
SENSES: 1. Abominable, detestable, or repugnant before God (Titus 1:16).

THAYER.pt: Que causa repulsa, aversão ou abominação moral e religiosa; digno de total rejeição. 1. Abominável, detestável ou repugnante diante de Deus (Tt 1.16).
THAYER.en: That which causes repulsion, aversion, or moral and religious abomination; worthy of total rejection. 1. Abominable, detestable, or repugnant before God (Titus 1:16).

DEFINITION: To feel deep repugnance or moral aversion toward something considered detestable, filthy, or abominable.
SENSES: 1. To repudiate and detest the practice of idolatry and immorality (Rom 2:22).

THAYER.pt: Sentir profunda repugnância ou aversão moral por algo considerado detestável, imundo ou abominável. 1. Repudiar e detestar a prática de idolatria e imoralidade (Rm 2.22).
THAYER.en: To feel deep repugnance or moral aversion toward something considered detestable, filthy, or abominable. 1. To repudiate and detest the practice of idolatry and immorality (Rom 2:22).

DEFINITION: The quality of that which is firm, secure, reliable, and maintains its validity or efficacy over time without causing disappointment.
SENSES: 1. Reliable and firm, upon which one can depend (Heb 6:19; 2 Cor 1:7).
2. Constant and unshakable in terms of perseverance.
3. Legally valid and in force (Rom 4:16; Heb 9:17).

THAYER.pt: Qualidade daquilo que é firme, seguro, confiável e que mantém sua validade ou eficácia ao longo do tempo sem causar desapontamento. 1. Confiável e firme, do qual se pode depender (Hb 6.19; 2Co 1.7). | 2. Constante e inabalável em termos de perseverança. | 3. Legalmente válido e em vigor (Rm 4.16; Hb 9.17).
THAYER.en: The quality of that which is firm, secure, reliable, and maintains its validity or efficacy over time without causing disappointment. 1. Reliable and firm, upon which one can depend (Heb 6:19; 2 Cor 1:7). | 2. Constant and unshakable in terms of perseverance. | 3. Legally valid and in force (Rom 4:16; Heb 9:17).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: βεβαιώσω, Aor: ἐβεβαίωσα, Pass: ἐβεβαιώθην
DEFINITION: To make something firm, certain, or indubitable, ensuring its validity or strengthening someone's conviction.
SENSES: 1. To confirm or validate a promise, word, or event through evidence (Rom 15:8; Heb 2:3).
2. To strengthen or establish a person spiritually in their faith and commitment (1 Cor 1:8; Col 2:7).

THAYER.pt: Tornar algo firme, certo ou indubitável, garantindo sua validade ou fortalecendo a convicção de alguém. 1. Confirmar ou validar uma promessa, palavra ou evento por evidências (Rm 15.8; Hb 2.3). | 2. Fortalecer ou firmar espiritualmente uma pessoa em sua fé e compromisso (1Co 1.8; Cl 2.7).
THAYER.en: To make something firm, certain, or indubitable, ensuring its validity or strengthening someone's conviction. 1. To confirm or validate a promise, word, or event through evidence (Rom 15:8; Heb 2:3). | 2. To strengthen or establish a person spiritually in their faith and commitment (1 Cor 1:8; Col 2:7).

DEFINITION: The act or process of making firm, validating, or ratifying something, conferring upon it legal or spiritual certainty.
SENSES: 1. The legal and firm confirmation or defense of the gospel (Phil 1:7).
2. An oath as a final guarantee to put an end to disputes (Heb 6:16).

THAYER.pt: O ato ou processo de firmar, validar ou ratificar algo, conferindo-lhe certeza jurídica ou espiritual. 1. A confirmação ou defesa legal e firme do evangelho (Fp 1.7). | 2. O juramento como garantia final para pôr fim a litígios (Hb 6.16).
THAYER.en: The act or process of making firm, validating, or ratifying something, conferring upon it legal or spiritual certainty. 1. The legal and firm confirmation or defense of the gospel (Phil 1:7). | 2. An oath as a final guarantee to put an end to disputes (Heb 6:16).

DEFINITION: Lacking a sacred character, being entirely secular, worldly, or profane in opposition to that which is holy and consecrated to God.
SENSES: 1. Conversation or teaching without spiritual value, profane (1 Tim 4:7; 2 Tim 2:16).
2. A worldly person devoid of the fear of God (1 Tim 1:9; Heb 12:16).

THAYER.pt: Que carece de caráter sagrado, sendo inteiramente secular, mundano ou profano em oposição ao que é santo e consagrado a Deus. 1. Conversa ou ensinamento sem valor espiritual, profano (1Tm 4.7; 2Tm 2.16). | 2. Pessoa mundana e destituída de temor a Deus (1Tm 1.9; Hb 12.16).
THAYER.en: Lacking a sacred character, being entirely secular, worldly, or profane in opposition to that which is holy and consecrated to God. 1. Conversation or teaching without spiritual value, profane (1 Tim 4:7; 2 Tim 2:16). | 2. A worldly person devoid of the fear of God (1 Tim 1:9; Heb 12:16).

DEFINITION: To make common or impure that which is sacred, violating its holiness through disrespectful actions.
SENSES: 1. To profane the Sabbath by performing daily work (Matt 12:5).
2. To violate the holiness of the temple (Acts 24:6).

THAYER.pt: Tornar comum ou impuro aquilo que é sagrado, violando a sua santidade por meio de ações desrespeitosas. 1. Profanar o sábado ao realizar trabalhos cotidianos (Mt 12.5). | 2. Violar a santidade do templo (At 24.6).
THAYER.en: To make common or impure that which is sacred, violating its holiness through disrespectful actions. 1. To profane the Sabbath by performing daily work (Matt 12:5). | 2. To violate the holiness of the temple (Acts 24:6).

DEFINITION: An indeclinable proper name used in the New Testament as the prince of demons or another name for Satan.
SENSES: 1. The leader of hostile forces and demons (Matt 12:24; Mark 3:22).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio indeclinável utilizado no Novo Testamento como o príncipe dos demônios ou outro nome para Satanás. 1. O líder das forças hostis e dos demônios (Mt 12:24; Mc 3:22).
THAYER.en: An indeclinable proper name used in the New Testament as the prince of demons or another name for Satan. 1. The leader of hostile forces and demons (Matt 12:24; Mark 3:22).

DEFINITION: A name of Semitic origin used in the New Testament as a designation for the Devil or the Antichrist, representing absolute evil.
SENSES: 1. A term that personifies the power of darkness or Satan in opposition to Christ (2 Cor 6:15).

THAYER.pt: Nome de origem semítica usado no Novo Testamento como uma designação para o Diabo ou o Anticristo, representando o mal absoluto. 1. Termo que personifica o poder das trevas ou Satanás em oposição a Cristo (2Co 6:15).
THAYER.en: A name of Semitic origin used in the New Testament as a designation for the Devil or the Antichrist, representing absolute evil. 1. A term that personifies the power of darkness or Satan in opposition to Christ (2 Cor 6:15).

DEFINITION: Any projectile launched with a sharp point, such as an arrow fired by a bow or a dart thrown by hand.
SENSES: 1. The flaming darts of the evil one as a metaphor for spiritual attacks (Eph 6:16).

THAYER.pt: Qualquer projétil lançado com ponta afiada, como uma flecha disparada por arco ou um dardo arremessado à mão. 1. Os dardos inflamados do maligno como metáfora de ataques espirituais (Ef 6.16).
THAYER.en: Any projectile launched with a sharp point, such as an arrow fired by a bow or a dart thrown by hand. 1. The flaming darts of the evil one as a metaphor for spiritual attacks (Eph 6:16).

DEFINITION: A comparative term denoting something or someone that possesses greater excellence, quality, or benefit in relation to another.
SENSES: 1. That which is superior or much better in terms of benefit or help (2 Tim 1:18).

THAYER.pt: Termo comparativo que denota algo ou alguém que possui maior excelência, qualidade ou benefício em relação a outro. 1. Aquilo que é superior ou muito melhor em termos de benefício ou auxílio (2Tm 1:18).
THAYER.en: A comparative term denoting something or someone that possesses greater excellence, quality, or benefit in relation to another. 1. That which is superior or much better in terms of benefit or help (2 Tim 1:18).

DEFINITION: A Hebrew proper name referring to the youngest son of Jacob and patriarch of one of the tribes of Israel.
SENSES: 1. The patriarch Benjamin and the Israelite tribe descended from him (Phil 3:5; Rev 7:8).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio hebraico referente ao filho mais novo de Jacó e patriarca de uma das tribos de Israel. 1. O patriarca Benjamin e a tribo israelita descendente dele (Fp 3.5; Ap 7.8).
THAYER.en: A Hebrew proper name referring to the youngest son of Jacob and patriarch of one of the tribes of Israel. 1. The patriarch Benjamin and the Israelite tribe descended from him (Phil 3:5; Rev 7:8).

DEFINITION: A feminine proper name of a Herodian princess, daughter of Herod Agrippa I.
SENSES: 1. Bernice, sister of Herod Agrippa II, present at the accounts of Paul's trial (Acts 25:13, 23; 26:30).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio feminino de uma princesa herodiana, filha de Herodes Agripa I. 1. Berenice, irmã de Herodes Agripa II, presente nos relatos do julgamento de Paulo (At 25.13, 23; 26.30).
THAYER.en: A feminine proper name of a Herodian princess, daughter of Herod Agrippa I. 1. Bernice, sister of Herod Agrippa II, present at the accounts of Paul's trial (Acts 25:13, 23; 26:30).

DEFINITION: An ancient city in Macedonia situated at the foot of Mount Vermio, visited by the apostle Paul.
SENSES: 1. The city of Berea, whose inhabitants examined the Scriptures (Acts 17:10).

THAYER.pt: Antiga cidade da Macedônia situada aos pés do monte Vermio, visitada pelo apóstolo Paulo. 1. A cidade de Bereia, cujos habitantes examinaram as Escrituras (At 17.10).
THAYER.en: An ancient city in Macedonia situated at the foot of Mount Vermio, visited by the apostle Paul. 1. The city of Berea, whose inhabitants examined the Scriptures (Acts 17:10).

DEFINITION: A gentilic adjective indicating origin or provenance from the Macedonian city of Berea.
SENSES: 1. An inhabitant or native of the city of Berea (Acts 20:4).

THAYER.pt: Adjetivo gentílico que indica naturalidade ou procedência da cidade macedônia de Bereia. 1. Habitante ou natural da cidade de Bereia (At 20:4).
THAYER.en: A gentilic adjective indicating origin or provenance from the Macedonian city of Berea. 1. An inhabitant or native of the city of Berea (Acts 20:4).

DEFINITION: A toponym designating a location situated on the eastern bank of the Jordan River, associated with the ministry of John the Baptist.
SENSES: 1. Bethabara, a location east of the Jordan River (John 1:28).

THAYER.pt: Topônimo que designa uma localidade situada na margem oriental do rio Jordão, associada ao ministério de João Batista. 1. Betabara, localidade a leste do rio Jordão (Jo 1.28).
THAYER.en: A toponym designating a location situated on the eastern bank of the Jordan River, associated with the ministry of John the Baptist. 1. Bethabara, a location east of the Jordan River (John 1:28).

SENSES: 1. A village situated on the eastern slope of the Mount of Olives, home of Lazarus, Martha, and Mary (John 11:1).
2. A location in the region beyond the Jordan where John was baptizing (John 1:28).

THAYER.pt: Nome de duas localidades geográficas mencionadas nos Evangelhos: uma aldeia perto de Jerusalém e um local além do Jordão. 1. Aldeia situada na encosta oriental do Monte das Oliveiras, lar de Lázaro, Marta e Maria (Jo 11.1). | 2. Localidade na região além do Jordão onde João batizava (Jo 1.28).
THAYER.en: The name of two geographical locations mentioned in the Gospels: a village near Jerusalem and a place beyond the Jordan. 1. A village situated on the eastern slope of the Mount of Olives, home of Lazarus, Martha, and Mary (John 11:1). | 2. A location in the region beyond the Jordan where John was baptizing (John 1:28).

DEFINITION: The proper name of a pool in Jerusalem, known for being the setting of a miraculous healing performed by Jesus.
SENSES: 1. A pool in Jerusalem with five porticoes, associated with therapeutic properties (John 5:2).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio de um tanque ou piscina em Jerusalém, conhecido por ser o cenário de uma cura milagrosa realizada por Jesus. 1. Tanque em Jerusalém com cinco pórticos, associado a propriedades terapêuticas (Jo 5:2).
THAYER.en: The proper name of a pool in Jerusalem, known for being the setting of a miraculous healing performed by Jesus. 1. A pool in Jerusalem with five porticoes, associated with therapeutic properties (John 5:2).

DEFINITION: A city in Judea, historically associated with King David and famous for being the birthplace of the Messiah.
SENSES: 1. The city of Bethlehem in Judea, the birthplace of Jesus (Matthew 2:1, 5).

THAYER.en: A city in Judea, historically associated with King David and famous for being the birthplace of the Messiah. 1. The city of Bethlehem in Judea, the birthplace of Jesus (Matthew 2:1, 5).

DEFINITION: The name of a location situated north of the Sea of Galilee, associated with several events in the ministry of Jesus.
SENSES: 1. The hometown of several disciples and a site of miracles (John 1:44; Matthew 11:21).

THAYER.pt: Nome de uma localidade situada ao norte do Mar da Galileia, associada a vários eventos do ministério de Jesus. 1. Cidade natal de vários discípulos e local de milagres (Jo 1:44; Mt 11:21).
THAYER.en: The name of a location situated north of the Sea of Galilee, associated with several events in the ministry of Jesus. 1. The hometown of several disciples and a site of miracles (John 1:44; Matthew 11:21).

SENSES: 1. Bethphage, a village located in the vicinity of Jerusalem and Bethany (Matthew 21:1; Mark 11:1; Luke 19:29).

THAYER.en: The name of a small village situated on the Mount of Olives, near Jerusalem. 1. Bethphage, a village located in the vicinity of Jerusalem and Bethany (Matthew 21:1; Mark 11:1; Luke 19:29).

THAYER.en: An elevated platform accessible by steps, used by magistrates and authorities to address crowds or deliver judicial sentences. 1. An elevated platform or official tribunal of a magistrate (Matthew 27:19; John 19:13). | 2. A physical space extremely limited, equivalent to a foot's breadth (Acts 7:5).

THAYER.en: A precious or semi-precious stone, generally characterized by its sea-green or bluish coloration. 1. A precious gem that forms part of the foundation of the walls of the New Jerusalem (Revelation 21:20).

DEFINITION: The use of intense physical force or coercive power, whether through natural elements or human actions.

THAYER.en: The use of intense physical force or coercive power, whether through natural elements or human actions. 1. Violent force of natural phenomena (Acts 27:41). | 2. Coercion, force, or violence exerted by people (Acts 5:26; Acts 21:35).

DEFINITION: To experience violent attacks or to employ intense force in the execution of an action or advance.

THAYER.en: To experience violent attacks or to employ intense force in the execution of an action or advance. 1. To be subject to violent attacks or to suffer direct hostility.

THAYER.en: Describes something that manifests with great intensity, physical force, or vigorous pressure. 1. Referring to the impetuous force of nature, such as a strong wind (Acts 2:2).

THAYER.en: An individual who employs energetic force or violence to achieve a purpose, with diverse connotations in the New Testament context. 1. A person of energetic, impetuous behavior or one who advances with strong determination (Matthew 11:12).

DEFINITION: A diminutive of book, denoting a small writing, scroll, or document.

THAYER.en: A written document, whether in the form of a brief message, a certificate, or an extended scroll containing a literary work. 1. A written message, certificate, or official document (Matthew 19:7). | 2. A long written composition, scroll, or book (Luke 4:17; Revelation 6:14).

THAYER.en: Refers to a scroll of papyrus or parchment containing a writing, document, or literary composition. 1. A written book or scroll (Matthew 1:1; Luke 4:17). | 2. An official record or document, such as the book of life (Philippians 4:3; Revelation 20:12).

THAYER.en: Refers both to human life in its daily activities and to the means of sustenance and material goods necessary to maintain it. 1. Physical life and daily occupations in the world (2 Tim 2:4). | 2. Material resources or means of subsistence (Luke 8:43; 1 John 3:17).

THAYER.en: The quality of that which causes harm, injury, or deleterious effects to someone. 1. That which is harmful to spiritual or physical well-being, such as foolish desires (1 Tim 6:9).

THAYER.en: The process of plant growth in which seeds or plants sprout, bear fruit, or produce new branches. 1. To grow, sprout, or germinate vegetation (Matt 13:26; Mark 4:27). | 2. To produce sprouts miraculously (Heb 9:4).

SENSES: 1. Chamberlain or personal official of King Herod (Acts 12:20).

THAYER.en: Proper name of a high-ranking official in the court of Herod Agrippa I. 1. Chamberlain or personal official of King Herod (Acts 12:20).

THAYER.en: To speak in a disrespectful and injurious manner, denigrating someone's reputation or outraging God. 1. To defame, slander, or insult human beings (Titus 3:2; James 2:7). | 2. To blaspheme or utter insults against God and sacred things (Rev 13:6).

DEFINITION: Injurious speech that denigrates, defames, or insults someone's reputation, especially applied to offenses against God.
SENSES: 1. Injurious or defamatory words against people or outrages against God (Mark 7:22).

THAYER.en: Injurious speech that denigrates, defames, or insults someone's reputation, especially applied to offenses against God. 1. Injurious or defamatory words against people or outrages against God (Mark 7:22).

DEFINITION: The quality of words or people who utter insults, slander, or outrages against God, sacred things, or one's neighbor.
SENSES: 1. Defamatory and blasphemous words or speeches against the truth (Acts 6:11; 2 Pet 2:11).

THAYER.pt: Qualidade de palavras ou pessoas que proferem insultos, calúnias ou ultrajes contra Deus, coisas sagradas ou o próximo. 1. Palavras ou discursos difamatórios e blasfemos contra a verdade (At 6.11; 2Pe 2.11).
THAYER.en: The quality of words or people who utter insults, slander, or outrages against God, sacred things, or one's neighbor. 1. Defamatory and blasphemous words or speeches against the truth (Acts 6:11; 2 Pet 2:11).

DEFINITION: The act of observing or the object viewed that affects someone's perception.
SENSES: 1. The visual perception of actions or the act of witnessing something with one's eyes (2 Pet 2:8).

THAYER.pt: O ato de observar ou o objeto visualizado que afeta a percepção de alguém. 1. A percepção visual de ações ou o ato de testemunhar algo com os olhos (2Pe 2:8).
THAYER.en: The act of observing or the object viewed that affects someone's perception. 1. The visual perception of actions or the act of witnessing something with one's eyes (2 Pet 2:8).

DEFINITION: To exercise the visual capacity to see or look at something, extending figuratively to mental perception, prudence, and caution against spiritual dangers.
SENSES: 1. To see with the eyes, to have the physical capacity of vision (Matt 7:3; 11:5).
2. To look with attention, to contemplate, to observe carefully (Acts 1:11; 1 Cor 1:26).
3. To be attentive, to watch, to be cautious, or to guard oneself against something dangerous (Mark 8:15; Gal 5:15).

THAYER.pt: Exercer a capacidade visual de enxergar ou olhar para algo, estendendo-se figuradamente à percepção mental, prudência e cuidado contra perigos espirituais. 1. Enxergar com os olhos, ver, ter a capacidade física da visão (Mt 7.3; 11.5). | 2. Olhar com atenção, contemplar, observar atentamente (At 1.11; 1Co 1.26). | 3. Estar atento, vigiar, acautelar-se ou guardar-se de algo perigoso (Mc 8.15; Gl 5.15).
THAYER.en: To exercise the visual capacity to see or look at something, extending figuratively to mental perception, prudence, and caution against spiritual dangers. 1. To see with the eyes, to have the physical capacity of vision (Matt 7:3; 11:5). | 2. To look with attention, to contemplate, to observe carefully (Acts 1:11; 1 Cor 1:26). | 3. To be attentive, to watch, to be cautious, or to guard oneself against something dangerous (Mark 8:15; Gal 5:15).

DEFINITION: Verbal adjective expressing imperative necessity or the obligation to put or pour something.
SENSES: 1. That which must necessarily be put or placed into containers (Luke 5:38).

THAYER.pt: Adjetivo verbal que expressa necessidade imperativa ou obrigação de colocar ou despejar algo. 1. Aquilo que obrigatoriamente deve ser colocado ou posto em recipientes (Lc 5:38).
THAYER.en: Verbal adjective expressing imperative necessity or the obligation to put or pour something. 1. That which must necessarily be put or placed into containers (Luke 5:38).

DEFINITION: Aramaic nickname given by Jesus to the brothers James and John, denoting fervor or impetuosity.
SENSES: 1. Honorific designation translated as 'sons of thunder' (Mark 3:17).

THAYER.pt: Apelido aramaico atribuído por Jesus aos irmãos Tiago e João, denotando fervor ou ímpeto. 1. Designação honorífica traduzida como 'filhos do trovão' (Mc 3:17).
THAYER.en: Aramaic nickname given by Jesus to the brothers James and John, denoting fervor or impetuosity. 1. Honorific designation translated as 'sons of thunder' (Mark 3:17).

SHORT_GLOSS: to shout, cry out, call out
DEFINITION: To emit sounds with the voice at a very high volume, expressing strong emotion, a request for help, or popular excitement.
SENSES: 1. To raise the voice in high intensity, to cry out or shout (Matt 3:3; Luke 9:38).
2. To express intense emotion, anguish, or a cry for justice (Gal 4:27).
USAGE: to shout, cry out, call out

THAYER.pt: Emitir sons com a voz em volume muito alto, expressando forte emoção, pedido de socorro ou excitação popular. 1. Levantar a voz em alta intensidade, clamar ou gritar (Mt 3.3; Lc 9.38). | 2. Expressar intensa emoção, angústia ou clamor por justiça (Gl 4.27).
THAYER.en: To emit sounds with the voice at a very high volume, expressing strong emotion, a request for help, or popular excitement. 1. To raise the voice in high intensity, to cry out or shout (Matt 3:3; Luke 9:38). | 2. To express intense emotion, anguish, or a cry for justice (Gal 4:27).

DEFINITION: A loud and expressive vocal emission resulting from strong emotion, a request for help, or an exclamation.
SENSES: 1. Vocal clamor, shout, or audible cry.

THAYER.pt: Emissão sonora alta e expressiva, resultante de forte emoção, pedido de socorro ou exclamação. 1. Clamor vocal, brado ou grito audível.
THAYER.en: A loud and expressive vocal emission resulting from strong emotion, a request for help, or an exclamation. 1. Vocal clamor, shout, or audible cry.

DEFINITION: Assistance provided to meet a need or material resource of support in crisis situations.
SENSES: 1. Timely divine help and grace in times of need (Heb 4:16).
2. Material resources or equipment to reinforce a ship in a storm (Acts 27:17).

THAYER.pt: Assistência prestada para suprir uma necessidade ou recurso material de apoio em situações de crise. 1. Socorro e graça divina oportuna em momentos de necessidade (Hb 4.16). | 2. Recursos materiais ou apetrechos para reforçar um navio em tempestade (At 27.17).
THAYER.en: Assistance provided to meet a need or material resource of support in crisis situations. 1. Timely divine help and grace in times of need (Heb 4:16). | 2. Material resources or equipment to reinforce a ship in a storm (Acts 27:17).

DEFINITION: To provide practical assistance or relief to someone who is in a situation of need or danger.
SENSES: 1. To come to the aid of someone who needs help (Acts 21:28; Heb 2:18).

THAYER.pt: Prestar assistência prática ou socorro a alguém que se encontra em situação de necessidade ou perigo. 1. Acudir em auxílio de alguém que necessita de socorro (At 21.28; Hb 2.18).
THAYER.en: To provide practical assistance or relief to someone who is in a situation of need or danger. 1. To come to the aid of someone who needs help (Acts 21:28; Heb 2:18).

DEFINITION: One who provides relief, assistance, or patronage to those in need.
SENSES: 1. A person or entity that offers support and help in times of distress or undertaking.

THAYER.pt: Aquele que presta socorro, assistência ou patrocínio a quem se encontra em necessidade. 1. Pessoa ou entidade que oferece suporte e ajuda em momentos de aperto ou empreendimento.
THAYER.en: One who provides relief, assistance, or patronage to those in need. 1. A person or entity that offers support and help in times of distress or undertaking.

DEFINITION: A deep cavity in the ground, whether excavated artificially or formed naturally.
SENSES: 1. A deep pit, hole, or trench in the ground (Mt 12:11; Lk 6:39).

THAYER.pt: Cavidade profunda no solo, seja escavada artificialmente ou formada de modo natural. 1. Cova, buraco ou fosso profundo no chão (Mt 12.11; Lc 6.39).
THAYER.en: A deep cavity in the ground, whether excavated artificially or formed naturally. 1. A deep pit, hole, or trench in the ground (Mt 12:11; Lk 6:39).

DEFINITION: The act of throwing or casting something through the air, or the distance reached by such a throw.
SENSES: 1. The approximate distance of a stone's throw (Lk 22:41).

THAYER.pt: O ato de arremessar ou lançar algo pelo ar, ou a distância alcançada por esse lançamento. 1. A distância aproximada de um arremesso de pedra (Lc 22:41).
THAYER.en: The act of throwing or casting something through the air, or the distance reached by such a throw. 1. The approximate distance of a stone's throw (Lk 22:41).

DEFINITION: To cast a line with a lead weight at the end into the sea to measure the depth of the water.
SENSES: 1. To sound the depth of the sea during a storm (Acts 27:28).

THAYER.pt: Lançar ao mar uma corda com um peso de chumbo na extremidade para medir a profundidade da água. 1. Sondar a profundidade do mar durante uma tempestade (At 27.28).
THAYER.en: To cast a line with a lead weight at the end into the sea to measure the depth of the water. 1. To sound the depth of the sea during a storm (Acts 27:28).

DEFINITION: A projectile launched at a distance, including arrows shot from bows or darts thrown by hand.
SENSES: 1. A war projectile such as an arrow or dart (Heb 12:20).

THAYER.pt: Projétil lançado à distância, compreendendo flechas disparadas por arcos ou dardos arremessados manualmente. 1. Projétil de guerra como flecha ou dardo (Hb 12.20).
THAYER.en: A projectile launched at a distance, including arrows shot from bows or darts thrown by hand. 1. A war projectile such as an arrow or dart (Heb 12:20).

DEFINITION: Proper name of an Old Testament character, ancestor of David and a central figure in the book of Ruth.
SENSES: 1. Boaz, a landowner in Bethlehem and an ancestor of Jesus in the genealogy of Matthew (Mt 1:5; Lk 3:32).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio de um personagem do Antigo Testamento, ancestral de Davi e figura central no livro de Rute. 1. Boaz, proprietário de terras em Belém e antepassado de Jesus na genealogia de Mateus (Mt 1.5; Lc 3.32).
THAYER.en: Proper name of an Old Testament character, ancestor of David and a central figure in the book of Ruth. 1. Boaz, a landowner in Bethlehem and an ancestor of Jesus in the genealogy of Matthew (Mt 1:5; Lk 3:32).

DEFINITION: Dirty, miry mud characterized by impurities, where unclean animals are accustomed to wallow.
SENSES: 1. Filthy mire associated with dirt and moral or physical degradation (2 Pet 2:22).

THAYER.pt: Lama lodosa e suja, caracterizada por impurezas, onde animais impuros costumam chafurdar. 1. Lodo imundo associado à sujeira e à degradação moral ou física (2Pe 2:22).
THAYER.en: Dirty, miry mud characterized by impurities, where unclean animals are accustomed to wallow. 1. Filthy mire associated with dirt and moral or physical degradation (2 Pet 2:22).

DEFINITION: The cardinal point corresponding to the north, from which cold winds blow or toward which certain regions face.
SENSES: 1. The geographical direction of the north (Lk 13:29; Rev 21:13).

THAYER.pt: Ponto cardinal correspondente ao norte, de onde sopram os ventos frios ou para onde se voltam certas regiões. 1. A direção geográfica do norte (Lc 13.29; Ap 21.13).
THAYER.en: The cardinal point corresponding to the north, from which cold winds blow or toward which certain regions face. 1. The geographical direction of the north (Lk 13:29; Rev 21:13).

DEFINITION: Describes the activity of caring for flocks, guiding them to pastures, and supplying their food needs; also used metaphorically for spiritual care.
SENSES: 1. To care for animals, to herd, or to tend (Mt 8:33; Jn 21:15).
2. To feed on pasture or grass (Mt 8:30).

THAYER.pt: Descreve a atividade de cuidar de rebanhos, guiando-os para pastagens e suprindo suas necessidades alimentares, usado também metaforicamente para o cuidado espiritual. 1. Cuidar de animais, pastorear ou apascentar (Mt 8.33; Jo 21.15). | 2. Alimentar-se de pasto ou grama (Mt 8.30).
THAYER.en: Describes the activity of caring for flocks, guiding them to pastures, and supplying their food needs; also used metaphorically for spiritual care. 1. To care for animals, to herd, or to tend (Mt 8:33; Jn 21:15). | 2. To feed on pasture or grass (Mt 8:30).

DEFINITION: A variant form of the name Beor, father of the prophet Balaam in the Old Testament.
SENSES: 1. The father of the prophet Balaam (2 Pet 2:15).

THAYER.pt: Forma variante do nome Beor, pai do profeta Balaam no Antigo Testamento. 1. Pai do profeta Balaão (2Pe 2:15).
THAYER.en: A variant form of the name Beor, father of the prophet Balaam in the Old Testament. 1. The father of the prophet Balaam (2 Pet 2:15).

DEFINITION: A generic term for smaller plants, low-lying vegetation, or herbs used as pasture or ground cover.
SENSES: 1. Low-lying vegetation or herbs cultivated or utilized on the land (Heb 6:7).

THAYER.pt: Termo genérico para plantas menores, vegetação rasteira ou ervas usadas como pasto ou cobertura do solo. 1. Vegetação rasteira ou erva cultivada ou aproveitada na terra (Hb 6:7).
THAYER.en: A generic term for smaller plants, low-lying vegetation, or herbs used as pasture or ground cover. 1. Low-lying vegetation or herbs cultivated or utilized on the land (Heb 6:7).

DEFINITION: A natural grouping of vine fruits attached to the same peduncle.
SENSES: 1. A cluster of ripe grapes ready for harvest on the vine (Rev 14:18).

THAYER.pt: Agrupamento natural de frutos da videira presos a um mesmo pedúnculo. 1. Cacho de uvas maduras pronto para a colheita na videira (Ap 14:18).
THAYER.en: A natural grouping of vine fruits attached to the same peduncle. 1. A cluster of ripe grapes ready for harvest on the vine (Rev 14:18).

DEFINITION: A member of a deliberative council, legislative assembly, or supreme court, such as the Jewish Sanhedrin.
SENSES: 1. A member of the Sanhedrin, referring to Joseph of Arimathea (Mk 15:43).

THAYER.pt: Membro de um conselho deliberativo, assembleia legislativa ou supremo tribunal, como o Sinédrio judaico. 1. Membro do Sinédrio, referindo-se a José de Arimateia (Mc 15.43).
THAYER.en: A member of a deliberative council, legislative assembly, or supreme court, such as the Jewish Sanhedrin. 1. A member of the Sanhedrin, referring to Joseph of Arimathea (Mk 15:43).

DEFINITION: Involves the process of reflecting deeply on a course of action, deliberating, and reaching a firm decision or purpose.
SENSES: 1. To deliberate or consider options and plans (Lk 14:31).
2. To make a resolution or deliberate decision (2 Cor 1:17).

THAYER.pt: Envolve o processo de refletir profundamente sobre um curso de ação, deliberar e chegar a uma decisão ou propósito firme. 1. Deliberar ou considerar opções e planos (Lc 14:31). | 2. Tomar uma resolução ou decisão deliberada (2Co 1:17).
THAYER.en: Involves the process of reflecting deeply on a course of action, deliberating, and reaching a firm decision or purpose. 1. To deliberate or consider options and plans (Lk 14:31). | 2. To make a resolution or deliberate decision (2 Cor 1:17).

DEFINITION: The result of the mental deliberation process; an intentional plan, design, or resolution made by humans or by divine will.
SENSES: 1. Intention, design, or plan established for action (Acts 5:38; 1 Cor 4:5).
2. The decree, counsel, or sovereign purpose of God's will (Lk 7:30; Acts 2:23).

THAYER.pt: O resultado do processo de deliberação mental; um plano intencional, desígnio ou resolução tomada por humanos ou pela vontade divina. 1. Intenção, desígnio ou plano estabelecido para ação (At 5.38; 1Co 4.5). | 2. O decreto, conselho ou propósito soberano da vontade de Deus (Lc 7.30; At 2.23).
THAYER.en: The result of the mental deliberation process; an intentional plan, design, or resolution made by humans or by divine will. 1. Intention, design, or plan established for action (Acts 5:38; 1 Cor 4:5). | 2. The decree, counsel, or sovereign purpose of God's will (Lk 7:30; Acts 2:23).

DEFINITION: That which is desired or planned with deliberation, involving conscious intention and will.
SENSES: 1. One's intent, design, or deliberate plan (Acts 27:43; Rom 9:19; 1 Pet 4:3).

THAYER.pt: Aquilo que é desejado ou planejado com deliberação, envolvendo a intenção e a vontade consciente. 1. O intento, desígnio ou plano deliberado de alguém (At 27.43; Rm 9.19; 1Pe 4.3).
THAYER.en: That which is desired or planned with deliberation, involving conscious intention and will. 1. One's intent, design, or deliberate plan (Acts 27:43; Rom 9:19; 1 Pet 4:3).

DEFINITION: Expresses a strong desire accompanied by deliberation, planning, or a firm resolution of the will.
SENSES: 1. To desire ardently or to want to experience something with purpose (Acts 25:22; 1 Tim 6:9).
2. To plan or have the deliberate intention to carry out an action (2 Cor 1:17; Jas 1:18).

THAYER.pt: Expressa um forte desejo acompanhado de deliberação, planejamento ou firme resolução de vontade. 1. Desejar ardentemente ou querer experimentar algo com propósito (At 25.22; 1Tm 6.9). | 2. Planejar ou ter a intenção deliberada de realizar uma ação (2Co 1.17; Tg 1.18).
THAYER.en: Expresses a strong desire accompanied by deliberation, planning, or a firm resolution of the will. 1. To desire ardently or to want to experience something with purpose (Acts 25:22; 1 Tim 6:9). | 2. To plan or have the deliberate intention to carry out an action (2 Cor 1:17; Jas 1:18).

DEFINITION: An elevation of land of lower altitude compared to a mountain (ὄρος).
SENSES: 1. A hill or mound that must be leveled in preparation for the coming of the Lord (Lk 3:5).

THAYER.pt: Elevação de terra de menor altitude em comparação com uma montanha (ὄρος). 1. Uma colina ou outeiro que deve ser aplanado na preparação para a vinda do Senhor (Lc 3.5).
THAYER.en: An elevation of land of lower altitude compared to a mountain (ὄρος). 1. A hill or mound that must be leveled in preparation for the coming of the Lord (Lk 3:5).

DEFINITION: A large quadruped animal used in livestock, agriculture, and draft work.
SENSES: 1. An ox, cow, or bovine animal used in agricultural work or for sacrifices (Lk 13:15; 14:19).

THAYER.pt: Animal quadrúpede de grande porte usado na pecuária, na agricultura e em trabalhos de tração. 1. Um boi, vaca ou animal bovino usado no trabalho agrícola ou em sacrifícios (Lc 13.15; 14.19).
THAYER.en: A large quadruped animal used in livestock, agriculture, and draft work. 1. An ox, cow, or bovine animal used in agricultural work or for sacrifices (Lk 13:15; 14:19).

DEFINITION: Designates the prize or reward granted to the winner of an athletic competition; used in the New Testament as a metaphor for spiritual and heavenly victory in Christ.
SENSES: 1. The prize granted to the winner in athletic games (Phil 3:14).

THAYER.pt: Designa o prêmio ou a recompensa concedida ao vencedor de uma competição atlética, empregado no Novo Testamento como metáfora para a vitória espiritual e celestial em Cristo. 1. O prêmio concedido ao vencedor nos jogos atléticos (Fp 3.14).
THAYER.en: Designates the prize or reward granted to the winner of an athletic competition; used in the New Testament as a metaphor for spiritual and heavenly victory in Christ. 1. The prize granted to the winner in athletic games (Phil 3:14).

DEFINITION: To act as an umpire, control, decide, or govern a situation based on criteria and discernment.
SENSES: 1. To rule, arbitrate, or maintain peaceful control in the heart (Col 3:15).

THAYER.pt: Atuar como árbitro, controlar, decidir ou governar uma situação com base em critério e discernimento. 1. Governar, arbitrar ou manter o controle pacífico no coração (Cl 3:15).
THAYER.en: To act as an umpire, control, decide, or govern a situation based on criteria and discernment. 1. To rule, arbitrate, or maintain peaceful control in the heart (Col 3:15).

DEFINITION: To extend a period of time with the implication of slowness, hesitation, or delay in performing an action.
SENSES: 1. To delay or be slow in the execution of an action or promise (2 Pet 3:9);
2. To hesitate or delay in practical instructions (1 Tim 3:15).

THAYER.pt: Significa estender um período de tempo com a implicação de lentidão, hesitação ou demora em realizar algo. 1. Demorar ou tardar na execução de uma ação ou promessa (2Pe 3.9); | 2. Hesitar ou demorar-se em instruções práticas (1Tm 3.15).
THAYER.en: To extend a period of time with the implication of slowness, hesitation, or delay in performing an action. 1. To delay or be slow in the execution of an action or promise (2 Pet 3:9); | 2. To hesitate or delay in practical instructions (1 Tim 3:15).

DEFINITION: To steer a vessel with slowness, progressing with difficulty through the sea.
SENSES: 1. To sail slowly due to contrary winds or bad weather (Acts 27:7).

THAYER.pt: Conduzir uma embarcação com lentidão, progredindo com dificuldade pelo mar. 1. Navegar de forma vagarosa devido a ventos contrários ou intempéries (At 27:7).
THAYER.en: To steer a vessel with slowness, progressing with difficulty through the sea. 1. To sail slowly due to contrary winds or bad weather (Acts 27:7).

DEFINITION: Characterizes someone who delays in performing an action or exhibits slowness of thought and spiritual perception.
SENSES: 1. Slow in reactions or actions, such as in speech or anger (Jas 1:19).
2. Figuratively, slow of heart or slow to understand (Lk 24:25).

THAYER.pt: Caracteriza quem demora a realizar uma ação ou apresenta lentidão de raciocínio e percepção espiritual. 1. Lento em reações ou ações, como na fala ou na ira (Tg 1.19). | 2. Figuraradamente, tardio de coração ou lento para compreender (Lc 24.25).
THAYER.en: Characterizes someone who delays in performing an action or exhibits slowness of thought and spiritual perception. 1. Slow in reactions or actions, such as in speech or anger (Jas 1:19). | 2. Figuratively, slow of heart or slow to understand (Lk 24:25).

DEFINITION: The quality of being slow or extending a temporal period with noticeable delay.
SENSES: 1. Slowness or delay in fulfilling promises, often viewed from the perspective of divine patience (2Pet 3:9).

THAYER.pt: A qualidade de ser lento ou de estender um período temporal com atraso perceptível. 1. Lentidão ou demora no cumprimento de promessas, frequentemente vista sob a ótica da paciência divina (2Pe 3:9).
THAYER.en: The quality of being slow or extending a temporal period with noticeable delay. 1. Slowness or delay in fulfilling promises, often viewed from the perspective of divine patience (2Pet 3:9).

DEFINITION: Literally the upper part of the human arm, frequently employed as a metaphorical symbol of divine strength and power in action.
SENSES: 1. The physical arm (Lk 1:51).
2. Anthropomorphic symbol of the manifestation of God's sovereign power (Jn 12:38; Acts 13:17).

THAYER.pt: Literalmente a parte superior do braço humano, frequentemente empregada como símbolo metafórico da força e do poder divino em ação. 1. O braço físico (Lc 1.51). | 2. Símbolo antropomórfico da manifestação do poder soberano de Deus (Jo 12.38; At 13.17).
THAYER.en: Literally the upper part of the human arm, frequently employed as a metaphorical symbol of divine strength and power in action. 1. The physical arm (Lk 1:51). | 2. Anthropomorphic symbol of the manifestation of God's sovereign power (Jn 12:38; Acts 13:17).

DEFINITION: Adjective describing small extent, whether in spatial terms, temporal duration, or numerical quantity.
SENSES: 1. Small extent or quantity (Acts 27:28; Jn 6:7).
2. Brief duration of time (Acts 5:34; Lk 22:58).

THAYER.pt: Adjetivo que descreve pequena extensão, seja em termos espaciais, de duração temporal ou em quantidade numérica. 1. Pequena extensão ou quantidade (At 27:28; Jo 6:7). | 2. Breve duração de tempo (At 5:34; Lc 22:58).
THAYER.en: Adjective describing small extent, whether in spatial terms, temporal duration, or numerical quantity. 1. Small extent or quantity (Acts 27:28; Jn 6:7). | 2. Brief duration of time (Acts 5:34; Lk 22:58).

DEFINITION: A very small child, including newborns and infants, and by extension the fetus still in the maternal womb.
SENSES: 1. A fetus still in the maternal womb (Lk 1:41, 44).
2. A newborn, infant, or small child (Lk 2:12; 2Tim 3:15).

THAYER.pt: Uma criança muito pequena, incluindo recém-nascidos e bebês, e por extensão o feto ainda no ventre materno. 1. Um feto ainda no ventre materno (Lc 1.41, 44). | 2. Um recém-nascido, bebê ou criança pequena (Lc 2.12; 2Tm 3.15).
THAYER.en: A very small child, including newborns and infants, and by extension the fetus still in the maternal womb. 1. A fetus still in the maternal womb (Lk 1:41, 44). | 2. A newborn, infant, or small child (Lk 2:12; 2Tim 3:15).

DEFINITION: Verb meaning both to cause rain to fall and to wet or moisten something with liquids.
SENSES: 1. To cause rain to fall, send rain upon the earth (Mt 5:45; Jas 5:17).
2. To wet or moisten something (Lk 7:38).

THAYER.pt: Verbo que significa tanto fazer cair chuva quanto molhar ou umedecer algo com líquidos. 1. Fazer chover, enviar chuva sobre a terra (Mt 5:45; Tg 5:17). | 2. Molhar ou umedecer algo (Lc 7:38).
THAYER.en: Verb meaning both to cause rain to fall and to wet or moisten something with liquids. 1. To cause rain to fall, send rain upon the earth (Mt 5:45; Jas 5:17). | 2. To wet or moisten something (Lk 7:38).

DEFINITION: The loud, rumbling noise that accompanies lightning in the atmosphere.
SENSES: 1. The resounding sound of thunder associated with storms or heavenly manifestations (Jn 12:29; Rev 6:1).

THAYER.pt: O estrondo forte e barulhento que acompanha um relâmpago na atmosfera. 1. O som estrondoso do trovão associado a tempestades ou manifestações celestiais (Jo 12.29; Ap 6.1).
THAYER.en: The loud, rumbling noise that accompanies lightning in the atmosphere. 1. The resounding sound of thunder associated with storms or heavenly manifestations (Jn 12:29; Rev 6:1).

DEFINITION: Refers to the precipitation of water from the atmosphere, ranging from gentle rains to storms or torrential downpours.
SENSES: 1. Literal rain falling upon the earth and feeding streams and winds (Mt 7:25, 27).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se à precipitação de água da atmosfera, abrangendo desde chuvas brandas até temporais ou aguaceiros torrenciais. 1. A chuva literal que cai sobre a terra e alimenta as correntes e ventos (Mt 7.25, 27).
THAYER.en: Refers to the precipitation of water from the atmosphere, ranging from gentle rains to storms or torrential downpours. 1. Literal rain falling upon the earth and feeding streams and winds (Mt 7:25, 27).

DEFINITION: Designates a noose, cord, or trap used for binding or strangling. In the New Testament, it appears metaphorically indicating restriction or coercion.
SENSES: 1. A noose or cord used as a trap or restriction (1Cor 7:35).

THAYER.pt: Designa um laço corrediço, corda ou armadilha usada para prender ou estrangular. No Novo Testamento, aparece metaforicamente indicando restrição ou coação. 1. Laço ou corda usada como armadilha ou restrição (1Co 7.35).
THAYER.en: Designates a noose, cord, or trap used for binding or strangling. In the New Testament, it appears metaphorically indicating restriction or coercion. 1. A noose or cord used as a trap or restriction (1Cor 7:35).

DEFINITION: The act of gnashing or grinding the teeth forcefully, generally expressing intense pain, despair, or extreme anguish.
SENSES: 1. Gnashing of teeth associated with eschatological suffering (Mt 8:12).

THAYER.pt: Ato de ranger ou esfregar os dentes com força, geralmente expressando dor intensa, desespero ou angústia extrema. 1. Ranger de dentes associado ao sofrimento escatológico (Mt 8:12).
THAYER.en: The act of gnashing or grinding the teeth forcefully, generally expressing intense pain, despair, or extreme anguish. 1. Gnashing of teeth associated with eschatological suffering (Mt 8:12).

DEFINITION: Means to gnash or press the teeth together forcefully, expressing intense fury, extreme anger, or despair in the face of opposition.
SENSES: 1. To gnash the teeth as a sign of extreme wrath and fury (Acts 7:54).

THAYER.pt: Significa ranger ou apertar os dentes com força, expressando intensa fúria, raiva extrema ou desespero diante de oposição. 1. Ranger os dentes como sinal de extrema ira e fúria (At 7.54).
THAYER.en: Means to gnash or press the teeth together forcefully, expressing intense fury, extreme anger, or despair in the face of opposition. 1. To gnash the teeth as a sign of extreme wrath and fury (Acts 7:54).

DEFINITION: Describes something that is full to the point of overflowing, pouring forth, or gushing in abundance.
SENSES: 1. To be full of something or cause it to gush abundantly (Jas 3:11).

THAYER.pt: Descreve algo que está repleto a ponto de transbordar, verter ou jorrar em abundância. 1. Estar cheio de algo ou fazer jorrar abundantemente (Tg 3.11).
THAYER.en: Describes something that is full to the point of overflowing, pouring forth, or gushing in abundance. 1. To be full of something or cause it to gush abundantly (Jas 3:11).

DEFINITION: Refers to any type of solid food consumed by humans. In New Testament writings, it appears both in debates over ritual purity and dietary rules, and in metaphors about the will of God as spiritual sustenance.
SENSES: 1. Solid food consumed daily, with special emphasis on meats or delicacies (Rom 14:15; 1Cor 8:13).
2. In a spiritual sense, transcendent sustenance derived from doing the will of God (Jn 4:34).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se a qualquer tipo de alimento sólido consumido por seres humanos. Nos escritos neotestamentários, aparece tanto em debates sobre pureza ritual e regras alimentares quanto em metáforas sobre a vontade de Deus como sustento espiritual. 1. Alimento sólido consumido no dia a dia, com destaque especial para carnes ou iguarias (Rm 14.15; 1Co 8.13). | 2. Em sentido espiritual, o sustento transcendente derivado de fazer a vontade de Deus (Jo 4.34).
THAYER.en: Refers to any type of solid food consumed by humans. In New Testament writings, it appears both in debates over ritual purity and dietary rules, and in metaphors about the will of God as spiritual sustenance. 1. Solid food consumed daily, with special emphasis on meats or delicacies (Rom 14:15; 1Cor 8:13). | 2. In a spiritual sense, transcendent sustenance derived from doing the will of God (Jn 4:34).

DEFINITION: Refers to substances or foods fit to be consumed by ingestion.
SENSES: 1. That can be eaten, edible (Lk 24:41).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se a substâncias ou alimentos próprios para serem consumidos por ingestão. 1. Que pode ser comido, comestível (Lc 24.41).
THAYER.en: Refers to substances or foods fit to be consumed by ingestion. 1. That can be eaten, edible (Lk 24:41).

DEFINITION: Refers to the act of eating, the food consumed, or, figuratively, the process of material corrosion and wear.
SENSES: 1. The act of eating or the consumption of food (Rom 14:17).
2. Solid food or provision to nourish the body (Heb 12:16).
3. The action of corroding or consuming by rust (Mt 6:19).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se ao ato de comer, ao alimento consumido ou, figuradamente, ao processo de corrosão e desgaste material. 1. O ato de comer ou o consumo de alimentos (Rm 14.17). | 2. Alimento sólido ou provisão para nutrir o corpo (Hb 12.16). | 3. Ação de corroer ou consumir por ferrugem (Mt 6.19).
THAYER.en: Refers to the act of eating, the food consumed, or, figuratively, the process of material corrosion and wear. 1. The act of eating or the consumption of food (Rom 14:17). | 2. Solid food or provision to nourish the body (Heb 12:16). | 3. The action of corroding or consuming by rust (Mt 6:19).

DEFINITION: Literally to cause something to submerge in water, also used figuratively to describe ruin or submission to disastrous consequences.
SENSES: 1. To cause to sink in water, submerge vessels (Lk 5:7);
2. To lead someone to disastrous consequences, plunging them into ruin (1Tim 6:9).

THAYER.pt: Literalmente causar a submersão de algo na água, sendo também usado figuradamente para descrever a ruína ou a submissão a consequências desastrosas. 1. Fazer afundar na água, submergir embarcações (Lc 5.7); | 2. Conduzir alguém a consequências desastrosas, precipitando na ruína (1Tm 6.9).
THAYER.en: Literally to cause something to submerge in water, also used figuratively to describe ruin or submission to disastrous consequences. 1. To cause to sink in water, submerge vessels (Lk 5:7); | 2. To lead someone to disastrous consequences, plunging them into ruin (1Tim 6:9).

DEFINITION: Indicates the deepest part of the sea or ocean, far from the coast, where waters reach great depths.
SENSES: 1. The depth of the sea or deep waters (2Cor 11:25).

THAYER.pt: Indica a parte mais profunda do mar ou oceano, longe da costa, onde as águas atingem grandes profundidades. 1. A profundidade do mar ou as águas profundas (2Co 11.25).
THAYER.en: Indicates the deepest part of the sea or ocean, far from the coast, where waters reach great depths. 1. The depth of the sea or deep waters (2Cor 11:25).

DEFINITION: Craftsman whose profession consists of tanning animal skins to transform them into leather.
SENSES: 1. Tanner of hides, an occupation practiced by Simon in Joppa (Acts 9:43; 10:6).

THAYER.pt: Artesão cuja profissão consiste em curtir peles de animais para transformá-las em couro. 1. Curtidor de peles, ofício exercido por Simão em Jope (At 9.43; 10.6).
THAYER.en: Craftsman whose profession consists of tanning animal skins to transform them into leather. 1. Tanner of hides, an occupation practiced by Simon in Joppa (Acts 9:43; 10:6).

DEFINITION: Made of fine linen fabric of the highest quality, commonly used in luxurious attire or priestly garments.
SENSES: 1. Made of the finest linen (Rev 18:12).

THAYER.pt: Feito de tecido de linho fino e de altíssima qualidade, comumente usado em trajes luxuosos ou vestimentas sacerdotais. 1. Confeccionado em linho finíssimo (Ap 18.12).
THAYER.en: Made of fine linen fabric of the highest quality, commonly used in luxurious attire or priestly garments. 1. Made of the finest linen (Rev 18:12).

DEFINITION: Designates a very fine linen fabric of high quality and great value, worn by the wealthy or in priestly garments.
SENSES: 1. Fine and luxurious linen (Lk 16:19).

THAYER.pt: Designa um tecido de linho muito fino, de alta qualidade e elevado valor, usado por pessoas ricas ou em trajes sacerdotais. 1. Linho fino e luxuoso (Lc 16.19).
THAYER.en: Designates a very fine linen fabric of high quality and great value, worn by the wealthy or in priestly garments. 1. Fine and luxurious linen (Lk 16:19).

DEFINITION: Elevated structure built to offer sacrifices or incense to deities, whether in pagan or Jewish worship.
SENSES: 1. An altar dedicated to religious worship (Acts 17:23).

THAYER.pt: Estrutura elevada construída para oferecer sacrifícios ou incenso a divindades, seja no culto pagão ou judaico. 1. Altar dedicado ao culto religioso (At 17.23).
THAYER.en: Elevated structure built to offer sacrifices or incense to deities, whether in pagan or Jewish worship. 1. An altar dedicated to religious worship (Acts 17:23).

DEFINITION: Aramaic term designating a specific location in Jerusalem, paved with stones, situated near the praetorium of Pontius Pilate.
SENSES: 1. Aramaic name of the stone pavement where Jesus was judged (Jn 19:13).

THAYER.pt: Termo aramaico que designa um local específico em Jerusalém, pavimentado com pedras, situado junto ao pretório de Pôncio Pilatos. 1. Nome aramaico do pavimento de pedras onde Jesus foi julgado (Jo 19.13).
THAYER.en: Aramaic term designating a specific location in Jerusalem, paved with stones, situated near the praetorium of Pontius Pilate. 1. Aramaic name of the stone pavement where Jesus was judged (Jn 19:13).

DEFINITION: Indeclinable proper name designating the archangel Gabriel, divine messenger sent with crucial revelations in the New Testament period.
