SENSES: 1. The archangel who announces the births of John the Baptist and Jesus (Lk 1:19, 26).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio indeclinável que designa o arcanjo Gabriel, mensageiro divino enviado com revelações cruciais no período neotestamentário. 1. O arcanjo que anuncia os nascimentos de João Batista e de Jesus (Lc 1.19, 26).
THAYER.en: Indeclinable proper name designating the archangel Gabriel, divine messenger sent with crucial revelations in the New Testament period. 1. The archangel who announces the births of John the Baptist and Jesus (Lk 1:19, 26).

DEFINITION: Severe infection or disease causing necrosis and progressive destruction of living tissues. In the NT, it is used metaphorically for destructive false doctrines.
SENSES: 1. Corrosive sore or gangrene that spreads destructively (2Tim 2:17).

THAYER.pt: Infecção ou doença grave que causa a necrose e destruição progressiva dos tecidos vivos. No NT, é usada metaforicamente para falsas doutrinas destrutivas. 1. Ferida corrosiva ou gangrena que se alastra destrutivamente (2Tm 2.17).
THAYER.en: Severe infection or disease causing necrosis and progressive destruction of living tissues. In the NT, it is used metaphorically for destructive false doctrines. 1. Corrosive sore or gangrene that spreads destructively (2Tim 2:17).

DEFINITION: Proper name of one of the sons of Jacob and patriarch of one of the tribes of Israel.
SENSES: 1. Gad, son of Jacob and ancestor of an Israelite tribe (Rev 7:5).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio de um dos filhos de Jacó e patriarca de uma das tribos de Israel. 1. Gade, filho de Jacó e ancestral de tribo israelita (Ap 7.5).
THAYER.en: Proper name of one of the sons of Jacob and patriarch of one of the tribes of Israel. 1. Gad, son of Jacob and ancestor of an Israelite tribe (Rev 7:5).

DEFINITION: Gentilic adjective indicating an inhabitant or native of Gadara, a city located in the eastern region of the Sea of Galilee.
SENSES: 1. Inhabitant or native of the region of Gadara (Mt 8:28; Lk 8:37).

THAYER.pt: Adjetivo gentílico que indica habitante ou natural de Gadara, cidade situada na região oriental do mar da Galileia. 1. Habitante ou natural da região de Gadara (Mt 8.28; Lc 8.37).
THAYER.en: Gentilic adjective indicating an inhabitant or native of Gadara, a city located in the eastern region of the Sea of Galilee. 1. Inhabitant or native of the region of Gadara (Mt 8:28; Lk 8:37).

DEFINITION: Term of Persian origin designating the royal treasury, chest, or depository of wealth and public goods.
SENSES: 1. The royal treasury or chest (Acts 8:27).

THAYER.pt: Termo de origem persa que designa o tesouro real, o cofre ou o depósito de riquezas e bens públicos. 1. O tesouro ou cofre real (At 8.27).
THAYER.en: Term of Persian origin designating the royal treasury, chest, or depository of wealth and public goods. 1. The royal treasury or chest (Acts 8:27).

DEFINITION: Ancient and important Philistine city located in southwestern Palestine, close to the route to Egypt.
SENSES: 1. Gaza, city on the route to Egypt (Acts 8:27).

THAYER.pt: Antiga e importante cidade filisteia localizada no sudoeste da Palestina, próxima à rota para o Egito. 1. Gaza, cidade na rota para o Egito (At 8.27).
THAYER.en: Ancient and important Philistine city located in southwestern Palestine, close to the route to Egypt. 1. Gaza, city on the route to Egypt (Acts 8:27).

DEFINITION: Place reserved for keeping wealth and offerings in the temple, or the chest/box where contribution money was deposited.
SENSES: 1. The treasury room in the temple of Jerusalem (Jn 8:20).
2. The temple's offering box or chest (Mk 12:41; Lk 21:1).

THAYER.pt: Local reservado para guardar riquezas e ofertas no templo, ou a própria arca/cofre onde o dinheiro das contribuições era depositado. 1. Sala do tesouro no templo de Jerusalém (Jo 8.20). | 2. Caixa ou cofre de ofertas do templo (Mc 12.41; Lc 21.1).
THAYER.en: Place reserved for keeping wealth and offerings in the temple, or the chest/box where contribution money was deposited. 1. The treasury room in the temple of Jerusalem (Jn 8:20). | 2. The temple's offering box or chest (Mk 12:41; Lk 21:1).

DEFINITION: Proper name of several disciples and Christian co-workers mentioned in the New Testament.
SENSES: 1. Gaius, companion of Paul or host of the church (Acts 19:29; Rom 16:23; 3Jn 1:1).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio de vários discípulos e cooperadores cristãos mencionados no Novo Testamento. 1. Gaios, companheiro de Paulo ou anfitrião da igreja (At 19.29; Rm 16.23; 3Jo 1.1).
THAYER.en: Proper name of several disciples and Christian co-workers mentioned in the New Testament. 1. Gaius, companion of Paul or host of the church (Acts 19:29; Rom 16:23; 3Jn 1:1).

DEFINITION: Nutritive fluid produced by female mammals, used metaphorically to describe the elementary teaching of the Christian faith.
SENSES: 1. Milk as natural food (1Co 9.7).
2. Metaphor for the rudiments and basic teachings of the word of God (1Co 3.2; Heb 5.12).

THAYER.pt: Fluido nutritivo produzido por fêmeas de mamíferos, usado metaforicamente para descrever o ensino elementar da fé cristã. 1. Leite como alimento natural (1Co 9.7). | 2. Metáfora para os rudimentos e ensinamentos básicos da palavra de Deus (1Co 3.2; Hb 5.12).
THAYER.en: Nutritive fluid produced by female mammals, used metaphorically to describe the elementary teaching of the Christian faith. 1. Milk as natural food (1Co 9.7). | 2. Metaphor for the rudiments and basic teachings of the word of God (1Co 3.2; Heb 5.12).

DEFINITION: An inhabitant of the Roman province of Galatia in Asia Minor, descended from the ancient Gauls who settled in the region.
SENSES: 1. A native or inhabitant of Galatia (Gal 3.1).

THAYER.pt: Habitante da província romana da Galácia, na Ásia Menor, descendente dos antigos gauleses que se estabeleceram na região. 1. Um nativo ou morador da Galácia (Gl 3.1).
THAYER.en: An inhabitant of the Roman province of Galatia in Asia Minor, descended from the ancient Gauls who settled in the region. 1. A native or inhabitant of Galatia (Gal 3.1).

DEFINITION: Region of Asia Minor inhabited by the Galatians, which later became a Roman province where Paul founded churches.
SENSES: 1. The region and Roman province of Galatia (Gal 1.2; 2Tm 4.10).

THAYER.pt: Região da Ásia Menor habitada pelos gálatas e que posteriormente se tornou uma província romana onde Paulo fundou igrejas. 1. A região e província romana da Galácia (Gl 1.2; 2Tm 4.10).
THAYER.en: Region of Asia Minor inhabited by the Galatians, which later became a Roman province where Paul founded churches. 1. The region and Roman province of Galatia (Gal 1.2; 2Tm 4.10).

DEFINITION: Geographical adjective qualifying what belongs or relates to the region of Galatia or its people.
SENSES: 1. Pertaining to the geographical region of Galatia in Asia Minor (Acts 16.6; 18.23).

THAYER.pt: Adjetivo geográfico que qualifica o que pertence ou se refere à região da Galácia ou ao seu povo. 1. Relativo à região geográfica da Galácia na Ásia Menor (At 16.6; 18.23).
THAYER.en: Geographical adjective qualifying what belongs or relates to the region of Galatia or its people. 1. Pertaining to the geographical region of Galatia in Asia Minor (Acts 16.6; 18.23).

DEFINITION: State of tranquility on the surface of waters, characterized by the absence of winds and rough waves.
SENSES: 1. Calm or stillness on the sea or a lake (Mt 8.26; Mk 4.39; Lk 8.24).

THAYER.pt: Estado de tranquilidade na superfície das águas, caracterizado pela ausência de ventos e ondas agitadas. 1. Calmaria ou bonança no mar ou em um lago (Mt 8.26; Mc 4.39; Lc 8.24).
THAYER.en: State of tranquility on the surface of waters, characterized by the absence of winds and rough waves. 1. Calm or stillness on the sea or a lake (Mt 8.26; Mk 4.39; Lk 8.24).

DEFINITION: Geographical region situated in northern Palestine, characterized by high population density and centrality in Jesus' earthly ministry.
SENSES: 1. The administrative and geographical region of northern Galilee (Mt 4.15; Acts 9.31).

THAYER.pt: Região geográfica situada no norte da Palestina, caracterizada por grande densidade populacional e centralidade no ministério terreno de Jesus. 1. A região administrativa e geográfica da Galileia setentrional (Mt 4.15; At 9.31).
THAYER.en: Geographical region situated in northern Palestine, characterized by high population density and centrality in Jesus' earthly ministry. 1. The administrative and geographical region of northern Galilee (Mt 4.15; Acts 9.31).

DEFINITION: Native, inhabitant, or person from the region of Galilee, a term frequently used in the New Testament to refer to Jesus and his disciples.
SENSES: 1. Inhabitant or native of the province of Galilee (Mt 26.69; Acts 2.7).

THAYER.pt: Natural, habitante ou procedente da região da Galileia, termo frequentemente usado no Novo Testamento para se referir a Jesus e aos seus discípulos. 1. Habitante ou natural da província da Galileia (Mt 26.69; At 2.7).
THAYER.en: Native, inhabitant, or person from the region of Galilee, a term frequently used in the New Testament to refer to Jesus and his disciples. 1. Inhabitant or native of the province of Galilee (Mt 26.69; Acts 2.7).

DEFINITION: Name of a Roman proconsul of Achaia during the apostle Paul's missionary journey, known for his indifferent attitude toward the Jews' accusations against Paul.
SENSES: 1. Gallio, Roman proconsul of Achaia (Acts 18.12).

THAYER.pt: Nome de um procônsul romano da Acaia durante a viagem missionária do apóstolo Paulo, conhecido por sua postura indiferente perante as acusações dos judeus contra Paulo. 1. Galião, procônsul romano da Acaia (At 18.12).
THAYER.en: Name of a Roman proconsul of Achaia during the apostle Paul's missionary journey, known for his indifferent attitude toward the Jews' accusations against Paul. 1. Gallio, Roman proconsul of Achaia (Acts 18.12).

DEFINITION: Proper name designating Gamaliel, a renowned teacher of the law and a Pharisee of great prestige in the Sanhedrin in Jerusalem.
SENSES: 1. The respected rabbi and Pharisee who advised moderation regarding the apostles (Acts 5.34).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio que designa Gamaliel, um renomado mestre da lei e fariseu de grande prestígio no sinédrio em Jerusalém. 1. O conceituado rabi e fariseu que aconselhou moderação em relação aos apóstolos (At 5.34).
THAYER.en: Proper name designating Gamaliel, a renowned teacher of the law and a Pharisee of great prestige in the Sanhedrin in Jerusalem. 1. The respected rabbi and Pharisee who advised moderation regarding the apostles (Acts 5.34).

DEFINITION: To take another person as a spouse, formally entering the state of matrimony, whether man or woman.
SENSES: 1. To marry or take someone as wife or husband (Mt 5.32; 1Co 7.28).

THAYER.pt: Tomar outra pessoa como cônjuge, entrando formalmente no estado de matrimônio, seja homem ou mulher. 1. Casar-se ou tomar alguém como esposa ou marido (Mt 5.32; 1Co 7.28).
THAYER.en: To take another person as a spouse, formally entering the state of matrimony, whether man or woman. 1. To marry or take someone as wife or husband (Mt 5.32; 1Co 7.28).

DEFINITION: Variant form of γαμίζω, which means to give someone in marriage.
SENSES: 1. To give a daughter or dependent in marriage (Mt 22.30 v.l.).

THAYER.pt: Forma variante de γαμίζω, que significa dar alguém em matrimônio. 1. Entregar uma filha ou dependente em casamento (Mt 22.30 v.l.).
THAYER.en: Variant form of γαμίζω, which means to give someone in marriage. 1. To give a daughter or dependent in marriage (Mt 22.30 v.l.).

DEFINITION: Refers to the civil state of matrimony or the festive public celebrations associated with the wedding ceremony.
SENSES: 1. Wedding feast or banquet (Mt 22.2; Jn 2.1).
2. The social institution and state of being married (Heb 13.4).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se ao estado civil do matrimônio ou às celebrações públicas festivas associadas à cerimônia de casamento. 1. Festa ou banquete de casamento (Mt 22.2; Jo 2.1). | 2. A instituição social e o estado de ser casado (Hb 13.4).
THAYER.en: Refers to the civil state of matrimony or the festive public celebrations associated with the wedding ceremony. 1. Wedding feast or banquet (Mt 22.2; Jn 2.1). | 2. The social institution and state of being married (Heb 13.4).

DEFINITION: Postpositive conjunction providing the logical justification, confirmation, or elucidation of the previous argument. Establishes why a preceding statement is true or appropriate.
SENSES: 1. Expressing cause or explanatory reason of a statement ('for', 'because') (Mt 1.21; Jn 3.16).
2. Epexegetical or elucidating, clarifying the developing argument ('indeed', 'truly') (Mt 12.40; Rom 1.16).
3. Inferential in rhetorical questions to confirm astonishment or intensity (Mt 27.23; Jn 9.30).

THAYER.pt: Conjunção pós-positiva que fornece a justificativa lógica, confirmação ou elucidação do argumento anterior. Estabelece por que uma afirmação antecedente é verdadeira ou apropriada. 1. Expressando a causa ou razão explicativa de um enunciado ('pois', 'porque') (Mt 1.21; Jo 3.16). | 2. Epexegético ou de elucidação, esclarecendo o argumento em desenvolvimento ('com efeito', 'realmente') (Mt 12.40; Rm 1.16). | 3. Inferencial em perguntas retóricas para confirmar espanto ou intensidade (Mt 27.23; Jo 9.30).
THAYER.en: Postpositive conjunction providing the logical justification, confirmation, or elucidation of the previous argument. Establishes why a preceding statement is true or appropriate. 1. Expressing cause or explanatory reason of a statement ('for', 'because') (Mt 1.21; Jn 3.16). | 2. Epexegetical or elucidating, clarifying the developing argument ('indeed', 'truly') (Mt 12.40; Rom 1.16). | 3. Inferential in rhetorical questions to confirm astonishment or intensity (Mt 27.23; Jn 9.30).

DEFINITION: Anatomical term designating the interior cavity of the body, encompassing both digestive organs and the maternal womb.
SENSES: 1. The region of the belly or stomach, sometimes associated with physical appetites (Tit 1.12).
2. The womb as the place of gestation and origin of life (Mt 1.18; Lk 1.31).

THAYER.pt: Termo anatômico que designa a cavidade interior do corpo, abrangendo tanto os órgãos digestivos quanto o útero materno. 1. A região do ventre ou estômago, por vezes associada a apetites físicos (Tt 1.12). | 2. O útero como local de gestação e origem da vida (Mt 1.18; Lc 1:31).
THAYER.en: Anatomical term designating the interior cavity of the body, encompassing both digestive organs and the maternal womb. 1. The region of the belly or stomach, sometimes associated with physical appetites (Tit 1.12). | 2. The womb as the place of gestation and origin of life (Mt 1.18; Lk 1.31).

DEFINITION: Enclitic particle serving to give strong emphasis to a word or limit a statement, indicating certainty.
SENSES: 1. Indicating limitation or concession, meaning 'at least' (Lk 11.8).
2. Highlighting with emphatic intensity, meaning 'certainly' or 'even' (Rom 8.32).

THAYER.pt: Partícula enclítica que serve para dar forte ênfase a uma palavra ou limitar uma afirmação, indicando certeza. 1. Indicar limitação ou concessão, significando 'ao menos' ou 'pelo menos' (Lc 11.8). | 2. Realçar com intensidade enfática, significando 'certamente' ou 'mesmo' (Rm 8.32).
THAYER.en: Enclitic particle serving to give strong emphasis to a word or limit a statement, indicating certainty. 1. Indicating limitation or concession, meaning 'at least' (Lk 11.8). | 2. Highlighting with emphatic intensity, meaning 'certainly' or 'even' (Rom 8.32).

DEFINITION: Famous military leader and judge of Israel who delivered the people from the oppression of the Midianites with a small army.
SENSES: 1. Gideon, hero of faith and judge of Israel (Heb 11.32).

THAYER.pt: Famoso líder militar e juiz de Israel que libertou o povo da opressão dos midianitas com um pequeno exército. 1. Gideão, herói da fé e juiz de Israel (Hb 11.32).
THAYER.en: Famous military leader and judge of Israel who delivered the people from the oppression of the Midianites with a small army. 1. Gideon, hero of faith and judge of Israel (Heb 11.32).

DEFINITION: Derived from the Valley of Hinnom south of Jerusalem, the term designates in the New Testament the eschatological place of punishment and eternal fire for the wicked.
SENSES: 1. The place of condemnation and eternal fire after the final judgment, hell (Mt 5.29; 23.33).

THAYER.pt: Derivado do vale de Hinhom ao sul de Jerusalém, o termo designa no Novo Testamento o lugar escatológico de punição e fogo eterno para os ímpios. 1. O lugar de condenação e fogo eterno após o juízo final, o inferno (Mt 5.29; 23.33).
THAYER.en: Derived from the Valley of Hinnom south of Jerusalem, the term designates in the New Testament the eschatological place of punishment and eternal fire for the wicked. 1. The place of condemnation and eternal fire after the final judgment, hell (Mt 5.29; 23.33).

DEFINITION: Aramaic toponym designating the garden or olive grove located at the foot of the Mount of Olives, scene of Jesus' agony.
SENSES: 1. The place where Jesus prayed and was betrayed before his crucifixion (Mt 26.36; Mk 14.32).

THAYER.pt: Topônimo aramaico que designa o jardim ou pomar de oliveiras localizado no sopé do Monte das Oliveiras, cenário da agonia de Jesus. 1. O local onde Jesus orou e foi traído antes de sua crucificação (Mt 26.36; Mc 14.32).
THAYER.en: Aramaic toponym designating the garden or olive grove located at the foot of the Mount of Olives, scene of Jesus' agony. 1. The place where Jesus prayed and was betrayed before his crucifixion (Mt 26.36; Mk 14.32).

DEFINITION: Refers to a person who dwells nearby or in the same neighborhood, forming part of the immediate social group.
SENSES: 1. Person who lives near or next to another (Lk 15.6).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se a uma pessoa que habita nas proximidades ou na mesma vizinhança, fazendo parte do grupo social imediato. 1. Pessoa que mora perto ou ao lado de outra (Lc 15.6).
THAYER.en: Refers to a person who dwells nearby or in the same neighborhood, forming part of the immediate social group. 1. Person who lives near or next to another (Lk 15.6).

DEFINITION: To express joy, hilarity, or rejoicing through laughter, also able to express contrast with weeping in sapiential or prophetic discourse.
SENSES: 1. To laugh as a sign of joy or future reversal of circumstances (Lk 6.21, 25).

THAYER.pt: Expressar alegria, hilaridade ou regozijo através do riso, podendo também expressar contraste com o pranto em discursos sapienciais ou proféticos. 1. Rir em sinal de alegria ou de reversão futura de circunstâncias (Lc 6.21, 25).
THAYER.en: To express joy, hilarity, or rejoicing through laughter, also able to express contrast with weeping in sapiential or prophetic discourse. 1. To laugh as a sign of joy or future reversal of circumstances (Lk 6.21, 25).

DEFINITION: Physical manifestation of joy, amusement, or, in specific contexts, mockery and levity.
SENSES: 1. The act of laughing or expression of laughter (Jas 4.9).

THAYER.pt: Manifestação física de alegria, divertimento ou, em contextos específicos, zombaria e leviandade. 1. O ato de rir ou expressão de riso (Tg 4.9).
THAYER.en: Physical manifestation of joy, amusement, or, in specific contexts, mockery and levity. 1. The act of laughing or expression of laughter (Jas 4.9).

DEFINITION: Indicates the action of completely filling a container or space so that it reaches its maximum capacity limit.
SENSES: 1. To fill an object or container with some substance (Jn 2.7; Rev 8.5).
2. To become full or begin to be filled, in the passive voice (Mk 4.37).

THAYER.pt: Indica a ação de preencher um recipiente ou espaço completamente, de modo que atinja o limite máximo de sua capacidade. 1. Encher um objeto ou recipiente com alguma substância (Jo 2.7; Ap 8.5). | 2. Tornar-se cheio ou começar a ser preenchido, na voz passiva (Mc 4.37).
THAYER.en: Indicates the action of completely filling a container or space so that it reaches its maximum capacity limit. 1. To fill an object or container with some substance (Jn 2.7; Rev 8.5). | 2. To become full or begin to be filled, in the passive voice (Mk 4.37).

DEFINITION: To be replete or full of some substance, object, or quality, describing a continuous state of fullness.
SENSES: 1. To be replete with something, containing it in large quantity (Mt 23.27; Rev 17.3).

THAYER.pt: Estar repleto ou cheio de alguma substância, objeto ou qualidade, descrevendo um estado contínuo de plenitude. 1. Estar repleto de alguma coisa, contendo-a em grande quantidade (Mt 23.27; Ap 17.3).
THAYER.en: To be replete or full of some substance, object, or quality, describing a continuous state of fullness. 1. To be replete with something, containing it in large quantity (Mt 23.27; Rev 17.3).

DEFINITION: Group of people living in the same period of time or descending from a common ancestor, forming a group with distinct characteristics.
SENSES: 1. The sum total of people alive in the same period, contemporaries (Mt 11.16; Acts 13.36).
2. An ethnic group or lineage with defined cultural or spiritual traits (Phil 2.15).
3. A period of time or historical era (Col 1.26).

THAYER.pt: Conjunto de pessoas que vivem no mesmo período de tempo ou que descendem de um ancestral comum, formando um grupo com características próprias. 1. A soma total de pessoas vivas em um mesmo período, os contemporâneos (Mt 11.16; At 13.36). | 2. Um grupo étnico ou linhagem com traços culturais ou espirituais definidos (Fp 2.15). | 3. Um período de tempo ou era histórica (Cl 1.26).
THAYER.en: Group of people living in the same period of time or descending from a common ancestor, forming a group with distinct characteristics. 1. The sum total of people alive in the same period, contemporaries (Mt 11.16; Acts 13.36). | 2. An ethnic group or lineage with defined cultural or spiritual traits (Phil 2.15). | 3. A period of time or historical era (Col 1.26).

DEFINITION: To record, track, or compute the descent and family lineage of someone through ancestors.
SENSES: 1. To trace or record family lineage and ancestry (Heb 7.6).

THAYER.pt: Registrar, rastrear ou computar a descendência e linhagem familiar de alguém através de ancestrais. 1. Rastrear ou registrar a linhagem e ascendência familiar (Hb 7.6).
THAYER.en: To record, track, or compute the descent and family lineage of someone through ancestors. 1. To trace or record family lineage and ancestry (Heb 7.6).

DEFINITION: Detailed record or account of descent or ancestry, frequently criticized in pastoral letters when associated with sterile speculations.
SENSES: 1. A detailed list of ancestors or speculative lineage discussions (1Tm 1.4; Tit 3.9).

THAYER.pt: Registro ou relato detalhado de descendência ou ancestralidade, frequentemente criticado em cartas pastorais quando associado a especulações estéreis. 1. Uma lista detalhada de antepassados ou discussões especulativas de linhagem (1Tm 1.4; Tt 3.9).
THAYER.en: Detailed record or account of descent or ancestry, frequently criticized in pastoral letters when associated with sterile speculations. 1. A detailed list of ancestors or speculative lineage discussions (1Tm 1.4; Tit 3.9).

DEFINITION: Neuter plural noun denoting the festive celebration commemorating someone's birth anniversary.
SENSES: 1. The birthday party or commemorative banquet (Mt 14.6; Mk 6.21).

THAYER.pt: Substantivo plural neutro que denota a celebração festiva comemorativa do aniversário natalício de alguém. 1. A festa ou banquete comemorativo de aniversário (Mt 14.6; Mc 6.21).
THAYER.en: Neuter plural noun denoting the festive celebration commemorating someone's birth anniversary. 1. The birthday party or commemorative banquet (Mt 14.6; Mk 6.21).

DEFINITION: The act or process of coming into existence, encompassing physical birth, family lineage, or the journey of human life.
SENSES: 1. Physical birth of a person (Mt 1.18; Lk 1.14).
2. Course and experience of human life (Jas 1.23; 3.6).
3. Origin, genealogy, or historical record (Mt 1.1).

THAYER.pt: O ato ou processo de vir à existência, abrangendo o nascimento físico, a linhagem familiar ou a jornada da vida humana. 1. Nascimento físico de uma pessoa (Mt 1.18; Lc 1.14). | 2. Curso e experiência da vida humana (Tg 1.23; 3.6). | 3. Origem, genealogia ou registro histórico (Mt 1.1).
THAYER.en: The act or process of coming into existence, encompassing physical birth, family lineage, or the journey of human life. 1. Physical birth of a person (Mt 1.18; Lk 1.14). | 2. Course and experience of human life (Jas 1.23; 3.6). | 3. Origin, genealogy, or historical record (Mt 1.1).

DEFINITION: The event or process of coming into the world through physical birth.
SENSES: 1. Birth, especially in the expression 'from birth' (Jn 9.1).

THAYER.pt: O evento ou processo de vir ao mundo por meio do nascimento físico. 1. Nascimento, especialmente na expressão 'desde o nascimento' (Jo 9.1).
THAYER.en: The event or process of coming into the world through physical birth. 1. Birth, especially in the expression 'from birth' (Jn 9.1).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: γεννήσω, Aor: ἐγέννησα, Perf: γεγέννηκα, Pass: γεγέννημαι
DEFINITION: Denotes biological generation by the father (to beget) or the mother (to give birth). In Johannine and Pauline corpus, it takes on strong soteriological connotation describing spiritual regeneration wrought by God.
SENSES: 1. To beget as a father or male progenitor (Mt 1.2; Heb 1.5).
2. To give birth as a mother (Lk 1.13, 57; Jn 16.21).
3. To beget spiritually or grant new birth (Jn 3.3-8; 1Jn 5.1; 1Co 4.15).

THAYER.pt: Denota a geração biológica a partir do pai (gerar) ou da mãe (dar à luz). No corpus joanino e paulino, assume forte conotação soteriológica ao descrever a regeneração espiritual operada por Deus. 1. Gerar na qualidade de pai ou progenitor masculino (Mt 1.2; Hb 1.5). | 2. Dar à luz na qualidade de mãe (Lc 1.13, 57; Jo 16.21). | 3. Gerar espiritualmente ou conceder novo nascimento (Jo 3.3-8; 1Jo 5.1; 1Co 4.15).
THAYER.en: Denotes biological generation by the father (to beget) or the mother (to give birth). In Johannine and Pauline corpus, it takes on strong soteriological connotation describing spiritual regeneration wrought by God. 1. To beget as a father or male progenitor (Mt 1.2; Heb 1.5). | 2. To give birth as a mother (Lk 1.13, 57; Jn 16.21). | 3. To beget spiritually or grant new birth (Jn 3.3-8; 1Jn 5.1; 1Co 4.15).

DEFINITION: The product or offspring generated by living beings, or the fruit produced by the earth.
SENSES: 1. Descendants, offspring, or brood of animals and human beings (Mt 3.7).
2. Fruit or product of the earth and the harvest.

THAYER.pt: O produto ou prole gerada por seres vivos, ou o fruto produzido pela terra. 1. Descendência, prole ou cria de animais e seres humanos (Mt 3.7). | 2. Fruto ou produto da terra e da colheita.
THAYER.en: The product or offspring generated by living beings, or the fruit produced by the earth. 1. Descendants, offspring, or brood of animals and human beings (Mt 3.7). | 2. Fruit or product of the earth and the harvest.

DEFINITION: Designation of a fertile plain situated on the western shore of the Sea of Galilee, as well as an alternate name for the lake itself.
SENSES: 1. A fertile and populous region or plain in Galilee (Lk 5.1).

THAYER.pt: Designação de uma planície fértil situada à margem ocidental do Mar da Galileia, bem como um nome alternativo para o próprio lago. 1. Região ou planície fértil e populosa na Galileia (Lc 5.1).
THAYER.en: Designation of a fertile plain situated on the western shore of the Sea of Galilee, as well as an alternate name for the lake itself. 1. A fertile and populous region or plain in Galilee (Lk 5.1).

DEFINITION: The act or process by which a living being comes into existence through birth.
SENSES: 1. The event of birth or biological origin (Mt 1.18).

THAYER.pt: O ato ou processo pelo qual um ser vivo vem à existência através do nascimento. 1. O evento do nascimento ou origem biológica (Mt 1.18).
THAYER.en: The act or process by which a living being comes into existence through birth. 1. The event of birth or biological origin (Mt 1.18).

DEFINITION: Adjective derived from generation words, meaning one who has undergone the process of birth or human procreation.
SENSES: 1. One born of woman, designating mortal human beings (Mt 11.11).

THAYER.pt: Adjetivo derivado de verbetes de geração, significando aquele que passou pelo processo de nascimento ou pro criação humana. 1. Aquele que nasceu de mulher, designando os seres humanos mortais (Mt 11.11).
THAYER.en: Adjective derived from generation words, meaning one who has undergone the process of birth or human procreation. 1. One born of woman, designating mortal human beings (Mt 11.11).

DEFINITION: Designates ancestral lineage, descent, ethnic group, or a class of beings united by common biological or social characteristics.
SENSES: 1. Family lineage or ancestral descent (Ac 4.6).
2. People, nation, or ethnic group (1Pe 2.9).
3. Kind, category, or type of beings or objects (Mt 13.47).

THAYER.pt: Designa linhagem ancestral, descendência, grupo étnico ou uma classe de seres unidos por características biológicas ou sociais comuns. 1. Linhagem familiar ou descendência ancestral (At 4.6). | 2. Povo, nação ou grupo étnico (1Pe 2.9). | 3. Espécie, categoria ou tipo de seres ou objetos (Mt 13.47).
THAYER.en: Designates ancestral lineage, descent, ethnic group, or a class of beings united by common biological or social characteristics. 1. Family lineage or ancestral descent (Ac 4.6). | 2. People, nation, or ethnic group (1Pe 2.9). | 3. Kind, category, or type of beings or objects (Mt 13.47).

DEFINITION: Relating to the inhabitants of Gergesa, a city located in the eastern region of the Sea of Galilee.
SENSES: 1. Inhabitant or native of Gergesa, the Gergesenes (Mt 8.28).

THAYER.pt: Relativo aos habitantes de Gergesa, cidade localizada na região oriental do lago da Galileia. 1. Habitante ou natural de Gergesa, os gergesenos (Mt 8.28).
THAYER.en: Relating to the inhabitants of Gergesa, a city located in the eastern region of the Sea of Galilee. 1. Inhabitant or native of Gergesa, the Gergesenes (Mt 8.28).

DEFINITION: A council composed of respectable elders; in the Jewish context, it refers to the Sanhedrin or the supreme assembly of religious leaders.
SENSES: 1. The council of elders or Sanhedrin in Jerusalem (Ac 5.21).

THAYER.pt: Conselho composto por anciãos respeitáveis; no contexto judaico, refere-se ao Sinédrio ou à suprema assembleia de líderes religiosos. 1. O conselho de anciãos ou Sinédrio em Jerusalém (At 5.21).
THAYER.en: A council composed of respectable elders; in the Jewish context, it refers to the Sanhedrin or the supreme assembly of religious leaders. 1. The council of elders or Sanhedrin in Jerusalem (Ac 5.21).

DEFINITION: An adult man who has reached advanced age, characterized by maturity and life experience.
SENSES: 1. An elderly man or one of advanced age (Jn 3.4).

THAYER.pt: Homem adulto que alcançou idade avançada, caracterizado pela maturidade e experiência de vida. 1. Um homem idoso ou de idade avançada (Jo 3.4).
THAYER.en: An adult man who has reached advanced age, characterized by maturity and life experience. 1. An elderly man or one of advanced age (Jn 3.4).

DEFINITION: To experience food through the palate or, figuratively, to experience a spiritual or emotional reality personally and cognitively.
SENSES: 1. To taste or consume food or drink by mouth (Jn 2.9; Ac 10.10).
2. To experience or undergo something deeply and personally (Heb 2.9; 6.4).

THAYER.pt: Experimentar alimentos pelo paladar ou, figurativamente, experimentar de forma pessoal e cognitiva uma realidade espiritual ou emocional. 1. Provar ou consumir alimentos ou bebidas pela boca (Jo 2.9; At 10.10). | 2. Vivenciar ou experimentar algo de maneira profunda e pessoal (Hb 2.9; 6.4).
THAYER.en: To experience food through the palate or, figuratively, to experience a spiritual or emotional reality personally and cognitively. 1. To taste or consume food or drink by mouth (Jn 2.9; Ac 10.10). | 2. To experience or undergo something deeply and personally (Heb 2.9; 6.4).

DEFINITION: To practice agriculture, plow the land, or tend to the cultivation of plants and crops.
SENSES: 1. To cultivate the land or tend crops (Heb 6.7).

THAYER.pt: Praticar a agricultura, arar a terra ou cuidar do cultivo de plantas e plantações. 1. Cultivar a terra ou cuidar de plantações (Hb 6.7).
THAYER.en: To practice agriculture, plow the land, or tend to the cultivation of plants and crops. 1. To cultivate the land or tend crops (Heb 6.7).

DEFINITION: An area of arable land intended for agricultural cultivation. In the New Testament, it is used metaphorically for the Christian community as God's tillage.
SENSES: 1. Arable land or cultivated field, applied to the church (1Co 3.9).

THAYER.pt: Área de terra arável destinada ao cultivo agrícola. No Novo Testamento, é usado metaforicamente para a comunidade cristã como lavoura de Deus. 1. Terra arável ou campo cultivado, aplicado à igreja (1Co 3.9).
THAYER.en: An area of arable land intended for agricultural cultivation. In the New Testament, it is used metaphorically for the Christian community as God's tillage. 1. Arable land or cultivated field, applied to the church (1Co 3.9).

DEFINITION: One who cultivates the land, tends crops, or works in agriculture and viticulture.
SENSES: 1. Farmer or plowman who cultivates the land (2Tm 2.6; Jas 5.7).
2. Vinedresser or tenant of a vineyard (Mt 21.33; Jn 15.1).

THAYER.pt: Aquele que cultiva a terra, cuida de plantações ou trabalha na agricultura e na viticultura. 1. Agricultor ou lavrador que cultiva a terra (2Tm 2.6; Tg 5.7). | 2. Viticultor ou arrendatário de vinha (Mt 21.33; Jo 15.1).
THAYER.en: One who cultivates the land, tends crops, or works in agriculture and viticulture. 1. Farmer or plowman who cultivates the land (2Tm 2.6; Jas 5.7). | 2. Vinedresser or tenant of a vineyard (Mt 21.33; Jn 15.1).

DEFINITION: The material layer of the planet inhabited by humanity, in contrast to the vastness of the seas or heavenly regions. It can point to the physical substance of agricultural soil, a delimited region, or the human world.
SENSES: 1. Planet earth as the stage of human life in contrast to heaven (Mt 5.34-35; 6.10).
2. Fertile soil, mineral dust, or arable ground (Mt 13.5; Jn 8.6).
3. Delimited region, homeland, national territory, or province (Mt 2.6; Ac 7.3).
4. Dry land in contrast to maritime waters (Mk 4.1; Jn 21.8).

THAYER.pt: Camada material do planeta habitada pela humanidade, em contraste com a vastidão dos mares ou com as regiões celestes. Pode apontar para a substância física do solo agrícola, para uma região delimitada ou para o mundo humano. 1. Planeta terra como palco da vida humana em oposição ao céu (Mt 5.34-35; 6.10). | 2. Solo fértil, poeira mineral ou terreno arável (Mt 13.5; Jo 8.6). | 3. Região delimitada, pátria, território nacional ou província (Mt 2.6; At 7.3). | 4. Terra firme em oposição às águas marítimas (Mc 4.1; Jo 21.8).
THAYER.en: The material layer of the planet inhabited by humanity, in contrast to the vastness of the seas or heavenly regions. It can point to the physical substance of agricultural soil, a delimited region, or the human world. 1. Planet earth as the stage of human life in contrast to heaven (Mt 5.34-35; 6.10). | 2. Fertile soil, mineral dust, or arable ground (Mt 13.5; Jn 8.6). | 3. Delimited region, homeland, national territory, or province (Mt 2.6; Ac 7.3). | 4. Dry land in contrast to maritime waters (Mk 4.1; Jn 21.8).

DEFINITION: The stage of life characterized by advancing years and old age.
SENSES: 1. Advanced age or old age (Lk 1.36).

THAYER.pt: O estágio da vida caracterizado pelo avançar dos anos e pela velhice. 1. Idade avançada ou velhice (Lc 1.36).
THAYER.en: The stage of life characterized by advancing years and old age. 1. Advanced age or old age (Lk 1.36).

DEFINITION: To describe the biological process of advancing in age, becoming elderly, or figuratively the wear and obsolescence of institutions or covenants.
SENSES: 1. To grow physically old over the years (Jn 21.18);
2. To become obsolete or antiquated (Heb 8.13).

THAYER.pt: Descrever o processo biológico de avançar em idade, tornando-se idoso, ou figuradamente o desgaste e obsolescência de instituições ou pactos. 1. Envelhecer fisicamente ao longo dos anos (Jo 21.18); | 2. Tornar-se obsoleto ou antiquado (Hb 8.13).
THAYER.en: To describe the biological process of advancing in age, becoming elderly, or figuratively the wear and obsolescence of institutions or covenants. 1. To grow physically old over the years (Jn 21.18); | 2. To become obsolete or antiquated (Heb 8.13).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Deponent. Fut: γενήσομαι, Aor: ἐγενόμην / ἐγενήθην, Perf: γέγονα
DEFINITION: Dynamic verb of existence indicating coming into being, entering a new state of being, or happening historically in time.
SENSES: 1. To come into existence, be created, or be born (Jn 1.3; 8.58).
2. To enter a new condition or become something (Jn 1.14; Ro 7.3).
3. To happen, take place, or come about as a historical event (Mt 1.22; 8.24).

THAYER.pt: Verbo dinâmico de existência que indica passar a existir, entrar em novo estado de ser ou suceder historicamente no tempo. 1. Vir a existir, ser criado ou nascer (Jo 1.3; 8.58). | 2. Passar a uma nova condição ou tornar-se algo (Jo 1.14; Rm 7.3). | 3. Acontecer, suceder ou realizar-se como evento histórico (Mt 1.22; 8.24).
THAYER.en: Dynamic verb of existence indicating coming into being, entering a new state of being, or happening historically in time. 1. To come into existence, be created, or be born (Jn 1.3; 8.58). | 2. To enter a new condition or become something (Jn 1.14; Ro 7.3). | 3. To happen, take place, or come about as a historical event (Mt 1.22; 8.24).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: γνώσομαι, Aor: ἔγνων, Perf: ἔγνωκα
DEFINITION: The process of assimilating knowledge through direct experience, intimate relational contact, or progressive reasoning. It can denote both intellectual perception and saving personal knowledge that binds the believer to God.
SENSES: 1. To understand, intellectually perceive, or discern the meaning of something (Mt 16.3; Jn 8.32).
2. To know intimately through experiential relationship (Jn 17.3; Gal 4.9).
3. To discover, ascertain through prior investigation (Mk 5.43; Ac 21.34).
4. Hebraizing euphemism for marital sexual intimacy (Mt 1.25; Lk 1.34).

THAYER.pt: Processo de assimilar conhecimento por meio de experiência direta, contato relacional íntimo ou raciocínio progressivo. Pode denotar tanto a percepção intelectual quanto o conhecimento pessoal salvífico que vincula o crente a Deus. 1. Compreender, perceber intelectualmente ou discernir o significado de algo (Mt 16.3; Jo 8.32). | 2. Conhecer intimamente por meio de relacionamento vivencial (Jo 17.3; Gl 4.9). | 3. Descobrir, averiguar mediante investigação prévia (Mc 5.43; At 21.34). | 4. Eufemismo hebraizante para relacionamento de intimidade sexual conjugal (Mt 1.25; Lc 1.34).
THAYER.en: The process of assimilating knowledge through direct experience, intimate relational contact, or progressive reasoning. It can denote both intellectual perception and saving personal knowledge that binds the believer to God. 1. To understand, intellectually perceive, or discern the meaning of something (Mt 16.3; Jn 8.32). | 2. To know intimately through experiential relationship (Jn 17.3; Gal 4.9). | 3. To discover, ascertain through prior investigation (Mk 5.43; Ac 21.34). | 4. Hebraizing euphemism for marital sexual intimacy (Mt 1.25; Lk 1.34).

DEFINITION: Sweet wine freshly extracted from grapes, known for its high sugar content and for fermenting rapidly.
SENSES: 1. New sweet wine or must (Ac 2.13).

THAYER.pt: Vinho doce recém-extraído das uvas, conhecido por seu alto teor de açúcar e por fermentar rapidamente. 1. Vinho doce novo ou mosto (At 2.13).
THAYER.en: Sweet wine freshly extracted from grapes, known for its high sugar content and for fermenting rapidly. 1. New sweet wine or must (Ac 2.13).

DEFINITION: Describes that which has a sweet taste or presents itself pure and fresh, as opposed to what is bitter or salty.
SENSES: 1. Fresh or potable water, not salty or corrupted (Jas 3.11).

THAYER.pt: Descreve aquilo que possui sabor doce ou que se apresenta puro e fresco, em oposição ao que é amargo ou salgado. 1. Água fresca ou potável, não salgada ou corrompida (Tg 3.11).
THAYER.en: Describes that which has a sweet taste or presents itself pure and fresh, as opposed to what is bitter or salty. 1. Fresh or potable water, not salty or corrupted (Jas 3.11).

DEFINITION: Refers anatomically to the organ of speech, to the articulated language spoken by a human group, and, by charismatic extension, to oral manifestations in spiritual tongues inspired by the Holy Spirit.
SENSES: 1. Physical organ of the mouth used in speech articulation or ingestion (Lk 16.24; Jas 3.5; 1Pe 3.10).
2. Language or dialect of a given people (Ac 2.11; Rev 5.9; Ro 14.11).
3. Phenomenon of spiritual elocution or tongues of charismatic prayer (Ac 2.4; 1Co 12.10; 1Co 14.2).
4. Appearance of flames resembling tongues of fire (Ac 2.3).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se anatomicamente ao órgão da fala, ao idioma articulado falado por um grupo humano e, por extensão carismática, às manifestações orais em línguas espirituais inspiradas pelo Espírito Santo. 1. Órgão físico da boca usado na articulação da fala ou ingestão (Lc 16.24; Tg 3.5; 1Pe 3.10). | 2. Idioma ou dialeto de um determinado povo (At 2.11; Ap 5.9; Rm 14.11). | 3. Fenômeno de elocução espiritual ou línguas de oração carismática (At 2.4; 1Co 12.10; 1Co 14.2). | 4. Aparência de labaredas semelhantes a línguas de fogo (At 2.3).
THAYER.en: Refers anatomically to the organ of speech, to the articulated language spoken by a human group, and, by charismatic extension, to oral manifestations in spiritual tongues inspired by the Holy Spirit. 1. Physical organ of the mouth used in speech articulation or ingestion (Lk 16.24; Jas 3.5; 1Pe 3.10). | 2. Language or dialect of a given people (Ac 2.11; Rev 5.9; Ro 14.11). | 3. Phenomenon of spiritual elocution or tongues of charismatic prayer (Ac 2.4; 1Co 12.10; 1Co 14.2). | 4. Appearance of flames resembling tongues of fire (Ac 2.3).

DEFINITION: Originally a case for flute mouthpieces, it came to designate any box or small coffer used to keep valuables or money.
SENSES: 1. Box or bag where coins and financial resources were kept (Jn 13.29).

THAYER.pt: Originalmente estojo para boquilhas de flauta, passou a designar qualquer caixa ou pequeno cofre utilizado para guardar objetos de valor ou dinheiro. 1. Caixa ou bolsa onde se guardavam moedas e recursos financeiros (Jo 13.29).
THAYER.en: Originally a case for flute mouthpieces, it came to designate any box or small coffer used to keep valuables or money. 1. Box or bag where coins and financial resources were kept (Jn 13.29).

DEFINITION: A professional specialized in the cleaning, whitening, washing, and treatment of woolen fabrics and clothes.
SENSES: 1. Fuller or launderer of fabrics (Mk 9.3).

THAYER.pt: Profissional especializado na limpeza, clareamento, lavagem e tratamento de tecidos e roupas de lã. 1. Pisoeiro ou lavadeiro de tecidos (Mc 9.3).
THAYER.en: A professional specialized in the cleaning, whitening, washing, and treatment of woolen fabrics and clothes. 1. Fuller or launderer of fabrics (Mk 9.3).

DEFINITION: Qualifies that which is authentic, true, or legitimate, demonstrating a genuine character and valid origin.
SENSES: 1. A true and legitimate companion or helper in the faith (Php 4.3);
2. Genuine sincerity that proves the reality of a virtue (2Co 8.8).

THAYER.pt: Qualifica o que é autêntico, verdadeiro ou legítimo, demonstrando caráter genuíno e procedência válida. 1. Companheiro ou colaborador verdadeiro e legítimo na fé (Fp 4.3); | 2. Sinceridade genuína que comprova a realidade de uma virtude (2Co 8.8).
THAYER.en: Qualifies that which is authentic, true, or legitimate, demonstrating a genuine character and valid origin. 1. A true and legitimate companion or helper in the faith (Php 4.3); | 2. Genuine sincerity that proves the reality of a virtue (2Co 8.8).

DEFINITION: Describes an attitude or action carried out in a genuine, sincere, and true manner, without pretense.
SENSES: 1. Sincerely and genuinely, with real affection (Php 2.20).

THAYER.pt: Descreve uma atitude ou ação realizada de maneira genuína, sincera e verdadeira, sem fingimento. 1. De modo sincero e genuíno, com afeição real (Fp 2.20).
THAYER.en: Describes an attitude or action carried out in a genuine, sincere, and true manner, without pretense. 1. Sincerely and genuinely, with real affection (Php 2.20).

DEFINITION: Indicates deep darkness or thick gloom, frequently associated with terrifying or atmospheric divine manifestations.
SENSES: 1. Dense darkness or gloom, used to describe the setting of Sinai (Heb 12.18).

THAYER.pt: Indica escuridão profunda ou negrume espesso, frequentemente associado a manifestações divinas aterrorizantes ou atmosféricas. 1. Escuridão densa ou negrume, usado para descrever o cenário do Sinai (Hb 12.18).
THAYER.en: Indicates deep darkness or thick gloom, frequently associated with terrifying or atmospheric divine manifestations. 1. Dense darkness or gloom, used to describe the setting of Sinai (Heb 12.18).

DEFINITION: Refers to the mental process or the result of deliberation, encompassing intentions, personal opinions, counsel, or resolutions made.
SENSES: 1. Purpose, intention, or direction of will (1Co 1.10; Rev 17.13).
2. Opinion, point of view, or personal judgment (1Co 7.25,40).
3. Approval, consent, or agreement (Phm 14).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se ao processo mental ou ao resultado de uma deliberação, abrangendo intenções, opiniões pessoais, conselhos ou resoluções tomadas. 1. Propósito, intenção ou direção de vontade (1Co 1.10; Ap 17.13). | 2. Opinião, ponto de vista ou parecer pessoal (1Co 7.25,40). | 3. Aprovação, consentimento ou acordo (Fm 14).
THAYER.en: Refers to the mental process or the result of deliberation, encompassing intentions, personal opinions, counsel, or resolutions made. 1. Purpose, intention, or direction of will (1Co 1.10; Rev 17.13). | 2. Opinion, point of view, or personal judgment (1Co 7.25,40). | 3. Approval, consent, or agreement (Phm 14).

DEFINITION: To cause information to be known by others, revealing truths or mysteries.
SENSES: 1. To communicate or reveal a divine or secret piece of information (Eph 6.19; Php 1.22).

THAYER.pt: Fazer com que uma informação se torne conhecida por outros, revelando verdades ou mistérios. 1. Comunicar ou revelar uma informação divina ou secreta (Ef 6.19; Fp 1.22).
THAYER.en: To cause information to be known by others, revealing truths or mysteries. 1. To communicate or reveal a divine or secret piece of information (Eph 6.19; Php 1.22).

DEFINITION: The faculty of understanding, retaining, and possessing intellectual or spiritual information about facts, truths, and God.
SENSES: 1. Intellectual understanding or perception of divine or human truths (Ro 11.33; 1Co 8.1).
2. The content of what is known or taught (Ro 2.20; 2Co 10.5).

THAYER.pt: A faculdade de compreender, reter e possuir informações intelectuais ou espirituais sobre fatos, verdades e sobre Deus. 1. Compreensão ou percepção intelectual de verdades divinas ou humanas (Rm 11.33; 1Co 8.1). | 2. O conteúdo daquilo que é conhecido ou ensinado (Rm 2.20; 2Co 10.5).
THAYER.en: The faculty of understanding, retaining, and possessing intellectual or spiritual information about facts, truths, and God. 1. Intellectual understanding or perception of divine or human truths (Ro 11.33; 1Co 8.1). | 2. The content of what is known or taught (Ro 2.20; 2Co 10.5).

DEFINITION: Refers to someone who possesses deep knowledge or intimate familiarity with a certain subject or custom.
SENSES: 1. One who knows deeply or is an expert in certain matters (Ac 26.3).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se a alguém que possui conhecimento profundo ou familiaridade íntima sobre um determinado assunto ou costume. 1. Aquele que conhece profundamente ou é perito em certos assuntos (At 26.3).
THAYER.en: Refers to someone who possesses deep knowledge or intimate familiarity with a certain subject or custom. 1. One who knows deeply or is an expert in certain matters (Ac 26.3).

DEFINITION: Refers to something that is widely known, understandable, or to a person who is close as a friend or acquaintance.
SENSES: 1. Something known, evident, or notorious (Ac 2.14; 4.10).
2. Known person, friend, or close relative (Lk 23.49; Jn 18.15).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se a algo que é amplamente conhecido, compreensível ou a uma pessoa que é próxima como amiga ou conhecida. 1. Algo que é conhecido, evidente ou notório (At 2.14; 4.10). | 2. Pessoa conhecida, amigo ou parente próximo (Lc 23.49; Jo 18.15).
THAYER.en: Refers to something that is widely known, understandable, or to a person who is close as a friend or acquaintance. 1. Something known, evident, or notorious (Ac 2.14; 4.10). | 2. Known person, friend, or close relative (Lk 23.49; Jn 18.15).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Impf: ἐγόγγυζון, Fut: γογγύσω, Aor: ἐγόγγυσα
DEFINITION: To express dissatisfaction or discontent in a low voice, grumbling or complaining against someone.
SENSES: 1. To murmur or complain in a disapproving way (Mt 20.11; Jn 6.41).
2. To speak in a low voice, whisper, or mutter (Jn 7.32).

THAYER.pt: Expressar insatisfação ou descontentamento em voz baixa, resmungando ou queixándose contra alguém. 1. Murmurar ou queixar-se de forma desaprovadora (Mt 20.11; Jo 6.41). | 2. Falar em voz baixa, cochichar ou sussurrar (Jo 7.32).
THAYER.en: To express dissatisfaction or discontent in a low voice, grumbling or complaining against someone. 1. To murmur or complain in a disapproving way (Mt 20.11; Jn 6.41). | 2. To speak in a low voice, whisper, or mutter (Jn 7.32).

DEFINITION: The act of expressing dissatisfaction or discontent in a low, whispered, or veiled tone; murmuring.
SENSES: 1. Complaint or murmuring among members of the community (Ac 6.1);
2. A disposition to complain without contention (Php 2.14; 1Pe 4.9).

THAYER.pt: Ato de expressar insatisfação ou descontentamento em tom baixo, sussurrado ou velado; murmuração. 1. Reclamação ou murmuração entre membros da comunidade (At 6.1); | 2. Disposição para queixar-se sem contenda (Fp 2.14; 1Pe 4.9).
THAYER.en: The act of expressing dissatisfaction or discontent in a low, whispered, or veiled tone; murmuring. 1. Complaint or murmuring among members of the community (Ac 6.1); | 2. A disposition to complain without contention (Php 2.14; 1Pe 4.9).

DEFINITION: Designates a person who has the habit of complaining, grumbling, or murmuring against circumstances or authorities.
SENSES: 1. One who murmurs or complains chronically, expressing dissatisfaction (Jude 16).

THAYER.pt: Designa uma pessoa que tem o hábito de reclamar, resmungar ou murmurar contra circunstâncias ou autoridades. 1. Aquele que murmura ou reclama cronicamente, expressando insatisfação (Jd 16).
THAYER.en: Designates a person who has the habit of complaining, grumbling, or murmuring against circumstances or authorities. 1. One who murmurs or complains chronically, expressing dissatisfaction (Jude 16).

DEFINITION: Indicates a deceiver or impostor who uses trickery, sorcery, or false teachings to lead others astray.
SENSES: 1. A person who seduces or deceives through falsehood and artifices (2Tm 3.13).

THAYER.pt: Indica um enganador ou impostor que usa de artimanhas, feitiçaria ou falsos ensinamentos para desviar os outros. 1. Pessoa que seduz ou engana por meio de falsidade e artifícios (2Tm 3.13).
THAYER.en: Indicates a deceiver or impostor who uses trickery, sorcery, or false teachings to lead others astray. 1. A person who seduces or deceives through falsehood and artifices (2Tm 3.13).

DEFINITION: A term of Aramaic origin meaning 'Place of the Skull', referring to the hill located outside Jerusalem where Jesus was crucified.
SENSES: 1. The site of Jesus' crucifixion, translated as Place of the Skull (Mt 27.33; Mk 15.22; Jn 19.17).

THAYER.pt: Termo de origem aramaica que significa 'Lugar da Caveira', referindo-se à colina localizada fora de Jerusalém onde Jesus foi crucificado. 1. O local da crucificação de Jesus, traduzido como Lugar da Caveira (Mt 27.33; Mc 15.22; Jo 19.17).
THAYER.en: A term of Aramaic origin meaning 'Place of the Skull', referring to the hill located outside Jerusalem where Jesus was crucified. 1. The site of Jesus' crucifixion, translated as Place of the Skull (Mt 27.33; Mk 15.22; Jn 19.17).

DEFINITION: An ancient city of the plain destroyed by fire and sulfur due to its great wickedness, serving as a symbol of divine judgment.
SENSES: 1. The city of Gomorrah, destroyed along with Sodom (Mt 10.15; 2Pe 2.6).

THAYER.pt: Antiga cidade da planície destruída por fogo e enxofre devido à sua grande maldade, servindo como símbolo de juízo divino. 1. Cidade de Gomorra, destruída juntamente com Sodoma (Mt 10.15; 2Pe 2.6).
THAYER.en: An ancient city of the plain destroyed by fire and sulfur due to its great wickedness, serving as a symbol of divine judgment. 1. The city of Gomorrah, destroyed along with Sodom (Mt 10.15; 2Pe 2.6).

DEFINITION: Refers to the weight or volume of goods transported by a means of transport, especially sea vessels.
SENSES: 1. Cargo or freight transported by a ship (Ac 21.3; Rev 18.12).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se ao peso ou volume de mercadorias transportadas por um meio de transporte, especialmente embarcações marítimas. 1. Carga ou frete transportado por um navio (At 21.3; Ap 18.12).
THAYER.en: Refers to the weight or volume of goods transported by a means of transport, especially sea vessels. 1. Cargo or freight transported by a ship (Ac 21.3; Rev 18.12).

DEFINITION: Refers to biological or legal progenitors, frequently used in the plural to indicate father and mother jointly.
SENSES: 1. Father and/or mother, a person's progenitors (Mt 10.21; Lk 2.27).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se aos progenitores biológicos ou legais, sendo frequentemente usado no plural para indicar pai e mãe conjuntamente. 1. Pai e/ou mãe, os progenitores de uma pessoa (Mt 10.21; Lc 2.27).
THAYER.en: Refers to biological or legal progenitors, frequently used in the plural to indicate father and mother jointly. 1. Father and/or mother, a person's progenitors (Mt 10.21; Lk 2.27).

DEFINITION: The joint connecting the thigh to the leg, frequently associated in the New Testament with a posture of worship, submission, or weakness.
SENSES: 1. The anatomical joint of the knee (Lk 5.12; Heb 12.12).
2. In a metaphorical or postural expression, bending the knees as a sign of prayer and submission (Eph 3.14).

THAYER.pt: A articulação que conecta a coxa à perna, frequentemente associada no Novo Testamento à postura de adoração, submissão ou fraqueza. 1. A articulação anatômica do joelho (Lc 5.12; Hb 12.12). | 2. Em expressão metafórica ou postural, dobrar os joelhos em sinal de oração e submissão (Ef 3.14).
THAYER.en: The joint connecting the thigh to the leg, frequently associated in the New Testament with a posture of worship, submission, or weakness. 1. The anatomical joint of the knee (Lk 5.12; Heb 12.12). | 2. In a metaphorical or postural expression, bending the knees as a sign of prayer and submission (Eph 3.14).

DEFINITION: To bow down on one's knees as a sign of deep supplication, reverence, or worship before someone.
SENSES: 1. To kneel before someone to ask for help or healing (Mt 17.14; Mk 1.40; 10.17).

THAYER.pt: Inclinar-se sobre os joelhos em sinal de súplica profunda, reverência ou adoração diante de alguém. 1. Ajoelhar-se diante de alguém para pedir socorro ou cura (Mt 17.14; Mc 1.40; 10.17).
THAYER.en: To bow down on one's knees as a sign of deep supplication, reverence, or worship before someone. 1. To kneel before someone to ask for help or healing (Mt 17.14; Mk 1.40; 10.17).

DEFINITION: A unit of an alphabet or any written document, epistle, or formal record based on graphic characters.
SENSES: 1. Letter of the alphabet (Gal 6.11).
2. Written document, letter, or epistle (Ac 28.21).
3. The literal sense of the written law in contrast to the Spirit (Rom 2.27; 2Co 3.6).

THAYER.pt: Unidade de um alfabeto ou qualquer documento escrito, epístola ou registro formal baseado em caracteres gráficos. 1. Letra do alfabeto (Gl 6.11). | 2. Documento escrito, carta ou epístola (At 28.21). | 3. O sentido literal da lei escrita em contraste com o Espírito (Rm 2.27; 2Co 3.6).
THAYER.en: A unit of an alphabet or any written document, epistle, or formal record based on graphic characters. 1. Letter of the alphabet (Gal 6.11). | 2. Written document, letter, or epistle (Ac 28.21). | 3. The literal sense of the written law in contrast to the Spirit (Rom 2.27; 2Co 3.6).

DEFINITION: Designates a person versed in documents and laws, acting in the Jewish context as an expert in the Law of Moses and religious tradition, or as an administrative official in the Greco-Roman world.
SENSES: 1. An executive official or secretary with state or municipal administrative functions (Ac 19.35).
2. A qualified specialist and interpreter of the Law of Moses, commonly called a scribe (1Co 1.20; Mt 13.52).

THAYER.pt: Designa uma pessoa versada em documentos e leis, atuando no contexto judaico como um perito na Lei de Moisés e na tradição religiosa, ou como oficial administrativo no mundo greco-romano. 1. Oficial executivo ou secretário com funções administrativas estatais ou municipais (At 19.35). | 2. Especialista e intérprete qualificado da Lei de Moisés, comumente chamado de escriba (1Co 1.20; Mt 13.52).
THAYER.en: Designates a person versed in documents and laws, acting in the Jewish context as an expert in the Law of Moses and religious tradition, or as an administrative official in the Greco-Roman world. 1. An executive official or secretary with state or municipal administrative functions (Ac 19.35). | 2. A qualified specialist and interpreter of the Law of Moses, commonly called a scribe (1Co 1.20; Mt 13.52).

DEFINITION: Qualifies something that has been recorded in writing, engraved, or printed on some material.
SENSES: 1. That which is recorded or written, such as the law on the conscience (Rom 2.15).

THAYER.pt: Qualifica algo que foi registrado por escrito, gravado ou impresso em algum material. 1. Aquilo que está registrado ou escrito, como a lei na consciência (Rm 2.15).
THAYER.en: Qualifies something that has been recorded in writing, engraved, or printed on some material. 1. That which is recorded or written, such as the law on the conscience (Rom 2.15).

DEFINITION: Originally any text or written document. In the New Testament context, it acquired a fixed technical use to denote the inspired sacred writings of the Old Testament or individual passages thereof.
SENSES: 1. A specific passage or punctual text of the Old Testament (Mk 12.10; Lk 4.21; Jn 19.37).
2. The body of Holy Scriptures in its entirety (Mt 21.42; Lk 24.27; 2Tm 3.16; 2Pe 3.16).

THAYER.pt: Originalmente qualquer texto ou documento escrito. No contexto neotestamentário, adquiriu uso técnico fixo para denotar os escritos sagrados inspirados do Antigo Testamento ou passagens individuais dele. 1. Passagem específica ou texto pontual do Antigo Testamento (Mc 12.10; Lc 4.21; Jo 19.37). | 2. O conjunto das Sagradas Escrituras em sua totalidade (Mt 21.42; Lc 24.27; 2Tm 3.16; 2Pe 3.16).
THAYER.en: Originally any text or written document. In the New Testament context, it acquired a fixed technical use to denote the inspired sacred writings of the Old Testament or individual passages thereof. 1. A specific passage or punctual text of the Old Testament (Mk 12.10; Lk 4.21; Jn 19.37). | 2. The body of Holy Scriptures in its entirety (Mt 21.42; Lk 24.27; 2Tm 3.16; 2Pe 3.16).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: γράψω, Aor: ἔγραψα, Perf: γέγραφα
DEFINITION: The act of inscribing alphabetic characters on a surface to record data, compose messages or letters. In the theological formula of the perfect tense 'it is written' (γέγραπται), it points to the irrefutable and permanent authority of the Scriptures.
SENSES: 1. To trace letters, record thoughts or messages in writing (Jn 19.22; Gal 6.11).
2. To compose official documents, laws, or sacred books (Lk 1.63; Rom 15.15).
3. In the passive perfect (γέγραπται), to cite sacred oracles as a final norm ('it is written') (Mt 4.4; Lk 2.23).

THAYER.pt: Ato de inscrever caracteres alfabéticos sobre uma superfície para registrar dados, compor mensagens ou cartas. Na fórmula teológica do pretérito perfeito 'está escrito' (γέγραπται), aponta para a autoridade irrefutável e permanente das Escrituras. 1. Traçar letras, registrar pensamentos ou mensagens por escrito (Jo 19.22; Gl 6.11). | 2. Compor documentos oficiais, leis ou livros sagrados (Lc 1.63; Rm 15.15). | 3. No perfeito passivo (γέγραπται), citar oráculos sagrados como norma final ('está escrito') (Mt 4.4; Lc 2.23).
THAYER.en: The act of inscribing alphabetic characters on a surface to record data, compose messages or letters. In the theological formula of the perfect tense 'it is written' (γέγραπται), it points to the irrefutable and permanent authority of the Scriptures. 1. To trace letters, record thoughts or messages in writing (Jn 19.22; Gal 6.11). | 2. To compose official documents, laws, or sacred books (Lk 1.63; Rom 15.15). | 3. In the passive perfect (γέγραπται), to cite sacred oracles as a final norm ('it is written') (Mt 4.4; Lk 2.23).

DEFINITION: Qualifies myths, legends, or tales without Christian pedagogical value, depreciatively compared to stories told by elderly women.
SENSES: 1. Characteristic of antiquated or spiritually unfounded fables (1Tm 4.7).

THAYER.pt: Qualifica mitos, lendas ou contos sem valor pedagógico cristão, comparados depreciativamente a histórias contadas por mulheres idosas. 1. Característico de fábulas antiquadas ou sem fundamento espiritual (1Tm 4.7).
THAYER.en: Qualifies myths, legends, or tales without Christian pedagogical value, depreciatively compared to stories told by elderly women. 1. Characteristic of antiquated or spiritually unfounded fables (1Tm 4.7).

DEFINITION: Means to abstain from sleep to stay awake. In the NT, it has a strong spiritual connotation of constant vigilance and moral readiness facing Christ's imminent return.
SENSES: 1. To remain awake or vigilant (Mt 24.43).
2. To be spiritually alert and prepared (1Th 5.6; Rev 16.15).

THAYER.pt: Significa abster-se do sono para manter-se acordado. No NT, possui forte conotação espiritual de vigilância constante e prontidão moral frente ao retorno iminente de Cristo. 1. Permanecer acordado ou vigilante (Mt 24.43). | 2. Estar espiritualmente alerta e preparado (1Ts 5.6; Ap 16.15).
THAYER.en: Means to abstain from sleep to stay awake. In the NT, it has a strong spiritual connotation of constant vigilance and moral readiness facing Christ's imminent return. 1. To remain awake or vigilant (Mt 24.43). | 2. To be spiritually alert and prepared (1Th 5.6; Rev 16.15).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: γυμνάσω, Aor: ἐγύμνασα, Perf. Pass: γεγυμνασμένος
DEFINITION: To rigorously exercise the body or the mental and spiritual faculties through continuous discipline.
SENSES: 1. To discipline or exercise spiritual faculties and godliness (Heb 5.14; 1Tm 4.7);
2. To undergo correction or training through discipline (Heb 12.11).

THAYER.pt: Exercitar rigorosamente o corpo ou as faculdades mentais e espirituais por meio de disciplina contínua. 1. Disciplinar ou exercitar as faculdades espirituais e a piedade (Hb 5.14; 1Tm 4.7); | 2. Passar por correção ou treinamento através da disciplina (Hb 12.11).
THAYER.en: To rigorously exercise the body or the mental and spiritual faculties through continuous discipline. 1. To discipline or exercise spiritual faculties and godliness (Heb 5.14; 1Tm 4.7); | 2. To undergo correction or training through discipline (Heb 12.11).

DEFINITION: Refers to rigorous physical training or exercise practiced for body conditioning.
SENSES: 1. The practice of physical exercises for bodily development (1Tm 4.8).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se ao treinamento ou exercício físico rigoroso praticado para o condicionamento do corpo. 1. Prática de exercícios físicos para o desenvolvimento corporal (1Tm 4.8).
THAYER.en: Refers to rigorous physical training or exercise practiced for body conditioning. 1. The practice of physical exercises for bodily development (1Tm 4.8).

DEFINITION: To be poorly dressed, lacking adequate clothing, or in a state of partial nudity due to poverty.
SENSES: 1. To find oneself without sufficient clothing or in extreme deprivation (1Co 4.11).

THAYER.pt: Estar mal vestido, desprovido de vestimentas adequadas ou em estado de nudez parcial por pobreza. 1. Encontrar-se sem roupa suficiente ou em extrema privação (1Co 4.11).
THAYER.en: To be poorly dressed, lacking adequate clothing, or in a state of partial nudity due to poverty. 1. To find oneself without sufficient clothing or in extreme deprivation (1Co 4.11).

DEFINITION: Describes someone who is completely without clothes, dressed inappropriately, or without appropriate outer garments.
SENSES: 1. Completely naked, without clothing (Mk 14.52; Rev 3.17).
2. Poorly dressed or lacking adequate clothing (Mt 25.36; Jas 2.15).

THAYER.pt: Descreve alguém que está totalmente sem roupas, vestida de maneira inadequada ou sem a vestimenta externa apropriada. 1. Completamente nu, sem vestimentas (Mc 14.52; Ap 3.17). | 2. Mal vestido ou desprovido de roupas adequadas (Mt 25.36; Tg 2.15).
THAYER.en: Describes someone who is completely without clothes, dressed inappropriately, or without appropriate outer garments. 1. Completely naked, without clothing (Mk 14.52; Rev 3.17). | 2. Poorly dressed or lacking adequate clothing (Mt 25.36; Jas 2.15).

DEFINITION: The state of being without clothes or with extremely inadequate clothing, also connoting extreme poverty and deprivation.
SENSES: 1. The physical state of nudity or lack of adequate clothing (Rev 3.18).
2. A condition of severe deprivation, persecution, and scarcity of clothing (Rom 8.35; 2Co 11.27).

THAYER.pt: O estado de estar sem roupas ou com vestimentas extremamente inadequadas, conotando também extrema pobreza e privação. 1. O estado físico de nudez ou falta de vestimentas adequadas (Ap 3.18). | 2. Condição de severa privação, perseguição e escassez de roupas (Rm 8.35; 2Co 11.27).
THAYER.en: The state of being without clothes or with extremely inadequate clothing, also connoting extreme poverty and deprivation. 1. The physical state of nudity or lack of adequate clothing (Rev 3.18). | 2. A condition of severe deprivation, persecution, and scarcity of clothing (Rom 8.35; 2Co 11.27).

DEFINITION: A diminutive term with a pejorative connotation to designate a weak, frivolous, or easily manipulated woman.
SENSES: 1. A woman of weak or impressionable character, target of false teachers (2Tm 3.6).

THAYER.pt: Termo diminutivo com conotação pejorativa para designar uma mulher fraca, frívola ou facilmente manipulável. 1. Mulher de caráter fraco ou influenciável, alvo de falsos mestres (2Tm 3.6).
THAYER.en: A diminutive term with a pejorative connotation to designate a weak, frivolous, or easily manipulated woman. 1. A woman of weak or impressionable character, target of false teachers (2Tm 3.6).

DEFINITION: Pertaining or relating to the female gender, to women.
SENSES: 1. Referring to the weaker vessel, that is, to the woman (1Pe 3.7).

THAYER.pt: Pertencente ou relativo ao gênero feminino, às mulheres. 1. Referente ao vaso mais fraco, isto é, à mulher (1Pe 3.7).
THAYER.en: Pertaining or relating to the female gender, to women. 1. Referring to the weaker vessel, that is, to the woman (1Pe 3.7).

DEFINITION: An adult human being of the female sex. Depending on the syntactic and relational context, it encompasses both the generic aspect of gender and the specific status of a companion within established matrimony.
SENSES: 1. An adult woman in general, regardless of marriage (Mt 9.20; Lk 13.12).
2. A wife legally married to a husband (Mt 5.31; Eph 5.22).
3. A courteous and respectful vocative for direct interpersonal address (Jn 2.4; 19.26).

THAYER.pt: Ser humano adulto do sexo feminino. Dependendo do contexto sintático e relacional, abrange tanto o aspecto genérico de gênero quanto o status específico de companheira dentro do matrimônio instituído. 1. Mulher adulta em geral, independentemente de matrimônio (Mt 9.20; Lc 13.12). | 2. Esposa legalmente casada com um marido (Mt 5.31; Ef 5.22). | 3. Vocativo cortês e respeitoso de tratamento interpessoal direto (Jo 2.4; 19.26).
THAYER.en: An adult human being of the female sex. Depending on the syntactic and relational context, it encompasses both the generic aspect of gender and the specific status of a companion within established matrimony. 1. An adult woman in general, regardless of marriage (Mt 9.20; Lk 13.12). | 2. A wife legally married to a husband (Mt 5.31; Eph 5.22). | 3. A courteous and respectful vocative for direct interpersonal address (Jn 2.4; 19.26).

DEFINITION: An eschatological symbolic name which, together with Magog, designates the nations enemies of God gathered against His people at the end of times.
SENSES: 1. Symbolic name of nations enemies of God at the end of times (Rev 20.8).

THAYER.pt: Nome simbólico escatológico que, junto com Magog, designa as nações inimigas de Deus reunidas contra o Seu povo no fim dos tempos. 1. Nome simbólico de nações inimigas de Deus no final dos tempos (Ap 20.8).
THAYER.en: An eschatological symbolic name which, together with Magog, designates the nations enemies of God gathered against His people at the end of times. 1. Symbolic name of nations enemies of God at the end of times (Rev 20.8).

DEFINITION: Designates the point of junction or angle formed by the walls of a building or the limits of a geographical area.
SENSES: 1. The inner or outer corner of an architectural structure (Mt 21.42).
2. A hidden place, nook, or remote place (Ac 26.26).

THAYER.pt: Designa o ponto de junção ou ângulo formado pelas paredes de uma construção ou pelos limites de uma área geográfica. 1. O canto interno ou externo de uma estrutura arquitetônica (Mt 21.42). | 2. Um local escondido, recanto ou lugar remoto (At 26.26).
THAYER.en: Designates the point of junction or angle formed by the walls of a building or the limits of a geographical area. 1. The inner or outer corner of an architectural structure (Mt 21.42). | 2. A hidden place, nook, or remote place (Ac 26.26).

DEFINITION: Proper name referring to David, the second king of Israel and ancestor in the earthly genealogy of Jesus.
SENSES: 1. David, king of Israel and central figure in Jewish history and eschatology (Mt 1.6; Ac 2.29).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio que se refere a Davi, o segundo rei de Israel e ancestral na genealogia terrena de Jesus. 1. Davi, rei de Israel e figura central na história e escatologia judaica (Mt 1.6; At 2.29).
THAYER.en: Proper name referring to David, the second king of Israel and ancestor in the earthly genealogy of Jesus. 1. David, king of Israel and central figure in Jewish history and eschatology (Mt 1.6; Ac 2.29).

DEFINITION: To be under the direct dominion or torment of an evil spirit (demon).
SENSES: 1. To find oneself possessed or tormented by a demon (Mt 4.24; 15.22).

THAYER.pt: Estar sob o domínio ou tormento direto de um espírito maligno (demônio). 1. Encontrar-se possesso ou atormentado por um demônio (Mt 4.24; 15.22).
THAYER.en: To be under the direct dominion or torment of an evil spirit (demon). 1. To find oneself possessed or tormented by a demon (Mt 4.24; 15.22).

DEFINITION: In the New Testament context, consistently refers to a hostile spiritual being subordinate to Satan, causing oppression, illnesses, and opposition to the kingdom of God.
SENSES: 1. A spiritual entity or lesser divinity in general Greco-Roman worldview (Ac 17.18).
2. An evil spirit, demon hostile to God and human beings (Mt 7.22; Lk 8.30).

THAYER.pt: No contexto do Novo Testamento, refere-se consistentemente a um ser espiritual hostil e subordinado a Satanás, causador de opressão, enfermidades e oposição ao reino de Deus. 1. Entidade espiritual ou divindade menor na cosmovisão greco-romana geral (At 17.18). | 2. Espírito maligno, demônio hostil a Deus e aos seres humanos (Mt 7.22; Lc 8.30).
THAYER.en: In the New Testament context, consistently refers to a hostile spiritual being subordinate to Satan, causing oppression, illnesses, and opposition to the kingdom of God. 1. A spiritual entity or lesser divinity in general Greco-Roman worldview (Ac 17.18). | 2. An evil spirit, demon hostile to God and human beings (Mt 7.22; Lk 8.30).

DEFINITION: Qualifies that which has its origin or inspiration in evil spirits or the demonic realm, in opposition to that which comes from above.
SENSES: 1. Of a demonic nature or inspired by demons (Jas 3:15).

THAYER.pt: Qualifica aquilo que tem origem ou inspiração nos espíritos maus ou no reino demoníaco, em oposição ao que vem do alto. 1. De natureza demoníaca ou inspirada por demônios (Tg 3.15).
THAYER.en: Qualifies that which has its origin or inspiration in evil spirits or the demonic realm, in opposition to that which comes from above. 1. Of a demonic nature or inspired by demons (Jas 3:15).

DEFINITION: A malevolent spiritual entity subordinate to Satan, acting against the will of God and human well-being.
SENSES: 1. An evil spiritual being or demon (Matt 8:31).

THAYER.pt: Entidade espiritual maligna subordinada a Satanás, atuando contra a vontade de Deus e o bem-estar humano. 1. Ser espiritual maligno ou demônio (Mt 8.31).
THAYER.en: A malevolent spiritual entity subordinate to Satan, acting against the will of God and human well-being. 1. An evil spiritual being or demon (Matt 8:31).

DEFINITION: To set teeth against something causing physical harm, or figuratively to cause emotional pain, wound, or act hostilely toward someone.
SENSES: 1. To cause injury by means of a physical bite.
2. To cause emotional pain, hurt, or act hostilely in social interaction (Gal 5:15).

THAYER.pt: Atirar os dentes contra algo causando dano físico, ou figuradamente causar dor emocional, ferir ou hostilizar alguém. 1. Causar ferimento por meio de mordida física. | 2. Causar dor emocional, magoar ou hostilizar no convívio (Gl 5.15).
THAYER.en: To set teeth against something causing physical harm, or figuratively to cause emotional pain, wound, or act hostilely toward someone. 1. To cause injury by means of a physical bite. | 2. To cause emotional pain, hurt, or act hostilely in social interaction (Gal 5:15).

DEFINITION: Designates the saline fluid that springs from the eyes in moments of deep pain, suffering, anguish, or emotion.
SENSES: 1. A physical tear shed from the eyes (Rev 7:17; 21:4).
2. The act or period of weeping and wailing (2 Tim 1:4).

THAYER.pt: Designa o fluido salino que brota dos olhos em momentos de profunda dor, sofrimento, angústia ou emoção. 1. Lágrima física vertida dos olhos (Ap 7.17; 21.4). | 2. O ato ou período de choro e pranto (2Tm 1.4).
THAYER.en: Designates the saline fluid that springs from the eyes in moments of deep pain, suffering, anguish, or emotion. 1. A physical tear shed from the eyes (Rev 7:17; 21:4). | 2. The act or period of weeping and wailing (2 Tim 1:4).

DEFINITION: To shed tears from the eyes as an expression of sadness, emotion, or deep pain.
SENSES: 1. To shed tears or weep quietly (John 11:35).

THAYER.pt: Derramar lágrimas dos olhos como expressão de tristeza, comoção ou dor profunda. 1. Verter lágrimas ou chorar discretamente (Jo 11.35).
THAYER.en: To shed tears from the eyes as an expression of sadness, emotion, or deep pain. 1. To shed tears or weep quietly (John 11:35).

DEFINITION: A circular ornament of precious metal worn on the finger, often serving as a signet to authenticate documents and attest to authority.
SENSES: 1. A ring worn on the finger, a symbol of status or authority (Luke 15:22).

THAYER.pt: Ornamento circular de metal precioso usado no dedo, frequentemente servindo como sinete para autenticar documentos e atestar autoridade. 1. Anel usado no dedo, símbolo de status ou autoridade (Lc 15.22).
THAYER.en: A circular ornament of precious metal worn on the finger, often serving as a signet to authenticate documents and attest to authority. 1. A ring worn on the finger, a symbol of status or authority (Luke 15:22).

DEFINITION: The terminal anatomical part of the human hand, used for manipulation and, figuratively, to indicate the action of divine power.
SENSES: 1. The finger of the human hand (John 20:25).
2. The finger of God as an expression of divine power and action (Luke 11:20).

THAYER.pt: Parte anatômica terminal da mão humana, usada para manipulação e, figuradamente, para indicar a ação do poder divino. 1. O dedo da mão humana (Jo 20.25). | 2. O dedo de Deus como expressão do poder e da ação divina (Lc 11.20).
THAYER.en: The terminal anatomical part of the human hand, used for manipulation and, figuratively, to indicate the action of divine power. 1. The finger of the human hand (John 20:25). | 2. The finger of God as an expression of divine power and action (Luke 11:20).

DEFINITION: A geographical locality of uncertain exact location, situated on the shores of the Sea of Galilee.
SENSES: 1. A region or village on the shores of the Sea of Galilee (Mark 8:10).

THAYER.pt: Localidade geográfica de localização exata incerta, situada nas margens do mar da Galileia. 1. Região ou vilarejo às margens do Mar da Galileia (Mc 8.10).
THAYER.en: A geographical locality of uncertain exact location, situated on the shores of the Sea of Galilee. 1. A region or village on the shores of the Sea of Galilee (Mark 8:10).

DEFINITION: A Roman province situated on the eastern coast of the Adriatic Sea, in the southern region of Illyria.
SENSES: 1. A Roman region situated on the east coast of the Adriatic (2 Tim 4:10).

THAYER.pt: Província romana situada na costa oriental do mar Adriático, na região sul da Ilíria. 1. Região romana situada na costa leste do Adriático (2Tm 4.10).
THAYER.en: A Roman province situated on the eastern coast of the Adriatic Sea, in the southern region of Illyria. 1. A Roman region situated on the east coast of the Adriatic (2 Tim 4:10).

DEFINITION: To bring under control untamed forces or impulses, keeping them firmly restrained.
SENSES: 1. To subdue or tame wild animals and one's own tongue (Jas 3:7, 8).

THAYER.pt: Trazer sob controle forças indomadas ou impulsos, mantendo-os firmemente refreados. 1. Subjugar ou domar animais selvagens e a própria língua (Tg 3.7, 8).
THAYER.en: To bring under control untamed forces or impulses, keeping them firmly restrained. 1. To subdue or tame wild animals and one's own tongue (Jas 3:7, 8).

DEFINITION: A young female of bovine cattle, frequently used in purification rituals in the Old Testament.
SENSES: 1. A heifer or young cow used in ritual sacrifices (Heb 9:13).

THAYER.pt: Fêmea jovem de gado bovino, frequentemente utilizada em rituais de purificação no Antigo Testamento. 1. Novilha ou vaca jovem usada em sacrifícios rituais (Hb 9.13).
THAYER.en: A young female of bovine cattle, frequently used in purification rituals in the Old Testament. 1. A heifer or young cow used in ritual sacrifices (Heb 9:13).

DEFINITION: The name of an Athenian woman who believed in the Gospel after the preaching of the apostle Paul at the Areopagus.
SENSES: 1. A woman from Athens converted under Paul's ministry (Acts 17:34).
