THAYER.pt: Nome de uma mulher ateniense que creu no EvangeltoBeTruthy após a pregação do apóstolo Paulo no Areópago. 1. Mulher de Atenas convertida sob o ministério de Paulo (At 17.34).
THAYER.en: The name of an Athenian woman who believed in the Gospel after the preaching of the apostle Paul at the Areopagus. 1. A woman from Athens converted under Paul's ministry (Acts 17:34).

DEFINITION: Relating to the city of Damascus or a natural inhabitant thereof.
SENSES: 1. A native or inhabitant of the city of Damascus (2 Cor 11:32).

THAYER.pt: Relativo à cidade de Damasco ou habitante natural dela. 1. Natural ou habitante da cidade de Damasco (2Co 11.32).
THAYER.en: Relating to the city of Damascus or a natural inhabitant thereof. 1. A native or inhabitant of the city of Damascus (2 Cor 11:32).

DEFINITION: An important city and capital of Syria, with a significant Jewish population in the New Testament period, famous for the conversion of the apostle Paul in its vicinity.
SENSES: 1. The city of Damascus in Syria (Acts 9:2).

THAYER.pt: Importante cidade e capital da Síria, com expressiva população judaica no período neotestamentário, célebre pela conversão do apóstolo Paulo nas suas proximidades. 1. A cidade de Damasco na Síria (At 9.2).
THAYER.en: An important city and capital of Syria, with a significant Jewish population in the New Testament period, famous for the conversion of the apostle Paul in its vicinity. 1. The city of Damascus in Syria (Acts 9:2).

DEFINITION: To provide goods or money under the condition of restitution, or to obtain something borrowed from another.
SENSES: 1. To grant a financial or material loan to someone (Matt 5:42; Luke 6:34, 35).

THAYER.pt: Fornecer bens ou dinheiro sob a condição de restituição, ou obter algo emprestado de outrem. 1. Conceder empréstimo financeiro ou material a alguém (Mt 5.42; Lc 6.34, 35).
THAYER.en: To provide goods or money under the condition of restitution, or to obtain something borrowed from another. 1. To grant a financial or material loan to someone (Matt 5:42; Luke 6:34, 35).

DEFINITION: An amount of money or a good that has been lent to someone under the obligation of return.
SENSES: 1. Money or value taken as a loan (Matt 18:27).

THAYER.pt: Quantia em dinheiro ou bem que foi emprestado a alguém sob a obrigação de devolução. 1. Dinheiro ou valor tomado por empréstimo (Mt 18.27).
THAYER.en: An amount of money or a good that has been lent to someone under the obligation of return. 1. Money or value taken as a loan (Matt 18:27).

DEFINITION: A person who lends money at interest or grants credit to third parties.
SENSES: 1. A creditor or moneylender who lends money (Luke 7:41).

THAYER.pt: Pessoa que empresta dinheiro a juros ou concede crédito a terceiros. 1. Credor ou agiota que empresta dinheiro (Lc 7.41).
THAYER.en: A person who lends money at interest or grants credit to third parties. 1. A creditor or moneylender who lends money (Luke 7:41).

DEFINITION: A proper name designating Daniel, the prominent Old Testament prophet famous for his eschatological visions and faithfulness to God.
SENSES: 1. The Old Testament prophet mentioned in eschatological discourses (Matt 24:15).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio que designa Daniel, o proeminente profeta do Antigo Testamento célebre por suas visões escatológicas e fidelidade a Deus. 1. O profeta do Antigo Testamento mencionado em discursos escatológicos (Mt 24.15).
THAYER.en: A proper name designating Daniel, the prominent Old Testament prophet famous for his eschatological visions and faithfulness to God. 1. The Old Testament prophet mentioned in eschatological discourses (Matt 24:15).

DEFINITION: To disburse money, employ financial resources, or consume energy for the sake of something or someone.
SENSES: 1. To spend money or material resources (Mk 5:26; 2 Cor 12:15).

THAYER.pt: Desembolsar dinheiro, empregar recursos financeiros ou consumir energias em prol de algo ou alguém. 1. Gastar dinheiro ou recursos materiais (Mc 5.26; 2Co 12.15).
THAYER.en: To disburse money, employ financial resources, or consume energy for the sake of something or someone. 1. To spend money or material resources (Mk 5:26; 2 Cor 12:15).

DEFINITION: The amount of resources spent or required to acquire a good or carry out a task.
SENSES: 1. Cost, expenditure, or financial expense (Lk 14:28).

THAYER.pt: O montante de recursos gastos ou necessários para adquirir um bem ou realizar uma obra. 1. Custo, dispêndio ou despesa financeira (Lc 14.28).
THAYER.en: The amount of resources spent or required to acquire a good or carry out a task. 1. Cost, expenditure, or financial expense (Lk 14:28).

DEFINITION: A postpositive connective particle that introduces a new element into discourse. It may express a mild contrast ('but', 'yet') or function merely as a transition of thought and narrative progression ('and', 'now').
SENSES: 1. Moderate adversative, indicating contrast ('but', 'yet', 'however') (Mt 5:22; Rom 6:23).
2. Connective and continuative, serving as a narrative transition ('and', 'now', 'then') (Mt 1:18; Acts 1:15).
3. Correlative with μέν to contrast two ideas (ὁ μὲν... ὁ δὲ, 'the one... the other') (1 Cor 1:12; Heb 7:18-19).

THAYER.pt: Partícula conectiva pós-positiva que introduz um novo elemento no discurso. Pode expressar um contraste suave ('mas', 'porém') ou atuar meramente na transição de pensamentos e encadeamento narrativo ('e', 'ora'). 1. Adversativa moderada, indicando contraste ('mas', 'porém', 'contudo') (Mt 5.22; Rm 6.23). | 2. Conectiva e continuativa, fazendo transição na narrativa ('e', 'ora', 'então') (Mt 1.18; At 1.15). | 3. Correlativa com μέν para contrapor duas ideias (ὁ μὲν... ὁ δὲ, 'um... o outro') (1Co 1.12; Hb 7.18-19).
THAYER.en: A postpositive connective particle that introduces a new element into discourse. It may express a mild contrast ('but', 'yet') or function merely as a transition of thought and narrative progression ('and', 'now'). 1. Moderate adversative, indicating contrast ('but', 'yet', 'however') (Mt 5:22; Rom 6:23). | 2. Connective and continuative, serving as a narrative transition ('and', 'now', 'then') (Mt 1:18; Acts 1:15). | 3. Correlative with μέν to contrast two ideas (ὁ μὲν... ὁ δὲ, 'the one... the other') (1 Cor 1:12; Heb 7:18-19).

DEFINITION: An urgent and fervent request motivated by the perception of a deep need, directed exclusively to God.
SENSES: 1. Sincere supplication or petition presented to God in prayer (Lk 1:13; Phil 1:19).

THAYER.pt: Pedido urgente e fervoroso motivado pela percepção de uma necessidade profunda, dirigido exclusivamente a Deus. 1. Súplica ou petição sincera apresentada a Deus em oração (Lc 1.13; Fp 1.19).
THAYER.en: An urgent and fervent request motivated by the perception of a deep need, directed exclusively to God. 1. Sincere supplication or petition presented to God in prayer (Lk 1:13; Phil 1:19).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Impersonal verb, Impf: ἔδει, Fut: δεήσει
DEFINITION: Expresses unavoidable obligation or imperative necessity. In the NT, it often denotes the 'divine decree,' that is, what must happen for the Scriptures and God's redemptive will to be fulfilled.
SENSES: 1. Necessity based on divine plan and decree (Mt 16:21; Lk 24:26).
2. Obligation of a moral, legal, or appropriate nature (Acts 5:29; 1 Tim 3:2).
3. Inevitability imposed by historical or natural circumstances (Mt 24:6; Jn 3:30).

THAYER.pt: Expressa obrigação incontornável ou necessidade imperativa. No NT, denota frequentemente o 'decreto divino', isto é, aquilo que precisa acontecer para que as Escrituras e a vontade redentora de Deus se cumpram. 1. Necessidade fundamentada no plano e decreto divinos (Mt 16.21; Lc 24.26). | 2. Obrigação de natureza moral, legal ou de conveniência apropriada (At 5.29; 1Tm 3.2). | 3. Inevitabilidade imposta por circunstâncias históricas ou naturais (Mt 24.6; Jo 3.30).
THAYER.en: Expresses unavoidable obligation or imperative necessity. In the NT, it often denotes the 'divine decree,' that is, what must happen for the Scriptures and God's redemptive will to be fulfilled. 1. Necessity based on divine plan and decree (Mt 16:21; Lk 24:26). | 2. Obligation of a moral, legal, or appropriate nature (Acts 5:29; 1 Tim 3:2). | 3. Inevitability imposed by historical or natural circumstances (Mt 24:6; Jn 3:30).

DEFINITION: That which serves as evidence, a sample, or a practical example, frequently used in the New Testament as a moral warning or visible proof of divine judgment.
SENSES: 1. Indicator or proof of something (Jude 7);
2. Ostensive example or warning (2 Pet 2:6).

THAYER.pt: Aquilo que serve como evidência, amostra ou exemplo prático, frequentemente utilizado no Novo Testamento como advertência moral ou prova visível de um juízo divino. 1. Indicador ou prova de algo (Jd 7); | 2. Exemplo ostensivo ou advertência (2Pe 2:6).
THAYER.en: That which serves as evidence, a sample, or a practical example, frequently used in the New Testament as a moral warning or visible proof of divine judgment. 1. Indicator or proof of something (Jude 7); | 2. Ostensive example or warning (2 Pet 2:6).

DEFINITION: To expose someone to public shame, making them a spectacle of dishonor or mockery before others.
SENSES: 1. To expose to public dishonor or humiliation (Mt 1:19);
2. To triumph publicly over powers, disarming them and exposing them (Col 2:15).

THAYER.pt: Expor alguém à vergonha pública, tornando-o espetáculo de desonra ou zombaria perante os outros. 1. Expor à desonra pública ou humilhação (Mt 1.19); | 2. Triunfar publicamente sobre potestades, desarmando-as e expondo-as (Cl 2.15).
THAYER.en: To expose someone to public shame, making them a spectacle of dishonor or mockery before others. 1. To expose to public dishonor or humiliation (Mt 1:19); | 2. To triumph publicly over powers, disarming them and exposing them (Col 2:15).

DEFINITION: To make something perceptible to the senses or evident through evidence, demonstration, or reasoning.
SENSES: 1. To exhibit something visible, to point out, or to show physically (Mt 4:8; 8:4).
2. To prove, demonstrate, or clarify through evidence (Mt 16:21; Jas 2:18).

THAYER.pt: Tornar algo perceptível aos sentidos ou evidente por meio de evidências, demonstração ou raciocínio. 1. Exibir algo visível, apontar ou mostrar fisicamente (Mt 4.8; 8.4). | 2. Provar, demonstrar ou esclarecer por meio de evidências (Mt 16.21; Tg 2.18).
THAYER.en: To make something perceptible to the senses or evident through evidence, demonstration, or reasoning. 1. To exhibit something visible, to point out, or to show physically (Mt 4:8; 8:4). | 2. To prove, demonstrate, or clarify through evidence (Mt 16:21; Jas 2:18).

DEFINITION: Lack of mental firmness or moral strength in the face of difficulties, characterized by cowardice or paralyzing fear that contrasts with the courage granted by the Holy Spirit.
SENSES: 1. Lack of courage or spiritual and moral cowardice (2 Tim 1:7).

THAYER.pt: Falta de firmeza mental ou força moral diante das dificuldades, caracterizada pela covardia ou medo paralisante que contrasta com a coragem concedida pelo Espírito Santo. 1. Falta de coragem ou covardia espiritual e moral (2Tm 1:7).
THAYER.en: Lack of mental firmness or moral strength in the face of difficulties, characterized by cowardice or paralyzing fear that contrasts with the courage granted by the Holy Spirit. 1. Lack of courage or spiritual and moral cowardice (2 Tim 1:7).

DEFINITION: To be overcome by fear, to lose courage, or to be intimidated in the face of adverse circumstances.
SENSES: 1. To be seized by fear or to act cowardly (Jn 14:27).

THAYER.pt: Deixar-se dominar pelo medo, perder a coragem ou intimidar-se diante de circunstâncias adversas. 1. Ser tomado pelo medo ou acovardar-se (Jo 14:27).
THAYER.en: To be overcome by fear, to lose courage, or to be intimidated in the face of adverse circumstances. 1. To be seized by fear or to act cowardly (Jn 14:27).

DEFINITION: Characterized by a lack of courage in the face of danger or adversity, acting with pusillanimous fear.
SENSES: 1. Fearful or overcome by excessive fear in the face of storms (Mt 8:26; Mk 4:40);
2. Cowardly in the face of the tests of faith (Rev 21:8).

THAYER.pt: Caracterizado pela falta de coragem diante do perigo ou de adversidades, agindo com temor pusilânime. 1. Medroso ou tomado por temor excessivo diante de tempestades (Mt 8.26; Mc 4.40); | 2. Covarde diante dos testes da fé (Ap 21.8).
THAYER.en: Characterized by a lack of courage in the face of danger or adversity, acting with pusillanimous fear. 1. Fearful or overcome by excessive fear in the face of storms (Mt 8:26; Mk 4:40); | 2. Cowardly in the face of the tests of faith (Rev 21:8).

DEFINITION: A pronoun used to refer to a specific person or entity whose name one does not wish to reveal or is unknown at the moment.
SENSES: 1. An individual not specified by name, 'so-and-so' or 'a certain someone' (Mt 26:18).

THAYER.pt: Pronome usado para se referir a uma pessoa ou entidade específica cujo nome não se deseja revelar ou é desconhecido no momento. 1. Um indivíduo não especificado nominalmente, 'fulano' ou 'certo alguém' (Mt 26:18).
THAYER.en: A pronoun used to refer to a specific person or entity whose name one does not wish to reveal or is unknown at the moment. 1. An individual not specified by name, 'so-and-so' or 'a certain someone' (Mt 26:18).

DEFINITION: An adverb expressing an extreme point on a negative value scale, indicating great intensity of suffering or opposition.
SENSES: 1. In a terrible or severe manner, with extreme pain or distress (Mt 8.6; Lc 11.53).

THAYER.pt: Advérbio que expressa um ponto extremo numa escala de valores negativos, indicando grande intensidade de sofrimento ou oposição. 1. De maneira terrível ou severa, com dor ou aflição extrema (Mt 8.6; Lc 11.53).
THAYER.en: An adverb expressing an extreme point on a negative value scale, indicating great intensity of suffering or opposition. 1. In a terrible or severe manner, with extreme pain or distress (Mt 8.6; Lc 11.53).

DEFINITION: To take the main meal of the day or participate in a communal or solemn banquet.
SENSES: 1. To partake of a meal or supper (Lc 17.8; 22.20; 1Co 11.25).

THAYER.pt: Tomar a refeição principal do dia ou participar de um banquete comunitário ou solene. 1. Participar de uma refeição ou ceia (Lc 17.8; 22.20; 1Co 11.25).
THAYER.en: To take the main meal of the day or participate in a communal or solemn banquet. 1. To partake of a meal or supper (Lc 17.8; 22.20; 1Co 11.25).

DEFINITION: The main meal of the day, usually held in the evening, which can be an ordinary meal or a formal banquet.
SENSES: 1. The main meal or dinner of the day (Lc 14.17).
2. A formal banquet or feast with guests (Mt 23.6; 1Co 11.20).

THAYER.pt: A principal refeição do dia, geralmente realizada à noitinha, podendo ser uma refeição comum ou um banquete formal. 1. A refeição principal ou jantar do dia (Lc 14.17). | 2. Um banquete formal ou festa com convidados (Mt 23.6; 1Co 11.20).
THAYER.en: The main meal of the day, usually held in the evening, which can be an ordinary meal or a formal banquet. 1. The main meal or dinner of the day (Lc 14.17). | 2. A formal banquet or feast with guests (Mt 23.6; 1Co 11.20).

DEFINITION: Demonstrating religious scruples or excessive reverence toward deities, which can denote either sincere devotion or superstition.
SENSES: 1. Extremely devoted to religious practices or superstitious (At 17:22).

THAYER.pt: Que demonstra escrúpulos religiosos ou excessiva reverência para com divindades, podendo denotar tanto devoção sincera quanto superstição. 1. Extremamente dedicado a práticas religiosas ou supersticioso (At 17:22).
THAYER.en: Demonstrating religious scruples or excessive reverence toward deities, which can denote either sincere devotion or superstition. 1. Extremely devoted to religious practices or superstitious (At 17:22).

DEFINITION: A set of beliefs, cultic practices, or scruples directed toward the spiritual realm or deities.
SENSES: 1. A system of religious beliefs or worship (At 25:19).

THAYER.pt: Conjunto de crenças, práticas cultuais ou escrúpulos voltados para o reino espiritual ou divindades. 1. Sistema de crenças religiosas ou culto (At 25:19).
THAYER.en: A set of beliefs, cultic practices, or scruples directed toward the spiritual realm or deities. 1. A system of religious beliefs or worship (At 25:19).

DEFINITION: Cardinal numeral representing the exact quantity of ten units.
SENSES: 1. The number ten in literal or parabolic contexts (Mt 20.24; 25.1).

THAYER.pt: Numeral cardinal que representa a quantidade exata de dez unidades. 1. O número dez em contextos literais ou parabólicos (Mt 20.24; 25.1).
THAYER.en: Cardinal numeral representing the exact quantity of ten units. 1. The number ten in literal or parabolic contexts (Mt 20.24; 25.1).

DEFINITION: Cardinal numeral representing the quantity equivalent to ten plus two.
SENSES: 1. The number twelve in counts or listings.

THAYER.pt: Numeral cardinal que representa a quantidade equivalente a dez mais dois. 1. O número doze em contagens ou listagens.
THAYER.en: Cardinal numeral representing the quantity equivalent to ten plus two. 1. The number twelve in counts or listings.

DEFINITION: Cardinal number representing the quantity ten plus five.
SENSES: 1. The number fifteen in chronological or quantitative contexts.

THAYER.pt: Número cardinal que representa a quantidade dez mais cinco. 1. O número quinze em contextos cronológicos ou quantitativos.
THAYER.en: Cardinal number representing the quantity ten plus five. 1. The number fifteen in chronological or quantitative contexts.

DEFINITION: Name given to a league of ten predominantly Greek-culture cities located east of the Jordan River and in Galilee.
SENSES: 1. The region and confederation of ten cities known as the Decapolis (Mt 4.25; Mc 5.20; 7.31).

THAYER.pt: Nome dado a uma liga de dez cidades predominantemente de cultura grega situadas a leste do Rio Jordão e na Galileia. 1. A região e confederação de dez cidades conhecida como Decápole (Mt 4.25; Mc 5.20; 7.31).
THAYER.en: Name given to a league of ten predominantly Greek-culture cities located east of the Jordan River and in Galilee. 1. The region and confederation of ten cities known as the Decapolis (Mt 4.25; Mc 5.20; 7.31).

DEFINITION: The cardinal number equivalent to fourteen (14).
SENSES: 1. The number fourteen in chronological or genealogical contexts (Mt 1.17; 2Co 12.2).

THAYER.pt: O número cardinal equivalente a catorze (14). 1. O número catorze em contextos cronológicos ou genealógicos (Mt 1.17; 2Co 12.2).
THAYER.en: The cardinal number equivalent to fourteen (14). 1. The number fourteen in chronological or genealogical contexts (Mt 1.17; 2Co 12.2).

DEFINITION: The tenth part of income or goods offered as a sacred tribute or religious contribution.
SENSES: 1. The tenth part set apart or paid as a religious tribute (Hb 7.2, 4, 6, 8, 9).

THAYER.pt: A décima parte de rendimentos ou bens oferecida como tributo sagrado ou contribuição religiosa. 1. A décima parte separada ou paga como tributo religioso (Hb 7.2, 4, 6, 8, 9).
THAYER.en: The tenth part of income or goods offered as a sacred tribute or religious contribution. 1. The tenth part set apart or paid as a religious tribute (Hb 7.2, 4, 6, 8, 9).

DEFINITION: Ordinal adjective indicating the tenth position in a series, or used substantively to denote the tenth part of something (tithe).
SENSES: 1. The tenth element in a sequence (Ap 21.20).
2. The tenth part of something, tithe (Hb 7.2, 4).

THAYER.pt: Adjetivo ordinal que indica a décima posição em uma série, ou substantivado para denotar a décima parte de algo (dízimo). 1. O décimo elemento em uma sequência (Ap 21.20). | 2. A décima parte de algo, dízimo (Hb 7.2, 4).
THAYER.en: Ordinal adjective indicating the tenth position in a series, or used substantively to denote the tenth part of something (tithe). 1. The tenth element in a sequence (Ap 21.20). | 2. The tenth part of something, tithe (Hb 7.2, 4).

DEFINITION: To act in the context of collecting or paying the tithe (the tenth part), whether by collecting from others or paying it.
SENSES: 1. To receive or collect tithes from another in a priestly context (Hb 7.6, 9).

THAYER.pt: Agir no contexto de cobrança ou pagamento do dízimo (a décima parte), seja coletando de outros ou pagando-o. 1. Receber ou cobrar dízimos de outrem no contexto sacerdotal (Hb 7.6, 9).
THAYER.en: To act in the context of collecting or paying the tithe (the tenth part), whether by collecting from others or paying it. 1. To receive or collect tithes from another in a priestly context (Hb 7.6, 9).

DEFINITION: That which is received with pleasure, approved for being agreeable, or considered appropriate for a given occasion.
SENSES: 1. Acceptable and well-regarded by God or humans (Lc 4.24; At 10.35).
2. Agreeable and propitious, like an opportune time (2Co 6.2).

THAYER.pt: Que é recebido com agrado, aprovado por ser agradável ou considerado apropriado para determinada ocasião. 1. Aceitável e bem-visto por Deus ou pelos homens (Lc 4.24; At 10.35). | 2. Agradável e propício, como um tempo oportuno (2Co 6.2).
THAYER.en: That which is received with pleasure, approved for being agreeable, or considered appropriate for a given occasion. 1. Acceptable and well-regarded by God or humans (Lc 4.24; At 10.35). | 2. Agreeable and propitious, like an opportune time (2Co 6.2).

DEFINITION: To attract someone by means of devices or baits, seducing or leading them into error and sin, similar to fishing.
SENSES: 1. To attract or seduce someone into sin through deceitful desires (Tg 1.14; 2Pe 2.14, 18).

THAYER.pt: Atrair alguém por meio de artifícios ou iscas, seduzindo ou induzindo ao erro e ao pecado, de forma semelhante à pesca. 1. Atrair ou seduzir alguém para o pecado através de desejos enganosos (Tg 1.14; 2Pe 2.14, 18).
THAYER.en: To attract someone by means of devices or baits, seducing or leading them into error and sin, similar to fishing. 1. To attract or seduce someone into sin through deceitful desires (Tg 1.14; 2Pe 2.14, 18).

DEFINITION: Generic term for any relatively large woody plant.
SENSES: 1. A large tree or shrub (Mt 21.8; Ap 7.1).

THAYER.pt: Termo genérico para qualquer planta lenhosa de porte relativamente grande. 1. Uma árvore ou arbusto de grande porte (Mt 21.8; Ap 7.1).
THAYER.en: Generic term for any relatively large woody plant. 1. A large tree or shrub (Mt 21.8; Ap 7.1).

DEFINITION: Military term of debated exact meaning, generally associated with a lightly armed soldier, spearmen, or member of a security escort.
SENSES: 1. A soldier armed with a spear or guard tasked with an escort (At 23:23).

THAYER.pt: Termo militar de significado exato debatido, geralmente associado a um soldado levemente armado, lanceiro ou integrante de uma escolta de segurança. 1. Soldado armado com lança ou guarda encarregado de escolta (At 23:23).
THAYER.en: Military term of debated exact meaning, generally associated with a lightly armed soldier, spearmen, or member of a security escort. 1. A soldier armed with a spear or guard tasked with an escort (At 23:23).

DEFINITION: Refers to the side opposite the left, frequently associated in biblical culture with places of honor, power, and favor.
SENSES: 1. The right side as opposed to the left (Mt 5.30; Lc 22.50).
2. The right hand as a symbol of power, prestige, and a position of honor (Mt 25.33; Ef 1.20).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se ao lado oposto ao esquerdo, frequentemente associado na cultura bíblica a lugares de honra, poder e favor. 1. O lado direito em oposição ao esquerdo (Mt 5.30; Lc 22.50). | 2. A mão direita como símbolo de poder, prestígio e posição de honra (Mt 25.33; Ef 1.20).
THAYER.en: Refers to the side opposite the left, frequently associated in biblical culture with places of honor, power, and favor. 1. The right side as opposed to the left (Mt 5.30; Lc 22.50). | 2. The right hand as a symbol of power, prestige, and a position of honor (Mt 25.33; Ef 1.20).

DEFINITION: To ask for something with a strong feeling of urgency and personal need; to express fervent petitions to people or to God in prayer.
SENSES: 1. To ask insistently of an authority or human person (Lc 8.38; At 21.39).
2. To beseech or implore God in intercessory or personal prayer (Mt 9.38; At 10.2).

THAYER.pt: Pedir algo com forte sentimento de urgência e necessidade pessoal; expressar petições fervorosas a pessoas ou a Deus em oração. 1. Pedir com insistência a uma autoridade ou pessoa humana (Lc 8.38; At 21.39). | 2. Rogar, suplicar a Deus em oração intercessória ou pessoal (Mt 9.38; At 10.2).
THAYER.en: To ask for something with a strong feeling of urgency and personal need; to express fervent petitions to people or to God in prayer. 1. To ask insistently of an authority or human person (Lc 8.38; At 21.39). | 2. To beseech or implore God in intercessory or personal prayer (Mt 9.38; At 10.2).

DEFINITION: Relating to the city of Derbe, in Lycaonia, or an ethnic designation applied to a native inhabitant of that locality.
SENSES: 1. A native or inhabitant of the city of Derbe (At 20:4).

THAYER.pt: Relativo à cidade de Derbe, na Licaônia, ou gentílico aplicado a um habitante nativo daquela localidade. 1. Natural ou habitante da cidade de Derbe (At 20:4).
THAYER.en: Relating to the city of Derbe, in Lycaonia, or an ethnic designation applied to a native inhabitant of that locality. 1. A native or inhabitant of the city of Derbe (At 20:4).

DEFINITION: A city in Lycaonia, in the Roman province of Galatia, visited by Paul during his missionary journeys.
SENSES: 1. Derbe, a city in the region of Lycaonia (At 14.6).

THAYER.pt: Cidade da Licaônia, na província romana da Galácia, visitada por Paulo durante suas viagens missionárias. 1. Derbe, cidade na região da Licaônia (At 14.6).
THAYER.en: A city in Lycaonia, in the Roman province of Galatia, visited by Paul during his missionary journeys. 1. Derbe, a city in the region of Lycaonia (At 14.6).

DEFINITION: Animal skin separated from the body, usually retaining the hair or treated as leather, used for rustic clothing.
SENSES: 1. An animal skin or cloak used by people in conditions of deprivation (Hb 11:37).

THAYER.pt: Pele de animal separada do corpo, geralmente mantendo os pelos ou tratada como couro, usada para vestimentas rústicas. 1. Pele ou capa de animal usada por pessoas em condições de privação (Hb 11:37).
THAYER.en: Animal skin separated from the body, usually retaining the hair or treated as leather, used for rustic clothing. 1. An animal skin or cloak used by people in conditions of deprivation (Hb 11:37).

DEFINITION: Adjective indicating the material of an object's manufacture, specifically when made from animal skin or tanned leather.
SENSES: 1. Made of leather or animal skin (Mt 3.4).

THAYER.pt: Adjetivo que indica o material de confecção de um objeto, especificamente quando fabricado a partir de pele de animais ou couro curtido. 1. Feito de couro ou pele animal (Mt 3.4).
THAYER.en: Adjective indicating the material of an object's manufacture, specifically when made from animal skin or tanned leather. 1. Made of leather or animal skin (Mt 3.4).

DEFINITION: Originally meaning to skin or flay, in the New Testament it comes to denote the act of inflicting severe physical punishment through whipping or beating.
SENSES: 1. To beat or physically scourge someone (Mt 21.35; Lc 12.47).

THAYER.pt: Significa originalmente esfriar ou esfolar, passando no Novo Testamento a denotar o ato de infligir punição física severa por meio de açoites ou espancamentos. 1. Espancar ou açoitar fisicamente alguém (Mt 21.35; Lc 12.47).
THAYER.en: Originally meaning to skin or flay, in the New Testament it comes to denote the act of inflicting severe physical punishment through whipping or beating. 1. To beat or physically scourge someone (Mt 21.35; Lc 12.47).

DEFINITION: The act of securing with chains, physically tying, or gathering elements together by binding them into bundles.
SENSES: 1. To tie or bind someone with shackles or chains (Lc 8.29).
2. To gather and tie into bundles (Mt 23.4).

THAYER.pt: Ato de prender com correntes, atar fisicamente ou juntar elementos amarrando-os em feixes. 1. Amarrar ou prender alguém com algemas ou correntes (Lc 8.29). | 2. Juntar e atar em feixes (Mt 23.4).
THAYER.en: The act of securing with chains, physically tying, or gathering elements together by binding them into bundles. 1. To tie or bind someone with shackles or chains (Lc 8.29). | 2. To gather and tie into bundles (Mt 23.4).

DEFINITION: To place chains, ropes, or bindings on someone to restrict their movements.
SENSES: 1. To keep chained or bound (Lc 8.29).

THAYER.pt: Colocar correntes, cordas ou ataduras em alguém para restringir-lhe os movimentos. 1. Manter acorrentado ou preso (Lc 8.29).
THAYER.en: To place chains, ropes, or bindings on someone to restrict their movements. 1. To keep chained or bound (Lc 8.29).

DEFINITION: A collection of objects, plants, or harvested crops tied together forming a single unit.
SENSES: 1. A bundle prepared to be burned or stored (Mt 13:30).

THAYER.pt: Conjunto de objetos, plantas ou colheitas amarrados juntos formando uma unidade. 1. Feixe preparado para ser queimado ou armazenado (Mt 13:30).
THAYER.en: A collection of objects, plants, or harvested crops tied together forming a single unit. 1. A bundle prepared to be burned or stored (Mt 13:30).

DEFINITION: Designates a person who is under custody and restriction of freedom in a prison. In the New Testament, apostles like Paul frequently call themselves prisoners for the sake of Christ and the Gospel.
SENSES: 1. A prisoner held under legal or military custody (At 23.18).
2. In a figurative or theological sense, someone who suffers restrictions because of their faithfulness to Christ (Ef 3.1; Fm 1).

THAYER.pt: Designa uma pessoa que se encontra sob custódia e restrição de liberdade em uma prisão. No Novo Testamento, apóstolos como Paulo frequentemente se autodenominam prisioneiros por causa de Cristo e do Evangelho. 1. Um prisioneiro mantido sob custódia legal ou militar (At 23.18). | 2. Em sentido figurado ou teológico, alguém que sofre restrições por causa de sua fidelidade a Cristo (Ef 3.1; Fm 1).
THAYER.en: Designates a person who is under custody and restriction of freedom in a prison. In the New Testament, apostles like Paul frequently call themselves prisoners for the sake of Christ and the Gospel. 1. A prisoner held under legal or military custody (At 23.18). | 2. In a figurative or theological sense, someone who suffers restrictions because of their faithfulness to Christ (Ef 3.1; Fm 1).

DEFINITION: Instrument used to bind or restrict movements (such as chains and shackles) or the condition of imprisonment.
SENSES: 1. Physical chains, shackles, or fetters of restriction (Lc 8.29).
2. The state of imprisonment or carceral confinement.

THAYER.pt: Instrumento usado para prender ou restringir movimentos (como correntes e algemas) ou condição de aprisionamento. 1. Correntes, algemas ou grilhões físicos de reestrição (Lc 8.29). | 2. O estado de aprisionamento ou reclusão carcerária.
THAYER.en: Instrument used to bind or restrict movements (such as chains and shackles) or the condition of imprisonment. 1. Physical chains, shackles, or fetters of restriction (Lc 8.29). | 2. The state of imprisonment or carceral confinement.

DEFINITION: Officer or guard entrusted with the surveillance, security, and administration of a prison.
SENSES: 1. The jailer responsible for guarding the prison (At 16.23).

THAYER.pt: Oficial ou guarda encarregado da vigilância, segurança e administração de uma prisão. 1. O carcereiro responsável pela guarda da prisão (At 16.23).
THAYER.en: Officer or guard entrusted with the surveillance, security, and administration of a prison. 1. The jailer responsible for guarding the prison (At 16.23).

DEFINITION: A place intended for the custody and detention of prisoners, usually for temporary detention before trial.
SENSES: 1. Correctional facility or prison where detainees were confined (Mt 11:2; Acts 5:21, 23).

THAYER.pt: Lugar destinado à custódia e detenção de prisioneiros, geralmente para detenção temporária antes do julgamento. 1. Estabelecimento carcerário ou prisão onde se confinavam detentos (Mt 11.2; At 5.21, 23).
THAYER.en: A place intended for the custody and detention of prisoners, usually for temporary detention before trial. 1. Correctional facility or prison where detainees were confined (Mt 11:2; Acts 5:21, 23).

DEFINITION: A person who is under legal custody, chained, or confined in a prison awaiting trial or the serving of a sentence.
SENSES: 1. A prisoner under the custody of authorities (Acts 27:1, 42).

THAYER.pt: Pessoa que se encontra sob custódia legal, acorrentada ou confinada em uma prisão aguardando julgamento ou cumprimento de pena. 1. Um prisioneiro sob custódia das autoridades (At 27.1, 42).
THAYER.en: A person who is under legal custody, chained, or confined in a prison awaiting trial or the serving of a sentence. 1. A prisoner under the custody of authorities (Acts 27:1, 42).

DEFINITION: Indicates someone who holds absolute authority, legal dominion, or possession over people (such as servants) or things.
SENSES: 1. Lord or owner of slaves and subordinates (1 Tim 6:1; Tit 2:9).
2. Supreme title applied to God or Christ as absolute sovereign (Lk 2:29; 2 Pet 2:1).

THAYER.pt: Indica alguém que detém autoridade absoluta, domínio legal ou posse sobre pessoas (como servos) ou coisas. 1. Senhor ou dono de escravos e subordinados (1Tm 6.1; Tt 2.9). | 2. Título supremo aplicado a Deus ou a Cristo como soberano absoluto (Lc 2.29; 2Pe 2.1).
THAYER.en: Indicates someone who holds absolute authority, legal dominion, or possession over people (such as servants) or things. 1. Lord or owner of slaves and subordinates (1 Tim 6:1; Tit 2:9). | 2. Supreme title applied to God or Christ as absolute sovereign (Lk 2:29; 2 Pet 2:1).

DEFINITION: A particle used both as a spatial invitation for someone to approach ('here', 'come here') and as a temporal expression denoting continuity up to the present moment ('until now').
SENSES: 1. A call or invitation to approach the speaker physically (Mt 19:21; Mk 10:21).
2. Indication of temporal extension up to the present moment, until now (Rom 1:13).

THAYER.pt: Partícula usada tanto como convite espacial para que alguém se aproxime ('aqui', 'vem cá') quanto como expressão temporal que denota continuidade até o momento presente ('até agora'). 1. Chamado ou convite para aproximar-se fisicamente do locutor (Mt 19.21; Mc 10.21). | 2. Indicação de extensão temporal até o momento presente, até agora (Rm 1.13).
THAYER.en: A particle used both as a spatial invitation for someone to approach ('here', 'come here') and as a temporal expression denoting continuity up to the present moment ('until now'). 1. A call or invitation to approach the speaker physically (Mt 19:21; Mk 10:21). | 2. Indication of temporal extension up to the present moment, until now (Rom 1:13).

DEFINITION: An imperative particle used in the plural as an urgent invitation for people to approach or come to the speaker.
SENSES: 1. An imperative call to approach: 'come here!' or 'come!' (Mt 28:6; Jn 4:29).

THAYER.pt: Partícula imperativa usada no plural como convite urgente para que pessoas se aproximem ou venham até quem fala. 1. Um chamado imperativo para aproximar-se: 'vinde cá!' ou 'venham!' (Mt 28.6; Jo 4.29).
THAYER.en: An imperative particle used in the plural as an urgent invitation for people to approach or come to the speaker. 1. An imperative call to approach: 'come here!' or 'come!' (Mt 28:6; Jn 4:29).

DEFINITION: That which occurs or arrives on the second day of a journey or temporal sequence.
SENSES: 1. To arrive at a destination on the second day (Acts 28:13).

THAYER.pt: Que ocorre ou chega no segundo dia de uma jornada ou sequência temporal. 1. Chegar a um destino no segundo dia (At 28:13).
THAYER.en: That which occurs or arrives on the second day of a journey or temporal sequence. 1. To arrive at a destination on the second day (Acts 28:13).

DEFINITION: A term of uncertain and debated meaning in the manuscripts, found only in the expression regarding the Sabbath in Luke 6:1.
SENSES: 1. Obscure designation of a specific Sabbath in the Jewish calendar (Lk 6:1).

THAYER.pt: Termo de significado incerto e debatido nos manuscritos, encontrado apenas na expressão sobre o sábado em Lucas 6:1. 1. Designação obscura de um sábado específico no calendário judaico (Lc 6.1).
THAYER.en: A term of uncertain and debated meaning in the manuscripts, found only in the expression regarding the Sabbath in Luke 6:1. 1. Obscure designation of a specific Sabbath in the Jewish calendar (Lk 6:1).

DEFINITION: An ordinal numeral indicating the element that immediately follows the first in a sequence of space, time, relevance, or hierarchy.
SENSES: 1. Second in a numerical or temporal succession (Mt 22:26; Mk 12:21; Jn 4:54).
2. Adverbial neuter usage (τὸ δεύτερον / δεύτερον): for the second time, again (Mt 26:42; Jn 3:4; Acts 10:15).
3. Next in moral or normative order of greatness (Mt 22:39).

THAYER.pt: Numeral ordinal que indica o elemento que sucede imediatamente ao primeiro numa sequência de espaço, tempo, relevância ou hierarquia. 1. Segundo numa sucessão numérica ou temporal (Mt 22.26; Mc 12.21; Jo 4.54). | 2. Emprego neutro adverbial (τὸ δεύτερον / δεύτερον): pela segunda vez, novamente (Mt 26.42; Jo 3.4; At 10.15). | 3. Próximo em ordem moral ou normativa de grandeza (Mt 22.39).
THAYER.en: An ordinal numeral indicating the element that immediately follows the first in a sequence of space, time, relevance, or hierarchy. 1. Second in a numerical or temporal succession (Mt 22:26; Mk 12:21; Jn 4:54). | 2. Adverbial neuter usage (τὸ δεύτερον / δεύτερον): for the second time, again (Mt 26:42; Jn 3:4; Acts 10:15). | 3. Next in moral or normative order of greatness (Mt 22:39).

DEFINITION: The act of receiving something offered or extending hospitality and approval to a person or message.
SENSES: 1. To receive something offered or transmitted (Lk 2:28; Phil 4:18).
2. To welcome a person with sympathy or hospitality (Lk 16:4; 9:53).
3. To accept a doctrine, conviction, or teaching (Acts 17:11; 1 Cor 2:14).

THAYER.pt: Ato de receber algo oferecido ou transmitir hospitalidade e aprovação a uma pessoa ou mensagem. 1. Receber algo que é oferecido ou transmitido (Lc 2.28; Fp 4.18). | 2. Acolher com simpatia ou hospitalidade uma pessoa (Lc 16.4; 9.53). | 3. Aceitar uma doutrina, convicção ou ensinamento (At 17.11; 1Co 2.14).
THAYER.en: The act of receiving something offered or extending hospitality and approval to a person or message. 1. To receive something offered or transmitted (Lk 2:28; Phil 4:18). | 2. To welcome a person with sympathy or hospitality (Lk 16:4; 9:53). | 3. To accept a doctrine, conviction, or teaching (Acts 17:11; 1 Cor 2:14).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: δήσω; Aor: ἔδησα; Pass: ἐδέθην
DEFINITION: To immobilize or restrict the movement of a person, animal, or object by means of ropes, chains, or obligations.
SENSES: 1. To physically confine or imprison someone with chains or ropes (Mt 14:3; Acts 12:6).
2. To tie or bind objects together (Mt 13:30).
3. To be bound by legal duties or ties (Rom 7:2).

THAYER.pt: Imobilizar ou restringir o movimento de uma pessoa, animal ou objeto por meio de cordas, correntes ou obrigações. 1. Confinar ou aprisionar fisicamente alguém com correntes ou cordas (Mt 14.3; At 12.6). | 2. Amarrar ou atar objetos entre si (Mt 13.30). | 3. Estar ligado por deveres ou laços legais (Rm 7.2).
THAYER.en: To immobilize or restrict the movement of a person, animal, or object by means of ropes, chains, or obligations. 1. To physically confine or imprison someone with chains or ropes (Mt 14:3; Acts 12:6). | 2. To tie or bind objects together (Mt 13:30). | 3. To be bound by legal duties or ties (Rom 7:2).

DEFINITION: An emphatic particle that draws attention to the truthfulness or urgency of a statement, exhortation, or command.
SENSES: 1. An emphasis marker that corroborates a statement (Mt 13:23).
2. A particle that confers urgency to exhortations or commands (Lk 2:15; 1 Cor 6:20).

THAYER.pt: Partícula enfática que chama a atenção para a veracidade ou urgência de uma declaração, exortação ou comando. 1. Marcador de ênfase que corrobora uma afirmação (Mt 13:23). | 2. Partícula que confere urgência a exortações ou comandos (Lc 2:15; 1Co 6:20).
THAYER.en: An emphatic particle that draws attention to the truthfulness or urgency of a statement, exhortation, or command. 1. An emphasis marker that corroborates a statement (Mt 13:23). | 2. A particle that confers urgency to exhortations or commands (Lk 2:15; 1 Cor 6:20).

DEFINITION: That which is clearly perceptible to the senses or evident to human understanding.
SENSES: 1. Something evident, manifest, or clearly understandable (Mt 26:73; 1 Cor 15:27).

THAYER.pt: Aquilo que é claramente perceptível aos sentidos ou evidente à compreensão humana. 1. Algo evidente, manifesto ou claramente compreensível (Mt 26.73; 1Co 15.27).
THAYER.en: That which is clearly perceptible to the senses or evident to human understanding. 1. Something evident, manifest, or clearly understandable (Mt 26:73; 1 Cor 15:27).

DEFINITION: To make known or manifest something that was previously hidden or difficult to understand.
SENSES: 1. To reveal or make a fact evident (1 Pet 1:11).
2. To explain or clarify a concept (Heb 12:27).

THAYER.pt: Tornar algo conhecido ou manifesto que antes estava oculto ou era difícil de compreender. 1. Revelar ou tornar evidente um fato (1Pe 1:11). | 2. Explicar ou esclarecer um conceito (Hb 12:27).
THAYER.en: To make known or manifest something that was previously hidden or difficult to understand. 1. To reveal or make a fact evident (1 Pet 1:11). | 2. To explain or clarify a concept (Heb 12:27).

DEFINITION: A Christian collaborator of the apostle Paul who initially accompanied him but later abandoned him due to his love for the present age.

THAYER.pt: A capacidade intelectual e espiritual de distinguir, avaliar corretamente ou julgar entre o bem e o mal, ou entre diferentes opiniões. 1. A capacidade de discernir, avaliar e distinguir o bem do mal (Hb 5.14; 1Co 12.10). | 2. Discussão ou controvérsia baseada em opiniões divergentes (Rm 14.1).
THAYER.en: The intellectual and spiritual ability to distinguish, correctly evaluate, or judge between good and evil, or between different opinions. 1. The ability to discern, evaluate, and distinguish good from evil (Heb 5:14; 1 Cor 12:10). | 2. Discussion or controversy based on divergent opinions (Rom 14:1).

DEFINITION: To place obstacles so that an event or action does not come to fruition.
SENSES: 1. To prevent something from happening or hinder an action (Matt 3:14).

THAYER.pt: Colocar obstáculos para que um evento ou ação não venha a concretizar-se. 1. Evitar que algo aconteça ou impedir uma ação (Mt 3:14).
THAYER.en: To place obstacles so that an event or action does not come to fruition. 1. To prevent something from happening or hinder an action (Matt 3:14).

DEFINITION: Indicates the act of conversing in detail about a subject or spreading news among people.
SENSES: 1. To debate or exchange opinions on a matter (Luke 6:11).
2. To publicize or speak broadly about an event (Luke 1:65).

THAYER.pt: Indica o ato de conversar detalhadamente sobre um assunto ou espalhar uma notícia entre pessoas. 1. Debater ou trocar opiniões sobre uma questão (Lc 6:11). | 2. Divulgar ou falar amplamente sobre um acontecimento (Lc 1:65).
THAYER.en: Indicates the act of conversing in detail about a subject or spreading news among people. 1. To debate or exchange opinions on a matter (Luke 6:11). | 2. To publicize or speak broadly about an event (Luke 1:65).

DEFINITION: To engage in verbal exchange, conversing, arguing, or lecturing in a formal or dialogical manner.
SENSES: 1. To converse, dialogue, or reason with others (Acts 17:2; 18:4).
2. To direct exhortations or verbal instruction (Heb 12:5).

THAYER.pt: Participar de um intercâmbio verbal, conversando, argumentando ou discursando de maneira formal ou dialogada. 1. Conversar, dialogar ou raciocinar com outros (At 17.2; 18.4). | 2. Dirigir exortações ou instrução verbal (Hb 12.5).
THAYER.en: To engage in verbal exchange, conversing, arguing, or lecturing in a formal or dialogical manner. 1. To converse, dialogue, or reason with others (Acts 17:2; 18:4). | 2. To direct exhortations or verbal instruction (Heb 12:5).

DEFINITION: To suspend or interrupt an activity that was being performed continuously.
SENSES: 1. To stop doing something or cease a continuous action (Luke 7:45).

THAYER.pt: Suspender ou interromper uma atividade que vinha sendo realizada de forma contínua. 1. Deixar de fazer algo ou cessar uma ação contínua (Lc 7:45).
THAYER.en: To suspend or interrupt an activity that was being performed continuously. 1. To stop doing something or cease a continuous action (Luke 7:45).

DEFINITION: Refers to the language, tongue, or mode of speech peculiar to a nation, region, or ethnic group.
SENSES: 1. The mother tongue or language of a people (Acts 1:19; Acts 2:6).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se ao idioma, língua ou modo de falar próprio de uma nação, região ou grupo étnico. 1. Língua ou idioma materno de um povo (At 1:19; At 2:6).
THAYER.en: Refers to the language, tongue, or mode of speech peculiar to a nation, region, or ethnic group. 1. The mother tongue or language of a people (Acts 1:19; Acts 2:6).

DEFINITION: To reestablish harmony and normal relations after a misunderstanding or enmity.
SENSES: 1. To make peace or be reconciled with someone (Matt 5:24).

THAYER.pt: Restabelecer a harmonia e as relações normais após um desentendimento ou inimizade. 1. Fazer as pazes ou ser reconciliado com alguém (Mt 5:24).
THAYER.en: To reestablish harmony and normal relations after a misunderstanding or enmity. 1. To make peace or be reconciled with someone (Matt 5:24).

DEFINITION: The mental activity of reasoning deeply, pondering the implications of something, or discussing a matter in detail.
SENSES: 1. To think carefully, ponder, and reason (Matt 16:7; Luke 5:22).
2. To discuss or argue about a matter among people (Mark 8:16; 11:31).

THAYER.pt: Atividade mental de raciocinar profundamente, ponderar sobre as implicações de algo ou discutir um assunto em detalhe. 1. Pensar cuidadosamente, ponderar e raciocinar (Mt 16.7; Lc 5.22). | 2. Discutir ou argumentar sobre um assunto entre pessoas (Mc 8.16; 11.31).
THAYER.en: The mental activity of reasoning deeply, pondering the implications of something, or discussing a matter in detail. 1. To think carefully, ponder, and reason (Matt 16:7; Luke 5:22). | 2. To discuss or argue about a matter among people (Mark 8:16; 11:31).

DEFINITION: Refers to the mental process of deep reasoning, internal pondering, or the discussions and doubts generated by conflicting opinions.
SENSES: 1. The process or content of human thought and reasoning (Luke 2:35; Rom 1:21).
2. Discussions, disputes, or contentions originating from opposing ideas (Phil 2:14).
3. Reasonings that generate uncertainty, skepticism, or doubt (Luke 24:38).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se ao processo mental de raciocínio profundo, ponderação interna, ou às discussões e dúvidas geradas por opiniões conflitantes. 1. O processo ou conteúdo do pensamento e raciocínio humano (Lc 2.35; Rm 1.21). | 2. Discussões, disputas ou contendas originadas de ideias opostas (Fp 2.14). | 3. Raciocínios que geram incerteza, ceticismo ou dúvida (Lc 24.38).
THAYER.en: Refers to the mental process of deep reasoning, internal pondering, or the discussions and doubts generated by conflicting opinions. 1. The process or content of human thought and reasoning (Luke 2:35; Rom 1:21). | 2. Discussions, disputes, or contentions originating from opposing ideas (Phil 2:14). | 3. Reasonings that generate uncertainty, skepticism, or doubt (Luke 24:38).

DEFINITION: To undo a structure, dissolve elements, or cause the dispersion of a group of people.
SENSES: 1. To undo or break apart by physical action (Acts 27:41);
2. To disperse or scatter a gathered group (Acts 5:36).

THAYER.pt: Desfazer uma estrutura, dissolver elementos ou causar a dispersão de um grupo de pessoas. 1. Desfazer ou despedaçar por ação física (At 27:41); | 2. Dispersar ou espalhar um grupo reunido (At 5:36).
THAYER.en: To undo a structure, dissolve elements, or cause the dispersion of a group of people. 1. To undo or break apart by physical action (Acts 27:41); | 2. To disperse or scatter a gathered group (Acts 5:36).

DEFINITION: To make a solemn, firm declaration based on personal knowledge, often charged with strong moral appeal or spiritual authority.
SENSES: 1. To testify or solemnly declare a truth (Acts 20:21);
2. To exhort or warn with authority and emphasis (2 Tim 4:1).

THAYER.pt: Fazer uma declaração solene, firme e baseada em conhecimento pessoal, frequentemente carregada de forte apelo moral ou autoridade espiritual. 1. Testemunhar ou declarar solenemente uma verdade (At 20.21); 2. Exortar ou advertir com autoridade e ênfase (2Tm 4.1).
THAYER.en: To make a solemn, firm declaration based on personal knowledge, often charged with strong moral appeal or spiritual authority. 1. To testify or solemnly declare a truth (Acts 20:21); | 2. To exhort or warn with authority and emphasis (2 Tim 4:1).

DEFINITION: To fight verbally with intensity, contend energetically, or protest vehemently against something or someone.
SENSES: 1. To dispute or contend with vehemence and firmness in a discussion (Acts 23:9).

THAYER.pt: Significa lutar verbalmente com intensidade, contender de forma enérgica ou protestar veementemente contra algo ou alguém. 1. Disputar ou contender com veemência e firmeza em uma discussão (At 23:9).
THAYER.en: To fight verbally with intensity, contend energetically, or protest vehemently against something or someone. 1. To dispute or contend with vehemence and firmness in a discussion (Acts 23:9).

DEFINITION: To continue to exist or persist unchanged in a condition, activity, or association over time.
SENSES: 1. To remain unchanged or continue existing (Heb 1:11; 2 Pet 3:4).
2. To continue in an activity or association (Luke 22:28; Gal 2:5).

THAYER.pt: Continuar a existir ou persistir inalterado em uma condição, atividade ou associação ao longo do tempo. 1. Permanecer inalterado ou continuar existindo (Hb 1.11; 2Pe 3.4). | 2. Continuar em uma atividade ou associação (Lc 22.28; Gl 2.5).
THAYER.en: To continue to exist or persist unchanged in a condition, activity, or association over time. 1. To remain unchanged or continue existing (Heb 1:11; 2 Pet 3:4). | 2. To continue in an activity or association (Luke 22:28; Gal 2:5).

DEFINITION: To distribute items among several people or fragment something into distinct parts, which can also denote division into opposing factions.
SENSES: 1. To distribute or divide goods among people (Luke 22:17; Acts 2:45).
2. To divide into separate parts (Acts 2:3).
3. To divide into hostile or opposing factions (Luke 11:17).

THAYER.pt: Distribuir itens entre várias pessoas ou fragmentar algo em partes distintas, podendo também denotar divisão em facções opostas. 1. Distribuir ou repartir bens entre pessoas (Lc 22.17; At 2.45). | 2. Dividir em partes separadas (At 2.3). | 3. Dividir-se em facções hostis ou opostas (Lc 11.17).
THAYER.en: To distribute items among several people or fragment something into distinct parts, which can also denote division into opposing factions. 1. To distribute or divide goods among people (Luke 22:17; Acts 2:45). | 2. To divide into separate parts (Acts 2:3). | 3. To divide into hostile or opposing factions (Luke 11:17).

DEFINITION: Describes the state of deep division between people or groups resulting in factional opposition and conflict.
SENSES: 1. Party division or dissension generating opposition and conflict of opinions (Luke 12:51).

THAYER.pt: Descreve o estado de divisão profunda entre pessoas ou grupos que resulta em oposição facciosa e conflito. 1. Divisão partidária ou dissensão que gera oposição e conflito de opiniões (Lc 12:51).
THAYER.en: Describes the state of deep division between people or groups resulting in factional opposition and conflict. 1. Party division or dissension generating opposition and conflict of opinions (Luke 12:51).

DEFINITION: Indicates the action of partitioning something or causing information or a rumor to spread widely among people.
SENSES: 1. To propagate or spread a news item or report among the population (Acts 4:17).

THAYER.pt: Indica a ação de repartir algo ou de fazer com que uma informação ou boato se espalhe amplamente entre as pessoas. 1. Propagar ou espalhar uma notícia ou relato entre a população (At 4:17).
THAYER.en: Indicates the action of partitioning something or causing information or a rumor to spread widely among people. 1. To propagate or spread a news item or report among the population (Acts 4:17).

SHORT_GLOSS: to beckon, gesture, make a sign
DEFINITION: Refers to the act of communicating or expressing an idea through bodily gestures, especially with the head, eyes, or hands.
SENSES: 1. To make signs or beckon with gestures to convey a message without using words (Lk 1:22).
USAGE: to beckon, gesture, make a sign

THAYER.pt: Refere-se ao ato de comunicar-se ou expressar uma ideia por meio de gestos corporais, especialmente com a cabeça, os olhos ou as mãos. 1. Fazer sinais ou acenar com gestos para transmitir uma mensagem sem usar palavras (Lc 1:22).
THAYER.en: Refers to the act of communicating or expressing an idea through bodily gestures, especially with the head, eyes, or hands. 1. To make signs or beckon with gestures to convey a message without using words (Lk 1:22).

DEFINITION: Designates the product of the mental process, the content of human thought, intention, or reasoning.
SENSES: 1. That which is thought or planned in the mind, encompassing intentions and reasoning (Lk 11:17).

THAYER.pt: Designa o produto do processo mental, o conteúdo do pensamento, intenção ou raciocínio humano. 1. Aquilo que é pensado ou planejado na mente, abrangendo intenções e raciocínios (Lc 11:17).
THAYER.en: Designates the product of the mental process, the content of human thought, intention, or reasoning. 1. That which is thought or planned in the mind, encompassing intentions and reasoning (Lk 11:17).

DEFINITION: The mental faculty of understanding, reasoning, and reflection, also encompassing a person's inner thoughts, intentions, and dispositions.
SENSES: 1. The rational and cognitive faculty of the mind, understanding (Mt 22:37; Eph 4:18).
2. The content of thoughts, intentions, or mental attitudes (Col 1:21).

THAYER.pt: A faculdade mental de compreensão, raciocínio e reflexão, englobando também os pensamentos, intenções e disposições íntimas da pessoa. 1. A faculdade racional e cognitiva da mente, o entendimento (Mt 22.37; Ef 4.18). | 2. O conteúdo dos pensamentos, intenções ou atitudes mentais (Cl 1.21).
THAYER.en: The mental faculty of understanding, reasoning, and reflection, also encompassing a person's inner thoughts, intentions, and dispositions. 1. The rational and cognitive faculty of the mind, understanding (Mt 22:37; Eph 4:18). | 2. The content of thoughts, intentions, or mental attitudes (Col 1:21).

DEFINITION: To open completely something that was closed, whether a physical organ, the womb, or the capacity for mental understanding.
SENSES: 1. To physically open ears, eyes, or the womb (Lk 2:23; Mk 7:34).
2. To open the mind or interpret scriptures to make them understandable (Lk 24:32; Acts 17:3).

THAYER.pt: Abrir completamente algo que estava fechado, seja um órgão físico, o ventre ou a capacidade de compreensão da mente. 1. Abrir fisicamente ouvidos, olhos ou a madre (Lc 2.23; Mc 7.34). | 2. Abrir a mente ou interpretar escrituras para torná-las compreensíveis (Lc 24.32; At 17.3).
THAYER.en: To open completely something that was closed, whether a physical organ, the womb, or the capacity for mental understanding. 1. To physically open ears, eyes, or the womb (Lk 2:23; Mk 7:34). | 2. To open the mind or interpret scriptures to make them understandable (Lk 24:32; Acts 17:3).

SHORT_GLOSS: to spend the night, pass the night
DEFINITION: Indicates the action of continuing in an activity or state throughout the entire period of the night.
SENSES: 1. To spend the entire night occupied in some activity, such as prayer (Lk 6:12).
USAGE: to spend the night, pass the night

THAYER.pt: Indica a ação de continuar em uma atividade ou estado durante todo o período da noite. 1. Passar a noite inteira ocupado em alguma atividade, como a oração (Lc 6:12).
THAYER.en: Indicates the action of continuing in an activity or state throughout the entire period of the night. 1. To spend the entire night occupied in some activity, such as prayer (Lk 6:12).

DEFINITION: Means to carry out an activity or journey to its end, completing it successfully.
SENSES: 1. To conclude or complete a journey or task involving travel (Acts 21:7).

THAYER.pt: Significa levar a cabo uma atividade ou percurso até o seu fim, completando-a com sucesso. 1. Concluir ou completar uma jornada ou tarefa que envolve deslocamento (At 21:7).
THAYER.en: Means to carry out an activity or journey to its end, completing it successfully. 1. To conclude or complete a journey or task involving travel (Acts 21:7).

DEFINITION: Adverbial expression denoting constancy or continuous frequency of an action over time.
SENSES: 1. In a continuous manner, always, at all times.

THAYER.pt: Expressão adverbial que denota constância ou frequência contínua de uma ação ao longo do tempo. 1. De maneira contínua, sempre, em todo o tempo.
THAYER.en: Adverbial expression denoting constancy or continuous frequency of an action over time. 1. In a continuous manner, always, at all times.

SHORT_GLOSS: to cross over, pass through, sail
DEFINITION: Indicates the action of moving from one side to the other of a geographical obstacle, such as a sea, lake, or valley.
SENSES: 1. To cross by sailing or on foot from one shore to another (Mt 9:1; Mk 5:21).
USAGE: to cross over, pass through, sail

THAYER.pt: Indica a ação de mover-se de um lado para o outro de um obstáculo geográfico, como um mar, lago ou vale. 1. Atravessar navegando ou a pé de uma margem a outra (Mt 9:1; Mc 5:21).
THAYER.en: Indicates the action of moving from one side to the other of a geographical obstacle, such as a sea, lake, or valley. 1. To cross by sailing or on foot from one shore to another (Mt 9:1; Mk 5:21).

DEFINITION: Describes the crossing of a body of water or maritime region from one side to the other by ship.
SENSES: 1. To sail through a maritime area, crossing it from one shore to another (Acts 27:5).

THAYER.pt: Descreve a travessia de um corpo de água ou região marítima de um lado a outro por meio de um navio. 1. Navegar por uma área marítima cruzando-a de uma margem a outra (At 27:5).
THAYER.en: Describes the crossing of a body of water or maritime region from one side to the other by ship. 1. To sail through a maritime area, crossing it from one shore to another (Acts 27:5).

DEFINITION: Describes the state of deep irritation, emotional burden, or strong indignation provoked by the attitude of others.
SENSES: 1. To feel deeply annoyed or irritated by opposition (Acts 4:2; Acts 16:18).

THAYER.pt: Descreve o estado de profunda irritação, fardo emocional ou forte indignação provocado pela atitude de outros. 1. Sentir-se profundamente incomodado ou irritado com a oposição (At 4:2; At 16:18).
THAYER.en: Describes the state of deep irritation, emotional burden, or strong indignation provoked by the attitude of others. 1. To feel deeply annoyed or irritated by opposition (Acts 4:2; Acts 16:18).

SHORT_GLOSS: to pass through, travel, go through
DEFINITION: To travel through a region or pass through a specific place from end to end.
SENSES: 1. To pass through or traverse a region (Lk 6:1; Acts 16:4).
USAGE: to pass through, travel, go through

THAYER.pt: Viajar através de uma região ou passar por um determinado lugar de ponta a ponta. 1. Passar por ou atravessar uma região (Lc 6.1; At 16.4).
THAYER.en: To travel through a region or pass through a specific place from end to end. 1. To pass through or traverse a region (Lk 6:1; Acts 16:4).

SHORT_GLOSS: to be perplexed, confused, in doubt
DEFINITION: To find oneself in a state of deep uncertainty and perplexity, not knowing which direction to take.
SENSES: 1. To be greatly confused or at a loss as to what to do in the face of events (Lk 9:7; Acts 5:24; 10:17).
USAGE: to be perplexed, confused, in doubt

THAYER.pt: Encontrar-se em estado de profunda incerteza e perplexidade, sem saber que rumo tomar. 1. Estar grandemente confuso ou sem saber o que fazer diante de acontecimentos (Lc 9.7; At 5.24; 10.17).
THAYER.en: To find oneself in a state of deep uncertainty and perplexity, not knowing which direction to take. 1. To be greatly confused or at a loss as to what to do in the face of events (Lk 9:7; Acts 5:24; 10:17).

DEFINITION: Refers to the activity of engaging in trade or financial transactions to obtain profit.
SENSES: 1. To obtain profit or financial gain through commercial negotiations (Lk 19:15).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se à atividade de engajar-se no comércio ou em transações financeiras para obter lucro. 1. Obter lucro ou ganho financeiro por meio de negociações comerciais (Lc 19:15).
THAYER.en: Refers to the activity of engaging in trade or financial transactions to obtain profit. 1. To obtain profit or financial gain through commercial negotiations (Lk 19:15).

SHORT_GLOSS: to be enraged, cut to the heart
DEFINITION: Literally to saw in half; in the New Testament, it is used figuratively to describe extreme anger that cuts or strikes the inner self.
SENSES: 1. To be enraged to the point of gnashing one's teeth in anger against someone (Acts 5:33; Acts 7:54).
USAGE: to be enraged, cut to the heart

THAYER.pt: Literalmente serrar ao meio; no Novo Testamento, é usado figuradamente para descrever uma ira extrema que corta ou atinge o íntimo. 1. Ficar enfurecido a ponto de ranger os dentes de raiva contra alguém (At 5:33; At 7:54).
THAYER.en: Literally to saw in half; in the New Testament, it is used figuratively to describe extreme anger that cuts or strikes the inner self. 1. To be enraged to the point of gnashing one's teeth in anger against someone (Acts 5:33; Acts 7:54).

DEFINITION: To practice theft or looting in a complete and systematic way, pillaging goods from a house or property.
SENSES: 1. To plunder or completely rob someone's goods (Mt 12:29; Mk 3:27).

THAYER.pt: Praticar o roubo ou saque de forma completa e sistemática, pilhando bens de uma casa ou propriedade. 1. Saquear ou roubar completamente os bens de alguém (Mt 12.29; Mc 3.27).
THAYER.en: To practice theft or looting in a complete and systematic way, pillaging goods from a house or property. 1. To plunder or completely rob someone's goods (Mt 12:29; Mk 3:27).

DEFINITION: To tear or rend with force, usually applied to garments as a sign of mourning, indignation, or revolt.
SENSES: 1. To tear garments as a sign of distress or indignation (Mt 26:65; Acts 14:14).

THAYER.pt: Rasgar ou romper com força, geralmente aplicado a vestimentas em sinal de luto, indignação ou revolta. 1. Rasgar vestes em sinal de angústia ou indignação (Mt 26.65; At 14.14).
THAYER.en: To tear or rend with force, usually applied to garments as a sign of mourning, indignation, or revolt. 1. To tear garments as a sign of distress or indignation (Mt 26:65; Acts 14:14).

DEFINITION: To make clear something that is obscure or to report an event in detail so that it may be understood.
SENSES: 1. To explain or clarify the meaning of something obscure (Mt 13:36).
2. To report or inform with details (Mt 18:31).

THAYER.pt: Tornar claro algo que é obscuro ou relatar detalhadamente um acontecimento para que seja compreendido. 1. Explicar ou esclarecer o significado de algo obscuro (Mt 13:36). | 2. Relatar ou informar com detalhes (Mt 18:31).
THAYER.en: To make clear something that is obscure or to report an event in detail so that it may be understood. 1. To explain or clarify the meaning of something obscure (Mt 13:36). | 2. To report or inform with details (Mt 18:31).

DEFINITION: Originally meaning to shake violently, it became a legal term for extorting money or goods through threat, coercion, or force.
SENSES: 1. To extort money or coerce people under threat or use of force (Lk 3:14).

THAYER.pt: Originalmente significando sacudir violentamente, passou a ser um termo jurídico para extorquir dinheiro ou bens mediante ameaça, coerção ou força. 1. Extorquir dinheiro ou coagir pessoas sob ameaça ou uso de força (Lc 3:14).
THAYER.en: Originally meaning to shake violently, it became a legal term for extorting money or goods through threat, coercion, or force. 1. To extort money or coerce people under threat or use of force (Lk 3:14).

DEFINITION: Means to cause the separation and scattering of a group or material goods in various directions, resulting in dispersion or waste.
SENSES: 1. To disperse or scatter a crowd or flock (Mt 26:31; Jn 11:52).
2. To dissipate, waste, or squander goods (Lk 15:13).

THAYER.pt: Significa causar a separação e o espalhamento de um grupo ou de bens materiais em várias direções, resultando em dispersão ou desperdício. 1. Dispersar ou espalhar uma multidão ou rebanho (Mt 26.31; Jo 11.52). | 2. Dissipar, desperdiçar ou esbanjar bens (Lc 15.13).
THAYER.en: Means to cause the separation and scattering of a group or material goods in various directions, resulting in dispersion or waste. 1. To disperse or scatter a crowd or flock (Mt 26:31; Jn 11:52). | 2. To dissipate, waste, or squander goods (Lk 15:13).

DEFINITION: To tear apart or rend something into several pieces with physical force.
SENSES: 1. To break chains or iron shackles into pieces (Mk 5:4).
2. To tear someone apart physically through extreme force (Acts 23:10).

THAYER.pt: Despedaçar ou rasgar algo em várias partes com força física. 1. Romper correntes ou correntes de ferro em pedaços (Mc 5:4). | 2. Despedaçar alguém fisicamente por força extrema (At 23:10).
THAYER.en: To tear apart or rend something into several pieces with physical force. 1. To break chains or iron shackles into pieces (Mk 5:4). | 2. To tear someone apart physically through extreme force (Acts 23:10).

DEFINITION: To cause the dispersion of a group or crowd, sending people in various different directions. In the New Testament, it is used especially to describe the scattering of Christians due to persecution.
SENSES: 1. To scatter or disperse people to different places (Acts 8:1; Acts 8:4; Acts 11:19).

THAYER.pt: Significa causar a dispersão de um grupo ou multidão, enviando pessoas em várias direções diferentes. No Novo Testamento, é usado especialmente para descrever a dispersão dos cristãos devido à perseguição. 1. Espalhar ou dispersar pessoas por diferentes lugares (At 8.1; At 8.4; At 11.19).
THAYER.en: To cause the dispersion of a group or crowd, sending people in various different directions. In the New Testament, it is used especially to describe the scattering of Christians due to persecution. 1. To scatter or disperse people to different places (Acts 8:1; Acts 8:4; Acts 11:19).

DEFINITION: Refers to the state of being dispersed or to the region and community where Jews (and later Christians) lived scattered outside their homeland. In the Christian context, it denotes believers living as pilgrims in the world.
SENSES: 1. The condition or the group of people dispersed among the nations (John 7:35; James 1:1; 1 Pet 1:1).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se ao estado de estar disperso ou à região e comunidade onde os judeus (e posteriormente os cristãos) viviam espalhados fora de sua terra natal. No contexto cristão, denota os crentes que vivem como peregrinos no mundo. 1. A condição ou o grupo de pessoas dispersas entre as nações (Jo 7.35; Tg 1.1; 1Pe 1.1).
THAYER.en: Refers to the state of being dispersed or to the region and community where Jews (and later Christians) lived scattered outside their homeland. In the Christian context, it denotes believers living as pilgrims in the world. 1. The condition or the group of people dispersed among the nations (John 7:35; James 1:1; 1 Pet 1:1).

DEFINITION: To give strict instructions or firm orders accompanied by a warning about what must or must not be done.
SENSES: 1. To give strict orders or severely forbid with authority (Mark 5:43; Acts 15:24).

THAYER.pt: Dar instruções estritas ou ordens firmes acompanhadas de advertência sobre o que deve ou não ser feito. 1. Dar ordens estritas ou proibir severamente com autoridade (Mc 5.43; At 15.24).
THAYER.en: To give strict instructions or firm orders accompanied by a warning about what must or must not be done. 1. To give strict orders or severely forbid with authority (Mark 5:43; Acts 15:24).

DEFINITION: Designates the space or temporal distance elapsed between two events or occurrences.
SENSES: 1. A specific time interval between events (Acts 5:7).

THAYER.pt: Designa o espaço ou a distância temporal decorrida entre dois eventos ou ocorrências. 1. Um intervalo de tempo específico entre acontecimentos (At 5:7).
THAYER.en: Designates the space or temporal distance elapsed between two events or occurrences. 1. A specific time interval between events (Acts 5:7).

THAYER.en: Indicates a clear difference or distinctive mark between things or persons, so that they are not confused. 1. A striking distinction or difference between entities (Rom 10:12; 1 Cor 14:7).

THAYER.en: To bring safely through imminent danger, deliver from a threat, or fully restore physical health. 1. To rescue or save from severe danger or shipwreck (Acts 27:44; 28:4). | 2. To heal or cure someone of an illness (Matt 14:36; Luke 7:3).

DEFINITION: That which has been specifically commanded, established, or decreed by legitimate authority.

THAYER.en: Refers to an official order, decree, or commandment issued by a governing authority. 1. An official edict or ordinance establishing a legal or royal determination (Heb 11:23).

DEFINITION: To cause deep mental confusion, perplexity, or emotional agitation in someone.
SENSES: 1. To greatly disturb or leave someone perplexed and confused facing a situation (Luke 1:29).

THAYER.en: To cause deep mental confusion, perplexity, or emotional agitation in someone. 1. To greatly disturb or leave someone perplexed and confused facing a situation (Luke 1:29).

SENSES: 1. To make arrangements or organize properly (Acts 20:13).

DEFINITION: Indicates persistence in a given state, condition, or behavior over time.

THAYER.en: Indicates persistence in a given state, condition, or behavior over time. 1. To continue or remain uninterruptedly in a specific condition (Acts 27:33).

DEFINITION: Compound interrogative pronoun used to inquire about the cause, motive, or reason for something.

THAYER.en: To make a solemn agreement, covenant, or testament involving reciprocal obligations and benefits. 1. To make or establish a covenant (Heb 8:10). | 2. To dispose of property by means of a will.

DEFINITION: Indicates the act of staying or residing in a certain place for a prolonged period, involving duration of time and activity.

THAYER.pt: Indica o ato de ficar ou residir em um determinado local por um período prolongado, envolvendo a duração de tempo e atividade. 1. Permanecer, residir ou passar o tempo em um lugar (At 14.3; At 15.35).
THAYER.en: Indicates the act of staying or residing in a certain place for a prolonged period, involving duration of time and activity. 1. To remain, reside, or spend time in a place (Acts 14:3; 15:35).

DEFINITION: Refers to the set of means or food necessary to maintain physical life and nourish the body.

THAYER.en: Refers to the set of means or food necessary to maintain physical life and nourish the body. 1. Material food or sustenance necessary for the maintenance of life (1 Tim 6:8).

THAYER.en: To shine through an obstacle or mark the appearance of daylight at dawn. 1. To shine or beam through (2 Cor 4:4). | 2. To dawn or break the day (2 Pet 1:19).

DEFINITION: Possessing the physical property of allowing light to pass through and be seen through; clear or crystalline.

THAYER.en: Possessing the physical property of allowing light to pass through and be seen through; clear or crystalline. 1. Being perfectly transparent or translucent like crystal (Rev 21:21).

DEFINITION: To carry something through a place, or, figuratively, to stand out by being different or superior to others.
SENSES: 1. To transport or carry something through a space (Mark 11:16).

THAYER.en: To carry something through a place, or, figuratively, to stand out by being different or superior to others. 1. To transport or carry something through a space (Mark 11:16). | 2. To differ or stand out positively, to be worth more (Matt 6:26; Gal 4:1).

DEFINITION: To succeed in getting away from danger or pursuers, achieving freedom through flight.

THAYER.en: To succeed in getting away from danger or pursuers, achieving freedom through flight. 1. To successfully escape a dangerous situation or persecution (Acts 27:42).

THAYER.en: To impart instruction, doctrinal truth, or practical guidance to individuals or groups, whether in public or private settings.
