DEFINITION: Meaning to acquire detailed information through persistent questioning or thorough investigation.
SENSES: 1. To question thoroughly to discover or ascertain a fact (At 10:17).

THAYER.pt: Significa adquirir informações detalhadas por meio de perguntas insistentes ou de uma investigação minuciosa. 1. Questionar minuciosamente para descobrir ou averiguar um fato (At 10:17).
THAYER.en: Meaning to acquire detailed information through persistent questioning or thorough investigation. 1. To question thoroughly to discover or ascertain a fact (At 10:17).

SHORT_GLOSS: two years old, of two years
DEFINITION: Refers to something that possesses the exact duration or age of two years.
SENSES: 1. That is of the age of two full years (Mt 2:16).
USAGE: two years old, of two years

THAYER.pt: Refere-se a algo que possui a duração ou a idade exata de dois anos. 1. Que tem a idade de dois anos completos (Mt 2:16).
THAYER.en: Refers to something that possesses the exact duration or age of two years. 1. That is of the age of two full years (Mt 2:16).

DEFINITION: A continuous time interval spanning exactly two years.
SENSES: 1. A span of two full years (At 24:27; At 28:30).

THAYER.pt: Um intervalo de tempo contínuo que abrange exatamente dois anos. 1. Um espaço de tempo de dois anos completos (At 24:27; At 28:30).
THAYER.en: A continuous time interval spanning exactly two years. 1. A span of two full years (At 24:27; At 28:30).

DEFINITION: To describe in detail or systematically narrate an event or story to listeners.
SENSES: 1. To relate or recount an event in detail (Lc 8.39; At 8.33).
2. To describe facts or experiences in an understandable way (Mc 5.16).

THAYER.pt: Descrever detalhadamente ou narrar sistematicamente um acontecimento ou uma história para ouvintes. 1. Relatar ou contar um evento em detalhes (Lc 8.39; At 8.33). | 2. Descrever fatos ou experiências de forma compreensível (Mc 5.16).
THAYER.en: To describe in detail or systematically narrate an event or story to listeners. 1. To relate or recount an event in detail (Lc 8.39; At 8.33). | 2. To describe facts or experiences in an understandable way (Mc 5.16).

DEFINITION: Designates an orderly and detailed description of historical facts, events, or teachings.
SENSES: 1. A structured narrative account of past events (Lc 1:1).

THAYER.pt: Designa uma descrição ordenada e detalhada de fatos, eventos ou ensinamentos históricos. 1. Um relato narrativo estruturado de acontecimentos passados (Lc 1:1).
THAYER.en: Designates an orderly and detailed description of historical facts, events, or teachings. 1. A structured narrative account of past events (Lc 1:1).

DEFINITION: Occurring without interruption over time, extending in a perpetual manner.
SENSES: 1. Continuous existence without temporal interruption (Hb 7.3).

THAYER.pt: Que ocorre sem interrupção ao longo do tempo, estendendo-se de maneira perpétua. 1. Existência contínua e sem interrupção temporal (Hb 7.3).
THAYER.en: Occurring without interruption over time, extending in a perpetual manner. 1. Continuous existence without temporal interruption (Hb 7.3).

DEFINITION: Describes a place washed by the sea on both sides or where two opposing sea currents meet.
SENSES: 1. A sandbar or place where opposing sea currents collide (At 27:41).

THAYER.pt: Descreve um local banhado pelo mar em ambos os lados ou onde duas correntes marinhas opostas se encontram. 1. Um banco de areia ou local onde correntes marinhas opostas se chocam (At 27:41).
THAYER.en: Describes a place washed by the sea on both sides or where two opposing sea currents meet. 1. A sandbar or place where opposing sea currents collide (At 27:41).

DEFINITION: Meaning to move through a three-dimensional space, penetrating deeply into something.
SENSES: 1. To penetrate deeply through physical or spiritual barriers (Hb 4:12).

THAYER.pt: Significa mover-se através de um espaço tridimensional, penetrando profundamente em algo. 1. Penetrar profundamente através de barreiras físicas ou espirituais (Hb 4:12).
THAYER.en: Meaning to move through a three-dimensional space, penetrating deeply into something. 1. To penetrate deeply through physical or spiritual barriers (Hb 4:12).

DEFINITION: Meaning to draw away, separate in space, or mark the passage of time between two events.
SENSES: 1. To depart or physically separate from someone (Lc 24.51).
2. To indicate the lapse or passage of a period of time (Lc 22.59).

THAYER.pt: Significa afastar-se, separar-se no espaço ou marcar a passagem do tempo entre dois eventos. 1. Afastar-se ou separar-se fisicamente de alguém (Lc 24.51). | 2. Indicar o transcurso ou a passagem de um período de tempo (Lc 22.59).
THAYER.en: Meaning to draw away, separate in space, or mark the passage of time between two events. 1. To depart or physically separate from someone (Lc 24.51). | 2. To indicate the lapse or passage of a period of time (Lc 22.59).

DEFINITION: To assert or affirm something with great conviction, firmness, and absolute certainty.
SENSES: 1. To assert vehemently or insist with conviction about a fact (Lc 22:59; At 12:15).

THAYER.pt: Aseverar ou afirmar algo com grande convicção, firmeza e certeza absoluta. 1. Afirmar veementemente ou insistir com convicção sobre um fato (Lc 22:59; At 12:15).
THAYER.en: To assert or affirm something with great conviction, firmness, and absolute certainty. 1. To assert vehemently or insist with conviction about a fact (Lc 22:59; At 12:15).

DEFINITION: Refers to a just and impartial verdict or judgment, applied in the Scriptures to God's equitable judgment.
SENSES: 1. The righteous judgment of God who will reward each one according to their deeds (Rm 2.5).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se a um veredito ou julgamento justo e imparcial, aplicado nas Escrituras ao juízo equitativo de Deus. 1. O justo juízo de Deus que retribuirá a cada um segundo as suas obras (Rm 2.5).
THAYER.en: Refers to a just and impartial verdict or judgment, applied in the Scriptures to God's equitable judgment. 1. The righteous judgment of God who will reward each one according to their deeds (Rm 2.5).

DEFINITION: Conforming to the perfect moral standards of God's holiness; an individual whose conduct is upright before divine law or who has been justified by faith.
SENSES: 1. Characteristic of one who fulfills God's will and lives uprightly (Mt 1.19; Lc 1.6).
2. Righteous in a forensic and theological sense through faith (Rm 1.17; Hb 10.38).
3. Attribute of the perfect righteousness of God and Christ (Jo 17.25; At 7.52; 1Jo 2.1).
4. That which is right, appropriate, or equitable (Ef 6.1; Fp 4.8).

THAYER.pt: Que se conforma aos padrões morais perfeitos da santidade de Deus; indivíduo cuja conduta é íntegra perante a lei divina ou que foi justificado pela fé. 1. Característica de quem cumpre a vontade de Deus e vive retamente (Mt 1.19; Lc 1.6). | 2. Justo em sentido forense e teológico pela fé (Rm 1.17; Hb 10.38). | 3. Atributo da perfeita justiça de Deus e de Cristo (Jo 17.25; At 7.52; 1Jo 2.1). | 4. Aquilo que é correto, apropriado ou equitativo (Ef 6.1; Fp 4.8).
THAYER.en: Conforming to the perfect moral standards of God's holiness; an individual whose conduct is upright before divine law or who has been justified by faith. 1. Characteristic of one who fulfills God's will and lives uprightly (Mt 1.19; Lc 1.6). | 2. Righteous in a forensic and theological sense through faith (Rm 1.17; Hb 10.38). | 3. Attribute of the perfect righteousness of God and Christ (Jo 17.25; At 7.52; 1Jo 2.1). | 4. That which is right, appropriate, or equitable (Ef 6.1; Fp 4.8).

DEFINITION: Moral quality or forensic state of conformity to the will and standards of God. In Paul's letters, it constitutes a foundational term of the doctrine of justification, referring to the status of righteousness freely imputed by faith to believers.
SENSES: 1. Righteousness and ethical uprightness in practical living (Mt 5.6; 6.33; 1Jo 3.7).
2. The gift of forensic righteousness granted by God through faith in Christ (Rm 1.17; 3.21-26; 2Co 5.21).
3. Administrative justice or legal equity (At 17.31; Hb 1.9).

THAYER.pt: Qualidade moral ou estado forense de conformidade com a vontade e os padrões de Deus. Nas cartas paulinas, constitui termo basilar da doutrina da justificação, referindo-se ao status de retidão imputado gratuitamente pela fé aos crentes. 1. Justiça e retidão ética no viver prático (Mt 5.6; 6.33; 1Jo 3.7). | 2. O dom da retidão forense concedido por Deus pela fé em Cristo (Rm 1.17; 3.21-26; 2Co 5.21). | 3. Justiça administrativa ou equidade jurídica (At 17.31; Hb 1.9).
THAYER.en: Moral quality or forensic state of conformity to the will and standards of God. In Paul's letters, it constitutes a foundational term of the doctrine of justification, referring to the status of righteousness freely imputed by faith to believers. 1. Righteousness and ethical uprightness in practical living (Mt 5.6; 6.33; 1Jo 3.7). | 2. The gift of forensic righteousness granted by God through faith in Christ (Rm 1.17; 3.21-26; 2Co 5.21). | 3. Administrative justice or legal equity (At 17.31; Hb 1.9).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: δικαιώσω, Aor: ἐδικαίωσα, Pass: ἐδικαίωθην
SEMANTIC_FIELD: Justice, Law and Relationship with God
DEFINITION: In the NT, refers primarily to the judicial and gracious act of God in declaring the sinner righteous, acquitting them of guilt and restoring their relationship with Him.
SENSES: 1. To do justice or vindicate a legal cause (Lc 7.29; Rm 3.4).
2. To justify, declare, or treat someone as righteous before the law or before God (Lc 10.29; Rm 3.20).
3. To free from the power or requirement of sin, to acquit (Rm 6.7).

THAYER.pt: No NT, refere-se principalmente à ação judicial e graciosa de Deus em declarar o pecador justo, absolvendo-o da culpa e restaurando seu relacionamento com Ele. 1. Fazer justiça ou vindicar uma causa legal (Lc 7.29; Rm 3.4). | 2. Justificar, declarar ou tratar alguém como justo perante a lei ou perante Deus (Lc 10.29; Rm 3.20). | 3. Libertar do poder ou da exigência do pecado, absolver (Rm 6.7).
THAYER.en: In the NT, refers primarily to the judicial and gracious act of God in declaring the sinner righteous, acquitting them of guilt and restoring their relationship with Him. 1. To do justice or vindicate a legal cause (Lc 7.29; Rm 3.4). | 2. To justify, declare, or treat someone as righteous before the law or before God (Lc 10.29; Rm 3.20). | 3. To free from the power or requirement of sin, to acquit (Rm 6.7).

DEFINITION: Describes a legal precept, a righteous requirement demanded by God, or a concrete act that fulfills the requirement of justice.
SENSES: 1. Decree, precept, or righteous ordinance of the law (Rm 2.26; Hb 9.1).
2. Act of righteousness or fulfillment of moral requirement (Rm 5.18; Ap 19.8).

THAYER.pt: Descreve um preceito legal, um requisito justo exigido por Deus ou um ato concreto que cumpre a exigência da justiça. 1. Decreto, preceito ou ordenança justa da lei (Rm 2.26; Hb 9.1). | 2. Ato de justiça ou cumprimento da exigência moral (Rm 5.18; Ap 19.8).
THAYER.en: Describes a legal precept, a righteous requirement demanded by God, or a concrete act that fulfills the requirement of justice. 1. Decree, precept, or righteous ordinance of the law (Rm 2.26; Hb 9.1). | 2. Act of righteousness or fulfillment of moral requirement (Rm 5.18; Ap 19.8).

DEFINITION: Indicates conduct or judgment in conformity with what is right, just, and morally correct before God and men.
SENSES: 1. In a just manner in a legal or factual sense (Lc 23.41).
2. With uprightness of character and blameless behavior (1Ts 2.10).

THAYER.pt: Indica uma conduta ou julgamento em conformidade com o que é reto, justo e moralmente correto diante de Deus e dos homens. 1. De maneira justa em um sentido jurídico ou factual (Lc 23.41). | 2. Com retidão de caráter e comportamento irrepreensível (1Ts 2.10).
THAYER.en: Indicates conduct or judgment in conformity with what is right, just, and morally correct before God and men. 1. In a just manner in a legal or factual sense (Lc 23.41). | 2. With uprightness of character and blameless behavior (1Ts 2.10).

DEFINITION: The divine act of declaring a person righteous, acquitting them of guilt and restoring their right relationship with God.
SENSES: 1. The act of justification resulting in acquittal and restoration before God (Rm 4:25).

THAYER.pt: O ato divino de declarar uma pessoa justa, absolvendo-a da culpa e restaurando seu relacionamento correto com Deus. 1. O ato de justificação que resulta na absolvição e restauração diante de Deus (Rm 4:25).
THAYER.en: The divine act of declaring a person righteous, acquitting them of guilt and restoring their right relationship with God. 1. The act of justification resulting in acquittal and restoration before God (Rm 4:25).

DEFINITION: One who presides over a court, evaluates cases, and pronounces legal sentences.
SENSES: 1. A magistrate or judge with authority to judge disputes (At 7:27).

THAYER.pt: Aquele que preside um tribunal, avalia causas e profere sentenças judiciais. 1. Um magistrado ou juiz com autoridade para julgar litígios (At 7:27).
THAYER.en: One who presides over a court, evaluates cases, and pronounces legal sentences. 1. A magistrate or judge with authority to judge disputes (At 7:27).

DEFINITION: Refers to the just penalty or punishment applied as a result of a committed act, and can also personify the goddess of justice in Greco-Roman culture.
SENSES: 1. Just punishment or penalty imposed as retribution (2Ts 1.9).
2. Justice personified as a deity in mythology (At 28.4).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se à penalidade ou punição justa aplicada em decorrência de um ato cometido, podendo também personificar a deusa da justiça na cultura greco-romana. 1. Punição ou penalidade justa imposta como retribuição (2Ts 1.9). | 2. A Justiça personificada como divindade na mitologia (At 28.4).
THAYER.en: Refers to the just penalty or punishment applied as a result of a committed act, and can also personify the goddess of justice in Greco-Roman culture. 1. Just punishment or penalty imposed as retribution (2Ts 1.9). | 2. Justice personified as a deity in mythology (At 28.4).

DEFINITION: Generic term for net, but used in the New Testament exclusively to designate the nets employed by fishermen to catch fish.
SENSES: 1. Fishing net used by fishermen in the sea or lakes (Mt 4.20; Lc 5.2).

THAYER.pt: Termo genérico para rede, mas utilizado no Novo Testamento exclusivamente para designar as redes empregadas por pescadores na captura de peixes. 1. Rede de pesca utilizada por pescadores no mar ou em lagos (Mt 4.20; Lc 5.2).
THAYER.en: Generic term for net, but used in the New Testament exclusively to designate the nets employed by fishermen to catch fish. 1. Fishing net used by fishermen in the sea or lakes (Mt 4.20; Lc 5.2).

DEFINITION: Describes someone who says one thing to one person and another to someone else, acting with falsity or duplicity of speech.
SENSES: 1. An insincere person or one of double word, forbidden among deacons (1Tm 3.8).

THAYER.pt: Descreve alguém que diz uma coisa para uma pessoa e outra para outra, agindo com falsidade ou duplicidade de palavras. 1. Pessoa insincera ou de palavra dupla, proibida entre os diáconos (1Tm 3.8).
THAYER.en: Describes someone who says one thing to one person and another to someone else, acting with falsity or duplicity of speech. 1. An insincere person or one of double word, forbidden among deacons (1Tm 3.8).

DEFINITION: An emphatic conclusive particle that introduces an evident deduction or logical consequence from what has just been stated.
SENSES: 1. A marker of result or logical inference; for this reason, wherefore (Mt 27.8; Mc 5.33; Lc 7.7; Rm 1.24).

THAYER.pt: Partícula conclusiva enfática que introduz uma dedução evidente ou consequência lógica a partir do que acabou de ser afirmado. 1. Marcador de resultado ou inferência lógica; por esta razão, pelo que (Mt 27.8; Mc 5.33; Lc 7.7; Rm 1.24).
THAYER.en: An emphatic conclusive particle that introduces an evident deduction or logical consequence from what has just been stated. 1. A marker of result or logical inference; for this reason, wherefore (Mt 27.8; Mc 5.33; Lc 7.7; Rm 1.24).

DEFINITION: To travel through an entire region, extensively covering the territory.
SENSES: 1. To travel through a region or city (Ac 17:1).
2. To go through villages and cities preaching (Lc 8:1).

THAYER.pt: Viajar por uma região inteira, cobrindo extensivamente o território. 1. Viajar através de uma região ou cidade (At 17:1). | 2. Percorrer vilas e cidades pregando (Lc 8:1).
THAYER.en: To travel through an entire region, extensively covering the territory. 1. To travel through a region or city (Ac 17:1). | 2. To go through villages and cities preaching (Lc 8:1).

DEFINITION: A masculine proper name referring to an Athenian citizen and member of the Areopagus who believed Paul's message.
SENSES: 1. Dionysius the Areopagite, converted in Athens (Ac 17.34).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio masculino referente a um cidadão ateniense e membro do Areópago que creu na mensagem de Paulo. 1. Dionísio, o areopagita convertido em Atenas (At 17.34).
THAYER.en: A masculine proper name referring to an Athenian citizen and member of the Areopagus who believed Paul's message. 1. Dionysius the Areopagite, converted in Athens (Ac 17.34).

DEFINITION: An emphatic conjunction that introduces an evident logical conclusion resulting from what was previously said.
SENSES: 1. To indicate a direct logical or moral consequence ("for this very reason"; 1Co 8:13; 10:14).

THAYER.pt: Conjunção enfática que introduz uma conclusão lógica evidente decorrente do que foi dito anteriormente. 1. Indicar uma consequência lógica ou moral direta ("por esta mesma razão"; 1Co 8:13; 10:14).
THAYER.en: An emphatic conjunction that introduces an evident logical conclusion resulting from what was previously said. 1. To indicate a direct logical or moral consequence ("for this very reason"; 1Co 8:13; 10:14).

DEFINITION: A term qualifying something that fell directly from heaven, used in antiquity for cult images of deities.
SENSES: 1. The image of Artemis considered fallen from heaven in Ephesus (Ac 19.35).

THAYER.pt: Termo que qualifica algo que caiu diretamente do céu, usado na antiguidade para imagens cultuais de divindades. 1. A imagem de Ártemis considerada caída do céu em Éfeso (At 19.35).
THAYER.en: A term qualifying something that fell directly from heaven, used in antiquity for cult images of deities. 1. The image of Artemis considered fallen from heaven in Ephesus (Ac 19.35).

DEFINITION: The process of correction or the establishment of a new order of things to replace a previous state.
SENSES: 1. A structural reformation or the establishment of a new eschatological order (Hb 9:10).

THAYER.pt: Processo de correção ou estabelecimento de uma nova ordem de coisas em substituição a um estado anterior. 1. Uma reforma estrutural ou estabelecimento de uma nova ordem escatológica (Hb 9:10).
THAYER.en: The process of correction or the establishment of a new order of things to replace a previous state. 1. A structural reformation or the establishment of a new eschatological order (Hb 9:10).

SHORT_GLOSS: break through, dig through, break in
DEFINITION: To make a way through a barrier or wall, usually by illicit excavation.
SENSES: 1. To break through the wall of a house to commit theft (Mt 6.19, 20; 24.43; Lc 12.39).
USAGE: break through, dig through, break in

THAYER.pt: Abrir passagem através de uma barreira ou parede, geralmente mediante escavação ilícita. 1. Romper a parede de uma casa para cometer furto (Mt 6.19, 20; 24.43; Lc 12.39).
THAYER.en: To make a way through a barrier or wall, usually by illicit excavation. 1. To break through the wall of a house to commit theft (Mt 6.19, 20; 24.43; Lc 12.39).

DEFINITION: The name given in Greco-Roman mythology to the twin brothers Castor and Pollux, sons of Zeus and Leda, worshipped as protectors of sailors.
SENSES: 1. Guardian deities represented as the figurehead of an Alexandrian ship (Ac 28.11).

THAYER.pt: Nome dado na mitologia greco-romana aos irmãos gêmeos Cástor e Pólux, filhos de Zeus e Leda, cultuados como protetores dos navegantes. 1. Divindades tutelares representadas como insígnia de um navio alexandrino (At 28.11).
THAYER.en: The name given in Greco-Roman mythology to the twin brothers Castor and Pollux, sons of Zeus and Leda, worshipped as protectors of sailors. 1. Guardian deities represented as the figurehead of an Alexandrian ship (Ac 28.11).

DEFINITION: A subordinating conjunction that introduces the cause, reason, or justification for a preceding statement. Equivalent to 'because' or 'since'.
SENSES: 1. Indicating cause or motive: because, forasmuch as (Lc 2.7; 1Co 15.9).

THAYER.pt: Conjunção subordinativa que introduz a causa, a razão ou a justificativa para uma afirmação precedente. Equivale a 'porque' ou 'visto que'. 1. Indicando causa ou motivo: porque, porquanto (Lc 2.7; 1Co 15.9).
THAYER.en: A subordinating conjunction that introduces the cause, reason, or justification for a preceding statement. Equivalent to 'because' or 'since'. 1. Indicating cause or motive: because, forasmuch as (Lc 2.7; 1Co 15.9).

DEFINITION: The name of a Christian leader who exerted strong negative influence in his community by seeking preeminence.
SENSES: 1. Diotrephes, the leader who rejected apostolic authority and the brethren (3Jo 9).

THAYER.pt: Nome de um líder cristão que exercia forte influência negativa em sua comunidade por buscar a preeminência. 1. Diótrefes, o líder que rejeitava a autoridade apostólica e os irmãos (3Jo 9).
THAYER.en: The name of a Christian leader who exerted strong negative influence in his community by seeking preeminence. 1. Diotrephes, the leader who rejected apostolic authority and the brethren (3Jo 9).

DEFINITION: Having double the original quantity, proportion, or measure.
SENSES: 1. A doubled quantity or a double reward (1Tm 5.17; Re 18.6).

THAYER.pt: Que tem o dobro da quantidade, proporção ou medida original. 1. Quantidade dobrada ou recompensa em dobro (1Tm 5.17; Ap 18.6).
THAYER.en: Having double the original quantity, proportion, or measure. 1. A doubled quantity or a double reward (1Tm 5.17; Re 18.6).

DEFINITION: To duplicate a quantity or pay double as retribution or penalty.
SENSES: 1. To double the punishment or repay twofold the sins of Babylon (Re 18.6).

THAYER.pt: Significa duplicar uma quantidade ou pagar em dobro como retribuição ou penalidade. 1. Dobrar a punição ou retribuir em dobro os pecados de Babilônia (Ap 18.6).
THAYER.en: To duplicate a quantity or pay double as retribution or penalty. 1. To double the punishment or repay twofold the sins of Babylon (Re 18.6).

DEFINITION: An adverb indicating the repetition of an action on two occasions.
SENSES: 1. The occurrence of an event in duplication, twice (Mc 14:30; Php 4:16).

THAYER.pt: Advérbio que indica a repetição de uma ação por duas ocasiões. 1. Ocorrência de um evento em duplicidade, duas vezes (Mc 14:30; Fp 4:16).
THAYER.en: An adverb indicating the repetition of an action on two occasions. 1. The occurrence of an event in duplication, twice (Mc 14:30; Php 4:16).

DEFINITION: To have doubts regarding the truth of something or to hesitate before a decision due to a lack of certainty.
SENSES: 1. To doubt or waver in a critical situation (Mt 14:31).
2. To hesitate or be uncertain about a course of action (Mt 28:17).

THAYER.pt: Ter dúvidas quanto à veracidade de algo ou hesitar diante de uma decisão por falta de certeza. 1. Duvidar ou vacilar diante de uma situação crítica (Mt 14:31). | 2. Hesitar ou ficar incerto sobre um curso de ação (Mt 28:17).
THAYER.en: To have doubts regarding the truth of something or to hesitate before a decision due to a lack of certainty. 1. To doubt or waver in a critical situation (Mt 14:31). | 2. To hesitate or be uncertain about a course of action (Mt 28:17).

DEFINITION: Describes a cutting instrument, especially a sword, that has two sharp blades or edges.
SENSES: 1. Endowed with two blades or sharp edges (Hb 4.12; Re 1.16; Re 2.12).

THAYER.pt: Descreve um instrumento cortante, especialmente uma espada, que possui duas lâminas ou gumes afiados. 1. Dotado de duas lâminas ou gumes cortantes (Hb 4.12; Ap 1.16; Ap 2.12).
THAYER.en: Describes a cutting instrument, especially a sword, that has two sharp blades or edges. 1. Endowed with two blades or sharp edges (Hb 4.12; Re 1.16; Re 2.12).

DEFINITION: A cardinal numeral representing the exact quantity of two thousands.
SENSES: 1. The approximate number of pigs that rushed into the sea (Mc 5.13).

THAYER.pt: Numeral cardinal que representa a quantidade exata de dois milhares. 1. O número aproximado de porcos que se precipitaram no mar (Mc 5.13).
THAYER.en: A cardinal numeral representing the exact quantity of two thousands. 1. The approximate number of pigs that rushed into the sea (Mc 5.13).

DEFINITION: The act of filtering a liquid through a cloth or strainer to remove impurities or small insects.
SENSES: 1. To strain out a gnat and swallow a camel, an illustration of ritual hypocrisy (Mt 23.24).

THAYER.pt: O ato de filtrar um líquido através de um tecido ou coador para remover impurezas ou pequenos insetos. 1. Coar o mosquito e engolir o camelo, ilustração sobre hipocrisia ritual (Mt 23.24).
THAYER.en: The act of filtering a liquid through a cloth or strainer to remove impurities or small insects. 1. To strain out a gnat and swallow a camel, an illustration of ritual hypocrisy (Mt 23.24).

DEFINITION: To cause division between parts or people, separating them into opposing factions.
SENSES: 1. To provoke division among members of a family because of Christ (Mt 10.35).

THAYER.pt: Causar divisão entre partes ou pessoas, separando-as em facções opostas. 1. Provocar divisão entre membros de uma família por causa de Cristo (Mt 10.35).
THAYER.en: To cause division between parts or people, separating them into opposing factions. 1. To provoke division among members of a family because of Christ (Mt 10.35).

DEFINITION: The state of deep division into opposing groups, generating discord and strife in a community.
SENSES: 1. Factional division or dissension that breaks fellowship (Rm 16:17).

THAYER.pt: O estado de divisão profunda em grupos opostos, gerando discórdia e contenda numa comunidade. 1. Divisão facciosa ou dissensão que rompe a comunhão (Rm 16:17).
THAYER.en: The state of deep division into opposing groups, generating discord and strife in a community. 1. Factional division or dissension that breaks fellowship (Rm 16:17).

DEFINITION: Literally to cut in half; figuratively, to inflict extremely severe punishment on someone.
SENSES: 1. To punish with the utmost rigor or severity (Mt 24:51).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Middle deponent. Fut: δράξομαι, Aor: ἐδραξάμην
DEFINITION: To take with a full hand, grasp firmly, or catch in the act.
SENSES: 1. To catch the wise in their own craftiness (1Co 3.19, citing Job 5.13).

THAYER.pt: Apanhar com a mão cheia, agarrar firmemente ou apanhar no flagrante. 1. Apanhar os sábios em sua própria astúcia (1Co 3.19, citando Jó 5.13).
THAYER.en: To take with a full hand, grasp firmly, or catch in the act. 1. To catch the wise in their own craftiness (1Co 3.19, citing Job 5.13).

DEFINITION: An ancient Greek silver coin, with a value approximately equivalent to the Roman denarius, corresponding to a worker's daily wage.
SENSES: 1. A Greek silver coin used in the monetary system of the time (Lk 15.8).

THAYER.pt: Antiga moeda grega de prata, com valor aproximadamente equivalente ao denário romano, correspondendo ao salário diário de um trabalhador. 1. Uma moeda de prata grega usada no sistema monetário da época (Lc 15.8).
THAYER.en: An ancient Greek silver coin, with a value approximately equivalent to the Roman denarius, corresponding to a worker's daily wage. 1. A Greek silver coin used in the monetary system of the time (Lk 15.8).

DEFINITION: An agricultural tool consisting of a curved blade attached to a handle, traditionally used in harvesting grain.
SENSES: 1. A curved instrument used to reap wheat or harvest the crop (Mk 4.29; Rv 14.14).

THAYER.pt: Uma ferramenta agrícola consistindo de uma lâmina curva afixada a um cabo, utilizada tradicionalmente na colheita de cereais. 1. Instrumento curvo usado para segar trigo ou ceifar a colheita (Mc 4.29; Ap 14.14).
THAYER.en: An agricultural tool consisting of a curved blade attached to a handle, traditionally used in harvesting grain. 1. A curved instrument used to reap wheat or harvest the crop (Mk 4.29; Rv 14.14).

DEFINITION: Refers to the course of a race or, figuratively, the course of life and the fulfillment of a designated mission or task.
SENSES: 1. The track or path of an athletic race (2Tm 4.7).
2. The course of life or the ministerial journey accomplished (Ac 13.25).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se ao percurso de uma corrida ou, figuradamente, ao curso da vida e ao cumprimento de uma missão ou tarefa designada. 1. A pista ou o trajeto de uma corrida atlética (2Tm 4.7). | 2. O curso da vida ou a jornada ministerial cumprida (At 13.25).
THAYER.en: Refers to the course of a race or, figuratively, the course of life and the fulfillment of a designated mission or task. 1. The track or path of an athletic race (2Tm 4.7). | 2. The course of life or the ministerial journey accomplished (Ac 13.25).

DEFINITION: Name of a noble woman, youngest daughter of Herod Agrippa I, wife of the Roman procurator Felix.
SENSES: 1. Drusilla, who heard Paul's message about righteousness and judgment (Ac 24.24).

THAYER.pt: Nome de uma mulher nobre, filha mais nova de Herodes Agripa I, esposa do procurador romano Félix. 1. Drusila, que ouviu a mensagem de Paulo sobre a justiça e o juízo (At 24.24).
THAYER.en: Name of a noble woman, youngest daughter of Herod Agrippa I, wife of the Roman procurator Felix. 1. Drusilla, who heard Paul's message about righteousness and judgment (Ac 24.24).

DEFINITION: Expresses possession of capacity, inherent power, competence, or authorization to accomplish or experience something. Frequently followed by an infinitive to point out the practical, physical, moral, or theological feasibility of an action.
SENSES: 1. To have physical/spiritual power, strength, or competence (Mt 6.24; Mk 9.22).
2. To possess permitted moral or legal capacity (Ac 4.20; 1Co 3.2).

THAYER.pt: Expressa posse de capacidade, poder inerente, competência ou autorização para realizar ou vivenciar algo. Seguido frequentemente de infinitivo para apontar a viabilidade prática, física, moral ou teológica de uma ação. 1. Ter poder, força ou competência física/espiritual (Mt 6.24; Mc 9.22). | 2. Possuir capacidade moral ou legal permitida (At 4.20; 1Co 3.2).
THAYER.en: Expresses possession of capacity, inherent power, competence, or authorization to accomplish or experience something. Frequently followed by an infinitive to point out the practical, physical, moral, or theological feasibility of an action. 1. To have physical/spiritual power, strength, or competence (Mt 6.24; Mk 9.22). | 2. To possess permitted moral or legal capacity (Ac 4.20; 1Co 3.2).

DEFINITION: Intrinsic capacity to act, effective and manifest power of God, enabling His servants or manifesting in extraordinary and supernatural acts.
SENSES: 1. Strength, energy, operative capacity or power, especially divine (Acts 1:8; Rom 1:16).
2. Miraculous deed, mighty work, or supernatural sign (Matt 7:22; 11:20; 2 Cor 12:12).
3. Entity, celestial power, or angelic and cosmic authority (Rom 8:38; 1 Pet 3:22).

THAYER.pt: Capacidade intrínseca de agir, poder eficaz e manifesto de Deus, habilitando Seus servos ou manifestando-se em atos extraordinários e sobrenaturais. 1. Força, energia, capacidade ou poder operativo, mormente divino (At 1.8; Rm 1.16). | 2. Feito miraculoso, ato poderoso ou sinal sobrenatural (Mt 7.22; 11.20; 2Co 12.12). | 3. Entidade, potência celestial ou autoridade angélica e cósmica (Rm 8.38; 1Pe 3.22).
THAYER.en: Intrinsic capacity to act, effective and manifest power of God, enabling His servants or manifesting in extraordinary and supernatural acts. 1. Strength, energy, operative capacity or power, especially divine (Acts 1:8; Rom 1:16). | 2. Miraculous deed, mighty work, or supernatural sign (Matt 7:22; 11:20; 2 Cor 12:12). | 3. Entity, celestial power, or angelic and cosmic authority (Rom 8:38; 1 Pet 3:22).

DEFINITION: To confer strength or ability on someone, making them fit to accomplish or endure something through divine power.
SENSES: 1. To grant spiritual strength or capacity, to strengthen (Col 1:11; Heb 11:34).

THAYER.pt: Significa conferir força ou habilidade a alguém, tornando-o apto para realizar ou suportar algo por meio de poder divino. 1. Conceder força ou capacidade espiritual, fortalecer (Cl 1.11; Hb 11.34).
THAYER.en: To confer strength or ability on someone, making them fit to accomplish or endure something through divine power. 1. To grant spiritual strength or capacity, to strengthen (Col 1:11; Heb 11:34).

DEFINITION: Indicates a person who holds great political power, sovereign authority, or a high official office.
SENSES: 1. A supreme ruler or sovereign, applied to God (1 Tim 6:15).
2. An earthly potentate or authority (Luke 1:52).
3. A high court official (Acts 8:27).

THAYER.pt: Indica uma pessoa que detém grande poder político, autoridade soberana ou um alto cargo oficial. 1. Um governante supremo ou soberano, aplicado a Deus (1Tm 6.15). | 2. Um potentado ou autoridade terrena (Lc 1.52). | 3. Um alto oficial da corte (At 8.27).
THAYER.en: Indicates a person who holds great political power, sovereign authority, or a high official office. 1. A supreme ruler or sovereign, applied to God (1 Tim 6:15). | 2. An earthly potentate or authority (Luke 1:52). | 3. A high court official (Acts 8:27).

DEFINITION: Expresses the capacity to accomplish something effectively or to demonstrate power and competence in an action.
SENSES: 1. To possess capacity or demonstrate effectiveness in accomplishing something (2 Cor 9:8; 2 Cor 13:3).

THAYER.pt: Expressa a capacidade de realizar algo de forma eficaz ou de demonstrar poder e competência em uma ação. 1. Possuir capacidade ou demonstrar eficácia em realizar algo (2Co 9.8; 2Co 13.3).
THAYER.en: Expresses the capacity to accomplish something effectively or to demonstrate power and competence in an action. 1. To possess capacity or demonstrate effectiveness in accomplishing something (2 Cor 9:8; 2 Cor 13:3).

DEFINITION: Endowed with power, competence, or capacity to perform great deeds or fulfill specific tasks.
SENSES: 1. Powerful or influential, applied to God or prominent people (Luke 1:49; Acts 25:5).
2. Capable or competent in a specific area of skill or teaching (Titus 1:9).

THAYER.pt: Dotado de poder, competência ou capacidade para realizar feitos grandiosos ou cumprir determinadas tarefas. 1. Poderoso ou influente, aplicado a Deus ou a pessoas de destaque (Lc 1.49; At 25.5). | 2. Capaz ou competente em uma área específica de habilidade ou ensino (Tt 1.9).
THAYER.en: Endowed with power, competence, or capacity to perform great deeds or fulfill specific tasks. 1. Powerful or influential, applied to God or prominent people (Luke 1:49; Acts 25:5). | 2. Capable or competent in a specific area of skill or teaching (Titus 1:9).

DEFINITION: Used primarily to describe the movement of the sun as it goes down below the horizon at the end of the day.
SENSES: 1. Sunset or the setting sun (Mark 1:32).

THAYER.pt: Usado primariamente para descrever o movimento do sol ao baixar-se abaixo da linha do horizonte no fim do dia. 1. O pôr-do-sol ou o sol que se põe (Mc 1.32).
THAYER.en: Used primarily to describe the movement of the sun as it goes down below the horizon at the end of the day. 1. Sunset or the setting sun (Mark 1:32).

DEFINITION: Basic cardinal numeral equivalent to the number two. It gains relevance in legal biblical contexts where reliable testimony before justice required at least two persons for full validation.
SENSES: 1. Numeral expressing the quantity of two (Matt 18:20; 26:60).
2. Judicial and ministerial principle of confirmation in pairs (Matt 18:16; Luke 10:1).

THAYER.pt: Numeral cardinal básico equivalente ao algarismo dois. Assume relevância em contextos bíblicos legais onde o testemunho confiável diante da justiça exigia pelo menos duas pessoas para validação plena. 1. Numeral que expressa a quantidade de dois ou duas (Mt 18.20; 26.60). | 2. Princípio judicial e ministerial de confirmação em pares (Mt 18.16; Lc 10.1).
THAYER.en: Basic cardinal numeral equivalent to the number two. It gains relevance in legal biblical contexts where reliable testimony before justice required at least two persons for full validation. 1. Numeral expressing the quantity of two (Matt 18:20; 26:60). | 2. Judicial and ministerial principle of confirmation in pairs (Matt 18:16; Luke 10:1).

DEFINITION: An inseparable prefix expressing negation, difficulty, deterioration, or an adverse sense.
SENSES: 1. A prefix denoting something difficult, painful, defective, or adverse.

THAYER.pt: Prefixo inseparável que expressa negação, dificuldade, aviltamento ou um sentido adverso. 1. Prefixo que denota algo difícil, penoso, defeituoso ou adverso.
THAYER.en: An inseparable prefix expressing negation, difficulty, deterioration, or an adverse sense. 1. A prefix denoting something difficult, painful, defective, or adverse.

DEFINITION: Describes something that is excessively heavy or difficult to carry, whether in a physical or metaphorical sense (such as oppressive burdens).
SENSES: 1. A load or burden difficult to bear or tolerate (Matt 23:4).

THAYER.pt: Descreve algo que é excessivamente pesado ou difícil de carregar, seja em sentido físico ou metafórico (como fardos opressivos). 1. Carga ou fardo difícil de suportar ou tolerar (Mt 23.4).
THAYER.en: Describes something that is excessively heavy or difficult to carry, whether in a physical or metaphorical sense (such as oppressive burdens). 1. A load or burden difficult to bear or tolerate (Matt 23:4).

DEFINITION: Intestinal illness characterized by severe inflammation and bloody diarrhea.
SENSES: 1. The illness that afflicted Publius's father in Malta (Acts 28:8).

THAYER.pt: Enfermidade intestinal caracterizada por inflamação grave e diarreia com sangue. 1. A enfermidade que acometeu o pai de Públio em Malta (At 28.8).
THAYER.en: Intestinal illness characterized by severe inflammation and bloody diarrhea. 1. The illness that afflicted Publius's father in Malta (Acts 28:8).

DEFINITION: The quality of something that is arduous to interpret, explain, or comprehend due to its depth.
SENSES: 1. Spiritual concepts difficult to explain to immature listeners (Heb 5:11).

THAYER.pt: Qualidade de algo que é árduo de interpretar, explicar ou compreender devido à sua profundidade. 1. Conceitos espirituais difíceis de explicar a ouvintes imaturos (Hb 5.11).
THAYER.en: The quality of something that is arduous to interpret, explain, or comprehend due to its depth. 1. Spiritual concepts difficult to explain to immature listeners (Heb 5:11).

DEFINITION: Presenting great difficulty in being performed, attained, or endured.
SENSES: 1. The extreme difficulty for the rich to enter the Kingdom of God (Mark 10:24).

THAYER.pt: Que apresenta grande dificuldade para ser realizado, alcançado ou suportado. 1. A dificuldade extrema para os ricos entrarem no Reino de Deus (Mc 10.24).
THAYER.en: Presenting great difficulty in being performed, attained, or endured. 1. The extreme difficulty for the rich to enter the Kingdom of God (Mark 10:24).

DEFINITION: Describes an action performed with great difficulty, obstacle, or considerable effort.
SENSES: 1. With great difficulty or resistance to be attained (Matt 19:23).

THAYER.pt: Descreve uma ação que é realizada com grande dificuldade, obstáculo ou esforço considerável. 1. Com grande dificuldade ou resistência para ser alcançado (Mt 19.23).
THAYER.en: Describes an action performed with great difficulty, obstacle, or considerable effort. 1. With great difficulty or resistance to be attained (Matt 19:23).

DEFINITION: Refers to the setting of the sun and, by extension, the cardinal point where it sets.
SENSES: 1. The cardinal point west or occident (Luke 12:54; Rev 21:13).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se ao pôr do sol e, por extensão, ao ponto cardeal onde ele se põe. 1. O ponto cardeal oeste ou ocidente (Lc 12:54; Ap 21:13).
THAYER.en: Refers to the setting of the sun and, by extension, the cardinal point where it sets. 1. The cardinal point west or occident (Luke 12:54; Rev 21:13).

DEFINITION: Having an obscure or complex meaning, requiring great intellectual and spiritual effort to be understood.
SENSES: 1. The hard-to-understand truths present in Paul's epistles (2 Pet 3:16).

THAYER.pt: Que possui sentido obscuro ou complexo, exigindo grande esforço intelectual e espiritual para ser compreendido. 1. As verdades difíceis de entender presentes nas epístolas de Paulo (2Pe 3.16).
THAYER.en: Having an obscure or complex meaning, requiring great intellectual and spiritual effort to be understood. 1. The hard-to-understand truths present in Paul's epistles (2 Pet 3:16).

DEFINITION: The act of speaking ill of someone with the purpose of damaging their reputation; defamation or slander.
SENSES: 1. An unjust negative reputation generated by defamation or slander (2 Cor 6:8).

THAYER.pt: Ato de falar mal de alguém com o propósito de danificar sua reputação; difamação ou calúnia. 1. Reputação negativa injusta gerada por difamação ou calúnia (2Co 6.8).
THAYER.en: The act of speaking ill of someone with the purpose of damaging their reputation; defamation or slander. 1. An unjust negative reputation generated by defamation or slander (2 Cor 6:8).

DEFINITION: Cardinal numeral representing twelve, possessing strong historical and theological symbolism in the New Testament, especially associated with the twelve tribes and the apostles.
SENSES: 1. The exact number twelve, referring to people or objects (Matt 9:20; Rev 12:1).
2. The group of twelve disciples chosen by Jesus (Matt 10:1; Mark 3:14).

THAYER.pt: Numeral cardinal que representa o doze, possuindo forte simbolismo histórico e teológico no Novo Testamento, especialmente associado às doze tribos e aos apóstolos. 1. O número exato doze, referente a pessoas ou objetos (Mt 9.20; Ap 12.1). | 2. O grupo dos doze discípulos escolhidos por Jesus (Mt 10.1; Mc 3.14).
THAYER.en: Cardinal numeral representing twelve, possessing strong historical and theological symbolism in the New Testament, especially associated with the twelve tribes and the apostles. 1. The exact number twelve, referring to people or objects (Matt 9:20; Rev 12:1). | 2. The group of twelve disciples chosen by Jesus (Matt 10:1; Mark 3:14).

DEFINITION: Ordinal number indicating the position of number twelve in a sequential series.
SENSES: 1. The twelfth foundation of the wall of the New Jerusalem (Rev 21:20).

THAYER.pt: Número ordinal que indica a posição de número doze em uma série sequencial. 1. O décimo segundo fundamento da muralha da Nova Jerusalém (Ap 21.20).
THAYER.en: Ordinal number indicating the position of number twelve in a sequential series. 1. The twelfth foundation of the wall of the New Jerusalem (Rev 21:20).

DEFINITION: Designates the ensemble of the twelve tribes of Israel, representing the totality of the ethnic and religious unity of the chosen people.
SENSES: 1. The twelve tribes of Israel as the complete ethnic unity of God's people (Acts 26:7).

THAYER.pt: Designa o conjunto das doze tribos de Israel, representando a totalidade da unidade étnica e religiosa do povo escolhido. 1. As doze tribos de Israel como a unidade étnica completa do povo de Deus (At 26.7).
THAYER.en: Designates the ensemble of the twelve tribes of Israel, representing the totality of the ethnic and religious unity of the chosen people. 1. The twelve tribes of Israel as the complete ethnic unity of God's people (Acts 26:7).

DEFINITION: Refers to the flat surface of the roof of traditional Near Eastern houses, frequently used for rest or prayer.
SENSES: 1. The terrace or flat roof of a dwelling (Matt 10:27).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se à superfície plana do telhado das casas tradicionais do Oriente Próximo, usada frequentemente para descanso ou oração. 1. O terraço ou telhado plano de uma habitação (Mt 10:27).
THAYER.en: Refers to the flat surface of the roof of traditional Near Eastern houses, frequently used for rest or prayer. 1. The terrace or flat roof of a dwelling (Matt 10:27).

DEFINITION: That which is freely and generously granted or transferred by one person to another, emphasizing the gratuitous character of the gift, especially from God.
SENSES: 1. A free gift or present granted gratuitously (John 4:10; Acts 11:17; Eph 4:7).

THAYER.pt: Aquilo que é concedido ou transferido livre e generosamente por uma pessoa a outra, enfatizando o caráter gratuito da dádiva, especialmente de Deus. 1. Uma dádiva ou presente concedido gratuitamente (Jo 4.10; At 11.17; Ef 4.7).
THAYER.en: That which is freely and generously granted or transferred by one person to another, emphasizing the gratuitous character of the gift, especially from God. 1. A free gift or present granted gratuitously (John 4:10; Acts 11:17; Eph 4:7).

DEFINITION: Adverb derived from the idea of gift, describing something done or given without requirement of payment, without legitimate reason, or without fruitful purpose.
SENSES: 1. Freely, as a gift without cost or payment (Matt 10:8; Rom 3:24).
2. Without just cause or legitimate reason (John 15:25).
3. Without purpose or in vain (Gal 2:21).

THAYER.pt: Advérbio derivado da ideia de dom, que descreve algo feito ou dado sem exigência de pagamento, sem motivo legítimo ou sem propósito frutífero. 1. Gratuitamente, como um presente sem custo ou pagamento (Mt 10.8; Rm 3.24). | 2. Sem causa justa ou motivo legítimo (Jo 15.25). | 3. Sem propósito ou em vão (Gl 2.21).
THAYER.en: Adverb derived from the idea of gift, describing something done or given without requirement of payment, without legitimate reason, or without fruitful purpose. 1. Freely, as a gift without cost or payment (Matt 10:8; Rom 3:24). | 2. Without just cause or legitimate reason (John 15:25). | 3. Without purpose or in vain (Gal 2:21).

DEFINITION: To give or grant something as a gracious gift or formal benefit, emphasizing the donor's generosity.
SENSES: 1. To grant or bestow a gift or benefit graciously (Mark 15:45; 2 Pet 1:3).

THAYER.pt: Significa dar ou conceder algo como um presente gracioso ou benefício formal, enfatizando a generosidade do doador. 1. Conceder ou outorgar um presente ou benefício de forma graciosa (Mc 15.45; 2Pe 1.3).
THAYER.en: To give or grant something as a gracious gift or formal benefit, emphasizing the donor's generosity. 1. To grant or bestow a gift or benefit graciously (Mark 15:45; 2 Pet 1:3).

DEFINITION: Designates a precious gift or gracious concession, emphasizing the generosity of the one who offers it.
SENSES: 1. A gracious gift or present (Jas 1:17; Rom 5:16).

THAYER.pt: Designa um presente precioso ou uma concessão graciosa, enfatizando a generosidade daquele que o oferece. 1. Uma dádiva ou presente gracioso (Tg 1.17; Rm 5.16).
THAYER.en: Designates a precious gift or gracious concession, emphasizing the generosity of the one who offers it. 1. A gracious gift or present (Jas 1:17; Rom 5:16).

DEFINITION: That which is given voluntarily as a goodwill present or as a cultic offering to God.
SENSES: 1. A present or gift in general (Matt 2:11; Rev 11:10).
2. A religious offering or sacrifice dedicated to God (Matt 5:23; Heb 8:4).

THAYER.pt: Aquilo que é dado voluntariamente como presente de boa vontade ou como oferta cultual a Deus. 1. Presente ou dádiva em geral (Mt 2.11; Ap 11.10). | 2. Oferta religiosa ou sacrifício dedicado a Deus (Mt 5.23; Hb 8.4).
THAYER.en: That which is given voluntarily as a goodwill present or as a cultic offering to God. 1. A present or gift in general (Matt 2:11; Rev 11:10). | 2. A religious offering or sacrifice dedicated to God (Matt 5:23; Heb 8:4).

DEFINITION: Exclamatory particle used to express strong surprise, indignation, or displeasure at an unexpected situation.
SENSES: 1. An expression of astonishment or annoyance at a spiritual manifestation or event (Mark 1:24; Luke 4:34).

THAYER.pt: Partícula exclamativa usada para expressar forte surpresa, indignação ou desprazer diante de uma situação inesperada. 1. Expressão de espanto ou contrariedade diante de uma manifestação espiritual ou evento (Mc 1.24; Lc 4.34).
THAYER.en: Exclamatory particle used to express strong surprise, indignation, or displeasure at an unexpected situation. 1. An expression of astonishment or annoyance at a spiritual manifestation or event (Mark 1:24; Luke 4:34).

DEFINITION: Conditional particle connecting a dependent clause to a main clause, usually constructed with the subjunctive mood. Introduces a probable hypothesis, future possibility, or present factual generalization.
SENSES: 1. Conditional marker with the subjunctive: 'if' (Matt 8:2; 1 John 1:9).
2. Temporal with eventual connotation: 'when', 'whenever' (John 12:32; 1 John 3:2).
3. Generalizer in relative clauses: 'whoever', 'whatever' (Matt 5:19).

THAYER.pt: Partícula condicional que conecta uma oração subordinada a uma principal, geralmente construída com o modo subjuntivo. Introduz uma hipótese provável, possibilidade futura ou generalização factual no presente. 1. Marcador condicional com subjuntivo: 'se' (Mt 8.2; 1Jo 1.9). | 2. Temporal com conotação eventual: 'quando', 'logo que' (Jo 12.32; 1Jo 3.2). | 3. Generalizador em orações relativas: 'quem quer que', 'qualquer que' (Mt 5.19).
THAYER.en: Conditional particle connecting a dependent clause to a main clause, usually constructed with the subjunctive mood. Introduces a probable hypothesis, future possibility, or present factual generalization. 1. Conditional marker with the subjunctive: 'if' (Matt 8:2; 1 John 1:9). | 2. Temporal with eventual connotation: 'when', 'whenever' (John 12:32; 1 John 3:2). | 3. Generalizer in relative clauses: 'whoever', 'whatever' (Matt 5:19).

DEFINITION: Reflexive pronoun that redirects the verbal action back to the acting subject itself. In the plural and in extended contexts, it can also assume nuances of mutuality and reciprocity.
SENSES: 1. Singular direct reflexive: 'himself', 'herself', 'itself' (Matt 16:24; Luke 7:39).
2. Plural reflexive: 'themselves' or reciprocally 'one another' (Eph 4:32; Col 3:16).
3. Emphatic possessive: 'his own', 'of oneself' (John 5:18; Rom 14:7).

THAYER.pt: Pronome reflexivo que redireciona a ação verbal de volta ao próprio sujeito agente. No plural e em contextos estendidos, pode assumir também nuances de mutualidade e reciprocidade. 1. Reflexivo direto singular: 'a si mesmo', 'ele mesmo' (Mt 16.24; Lc 7.39). | 2. Reflexivo plural: 'a si mesmos' ou reciprocamente 'uns aos outros' (Ef 4.32; Cl 3.16). | 3. Possessivo enfático: 'seu próprio', 'de si' (Jo 5.18; Rm 14.7).
THAYER.en: Reflexive pronoun that redirects the verbal action back to the acting subject itself. In the plural and in extended contexts, it can also assume nuances of mutuality and reciprocity. 1. Singular direct reflexive: 'himself', 'herself', 'itself' (Matt 16:24; Luke 7:39). | 2. Plural reflexive: 'themselves' or reciprocally 'one another' (Eph 4:32; Col 3:16). | 3. Emphatic possessive: 'his own', 'of oneself' (John 5:18; Rom 14:7).

DEFINITION: To grant permission for something to happen or to abstain from interfering, leaving someone or something in peace.
SENSES: 1. To permit someone to do something or to tolerate an action (Acts 14:16; 27:40).
2. To leave alone, not disturb, or abandon momentarily (Luke 22:51).

THAYER.pt: Conceder permissão para que algo aconteça ou abster-se de interferir, deixando algo ou alguém em paz. 1. Permitir que alguém faça algo ou tolerar uma ação (At 14.16; 27.40). | 2. Deixar em paz, não incomodar ou abandonar momentaneamente (Lc 22.51).
THAYER.en: To grant permission for something to happen or to abstain from interfering, leaving someone or something in peace. 1. To permit someone to do something or to tolerate an action (Acts 14:16; 27:40). | 2. To leave alone, not disturb, or abandon momentarily (Luke 22:51).

DEFINITION: Cardinal numeral representing the exact quantity of seventy.
SENSES: 1. The number seventy (Acts 23:23).

THAYER.pt: Numeral cardinal que representa a quantidade exata de setenta. 1. O número setenta (At 23.23).
THAYER.en: Cardinal numeral representing the exact quantity of seventy. 1. The number seventy (Acts 23:23).

DEFINITION: Indicates the occurrence of an action seventy times, used figuratively to denote unlimited or abundant frequency.
SENSES: 1. Literally or figuratively, the intensive repetition of an act, such as inexhaustible forgiveness (Mt 18.22).

THAYER.pt: Indica a ocorrência de uma ação setenta vezes, usada figuradamente para denotar uma frequência ilimitada ou abundante. 1. Literal ou figuradamente, a repetição intensiva de um ato, como o perdão inesgotável (Mt 18.22).
THAYER.en: Indicates the occurrence of an action seventy times, used figuratively to denote unlimited or abundant frequency. 1. Literally or figuratively, the intensive repetition of an act, such as inexhaustible forgiveness (Mt 18.22).

DEFINITION: Ordinal numeral indicating the position number seven in an ordered series of time, space, or elements.
SENSES: 1. The seventh element in an ordered sequence (Jude 14; Rev 8.1).

THAYER.pt: Numeral ordinal que indica a posição número sete em uma série ordenada de tempo, espaço ou elementos. 1. O sétimo elemento em uma sequência ordenada (Jd 14; Ap 8.1).
THAYER.en: Ordinal numeral indicating the position number seven in an ordered series of time, space, or elements. 1. The seventh element in an ordered sequence (Jude 14; Rev 8.1).

DEFINITION: Name of a Hebrew patriarch, descendant of Shem and ancestor of Abraham, mentioned in the genealogical lineage of Jesus.
SENSES: 1. Historical figure in the genealogy of Christ (Lk 3.35).

THAYER.pt: Nome de um patriarca hebreu, descendente de Sem e ancestral de Abraão, mencionado na linhagem genealógica de Jesus. 1. Personagem histórico na genealogia de Cristo (Lc 3.35).
THAYER.en: Name of a Hebrew patriarch, descendant of Shem and ancestor of Abraham, mentioned in the genealogical lineage of Jesus. 1. Historical figure in the genealogy of Christ (Lk 3.35).

DEFINITION: Pertaining or relating to the Hebrew people, their culture, or their traditional language.
SENSES: 1. Relating to the language or characters used by the Hebrews (Lk 23.38).

THAYER.pt: Pertinente ou relativo ao povo hebraico, sua cultura ou sua língua tradicional. 1. Relativo à língua ou aos caracteres usados pelos hebreus (Lc 23.38).
THAYER.en: Pertaining or relating to the Hebrew people, their culture, or their traditional language. 1. Relating to the language or characters used by the Hebrews (Lk 23.38).

DEFINITION: Ethnic and linguistic designation for an Israelite, whether emphasizing ancestry or the use of the Hebrew/Aramaic language.
SENSES: 1. Descendant of Abraham or Israelite by origin (2Co 11.22; Phil 3.5);
2. Hebrew/Aramaic-speaking Jew in contrast to Greek-speaking ones (Acts 6.1).

THAYER.pt: Designação étnica e linguística para um israelita, seja enfatizando a ancestralidade ou o uso da língua hebraica/aramaica. 1. Descendente de Abraão ou israelita de origem (2Co 11.22; Fp 3.5); | 2. Judeu de língua hebraica/aramaica em contraste com os de fala grega (At 6.1).
THAYER.en: Ethnic and linguistic designation for an Israelite, whether emphasizing ancestry or the use of the Hebrew/Aramaic language. 1. Descendant of Abraham or Israelite by origin (2Co 11.22; Phil 3.5); | 2. Hebrew/Aramaic-speaking Jew in contrast to Greek-speaking ones (Acts 6.1).

DEFINITION: Designates the Hebrew or Aramaic language spoken by Jews at the time of the New Testament.
SENSES: 1. The vernacular Hebrew or Aramaic language (Acts 21.40; Acts 22.2; Acts 26.14).

THAYER.pt: Designa a língua hebraica ou aramaica falada pelos judeus na época do Novo Testamento. 1. O idioma hebraico ou aramaico vernáculo (At 21.40; At 22.2; At 26.14).
THAYER.en: Designates the Hebrew or Aramaic language spoken by Jews at the time of the New Testament. 1. The vernacular Hebrew or Aramaic language (Acts 21.40; Acts 22.2; Acts 26.14).

DEFINITION: Indicates the use of the Hebrew language or vernacular Aramaic spoken in Judea in the New Testament period.
SENSES: 1. In the Hebrew or Aramaic language (Jn 5:2; 19:13).

THAYER.pt: Indica o uso da língua hebraica ou do aramaico vernáculo falado na Judeia no período do Novo Testamento. 1. Na língua hebraica ou aramaica (Jo 5:2; 19:13).
THAYER.en: Indicates the use of the Hebrew language or vernacular Aramaic spoken in Judea in the New Testament period. 1. In the Hebrew or Aramaic language (Jn 5:2; 19:13).

DEFINITION: To move toward a reference point in space or time, reducing distance.
SENSES: 1. To draw physically close to a place or someone (Mt 21.1; Lk 7.12).
2. To arrive near in temporal terms, to be imminent (Mt 3.2; Lk 21.8).

THAYER.pt: Mover-se em direção a um ponto de referência no espaço ou no tempo, reduzindo a distância. 1. Aproximar-se fisicamente de um lugar ou de alguém (Mt 21.1; Lc 7.12). | 2. Chegar próximo em termos temporais, estar iminente (Mt 3.2; Lc 21.8).
THAYER.en: To move toward a reference point in space or time, reducing distance. 1. To draw physically close to a place or someone (Mt 21.1; Lk 7.12). | 2. To arrive near in temporal terms, to be imminent (Mt 3.2; Lk 21.8).

DEFINITION: Means to record information, names, or messages in writing on a document or permanent medium.
SENSES: 1. To record or enroll names in an official document (Lk 10.20).
2. To write a message indelibly (2Co 3.2).

THAYER.pt: Significa registrar informações, nomes ou mensagens por escrito em um documento ou suporte permanente. 1. Registrar ou inscrever nomes em um documento oficial (Lc 10.20). | 2. Escrever uma mensagem de modo indelével (2Co 3.2).
THAYER.en: Means to record information, names, or messages in writing on a document or permanent medium. 1. To record or enroll names in an official document (Lk 10.20). | 2. To write a message indelibly (2Co 3.2).

DEFINITION: One who serves as legal security or guarantor for the fulfillment of an agreement or covenant.
SENSES: 1. Title applied to Jesus as the supreme guarantee of a better and eternal covenant (Heb 7.22).

THAYER.pt: Aquele que serve como garantia legal ou fiador para o cumprimento de um acordo ou aliança. 1. Título aplicado a Jesus como a garantia suprema de uma melhor e eterna aliança (Hb 7.22).
THAYER.en: One who serves as legal security or guarantor for the fulfillment of an agreement or covenant. 1. Title applied to Jesus as the supreme guarantee of a better and eternal covenant (Heb 7.22).

DEFINITION: Found in close spatial physical proximity or temporal imminence.
SENSES: 1. Near in terms of spatial location or physical proximity (Jn 19.42; Eph 2.13).
2. Close in terms of time, imminent (Mt 24.33; Phil 4.5).

THAYER.pt: Que se encontra em proximidade física espacial próxima ou em iminência temporal. 1. Perto em termos de localização espacial ou proximidade física (Jo 19.42; Ef 2.13). | 2. Próximo em termos de tempo, iminente (Mt 24.33; Fp 4.5).
THAYER.en: Found in close spatial physical proximity or temporal imminence. 1. Near in terms of spatial location or physical proximity (Jn 19.42; Eph 2.13). | 2. Close in terms of time, imminent (Mt 24.33; Phil 4.5).

DEFINITION: Comparative form indicating greater proximity, whether in spatial or temporal terms.
SENSES: 1. Greater proximity in time, especially regarding eschatological salvation (Rom 13.11).

THAYER.pt: Forma comparativa que indica uma proximidade maior, seja em termos espaciais ou temporais. 1. Proximidade maior no tempo, especialmente em referência à salvação escatológica (Rm 13.11).
THAYER.en: Comparative form indicating greater proximity, whether in spatial or temporal terms. 1. Greater proximity in time, especially regarding eschatological salvation (Rom 13.11).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: ἐγερῶ, Aor: ἤγειρα, Perf: ἐγήγερκα, Pass. Aor: ἠγέρθην
DEFINITION: The act of awakening from deep sleep or raising someone from a fallen posture. It possesses supreme theological value by indicating the physical resurrection of Jesus and the future eschatological hope of believers' resurrection.
SENSES: 1. To raise the dead, bring back to life (Mt 10.8; 1Co 15.12).
2. To stand up, rise from a lying or sitting position (Mt 2.14; Mk 2.12).
3. To awake from natural sleep or spiritual lethargy (Mt 8.25; Rom 13.11).
4. To bring forth publicly, raise up a leader or servant (Acts 13.22).

THAYER.pt: Ação de despertar de um sono profundo ou erguer alguém de uma postura caída. Possui supremo valor teológico ao indicar a ressurreição física de Jesus e a futura esperança escatológica da ressurreição dos crentes. 1. Ressuscitar os mortos, trazer de volta à vida (Mt 10.8; 1Co 15.12). | 2. Erguer-se, levantar de uma posição deitada ou sentada (Mt 2.14; Mc 2.12). | 3. Despertar do sono natural ou letargia espiritual (Mt 8.25; Rm 13.11). | 4. Fazer surgir publicamente, suscitar um líder ou servo (At 13.22).
THAYER.en: The act of awakening from deep sleep or raising someone from a fallen posture. It possesses supreme theological value by indicating the physical resurrection of Jesus and the future eschatological hope of believers' resurrection. 1. To raise the dead, bring back to life (Mt 10.8; 1Co 15.12). | 2. To stand up, rise from a lying or sitting position (Mt 2.14; Mk 2.12). | 3. To awake from natural sleep or spiritual lethargy (Mt 8.25; Rom 13.11). | 4. To bring forth publicly, raise up a leader or servant (Acts 13.22).

DEFINITION: The act of returning to life after death, lit. the awakening from a state of death.
SENSES: 1. The return to life or resurrection of a deceased person.

THAYER.pt: O ato de retornar à vida após a morte, lit. o despertar de um estado de morte. 1. O retorno à vida ou a ressurreição de uma pessoa falecida.
THAYER.en: The act of returning to life after death, lit. the awakening from a state of death. 1. The return to life or resurrection of a deceased person.

DEFINITION: One who is hired or tasked to lurk and obtain secret information with ulterior motives.
SENSES: 1. Informant or spy sent covertly to catch someone in the act (Lk 20.20).

THAYER.pt: Aquele que é contratado ou encarregado de espreitar e obter informações secretas com segundas intenções. 1. Informante ou espião enviado dissimuladamente para apanhar alguém em flagrante (Lc 20.20).
THAYER.en: One who is hired or tasked to lurk and obtain secret information with ulterior motives. 1. Informant or spy sent covertly to catch someone in the act (Lk 20.20).

DEFINITION: Annual Jewish festival commemorating the purification and re-dedication of the Jerusalem Temple by Judas Maccabeus.
SENSES: 1. The festive feast of the Dedication of the Temple celebrated in winter (Jn 10.22).

THAYER.pt: Festival judaico anual que comemorava a purificação e rededicação do Templo de Jerusalém por Judas Macabeu. 1. A festa festiva da Dedicação do Templo celebrada no inverno (Jo 10.22).
THAYER.en: Annual Jewish festival commemorating the purification and re-dedication of the Jerusalem Temple by Judas Maccabeus. 1. The festive feast of the Dedication of the Temple celebrated in winter (Jn 10.22).

DEFINITION: To bring something into force for the first time or ceremonially inaugurate something newly established.
SENSES: 1. To solemnly inaugurate or ratify (Heb 10.20).

THAYER.pt: Colocar algo em vigor pela primeira vez ou inaugurar cerimonialmente algo recém-estabelecido. 1. Inaugurar ou ratificar solenemente (Hb 10.20).
THAYER.en: To bring something into force for the first time or ceremonially inaugurate something newly established. 1. To solemnly inaugurate or ratify (Heb 10.20).

DEFINITION: To bring formal charges or impute blame to someone, usually in a legal or official context.
SENSES: 1. To formally accuse or bring a lawsuit against someone (Acts 19:38; Rom 8:33).

THAYER.pt: Apresentar acusações formais ou imputar uma culpa a alguém, geralmente em contexto jurídico ou oficial. 1. Acusar formalmente ou mover processo contra alguém (At 19:38; Rm 8:33).
THAYER.en: To bring formal charges or impute blame to someone, usually in a legal or official context. 1. To formally accuse or bring a lawsuit against someone (Acts 19:38; Rom 8:33).

DEFINITION: Means to leave someone helpless in a difficult situation, desert, or fail to provide necessary support.
SENSES: 1. To abandon or forsake someone in a time of affliction (Mt 27.46; 2Tim 4.10).
2. To leave behind or not completely forsake (Acts 2.27).

THAYER.pt: Significa deixar alguém desamparado em uma situação difícil, desertar ou falhar em dar o apoio necessário. 1. Abandonar ou desamparar alguém em momento de aflição (Mt 27.46; 2Tm 4.10). | 2. Deixar para trás ou não desamparar totalmente (At 2.27).
THAYER.en: Means to leave someone helpless in a difficult situation, desert, or fail to provide necessary support. 1. To abandon or forsake someone in a time of affliction (Mt 27.46; 2Tim 4.10). | 2. To leave behind or not completely forsake (Acts 2.27).

DEFINITION: To live or establish permanent residence in the midst of a group or locality.
SENSES: 1. The act of residing and living among wicked people, experiencing moral distress (2Pet 2.8).

THAYER.pt: Viver ou estabelecer residência de forma permanente no meio de um grupo ou localidade. 1. O ato de residir e conviver no meio de pessoas iníquas, experimentando aflição moral (2Pe 2.8).
THAYER.en: To live or establish permanent residence in the midst of a group or locality. 1. The act of residing and living among wicked people, experiencing moral distress (2Pet 2.8).

DEFINITION: Agricultural technique of inserting a bud or branch of one plant into the trunk of another so they grow joined.
SENSES: 1. To graft branches of an olive tree (or another plant) (Rom 11:17,24).

THAYER.pt: Técnica agrícola de inserir um broto ou galho de uma planta no tronco de outra para que cresçam unidos. 1. Enxertar ramos de oliveira (ou outra planta) (Rm 11:17,24).
THAYER.en: Agricultural technique of inserting a bud or branch of one plant into the trunk of another so they grow joined. 1. To graft branches of an olive tree (or another plant) (Rom 11:17,24).

DEFINITION: Formal legal term for an accusation or complaint brought against someone in a court.
SENSES: 1. Formal accusation or lawsuit brought against someone (Acts 23.29; 25.16).

THAYER.pt: Termo jurídico formal para uma acusação ou denúncia apresentada contra alguém em um tribunal. 1. Acusação formal ou processo movido contra alguém (At 23.29; 25.16).
THAYER.en: Formal legal term for an accusation or complaint brought against someone in a court. 1. Formal accusation or lawsuit brought against someone (Acts 23.29; 25.16).

DEFINITION: To fasten or tie a garment around oneself, often denoting the adoption of a humble posture.
SENSES: 1. To clothe oneself with mutual humility like one tying on a servant's garment (1Pet 5.5).

THAYER.pt: Apertar ou amarrar uma vestimenta ao redor de si, frequentemente denotando a adoção de uma postura humilde. 1. Revestir-se de humildade mútua como quem ata uma veste de servo (1Pe 5.5).
THAYER.en: To fasten or tie a garment around oneself, often denoting the adoption of a humble posture. 1. To clothe oneself with mutual humility like one tying on a servant's garment (1Pet 5.5).

DEFINITION: That which stops, blocks, or delays the advance and progress of an activity or cause.
SENSES: 1. Impediment or barrier hindering the progress of the gospel work (1Co 9.12).

THAYER.pt: Aquilo que detém, bloqueia ou retarda o avanço e o progresso de uma atividade ou causa. 1. Impedimento ou barreira que dificulta o avanço da obra evangélica (1Co 9.12).
THAYER.en: That which stops, blocks, or delays the advance and progress of an activity or cause. 1. Impediment or barrier hindering the progress of the gospel work (1Co 9.12).

DEFINITION: Means to create obstacles or barriers that make the progress of something slow or difficult, frustrating an action or journey.
SENSES: 1. To hinder or interrupt someone's progress in a task or walk (Gal 5.7; 1Pet 3.7; Rom 15.22).

THAYER.pt: Significa criar obstáculos ou barreiras que tornam o progresso de algo lento ou difícil, frustrando uma ação ou jornada. 1. Impedir ou interromper o progresso de alguém em uma tarefa ou caminhada (Gl 5.7; 1Pe 3.7; Rm 15.22).
THAYER.en: Means to create obstacles or barriers that make the progress of something slow or difficult, frustrating an action or journey. 1. To hinder or interrupt someone's progress in a task or walk (Gal 5.7; 1Pet 3.7; Rom 15.22).

DEFINITION: Moral virtue consisting of strict control over one's own impulses, desires, and passions.
SENSES: 1. Self-control as a fruit of the Spirit and Christian virtue (Acts 24.25; Gal 5.23).

THAYER.pt: Virtude moral que consiste no controle rigoroso sobre os próprios impulsos, desejos e paixões. 1. Domínio próprio como fruto do Espírito e virtude cristã (At 24.25; Gl 5.23).
THAYER.en: Moral virtue consisting of strict control over one's own impulses, desires, and passions. 1. Self-control as a fruit of the Spirit and Christian virtue (Acts 24.25; Gal 5.23).

DEFINITION: To exercise strict control over one's own impulses, passions, and bodily desires; to be temperate or continent.
SENSES: 1. To exercise self-control over desires (1Co 7.9).

THAYER.pt: Exercer domínio rigoroso sobre os próprios impulsos, paixões e desejos corporais; ser temperante ou continente. 1. Exercer autocontrole sobre os desejos (1Co 7.9).
THAYER.en: To exercise strict control over one's own impulses, passions, and bodily desires; to be temperate or continent. 1. To exercise self-control over desires (1Co 7.9).

DEFINITION: Exercising control over one's own passions, impulses, and fleshly desires; disciplined.
SENSES: 1. Virtue required of Christian leaders to maintain self-control (Titus 1.8).

THAYER.pt: Que exerce domínio sobre as próprias paixões, impulsos e desejos carnais; disciplinado. 1. Virtude exigida de líderes cristãos de manter o autocontrole (Tt 1.8).
THAYER.en: Exercising control over one's own passions, impulses, and fleshly desires; disciplined. 1. Virtue required of Christian leaders to maintain self-control (Titus 1.8).

DEFINITION: To judge and include someone within a certain group, category, or standard of comparison.
SENSES: 1. To include or compare oneself within the same evaluation standard as others (2Co 10.12).

THAYER.pt: Julgar e incluir alguém dentro de um determinado grupo, categoria ou padrão de comparação. 1. Incluir ou comparar a si mesmo no mesmo padrão de avaliação que outros (2Co 10.12).
THAYER.en: To judge and include someone within a certain group, category, or standard of comparison. 1. To include or compare oneself within the same evaluation standard as others (2Co 10.12).

DEFINITION: To place something inside another substance so that it is hidden and out of sight.
SENSES: 1. To hide leaven in flour dough until the whole batch is leavened (Mt 13.33).

THAYER.pt: Colocar algo dentro de outra substância de modo que fique oculto e fora de vista. 1. Ocultar fermento na massa de farinha até levedar toda a porção (Mt 13.33).
THAYER.en: To place something inside another substance so that it is hidden and out of sight. 1. To hide leaven in flour dough until the whole batch is leavened (Mt 13.33).

DEFINITION: Being in a state of pregnancy, generating a new life in the womb.
SENSES: 1. State of gestation, referring to Mary when traveling to Bethlehem (Lk 2.5).

THAYER.pt: Que está no estado de gravidez, gerando uma nova vida no ventre. 1. Condição de gestação, referindo-se a Maria ao viajar para Belém (Lc 2.5).
THAYER.en: Being in a state of pregnancy, generating a new life in the womb. 1. State of gestation, referring to Mary when traveling to Bethlehem (Lk 2.5).

DEFINITION: To apply by friction an unctuous substance, such as medicinal oil or eye salve, onto a body surface.
SENSES: 1. Apply medicinal eye salve to the eyes to recover spiritual sight (Rev 3.18).

THAYER.pt: Aplicar por fricção uma substância untuosa, como óleo medicinal ou colírio, sobre uma superfície corporal. 1. Aplicar colírio medicinal aos olhos para recuperar a visão espiritual (Ap 3.18).
THAYER.en: To apply by friction an unctuous substance, such as medicinal oil or eye salve, onto a body surface. 1. Apply medicinal eye salve to the eyes to recover spiritual sight (Rev 3.18).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Gen. ἐμοῦ/μου, Dat. ἐμοί/μοι, Ac. ἐμέ/με; Plur. ἡμεῖς
DEFINITION: First-person singular personal pronoun. When expressed in the nominative case, it carries strong emphatic, authoritative, or contrasting value, very notable in Jesus' solemn formulations.
SENSES: 1. First-person personal pronoun in the nominative with emphatic value ('I myself') (Mt 5.22; Jn 14.6).
2. Solemn formula of divine revelation and self-identification (ἐγώ εἰμι, 'I am') (Jn 8.58; Jn 18.5).
3. Plural (ἡμεῖς) indicating the apostolic group or the Christian community ('we') (1Jn 1.1; Rom 8.37).

THAYER.pt: Pronome pessoal de primeira pessoa singular. Quando expresso no caso nominativo, carrega forte valor enfático, autoritativo ou contrastante, muito notável nas formulações solenes de Jesus. 1. Pronome pessoal de 1ª pessoa no nominativo com valor enfático ('eu mesmo') (Mt 5.22; Jo 14.6). | 2. Fórmula solene de revelação e autoidentificação divina (ἐγώ εἰμι, 'Eu Sou') (Jo 8.58; Jo 18.5). | 3. Plural (ἡμεῖς) indicando o grupo apostólico ou a comunidade cristã ('nós') (1Jo 1.1; Rm 8.37).
THAYER.en: First-person singular personal pronoun. When expressed in the nominative case, it carries strong emphatic, authoritative, or contrasting value, very notable in Jesus' solemn formulations. 1. First-person personal pronoun in the nominative with emphatic value ('I myself') (Mt 5.22; Jn 14.6). | 2. Solemn formula of divine revelation and self-identification (ἐγώ εἰμι, 'I am') (Jn 8.58; Jn 18.5). | 3. Plural (ἡμεῖς) indicating the apostolic group or the Christian community ('we') (1Jn 1.1; Rom 8.37).

DEFINITION: To destroy or demolish an urban structure so as to reduce it to ground level.
SENSES: 1. The devastation and razing prophesied against the city of Jerusalem (Lk 19.44).

THAYER.pt: Destruir ou demolir uma estrutura urbana de modo a reduzi-la ao nível do solo. 1. A devastação e o arrasamento profetizados contra a cidade de Jerusalém (Lc 19.44).
THAYER.en: To destroy or demolish an urban structure so as to reduce it to ground level. 1. The devastation and razing prophesied against the city of Jerusalem (Lk 19.44).

DEFINITION: The firm surface of the earth upon which we rest or walk.
SENSES: 1. The soil or physical surface where someone falls (Acts 22.7).

THAYER.pt: A superfície firme da terra sobre a qual repousamos ou caminhamos. 1. O solo ou a superfície física onde alguém cai (At 22.7).
THAYER.en: The firm surface of the earth upon which we rest or walk. 1. The soil or physical surface where someone falls (Acts 22.7).

DEFINITION: Describes someone or something that is solidly established, firm in convictions, and immune to shaking.
SENSES: 1. Firm, constant, and immovable in moral position or conviction (1Cor 15.58; 1Pet 5.9).

THAYER.pt: Descreve alguém ou algo que está solidamente estabelecido, firme em suas convicções e imune a abalos. 1. Firme, constante e inabalável em posição ou convicção moral (1Co 15.58; 1Pe 5.9).
THAYER.en: Describes someone or something that is solidly established, firm in convictions, and immune to shaking. 1. Firm, constant, and immovable in moral position or conviction (1Cor 15.58; 1Pet 5.9).

DEFINITION: That which serves as a firm support, structural base, or solid underpinning for something.
SENSES: 1. The church described as the base and support of the truth (1Tim 3.15).

THAYER.pt: Aquilo que serve como suporte firme, base estrutural ou sustentação sólida para algo. 1. A igreja descrita como a base e sustentáculo da verdade (1Tm 3.15).
THAYER.en: That which serves as a firm support, structural base, or solid underpinning for something. 1. The church described as the base and support of the truth (1Tim 3.15).

DEFINITION: Masculine proper name referring to King Hezekiah of Judah, mentioned in the earthly genealogy of Jesus.
SENSES: 1. King Hezekiah in the genealogy of Christ (Mt 1.9-10).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio masculino referente ao rei Ezequias de Judá, mencionado na genealogia terrena de Jesus. 1. O rei Ezequias na genealogia de Cristo (Mt 1.9-10).
THAYER.en: Masculine proper name referring to King Hezekiah of Judah, mentioned in the earthly genealogy of Jesus. 1. King Hezekiah in the genealogy of Christ (Mt 1.9-10).

DEFINITION: Religiosity invented or imposed by one's own will, characterized by human rigorism and hypocrisy.
SENSES: 1. Form of false worship motivated by human precepts and inventions (Col 2.23).

THAYER.pt: Religiosidade inventada ou imposta por vontade própria, caracterizada por rigorismo humano e hipocrisia. 1. Forma de adoração falsa motivada por preceitos e invenções humanas (Cl 2.23).
THAYER.en: Religiosity invented or imposed by one's own will, characterized by human rigorism and hypocrisy. 1. Form of false worship motivated by human precepts and inventions (Col 2.23).

DEFINITION: To adjust or conform to an established custom, tradition, or habit.
SENSES: 1. Practice something according to the traditional custom of the religious law (Lk 2.27).

THAYER.pt: Ajustar-se ou conformar-se a um costume, tradição ou hábito estabelecido. 1. Praticar algo de acordo com o costume tradicional da lei religiosa (Lc 2.27).
THAYER.en: To adjust or conform to an established custom, tradition, or habit. 1. Practice something according to the traditional custom of the religious law (Lk 2.27).

DEFINITION: Political authority appointed to rule over a specific province or minority ethnic community.
SENSES: 1. Regional governor under higher authority in Damascus (2Cor 11.32).

THAYER.pt: Autoridade política nomeada para governar sobre uma província específica ou comunidade étnica minoritária. 1. Governador regional sob autoridade superior em Damasco (2Co 11.32).
THAYER.en: Political authority appointed to rule over a specific province or minority ethnic community. 1. Regional governor under higher authority in Damascus (2Cor 11.32).

DEFINITION: Referring to peoples who do not belong to the covenant of Israel, characterized by idolatry and secular practices.
SENSES: 1. Person of a non-Israelite nation, gentile, or pagan (Mt 5.47; 6.7; 18.17).

THAYER.pt: Referente aos povos que não pertencem ao pacto de Israel, caracterizados pela idolatria e práticas seculares. 1. Pessoa de nação não israelita, gentio ou pagão (Mt 5.47; 6.7; 18.17).
THAYER.en: Referring to peoples who do not belong to the covenant of Israel, characterized by idolatry and secular practices. 1. Person of a non-Israelite nation, gentile, or pagan (Mt 5.47; 6.7; 18.17).

DEFINITION: In a manner similar to gentiles or non-Jewish peoples, following pagan customs.
SENSES: 1. To live or act identically to pagans, contrary to the truth of the gospel (Gal 2.14).

THAYER.pt: De maneira semelhante aos gentios ou povos não judeus, seguindo costumes pagãos. 1. Viver ou agir de modo idêntico aos pagãos, contrariando a verdade do evangelho (Gl 2.14).
THAYER.en: In a manner similar to gentiles or non-Jewish peoples, following pagan customs. 1. To live or act identically to pagans, contrary to the truth of the gospel (Gal 2.14).
