DEFINITION: Human group united by ancestral kinship ties, common language, and shared culture. In the plural in the Jewish-Christian context (τὰ ἔθνη), it specifically designates gentiles or pagan peoples in distinction to the chosen people of Israel.
SENSES: 1. People, nation, sociopolitical community body (Mt 24.7; Acts 8.9; Acts 10.22).
2. In the plural (τὰ ἔθνη), the gentile nations in contrast to the Jewish people (Mt 28.19; Rom 1.5).
3. Converted Christians originating from a gentile background (Rom 11.13; Rom 16.4).

THAYER.pt: Grupo humano unido por laços de parentesco ancestral, idioma comum e cultura compartilhada. No plural no contexto judaico-cristão (τὰ ἔθνη), designa especificamente os gentios ou povos pagãos em distinção ao povo eleito de Israel. 1. Povo, nação, corpo comunitário sociopolítico (Mt 24.7; At 8.9; At 10.22). | 2. No plural (τὰ ἔθνη), as nações gentílicas em contraste com o povo judeu (Mt 28.19; Rm 1.5). | 3. Cristãos convertidos oriundos do meio gentílico (Rm 11.13; Rm 16.4).
THAYER.en: Human group united by ancestral kinship ties, common language, and shared culture. In the plural in the Jewish-Christian context (τὰ ἔθνη), it specifically designates gentiles or pagan peoples in distinction to the chosen people of Israel. 1. People, nation, sociopolitical community body (Mt 24.7; Acts 8.9; Acts 10.22). | 2. In the plural (τὰ ἔθνη), the gentile nations in contrast to the Jewish people (Mt 28.19; Rom 1.5). | 3. Converted Christians originating from a gentile background (Rom 11.13; Rom 16.4).

DEFINITION: Refers to a pattern of behavior established by prolonged use, tradition, or common practice of a group or society.
SENSES: 1. Personal habit or custom of behavior (Heb 10.25; Jn 19.14).
2. Tradition or practice established in a community or culture (Lk 1.9; Acts 28.17).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se a um padrão de comportamento estabelecido pelo uso prolongado, tradição ou prática comum de um grupo ou sociedade. 1. Hábito ou costume pessoal de comportamento (Hb 10.25; Jo 19.14). | 2. Tradição ou prática estabelecida em uma comunidade ou cultura (Lc 1.9; At 28.17).
THAYER.en: Refers to a pattern of behavior established by prolonged use, tradition, or common practice of a group or society. 1. Personal habit or custom of behavior (Heb 10.25; Jn 19.14). | 2. Tradition or practice established in a community or culture (Lk 1.9; Acts 28.17).

SHORT_GLOSS: be accustomed, have as a habit
DEFINITION: To practice something regularly by force of established custom, tradition, or habit.
SENSES: 1. To be accustomed to performing a certain practice or custom (Lk 4.16; Acts 17.2).
USAGE: be accustomed, have as a habit

THAYER.pt: Praticar algo regularmente por força de costume, tradição ou hábito estabelecido. 1. Estar habituado a realizar determinada prática ou costume (Lc 4.16; At 17.2).
THAYER.en: To practice something regularly by force of established custom, tradition, or habit. 1. To be accustomed to performing a certain practice or custom (Lk 4.16; Acts 17.2).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Proclitic conditional conjunction used with indicative or optative mood
DEFINITION: Subordinating conjunction that introduces a conditional clause taken as a real premise, hypothetical supposition, or indirect interrogative clause.
SENSES: 1. Marker of conditional protasis: if (Mt 4.3; Rom 8.31).
2. Causal based on accepted premise: seeing that, since, if indeed (Mt 6.30; Acts 11.17).
3. Introduction of indirect question: whether, to see if (Mk 15.44; Acts 19.2).

THAYER.pt: Conjunção subordinativa que introduz uma oração condicional tomada como premissa real, suposição hipotética ou oração interrogativa indireta. 1. Marcador da prótase condicional: se (Mt 4.3; Rm 8.31). | 2. Causal baseada em premissa aceita: visto que, já que, se é verdade que (Mt 6.30; At 11.17). | 3. Introdução de interrogação indireta: se, para ver se (Mc 15.44; At 19.2).
THAYER.en: Subordinating conjunction that introduces a conditional clause taken as a real premise, hypothetical supposition, or indirect interrogative clause. 1. Marker of conditional protasis: if (Mt 4.3; Rom 8.31). | 2. Causal based on accepted premise: seeing that, since, if indeed (Mt 6.30; Acts 11.17). | 3. Introduction of indirect question: whether, to see if (Mk 15.44; Acts 19.2).

DEFINITION: Indicative verb form expressing the existence or identity of the subject in the second person.
SENSES: 1. To be in a certain condition or identity.

THAYER.pt: Forma verbal indicativa que expressa a existência ou identidade do sujeito na segunda pessoa. 1. Ser ou estar em determinada condição ou identidade.
THAYER.en: Indicative verb form expressing the existence or identity of the subject in the second person. 1. To be in a certain condition or identity.

DEFINITION: Strengthened conditional conjunction that introduces a premise considered true or highly probable.
SENSES: 1. Affirmative condition presuming the reality of the fact ('if indeed', 'seeing that').

THAYER.pt: Conjunção condicional fortalecida que introduz uma premissa considerada verdadeira ou altamente provável. 1. Condição afirmativa que pressupõe a realidade do fato ('se é verdade que', 'visto que').
THAYER.en: Strengthened conditional conjunction that introduces a premise considered true or highly probable. 1. Affirmative condition presuming the reality of the fact ('if indeed', 'seeing that').

DEFINITION: Negative conditional expression used to indicate what will happen if the previous premise is not true.
SENSES: 1. Particle introducing an adverse hypothetical consequence (Mt 6.1; Lk 10.6).

THAYER.pt: Expressão condicional negativa usada para indicar o que acontecerá caso a premissa anterior não seja verdadeira. 1. Partícula introduzindo uma consequência hipotética adversa (Mt 6.1; Lc 10.6).
THAYER.en: Negative conditional expression used to indicate what will happen if the previous premise is not true. 1. Particle introducing an adverse hypothetical consequence (Mt 6.1; Lk 10.6).

DEFINITION: Describes the outer shape, visual form, or aspect under which something or someone presents itself to human perception.
SENSES: 1. The visible form or outer appearance of something (Lk 3.22; 9.29; Jn 5.37).
2. Sight or the act of seeing (2Cor 5.7).

THAYER.pt: Descreve a forma exterior, o formato visual ou o aspecto sob o qual algo ou alguém se apresenta à percepção humana. 1. A forma visível ou a aparência exterior de algo (Lc 3.22; 9.29; Jo 5.37). | 2. Visão ou o ato de ver (2Co 5.7).
THAYER.en: Describes the outer shape, visual form, or aspect under which something or someone presents itself to human perception. 1. The visible form or outer appearance of something (Lk 3.22; 9.29; Jn 5.37). | 2. Sight or the act of seeing (2Cor 5.7).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Perf. with present meaning; inf. εἰδέναι
DEFINITION: Perfect form with present value, cognate with 'to see', expressing consolidated possession of facts, intuitive capacity, or full perception of reality. It is often distinguished by emphasis on the inner and unquestionable possession of knowledge.
SENSES: 1. To know objective facts or be fully informed (Mt 25.13; Jn 9.25).
2. To know intimately a person or have spiritual discernment (Mk 1.34; 1Th 5.12).
3. To know how to do something, be capable of executing (Mt 7.11; Phil 4.12).

THAYER.pt: Forma de perfeito com valor de presente, cognata de 'ver', que expressa posse consolidada de fatos, capacidade intuitiva ou plena percepção da realidade. Distingue-se frequentemente pela ênfase na posse interior e inquestionável do saber. 1. Saber fatos objetivos ou estar plenamente informado (Mt 25.13; Jo 9.25). | 2. Conhecer intimamente uma pessoa ou ter discernimento espiritual (Mc 1.34; 1Ts 5.12). | 3. Saber como fazer algo, ser capaz de executar (Mt 7.11; Fp 4.12).
THAYER.en: Perfect form with present value, cognate with 'to see', expressing consolidated possession of facts, intuitive capacity, or full perception of reality. It is often distinguished by emphasis on the inner and unquestionable possession of knowledge. 1. To know objective facts or be fully informed (Mt 25.13; Jn 9.25). | 2. To know intimately a person or have spiritual discernment (Mk 1.34; 1Th 5.12). | 3. To know how to do something, be capable of executing (Mt 7.11; Phil 4.12).

DEFINITION: Designates a temple or sanctuary dedicated to the worship of pagan images and deities. In the New Testament, it appears in the context of discussions about eating food sacrificed to idols.
SENSES: 1. Place of worship where an idol image is housed (1Cor 8.10).

THAYER.pt: Designa um templo ou santuário dedicado ao culto de imagens e divindades pagãs. No Novo Testamento, aparece no contexto das discussões sobre comer carne sacrificada a ídolos. 1. Lugar de culto onde se abriga uma imagem de ídolo (1Co 8.10).
THAYER.en: Designates a temple or sanctuary dedicated to the worship of pagan images and deities. In the New Testament, it appears in the context of discussions about eating food sacrificed to idols. 1. Place of worship where an idol image is housed (1Cor 8.10).

DEFINITION: Qualifies meat or food that has been offered in sacrifice to a pagan image or deity in an idolatrous context.
SENSES: 1. Food sacrificed to idols (Acts 15.29; 1Cor 8.1).

THAYER.pt: Qualifica carne ou comida que foi oferecida em sacrifício a uma imagem ou divindade pagã em um contexto idolátrico. 1. Alimento sacrificado a ídolos (At 15.29; 1Co 8.1).
THAYER.en: Qualifies meat or food that has been offered in sacrifice to a pagan image or deity in an idolatrous context. 1. Food sacrificed to idols (Acts 15.29; 1Cor 8.1).

DEFINITION: Noun designating the practice of worshiping idols or false gods, severely condemned in the New Testament as incompatible with exclusive devotion to the true God.
SENSES: 1. Worship rendered to images or pagan deities (1Cor 10.14).
2. Excessive attachment to worldly values or riches that usurp God's place (Col 3.5).

THAYER.pt: Substantivo que designa a prática de adorar ídolos ou falsos deuses, sendo severamente condenada no Novo Testamento como incompatível com a devoção exclusiva ao Deus verdadeiro. 1. A adoração prestada a imagens ou divindades pagãs (1Co 10:14). | 2. Apego excessivo a valores ou riquezas mundanas que usurpam o lugar de Deus (Cl 3:5).
THAYER.en: Noun designating the practice of worshiping idols or false gods, severely condemned in the New Testament as incompatible with exclusive devotion to the true God. 1. Worship rendered to images or pagan deities (1Cor 10.14). | 2. Excessive attachment to worldly values or riches that usurp God's place (Col 3.5).

DEFINITION: Person who renders worship, adoration, or devotion to idols or false deities instead of the true God.
SENSES: 1. One who worships images or idols (1Cor 5.10; 10.7).

THAYER.pt: Pessoa que presta culto, adoração ou devoção a ídolos ou falsas divindades em vez do Deus verdadeiro. 1. Aquele que adora imagens ou ídolos (1Co 5:10; 10:7).
THAYER.en: Person who renders worship, adoration, or devotion to idols or false deities instead of the true God. 1. One who worships images or idols (1Cor 5.10; 10.7).

DEFINITION: A sculpted or represented image that serves as an object of religious worship, or the false deity it supposedly represents.
SENSES: 1. Cultic image or representation of a deity (Acts 7.41; 1Cor 12.2).
2. False god or deity without spiritual reality (1Cor 8.4; 1Th 1.9).

THAYER.pt: Uma imagem esculpida ou representada que serve como objeto de adoração religiosa, ou a divindade falsa que ela supostamente representa. 1. Imagem ou representação cultual de uma divindade (At 7.41; 1Co 12.2). | 2. Falso deus ou divindade sem realidade espiritual (1Co 8.4; 1Ts 1.9).
THAYER.en: A sculpted or represented image that serves as an object of religious worship, or the false deity it supposedly represents. 1. Cultic image or representation of a deity (Acts 7.41; 1Cor 12.2). | 2. False god or deity without spiritual reality (1Cor 8.4; 1Th 1.9).

DEFINITION: Optative mood of the verb to be, expressing possibility, desire, or eventuality.
SENSES: 1. Form of desire or possibility for the verb to exist.

THAYER.pt: Modo optativo do verbo ser, expressando possibilidade, desejo ou eventualidade. 1. Forma de desejo ou possibilidade para o verbo existir.
THAYER.en: Optative mood of the verb to be, expressing possibility, desire, or eventuality. 1. Form of desire or possibility for the verb to exist.

DEFINITION: Concessive conjunctive locution that introduces a real or supposed circumstance that contrasts with the main one.
SENSES: 1. Expresses concession or moderate opposition ('even though', 'even if').

THAYER.pt: Locução conjuntiva concessiva que introduz uma circunstância real ou suposta que contrasta com a principal. 1. Expressa concessão ou oposição moderada ('ainda que', 'mesmo se').
THAYER.en: Concessive conjunctive locution that introduces a real or supposed circumstance that contrasts with the main one. 1. Expresses concession or moderate opposition ('even though', 'even if').

DEFINITION: Indicates the absence of a legitimate cause, purpose, success, or adequate reflection in an action.
SENSES: 1. Without cause or justified reason (Col 2.18).
2. In vain, without achieving any result (Gal 3.4).

THAYER.pt: Indica a ausência de uma causa legítima, de propósito, de sucesso ou de reflexão adequada em uma ação. 1. Sem causa ou motivo justificado (Cl 2:18). | 2. Em vão, sem alcançar nenhum resultado (Gl 3:4).
THAYER.en: Indicates the absence of a legitimate cause, purpose, success, or adequate reflection in an action. 1. Without cause or justified reason (Col 2.18). | 2. In vain, without achieving any result (Gal 3.4).

DEFINITION: Cardinal numeral representing the exact quantity of twenty units.
SENSES: 1. The cardinal number twenty (Lk 14:31; Acts 1:15; 27:28).

THAYER.pt: Numeral cardinal que representa a quantidade exata de vinte unidades. 1. O número cardinal vinte (Lc 14.31; At 1.15; 27.28).
THAYER.en: Cardinal numeral representing the exact quantity of twenty units. 1. The cardinal number twenty (Lk 14:31; Acts 1:15; 27:28).

DEFINITION: To bow before a force, authority, or argument, yielding or giving up a position.
SENSES: 1. To yield or submit to the pressure or demand of others (Gal 2:5).

THAYER.pt: Significa curvar-se diante de uma força, autoridade ou argumento, cedendo ou desistindo de uma posição. 1. Ceder ou submeter-se à pressão ou exigência de outros (Gl 2.5).
THAYER.en: To bow before a force, authority, or argument, yielding or giving up a position. 1. To yield or submit to the pressure or demand of others (Gal 2:5).

DEFINITION: A verb expressing visual or conceptual similarity; to be like something or to appear as such.
SENSES: 1. To resemble or appear like something (James 1:6).

THAYER.pt: Verbo que expressa semelhança visual ou conceitual; assemelhar-se a algo ou parecer-se com. 1. Assemelhar-se ou parecer-se com algo (Tg 1.6).
THAYER.en: A verb expressing visual or conceptual similarity; to be like something or to appear as such. 1. To resemble or appear like something (James 1:6).

DEFINITION: A visual representation or reflection that resembles an original. In the NT, it denotes both minted images and the human being created in the image of God, and Christ as the perfect divine image.
SENSES: 1. A visual image, representation, or portrait (Matt 22:20; Rev 13:14).
2. The essential likeness or living reflection of someone (1 Cor 11:7; Col 1:15).

THAYER.pt: Representação visual ou reflexo que se assemelha a um original. No NT, denota tanto imagens cunhadas quanto o ser humano criado à imagem de Deus e Cristo como a perfeita imagem divina. 1. Uma imagem, representação ou retrato visual (Mt 22.20; Ap 13.14). | 2. A semelhança essencial ou reflexo vivo de alguém (1Co 11.7; Cl 1.15).
THAYER.en: A visual representation or reflection that resembles an original. In the NT, it denotes both minted images and the human being created in the image of God, and Christ as the perfect divine image. 1. A visual image, representation, or portrait (Matt 22:20; Rev 13:14). | 2. The essential likeness or living reflection of someone (1 Cor 11:7; Col 1:15).

DEFINITION: The quality of being pure in motivation, free from ulterior motives, falsehood, or hypocrisy.
SENSES: 1. Sincerity and purity of motives in Christian conduct (1 Cor 5:8; 2 Cor 1:12; 2 Cor 2:17).

THAYER.pt: Qualidade de ser puro em motivações, isento de segundas intenções, falsidade ou hipocrisia. 1. Sinceridade e pureza de motivos na conduta cristã (1Co 5.8; 2Co 1.12; 2Co 2.17).
THAYER.en: The quality of being pure in motivation, free from ulterior motives, falsehood, or hypocrisy. 1. Sincerity and purity of motives in Christian conduct (1 Cor 5:8; 2 Cor 1:12; 2 Cor 2:17).

DEFINITION: Describes something that has been tested in the sunlight and found pure, without falsehood, ulterior motives, or moral impurities.
SENSES: 1. Sincere and pure, without falsehood or impure motivation (Phil 1:10; 2 Pet 3:1).

THAYER.pt: Descreve algo que foi testado à luz do sol e encontrado puro, sem falsidade, segundas intenções ou impurezas morais. 1. Sincere e puro, sem falsidade ou motivação impura (Fp 1.10; 2Pe 3.1).
THAYER.en: Describes something that has been tested in the sunlight and found pure, without falsehood, ulterior motives, or moral impurities. 1. Sincere and pure, without falsehood or impure motivation (Phil 1:10; 2 Pet 3:1).

DEFINITION: To move in circles, to roll up or fold something, frequently used in the context of parchment scrolls.
SENSES: 1. To roll up or gather something into a cylindrical shape.

THAYER.pt: Mover em círculos, enrolar ou dobrar algo, frequentemente usado no contexto de rolos de pergaminho. 1. Enrolar ou recolher algo em forma cilíndrica.
THAYER.en: To move in circles, to roll up or fold something, frequently used in the context of parchment scrolls. 1. To roll up or gather something into a cylindrical shape.

DEFINITION: A conjunctive phrase that establishes a restriction, limitation, or exception to a previous statement.
SENSES: 1. Introduces a restriction or exception ('unless', 'except').

THAYER.pt: Locução conjuntiva que estabelece uma restrição, limitação ou exceção a uma afirmação anterior. 1. Introduz uma restrição ou exceção ('a não ser que', 'exceto').
THAYER.en: A conjunctive phrase that establishes a restriction, limitation, or exception to a previous statement. 1. Introduces a restriction or exception ('unless', 'except').

DEFINITION: A restrictive conditional expression that introduces a strong reservation to an assertion.
SENSES: 1. Conditional exception softened ('unless perhaps').

THAYER.pt: Expressão condicional restritiva que introduz uma forte reserva a uma asserção. 1. Exceção condicional suavizada ('a menos que por acaso').
THAYER.en: A restrictive conditional expression that introduces a strong reservation to an assertion. 1. Conditional exception softened ('unless perhaps').

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: ἔσομαι, Impf: ἤμην, Inf: εἶναι, Part: ὤν, οὖσα, ὄν
DEFINITION: The fundamental verb of being and existence in Greek. It serves to assign predicates, express ontological subsistence, or act in the formation of periphrastic tenses.
SENSES: 1. Copula verb, expressing state or quality of being (Matt 16:16; 1 John 4:8).
2. To exist in an absolute, enduring way or to subsist (John 1:1; Heb 11:6).
3. Static location ('to be in') (Matt 2:13; John 1:48).

THAYER.pt: Verbo de ligação e de existência fundamental no grego. Serve para atribuir predicativos, expressar subsistência ontológica ou atuar na formação de tempos perifrásticos. 1. Verbo de ligação cópula, expressando estado ou qualidade de ser (Mt 16.16; 1Jo 4.8). | 2. Existir de modo absoluto, duradouro ou subsistir (Jo 1.1; Hb 11.6). | 3. Localização estática ('estar em') (Mt 2.13; Jo 1.48).
THAYER.en: The fundamental verb of being and existence in Greek. It serves to assign predicates, express ontological subsistence, or act in the formation of periphrastic tenses. 1. Copula verb, expressing state or quality of being (Matt 16:16; 1 John 4:8). | 2. To exist in an absolute, enduring way or to subsist (John 1:1; Heb 11:6). | 3. Static location ('to be in') (Matt 2:13; John 1:48).

DEFINITION: Infinitive of the fundamental substantive verb, indicating existence, state, or identity.
SENSES: 1. To exist or possess a certain quality or state.

THAYER.pt: Infinitivo do verbo substantivo fundamental, indicando existência, estado ou identidade. 1. Existir ou possuir determinada qualidade ou estado.
THAYER.en: Infinitive of the fundamental substantive verb, indicating existence, state, or identity. 1. To exist or possess a certain quality or state.

SHORT_GLOSS: if indeed, since, if at all
DEFINITION: An emphatic conditional particle that expresses the premise that something is true, frequently equivalent to 'since' or 'if it is true that'.
SENSES: 1. Emphatic marker of condition or valid assumption.
USAGE: if indeed, since, if at all

THAYER.pt: Partícula condicional enfática que expressa a premissa de que algo é verdadeiro, frequentemente equivalendo a 'visto que' ou 'se é verdade que'. 1. Marcador enfático de condição ou suposição válida.
THAYER.en: An emphatic conditional particle that expresses the premise that something is true, frequently equivalent to 'since' or 'if it is true that'. 1. Emphatic marker of condition or valid assumption.

DEFINITION: A conditional adverbial phrase that expresses hope or an uncertain attempt to reach a goal.
SENSES: 1. Expresses an uncertain conditional expectation ('if perhaps', 'if somehow').

THAYER.pt: Locução adverbial condicional que expressa esperança ou tentativa incerta de alcançar um objetivo. 1. Expressa uma expectativa condicional incerta ('se porventura', 'se de algum modo').
THAYER.en: A conditional adverbial phrase that expresses hope or an uncertain attempt to reach a goal. 1. Expresses an uncertain conditional expectation ('if perhaps', 'if somehow').

DEFINITION: A verb meaning to maintain or seek peace in interpersonal relationships, acting in a way to avoid conflict and promote harmony.
SENSES: 1. To strive to live in harmony with others (Rom 12:18).
2. To maintain peace in the context of the Christian community (Mark 9:50).

THAYER.pt: Verbo que significa manter ou buscar a paz nos relacionamentos interpessoais, agindo de maneira a evitar conflitos e promover a harmonia. 1. Esforçar-se para viver em harmonia com os outros (Rm 12:18). | 2. Manter a paz no contexto da comunidade cristã (Mc 9:50).
THAYER.en: A verb meaning to maintain or seek peace in interpersonal relationships, acting in a way to avoid conflict and promote harmony. 1. To strive to live in harmony with others (Rom 12:18). | 2. To maintain peace in the context of the Christian community (Mark 9:50).

DEFINITION: Harmony and absence of hostility between individuals or peoples. In the New Testament context, it inherits the full meaning of the Hebrew 'shalom', denoting reconciliation with God, inner integrity, and full messianic blessing.
SENSES: 1. Absence of war and political or social harmony (Luke 14:32; Acts 12:20).
2. Inner peace and spiritual serenity under divine grace (John 14:27; Rom 15:13; Phil 4:7).
3. Reconciliation and salvific state granted by Christ between God and man (Rom 5:1; Eph 2:14-17).

THAYER.pt: Harmonia e ausência de hostilidade entre indivíduos ou povos. No contexto neotestamentário herda o sentido pleno do hebraico 'shalom', denotando a reconciliação com Deus, integridade interior e bênção messiânica plena. 1. Ausência de guerra e harmonia política ou social (Lc 14.32; At 12.20). | 2. Paz interior e serenidade espiritual sob a graça divina (Jo 14.27; Rm 15.13; Fp 4.7). | 3. Reconciliação e estado salvífico concedido por Cristo entre Deus e o homem (Rm 5.1; Ef 2.14-17).
THAYER.en: Harmony and absence of hostility between individuals or peoples. In the New Testament context, it inherits the full meaning of the Hebrew 'shalom', denoting reconciliation with God, inner integrity, and full messianic blessing. 1. Absence of war and political or social harmony (Luke 14:32; Acts 12:20). | 2. Inner peace and spiritual serenity under divine grace (John 14:27; Rom 15:13; Phil 4:7). | 3. Reconciliation and salvific state granted by Christ between God and man (Rom 5:1; Eph 2:14-17).

DEFINITION: That which promotes peace, harmony, and cordial relationships, avoiding conflicts and contentions.
SENSES: 1. Characterized by peace and conducive to harmony (James 3:17; Heb 12:11).

THAYER.pt: Que promove a paz, a harmonia e relações cordiais, evitando conflitos e contendas. 1. Caracterizado pela paz e propício à harmonia (Tg 3.17; Hb 12.11).
THAYER.en: That which promotes peace, harmony, and cordial relationships, avoiding conflicts and contentions. 1. Characterized by peace and conducive to harmony (James 3:17; Heb 12:11).

DEFINITION: The act of establishing a harmonious and correct relationship, promoting peace and reconciliation between previously divided parties.
SENSES: 1. To cause a state of peace and definitive reconciliation, such as Christ's work on the cross (Col 1:20).

THAYER.pt: Ato de estabelecer um relacionamento harmonioso e correto, promovendo a paz e a reconciliação entre partes antes divididas. 1. Causar um estado de paz e reconciliação definitiva, como a obra de Cristo na cruz (Cl 1.20).
THAYER.en: The act of establishing a harmonious and correct relationship, promoting peace and reconciliation between previously divided parties. 1. To cause a state of peace and definitive reconciliation, such as Christ's work on the cross (Col 1:20).

DEFINITION: Attribute of one who actively strives to restore harmony and resolve conflicts between people.
SENSES: 1. One who works for peace and reconciliation (Matt 5:9).

THAYER.pt: Atributo daquele que se empenha ativamente em restaurar a harmonia e resolver conflitos entre pessoas. 1. Aquele que trabalha pela paz e reconciliação (Mt 5.9).
THAYER.en: Attribute of one who actively strives to restore harmony and resolve conflicts between people. 1. One who works for peace and reconciliation (Matt 5:9).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Preposition governing only the accusative case
DEFINITION: A preposition that expresses movement, direction, and penetration into the interior of a spatial or temporal limit. By extension, it indicates goal, purpose, result, and personal or faith relationships.
SENSES: 1. Spatial: movement toward or penetration into a place ('into', 'to', 'toward') (Matt 2:13; John 2:12).
2. Finality, purpose, or result ('for', 'with a view to') (Matt 26:28; Rom 1:16).
3. Object of faith, trust, and loyalty ('to believe in') (John 3:16; Acts 16:31).

THAYER.pt: Preposição que expressa movimento, direção e penetração para o interior de um limite espacial ou temporal. Por extensão, indica meta, propósito, resultado e relacionamento pessoal ou de fé. 1. Espacial: movimento em direção a ou penetração em um lugar ('para dentro de', 'a', 'para') (Mt 2.13; Jo 2.12). | 2. Finalidade, propósito ou resultado ('para', 'com vistas a') (Mt 26.28; Rm 1.16). | 3. Objeto de fé, confiança e lealdade ('crer em') (Jo 3.16; At 16.31).
THAYER.en: A preposition that expresses movement, direction, and penetration into the interior of a spatial or temporal limit. By extension, it indicates goal, purpose, result, and personal or faith relationships. 1. Spatial: movement toward or penetration into a place ('into', 'to', 'toward') (Matt 2:13; John 2:12). | 2. Finality, purpose, or result ('for', 'with a view to') (Matt 26:28; Rom 1:16). | 3. Object of faith, trust, and loyalty ('to believe in') (John 3:16; Acts 16:31).

DEFINITION: Cardinal numeral indicating an individual unit in contrast to plurality. Frequently expresses qualitative uniqueness, exclusivity, or indissoluble union between parts.
SENSES: 1. Singular quantitative: 'one single' as opposed to many (Mt 5:41; 19:5).
2. Uniqueness of God or of Christ (Mk 12:29; 1Tim 2:5).
3. Community unity or unity of purpose among people (Jn 17:21; Gal 3:28).

THAYER.pt: Numeral cardinal que indica uma unidade individual em contraste com a pluralidade. Frequentemente expressa unicidade qualitativa, exclusividade ou união indissolúvel entre partes. 1. Quantitativo singular: 'um só' em oposição a muitos (Mt 5.41; 19.5). | 2. Unicidade de Deus ou de Cristo (Mc 12.29; 1Tm 2.5). | 3. Unidade comunitária ou de propósito entre pessoas (Jo 17.21; Gl 3.28).
THAYER.en: Cardinal numeral indicating an individual unit in contrast to plurality. Frequently expresses qualitative uniqueness, exclusivity, or indissoluble union between parts. 1. Singular quantitative: 'one single' as opposed to many (Mt 5:41; 19:5). | 2. Uniqueness of God or of Christ (Mk 12:29; 1Tim 2:5). | 3. Community unity or unity of purpose among people (Jn 17:21; Gal 3:28).

DEFINITION: To lead, guide, or bring someone or something inside a specific place or enclosure.
SENSES: 1. Physically leading someone into a house or enclosure (John 18:16; Acts 9:8).
2. Introducing the Firstborn into the inhabited world, in an eschatological context (Heb 1:6).

THAYER.pt: Significa conduzir, guiar ou trazer alguém ou algo para dentro de um determinado lugar ou recinto. 1. Conduzir fisicamente alguém para dentro de uma casa ou recinto (Jo 18:16; At 9:8). | 2. Introduzir o Primogênito no mundo habitado, em contexto escatológico (Hb 1:6).
THAYER.en: To lead, guide, or bring someone or something inside a specific place or enclosure. 1. Physically leading someone into a house or enclosure (John 18:16; Acts 9:8). | 2. Introducing the Firstborn into the inhabited world, in an eschatological context (Heb 1:6).

DEFINITION: To listen attentively with the implication of responding favorably, answering a request, or obeying an instruction.
SENSES: 1. To answer a supplication or hear a prayer with a favorable response (Luke 1:13; Acts 10:31).
2. To obey based on attentive listening (1 Cor 14:21).

THAYER.pt: Significa escutar com atenção e com a implicação de responder favoravelmente, atender a um pedido ou obedecer a uma instrução. 1. Atender a uma súplica ou ouvir uma oração com resposta favorável (Lc 1.13; At 10.31). | 2. Obedecer com base em escutar atentamente (1Co 14.21).
THAYER.en: To listen attentively with the implication of responding favorably, answering a request, or obeying an instruction. 1. To answer a supplication or hear a prayer with a favorable response (Luke 1:13; Acts 10:31). | 2. To obey based on attentive listening (1 Cor 14:21).

DEFINITION: To receive someone with warmth, kindness, and open arms into one's presence or community.
SENSES: 1. To graciously welcome or accept with benevolence (2 Cor 6:17).

THAYER.pt: Receber alguém com cordialidade, bondade e de braços abertos na própria presença ou comunidade. 1. Acolher graciosamente ou aceitar com benevolência (2Co 6.17).
THAYER.en: To receive someone with warmth, kindness, and open arms into one's presence or community. 1. To graciously welcome or accept with benevolence (2 Cor 6:17).

DEFINITION: A verbal compound indicating the physical movement of transition into the interior of a delimited space, such as a building or enclosure.
SENSES: 1. To enter a physical place or enclosure (Acts 3:3; Acts 21:18).

THAYER.pt: Composto verbal que indica o movimento físico de transição para o interior de um espaço delimitado, como um edifício ou recinto. 1. Entrar em um lugar ou recinto físico (At 3:3; At 21:18).
THAYER.en: A verbal compound indicating the physical movement of transition into the interior of a delimited space, such as a building or enclosure. 1. To enter a physical place or enclosure (Acts 3:3; Acts 21:18).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: εἰσελεύσομαι, Aor: εἰσῆλθον, Perf: εἰσελήλυθα
DEFINITION: Indicates physical displacement into the interior of a two-dimensional or three-dimensional space (house, city, tomb). Metaphorically, denotes someone's participation in a spiritual state, experience, or eschatological reality.
SENSES: 1. To physically enter a place, house, or territory (Matt 8:5; Heb 9:12).
2. To spiritually enter a divine condition or kingdom (Matt 5:20; Matt 18:8; Heb 4:1).
3. To arise or penetrate into the world of human experience (Rom 5:12).

THAYER.pt: Indica deslocamento físico para o interior de um espaço bidimensional ou tridimensional (casa, cidade, túmulo). Metaforicamente, denota a participação de alguém em um estado espiritual, experiência ou realidade escatológica. 1. Entrar fisicamente em um lugar, casa ou território (Mt 8.5; Hb 9.12). | 2. Ingressar espiritualmente em uma condição ou reino divino (Mt 5.20; Mt 18.8; Hb 4.1). | 3. Surgir ou penetrar no mundo da experiência humana (Rm 5.12).
THAYER.en: Indicates physical displacement into the interior of a two-dimensional or three-dimensional space (house, city, tomb). Metaphorically, denotes someone's participation in a spiritual state, experience, or eschatological reality. 1. To physically enter a place, house, or territory (Matt 8:5; Heb 9:12). | 2. To spiritually enter a divine condition or kingdom (Matt 5:20; Matt 18:8; Heb 4:1). | 3. To arise or penetrate into the world of human experience (Rom 5:12).

DEFINITION: The third-person plural form of the verb 'to be' in the present indicative.
SENSES: 1. Indicating existence or the state of multiple persons or things (Matt 24:5).

THAYER.pt: Forma da terceira pessoa do plural do verbo 'ser' ou 'estar' no presente do indicativo. 1. Indicar existência ou estado de múltiplas pessoas ou coisas (Mt 24.5).
THAYER.en: The third-person plural form of the verb 'to be' in the present indicative. 1. Indicating existence or the state of multiple persons or things (Matt 24:5).

DEFINITION: Cardinal numeral denoting basic quantitative unity or absolute singularity of a being or object.
SENSES: 1. A single one in contrast to multiple (Mt 5:41).
2. One only, exclusive or identical (Mt 21:24).

THAYER.pt: Numeral cardinal que denota a unidade quantitativa básica ou singularidade absoluta de um ser ou objeto. 1. Um único em contraste com múltiplos (Mt 5.41). | 2. Um só, exclusivo ou idêntico (Mt 21.24).
THAYER.en: Cardinal numeral denoting basic quantitative unity or absolute singularity of a being or object. 1. A single one in contrast to multiple (Mt 5:41). | 2. One only, exclusive or identical (Mt 21:24).

DEFINITION: To formally invite a person to enter a house or enclosure as a guest or visitor.
SENSES: 1. To invite to enter (Acts 10:23).

THAYER.pt: Convidar formalmente uma pessoa a entrar em uma casa ou recinto como hóspede ou visitante. 1. Convidar para entrar (At 10.23).
THAYER.en: To formally invite a person to enter a house or enclosure as a guest or visitor. 1. To invite to enter (Acts 10:23).

DEFINITION: Designates the act or place of entering, arrival at a destination, or the favorable reception granted to someone.
SENSES: 1. The act of arriving at or having access to a place or state (Heb 10:19; 2 Pet 1:11).
2. The warm reception or acceptance granted to someone (1 Thess 1:9).

THAYER.pt: Designa o ato ou o lugar de entrar, a chegada a um destino ou a recepção favorável concedida a alguém. 1. O ato de chegar ou ter acesso a um local ou estado (Hb 10.19; 2Pe 1.11). | 2. A recepção ou aceitação calorosa concedida a alguém (1Ts 1.9).
THAYER.en: Designates the act or place of entering, arrival at a destination, or the favorable reception granted to someone. 1. The act of arriving at or having access to a place or state (Heb 10:19; 2 Pet 1:11). | 2. The warm reception or acceptance granted to someone (1 Thess 1:9).

DEFINITION: Indicates a rapid and impetuous movement into the interior of a place.
SENSES: 1. To run or leap precipitously into an environment (Acts 16:29).

THAYER.pt: Indica um movimento rápido e impetuoso para o interior de um lugar. 1. Correr ou saltar precipitadamente para dentro de um ambiente (At 16.29).
THAYER.en: Indicates a rapid and impetuous movement into the interior of a place. 1. To run or leap precipitously into an environment (Acts 16:29).

DEFINITION: The act of moving into the interior of a delimited space, such as a city, house, or enclosure.
SENSES: 1. To enter a place or enclosure (Mk 1:21; Lk 8:16).

THAYER.pt: O ato de mover-se para o interior de um espaço delimitado, como uma cidade, casa ou recinto. 1. Entrar em um lugar ou recinto (Mc 1.21; Lc 8.16).
THAYER.en: The act of moving into the interior of a delimited space, such as a city, house, or enclosure. 1. To enter a place or enclosure (Mk 1:21; Lk 8:16).

DEFINITION: To move rapidly into the interior of a physical space.
SENSES: 1. To run into an environment (Ac 12:14).

THAYER.pt: Movimentar-se rapidamente para o interior de um espaço físico. 1. Entrar correndo em um ambiente (At 12.14).
THAYER.en: To move rapidly into the interior of a physical space. 1. To run into an environment (Ac 12:14).

DEFINITION: To carry or lead something physically into the interior of a space, or to bring a concept to someone's knowledge.
SENSES: 1. To carry or take something into a place (Lk 5:19; 1Tm 6:7).
2. To lead into a situation or subject to a condition (Mt 6:13; Ac 17:20).

THAYER.pt: Carregar ou conduzir algo fisicamente para o interior de um espaço, ou trazer um conceito ao conhecimento de alguém. 1. Levar ou carregar algo para dentro de um lugar (Lc 5.19; 1Tm 6.7). | 2. Conduzir a uma situação ou submeter a uma condição (Mt 6.13; At 17.20).
THAYER.en: To carry or lead something physically into the interior of a space, or to bring a concept to someone's knowledge. 1. To carry or take something into a place (Lk 5:19; 1Tm 6:7). | 2. To lead into a situation or subject to a condition (Mt 6:13; Ac 17:20).

DEFINITION: An adverb denoting immediate chronological succession or logical transition to add a new point to an argument.
SENSES: 1. Next in the order of time, then, afterwards (Mk 4:17; 1Tm 2:13); 2. Marker of addition or logical transition, besides (Heb 12:9).

THAYER.pt: Advérbio que denota sucessão cronológica imediata ou transição lógica para acrescentar um novo ponto a um argumento. 1. Em seguida na ordem do tempo, então, depois (Mc 4.17; 1Tm 2.13); 2. Marcador de adição ou transição lógica, além disso (Hb 12.9).
THAYER.en: An adverb denoting immediate chronological succession or logical transition to add a new point to an argument. 1. Next in the order of time, then, afterwards (Mk 4:17; 1Tm 2:13); 2. Marker of addition or logical transition, besides (Heb 12:9).

DEFINITION: A coordinating conjunction used to introduce equivalent alternatives, often appearing in correlative pairs to indicate mutual inclusion of possibilities.
SENSES: 1. Introduces equivalent alternatives in a conditional or disjunctive structure, translated by 'whether... or' or 'either... or'.

THAYER.pt: Conjunção coordenativa usada para introduzir alternativas equivalentes, frequentemente aparecendo em pares correlativos para indicar inclusão mútua de possibilidades. 1. Introduz alternativas equivalentes em uma estrutura condicional ou disjuntiva, traduzido por 'quer... quer' ou 'seja... seja'.
THAYER.en: A coordinating conjunction used to introduce equivalent alternatives, often appearing in correlative pairs to indicate mutual inclusion of possibilities. 1. Introduces equivalent alternatives in a conditional or disjunctive structure, translated by 'whether... or' or 'either... or'.

DEFINITION: A conditional indefinite pronominal locution referring to any potential person.
SENSES: 1. Generic conditional applied to persons ('if anyone', 'if someone').

THAYER.pt: Locução pronominal indefinida condicional que se refere a qualquer pessoa em potencial. 1. Condicional genérica aplicada a pessoas ('se alguém', 'caso alguém').
THAYER.en: A conditional indefinite pronominal locution referring to any potential person. 1. Generic conditional applied to persons ('if anyone', 'if someone').

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Form ἐξ before vowels; governs only the genitive case
DEFINITION: A preposition denoting departure from the interior of something, pointing to the source, material, ethnic, or causal provenance. It plays a vital role in Pauline theology of justification by faith.
SENSES: 1. Spatial: exit or movement from the interior ('out of', 'away from') (Mt 2:15; Mk 1:25).
2. Origin, genealogical lineage, or provenance ('from', 'descended from') (Mt 1:3; Rom 1:3).
3. Cause, basis, foundation, or means ('by faith', 'from') (Rom 1:17; Gal 2:16).

THAYER.pt: Preposição que denota afastamento a partir do interior de algo, apontando para a fonte, procedência material, étnica ou causal. Desempenha papel vital na teologia paulina da justificação pela fé. 1. Espacial: saída ou movimento a partir do interior ('de dentro de', 'fora de') (Mt 2.15; Mc 1.25). | 2. Origem, linhagem genealógica ou proveniência ('de', 'oriundo de') (Mt 1.3; Rm 1.3). | 3. Causa, base, fundamento ou meio ('pela fé', 'a partir de') (Rm 1.17; Gl 2.16).
THAYER.en: A preposition denoting departure from the interior of something, pointing to the source, material, ethnic, or causal provenance. It plays a vital role in Pauline theology of justification by faith. 1. Spatial: exit or movement from the interior ('out of', 'away from') (Mt 2:15; Mk 1:25). | 2. Origin, genealogical lineage, or provenance ('from', 'descended from') (Mt 1:3; Rom 1:3). | 3. Cause, basis, foundation, or means ('by faith', 'from') (Rom 1:17; Gal 2:16).

DEFINITION: A distributive pronoun-adjective that individualizes each constituent member of a collectivity or totality, conferring personal responsibility.
SENSES: 1. Adjectival use: each, every (Lk 6:44; Jn 19:23; Heb 3:13).
2. Substantival use: each one, each person individually (Mt 25:15; Rom 14:12; 1Co 3:8).

THAYER.pt: Pronome-adjetivo distributivo que individualiza cada membro constituinte de uma coletividade ou totalidade, conferindo responsabilidade pessoal. 1. Uso adjetival: cada, todo (Lk 6.44; Jo 19.23; Hb 3.13). | 2. Uso substantivado: cada um, cada pessoa individualmente (Mt 25.15; Rm 14.12; 1Co 3.8).
THAYER.en: A distributive pronoun-adjective that individualizes each constituent member of a collectivity or totality, conferring personal responsibility. 1. Adjectival use: each, every (Lk 6:44; Jn 19:23; Heb 3:13). | 2. Substantival use: each one, each person individually (Mt 25:15; Rom 14:12; 1Co 3:8).

DEFINITION: Indicates continuous frequency or occurrence on all possible occasions over time.
SENSES: 1. On every occasion or at any necessary moment (2Pe 1:15).

THAYER.pt: Indica frequência contínua ou ocorrência em todas as ocasiões possíveis ao longo do tempo. 1. Em toda ocasião ou a qualquer momento necessário (2Pe 1.15).
THAYER.en: Indicates continuous frequency or occurrence on all possible occasions over time. 1. On every occasion or at any necessary moment (2Pe 1:15).

DEFINITION: A cardinal numeral representing the exact or round quantity of one hundred. It is used in various parables and narrative accounts in the Gospels and Revelation.
SENSES: 1. The exact or approximate number of one hundred units (Mt 13:8; Lk 16:6; Rev 7:4).

THAYER.pt: Numeral cardinal que representa a quantidade exata ou redonda de cem. É utilizado em várias parábolas e relatos narrativos nos Evangelhos e no Apocalipse. 1. O número exato ou aproximado de cem unidades (Mt 13.8; Lc 16.6; Ap 7.4).
THAYER.en: A cardinal numeral representing the exact or round quantity of one hundred. It is used in various parables and narrative accounts in the Gospels and Revelation. 1. The exact or approximate number of one hundred units (Mt 13:8; Lk 16:6; Rev 7:4).

DEFINITION: Possessing the exact duration or age of one hundred years.
SENSES: 1. Pertaining to the age of approximately one hundred years (Rom 4:19).

THAYER.pt: Que possui a duração ou a idade exata de cem anos. 1. Referente à idade de aproximadamente cem anos (Rm 4.19).
THAYER.en: Possessing the exact duration or age of one hundred years. 1. Pertaining to the age of approximately one hundred years (Rom 4:19).

DEFINITION: Denotes a quantity multiplied by one hundred in relation to a reference point.
SENSES: 1. A hundred times more in quantity or value (Mt 19:29).

THAYER.pt: Denota uma quantidade que é multiplicada por cem em relação a um ponto de referência. 1. Cem vezes mais em quantidade ou valor (Mt 19.29).
THAYER.en: Denotes a quantity multiplied by one hundred in relation to a reference point. 1. A hundred times more in quantity or value (Mt 19:29).

DEFINITION: A Roman military officer in direct command of a century, equivalent to about a hundred soldiers.
SENSES: 1. A Roman army officer in command of approximately one hundred men (Mt 8:13; Ac 10:1).

THAYER.pt: Oficial militar romano encarregado do comando direto de uma centúria, equivalente a cerca de cem soldados. 1. Oficial do exército romano no comando de aproximadamente cem homens (Mt 8.13; At 10.1).
THAYER.en: A Roman military officer in direct command of a century, equivalent to about a hundred soldiers. 1. A Roman army officer in command of approximately one hundred men (Mt 8:13; Ac 10:1).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: ἐκβαλῶ, Aor2: ἐξέβαλον, Perf: ἐκβέβληκα
SHORT_GLOSS: cast out, send out, drive out
DEFINITION: To force out or throw out; a technical term in the Gospels for the expulsion of demons, as well as designating the intentional sending out of workers.
SENSES: 1. To cast out demons or unclean spirits by the royal authority of Jesus (Mt 8:16; Mk 1:34).
2. To expel or banish someone from a community, temple, or city (Mt 21:12; Jn 9:34).
3. To take out or pull out something from a place (Mt 7:4-5).
4. To send out with an urgent purpose (Mt 9:38; Mk 1:12).
USAGE: cast out, send out, drive out

THAYER.pt: Fazer sair forçosamente ou atirar para fora; termo técnico nos Evangelhos para a expulsão de demônios, além de designar o envio intencional de trabalhadores. 1. Expulsar demônios ou espíritos imundos pela autoridade régia de Jesus (Mt 8.16; Mc 1.34). | 2. Expulsar ou banir alguém de uma comunidade, templo ou cidade (Mt 21.12; Jo 9.34). | 3. Tirar ou arrancar algo de um lugar (Mt 7.4-5). | 4. Enviar para fora com propósito urgente (Mt 9.38; Mc 1.12).
THAYER.en: To force out or throw out; a technical term in the Gospels for the expulsion of demons, as well as designating the intentional sending out of workers. 1. To cast out demons or unclean spirits by the royal authority of Jesus (Mt 8:16; Mk 1:34). | 2. To expel or banish someone from a community, temple, or city (Mt 21:12; Jn 9:34). | 3. To take out or pull out something from a place (Mt 7:4-5). | 4. To send out with an urgent purpose (Mt 9:38; Mk 1:12).

DEFINITION: Refers to the final point of a period, the result of an event, or a means of escaping a difficulty.
SENSES: 1. The outcome or end of a way of life (Heb 13:7).
2. A means of escape or way out for a difficult situation (1Co 10:13).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se ao ponto final de um período, ao resultado de um evento ou a um meio de escapar de uma dificuldade. 1. O desfecho ou término de uma conduta de vida (Hb 13.7). | 2. Um meio de escape ou saída para uma situação difícil (1Co 10.13).
THAYER.en: Refers to the final point of a period, the result of an event, or a means of escaping a difficulty. 1. The outcome or end of a way of life (Heb 13:7). | 2. A means of escape or way out for a difficult situation (1Co 10:13).

DEFINITION: A nautical term describing the act of throwing a ship's cargo into the sea to save it during a severe storm.
SENSES: 1. The act of throwing the ship's cargo into the sea (Ac 27:18).

THAYER.pt: Termo náutico que descreve o ato de lançar ao mar a carga de uma embarcação para salvá-la durante uma tempestade severa. 1. O ato de jogar a carga do navio ao mar (At 27.18).
THAYER.en: A nautical term describing the act of throwing a ship's cargo into the sea to save it during a severe storm. 1. The act of throwing the ship's cargo into the sea (Ac 27:18).

DEFINITION: The act of giving a daughter or woman in marriage, arranging her wedding.
SENSES: 1. To give in marriage or hand over for matrimonial union (Mt 24:38).

THAYER.pt: Ato de dar uma filha ou mulher em matrimônio, arranjando o seu casamento. 1. Dar em casamento ou entregar para a união matrimonial (Mt 24.38).
THAYER.en: The act of giving a daughter or woman in marriage, arranging her wedding. 1. To give in marriage or hand over for matrimonial union (Mt 24:38).

DEFINITION: A late or intensive variant of ἐκγαμίζω, meaning to give in matrimony.
SENSES: 1. To promote or grant the marriage of another.

THAYER.pt: Variante tardia ou intensiva de ἐκγαμίζω, significando dar em matrimônio. 1. Promover ou conceder o casamento de outrem.
THAYER.en: A late or intensive variant of ἐκγαμίζω, meaning to give in matrimony. 1. To promote or grant the marriage of another.

DEFINITION: One who is born of someone, belonging to subsequent generations of the same biological lineage.
SENSES: 1. Direct descendants, especially grandchildren or posterity (1Tm 5:4).

THAYER.pt: Aquele que nasce de alguém, pertencendo às gerações seguintes de uma mesma linhagem biológica. 1. Descendentes diretos, especialmente netos ou posteridade (1Tm 5.4).
THAYER.en: One who is born of someone, belonging to subsequent generations of the same biological lineage. 1. Direct descendants, especially grandchildren or posterity (1Tm 5:4).

DEFINITION: To wear out or spend completely one's own resources, including one's own energy or life on behalf of others.
SENSES: 1. To spend oneself completely or sacrifice totally for others (2Co 12:15).

THAYER.pt: Desgastar ou gastar por completo os recursos próprios, inclusive a própria energia ou vida em favor de outros. 1. Gastar-se por completo ou sacrificar-se totalmente pelos outros (2Co 12.15).
THAYER.en: To wear out or spend completely one's own resources, including one's own energy or life on behalf of others. 1. To spend oneself completely or sacrifice totally for others (2Co 12:15).

DEFINITION: To remain in a place or state while maintaining expectation for the arrival of someone or the occurrence of an event.
SENSES: 1. To wait patiently with expectation (Ac 17:16; 1Co 11:33).

THAYER.pt: Permanecer em um lugar ou estado mantendo a expectativa pela chegada de alguém ou pela ocorrência de um evento. 1. Aguardar pacientemente com expectativa (At 17:16; 1Co 11:33).
THAYER.en: To remain in a place or state while maintaining expectation for the arrival of someone or the occurrence of an event. 1. To wait patiently with expectation (Ac 17:16; 1Co 11:33).

DEFINITION: That which stands out clearly, becoming perfectly visible or understandable to all.
SENSES: 1. Something very evident and easily perceptible (2Tm 3:9).

THAYER.pt: Que se destaca de maneira clara, tornando-se perfeitamente visível ou compreensível a todos. 1. Algo muito evidente e facilmente perceptível (2Tm 3.9).
THAYER.en: That which stands out clearly, becoming perfectly visible or understandable to all. 1. Something very evident and easily perceptible (2Tm 3:9).

DEFINITION: Means to be away from one's homeland or a place where one rightly belongs, like the spirit absent from the body.
SENSES: 1. To be absent from the body or from a specific location (2Co 5:6; 2Co 5:8).

THAYER.pt: Significa estar ausente de sua terra natal ou de um lugar onde se pertence por direito, como o espírito ausente do corpo. 1. Estar ausente do corpo ou de um local específico (2Co 5.6; 2Co 5.8).
THAYER.en: Means to be away from one's homeland or a place where one rightly belongs, like the spirit absent from the body. 1. To be absent from the body or from a specific location (2Co 5:6; 2Co 5:8).

DEFINITION: A verb that in the New Testament appears mainly linked to the parable of the tenants, meaning to cede the use of a property through contract or rent.
SENSES: 1. To lease or rent a property to farmers (Mt 21:33; Mk 12:1).

THAYER.pt: Verbo que no Novo Testamento aparece principalmente ligado à parábola dos lavradores, significando ceder o uso de uma propriedade mediante contrato ou aluguel. 1. Arrendar ou alugar uma propriedade a agricultores (Mt 21:33; Mc 12:1).
THAYER.en: A verb that in the New Testament appears mainly linked to the parable of the tenants, meaning to cede the use of a property through contract or rent. 1. To lease or rent a property to farmers (Mt 21:33; Mk 12:1).

DEFINITION: To narrate or relate an event thoroughly, providing all details in a systematic way.
SENSES: 1. To tell or relate in detail (Ac 15:3).

THAYER.pt: Narrar ou relatar um evento minuciosamente, fornecendo todos os detalhes de forma sistemática. 1. Contar ou relatar pormenorizadamente (At 15.3).
THAYER.en: To narrate or relate an event thoroughly, providing all details in a systematic way. 1. To tell or relate in detail (Ac 15:3).

DEFINITION: Means to secure justice for someone oppressed, vindicate a cause, or inflict fair punishment on wrongdoers.
SENSES: 1. To do justice or vindicate someone's rights (Lk 18:5).
2. To repay evil with punishment or execute righteous vengeance (Rom 12:19; Rev 6:10).

THAYER.pt: Significa assegurar justiça para alguém oprimido, vindicar uma causa ou infligir punição justa aos transgressores. 1. Fazer justiça ou vindicar os direitos de alguém (Lc 18:5). | 2. Retribuir o mal com castigo ou executar vingança justa (Rm 12:19; Ap 6:10).
THAYER.en: Means to secure justice for someone oppressed, vindicate a cause, or inflict fair punishment on wrongdoers. 1. To do justice or vindicate someone's rights (Lk 18:5). | 2. To repay evil with punishment or execute righteous vengeance (Rom 12:19; Rev 6:10).

DEFINITION: Refers to the act of executing justice, whether by inflicting deserved punishment on evildoers or applying retribution for a committed offense.
SENSES: 1. Execution of justice and redress of wrongs (Lk 18:7; Ac 7:24).
2. Retribution or vengeance for committed injustices (Rom 12:19).
3. Punishment applied to transgressors (2Co 7:11; 1Pe 2:14).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se ao ato de executar a justiça, seja infligindo a punição merecida aos malfeitores ou aplicando retribuição por um agravo cometido. 1. Execução de justiça e reparação de danos (Lc 18.7; At 7.24). | 2. Retribuição ou vingança por causa de injustiças cometidas (Rm 12.19). | 3. Punição aplicada a transgressores (2Co 7.11; 1Pe 2.14).
THAYER.en: Refers to the act of executing justice, whether by inflicting deserved punishment on evildoers or applying retribution for a committed offense. 1. Execution of justice and redress of wrongs (Lk 18:7; Ac 7:24). | 2. Retribution or vengeance for committed injustices (Rom 12:19). | 3. Punishment applied to transgressors (2Co 7:11; 1Pe 2:14).

DEFINITION: One who executes justice by punishing someone who has committed an injustice or offense; an agent of retribution.
SENSES: 1. One who punishes or avenges wrongdoing (Rom 13:4; 1Th 4:6).

THAYER.pt: Aquele que executa a justiça punindo quem cometeu uma injustiça ou ofensa; um agente de retribuição. 1. Aquele que castiga ou vinga o mal praticado (Rm 13.4; 1Ts 4.6).
THAYER.en: One who executes justice by punishing someone who has committed an injustice or offense; an agent of retribution. 1. One who punishes or avenges wrongdoing (Rom 13:4; 1Th 4:6).

DEFINITION: To pursue someone with persistence and hostility to the point of forcing them to flee or leave the place.
SENSES: 1. To expel or banish someone through persecution (1Th 2:15).
2. To harass or severely persecute (1Th 2:15).

THAYER.pt: Perseguir alguém com insistência e hostilidade a ponto de forçá-lo a fugir ou deixar o lugar. 1. Expulsar ou banir alguém mediante perseguição (1Ts 2.15). | 2. Assediar ou perseguir severamente (1Ts 2.15).
THAYER.en: To pursue someone with persistence and hostility to the point of forcing them to flee or leave the place. 1. To expel or banish someone through persecution (1Th 2:15). | 2. To harass or severely persecute (1Th 2:15).

DEFINITION: That which has been handed over to the power or control of another, often through betrayal or decree.
SENSES: 1. Delivered into the hands of enemies or authorities (Ac 2:23).

THAYER.pt: Que foi entregue ao poder ou controle de outrem, muitas vezes por traição ou decreto. 1. Entregue nas mãos de inimigos ou autoridades (At 2.23).
THAYER.en: That which has been handed over to the power or control of another, often through betrayal or decree. 1. Delivered into the hands of enemies or authorities (Ac 2:23).

DEFINITION: The attitude of waiting with firm expectation and eagerness for a future event to occur.
SENSES: 1. The anxious waiting or expectation for something to happen (Heb 10.27).

THAYER.pt: Atitude de aguardar com expectativa e firmeza a ocorrência de um evento futuro. 1. A espera ansiosa ou expectativa por algo que vai acontecer (Hb 10.27).
THAYER.en: The attitude of waiting with firm expectation and eagerness for a future event to occur. 1. The anxious waiting or expectation for something to happen (Heb 10.27).

DEFINITION: Means to remove clothing from someone's body, acting as the reverse process of dressing.
SENSES: 1. To undress or strip the garments off a person (Matt 27.28; Luke 10.30).

THAYER.pt: Significa remover as roupas do corpo de alguém, agindo como o processo inverso de vestir. 1. Despir ou arrancar as vestes de uma pessoa (Mt 27.28; Lc 10.30).
THAYER.en: Means to remove clothing from someone's body, acting as the reverse process of dressing. 1. To undress or strip the garments off a person (Matt 27.28; Luke 10.30).

DEFINITION: Indicates a static position relatively distant from the speaker or the observer of the narrated event. In some contexts, it acquires a nuance of direction toward a specific place.
SENSES: 1. In that place, there, yonder (Matt 2.13; 5.24; Mark 1.35).
2. Thither, in the direction of that specific place (Matt 2.22; 17.20).

THAYER.pt: Indica uma posição estática relativamente distante do emissor ou de quem observa o evento narrado. Em alguns contextos, adquire nuance de direção para um determinado lugar. 1. Naquele lugar, lá, ali (Mt 2.13; 5.24; Mc 1.35). | 2. Para lá, em direção àquele local específico (Mt 2.22; 17.20).
THAYER.en: Indicates a static position relatively distant from the speaker or the observer of the narrated event. In some contexts, it acquires a nuance of direction toward a specific place. 1. In that place, there, yonder (Matt 2.13; 5.24; Mark 1.35). | 2. Thither, in the direction of that specific place (Matt 2.22; 17.20).

SHORT_GLOSS: thence, from there, from that place
DEFINITION: Indicates spatial origin from a determined point, meaning 'from that place' or 'from there'.
SENSES: 1. Movement of departure or provenance from a specific place (Matt 4.21; 5.26).
USAGE: thence, from there, from that place

THAYER.pt: Indica a procedência espacial a partir de um ponto determinado, significando 'daquele lugar' ou 'de lá'. 1. Movimento de afastamento ou procedência a partir de um lugar específico (Mt 4.21; 5.26).
THAYER.en: Indicates spatial origin from a determined point, meaning 'from that place' or 'from there'. 1. Movement of departure or provenance from a specific place (Matt 4.21; 5.26).

DEFINITION: Deictic demonstrative pronoun that locates entities relatively distant in time, space, or the flow of the narrative discourse. Frequently emphasizes a predetermined individual or refers emphatically to Christ.
SENSES: 1. Demonstrative of distance: 'that', 'those' (Matt 7.27; John 4.15).
2. Substantivized emphatic pronoun: 'he', 'that man' (John 1.8; 9.37).
3. Antithetical reference in comparison with another group ('the one... the other') (Luke 18.14).

THAYER.pt: Pronome demonstrativo dêitico que localiza entidades relativamente distantes no tempo, espaço ou fluxo da narrativa discursiva. Frequentemente enfatiza um indivíduo predeterminado ou remete enfaticamente a Cristo. 1. Demonstrativo de distância: 'aquele', 'aquela' (Mt 7.27; Jo 4.15). | 2. Pronome enfático substantivado: 'ele', 'aquele homem' (Jo 1.8; 9.37). | 3. Referência antitética em comparação com outro grupo ('este... aquele') (Lc 18.14).
THAYER.en: Deictic demonstrative pronoun that locates entities relatively distant in time, space, or the flow of the narrative discourse. Frequently emphasizes a predetermined individual or refers emphatically to Christ. 1. Demonstrative of distance: 'that', 'those' (Matt 7.27; John 4.15). | 2. Substantivized emphatic pronoun: 'he', 'that man' (John 1.8; 9.37). | 3. Antithetical reference in comparison with another group ('the one... the other') (Luke 18.14).

DEFINITION: Adverb denoting movement or direction to a place distant from the speaker's perspective; thither.
SENSES: 1. To that place, there (Acts 21.3).

THAYER.pt: Advérbio que denota movimento ou direção para um lugar distante da perspectiva de quem fala; para lá. 1. Para aquele lugar, ali (At 21.3).
THAYER.en: Adverb denoting movement or direction to a place distant from the speaker's perspective; thither. 1. To that place, there (Acts 21.3).

DEFINITION: To look for something or someone diligently, or to demand an account for something rigorously.
SENSES: 1. To seek with earnestness and dedication (Heb 11.6; Acts 15.17).
2. To require or demand responsibility for faults (Luke 11.50).

THAYER.pt: Procurar diligentemente por algo ou alguém, ou exigir contas por algo de maneira rigorosa. 1. Buscar com afinco e dedicação (Hb 11:6; At 15:17). | 2. Requerer ou exigir responsabilidade por faltas (Lc 11:50).
THAYER.en: To look for something or someone diligently, or to demand an account for something rigorously. 1. To seek with earnestness and dedication (Heb 11.6; Acts 15.17). | 2. To require or demand responsibility for faults (Luke 11.50).

DEFINITION: Verb in the passive voice describing a state of intense surprise, astonishment, or dismay in the face of something extraordinary or terrifying.
SENSES: 1. To be deeply amazed or alarmed by something unexpected (Mark 9.15; 16.6).

THAYER.pt: Verbo na voz passiva que descreve um estado de intensa surpresa, assombro ou consternação diante de algo extraordinário ou aterrorizante. 1. Ficar profundamente maravilhado ou alarmado com algo inesperado (Mc 9:15; 16:6).
THAYER.en: Verb in the passive voice describing a state of intense surprise, astonishment, or dismay in the face of something extraordinary or terrifying. 1. To be deeply amazed or alarmed by something unexpected (Mark 9.15; 16.6).

DEFINITION: State of profound astonishment, admiration, or perplexity before an extraordinary event.
SENSES: 1. Filled with complete admiration or amazement (Acts 3.11).

THAYER.pt: Estado de profundo espanto, admiração ou perplexidade diante de um evento extraordinário. 1. Tomado de completa admiração ou espanto (At 3.11).
THAYER.en: State of profound astonishment, admiration, or perplexity before an extraordinary event. 1. Filled with complete admiration or amazement (Acts 3.11).

DEFINITION: Referring to newborns who were placed outside the house and abandoned to their fate.
SENSES: 1. A child exposed or abandoned after birth (Acts 7.19).

THAYER.pt: Referente a recém-nascidos que eram colocados para fora de casa e abandonados à própria sorte. 1. Criança exposta ou abandonada após o nascimento (At 7.19).
THAYER.en: Referring to newborns who were placed outside the house and abandoned to their fate. 1. A child exposed or abandoned after birth (Acts 7.19).

DEFINITION: To remove completely what contaminates or makes impure, cleaning thoroughly.
SENSES: 1. To cleanse completely or purge out evil (1 Cor 5.7; 2 Tim 2.21).

THAYER.pt: Remover completamente aquilo que contamina ou torna impuro, limpando minuciosamente. 1. Limpar completamente ou expurgar o mal (1Co 5.7; 2Tm 2.21).
THAYER.en: To remove completely what contaminates or makes impure, cleaning thoroughly. 1. To cleanse completely or purge out evil (1 Cor 5.7; 2 Tim 2.21).

DEFINITION: To be seized by intense desires or burning passions, especially of a sensual or emotional nature.
SENSES: 1. To be inflamed with passion or burning desire (Rom 1.27).

THAYER.pt: Ser tomado por desejos intensos ou paixões ardentes, especialmente de natureza sensual ou emocional. 1. Estar inflamado de paixão ou desejo ardente (Rm 1.27).
THAYER.en: To be seized by intense desires or burning passions, especially of a sensual or emotional nature. 1. To be inflamed with passion or burning desire (Rom 1.27).

DEFINITION: Means to lose courage or become discouraged in the face of difficulties or prolonged trials.
SENSES: 1. To become spiritually discouraged or lose heart in doing good.

THAYER.pt: Significa perder a coragem ou desanimar diante de dificuldades ou provações prolongadas. 1. Desanimar espiritualmente ou perder o ânimo na prática do bem.
THAYER.en: Means to lose courage or become discouraged in the face of difficulties or prolonged trials. 1. To become spiritually discouraged or lose heart in doing good.

DEFINITION: To pierce deeply with a pointed instrument, wounding the body severely.
SENSES: 1. To transfix or pierce with a pointed object (John 19.37; Rev 1.7).

THAYER.pt: Perfurar profundamente com um instrumento pontiagudo, ferindo o corpo de modo severo. 1. Traspassar ou perfurar com objeto pontiagudo (Jo 19.37; Ap 1.7).
THAYER.en: To pierce deeply with a pointed instrument, wounding the body severely. 1. To transfix or pierce with a pointed object (John 19.37; Rev 1.7).

DEFINITION: Means to separate a part from a whole by applying breaking force, like breaking off a branch.
SENSES: 1. To break off or cut off a branch from a tree (Rom 11.17).

THAYER.pt: Significa separar uma parte de um todo aplicando força de ruptura, como quebrar um galho. 1. Quebrar ou cortar fora um ramo de uma árvore (Rm 11.17).
THAYER.en: Means to separate a part from a whole by applying breaking force, like breaking off a branch. 1. To break off or cut off a branch from a tree (Rom 11.17).

DEFINITION: To prevent the entry or participation of someone by locking out or making something impossible.
SENSES: 1. To exclude from fellowship or access (Gal 4.17).
2. To render groundless or completely nullify (Rom 3.27).

THAYER.pt: Impedir a entrada ou a participação de alguém, trancando para fora ou tornando algo impossível. 1. Excluir da comunhão ou do acesso (Gl 4.17). | 2. Tornar sem cabimento ou anular por completo (Rm 3.27).
THAYER.en: To prevent the entry or participation of someone by locking out or making something impossible. 1. To exclude from fellowship or access (Gal 4.17). | 2. To render groundless or completely nullify (Rom 3.27).

DEFINITION: Originally designates the summoned civil assembly; in the New Testament, describes the community or the total body of the redeemed gathered in the name of Jesus Christ.
SENSES: 1. A local community and visible congregation of believers meeting for worship and fellowship (Rom 16.5; 1 Cor 1.2; 1 Thess 1.1).
2. The universal and spiritual body of all who belong to Christ across all ages (Matt 16.18; Eph 1.22; Col 1.18).
3. Assembly of citizens in a classical civic context or the Israelite gathering in the wilderness (Acts 7.38; 19.32, 39).

THAYER.pt: Designa originalmente a assembleia civil convocada; no Novo Testamento, descreve a comunidade ou o corpo total dos remidos reunidos em nome de Jesus Cristo. 1. Uma comunidade local e congregação visível de crentes que se reúne para adoração e comunhão (Rm 16.5; 1Co 1.2; 1Ts 1.1). | 2. O corpo universal e espiritual de todos os que pertencem a Cristo em todas as épocas (Mt 16.18; Ef 1.22; Cl 1.18). | 3. Assembleia de cidadãos no contexto cívico clássico ou reunião israelita no deserto (At 7.38; 19.32, 39).
THAYER.en: Originally designates the summoned civil assembly; in the New Testament, describes the community or the total body of the redeemed gathered in the name of Jesus Christ. 1. A local community and visible congregation of believers meeting for worship and fellowship (Rom 16.5; 1 Cor 1.2; 1 Thess 1.1). | 2. The universal and spiritual body of all who belong to Christ across all ages (Matt 16.18; Eph 1.22; Col 1.18). | 3. Assembly of citizens in a classical civic context or the Israelite gathering in the wilderness (Acts 7.38; 19.32, 39).

DEFINITION: Means to turn away from a moral path or deliberately distance oneself from someone to avoid sinful association.
SENSES: 1. To avoid or turn away from people who cause divisions (Rom 16.17).
2. To deviate from the right path or righteousness (Rom 3.12).

THAYER.pt: Significa desviar-se de um caminho moral ou afastar-se deliberadamente de alguém para evitar associação pecaminosa. 1. Evitar ou afastar-se de pessoas que causam divisões (Rm 16.17). | 2. Desviar-se do caminho reto ou da justiça (Rm 3.12).
THAYER.en: Means to turn away from a moral path or deliberately distance oneself from someone to avoid sinful association. 1. To avoid or turn away from people who cause divisions (Rom 16.17). | 2. To deviate from the right path or righteousness (Rom 3.12).

DEFINITION: The act of distancing oneself from a dangerous place, such as a wrecked ship, by swimming to dry land.
SENSES: 1. To swim out from a place of danger or toward the shore (Acts 27.42).

THAYER.pt: Ação de distanciar-se de um local perigoso, como um navio naufragado, nadando para terra firme. 1. Nadar para fora de um local de perigo ou rumo à margem (At 27.42).
THAYER.en: The act of distancing oneself from a dangerous place, such as a wrecked ship, by swimming to dry land. 1. To swim out from a place of danger or toward the shore (Acts 27.42).

DEFINITION: To transport a body out of a locality or dwelling for the purpose of carrying out a burial.
SENSES: 1. To carry a dead body out of the city for burial (Luke 7.12).

THAYER.pt: Transportar um corpo para fora de uma localidade ou habitação com o propósito de realizar o sepultamento. 1. Carregar um defunto para fora da cidade para o sepultamento (Lc 7.12).
THAYER.en: To transport a body out of a locality or dwelling for the purpose of carrying out a burial. 1. To carry a dead body out of the city for burial (Luke 7.12).

DEFINITION: Means to cut something to separate it, fell a tree by the roots, or completely eliminate something unwanted.
SENSES: 1. To physically cut down or chop off (Matt 3.10; 5.30).
2. To eliminate, eradicate, or remove something harmful (2 Cor 11.12).

THAYER.en: Means to cut something to separate it, fell a tree by the roots, or completely eliminate something unwanted. 1. To physically cut down or chop off (Matt 3.10; 5.30). | 2. To eliminate, eradicate, or remove something harmful (2 Cor 11.12).

SENSES: 1. To pay close attention, eagerly absorbing someone's words (Luke 19.48).

THAYER.en: Literally to hang something out; figuratively, describes the attitude of someone who greedily absorbs every word of a speaker. 1. To pay close attention, eagerly absorbing someone's words (Luke 19.48).

THAYER.en: To speak openly about a matter, publishing or reporting information to others. 1. To publicly divulge or report information (Acts 23.22).

THAYER.en: To emit intense luminous rays, spreading brightness from a source. 1. To shine or glow brightly, often in a figurative or eschatological sense (Matt 13.43).

DEFINITION: Means to forget completely or lose the memory of something totally.

Escolher pessoas para uma incumbência ou ofício específico (Lc 6.13; At 1.2). | 2. Eleger Deus a seu povo ou indivíduos para salvação e bênção (Jo 15.16; Ef 1.4).
THAYER.en: To pick out from among many, intentionally selecting for oneself according to a defined plan, highlighting especially God's sovereign gracious choice. 1. To choose people for a specific task or office (Luke 6.13; Acts 1.2). | 2. God electing His people or individuals for salvation and blessing (John 15.16; Eph 1.4).

DEFINITION: Verb expressing the exhaustion of something, the cessation of existence, or the end of a resource or event.
SENSES: 1. To run out or lack material resources (Luke 16.9).

THAYER.pt: Verbo que expressa o esgotamento de algo, a cessação da existência ou o término de um recurso ou evento. 1. Esgotar-se ou faltar recursos materiais (Lc 16:9). | 2. Extinguir-se ou deixar de existir (Lc 22:32; 23:45).
THAYER.en: Verb expressing the exhaustion of something, the cessation of existence, or the end of a resource or event. 1. To run out or lack material resources (Luke 16.9). | 2. To die out or cease to exist (Luke 22.32; 23.45).

SENSES: 1. Chosen by God, elect for salvation (Matt 22.14; 1 Pet 2.9).
2. Possessing excellent quality, distinguished or select (Rom 16.13).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se àqueles que foram selecionados ou escolhidos por Deus para receberem a salvação e cumprirem um propósito divino específico. 1. Escolhido por Deus, eleito para a salvação (Mt 22.14; 1Pe 2.9). | 2. Que possui excelente qualidade, distinto ou seleto (Rm 16.13).
THAYER.en: Refers to those who have been selected or chosen by God to receive salvation and fulfill a specific divine purpose. 1. Chosen by God, elect for salvation (Matt 22.14; 1 Pet 2.9). | 2. Possessing excellent quality, distinguished or select (Rom 16.13).

DEFINITION: The act of making a selection based on preference or deliberate purpose, frequently referring to divine choice.
SENSES: 1. Sovereign choice or divine election (Acts 9.15; Rom 11.5).

THAYER.pt: O ato de fazer uma seleção com base em preferência ou propósito deliberado, referindo-se frequentemente à escolha divina. 1. A escolha soberana ou eleição divina (At 9:15; Rm 11:5). | 2. O grupo de pessoas que foi escolhido (Rm 11:7).
THAYER.en: The act of making a selection based on preference or deliberate purpose, frequently referring to divine choice. 1. Sovereign choice or divine election (Acts 9.15; Rom 11.5). | 2. The group of people who were chosen (Rom 11.7).

DEFINITION: Describes the exhaustion of physical strength or moral discouragement, leading to exhaustion and loss of courage.
SENSES: 1. To become completely exhausted in strength or lose heart (Matt 15.32; Heb 12.5).

THAYER.pt: Descreve o esgotamento das forças físicas ou o desânimo moral, levando à exaustão e à perda de coragem. 1. Ficar completamente exausto em termos de força ou perder o ânimo (Mt 15.32; Hb 12.5).
THAYER.en: Describes the exhaustion of physical strength or moral discouragement, leading to exhaustion and loss of courage. 1. To become completely exhausted in strength or lose heart (Matt 15.32; Heb 12.5).

DEFINITION: Means to dry the surface of something or someone through the act of rubbing or passing an absorbent material.

THAYER.en: Means to dry the surface of something or someone through the act of rubbing or passing an absorbent material. 1. To wipe or dry something by means of friction (Lk 7.38).

THAYER.en: To show profound disdain through gestures or words of scorn; to mock with contempt. 1. To ridicule or mock someone with disdain (Lk 16.14).

DEFINITION: To deviate or quietly withdraw from a place to avoid attention or danger.
SENSES: 1. To turn away or withdraw silently from a crowd or location (Jn 5.13).

THAYER.pt: Desviar-se ou retirar-se discretamente de um lugar para evitar atenção ou perigo. 1. Afastar-se ou retirar-se silenciosamente de uma multidão ou local (Jo 5.13).
THAYER.en: To deviate or quietly withdraw from a place to avoid attention or danger. 1. To turn away or withdraw silently from a crowd or location (Jn 5.13).

DEFINITION: To return to a state of lucidity and mental control, awakening from a spiritual or moral stupor.
SENSES: 1. To return to good sense and moral sobriety, ceasing sin (1Co 15.34).

DEFINITION: Done by free and spontaneous will, without coercion or external pressure.

THAYER.en: Done by free and spontaneous will, without coercion or external pressure. 1. Acting voluntarily, of one's own free will (Phlm 14).

DEFINITION: Acting by free and spontaneous will, without external coercion, in a deliberate and intentional manner.
SENSES: 1. In a voluntary and intentional manner (Heb 10.26).

THAYER.en: Acting by free and spontaneous will, without external coercion, in a deliberate and intentional manner. 1. In a voluntary and intentional manner (Heb 10.26).

DEFINITION: Indicates a point in time very distant in the past or a long period elapsed since antiquity.
SENSES: 1. From a long time ago, of old (2Pe 2.3; 3.5).

THAYER.pt: Indica um ponto no tempo muito distante no passado ou um longo período decorrido desde a antiguidade. 1. Desde muito tempo atrás, há muito (2Pe 2.3; 3.5).
THAYER.en: Indicates a point in time very distant in the past or a long period elapsed since antiquity. 1. From a long time ago, of old (2Pe 2.3; 3.5).

DEFINITION: An inhabitant or native of the region of Elam, east of Mesopotamia.
SENSES: 1. Jews or pilgrims of Elamite origin present at Pentecost (Acts 2:9).

THAYER.pt: Habitante ou natural da região de Elão (Elam), a leste da Mesopotâmia. 1. Judeus ou peregrinos de origem elamita presentes no Pentecostes (At 2.9).
THAYER.en: An inhabitant or native of the region of Elam, east of Mesopotamia. 1. Jews or pilgrims of Elamite origin present at Pentecost (Acts 2:9).

DEFINITION: Adjective used as a comparative to indicate smaller quantity, lower hierarchical status, or younger age in relation to another.
SENSES: 1. Relative to a smaller quantity or age limit (1 Tim 5:9).
2. Inferior in position, authority, or status (Heb 7:7).

THAYER.pt: Adjetivo usado como comparativo para indicar menor quantidade, menor status hierárquico ou menor idade em relação a outro. 1. Relativo a menor quantidade ou limite de idade (1Tm 5:9). | 2. Inferior em posição, autoridade ou status (Hb 7:7).
THAYER.en: Adjective used as a comparative to indicate smaller quantity, lower hierarchical status, or younger age in relation to another. 1. Relative to a smaller quantity or age limit (1 Tim 5:9). | 2. Inferior in position, authority, or status (Heb 7:7).

DEFINITION: To be in possession of a smaller quantity than necessary or than others.
SENSES: 1. To have a shortage or less than necessary in the context of sharing (2 Cor 8:15).

THAYER.pt: Estar em posse de uma quantidade menor do que o necessário ou do que os outros. 1. Ter escassez ou menos do que o necessário no contexto de partilha (2Co 8.15).
THAYER.en: To be in possession of a smaller quantity than necessary or than others. 1. To have a shortage or less than necessary in the context of sharing (2 Cor 8:15).

DEFINITION: To make someone inferior in status, position, or importance, or to experience a decrease.
SENSES: 1. To make someone lower in status or dignity (Heb 2:7).
2. To become inferior or decrease in relevance (Jn 3:30).

THAYER.pt: Significa tornar alguém inferior em status, posição ou importância, ou experimentar diminuição. 1. Fazer alguém menor em status ou dignidade (Hb 2.7). | 2. Tornar-se inferior ou diminuir em relevância (Jo 3.30).
THAYER.en: To make someone inferior in status, position, or importance, or to experience a decrease. 1. To make someone lower in status or dignity (Heb 2:7). | 2. To become inferior or decrease in relevance (Jn 3:30).

DEFINITION: Indicates the action of propelling or moving an object or vessel through vigorous force.
SENSES: 1. To propel a vessel by rowing or to be driven by the wind (Mk 6:48; Jn 6:19).

THAYER.pt: Indica a ação de impulsionar ou fazer mover um objeto ou embarcação através de força vigorosa. 1. Propulsar uma embarcação remando ou ser impulsionado pelo vento (Mc 6.48; Jo 6.19).
THAYER.en: Indicates the action of propelling or moving an object or vessel through vigorous force. 1. To propel a vessel by rowing or to be driven by the wind (Mk 6:48; Jn 6:19).

DEFINITION: Behavior characterized by levity, caprice, and irresponsible change of opinion.
SENSES: 1. Instability or levity in decisions and promises (2 Cor 1:17).

THAYER.pt: Comportamento caracterizado por leviandade, capricho e mudança irresponsável de opinião. 1. Instabilidade ou leviandade em decisões e promessas (2Co 1.17).
