THAYER.en: Behavior characterized by levity, caprice, and irresponsible change of opinion. 1. Instability or levity in decisions and promises (2 Cor 1:17).

DEFINITION: The quality of that which has little physical weight or which is easy to bear and tolerate.
SENSES: 1. That which has little weight or is easy to carry (Mt 11:30).
2. Sufferings or tribulations of short duration and bearable (2 Cor 4:17).

THAYER.pt: Qualidade daquilo que possui pouco peso físico ou que é fácil de suportar e tolerar. 1. Que tem pouco peso ou é fácil de carregar (Mt 11.30). | 2. Sofrimentos ou tribulações de curta duração e suportáveis (2Co 4.17).
THAYER.en: The quality of that which has little physical weight or which is easy to bear and tolerate. 1. That which has little weight or is easy to carry (Mt 11:30). | 2. Sufferings or tribulations of short duration and bearable (2 Cor 4:17).

DEFINITION: The superlative degree denoting the smallest in size, quantity, importance, or social position.
SENSES: 1. The least in terms of status or importance (Mt 2:6; 1 Cor 15:9).
2. The one of least relevance or physical size (Jas 3:4).

THAYER.pt: O grau superlativo que denota o menor em tamanho, quantidade, importância ou posição social. 1. O menor em termos de status ou importância (Mt 2.6; 1Co 15.9). | 2. O de menor relevância ou tamanho físico (Tg 3.4).
THAYER.en: The superlative degree denoting the smallest in size, quantity, importance, or social position. 1. The least in terms of status or importance (Mt 2:6; 1 Cor 15:9). | 2. The one of least relevance or physical size (Jas 3:4).

DEFINITION: An intensified superlative form denoting someone who considers themselves inferior to the least.
SENSES: 1. Expression of profound humility regarding one's own spiritual position (Eph 3:8).

THAYER.pt: Forma superlativa intensificada que denota alguém que se considera inferior aos menores. 1. Expressão de profunda humildade sobre a própria posição espiritual (Ef 3.8).
THAYER.en: An intensified superlative form denoting someone who considers themselves inferior to the least. 1. Expression of profound humility regarding one's own spiritual position (Eph 3:8).

DEFINITION: A masculine proper name referring to one of the ancestors in the earthly genealogy of Jesus.
SENSES: 1. A figure in the ancestry of Jesus according to the Gospel of Matthew (Mt 1:15).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio masculino referente a um dos antepassados na genealogia terrena de Jesus. 1. Personagem na ancestralidade de Jesus segundo o Evangelho de Mateus (Mt 1.15).
THAYER.en: A masculine proper name referring to one of the ancestors in the earthly genealogy of Jesus. 1. A figure in the ancestry of Jesus according to the Gospel of Matthew (Mt 1:15).

DEFINITION: A clear expression of strong disapproval for wrong conduct.
SENSES: 1. Severe rebuke for an act of foolishness or transgression (2 Pet 2:16).

THAYER.pt: Expressão clara de forte desaprovação por uma conduta errada. 1. Repreensão severa por ato de insensatez ou transgressão (2Pe 2.16).
THAYER.en: A clear expression of strong disapproval for wrong conduct. 1. Severe rebuke for an act of foolishness or transgression (2 Pet 2:16).

DEFINITION: The presentation of arguments or evidence that demonstrates the truth of something, or the expression of a rebuke.
SENSES: 1. Evident proof or solid conviction regarding invisible realities (Heb 11:1).

THAYER.pt: Apresentação de argumentos ou evidências que demonstram a verdade de algo, ou a expressão de repreensão. 1. Prova evidente ou convicção sólida sobre realidades invisíveis (Hb 11.1).
THAYER.en: The presentation of arguments or evidence that demonstrates the truth of something, or the expression of a rebuke. 1. Evident proof or solid conviction regarding invisible realities (Heb 11:1).

DEFINITION: To examine rigorously, to bring to light the truth about an error, to rebuke with evidence, or to convince someone of their guilt.
SENSES: 1. To expose or clearly demonstrate the truth or an error (Tit 2:15).
2. To convince someone of their sin or guilt with evidence (Jas 2:9).
3. To rebuke or discipline for correction (Mt 18:15; Heb 12:5).

THAYER.pt: Examinar com rigor, trazer à luz a verdade sobre um erro, repreender com provas ou convencer alguém de sua culpa. 1. Expor ou demonstrar claramente a verdade ou um erro (Tt 2.15). | 2. Convencer alguém de seu pecado ou culpa com evidências (Tg 2.9). | 3. Repreender ou disciplinar para correção (Mt 18.15; Hb 12.5).
THAYER.en: To examine rigorously, to bring to light the truth about an error, to rebuke with evidence, or to convince someone of their guilt. 1. To expose or clearly demonstrate the truth or an error (Tit 2:15). | 2. To convince someone of their sin or guilt with evidence (Jas 2:9). | 3. To rebuke or discipline for correction (Mt 18:15; Heb 12:5).

DEFINITION: Being in a deplorable condition that evokes deep sympathy, compassion, or pity.
SENSES: 1. A condition worthy of pity or extreme spiritual misery (Rev 3:17; 1 Cor 15:19).

THAYER.pt: Que se encontra em condição deplorável, despertando profunda simpatia, compaixão ou pena. 1. Condição digna de lástima ou extrema miséria espiritual (Ap 3.17; 1Co 15.19).
THAYER.en: Being in a deplorable condition that evokes deep sympathy, compassion, or pity. 1. A condition worthy of pity or extreme spiritual misery (Rev 3:17; 1 Cor 15:19).

DEFINITION: To demonstrate deep concern and active grace toward someone who is in a state of need or suffering.
SENSES: 1. To have compassion, to show mercy or pity toward the needy (Matt 18:33; Rom 9:15).

THAYER.pt: Demonstrar profunda preocupação e graça ativa para com alguém que se encontra em situação de necessidade ou sofrimento. 1. Ter compaixão, demonstrar misericórdia ou piedade para com os necessitados (Mt 18.33; Rm 9.15).
THAYER.en: To demonstrate deep concern and active grace toward someone who is in a state of need or suffering. 1. To have compassion, to show mercy or pity toward the needy (Matt 18:33; Rom 9:15).

DEFINITION: Describes the practice of giving material aid to the needy as a concrete expression of compassion and mercy. In the New Testament, it is associated with works of righteousness before God.
SENSES: 1. The act of practicing charity or giving alms to the needy (Matt 6:2; Acts 10:2).
2. The donation or material aid provided to meet a need (Acts 3:2).

THAYER.pt: Descreve a prática de dar auxílio material aos necessitados como uma expressão concreta de compaixão e misericórdia. No Novo Testamento, está associada a obras de justiça diante de Deus. 1. Ação de praticar a caridade ou dar esmolas aos necessitados (Mt 6.2; At 10.2). | 2. O donativo ou auxílio material provido para suprir uma necessidade (At 3.2).
THAYER.en: Describes the practice of giving material aid to the needy as a concrete expression of compassion and mercy. In the New Testament, it is associated with works of righteousness before God. 1. The act of practicing charity or giving alms to the needy (Matt 6:2; Acts 10:2). | 2. The donation or material aid provided to meet a need (Acts 3:2).

DEFINITION: The quality of one who demonstrates deep compassion and acts actively to alleviate the needs of others.
SENSES: 1. One who demonstrates mercy and compassionate empathy (Matt 5:7).

THAYER.pt: Qualidade de quem demonstra profunda compaixão e age ativamente para aliviar a necessidade alheia. 1. Aquele que demonstra misericórdia e empatia compassiva (Mt 5.7).
THAYER.en: The quality of one who demonstrates deep compassion and acts actively to alleviate the needs of others. 1. One who demonstrates mercy and compassionate empathy (Matt 5:7).

DEFINITION: An attitude of deep kindness and compassion actively demonstrated toward someone in a situation of need or misery.
SENSES: 1. Active kindness and compassion expressed to those who suffer or are in need (Matt 9:13; Jas 2:13).

THAYER.pt: Atitude de profunda bondade e compaixão demonstrada ativamente para com alguém que se encontra em situação de necessidade ou miséria. 1. Bondade e compaixão ativas expressas a quem sofre ou necessita (Mt 9.13; Tg 2.13).
THAYER.en: An attitude of deep kindness and compassion actively demonstrated toward someone in a situation of need or misery. 1. Active kindness and compassion expressed to those who suffer or are in need (Matt 9:13; Jas 2:13).

DEFINITION: The state of being free, denoting in the New Testament the spiritual liberation from the slavery of sin and the Law.
SENSES: 1. Freedom of action or the social condition of a free person (2 Pet 2:19).
2. Spiritual emancipation from the slavery of sin and the Law granted by Christ (Gal 5:1).

THAYER.pt: O estado de ser livre, denotando no Novo Testamento a libertação espiritual da escravidão do pecado e da Lei. 1. Liberdade de ação ou condição social de uma pessoa livre (2Pe 2:19). | 2. Emancipação espiritual da escravidão do pecado e da Lei concedida por Cristo (Gl 5:1).
THAYER.en: The state of being free, denoting in the New Testament the spiritual liberation from the slavery of sin and the Law. 1. Freedom of action or the social condition of a free person (2 Pet 2:19). | 2. Spiritual emancipation from the slavery of sin and the Law granted by Christ (Gal 5:1).

DEFINITION: Describes someone who is not a slave, enjoying social and political freedom. Theologically, it expresses liberation from the slavery of sin and the condemnation of the law through Christ.
SENSES: 1. Socially or politically free, not a slave (John 8:33; 1 Cor 7:22).
2. Exempt from obligations or spiritually liberated (Rom 6:18; 1 Pet 2:16).

THAYER.pt: Descreve alguém que não é escravo, gozando de liberdade social e política. Teologicamente, expressa a libertação da escravidão do pecado e da condenação da lei através de Cristo. 1. Livre social ou politicamente, não escravo (Jo 8.33; 1Co 7.22). | 2. Isento de obrigações ou espiritualmente liberto (Rm 6.18; 1Pe 2.16).
THAYER.en: Describes someone who is not a slave, enjoying social and political freedom. Theologically, it expresses liberation from the slavery of sin and the condemnation of the law through Christ. 1. Socially or politically free, not a slave (John 8:33; 1 Cor 7:22). | 2. Exempt from obligations or spiritually liberated (Rom 6:18; 1 Pet 2:16).

DEFINITION: To cause the liberation of someone who was under a yoke, slavery, or oppressive dominion.
SENSES: 1. To set free from the slavery of sin or the law (John 8:32; Rom 6:18).

THAYER.pt: Causar a libertação de alguém que se encontrava sob jugo, escravidão ou domínio opressor. 1. Libertar da escravidão do pecado ou da lei (Jo 8:32; Rm 6:18).
THAYER.en: To cause the liberation of someone who was under a yoke, slavery, or oppressive dominion. 1. To set free from the slavery of sin or the law (John 8:32; Rom 6:18).

DEFINITION: The act of approaching and arriving at a determined point or destination.
SENSES: 1. The coming or advent of an expected person (Acts 7:52).

THAYER.pt: O ato de aproximar-se e chegar a um ponto ou destino determinado. 1. A vinda ou o advento de uma pessoa esperada (At 7.52).
THAYER.en: The act of approaching and arriving at a determined point or destination. 1. The coming or advent of an expected person (Acts 7:52).

DEFINITION: That which is constituted or made from elephant tusks (ivory).
SENSES: 1. Artifacts or precious objects made of ivory (Rev 18:12).

THAYER.pt: Que é constituído ou feito a partir de presas de elefante (marfim). 1. Artefatos ou objetos preciosos feitos de marfim (Ap 18.12).
THAYER.en: That which is constituted or made from elephant tusks (ivory). 1. Artifacts or precious objects made of ivory (Rev 18:12).

DEFINITION: A masculine proper name of Hebrew origin, present in the genealogy of Jesus in the New Testament.
SENSES: 1. An ancestor of Jesus in the lineage of descent (Matt 1:13; Luke 3:30).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio masculino de origem hebraica, presente na genealogia de Jesus no Novo Testamento. 1. Antecessor de Jesus na linhagem de descendência (Mt 1.13; Lc 3.30).
THAYER.en: A masculine proper name of Hebrew origin, present in the genealogy of Jesus in the New Testament. 1. An ancestor of Jesus in the lineage of descent (Matt 1:13; Luke 3:30).

DEFINITION: A masculine proper name of Hebrew origin, meaning 'God is help.' It appears in the genealogy of Jesus recorded in the Gospel of Luke.
SENSES: 1. An ancestor in the human lineage of Jesus (Luke 3:29).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio masculino de origem hebraica, que significa 'Deus é socorro'. Aparece na genealogia de Jesus registrada no Evangelho de Lucas. 1. ancestral na linhagem humana de Jesus (Lc 3.29).
THAYER.en: A masculine proper name of Hebrew origin, meaning 'God is help.' It appears in the genealogy of Jesus recorded in the Gospel of Luke. 1. An ancestor in the human lineage of Jesus (Luke 3:29).

DEFINITION: A proper name of one of the ancestors in the genealogical lineage of Jesus Christ.
SENSES: 1. A descendant listed in the genealogy of Jesus (Matt 1:14).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio de um dos antepassados na linhagem genealógica de Jesus Cristo. 1. Descendente listado na genealogia de Jesus (Mt 1.14).
THAYER.en: A proper name of one of the ancestors in the genealogical lineage of Jesus Christ. 1. A descendant listed in the genealogy of Jesus (Matt 1:14).

DEFINITION: Elizabeth, the wife of the priest Zechariah and mother of John the Baptist. She was a descendant of Aaron and was graced by God in her old age with the birth of her son.
SENSES: 1. Elizabeth, the mother of John the Baptist (Luke 1:5).

THAYER.pt: Isabel, esposa do sacerdote Zacarias e mãe de João o Batista. Ela era descendente de Arão e agraciada por Deus na sua velhice com o nascimento de seu filho. 1. Isabel, a mãe de João Batista (Lc 1.5).
THAYER.en: Elizabeth, the wife of the priest Zechariah and mother of John the Baptist. She was a descendant of Aaron and was graced by God in her old age with the birth of her son. 1. Elizabeth, the mother of John the Baptist (Luke 1:5).

DEFINITION: A proper name designating the renowned Old Testament prophet, known for his numerous miracles and ministry in Israel.
SENSES: 1. The prophet Elisha, mentioned as a figure of contrast or historical reference (Luke 4:27).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio que designa o renomado profeta do Antigo Testamento, conhecido por seus inúmeros milagres e ministério em Israel. 1. o profeta Eliseu, mencionado como figura de contraste ou referência histórica (Lc 4.27).
THAYER.en: A proper name designating the renowned Old Testament prophet, known for his numerous miracles and ministry in Israel. 1. The prophet Elisha, mentioned as a figure of contrast or historical reference (Luke 4:27).

DEFINITION: The act of folding or rolling something to give it the cylindrical shape of a scroll.
SENSES: 1. To roll up garments or the heavens like a scroll (Heb 1:12; Rev 6:14).

THAYER.pt: Ato de dobrar ou enrolar algo para conferir-lhe a forma cilíndrica de um rolo. 1. Enrolar vestimentas ou os céus como um pergaminho (Hb 1.12; Ap 6.14).
THAYER.en: The act of folding or rolling something to give it the cylindrical shape of a scroll. 1. To roll up garments or the heavens like a scroll (Heb 1:12; Rev 6:14).

DEFINITION: Refers to an open, painful, or ulcerated wound resulting from infection or physical punishment.
SENSES: 1. An ulcer or a malignant and painful wound (Rev 16:2, 11).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se a uma ferida aberta, dolorosa ou ulcerada decorrente de infecção ou castigo físico. 1. Úlcera ou ferida maligna e dolorosa (Ap 16.2, 11).
THAYER.en: Refers to an open, painful, or ulcerated wound resulting from infection or physical punishment. 1. An ulcer or a malignant and painful wound (Rev 16:2, 11).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: ἑλκώσω, Aor: εἵλκωσα, Perf. Pass. Participle: εἱλκωμένος
SHORT_GLOSS: to cover with sores, to ulcerate
DEFINITION: To cover the body or skin with wounds, ulcers, or purulent sores. In the New Testament, it describes the debilitated physical condition of Lazarus in the parable.
SENSES: 1. To cover with sores or ulcerous wounds (Luke 16:20).
USAGE: to cover with sores, to ulcerate

THAYER.pt: Cobrir o corpo ou a pele com feridas, úlceras ou chagas purulentas. No Novo Testamento, descreve a condição física debilitada de Lázaro na parábola. 1. cobrir com chagas ou feridas ulcerosas (Lc 16.20).
THAYER.en: To cover the body or skin with wounds, ulcers, or purulent sores. In the New Testament, it describes the debilitated physical condition of Lazarus in the parable. 1. To cover with sores or ulcerous wounds (Luke 16:20).

SHORT_GLOSS: to pull, to drag, to draw
DEFINITION: To exert physical force to attract something or someone in the direction of the one pulling, which can have a literal or spiritual meaning.
SENSES: 1. To pull or drag a heavy object or net (John 21:6).
2. To draw spiritually toward Christ by divine power (John 12:32).
USAGE: to pull, to drag, to draw

THAYER.pt: Exercer força física para atrair algo ou alguém na direção de quem puxa, podendo ter sentido literal ou espiritual. 1. Puxar ou arrastar um objeto pesado ou rede (Jo 21.6). | 2. Atrair espiritualmente para Cristo pelo poder divino (Jo 12.32).
THAYER.en: To exert physical force to attract something or someone in the direction of the one pulling, which can have a literal or spiritual meaning. 1. To pull or drag a heavy object or net (John 21:6). | 2. To draw spiritually toward Christ by divine power (John 12:32).

DEFINITION: A geographical region of the Balkan Peninsula known as Greece. In the Roman period, it was frequently associated with or administratively superimposed upon the province of Achaia.
SENSES: 1. The region of Greece visited by Paul during his missionary journeys (Acts 20:2).

THAYER.pt: Região geográfica da península balcânica conhecida como Grécia. No período romano, era frequentemente associada ou sobreposta administrativamente à província da Acaia. 1. a região da Grécia visitada por Paulo durante suas viagens missionárias (At 20.2).
THAYER.en: A geographical region of the Balkan Peninsula known as Greece. In the Roman period, it was frequently associated with or administratively superimposed upon the province of Achaia. 1. The region of Greece visited by Paul during his missionary journeys (Acts 20:2).

DEFINITION: Originally refers to a person of Greek culture, but in the NT it frequently designates Gentiles in contrast to Jews.
SENSES: 1. An ethnic or cultural Greek (Acts 18:17; Rom 1:14).
2. In a broad sense, any non-Jew or Gentile (John 12:20; Acts 14:1).

THAYER.pt: Originalmente refere-se a uma pessoa de cultura grega, mas no NT frequentemente designa os gentios em contraste com os judeus. 1. Um grego étnico ou cultural (At 18.17; Rm 1.14). | 2. Em sentido amplo, qualquer não-judeu ou gentio (Jo 12.20; At 14.1).
THAYER.en: Originally refers to a person of Greek culture, but in the NT it frequently designates Gentiles in contrast to Jews. 1. An ethnic or cultural Greek (Acts 18:17; Rom 1:14). | 2. In a broad sense, any non-Jew or Gentile (John 12:20; Acts 14:1).

DEFINITION: Belonging or relating to the culture, language, or people of Greece.
SENSES: 1. The language or characteristic elements of Greek culture (Luke 23:38; Rev 9:11).

THAYER.pt: Pertencente ou relativo à cultura, língua ou povo da Grécia. 1. O idioma ou os elementos característicos da cultura grega (Lc 23.38; Ap 9.11).
THAYER.en: Belonging or relating to the culture, language, or people of Greece. 1. The language or characteristic elements of Greek culture (Luke 23:38; Rev 9:11).

DEFINITION: A woman of Greek origin or culture, frequently used in the sense of a Gentile (non-Jewish) woman.
SENSES: 1. A Greek woman or one of Hellenic culture (Mark 7:26; Acts 17:12).

THAYER.pt: Mulher de origem ou cultura grega, frequentemente utilizada no sentido de gentia (não-judaica). 1. Mulher grega ou de cultura helênica (Mc 7.26; Ac 17.12).
THAYER.en: A woman of Greek origin or culture, frequently used in the sense of a Gentile (non-Jewish) woman. 1. A Greek woman or one of Hellenic culture (Mark 7:26; Acts 17:12).

DEFINITION: Designates a Greek-speaking Jew, culturally influenced by Hellenism, in contrast to Semitic-speaking Jews.
SENSES: 1. A Greek-speaking Jew in the early Christian community (Acts 6:1; 9:29; 11:20).

THAYER.pt: Designa um judeu de fala grega, culturalmente influenciado pelo helenismo, em contraste com os judeus de língua semítica. 1. Judeu de língua grega na comunidade cristã primitiva (At 6.1; 9.29; 11.20).
THAYER.en: Designates a Greek-speaking Jew, culturally influenced by Hellenism, in contrast to Semitic-speaking Jews. 1. A Greek-speaking Jew in the early Christian community (Acts 6:1; 9:29; 11:20).

DEFINITION: A mode of expression that specifically utilizes the Greek language.
SENSES: 1. To communicate or write in the Greek language (John 19:20; Acts 21:37).

THAYER.pt: Modo de expressão que utiliza especificamente a língua grega. 1. Comunicar-se ou redigir no idioma grego (Jo 19.20; Ac 21.37).
THAYER.en: A mode of expression that specifically utilizes the Greek language. 1. To communicate or write in the Greek language (John 19:20; Acts 21:37).

DEFINITION: A commercial and metaphorical term for recording a debt or financial obligation to someone's account.
SENSES: 1. To charge or debit something to another's account (Rom 5:13; Phlm 18).

THAYER.pt: Termo comercial e metafórico para registrar uma dívida ou obrigação financeira na conta de alguém. 1. Cobrar ou debitar algo na conta de outrem (Rm 5.13; Fm 18).
THAYER.en: A commercial and metaphorical term for recording a debt or financial obligation to someone's account. 1. To charge or debit something to another's account (Rom 5:13; Phlm 18).

DEFINITION: A masculine proper name of Semitic origin that is part of the human genealogy of Jesus Christ presented in the third Gospel.
SENSES: 1. An ancestor of Jesus in the lineage of Luke (Luke 3:28).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio masculino de origem semítica que integra a genealogia humana de Jesus Cristo apresentada no terceiro evangelho. 1. ancestral de Jesus na linhagem de Lucas (Lc 3.28).
THAYER.en: A masculine proper name of Semitic origin that is part of the human genealogy of Jesus Christ presented in the third Gospel. 1. An ancestor of Jesus in the lineage of Luke (Luke 3:28).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: ἐλπιῶ, Aor: ἤλπισα, Perf: ἤλπικα
DEFINITION: To await the future with a confident and firm expectation that good and divine promises will be fulfilled.
SENSES: 1. To have firm hope and trust in something future and beneficial (Rom 8:24; 1 Cor 13:7).
2. To await or expect something based on circumstances or agreements (Luke 6:34).

THAYER.pt: Aguardar o futuro com uma expectativa confiante e firme de que o bem e as promessas divinas se cumprirão. 1. Ter esperança firme e confiança em algo futuro e benéfico (Rm 8.24; 1Co 13.7). | 2. Aguardar ou esperar algo com base em circunstâncias ou acordos (Lc 6.34).
THAYER.en: To await the future with a confident and firm expectation that good and divine promises will be fulfilled. 1. To have firm hope and trust in something future and beneficial (Rom 8:24; 1 Cor 13:7). | 2. To await or expect something based on circumstances or agreements (Luke 6:34).

DEFINITION: A firm and confident expectation regarding the future based on divine promises. In the New Testament, it does not denote uncertainty or mere desire, but certainty grounded in the character of God.
SENSES: 1. The inner attitude of confident expectation and living hope (1 Cor 9:10; Rom 4:18; Acts 16:19).
2. The basis or foundation upon which trust rests (1 Thess 2:19; 1 Tim 1:1).
3. The object or future reality that one expects to obtain (Rom 8:24; Col 1:5; Titus 2:13).

THAYER.pt: Expectativa firme e confiante em relação ao futuro baseada nas promessas divinas. No Novo Testamento, não denota incerteza ou mero desejo, mas certeza fundamentada no caráter de Deus. 1. A atitude interior de expectativa confiante e esperança viva (1Co 9.10; Rm 4.18; At 16.19). | 2. A base ou fundamento sobre o qual repousa a confiança (1Ts 2.19; 1Tm 1.1). | 3. O objeto ou realidade futura que se espera obter (Rm 8.24; Cl 1.5; Tt 2.13).
THAYER.en: A firm and confident expectation regarding the future based on divine promises. In the New Testament, it does not denote uncertainty or mere desire, but certainty grounded in the character of God. 1. The inner attitude of confident expectation and living hope (1 Cor 9:10; Rom 4:18; Acts 16:19). | 2. The basis or foundation upon which trust rests (1 Thess 2:19; 1 Tim 1:1). | 3. The object or future reality that one expects to obtain (Rom 8:24; Col 1:5; Titus 2:13).

DEFINITION: The name or title of a Jewish magician and false prophet on the island of Cyprus, whose opposition to the apostle Paul resulted in his temporary blindness.
SENSES: 1. The magician Elymas, also called Bar-Jesus (Acts 13:8).

THAYER.pt: Nome ou título de um mago e falso profeta judeu na ilha de Chipre, cuja oposição ao apóstolo Paulo resultou em sua cegueira temporária. 1. o mago Elimas, também chamado Bar-Jesus (At 13.8).
THAYER.en: The name or title of a Jewish magician and false prophet on the island of Cyprus, whose opposition to the apostle Paul resulted in his temporary blindness. 1. The magician Elymas, also called Bar-Jesus (Acts 13:8).

DEFINITION: A transliteration of an Aramaic expression meaning 'my God'.
SENSES: 1. A cry of anguish directed to God on the cross ('Eloi, Eloi...') (Matt 27:46; Mark 15:34).

THAYER.pt: Transliteração de uma expressão aramaica que significa 'meu Deus'. 1. Clamo de angústia dirigido a Deus na cruz ('Eloi, Eloi...') (Mt 27.46; Mc 15.34).
THAYER.en: A transliteration of an Aramaic expression meaning 'my God'. 1. A cry of anguish directed to God on the cross ('Eloi, Eloi...') (Matt 27:46; Mark 15:34).

DEFINITION: A first-person singular reflexive pronoun, used to indicate that the action falls upon the speaker themselves.
SENSES: 1. To oneself, referring directly to the subject who is speaking (1 Cor 10:33; John 14:21).

THAYER.pt: Pronome reflexivo de primeira pessoa do singular, usado para indicar que a ação recai sobre o próprio locutor. 1. A si mesmo, referindo-se diretamente ao sujeito que fala (1Co 10.33; Jo 14.21).
THAYER.en: A first-person singular reflexive pronoun, used to indicate that the action falls upon the speaker themselves. 1. To oneself, referring directly to the subject who is speaking (1 Cor 10:33; John 14:21).

DEFINITION: Means to take a step into a delimited space or to board a waterborne means of transport. It is frequently used in the Gospels when Jesus and the disciples enter a boat.
SENSES: 1. To embark or enter a boat or ship (Matt 8:23; Luke 5:3).
2. To enter or step into a specific area (Acts 21:6).

THAYER.pt: Significa dar um passo para dentro de um espaço delimitado ou embarcar em um meio de transporte aquático. É frequentemente usado nos Evangelhos quando Jesus e os discípulos entram em um barco. 1. Embarcar ou entrar em um barco ou navio (Mt 8.23; Lc 5.3). | 2. Entrar ou pisar em uma área específica (At 21.6).
THAYER.en: Means to take a step into a delimited space or to board a waterborne means of transport. It is frequently used in the Gospels when Jesus and the disciples enter a boat. 1. To embark or enter a boat or ship (Matt 8:23; Luke 5:3). | 2. To enter or step into a specific area (Acts 21:6).

DEFINITION: To throw, place, or cast something or someone into a specific space or place, often with a connotation of imposition or force.
SENSES: 1. To cast or throw someone into Gehenna or fire (Luke 12:5).

THAYER.pt: Atirar, colocar ou precipitar algo ou alguém dentro de um determinado espaço ou lugar, frequentemente com conotação de imposição ou força. 1. lançar ou precipitar alguém na geena ou no fogo (Lc 12.5).
THAYER.en: To throw, place, or cast something or someone into a specific space or place, often with a connotation of imposition or force. 1. To cast or throw someone into Gehenna or fire (Luke 12:5).

DEFINITION: The act of introducing or submerging an object into a liquid.
SENSES: 1. To dip food into a sauce or liquid (Matt 26:23).

THAYER.pt: Ato de introduzir ou submergir um objeto em um líquido. 1. Mergulhar um alimento em um molho ou líquido (Mt 26.23).
THAYER.en: The act of introducing or submerging an object into a liquid. 1. To dip food into a sauce or liquid (Matt 26:23).

DEFINITION: A term of complex meaning in ancient Greek, which can denote the act of setting foot in a place, taking possession, or minutely investigating hidden and visionary things.
SENSES: 1. To intrude presumptuously into visions or speculative mysteries (Col 2:18).

THAYER.pt: Termo de significado complexo no grego antigo, podendo denotar o ato de pôr os pés em um lugar, tomar posse ou investigar minuciosamente coisas ocultas e visionárias. 1. intrometer-se presunçosamente em visões ou mistérios especulativos (Col 2.18).
THAYER.en: A term of complex meaning in ancient Greek, which can denote the act of setting foot in a place, taking possession, or minutely investigating hidden and visionary things. 1. To intrude presumptuously into visions or speculative mysteries (Col 2:18).

DEFINITION: To cause someone to enter a means of transport, especially to lead passengers or crew into a ship.
SENSES: 1. To put people on board a vessel, to cause to embark (Acts 27:6).

THAYER.pt: Fazer com que alguém entre em algum meio de transporte, especialmente conduzir passageiros ou tripulantes para dentro de um navio. 1. colocar pessoas a bordo de uma embarcação, fazer embarcar (At 27.6).
THAYER.en: To cause someone to enter a means of transport, especially to lead passengers or crew into a ship. 1. To put people on board a vessel, to cause to embark (Acts 27:6).

DEFINITION: To direct one's vision and attention in a direct and intentional manner toward someone or something, often with deep observation.
SENSES: 1. To look fixedly or with deep attention at an object or person (Mark 10:21; Luke 22:61).
2. To discern or see something with spiritual clarity (Mark 8:25).

THAYER.pt: Dirigir a visão e a atenção de maneira direta e intencional para alguém ou algo, muitas vezes com profunda observação. 1. Olhar fixamente ou com atenção profunda para um objeto ou pessoa (Mc 10:21; Lc 22:61). | 2. Discernir ou enxergar algo com clareza espiritual (Mc 8:25).
THAYER.en: To direct one's vision and attention in a direct and intentional manner toward someone or something, often with deep observation. 1. To look fixedly or with deep attention at an object or person (Mark 10:21; Luke 22:61). | 2. To discern or see something with spiritual clarity (Mark 8:25).

DEFINITION: Expresses a deep and intense emotion, often accompanied by indignation, strong censure, or severe admonition.
SENSES: 1. To give a severe order or warn with firmness (Mark 1:43; Matt 9:30).
2. To feel deep inner commotion or indignation (John 11:38).

THAYER.pt: Expressa uma emoção profunda e intensa, muitas vezes acompanhada de indignação, forte censura ou severa admoestação. 1. Dar uma ordem severa ou advertir com firmeza (Mc 1.43; Mt 9.30). | 2. Sentir profunda comoção ou indignação interior (Jo 11.38).
THAYER.en: Expresses a deep and intense emotion, often accompanied by indignation, strong censure, or severe admonition. 1. To give a severe order or warn with firmness (Mark 1:43; Matt 9:30). | 2. To feel deep inner commotion or indignation (John 11:38).

DEFINITION: A first-person personal pronoun in the accusative case, used to indicate the direct object of the verbal action in relation to the speaker themselves.
SENSES: 1. Direct object referring to the speaker (John 17:24).

THAYER.pt: Pronome pessoal de primeira pessoa no caso acusativo, usado para indicar o objeto direto da ação verbal em relação ao próprio falante. 1. Objeto direto referindo-se ao falante (Jo 17.24).
THAYER.en: A first-person personal pronoun in the accusative case, used to indicate the direct object of the verbal action in relation to the speaker themselves. 1. Direct object referring to the speaker (John 17:24).

DEFINITION: To eliminate the contents of the stomach through the mouth due to nausea or disgust; figuratively, to reject with extreme aversion.
SENSES: 1. To expel or reject someone from the mouth due to spiritual repulsion (Rev 3:16).

THAYER.pt: Eliminar o conteúdo do estômago pela boca devido a náusea ou repugnância; no sentido figurado, rejeitar com aversão extrema. 1. expulsar ou rejeitar alguém da boca por causa de repulsa espiritual (Ap 3.16).
THAYER.en: To eliminate the contents of the stomach through the mouth due to nausea or disgust; figuratively, to reject with extreme aversion. 1. To expel or reject someone from the mouth due to spiritual repulsion (Rev 3:16).

DEFINITION: To be seized by such intense and uncontrolled anger that one appears mentally unbalanced or driven by madness against someone.
SENSES: 1. To demonstrate extreme fury and persecutory zeal against someone (Acts 26:11).

THAYER.pt: Estar tomado por uma ira tão intensa e descontrolada a ponto de parecer mentalmente desequilibrado ou tomado pela loucura contra alguém. 1. demonstrar fúria extrema e sanha persecutória contra alguém (At 26.11).
THAYER.en: To be seized by such intense and uncontrolled anger that one appears mentally unbalanced or driven by madness against someone. 1. To demonstrate extreme fury and persecutory zeal against someone (Acts 26:11).

DEFINITION: A Hebrew prophetic title transliterated into Greek, explicitly translated as 'God with us', applied to the Messiah.
SENSES: 1. The prophetic name given to Jesus, signifying the saving presence of God with humanity (Matt 1:23).

THAYER.pt: Título profético hebraico transliterado para o grego, traduzido explicitamente como 'Deus conosco', aplicado ao Messias. 1. o nome profético dado a Jesus, significando a presença salvadora de Deus com a humanidade (Mt 1.23).
THAYER.en: A Hebrew prophetic title transliterated into Greek, explicitly translated as 'God with us', applied to the Messiah. 1. The prophetic name given to Jesus, signifying the saving presence of God with humanity (Matt 1:23).

DEFINITION: The name of a village situated in Judea, located at a distance of approximately sixty stadia (about 11 kilometers) from Jerusalem.
SENSES: 1. The village to which two disciples were traveling on the day of the resurrection (Luke 24:13).

THAYER.pt: Nome de uma aldeia situada na Judeia, localizada a uma distância aproximada de sessenta estádios (cerca de 11 quilômetros) de Jerusalém. 1. a vila para onde se dirigiam dois discípulos no dia da ressurreição (Lc 24.13).
THAYER.en: The name of a village situated in Judea, located at a distance of approximately sixty stadia (about 11 kilometers) from Jerusalem. 1. The village to which two disciples were traveling on the day of the resurrection (Luke 24:13).

DEFINITION: A verb denoting the attitude of holding firm to a condition, commitment, covenant, or location over time.
SENSES: 1. To continue in a physical place (Acts 28:30).
2. To persevere or remain faithful to a law, covenant, or faith (Acts 14:22; Gal 3:10).

THAYER.pt: Verbo que denota a atitude de manter-se firme em uma condição, compromisso, aliança ou local ao longo do tempo. 1. Continuar em um lugar físico (At 28:30). | 2. Perseverar ou manter-se fiel a uma lei, aliança ou fé (At 14:22; Gl 3:10).
THAYER.en: A verb denoting the attitude of holding firm to a condition, commitment, covenant, or location over time. 1. To continue in a physical place (Acts 28:30). | 2. To persevere or remain faithful to a law, covenant, or faith (Acts 14:22; Gal 3:10).

DEFINITION: The proper name of a Hivite leader from the Old Testament, father of Shechem, associated with the purchase of land in Shechem.
SENSES: 1. A patriarchal figure mentioned in Stephen's historical discourse (Acts 7:16).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio de um líder heveu do Antigo Testamento, pai de Siquém, associado à compra de terras em Siquém. 1. figura patriarcal mencionada no discurso histórico de Estêvão (At 7.16).
THAYER.en: The proper name of a Hivite leader from the Old Testament, father of Shechem, associated with the purchase of land in Shechem. 1. A patriarchal figure mentioned in Stephen's historical discourse (Acts 7:16).

DEFINITION: A first-person personal pronoun in the dative case, indicating the beneficiary, instrument, or location in relation to the speaker.
SENSES: 1. Indirect object or dative of advantage/disadvantage (Gal 6:14).

THAYER.pt: Pronome pessoal de primeira pessoa no caso dativo, indicando o beneficiário, o instrumento ou a localização em relação ao falante. 1. Objeto indireto ou dativo de vantagem/desvantagem (Gl 6.14).
THAYER.en: A first-person personal pronoun in the dative case, indicating the beneficiary, instrument, or location in relation to the speaker. 1. Indirect object or dative of advantage/disadvantage (Gal 6:14).

DEFINITION: A first-person singular possessive pronoun used to indicate possession, origin, direct relationship, or authority belonging to the speaker.
SENSES: 1. Indicates possession or direct ownership: my, that which belongs to me (John 7:16; John 18:36).
2. Used with the value of an objective genitive in 'my memory' (Luke 22:19; 1 Cor 11:24).

THAYER.pt: Pronome possessivo da primeira pessoa do singular empregado para indicar posse, origem, relação direta ou autoridade pertencente ao falante. 1. Indica posse ou propriedade direta: meu, aquilo que me pertence (Jo 7.16; Jo 18.36). | 2. Usado com valor de genitivo objetivo em minha memória (Lc 22.19; 1Co 11.24).
THAYER.en: A first-person singular possessive pronoun used to indicate possession, origin, direct relationship, or authority belonging to the speaker. 1. Indicates possession or direct ownership: my, that which belongs to me (John 7:16; John 18:36). | 2. Used with the value of an objective genitive in 'my memory' (Luke 22:19; 1 Cor 11:24).

DEFINITION: A first-person personal pronoun in the genitive case, expressing possession, origin, or relationship with the speaker.
SENSES: 1. Genitive of possession or relationship with the speaker (Matt 3:17).

THAYER.pt: Pronome pessoal de primeira pessoa no caso genitivo, expressando posse, procedência ou relação com o falante. 1. Genitivo de posse ou relação com o falante (Mt 3.17).
THAYER.en: A first-person personal pronoun in the genitive case, expressing possession, origin, or relationship with the speaker. 1. Genitive of possession or relationship with the speaker (Matt 3:17).

DEFINITION: A verbal or physical expression of contempt, mockery, and derision against someone.
SENSES: 1. Suffering through mocking and injurious derision (Heb 11:36).

THAYER.pt: Expressão verbal ou física de desprezo, zombaria e escárnio contra alguém. 1. Sofrimento por zombaria e escárnio injuriante (Hb 11.36).
THAYER.en: A verbal or physical expression of contempt, mockery, and derision against someone. 1. Suffering through mocking and injurious derision (Heb 11:36).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: ἐμπαίξω, Aor: ἐνέπαιξα, Perf: ἐμπέπαιχα
DEFINITION: To treat someone with derision, mockery, or disrespect, whether by words or actions. It can also denote the act of deluding or deceiving someone.
SENSES: 1. To subject someone to mockery, to deride, or to make light of (Matt 27:29; Luke 22:63).
2. To deceive or cunningly delude someone (Matt 2:16).

THAYER.pt: Significa tratar alguém com escárnio, zombaria ou desrespeito, seja por palavras ou ações. Pode denotar também o ato de iludir ou enganar alguém. 1. Submeter alguém à zombaria, escarnecer ou fazer pouco caso (Mt 27.29; Lc 22.63). | 2. Enganar ou iludir astutamente alguém (Mt 2.16).
THAYER.en: To treat someone with derision, mockery, or disrespect, whether by words or actions. It can also denote the act of deluding or deceiving someone. 1. To subject someone to mockery, to deride, or to make light of (Matt 27:29; Luke 22:63). | 2. To deceive or cunningly delude someone (Matt 2:16).

DEFINITION: One who mocks, ironizes, or scoffs at beliefs, values, or people.
SENSES: 1. An individual who mocks the faith and divine promises (Jude 18).

THAYER.pt: Aquele que zomba, ironiza ou escarnece de crenças, valores ou pessoas. 1. Indivíduo que zomba da fé e das promessas divinas (Jd 18).
THAYER.en: One who mocks, ironizes, or scoffs at beliefs, values, or people. 1. An individual who mocks the faith and divine promises (Jude 18).

DEFINITION: To walk or circulate within an area; in a figurative and biblical sense, to conduct one's life and actively dwell in the midst of a group of people.
SENSES: 1. To live, dwell, and relate intimately in the midst of one's people (2 Cor 6:16).

THAYER.pt: Caminhar ou circular no interior de uma área; no sentido figurado e bíblico, conduzir a vida e habitar ativamente no meio de um grupo de pessoas. 1. viver, habitar e relacionar-se intimamente no meio do seu povo (2Co 6.16).
THAYER.en: To walk or circulate within an area; in a figurative and biblical sense, to conduct one's life and actively dwell in the midst of a group of people. 1. To live, dwell, and relate intimately in the midst of one's people (2 Cor 6:16).

DEFINITION: To supply someone or something with abundance, completely fulfilling physical or spiritual needs.
SENSES: 1. To satisfy hunger, supply with abundance, or fill the heart with joy.

THAYER.pt: Significa suprir alguém ou algo com abundância, preenchendo completamente necessidades físicas ou espirituais. 1. Saciar a fome, suprir com fartura ou preencher o coração com alegria.
THAYER.en: To supply someone or something with abundance, completely fulfilling physical or spiritual needs. 1. To satisfy hunger, supply with abundance, or fill the heart with joy.

DEFINITION: To fall physically into a bounded space or to suddenly experience a difficult or dangerous situation.
SENSES: 1. To fall into a physical place (Matt 12:11).
2. To fall into trials or traps (Luke 10:36; 1 Tim 6:9).

THAYER.pt: Cair fisicamente em um local delimitado ou experimentar de forma súbita uma situação difícil ou perigosa. 1. Cair dentro de um lugar físico (Mt 12:11). | 2. Cair em provações ou armadilhas (Lc 10:36; 1Tm 6:9).
THAYER.en: To fall physically into a bounded space or to suddenly experience a difficult or dangerous situation. 1. To fall into a physical place (Matt 12:11). | 2. To fall into trials or traps (Luke 10:36; 1 Tim 6:9).

DEFINITION: To become trapped, intertwined, or involved in occupations that hinder freedom of action.
SENSES: 1. To become excessively involved in secular affairs to the point of hindering service to God (2 Tim 2:4).

THAYER.pt: Ficar preso, entrelaçado ou envolvido em ocupações que dificultam a liberdade de ação. 1. Envolver-se excessivamente em assuntos seculares a ponto de atrapalhar o serviço a Deus (2Tm 2.4).
THAYER.en: To become trapped, intertwined, or involved in occupations that hinder freedom of action. 1. To become excessively involved in secular affairs to the point of hindering service to God (2 Tim 2:4).

DEFINITION: The act or result of intertwining strands, specifically applied to the elaborate hairstyle or braiding of hair with ornaments.
SENSES: 1. The hairstyle elaborated through artificial or ostentatious braids (1 Pet 3:3).

THAYER.pt: O ato ou o resultado de entrelaçar fios, especificamente aplicado ao elaborado penteado ou trançado dos cabelos com adornos. 1. o penteado elaborado por meio de tranças artificiais ou ostentosas (1Pe 3.3).
THAYER.en: The act or result of intertwining strands, specifically applied to the elaborate hairstyle or braiding of hair with ornaments. 1. The hairstyle elaborated through artificial or ostentatious braids (1 Pet 3:3).

DEFINITION: To emit breath or air; in metaphorical and intensive usage, to exhale or overflow with aggressive feelings or visceral threats.
SENSES: 1. To breathe or overflow with threats and fury against someone (Acts 9:1).

THAYER.pt: Emitir respiração ou ar; no uso metafórico e intensivo, exalar ou transbordar sentimentos agressivos ou ameaças viscerais. 1. respirar ou transbordar ameaças e fúria contra alguém (At 9.1).
THAYER.en: To emit breath or air; in metaphorical and intensive usage, to exhale or overflow with aggressive feelings or visceral threats. 1. To breathe or overflow with threats and fury against someone (Acts 9:1).

DEFINITION: To practice commercial activities of buying and selling, which can take on the sense of dishonest exploitation.
SENSES: 1. To conduct business of buying and selling and mercantile travel (Jas 4:13).
2. To exploit people out of greed through deception (2 Pet 2:3).

THAYER.pt: Praticar atividades comerciais de compra e venda, podendo assumir sentido de exploração desonesta. 1. Conduzir negócios de compra e venda e viagens mercantis (Tg 4.13). | 2. Explorar pessoas por ganância através de engano (2Pe 2.3).
THAYER.en: To practice commercial activities of buying and selling, which can take on the sense of dishonest exploitation. 1. To conduct business of buying and selling and mercantile travel (Jas 4:13). | 2. To exploit people out of greed through deception (2 Pet 2:3).

DEFINITION: Economic activity aimed at the transaction of goods, the exercise of trade, or profitable business.
SENSES: 1. Commercial occupation or secular business enterprise (Matt 22:5).

THAYER.pt: A atividade econômica voltada para a transação de mercadorias, o exercício do comércio ou negócios lucrativos. 1. ocupação comercial ou empreendimento de negócios seculares (Mt 22.5).
THAYER.en: Economic activity aimed at the transaction of goods, the exercise of trade, or profitable business. 1. Commercial occupation or secular business enterprise (Matt 22:5).

DEFINITION: A physical location designated for commercial transactions, a fair or marketplace where goods are bought and sold.
SENSES: 1. A market or center of trade, used metaphorically by Jesus for the temple turned into a marketplace (John 2:16).

THAYER.pt: Local físico destinado a transações comerciais, feira ou mercado onde mercadorias são compradas e vendidas. 1. mercado ou centro de comércio, usado metaforicamente por Jesus para o templo transformado em feira (Jo 2.16).
THAYER.en: A physical location designated for commercial transactions, a fair or marketplace where goods are bought and sold. 1. A market or center of trade, used metaphorically by Jesus for the temple turned into a marketplace (John 2:16).

DEFINITION: Designates a person who travels, especially by ship, to conduct commercial transactions and business.
SENSES: 1. A merchant who travels for the purpose of trade (Matt 13:45; Rev 18:3).

THAYER.pt: Designa uma pessoa que viaja, especialmente por navio, para realizar transações comerciais e negócios. 1. Um mercador que viaja para fins de comércio (Mt 13.45; Ap 18.3).
THAYER.en: Designates a person who travels, especially by ship, to conduct commercial transactions and business. 1. A merchant who travels for the purpose of trade (Matt 13:45; Rev 18:3).

SHORT_GLOSS: to set on fire, to burn
DEFINITION: To consume entirely by means of fire, to set ablaze, or to destroy through flames.
SENSES: 1. To set on fire and destroy villages, cities, or property (cf. Matt 22:7).
USAGE: to set on fire, to burn

THAYER.pt: Consumir totalmente por meio do fogo, incendiar ou destruir através de chamas. 1. incendiar e destruir vilas, cidades ou propriedades (cf. Mt 22.7).
THAYER.en: To consume entirely by means of fire, to set ablaze, or to destroy through flames. 1. To set on fire and destroy villages, cities, or property (cf. Matt 22:7).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Adverb and improper preposition governing the genitive
SHORT_GLOSS: before, in front of, in the presence
DEFINITION: An adverb or preposition describing a position situated in front of something or someone, or the conscious presence and testimony before a human or divine authority.
SENSES: 1. Spatial position: in front of, before (Matt 5:24; Matt 6:2; Luke 5:19).
2. In the presence of, before the eyes of God or men (Matt 10:32; Luke 12:8; 2 Cor 5:10).
3. Ahead of, preceding on the way (John 10:4).
USAGE: before, in front of, in the presence

THAYER.pt: Advérbio ou preposição que descreve uma posição situada em frente a algo ou alguém, ou a presença e o testemunho consciente diante de uma autoridade humana ou divina. 1. Posição espacial: em frente de, perante (Mt 5.24; Mt 6.2; Lc 5.19). | 2. Na presença de, diante dos olhos de Deus ou de homens (Mt 10.32; Lc 12.8; 2Co 5.10). | 3. À frente de, precedendo no caminho (Jo 10.4).
THAYER.en: An adverb or preposition describing a position situated in front of something or someone, or the conscious presence and testimony before a human or divine authority. 1. Spatial position: in front of, before (Matt 5:24; Matt 6:2; Luke 5:19). | 2. In the presence of, before the eyes of God or men (Matt 10:32; Luke 12:8; 2 Cor 5:10). | 3. Ahead of, preceding on the way (John 10:4).

DEFINITION: Indicates the physical act of spitting on someone as a supreme sign of contempt, mockery, and humiliation.
SENSES: 1. To spit in the face or upon someone (Mark 10:34; Mark 14:65; Mark 15:19).

THAYER.pt: Indica o ato físico de cuspir em alguém como sinal supremo de desprezo, escárnio e humilhação. 1. Cuspir no rosto ou sobre alguém (Mc 10:34; Mc 14:65; Mc 15:19).
THAYER.en: Indicates the physical act of spitting on someone as a supreme sign of contempt, mockery, and humiliation. 1. To spit in the face or upon someone (Mark 10:34; Mark 14:65; Mark 15:19).

DEFINITION: That which becomes clearly visible, evident, or manifested to public knowledge.
SENSES: 1. To become visible or publicly manifest (Acts 10:40; Rom 10:20).

THAYER.pt: Aquilo que se torna claramente visível, evidente ou manifestado ao conhecimento público. 1. Tornar-se visível ou manifesto publicamente (At 10.40; Rm 10.20).
THAYER.en: That which becomes clearly visible, evident, or manifested to public knowledge. 1. To become visible or publicly manifest (Acts 10:40; Rom 10:20).

DEFINITION: To make something visible and evident to the senses, or to formally report and declare information before authorities.
SENSES: 1. To make visible, manifest, or reveal clearly (John 14:22; Heb 9:24).
2. To inform, denounce, or present a formal accusation before courts (Acts 23:22; 24:1).

THAYER.pt: Significa tornar algo visível e evidente aos sentidos, ou relatar e declarar formalmente uma informação perante autoridades. 1. Tornar visível, manifestar ou revelar claramente (Jo 14.22; Hb 9.24). | 2. Informar, denunciar ou apresentar acusação formal perante tribunais (At 23.22; 24.1).
THAYER.en: To make something visible and evident to the senses, or to formally report and declare information before authorities. 1. To make visible, manifest, or reveal clearly (John 14:22; Heb 9:24). | 2. To inform, denounce, or present a formal accusation before courts (Acts 23:22; 24:1).

DEFINITION: Describes the state of someone who is seized by intense dread, fright, or deep fear.
SENSES: 1. To be extremely frightened or seized with panic in the face of an extraordinary manifestation (Luke 24:5).

THAYER.pt: Descreve o estado de alguém que se encontra tomado por intenso pavor, susto ou temor profundo. 1. Estar extremamente assustado ou tomado de pânico diante de uma manifestação extraordinária (Lc 24.5).
THAYER.en: Describes the state of someone who is seized by intense dread, fright, or deep fear. 1. To be extremely frightened or seized with panic in the face of an extraordinary manifestation (Luke 24:5).

DEFINITION: The act of blowing air directly upon someone or something, a gesture symbolizing the transmission of power, spirit, or life.
SENSES: 1. To breathe upon the disciples to confer the Holy Spirit (John 20:22).

THAYER.pt: O ato de soprar ar diretamente sobre alguém ou alguma coisa, gesto que simboliza a transmissão de poder, espírito ou vida. 1. soprar sobre os discípulos para conferir o Espírito Santo (Jo 20.22).
THAYER.en: The act of blowing air directly upon someone or something, a gesture symbolizing the transmission of power, spirit, or life. 1. To breathe upon the disciples to confer the Holy Spirit (John 20:22).

DEFINITION: That which is naturally inherent, rooted, or firmly planted in someone's nature.
SENSES: 1. The word of God implanted in the soul and capable of saving (James 1:21).

THAYER.pt: Aquilo que é naturalmente inerente, enraizado ou firmemente plantado na natureza de alguém. 1. a palavra de Deus implantada na alma e capaz de salvar (Tg 1.21).
THAYER.en: That which is naturally inherent, rooted, or firmly planted in someone's nature. 1. The word of God implanted in the soul and capable of saving (James 1:21).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Preposition governing only the dative case
DEFINITION: An extremely frequent preposition indicating static location in a space or temporal period. It developed important theological and instrumental uses in the New Testament, such as the sphere of spiritual union ('in Christ').
SENSES: 1. Local spatial: 'in', 'within', 'among' (Matt 2:1; John 1:10).
2. Theological of union or sphere of existence, especially 'in Christ' (Rom 8:1; Eph 1:3).
3. Instrumental, of means or cause ('by means of', 'with') (Matt 9:34; Rom 5:9).
4. Temporal: 'during', 'in' (John 2:19; 1 Thess 5:2).

THAYER.pt: Preposição extremamente frequente que indica localização estática em um espaço ou período temporal. Desenvolveu importantes usos teológicos e instrumentais no Novo Testamento, como na esfera de união espiritual ('em Cristo'). 1. Espacial local: 'em', 'dentro de', 'entre' (Mt 2.1; Jo 1.10). | 2. Teológico de união ou esfera de existência, especialmente 'em Cristo' (Rm 8.1; Ef 1.3). | 3. Instrumental, de meio ou causa ('por meio de', 'com') (Mt 9.34; Rm 5.9). | 4. Temporal: 'durante', 'em' (Jo 2.19; 1Ts 5.2).
THAYER.en: An extremely frequent preposition indicating static location in a space or temporal period. It developed important theological and instrumental uses in the New Testament, such as the sphere of spiritual union ('in Christ'). 1. Local spatial: 'in', 'within', 'among' (Matt 2:1; John 1:10). | 2. Theological of union or sphere of existence, especially 'in Christ' (Rom 8:1; Eph 1:3). | 3. Instrumental, of means or cause ('by means of', 'with') (Matt 9:34; Rom 5:9). | 4. Temporal: 'during', 'in' (John 2:19; 1 Thess 5:2).

SHORT_GLOSS: to embrace, to take in arms
DEFINITION: The act of enveloping someone with the arms as a demonstration of affection, fondness, and welcome.
SENSES: 1. To welcome and embrace someone affectionately in the arms (Mark 9:36; 10:16).
USAGE: to embrace, to take in arms

THAYER.pt: Ato de envolver alguém com os braços como demonstração de carinho, afeto e acolhimento. 1. Acolher e abraçar afetuosamente alguém nos braços (Mc 9.36; 10.16).
THAYER.en: The act of enveloping someone with the arms as a demonstration of affection, fondness, and welcome. 1. To welcome and embrace someone affectionately in the arms (Mark 9:36; 10:16).

DEFINITION: That which belongs to the sea, which lives or originates in marine waters.
SENSES: 1. Creatures or beings that inhabit the marine environment (cf. James 3:7).

THAYER.pt: Que pertence ao mar, que vive ou se origina nas águas marinhas. 1. criaturas ou seres que habitam o ambiente marinho (cf. Tg 3.7).
THAYER.en: That which belongs to the sea, which lives or originates in marine waters. 1. Creatures or beings that inhabit the marine environment (cf. James 3:7).

DEFINITION: Indicates physical frontal position or, metaphorically, the point of view and judgment in someone's concept.
SENSES: 1. Physical location in front of an object or person (Luke 1:8).
2. Before the judgment or in the opinion of someone (Acts 8:21).

THAYER.pt: Indica posição frontal física ou, metaforicamente, o ponto de vista e julgamento no conceito de alguém. 1. Localização física em frente a um objeto ou pessoa (Lc 1.8). | 2. Perante o julgamento ou na opinião de alguém (At 8.21).
THAYER.en: Indicates physical frontal position or, metaphorically, the point of view and judgment in someone's concept. 1. Physical location in front of an object or person (Luke 1:8). | 2. Before the judgment or in the opinion of someone (Acts 8:21).

SHORT_GLOSS: before, in front of, in presence of
DEFINITION: Used spatially to indicate frontal position in relation to someone, or figuratively to denote judgment in a person's perspective.
SENSES: 1. In the physical presence of or before someone (Luke 20:26; Acts 8:32).
2. In the judgment or perspective of someone (Luke 1:6; Acts 7:10).
USAGE: before, in front of, in presence of

THAYER.pt: Utilizado espacialmente para indicar a posição frontal em relação a alguém, ou figurativamente para denotar julgamento na perspectiva de uma pessoa. 1. Na presença física ou diante de alguém (Lc 20.26; At 8.32). | 2. No julgamento ou na perspectiva de alguém (Lc 1.6; At 7.10).
THAYER.en: Used spatially to indicate frontal position in relation to someone, or figuratively to denote judgment in a person's perspective. 1. In the physical presence of or before someone (Luke 20:26; Acts 8:32). | 2. In the judgment or perspective of someone (Luke 1:6; Acts 7:10).

DEFINITION: That which is situated in an opposite direction or which opposes ideas, people, or paths frontally.
SENSES: 1. Located in a contrary or opposite direction (Matt 14:24; Acts 27:4).
2. Opposing, hostile, or contradicting convictions (Acts 26:9; Titus 2:8).

THAYER.pt: Aquilo que está situado em direção oposta ou que se opõe de maneira frontal a ideias, pessoas ou caminhos. 1. Localizado em direção contrária ou oposta (Mt 14.24; At 27.4). | 2. Opositor, hostil ou contrariador de convicções (At 26.9; Tt 2.8).
THAYER.en: That which is situated in an opposite direction or which opposes ideas, people, or paths frontally. 1. Located in a contrary or opposite direction (Matt 14:24; Acts 27:4). | 2. Opposing, hostile, or contradicting convictions (Acts 26:9; Titus 2:8).

DEFINITION: To initiate or start an action, state, or process, frequently with implications of a commitment or work already underway.
SENSES: 1. To begin or initiate something, such as spiritual life in faith (Gal 3:3);
2. To start a work that God Himself will carry out (Phil 1:6).

THAYER.pt: Significa iniciar ou dar começo a uma ação, estado ou processo, frequentemente com implicações de um compromisso ou obra que já está em andamento. 1. Começar ou iniciar algo, como a vida espiritual na fé (Gl 3.3); | 2. Dar início a uma obra que Deus mesmo levará a cabo (Fp 1.6).
THAYER.en: To initiate or start an action, state, or process, frequently with implications of a commitment or work already underway. 1. To begin or initiate something, such as spiritual life in faith (Gal 3:3); | 2. To start a work that God Himself will carry out (Phil 1:6).

DEFINITION: One who is in a situation of material scarcity, extreme poverty, or lack of essential resources for subsistence.
SENSES: 1. Poor or needy people who received support in the primitive community (Acts 4:34).

THAYER.pt: Aquele que se encontra em situação de escassez material, pobreza extrema ou falta dos recursos essenciais para a subsistência. 1. pessoas pobres ou necessitadas que recebiam suprimento na comunidade primitiva (At 4.34).
THAYER.en: One who is in a situation of material scarcity, extreme poverty, or lack of essential resources for subsistence. 1. Poor or needy people who received support in the primitive community (Acts 4:34).

DEFINITION: Clear demonstration, visible sign, or irrefutable evidence that proves the veracity of a fact or judgment.
SENSES: 1. Clear evidence or just sign of the judgment of God (2 Thess 1:5).

THAYER.pt: Demonstração clara, sinal visível ou evidência irrefutável que comprova a veracidade de um fato ou juízo. 1. clara evidência ou sinal justo do juízo de Deus (2Ts 1.5).
THAYER.en: Clear demonstration, visible sign, or irrefutable evidence that proves the veracity of a fact or judgment. 1. Clear evidence or just sign of the judgment of God (2 Thess 1:5).

DEFINITION: To cause something to become known or evident through practical demonstration, attitude, or conduct.
SENSES: 1. To demonstrate or manifest clearly a quality or attribute (Rom 9:22; Titus 2:10).
2. To perform an action or conduct that directly affects another person (2 Tim 4:14).

THAYER.pt: Causar que algo se torne conhecido ou evidente por meio de demonstração prática, atitude ou conduta. 1. Demonstrar ou manifestar claramente uma qualidade ou atributo (Rm 9:22; Tt 2:10). | 2. Praticar uma ação ou conduta que afeta diretamente outra pessoa (2Tm 4:14).
THAYER.en: To cause something to become known or evident through practical demonstration, attitude, or conduct. 1. To demonstrate or manifest clearly a quality or attribute (Rom 9:22; Titus 2:10). | 2. To perform an action or conduct that directly affects another person (2 Tim 4:14).

DEFINITION: A noun denoting visible evidence or an unequivocal sign that confirms the truth of a fact or the character of a reality.
SENSES: 1. Evident sign or clear proof of something (Phil 1:28).
2. Public demonstration of God's justice (Rom 3:25).

THAYER.pt: Substantivo que denota uma evidência visível ou sinal inequívoco que comprova a veracidade de um fato ou o caráter de uma realidade. 1. Sinal evidente ou prova clara de algo (Fp 1:28). | 2. Demonstração pública da justiça de Deus (Rm 3:25).
THAYER.en: A noun denoting visible evidence or an unequivocal sign that confirms the truth of a fact or the character of a reality. 1. Evident sign or clear proof of something (Phil 1:28). | 2. Public demonstration of God's justice (Rom 3:25).

DEFINITION: A cardinal numeral representing the quantity ten plus one.
SENSES: 1. The number eleven, often used to refer to the group of remaining apostles (Matt 28:16; Acts 1:26).

THAYER.pt: Numeral cardinal que representa a quantidade dez mais um. 1. O número onze, usado frequentemente para se referir ao grupo dos apóstolos restantes (Mt 28:16; At 1:26).
THAYER.en: A cardinal numeral representing the quantity ten plus one. 1. The number eleven, often used to refer to the group of remaining apostles (Matt 28:16; Acts 1:26).

DEFINITION: An ordinal numeral indicating the eleventh element in a sequential, spatial, or temporal series.
SENSES: 1. The eleventh in an order or sequence (Matt 20:9; Rev 21:20).

THAYER.pt: Numeral ordinal que indica o décimo primeiro elemento em uma série sequencial, espacial ou temporal. 1. O décimo primeiro em uma ordem ou sequência (Mt 20.9; Ap 21.20).
THAYER.en: An ordinal numeral indicating the eleventh element in a sequential, spatial, or temporal series. 1. The eleventh in an order or sequence (Matt 20:9; Rev 21:20).

SHORT_GLOSS: to be possible, to be acceptable
DEFINITION: Indicates the possibility or viability of something occurring or being accepted within certain circumstances.
SENSES: 1. To be possible or admissible according to context or logic (Luke 13:33).
USAGE: to be possible, to be acceptable

THAYER.pt: Indica a possibilidade ou viabilidade de que algo ocorra ou seja aceito dentro de certas circunstâncias. 1. Ser possível ou admissível segundo o contexto ou a lógica (Lc 13.33).
THAYER.en: Indicates the possibility or viability of something occurring or being accepted within certain circumstances. 1. To be possible or admissible according to context or logic (Luke 13:33).

SHORT_GLOSS: to dwell, to be at home
DEFINITION: To be in a familiar place or to dwell in one's own home; in the NT, used metaphorically for the soul's dwelling in the body or with the Lord.
SENSES: 1. To be present at home or to dwell with the Lord (2 Cor 5:6, 8).
USAGE: to dwell, to be at home

THAYER.pt: Estar em um lugar familiar ou habitar em sua própria casa; no NT, usado metaforicamente para a habitação da alma no corpo ou com o Senhor. 1. Estar presente em casa ou habitar com o Senhor (2Co 5.6, 8).
THAYER.en: To be in a familiar place or to dwell in one's own home; in the NT, used metaphorically for the soul's dwelling in the body or with the Lord. 1. To be present at home or to dwell with the Lord (2 Cor 5:6, 8).

SHORT_GLOSS: to dress, to put on garments
DEFINITION: The verb refers to the act of wearing clothes or covering the body with attire.
SENSES: 1. To dress someone with a specific garment or robe (Mark 15:17).
USAGE: to dress, to put on garments

THAYER.pt: O verbo refere-se ao ato de vestir roupas ou cobrir o corpo com vestimenta. 1. Vestir alguém com uma veste específica ou manto (Mc 15.17).
THAYER.en: The verb refers to the act of wearing clothes or covering the body with attire. 1. To dress someone with a specific garment or robe (Mark 15:17).

DEFINITION: Describes that which is in accordance with justice, being therefore upright, appropriate, and deserved.
SENSES: 1. Pertaining to or based on what is just and correct (Rom 3:8);
2. Just and deserved as retribution (Heb 2:2).

THAYER.pt: Descreve aquilo que está de acordo com a justiça, sendo, portanto, reto, apropriado e merecido. 1. Pertencente ou baseado no que é justo e correto (Rm 3.8); | 2. Justo e merecido como retribuição (Hb 2.2).
THAYER.en: Describes that which is in accordance with justice, being therefore upright, appropriate, and deserved. 1. Pertaining to or based on what is just and correct (Rom 3:8); | 2. Just and deserved as retribution (Heb 2:2).

DEFINITION: Refers to the act of building, incorporating, or structuring something within a building.
SENSES: 1. Construction work or structure integrated into buildings.

THAYER.pt: Refere-se ao ato de construir, incorporar ou estruturar algo dentro de uma edificação. 1. Trabalho de construção ou estrutura integrada em edifícios.
THAYER.en: Refers to the act of building, incorporating, or structuring something within a building. 1. Construction work or structure integrated into buildings.

DEFINITION: Means to clothe with glory, to honor, or to exalt someone publicly.
SENSES: 1. To make glorious or to manifest the glory of someone.

THAYER.pt: Significa revestir de glória, honrar ou exaltar alguém publicamente. 1. Tornar glorioso ou manifestar a glória de alguém.
THAYER.en: Means to clothe with glory, to honor, or to exalt someone publicly. 1. To make glorious or to manifest the glory of someone.

DEFINITION: An adjective describing something or someone endowed with great honor, distinction, respect, or majestic splendor.
SENSES: 1. Endowed with glory, splendor, or magnificent beauty (Eph 5:27).
2. Respected, esteemed, and of high social standing (1 Cor 4:10).

THAYER.pt: Adjetivo que descreve algo ou alguém dotado de grande honra, distinção, respeito ou esplendor majestoso. 1. Dotado de glória, esplendor ou beleza magnífica (Ef 5:27). | 2. Respeitado, estimado e de alta posição social (1Co 4:10).
THAYER.en: An adjective describing something or someone endowed with great honor, distinction, respect, or majestic splendor. 1. Endowed with glory, splendor, or magnificent beauty (Eph 5:27). | 2. Respected, esteemed, and of high social standing (1 Cor 4:10).

DEFINITION: Any type of textile material made for the purpose of covering and protecting the human body.
SENSES: 1. Clothing, attire, or a robe worn by people (Matt 3:4; 6:25).

THAYER.pt: Qualquer tipo de material têxtil confeccionado com a finalidade de cobrir e proteger o corpo humano. 1. Roupa, vestimenta ou manto usado por pessoas (Mt 3.4; 6.25).
THAYER.en: Any type of textile material made for the purpose of covering and protecting the human body. 1. Clothing, attire, or a robe worn by people (Matt 3:4; 6:25).

DEFINITION: To grant strength, vigor, or functional capacity to someone to perform a task or endure circumstances.
SENSES: 1. To strengthen spiritually or to empower for action (Phil 4:13; 2 Tim 2:1).

THAYER.pt: Conceder força, vigor ou capacidade funcional a alguém para realizar uma tarefa ou suportar circunstâncias. 1. Fortalecer espiritualmente ou capacitar para a ação (Fp 4:13; 2Tm 2:1).
THAYER.en: To grant strength, vigor, or functional capacity to someone to perform a task or endure circumstances. 1. To strengthen spiritually or to empower for action (Phil 4:13; 2 Tim 2:1).

DEFINITION: Describes the action of entering a place in a stealthy, dissimulated manner, or with ulterior motives.
SENSES: 1. To infiltrate secretly or to penetrate with trickery into a group or environment (2 Tim 3:6).

THAYER.pt: Descreve a ação de entrar em algum lugar de maneira furtiva, dissimulada ou com segundas intenções. 1. Infiltrar-se secretamente ou penetrar com artimanhas em um grupo ou ambiente (2Tm 3.6).
THAYER.en: Describes the action of entering a place in a stealthy, dissimulated manner, or with ulterior motives. 1. To infiltrate secretly or to penetrate with trickery into a group or environment (2 Tim 3:6).

DEFINITION: The act of wearing clothes or external adornment consisting of special attire.
SENSES: 1. The act of putting on garments or the use of ornamental clothing (1 Pet 3:3).

THAYER.pt: O ato de vestir roupas ou o adorno externo consistente em trajes especiais. 1. O ato de colocar vestimentas ou o uso de roupas ornamentais (1Pe 3.3).
THAYER.en: The act of wearing clothes or external adornment consisting of special attire. 1. The act of putting on garments or the use of ornamental clothing (1 Pet 3:3).

SHORT_GLOSS: to dress, to clothe, to put on
DEFINITION: To put clothes on someone or to clothe oneself in physical garments or spiritual virtues.
SENSES: 1. To dress someone with physical clothes (Luke 15:22; Mark 15:20).
2. To clothe oneself figuratively with spiritual armor or virtues (Eph 6:11; 1 Thess 5:8).
USAGE: to dress, to clothe, to put on

THAYER.pt: Colocar roupas em alguém ou revestir-se a si mesmo de vestimentas físicas ou de virtudes espirituais. 1. Vestir alguém com roupas físicas (Lc 15:22; Mc 15:20). | 2. Revestir-se figuradamente de armadura espiritual ou virtudes (Ef 6:11; 1Ts 5:8).
THAYER.en: To put clothes on someone or to clothe oneself in physical garments or spiritual virtues. 1. To dress someone with physical clothes (Luke 15:22; Mark 15:20). | 2. To clothe oneself figuratively with spiritual armor or virtues (Eph 6:11; 1 Thess 5:8).

DEFINITION: Refers to the act of hiding to carry out a surprise attack, or a conspiracy and trap elaborated secretly.
SENSES: 1. An ambush or secret plan to attack (Acts 25:3).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se ao ato de ocultar-se para realizar um ataque de surpresa, ou a uma conspiração e armadilha elaborada secretamente. 1. Uma emboscada ou plano secreto para atacar (At 25.3).
THAYER.en: Refers to the act of hiding to carry out a surprise attack, or a conspiracy and trap elaborated secretly. 1. An ambush or secret plan to attack (Acts 25:3).

SHORT_GLOSS: to set a trap, to ambush
DEFINITION: Means to lie in wait, to hide in order to attack by surprise, or to plot machinations against someone.
SENSES: 1. To set an ambush or wait to attack (Acts 23:21);
2. To use intrigue or plot against someone (Luke 11:54).
USAGE: to set a trap, to ambush

THAYER.pt: Significa espreitar, esconder-se para atacar de surpresa ou tramar maquinações contra alguém. 1. Fazer uma emboscada ou aguardar para atacar (At 23.21); | 2. Usar de intriga ou tramar contra alguém (Lc 11.54).
THAYER.en: Means to lie in wait, to hide in order to attack by surprise, or to plot machinations against someone. 1. To set an ambush or wait to attack (Acts 23:21); | 2. To use intrigue or plot against someone (Luke 11:54).

DEFINITION: A noun denoting a location or secret plan to carry out a surprise attack or deception against someone.
SENSES: 1. Ambush or secret plan of attack (Acts 23:16).

THAYER.pt: Substantivo que denota um local ou plano secreto para realizar um ataque de surpresa ou engano contra alguém. 1. Emboscada ou plano secreto de ataque (At 23.16).
THAYER.en: A noun denoting a location or secret plan to carry out a surprise attack or deception against someone. 1. Ambush or secret plan of attack (Acts 23:16).

DEFINITION: To cover or wrap completely an object by rolling material around it.
SENSES: 1. To wrap or wrap firmly in cloths or fabrics (Mark 15:46).

THAYER.pt: Cobrir ou envolver completamente um objeto enrolando material ao seu redor. 1. Envolver ou envolver firmemente em panos ou tecidos (Mc 15.46).
THAYER.en: To cover or wrap completely an object by rolling material around it. 1. To wrap or wrap firmly in cloths or fabrics (Mark 15:46).

DEFINITION: To be contained within the interior of an area, object, or determined limit.
SENSES: 1. To be present inside something (Luke 11:41).

THAYER.pt: Estar contido no interior de uma área, objeto ou limite determinado. 1. Estar presente no interior de algo (Lc 11.41).
THAYER.en: To be contained within the interior of an area, object, or determined limit. 1. To be present inside something (Luke 11:41).

SHORT_GLOSS: because of, for the sake of
DEFINITION: A preposition expressing the motivating cause, reason, or fundamental purpose for which an action is performed.
SENSES: 1. By reason of, because of, or on behalf of someone (Mt 5:10; 2Co 7:12).
USAGE: because of, for the sake of

THAYER.pt: Preposição que expressa a causa motivadora, a razão ou o propósito fundamental pelo qual uma ação é realizada. 1. Em razão de, por causa de ou em favor de alguém (Mt 5.10; 2Co 7.12).
THAYER.en: A preposition expressing the motivating cause, reason, or fundamental purpose for which an action is performed. 1. By reason of, because of, or on behalf of someone (Mt 5:10; 2Co 7:12).

DEFINITION: The manifestation of active force, energetic operation, or dynamic efficacy, especially attributed to divine or spiritual beings.
SENSES: 1. The powerful action or effective operation of God or spiritual forces (Eph 1:19; Phil 3:21).

THAYER.pt: A manifestação de força ativa, operação enérgica ou eficácia dinâmica, especialmente atribuída a seres divinos ou espirituais. 1. A ação poderosa ou operação eficaz de Deus ou de forças espirituais (Ef 1.19; Fp 3.21).
THAYER.en: The manifestation of active force, energetic operation, or dynamic efficacy, especially attributed to divine or spiritual beings. 1. The powerful action or effective operation of God or spiritual forces (Eph 1:19; Phil 3:21).

DEFINITION: To demonstrate dynamic efficacy, to put into operation capabilities or energies to produce a determined result, especially the working of God's power.
SENSES: 1. To be in full activity, to operate or function effectively (Phil 2:13).
2. To produce an effect or perform a work through active power (1Co 12:6).

THAYER.pt: Demonstrar eficácia dinâmica, colocar em operação capacidades ou energias para produzir um resultado determinado, especialmente a atuação do poder de Deus. 1. Estar em plena atividade, operar ou funcionar com eficácia (Fp 2.13). | 2. Produzir um efeito ou realizar uma obra através de poder ativo (1Co 12.6).
THAYER.en: To demonstrate dynamic efficacy, to put into operation capabilities or energies to produce a determined result, especially the working of God's power. 1. To be in full activity, to operate or function effectively (Phil 2:13). | 2. To produce an effect or perform a work through active power (1Co 12:6).

DEFINITION: Denotes the result of an energetic activity or the practical effect of an operating power, especially of a miraculous nature.
SENSES: 1. Operation or manifestation of dynamic power (1Co 12:10).

THAYER.pt: Denota o resultado de uma atividade enérgica ou o efeito prático de um poder operante, especialmente de natureza milagrosa. 1. Operação ou manifestação de poder dinâmico (1Co 12.10).
THAYER.en: Denotes the result of an energetic activity or the practical effect of an operating power, especially of a miraculous nature. 1. Operation or manifestation of dynamic power (1Co 12:10).

DEFINITION: Possessing efficient operational capacity; that which produces the desired effect or performs its function with power.
SENSES: 1. Effective and operative in the realization of purposes (1Co 16:9; Phil 1:6; Heb 4:12).

THAYER.pt: Que possui capacidade operacional eficiente; aquilo que produz o efeito desejado ou realiza sua função com poder. 1. Eficaz e operante na realização de propósitos (1Co 16.9; Fp 1.6; Hb 4.12).
THAYER.en: Possessing efficient operational capacity; that which produces the desired effect or performs its function with power. 1. Effective and operative in the realization of purposes (1Co 16:9; Phil 1:6; Heb 4:12).

DEFINITION: To confer a special blessing or to act with kindness toward someone, often with implications of divine favor.
SENSES: 1. To grant divine blessings or to act beneficially (Acts 3:25; Gal 3:8).

THAYER.pt: Conferir uma bênção especial ou agir com bondade para com alguém, frequentemente com implicações de favor divino. 1. Conceder bênçãos divinas ou agir beneficamente (At 3.25; Gl 3.8).
THAYER.en: To confer a special blessing or to act with kindness toward someone, often with implications of divine favor. 1. To grant divine blessings or to act beneficially (Acts 3:25; Gal 3:8).

SHORT_GLOSS: to hold a grudge, bear enmity
DEFINITION: To harbor resentment or hostility against someone, or to be subject to constraints and oppression.
SENSES: 1. To hold a grudge or enmity against someone (Mk 6:19; Lk 11:53).
2. To be subject to a yoke or oppression (Gal 5:1).
USAGE: to hold a grudge, bear enmity

THAYER.pt: Nutrir ressentimento ou hostilidade contra alguém, ou estar sujeito a constrangimentos e opressão. 1. Guardar rancor ou inimizade contra alguém (Mc 6.19; Lc 11.53). | 2. Estar sujeito a jugo ou opressão (Gl 5.1).
THAYER.en: To harbor resentment or hostility against someone, or to be subject to constraints and oppression. 1. To hold a grudge or enmity against someone (Mk 6:19; Lk 11:53). | 2. To be subject to a yoke or oppression (Gal 5:1).

DEFINITION: A locative term pointing to the exact place where the speaker or writer is located at the moment.

SENSES: 1. Spatial physical position ('upon', 'on top of') with genitive, dative, or accusative (Matt 14:19; Mark 2:10).

3. Direction, goal, hostility, or purpose ('against', 'towards') with accusative (Matt 10:21; Luke 1:33).

Espacial de posição física ('sobre', 'em cima de') com genitivo, dativo ou acusativo (Mt 14.19; Mc 2.10). | 2. Autoridade, supervisão ou domínio institucional ('sobre', 'encarregado de') (Mt 25.21; At 6.3). | 3. Direção, meta, hostilidade ou propósito ('contra', 'em direção a') com acusativo (Mt 10.21; Lk 1.33).
THAYER.en: Versatile preposition governing three cases and denoting contact, position, or support upon a base. Depending on the case governed, it expresses spatial rest, authority over subordinates, or direction of movement and attitude. 1. Spatial physical position ('upon', 'on top of') with genitive, dative, or accusative (Matt 14:19; Mark 2:10). | 2. Authority, supervision, or institutional rule ('over', 'in charge of') (Matt 25:21; Acts 6:3). | 3. Direction, goal, hostility, or purpose ('against', 'towards') with accusative (Matt 10:21; Luke 1:33).

DEFINITION: Refers to the result of a mental process, denoting a design, thought, or intention conceived in the mind.
SENSES: 1. Intention or purpose plotted in the heart (Acts 8:22).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se ao resultado de um processo mental, denotando um desígnio, pensamento ou intenção concebida na mente. 1. Intenção ou propósito maquinado no coração (At 8.22).
THAYER.en: Refers to the result of a mental process, denoting a design, thought, or intention conceived in the mind. 1. Intention or purpose plotted in the heart (Acts 8:22).

DEFINITION: To violate a sworn oath or to give false testimony under oath, knowing that the statement is false.
SENSES: 1. To fail to keep an oath made or to perjure oneself before God (Matt 5:33).

THAYER.pt: Significa violar um juramento prestado ou prestar um falso testemunho sob juramento, sabendo que a afirmação é falsa. 1. Faltar com o juramento feito ou perjurar diante de Deus (Mt 5.33).
