THAYER.en: To violate a sworn oath or to give false testimony under oath, knowing that the statement is false. 1. To fail to keep an oath made or to perjure oneself before God (Matt 5:33).

DEFINITION: Describes one who breaks a solemn oath or who lies deliberately after invoking the name of God.
SENSES: 1. One who commits perjury or breaks sworn covenants (1 Tim 1:10).

THAYER.pt: Descreve aquele que quebra um juramento solene ou que mente deliberadamente após invocar o nome de Deus. 1. Aquele que comete perjúrio ou quebra alianças juradas (1Tm 1.10).
THAYER.en: Describes one who breaks a solemn oath or who lies deliberately after invoking the name of God. 1. One who commits perjury or breaks sworn covenants (1 Tim 1:10).

DEFINITION: Used as a noun (implying ἡμέρα), it refers to the day that immediately follows the current one.
SENSES: 1. The following day or the approaching dawn (Acts 7:26; 16:11).

THAYER.pt: Empregado como substantivo (implícito ἡμέρα), refere-se ao dia que se segue imediatamente após o atual. 1. O dia seguinte ou a madrugada que se aproxima (At 7.26; 16.11).
THAYER.en: Used as a noun (implying ἡμέρα), it refers to the day that immediately follows the current one. 1. The following day or the approaching dawn (Acts 7:26; 16:11).

DEFINITION: A rare term used in the Lord's Prayer to qualify the bread necessary for daily subsistence or for the present day.
SENSES: 1. Necessary for daily subsistence, the daily bread (Matt 6:11; Luke 11:3).

THAYER.pt: Termo raro usado na Oração Dominical para qualificar o pão necessário para a subsistência diária ou para o dia presente. 1. Necessário para a subsistência diária, o pão cotidiano (Mt 6.11; Lc 11.3).
THAYER.en: A rare term used in the Lord's Prayer to qualify the bread necessary for daily subsistence or for the present day. 1. Necessary for daily subsistence, the daily bread (Matt 6:11; Luke 11:3).

SHORT_GLOSS: to fall upon, come upon, embrace
DEFINITION: To fall physically upon something or someone, whether by an impulse of affection, by violent impact, or by the sudden irruption of an event.
SENSES: 1. To embrace affectionately, throwing oneself into someone's arms or neck (Luke 15:20).
2. To overwhelm, oppress, or strike suddenly with force or fear (Luke 1:12; Acts 19:17).
USAGE: to fall upon, come upon, embrace

THAYER.pt: Cair fisicamente sobre algo ou alguém, seja por ímpeto de afeto, por impacto violento ou pela irrupção repentina de um evento. 1. Abraçar afetuosamente, jogando-se nos braços ou no pescoço de alguém (Lc 15:20). | 2. Sobrecarregar, oprimir ou acometer repentinamente com força ou medo (Lc 1:12; At 19:17).
THAYER.en: To fall physically upon something or someone, whether by an impulse of affection, by violent impact, or by the sudden irruption of an event. 1. To embrace affectionately, throwing oneself into someone's arms or neck (Luke 15:20). | 2. To overwhelm, oppress, or strike suddenly with force or fear (Luke 1:12; Acts 19:17).

DEFINITION: Derived from the idea of striking a blow, it means to express strong disapproval or censure to someone as a form of correction.
SENSES: 1. To direct a severe rebuke or censure toward someone (1 Tim 5:1; cf. Matt 12:15).

THAYER.pt: Derivado da ideia de desferir um golpe, significa expressar forte reprovação ou censura a alguém como forma de correção. 1. Dirigir repreensão severa ou censura a alguém (1Tm 5.1; cf. Mt 12.15).
THAYER.en: Derived from the idea of striking a blow, it means to express strong disapproval or censure to someone as a form of correction. 1. To direct a severe rebuke or censure toward someone (1 Tim 5:1; cf. Matt 12:15).

DEFINITION: A compound verb meaning to choke or prevent breathing or growth, often used figuratively for the strangling of plants by thorns.
SENSES: 1. To choke the growth of plants by excessive competing vegetation (Matt 13:7).

THAYER.pt: Verbo composto que significa sufocar ou impedir a respiração ou o crescimento, muitas vezes usado figurativamente para o estrangulamento de plantas por espinheiros. 1. Sufocar o crescimento de plantas pelo excesso de vegetação concorrente (Mt 13.7).
THAYER.en: A compound verb meaning to choke or prevent breathing or growth, often used figuratively for the strangling of plants by thorns. 1. To choke the growth of plants by excessive competing vegetation (Matt 13:7).

DEFINITION: To have a strong yearning or deep desire for something or someone, frequently accompanied by the awareness of a lack or by deep relational affection.
SENSES: 1. To desire ardently or yearn for something (1 Pet 2:2; Phil 1:8).
2. To have great affection or nostalgic longing for someone (Phil 2:26).

THAYER.pt: Ter um forte anseio ou desejo profundo por algo ou alguém, frequentemente acompanhado pela consciência de uma carência ou por um profundo afeto relacional. 1. Desejar ardentemente ou anelar por algo (1Pe 2.2; Fp 1.8). | 2. Ter grande afeição ou saudade nostálgica por alguém (Fp 2.26).
THAYER.en: To have a strong yearning or deep desire for something or someone, frequently accompanied by the awareness of a lack or by deep relational affection. 1. To desire ardently or yearn for something (1 Pet 2:2; Phil 1:8). | 2. To have great affection or nostalgic longing for someone (Phil 2:26).

DEFINITION: A strong yearning or deep longing for someone, motivated by the recognition of absence and mutual affection.
SENSES: 1. Strong desire or deep longing for someone (2 Cor 7:7, 11).

THAYER.pt: Um forte anseio ou profunda saudade por alguém, motivado pelo reconhecimento da ausência e pelo afeto mútuo. 1. Forte desejo ou profundo anseio por alguém (2Co 7.7, 11).
THAYER.en: A strong yearning or deep longing for someone, motivated by the recognition of absence and mutual affection. 1. Strong desire or deep longing for someone (2 Cor 7:7, 11).

DEFINITION: Qualifies that which or the one who is ardently desired and the object of deep affection and longing.
SENSES: 1. A person or thing very dear and intensely desired (Phil 4:1).

THAYER.pt: Qualifica aquilo ou aquele que é ardentemente desejado e alvo de profunda afeição e saudade. 1. Pessoa ou coisa muito querida e intensamente desejada (Fp 4.1).
THAYER.en: Qualifies that which or the one who is ardently desired and the object of deep affection and longing. 1. A person or thing very dear and intensely desired (Phil 4:1).

DEFINITION: Describes a strong yearning or desire for something or someone, often accompanied by the perception of an absence.
SENSES: 1. Deep and persistent longing for communion or presence (Rom 15:23).

THAYER.pt: Descreve um forte anseio ou desejo por algo ou alguém, frequentemente acompanhado pela percepção de uma ausência. 1. Anseio profundo e persistente por comunhão ou presença (Rm 15.23).
THAYER.en: Describes a strong yearning or desire for something or someone, often accompanied by the perception of an absence. 1. Deep and persistent longing for communion or presence (Rom 15:23).

SHORT_GLOSS: to go to, travel to, approach
DEFINITION: To move toward a destination, undertaking a journey with the sense of arrival.
SENSES: 1. To travel or move toward a place (Luke 8:4).
USAGE: to go to, travel to, approach

THAYER.pt: Movimentar-se em direção a um destino, empreendendo uma jornada com o sentido de chegada. 1. Viajar ou deslocar-se em direção a um lugar (Lc 8.4).
THAYER.en: To move toward a destination, undertaking a journey with the sense of arrival. 1. To travel or move toward a place (Luke 8:4).

DEFINITION: Signifies applying stitching onto a surface or joining parts together using needle and thread.
SENSES: 1. The act of sewing something onto a fabric or material.

THAYER.pt: Significa aplicar costura sobre alguma superfície ou unir partes através de linha e agulha. 1. O ato de costurar algo sobre um tecido ou material.
THAYER.en: Signifies applying stitching onto a surface or joining parts together using needle and thread. 1. The act of sewing something onto a fabric or material.

DEFINITION: Signifies physically throwing or placing something onto a surface, or transferring a burden of concern to God.
SENSES: 1. To cast garments upon an animal (Luke 19:35).
2. To deposit concerns upon God's care (1 Pet 5:7).

THAYER.pt: Significa arremessar ou colocar algo fisicamente sobre uma superfície, ou transferir uma carga de preocupação para Deus. 1. Lançar vestes sobre um animal (Lc 19.35). | 2. Depositar preocupações sobre os cuidados de Deus (1Pe 5.7).
THAYER.en: Signifies physically throwing or placing something onto a surface, or transferring a burden of concern to God. 1. To cast garments upon an animal (Luke 19:35). | 2. To deposit concerns upon God's care (1 Pet 5:7).

DEFINITION: Refers to someone or something that stands out widely, whether positively for excellence or negatively.
SENSES: 1. Distinguished, prominent, or notable in a positive sense (Rom 16:7).
2. Notorious or infamous in a negative sense (Matt 27:16).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se a alguém ou algo que se destaca amplamente, seja de forma positiva por sua excelência ou de forma negativa. 1. Destacado, proeminente ou notável em sentido positivo (Rm 16.7). | 2. Notório ou infame em sentido negativo (Mt 27.16).
THAYER.en: Refers to someone or something that stands out widely, whether positively for excellence or negatively. 1. Distinguished, prominent, or notable in a positive sense (Rom 16:7). | 2. Notorious or infamous in a negative sense (Matt 27:16).

DEFINITION: Refers to the supply of food or provisions necessary for subsistence during a journey or stay.
SENSES: 1. Food provisions for nutrition or a journey (Luke 9:12).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se ao suprimento de alimentos ou provisões necessárias para a subsistência durante uma viagem ou estada. 1. Provisões de alimentos para nutrição ou jornada (Lc 9.12).
THAYER.en: Refers to the supply of food or provisions necessary for subsistence during a journey or stay. 1. Food provisions for nutrition or a journey (Luke 9:12).

DEFINITION: To go to meet someone with benevolent purposes of help, or to perform a careful inspection to evaluate a situation.
SENSES: 1. To inspect or select after careful investigation (Acts 6:3).
2. To visit someone with the intention of aid and comfort (Matt 25:36; Acts 7:23).
3. The saving and merciful intervention of God on behalf of His people (Luke 1:68).

THAYER.pt: Ir ao encontro de alguém com propósitos benevolentes de ajuda, ou realizar uma inspeção cuidadosa para avaliar uma situação. 1. Inspecionar ou selecionar após cuidadosa investigação (At 6:3). | 2. Visitar alguém com intenção de auxílio e conforto (Mt 25:36; At 7:23). | 3. A intervenção salvadora e misericordiosa de Deus em favor do seu povo (Lc 1:68).
THAYER.en: To go to meet someone with benevolent purposes of help, or to perform a careful inspection to evaluate a situation. 1. To inspect or select after careful investigation (Acts 6:3). | 2. To visit someone with the intention of aid and comfort (Matt 25:36; Acts 7:23). | 3. The saving and merciful intervention of God on behalf of His people (Luke 1:68).

SHORT_GLOSS: to dwell upon, rest, pitch a tent
DEFINITION: To settle or make a dwelling upon someone or in some place, often with a spiritual connotation or divine protection.
SENSES: 1. The dwelling of divine power that rests upon the believer (2 Cor 12:9).
USAGE: to dwell upon, rest, pitch a tent

THAYER.pt: Instalar-se ou fazer morada sobre alguém ou em algum lugar, muitas vezes com conotação espiritual ou de proteção divina. 1. A habitação do poder divino que repousa sobre o crente (2Co 12.9).
THAYER.en: To settle or make a dwelling upon someone or in some place, often with a spiritual connotation or divine protection. 1. The dwelling of divine power that rests upon the believer (2 Cor 12:9).

SHORT_GLOSS: to overshadow, cover, cast a shadow
DEFINITION: To cast a shadow over something, whether by covering with a cloud or by the interposition of an object between the light and the target.
SENSES: 1. To cast a shadow over someone or something (Acts 5:15).
2. To cover with a divine cloud as a sign of glorious presence (Matt 17:5; Luke 9:34).
USAGE: to overshadow, cover, cast a shadow

THAYER.pt: Projetar sombra sobre algo, seja cobrindo com uma nuvem ou por interposição de um objeto entre a luz e o alvo. 1. Projetar sombra sobre alguém ou algo (At 5.15). | 2. Cobrir com uma nuvem divina em sinal de presença gloriosa (Mt 17.5; Lc 9.34).
THAYER.en: To cast a shadow over something, whether by covering with a cloud or by the interposition of an object between the light and the target. 1. To cast a shadow over someone or something (Acts 5:15). | 2. To cover with a divine cloud as a sign of glorious presence (Matt 17:5; Luke 9:34).

DEFINITION: Describes the responsibility of watching over, supervising, and caring spiritually for a community or person.
SENSES: 1. To give diligent attention so that no one falls short of grace (Heb 12:15).
2. To exercise pastoral supervision or care over the flock (1 Pet 5:2).

THAYER.pt: Descreve a responsabilidade de zelar, supervisionar e cuidar espiritualmente de uma comunidade ou pessoa. 1. Dar atenção diligente para que ninguém fique sem a graça (Hb 12.15). | 2. Exercer supervisão pastoral ou cuidado sobre o rebanho (1Pe 5.2).
THAYER.en: Describes the responsibility of watching over, supervising, and caring spiritually for a community or person. 1. To give diligent attention so that no one falls short of grace (Heb 12:15). | 2. To exercise pastoral supervision or care over the flock (1 Pet 5:2).

DEFINITION: A noun denoting divine intervention in history (visitation) or the charge of supervision and leadership in the Christian community.
SENSES: 1. Visitation or intervention of God for grace or judgment (Luke 19:44; 1 Pet 2:12).
2. The charge or office of pastoral supervision in the church (Acts 1:20; 1 Tim 3:1).

THAYER.pt: Substantivo que denota a intervenção divina na história (visitação) ou o encargo de supervisão e liderança na comunidade cristã. 1. Visitação ou intervenção de Deus para graça ou juízo (Lc 19:44; 1Pe 2:12). | 2. O encargo ou ofício de supervisão pastoral na igreja (At 1:20; 1Tm 3:1).
THAYER.en: A noun denoting divine intervention in history (visitation) or the charge of supervision and leadership in the Christian community. 1. Visitation or intervention of God for grace or judgment (Luke 19:44; 1 Pet 2:12). | 2. The charge or office of pastoral supervision in the church (Acts 1:20; 1 Tim 3:1).

DEFINITION: One who holds the responsibility of inspecting, supervising, guiding, and caring for the spiritual well-being of a community.
SENSES: 1. Supreme spiritual guardian or supervisor, a title applied to Christ (1 Pet 2:25).
2. Leader or elder with a function of superintendence in the church (Acts 20:28; Phil 1:1; 1 Tim 3:2).

THAYER.pt: Aquele que detém a responsabilidade de inspecionar, supervisionar, guiar e cuidar do bem-estar espiritual de uma comunidade. 1. Guardião ou supervisor espiritual supremo, título aplicado a Cristo (1Pe 2.5). | 2. Líder ou presbítero com função de superintendência na igreja (At 20.28; Fp 1.1; 1Tm 3.2).
THAYER.en: One who holds the responsibility of inspecting, supervising, guiding, and caring for the spiritual well-being of a community. 1. Supreme spiritual guardian or supervisor, a title applied to Christ (1 Pet 2:25). | 2. Leader or elder with a function of superintendence in the church (Acts 20:28; Phil 1:1; 1 Tim 3:2).

DEFINITION: A technical medical and cultural term describing the surgical or physical procedure to extend the foreskin, seeking to disguise the mark of Jewish circumcision.
SENSES: 1. To hide the condition of being circumcised for reasons of cultural assimilation.

THAYER.pt: Termo técnico médico e cultural que descreve o procedimento cirúrgico ou físico para estender o prepúcio, buscando disfarçar a marca da circuncisão judaica. 1. Esconder a condição de circuncidado por motivos de assimilação cultural.
THAYER.en: A technical medical and cultural term describing the surgical or physical procedure to extend the foreskin, seeking to disguise the mark of Jewish circumcision. 1. To hide the condition of being circumcised for reasons of cultural assimilation.

DEFINITION: To possess firm mental comprehension or secure knowledge about a subject, facts, or circumstances.
SENSES: 1. To understand deeply or have discernment about something (1 Tim 6:4).
2. To have knowledge or be familiar with facts or information (Acts 19:15).

THAYER.pt: Possuir firme compreensão mental ou conhecimento seguro sobre um assunto, fatos ou circunstâncias. 1. Compreender profundamente ou ter discernimento sobre algo (1Tm 6.4). | 2. Ter conhecimento ou estar familiarizado com fatos ou informações (At 19.15).
THAYER.en: To possess firm mental comprehension or secure knowledge about a subject, facts, or circumstances. 1. To understand deeply or have discernment about something (1 Tim 6:4). | 2. To have knowledge or be familiar with facts or information (Acts 19:15).

DEFINITION: A term used in the New Testament almost exclusively in the Gospels of Luke to refer to Jesus with respect, denoting authority and leadership.
SENSES: 1. A person with a position of prominence or leadership, used as a respectful address to Jesus (Luke 5:5; 8:24, 45).

THAYER.pt: Termo usado no Novo Testamento quase exclusivamente nos Evangelhos de Lucas para se referir a Jesus com respeito, denotando autoridade e liderança. 1. Pessoa com posição de destaque ou liderança, usada como tratamento respeitoso a Jesus (Lc 5.5; 8.24, 45).
THAYER.en: A term used in the New Testament almost exclusively in the Gospels of Luke to refer to Jesus with respect, denoting authority and leadership. 1. A person with a position of prominence or leadership, used as a respectful address to Jesus (Luke 5:5; 8:24, 45).

DEFINITION: To communicate with someone by means of a written message or formal letter.
SENSES: 1. To write an instructive or exhortatory letter (Acts 15:20; 21:25).
2. To compose an epistle to believers (Heb 13:22).

THAYER.pt: Comunicar-se com alguém por meio de uma mensagem escrita ou carta formal. 1. Escrever uma carta instrutiva ou exortatória (At 15.20; 21.25); | 2. Redigir uma epístola aos crentes (Hb 13.22).
THAYER.en: To communicate with someone by means of a written message or formal letter. 1. To write an instructive or exhortatory letter (Acts 15:20; 21:25). | 2. To compose an epistle to believers (Heb 13:22).

DEFINITION: Qualifies a person who possesses discernment, skill, and deep practical knowledge in a given area.
SENSES: 1. One who demonstrates practical wisdom and understanding (Jas 3:13).

THAYER.pt: Qualifica a pessoa que possui discernimento, perícia e profundo conhecimento prático em determinada área. 1. Aquele que demonstra sabedoria prática e compreensão (Tg 3.13).
THAYER.en: Qualifies a person who possesses discernment, skill, and deep practical knowledge in a given area. 1. One who demonstrates practical wisdom and understanding (Jas 3:13).

DEFINITION: A verb meaning to make someone firmer, stronger, or more constant in their faith, convictions, and spiritual faithfulness in the face of trials.
SENSES: 1. To strengthen the disciples spiritually in faith and perseverance (Acts 14:22; 18:23).

THAYER.pt: Verbo que significa tornar alguém mais firme, forte ou constante em sua fé, convicções e fidelidade espiritual diante das provações. 1. Fortalecer espiritualmente os discípulos na fé e perseverança (At 14:22; 18:23).
THAYER.en: A verb meaning to make someone firmer, stronger, or more constant in their faith, convictions, and spiritual faithfulness in the face of trials. 1. To strengthen the disciples spiritually in faith and perseverance (Acts 14:22; 18:23).

DEFINITION: Refers to a written communication addressed to one or more persons. In the New Testament, it designates both common letters and the inspired apostolic documents that make up the canon.
SENSES: 1. A letter or written message sent to recipients (2Cor 7:8; 2Thess 3:17).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se a uma comunicação escrita endereçada a uma ou mais pessoas. No Novo Testamento, designa tanto cartas comuns quanto os documentos apostólicos inspirados que compõem o cânon. 1. Uma carta ou mensagem escrita enviada a destinatários (2Co 7.8; 2Ts 3.17).
THAYER.en: Refers to a written communication addressed to one or more persons. In the New Testament, it designates both common letters and the inspired apostolic documents that make up the canon. 1. A letter or written message sent to recipients (2Cor 7:8; 2Thess 3:17).

DEFINITION: Literally to place something over the mouth; figuratively, to reduce to silence by means of irrefutable arguments or rebuke.
SENSES: 1. To silence opponents or false teachers, preventing them from continuing to speak (Titus 1:11).

THAYER.pt: Literalmente colocar algo sobre a boca; figuradamente, reduzir ao silêncio por meio de argumentos irrefutáveis ou repreensão. 1. Silenciar opositores ou falsos mestres, impedindo que continuem falando (Tt 1.11).
THAYER.en: Literally to place something over the mouth; figuratively, to reduce to silence by means of irrefutable arguments or rebuke. 1. To silence opponents or false teachers, preventing them from continuing to speak (Titus 1:11).

DEFINITION: To change physical direction or experience a profound spiritual reversal toward God.
SENSES: 1. To turn physically or return to a previous point (Mark 13:16).
2. To change moral or spiritual course, converting to God (Luke 1:16; Acts 9:35).

THAYER.pt: Mudar de direção física ou experimentar uma profunda reviravolta espiritual em direção a Deus. 1. Voltar fisicamente ou retornar a um ponto anterior (Mc 13.16). | 2. Mudar de rumo moral ou espiritual, convertendo-se a Deus (Lc 1.16; At 9.35).
THAYER.en: To change physical direction or experience a profound spiritual reversal toward God. 1. To turn physically or return to a previous point (Mark 13:16). | 2. To change moral or spiritual course, converting to God (Luke 1:16; Acts 9:35).

DEFINITION: Indicates a radical change of direction, thought, or belief, referring specifically to the return to God.
SENSES: 1. The conversion of Gentiles or unbelievers to the Christian faith (Acts 15:3).

THAYER.pt: Indica uma mudança radical de direção, pensamento ou crença, referindo-se especificamente ao retorno a Deus. 1. A conversão de gentios ou descrentes à fé cristã (At 15.3).
THAYER.en: Indicates a radical change of direction, thought, or belief, referring specifically to the return to God. 1. The conversion of Gentiles or unbelievers to the Christian faith (Acts 15:3).

DEFINITION: To bring multiple individuals to the same place, bringing them together into a single group or shelter.
SENSES: 1. To gather people or animals in a specific location (Matt 23:37; Mark 1:33).
2. The eschatological gathering of the elect by God (Matt 24:31).

THAYER.pt: Conduzir múltiplos indivíduos para um mesmo local, reunindo-os em um só grupo ou abrigo. 1. Reunir pessoas ou animais em um local específico (Mt 23.37; Mc 1.33). | 2. O recolhimento escatológico dos eleitos por Deus (Mt 24.31).
THAYER.en: To bring multiple individuals to the same place, bringing them together into a single group or shelter. 1. To gather people or animals in a specific location (Matt 23:37; Mark 1:33). | 2. The eschatological gathering of the elect by God (Matt 24:31).

DEFINITION: The act of gathering people in the same place, especially to worship God or in an eschatological context.
SENSES: 1. The congregational gathering of the faithful (Heb 10:25).
2. The gathering of the elect at the end of the age (2Thess 2:1).

THAYER.pt: O ato de reunir pessoas em um mesmo local, especialmente para cultuar a Deus ou no contexto escatológico. 1. A reunião congregacional dos fiéis (Hb 10.25). | 2. A reunião dos eleitos no fim dos tempos (2Ts 2.1).
THAYER.en: The act of gathering people in the same place, especially to worship God or in an eschatological context. 1. The congregational gathering of the faithful (Heb 10:25). | 2. The gathering of the elect at the end of the age (2Thess 2:1).

DEFINITION: Describes the movement of a crowd running precipitously to gather in the same place.
SENSES: 1. The rapid influx of people running to observe an event (Mark 9:25).

THAYER.pt: Descreve o movimento de uma multidão que corre precipitadamente para se juntar em um mesmo local. 1. O afluxo rápido de pessoas correndo para observar um evento (Mc 9.25).
THAYER.en: Describes the movement of a crowd running precipitously to gather in the same place. 1. The rapid influx of people running to observe an event (Mark 9:25).

DEFINITION: Refers to a popular disturbance, revolt, or conspiracy against established authority.
SENSES: 1. A tumult or revolt against public order or authorities (Acts 24:12).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se a uma agitação popular, revolta ou conspiração contra a autoridade estabelecida. 1. Um tumulto ou revolta contra a ordem pública ou autoridades (At 24.12).
THAYER.en: Refers to a popular disturbance, revolt, or conspiracy against established authority. 1. A tumult or revolt against public order or authorities (Acts 24:12).

DEFINITION: Qualifies a situation, place, or condition that presents high risks of damage or shipwreck.
SENSES: 1. A condition of peril for navigation or journey (Acts 27:9).

THAYER.pt: Qualifica uma situação, local ou condição que apresenta riscos elevados de danos ou naufrágio. 1. Condição de periculosidade para a navegação ou jornada (At 27.9).
THAYER.en: Qualifies a situation, place, or condition that presents high risks of damage or shipwreck. 1. A condition of peril for navigation or journey (Acts 27:9).

DEFINITION: To act with strong insistence, firmness, or increased vigor in defending a position or demand.
SENSES: 1. To insist vehemently on an accusation or demand (Luke 23:5).

THAYER.pt: Atuar com forte insistência, firmeza ou aumento de vigor na defesa de uma posição ou exigência. 1. Insistir veementemente em uma acusação ou exigência (Lc 23.5).
THAYER.en: To act with strong insistence, firmness, or increased vigor in defending a position or demand. 1. To insist vehemently on an accusation or demand (Luke 23:5).

DEFINITION: To accumulate large quantities of something excessively, frequently used in a metaphorical sense.
SENSES: 1. To accumulate a large quantity of false teachers out of personal caprice (2Tim 4:3).

THAYER.pt: Acumular grandes quantidades de algo de maneira excessiva, frequentemente usado em sentido metafórico. 1. Acumular grande quantidade de falsos mestres por capricho pessoal (2Tm 4.3).
THAYER.en: To accumulate large quantities of something excessively, frequently used in a metaphorical sense. 1. To accumulate a large quantity of false teachers out of personal caprice (2Tim 4:3).

DEFINITION: Refers to an authoritative directive, express order, or the right and authority to issue commands.
SENSES: 1. An authoritative order or command (Rom 16:26; 1Cor 7:25; 1Tim 1:1).
2. The right or prerogative to command (Titus 2:15).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se a uma diretriz autoritativa, ordem expressa ou ao direito e autoridade de emitir mandamentos. 1. Uma ordem ou mandamento com autoridade (Rm 16.26; 1Co 7.25; 1Tm 1.1). | 2. O direito ou prerrogativa de mandar (Tt 2.15).
THAYER.en: Refers to an authoritative directive, express order, or the right and authority to issue commands. 1. An authoritative order or command (Rom 16:26; 1Cor 7:25; 1Tim 1:1). | 2. The right or prerogative to command (Titus 2:15).

DEFINITION: Means to give orders with authority and firmness, prescribing detailed instructions about what must be done.
SENSES: 1. To give categorical orders or commands with authority (Mark 1:27; Phlm 8).

THAYER.pt: Significa dar ordens com autoridade e firmeza, prescrevendo instruções detalhadas sobre o que deve ser feito. 1. Dar ordens categóricas ou comandos com autoridade (Mc 1.27; Fm 8).
THAYER.en: Means to give orders with authority and firmness, prescribing detailed instructions about what must be done. 1. To give categorical orders or commands with authority (Mark 1:27; Phlm 8).

DEFINITION: Describes the act of bringing a task, promise, or plan to its successful completion and consummation.
SENSES: 1. To conclude or finish something that has been started (2Cor 8:6; Phil 1:6).
2. To execute, fulfill, or perform a duty or religious act (Heb 8:5; 1Pet 5:9).

THAYER.pt: Descreve o ato de levar uma tarefa, promessa ou plano até o seu término bem-sucedido e consumação. 1. Concluir ou finalizar algo que foi iniciado (2Co 8.6; Fp 1.6). | 2. Executar, cumprir ou realizar um dever ou ato religioso (Hb 8.5; 1Pe 5.9).
THAYER.en: Describes the act of bringing a task, promise, or plan to its successful completion and consummation. 1. To conclude or finish something that has been started (2Cor 8:6; Phil 1:6). | 2. To execute, fulfill, or perform a duty or religious act (Heb 8:5; 1Pet 5:9).

DEFINITION: Describes that which is indispensable, adequate, or necessary to fulfill a specific purpose.
SENSES: 1. Necessary or essential things for life or occasion (Acts 24:25; Jas 2:16).

THAYER.pt: Descreve aquilo que é indispensável, adequado ou necessário para cumprir um propósito específico. 1. Coisas necessárias ou essenciais para a vida ou ocasião (At 24.25; Tg 2.16).
THAYER.en: Describes that which is indispensable, adequate, or necessary to fulfill a specific purpose. 1. Necessary or essential things for life or occasion (Acts 24:25; Jas 2:16).

DEFINITION: Means to physically place something upon someone or an object, transferring loads, burdens, or laying on hands for healing or blessing.
SENSES: 1. To place or put something upon someone or a place (Matt 9:18; 23:4).
2. To attack or inflict violence against someone, to lay on hands (Acts 18:10).

THAYER.pt: Significa colocar fisicamente algo sobre alguém ou um objeto, transferindo cargas, fardos ou impondo mãos para cura ou bênção. 1. Colocar ou pôr algo sobre alguém ou sobre um lugar (Mt 9.18; 23.4). | 2. Atacar ou desferir violência contra alguém, impor as mãos (At 18.10).
THAYER.en: Means to physically place something upon someone or an object, transferring loads, burdens, or laying on hands for healing or blessing. 1. To place or put something upon someone or a place (Matt 9:18; 23:4). | 2. To attack or inflict violence against someone, to lay on hands (Acts 18:10).

DEFINITION: To express strong disapproval or censure toward someone, frequently with the implication of a severe order or threat.
SENSES: 1. To severely rebuke or censure someone (Luke 4:41; 2Tim 4:2).
2. To command with authority or impose a strict prohibition (Matt 16:22).

THAYER.pt: Expressar forte desaprovação ou censura a alguém, frequentemente com a implicação de uma ordem severa ou ameaça. 1. Repreender ou censurar severamente alguém (Lc 4:41; 2Tm 4:2). | 2. Ordenar com autoridade ou impor uma proibição estrita (Mt 16:22).
THAYER.en: To express strong disapproval or censure toward someone, frequently with the implication of a severe order or threat. 1. To severely rebuke or censure someone (Luke 4:41; 2Tim 4:2). | 2. To command with authority or impose a strict prohibition (Matt 16:22).

DEFINITION: Indicates the imposition of a just disciplinary penalty or sanction applied by an authority or community.
SENSES: 1. The sanction or disciplinary punishment applied by the church (2Cor 2:6).

THAYER.pt: Indica a imposição de uma penalidade ou sanção disciplinar justa aplicada por uma autoridade ou comunidade. 1. A sanção ou castigo disciplinar aplicado pela igreja (2Co 2.6).
THAYER.en: Indicates the imposition of a just disciplinary penalty or sanction applied by an authority or community. 1. The sanction or disciplinary punishment applied by the church (2Cor 2:6).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: ἐπιτρέψω, Aor: ἐπέτρεψα, Perf: ἐπιτέτραμμαι
DEFINITION: Means to grant permission or freedom for someone to perform an action. In the New Testament, it is frequently used in contexts of granting requests or legal and moral authorization.
SENSES: 1. To permit or grant that someone do something (Matt 8:21; 1Tim 2:12).
2. To order or instruct with authority.

THAYER.pt: Significa conceder permissão ou liberdade para alguém realizar uma ação. No Novo Testamento, é frequentemente usado em contextos de concessão de pedidos ou autorização legal e moral. 1. Permitir ou conceder que alguém faça algo (Mt 8.21; 1Tm 2.12). | 2. Ordenar ou instruir com autoridade.
THAYER.en: Means to grant permission or freedom for someone to perform an action. In the New Testament, it is frequently used in contexts of granting requests or legal and moral authorization. 1. To permit or grant that someone do something (Matt 8:21; 1Tim 2:12). | 2. To order or instruct with authority.

DEFINITION: Official concession of full authority and powers to execute a specific mission or charge.
SENSES: 1. Official authorization granted to perform a task (Acts 26:12).

THAYER.pt: Concessão oficial de plena autoridade e plenos poderes para executar uma missão ou encargo específico. 1. Autorização oficial conferida para realizar uma tarefa (At 26.12).
THAYER.en: Official concession of full authority and powers to execute a specific mission or charge. 1. Official authorization granted to perform a task (Acts 26:12).

DEFINITION: A person charged with supervising workers, managing property, or acting as a legal guardian.
SENSES: 1. Manager or steward of goods or property (Matt 20:8);
2. Guardian or person in charge of minors (Gal 4:2).

THAYER.pt: Pessoa encarregada de supervisionar trabalhadores, administrar propriedades ou atuar como tutor legal. 1. Administrador ou mordomo de bens ou propriedades (Mt 20.8); | 2. Tutor ou encarregado de menores (Gl 4.2).
THAYER.en: A person charged with supervising workers, managing property, or acting as a legal guardian. 1. Manager or steward of goods or property (Matt 20:8); | 2. Guardian or person in charge of minors (Gal 4:2).

DEFINITION: To successfully attain the target, prize, or object that is ardently sought.
SENSES: 1. To obtain or reach what is sought (Rom 11:7; Heb 6:15).

THAYER.pt: Alcançar com sucesso o alvo, o prêmio ou o objeto que se busca ardentemente. 1. Obter ou alcançar o que se busca (Rm 11.7; Hb 6.15).
THAYER.en: To successfully attain the target, prize, or object that is ardently sought. 1. To obtain or reach what is sought (Rom 11:7; Heb 6:15).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Aor: ἐπέφανα, Fut: ἐπιφανοῦμαι, Pass: ἐπιφανήσεται
DEFINITION: To cause visibility, shine with light, or manifest clearly and visibly to the eyes.
SENSES: 1. To provide illumination or shine upon someone (Luke 1:79).
2. To make one's presence known or become apparent (Acts 27:20).
3. To show oneself publicly, to manifest (Titus 2:11; 3:4).

THAYER.pt: Significa causar visibilidade, brilhar com luz ou manifestar-se de forma clara e visível aos olhos. 1. Fornecer iluminação ou brilhar sobre alguém (Lc 1.79). | 2. Fazer a própria presença ser conhecida ou tornar-se aparente (At 27.20). | 3. Mostrar-se publicamente, manifestar-se (Tt 2.11; 3.4).
THAYER.en: To cause visibility, shine with light, or manifest clearly and visibly to the eyes. 1. To provide illumination or shine upon someone (Luke 1:79). | 2. To make one's presence known or become apparent (Acts 27:20). | 3. To show oneself publicly, to manifest (Titus 2:11; 3:4).

DEFINITION: The visible and striking manifestation of someone, used in the New Testament to describe the coming and glorious revelation of Christ.
SENSES: 1. The visible manifestation or glorious coming of Jesus Christ (2 Thess 2:8; 1 Tim 6:14).

THAYER.pt: A manifestação visível e marcante de alguém, sendo usada no Novo Testamento para descrever a vinda e a revelação gloriosa de Cristo. 1. A manifestação visível ou vinda gloriosa de Jesus Cristo (2Ts 2.8; 1Tm 6.14).
THAYER.en: The visible and striking manifestation of someone, used in the New Testament to describe the coming and glorious revelation of Christ. 1. The visible manifestation or glorious coming of Jesus Christ (2 Thess 2:8; 1 Tim 6:14).

DEFINITION: Qualifies that which stands out in a bright, magnificent, or glorious way, frequently associated with heavenly manifestations.
SENSES: 1. The glorious and resplendent character of the Day of the Lord (Acts 2:20).

THAYER.pt: Qualifica o que se destaca de maneira brilhante, magnífica ou gloriosa, frequentemente associado a manifestações celestiais. 1. O caráter glorioso e resplandecente do Dia do Senhor (At 2.20).
THAYER.en: Qualifies that which stands out in a bright, magnificent, or glorious way, frequently associated with heavenly manifestations. 1. The glorious and resplendent character of the Day of the Lord (Acts 2:20).

DEFINITION: To emit light or shine upon something, illuminating the darkness with clarity.
SENSES: 1. The act of Christ spiritually illuminating the believer (Eph 5:14).

THAYER.pt: Emitir luz ou brilhar sobre algo, iluminando as trevas com claridade. 1. O ato de Cristo iluminar espiritualmente o crente (Ef 5.14).
THAYER.en: To emit light or shine upon something, illuminating the darkness with clarity. 1. The act of Christ spiritually illuminating the believer (Eph 5:14).

DEFINITION: To bring something toward someone, imposing a burden, punishment, accusation, or adverse consequence.
SENSES: 1. To inflict or bring punishment and judgment upon someone (Rom 3:5).
2. To present a formal accusation against someone (Jude 9).

THAYER.pt: Significa trazer algo em direção a alguém, impondo uma carga, castigo, acusação ou consequência adversa. 1. Infligir ou trazer castigo e juízo sobre alguém (Rm 3.5). | 2. Apresentar uma acusação formal contra alguém (Jd 9).
THAYER.en: To bring something toward someone, imposing a burden, punishment, accusation, or adverse consequence. 1. To inflict or bring punishment and judgment upon someone (Rom 3:5). | 2. To present a formal accusation against someone (Jude 9).

DEFINITION: To emit a sound with considerable volume or vocal intensity, generally expressing strong emotion or demand.
SENSES: 1. To shout aloud or cry out against someone (Luke 23:21; Acts 12:22).

THAYER.pt: Emitir um som com considerável volume ou intensidade vocal, geralmente expressando forte emoção ou exigência. 1. Gritar em voz alta ou clamar contra alguém (Lc 23.21; At 12.22).
THAYER.en: To emit a sound with considerable volume or vocal intensity, generally expressing strong emotion or demand. 1. To shout aloud or cry out against someone (Luke 23:21; Acts 12:22).

DEFINITION: Indicates the transition from darkness to daylight, referring to the break of dawn or the approach of morning.
SENSES: 1. To begin to grow light or dawn (Matt 28:1; Luke 23:54).

THAYER.pt: Indica a transição da escuridão para a luz do dia, referindo-se ao romper da alvorada ou ao aproximar-se do amanhecer. 1. Começar a clarear ou amanhecer (Mt 28.1; Lc 23.54).
THAYER.en: Indicates the transition from darkness to daylight, referring to the break of dawn or the approach of morning. 1. To begin to grow light or dawn (Matt 28:1; Luke 23:54).

DEFINITION: To set one's hand to a task, attempt to carry out, or undertake an activity.
SENSES: 1. To undertake the writing of a historical account (Luke 1:1);
2. To attempt to carry out an action or enterprise (Acts 9:29).

THAYER.pt: Pôr a mão em uma tarefa, tentar realizar ou empreender uma atividade. 1. Empreender a elaboração de um relato histórico (Lc 1.1); | 2. Tentar realizar uma ação ou empreendimento (At 9.29).
THAYER.en: To set one's hand to a task, attempt to carry out, or undertake an activity. 1. To undertake the writing of a historical account (Luke 1:1); | 2. To attempt to carry out an action or enterprise (Acts 9:29).

DEFINITION: The act of pouring or spilling a liquid over a surface, wound, or object.
SENSES: 1. To pour oil and wine over wounds for treatment (Luke 10:34).

THAYER.pt: O ato de verter ou derramar um líquido por cima de uma superfície, ferida ou objeto. 1. Derramar óleo e vinho sobre ferimentos para tratamento (Lc 10.34).
THAYER.en: The act of pouring or spilling a liquid over a surface, wound, or object. 1. To pour oil and wine over wounds for treatment (Luke 10:34).

DEFINITION: To generously provide what is necessary for sustenance, supply, or spiritual and material development.
SENSES: 1. To generously grant provision or sustenance (2 Cor 9:10; Gal 3:5).
2. To supply the necessary resources for Christian growth (2 Pet 1:5).

THAYER.pt: Fornecer generosamente o que é necessário para o sustento, suprimento ou desenvolvimento espiritual e material. 1. Conceder generosamente provisão ou sustento (2Co 9.10; Gl 3.5). | 2. Fornecer os recursos necessários para o crescimento cristão (2Pe 1.5).
THAYER.en: To generously provide what is necessary for sustenance, supply, or spiritual and material development. 1. To generously grant provision or sustenance (2 Cor 9:10; Gal 3:5). | 2. To supply the necessary resources for Christian growth (2 Pet 1:5).

DEFINITION: Refers to the act of providing what is necessary to sustain, assist, or supply the needs of someone in the body of Christ.
SENSES: 1. Spiritual and practical assistance or support (Eph 4:16; Phil 1:19).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se ao ato de prover o que é necessário para sustentar, auxiliar ou suprir as necessidades de alguém no corpo de Cristo. 1. Assistência ou suporte espiritual e prático (Ef 4.16; Fp 1.19).
THAYER.en: Refers to the act of providing what is necessary to sustain, assist, or supply the needs of someone in the body of Christ. 1. Spiritual and practical assistance or support (Eph 4:16; Phil 1:19).

SEMANTIC_FIELD: Superficial Contact and Application of Liquids
DEFINITION: Describes the action of applying or spreading a viscous substance, such as ointment, mud, or oil, over a surface or part of the body.
SENSES: 1. To smear or apply mud over the eyes (John 9:6, 11).

THAYER.pt: Descreve a ação de aplicar ou espalhar uma substância viscosa, como pomada, lama ou óleo, sobre uma superfície ou parte do corpo. 1. Untar ou aplicar lama sobre os olhos (Jo 9.6, 11).
THAYER.en: Describes the action of applying or spreading a viscous substance, such as ointment, mud, or oil, over a surface or part of the body. 1. To smear or apply mud over the eyes (John 9:6, 11).

DEFINITION: To build a structure upon an already existing foundation, frequently used in a figurative sense for the spiritual and communal growth of believers.
SENSES: 1. To build something physically upon a pre-existing foundation (Eph 2:20).
2. To build up or strengthen personally or communally in spirit (Col 2:7; 1 Pet 2:5; Jude 20).

THAYER.pt: Significa construir uma estrutura sobre uma base já existente, sendo frequentemente empregado em sentido figurado para o crescimento espiritual e comunitário dos crentes. 1. Construir algo fisicamente sobre uma base preexistente (Ef 2.20). | 2. Edificar ou fortalecer espiritualmente a vida pessoal ou comunitária (Cl 2.7; 1Pe 2.5; Jd 20).
THAYER.en: To build a structure upon an already existing foundation, frequently used in a figurative sense for the spiritual and communal growth of believers. 1. To build something physically upon a pre-existing foundation (Eph 2:20). | 2. To build up or strengthen personally or communally in spirit (Col 2:7; 1 Pet 2:5; Jude 20).

DEFINITION: A nautical term for steering or forcing a vessel against a beach or sandbar, causing it to run aground.
SENSES: 1. The forced grounding of a ship in shallow waters (Acts 27:41).

THAYER.pt: Termo náutico para direcionar ou forçar uma embarcação contra a praia ou banco de areia, fazendo-a encalhar. 1. O encalhe forçado de um navio em águas rasas (At 27.41).
THAYER.en: A nautical term for steering or forcing a vessel against a beach or sandbar, causing it to run aground. 1. The forced grounding of a ship in shallow waters (Acts 27:41).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: ἐπονομάσω, Aor: ἐπωνόμασα, Aor. Pass: ἐπωνομάσθην
DEFINITION: To attribute a name or title to someone or something, conferring a specific designation.
SENSES: 1. To adopt or assume a name or title (Rom 2:17).

THAYER.pt: Significa atribuir um nome ou intitular alguém ou algo, conferindo uma designação específica. 1. Adotar ou assumir um nome ou título (Rm 2.17).
THAYER.en: To attribute a name or title to someone or something, conferring a specific designation. 1. To adopt or assume a name or title (Rom 2:17).

DEFINITION: To pay close attention to something with intention and continuity, observing behavior or reality attentively.
SENSES: 1. To closely observe or contemplate the conduct of others (1 Pet 2:12; 3:2).

THAYER.pt: Significa prestar muita atenção em algo com intenção e continuidade, observando atentamente o comportamento ou a realidade. 1. Observar ou contemplar de perto a conduta alheia (1Pe 2.12; 3.2).
THAYER.en: To pay close attention to something with intention and continuity, observing behavior or reality attentively. 1. To closely observe or contemplate the conduct of others (1 Pet 2:12; 3:2).

DEFINITION: Refers to one who directly observes an event with their own eyes, possessing firsthand knowledge.
SENSES: 1. An eyewitness who personally witnessed the events and majesty of Christ (2 Pet 1:16).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se àquele que observa diretamente um evento com os próprios olhos, possuindo conhecimento em primeira mão. 1. Testemunha ocular que presenciou pessoalmente os eventos e a majestade de Cristo (2Pe 1.16).
THAYER.en: Refers to one who directly observes an event with their own eyes, possessing firsthand knowledge. 1. An eyewitness who personally witnessed the events and majesty of Christ (2 Pet 1:16).

DEFINITION: Represents a minimal unit of discourse, frequently a single word or declaration.
SENSES: 1. A word or expression spoken in the context of a discursive argument (Heb 7:9).

THAYER.pt: Representa uma unidade mínima de discurso, frequentemente uma única palavra ou declaração. 1. Uma palavra ou expressão dita no contexto de um argumento discursivo (Hb 7.9).
THAYER.en: Represents a minimal unit of discourse, frequently a single word or declaration. 1. A word or expression spoken in the context of a discursive argument (Heb 7:9).

DEFINITION: Refers to that which belongs to heaven, the divine sphere, or the transcendent realm, in opposition to that which is earthly.
SENSES: 1. Pertaining to heaven or celestial phenomena (1 Cor 15:40).
2. Relating to the spiritual realm and the dwelling place of God and the saved (Matt 18:35; Heb 12:22).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se àquilo que pertence ao céu, à esfera divina ou ao reino transcendente, em oposição ao que é terreno. 1. Pertençente ao céu ou aos fenômenos celestes (1Co 15.40). | 2. Relativo ao reino espiritual e à habitação de Deus e dos salvos (Mt 18.35; Hb 12.22).
THAYER.en: Refers to that which belongs to heaven, the divine sphere, or the transcendent realm, in opposition to that which is earthly. 1. Pertaining to heaven or celestial phenomena (1 Cor 15:40). | 2. Relating to the spiritual realm and the dwelling place of God and the saved (Matt 18:35; Heb 12:22).

DEFINITION: Cardinal numeral indicating the sum of seven units. In biblical literature, especially apocalyptic writings, it carries strong symbolic value associated with fullness, divine perfection, totality, and temporal conclusion.
SENSES: 1. Strict numerical value of seven elements (Matt 15:34; 22:25; Acts 6:3).
2. Apocalyptic symbol of totality or fullness in prophetic visions (Rev 1:4; 5:1; 8:2).

THAYER.pt: Numeral cardinal que indica a soma de sete unidades. Na literatura bíblica e em especial nos escritos apocalípticos, carrega forte valor simbólico associado à plenitude, perfeição divina, totalidade e conclusão temporal. 1. Valor numérico estrito de sete elementos (Mt 15.34; 22.25; At 6.3). | 2. Símbolo apocalíptico de totalidade ou plenitude nas visões proféticas (Ap 1.4; 5.1; 8.2).
THAYER.en: Cardinal numeral indicating the sum of seven units. In biblical literature, especially apocalyptic writings, it carries strong symbolic value associated with fullness, divine perfection, totality, and temporal conclusion. 1. Strict numerical value of seven elements (Matt 15:34; 22:25; Acts 6:3). | 2. Apocalyptic symbol of totality or fullness in prophetic visions (Rev 1:4; 5:1; 8:2).

DEFINITION: Indicates the occurrence of an action repeated exactly seven times, frequently expressing an ample or complete quantity.
SENSES: 1. To do something seven times on the same occasion (Luke 17:4).

THAYER.pt: Indica a ocorrência de uma ação repetida exatamente sete vezes, frequentemente expressando uma quantidade ampla ou completa. 1. Fazer algo sete vezes em uma mesma ocasião (Lc 17.4).
THAYER.en: Indicates the occurrence of an action repeated exactly seven times, frequently expressing an ample or complete quantity. 1. To do something seven times on the same occasion (Luke 17:4).

DEFINITION: Cardinal numeral expressing the exact quantity of seven thousand.
SENSES: 1. The number seven thousand, used in the context of the remnant of Israel preserved by God (Rom 11:4).

THAYER.pt: Numeral cardinal que expressa exatamente a quantidade de sete mil. 1. O número sete mil, usado no contexto do remanescente de Israel preservado por Deus (Rm 11.4).
THAYER.en: Cardinal numeral expressing the exact quantity of seven thousand. 1. The number seven thousand, used in the context of the remnant of Israel preserved by God (Rom 11:4).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: 2nd Aorist of λέγω; Inf: εἰπεῖν, Part: εἰπών
DEFINITION: Historical aorist form employed to supply the defective verbal system of λέγω. Denotes the punctual and historical act of verbally articulating a message, command, response, or revelation.
SENSES: 1. To pronounce or articulate words at a given historical moment ('said', 'spoke') (Matt 2:8; John 1:21).
2. To give a command or imperative instruction ('to command', 'order') (Matt 4:3; Luke 12:13).
3. To declare or respond to an interrogation ('answered') (Matt 16:16; Luke 22:70).

THAYER.pt: Forma histórica de aoristo empregada para suprir o sistema verbal defectivo de λέγω. Denota o ato pontual e histórico de articular verbalmente uma mensagem, ordem, resposta ou revelação. 1. Pronunciar ou articular palavras em dado momento histórico ('disse', 'falou') (Mt 2.8; Jo 1.21). | 2. Dar uma ordem ou instrução imperativa ('mandar', 'ordenar') (Mt 4.3; Lk 12.13). | 3. Declarar ou responder a uma interpelação ('respondeu') (Mt 16.16; Lk 22.70).
THAYER.en: Historical aorist form employed to supply the defective verbal system of λέγω. Denotes the punctual and historical act of verbally articulating a message, command, response, or revelation. 1. To pronounce or articulate words at a given historical moment ('said', 'spoke') (Matt 2:8; John 1:21). | 2. To give a command or imperative instruction ('to command', 'order') (Matt 4:3; Luke 12:13). | 3. To declare or respond to an interrogation ('answered') (Matt 16:16; Luke 22:70).

DEFINITION: Name of a Christian associated with the apostle Paul, mentioned as the city treasurer of Corinth.
SENSES: 1. Co-worker and traveling companion of Paul (Acts 19:22);
2. City treasurer of Corinth and brother in the faith (Rom 16:23).

THAYER.pt: Nome de um cristão associado ao apóstolo Paulo, mencionado como tesoureiro da cidade de Corinto. 1. Cooperador e companheiro de viagens de Paulo (At 19.22); | 2. Tesoureiro da cidade de Corinto e irmão na fé (Rm 16.23).
THAYER.en: Name of a Christian associated with the apostle Paul, mentioned as the city treasurer of Corinth. 1. Co-worker and traveling companion of Paul (Acts 19:22); | 2. City treasurer of Corinth and brother in the faith (Rom 16:23).

DEFINITION: To develop productive activity that requires physical or mental effort, generating fruits or practical results.
SENSES: 1. To perform manual or professional labor, to work (Acts 18:3; 1 Thess 2:9).
2. To practice, perform, or execute an action or deed (John 6:28; Rom 2:10).

THAYER.pt: Desenvolver atividade produtiva que exige esforço físico ou mental, gerando frutos ou resultados práticos. 1. Realizar trabalho manual ou profissional, laborar (At 18.3; 1Ts 2.9). | 2. Praticar, realizar ou executar uma ação ou obra (Jo 6.28; Rm 2.10).
THAYER.en: To develop productive activity that requires physical or mental effort, generating fruits or practical results. 1. To perform manual or professional labor, to work (Acts 18:3; 1 Thess 2:9). | 2. To practice, perform, or execute an action or deed (John 6:28; Rom 2:10).

DEFINITION: Active involvement in an occupation, commercial activity, habitual behavior, or the revenue obtained through such labor.
SENSES: 1. Practice or conduct in a lifestyle (Eph 4:19).
2. Commercial activity or profession (Acts 19:25).
3. Profit or financial gain coming from labor (Acts 16:19).

THAYER.pt: O envolvimento ativo em uma ocupação, atividade comercial, comportamento habitual ou o rendimento obtido por meio de tal labor. 1. Prática ou conduta em um estilo de vida (Ef 4.19). | 2. Atividade comercial ou profissão (At 19.25). | 3. Lucro ou ganho financeiro proveniente do trabalho (At 16.19).
THAYER.en: Active involvement in an occupation, commercial activity, habitual behavior, or the revenue obtained through such labor. 1. Practice or conduct in a lifestyle (Eph 4:19). | 2. Commercial activity or profession (Acts 19:25). | 3. Profit or financial gain coming from labor (Acts 16:19).

DEFINITION: One who engages in a labor activity, whether manual labor or apostolic and evangelistic ministry.
SENSES: 1. Manual laborer or agricultural worker (Matt 10:10; Jas 5:4).
2. Worker engaged in the work of the gospel and teaching (2 Cor 11:13; 2 Tim 2:15).

THAYER.pt: Aquele que se dedica a uma atividade laboral, seja trabalho físico ou o ministério apostólico e evangelístico. 1. Trabalhador braçal ou operário agrícola (Mt 10.10; Tg 5.4). | 2. Obreiro engajado na obra do evangelho e no ensino (2Co 11.13; 2Tm 2.15).
THAYER.en: One who engages in a labor activity, whether manual labor or apostolic and evangelistic ministry. 1. Manual laborer or agricultural worker (Matt 10:10; Jas 5:4). | 2. Worker engaged in the work of the gospel and teaching (2 Cor 11:13; 2 Tim 2:15).

DEFINITION: Any undertaken action, executed task, or deed operated by a person. It encompasses someone's professional occupation, moral conduct manifested in concrete acts, or God's salvific and miraculous action.
SENSES: 1. Concrete action, moral conduct, or individual ethical deed (Matt 5:16; Jas 2:14; John 3:19).
2. Vocational work, continuous occupation, or assigned task (John 17:4; 1Cor 15:58).
3. The miraculous and redemptive acts of God and Christ (John 5:20; John 10:25).

THAYER.pt: Qualquer ação empreendida, tarefa executada ou feito operado por uma pessoa. Abrange a ocupação profissional de alguém, a conduta moral manifestada em atos concretos ou a ação salvífica e miraculosa de Deus. 1. Ação concreta, conduta moral ou feito ético individual (Mt 5.16; Tg 2.14; Jo 3.19). | 2. Trabalho vocacional, ocupação contínua ou tarefa atribuída (Jo 17.4; 1Co 15.58). | 3. Os atos miraculosos e redentores de Deus e de Cristo (Jo 5.20; Jo 10.25).
THAYER.en: Any undertaken action, executed task, or deed operated by a person. It encompasses someone's professional occupation, moral conduct manifested in concrete acts, or God's salvific and miraculous action. 1. Concrete action, moral conduct, or individual ethical deed (Matt 5:16; Jas 2:14; John 3:19). | 2. Vocational work, continuous occupation, or assigned task (John 17:4; 1Cor 15:58). | 3. The miraculous and redemptive acts of God and Christ (John 5:20; John 10:25).

DEFINITION: To stimulate or provoke a reaction in someone, which may have a negative sense of irritating or embittering, or a positive sense of encouraging.
SENSES: 1. To irritate or exasperate someone, especially parents toward children (Col 3:21).
2. To stimulate or encourage toward good deeds (2 Cor 9:2).

THAYER.pt: Estimular ou provocar uma reação em alguém, podendo ter um sentido negativo de irritar ou amargurar, ou positivo de encorajar. 1. Irritar ou exasperar alguém, especialmente pais aos filhos (Cl 3.21). | 2. Estimular ou encorajar a boas ações (2Co 9.2).
THAYER.en: To stimulate or provoke a reaction in someone, which may have a negative sense of irritating or embittering, or a positive sense of encouraging. 1. To irritate or exasperate someone, especially parents toward children (Col 3:21). | 2. To stimulate or encourage toward good deeds (2 Cor 9:2).

DEFINITION: Describes the action of fixing something firmly or causing it to run aground so that it cannot be moved.
SENSES: 1. To run aground or fix a ship firmly on a sandbar or reef (Acts 27:41).

THAYER.pt: Descreve a ação de fixar firmemente algo ou fazer com que encalhe de modo a não poder ser movido. 1. Encalhar ou fixar firmemente um navio em um banco de areia ou recife (At 27.41).
THAYER.en: Describes the action of fixing something firmly or causing it to run aground so that it cannot be moved. 1. To run aground or fix a ship firmly on a sandbar or reef (Acts 27:41).

DEFINITION: Originally meaning to gush forth or expel, it came to indicate the solemn and emphatic announcement of hidden truths.
SENSES: 1. To proclaim or declare truths hidden since the foundation of the world (Matt 13:35).

THAYER.pt: Originariamente significando jorrar ou expelir, passou a indicar o anúncio solene e enfático de verdades ocultas. 1. Proclamar ou declarar verdades encobertas desde a fundação do mundo (Mt 13.35).
THAYER.en: Originally meaning to gush forth or expel, it came to indicate the solemn and emphatic announcement of hidden truths. 1. To proclaim or declare truths hidden since the foundation of the world (Matt 13:35).

DEFINITION: To conduct a thorough and diligent search to discover information, truths, or deep intentions.
SENSES: 1. To examine the Scriptures carefully or investigate a matter (John 5:39; Rom 8:27).

THAYER.pt: Realizar uma busca minuciosa e diligente para descobrir informações, verdades ou intenções profundas. 1. Examinar cuidadosamente as Escrituras ou investigar um assunto (Jo 5.39; Rm 8.27).
THAYER.en: To conduct a thorough and diligent search to discover information, truths, or deep intentions. 1. To examine the Scriptures carefully or investigate a matter (John 5:39; Rom 8:27).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Suppletive future of λέγω/εἶπον; Perf: εἴρηκα, Perf Pass: εἴρημαι
DEFINITION: A form used in the defective system of the Greek verb for 'to speak/say' with a predominant future or perfect value; it expresses the act of issuing a declaration, revelation, promise, or prophetic citation.
SENSES: 1. To say in the future tense: I will speak, I will proclaim (Matt 26:75; Rom 9:19).
2. In the perfect passive participle (τὸ εἰρημένον): that which was spoken or predicted by prophecy (Matt 2:17; Luke 2:24).
3. To declare or call out emphatically (Rev 17:7).

THAYER.pt: Forma usada no sistema defectivo do verbo grego para 'falar/dizer' com valor preponderante de futuro ou perfeito; expressa o ato de emitir uma declaração, revelação, promessa ou citação profética. 1. Dizer no tempo futuro: falarei, proclamarei (Mt 26.75; Rm 9.19). | 2. No particípio perfeito passivo (τὸ εἰρημένον): aquilo que foi falado ou predito pela profecia (Mt 2.17; Lc 2.24). | 3. Declarar ou chamar de modo enfático (Ap 17.7).
THAYER.en: A form used in the defective system of the Greek verb for 'to speak/say' with a predominant future or perfect value; it expresses the act of issuing a declaration, revelation, promise, or prophetic citation. 1. To say in the future tense: I will speak, I will proclaim (Matt 26:75; Rom 9:19). | 2. In the perfect passive participle (τὸ εἰρημένον): that which was spoken or predicted by prophecy (Matt 2:17; Luke 2:24). | 3. To declare or call out emphatically (Rev 17:7).

DEFINITION: Refers to an uninhabited or sparsely populated region, characterized by sparse vegetation and isolation.
SENSES: 1. Desert or isolated region (Matt 15:33).
2. Dangers or solitude in uninhabited regions (2 Cor 11:26).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se a uma região desabitada ou escassamente povoada, caracterizada pela vegetação esparsa e isolamento. 1. Região desértica ou isolada (Mt 15.33). | 2. Perigos ou solidão em regiões desabitadas (2Co 11.26).
THAYER.en: Refers to an uninhabited or sparsely populated region, characterized by sparse vegetation and isolation. 1. Desert or isolated region (Matt 15:33). | 2. Dangers or solitude in uninhabited regions (2 Cor 11:26).

DEFINITION: Qualifies an uninhabited, barren, and depopulated area, or a helpless person. Used as a noun in the feminine (ἡ ἔρημος), it denotes the desert region of Judea and the Sinai Peninsula.
SENSES: 1. Feminine noun: desert, uninhabited and wild region (Matt 3:1; Matt 4:1; Acts 7:30).
2. Isolated, retired, or desert place in contrast to the city (Matt 14:13; Mark 1:35).
3. Desolate, abandoned, or emptied of its inhabitants (Matt 23:38; Gal 4:27; Rev 17:16).

THAYER.pt: Qualifica uma área desabitada, estéril e despovoada, ou uma pessoa desamparada. Substantivado no feminino (ἡ ἔρημος), denota a região do deserto ou ermo da Judeia e da península do Sinai. 1. Substantivado feminino: deserto, região desabitada e selvagem (Mt 3.1; Mt 4.1; At 7.30). | 2. Lugar isolado, retirado ou deserto em contraste com a cidade (Mt 14.13; Mc 1.35). | 3. Desolado, abandonado ou esvaziado de seus habitantes (Mt 23.38; Gl 4.27; Ap 17.16).
THAYER.en: Qualifies an uninhabited, barren, and depopulated area, or a helpless person. Used as a noun in the feminine (ἡ ἔρημος), it denotes the desert region of Judea and the Sinai Peninsula. 1. Feminine noun: desert, uninhabited and wild region (Matt 3:1; Matt 4:1; Acts 7:30). | 2. Isolated, retired, or desert place in contrast to the city (Matt 14:13; Mark 1:35). | 3. Desolate, abandoned, or emptied of its inhabitants (Matt 23:38; Gal 4:27; Rev 17:16).

DEFINITION: To reduce a place or institution to a state of total desolation, ruin, or uninhabitability.
SENSES: 1. To destroy or devastate cities, kingdoms, or structures (Matt 12:25; Rev 17:16).

THAYER.pt: Reduzir um lugar ou instituição a um estado de total desolação, ruína ou inabitabilidade. 1. Destruir ou devastar cidades, reinos ou estruturas (Mt 12.25; Ap 17.16).
THAYER.en: To reduce a place or institution to a state of total desolation, ruin, or uninhabitability. 1. To destroy or devastate cities, kingdoms, or structures (Matt 12:25; Rev 17:16).

DEFINITION: The state or act of making a place totally uninhabited, devastated, or ruined.
SENSES: 1. The desolation prophesied over the city of Jerusalem (Luke 21:20);
2. The abomination of desolation in the holy place (Matt 24:15).

THAYER.pt: O estado ou ato de tornar um lugar totalmente desabitado, devastado ou arruinado. 1. A desolação profetizada sobre a cidade de Jerusalém (Lc 21.20); | 2. A abominação desoladora no lugar santo (Mt 24.15).
THAYER.en: The state or act of making a place totally uninhabited, devastated, or ruined. 1. The desolation prophesied over the city of Jerusalem (Luke 21:20); | 2. The abomination of desolation in the holy place (Matt 24:15).

DEFINITION: Involves expressing differences of opinion accompanied by antagonism, strife, or verbal hostility.
SENSES: 1. To dispute, contend, or quarrel verbally in opposition to a peaceful spirit (Matt 12:19).

THAYER.pt: Envolve expressar diferenças de opinião acompanhadas de antagonismo, contenda ou hostilidade verbal. 1. Disputar, contender ou brigar verbalmente em oposição ao espírito pacífico (Mt 12.19).
THAYER.en: Involves expressing differences of opinion accompanied by antagonism, strife, or verbal hostility. 1. To dispute, contend, or quarrel verbally in opposition to a peaceful spirit (Matt 12:19).

DEFINITION: Indicates an attitude motivated by selfishness, the pursuit of supremacy, and factious rivalry, generating division and strife.
SENSES: 1. Factious rivalry and a spirit of contention (Phil 1:17; 2:3).
2. Selfish ambition based on jealousy and opposition (Rom 2:8).

THAYER.pt: Indica uma atitude motivada pelo egoísmo, busca por supremacia e rivalidade facciosa, gerando divisão e contenda. 1. Rivalidade facciosa e espírito de contenda (Fp 1.17; 2.3). | 2. Ambição egoísta baseada em ciúme e oposição (Rm 2.8).
THAYER.en: Indicates an attitude motivated by selfishness, the pursuit of supremacy, and factious rivalry, generating division and strife. 1. Factious rivalry and a spirit of contention (Phil 1:17; 2:3). | 2. Selfish ambition based on jealousy and opposition (Rom 2:8).

DEFINITION: The curly, processed hair of sheep, used in antiquity for clothing, fabrics, and purification rituals.
SENSES: 1. Sheep's wool used in liturgical and symbolic contexts (Heb 9:19; Rev 1:14).

THAYER.pt: O pelo crespo e processado de ovelhas, utilizado na antiguidade para vestimentas, tecidos e rituais de purificação. 1. Lã de ovelha usada em contextos litúrgicos e simbólicos (Hb 9.19; Ap 1.14).
THAYER.en: The curly, processed hair of sheep, used in antiquity for clothing, fabrics, and purification rituals. 1. Sheep's wool used in liturgical and symbolic contexts (Heb 9:19; Rev 1:14).

DEFINITION: Conflict or rivalry expressed in heated debates, discord, and factional disagreements between people.
SENSES: 1. Strife, discord, or interpersonal rivalry (Rom 13:13; 1 Cor 1:11).

THAYER.pt: Conflito ou rivalidade expressa em debates acalorados, discórdias e desentendimentos faccionais entre pessoas. 1. Contenda, discórdia ou rivalidade interpessoal (Rm 13.13; 1Co 1.11).
THAYER.en: Conflict or rivalry expressed in heated debates, discord, and factional disagreements between people. 1. Strife, discord, or interpersonal rivalry (Rom 13:13; 1 Cor 1:11).

DEFINITION: Diminutive of érifos, designating a young goat or kid, frequently used in metaphors.
SENSES: 1. A kid, used in contrast with sheep in the parable of the final judgment (Matt 25:33; Luke 15:29).

THAYER.pt: Diminutivo de érifos, designando um cabrito ou bode jovem, frequentemente usado em metáforas. 1. Um cabrito, usado em contraste com as ovelhas na parábola do juízo final (Mt 25.33; Lc 15.29).
THAYER.en: Diminutive of érifos, designating a young goat or kid, frequently used in metaphors. 1. A kid, used in contrast with sheep in the parable of the final judgment (Matt 25:33; Luke 15:29).

DEFINITION: Designates the young of a goat (kid), frequently used in parables and contrasted with sheep.
SENSES: 1. Kid or goat in metaphors of judgment or everyday narratives (Matt 25:32; Luke 15:29).

THAYER.pt: Designa o filhote da cabra (cabrito), frequentemente usado em parábolas e contrastado com ovelhas. 1. Cabrito ou bode em metáforas de julgamento ou narrativas cotidianas (Mt 25.32; Lc 15.29).
THAYER.en: Designates the young of a goat (kid), frequently used in parables and contrasted with sheep. 1. Kid or goat in metaphors of judgment or everyday narratives (Matt 25:32; Luke 15:29).

DEFINITION: Name of an early Christian associated with the community in Rome.
SENSES: 1. A Roman Christian to whom Paul sends greetings in the Epistle to the Romans (Rom 16:14).

THAYER.pt: Nome de um cristão primitivo associado à comunidade de Roma. 1. Um cristão romano a quem Paulo envia saudações na Epístola aos Romanos (Rm 16.14).
THAYER.en: Name of an early Christian associated with the community in Rome. 1. A Roman Christian to whom Paul sends greetings in the Epistle to the Romans (Rom 16:14).

DEFINITION: The ability or process of explaining, clarifying, or translating a message or unknown language so that it may be understood.
SENSES: 1. The spiritual gift of interpretation of tongues in the community (1 Cor 12:10).

THAYER.pt: A capacidade ou o processo de explicar, esclarecer ou traduzir uma mensagem ou língua desconhecida para que seja compreendida. 1. O dom espiritual de interpretação de línguas na comunidade (1Co 12.10).
THAYER.en: The ability or process of explaining, clarifying, or translating a message or unknown language so that it may be understood. 1. The spiritual gift of interpretation of tongues in the community (1 Cor 12:10).

DEFINITION: To clarify the meaning of something obscure or to translate words from one language to another.
SENSES: 1. To explain or clarify the meaning of a text or concept;
2. To translate terms from one language to another (Heb 7:2).

THAYER.pt: Esclarecer o significado de algo obscuro ou traduzir palavras de uma língua para outra. 1. Explicar ou esclarecer o sentido de um texto ou conceito; | 2. Traduzir termos de um idioma para outro (Hb 7.2).
THAYER.en: To clarify the meaning of something obscure or to translate words from one language to another. 1. To explain or clarify the meaning of a text or concept; | 2. To translate terms from one language to another (Heb 7:2).

DEFINITION: Proper name referring both to the Greek god of eloquence and to a Christian in the community of Rome.
SENSES: 1. Hermes, the Greek god identified with Paul in Lystra (Acts 14:12).
2. A Christian greeted in the letter to the Romans (Rom 16:14).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio que se refere tanto ao deus grego da eloquência quanto a um cristão na comunidade de Roma. 1. Hermes, o deus grego identificado com Paulo em Listra (At 14.12). | 2. Um cristão saudado na carta aos Romanos (Rm 16.14).
THAYER.en: Proper name referring both to the Greek god of eloquence and to a Christian in the community of Rome. 1. Hermes, the Greek god identified with Paul in Lystra (Acts 14:12). | 2. A Christian greeted in the letter to the Romans (Rom 16:14).

DEFINITION: Masculine proper name of a Christian from the province of Asia.
SENSES: 1. An Asian Christian who abandoned the apostle Paul during his hardships (2 Tim 1:15).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio masculino de um cristão da província da Ásia. 1. Um cristão asiático que abandonou o apóstolo Paulo durante suas privações (2Tm 1.15).
THAYER.en: Masculine proper name of a Christian from the province of Asia. 1. An Asian Christian who abandoned the apostle Paul during his hardships (2 Tim 1:15).

DEFINITION: Designates animals that crawl or move close to the ground, including reptiles and snakes.
SENSES: 1. Creeping creatures and reptiles in general (Acts 10:12; Rom 1:23).

THAYER.pt: Designa animais que rastejam ou se movem rente ao solo, abrangendo répteis e serpentes. 1. Criaturas rastejantes e répteis em geral (At 10.12; Rm 1.23).
THAYER.en: Designates animals that crawl or move close to the ground, including reptiles and snakes. 1. Creeping creatures and reptiles in general (Acts 10:12; Rom 1:23).

DEFINITION: An adjective denoting the bright red color, classically associated with bodies of water in biblical geographical contexts.
SENSES: 1. Red, in reference to the Red Sea (Acts 7:36).

THAYER.pt: Adjetivo que denota a cor vermelha viva, associada classicamente a corpos d'água em contextos geográficos bíblicos. 1. Vermelho, em referência ao Mar Vermelho (At 7.36).
THAYER.en: An adjective denoting the bright red color, classically associated with bodies of water in biblical geographical contexts. 1. Red, in reference to the Red Sea (Acts 7:36).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Deponent. Fut: ἐλεύσομαι, Aor: ἦλθον, Perf: ἐλήλυθα
DEFINITION: A polysemous verb of displacement denoting approach or movement toward a destination, as well as public appearance or eschatological advent.
SENSES: 1. To move from one point to another; to come toward the speaker (Matt 8:9; John 1:39).
2. To go toward a specific place or destination (Matt 16:24; Mark 1:45).
3. To make a public appearance or manifest historically, said of Jesus or the Messiah (Matt 11:3; John 4:25).

THAYER.pt: Verbo polissêmico de deslocamento que denota aproximação ou movimento em direção a um destino, bem como o comparecimento público ou advento escatológico. 1. Mover-se de um ponto a outro; vir em direção a quem fala (Mt 8.9; Jo 1.39). | 2. Ir em direção a determinado lugar ou destino (Mt 16.24; Mc 1.45). | 3. Fazer aparição pública ou manifestar-se historicamente, dito de Jesus ou do Messias (Mt 11.3; Jo 4.25).
THAYER.en: A polysemous verb of displacement denoting approach or movement toward a destination, as well as public appearance or eschatological advent. 1. To move from one point to another; to come toward the speaker (Matt 8:9; John 1:39). | 2. To go toward a specific place or destination (Matt 16:24; Mark 1:45). | 3. To make a public appearance or manifest historically, said of Jesus or the Messiah (Matt 11:3; John 4:25).

DEFINITION: Means to direct a question to someone to obtain information or, by frequent extension, to make a solicitous request or supplication.
SENSES: 1. To direct a question to someone, to inquire (Matt 21:24; Mark 4:10).
2. To make a request, to solicit or implore for something (Luke 4:38; John 17:9).

THAYER.pt: Significa dirigir uma pergunta a alguém para obter informação ou, por extensão frequente, fazer um pedido solícito ou súplica. 1. Dirigir uma pergunta a alguém, indagar (Mt 21.24; Mk 4.10). | 2. Fazer um pedido, solicitar ou rogar por algo (Lc 4.38; Jo 17.9).
THAYER.en: Means to direct a question to someone to obtain information or, by frequent extension, to make a solicitous request or supplication. 1. To direct a question to someone, to inquire (Matt 21:24; Mark 4:10). | 2. To make a request, to solicit or implore for something (Luke 4:38; John 17:9).

DEFINITION: A general term referring to costumes, cloaks, or elegant or common garments worn by individuals.
SENSES: 1. Clothing or formal or everyday attire (Luke 23:11; Acts 10:30).

THAYER.pt: Termo geral que se refere a trajes, mantos ou vestimentas elegantes ou comuns usadas por indivíduos. 1. Roupa ou traje formal ou cotidiano (Lc 23.11; At 10.30).
THAYER.en: A general term referring to costumes, cloaks, or elegant or common garments worn by individuals. 1. Clothing or formal or everyday attire (Luke 23:11; Acts 10:30).

DEFINITION: A noun referring to the clothing, garment, or attire worn by a person.
SENSES: 1. An article of clothing or garment in general (Luke 24:4).

THAYER.pt: Substantivo que se refere ao vestuário, roupa ou indumentária utilizada por uma pessoa. 1. Peça de roupa ou vestimenta em geral (Lc 24.4).
THAYER.en: A noun referring to the clothing, garment, or attire worn by a person. 1. An article of clothing or garment in general (Luke 24:4).

DEFINITION: Refers to the physiological act of ingesting solid or liquid food, and, in a metaphorical sense, to the total consumption or destruction of something.
SENSES: 1. To ingest food, to eat or feed oneself (Matt 15:32; Luke 12:19).
2. To consume or destroy something completely, as fire consumes substances (Heb 10:27; Jas 5:3).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se ao ato fisiológico de ingerir alimentos sólidos ou líquidos, e, em sentido metafórico, ao consumo ou destruição total de algo. 1. Ingerir alimentos, comer ou alimentar-se (Mt 15.32; Lc 12.19). | 2. Consumir ou destruir completamente algo, como o fogo consome substâncias (Hb 10.27; Tg 5.3).
THAYER.en: Refers to the physiological act of ingesting solid or liquid food, and, in a metaphorical sense, to the total consumption or destruction of something. 1. To ingest food, to eat or feed oneself (Matt 15:32; Luke 12:19). | 2. To consume or destroy something completely, as fire consumes substances (Heb 10:27; Jas 5:3).

DEFINITION: A man's proper name present in the genealogy of Jesus Christ according to the account of Luke.
SENSES: 1. An ancestor of Jesus in the lineage described in the third gospel (Luke 3:25).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio de homem presente na genealogia de Jesus Cristo segundo o relato de Lucas. 1. Ancestral de Jesus na linhagem descrita no terceiro evangelho (Lc 3.25).
THAYER.en: A man's proper name present in the genealogy of Jesus Christ according to the account of Luke. 1. An ancestor of Jesus in the lineage described in the third gospel (Luke 3:25).

DEFINITION: A verbal form of the verb 'to be' in the first person plural of the present indicative, expressing collective identity, state, or existence.
SENSES: 1. Expression of collective existence or identity (Eph 2:10).

THAYER.pt: Forma verbal do verbo ser na primeira pessoa do plural do presente do indicativo, expressando identidade, estado ou existência coletiva. 1. Expressão de existência ou identidade coletiva (Ef 2.10).
THAYER.en: A verbal form of the verb 'to be' in the first person plural of the present indicative, expressing collective identity, state, or existence. 1. Expression of collective existence or identity (Eph 2:10).

DEFINITION: A form of the future middle of the verb 'to be', indicating a future state or condition to be realized.
SENSES: 1. Indication of future state or existence (Heb 8:10).

THAYER.pt: Forma do futuro médio do verbo ser/estar, indicando um estado ou condição futura a se realizar. 1. Indicação de estado ou existência futura (Hb 8.10).
THAYER.en: A form of the future middle of the verb 'to be', indicating a future state or condition to be realized. 1. Indication of future state or existence (Heb 8:10).

DEFINITION: A flat piece of highly polished metal used in antiquity to reflect an image, serving as an analogy for spiritual perception.
SENSES: 1. A reflective surface or mirror used for spiritual analogies (1 Cor 13:12; Jas 1:23).

THAYER.pt: Uma peça plana de metal altamente polido usada na Antiguidade para refletir a imagem, servindo como analogia para a percepção espiritual. 1. Superfície refletora ou espelho usado para analogias espirituais (1Co 13.12; Tg 1.23).
THAYER.en: A flat piece of highly polished metal used in antiquity to reflect an image, serving as an analogy for spiritual perception. 1. A reflective surface or mirror used for spiritual analogies (1 Cor 13:12; Jas 1:23).

DEFINITION: The period of the day from late afternoon until nightfall.
SENSES: 1. The fall of evening or the beginning of night (Luke 24:29; Acts 4:3).

THAYER.pt: O período do dia que vai do final da tarde até o cair da noite. 1. O cair da tarde ou início da noite (Lc 24.29; At 4.3).
THAYER.en: The period of the day from late afternoon until nightfall. 1. The fall of evening or the beginning of night (Luke 24:29; Acts 4:3).

DEFINITION: An Old Testament character mentioned in the genealogy of the Lord Jesus Christ.
SENSES: 1. An ancestor of Jesus in the messianic line (Matt 1:3; Luke 3:33).

THAYER.pt: Personagem veterotestamentário mencionado na genealogia do Senhor Jesus Cristo. 1. Ancestral de Jesus na linha messiânica (Mt 1.3; Lc 3.33).
THAYER.en: An Old Testament character mentioned in the genealogy of the Lord Jesus Christ. 1. An ancestor of Jesus in the messianic line (Matt 1:3; Luke 3:33).

DEFINITION: A verbal form of the verb 'to be' in the second person plural of the present indicative, addressed to listeners to indicate their condition or identity.
SENSES: 1. Indication of the identity or condition of the listeners (Col 3:3).

THAYER.pt: Forma verbal do verbo ser na segunda pessoa do plural do presente do indicativo, dirigida aos ouvintes para indicar sua condição ou identidade. 1. Indicação de identidade ou condição dos ouvintes (Cl 3.3).
THAYER.en: A verbal form of the verb 'to be' in the second person plural of the present indicative, addressed to listeners to indicate their condition or identity. 1. Indication of the identity or condition of the listeners (Col 3:3).

DEFINITION: A verbal form of the verb 'to be' in the third person singular of the present indicative, indicating attribution, existence, or equivalence.
SENSES: 1. Affirmation of existence, identity, or attribute (John 1:1).

THAYER.pt: Forma verbal do verbo ser na terceira pessoa do singular do presente do indicativo, indicando atribuição, existência ou equivalência. 1. Afirmação de existência, identidade ou atributo (Jo 1.1).
THAYER.en: A verbal form of the verb 'to be' in the third person singular of the present indicative, indicating attribution, existence, or equivalence. 1. Affirmation of existence, identity, or attribute (John 1:1).
