DEFINITION: An imperative form of the verb 'to be' in the third person singular, used to order or express a wish regarding a state of affairs.
SENSES: 1. An order or exhortation for something to be or remain in a certain state (Jas 1:19).

THAYER.pt: Forma do imperativo do verbo ser na terceira pessoa do singular, usada para ordenar ou expressar um desejo sobre um estado de coisas. 1. Ordem ou exortação para que algo seja ou permaneça em determinado estado (Tg 1.19).
THAYER.en: An imperative form of the verb 'to be' in the third person singular, used to order or express a wish regarding a state of affairs. 1. An order or exhortation for something to be or remain in a certain state (Jas 1:19).

DEFINITION: Indicates the point furthest in space or the final element in a temporal or hierarchical series.
SENSES: 1. The last in a series or temporal succession (Matt 20:8; Rev 1:17).
2. The furthest in space or extreme limit (Acts 1:8).
3. The lowest in status, importance, or position (Matt 19:30; 1 Cor 4:9).

THAYER.pt: Indica o ponto mais distante no espaço ou o derradeiro elemento em uma série temporal ou de hierarquia. 1. O último em uma série ou sucessão temporal (Mt 20.8; Ap 1.17). | 2. O mais distante no espaço ou limite extremo (At 1.8). | 3. O mais inferior em status, importância ou posição (Mt 19.30; 1Co 4.9).
THAYER.en: Indicates the point furthest in space or the final element in a temporal or hierarchical series. 1. The last in a series or temporal succession (Matt 20:8; Rev 1:17). | 2. The furthest in space or extreme limit (Acts 1:8). | 3. The lowest in status, importance, or position (Matt 19:30; 1 Cor 4:9).

SHORT_GLOSS: at the point of death, gravely
DEFINITION: Indicates the condition of being at the extreme limit of life, gravely ill and about to die.
SENSES: 1. To be very ill, on the threshold of death (Mark 5:23).
USAGE: at the point of death, gravely

THAYER.pt: Indica a condição de estar no extremo limite da vida, gravemente enfermo e prestes a falecer. 1. Estar muito mal de saúde, no limiar da morte (Mc 5.23).
THAYER.en: Indicates the condition of being at the extreme limit of life, gravely ill and about to die. 1. To be very ill, on the threshold of death (Mark 5:23).

DEFINITION: Indicates a position inside a delimited space or refers figuratively to the internal psychological and spiritual realm of a person.
SENSES: 1. Into or inside a place (Matt 26:58; John 20:26).
2. Figuratively, in the inner self or the inner man (Rom 7:22).

THAYER.pt: Indica uma posição no interior de um espaço delimitado ou refere-se figurativamente ao âmbito psicológico e espiritual interno da pessoa. 1. Para dentro ou no interior de um lugar (Mt 26.58; Jo 20.26). | 2. Figurativamente, no íntimo ou no homem interior (Rm 7.22).
THAYER.en: Indicates a position inside a delimited space or refers figuratively to the internal psychological and spiritual realm of a person. 1. Into or inside a place (Matt 26:58; John 20:26). | 2. Figuratively, in the inner self or the inner man (Rom 7:22).

DEFINITION: Indicates the internal location of an object or the origin of something that originates from within.
SENSES: 1. From a source or origin situated within (Mark 7:23).
2. On the inside, within something (Luke 11:39).

THAYER.pt: Indica a localização interna de um objeto ou a procedência de algo que se origina a partir do interior. 1. A partir de uma fonte ou origem situada no interior (Mc 7.23). | 2. Na parte interna, no interior de algo (Lc 11.39).
THAYER.en: Indicates the internal location of an object or the origin of something that originates from within. 1. From a source or origin situated within (Mark 7:23). | 2. On the inside, within something (Luke 11:39).

DEFINITION: Pertaining to or relating to a position situated further inside, within the interior of a space or structure.
SENSES: 1. The innermost part of a building or sanctuary, such as the Most Holy Place (Acts 16:24; Heb 6:19).

THAYER.pt: Pertencente ou relativo a uma posição situada mais para dentro, no interior de um espaço ou estrutura. 1. A parte mais interior de um edifício ou santuário, como o santíssimo (At 16.24; Hb 6.19).
THAYER.en: Pertaining to or relating to a position situated further inside, within the interior of a space or structure. 1. The innermost part of a building or sanctuary, such as the Most Holy Place (Acts 16:24; Heb 6:19).

DEFINITION: A person with whom one has an association or partnership, not necessarily implying deep affection, but sharing a common context.
SENSES: 1. Companion or fellow worker in parables (Matt 20:13);
2. Vocative used for an interlocutor in contexts of rebuke (Matt 22:12).

THAYER.pt: Pessoa com quem se tem associação ou parceria, não necessariamente implicando afeto profundo, mas partilhando de um contexto comum. 1. Companheiro ou colega de trabalho em parábolas (Mt 20.13); | 2. Vocativo usado para um interlocutor em contextos de repreensão (Mt 22.12).
THAYER.en: A person with whom one has an association or partnership, not necessarily implying deep affection, but sharing a common context. 1. Companion or fellow worker in parables (Matt 20:13); | 2. Vocative used for an interlocutor in contexts of rebuke (Matt 22:12).

DEFINITION: Refers to one who speaks a different, strange, or foreign language.
SENSES: 1. A person who speaks in a foreign or unknown language (1 Cor 14:21).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se àquele que fala uma língua diferente, estranha ou estrangeira. 1. Pessoa que fala em uma língua estrangeira ou desconhecida (1Co 14.21).
THAYER.en: Refers to one who speaks a different, strange, or foreign language. 1. A person who speaks in a foreign or unknown language (1 Cor 14:21).

DEFINITION: To teach doctrines contrary to the sound and standard apostolic instruction, causing division and deviation in the faith community.
SENSES: 1. To disseminate false or divergent teachings from the Christian truth (1 Tim 1:3).

THAYER.pt: Ensinar doutrinas contrárias à sã e padrão instrução apostólica, gerando divisão e desvio na comunidade de fé. 1. Disseminar ensinamentos falsos ou divergentes da verdade cristã (1Tm 1.3).
THAYER.en: To teach doctrines contrary to the sound and standard apostolic instruction, causing division and deviation in the faith community. 1. To disseminate false or divergent teachings from the Christian truth (1 Tim 1:3).

DEFINITION: Metaphorically, it means to be poorly associated or placed under an improper yoke with someone incompatible.
SENSES: 1. To maintain an inadequate association or unequal yoke with unbelievers (2 Cor 6:14).

THAYER.pt: Metaforicamente, significa estar mal associado ou colocado sob um jugo impróprio com alguém incompatível. 1. Manter uma associação inadequada ou jugo desigual com descrentes (2Co 6.14).
THAYER.en: Metaphorically, it means to be poorly associated or placed under an improper yoke with someone incompatible. 1. To maintain an inadequate association or unequal yoke with unbelievers (2 Cor 6:14).

DEFINITION: Indicates another in contrast to the first, often signaling a qualitative difference or difference in nature regarding the previous referent (in contrast to ἄλλος, which commonly points to numerical otherness).
SENSES: 1. One of two elements in comparison: the other (Matt 8:21; Luke 7:41).
2. Different in character, substance, or type: of another kind (Gal 1:6; 1 Cor 15:40).
3. The neighbor, the fellow human in social interaction (Rom 13:8).

THAYER.pt: Indica outro em contraste com o primeiro, amiúde assinalando uma diferença qualitativa ou de natureza com relação ao referente anterior (em contraste com ἄλλος, que comumente aponta para outro numérico). 1. Um outro de dois elementos em comparação: o outro (Mt 8.21; Lc 7.41). | 2. Diferente em caráter, substância ou tipo: de outra espécie (Gl 1.6; 1Co 15.40). | 3. O próximo, o semelhante no convívio social (Rm 13.8).
THAYER.en: Indicates another in contrast to the first, often signaling a qualitative difference or difference in nature regarding the previous referent (in contrast to ἄλλος, which commonly points to numerical otherness). 1. One of two elements in comparison: the other (Matt 8:21; Luke 7:41). | 2. Different in character, substance, or type: of another kind (Gal 1:6; 1 Cor 15:40). | 3. The neighbor, the fellow human in social interaction (Rom 13:8).

DEFINITION: Describes an action or circumstance that occurs in a distinct, contrary, or alternative manner.
SENSES: 1. To think or act in a way different from what is expected or correct (Phil 3:15).

THAYER.pt: Descreve uma ação ou circunstância que ocorre de maneira distinta, contrária ou alternativa. 1. Pensar ou agir de modo diferente do esperado ou correto (Fp 3.15).
THAYER.en: Describes an action or circumstance that occurs in a distinct, contrary, or alternative manner. 1. To think or act in a way different from what is expected or correct (Phil 3:15).

DEFINITION: Denotes the temporal continuation of a state or action until the present or beyond what is expected. When combined with negations, it establishes the irrevocable cessation of an event.
SENSES: 1. Still, continuously in time (Matt 12:46; Rom 5:6, 8; Gal 1:10).
2. In numerical or quantitative addition: still, furthermore (Matt 19:20; Heb 11:32).
3. With negation (οὐκέτι, μήτι): no longer, never again (Luke 16:2; Heb 8:12).

THAYER.pt: Denota a continuação temporal de um estado ou ação até o presente ou além do esperado. Quando combinado com negações, estabelece a cessação irrevogável de um evento. 1. Ainda, continuamente no tempo (Mt 12.46; Rm 5.6, 8; Gl 1.10). | 2. Em acréscimo numérico ou quantitativo: ainda, além disso (Mt 19.20; Hb 11.32). | 3. Com negação (οὐκέτι, μήτι): não mais, nunca mais (Lc 16.2; Hb 8.12).
THAYER.en: Denotes the temporal continuation of a state or action until the present or beyond what is expected. When combined with negations, it establishes the irrevocable cessation of an event. 1. Still, continuously in time (Matt 12:46; Rom 5:6, 8; Gal 1:10). | 2. In numerical or quantitative addition: still, furthermore (Matt 19:20; Heb 11:32). | 3. With negation (οὐκέτι, μήτι): no longer, never again (Luke 16:2; Heb 8:12).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: ἑτοιμάσω, Aor: ἡτοίμασα, Perf: ἡτοίμακα
DEFINITION: Means to make something or someone ready, placing them in a state of readiness for a specific purpose.
SENSES: 1. To make preparations or arrange something for future use (Matt 3:3; Luke 12:20).
2. To prepare or get people ready for a task or journey (Matt 20:23; Acts 23:23).

THAYER.pt: Significa fazer com que algo ou alguém esteja pronto, colocando em estado de prontidão para um propósito específico. 1. Fazer preparativos ou dispor algo para uso futuro (Mt 3.3; Lc 12.20). | 2. Preparar ou aprontar pessoas para uma tarefa ou jornada (Mt 20.23; At 23.23).
THAYER.en: Means to make something or someone ready, placing them in a state of readiness for a specific purpose. 1. To make preparations or arrange something for future use (Matt 3:3; Luke 12:20). | 2. To prepare or get people ready for a task or journey (Matt 20:23; Acts 23:23).

DEFINITION: The state of being prepared, equipped, and ready for action or to face a situation.
SENSES: 1. The firm readiness and preparation provided by the gospel of peace (Eph 6:15).

THAYER.pt: O estado de estar preparado, equipado e pronto para a ação ou para enfrentar uma situação. 1. A firme prontidão e o preparo proporcionados pelo evangelho da paz (Ef 6.15).
THAYER.en: The state of being prepared, equipped, and ready for action or to face a situation. 1. The firm readiness and preparation provided by the gospel of peace (Eph 6:15).

DEFINITION: Qualifies someone or something that is fully prepared and in a state of readiness to fulfill a purpose, face a situation, or perform a task.
SENSES: 1. To be ready or prepared for a specific purpose (Matt 22:4; 2 Tim 2:21).
2. To be vigilant and prepared in a moral or eschatological sense (Matt 24:44; 1 Pet 1:5).

THAYER.pt: Qualifica alguém ou algo que está totalmente preparado e em estado de prontidão para cumprir um propósito, enfrentar uma situação ou realizar uma tarefa. 1. Estar pronto ou preparado para uma finalidade específica (Mt 22.4; 2Tm 2.21). | 2. Estar vigilante e preparado no aspecto moral ou escatológico (Mt 24.44; 1Pe 1.5).
THAYER.en: Qualifies someone or something that is fully prepared and in a state of readiness to fulfill a purpose, face a situation, or perform a task. 1. To be ready or prepared for a specific purpose (Matt 22:4; 2 Tim 2:21). | 2. To be vigilant and prepared in a moral or eschatological sense (Matt 24:44; 1 Pet 1:5).

DEFINITION: In a prepared and willing manner to act immediately in the face of a requirement.
SENSES: 1. To be ready and willing to suffer or preach the gospel (Acts 21:13; 2 Cor 12:14).

THAYER.pt: De maneira preparada e disposta para agir imediatamente diante de uma exigência. 1. Estar pronto e disposto a sofrer ou pregar o evangelho (At 21.13; 2Co 12.14).
THAYER.en: In a prepared and willing manner to act immediately in the face of a requirement. 1. To be ready and willing to suffer or preach the gospel (Acts 21:13; 2 Cor 12:14).

DEFINITION: An astronomical and civil unit of time comprising the annual cycle of seasons; commonly used in the New Testament in chronological formulas and age records.
SENSES: 1. Year of civil or chronological time (Luke 2:42; Luke 3:1; Gal 1:18; Heb 3:9).
2. Designation of age or prolonged duration of illnesses and events (Mark 5:42; Luke 13:11; Acts 7:30).

THAYER.pt: Unidade de tempo astronômica e civil que compreende o ciclo anual das estações; empregado comumente no Novo Testamento em fórmulas cronológicas e registro de idades. 1. Ano de tempo civil ou cronológico (Lc 2.42; Lc 3.1; Gl 1.18; Hb 3.9). | 2. Designação de idade ou duração prolongada de enfermidades e eventos (Mc 5.42; Lc 13.11; At 7.30).
THAYER.en: An astronomical and civil unit of time comprising the annual cycle of seasons; commonly used in the New Testament in chronological formulas and age records. 1. Year of civil or chronological time (Luke 2:42; Luke 3:1; Gal 1:18; Heb 3:9). | 2. Designation of age or prolonged duration of illnesses and events (Mark 5:42; Luke 13:11; Acts 7:30).

DEFINITION: A term that qualifies an action or event as morally good, beneficial, or executed according to the expected standard.
SENSES: 1. To act or proceed in a beneficial and correct manner (Acts 15:29; Eph 6:3).
2. Expression of approval for excellent performance (Matt 25:21).

THAYER.pt: Termo que qualifica uma ação ou evento como moralmente bom, benéfico ou executado de acordo com o padrão esperado. 1. Agir ou proceder de maneira benéfica e correta (At 15.29; Ef 6.3). | 2. Expressão de aprovação por um desempenho excelente (Mt 25.21).
THAYER.en: A term that qualifies an action or event as morally good, beneficial, or executed according to the expected standard. 1. To act or proceed in a beneficial and correct manner (Acts 15:29; Eph 6:3). | 2. Expression of approval for excellent performance (Matt 25:21).

DEFINITION: Name of the first woman created by God, ancestor of humanity, mentioned in Pauline writings in theological discussions.
SENSES: 1. Eve, the first woman and figure associated with temptation and creation (2 Cor 11:3; 1 Tim 2:13).

THAYER.pt: Nome da primeira mulher criada por Deus, ancestral da humanidade, mencionada nos escritos paulinos em discussões teológicas. 1. Eva, a primeira mulher e figura associada à tentação e à criação (2Co 11.3; 1Tm 2.13).
THAYER.en: Name of the first woman created by God, ancestor of humanity, mentioned in Pauline writings in theological discussions. 1. Eve, the first woman and figure associated with temptation and creation (2 Cor 11:3; 1 Tim 2:13).

DEFINITION: To proclaim good news, specifically the salvific message of God in Christ revealed in the gospel.
SENSES: 1. To announce good news in a general sense (Luke 1:19; Rev 10:7).
2. To proclaim the Christian message of salvation and the gospel (Luke 4:43; Acts 13:32).

THAYER.pt: Proclamar boas novas, especificamente a mensagem salvífica de Deus em Cristo revelada no evangelho. 1. Anunciar boas notícias de modo geral (Lc 1.19; Ap 10.7). | 2. Proclamar a mensagem cristã de salvação e o evangelho (Lc 4.43; At 13.32).
THAYER.en: To proclaim good news, specifically the salvific message of God in Christ revealed in the gospel. 1. To announce good news in a general sense (Luke 1:19; Rev 10:7). | 2. To proclaim the Christian message of salvation and the gospel (Luke 4:43; Acts 13:32).

DEFINITION: Originally designated the reward given to the messenger of good news, and in the New Testament, it came to mean the salvific message of God revealed in Jesus Christ.
SENSES: 1. The message of good news about salvation in Christ (Mark 1:15; Rom 1:16).
2. The historical and theological content concerning the life, death, and resurrection of Jesus (Phil 4:3).

THAYER.pt: Designa originalmente a recompensa dada ao mensageiro de boas notícias e, no Novo Testamento, passou a significar a mensagem salvífica de Deus revelada em Jesus Cristo. 1. A mensagem das boas-novas sobre a salvação em Cristo (Mc 1.15; Rm 1.16). | 2. O conteúdo histórico e teológico acerca da vida, morte e ressurreição de Jesus (Fp 4.3).
THAYER.en: Originally designated the reward given to the messenger of good news, and in the New Testament, it came to mean the salvific message of God revealed in Jesus Christ. 1. The message of good news about salvation in Christ (Mark 1:15; Rom 1:16). | 2. The historical and theological content concerning the life, death, and resurrection of Jesus (Phil 4:3).

DEFINITION: One who proclaims the good news of the gospel of Christ, exercising an itinerant or local ministry of proclamation.
SENSES: 1. Minister with the specific gift of proclaiming the gospel (Eph 4:11; Acts 21:8).

THAYER.pt: Aquele que proclama as boas-novas do evangelho de Cristo, exercendo um ministério itinerante ou local de proclamação. 1. Ministro com o dom específico de proclamar o evangelho (Ef 4.11; At 21.8).
THAYER.en: One who proclaims the good news of the gospel of Christ, exercising an itinerant or local ministry of proclamation. 1. Minister with the specific gift of proclaiming the gospel (Eph 4:11; Acts 21:8).

DEFINITION: To act in a way that fully satisfies or causes great pleasure to someone, especially to God.
SENSES: 1. To live in a way that pleases God through faith (Heb 11:5);

THAYER.pt: Agir de maneira que satisfaça plenamente ou cause grande agrado a alguém, especialmente a Deus. 1. Viver de modo a agradar a Deus pela fé (Hb 11.5);
THAYER.en: To act in a way that fully satisfies or causes great pleasure to someone, especially to God. 1. To live in a way that pleases God through faith (Heb 11:5);

DEFINITION: The quality of that which causes satisfaction, being fully acceptable and pleasing to someone, especially with reference to God.
SENSES: 1. Pleasing or acceptable to God (Rom 12:1; Phil 4:18).

THAYER.pt: Qualidade daquilo que causa satisfação, sendo plenamente aceitável e agradável a alguém, especialmente em referência a Deus. 1. Agradável ou aceitável a Deus (Rm 12.1; Fp 4.18).
THAYER.en: The quality of that which causes satisfaction, being fully acceptable and pleasing to someone, especially with reference to God. 1. Pleasing or acceptable to God (Rom 12:1; Phil 4:18).

DEFINITION: Indicates conduct performed in a manner that causes pleasure, satisfaction, and approval.
SENSES: 1. Serving God in an acceptable and pleasing manner, with reverence (Heb 12:28).

THAYER.pt: Indica uma conduta realizada de maneira a causar agrado, satisfação e aprovação. 1. Servir a Deus de maneira aceitável e agradável, com reverência (Hb 12.28).
THAYER.en: Indicates conduct performed in a manner that causes pleasure, satisfaction, and approval. 1. Serving God in an acceptable and pleasing manner, with reverence (Heb 12:28).

DEFINITION: Proper name of a Roman Christian mentioned in Paul's final greetings.
SENSES: 1. A Christian in Rome who sent greetings to Timothy (2 Tim 4:21).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio de um cristão romano mencionado nas saudações finais de Paulo. 1. Um cristão em Roma que enviou saudações a Timóteo (2Tm 4.21).
THAYER.en: Proper name of a Roman Christian mentioned in Paul's final greetings. 1. A Christian in Rome who sent greetings to Timothy (2 Tim 4:21).

DEFINITION: Refers both to one of high social class or illustrious birth and to a person of open mind and noble disposition.
SENSES: 1. A person of high origin or social class (1 Cor 1:26);
2. A person of noble, receptive, and fair character in evaluating the Word (Acts 17:11).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se tanto a quem possui alta classe social ou nascimento ilustre quanto à pessoa de mente aberta e nobre disposição. 1. Pessoa de origem ou classe social elevada (1Co 1.26); | 2. Pessoa de caráter nobre, receptiva e justa ao avaliar a Palavra (At 17.11).
THAYER.en: Refers both to one of high social class or illustrious birth and to a person of open mind and noble disposition. 1. A person of high origin or social class (1 Cor 1:26); | 2. A person of noble, receptive, and fair character in evaluating the Word (Acts 17:11).

DEFINITION: Denotes clear, calm, and sunny weather without strong winds, often associated with calm seas.
SENSES: 1. Good atmospheric weather indicated by a red sky (Matt 16:2).

THAYER.pt: Denota tempo limpo, calmo e ensolarado, sem ventos fortes, frequentemente associado à calmaria. 1. Bom tempo atmosférico indicado pelo céu avermelhado (Mt 16.2).
THAYER.en: Denotes clear, calm, and sunny weather without strong winds, often associated with calm seas. 1. Good atmospheric weather indicated by a red sky (Matt 16:2).

DEFINITION: To feel deep satisfaction or benevolence toward something or someone, also indicating free determination based on good will.
SENSES: 1. To take great pleasure or delight in someone (Matt 3:17).
2. To decide with benevolence, to resolve by good will (Luke 12:32).

THAYER.pt: Sentir profunda satisfação ou benevolência em relação a algo ou alguém, indicando também a livre determinação baseada na boa vontade. 1. Tomar grande prazer ou ter deleite em alguém (Mt 3.17). | 2. Decidir com benevolência, resolver por boa vontade (Lc 12.32).
THAYER.en: To feel deep satisfaction or benevolence toward something or someone, also indicating free determination based on good will. 1. To take great pleasure or delight in someone (Matt 3:17). | 2. To decide with benevolence, to resolve by good will (Luke 12:32).

DEFINITION: A state of benevolent disposition, unmerited favor, or gracious desire originating from pleasure and sovereign will.
SENSES: 1. Good will or favor toward others (Phil 1:15).
2. Good pleasure or sovereign will (Matt 11:26).

THAYER.pt: Estado de disposição benevolente, favor imerecido ou o desejo gracioso originado no agrado e na vontade soberana. 1. Boa vontade ou favor para com outros (Fp 1.15). | 2. O bom prazer, agrado ou vontade soberana (Mt 11.26).
THAYER.en: A state of benevolent disposition, unmerited favor, or gracious desire originating from pleasure and sovereign will. 1. Good will or favor toward others (Phil 1:15). | 2. Good pleasure or sovereign will (Matt 11:26).

DEFINITION: The practice of doing good, rendering useful services, or granting favors and benefits to other people.
SENSES: 1. A benefit or act of kindness granted to someone (Acts 4:9; 1 Tim 6:2).

THAYER.pt: A prática de fazer o bem, prestar serviços úteis ou conceder favores e benefícios a outras pessoas. 1. Benefício ou ato de bondade concedido a alguém (At 4.9; 1Tm 6.2).
THAYER.en: The practice of doing good, rendering useful services, or granting favors and benefits to other people. 1. A benefit or act of kindness granted to someone (Acts 4:9; 1 Tim 6:2).

DEFINITION: Means to render exceptional services, do good, and actively benefit someone.
SENSES: 1. To practice good and heal the oppressed, exemplified in the life of Jesus (Acts 10:38).

THAYER.pt: Significa prestar serviços excepcionais, fazer o bem e beneficiar ativamente a alguém. 1. Praticar o bem e curar os oprimidos, exemplificado na vida de Jesus (At 10.38).
THAYER.en: Means to render exceptional services, do good, and actively benefit someone. 1. To practice good and heal the oppressed, exemplified in the life of Jesus (Acts 10:38).

DEFINITION: An honorary title conferred upon those who render great help or notable benefits to society.
SENSES: 1. Benefactor, a title frequently assumed by secular rulers (Luke 22:25).

THAYER.pt: Título honorífico conferido àqueles que prestam grande auxílio ou benefícios notáveis à sociedade. 1. Benfeitor, título frequentemente tomado por governantes seculares (Lc 22.25).
THAYER.en: An honorary title conferred upon those who render great help or notable benefits to society. 1. Benefactor, a title frequently assumed by secular rulers (Luke 22:25).

DEFINITION: That which is well-adapted, suitable, or useful for a specific purpose.
SENSES: 1. Fit or useful for service in the Kingdom of God (Luke 9:62);
2. Proper and useful for agriculture (Heb 6:7).

THAYER.pt: Que é bem adaptado, adequado ou útil para uma finalidade específica. 1. Apto ou útil para o serviço no Reino de Deus (Lc 9.62); | 2. Próprio e útil para a agricultura (Hb 6.7).
THAYER.en: That which is well-adapted, suitable, or useful for a specific purpose. 1. Fit or useful for service in the Kingdom of God (Luke 9:62); | 2. Proper and useful for agriculture (Heb 6:7).

DEFINITION: Indicates the almost instantaneous occurrence of an action right after a preceding event, imparting urgency and rapidity to the narrative flow.
SENSES: 1. Immediately, without temporal delay (Matt 4:20, 22; John 6:21).
2. Soon afterwards, subsequently (Acts 9:18; Gal 1:16; Jas 1:24).

THAYER.pt: Indica a ocorrência quase instantânea de uma ação logo em seguida a um acontecimento precedente, conferindo urgência, rapidez e dinamismo ao fluxo da narrativa. 1. Imediatamente, sem demora temporal (Mt 4.20, 22; Jo 6.21). | 2. Logo em seguida, subsequentemente (At 9.18; Gl 1.16; Tg 1.24).
THAYER.en: Indicates the almost instantaneous occurrence of an action right after a preceding event, imparting urgency and rapidity to the narrative flow. 1. Immediately, without temporal delay (Matt 4:20, 22; John 6:21). | 2. Soon afterwards, subsequently (Acts 9:18; Gal 1:16; Jas 1:24).

DEFINITION: A nautical term describing a vessel that proceeds directly and without deviation toward its destination.
SENSES: 1. To set a direct course in sea voyages (Acts 16:11; 21:1).

THAYER.pt: Termo náutico que descreve uma embarcação que segue diretamente e sem desvios em direção ao seu destino. 1. Seguir rumo direto em viagens marítimas (At 16.11; 21.1).
THAYER.en: A nautical term describing a vessel that proceeds directly and without deviation toward its destination. 1. To set a direct course in sea voyages (Acts 16:11; 21:1).

SHORT_GLOSS: be of good cheer, take heart
DEFINITION: To be of good courage, joyful, or encouraged in the face of circumstances.
SENSES: 1. To keep one's courage firm and cheerful amid trials (Acts 27:22, 25);
2. To express spiritual joy in moments of praise (Jas 5:13).

DEFINITION: Describes appropriate, respectable behavior consistent with Christian morals or established order.
SENSES: 1. In a decent and honorable manner in daily conduct (Rom 13.13; 1Th 4.12).
2. In an appropriate and orderly fashion in the community context (1Cor 14.40).

THAYER.pt: Descreve um comportamento adequado, respeitável e condizente com a moral cristã ou com a ordem estabelecida. 1. De maneira decente e honrosa na conduta diária (Rm 13.13; 1Ts 4.12). | 2. De forma apropriada e ordenada no contexto comunitário (1Co 14.40).
THAYER.en: Describes appropriate, respectable behavior consistent with Christian morals or established order. 1. In a decent and honorable manner in daily conduct (Rom 13.13; 1Th 4.12). | 2. In an appropriate and orderly fashion in the community context (1Cor 14.40).

DEFINITION: The state of conduct or presentation that is appropriate, dignified, and generates respect.
SENSES: 1. The decorum and honor due to the less presentable members of the body (1Cor 12.23).

THAYER.pt: O estado de conduta ou apresentação que é apropriado, digno e gera respeito. 1. O decoro e a honra devidos aos membros menos vistosos do corpo (1Co 12.23).
THAYER.en: The state of conduct or presentation that is appropriate, dignified, and generates respect. 1. The decorum and honor due to the less presentable members of the body (1Cor 12.23).

DEFINITION: Describes what possesses a good appearance, decorum, or a high social position of nobility and public respect.
SENSES: 1. Appropriate, decent, or suitable for display (1Cor 7.35; 12.24).
2. Of high reputation, noble, or prominent in society (Mk 15.43).

THAYER.pt: Descreve o que possui boa aparência, decoro, ou uma alta posição social de nobreza e respeito público. 1. Apropriado, decente ou adequado para a exibição (1Co 7.35; 12.24). | 2. De alta reputação, nobre ou proeminente na sociedade (Mc 15.43).
THAYER.en: Describes what possesses a good appearance, decorum, or a high social position of nobility and public respect. 1. Appropriate, decent, or suitable for display (1Cor 7.35; 12.24). | 2. Of high reputation, noble, or prominent in society (Mk 15.43).

DEFINITION: Indicates an action performed with great intensity, vigor, or firmness, often expressing strong conviction or opposition.
SENSES: 1. To act with strong intensity or vehemence in an argument or accusation (Lk 23.10; Acts 18.28).

THAYER.pt: Indica uma ação realizada com grande intensidade, vigor ou firmeza, muitas vezes expressando forte convicção ou oposição. 1. Agir com forte intensidade ou veemência em um argumento ou acusação (Lc 23.10; At 18.28).
THAYER.en: Indicates an action performed with great intensity, vigor, or firmness, often expressing strong conviction or opposition. 1. To act with strong intensity or vehemence in an argument or accusation (Lk 23.10; Acts 18.28).

DEFINITION: In the New Testament, refers specifically to crude jesting, vulgar wit, or indecent conversation.
SENSES: 1. Vulgar or shameful talk improper for saints (Eph 5.4).

THAYER.pt: No Novo Testamento, refere-se especificamente ao gracejo grosseiro, espirituosidade vulgar ou conversa indecente. 1. Conversa chocarreira ou torpe imprópria para os santos (Ef 5.4).
THAYER.en: In the New Testament, refers specifically to crude jesting, vulgar wit, or indecent conversation. 1. Vulgar or shameful talk improper for saints (Eph 5.4).

DEFINITION: Masculine proper name of a young man in Troas who fell from a window while Paul was preaching.
SENSES: 1. The young man who fell asleep and fell from the third story in Troas (Acts 20:9).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio masculino de um jovem em Trôade que caiu da janela enquanto Paulo pregava. 1. O jovem que adormeceu e caiu do terceiro andar em Trôade (At 20.9).
THAYER.en: Masculine proper name of a young man in Troas who fell from a window while Paul was preaching. 1. The young man who fell asleep and fell from the third story in Troas (Acts 20:9).

DEFINITION: Favorable expression regarding someone, resulting in a good reputation and honor.
SENSES: 1. Good testimony and reputation through honor and dishonor (2 Cor 6:8).

THAYER.pt: Expressão favorável sobre alguém, resultando em boa reputação e honra. 1. O bom testemunho e reputação através de honra e desonra (2Co 6.8).
THAYER.en: Favorable expression regarding someone, resulting in a good reputation and honor. 1. Good testimony and reputation through honor and dishonor (2 Cor 6:8).

DEFINITION: Deserving approval, praise, or possessing a morally exemplary reputation.
SENSES: 1. Things that are of good report and worthy of praise (Phil 4:8).

THAYER.pt: Que merece aprovação, louvor ou possui uma reputação moralmente exemplar. 1. Coisas que são de boa fama e dignas de louvor (Fp 4.8).
THAYER.en: Deserving approval, praise, or possessing a morally exemplary reputation. 1. Things that are of good report and worthy of praise (Phil 4:8).

DEFINITION: To produce excellent crops or bear fruit in great quantity.
SENSES: 1. The land of a rich man that produced very abundantly (Luke 12:16).

THAYER.pt: Produzir colheitas excelentes ou render frutos em grande quantidade. 1. A terra de um homem rico que produziu com muita abundância (Lc 12.16).
THAYER.en: To produce excellent crops or bear fruit in great quantity. 1. The land of a rich man that produced very abundantly (Luke 12:16).

DEFINITION: To cause joy and contentment to someone, or to experience personal jubilation, festivity, and rejoicing.
SENSES: 1. To produce joy, make glad, or comfort someone's heart (Acts 2:26).
2. To be joyful, rejoice, or celebrate with festivities (Luke 12:19; 15:23).

THAYER.pt: Causar alegria e contentamento a alguém, ou experimentar júbilo, festividade e regozijo pessoal. 1. Produzir alegria, alegrar ou consolar o coração de alguém (At 2.26). | 2. Estar alegre, regozijar-se ou celebrar com festividades (Lc 12.19; 15.23).
THAYER.en: To cause joy and contentment to someone, or to experience personal jubilation, festivity, and rejoicing. 1. To produce joy, make glad, or comfort someone's heart (Acts 2:26). | 2. To be joyful, rejoice, or celebrate with festivities (Luke 12:19; 15:23).

DEFINITION: Name of one of the largest and most important rivers of the Middle East, which bounded Mesopotamia to the west.
SENSES: 1. The Euphrates river, mentioned in biblical geography and eschatological contexts (Rev 9:14).

THAYER.pt: Nome de um dos maiores e mais importantes rios do Oriente Médio, que delimitava a Mesopotâmia a oeste. 1. O rio Eufrates, mencionado na geografia bíblica e em contextos escatológicos (Ap 9.14).
THAYER.en: Name of one of the largest and most important rivers of the Middle East, which bounded Mesopotamia to the west. 1. The Euphrates river, mentioned in biblical geography and eschatological contexts (Rev 9:14).

DEFINITION: Refers to a state of profound happiness, joy, and inner contentment, often associated with the blessedness granted by God.
SENSES: 1. A state of great spiritual or daily joy and jubilation (Acts 2:28; 14:17).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se a um estado de profunda felicidade, alegria e contentamento interior, frequentemente associado à bien-aventurança concedida por Deus. 1. Estado de grande alegria e júbilo espiritual ou cotidiano (At 2.28; At 14.17).
THAYER.en: Refers to a state of profound happiness, joy, and inner contentment, often associated with the blessedness granted by God. 1. A state of great spiritual or daily joy and jubilation (Acts 2:28; 14:17).

DEFINITION: To express deep gratitude and recognition for blessings, favors, or gifts received, especially to God.
SENSES: 1. To feel obligated to thank or express gratitude (Luke 18:11; Rom 16:4).
2. To give thanks or express praise to God for His gifts (Luke 17:16; John 11:41).

THAYER.pt: Expressar gratidão e reconhecimento profundo por bênçãos, favores ou dádivas recebidas, especialmente a Deus. 1. Sentir-se obrigado a agradecer ou manifestar gratidão (Lc 18.11; Rm 16.4). | 2. Dar graças ou expressar louvor a Deus por suas dadivas (Lc 17.16; Jo 11.41).
THAYER.en: To express deep gratitude and recognition for blessings, favors, or gifts received, especially to God. 1. To feel obligated to thank or express gratitude (Luke 18:11; Rom 16:4). | 2. To give thanks or express praise to God for His gifts (Luke 17:16; John 11:41).

DEFINITION: An attitude of recognition and gratitude for benefits received, expressed in praise, prayer, or liturgical celebration.
SENSES: 1. The feeling of gratitude and recognition (Acts 24:3);
2. The verbal expression of thanksgiving to God (Phil 4:6);
3. The celebration of the Eucharist or the Lord's Supper (1 Cor 10:16).

THAYER.pt: Atitude de reconhecimento e gratidão por benefícios recebidos, expressando-se em louvor, oração ou na celebração litúrgica. 1. O sentimento de gratidão e reconhecimento (At 24.3); 2. A expressão verbal de ações de graças a Deus (Fp 4.6); 3. A celebração da Eucaristia ou Ceia do Senhor (1Co 10.16).
THAYER.en: An attitude of recognition and gratitude for benefits received, expressed in praise, prayer, or liturgical celebration. 1. The feeling of gratitude and recognition (Acts 24:3); | 2. The verbal expression of thanksgiving to God (Phil 4:6); | 3. The celebration of the Eucharist or the Lord's Supper (1 Cor 10:16).

DEFINITION: Possessing an attitude of gratitude or expressing recognition for benefits received.
SENSES: 1. The exhortation for believers to be thankful to God (Col 3:15).

THAYER.pt: Que possui uma atitude de gratidão ou expressa reconhecimento pelos benefícios recebidos. 1. A exortação para que os crentes sejam gratos a Deus (Cl 3.15).
THAYER.en: Possessing an attitude of gratitude or expressing recognition for benefits received. 1. The exhortation for believers to be thankful to God (Col 3:15).

DEFINITION: Refers both to a petition or speech directed to God and to a solemn vow made under spiritual commitment.
SENSES: 1. Fervent prayer or supplication to God (Jas 5:15).
2. Solemn religious vow or promise (Acts 18:18; 21:23).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se tanto a uma petição ou discurso dirigido a Deus quanto a um voto solene feito sob compromisso espiritual. 1. Oração ou súplica fervorosa a Deus (Tg 5.15). | 2. Voto ou promessa solene de caráter religioso (At 18.18; 21.23).
THAYER.en: Refers both to a petition or speech directed to God and to a solemn vow made under spiritual commitment. 1. Fervent prayer or supplication to God (Jas 5:15). | 2. Solemn religious vow or promise (Acts 18:18; 21:23).

DEFINITION: Expresses both the pious act of speaking and making petitions to God and a deep desire for something.
SENSES: 1. To address God in prayer or supplication (2 Cor 13:7, 9).
2. To desire ardently or long for something (Acts 27:29; 3 John 2).

THAYER.pt: Expressa tanto o ato piedoso de falar e fazer petições a Deus quanto o desejo profundo por algo. 1. Dirigir-se a Deus em oração ou súplica (2Co 13.7, 9). | 2. Desejar ardentemente ou ansiar por algo (At 27.29; 3Jo 2).
THAYER.en: Expresses both the pious act of speaking and making petitions to God and a deep desire for something. 1. To address God in prayer or supplication (2 Cor 13:7, 9). | 2. To desire ardently or long for something (Acts 27:29; 3 John 2).

DEFINITION: Qualifies someone or something that demonstrates great utility, helpfulness, or practical value for accomplishing a task.
SENSES: 1. Useful or profitable for the service of the Lord and ministry (2 Tim 2:21; 4:11; Phlm 11).

THAYER.pt: Qualifica algo ou alguém que demonstra grande utilidade, préstimo ou valor prático para a realização de uma tarefa. 1. Útil ou proveitoso para o serviço do Senhor e do ministério (2Tm 2.21; 4.11; Fp 11).
THAYER.en: Qualifies someone or something that demonstrates great utility, helpfulness, or practical value for accomplishing a task. 1. Useful or profitable for the service of the Lord and ministry (2 Tim 2:21; 4:11; Phlm 11).

DEFINITION: To be of good cheer, full of courage, or comforted amid circumstances.
SENSES: 1. Paul's desire to be cheered upon hearing news of the Philippians (Phil 2:19).

THAYER.pt: Estar animado, cheio de coragem ou consolado em meio às circunstâncias. 1. O desejo de Paulo de ser confortado ao saber notícias dos filipenses (Fp 2.19).
THAYER.en: To be of good cheer, full of courage, or comforted amid circumstances. 1. Paul's desire to be cheered upon hearing news of the Philippians (Phil 2:19).

DEFINITION: Indicates a pleasant odor or fragrance, often used in the New Testament in a metaphorical sense for sacrifices and lives acceptable to God.
SENSES: 1. Sweet aroma of a spiritual sacrifice or offering (Phil 4:18).
2. The figurative fragrance of the knowledge of Christ diffused by believers (2 Cor 2:15).

THAYER.pt: Indica um odor agradável ou fragrância, frequentemente usado no Novo Testamento em sentido metafórico para sacrifícios e vidas aceitáveis a Deus. 1. Aroma suave de um sacrifício ou oferta espiritual (Fp 4.18). | 2. Fragrância figurada do conhecimento de Cristo difundida pelos crentes (2Co 2.15).
THAYER.en: Indicates a pleasant odor or fragrance, often used in the New Testament in a metaphorical sense for sacrifices and lives acceptable to God. 1. Sweet aroma of a spiritual sacrifice or offering (Phil 4:18). | 2. The figurative fragrance of the knowledge of Christ diffused by believers (2 Cor 2:15).

DEFINITION: Term used to designate the left side in relation to a spatial reference point.
SENSES: 1. The left side or positioned on the left (Matt 20:23; Acts 21:3).

THAYER.pt: Termo utilizado para designar o lado esquerdo em relação a um ponto de referência espacial. 1. O lado esquerdo ou posicionado à esquerda (Mt 20.23; At 21.3).
THAYER.en: Term used to designate the left side in relation to a spatial reference point. 1. The left side or positioned on the left (Matt 20:23; Acts 21:3).

DEFINITION: To make a violent jump or leap upon a target or person.
SENSES: 1. The demon-possessed man of Ephesus who leaped upon the sons of Sceva (Acts 19:16).

THAYER.pt: Dar um salto ou pulo violento sobre um alvo ou pessoa. 1. O homem endemoninhado de Éfeso que saltou sobre os filhos de Esqueva (At 19.16).
THAYER.en: To make a violent jump or leap upon a target or person. 1. The demon-possessed man of Ephesus who leaped upon the sons of Sceva (Acts 19:16).

DEFINITION: Indicates a single, definitive, and exclusive event that occurs once and for all without the need for repetition.
SENSES: 1. Simultaneously or all at once to a group (1 Cor 15:6).
2. Once for all, with definitive and eternal value (Rom 6:10; Heb 7:27).

THAYER.pt: Indica um evento único, definitivo e exclusivo, que ocorre de uma vez para sempre, sem necessidade de repetição. 1. Simultaneamente ou de uma só vez para um grupo (1Co 15.6). | 2. Uma vez por todas, com valor definitivo e eterno (Rm 6.10; Hb 7.27).
THAYER.en: Indicates a single, definitive, and exclusive event that occurs once and for all without the need for repetition. 1. Simultaneously or all at once to a group (1 Cor 15:6). | 2. Once for all, with definitive and eternal value (Rom 6:10; Heb 7:27).

DEFINITION: Gentilic adjective designating that which belongs to or originates from the city of Ephesus.
SENSES: 1. Relating to the city of Ephesus or its inhabitants.

THAYER.pt: Adjetivo gentílico que designa o que pertence ou se origina da cidade de Éfeso. 1. Relativo à cidade de Éfeso ou aos seus habitantes.
THAYER.en: Gentilic adjective designating that which belongs to or originates from the city of Ephesus. 1. Relating to the city of Ephesus or its inhabitants.

DEFINITION: Relating to the city of Ephesus or its native inhabitants.
SENSES: 1. An inhabitant or native of the city of Ephesus (Acts 19:28).

THAYER.pt: Relativo à cidade de Éfeso ou aos seus habitantes nativos. 1. Habitante ou natural da cidade de Éfeso (At 19.28).
THAYER.en: Relating to the city of Ephesus or its native inhabitants. 1. An inhabitant or native of the city of Ephesus (Acts 19:28).

DEFINITION: Prominent port city of Asia Minor, famous for the temple of Artemis and an important center of Christian missionary activity.
SENSES: 1. The city of Ephesus in the Roman province of Asia (Acts 18:19; Rev 1:11).

THAYER.pt: Proeminente cidade portuária da Ásia Menor, famosa pelo templo de Ártemis e centro importante da atividade missionária cristã. 1. A cidade de Éfeso na província romana da Ásia (At 18.19; Ap 1.11).
THAYER.en: Prominent port city of Asia Minor, famous for the temple of Artemis and an important center of Christian missionary activity. 1. The city of Ephesus in the Roman province of Asia (Acts 18:19; Rev 1:11).

DEFINITION: One who plans, conceives, or invents schemes, wiles, or forms of wickedness.
SENSES: 1. Inventors of evil who oppose God's precepts (Rom 1:30).

THAYER.pt: Aquele que planeja, concebe ou inventa esquemas, artimanhas ou formas de maldade. 1. Inventores de males que se opõem aos preceitos de Deus (Rm 1.30).
THAYER.en: One who plans, conceives, or invents schemes, wiles, or forms of wickedness. 1. Inventors of evil who oppose God's precepts (Rom 1:30).

DEFINITION: Designates a group or shift of priests who performed daily and regular service in the temple of Jerusalem for a determined period.
SENSES: 1. Division or shift of priests in temple service (Luke 1:5).

THAYER.pt: Designa um grupo ou turno de sacerdotes que prestava serviços diários e regulares no templo de Jerusalém por um período determinado. 1. Divisão ou turno de sacerdotes no serviço do templo (Lc 1.5).
THAYER.en: Designates a group or shift of priests who performed daily and regular service in the temple of Jerusalem for a determined period. 1. Division or shift of priests in temple service (Luke 1:5).

DEFINITION: Occurring, subsisting, or necessary on a daily basis.
SENSES: 1. The daily sustenance necessary for physical survival (Jas 2:15).

THAYER.pt: Que ocorre, subsiste ou é necessário em base diária. 1. O sustento diário necessário para a sobrevivência física (Tg 2.15).
THAYER.en: Occurring, subsisting, or necessary on a daily basis. 1. The daily sustenance necessary for physical survival (Jas 2:15).

DEFINITION: Means to move toward a point and arrive at it, used either in a physical/geographic sense or in reaching an authority limit.
SENSES: 1. To reach or arrive at a certain place or limit in the expansion of work (2 Cor 10:13, 14).

THAYER.pt: Significa mover-se em direção a um ponto e chegar a ele, podendo ser usado tanto em sentido físico quanto geográfico ou de alcance de autoridade. 1. Alcançar ou chegar a um determinado lugar ou limite na expansão do trabalho (2Co 10.13,14).
THAYER.en: Means to move toward a point and arrive at it, used either in a physical/geographic sense or in reaching an authority limit. 1. To reach or arrive at a certain place or limit in the expansion of work (2 Cor 10:13, 14).

DEFINITION: To appear suddenly, stand by someone, or come upon unexpectedly, referring to people, trials, or the timing of events.
SENSES: 1. To stand near or approach suddenly (Luke 2:9; Acts 4:1).
2. To come upon unexpectedly, like calamities or judgment (Luke 21:34; 1 Thess 5:3).
3. To be ready or present to fulfill a task (2 Tim 4:2).

THAYER.pt: Aparecer de surpresa, colocar-se de pé junto a alguém ou sobrevir de modo repentino, seja referindo-se a pessoas, provações ou o tempo de eventos. 1. Ficar de pé perto ou aproximar-se repentinamente (Lc 2.9; At 4.1). | 2. Sobrevir de forma imprevista, como calamidades ou o juízo (Lc 21.34; 1Ts 5.3). | 3. Estar pronto ou presente para cumprir uma tarefa (2Tm 4.2).
THAYER.en: To appear suddenly, stand by someone, or come upon unexpectedly, referring to people, trials, or the timing of events. 1. To stand near or approach suddenly (Luke 2:9; Acts 4:1). | 2. To come upon unexpectedly, like calamities or judgment (Luke 21:34; 1 Thess 5:3). | 3. To be ready or present to fulfill a task (2 Tim 4:2).

DEFINITION: Proper name designating both Ephraim, son of Joseph, and a specific locality to which Jesus withdrew with His disciples.
SENSES: 1. Ephraim, son of Joseph and patriarch of the eponymous tribe.
2. A city located near the wilderness to which Jesus withdrew (John 11:54).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio que designa tanto a Efraim, filho de José, quanto a uma localidade específica para a qual Jesus se retirou com seus discípulos. 1. Efraim, filho de José e patriarca da tribo homônima. | 2. Cidade situada próxima ao deserto para onde Jesus se retirou (Jo 11.54).
THAYER.en: Proper name designating both Ephraim, son of Joseph, and a specific locality to which Jesus withdrew with His disciples. 1. Ephraim, son of Joseph and patriarch of the eponymous tribe. | 2. A city located near the wilderness to which Jesus withdrew (John 11:54).

DEFINITION: Aramaic term transliterated into Greek, used by Jesus with the imperative sense of opening or clearing something.
SENSES: 1. Aramaic word meaning 'be opened', used in the healing of a deaf-mute (Mark 7:34).

THAYER.pt: Termo de origem aramaica transliterado para o grego, empregado por Jesus com o sentido imperativo de abrir ou desobstruir algo. 1. Palavra aramaica que significa 'seja aberto', usada na cura de um surdo-gago (Mc 7.34).
THAYER.en: Aramaic term transliterated into Greek, used by Jesus with the imperative sense of opening or clearing something. 1. Aramaic word meaning 'be opened', used in the healing of a deaf-mute (Mark 7:34).

DEFINITION: A deep state of opposition, animosity, or hostility between people, groups, or between humanity and God.
SENSES: 1. State of enmity or declared opposition (Eph 2:14, 16; Jas 4:4).

THAYER.pt: Um estado profundo de oposição, animosidade ou hostilidade entre pessoas, grupos ou entre a humanidade e Deus. 1. Estado de inimizade ou oposição declarada (Ef 2.14, 16; Tg 4.4).
THAYER.en: A deep state of opposition, animosity, or hostility between people, groups, or between humanity and God. 1. State of enmity or declared opposition (Eph 2:14, 16; Jas 4:4).

DEFINITION: Being in a state of hostility, opposition, or enmity against someone.
SENSES: 1. Opposed or hostile in attitude or alliance (Rom 11:28).
2. Noun: the personal enemy or opponent (Matt 5:44; Luke 1:74).

THAYER.pt: Que se encontra em estado de hostilidade, oposição ou inimizade contra alguém. 1. Oposto ou hostil em atitude ou aliança (Rm 11.28). | 2. Substantivo: o inimigo ou oponente pessoal (Mt 5.44; Lc 1.74).
THAYER.en: Being in a state of hostility, opposition, or enmity against someone. 1. Opposed or hostile in attitude or alliance (Rom 11:28). | 2. Noun: the personal enemy or opponent (Matt 5:44; Luke 1:74).

DEFINITION: A species of venomous snake and, by metaphorical extension, a cunning, dangerous, and morally corrupt person.
SENSES: 1. Venomous snake, such as a viper (Acts 28:3).
2. Metaphor for perfidious and evil people, 'brood of vipers' (Matt 3:7; 12:34).

THAYER.pt: Uma espécie de serpente venenosa e, por extensão metafórica, uma pessoa astuta, perigosa e moralmente corrupta. 1. Serpente peçonhenta, como a víbora (At 28.3). | 2. Metáfora para pessoas pérfidas e maldosas, 'raça de víboras' (Mt 3.7; 12.34).
THAYER.en: A species of venomous snake and, by metaphorical extension, a cunning, dangerous, and morally corrupt person. 1. Venomous snake, such as a viper (Acts 28:3). | 2. Metaphor for perfidious and evil people, 'brood of vipers' (Matt 3:7; 12:34).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: ἕξω/σχήσω, Aor: ἔσχον, Perf: ἔσχηκα
DEFINITION: A comprehensive verb expressing material possession, custody, interpersonal relationships, or physical and psychological states. When used with adverbs, it acquires an intransitive copulative sense ('to be in a certain way').
SENSES: 1. To possess goods, property, authority, or attributes ('to have', 'to possess') (Mt 19.22; Jn 5.24).
2. To be in a certain physical condition or relationship ('to have a disease', 'to have peace') (Mt 8.9; Rom 5.1).
3. To estimate intellectually or consider ('to hold as', 'to consider') (Mt 14.5; Phil 2.29).

THAYER.pt: Verbo abrangente que expressa posse material, custódia, relações interpessoais ou estados físicos e psicológicos. Usado com advérbios, adquire sentido intransitivo copulativo ('estar de certo modo'). 1. Possuir bens, propriedades, autoridade ou atributos ('ter', 'possuir') (Mt 19.22; Jo 5.24). | 2. Estar em determinada condição física ou relação ('ter doença', 'ter paz') (Mt 8.9; Rm 5.1). | 3. Estimar intelectualmente ou considerar ('ter por', 'considerar') (Mt 14.5; Fp 2.29).
THAYER.en: A comprehensive verb expressing material possession, custody, interpersonal relationships, or physical and psychological states. When used with adverbs, it acquires an intransitive copulative sense ('to be in a certain way'). 1. To possess goods, property, authority, or attributes ('to have', 'to possess') (Mt 19.22; Jn 5.24). | 2. To be in a certain physical condition or relationship ('to have a disease', 'to have peace') (Mt 8.9; Rom 5.1). | 3. To estimate intellectually or consider ('to hold as', 'to consider') (Mt 14.5; Phil 2.29).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Also functions as an improper preposition with the genitive
DEFINITION: A conjunction and improper preposition that marks temporal, spatial, or quantitative limits. It establishes the end point of a period of time or the termination of the reach of movement in space.
SENSES: 1. Preposition with temporal genitive: until, up to the moment of (Mt 1.17; Jn 2.10).
2. Preposition with spatial genitive: until, as far as (Mt 24.27; Lk 2.15).
3. Conjunction: until, while (Mt 2.13; Jn 9.4).

THAYER.pt: Conjunção e preposição imprópria que marca limites temporais, espaciais ou quantitativos. Estabelece o ponto final de um período de tempo ou o término do alcance de um movimento no espaço. 1. Preposição com genitivo temporal: até, até o momento de (Mt 1.17; Jo 2.10). | 2. Preposição com genitivo espacial: até, tão longe quanto (Mt 24.27; Lc 2.15). | 3. Conjunção: até que, enquanto (Mt 2.13; Jo 9.4).
THAYER.en: A conjunction and improper preposition that marks temporal, spatial, or quantitative limits. It establishes the end point of a period of time or the termination of the reach of movement in space. 1. Preposition with temporal genitive: until, up to the moment of (Mt 1.17; Jn 2.10). | 2. Preposition with spatial genitive: until, as far as (Mt 24.27; Lk 2.15). | 3. Conjunction: until, while (Mt 2.13; Jn 9.4).

DEFINITION: A proper noun designating both the son of Jacob and the tribe of Israel and the geographical territory associated with it.
