THAYER.pt: Designa qualquer ser dotado de vida, animal ou criatura viva. No livro do Apocalipse, refere-se especificamente aos seres celestiais que guardam o trono divino. 1. Uma criatura viva ou animal (Hb 13.11; 2Pe 2.12). | 2. Um ser vivente de natureza celestial nas visões apocalípticas (Ap 4.6).
THAYER.en: Designates any being endowed with life, animal or living creature. In the book of Revelation, it refers specifically to the celestial beings that guard the divine throne. 1. A living creature or animal (Heb 13:11; 2 Pet 2:12). | 2. A living being of celestial nature in apocalyptic visions (Rev 4:6).

DEFINITION: To give life, to make alive, or to restore to existence, especially in the spiritual and transcendent sense attributed to God and the Spirit.
SENSES: 1. To grant spiritual or physical life, being a divine prerogative (Jn 5:21; Rom 8:11).
2. The act of resurrecting the dead on the last day (1 Cor 15:22).

THAYER.pt: Dar vida, fazer viver ou restaurar à existência, especialmente no sentido espiritual e transcendente atribuído a Deus e ao Espírito. 1. Conceder vida espiritual ou física, sendo prerrogativa divina (Jo 5:21; Rm 8:11). | 2. O ato de ressuscitar os mortos no último dia (1Co 15:22).
THAYER.en: To give life, to make alive, or to restore to existence, especially in the spiritual and transcendent sense attributed to God and the Spirit. 1. To grant spiritual or physical life, being a divine prerogative (Jn 5:21; Rom 8:11). | 2. The act of resurrecting the dead on the last day (1 Cor 15:22).

DEFINITION: A conjunction used to introduce mutually exclusive alternative terms, or a term of comparison after comparative adjectives.
SENSES: 1. Logical disjunction of alternatives: or, or else (Mt 5:36; 6:24).
2. Distributive correlative use: whether... or, either... or (Rom 14:10; 1 Cor 14:6).
3. Comparative of superiority preceded by adverb/adjective: (more) than (Mt 10:15; Lk 18:14).

THAYER.pt: Conjunção empregada para introduzir termos alternativos mutuamente excludentes, ou termo de comparação após adjetivos comparativos. 1. Disjunção lógica de alternativas: ou, ou então (Mt 5.36; 6.24). | 2. Uso correlativo distributivo: quer... quer, ou... ou (Rm 14.10; 1Co 14.6). | 3. Comparativo de superioridade antecedido de advérbio/adjetivo: (mais) do que (Mt 10.15; Lc 18.14).
THAYER.en: A conjunction used to introduce mutually exclusive alternative terms, or a term of comparison after comparative adjectives. 1. Logical disjunction of alternatives: or, or else (Mt 5:36; 6:24). | 2. Distributive correlative use: whether... or, either... or (Rom 14:10; 1 Cor 14:6). | 3. Comparative of superiority preceded by adverb/adjective: (more) than (Mt 10:15; Lk 18:14).

DEFINITION: An emphatic particle used to reinforce the veracity of a statement or solemn promise.
SENSES: 1. Strong and solemn affirmation of a truth or oath (Heb 6:14).

THAYER.pt: Partícula enfática utilizada para reforçar a veracidade de uma declaração ou promessa solene. 1. Afirmação forte e solene de uma verdade ou juramento (Hb 6.14).
THAYER.en: An emphatic particle used to reinforce the veracity of a statement or solemn promise. 1. Strong and solemn affirmation of a truth or oath (Heb 6:14).

DEFINITION: To exercise a position of leadership or administrative authority, specifically the office of governor of a Roman province.
SENSES: 1. To hold the political office of governor of a region (Lk 2:2; Lk 3:1).

THAYER.pt: Exercer uma posição de liderança ou autoridade administrativa, especificamente o cargo de governador de uma província romana. 1. Desempenhar o cargo de governador político de uma região (Lc 2.2; Lc 3.1).
THAYER.en: To exercise a position of leadership or administrative authority, specifically the office of governor of a Roman province. 1. To hold the political office of governor of a region (Lk 2:2; Lk 3:1).

DEFINITION: The condition or exercise of supreme authority, official command, or administration of a high government office.
SENSES: 1. The exercise of political or imperial authority, such as the government of Tiberius Caesar (Lk 3:1).

THAYER.pt: Condição ou exercício de autoridade suprema, comando oficial ou administração de um alto cargo governamental. 1. O exercício de autoridade política ou imperial, como o governo de Tibério César (Lc 3.1).
THAYER.en: The condition or exercise of supreme authority, official command, or administration of a high government office. 1. The exercise of political or imperial authority, such as the government of Tiberius Caesar (Lk 3:1).

DEFINITION: Designates someone who exercises governmental authority or leadership, especially applied in the New Testament to Roman officials and procurators in the provinces.
SENSES: 1. Roman provincial governor or administrator (Mt 27:2; Lk 2:1).
2. Regent or governing authority in a general sense (Mt 2:6; 1Pe 2:14).

THAYER.pt: Designa alguém que exerce autoridade governamental ou de liderança, especialmente aplicado no Novo Testamento aos oficiais e procuradores romanos nas províncias. 1. Governador ou administrador provincial romano (Mt 27.2; Lc 2.1). | 2. Regente ou autoridade governante em sentido geral (Mt 2.6; 1Pe 2.14).
THAYER.en: Designates someone who exercises governmental authority or leadership, especially applied in the New Testament to Roman officials and procurators in the provinces. 1. Roman provincial governor or administrator (Mt 27:2; Lk 2:1). | 2. Regent or governing authority in a general sense (Mt 2:6; 1Pe 2:14).

DEFINITION: To exercise leadership and guidance over others, or to perform a mental process of evaluation and judgment.
SENSES: 1. To be in a position of leadership or to govern (Lk 22:26; Heb 13:7).
2. To evaluate mentally, consider, or estimate something (Php 2:3; Jas 1:2).

THAYER.pt: exercer liderança e orientação sobre outros, ou realizar um processo mental de avaliação e julgamento. 1. Estar em posição de liderança ou governar (Lc 22:26; Hb 13:7). | 2. Avaliar mentalmente, considerar ou estimar algo (Fp 2:3; Tg 1:2).
THAYER.en: To exercise leadership and guidance over others, or to perform a mental process of evaluation and judgment. 1. To be in a position of leadership or to govern (Lk 22:26; Heb 13:7). | 2. To evaluate mentally, consider, or estimate something (Php 2:3; Jas 1:2).

DEFINITION: Indicates an attitude performed with satisfaction, contentment, or personal pleasure.
SENSES: 1. To hear or act with pleasure, joy, and willingness (Mk 6:20).

THAYER.pt: Indica uma atitude realizada com satisfação, contentamento ou agrado pessoal. 1. Ouvir ou agir com prazer, alegria e boa vontade (Mc 6.20).
THAYER.en: Indicates an attitude performed with satisfaction, contentment, or personal pleasure. 1. To hear or act with pleasure, joy, and willingness (Mk 6:20).

DEFINITION: Indicates a point in time that is prior to another or that marks the conclusion and imminent fulfillment of a situation.
SENSES: 1. A moment prior to another, implying completion or current state, already (Mt 3:10; Lk 21:30).

THAYER.pt: Indica um ponto no tempo que é anterior a outro ou que marca a conclusão e o cumprimento iminente de uma situação. 1. Um momento anterior a outro, implicando conclusão ou estado atual, já (Mt 3.10; Lc 21.30).
THAYER.en: Indicates a point in time that is prior to another or that marks the conclusion and imminent fulfillment of a situation. 1. A moment prior to another, implying completion or current state, already (Mt 3:10; Lk 21:30).

DEFINITION: Superlative form indicating the maximum degree of satisfaction or willingness when performing an action.
SENSES: 1. To do something with the utmost pleasure, joy, or willingness (2Co 11:19; 12:9).

THAYER.pt: Forma superlativa que indica o grau máximo de satisfação ou boa vontade ao realizar alguma ação. 1. Fazer algo com o máximo de prazer, alegria ou boa vontade (2Co 11.19; 12.9).
THAYER.en: Superlative form indicating the maximum degree of satisfaction or willingness when performing an action. 1. To do something with the utmost pleasure, joy, or willingness (2Co 11:19; 12:9).

DEFINITION: A state or sensation of pleasure, delight, or personal satisfaction, which may refer to selfish impulses or sinful passions.
SENSES: 1. Pleasure, delight, or enjoyment of pleasant experiences (Lk 8:14; Tit 3:3).
2. Passional desires and unbridled pursuit of sensual pleasures (Jas 4:1, 3; 2Pe 2:13).

THAYER.pt: Estado ou sensação de prazer, deleite ou satisfação pessoal, podendo referir-se a impulsos egoístas ou paixões pecaminosas. 1. Prazer, deleite ou fruição de experiências agradáveis (Lc 8.14; Tt 3.3). | 2. Desejos passionais e busca desenfreada por prazeres sensuais (Tg 4.1, 3; 2Pe 2.13).
THAYER.en: A state or sensation of pleasure, delight, or personal satisfaction, which may refer to selfish impulses or sinful passions. 1. Pleasure, delight, or enjoyment of pleasant experiences (Lk 8:14; Tit 3:3). | 2. Passional desires and unbridled pursuit of sensual pleasures (Jas 4:1, 3; 2Pe 2:13).

DEFINITION: An aromatic garden plant whose leaves were used for seasoning and for the payment of small ritual tithes.
SENSES: 1. Mint, an aromatic herb cultivated and mentioned in the legal precepts of the Pharisees (Mt 23:23; Lk 11:42).

THAYER.pt: Planta aromática de jardim cujas folhas eram usadas para condimento e para o pagamento de pequenos dízimos rituais. 1. A hortelã, erva aromática cultivada e mencionada nos preceitos legais dos fariseus (Mt 23.23; Lc 11.42).
THAYER.en: An aromatic garden plant whose leaves were used for seasoning and for the payment of small ritual tithes. 1. Mint, an aromatic herb cultivated and mentioned in the legal precepts of the Pharisees (Mt 23:23; Lk 11:42).

DEFINITION: A pattern of behavior, habitual practice, or conduct characteristic of an individual or a social group.
SENSES: 1. Habit or moral custom that shapes human conduct, often influenced by convictions (1Co 15:33).

THAYER.pt: Padrão de comportamento, prática habitual ou conduta característica de um indivíduo ou de um grupo social. 1. Hábito ou costume moral que molda a conduta humana, frequentemente influenciado por convicções (1Co 15.33).
THAYER.en: A pattern of behavior, habitual practice, or conduct characteristic of an individual or a social group. 1. Habit or moral custom that shapes human conduct, often influenced by convictions (1Co 15:33).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Impf: ἧκον, Fut: ἥξω, Aor: ἧξα
DEFINITION: To arrive at a specific location as a result of movement, now being present at the destination.
SENSES: 1. To be present in a place after having arrived (Mt 8:11; Jn 4:47).
2. To happen or come to pass with the passage of time (Mt 23:36).

THAYER.pt: Chegar a um determinado local como resultado de um deslocamento, encontrando-se agora presente no destino. 1. Estar presente em um lugar após ter chegado (Mt 8.11; Jo 4.47). | 2. Acontecer ou sobrevir com o transcurso do tempo (Mt 23.36).
THAYER.en: To arrive at a specific location as a result of movement, now being present at the destination. 1. To be present in a place after having arrived (Mt 8:11; Jn 4:47). | 2. To happen or come to pass with the passage of time (Mt 23:36).

DEFINITION: A term transliterated from Hebrew or Aramaic that expresses the intimate and reverent invocation of the deity.
SENSES: 1. An expression meaning 'My God,' used by Jesus on the cross (Mt 27:46).

THAYER.pt: Termo transliterado do hebraico ou aramaico que expressa a invocação íntima e reverente da divindade. 1. Expressão que significa 'Meu Deus', usada por Jesus na cruz (Mt 27.46).
THAYER.en: A term transliterated from Hebrew or Aramaic that expresses the intimate and reverent invocation of the deity. 1. An expression meaning 'My God,' used by Jesus on the cross (Mt 27:46).

DEFINITION: A masculine proper name that appears in the ancestral lineage of Jesus Christ according to the Lucan account.
SENSES: 1. Heli, an ancestor in the human genealogy of Jesus (Lk 3:23).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio masculino que figura na linhagem ancestral de Jesus Cristo conforme o relato lucano. 1. Heli, ancestral na genealogia humana de Jesus (Lc 3.23).
THAYER.en: A masculine proper name that appears in the ancestral lineage of Jesus Christ according to the Lucan account. 1. Heli, an ancestor in the human genealogy of Jesus (Lk 3:23).

DEFINITION: Elijah, one of the greatest prophets of the Old Testament, known for his ministry during the time of Ahab and for his ascension to heaven.
SENSES: 1. The prophet Elijah of the Old Testament (Lk 4:25).
2. The eschatological figure expected before the day of the Lord (Mt 17:11).

THAYER.pt: Elias, um dos maiores profetas do Antigo Testamento, conhecido por seu ministério na época de Acabe e por sua ascensão aos céus. 1. O profeta Elias do Antigo Testamento (Lc 4:25). | 2. A figura escatológica esperada antes do dia do Senhor (Mt 17:11).
THAYER.en: Elijah, one of the greatest prophets of the Old Testament, known for his ministry during the time of Ahab and for his ascension to heaven. 1. The prophet Elijah of the Old Testament (Lk 4:25). | 2. The eschatological figure expected before the day of the Lord (Mt 17:11).

DEFINITION: Refers both to the period or duration of human life (age) and to the physical height of a person (stature). In the New Testament, it can denote the vigor of maturity or a phase of development.
SENSES: 1. Period or time of life, age (Mt 6:27; Lk 2:52).
2. Stature or physical height of a human being (Lk 19:3).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se tanto ao período ou duração da vida humana (idade) quanto à altura física de uma pessoa (estatura). No Novo Testamento, pode denotar o vigor da maturidade ou a fase de desenvolvimento. 1. Período ou tempo de vida, idade (Mt 6.27; Lc 2.52). | 2. Estatura ou altura física de um ser humano (Lc 19.3).
THAYER.en: Refers both to the period or duration of human life (age) and to the physical height of a person (stature). In the New Testament, it can denote the vigor of maturity or a phase of development. 1. Period or time of life, age (Mt 6:27; Lk 2:52). | 2. Stature or physical height of a human being (Lk 19:3).

DEFINITION: An interrogative or exclamatory pronoun that expresses great proportion, extent, or size.
SENSES: 1. How great, in exclamations about the magnitude of something (Jas 3:5; Col 2:1).

THAYER.pt: Pronome interrogativo ou exclamativo que expressa grande proporção, extensão ou tamanho. 1. Quão grande, em exclamações sobre a magnitude de algo (Tg 3.5; Cl 2.1).
THAYER.en: An interrogative or exclamatory pronoun that expresses great proportion, extent, or size. 1. How great, in exclamations about the magnitude of something (Jas 3:5; Col 2:1).

DEFINITION: The luminous celestial body that governs the day and illuminates the earth in the natural system.
SENSES: 1. The sun as the luminescent star of the firmament (Mt 13:43; Rev 16:8).

THAYER.pt: O corpo celeste luminoso que governa o dia e ilumina a terra no sistema natural. 1. O sol como astro luminescente do firmamento (Mt 13.43; Ap 16.8).
THAYER.en: The luminous celestial body that governs the day and illuminates the earth in the natural system. 1. The sun as the luminescent star of the firmament (Mt 13:43; Rev 16:8).

DEFINITION: A pointed piece of metal used to fix or fasten objects, famous for its use in the crucifixion.
SENSES: 1. Metal nail used in the crucifixion of Jesus (Jn 20:25).

THAYER.pt: Peça pontiaguda de metal utilizada para fixar ou prender objetos, célebre pelo seu uso na crucificação. 1. Prego de metal empregado na crucificação de Jesus (Jo 20.25).
THAYER.en: A pointed piece of metal used to fix or fasten objects, famous for its use in the crucifixion. 1. Metal nail used in the crucifixion of Jesus (Jn 20:25).

DEFINITION: First-person plural personal pronoun in the accusative case, referring to the author/speaker and his companions as a direct object.
SENSES: 1. Direct object encompassing the speaker and his group (2Co 5:14).

THAYER.pt: Pronome pessoal de primeira pessoa do plural no caso acusativo, referindo-se ao autor/falante e seus companheiros como objeto direto. 1. Objeto direto englobando o falante e seu grupo (2Co 5.14).
THAYER.en: First-person plural personal pronoun in the accusative case, referring to the author/speaker and his companions as a direct object. 1. Direct object encompassing the speaker and his group (2Co 5:14).

DEFINITION: First-person plural personal pronoun in the nominative case, used emphatically for the subject that includes the speaker.
SENSES: 1. Collective subject emphasizing the speaker's group (Php 3:3).

THAYER.pt: Pronome pessoal de primeira pessoa do plural no caso nominativo, usado enfaticamente para o sujeito que inclui o falante. 1. Sujeito coletivo enfatizando o grupo do falante (Fp 3.3).
THAYER.en: First-person plural personal pronoun in the nominative case, used emphatically for the subject that includes the speaker. 1. Collective subject emphasizing the speaker's group (Php 3:3).

DEFINITION: The twelve-hour light period between dawn and sunset, the full 24-hour cycle, or an era/epoch historically determined by divine judgment or intervention.
SENSES: 1. Daylight period of sunlight, as opposed to night (Mt 20:6; Lk 4:42).
2. Civil time unit of twenty-four hours (Mt 12:40; 16:21).
3. Specific occasion of eschatological judgment or historically determined epoch: the Day of the Lord (Mt 25:13; 1Co 3:13).

THAYER.pt: Período claro de doze horas entre a aurora e o pôr do sol, o ciclo integral de 24 horas, ou uma era/época historicamente determinada pelo julgamento ou intervenção divina. 1. Período diurno de luz solar, em oposição à noite (Mt 20.6; Lc 4.42). | 2. Unidade de tempo civil de vinte e quatro horas (Mt 12.40; 16.21). | 3. Ocasião específica de juízo escatológico ou época histórica determinada: o Dia do Senhor (Mt 25.13; 1Co 3.13).
THAYER.en: The twelve-hour light period between dawn and sunset, the full 24-hour cycle, or an era/epoch historically determined by divine judgment or intervention. 1. Daylight period of sunlight, as opposed to night (Mt 20:6; Lk 4:42). | 2. Civil time unit of twenty-four hours (Mt 12:40; 16:21). | 3. Specific occasion of eschatological judgment or historically determined epoch: the Day of the Lord (Mt 25:13; 1Co 3:13).

DEFINITION: First-person plural possessive pronoun, indicating what belongs to or refers to the speaker and those associated with him.
SENSES: 1. That which belongs to us, our (Acts 2:11; Lk 16:12).

THAYER.pt: Pronome possessivo da primeira pessoa do plural, indicando o que pertence ou se refere ao falante e aos que estão associados a ele. 1. O que pertence a nós, nosso (At 2.11; Lc 16.12).
THAYER.en: First-person plural possessive pronoun, indicating what belongs to or refers to the speaker and those associated with him. 1. That which belongs to us, our (Acts 2:11; Lk 16:12).

DEFINITION: Imperfect tense of the verb to be in the first person singular, indicating a continuous action or state in the past.
SENSES: 1. Continuous state in the past in relation to the speaker (Jn 11:15).

THAYER.pt: Forma do imperfeito do verbo ser/estar na primeira pessoa do singular, indicando uma ação ou estado contínuo no passado. 1. Estado contínuo no passado em relação ao falante (Jo 11.15).
THAYER.en: Imperfect tense of the verb to be in the first person singular, indicating a continuous action or state in the past. 1. Continuous state in the past in relation to the speaker (Jn 11:15).

DEFINITION: The physical state of someone on the borderline between life and death, severely wounded.
SENSES: 1. A person who is almost dead as a result of violence or an accident (Lk 10:30).

THAYER.pt: Estado físico de alguém que se encontra no limite entre a vida e a morte, gravemente ferido. 1. Pessoa que está quase morta em decorrência de violência ou acidente (Lc 10.30).
THAYER.en: The physical state of someone on the borderline between life and death, severely wounded. 1. A person who is almost dead as a result of violence or an accident (Lk 10:30).

DEFINITION: First-person plural personal pronoun in the dative case, indicating the beneficiary or receiver of the action for the speaker's group.
SENSES: 1. Dative of advantage or indirect object of the speaker's group (Acts 4:12).

THAYER.pt: Pronome pessoal de primeira pessoa do plural no caso dativo, indicando o beneficiário ou receptor da ação para o grupo do falante. 1. Dativo de vantagem ou objeto indireto do grupo do falante (At 4.12).
THAYER.en: First-person plural personal pronoun in the dative case, indicating the beneficiary or receiver of the action for the speaker's group. 1. Dative of advantage or indirect object of the speaker's group (Acts 4:12).

DEFINITION: Represents a part equal to fifty percent of a whole, half of a quantity or measure.
SENSES: 1. The half of an amount, object, or time period (Mk 6:23; Lk 19:8; Rev 12:14).

THAYER.pt: Representa uma parte igual a cinquenta por cento de um todo, a metade de uma quantidade ou medida. 1. A metade de uma quantia, objeto ou período temporal (Mc 6.23; Lc 19.8; Ap 12.14).
THAYER.en: Represents a part equal to fifty percent of a whole, half of a quantity or measure. 1. The half of an amount, object, or time period (Mk 6:23; Lk 19:8; Rev 12:14).

DEFINITION: An exact time period equivalent to half an hour.
SENSES: 1. A time interval of thirty minutes, used in an eschatological context (Rev 8:1).

THAYER.pt: Período temporal exato equivalente à metade de uma hora. 1. Um intervalo de tempo de trinta minutos, usado em contexto escatológico (Ap 8.1).
THAYER.en: An exact time period equivalent to half an hour. 1. A time interval of thirty minutes, used in an eschatological context (Rev 8:1).

DEFINITION: First-person plural personal pronoun in the genitive case, indicating possession or relationship with the speaker's group.
SENSES: 1. Genitive of possession or association with the speaker's group (1Jn 1:3).

THAYER.pt: Pronome pessoal de primeira pessoa do plural no caso genitivo, indicando posse ou relação com o grupo do falante. 1. Genitivo de posse ou associação com o grupo do falante (1Jo 1.3).
THAYER.en: First-person plural personal pronoun in the genitive case, indicating possession or relationship with the speaker's group. 1. Genitive of possession or association with the speaker's group (1Jn 1:3).

DEFINITION: Imperfect tense of the verb to be in the third person singular, indicating existence or continuous condition in the past.
SENSES: 1. Existence or continuous state in the past (Jn 1:1).

THAYER.pt: Forma do imperfeito do verbo ser/estar na terceira pessoa do singular, indicando existência ou condição contínua no passado. 1. Existência ou estado contínuo no passado (Jo 1.1).
THAYER.en: Imperfect tense of the verb to be in the third person singular, indicating existence or continuous condition in the past. 1. Existence or continuous state in the past (Jn 1:1).

DEFINITION: Temporal conjunction or adverb denoting the moment or simultaneous repetition of one event in relation to another.
SENSES: 1. At the time when or whenever an event occurs (2Cor 3:15,16).

THAYER.pt: Conjunção temporal ou advérbio que denota o momento ou a repetição simultânea de um evento em relação a outro. 1. No momento em que ou sempre que um evento ocorre (2Co 3.15,16).
THAYER.en: Temporal conjunction or adverb denoting the moment or simultaneous repetition of one event in relation to another. 1. At the time when or whenever an event occurs (2Cor 3:15,16).

DEFINITION: Emphatic particle used to introduce comparisons, highlighting the difference between two elements.
SENSES: 1. Emphatic marker of comparison with the meaning of 'than' or 'much more than'.

THAYER.pt: Partícula enfática empregada para introduzir comparações, realçando a diferença entre dois elementos. 1. Marcador enfático de comparação com o sentido de 'do que' ou 'muito mais do que'.
THAYER.en: Emphatic particle used to introduce comparisons, highlighting the difference between two elements. 1. Emphatic marker of comparison with the meaning of 'than' or 'much more than'.

DEFINITION: Attribute of one who demonstrates softness, gentleness, and sincere kindness in dealing with people.
SENSES: 1. Attitude of gentleness and maternal care, like that of a nursing mother (1Th 2:7).
2. Attitude of kindness and patience required of a servant of the Lord (2Tm 2:24).

THAYER.pt: Atributo de quem demonstra suavidade, brandura e sincera bondade no trato com as pessoas. 1. Atitude de brandura e cuidado maternal, como a de uma ama (1Ts 2.7). | 2. Postura de bondade e paciência exigida de um servo do Senhor (2Tm 2.24).
THAYER.en: Attribute of one who demonstrates softness, gentleness, and sincere kindness in dealing with people. 1. Attitude of gentleness and maternal care, like that of a nursing mother (1Th 2:7). | 2. Attitude of kindness and patience required of a servant of the Lord (2Tm 2:24).

DEFINITION: Masculine proper name referring to an ancestor in the genealogy of Christ.
SENSES: 1. Er, a character mentioned in the human lineage of Jesus (Lk 3:28).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio masculino referente a um dos antepassados na genealogia de Cristo. 1. Er, personagem mencionado na linhagem humana de Jesus (Lc 3.28).
THAYER.en: Masculine proper name referring to an ancestor in the genealogy of Christ. 1. Er, a character mentioned in the human lineage of Jesus (Lk 3:28).

DEFINITION: Quality of a peaceful existence, free from agitation, conflicts, or external disturbances.
SENSES: 1. Calm and peaceful lifestyle that believers should seek in prayer (1Tm 2:2).

THAYER.pt: Qualidade de uma existência pacífica, livre de agitações, conflitos ou perturbações externas. 1. Estilo de vida calmo e pacífico que os crentes devem buscar em oração (1Tm 2.2).
THAYER.en: Quality of a peaceful existence, free from agitation, conflicts, or external disturbances. 1. Calm and peaceful lifestyle that believers should seek in prayer (1Tm 2:2).

DEFINITION: Name of several rulers of the Idumean family who ruled Judea and surrounding regions during the New Testament period.
SENSES: 1. Herod the Great, king of Judea at the time of Jesus' birth (Mt 2:1).
2. Herod Antipas, tetrarch of Galilee and Perea, responsible for the execution of John the Baptist (Mt 14:1; Lk 23:7).
3. Herod Agrippa I, who persecuted the church in Jerusalem (Acts 12:1).

THAYER.pt: Nome de vários governantes da família idumeia que dominaram a Judeia e regiões adjacentes durante o período do Novo Testamento. 1. Herodes, o Grande, rei da Judeia por ocasião do nascimento de Jesus (Mt 2.1). | 2. Herodes Antipas, tetrarca da Galileia e Perea, responsável pela execução de João Batista (Mt 14.1; Lc 23.7). | 3. Herodes Agripa I, que perseguiu a igreja em Jerusalém (At 12.1).
THAYER.en: Name of several rulers of the Idumean family who ruled Judea and surrounding regions during the New Testament period. 1. Herod the Great, king of Judea at the time of Jesus' birth (Mt 2:1). | 2. Herod Antipas, tetrarch of Galilee and Perea, responsible for the execution of John the Baptist (Mt 14:1; Lk 23:7). | 3. Herod Agrippa I, who persecuted the church in Jerusalem (Acts 12:1).
