THAYER.pt: Aquilo que pertence à natureza, ao caráter ou à esfera de Deus. 1. Que pertence ou procede de Deus, divino (2Pe 1.3, 4). | 2. O Ser Divino, a divindade (At 17.29).
THAYER.en: That which pertains to the nature, character, or sphere of God. 1. Pertaining to or proceeding from God, divine (2 Pet 1:3, 4). | 2. The Divine Being, the divinity (Acts 17:29).

DEFINITION: Refers to the essence, quality, or attribute inherent to divinity. In the New Testament, it denotes the divine nature itself manifested in creation.
SENSES: 1. The quality of being God or the divine nature (Rom 1:20).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se à essência, qualidade ou atributo inerente à divindade. No Novo Testamento, denota a própria natureza divina manifestada na criação. 1. A qualidade de ser Deus ou a natureza divina (Rm 1.20).
THAYER.en: Refers to the essence, quality, or attribute inherent to divinity. In the New Testament, it denotes the divine nature itself manifested in creation. 1. The quality of being God or the divine nature (Rom 1:20).

DEFINITION: Describes something that possesses the characteristics or appearance of sulfur, especially in color or burning odor.
SENSES: 1. Resembling sulfur or of a sulfurous yellowish color (Rev 9:17).

THAYER.pt: Descreve algo que possui as características ou a aparência de enxofre, especialmente na cor ou no odor ardente. 1. Semelhante ao enxofre ou de cor amarelada sulfurosa (Ap 9.17).
THAYER.en: Describes something that possesses the characteristics or appearance of sulfur, especially in color or burning odor. 1. Resembling sulfur or of a sulfurous yellowish color (Rev 9:17).

DEFINITION: Designates that which is desired, intended, or decreed, encompassing both human desires and impulses and the sovereign and moral plan of God.
SENSES: 1. That which is desired or decreed by God or Christ, His sovereign will (Matt 6:10; John 6:39).
2. The will, purpose, or intentional desire of human beings (1 Cor 7:37; 2 Pet 1:21).

THAYER.pt: Designa aquilo que é desejado, pretendido ou decretado, abrangendo tanto os desejos e impulsos humanos quanto o plano soberano e moral de Deus. 1. O que é desejado ou decretado por Deus ou Cristo, Sua vontade soberana (Mt 6.10; Jo 6.39). | 2. A vontade, o propósito ou o desejo intencional de seres humanos (1Co 7.37; 2Pe 1.21).
THAYER.en: Designates that which is desired, intended, or decreed, encompassing both human desires and impulses and the sovereign and moral plan of God. 1. That which is desired or decreed by God or Christ, His sovereign will (Matt 6:10; John 6:39). | 2. The will, purpose, or intentional desire of human beings (1 Cor 7:37; 2 Pet 1:21).

DEFINITION: Indicates the action or process of exercising the will, the deliberate desire, or the good pleasure, especially in reference to God.
SENSES: 1. The act of willing or the expressed will of God (Heb 2:4).

THAYER.pt: Indica a ação ou o processo de exercer a vontade, o desejo deliberado ou o beneplácito, especialmente em referência a Deus. 1. O ato de querer ou a vontade expressa de Deus (Hb 2.4).
THAYER.en: Indicates the action or process of exercising the will, the deliberate desire, or the good pleasure, especially in reference to God. 1. The act of willing or the expressed will of God (Heb 2:4).

DEFINITION: Denotes the deliberate volitional act, involving intentional desire, determination, or active purpose. It differs from mere whim by often encompassing the active resolution of the divine or human will.
SENSES: 1. To desire ardently, to want to have something (Matt 19:21; John 9:27).
2. To resolve deliberately, to dispose the will, to plan (Matt 8:3; Rom 7:15).
3. To take pleasure in, to delight in (Mark 12:38; Col 2:18).

THAYER.pt: Denota o ato volitivo deliberado, envolvendo o desejo intencional, a determinação ou o propósito ativo de alguém. Diferencia-se do mero capricho por englobar com frequência a resolução ativa da vontade divina ou humana. 1. Desejar ardentemente, querer ter algo (Mt 19.21; Jo 9.27). | 2. Resolver deliberadamente, dispor a vontade, planejar (Mt 8.3; Rm 7.15). | 3. Ter prazer em, comprazer-se em (Mc 12.38; Cl 2.18).
THAYER.en: Denotes the deliberate volitional act, involving intentional desire, determination, or active purpose. It differs from mere whim by often encompassing the active resolution of the divine or human will. 1. To desire ardently, to want to have something (Matt 19:21; John 9:27). | 2. To resolve deliberately, to dispose the will, to plan (Matt 8:3; Rom 7:15). | 3. To take pleasure in, to delight in (Mark 12:38; Col 2:18).

DEFINITION: The structural base supporting a building or, figuratively, the initial principles upon which something is built.
SENSES: 1. The physical foundation or cornerstone of a construction (Luke 6:49; Rev 21:14).
2. The conceptual or doctrinal base for the beginning of something (Rom 15:20; 1 Cor 3:10).

THAYER.pt: A base estrutural de sustentação de um edifício ou, figuradamente, os princípios iniciais sobre os quais algo é edificado. 1. O alicerce físico ou pedra fundamental de uma construção (Lc 6.49; Ap 21.14). | 2. A base conceitual ou doutrinária para o início de algo (Rm 15.20; 1Co 3.10).
THAYER.en: The structural base supporting a building or, figuratively, the initial principles upon which something is built. 1. The physical foundation or cornerstone of a construction (Luke 6:49; Rev 21:14). | 2. The conceptual or doctrinal base for the beginning of something (Rom 15:20; 1 Cor 3:10).

DEFINITION: To build or place a solid base for a physical structure, or to provide spiritual firmness for the life of the believer.
SENSES: 1. To lay a foundation or found a physical structure (Matt 7:25).
2. To establish, firm up, and strengthen believers spiritually (1 Pet 5:10).

THAYER.pt: Construir ou colocar uma base sólida para uma estrutura física, ou prover firmeza espiritual para a vida do crente. 1. Lançar alicerce ou fundar uma estrutura física (Mt 7.25). | 2. Estabelecer, firmar e fortalecer espiritualmente os crentes (1Pe 5.10).
THAYER.en: To build or place a solid base for a physical structure, or to provide spiritual firmness for the life of the believer. 1. To lay a foundation or found a physical structure (Matt 7:25). | 2. To establish, firm up, and strengthen believers spiritually (1 Pet 5:10).

DEFINITION: Qualifies one who receives direct instruction or teaching from God, applied in the New Testament to mutual love among believers.
SENSES: 1. Instructed or taught directly by God (1 Thess 4:9).

THAYER.pt: Qualifica aquele que recebe instrução ou ensino direto de Deus, aplicado no Novo Testamento ao amor mútuo entre os crentes. 1. Instruído ou ensinado diretamente por Deus (1Ts 4.9).
THAYER.en: Qualifies one who receives direct instruction or teaching from God, applied in the New Testament to mutual love among believers. 1. Instructed or taught directly by God (1 Thess 4:9).

DEFINITION: Signifies actively opposing God, resisting His purposes and His sovereign work.
SENSES: 1. To oppose God or fight against the divine will (Acts 23:9).

THAYER.pt: Significa opor-se ativamente a Deus, resistindo aos seus propósitos e à sua obra soberana. 1. Opor-se a Deus ou lutar contra a vontade divina (At 23.9).
THAYER.en: Signifies actively opposing God, resisting His purposes and His sovereign work. 1. To oppose God or fight against the divine will (Acts 23:9).

DEFINITION: Describes a person who is in a state of active enmity against God, fighting against His designs.
SENSES: 1. One who fights against God or is an enemy of God (Acts 5:39).

THAYER.pt: Descreve a pessoa que está em estado de inimizade ativa contra Deus, combatendo os seus desígnios. 1. Aquele que luta contra Deus ou é inimigo de Deus (At 5.39).
THAYER.en: Describes a person who is in a state of active enmity against God, fighting against His designs. 1. One who fights against God or is an enemy of God (Acts 5:39).

DEFINITION: A term indicating that a writing or communication originated from the inspiring breath of God, possessing divine authority.
SENSES: 1. Produced under the direct inspiration of God (2 Tim 3:16).

THAYER.pt: Termo que indica que um escrito ou comunicação teve origem no sopro inspirador de Deus, possuindo autoridade divina. 1. Produzido sob a inspiração direta de Deus (2Tm 3.16).
THAYER.en: A term indicating that a writing or communication originated from the inspiring breath of God, possessing divine authority. 1. Produced under the direct inspiration of God (2 Tim 3:16).

DEFINITION: A central theological term designating the one God, creator, sustainer, and sovereign in biblical monotheistic revelation. It is also applied to Christ in core Christological passages and, rarely, to false divinities.
SENSES: 1. The one true God of biblical monotheism (Matt 1:23; John 1:1; 1 Tim 2:5).
2. Full title attributed to Jesus Christ as God manifest (John 20:28; Titus 2:13; Heb 1:8).
3. Pagan divinities, mythical gods, or idolatrous powers (Acts 14:11; 1 Cor 8:5; 2 Cor 4:4).

THAYER.pt: Termo teológico central que designa o Deus único, criador, sustentador e soberano na revelação bíblica monoteísta. Também é aplicado a Cristo em passagens cristológicas nucleares e, raramente, a falsas divindades. 1. O Deus único e verdadeiro do monoteísmo bíblico (Mt 1.23; Jo 1.1; 1Tm 2.5). | 2. Título pleno atribuído a Jesus Cristo como Deus manifesto (Jo 20.28; Tt 2.13; Hb 1.8). | 3. Divindades pagãs, deuses míticos ou potestades idólatras (At 14.11; 1Co 8.5; 2Co 4.4).
THAYER.en: A central theological term designating the one God, creator, sustainer, and sovereign in biblical monotheistic revelation. It is also applied to Christ in core Christological passages and, rarely, to false divinities. 1. The one true God of biblical monotheism (Matt 1:23; John 1:1; 1 Tim 2:5). | 2. Full title attributed to Jesus Christ as God manifest (John 20:28; Titus 2:13; Heb 1:8). | 3. Pagan divinities, mythical gods, or idolatrous powers (Acts 14:11; 1 Cor 8:5; 2 Cor 4:4).

DEFINITION: Refers to genuine devotion, fear, and reverence owed to God, expressed through sincere religious practices.
SENSES: 1. Reverent awe and devout practice toward God (1 Tim 2:10).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se à devoção genuína, temor e reverência devidos a Deus, expressos por meio de práticas religiosas sinceras. 1. Reverência reverente e prática devota para com Deus (1Tm 2.10).
THAYER.en: Refers to genuine devotion, fear, and reverence owed to God, expressed through sincere religious practices. 1. Reverent awe and devout practice toward God (1 Tim 2:10).

DEFINITION: Qualifies a person who demonstrates reverent fear of God, honoring Him in their life and conduct.
SENSES: 1. Devout, God-fearing, and obedient to His precepts (John 9:31).

THAYER.pt: Qualifica a pessoa que demonstra temor reverente a Deus, honrando-o em sua vida e conduta. 1. Devoto, temente a Deus e obediente aos seus preceitos (Jo 9.31).
THAYER.en: Qualifies a person who demonstrates reverent fear of God, honoring Him in their life and conduct. 1. Devout, God-fearing, and obedient to His precepts (John 9:31).

DEFINITION: Describes someone who harbors deep aversion or hatred against God, demonstrated in lists of moral vices.
SENSES: 1. One who hates God or is detested by Him (Rom 1:30).

THAYER.pt: Descreve alguém que nutre aversão ou ódio profundo contra Deus, demonstrado em listas de vícios morais. 1. Aquele que odeia a Deus ou é detestado por Ele (Rm 1.30).
THAYER.en: Describes someone who harbors deep aversion or hatred against God, demonstrated in lists of moral vices. 1. One who hates God or is detested by Him (Rom 1:30).

DEFINITION: Designates the fullness of divine nature and essence, used in the New Testament to affirm the absolute divinity of Christ.
SENSES: 1. The essence and state of being God, the divinity (Col 2:9).

THAYER.pt: Designa a plenitude da natureza e essência divina, usada no Novo Testamento para afirmar a divindade absoluta de Cristo. 1. A essência e o estado de ser Deus, a divindade (Cl 2.9).
THAYER.en: Designates the fullness of divine nature and essence, used in the New Testament to affirm the absolute divinity of Christ. 1. The essence and state of being God, the divinity (Col 2:9).

DEFINITION: A proper name meaning 'friend of God', referring to the Christian dignitary to whom the Gospel of Luke and the book of Acts were dedicated.
SENSES: 1. Theophilus, noble recipient of Luke's writings (Luke 1:3; Acts 1:1).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio que significa 'amigo de Deus', referente ao dignitário cristão a quem o Evangelho de Lucas e o livro de Atos foram dedicados. 1. Teófilo, destinatário nobre dos escritos de Lucas (Lc 1.3; At 1.1).
THAYER.en: A proper name meaning 'friend of God', referring to the Christian dignitary to whom the Gospel of Luke and the book of Acts were dedicated. 1. Theophilus, noble recipient of Luke's writings (Luke 1:3; Acts 1:1).

DEFINITION: The act of caring for the sick, the restoration of health, or, by extension, the body of servants in a household.
SENSES: 1. Healing or medical treatment of the sick (Lk 9:11).
2. The group of servants or the household staff (Lk 12:42).

THAYER.pt: Ato de cuidar de enfermos, restauração da saúde ou, por extensão, o corpo de servos de uma casa. 1. Cura ou tratamento médico de enfermos (Lc 9.11). | 2. O conjunto de servos ou a equipe doméstica (Lc 12.42).
THAYER.en: The act of caring for the sick, the restoration of health, or, by extension, the body of servants in a household. 1. Healing or medical treatment of the sick (Lk 9:11). | 2. The group of servants or the household staff (Lk 12:42).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: θεραπεύσω; Aor: ἐθεράπευσα; Pass: ἐθεραπεύθην
DEFINITION: To restore the physical health of someone through medical or miraculous care, or to render service and worship.
SENSES: 1. To heal or restore the health of someone weakened by illness or demons (Mt 4:24; Lk 7:21).
2. To render service or worship to a deity (Ac 17:25).

THAYER.pt: Restaurar a saúde física de alguém através de cuidados médicos ou milagrosos, ou prestar serviço e adoração. 1. Curar ou restaurar a saúde de alguém debilitado por enfermidades ou demônios (Mt 4.24; Lc 7.21). | 2. Prestar serviço ou culto a uma divindade (At 17.25).
THAYER.en: To restore the physical health of someone through medical or miraculous care, or to render service and worship. 1. To heal or restore the health of someone weakened by illness or demons (Mt 4:24; Lk 7:21). | 2. To render service or worship to a deity (Ac 17:25).

DEFINITION: Denotes a servant or assistant who provides voluntary service, distinct from a common slave, indicating a relationship of honor and devotion.
SENSES: 1. A dedicated and honored servant, used specifically to describe the faithfulness of Moses (Heb 3:5).

THAYER.pt: Denota um servo ou assistente que presta serviço voluntário, distinto do escravo comum, indicando uma relação de honra e devoção. 1. Um servo dedicado e honrado, usado especificamente para descrever a fidelidade de Moisés (Hb 3.5).
THAYER.en: Denotes a servant or assistant who provides voluntary service, distinct from a common slave, indicating a relationship of honor and devotion. 1. A dedicated and honored servant, used specifically to describe the faithfulness of Moses (Heb 3:5).

DEFINITION: To cut and gather ripe cereal crops, widely used in the NT as a metaphor for the result of moral and spiritual actions.
SENSES: 1. To harvest cereals in the field (Mt 6:26).
2. Figuratively, to reap the consequences or spiritual fruits of one's own actions (Gal 6:7).

THAYER.pt: Cortar e recolher plantações maduras de cereais, amplamente utilizado no NT como metáfora para o resultado de ações morais e espirituais. 1. Fazer a colheita de cereais no campo (Mt 6.26). | 2. Em sentido figurado, colher as consequências ou frutos espirituais das próprias ações (Gl 6.7).
THAYER.en: To cut and gather ripe cereal crops, widely used in the NT as a metaphor for the result of moral and spiritual actions. 1. To harvest cereals in the field (Mt 6:26). | 2. Figuratively, to reap the consequences or spiritual fruits of one's own actions (Gal 6:7).

DEFINITION: Refers to the process and period of the agricultural harvest, as well as the fruits or grains ready to be gathered. It is frequently used in eschatological metaphors.
SENSES: 1. The time or activity of gathering ripe crops (Mt 13:30).
2. The harvest or crop ready for spiritual reaping (Mt 9:37; Jn 4:35).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se ao processo e ao período da colheita agrícola, bem como aos frutos ou grãos prontos para serem colhidos. É muito usado em metáforas escatológicas. 1. O tempo ou a atividade de colher as plantações maduras (Mt 13.30). | 2. A seara ou a safra pronta para a colheita espiritual (Mt 9.37; Jo 4.35).
THAYER.en: Refers to the process and period of the agricultural harvest, as well as the fruits or grains ready to be gathered. It is frequently used in eschatological metaphors. 1. The time or activity of gathering ripe crops (Mt 13:30). | 2. The harvest or crop ready for spiritual reaping (Mt 9:37; Jn 4:35).

DEFINITION: One whose work is to harvest ripe crops in agricultural fields.
SENSES: 1. A rural worker who performs the harvesting of wheat or other crops (Mt 13:30, 39).

THAYER.pt: Aquele cujo trabalho é colher as plantações maduras nos campos agrícolas. 1. Trabalhador rural que realiza a colheita do trigo ou de outras safras (Mt 13.30,39).
THAYER.en: One whose work is to harvest ripe crops in agricultural fields. 1. A rural worker who performs the harvesting of wheat or other crops (Mt 13:30, 39).

DEFINITION: To raise the temperature of something or oneself, especially in front of a heat source such as a fire.
SENSES: 1. To warm oneself by the fire (Mk 14:54; Jn 18:18).

THAYER.pt: Elevar a temperatura de algo ou de si mesmo, especialmente diante de uma fonte de calor como o fogo. 1. Aquecer a si mesmo junto ao fogo (Mc 14.54; Jo 18.18).
THAYER.en: To raise the temperature of something or oneself, especially in front of a heat source such as a fire. 1. To warm oneself by the fire (Mk 14:54; Jn 18:18).

DEFINITION: Refers to the state of high temperature or the physical sensation of heat generated by fire or weather conditions.
SENSES: 1. Intense physical heat generated by fire (Ac 28:3).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se ao estado de alta temperatura ou à sensação física de calor gerada por fogo ou condições climáticas. 1. Calor físico intenso gerado pelo fogo (At 28.3).
THAYER.en: Refers to the state of high temperature or the physical sensation of heat generated by fire or weather conditions. 1. Intense physical heat generated by fire (Ac 28:3).

DEFINITION: The hottest season of the year, characterized by the growth of vegetation and harvest.
SENSES: 1. The summer season as a temporal and agricultural marker (Mt 24:32).

THAYER.pt: A estação mais quente do ano, caracterizada pelo crescimento da vegetação e colheita. 1. A estação do verão como marco temporal e agrícola (Mt 24.32).
THAYER.en: The hottest season of the year, characterized by the growth of vegetation and harvest. 1. The summer season as a temporal and agricultural marker (Mt 24:32).

DEFINITION: An inhabitant or native of the Macedonian city of Thessalonica.
SENSES: 1. A citizen or native of Thessalonica (Ac 20:4).

THAYER.pt: Habitante ou nativo da cidade macedônia de Tessalônica. 1. Cidadão ou natural de Tessalônica (At 20.4).
THAYER.en: An inhabitant or native of the Macedonian city of Thessalonica. 1. A citizen or native of Thessalonica (Ac 20:4).

DEFINITION: An important port city of Roman Macedonia, visited by the apostle Paul during his missionary journeys.
SENSES: 1. The city of Thessalonica in Macedonia (Ac 17:1; Phil 4:16).

THAYER.pt: Importante cidade portuária da macedônia romana, visitada pelo apóstolo Paulo em suas viagens missionárias. 1. A cidade de Tessalônica na Macedônia (At 17.1; Fp 4.16).
THAYER.en: An important port city of Roman Macedonia, visited by the apostle Paul during his missionary journeys. 1. The city of Thessalonica in Macedonia (Ac 17:1; Phil 4:16).

DEFINITION: Proper name of a Jewish agitator or insurrectionist who led an uprising before the apostolic period.
SENSES: 1. Theudas, a Jewish rebel leader mentioned by Gamaliel (Ac 5:36).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio de um agitador ou insurrectionista judeu que liderou um levante antes do período apostólico. 1. Teudas, um líder rebelde judeu mencionado por Gamaliel (At 5.36).
THAYER.en: Proper name of a Jewish agitator or insurrectionist who led an uprising before the apostolic period. 1. Theudas, a Jewish rebel leader mentioned by Gamaliel (Ac 5:36).

DEFINITION: To observe something with sustained and continuous attention, acting as a spectator or arriving at a deep understanding.
SENSES: 1. To look attentively at something or be a spectator of an event (Mt 27:55; Jn 2:23).
2. To perceive, discern, or arrive at an understanding of something (Ac 4:13; 17:22).

THAYER.pt: Observar algo com atenção sustentada e contínua, atuando como espectador ou chegando a uma compreensão profunda. 1. Olhar atentamente para algo ou ser espectador de um evento (Mt 27.55; Jo 2.23). | 2. Perceber, discernir ou chegar à compreensão de algo (At 4.13; 17.22).
THAYER.en: To observe something with sustained and continuous attention, acting as a spectator or arriving at a deep understanding. 1. To look attentively at something or be a spectator of an event (Mt 27:55; Jn 2:23). | 2. To perceive, discern, or arrive at an understanding of something (Ac 4:13; 17:22).

DEFINITION: Designates that which is observed as a spectacle or a notable scene that attracts the gaze of spectators.
SENSES: 1. A spectacle or impressive scene for the eyes (Lk 23:48).

THAYER.pt: Designa aquilo que é observado como um espetáculo ou uma cena notável que atrai o olhar dos espectadores. 1. Um espetáculo ou cena impressionante para os olhos (Lc 23.48).
THAYER.en: Designates that which is observed as a spectacle or a notable scene that attracts the gaze of spectators. 1. A spectacle or impressive scene for the eyes (Lk 23:48).

DEFINITION: A receptacle or case intended to store objects securely, such as a sword sheath or a tomb.
SENSES: 1. A sheath intended to hold a sword (Jn 18:11).

THAYER.pt: Receptáculo ou estojo próprio para guardar objetos com segurança, como uma bainha de espada ou uma tumba. 1. Bainha destinada a guardar uma espada (Jo 18.11).
THAYER.en: A receptacle or case intended to store objects securely, such as a sword sheath or a tomb. 1. A sheath intended to hold a sword (Jn 18:11).

DEFINITION: To feed a newborn with breast milk or the act of an infant nursing.
SENSES: 1. To nurse or feed a baby at the breast (Mt 24:19).
2. To suck breast milk as an infant (Mt 21:16).

THAYER.pt: Alimentar um recém-nascido com leite materno ou o ato do lactente de mamar. 1. Amamentar ou alimentar um bebê ao peito (Mt 24.19). | 2. Sugar o leite materno como lactente (Mt 21.16).
THAYER.en: To feed a newborn with breast milk or the act of an infant nursing. 1. To nurse or feed a baby at the breast (Mt 24:19). | 2. To suck breast milk as an infant (Mt 21:16).

DEFINITION: Refers to the female gender in humans or animals, in distinction to the male.
SENSES: 1. The female sex of any living creature (Mt 19:4; Rom 1:26).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se ao gênero feminino em seres humanos ou animais, em distinção ao macho. 1. O sexo feminino de qualquer criatura viva (Mt 19.4; Rm 1.26).
THAYER.en: Refers to the female gender in humans or animals, in distinction to the male. 1. The female sex of any living creature (Mt 19:4; Rom 1:26).

DEFINITION: An instrument used to hunt or capture prey, frequently employed in the New Testament in a metaphorical sense of ruin or ambush.
SENSES: 1. A trap or snare used for capture and spiritual ruin (Rom 11:9).

THAYER.pt: Instrumento usado para caçar ou capturar presas, frequentemente empregado no Novo Testamento em sentido metafórico de ruína ou cilada. 1. Armadilha ou laço usado para captura e ruína espiritual (Rm 11.9).
THAYER.en: An instrument used to hunt or capture prey, frequently employed in the New Testament in a metaphorical sense of ruin or ambush. 1. A trap or snare used for capture and spiritual ruin (Rom 11:9).

SHORT_GLOSS: to catch, hunt, set a trap
DEFINITION: Originally means to hunt animals, but is used metaphorically to denote the action of setting traps to catch someone in their words.
SENSES: 1. To attempt to catch someone by surprise or incriminate them through cunning (Lk 11:54).
USAGE: to catch, hunt, set a trap

THAYER.pt: Significa originalmente caçar animais, mas é usado metaforicamente para denotar a ação de armar ciladas para apanhar alguém em suas palavras. 1. Tentar apanhar alguém de surpresa ou incriminar por meio de astúcia (Lc 11.54).
THAYER.en: Originally means to hunt animals, but is used metaphorically to denote the action of setting traps to catch someone in their words. 1. To attempt to catch someone by surprise or incriminate them through cunning (Lk 11:54).

DEFINITION: To fight with wild animals in the arena, or, in a figurative sense, to face fierce opposition and extreme hostility.
SENSES: 1. To face fierce opposition or fight against relentless adversaries (1Co 15.32).

THAYER.pt: Lutar contra animais selvagens na arena, ou, em sentido figurado, enfrentar oposição feroz e hostilidade extrema. 1. Enfrentar oposição feroz ou lutar contra adversários implacáveis (1Co 15.32).
THAYER.en: To fight with wild animals in the arena, or, in a figurative sense, to face fierce opposition and extreme hostility. 1. To face fierce opposition or fight against relentless adversaries (1Co 15.32).

DEFINITION: Describes any wild or venomous animal in contrast to domestic animals. In apocalyptic literature and metaphors, it points to evil powers, tyrannical empires, or people of predatory and vile conduct.
SENSES: 1. Wild animal, beast of the earth, or poisonous snake (Mk 1.13; Ac 28.4).
2. Monster or figurative beast in prophetic visions (Rev 11.7; 13.1; 17.3).
3. Metaphor for ravenous, brutal, and wicked individuals (Tit 1.12).

THAYER.pt: Descreve qualquer animal selvagem ou peçonhento em oposição aos animais domésticos. No gênero apocalíptico e em metáforas, aponta para poderes malignos, impérios tiranos ou pessoas de conduta predatória e vil. 1. Animal selvagem, fera da terra ou serpente venenosa (Mc 1.13; At 28.4). | 2. Monstro ou besta figurativa em visões proféticas (Ap 11.7; 13.1; 17.3). | 3. Metáfora para indivíduos vorazes, brutais e perversos (Tt 1.12).
THAYER.en: Describes any wild or venomous animal in contrast to domestic animals. In apocalyptic literature and metaphors, it points to evil powers, tyrannical empires, or people of predatory and vile conduct. 1. Wild animal, beast of the earth, or poisonous snake (Mk 1.13; Ac 28.4). | 2. Monster or figurative beast in prophetic visions (Rev 11.7; 13.1; 17.3). | 3. Metaphor for ravenous, brutal, and wicked individuals (Tit 1.12).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: θησαυρίσω, Aor: ἐθησαύρισα, Perf.Pass: τεθησαυρισμένος
DEFINITION: To accumulate valuables for future use or to keep something safe. Figuratively, it can denote the accumulation of judgment or spiritual consequences.
SENSES: 1. To gather and store up wealth or material goods, to treasure up (Mt 6.19).
2. To accumulate conduct or judgment for the future, to store up wrath (Ro 2.5).

THAYER.pt: Acumular bens de valor para uso futuro ou guardar algo em segurança. Em sentido figurado, pode denotar o acúmulo de juízo ou consequências espirituais. 1. Juntar e guardar riquezas ou bens materiais, atesourar (Mt 6.19). | 2. Acumular conduta ou juízo para o futuro, entesourar (Rm 2.5).
THAYER.en: To accumulate valuables for future use or to keep something safe. Figuratively, it can denote the accumulation of judgment or spiritual consequences. 1. To gather and store up wealth or material goods, to treasure up (Mt 6.19). | 2. To accumulate conduct or judgment for the future, to store up wrath (Ro 2.5).

DEFINITION: Designates a secure place to keep valuables (such as a chest or storehouse) or the accumulated treasure itself. In the New Testament, it is frequently employed in parables and teachings about eternal spiritual values.
SENSES: 1. A container, chest, or compartment used to store valuables (Mt 2.11; 13.52).
2. Riches, precious goods, or that which the heart supremely values (Mt 6.21; Lk 12.34).

THAYER.pt: Designa um local seguro para guardar objetos de valor (como um cofre ou paiol) ou o próprio tesouro acumulado. No Novo Testamento, é frequentemente empregado em parábolas e ensinamentos sobre valores espirituais eternos. 1. Um recipiente, cofre ou compartimento usado para guardar valores (Mt 2.11; 13.52). | 2. Riquezas, bens preciosos ou aquilo que o coração valoriza supremamente (Mt 6.21; Lc 12.34).
THAYER.en: Designates a secure place to keep valuables (such as a chest or storehouse) or the accumulated treasure itself. In the New Testament, it is frequently employed in parables and teachings about eternal spiritual values. 1. A container, chest, or compartment used to store valuables (Mt 2.11; 13.52). | 2. Riches, precious goods, or that which the heart supremely values (Mt 6.21; Lk 12.34).

DEFINITION: To come into physical contact with something or someone, sometimes with implications of ritual purity or hostility.
SENSES: 1. To touch physically something (Heb 12.20; Col 2.21).

THAYER.pt: Entrar em contato físico com algo ou alguém, por vezes com implicações de pureza ritual ou hostilidade. 1. Tocar fisicamente em algo (Hb 12.20; Cl 2.21).
THAYER.en: To come into physical contact with something or someone, sometimes with implications of ritual purity or hostility. 1. To touch physically something (Heb 12.20; Col 2.21).

DEFINITION: Means to exert direct physical pressure, to narrow a space, or, figuratively, to cause great affliction and tribulation.
SENSES: 1. To press or crowd physically due to an accumulation of people (Mk 3.9).
2. To make narrow or constrict (Mt 7.14).
3. To afflict, persecute, or cause great tribulation (2Th 1.6).

THAYER.pt: Significa exercer pressão física direta, estreitar um espaço ou, figuradamente, causar grande aflição e tribulação. 1. Apertar ou comprimir fisicamente pelo acúmulo de pessoas (Mc 3.9). | 2. Estreitar ou tornar constrito (Mt 7.14). | 3. Afligir, perseguir ou causar grande tribulação (2Ts 1.6).
THAYER.en: Means to exert direct physical pressure, to narrow a space, or, figuratively, to cause great affliction and tribulation. 1. To press or crowd physically due to an accumulation of people (Mk 3.9). | 2. To make narrow or constrict (Mt 7.14). | 3. To afflict, persecute, or cause great tribulation (2Th 1.6).

DEFINITION: Originally alludes to crushing physical pressure. Metaphorically, it denotes severe inner anguish or the sufferings, persecutions, and adversities imposed upon the community of faith.
SENSES: 1. Pressure arising from adverse circumstances, persecution, and external oppression (Mt 13.21; Ac 11.19; 14.22).
2. Deep anguish, internal suffering, and emotional pain in the heart (2Co 2.4; Php 1.17).
3. Eschatological tribulation reserved for the final times before the fulfillment of the divine plan (Mt 24.21; Rev 7.14).

THAYER.pt: Originalmente alude a uma pressão esmagadora física. Metaforicamente, denota a severa angústia interior ou os sofrimentos, perseguições e adversidades impostos sobre a comunidade de fé. 1. Pressão decorrente de circunstâncias adversas, perseguição e opressão externa (Mt 13.21; At 11.19; 14.22). | 2. Angústia profunda, sofrimento interno e dor emocional no coração (2Co 2.4; Fp 1.17). | 3. Tribulação escatológica reservada aos tempos finais antes do desfecho do plano divino (Mt 24.21; Ap 7.14).
THAYER.en: Originally alludes to crushing physical pressure. Metaphorically, it denotes severe inner anguish or the sufferings, persecutions, and adversities imposed upon the community of faith. 1. Pressure arising from adverse circumstances, persecution, and external oppression (Mt 13.21; Ac 11.19; 14.22). | 2. Deep anguish, internal suffering, and emotional pain in the heart (2Co 2.4; Php 1.17). | 3. Eschatological tribulation reserved for the final times before the fulfillment of the divine plan (Mt 24.21; Rev 7.14).

DEFINITION: The act of ceasing physical life or, in a metaphorical sense, losing spiritual communion and vital relationship with God.
SENSES: 1. To pass from physical life to death, to die (Mt 2.20; Ac 14.19).
2. Figuratively, to be spiritually dead (1Tm 5.6).

THAYER.pt: O ato de cessar a vida física ou, em sentido metafórico, perder a comunhão espiritual e o relacionamento vital com Deus. 1. Passar da vida física para a morte, morrer (Mt 2.20; At 14.19). | 2. Figuramente, estar espiritualmente morto (1Tm 5.6).
THAYER.en: The act of ceasing physical life or, in a metaphorical sense, losing spiritual communion and vital relationship with God. 1. To pass from physical life to death, to die (Mt 2.20; Ac 14.19). | 2. Figuratively, to be spiritually dead (1Tm 5.6).

DEFINITION: Subject to physical death, characteristic of the passing human condition.
SENSES: 1. The body or the human condition subject to physical mortality (Ro 6.12; 2Co 4.11).

THAYER.pt: Que está sujeito à morte física, característico da condição humana passageira. 1. O corpo ou a condição humana sujeita à mortalidade física (Rm 6.12; 2Co 4.11).
THAYER.en: Subject to physical death, characteristic of the passing human condition. 1. The body or the human condition subject to physical mortality (Ro 6.12; 2Co 4.11).

DEFINITION: To create tumult, disorder, uproar, or emotional disturbance in a crowd or individual.
SENSES: 1. To provoke a tumult, riot, or public commotion (Ac 17.5).
2. To cause emotional disturbance, excessive weeping, or agitation (Mt 9.23; Ac 20.10).

THAYER.pt: Criar tumulto, desordem, alvoroço ou perturbação emocional em uma multidão ou indivíduo. 1. Provocar tumulto, motim ou alvoroço público (At 17.5). | 2. Causar perturbação emocional, choro excessivo ou agitação (Mt 9.23; At 20.10).
THAYER.en: To create tumult, disorder, uproar, or emotional disturbance in a crowd or individual. 1. To provoke a tumult, riot, or public commotion (Ac 17.5). | 2. To cause emotional disturbance, excessive weeping, or agitation (Mt 9.23; Ac 20.10).

DEFINITION: Describes confused noise, social agitation, disturbance, or tumult caused by excited crowds.
SENSES: 1. Noisy and confused clamor (Ac 21.34).
2. Tumult, rebellion, or public commotion (Mk 5.38; Ac 20.1).

THAYER.pt: Descreve barulho confuso, agitação social, distúrbio ou tumulto causado por multidões exaltadas. 1. Clamor barulhento e confuso (At 21.34). | 2. Tumulto, rebelião ou comoção pública (Mc 5.38; At 20.1).
THAYER.en: Describes confused noise, social agitation, disturbance, or tumult caused by excited crowds. 1. Noisy and confused clamor (Ac 21.34). | 2. Tumult, rebellion, or public commotion (Mk 5.38; Ac 20.1).

DEFINITION: Means to break into pieces or cause severe damage resulting in weakening and oppression.
SENSES: 1. To break or shatter a physical object (Mk 14.3).
2. To oppress, debilitate, or severely injure (Lk 4.18).

THAYER.pt: Significa quebrar em pedaços ou causar danos severos que resultam em enfraquecimento e opressão. 1. Quebrar ou despedaçar um objeto físico (Mc 14.3). | 2. Oprimir, debilitar ou ferir severamente (Lc 4.18).
THAYER.en: Means to break into pieces or cause severe damage resulting in weakening and oppression. 1. To break or shatter a physical object (Mk 14.3). | 2. To oppress, debilitate, or severely injure (Lk 4.18).

DEFINITION: Designates domesticated animals raised for sustenance, especially smaller livestock like sheep and goats.
SENSES: 1. Farm animals, cattle, or domestic flock (Jn 4.12).

THAYER.pt: Designa animais domesticados criados para o sustento, especialmente o ganado menor como ovelhas e cabras. 1. Animais de criação, gado ou rebanho doméstico (Jo 4.12).
THAYER.en: Designates domesticated animals raised for sustenance, especially smaller livestock like sheep and goats. 1. Farm animals, cattle, or domestic flock (Jn 4.12).

DEFINITION: To express deep pain and sorrow through groaning, ritualistic weeping, or funeral chants.
SENSES: 1. To mourn or lament the loss of someone (Jn 16.20).
2. To sing funeral lamentations in rituals (Mt 11.17; Lk 23.27).

THAYER.pt: Expressar dor profunda e pesar através de gemidos, choro ritualístico ou cânticos fúnebres. 1. Prantear ou lamentar a perda de alguém (Jo 16.20). | 2. Cantar lamentações fúnebres em rituais (Mt 11.17; Lc 23.27).
THAYER.en: To express deep pain and sorrow through groaning, ritualistic weeping, or funeral chants. 1. To mourn or lament the loss of someone (Jn 16.20). | 2. To sing funeral lamentations in rituals (Mt 11.17; Lk 23.27).

DEFINITION: A noun designating a song or vocal expression of deep pain, mourning, or lamentation, especially for the dead.
SENSES: 1. Funeral wailing or song of lamentation over death (Mt 2.18).

THAYER.pt: Substantivo que designa uma canção ou expressão vocal de profunda dor, luto ou lamentação, especialmente por mortos. 1. Pranto fúnebre ou canto de lamentação pela morte (Mt 2.18).
THAYER.en: A noun designating a song or vocal expression of deep pain, mourning, or lamentation, especially for the dead. 1. Funeral wailing or song of lamentation over death (Mt 2.18).

DEFINITION: External expression of devotion to deities, manifested through sacred rites, worship, and religious practices.
SENSES: 1. Practice of worship and religious devotion (Col 2.18; Ac 26.5).

THAYER.pt: Expressão externa de devoção a divindades, manifestada por meio de ritos sagrados, cultos e práticas religiosas. 1. Prática de culto e devoção religiosa (Cl 2.18; At 26.5).
THAYER.en: External expression of devotion to deities, manifested through sacred rites, worship, and religious practices. 1. Practice of worship and religious devotion (Col 2.18; Ac 26.5).

DEFINITION: Qualifies a person who demonstrates zeal and careful observance of religious duties and rituals.
SENSES: 1. Devout or careful in the practices of one's religion (Jas 1.26).

THAYER.pt: Qualifica a pessoa que demonstra zelo e observância cuidadosa dos deveres e rituais religiosos. 1. Devoto ou cuidadoso nas práticas da sua religião (Tg 1.26).
THAYER.en: Qualifies a person who demonstrates zeal and careful observance of religious duties and rituals. 1. Devout or careful in the practices of one's religion (Jas 1.26).

DEFINITION: Derived from the Roman custom of the triumphal parade, it denotes publicly displaying the victor and the vanquished.
SENSES: 1. To lead in a triumphal procession as a victor (2Co 2.14).
2. To cause complete triumph over opposing forces (Col 2.15).

THAYER.pt: Derivado do costume romano do desfile triunfal, denota exibir publicamente o vitorioso e seus vencidos. 1. Conduzir em cortejo triunfal como vencedor (2Co 2.14). | 2. Causar o triunfo completo sobre forças opositoras (Cl 2.15).
THAYER.en: Derived from the Roman custom of the triumphal parade, it denotes publicly displaying the victor and the vanquished. 1. To lead in a triumphal procession as a victor (2Co 2.14). | 2. To cause complete triumph over opposing forces (Col 2.15).

DEFINITION: A single strand or set of strands of human hair or animal fur.
SENSES: 1. Animal hair (Mt 3.4); 2. Human hair (Mt 5.36; 10.30).

THAYER.pt: Fio ou conjunto de fios de cabelo humano ou de pêlos de animais. 1. Pêlos de animais (Mt 3.4); 2. Cabelo humano (Mt 5.36; 10.30).
THAYER.en: A single strand or set of strands of human hair or animal fur. 1. Animal hair (Mt 3.4); 2. Human hair (Mt 5.36; 10.30).

DEFINITION: To agitate inwardly, disturb emotionally, or cause panic in the face of news or events.
SENSES: 1. To be deeply troubled or frightened (Mt 24.6).

THAYER.pt: Agitar internamente, perturbar emocionalmente ou causar pânico diante de notícias ou eventos. 1. Ficar profundamente perturbado ou amedrontado (Mt 24.6).
THAYER.en: To agitate inwardly, disturb emotionally, or cause panic in the face of news or events. 1. To be deeply troubled or frightened (Mt 24.6).

DEFINITION: Refers to a small portion of thickened or coagulated body fluid, specifically drops of blood.
SENSES: 1. A clot or large drop of blood (Lk 22.44).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se a uma pequena porção de fluido corporal espessado ou coagulado, especificamente gotas de sangue. 1. Um coágulo ou grande gota de sangue (Lc 22.44).
THAYER.en: Refers to a small portion of thickened or coagulated body fluid, specifically drops of blood. 1. A clot or large drop of blood (Lk 22.44).

DEFINITION: Refers to an elaborate and elevated seat reserved for kings, rulers, or deities, symbolizing supreme power, sovereignty, and royal jurisdiction.
SENSES: 1. An elevated and ornamented seat of a monarch or ruler, the throne (Rev 1.4).
2. Sovereign power, dominion, or governing authority (Col 1.16).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se a um assento elaborado e elevado reservado para reis, governantes ou divindades, simbolizando poder supremo, soberania e jurisdição real. 1. Um assento elevado e ornamentado de um monarca ou governante, o trono (Ap 1.4). | 2. Poder soberano, domínio ou autoridade de governo (Cl 1.16).
THAYER.en: Refers to an elaborate and elevated seat reserved for kings, rulers, or deities, symbolizing supreme power, sovereignty, and royal jurisdiction. 1. An elevated and ornamented seat of a monarch or ruler, the throne (Rev 1.4). | 2. Sovereign power, dominion, or governing authority (Col 1.16).

DEFINITION: Ancient city located in the Roman province of Lydia in Asia Minor, known for its commerce.
SENSES: 1. The city of Thyatira (Ac 16.14).

THAYER.pt: Antiga cidade localizada na província romana da Lídia, na Ásia Menor, conhecida por seu comércio. 1. A cidade de Tiatira (At 16.14).
THAYER.en: Ancient city located in the Roman province of Lydia in Asia Minor, known for its commerce. 1. The city of Thyatira (Ac 16.14).

DEFINITION: Daughter in relation to parents, or a term used in a figurative sense to designate women belonging to a group or community.
SENSES: 1. Daughter in a biological sense (Mt 10.35).
2. Affectionate term of address or spiritual relationship (Mt 9.22).
3. Women members of a community or nation (Lk 1.5; 23.28).

THAYER.pt: Filha em relação aos pais, ou termo usado em sentido figurado para designar mulheres pertencentes a um grupo ou comunidade. 1. Filha em sentido biológico (Mt 10:35). | 2. Termo afetuoso de tratamento ou relação espiritual (Mt 9:22). | 3. Mulheres integrantes de uma comunidade ou nação (Lc 1:5; 23:28).
THAYER.en: Daughter in relation to parents, or a term used in a figurative sense to designate women belonging to a group or community. 1. Daughter in a biological sense (Mt 10.35). | 2. Affectionate term of address or spiritual relationship (Mt 9.22). | 3. Women members of a community or nation (Lk 1.5; 23.28).

DEFINITION: Diminutive of θυγάτηρ, used to affectionately designate a young daughter, with a strong tone of affection.
SENSES: 1. Small or young daughter (Mk 5.23);
2. Girl treated with affection and fondness (Mk 7.25).

THAYER.pt: Diminutivo de θυγάτηr, usado para designar carinhosamente uma filha pequena, com forte tom de afeição. 1. Filha pequena ou jovem (Mc 5.23); | 2. Menina tratada com afeto e carinho (Mc 7.25).
THAYER.en: Diminutive of θυγάτηρ, used to affectionately designate a young daughter, with a strong tone of affection. 1. Small or young daughter (Mk 5.23); | 2. Girl treated with affection and fondness (Mk 7.25).

DEFINITION: Atmospheric disturbance characterized by violent gusts of wind, storms, or whirlwinds.
SENSES: 1. A violent storm or impetuous gale (Heb 12.18).

THAYER.pt: Perturbação atmosférica caracterizada por rajadas de vento violentas, tempestades ou redemoinhos. 1. Uma tempestade violenta ou vendaval impetuoso (Hb 12.18).
THAYER.en: Atmospheric disturbance characterized by violent gusts of wind, storms, or whirlwinds. 1. A violent storm or impetuous gale (Heb 12.18).

DEFINITION: Relating to the wood of the cypress or thyine tree (citrus wood), which is very precious and aromatic.
SENSES: 1. Made of perfumed cedar or cypress wood (Rev 18.12).

THAYER.pt: Relativo à madeira da árvore de cipreste ou tília (cedro-do-líbano/arariba), muito preciosa e aromática. 1. Feito de madeira de cedro ou cipreste perfumado (Ap 18.12).
THAYER.en: Relating to the wood of the cypress or thyine tree (citrus wood), which is very precious and aromatic. 1. Made of perfumed cedar or cypress wood (Rev 18.12).

DEFINITION: Aromatic resinous substance burned in sacred rituals to produce fragrant smoke, symbolizing the prayers of the saints.
SENSES: 1. Aromatic substance or the act of burning it in worship (Lk 1.10; Rev 5.8).

THAYER.pt: Substância aromática resinosas queimada em rituais sagrados para produzir fumaça perfumada, simbolizando as orações dos santos. 1. Substância aromática ou o ato de queimá-la no culto (Lc 1.10; Ap 5.8).
THAYER.en: Aromatic resinous substance burned in sacred rituals to produce fragrant smoke, symbolizing the prayers of the saints. 1. Aromatic substance or the act of burning it in worship (Lk 1.10; Rev 5.8).

DEFINITION: Designates a container or object used to burn incense, which may refer specifically to the altar of incense in the context of the tabernacle or temple.
SENSES: 1. Object or altar intended for burning incense before God (Heb 9.4).

THAYER.pt: Designa um recipiente ou objeto utilizado para queimar incenso, podendo referir-se especificamente ao altar de incenso no contexto do tabernáculo ou templo. 1. Objeto ou altar destinado à queima de incenso perante Deus (Hb 9.4).
THAYER.en: Designates a container or object used to burn incense, which may refer specifically to the altar of incense in the context of the tabernacle or temple. 1. Object or altar intended for burning incense before God (Heb 9.4).

DEFINITION: The act of burning aromatic substances as a cultic and sacred offering directed to God.
SENSES: 1. To perform the offering of incense in the sanctuary (Lk 1.9).

THAYER.pt: O ato de queimar substâncias aromáticas como oferta cultual e sagrada dirigida a Deus. 1. Realizar a oferta de incenso no santuário (Lc 1.9).
THAYER.en: The act of burning aromatic substances as a cultic and sacred offering directed to God. 1. To perform the offering of incense in the sanctuary (Lk 1.9).

DEFINITION: To manifest deep indignation and extreme anger, often accompanied by hostility or contention against someone.
SENSES: 1. To be violently angered or enter into furious conflict against someone (Acts 12:20).

THAYER.pt: Manifestar profunda indignação e raiva extrema, muitas vezes acompanhada de hostilidade ou contenda contra alguém. 1. Irritar-se violentamente ou entrar em conflito furioso contra alguém (At 12.20).
THAYER.en: To manifest deep indignation and extreme anger, often accompanied by hostility or contention against someone. 1. To be violently angered or enter into furious conflict against someone (Acts 12:20).

DEFINITION: Describes a state of strong emotional agitation, ranging from intense passions to sudden outbursts of wrath or fury. In the NT, it often denotes burning anger and divine judgment against sin.
SENSES: 1. Intense passion or overwhelming desire (Rev 14:8).
2. Violent wrath, fury, indignation, or an outburst of anger (Luke 4:28; Rev 14:10).

THAYER.pt: Descreve um estado de forte agitação emocional, abrangendo desde paixões intensas até explosões repentinas de ira ou furor. No NT, muitas vezes denota a ira ardente e o juízo divino contra o pecado. 1. Paixão intensa ou desejo avassalador (Ap 14.8). | 2. Ira violenta, furor, indignação ou explosão de raiva (Lc 4.28; Ap 14.10).
THAYER.en: Describes a state of strong emotional agitation, ranging from intense passions to sudden outbursts of wrath or fury. In the NT, it often denotes burning anger and divine judgment against sin. 1. Intense passion or overwhelming desire (Rev 14:8). | 2. Violent wrath, fury, indignation, or an outburst of anger (Luke 4:28; Rev 14:10).

DEFINITION: To cause anger or, in the passive voice, to be taken over by a strong feeling of indignation and wrath.
SENSES: 1. To become deeply angered or enraged (Matt 2:16).

THAYER.pt: Causar ira ou, na voz passiva, ser tomado por forte sentimento de indignação e cólera. 1. Ficar profundamente irado ou encolerizado (Mt 2.16).
THAYER.en: To cause anger or, in the passive voice, to be taken over by a strong feeling of indignation and wrath. 1. To become deeply angered or enraged (Matt 2:16).

DEFINITION: An opening or movable structure that serves to close and open the entrance of a dwelling, enclosure, or walled compound.
SENSES: 1. Door of a house or habitable room (Luke 13:25; Acts 5:19).
2. Entrance, portal, or gate of a structure (Matt 27:60).

THAYER.pt: Abertura ou estrutura móvel que serve para fechar e abrir a entrada de uma habitação, recinto ou recinto murado. 1. Porta de uma casa ou aposento habitável (Lc 13.25; At 5.19). | 2. Entrada, portal ou portão de uma estrutura (Mt 27.60).
THAYER.en: An opening or movable structure that serves to close and open the entrance of a dwelling, enclosure, or walled compound. 1. Door of a house or habitable room (Luke 13:25; Acts 5:19). | 2. Entrance, portal, or gate of a structure (Matt 27:60).

DEFINITION: Refers to a large shield, usually oblong or rectangular in shape, used for full body protection in spiritual or physical warfare.
SENSES: 1. Large protective shield used in the believer's spiritual armor (Eph 6:16).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se a um escudo grande, geralmente de formato oblongo ou retangular, usado como proteção corporal completa na guerra espiritual ou física. 1. Grande escudo protetor usado na armadura espiritual do crente (Ef 6.16).
THAYER.en: Refers to a large shield, usually oblong or rectangular in shape, used for full body protection in spiritual or physical warfare. 1. Large protective shield used in the believer's spiritual armor (Eph 6:16).

DEFINITION: An opening in a wall intended to allow the entry of light and air, or used to observe the outside.
SENSES: 1. Window of a building through which someone can look or fall (Acts 20:9);
2. Opening in a fortified wall (2 Cor 11:33).

THAYER.pt: Abertura em uma parede destinada a permitir a entrada de luz e ar, ou usada para observar o exterior. 1. Janela de um edifício por onde alguém pode olhar ou cair (At 20.9); | 2. Abertura em muralha fortificada (2Co 11.33).
THAYER.en: An opening in a wall intended to allow the entry of light and air, or used to observe the outside. 1. Window of a building through which someone can look or fall (Acts 20:9); | 2. Opening in a fortified wall (2 Cor 11:33).

DEFINITION: Person in charge of watching and controlling the entry of a door, gate, or residence.
SENSES: 1. Guardian of the door or doorkeeper of a house (Mark 13:34; John 10:3; 18:16).

THAYER.pt: Pessoa encarregada de vigiar e controlar a entrada de uma porta, portão ou residência. 1. Guardião da porta ou porteiro de uma casa (Mc 13.34; Jo 10.3; 18.16).
THAYER.en: Person in charge of watching and controlling the entry of a door, gate, or residence. 1. Guardian of the door or doorkeeper of a house (Mark 13:34; John 10:3; 18:16).

DEFINITION: The act of offering something to God or an object of worship, or the thing offered itself, whether in a ritual or figurative context.
SENSES: 1. Sacrificial offering presented to God on the altar (Matt 9:13).
2. Figurative sense of spiritual surrender and obedience to God (Rom 12:1; Phil 2:17).

THAYER.pt: O ato de oferecer algo a Deus ou a objeto de adoração, ou a própria coisa ofertada, seja em contexto ritual ou figurado. 1. Oferta sacrificial apresentada a Deus no altar (Mt 9:13). | 2. Sentido figurado de entrega espiritual e obediência a Deus (Rm 12:1; Fp 2:17).
THAYER.en: The act of offering something to God or an object of worship, or the thing offered itself, whether in a ritual or figurative context. 1. Sacrificial offering presented to God on the altar (Matt 9:13). | 2. Figurative sense of spiritual surrender and obedience to God (Rom 12:1; Phil 2:17).

DEFINITION: Physical structure erected for the presentation of sacrifices and religious offerings to a divinity. In the biblical context, it refers to the altars of the Jewish temple.
SENSES: 1. The altar of burnt offering or incense in the sanctuary (Matt 5:23; Luke 1:11).

THAYER.pt: Estrutura física erigida para a apresentação de sacrifícios e ofertas religiosas a uma divindade. No contexto bíblico, refere-se aos altares do templo judaico. 1. O altar de holocaustos ou de incenso no santuário (Mt 5.23; Lc 1.11).
THAYER.en: Physical structure erected for the presentation of sacrifices and religious offerings to a divinity. In the biblical context, it refers to the altars of the Jewish temple. 1. The altar of burnt offering or incense in the sanctuary (Matt 5:23; Luke 1:11).

DEFINITION: The act of performing a cultic sacrifice, immolating animals, or, in a general sense, slaughtering and killing for consumption or ritual.
SENSES: 1. To offer a ritual or religious sacrifice (Acts 14:13; 1 Cor 10:20).
2. To slaughter or kill animals for meat or festivities (Matt 22:4; Luke 15:23).

THAYER.pt: Ato de realizar um sacrifício cultual, imolando animais, ou, em sentido geral, abater e matar para consumo ou ritual. 1. Oferecer um sacrifício ritual ou religioso (At 14.13; 1Co 10.20). | 2. Abater ou matar animais para abate ou festividades (Mt 22.4; Lc 15.23).
THAYER.en: The act of performing a cultic sacrifice, immolating animals, or, in a general sense, slaughtering and killing for consumption or ritual. 1. To offer a ritual or religious sacrifice (Acts 14:13; 1 Cor 10:20). | 2. To slaughter or kill animals for meat or festivities (Matt 22:4; Luke 15:23).

DEFINITION: Aramaic proper name meaning 'twin', designating one of the twelve apostles of Jesus.
SENSES: 1. The apostle Thomas, also called Didymus, known for his initial doubt in the resurrection (Matt 10:3; John 20:24).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio aramaico que significa 'gêmeo', designando um dos doze apóstolos de Jesus. 1. O apóstolo Tomé, também chamado Dídimo, conhecido por sua dúvida inicial na ressurreição (Mt 10:3; Jo 20:24).
THAYER.en: Aramaic proper name meaning 'twin', designating one of the twelve apostles of Jesus. 1. The apostle Thomas, also called Didymus, known for his initial doubt in the resurrection (Matt 10:3; John 20:24).

DEFINITION: Primarily designates the breastplate or chest armor worn for protection in combat, also used figuratively for the upper portion of the human trunk.
SENSES: 1. Piece of rigid armor protecting the chest and torso in combat (Eph 6:14; 1 Thess 5:8; Rev 9:9).
2. The part of the human body corresponding to the chest or thorax (Rev 9:9).

THAYER.pt: Designa primariamente a couraça ou peito de armadura usada para proteção em combate, sendo também empregado figuradamente para a porção superior do tronco humano. 1. Peça de armadura rígida que protege o peito e o tronco em combate (Ef 6.14; 1Ts 5.8; Ap 9.9). | 2. A parte do corpo humana correspondente ao peito ou tórax (Ap 9.9).
THAYER.en: Primarily designates the breastplate or chest armor worn for protection in combat, also used figuratively for the upper portion of the human trunk. 1. Piece of rigid armor protecting the chest and torso in combat (Eph 6:14; 1 Thess 5:8; Rev 9:9). | 2. The part of the human body corresponding to the chest or thorax (Rev 9:9).

DEFINITION: Jairus, a synagogue official in Galilee whose daughter was raised from the dead by Jesus.
SENSES: 1. Name of a Jewish religious authority (Mark 5:22).

THAYER.pt: Jairo, um chefe de sinagoga na Galileia cuja filha foi ressuscitada por Jesus. 1. Nome de uma autoridade religiosa judaica (Mc 5.22).
THAYER.en: Jairus, a synagogue official in Galilee whose daughter was raised from the dead by Jesus. 1. Name of a Jewish religious authority (Mark 5:22).

DEFINITION: Masculine proper name referring to the Israelite patriarch son of Isaac, or other ancestors in the lineage of Jesus.
SENSES: 1. The patriarch Jacob, son of Isaac and grandson of Abraham (Matt 1:2; John 4:5).
2. The father of Joseph in the genealogy of Jesus according to the Gospel of Matthew (Matt 1:15).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio masculino referente ao patriarca israelita filho de Isaque, ou a outros antepassados na linhagem de Jesus. 1. O patriarca Jacó, filho de Isaque e neto de Abraão (Mt 1.2; Jo 4.5). | 2. O pai de José na genealogia de Jesus segundo o Evangelho de Mateus (Mt 1.15).
THAYER.en: Masculine proper name referring to the Israelite patriarch son of Isaac, or other ancestors in the lineage of Jesus. 1. The patriarch Jacob, son of Isaac and grandson of Abraham (Matt 1:2; John 4:5). | 2. The father of Joseph in the genealogy of Jesus according to the Gospel of Matthew (Matt 1:15).

DEFINITION: Common masculine proper name in the New Testament, attributed to several prominent figures in the early church.
SENSES: 1. James, son of Zebedee and brother of the apostle John (Matt 4:21).
2. James, the Lord's brother and leader of the Jerusalem community (Gal 1:19).
3. James, son of Alphaeus, one of the twelve apostles (Matt 10:3).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio masculino comum no Novo Testamento, atribuído a vários personagens de destaque na igreja primitiva. 1. Tiago, filho de Zebedeu e irmão do apóstolo João (Mt 4.21). | 2. Tiago, o irmão do Senhor e líder da comunidade de Jerusalém (Gl 1.19). | 3. Tiago, filho de Alfeu, um dos doze apóstolos (Mt 10.3).
THAYER.en: Common masculine proper name in the New Testament, attributed to several prominent figures in the early church. 1. James, son of Zebedee and brother of the apostle John (Matt 4:21). | 2. James, the Lord's brother and leader of the Jerusalem community (Gal 1:19). | 3. James, son of Alphaeus, one of the twelve apostles (Matt 10:3).

DEFINITION: The gift or practical result of a restoration of physical or spiritual health.
SENSES: 1. Spiritual gifts of healing granted to the community (1 Cor 12:9).

THAYER.pt: O dom ou o resultado prático de uma restauração da saúde física ou espiritual. 1. Dons espirituais de cura concedidos à comunidade (1Co 12.9).
THAYER.en: The gift or practical result of a restoration of physical or spiritual health. 1. Spiritual gifts of healing granted to the community (1 Cor 12:9).

DEFINITION: Name of one of the Egyptian sorcerers of Jewish tradition who resisted Moses before Pharaoh.
SENSES: 1. Name of an Egyptian magician who opposed Moses (2 Tim 3:8).

THAYER.pt: Nome de um dos feiticeiros egípcios da tradição judaica que resistiram a Moisés perante o Faraó. 1. Nome de um mago egípcio opositor de Moisés (2Tm 3.8).
THAYER.en: Name of one of the Egyptian sorcerers of Jewish tradition who resisted Moses before Pharaoh. 1. Name of an Egyptian magician who opposed Moses (2 Tim 3:8).

DEFINITION: Male ancestor in the genealogy of Jesus Christ recorded in the New Testament.
SENSES: 1. Name of an ancestor in the messianic line (Luke 3:24).

THAYER.pt: Antepassado masculino na genealogia de Jesus Cristo registrada no Novo Testamento. 1. Nome de um ancestral na linha messiana (Lc 3.24).
THAYER.en: Male ancestor in the genealogy of Jesus Christ recorded in the New Testament. 1. Name of an ancestor in the messianic line (Luke 3:24).

DEFINITION: Name of one of the Egyptian sorcerers associated with the opposition against Moses in ancient Egypt.
SENSES: 1. Name of an Egyptian magician who resisted Moses (2 Tim 3:8).

THAYER.pt: Nome de um dos feiticeiros egípcios associados à oposição contra Moisés no Egito antigo. 1. Nome de um mago egípcio que resistiu a Moisés (2Tm 3.8).
THAYER.en: Name of one of the Egyptian sorcerers associated with the opposition against Moses in ancient Egypt. 1. Name of an Egyptian magician who resisted Moses (2 Tim 3:8).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Middle deponent, Fut: ἰάσομαι, Aor: ἰασάμην
DEFINITION: To restore someone to full physical integrity or to cure bodily illnesses and spiritual ailments.
SENSES: 1. To restore someone's health after a physical illness (Luke 5:17).
2. To spiritually heal or deliver from degrading conditions (Matt 13:15).

THAYER.pt: Restaurar alguém à integridade física plena ou curar de enfermidades corporais e mazelas espirituais. 1. Restaurar a saúde de alguém após uma enfermidade física (Lc 5.17). | 2. Curar ou libertar espiritualmente de condições degradantes (Mt 13.15).
THAYER.en: To restore someone to full physical integrity or to cure bodily illnesses and spiritual ailments. 1. To restore someone's health after a physical illness (Luke 5:17). | 2. To spiritually heal or deliver from degrading conditions (Matt 13:15).

DEFINITION: Patriarchal ancestor in the line of descent from Adam to Noah.
SENSES: 1. Patriarch descended from Seth and ancestor of Enoch (Luke 3:37).

THAYER.pt: Antepassado patriarcal na linhagem de descendência de Adão até Noé. 1. Patriarca descendente de Sete e ancestral de Enoque (Lc 3.37).
THAYER.en: Patriarchal ancestor in the line of descent from Adam to Noah. 1. Patriarch descended from Seth and ancestor of Enoch (Luke 3:37).

DEFINITION: The process or act of restoring the health of someone who was ill.
SENSES: 1. Restoration to physical health or cure of illnesses (Acts 4:22, 30).

THAYER.pt: O processo ou o ato de restaurar a saúde de alguém que se encontrava enferma. 1. Restauração à saúde física ou cura de enfermidades (At 4.22, 30).
THAYER.en: The process or act of restoring the health of someone who was ill. 1. Restoration to physical health or cure of illnesses (Acts 4:22, 30).

DEFINITION: Precious stone of high value, found in various colors, notably translucent, reddish, or greenish shades.
SENSES: 1. The precious stone jasper in the heavenly vision (Rev 21:11).

THAYER.pt: Pedra preciosa de alto valor, encontrada em várias colorações, com destaque para tons translúcidos, avermelhados ou esverdeados. 1. A pedra preciosa jaspe na visão celestial (Ap 21.11).
THAYER.en: Precious stone of high value, found in various colors, notably translucent, reddish, or greenish shades. 1. The precious stone jasper in the heavenly vision (Rev 21:11).

DEFINITION: Greek proper name identifying an early Christian, notably the host of Paul and Silas in Thessalonica.
SENSES: 1. Jason of Thessalonica, who hosted the apostle Paul and faced persecution for the faith (Acts 17:5-9).
2. A Christian who sends greetings to the Romans along with Paul (Rom 16:21).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio grego que identifica um cristão primitivo, notadamente o hospedeiro de Paulo e Silas em Tessalônica. 1. Jasom de Tessalônica, que hospedou o apóstolo Paulo e enfrentou perseguição por causa da fé (At 17.5-9). | 2. Um cristão que envia saudações aos Romanos juntamente com Paulo (Rm 16.21).
THAYER.en: Greek proper name identifying an early Christian, notably the host of Paul and Silas in Thessalonica. 1. Jason of Thessalonica, who hosted the apostle Paul and faced persecution for the faith (Acts 17:5-9). | 2. A Christian who sends greetings to the Romans along with Paul (Rom 16:21).

DEFINITION: Professional dedicated to the treatment and cure of physical illnesses, also used metaphorically for Christ's healing ministry.
SENSES: 1. Physician or healer of physical illnesses (Matt 9:12; Luke 4:23).

THAYER.pt: Profissional dedicado ao tratamento e cura de enfermidades físicas, usado também metaforicamente para o ministério curador de Cristo. 1. Médico ou curador de enfermidades físicas (Mt 9.12; Lc 4.23).
THAYER.en: Professional dedicated to the treatment and cure of physical illnesses, also used metaphorically for Christ's healing ministry. 1. Physician or healer of physical illnesses (Matt 9:12; Luke 4:23).

DEFINITION: Demonstrative particle used to draw the listener's attention to something important, unusual, or to indicate someone's presence.
SENSES: 1. To point out something to which the speaker wishes to draw attention (Matt 25:20).
2. To introduce an unexpected or notable element into the narrative (John 3:26).
3. To indicate the presence or location of a person or object (Mark 16:6).

THAYER.pt: Partícula demonstrativa usada para chamar a atenção do ouvinte para algo importante, inusitado ou para indicar a presença de alguém. 1. Apontar algo para o qual o falante deseja chamar atenção (Mt 25.20). | 2. Introduzir um elemento inesperado ou notável na narrativa (Jo 3.26). | 3. Indicar a presença ou localização de uma pessoa ou objeto (Mc 16.6).
THAYER.en: Demonstrative particle used to draw the listener's attention to something important, unusual, or to indicate someone's presence. 1. To point out something to which the speaker wishes to draw attention (Matt 25:20). | 2. To introduce an unexpected or notable element into the narrative (John 3:26). | 3. To indicate the presence or location of a person or object (Mark 16:6).

DEFINITION: External appearance, physical feature, or the perceptible visual aspect of someone or something.
SENSES: 1. The exterior aspect or visual appearance of a person or being (Matt 28:3).

THAYER.pt: A aparência externa, feição física ou o aspecto visual perceptível de alguém ou algo. 1. O aspecto exterior ou a aparência visual de uma pessoa ou ser (Mt 28.3).
THAYER.en: External appearance, physical feature, or the perceptible visual aspect of someone or something. 1. The exterior aspect or visual appearance of a person or being (Matt 28:3).

DEFINITION: Relating to that which belongs in an exclusive, reserved, or personal way to someone, in clear opposition to what is public or collective.
SENSES: 1. Personal or distinctive belonging: own, due, private (Matt 25:14; John 1:41; Acts 1:25).
2. In the neuter plural as a noun: one's own goods, one's home, one's own property (John 1:11; 19:27).
3. In the adverbial expression κατ’ ἰδίαν: privately, in private, apart (Matt 14:13; Mark 9:2).

THAYER.pt: Relativo àquilo que pertence de maneira exclusiva, reservada ou pessoal a alguém, em clara oposição ao que é público ou coletivo. 1. Pertença pessoal ou distintiva: próprio, devido, particular (Mt 25.14; Jo 1.41; At 1.25). | 2. No neutro plural como substantivo: os seus bens, a sua casa, a propriedade própria (Jo 1.11; 19.27). | 3. Na expressão adverbial κατ’ ἰδίαν: em particular, em particular, à parte (Mt 14.13; Mc 9.2).
THAYER.en: Relating to that which belongs in an exclusive, reserved, or personal way to someone, in clear opposition to what is public or collective. 1. Personal or distinctive belonging: own, due, private (Matt 25:14; John 1:41; Acts 1:25). | 2. In the neuter plural as a noun: one's own goods, one's home, one's own property (John 1:11; 19:27). | 3. In the adverbial expression κατ’ ἰδίαν: privately, in private, apart (Matt 14:13; Mark 9:2).

DEFINITION: Individual who lacks formal instruction or specialization in a given field of knowledge, being considered a layman or ordinary person in contrast to specialists.
SENSES: 1. A person without formal instruction or specialization in oratory or theology, a layman (Acts 4:13; 2 Cor 11:6).
2. Someone from outside a specific group, who does not understand the internal matters or mysteries of a community (1 Cor 14:23).

THAYER.pt: Indivíduo que carece de instrução formal ou especialização em determinado campo do saber, sendo considerado um leigo ou pessoa comum em contraste com os especialistas. 1. Pessoa sem instrução formal ou especialização em oratória ou teologia, um leigo (At 4.13; 2Co 11.6). | 2. Alguém de fora de um grupo específico, que não compreende os assuntos internos ou mistérios de uma comunidade (1Co 14.23).
THAYER.en: Individual who lacks formal instruction or specialization in a given field of knowledge, being considered a layman or ordinary person in contrast to specialists. 1. A person without formal instruction or specialization in oratory or theology, a layman (Acts 4:13; 2 Cor 11:6). | 2. Someone from outside a specific group, who does not understand the internal matters or mysteries of a community (1 Cor 14:23).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Aorist middle imperative of εἶδον used as particle
DEFINITION: Demonstrative and exclamatory particle of great rhetorical force, originating from a fossilized imperative. It serves to arouse immediate attention in the listener or reader before a dramatic twist or crucial messianic declaration.
SENSES: 1. Empathetic call to attention and reflection: 'look!', 'take heed!' (Matt 1:23; Luke 2:48).
2. Introductory marker of a sudden or unexpected event: 'behold' (Matt 2:1; 28:9).
3. Identifier of solemn presence: 'here is', 'here I am' (Luke 1:38; Acts 9:10).

THAYER.pt: Partícula demonstrativa e exclamativa de grande força retórica, originada de um imperativo fossilizado. Serve para despertar atenção imediata no ouvinte ou leitor perante uma reviravolta dramática ou declaração messiânica crucial. 1. Chamado enfático à atenção e reflexão: 'olhai!', 'reparai!' (Mt 1.23; Lc 2.48). | 2. Marcador introdutório de acontecimento súbito ou inesperado: 'eis que' (Mt 2.1; 28.9). | 3. Identificador de presença solene: 'aqui está', 'eis-me aqui' (Lc 1.38; At 9.10).
THAYER.en: Demonstrative and exclamatory particle of great rhetorical force, originating from a fossilized imperative. It serves to arouse immediate attention in the listener or reader before a dramatic twist or crucial messianic declaration. 1. Empathetic call to attention and reflection: 'look!', 'take heed!' (Matt 1:23; Luke 2:48). | 2. Introductory marker of a sudden or unexpected event: 'behold' (Matt 2:1; 28:9). | 3. Identifier of solemn presence: 'here is', 'here I am' (Luke 1:38; Acts 9:10).

DEFINITION: A mountainous region located south of Judea, historically corresponding to the land of Edom.
SENSES: 1. A geographical region south of Judea from which some people came to hear Jesus (Mk 3:8).

THAYER.pt: Região montanhosa situada ao sul da Judeia, correspondendo historicamente à terra de Edom. 1. Região geográfica ao sul da Judeia de onde vinham algumas pessoas para ouvir a Jesus (Mc 3.8).
THAYER.en: A mountainous region located south of Judea, historically corresponding to the land of Edom. 1. A geographical region south of Judea from which some people came to hear Jesus (Mk 3:8).

DEFINITION: The aqueous fluid excreted by human skin glands, associated with intense physical exertion or extreme anguish.
SENSES: 1. Drops of sweat produced under circumstances of intense agony or exertion (Lk 22:44).

THAYER.pt: O fluido aquoso excretado pelas glândulas da pele humana, associado ao esforço físico intenso ou à angústia extrema. 1. Gotas de suor produzidas em circunstâncias de intensa agonia ou esforço (Lc 22.44).
THAYER.en: The aqueous fluid excreted by human skin glands, associated with intense physical exertion or extreme anguish. 1. Drops of sweat produced under circumstances of intense agony or exertion (Lk 22:44).

DEFINITION: A Phoenician queen consort of Ahab, notorious for promoting idolatry and persecuting the prophets of Yahweh, used metaphorically in Revelation.
SENSES: 1. A female proper name used symbolically to describe a corrupting false prophetess (Rev 2:20).

THAYER.pt: Rainha fenícia consorte de Acabe, notória por promover a idolatria e perseguir os profetas de Javé, usada metaforicamente no Apocalipse. 1. Nome próprio feminino empregado simbolicamente para descrever uma falsa profetisa corruptora (Ap 2.20).
THAYER.en: A Phoenician queen consort of Ahab, notorious for promoting idolatry and persecuting the prophets of Yahweh, used metaphorically in Revelation. 1. A female proper name used symbolically to describe a corrupting false prophetess (Rev 2:20).

DEFINITION: Hierapolis was a city in Phrygia, situated in the Lycus River valley, near Laodicea and Colossae, in Asia Minor.
SENSES: 1. A city in Phrygia mentioned in the context of the Pauline epistles (Col 4:13).

THAYER.pt: Hierápolis era uma cidade da Frígia, situada no vale do rio Lico, próxima a Laodicéia e Colossos, na Ásia Menor. 1. Cidade da Frígia mencionada no contexto das cartas paulinas (Col 4.13).
THAYER.en: Hierapolis was a city in Phrygia, situated in the Lycus River valley, near Laodicea and Colossae, in Asia Minor. 1. A city in Phrygia mentioned in the context of the Pauline epistles (Col 4:13).

DEFINITION: The office, charge, or the exercise of the functions inherent to the priesthood before God.
SENSES: 1. The priestly service and duty in the temple (Lk 1:9);
2. The function or order of the Levitical priesthood (Heb 7:5).

THAYER.pt: O ofício, encargo ou o exercício das funções inerentes ao sacerdócio perante Deus. 1. O serviço e dever sacerdotal no templo (Lc 1.9); | 2. A função ou ordem do sacerdócio levítico (Hb 7.5).
THAYER.en: The office, charge, or the exercise of the functions inherent to the priesthood before God. 1. The priestly service and duty in the temple (Lk 1:9); | 2. The function or order of the Levitical priesthood (Heb 7:5).

DEFINITION: A collective body of priests, referring to the community of the redeemed who offer worship to God.
SENSES: 1. The community of believers as a holy priesthood (1 Pet 2:5, 9).

THAYER.pt: Um corpo coletivo de sacerdotes, referindo-se à comunidade dos remidos que exercem culto a Deus. 1. A comunidade de crentes como sacerdócio santo (1Pe 2.5, 9).
THAYER.en: A collective body of priests, referring to the community of the redeemed who offer worship to God. 1. The community of believers as a holy priesthood (1 Pet 2:5, 9).

SHORT_GLOSS: to officiate as a priest, serve
DEFINITION: To perform the functions, duties, and charges proper to the priesthood before God.
SENSES: 1. To exercise the priestly ministry and fulfill cultic duties (Lk 1:8).
USAGE: to officiate as a priest, serve

THAYER.pt: Desempenhar as funções, deveres e encargos próprios do sacerdócio perante Deus. 1. Exercer o ministério sacerdotal e cumprir os deveres cultuais (Lc 1.8).
THAYER.en: To perform the functions, duties, and charges proper to the priesthood before God. 1. To exercise the priestly ministry and fulfill cultic duties (Lk 1:8).

DEFINITION: One of the major prophets of the Old Testament, whose ministry preceded the Babylonian captivity.
SENSES: 1. Jeremiah, the prophet of Israel (Mt 2:17).

THAYER.pt: Um dos principais profetas do Antigo Testamento, cujo ministério antecedeu o cativeiro babilônico. 1. Jeremias, o profeta de Israel (Mt 2.17).
THAYER.en: One of the major prophets of the Old Testament, whose ministry preceded the Babylonian captivity. 1. Jeremiah, the prophet of Israel (Mt 2:17).

DEFINITION: An individual officially separated and consecrated to perform sacred rites, offer sacrifices, and mediate between God and humanity.
SENSES: 1. A priest of the Levitical or pagan system who ministers in traditional rituals (Mt 8:4; Acts 14:13).
2. Christ as the perfect and eternal High Priest (Heb 5:6; 7:17).
3. New Testament believers as spiritual priests of God (Rev 1:6; 20:6).

THAYER.pt: Indivíduo oficialmente separado e consagrado para realizar ritos sagrados, oferecer sacrifícios e mediar entre Deus e a humanidade. 1. Sacerdote do sistema levítico ou pagão que ministra nos rituais tradicionais (Mt 8.4; At 14.13). | 2. Cristo como o Sumo Sacerdote perfeito e eterno (Hb 5.6; 7.17). | 3. Os crentes do Novo Testamento como sacerdotes espirituais de Deus (Ap 1.6; 20.6).
THAYER.en: An individual officially separated and consecrated to perform sacred rites, offer sacrifices, and mediate between God and humanity. 1. A priest of the Levitical or pagan system who ministers in traditional rituals (Mt 8:4; Acts 14:13). | 2. Christ as the perfect and eternal High Priest (Heb 5:6; 7:17). | 3. New Testament believers as spiritual priests of God (Rev 1:6; 20:6).

DEFINITION: An important historical city located in Judea, near the Jordan Valley and north of the Dead Sea.
SENSES: 1. The city of Jericho mentioned in the Gospel accounts (Mt 20:29; Lk 18:35).

THAYER.pt: Importante cidade histórica localizada na Judeia, próxima ao vale do Jordão e ao norte do Mar Morto. 1. A cidade de Jericó mencionada nos relatos dos Evangelhos (Mt 20.29; Lc 18.35).
THAYER.en: An important historical city located in Judea, near the Jordan Valley and north of the Dead Sea. 1. The city of Jericho mentioned in the Gospel accounts (Mt 20:29; Lk 18:35).

DEFINITION: Designates the sacred temple complex in Jerusalem, including all its courts, porticoes, and adjacent buildings, differing from the restricted inner building (naos).
SENSES: 1. The Jerusalem temple complex with its precincts (Mt 21:12; Lk 2:46).
2. Other pagan temples dedicated to deities (Acts 19:27).

THAYER.pt: Designa o complexo sagrado do templo em Jerusalém, incluindo todos os seus pátios, pórticos e edifícios adjacentes, diferindo do edifício interno restrito (naos). 1. O complexo do templo de Jerusalém com seus recintos (Mt 21.12; Lc 2.46). | 2. Outros templos pagãos dedicados a divindades (At 19.27).
THAYER.en: Designates the sacred temple complex in Jerusalem, including all its courts, porticoes, and adjacent buildings, differing from the restricted inner building (naos). 1. The Jerusalem temple complex with its precincts (Mt 21:12; Lk 2:46). | 2. Other pagan temples dedicated to deities (Acts 19:27).

DEFINITION: That which is proper to sacred things or which inspires religious respect, dignity, and piety in behavior.
SENSES: 1. Behavior or posture worthy of devout persons and consistent with holiness (Tit 2:3).

THAYER.pt: Que é próprio de coisas sagradas ou que inspira respeito religioso, dignidade e piedade no comportamento. 1. Comportamento ou postura digna de pessoas devotas e condizente com a santidade (Tt 2.3).
THAYER.en: That which is proper to sacred things or which inspires religious respect, dignity, and piety in behavior. 1. Behavior or posture worthy of devout persons and consistent with holiness (Tit 2:3).

DEFINITION: Belonging to the sphere of the divine, characterized by transcendent purity or consecrated to temple service.
SENSES: 1. Sacred or consecrated to God, such as the Scriptures (2 Tim 3:15).
2. Relating to the services and goods of the temple (1 Cor 9:13).

THAYER.pt: Pertecente à esfera do divino, caracterizado por pureza transcendente ou consagrado ao serviço do templo. 1. Sagrado ou consagrado a Deus, como as Escrituras (2Tm 3.15). | 2. Relativo aos serviços e bens do templo (1Co 9.13).
THAYER.en: Belonging to the sphere of the divine, characterized by transcendent purity or consecrated to temple service. 1. Sacred or consecrated to God, such as the Scriptures (2 Tim 3:15). | 2. Relating to the services and goods of the temple (1 Cor 9:13).

DEFINITION: The name of the capital city of Judea and the religious center of Judaism, which can also collectively represent its inhabitants or allude to the heavenly Jerusalem.
SENSES: 1. The geographical and historical city of Jerusalem (Mt 2:1; Lk 2:25).
2. The inhabitants of Jerusalem as a collective (Mt 2:3).

SENSES: 1. To live according to Jewish customs and ordinances (Gal 2.14).

THAYER.pt: Praticar os costumes, tradições e ordenanças judaicas, adotando o estilo de vida da comunidade judaica. 1. Viver de acordo com os costumes e ordenanças judaicas (Gl 2.14).
THAYER.en: To practice Jewish customs, traditions, and ordinances, adopting the lifestyle of the Jewish community. 1. To live according to Jewish customs and ordinances (Gal 2.14).

DEFINITION: Pertaining or relating to Jewish culture, customs, or nation.
SENSES: 1. Pertaining to the Jewish way of life or traditions (Tit 1.14).

THAYER.pt: Pertencente ou relativo à cultura, aos costumes ou à nação judaica. 1. Pertençente ao modo de vida ou tradições judaicas (Tt 1.14).
THAYER.en: Pertaining or relating to Jewish culture, customs, or nation. 1. Pertaining to the Jewish way of life or traditions (Tit 1.14).

DEFINITION: In a manner characteristic of the Jews, following Jewish norms and traditions.
SENSES: 1. To live or act in a typically Jewish manner (Gal 2.14).
