THAYER.pt: De modo característico dos judeus, seguindo as normas e tradições judaicas. 1. Viver ou agir de maneira tipicamente judaica (Gl 2.14).
THAYER.en: In a manner characteristic of the Jews, following Jewish norms and traditions. 1. To live or act in a typically Jewish manner (Gal 2.14).

DEFINITION: Denotes that which belongs to or is characteristic of Judea or the Israelite nation. Used as a substantive in the New Testament, it describes ethnic and religious descendants of Jacob faithful to the Mosaic tradition, or specifically the religious authorities of Jerusalem.
SENSES: 1. Pertaining to the province of Judea or of Jewish ethnicity (Acts 10.28; Rom 3.1).
2. Substantive: a Jew, the Jewish people (Jn 4.9; Rom 2.28-29).
3. In the Gospel of John, the religious leaders opposing Jesus (Jn 5.18; Jn 7.1).

THAYER.pt: Denomina aquilo que pertence ou é característico da Judeia ou da nação israelita. Usado substantivado no Novo Testamento, descreve os descendentes étnicos e religiosos de Jacó fiéis à tradição mosaica, ou especificamente as autoridades religiosas de Jerusalém. 1. Pertencente à província da Judeia ou de etnia judaica (At 10.28; Rm 3.1). | 2. Substantivado: um judeu, o povo judeu (Jo 4.9; Rm 2.28-29). | 3. No Evangelho de João, os líderes religiosos opositores de Jesus (Jo 5.18; Jo 7.1).
THAYER.en: Denotes that which belongs to or is characteristic of Judea or the Israelite nation. Used as a substantive in the New Testament, it describes ethnic and religious descendants of Jacob faithful to the Mosaic tradition, or specifically the religious authorities of Jerusalem. 1. Pertaining to the province of Judea or of Jewish ethnicity (Acts 10.28; Rom 3.1). | 2. Substantive: a Jew, the Jewish people (Jn 4.9; Rom 2.28-29). | 3. In the Gospel of John, the religious leaders opposing Jesus (Jn 5.18; Jn 7.1).

DEFINITION: The system of beliefs, traditions, customs, and religious practices of the Jews.
SENSES: 1. The Jewish tradition and religion in which the Apostle Paul formerly participated zealously (Gal 1.13).

THAYER.pt: O sistema de crenças, tradições, costumes e práticas religiosas dos judeus. 1. A tradição e religião judaica da qual o apóstolo Paulo antes participava zelosamente (Gl 1.13).
THAYER.en: The system of beliefs, traditions, customs, and religious practices of the Jews. 1. The Jewish tradition and religion in which the Apostle Paul formerly participated zealously (Gal 1.13).

DEFINITION: A Hebrew name widely used in the New Testament to designate different historical figures.
SENSES: 1. Judas Iscariot, the disciple who betrayed Jesus (Mt 10.4; Jn 12.4).
2. Judas, brother or half-brother of Jesus (Mt 13.55; Jude 1).
3. The tribe or geographical region of Judah (Mt 2.6; Heb 7.14).

THAYER.pt: Nome hebraico amplamente utilizado no Novo Testamento para designar diferentes personagens históricos. 1. Judas Iscariotes, o discípulo que traiu Jesus (Mt 10.4; Jo 12.4). | 2. Judas, irmão ou meio-irmão de Jesus (Mt 13.55; Jd 1). | 3. A tribo ou a região geográfica de Judá (Mt 2.6; Hb 7.14).
THAYER.en: A Hebrew name widely used in the New Testament to designate different historical figures. 1. Judas Iscariot, the disciple who betrayed Jesus (Mt 10.4; Jn 12.4). | 2. Judas, brother or half-brother of Jesus (Mt 13.55; Jude 1). | 3. The tribe or geographical region of Judah (Mt 2.6; Heb 7.14).

DEFINITION: A Roman female proper name, belonging to a Christian greeted by the Apostle Paul.
SENSES: 1. A Christian woman in Rome greeted by Paul (Rom 16.15).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio feminino romano, pertencente a uma cristã cumprimentada pelo apóstolo Paulo. 1. Mulher cristã em Roma saudada por Paulo (Rm 16.15).
THAYER.en: A Roman female proper name, belonging to a Christian greeted by the Apostle Paul. 1. A Christian woman in Rome greeted by Paul (Rom 16.15).

DEFINITION: Julius, a Roman centurion of the Augustan cohort who treated the Apostle Paul with kindness.
SENSES: 1. A Roman military officer charged with escorting Paul to Rome (Acts 27.1).

THAYER.pt: Júlio, um centurião romano da coorte augustéia que tratou o apóstolo Paulo com bondade. 1. Oficial militar romano encarregado de escoltar Paulo a Roma (At 27.1).
THAYER.en: Julius, a Roman centurion of the Augustan cohort who treated the Apostle Paul with kindness. 1. A Roman military officer charged with escorting Paul to Rome (Acts 27.1).

DEFINITION: A male proper name (or female, Junia) of a relative and fellow prisoner/worker with Paul.
SENSES: 1. A prominent Jewish Christian among the apostles (Rom 16.7).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio masculino (ou feminino, Júnia) de um(a) parente e colaborador(a) de Paulo na prisão. 1. Judeu cristão de destaque entre os apóstolos (Rm 16.7).
THAYER.en: A male proper name (or female, Junia) of a relative and fellow prisoner/worker with Paul. 1. A prominent Jewish Christian among the apostles (Rom 16.7).

DEFINITION: A Roman proper name adopted by three Christians in the New Testament, meaning 'righteous' or 'just'.
SENSES: 1. Joseph, called Barsabbas, who was also surnamed Justus (Acts 1.23).
2. Titius Justus, a proselyte in whose house Paul stayed in Corinth (Acts 18.7).
3. Jesus, called Justus, a Jewish-Christian co-worker of Paul (Col 4.11).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio romano adotado por três cristãos no Novo Testamento, significando 'justo'. 1. José, chamado Barsabás, que também tinha o sobrenome de Justo (At 1.23). | 2. Tício Justo, prosélito em cuja casa Paulo esteve em Corinto (At 18.7). | 3. Jesus, chamado Justo, um cooperador judeu-cristão de Paulo (Cl 4.11).
THAYER.en: A Roman proper name adopted by three Christians in the New Testament, meaning 'righteous' or 'just'. 1. Joseph, called Barsabbas, who was also surnamed Justus (Acts 1.23). | 2. Titius Justus, a proselyte in whose house Paul stayed in Corinth (Acts 18.7). | 3. Jesus, called Justus, a Jewish-Christian co-worker of Paul (Col 4.11).

DEFINITION: A soldier who fights on horseback, a member of the cavalry.
SENSES: 1. A horseman or cavalry soldier (Acts 23.23).

THAYER.pt: Soldado que combate a cavalo, membro da cavalaria militar. 1. Cavaleiro ou soldado da cavalaria (At 23.23).
THAYER.en: A soldier who fights on horseback, a member of the cavalry. 1. A horseman or cavalry soldier (Acts 23.23).

DEFINITION: Military force composed of soldiers fighting on horseback; cavalry troop.
SENSES: 1. A body of mounted troops or cavalry (Rev 9:16).

THAYER.pt: Força militar composta por soldados que combatem a cavalo; tropa de cavalaria. 1. Corpo de tropa montada ou cavalaria (Ap 9.16).
THAYER.en: Military force composed of soldiers fighting on horseback; cavalry troop. 1. A body of mounted troops or cavalry (Rev 9:16).

DEFINITION: Noun referring to the equine quadruped animal, used in the ancient world primarily for military transport, pulling chariots, or in battles. In the New Testament, it appears in analogies and strikingly in the symbolic descriptions of Revelation.
SENSES: 1. The horse animal used for riding or traction (Jas 3:3; Rev 9:7).

THAYER.pt: Substantivo que se refere ao animal quadrúpede equino, usado no mundo antigo principalmente para o transporte militar, puxar carruagens ou em batalhas. No Novo Testamento, aparece em analogias e de forma marcante nas descrições simbólicas do Apocalipse. 1. O animal cavalo usado para montaria ou tração (Tg 3.3; Ap 9.7).
THAYER.en: Noun referring to the equine quadruped animal, used in the ancient world primarily for military transport, pulling chariots, or in battles. In the New Testament, it appears in analogies and strikingly in the symbolic descriptions of Revelation. 1. The horse animal used for riding or traction (Jas 3:3; Rev 9:7).

DEFINITION: Atmospheric optical phenomenon characterized by a circular or semicircular band of colors.
SENSES: 1. The rainbow around the celestial throne (Rev 4:3).

THAYER.pt: Fenômeno óptico atmosférico caracterizado por uma faixa circular ou semicircular de cores. 1. O arco-íris ao redor do trono celestial (Ap 4.3).
THAYER.en: Atmospheric optical phenomenon characterized by a circular or semicircular band of colors. 1. The rainbow around the celestial throne (Rev 4:3).

DEFINITION: Proper name of one of the Old Testament patriarchs, son of Abraham and Sarah, father of Jacob and Esau.
SENSES: 1. Isaac, the patriarch of Israel's history (Matt 8:11; Acts 7:8; Heb 11:17).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio de um dos patriarcas do Antigo Testamento, filho de Abraão e Sara, pai de Jacó e Esaú. 1. Isaque, o patriarca da história de Israel (Mt 8.11; At 7.8; Hb 11.17).
THAYER.en: Proper name of one of the Old Testament patriarchs, son of Abraham and Sarah, father of Jacob and Esau. 1. Isaac, the patriarch of Israel's history (Matt 8:11; Acts 7:8; Heb 11:17).

DEFINITION: Possessing a condition or nature similar to that of angels, especially in glory and immortality.
SENSES: 1. Similar to the angels in the resurrection (Luke 20:36).

THAYER.pt: Que possui condição ou natureza semelhante à dos anjos, especialmente na glória e imortalidade. 1. Semelhante aos anjos na ressurreição (Lc 20.36).
THAYER.en: Possessing a condition or nature similar to that of angels, especially in glory and immortality. 1. Similar to the angels in the resurrection (Luke 20:36).

DEFINITION: Name of one of the sons of Jacob and patriarch of one of the tribes of Israel.
SENSES: 1. Patriarch of the tribe of Issachar (Rev 7:7).

THAYER.pt: Nome de um dos filhos de Jacó e patriarca de uma das tribos de Israel. 1. Patriarca da tribo de Issacar (Ap 7.7).
THAYER.en: Name of one of the sons of Jacob and patriarch of one of the tribes of Israel. 1. Patriarch of the tribe of Issachar (Rev 7:7).

DEFINITION: Archaic or variant form denoting the possession of knowledge, understanding, or perception about something.
SENSES: 1. To have mental perception or knowledge of facts or realities.

THAYER.pt: Forma arcaica ou variante que denota a posse de conhecimento, entendimento ou percepção sobre algo. 1. Ter percepção mental ou conhecimento de fatos ou realidades.
THAYER.en: Archaic or variant form denoting the possession of knowledge, understanding, or perception about something. 1. To have mental perception or knowledge of facts or realities.

SHORT_GLOSS: be, I feel, may you be
DEFINITION: Imperative form of the verb 'to be', used to order or exhort someone to remain in a certain state or condition.
SENSES: 1. To express an order or imperative advice to be or remain in a certain condition.
USAGE: be, I feel, may you be

THAYER.pt: Forma de imperativo do verbo ser, utilizada para ordenar ou exortar alguém a manter-se em um determinado estado ou condição. 1. Expressar uma ordem ou conselho imperativo para ser ou permanecer em certa condição.
THAYER.en: Imperative form of the verb 'to be', used to order or exhort someone to remain in a certain state or condition. 1. To express an order or imperative advice to be or remain in a certain condition.

DEFINITION: Surname or geographical designation applied to Judas, the disciple who betrayed Jesus.
SENSES: 1. The epithet of Judas Iscariot, possibly indicating his origin in Kerioth (Matt 10:4).

THAYER.pt: Sobrenome ou designação geográfica aplicada a Judas, o discípulo que traiu Jesus. 1. O epíteto de Judas Iscariotes, indicando possivelmente sua origem em Queriote (Mt 10:4).
THAYER.en: Surname or geographical designation applied to Judas, the disciple who betrayed Jesus. 1. The epithet of Judas Iscariot, possibly indicating his origin in Kerioth (Matt 10:4).

DEFINITION: Describes that which is perfectly equivalent in number, size, quality, status, or fundamental characteristics.
SENSES: 1. Possessing equality in dimensions or equivalence (Rev 21:16).
2. On an equal footing or with the same status (Phil 2:6).

THAYER.pt: Descreve aquilo que é perfeitamente equivalente em número, tamanho, qualidade, status ou características fundamentais. 1. Que possui igualdade em dimensões ou equivalência (Ap 21.16). | 2. Em pé de igualdade ou com o mesmo status (Fp 2.6).
THAYER.en: Describes that which is perfectly equivalent in number, size, quality, status, or fundamental characteristics. 1. Possessing equality in dimensions or equivalence (Rev 21:16). | 2. On an equal footing or with the same status (Phil 2:6).

DEFINITION: The state or quality of being equal or just, implying balance, impartiality, and equitable treatment in social and Christian relationships.
SENSES: 1. Equality and reciprocity in the sharing of material resources among brothers in faith (2 Cor 8:13, 14).
2. Justice, equity, and impartiality in dealing with others (Col 4:1).

THAYER.pt: O estado ou qualidade de ser igual ou justo, implicando equilíbrio, imparcialidade e tratamento equitativo nas relações sociais e cristãs. 1. Igualdade e reciprocidade na partilha de recursos materiais entre irmãos na fé (2Co 8.13, 14). | 2. Justiça, eqüidade e imparcialidade no trato com os outros (Cl 4.1).
THAYER.en: The state or quality of being equal or just, implying balance, impartiality, and equitable treatment in social and Christian relationships. 1. Equality and reciprocity in the sharing of material resources among brothers in faith (2 Cor 8:13, 14). | 2. Justice, equity, and impartiality in dealing with others (Col 4:1).

DEFINITION: Possessing the same value, honor, or degree of importance as something else.
SENSES: 1. Having equal value or privilege (2Pe 1.1).

THAYER.pt: Que possui o mesmo valor, honra ou grau de importância que outra coisa. 1. Que tem igual valor ou privilégio (2Pe 1.1).
THAYER.en: Possessing the same value, honor, or degree of importance as something else. 1. Having equal value or privilege (2Pe 1.1).

DEFINITION: Possessing the same mindset, attitude, or disposition of spirit.
SENSES: 1. Of equal sentiment or similar attitude (Php 2.20).

THAYER.pt: Que possui a mesma mentalidade, atitude ou disposição de espírito. 1. De igual sentimento ou atitude semelhante (Fp 2.20).
THAYER.en: Possessing the same mindset, attitude, or disposition of spirit. 1. Of equal sentiment or similar attitude (Php 2.20).

DEFINITION: Designates both the patriarch Jacob and the chosen nation descended from him, extending in the New Testament to describe the community of believers in Christ.
SENSES: 1. The biblical patriarch Jacob, renamed Israel (Mt 8.11; Ro 9.6).
2. The people or nation of Israel in an ethnic sense (Mt 2.6; Ac 4.10).
3. The church as the new spiritual people of God ('the Israel of God') (Ga 6.16).

THAYER.pt: Designa tanto o patriarca Jacó quanto a nação escolhida descendente dele, estendendo-se no Novo Testamento para descrever também a comunidade dos crentes em Cristo. 1. O patriarca bíblico Jacó, renomeado Israel (Mt 8.11; Rm 9.6). | 2. O povo ou nação de Israel em sentido étnico (Mt 2.6; At 4.10). | 3. A igreja como o novo povo espiritual de Deus ('o Israel de Deus') (Gl 6.16).
THAYER.en: Designates both the patriarch Jacob and the chosen nation descended from him, extending in the New Testament to describe the community of believers in Christ. 1. The biblical patriarch Jacob, renamed Israel (Mt 8.11; Ro 9.6). | 2. The people or nation of Israel in an ethnic sense (Mt 2.6; Ac 4.10). | 3. The church as the new spiritual people of God ('the Israel of God') (Ga 6.16).

DEFINITION: An ethnic and religious designation for a descendant of Jacob (Israel), a member of God's covenant people.
SENSES: 1. An Israelite, a member of the people of Israel (Jn 1.47; Ac 2.22).

THAYER.pt: Designação étnica e religiosa para um descendente de Jacó (Israel), membro do povo da aliança de Deus. 1. Um israelita, membro do povo de Israel (Jo 1.47; At 2.22).
THAYER.en: An ethnic and religious designation for a descendant of Jacob (Israel), a member of God's covenant people. 1. An Israelite, a member of the people of Israel (Jn 1.47; Ac 2.22).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: στήσω, Aor: ἔστησα / ἔστην, Perf: ἕστηκα
DEFINITION: A fundamental verb with transitive forms ('to set', 'to establish') and intransitive forms ('to stand', 'to remain firm'). It is used for both upright physical positions and doctrinal solidity or the confirmation of decrees.
SENSES: 1. Intransitive: to stand, to rise, to appear before someone (Mt 20.32; Re 6.17).
2. Transitive: to place, to set, to position, or to present someone (Ac 5.27; 1Co 3.10).
3. Moral or judicial sense: to stand firm, to persevere, to sustain oneself (Ro 14.4; Eph 6.13).
4. To establish, validate, or ratify a law, covenant, or judgment (Ro 3.31; Heb 10.9).

THAYER.pt: Verbo fundamental com formas transitivas ('pôr', 'estabelecer') e intransitivas ('ficar de pé', 'permanecer firme'). É usado tanto para posições físicas eretas quanto para solidez doutrinária e confirmação de decretos. 1. Intransitivo: ficar de pé, erguer-se, comparecer diante de alguém (Mt 20.32; Ap 6.17). | 2. Transitivo: colocar, pôr, posicionar ou apresentar alguém (At 5.27; 1Co 3.10). | 3. Sentido moral ou judicial: manter-se firme, perseverar, sustentar-se (Rm 14.4; Ef 6.13). | 4. Estabelecer, validar ou ratificar uma lei, aliança ou juízo (Rm 3.31; Hb 10.9).
THAYER.en: A fundamental verb with transitive forms ('to set', 'to establish') and intransitive forms ('to stand', 'to remain firm'). It is used for both upright physical positions and doctrinal solidity or the confirmation of decrees. 1. Intransitive: to stand, to rise, to appear before someone (Mt 20.32; Re 6.17). | 2. Transitive: to place, to set, to position, or to present someone (Ac 5.27; 1Co 3.10). | 3. Moral or judicial sense: to stand firm, to persevere, to sustain oneself (Ro 14.4; Eph 6.13). | 4. To establish, validate, or ratify a law, covenant, or judgment (Ro 3.31; Heb 10.9).

SHORT_GLOSS: to visit, to get to know
DEFINITION: To visit someone personally for the purpose of obtaining information or getting to know them better.
SENSES: 1. To make a visit to get to know someone personally (Ga 1.18).
USAGE: to visit, to get to know

THAYER.pt: Visitar alguém pessoalmente com o propósito de obter informações ou conhecer melhor. 1. Fazer uma visita para conhecer pessoalmente (Gl 1.18).
THAYER.en: To visit someone personally for the purpose of obtaining information or getting to know them better. 1. To make a visit to get to know someone personally (Ga 1.18).

DEFINITION: Possessing great strength, power, or intensity, whether physical, mental, spiritual, or manifested in natural events.
SENSES: 1. Strong or powerful in physical or spiritual terms (Re 6:15; 18:8).
2. Intense, violent, or thunderous in degree (Lk 15:14; Re 19:6).

THAYER.pt: Que possui grande força, poder ou intensidade, seja física, mental, espiritual ou manifestada em eventos da natureza. 1. Forte ou poderoso em termos físicos ou espirituais (Ap 6:15; 18:8). | 2. Intenso, violento ou estrondoso em grau (Lc 15:14; Ap 19:6).
THAYER.en: Possessing great strength, power, or intensity, whether physical, mental, spiritual, or manifested in natural events. 1. Strong or powerful in physical or spiritual terms (Re 6:15; 18:8). | 2. Intense, violent, or thunderous in degree (Lk 15:14; Re 19:6).

DEFINITION: Represents inherent strength, physical vigor, or the potential capacity to perform effective actions.
SENSES: 1. Vigor or physical strength and capacity for action (Mk 12.30; 1Pe 4.11).

THAYER.pt: Representa a força inerente, o vigor físico ou a capacidade potencial para realizar ações eficazes. 1. Vigor ou força física e capacidade de ação (Mc 12.30; 1Pe 4.11).
THAYER.en: Represents inherent strength, physical vigor, or the potential capacity to perform effective actions. 1. Vigor or physical strength and capacity for action (Mk 12.30; 1Pe 4.11).

SHORT_GLOSS: to have power, be able, be valid
DEFINITION: To possess physical strength, authority, competence, or legal validity to perform a certain action.
SENSES: 1. To be physically strong or in good health (Mt 9:12).
2. To have the capacity or resources to accomplish something (Php 4:13).
3. To prevail or have power and efficacy (Ac 19:20; Re 12:8).
4. To have legal validity or force (Heb 9:17).
USAGE: to have power, be able, be valid

THAYER.pt: Possuir força física, autoridade, competência ou validade legal para realizar determinada ação. 1. Estar fisicamente forte ou com boa saúde (Mt 9:12). | 2. Ter capacidade ou recursos para realizar algo (Fp 4:13). | 3. Prevalecer ou ter poder e eficácia (At 19:20; Ap 12:8). | 4. Ter validade ou vigor legal (Hb 9:17).
THAYER.en: To possess physical strength, authority, competence, or legal validity to perform a certain action. 1. To be physically strong or in good health (Mt 9:12). | 2. To have the capacity or resources to accomplish something (Php 4:13). | 3. To prevail or have power and efficacy (Ac 19:20; Re 12:8). | 4. To have legal validity or force (Heb 9:17).

DEFINITION: Indicates that an event or action has a high degree of probability of occurring.
SENSES: 1. Expresses possibility or probability (Lk 20.13).

THAYER.pt: Indica que um evento ou ação tem um alto grau de probabilidade de ocorrer. 1. Expressa possibilidade ou probabilidade (Lc 20.13).
THAYER.en: Indicates that an event or action has a high degree of probability of occurring. 1. Expresses possibility or probability (Lk 20.13).

DEFINITION: A peninsular region and country in southern Europe, the political and administrative center of the Roman Empire.
SENSES: 1. The peninsula and nation of Italy (Ac 18.2; 27.1; Heb 13.24).

THAYER.pt: Região peninsular e país do sul da Europa, centro político e administrativo do Império Romano. 1. A península e nação da Itália (At 18.2; 27.1; Hb 13.24).
THAYER.en: A peninsular region and country in southern Europe, the political and administrative center of the Roman Empire. 1. The peninsula and nation of Italy (Ac 18.2; 27.1; Heb 13.24).

DEFINITION: Belonging or relating to the region of Italy.
SENSES: 1. Designating a Roman cohort originating from Italy (Ac 10.1).

THAYER.pt: Pertencente ou relativo à região da Itália. 1. Designativo de coorte romana originária da Itália (At 10.1).
THAYER.en: Belonging or relating to the region of Italy. 1. Designating a Roman cohort originating from Italy (Ac 10.1).

DEFINITION: Relating to Iturea, a mountainous region located northeast of Galilee.
SENSES: 1. Belonging to the region of Iturea (Lk 3.1).

THAYER.pt: Relativo à Itureia, região montanhosa localizada a nordeste da Galileia. 1. Pertencente à região da Itureia (Lc 3.1).
THAYER.en: Relating to Iturea, a mountainous region located northeast of Galilee. 1. Belonging to the region of Iturea (Lk 3.1).

DEFINITION: Diminutive of ἰχθύς, indicating a small-sized fish.
SENSES: 1. A small fish used for food (Mt 15.34; Mk 8.7).

THAYER.pt: Diminutivo de ἰχθύς, indicando um peixe de pequeno porte. 1. Um peixe pequeno usado na alimentação (Mt 15.34; Mc 8.7).
THAYER.en: Diminutive of ἰχθύς, indicating a small-sized fish. 1. A small fish used for food (Mt 15.34; Mk 8.7).

DEFINITION: A generic term designating aquatic vertebrate animals known as fish, frequently mentioned in Gospel accounts in contexts of fishing and food.
SENSES: 1. Fish as a living creature or food (Mt 7.10; Lk 5.6; Jn 21.9).

THAYER.pt: Termo genérico que designa os animais aquáticos vertebrados conhecidos como peixes, frequentemente mencionados nos relatos dos Evangelhos em contextos de pesca e alimentação. 1. Peixe como criatura viva ou alimento (Mt 7.10; Lc 5.6; Jo 21.9).
THAYER.en: A generic term designating aquatic vertebrate animals known as fish, frequently mentioned in Gospel accounts in contexts of fishing and food. 1. Fish as a living creature or food (Mt 7.10; Lk 5.6; Jn 21.9).

DEFINITION: Literally the footprint or sole of the foot, used metaphorically in the New Testament to indicate following a moral or spiritual example.
SENSES: 1. Footprints or steps, used figuratively to imitate someone's conduct or faith (Ro 4.12; 2Co 12.18; 1Pe 2.21).

THAYER.pt: Literalmente a pegada ou sola do pé, usado metaforicamente no Novo Testamento para indicar o seguimento de um exemplo moral ou espiritual. 1. Pegadas ou passos, usados figuradamente para imitar a conduta ou a fé de alguém (Rm 4.12; 2Co 12.18; 1Pe 2.21).
THAYER.en: Literally the footprint or sole of the foot, used metaphorically in the New Testament to indicate following a moral or spiritual example. 1. Footprints or steps, used figuratively to imitate someone's conduct or faith (Ro 4.12; 2Co 12.18; 1Pe 2.21).

DEFINITION: Jotham, king of Judah, an ancestor in the earthly genealogy of Jesus Christ.
SENSES: 1. King of Judah mentioned in the Davidic lineage (Mt 1.9).

THAYER.pt: Jotão, rei de Judá, ancestral na genealogia terrena de Jesus Cristo. 1. Rei de Judá mencionado na linhagem davídica (Mt 1.9).
THAYER.en: Jotham, king of Judah, an ancestor in the earthly genealogy of Jesus Christ. 1. King of Judah mentioned in the Davidic lineage (Mt 1.9).

DEFINITION: Joanna, wife of Chuza, Herod's steward, a follower and minister to Jesus.
SENSES: 1. A Galilean woman who followed and supported Jesus with her means (Lk 8.3; 24.10).

THAYER.pt: Joana, esposa de Cuza, administrador de Herodes, seguidora e ministra de Jesus. 1. Mulher galileia que seguia e auxiliava Jesus com seus bens (Lc 8.3; 24.10).
THAYER.en: Joanna, wife of Chuza, Herod's steward, a follower and minister to Jesus. 1. A Galilean woman who followed and supported Jesus with her means (Lk 8.3; 24.10).

DEFINITION: A character cited in the genealogy of Jesus Christ according to the Gospel of Luke.
SENSES: 1. An ancestor in the lineage of Jesus (Lk 3.27).

THAYER.pt: Personagem citado na genealogia de Jesus Cristo segundo o Evangelho de Lucas. 1. Ancestral na linhagem de Jesus (Lc 3.27).
THAYER.en: A character cited in the genealogy of Jesus Christ according to the Gospel of Luke. 1. An ancestor in the lineage of Jesus (Lk 3.27).

DEFINITION: Proper name of prominent biblical figures in the New Testament, referring principally to the forerunner of Christ (the Baptist) and the beloved apostle, son of Zebedee.
SENSES: 1. John the Baptist, the prophet and forerunner of Jesus Christ (Matt 3:1; Mark 1:4).
2. John, son of Zebedee and brother of James, one of the twelve apostles (Matt 4:21; John 21:24).
3. Other historical figures, such as John Mark or members of the priestly leadership (Acts 4:6; 12:12).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio de proeminentes figuras bíblicas do Novo Testamento, designando principalmente o precursor de Cristo (o Batista) e o apóstolo amado, filho de Zebedeu. 1. João Batista, o profeta e precursor de Jesus Cristo (Mt 3.1; Mc 1.4). | 2. João, filho de Zebedeu e irmão de Tiago, um dos doze apóstolos (Mt 4.21; Jo 21.24). | 3. Outras personagens históricas, como João Marcos ou membros da liderança sacerdotal (At 4.6; 12.12).
THAYER.en: Proper name of prominent biblical figures in the New Testament, referring principally to the forerunner of Christ (the Baptist) and the beloved apostle, son of Zebedee. 1. John the Baptist, the prophet and forerunner of Jesus Christ (Matt 3:1; Mark 1:4). | 2. John, son of Zebedee and brother of James, one of the twelve apostles (Matt 4:21; John 21:24). | 3. Other historical figures, such as John Mark or members of the priestly leadership (Acts 4:6; 12:12).

DEFINITION: Hero of the Old Testament book of the same name, celebrated for his patience and perseverance in suffering.
SENSES: 1. Example of patience and perseverance in the face of affliction (Jas 5:11).

THAYER.pt: Herói do livro veterotestamentário homônimo, célebre por sua paciência e perseverança no sofrimento. 1. Exemplo de paciência e perseverança diante da aflição (Tg 5.11).
THAYER.en: Hero of the Old Testament book of the same name, celebrated for his patience and perseverance in suffering. 1. Example of patience and perseverance in the face of affliction (Jas 5:11).

DEFINITION: Old Testament prophet whose prophecies were cited in the New Testament.
SENSES: 1. The prophet Joel, whose words were quoted at Pentecost (Acts 2:16).

THAYER.pt: Profeta do Antigo Testamento cujas profecias foram citadas no Novo Testamento. 1. O profeta Joel, cujas palavras foram citadas no Pentecostes (At 2.16).
THAYER.en: Old Testament prophet whose prophecies were cited in the New Testament. 1. The prophet Joel, whose words were quoted at Pentecost (Acts 2:16).

DEFINITION: Masculine proper name present in the genealogy of Jesus.
SENSES: 1. A person in the ancestral lineage of Christ (Luke 3:30).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio masculino presente na genealogia de Jesus. 1. Pessoa na linhagem ancestral de Cristo (Lc 3.30).
THAYER.en: Masculine proper name present in the genealogy of Jesus. 1. A person in the ancestral lineage of Christ (Luke 3:30).

DEFINITION: Masculine proper name referring to the Old Testament prophet or the father of the apostle Peter (also called John).
SENSES: 1. The Old Testament prophet Jonah (Matt 12:39).
2. The father of Simon Peter (Matt 16:17).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio masculino referente ao profeta do Antigo Testamento ou ao pai do apóstolo Pedro (também chamado João). 1. O profeta Jonas do Antigo Testamento (Mt 12.39). | 2. O pai de Simão Pedro (Mt 16.17).
THAYER.en: Masculine proper name referring to the Old Testament prophet or the father of the apostle Peter (also called John). 1. The Old Testament prophet Jonah (Matt 12:39). | 2. The father of Simon Peter (Matt 16:17).

DEFINITION: Joram (Jehoram), king of Judah, an ancestor in the genealogy of Jesus.
SENSES: 1. King of Judah listed in Matthew's genealogy (Matt 1:8).

THAYER.pt: Jorão (Jeorão), rei de Judá, antepassado na genealogia de Jesus. 1. Rei de Judá listado na genealogia de Mateus (Mt 1.8).
THAYER.en: Joram (Jehoram), king of Judah, an ancestor in the genealogy of Jesus. 1. King of Judah listed in Matthew's genealogy (Matt 1:8).

DEFINITION: Name of an ancestor in the genealogy of Jesus recorded in Luke.
SENSES: 1. Descendant in the lineage of Jesus (Luke 3:29).

THAYER.pt: Nome de um ancestral na genealogia de Jesus registrada em Lucas. 1. Descendente na linhagem de Jesus (Lc 3.29).
THAYER.en: Name of an ancestor in the genealogy of Jesus recorded in Luke. 1. Descendant in the lineage of Jesus (Luke 3:29).

DEFINITION: Jehoshaphat, pious king of Judah, an ancestor of Jesus.
SENSES: 1. King of Judah mentioned in the messianic genealogy (Matt 1:8).

THAYER.pt: Josafá (Jeosafá), rei piedoso de Judá, antepassado de Jesus. 1. Rei de Judá mencionado na genealogia messiânica (Mt 1.8).
THAYER.en: Jehoshaphat, pious king of Judah, an ancestor of Jesus. 1. King of Judah mentioned in the messianic genealogy (Matt 1:8).

DEFINITION: Abbreviated or variant Semitic form of the proper name Joseph, referring to New Testament individuals.
SENSES: 1. Masculine proper name of New Testament figures.

THAYER.pt: Forma semítica abreviada ou variante do nome próprio José, referindo-se a indivíduos do Novo Testamento. 1. Nome próprio masculino de personagens neotestamentários.
THAYER.en: Abbreviated or variant Semitic form of the proper name Joseph, referring to New Testament individuals. 1. Masculine proper name of New Testament figures.

DEFINITION: Greek form of a common Hebrew name (variant of Joseph), referring to different persons in the Gospels.
SENSES: 1. One of the brothers of Jesus (Mark 6:3).
2. Son of Mary and brother of James the younger (Mark 15:40, 47).

THAYER.pt: Forma grega de um nome hebraico comum (variante de José), referente a diferentes pessoas nos Evangelhos. 1. Um dos irmãos de Jesus (Mc 6.3). | 2. Filho de Maria e irmão de Tiago, o menor (Mc 15.40, 47).
THAYER.en: Greek form of a common Hebrew name (variant of Joseph), referring to different persons in the Gospels. 1. One of the brothers of Jesus (Mark 6:3). | 2. Son of Mary and brother of James the younger (Mark 15:40, 47).

DEFINITION: Hebrew name transliterated into Greek, associated with prominent figures of biblical history and the genealogy of Jesus.
SENSES: 1. Joseph, the patriarch son of Jacob (Acts 7:9; Heb 11:21).
2. Joseph, the husband of Mary, the mother of Jesus (Matt 1:16; Luke 2:4).
3. Joseph of Arimathea, member of the Sanhedrin who buried Jesus (Matt 27:57).

THAYER.pt: Nome hebraico transliterado no grego, associado a figuras proeminentes da história bíblica e da genealogia de Jesus. 1. José, o patriarca filho de Jacó (At 7.9; Hb 11.21). | 2. José, o marido de Maria, mãe de Jesus (Mt 1.16; Lc 2.4). | 3. José de Arimateia, membro do Sinédrio que sepultou Jesus (Mt 27.57).
THAYER.en: Hebrew name transliterated into Greek, associated with prominent figures of biblical history and the genealogy of Jesus. 1. Joseph, the patriarch son of Jacob (Acts 7:9; Heb 11:21). | 2. Joseph, the husband of Mary, the mother of Jesus (Matt 1:16; Luke 2:4). | 3. Joseph of Arimathea, member of the Sanhedrin who buried Jesus (Matt 27:57).

DEFINITION: Josiah, reforming king of Judah, ancestor of Jesus in the pre-exilic period.
SENSES: 1. King of Judah in the genealogy of Christ (Matt 1:10, 11).

THAYER.pt: Josias, rei reformador de Judá, antepassado de Jesus no período pré-exílico. 1. Rei de Judá na genealogia de Cristo (Mt 1.10,11).
THAYER.en: Josiah, reforming king of Judah, ancestor of Jesus in the pre-exilic period. 1. King of Judah in the genealogy of Christ (Matt 1:10, 11).

DEFINITION: The smallest letter of the Greek alphabet, corresponding to the Hebrew 'yod', used to denote the smallest detail.
SENSES: 1. The smallest letter or stroke of the alphabet (Matt 5:18).

THAYER.pt: A menor letra do alfabeto grego, correspondente ao 'yod' hebraico, usada para denotar o menor detalhe. 1. A menor letra ou traço do alfabeto (Mt 5.18).
THAYER.en: The smallest letter of the Greek alphabet, corresponding to the Hebrew 'yod', used to denote the smallest detail. 1. The smallest letter or stroke of the alphabet (Matt 5:18).

SHORT_GLOSS: and I, I also, I myself
DEFINITION: Emphatic combination by crasis of the conjunction καί with the pronoun ἐγώ, highlighting the speaker in reciprocal connection or contrast with another.
SENSES: 1. And I, I in my turn (John 6:57; Matt 11:28).
2. I also, likewise I (Matt 2:8; 1 Cor 7:40).
3. But I, I by contrast (John 10:28; Acts 22:19).
USAGE: and I, I also, I myself

THAYER.pt: Combinação enfática por crase da conjunção καί com o pronome ἐγώ, destacando o próprio falante em conexão recíproca ou de contraste com outrem. 1. E eu, eu por minha vez (Jo 6.57; Mt 11.28). | 2. Eu também, igualmente eu (Mt 2.8; 1Co 7.40). | 3. Mas eu, eu em contraste (Jo 10.28; At 22.19).
THAYER.en: Emphatic combination by crasis of the conjunction καί with the pronoun ἐγώ, highlighting the speaker in reciprocal connection or contrast with another. 1. And I, I in my turn (John 6:57; Matt 11:28). | 2. I also, likewise I (Matt 2:8; 1 Cor 7:40). | 3. But I, I by contrast (John 10:28; Acts 22:19).

DEFINITION: Particle indicating exact similarity or conformity between events, states, or actions.
SENSES: 1. In the same way as, exactly as (Matt 27:10).

THAYER.pt: Partícula que indica semelhança ou conformidade exata entre eventos, estados ou ações. 1. Da mesma forma que, exatamente como (Mt 27.10).
THAYER.en: Particle indicating exact similarity or conformity between events, states, or actions. 1. In the same way as, exactly as (Matt 27:10).

DEFINITION: The act of completely pulling down a physical structure or, figuratively, of weakening and disarming opposition or capability.
SENSES: 1. Demolition or destruction of strongholds (2 Cor 10:4).
2. Authority given for edification and not for spiritual destruction (2 Cor 10:8; 13:10).

THAYER.pt: Ação de derrubar completamente uma estrutura física ou, figuradamente, de enfraquecer e desarmar uma oposição ou capacidade. 1. Demolição ou destruição de fortalezas (2Co 10.4). | 2. Autoridade conferida para edificação e não para destruição espiritual (2Co 10.8; 13.10).
THAYER.en: The act of completely pulling down a physical structure or, figuratively, of weakening and disarming opposition or capability. 1. Demolition or destruction of strongholds (2 Cor 10:4). | 2. Authority given for edification and not for spiritual destruction (2 Cor 10:8; 13:10).

DEFINITION: Physically bringing something down from a higher to a lower level, or dismantling and destroying structures and strongholds by power.
SENSES: 1. To lower, bring down, or remove something from above (Luke 1:52; Acts 13:29).
2. To destroy, pull down, or dismantle buildings or strongholds (Luke 12:18; 2 Cor 10:4).

THAYER.pt: Abaixar fisicamente algo de um nível superior para inferior, ou desmantelar e destruir estruturas e fortalezas por meio de poder. 1. Abaixar, descer ou retirar algo de cima (Lc 1.52; At 13.29). | 2. Destruir, derrubar ou desmantelar edifícios ou fortalezas (Lc 12.18; 2Co 10.4).
THAYER.en: Physically bringing something down from a higher to a lower level, or dismantling and destroying structures and strongholds by power. 1. To lower, bring down, or remove something from above (Luke 1:52; Acts 13:29). | 2. To destroy, pull down, or dismantle buildings or strongholds (Luke 12:18; 2 Cor 10:4).

DEFINITION: To make something clean, purify from impurities, or prune superfluous plant shoots for fruitfulness.
SENSES: 1. To purify or cleanse spiritually.
2. To prune branches of a vine to bear more fruit (John 15:2).

THAYER.pt: Tornar algo limpo, purificar de impurezas ou podar brotos supérfluos de plantas para frutificação. 1. Purificar ou limpar espiritualmente. | 2. Podar ramos de videira para dar mais frutos (Jo 15.2).
THAYER.en: To make something clean, purify from impurities, or prune superfluous plant shoots for fruitfulness. 1. To purify or cleanse spiritually. | 2. To prune branches of a vine to bear more fruit (John 15:2).

SHORT_GLOSS: even as, just as, even so
DEFINITION: Emphatic particle of comparison establishing a close resemblance between facts, states, or statements.
SENSES: 1. Exactly just as, in the very manner that (Rom 3:4; 4:6).
USAGE: even as, just as, even so

THAYER.pt: Partícula enfática de comparação que estabelece uma semelhança estreita entre fatos, estados ou declarações. 1. Exatamente assim como, da mesma maneira que (Rm 3.4; 4.6).
THAYER.en: Emphatic particle of comparison establishing a close resemblance between facts, states, or statements. 1. Exactly just as, in the very manner that (Rom 3:4; 4:6).

DEFINITION: To seize firmly, catch, or fasten onto something physically.
SENSES: 1. To fasten or seize with force, like a viper on the hand (Acts 28:3).

THAYER.pt: Agarrar com firmeza, apanhar ou fixar-se em algo de modo físico. 1. Fixar-se ou agarrar com força, como uma víbora na mão (At 28.3).
THAYER.en: To seize firmly, catch, or fasten onto something physically. 1. To fasten or seize with force, like a viper on the hand (Acts 28:3).

DEFINITION: To make something physically clean, ritually pure, or spiritually free from the stain of sin and illness.
SENSES: 1. To physically clean objects or utensils (Matt 23:25).
2. To heal a person of illnesses causing ritual impurity, such as leprosy (Matt 8:2–3).
3. To purify ceremonially or spiritually, declaring clean before God (Acts 10:15).

THAYER.pt: Tornar algo fisicamente limpo, ritualmente puro ou espiritualmente livre da mancha do pecado e da enfermidade. 1. Limpar fisicamente objetos ou utensílios (Mt 23.25). | 2. Curar uma pessoa de enfermidades que causam impureza ritual, como a lepra (Mt 8.2-3). | 3. Purificar cerimonial ou espiritualmente, declarando limpo perante Deus (At 10.15).
THAYER.en: To make something physically clean, ritually pure, or spiritually free from the stain of sin and illness. 1. To physically clean objects or utensils (Matt 23:25). | 2. To heal a person of illnesses causing ritual impurity, such as leprosy (Matt 8:2–3). | 3. To purify ceremonially or spiritually, declaring clean before God (Acts 10:15).

DEFINITION: The act of purifying or cleansing, whether from ritual and cultic impurities, or from the moral and spiritual pollution of sin.
SENSES: 1. Ritual purification or ablution from impurities (John 2:6).
2. Cleansing and expiation of sins and inner pollution (Heb 1:3).

THAYER.pt: Ato de purificar ou limpar, seja de impurezas rituais e cultuais, seja da poluição moral e espiritual do pecado. 1. Purificação ou ablução ritual de impurezas (Jo 2.6). | 2. Limpeza e expiação dos pecados e poluição interior (Hb 1.3).
THAYER.en: The act of purifying or cleansing, whether from ritual and cultic impurities, or from the moral and spiritual pollution of sin. 1. Ritual purification or ablution from impurities (John 2:6). | 2. Cleansing and expiation of sins and inner pollution (Heb 1:3).

DEFINITION: Quality of being free from physical impurities, ritual contamination, or moral blame, denoting integrity and holiness.
SENSES: 1. Free from material impurities or contamination, clean (John 13:10).
2. Cultically or ritually pure before the law (Rom 14:20).
3. Pure in heart, free from moral blame and sin (Matt 5:8).

THAYER.pt: Qualidade de estar livre de impurezas físicas, contaminação ritual ou culpa moral, denotando integridade e santidade. 1. Livre de impurezas materiais ou contaminação, limpo (Jo 13.10). | 2. Culticamente ou ritualmente puro perante a lei (Rm 14.20). | 3. Puro de coração, isento de culpa moral e pecado (Mt 5.8).
THAYER.en: Quality of being free from physical impurities, ritual contamination, or moral blame, denoting integrity and holiness. 1. Free from material impurities or contamination, clean (John 13:10). | 2. Cultically or ritually pure before the law (Rom 14:20). | 3. Pure in heart, free from moral blame and sin (Matt 5:8).

DEFINITION: The state or condition of being ritually clean and purified from contamination.
SENSES: 1. Ritual or ceremonial purity (Heb 9:13).

THAYER.pt: O estado ou condição de estar ritualmente limpo e purificado de contaminação. 1. Pureza ritual ou ceremonial (Hb 9.13).
THAYER.en: The state or condition of being ritually clean and purified from contamination. 1. Ritual or ceremonial purity (Heb 9:13).

DEFINITION: A seat or chair used for sitting, employed in the New Testament in a figurative sense for the position of doctrinal authority.
SENSES: 1. A physical chair or seat, associated in gospel literature with the authority of the scribes and Pharisees (Matt 23:2).

THAYER.pt: Assento ou cadeira utilizada para sentar-se, empregada no Novo Testamento em sentido figurado para a posição de autoridade doutrinária. 1. Cadeira ou assento físico, associado na literatura evangélica à autoridade dos escribas e fariseus (Mt 23.2).
THAYER.en: A seat or chair used for sitting, employed in the New Testament in a figurative sense for the position of doctrinal authority. 1. A physical chair or seat, associated in gospel literature with the authority of the scribes and Pharisees (Matt 23:2).

DEFINITION: Indicates the action of taking a seated position or the state of being at rest while seated.
SENSES: 1. To be seated or take a seated place (Matt 26:55; John 4:6).

THAYER.pt: Indica a ação de tomar uma posição sentada ou o estado de estar em repouso sentado. 1. Estar sentado ou tomar um lugar sentado (Mt 26.55; Jo 4.6).
THAYER.en: Indicates the action of taking a seated position or the state of being at rest while seated. 1. To be seated or take a seated place (Matt 26:55; John 4:6).

DEFINITION: Indicates an ordered succession of events, actions, or things, whether in time, space, or logical sequence.
SENSES: 1. Successively or in chronological and logical order, one after another (Acts 18:23).

THAYER.pt: Indica uma sucessão ordenada de eventos, ações ou coisas, seja no tempo, no espaço ou em uma sequência lógica. 1. De maneira sucessiva ou em ordem cronológica e lógica, um após o outro (At 18.23).
THAYER.en: Indicates an ordered succession of events, actions, or things, whether in time, space, or logical sequence. 1. Successively or in chronological and logical order, one after another (Acts 18:23).

DEFINITION: To be in the physiological resting state of sleep. It is also used metaphorically for spiritual apathy or as a Christian euphemism for biological death.
SENSES: 1. To sleep normal physical sleep (Matt 8:24; Mark 4:27).
2. To be spiritually dormant or careless (Eph 5:14; 1 Thess 5:6).
3. Euphemism for death (Matt 9:24; 1 Thess 5:10).

THAYER.pt: Estar no estado de repouso fisiológico do sono. Empregase também de modo metafórico para apatia espiritual ou como eufemismo cristão para a morte biológica. 1. Dormir sono físico normal (Mt 8.24; Mc 4.27). | 2. Estar espiritualmente dormente ou descuidado (Ef 5.14; 1Ts 5.6). | 3. Eufemismo para a morte (Mt 9.24; 1Ts 5.10).
THAYER.en: To be in the physiological resting state of sleep. It is also used metaphorically for spiritual apathy or as a Christian euphemism for biological death. 1. To sleep normal physical sleep (Matt 8:24; Mark 4:27). | 2. To be spiritually dormant or careless (Eph 5:14; 1 Thess 5:6). | 3. Euphemism for death (Matt 9:24; 1 Thess 5:10).

DEFINITION: One who provides instruction, intellectual leadership, or spiritual guidance.
SENSES: 1. Master or spiritual guide, a title applied exclusively to Christ (Matt 23:10).

THAYER.pt: Aquele que provê instrução, liderança intelectual ou orientação espiritual. 1. Mestre ou guia espiritual, título aplicado exclusivamente a Cristo (Mt 23.10).
THAYER.en: One who provides instruction, intellectual leadership, or spiritual guidance. 1. Master or spiritual guide, a title applied exclusively to Christ (Matt 23:10).

DEFINITION: To be suitable, appropriate, or morally required by the circumstances.
SENSES: 1. What is appropriate or due (Acts 22:22);
2. What is morally fitting or improper (Rom 1:28).

THAYER.pt: Ser adequado, apropriado ou moralmente exigido pelas circunstâncias. 1. O que é apropriado ou devido (At 22.22); | 2. O que é moralmente conveniente ou impróprio (Rm 1.28).
THAYER.en: To be suitable, appropriate, or morally required by the circumstances. 1. What is appropriate or due (Acts 22:22); | 2. What is morally fitting or improper (Rom 1:28).

SHORT_GLOSS: to sit, to be seated, to reside
DEFINITION: To adopt or remain in a seated posture for resting, teaching, or judging. In a broad sense and of Semitic origin, it can indicate residing or dwelling in a given place.
SENSES: 1. To be seated, to sit down (Mt 9.9; 26.69; Lk 10.13).
2. To be enthroned in sovereign majesty or a judgment seat (Mt 22.44; Re 4.2).
3. To reside, to dwell, or to remain (Mt 4.16; Lk 1.79).
USAGE: to sit, to be seated, to reside

THAYER.pt: Adotar ou permanecer na postura sentada para descansar, lecionar ou julgar. Em sentido amplo e de origem semítica, pode indicar residir ou habitar em um dado lugar. 1. Estar assentado, sentar-se (Mt 9.9; 26.69; Lc 10.13). | 2. Estar entronizado em majestade soberana ou tribunal de juízo (Mt 22.44; Ap 4.2). | 3. Residir, habitar ou permanecer (Mt 4.16; Lc 1.79).
THAYER.en: To adopt or remain in a seated posture for resting, teaching, or judging. In a broad sense and of Semitic origin, it can indicate residing or dwelling in a given place. 1. To be seated, to sit down (Mt 9.9; 26.69; Lk 10.13). | 2. To be enthroned in sovereign majesty or a judgment seat (Mt 22.44; Re 4.2). | 3. To reside, to dwell, or to remain (Mt 4.16; Lk 1.79).

DEFINITION: Describes something that occurs or repeats daily, forming part of the daily routine in the New Testament.
SENSES: 1. Pertaining to daily life or daily provision (Acts 6:1).

THAYER.pt: Descreve algo que ocorre ou se repete diariamente, fazendo parte da rotina de cada dia no Novo Testamento. 1. Pertencente ao dia a dia ou suprimento diário (At 6.1).
THAYER.en: Describes something that occurs or repeats daily, forming part of the daily routine in the New Testament. 1. Pertaining to daily life or daily provision (Acts 6:1).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: καθίσω, Aor: ἐκάθισα, Perf: κεκάθικα
DEFINITION: Used both intransitively (to assume or be in a sitting position, to dwell) and transitively (to cause someone to sit, to install in a throne of dignity or judgment).
SENSES: 1. To sit down, take a seat (Matt 5:1; 26:55; John 19:13).
2. To cause to sit, to install in a royal office or position of honor (Acts 2:30; Eph 1:20).
3. To remain, reside, or stay in a place (Luke 24:49; Acts 18:11).

THAYER.pt: Usado tanto de modo intransitivo (assumir ou estar na posição sentada, habitar) quanto transitivo (fazer alguém sentar-se, empossar em trono de dignidade ou juízo). 1. Sentar-se, tomar assento (Mt 5.1; 26.55; Jo 19.13). | 2. Fazer sentar, empossar em função régia ou magistratura de honra (At 2.30; Ef 1.20). | 3. Permanecer, residir ou hospedar-se num lugar (Lc 24.49; At 18.11).
THAYER.en: Used both intransitively (to assume or be in a sitting position, to dwell) and transitively (to cause someone to sit, to install in a throne of dignity or judgment). 1. To sit down, take a seat (Matt 5:1; 26:55; John 19:13). | 2. To cause to sit, to install in a royal office or position of honor (Acts 2:30; Eph 1:20). | 3. To remain, reside, or stay in a place (Luke 24:49; Acts 18:11).

DEFINITION: The act of lowering something or someone, usually by using ropes or through upper openings.
SENSES: 1. To lower someone through an opening or by ropes (Luke 5:19; Acts 9:25).

THAYER.pt: O ato de soltar algo ou alguém para baixo, geralmente utilizando cordas ou aberturas superiores. 1. Descer alguém por uma abertura ou cordas (Lc 5.19; At 9.25).
THAYER.en: The act of lowering something or someone, usually by using ropes or through upper openings. 1. To lower someone through an opening or by ropes (Luke 5:19; Acts 9:25).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: καταστήσω, Aor: κατέστησα, Aor. Pass: κατεστάθην
DEFINITION: To invest someone with an office, authority, or public function; to establish. It can also mean to lead someone to a place or to cause someone to become something.
SENSES: 1. To appoint, designate, or constitute for an office (Matt 24:45; Titus 1:5; Heb 5:1).
2. To cause someone to be or become something (Rom 5:19; 2 Pet 1:8).
3. To lead or escort someone to a specific destination (Acts 17:15).

THAYER.pt: Investir alguém em cargo, autoridade ou função pública; estabelecer. Pode também significar conduzir alguém a um local ou fazer com que alguém se torne algo. 1. Nomear, designar, constituir para um ofício (Mt 24.45; Tt 1.5; Hb 5.1). | 2. Fazer com que alguém seja ou se torne algo (Rm 5.19; 2Pe 1.8). | 3. Conduzir ou escoltar alguém até determinado destino (At 17.15).
THAYER.en: To invest someone with an office, authority, or public function; to establish. It can also mean to lead someone to a place or to cause someone to become something. 1. To appoint, designate, or constitute for an office (Matt 24:45; Titus 1:5; Heb 5:1). | 2. To cause someone to be or become something (Rom 5:19; 2 Pet 1:8). | 3. To lead or escort someone to a specific destination (Acts 17:15).

DEFINITION: A particle that establishes a comparison of similarity or proportional degree between events and circumstances.
SENSES: 1. Just as or in the manner that (Rom 8:26).
2. Insofar as or in proportion to (2 Cor 8:12; 1 Pet 4:13).

THAYER.pt: Partícula que estabelece comparação de similaridade ou grau proporcional entre eventos e circunstâncias. 1. Assim como ou da maneira que (Rm 8.26). | 2. Na medida em que ou proporcionalmente a (2Co 8.12; 1Pe 4.13).
THAYER.en: A particle that establishes a comparison of similarity or proportional degree between events and circumstances. 1. Just as or in the manner that (Rom 8:26). | 2. Insofar as or in proportion to (2 Cor 8:12; 1 Pet 4:13).

DEFINITION: Indicates a complete extent or totality, often used with negation to mean 'not at all' or 'absolutely not'.
SENSES: 1. Completely, entirely, or in an absolute manner (Acts 4:18).

THAYER.pt: Indica uma extensão completa ou totalidade, frequentemente usado com negação para significar 'de modo algum' ou 'absolutamente não'. 1. Por completo, inteiramente ou de forma absoluta (At 4.18).
THAYER.en: Indicates a complete extent or totality, often used with negation to mean 'not at all' or 'absolutely not'. 1. Completely, entirely, or in an absolute manner (Acts 4:18).

DEFINITION: Means to equip entirely with weapons or to provide military apparatus for defense or combat.
SENSES: 1. To arm oneself completely with physical or spiritual weapons (Luke 11:21).

THAYER.pt: Significa equipar inteiramente com armas ou providenciar aparato militar para defesa ou combate. 1. Armar-se completamente com armas físicas ou espirituais (Lc 11.21).
THAYER.en: Means to equip entirely with weapons or to provide military apparatus for defense or combat. 1. To arm oneself completely with physical or spiritual weapons (Luke 11:21).

DEFINITION: Refers to the act of seeing with clarity, contemplating, or discerning in a profound and perceptive manner.
SENSES: 1. To discern or perceive clearly through observation (Rom 1:20).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se ao ato de ver com clareza, contemplar ou discernir de maneira profunda e perceptiva. 1. Discernir ou perceber claramente através da observação (Rm 1.20).
THAYER.en: Refers to the act of seeing with clarity, contemplating, or discerning in a profound and perceptive manner. 1. To discern or perceive clearly through observation (Rom 1:20).

DEFINITION: A conjunction or adverb that indicates proportion (insofar as) or cause and justification (since, because).
SENSES: 1. In accordance with the degree or proportion of something (Acts 2:45).
2. Because of or since (Luke 1:7; 19:9).

THAYER.pt: Conjunção ou advérbio que indica proporção (na medida em que) ou causa e justificativa (visto que, porque). 1. Em conformidade com o grau ou proporção de algo (At 2.45). | 2. Em razão de ou visto que (Lc 1.7; 19.9).
THAYER.en: A conjunction or adverb that indicates proportion (insofar as) or cause and justification (since, because). 1. In accordance with the degree or proportion of something (Acts 2:45). | 2. Because of or since (Luke 1:7; 19:9).

SHORT_GLOSS: just as, according to, even as
DEFINITION: A comparative adverbial conjunction formed by the fusion of κατά and ὡς, used to attest exact correspondence of manner, analogy, proportion, or substantial conformity to a predetermined or prophetic standard.
SENSES: 1. In a comparative manner: 'just as', 'in the same way that' (Matt 21:6; Luke 11:30).
2. In accordance with what was said or determined: 'according to', 'as' (John 14:31; 1 Cor 1:31).
3. Causal or temporal: 'since', 'as' (1 Cor 1:6; Eph 1:4).
USAGE: just as, according to, even as

THAYER.pt: Conjunção adverbial comparativa formada pela fusão de κατά e ὡς, usada para atestar correspondência exata de modo, analogia, proporção ou conformidade substancial a um padrão predeterminado ou profético. 1. De maneira comparativa: 'assim como', 'do mesmo modo que' (Mt 21.6; Lc 11.30). | 2. Em conformidade com o que foi dito ou determinado: 'conforme', 'segundo' (Jo 14.31; 1Co 1.31). | 3. Causal ou temporal: 'visto que', 'à medida que' (1Co 1.6; Ef 1.4).
THAYER.en: A comparative adverbial conjunction formed by the fusion of κατά and ὡς, used to attest exact correspondence of manner, analogy, proportion, or substantial conformity to a predetermined or prophetic standard. 1. In a comparative manner: 'just as', 'in the same way that' (Matt 21:6; Luke 11:30). | 2. In accordance with what was said or determined: 'according to', 'as' (John 14:31; 1 Cor 1:31). | 3. Causal or temporal: 'since', 'as' (1 Cor 1:6; Eph 1:4).

DEFINITION: The fundamental copulative conjunction of Greek, used to coordinate terms, clauses, and narrative sequences. It frequently assumes an emphatic additive value ('also', 'even') or an explanatory one.
SENSES: 1. Simple additive coordinating conjunction ('and') (Matt 1:2; John 1:1).
2. Emphatic or ascensive value ('also', 'even') (Matt 5:39; Luke 10:37).
3. Epexegetical or explanatory function ('that is', 'namely') (Eph 1:3; Gal 6:16).

THAYER.pt: Conjunção copulativa fundamental do grego, empregada para coordenar termos, orações e sequências narrativas. Assume frequentemente valor aditivo enfático ('também', 'inclusive') ou explicativo. 1. Conjunção coordenativa aditiva simples ('e') (Mt 1.2; Jo 1.1). | 2. Valor enfático ou ascensivo ('também', 'até', 'mesmo') (Mt 5.39; Lk 10.37). | 3. Função epexegética ou explicativa ('isto é', 'a saber') (Ef 1.3; Gl 6.16).
THAYER.en: The fundamental copulative conjunction of Greek, used to coordinate terms, clauses, and narrative sequences. It frequently assumes an emphatic additive value ('also', 'even') or an explanatory one. 1. Simple additive coordinating conjunction ('and') (Matt 1:2; John 1:1). | 2. Emphatic or ascensive value ('also', 'even') (Matt 5:39; Luke 10:37). | 3. Epexegetical or explanatory function ('that is', 'namely') (Eph 1:3; Gal 6:16).

DEFINITION: Jewish high priest who held office between 18 and 36 AD and played a central role in the trial and condemnation of Jesus.
SENSES: 1. Caiaphas, the high priest (Matt 26:3; John 11:49).

THAYER.pt: Sumosacerdote judeu que exerceu o cargo entre 18 e 36 d.C. e teve papel central no julgamento e condenação de Jesus. 1. Caifás, o sumo sacerdote (Mt 26.3; Jo 11.49).
THAYER.en: Jewish high priest who held office between 18 and 36 AD and played a central role in the trial and condemnation of Jesus. 1. Caiaphas, the high priest (Matt 26:3; John 11:49).

DEFINITION: An intensifying particle that combines conjunction and emphasis to highlight an additional element in the sentence.
SENSES: 1. To add strong emphasis to a statement or progressive argument.

THAYER.pt: Partícula intensificadora que combina conjunção e ênfase para realçar um elemento adicional na frase. 1. Adicionar forte ênfase a uma afirmação ou argumento progressivo.
THAYER.en: An intensifying particle that combines conjunction and emphasis to highlight an additional element in the sentence. 1. To add strong emphasis to a statement or progressive argument.

DEFINITION: The first son of Adam and Eve, known for his disobedience and for murdering his brother Abel.
SENSES: 1. Cain, the firstborn of Adam, cited as an example of evil works and lack of faith (Heb 11:4; 1 John 3:12).

THAYER.pt: O primeiro filho de Adão e Eva, conhecido por sua desobediência e por assassinar seu irmão Abel. 1. Caim, o primogênito de Adão, citado como exemplo de obras más e falta de fé (Hb 11.4; 1Jo 3.12).
THAYER.en: The first son of Adam and Eve, known for his disobedience and for murdering his brother Abel. 1. Cain, the firstborn of Adam, cited as an example of evil works and lack of faith (Heb 11:4; 1 John 3:12).

DEFINITION: A masculine proper name that appears in the genealogies of Jesus in the New Testament, referring to one of the ancestors.
SENSES: 1. Ancestor of Jesus in the lineage described in the Gospel of Luke (Luke 3:36-37).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio masculino que aparece nas genealogias de Jesus no Novo Testamento, referindo-se a um dos antepassados. 1. Antepassado de Jesus na linhagem descrita no Evangelho de Lucas (Lc 3:36,37).
THAYER.en: A masculine proper name that appears in the genealogies of Jesus in the New Testament, referring to one of the ancestors. 1. Ancestor of Jesus in the lineage described in the Gospel of Luke (Luke 3:36-37).

DEFINITION: Possessing the quality of newness, whether by having been made recently or by being superior and different from the old.
SENSES: 1. New in terms of existence or recent use, not used before (Matt 9:17; 27:60).
2. New in quality, character, or nature, previously unknown and admirable (Mark 1:27; 2 Cor 5:17).

THAYER.pt: Que possui a qualidade de novidade, seja por ter sido feito recentemente ou por ser superior e diferente do antigo. 1. Novo quanto à existência ou ao uso recente, não usado antes (Mt 9.17; 27.60). | 2. Novo em qualidade, caráter ou natureza, anteriormente desconhecido e admirável (Mc 1.27; 2Co 5.17).
THAYER.en: Possessing the quality of newness, whether by having been made recently or by being superior and different from the old. 1. New in terms of existence or recent use, not used before (Matt 9:17; 27:60). | 2. New in quality, character, or nature, previously unknown and admirable (Mark 1:27; 2 Cor 5:17).

DEFINITION: The state or condition of being new, with the connotation of something extraordinary, fresh, and spiritually transformed.
SENSES: 1. The state of newness of life granted to believers in Christ (Rom 6:4).
2. The new condition of serving God in the Spirit (Rom 7:6).

THAYER.pt: O estado ou condição de ser novo, com a conotação de algo extraordinário, fresco e espiritualmente transformado. 1. O estado de novidade de vida concedido aos crentes em Cristo (Rm 6:4). | 2. A nova condição de servir a Deus no Espírito (Rm 7:6).
THAYER.en: The state or condition of being new, with the connotation of something extraordinary, fresh, and spiritually transformed. 1. The state of newness of life granted to believers in Christ (Rom 6:4). | 2. The new condition of serving God in the Spirit (Rom 7:6).

DEFINITION: An emphatic concessive particle used to introduce a subordinate clause that expresses a fact contrary to the expectation generated by the main clause.
SENSES: 1. Concessive conjunction denoting unexpected opposition, translated as 'although' or 'even though' (Phil 3:4; Heb 5:8; 2 Pet 1:12).

THAYER.pt: Partícula concessiva enfática usada para introduzir uma oração subordinada que expressa um fato contrário à expectativa gerada pela oração principal. 1. Conjunção concessiva que denota oposição inesperada, traduzida como 'embora' ou 'ainda que' (Fp 3.4; Hb 5.8; 2Pe 1.12).
THAYER.en: An emphatic concessive particle used to introduce a subordinate clause that expresses a fact contrary to the expectation generated by the main clause. 1. Concessive conjunction denoting unexpected opposition, translated as 'although' or 'even though' (Phil 3:4; Heb 5:8; 2 Pet 1:12).

DEFINITION: Refers to qualitative time, that is, a propitious epoch, a determined moment, or a favorable season designated in divine plans, in contrast to simple chronological succession.
SENSES: 1. Appropriate moment, decisive epoch, or favorable opportunity (Rom 13:11; 2 Cor 6:2).
2. Determined, fixed, or established time for certain events (Matt 13:30; Luke 21:24).
3. Period characterized by crisis or particular aspects of the present age (Matt 11:25; 2 Tim 3:1).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se ao tempo qualitativo, ou seja, uma época propícia, momento determinado ou estação favorável designada nos planos divinos, em contraste com a simples sucessão cronológica. 1. Momento adequado, época decisiva ou oportunidade favorável (Rm 13.11; 2Co 6.2). | 2. Tempo determinado, fixado ou estabelecido para certos acontecimentos (Mt 13.30; Lk 21.24). | 3. Período caracterizado por crise ou aspectos particulares da presente época (Mt 11.25; 2Tm 3.1).
THAYER.en: Refers to qualitative time, that is, a propitious epoch, a determined moment, or a favorable season designated in divine plans, in contrast to simple chronological succession. 1. Appropriate moment, decisive epoch, or favorable opportunity (Rom 13:11; 2 Cor 6:2). | 2. Determined, fixed, or established time for certain events (Matt 13:30; Luke 21:24). | 3. Period characterized by crisis or particular aspects of the present age (Matt 11:25; 2 Tim 3:1).

DEFINITION: Roman family name originating from Julius Caesar, later adopted as an official title by Roman emperors.
SENSES: 1. The reigning Roman emperor (Matt 22:21; John 19:12).

THAYER.pt: Nome de família romano originado de Júlio César, posteriormente adotado como título oficial pelos imperadores romanos. 1. O imperador romano reinante (Mt 22:21; Jo 19:12).
THAYER.en: Roman family name originating from Julius Caesar, later adopted as an official title by Roman emperors. 1. The reigning Roman emperor (Matt 22:21; John 19:12).

DEFINITION: The proper name of two important cities in the region of Palestine during the New Testament period: Caesarea Maritima, the seat of the Roman procurators, and Caesarea Philippi, located at the foot of Mount Hermon.
SENSES: 1. Caesarea Maritima, a port city on the Mediterranean Sea (Acts 8:40; 10:1).
2. Caesarea Philippi, a city in northern Judea, near the sources of the Jordan (Matt 16:13).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio de duas importantes cidades na região da Palestina durante o período do Novo Testamento: Cesareia Marítima, sede dos procuradores romanos, e Cesareia de Filipe, situada ao pé do monte Hermon. 1. Cesareia Marítima, cidade portuária no mar Mediterrâneo (At 8.40; 10.1). | 2. Cesareia de Filipe, cidade ao norte da Judeia, próxima às nascentes do Jordão (Mt 16.13).
THAYER.en: The proper name of two important cities in the region of Palestine during the New Testament period: Caesarea Maritima, the seat of the Roman procurators, and Caesarea Philippi, located at the foot of Mount Hermon. 1. Caesarea Maritima, a port city on the Mediterranean Sea (Acts 8:40; 10:1). | 2. Caesarea Philippi, a city in northern Judea, near the sources of the Jordan (Matt 16:13).

DEFINITION: A concessive conjunction used to introduce a clause that contrasts with the main clause, meaning 'even if' or 'nevertheless'.
SENSES: 1. Indicator of concession with a contrastive component (Heb 4:3).

THAYER.pt: Conjunção concessiva utilizada para introduzir uma cláusula que contrasta com a principal, significando 'ainda que' ou 'contudo'. 1. Indicador de concessão com componente de contraste (Hb 4:3).
THAYER.en: A concessive conjunction used to introduce a clause that contrasts with the main clause, meaning 'even if' or 'nevertheless'. 1. Indicator of concession with a contrastive component (Heb 4:3).

DEFINITION: An emphatic concessive particle that introduces a reservation or strong contrast in relation to the previous argument.
SENSES: 1. Indicator of concession and contrast, translated as 'even if' or 'although'.

THAYER.pt: Partícula concessiva enfática que introduz uma ressalva ou contraste forte em relação ao argumento anterior. 1. Indicador de concessão e contraste, traduzido por 'ainda que' ou 'embora'.
THAYER.en: An emphatic concessive particle that introduces a reservation or strong contrast in relation to the previous argument. 1. Indicator of concession and contrast, translated as 'even if' or 'although'.

SHORT_GLOSS: to burn, to light, to kindle
DEFINITION: To cause combustion, to light a flame, or to keep something in a state of fire and incandescence.
SENSES: 1. To light or keep a lamp burning (Matt 5:15; Luke 12:35).
2. The figurative burning of the human heart under the impact of divine revelation (Luke 24:32).
USAGE: to burn, to light, to kindle

THAYER.pt: Causar combustão, acender uma chama ou manter algo em estado de fogo e incandescência. 1. Acender ou manter uma lâmpada acesa (Mt 5:15; Lc 12:35). | 2. O arder figurado do coração humano sob o impacto da revelação divina (Lc 24:32).
THAYER.en: To cause combustion, to light a flame, or to keep something in a state of fire and incandescence. 1. To light or keep a lamp burning (Matt 5:15; Luke 12:35). | 2. The figurative burning of the human heart under the impact of divine revelation (Luke 24:32).

DEFINITION: A combined form indicating the addition of a new location to the narrative setting, meaning 'and there' or 'also there'.
SENSES: 1. Indication of an additional and simultaneous location (Matt 5:23).

THAYER.pt: Forma combinada que indica a adição de um novo local ao cenário narrativo, significando 'e ali' ou 'também lá'. 1. Indicação de localização adicional e simultânea (Mt 5.23).
THAYER.en: A combined form indicating the addition of a new location to the narrative setting, meaning 'and there' or 'also there'. 1. Indication of an additional and simultaneous location (Matt 5:23).

DEFINITION: A correlative expression denoting the continuity of a journey from a previous point or the temporal succession of an event.
SENSES: 1. Physical departure from one place to another, and from there (Mark 9:30).
2. Subsequent temporal sequence, and then (Acts 13:21).

THAYER.pt: Expressão correlativa que denota a continuidade de uma jornada a partir de um ponto anterior ou a sucessão temporal de um evento. 1. Partida física de um lugar para outro, e dali (Mc 9.30). | 2. Sequência temporal subsequente, e então (At 13.21).
THAYER.en: A correlative expression denoting the continuity of a journey from a previous point or the temporal succession of an event. 1. Physical departure from one place to another, and from there (Mark 9:30). | 2. Subsequent temporal sequence, and then (Acts 13:21).

SHORT_GLOSS: and that one, he also, also that one
DEFINITION: A fusion by crasis of the conjunction καί with the demonstrative ἐκεῖνος, serving to refer to a distant or previously mentioned entity, highlighting it.
SENSES: 1. And that one, also that one, he also (Matt 15:18; John 10:16).
2. Distinction between elements: the first... and also the second (Luke 11:42).
USAGE: and that one, he also, also that one

THAYER.pt: Fusão por crase da conjunção καί com o demonstrativo ἐκεῖνος, servindo para referir-se a uma entidade distante ou já mencionada, ressaltando-a. 1. E aquele, também aquele, ele também (Mt 15.18; Jo 10.16). | 2. Distinção entre elementos: o primeiro... e também o segundo (Lc 11.42).
THAYER.en: A fusion by crasis of the conjunction καί with the demonstrative ἐκεῖνος, serving to refer to a distant or previously mentioned entity, highlighting it. 1. And that one, also that one, he also (Matt 15:18; John 10:16). | 2. Distinction between elements: the first... and also the second (Luke 11:42).

DEFINITION: The moral quality of depravity or inner inclination toward evil, manifested in attitudes harmful to others.
SENSES: 1. General perversity or depravity of character (Acts 8:22; Jas 1:21).
2. Intentional malice and ill-disposed nature against others (Eph 4:31).
3. Severe difficulty or circumstantial tribulation (Matt 6:34).

THAYER.pt: Qualidade moral de depravação ou inclinação interior para o mal, manifestada em atitudes nocivas ao próximo. 1. Perversidade geral ou depravação de caráter (At 8:22; Tg 1:21). | 2. Malícia intencional e disposição mal-intencionada contra terceiros (Ef 4:31). | 3. Dificuldade severa ou tribulação circunstancial (Mt 6:34).
THAYER.en: The moral quality of depravity or inner inclination toward evil, manifested in attitudes harmful to others. 1. General perversity or depravity of character (Acts 8:22; Jas 1:21). | 2. Intentional malice and ill-disposed nature against others (Eph 4:31). | 3. Severe difficulty or circumstantial tribulation (Matt 6:34).

DEFINITION: An inner malignant and wicked disposition that leads someone to act with perversity and the intention to harm others.
SENSES: 1. Inclination toward evil, malevolence, or an evil spirit (Rom 1:29).

THAYER.pt: Disposição interior maligna e maldosa que leva alguém a agir com perversidade e intenção de ferir os outros. 1. Inclinação para o mal, malevolência ou espírito maligno (Rm 1.29).
THAYER.en: An inner malignant and wicked disposition that leads someone to act with perversity and the intention to harm others. 1. Inclination toward evil, malevolence, or an evil spirit (Rom 1:29).

DEFINITION: To speak ill of someone with strong hostility, uttering insults, slander, or unjustified curses.
SENSES: 1. To mistreat verbally, revile, or curse (Matt 15:4; Mark 9:39).

THAYER.pt: Falar mal de alguém com forte hostilidade, proferindo insultos, calúnias ou maldições injustificadas. 1. Maltratar verbalmente, injuriar ou amaldiçoar (Mt 15.4; Mc 9.39).
THAYER.en: To speak ill of someone with strong hostility, uttering insults, slander, or unjustified curses. 1. To mistreat verbally, revile, or curse (Matt 15:4; Mark 9:39).

DEFINITION: The state of experiencing pain, physical afflictions, or severe difficulties along life's journey.
SENSES: 1. The experience of affliction, enduring the pains and hardships of life.

THAYER.pt: Estado de vivenciar dores, aflições físicas ou severas dificuldades ao longo da jornada. 1. Vivência de aflição, suportando dores e agruras da vida.
THAYER.en: The state of experiencing pain, physical afflictions, or severe difficulties along life's journey. 1. The experience of affliction, enduring the pains and hardships of life.

DEFINITION: To experience adversity, pains, difficulties, or to endure mistreatment and deprivation with patience.
SENSES: 1. To go through afflictions, distress, or physical sufferings (2 Tim 2:9; Jas 5:13).
2. To endure hardships and toil with patience and perseverance (2 Tim 4:5).

THAYER.pt: Experimentar adversidades, dores, dificuldades ou suportar maus tratos e privações com paciência. 1. Passar por aflições, angústias ou sofrimentos físicos (2Tm 2.9; Tg 5.13). | 2. Suportar dificuldades e fadigas com paciência e perseverança (2Tm 4.5).
THAYER.en: To experience adversity, pains, difficulties, or to endure mistreatment and deprivation with patience. 1. To go through afflictions, distress, or physical sufferings (2 Tim 2:9; Jas 5:13). | 2. To endure hardships and toil with patience and perseverance (2 Tim 4:5).

DEFINITION: To practice morally wrong or criminal actions, or to cause physical harm and suffering to other people.
SENSES: 1. To commit evil or act improperly (1 Pet 3:17).
2. To cause harm or injure someone.

THAYER.pt: Praticar ações moralmente erradas, criminosas ou causar danos físicos e sofrimento a outras pessoas. 1. Cometer o mal ou agir indevidamente (1Pe 3.17). | 2. Causar prejuízo ou ferir alguém.
THAYER.en: To practice morally wrong or criminal actions, or to cause physical harm and suffering to other people. 1. To commit evil or act improperly (1 Pet 3:17). | 2. To cause harm or injure someone.

DEFINITION: One who practices evil or acts contrary to moral and civil laws; an evildoer.
SENSES: 1. One who commits crimes or iniquitous practices, a criminal (John 18:30; 1 Pet 2:12).

THAYER.pt: Que pratica o mal ou age contrariamente às leis morais e civis; malfeitor. 1. Aquele que comete crimes ou práticas iníquas, criminoso (Jo 18.30; 1Pe 2.12).
THAYER.en: One who practices evil or acts contrary to moral and civil laws; an evildoer. 1. One who commits crimes or iniquitous practices, a criminal (John 18:30; 1 Pet 2:12).

DEFINITION: Qualifies that which is morally depraved, reprehensible, perverted, or that which causes injury, affliction, and severe damage to another.
SENSES: 1. Morally perverse, sinful, or corrupt (Matt 24:48; 1 Tim 6:10; 1 Pet 3:10).
2. Substantival neuter (τὸ κακόν): evil, iniquity, ethical harm (Rom 12:17; Rom 13:4; Matt 27:23).
3. Noxious, dangerous, destructive, or bringing physical misfortune (Rev 16:2).

THAYER.pt: Qualifica o que é moralmente depravado, reprovável, perverso ou o que provoca prejuízo, aflição e danos severos a outrem. 1. Moralmente perverso, pecaminoso ou corrupto (Mt 24.48; 1Tm 6.10; 1Pe 3.10). | 2. Neutro substantivado (τὸ κακόν): o mal, iniquidade, dano ético (Rm 12.17; Rm 13.4; Mt 27.23). | 3. Nocivo, perigoso, destrutivo ou que traz desgraça física (Ap 16.2).
THAYER.en: Qualifies that which is morally depraved, reprehensible, perverted, or that which causes injury, affliction, and severe damage to another. 1. Morally perverse, sinful, or corrupt (Matt 24:48; 1 Tim 6:10; 1 Pet 3:10). | 2. Substantival neuter (τὸ κακόν): evil, iniquity, ethical harm (Rom 12:17; Rom 13:4; Matt 27:23). | 3. Noxious, dangerous, destructive, or bringing physical misfortune (Rev 16:2).

DEFINITION: Refers to someone who commits serious crimes or severe infractions, usually translated as criminal or evildoer in the New Testament.
SENSES: 1. A criminal or evildoer executed or condemned alongside Jesus (Luke 23:32-39).
2. A person treated as a criminal because of their association with the faith (2 Tim 2:9).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se a alguém que comete crimes graves ou infrações severas, sendo habitualmente traduzido como criminoso ou malfeitor no Novo Testamento. 1. Criminoso ou malfeitor executado ou condenado junto a Jesus (Lc 23.32-39). | 2. Pessoa tratada como criminoso por causa de sua associação com a fé (2Tm 2.9).
THAYER.en: Refers to someone who commits serious crimes or severe infractions, usually translated as criminal or evildoer in the New Testament. 1. A criminal or evildoer executed or condemned alongside Jesus (Luke 23:32-39). | 2. A person treated as a criminal because of their association with the faith (2 Tim 2:9).

DEFINITION: To cause physical or moral suffering to someone, subjecting them to mistreatment or severe adversity.
SENSES: 1. To suffer mistreatment and persecution for the sake of the faith (Heb 11:37).
2. To empathize with those who suffer adversities (Heb 13:3).

THAYER.pt: Causar sofrimento físico ou moral a alguém, submetendo-o a maus-tratos ou severa adversidade. 1. Sofrer maus-tratos e perseguição por causa da fé (Hb 11:37). | 2. Solidarizar-se com os que sofrem adversidades (Hb 13:3).
THAYER.en: To cause physical or moral suffering to someone, subjecting them to mistreatment or severe adversity. 1. To suffer mistreatment and persecution for the sake of the faith (Heb 11:37). | 2. To empathize with those who suffer adversities (Heb 13:3).

DEFINITION: To cause physical harm, oppression, or suffering to someone, or to instigate hostility in the minds of others against someone.
SENSES: 1. To cause harm, injure, or mistreat severely (Acts 7:6; 12:1).
2. To poison someone's mind or attitude against another (Acts 14:2).

THAYER.pt: Causar dano físico, opressão ou sofrimento a alguém, ou instigar hostilidade na mente de terceiros contra outrem. 1. Causar dano, ferir ou maltratar severamente (At 7.6; 12.1). | 2. Envenenar a mente ou atitude de alguém contra outrem (At 14.2).
THAYER.en: To cause physical harm, oppression, or suffering to someone, or to instigate hostility in the minds of others against someone. 1. To cause harm, injure, or mistreat severely (Acts 7:6; 12:1). | 2. To poison someone's mind or attitude against another (Acts 14:2).

DEFINITION: Describes a condition of physical harm, illness, incorrect moral behavior, or severe suffering.
SENSES: 1. To be gravely ill or suffer severely (Matt 4:24; 17:15).
2. To act in a morally wrong or improper manner (John 18:23; Jas 4:3).

THAYER.pt: Descreve uma condição de dano físico, enfermidade, comportamento moral incorreto ou sofrimento severo. 1. Estar gravemente enfermo ou sofrer severamente (Mt 4.24; 17.15). | 2. Agir de maneira moralmente errada ou imprópria (Jo 18.23; Tg 4.3).
THAYER.en: Describes a condition of physical harm, illness, incorrect moral behavior, or severe suffering. 1. To be gravely ill or suffer severely (Matt 4:24; 17:15). | 2. To act in a morally wrong or improper manner (John 18:23; Jas 4:3).

DEFINITION: The act of inflicting harm, oppression, or severe suffering on someone.
SENSES: 1. The experience of mistreatment or oppressive subjugation (Acts 7:34).

THAYER.pt: Ato de infligir dano, opressão ou sofrimento severo a alguém. 1. Experiência de maus-tratos ou subjugação opressiva (At 7.34).
THAYER.en: The act of inflicting harm, oppression, or severe suffering on someone. 1. The experience of mistreatment or oppressive subjugation (Acts 7:34).

DEFINITION: The dry stalk of cereal plants remaining after harvest, used metaphorically as fragile and flammable material.
SENSES: 1. Straw or stubble of grain (1 Cor 3:12).

THAYER.pt: A haste seca dos cereais que sobra após a colheita, usada metaforicamente como material frágil e inflamável. 1. Palha ou restolho de grãos (1Co 3.12).
THAYER.en: The dry stalk of cereal plants remaining after harvest, used metaphorically as fragile and flammable material. 1. Straw or stubble of grain (1 Cor 3:12).

DEFINITION: An herbaceous plant with a long, hollow stem growing in damp places, whose dried stalks were cut for various uses, including staffs and writing instruments.
SENSES: 1. A reed or cane growing in marshy areas (Matt 12:20).
2. A stalk or staff used as a support or walking stick (Matt 27:29).
3. A sharp reed or rush used as a pen for writing (3 John 13).
