THAYER.pt: Planta herbácea de caule longo e oco que cresce em lugares úmidos, cujos caules secos eram cortados para diversos usos, incluindo varas e instrumentos de escrita. 1. Cana ou caniço que cresce em áreas pantanosas (Mt 12.20). | 2. Haste ou vara utilizada como suporte ou cajado (Mt 27.29). | 3. Cana ou junco afiado usado como pena para escrever (3Jo 13).
THAYER.en: An herbaceous plant with a long, hollow stem growing in damp places, whose dried stalks were cut for various uses, including staffs and writing instruments. 1. A reed or cane growing in marshy areas (Matt 12:20). | 2. A stalk or staff used as a support or walking stick (Matt 27:29). | 3. A sharp reed or rush used as a pen for writing (3 John 13).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: καλέσω, Aor: ἐκάλεσα, Perf: κέκληκα, Pass. Aor: ἐκλήθην
DEFINITION: Expresses a vocal utterance to summon someone, name a person, or invite to an event. In a theological context, it refers to God's effective and gracious call to discipleship, salvation, and service in the Kingdom.
SENSES: 1. To give a name to, identify by formal designation (Matt 1:21; Luke 1:13).
2. To call to oneself, summon formally (Matt 4:21; Acts 4:18).
3. To invite to a meal, wedding feast, or celebration (Matt 22:3; John 2:2).
4. Divine calling to communion with Christ and salvation (Rom 8:30; 1 Cor 1:9).

THAYER.pt: Expressa a emissão vocal para convocar alguém, nomear uma pessoa ou convidar para um evento. No contexto teológico, refere-se ao chamado eficaz e gracioso de Deus para o discipulado, a salvação e o serviço no Reino. 1. Dar nome a, identificar mediante designação formal (Mt 1.21; Lc 1.13). | 2. Chamar para si, convocar formalmente (Mt 4.21; At 4.18). | 3. Convidar para refeição, festa de casamento ou celebração (Mt 22.3; Jo 2.2). | 4. Vocação divina para a comunhão com Cristo e a salvação (Rm 8.30; 1Co 1.9).
THAYER.en: Expresses a vocal utterance to summon someone, name a person, or invite to an event. In a theological context, it refers to God's effective and gracious call to discipleship, salvation, and service in the Kingdom. 1. To give a name to, identify by formal designation (Matt 1:21; Luke 1:13). | 2. To call to oneself, summon formally (Matt 4:21; Acts 4:18). | 3. To invite to a meal, wedding feast, or celebration (Matt 22:3; John 2:2). | 4. Divine calling to communion with Christ and salvation (Rom 8:30; 1 Cor 1:9).

DEFINITION: The cultivated and productive olive tree, in contrast to the wild olive tree.
SENSES: 1. The true cultivated and fruitful olive tree (Rom 11:24).

THAYER.pt: A oliveira cultivada e produtiva, em contraste com a oliveira brava ou silvestre. 1. A verdadeira oliveira cultivada e frutífera (Rm 11.24).
THAYER.en: The cultivated and productive olive tree, in contrast to the wild olive tree. 1. The true cultivated and fruitful olive tree (Rom 11:24).

DEFINITION: Comparative form of an adverb denoting something superior, preferable, or done in an excellent manner.
SENSES: 1. In a superior way, very well, or preferably.

THAYER.pt: Forma comparativa de advérbio que denota algo superior, preferível ou feito de maneira excelente. 1. De maneira superior, muito bem ou preferivelmente.
THAYER.en: Comparative form of an adverb denoting something superior, preferable, or done in an excellent manner. 1. In a superior way, very well, or preferably.

SHORT_GLOSS: teacher of good, instructor of good
DEFINITION: One who instructs others in what is morally good, upright, and aligned with sound doctrine.
SENSES: 1. An instructor of moral principles and upright conduct (Titus 2:3).
USAGE: teacher of good, instructor of good

THAYER.pt: Aquele que instrui outros naquilo que é moralmente bom, reto e alinhado com a sã doutrina. 1. Instrutor de princípios morais e condutas retas (Tt 2.3).
THAYER.en: One who instructs others in what is morally good, upright, and aligned with sound doctrine. 1. An instructor of moral principles and upright conduct (Titus 2:3).

DEFINITION: Name of an anchorage located on the southern coast of the island of Crete, mentioned in the narrative of Paul's journey to Rome.
SENSES: 1. A bay and harbor on the southern coast of Crete (Acts 27:8).

THAYER.pt: Nome de um ancoradouro localizado na costa sul da ilha de Creta, mencionado na narrativa da viagem de Paulo a Roma. 1. Baía e porto na costa meridional de Creta (At 27.8).
THAYER.en: Name of an anchorage located on the southern coast of the island of Crete, mentioned in the narrative of Paul's journey to Rome. 1. A bay and harbor on the southern coast of Crete (Acts 27:8).

DEFINITION: To act in a right manner, producing positive and beneficial moral fruits for one's neighbor.
SENSES: 1. To practice noble, correct, and beneficial actions (2 Thess 3:13).

THAYER.pt: Agir de maneira correta, gerando frutos morais positivos e benéficos para o próximo. 1. Praticar ações nobres, corretas e benéficas (2Ts 3.13).
THAYER.en: To act in a right manner, producing positive and beneficial moral fruits for one's neighbor. 1. To practice noble, correct, and beneficial actions (2 Thess 3:13).

DEFINITION: Qualifies that which is intrinsically good, aesthetically pleasing, morally noble, exemplary, or fitting to its intended purpose. Emphasizes the outward beauty of virtue.
SENSES: 1. Morally excellent, admirable, exemplary, and noble (Matt 5:16; 1 Tim 3:1).
2. Suitable, profitable, and satisfying for a given task (Matt 13:8; John 10:11).
3. Appropriate, right, or convenient under given circumstances (Matt 17:4; 1 Cor 7:8).

THAYER.pt: Qualifica o que é intrinsecamente bom, esteticamente aprazível, moralmente nobre, exemplar ou conveniente à finalidade a que se destina. Enfatiza a beleza exteriorizada da virtude. 1. Moralmente excelente, admirável, exemplar e nobre (Mt 5.16; 1Tm 3.1). | 2. Adequado, proveitoso e satisfatório para uma dada tarefa (Mt 13.8; Jo 10.11). | 3. Apropriado, justo ou conveniente em dadas circunstâncias (Mt 17.4; 1Co 7.8).
THAYER.en: Qualifies that which is intrinsically good, aesthetically pleasing, morally noble, exemplary, or fitting to its intended purpose. Emphasizes the outward beauty of virtue. 1. Morally excellent, admirable, exemplary, and noble (Matt 5:16; 1 Tim 3:1). | 2. Suitable, profitable, and satisfying for a given task (Matt 13:8; John 10:11). | 3. Appropriate, right, or convenient under given circumstances (Matt 17:4; 1 Cor 7:8).

DEFINITION: Denotes a piece of fabric used to cover the head or face, also used metaphorically to indicate spiritual blindness or incomprehension.
SENSES: 1. A physical veil placed over the face, like the one used by Moses (2 Cor 3:13).
2. A metaphorical covering that prevents spiritual understanding of the old covenant (2 Cor 3:14).

THAYER.pt: Denota um pedaço de tecido usado para cobrir a cabeça ou o rosto, empregado também metaforicamente para indicar cegueira espiritual ou incompreensão. 1. Véu físico colocado sobre o rosto, como o usado por Moisés (2Co 3.13). | 2. Cobertura metafórica que impede a compreensão espiritual da antiga aliança (2Co 3.14).
THAYER.en: Denotes a piece of fabric used to cover the head or face, also used metaphorically to indicate spiritual blindness or incomprehension. 1. A physical veil placed over the face, like the one used by Moses (2 Cor 3:13). | 2. A metaphorical covering that prevents spiritual understanding of the old covenant (2 Cor 3:14).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: καλύψω, Aor: ἐκάλυψα, Perf.Pass: κεκαλυμμένος
DEFINITION: To place something over an object or person to hide it from view, or to hide information and cover up flaws in a moral sense.
SENSES: 1. To physically cover or hide from view (Matt 8:24; Luke 23:30).
2. To conceal transgressions or keep secret (Jas 5:20; 1 Pet 4:8).

THAYER.pt: Colocar algo sobre um objeto ou pessoa para ocultá-lo da vista, ou esconder uma informação e encobrir falhas em sentido moral. 1. Cobrir fisicamente ou ocultar da vista (Mt 8.24; Lc 23.30). | 2. Ocultar transgressões ou manter em segredo (Tg 5.20; 1Pe 4.8).
THAYER.en: To place something over an object or person to hide it from view, or to hide information and cover up flaws in a moral sense. 1. To physically cover or hide from view (Matt 8:24; Luke 23:30). | 2. To conceal transgressions or keep secret (Jas 5:20; 1 Pet 4:8).

DEFINITION: Indicates that an action or state meets high standards of excellence, correctness, or appropriateness.
SENSES: 1. In an excellent, correct, or appropriate manner (Mark 7:37; Luke 6:48).
2. In a praiseworthy and blameless way (Gal 4:17).
3. Beneficially and opportunely (Matt 12:12; Jas 2:8).

THAYER.pt: Indica que uma ação ou estado atende a altos padrões de excelência, correção ou adequação. 1. De maneira excelente, correta ou apropriada (Mc 7.37; Lc 6.48). | 2. De forma louvável e irrepreensível (Gl 4.17). | 3. Benéfica e oportunamente (Mt 12.12; Tg 2.8).
THAYER.en: Indicates that an action or state meets high standards of excellence, correctness, or appropriateness. 1. In an excellent, correct, or appropriate manner (Mark 7:37; Luke 6:48). | 2. In a praiseworthy and blameless way (Gal 4:17). | 3. Beneficially and opportunely (Matt 12:12; Jas 2:8).

DEFINITION: Large quadruped beast of burden native to arid regions, known in the NT also in proverbial hyperboles.
SENSES: 1. The camel animal, used in proverbs and illustrations (Matt 3:4; 19:24).

THAYER.pt: Grande animal quadrúpede de carga nativo de regiões áridas, conhecido no NT também em hipérboles proverbiais. 1. O animal camelo, usado em provérbios e ilustrações (Mt 3.4; 19.24).
THAYER.en: Large quadruped beast of burden native to arid regions, known in the NT also in proverbial hyperboles. 1. The camel animal, used in proverbs and illustrations (Matt 3:4; 19:24).

DEFINITION: Designates a structure designed to reach high temperatures, used to smelt metals, fire pottery, or as a symbol of final judgment and severe punishment.
SENSES: 1. A fiery furnace or oven used for eschatological judgment (Matt 13:42, 50).
2. A furnace associated with catastrophes or apocalyptic visions (Rev 9:2).

THAYER.pt: Designa uma construção projetada para atingir altas temperaturas, usada para fundir metais, queimar cerâmica ou como símbolo de juízo final e punição severa. 1. Fornalha ou forno de fogo ardente usado para o juízo escatológico (Mt 13.42, 50). | 2. Fornalha associada a catástrofes ou visões apocalípticas (Ap 9.2).
THAYER.en: Designates a structure designed to reach high temperatures, used to smelt metals, fire pottery, or as a symbol of final judgment and severe punishment. 1. A fiery furnace or oven used for eschatological judgment (Matt 13:42, 50). | 2. A furnace associated with catastrophes or apocalyptic visions (Rev 9:2).

DEFINITION: To close the eyes firmly, frequently used in the New Testament in a figurative sense to describe the refusal to see or comprehend spiritual truth.
SENSES: 1. To close one's eyes so as not to perceive the divine message (Matt 13:15; Acts 28:27).

THAYER.pt: Fechar os olhos firmemente, frequentemente usado no Novo Testamento em sentido figurado para descrever a recusa em ver ou compreender a verdade espiritual. 1. Fechar os olhos de modo a não perceber a mensagem divina (Mt 13:15; At 28:27).
THAYER.en: To close the eyes firmly, frequently used in the New Testament in a figurative sense to describe the refusal to see or comprehend spiritual truth. 1. To close one's eyes so as not to perceive the divine message (Matt 13:15; Acts 28:27).

DEFINITION: To be physically fatigued, ill, or, in a figurative sense, to lose motivation and faint in the face of a trial.
SENSES: 1. To be physically infirm or sick (Jas 5:15).
2. To faint or lose heart spiritually under fatigue (Heb 12:3).

THAYER.pt: Estar fisicamente fatigado, adoecido ou, em sentido figurado, perder a motivação e desfalecer diante de uma prova. 1. Estar enfermo ou doente fisicamente (Tg 5:15). | 2. Desfalecer ou desanimar espiritualmente sob fadiga (Hb 12:3).
THAYER.en: To be physically fatigued, ill, or, in a figurative sense, to lose motivation and faint in the face of a trial. 1. To be physically infirm or sick (Jas 5:15). | 2. To faint or lose heart spiritually under fatigue (Heb 12:3).

DEFINITION: Means to incline or bend a part of the body, especially the knees, as a physical expression of submission, worship, or reverence to God.
SENSES: 1. To bend the knees in prayer or worship to God (Rom 11:4; Eph 3:14).
2. To bow before God in recognition of His universal sovereignty (Rom 14:11).

THAYER.pt: Significa inclinar ou dobrar uma parte do corpo, especialmente os joelhos, como expressão física de submissão, adoração ou reverência a Deus. 1. Dobrar os joelhos em oração ou adoração a Deus (Rm 11.4; Ef 3.14). | 2. Curvar-se diante de Deus no reconhecimento de Sua soberania universal (Rm 14.11).
THAYER.en: Means to incline or bend a part of the body, especially the knees, as a physical expression of submission, worship, or reverence to God. 1. To bend the knees in prayer or worship to God (Rom 11:4; Eph 3:14). | 2. To bow before God in recognition of His universal sovereignty (Rom 14:11).

DEFINITION: An emphatic conditional conjunction expressing concession, meaning that even in the minimum hypothesis something is valid.
SENSES: 1. Even if, although, even in the case of (Matt 21:21).
2. At the very least, at least (Mark 5:28; Acts 5:15).

THAYER.pt: Conjunção condicional enfática que expressa concessão, significando que mesmo na hipótese mínima algo é válido. 1. Mesmo se, ainda que, mesmo no caso de (Mt 21.21). | 2. No mínimo, pelo menos (Mc 5.28; At 5.15).
THAYER.en: An emphatic conditional conjunction expressing concession, meaning that even in the minimum hypothesis something is valid. 1. Even if, although, even in the case of (Matt 21:21). | 2. At the very least, at least (Mark 5:28; Acts 5:15).

SEMANTIC_FIELD: Names of Persons and Places - Places
DEFINITION: Cana, a town located in the region of Galilee, known principally as the site of Jesus' first sign.
SENSES: 1. Town of Galilee where Jesus turned water into wine (John 2:1, 11).

THAYER.pt: Cana, uma cidade localizada na região da Galileia, conhecida principalmente como o local do primeiro sinal de Jesus. 1. Cidade da Galileia onde Jesus transformou água em vinho (Jo 2.1, 11).
THAYER.en: Cana, a town located in the region of Galilee, known principally as the site of Jesus' first sign. 1. Town of Galilee where Jesus turned water into wine (John 2:1, 11).

DEFINITION: A designation applied to Simon, one of Jesus' disciples, indicating his origin or his affiliation with the Zealot group.
SENSES: 1. Epithet of Simon, the disciple (Matt 10:4; Mark 3:18).

THAYER.pt: Designação aplicada a Simão, um dos discípulos de Jesus, indicando sua origem ou sua afiliação ao grupo dos Zelotes. 1. Epíteto de Simão, o discípulo (Mt 10:4; Mc 3:18).
THAYER.en: A designation applied to Simon, one of Jesus' disciples, indicating his origin or his affiliation with the Zealot group. 1. Epithet of Simon, the disciple (Matt 10:4; Mark 3:18).

DEFINITION: A hereditary royal title given to the queen mothers or sovereigns of the kingdom of Ethiopia (Cush).
SENSES: 1. Official title of the queen of Ethiopia mentioned in the book of Acts (Acts 8:27).

THAYER.pt: Título real hereditário dado às rainhas-mães ou soberanas do reino de Etiópia (Cuxe). 1. Título oficial da rainha da Etiópia mencionada no livro de Atos (At 8.27).
THAYER.en: A hereditary royal title given to the queen mothers or sovereigns of the kingdom of Ethiopia (Cush). 1. Official title of the queen of Ethiopia mentioned in the book of Acts (Acts 8:27).

DEFINITION: A measuring instrument that came to denote a rule, moral standard, or limit assigned to govern conduct and activity.
SENSES: 1. Normative standard or rule to evaluate and guide Christian conduct (Gal 6:16).
2. Assigned limit, sphere of activity, or area of responsibility (2 Cor 10:13).

THAYER.pt: Instrumento de medição que passou a denotar uma regra, padrão moral ou limite atribuído para reger a conduta e a atividade. 1. Padrão ou regra normativa para avaliar e guiar a conduta cristã (Gl 6.16). | 2. Limite designado, esfera de atuação ou área de responsabilidade atribuída (2Co 10.13).
THAYER.en: A measuring instrument that came to denote a rule, moral standard, or limit assigned to govern conduct and activity. 1. Normative standard or rule to evaluate and guide Christian conduct (Gal 6:16). | 2. Assigned limit, sphere of activity, or area of responsibility (2 Cor 10:13).

DEFINITION: An important city located on the northwest shore of the Sea of Galilee, which served as the headquarters for Jesus' earthly ministry.
SENSES: 1. The Galilean city of Capernaum (Matt 4:13; Mark 2:1; Luke 4:31).

THAYER.pt: Importante cidade localizada na margem noroeste do mar da Galileia, que serviu de quartel-general para o ministério terreno de Jesus. 1. A cidade galileia de Cafarnaum (Mt 4.13; Mc 2.1; Lc 4.31).
THAYER.en: An important city located on the northwest shore of the Sea of Galilee, which served as the headquarters for Jesus' earthly ministry. 1. The Galilean city of Capernaum (Matt 4:13; Mark 2:1; Luke 4:31).

SHORT_GLOSS: to trade, to adulterate, to peddle
DEFINITION: To act as a merchant with selfish and fraudulent interests, often used in the sense of corrupting the word of God for greed.
SENSES: 1. To exploit commercially or corrupt for base motives (2 Cor 2:17).
USAGE: to trade, to adulterate, to peddle

THAYER.pt: Atuar como mercador com interesses egoístas e fraudulentos, frequentemente usado no sentido de corromper a palavra de Deus por ganância. 1. Explorar comercialmente ou corromper por motivos torpes (2Co 2.17).
THAYER.en: To act as a merchant with selfish and fraudulent interests, often used in the sense of corrupting the word of God for greed. 1. To exploit commercially or corrupt for base motives (2 Cor 2:17).

DEFINITION: Designates the visible smoke resulting from combustion, often associated in the New Testament with divine manifestations, judgment, or apocalyptic visions.
SENSES: 1. Smoke generated by fire or cataclysm (Acts 2:19; Rev 9:2).

THAYER.pt: Designa a fumaça visível resultante da combustão, frequentemente associada no Novo Testamento a manifestações divinas, juízo ou visões apocalípticas. 1. Fumaça gerada por fogo ou cataclismo (At 2.19; Ap 9.2).
THAYER.en: Designates the visible smoke resulting from combustion, often associated in the New Testament with divine manifestations, judgment, or apocalyptic visions. 1. Smoke generated by fire or cataclysm (Acts 2:19; Rev 9:2).

DEFINITION: A Roman province located in the interior region of Asia Minor.
SENSES: 1. Geographical region whose inhabitants were present in Jerusalem on the Day of Pentecost (Acts 2:9).

THAYER.pt: Província romana situada na região interior da Ásia Menor. 1. Região geográfica cujos habitantes estavam presentes em Jerusalém no Dia de Pentecostes (At 2:9).
THAYER.en: A Roman province located in the interior region of Asia Minor. 1. Geographical region whose inhabitants were present in Jerusalem on the Day of Pentecost (Acts 2:9).

DEFINITION: In biblical thought, it designates the integrating center of human inner life, encompassing reason, affections, moral conscience, and volitional will. It rarely refers to the physical organ, focusing instead on the seat of ethical decisions before God.
SENSES: 1. Center of human volitional, moral, and intellectual life (Matt 6:21; Rom 10:10).
2. Seat of emotions, feelings, and longings (John 14:1; 2 Cor 2:4).
3. The core, depths, or hidden center of something, by figurative spatial extension (Matt 12:40).

THAYER.pt: No pensamento bíblico, designa o centro integrador da vida humana interior, abrangendo a razão, os afetos, a consciência moral e a vontade volitiva. Raramente se refere ao órgão físico, focando antes na sede das decisões éticas diante de Deus. 1. Centro da vida volitiva, moral e intelectual humana (Mt 6.21; Rm 10.10). | 2. Sede das emoções, sentimentos e anseios (Jo 14.1; 2Co 2.4). | 3. O âmago, profundezas ou centro oculto de algo, por extensão espacial figurada (Mt 12.40).
THAYER.en: In biblical thought, it designates the integrating center of human inner life, encompassing reason, affections, moral conscience, and volitional will. It rarely refers to the physical organ, focusing instead on the seat of ethical decisions before God. 1. Center of human volitional, moral, and intellectual life (Matt 6:21; Rom 10:10). | 2. Seat of emotions, feelings, and longings (John 14:1; 2 Cor 2:4). | 3. The core, depths, or hidden center of something, by figurative spatial extension (Matt 12:40).

DEFINITION: The one who knows the thoughts, intentions, and the inner being of the human heart; a title applied to God.
SENSES: 1. The one who knows the inner being of all people (Acts 1:24; Acts 15:8).

THAYER.pt: Aquele que conhece os pensamentos, intenções e o íntimo do coração humano; título aplicado a Deus. 1. Aquele que conhece o íntimo de todas as pessoas (At 1:24; At 15:8).
THAYER.en: The one who knows the thoughts, intentions, and the inner being of the human heart; a title applied to God. 1. The one who knows the inner being of all people (Acts 1:24; Acts 15:8).

SHORT_GLOSS: fruit, fruit of the womb, profit
DEFINITION: Primarily refers to the organic product of plants and trees, but is frequently used figuratively to indicate offspring, the result of human actions, or spiritual profit.
SENSES: 1. Physical fruit generated by trees, plants, or harvests (Matt 3:10).
2. Offspring or the fruit of the human womb (Luke 1:42; Acts 2:30).
3. Moral, spiritual result, or practical profit of an activity (Phil 1:22).
USAGE: fruit, fruit of the womb, profit

THAYER.pt: Refere-se primariamente ao produto orgânico de plantas e árvores, mas é frequentemente empregado de forma figurada para indicar descendência, o resultado de ações humanas ou o proveito espiritual. 1. Fruto físico gerado por árvores, plantas ou colheitas (Mt 3.10). | 2. Descendência ou o fruto do ventre humano (Lc 1.42; At 2.30). | 3. Resultado moral, espiritual ou proveito prático de uma atividade (Fp 1.22).
THAYER.en: Primarily refers to the organic product of plants and trees, but is frequently used figuratively to indicate offspring, the result of human actions, or spiritual profit. 1. Physical fruit generated by trees, plants, or harvests (Matt 3:10). | 2. Offspring or the fruit of the human womb (Luke 1:42; Acts 2:30). | 3. Moral, spiritual result, or practical profit of an activity (Phil 1:22).

DEFINITION: The proper name of a Christian associated with the apostle Paul in Troas.
SENSES: 1. Disciple and companion of Paul, in whose house in Troas cloaks and parchments were left.

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio de um cristão associado ao apóstolo Paulo em Trôade. 1. Discípulo e companheiro de Paulo, em cuja casa em Trôade foram deixadas capas e pergaminhos.
THAYER.en: The proper name of a Christian associated with the apostle Paul in Troas. 1. Disciple and companion of Paul, in whose house in Troas cloaks and parchments were left.

SHORT_GLOSS: to bear fruit, to be fruitful
DEFINITION: To produce fruit or crops in agriculture; widely used in the New Testament as a metaphor for a productive and obedient spiritual life.
SENSES: 1. To produce fruit or harvest in plants (Mk 4:28).
2. To be morally and spiritually fruitful in the Christian life (Col 1:10).
USAGE: to bear fruit, to be fruitful

THAYER.pt: Produzir frutos ou colheitas na agricultura, sendo amplamente utilizado no Novo Testamento como metáfora para uma vida espiritual produtiva e obediente. 1. Produzir fruto ou colheita em plantas (Mc 4.28). | 2. Frutificar moral e espiritualmente na vida cristã (Cl 1.10).
THAYER.en: To produce fruit or crops in agriculture; widely used in the New Testament as a metaphor for a productive and obedient spiritual life. 1. To produce fruit or harvest in plants (Mk 4:28). | 2. To be morally and spiritually fruitful in the Christian life (Col 1:10).

DEFINITION: That which produces abundant fruit, whether in an agricultural or spiritual sense.
SENSES: 1. Capable of producing an abundant harvest or fruit (Acts 14:17).

THAYER.pt: Que produz frutos abundantes, seja no sentido agrícola ou espiritual. 1. Capaz de produzir colheita ou frutos abundantes (At 14.17).
THAYER.en: That which produces abundant fruit, whether in an agricultural or spiritual sense. 1. Capable of producing an abundant harvest or fruit (Acts 14:17).

SHORT_GLOSS: to persevere, to endure, to be firm
DEFINITION: To remain firm and unshakable in the face of intense pressure, demonstrating courage and moral resilience.
SENSES: 1. To be steadfast, to persevere with firmness in the face of trials (Heb 11:27).
USAGE: to persevere, to endure, to be firm

THAYER.pt: Manter-se firme e inabalável diante de pressões intensas, demonstrando coragem e resiliência moral. 1. Ser steadfast, perseverar com firmeza diante de provações (Hb 11.27).
THAYER.en: To remain firm and unshakable in the face of intense pressure, demonstrating courage and moral resilience. 1. To be steadfast, to persevere with firmness in the face of trials (Heb 11:27).

DEFINITION: A small piece of wood, straw, or dust, used metaphorically in contrast to something much larger to illustrate insignificant defects.
SENSES: 1. A speck or small fragment of wood (Mt 7:3, 4, 5).

THAYER.pt: Um pequeno pedaço de madeira, palha ou pó, empregado metaforicamente em contraste com algo muito maior para ilustrar defeitos insignificantes. 1. Um cisco ou pequeno fragmento de madeira (Mt 7.3, 4, 5).
THAYER.en: A small piece of wood, straw, or dust, used metaphorically in contrast to something much larger to illustrate insignificant defects. 1. A speck or small fragment of wood (Mt 7:3, 4, 5).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Governs genitive and accusative; elided as κατ’ or καθ’
DEFINITION: A preposition expressing descent or antagonism when with the genitive, and conformity, norm, distribution, or extent when with the accusative.
SENSES: 1. With accusative: in accordance with, according to the criterion or standard of (Mt 9:29; Rom 2:16).
2. With accusative: temporal, spatial, or individual distribution: day by day, house by house (Acts 2:46; 1 Cor 14:27).
3. With genitive: physical descent ('down') or hostility and opposition; against (Mt 8:32; 12:30).

THAYER.pt: Preposição que expressa descida ou antagonismo quando com genitivo, e conformidade, norma, distribuição ou extensão quando com acusativo. 1. Com acusativo: de acordo com, segundo o critério ou padrão de (Mt 9.29; Rm 2.16). | 2. Com acusativo: distribuição temporal, espacial ou individual: dia após dia, por casas (At 2.46; 1Co 14.27). | 3. Com genitivo: descida física ('para baixo') ou hostilidade e oposição; contra (Mt 8.32; 12.30).
THAYER.en: A preposition expressing descent or antagonism when with the genitive, and conformity, norm, distribution, or extent when with the accusative. 1. With accusative: in accordance with, according to the criterion or standard of (Mt 9:29; Rom 2:16). | 2. With accusative: temporal, spatial, or individual distribution: day by day, house by house (Acts 2:46; 1 Cor 14:27). | 3. With genitive: physical descent ('down') or hostility and opposition; against (Mt 8:32; 12:30).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: καταβήσομαι, Aor2: κατέβην, Perf: καταβέβηκα
SHORT_GLOSS: to descend, to fall, to come down
DEFINITION: To move from a higher physical or spiritual elevation to a lower one; very frequent for the coming of celestial beings or the descent of divine presence to earth.
SENSES: 1. To descend from a high physical position, such as a mountain or tree (Mt 8:1; Lk 19:5).
2. To descend from Jerusalem to other regions of Judea or Samaria (Lk 10:30; Acts 8:5).
3. To descend from heaven to earth, referring to the Spirit, Christ, or angels (Mt 3:16; Jn 6:38; 1 Thess 4:16).
USAGE: to descend, to fall, to come down

THAYER.pt: Deslocar-se de uma elevação física ou espiritual superior para uma inferior; muito frequente para a vinda de seres celestiais ou descida da presença divina à terra. 1. Descer de uma posição física elevada, como um monte ou árvore (Mt 8.1; Lk 19.5). | 2. Descer de Jerusalém para outras regiões da Judeia ou Samaria (Lc 10.30; At 8.5). | 3. Descer do céu para a terra, referente ao Espírito, a Cristo ou anjos (Mt 3.16; Jo 6.38; 1Ts 4.16).
THAYER.en: To move from a higher physical or spiritual elevation to a lower one; very frequent for the coming of celestial beings or the descent of divine presence to earth. 1. To descend from a high physical position, such as a mountain or tree (Mt 8:1; Lk 19:5). | 2. To descend from Jerusalem to other regions of Judea or Samaria (Lk 10:30; Acts 8:5). | 3. To descend from heaven to earth, referring to the Spirit, Christ, or angels (Mt 3:16; Jn 6:38; 1 Thess 4:16).

SHORT_GLOSS: to cast down, to overthrow, to found
DEFINITION: To throw with force to the ground to overthrow, or to deposit something permanently, such as establishing foundations.
SENSES: 1. To overthrow or strike to the ground (2 Cor 4:9).
2. To establish or lay foundations (Heb 6:1).
USAGE: to cast down, to overthrow, to found

THAYER.pt: Atirar com força ao chão para derrubar, ou depositar algo de forma permanente, como estabelecer fundamentos. 1. Derrubar ou golpear ao chão (2Co 4:9). | 2. Estabelecer ou lançar fundamentos (Hb 6:1).
THAYER.en: To throw with force to the ground to overthrow, or to deposit something permanently, such as establishing foundations. 1. To overthrow or strike to the ground (2 Cor 4:9). | 2. To establish or lay foundations (Heb 6:1).

DEFINITION: To impose an excessive load or cause great difficulty and burden to someone.
SENSES: 1. To be a heavy burden or to overburden someone financially or emotionally (2 Cor 12:16).

THAYER.pt: Impor uma carga excessiva ou causar grande dificuldade e fardo a alguém. 1. Ser um fardo pesado ou sobrecarregar alguém financeiramente ou emocionalmente (2Co 12:16).
THAYER.en: To impose an excessive load or cause great difficulty and burden to someone. 1. To be a heavy burden or to overburden someone financially or emotionally (2 Cor 12:16).

DEFINITION: A path or hillside that leads downward from a higher place.
SENSES: 1. The slope or decline that descends from a mountain (Lk 19:37).

THAYER.pt: Caminho ou encosta que conduz para baixo a partir de um lugar mais alto. 1. A encosta ou declive que desce de um monte (Lc 19.37).
THAYER.en: A path or hillside that leads downward from a higher place. 1. The slope or decline that descends from a mountain (Lk 19:37).

SHORT_GLOSS: to bring down, to cast down
DEFINITION: To cause the movement of something or someone from a higher position to a lower one, i.e., to make descend.
SENSES: 1. To cause to move downward or to cast down from a high place (Mt 11:23; Lk 10:15).
USAGE: to bring down, to cast down

THAYER.pt: Causar o movimento de algo ou alguém de uma posição superior para uma inferior, ou seja, fazer descer. 1. Fazer mover para baixo ou precipitar de um lugar alto (Mt 11.23; Lc 10.15).
THAYER.en: To cause the movement of something or someone from a higher position to a lower one, i.e., to make descend. 1. To cause to move downward or to cast down from a high place (Mt 11:23; Lk 10:15).

DEFINITION: The act of laying structural bases, denoting the starting point or the original foundation of something, such as the cosmos.
SENSES: 1. The foundation or absolute beginning of the world and the universe (Mt 13:35; Eph 1:4).
2. The biological act of conception or generation of a seed (Heb 11:11).

THAYER.pt: O ato de lançar bases estruturais, denotando o ponto de partida ou a fundação original de algo, como o cosmos. 1. A fundação ou o início absoluto do mundo e do universo (Mt 13:35; Ef 1:4). | 2. O ato biológico de concepção ou geração de uma semente (Hb 11:11).
THAYER.en: The act of laying structural bases, denoting the starting point or the original foundation of something, such as the cosmos. 1. The foundation or absolute beginning of the world and the universe (Mt 13:35; Eph 1:4). | 2. The biological act of conception or generation of a seed (Heb 11:11).

DEFINITION: To act as a biased umpire who decides against someone, unjustly depriving them of the prize.
SENSES: 1. To disqualify or deprive someone of their due spiritual reward (Col 2:18).

THAYER.pt: Atuar como um árbitro parcial que decide contra alguém, privando-o injustamente da recompensa. 1. Desqualificar ou privar alguém da devida recompensa espiritual (Cl 2.18).
THAYER.en: To act as a biased umpire who decides against someone, unjustly depriving them of the prize. 1. To disqualify or deprive someone of their due spiritual reward (Col 2:18).

DEFINITION: One who publicly announces a message with authority and clarity.
SENSES: 1. Preacher or proclaimer of new doctrines or truths (Acts 17:18).

THAYER.pt: Aquele que anuncia publicamente uma mensagem com autoridade e clareza. 1. Pregador ou proclamador de novas doutrinas ou verdades (At 17.18).
THAYER.en: One who publicly announces a message with authority and clarity. 1. Preacher or proclaimer of new doctrines or truths (Acts 17:18).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: καταγγελῶ, Aor: κατήγγειλα, Pass: κατηγγέλην
SHORT_GLOSS: to proclaim, to announce, to publish
DEFINITION: Indicates the public proclamation of a message with emphasis on the wide diffusion and authority of the announcement. In the New Testament context, it is the act of preaching the gospel and the works of God.
SENSES: 1. To proclaim publicly or announce widely a message (Rom 1:8; 1 Cor 11:26).
USAGE: to proclaim, to announce, to publish

THAYER.pt: Indica a proclamação pública de uma mensagem com ênfase na ampla difusão e autoridade do anúncio. No contexto neotestamentário, é o ato solnewToken de pregar o evangelho e as obras de Deus. 1. Proclamar publicamente ou anunciar amplamente uma mensagem (Rm 1.8; 1Co 11.26).
THAYER.en: Indicates the public proclamation of a message with emphasis on the wide diffusion and authority of the announcement. In the New Testament context, it is the act of preaching the gospel and the works of God. 1. To proclaim publicly or announce widely a message (Rom 1:8; 1 Cor 11:26).

SHORT_GLOSS: to laugh at, to mock, to deride
DEFINITION: To laugh at someone with disdain or mockery, demonstrating total disbelief or contempt.
SENSES: 1. To laugh in a mocking way or to deride someone in the face of a situation (Mt 9:24; Mk 5:40; Lk 8:53).
USAGE: to laugh at, to mock, to deride

THAYER.pt: Rir de alguém com desdém ou escárnio, demonstrando total incredulidade ou desprezo. 1. Rir de modo zombeteiro ou escarnecer de alguém diante de uma situação (Mt 9.24; Mc 5.40; Lc 8.53).
THAYER.en: To laugh at someone with disdain or mockery, demonstrating total disbelief or contempt. 1. To laugh in a mocking way or to deride someone in the face of a situation (Mt 9:24; Mk 5:40; Lk 8:53).

SHORT_GLOSS: to condemn, to censure, to blame
DEFINITION: To find fault in someone or judge unfavorably, resulting in censure or moral condemnation.
SENSES: 1. To condemn or censure someone publicly for misconduct (Gal 2:11).
2. To be condemned or reproved by one's own conscience (1 Jn 3:20).
USAGE: to condemn, to censure, to blame

THAYER.pt: Achar culpa em alguém ou julgar desfavoravelmente, resultando em censura ou condenação moral. 1. Condenar ou censurar alguém publicamente por erro de conduta (Gl 2.11). | 2. Ser condenado ou reprovado pela própria consciência (1Jo 3.20).
THAYER.en: To find fault in someone or judge unfavorably, resulting in censure or moral condemnation. 1. To condemn or censure someone publicly for misconduct (Gal 2:11). | 2. To be condemned or reproved by one's own conscience (1 Jn 3:20).

SHORT_GLOSS: to break, to shatter, to crush
DEFINITION: Describes the action of breaking, shattering, or rupturing a rigid object; also applied prophetically or literally to bones.
SENSES: 1. To break or crush something fragile so as to damage it (Mt 12:20).
2. To break the legs of those crucified to hasten death (Jn 19:31-33).
USAGE: to break, to shatter, to crush

THAYER.pt: Descreve a ação de quebrar, estilhaçar ou romper um objeto rígido, aplicando-se também profética ou literalmente a ossos. 1. Quebrar ou esmagar algo frágil de modo a danificá-lo (Mt 12.20). | 2. Quebrar as pernas de crucificados para apressar a morte (Jo 19.31-33).
THAYER.en: Describes the action of breaking, shattering, or rupturing a rigid object; also applied prophetically or literally to bones. 1. To break or crush something fragile so as to damage it (Mt 12:20). | 2. To break the legs of those crucified to hasten death (Jn 19:31-33).

DEFINITION: To lead or guide someone or something from a higher place to a lower one, or to guide a ship to the shore.
SENSES: 1. To lead or bring down (Rom 10:6; Lk 5:11).

THAYER.pt: Conduzir ou guiar alguém ou algo de um lugar mais alto para um mais baixo, ou guiar um navio até a costa. 1. Conduzir ou trazer para baixo (Rm 10.6; Lc 5.11).
THAYER.en: To lead or guide someone or something from a higher place to a lower one, or to guide a ship to the shore. 1. To lead or bring down (Rom 10:6; Lk 5:11).

SHORT_GLOSS: to conquer, to subdue, to overcome
DEFINITION: To overcome an adversary in combat or intense struggle, obtaining definitive victory.
SENSES: 1. To subdue enemies or overcome arduous challenges through perseverance (Heb 11:33).
USAGE: to conquer, to subdue, to overcome

THAYER.pt: Superar o adversário em combate ou intensa luta, obtendo a vitória definitiva. 1. Subjugar inimigos ou vencer desafios árduos pela perseverança (Hb 11.33).
THAYER.en: To overcome an adversary in combat or intense struggle, obtaining definitive victory. 1. To subdue enemies or overcome arduous challenges through perseverance (Heb 11:33).

SHORT_GLOSS: to bind, to bandage, to heal
DEFINITION: To tie around, especially applying bandages to treat wounds.
SENSES: 1. To bandage and care for physical wounds (Lk 10:34).
USAGE: to bind, to bandage, to heal

THAYER.pt: Amarrar ao redor, especialmente aplicando bandagens para tratar ferimentos. 1. Enfaixar e cuidar de feridas físicas (Lc 10.34).
THAYER.en: To tie around, especially applying bandages to treat wounds. 1. To bandage and care for physical wounds (Lk 10:34).

DEFINITION: That which stands out with total clarity, becoming perfectly understandable to everyone.
SENSES: 1. Something fully manifest and evident to be understood (Heb 7:15).

THAYER.pt: Aquilo que se sobressai com total clareza, tornando-se perfeitamente compreensível a todos. 1. Algo plenamente manifesto e evidente de ser compreendido (Hb 7.15).
THAYER.en: That which stands out with total clarity, becoming perfectly understandable to everyone. 1. Something fully manifest and evident to be understood (Heb 7:15).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: καταδικάσω, Aor: κατεδίκασα, Pass: κατεδικάσθην
DEFINITION: To pronounce a judicial sentence against someone, declaring them guilty of a crime or fault. In the New Testament, it is used in both human legal contexts and in terms of moral or spiritual condemnation.
SENSES: 1. To pronounce a sentence of condemnation or to find guilty (Matt 12:7; Matt 12:37).

THAYER.pt: Significa pronunciar uma sentença judicial contra alguém, declarando-o culpado de um crime ou falta. No Novo Testamento, é usado tanto em contextos legais humanos quanto em termos da condenação moral ou espiritual. 1. Pronunciar sentença de condenação ou achar culpado (Mt 12.7; Mt 12.37).
THAYER.en: To pronounce a judicial sentence against someone, declaring them guilty of a crime or fault. In the New Testament, it is used in both human legal contexts and in terms of moral or spiritual condemnation. 1. To pronounce a sentence of condemnation or to find guilty (Matt 12:7; Matt 12:37).

DEFINITION: To track or go in insistent search of someone or something with determination.
SENSES: 1. To seek with effort or to track the whereabouts of someone (Mark 1:36).

THAYER.pt: Rastrear ou ir em busca insistente de alguém ou algo com determinação. 1. Procurar com afinco ou rastrear o paradeiro de alguém (Mc 1.36).
THAYER.en: To track or go in insistent search of someone or something with determination. 1. To seek with effort or to track the whereabouts of someone (Mark 1:36).

DEFINITION: To reduce someone to slavery, exercising absolute control and subjecting them to one's own interests.
SENSES: 1. To reduce to spiritual or legal servitude (2 Cor 11:20; Gal 2:4).

THAYER.pt: Reduzir alguém à escravidão, exercendo controle absoluto e submetendo-o aos próprios interesses. 1. Reduzir à servidão espiritual ou legal (2Co 11:20; Gl 2:4).
THAYER.en: To reduce someone to slavery, exercising absolute control and subjecting them to one's own interests. 1. To reduce to spiritual or legal servitude (2 Cor 11:20; Gal 2:4).

DEFINITION: To exercise power in a tyrannical and cruel manner over the vulnerable, causing severe deprivation and suffering.
SENSES: 1. To oppress or unjustly exploit the weak (Acts 10:38; Jas 2:6).

THAYER.pt: Exercer poder de forma tirânica e cruel sobre os vulneráveis, causando graves privações e sofrimento. 1. Oprimir ou explorar injustamente os mais fracos (At 10:38; Tg 2:6).
THAYER.en: To exercise power in a tyrannical and cruel manner over the vulnerable, causing severe deprivation and suffering. 1. To oppress or unjustly exploit the weak (Acts 10:38; Jas 2:6).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: καταισχυνῶ, Aor: κατῄσχυνα, Pass: κατῃσχύνθην
SHORT_GLOSS: to shame, to dishonor, to confuse
DEFINITION: To cause shame, dishonor, or humiliation to someone, or to frustrate expectations in a way that covers one with ignominy.
SENSES: 1. To dishonor or bring reproach upon someone (1 Cor 11:4).
2. To shame or cover with vexation (1 Cor 1:27).
3. To disappoint those whose hope is firm (Rom 5:5; 9:33).
USAGE: to shame, to dishonor, to confuse

THAYER.pt: Causar vergonha, desonra ou humilhação a alguém, ou frustrar as expectativas de modo a cobrir de ignomínia. 1. Desonrar ou trazer opróbrio sobre alguém (1Co 11.4). | 2. Envergonhar ou cobrir de vexame (1Co 1.27). | 3. Decepcionar ou desapontar aqueles cuja esperança é firme (Rm 5.5; 9.33).
THAYER.en: To cause shame, dishonor, or humiliation to someone, or to frustrate expectations in a way that covers one with ignominy. 1. To dishonor or bring reproach upon someone (1 Cor 11:4). | 2. To shame or cover with vexation (1 Cor 1:27). | 3. To disappoint those whose hope is firm (Rom 5:5; 9:33).

SHORT_GLOSS: to burn, to incinerate, to consume
DEFINITION: To destroy something completely by means of fire, reducing it to ashes.
SENSES: 1. To burn totally or consume by fire (Matt 13:30).
USAGE: to burn, to incinerate, to consume

THAYER.pt: Destruir completamente algo por meio do fogo, reduzindo a cinzas. 1. Queimar totalmente ou consumir pelo fogo (Mt 13.30).
THAYER.en: To destroy something completely by means of fire, reducing it to ashes. 1. To burn totally or consume by fire (Matt 13:30).

SHORT_GLOSS: to cover, to veil, to mask
DEFINITION: To cover entirely with a garment or veil, hiding from view.
SENSES: 1. To cover or place a veil over the head or body (1 Cor 11:6, 7).
USAGE: to cover, to veil, to mask

THAYER.pt: Cobrir inteiramente com uma vestimenta ou véu, ocultando da vista. 1. Cobrir ou colocar um véu sobre a cabeça ou o corpo (1Co 11.6, 7).
THAYER.en: To cover entirely with a garment or veil, hiding from view. 1. To cover or place a veil over the head or body (1 Cor 11:6, 7).

DEFINITION: To boast or exalt oneself in an arrogant manner at the expense of another person, or to demonstrate presumption regarding a perceived advantage.
SENSES: 1. To boast arrogantly at the expense of others (Rom 11:18; Jas 3:14).
2. To triumph superbly over something, such as mercy over judgment (Jas 2:13).

THAYER.pt: Significa vangloriar-se ou exaltar-se de maneira arrogante à custa de outra pessoa, ou demonstrar presunção em relação a uma vantagem percebida. 1. Vangloriar-se com arrogância às expensas de outrem (Rm 11.18; Tg 3.14). | 2. Triunfar soberbamente sobre algo, como a misericórdia sobre o juízo (Tg 2.13).
THAYER.en: To boast or exalt oneself in an arrogant manner at the expense of another person, or to demonstrate presumption regarding a perceived advantage. 1. To boast arrogantly at the expense of others (Rom 11:18; Jas 3:14). | 2. To triumph superbly over something, such as mercy over judgment (Jas 2:13).

DEFINITION: To be in a horizontal or reclining position, whether due to physical illness or to participate in a meal.
SENSES: 1. To lie down due to illness or physical weakness (Mark 1:30; Acts 9:33).
2. To recline at the table to eat a meal (Mark 14:3; Luke 5:29).

THAYER.pt: Estar em uma posição horizontal ou reclinada, seja devido a uma enfermidade física ou para participar de uma refeição. 1. Estar deitado por motivo de doença ou fraqueza física (Mc 1.30; At 9.33). | 2. Reclinar-se à mesa para fazer uma refeição (Mc 14.3; Lc 5.29).
THAYER.en: To be in a horizontal or reclining position, whether due to physical illness or to participate in a meal. 1. To lie down due to illness or physical weakness (Mark 1:30; Acts 9:33). | 2. To recline at the table to eat a meal (Mark 14:3; Luke 5:29).

DEFINITION: To break something completely into several pieces.
SENSES: 1. To break bread into pieces for distribution (Mark 6:41; Luke 9:16).

THAYER.pt: Quebrar algo completamente em vários pedaços. 1. Partir o pão em pedaços para distribuição (Mc 6:41; Lc 9:16).
THAYER.en: To break something completely into several pieces. 1. To break bread into pieces for distribution (Mark 6:41; Luke 9:16).

DEFINITION: To confine someone by locking them in a secure place or prison.
SENSES: 1. To place under custody in a prison (Luke 3:20; Acts 26:10).

THAYER.pt: Confinar alguém trancando-o em um lugar seguro ou prisão. 1. Colocar sob custódia em uma prisão (Lc 3:20; At 26:10).
THAYER.en: To confine someone by locking them in a secure place or prison. 1. To place under custody in a prison (Luke 3:20; Acts 26:10).

DEFINITION: To distribute or grant something as legitimate property or inheritance to someone.
SENSES: 1. To distribute lands or possessions as an inheritance (Acts 13:19).

THAYER.pt: Significa distribuir ou conceder algo como propriedade ou herança legítima a alguém. 1. Distribuir terras ou possessões por herança (At 13:19).
THAYER.en: To distribute or grant something as legitimate property or inheritance to someone. 1. To distribute lands or possessions as an inheritance (Acts 13:19).

SHORT_GLOSS: to recline, to seat, to lay down
DEFINITION: The act of making someone lie down or recline, especially in a social sense for a meal at ancient banquets.
SENSES: 1. To cause someone to lie down or be seated (Luke 9:14).
2. To recline at the table to participate in a meal or banquet (Luke 7:36; 14:8).
USAGE: to recline, to seat, to lay down

THAYER.pt: Ato de fazer alguém deitar-se ou reclinar-se, especialmente em sentido social para a refeição nos banquetes antigos. 1. Fazer com que alguém se deite ou se assente (Lc 9.14). | 2. Reclinar-se à mesa para participar de uma refeição ou banquete (Lc 7.36; 14.8).
THAYER.en: The act of making someone lie down or recline, especially in a social sense for a meal at ancient banquets. 1. To cause someone to lie down or be seated (Luke 9:14). | 2. To recline at the table to participate in a meal or banquet (Luke 7:36; 14:8).

SHORT_GLOSS: to flood, to submerge, to destroy
DEFINITION: To cover completely with water, causing destruction by means of a great flood or deluge.
SENSES: 1. To flood or destroy by means of a deluge (2 Pet 3:6).
USAGE: to flood, to submerge, to destroy

THAYER.pt: Cobrir completamente com água, causando destruição por meio de uma grande inundação ou dilúvio. 1. Inundar ou destruir por meio de um dilúvio (2Pe 3:6).
THAYER.en: To cover completely with water, causing destruction by means of a great flood or deluge. 1. To flood or destroy by means of a deluge (2 Pet 3:6).

DEFINITION: Refers to a flood of great proportion and destructive force, associated in the New Testament with the historical cataclysm of Noah's days.
SENSES: 1. The great universal flood that destroyed humanity in the time of Noah (Matt 24:38-39; 2 Pet 2:5).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se a uma inundação de grande proporção e força destrutiva, associada no Novo Testamento ao cataclismo histórico dos dias de Noé. 1. O grande dilúvio universal que destruiu a humanidade no tempo de Noé (Mt 24.38-39; 2Pe 2.5).
THAYER.en: Refers to a flood of great proportion and destructive force, associated in the New Testament with the historical cataclysm of Noah's days. 1. The great universal flood that destroyed humanity in the time of Noah (Matt 24:38-39; 2 Pet 2:5).

DEFINITION: To follow closely, accompanying someone's steps in a continuous manner.
SENSES: 1. To accompany closely or follow someone in their steps (Luke 23:55; Acts 16:17).

THAYER.pt: Seguir de perto, acompanhando os passos de alguém de maneira contínua. 1. Acompanhar de perto ou seguir alguém em seus passos (Lc 23:55; At 16:17).
THAYER.en: To follow closely, accompanying someone's steps in a continuous manner. 1. To accompany closely or follow someone in their steps (Luke 23:55; Acts 16:17).

SHORT_GLOSS: to cut, to slash, to lacerate
DEFINITION: To cut severely or injure the body with sharp instruments, causing lacerations.
SENSES: 1. To slash or severely injure oneself or others (Mark 5:5).
USAGE: to cut, to slash, to lacerate

THAYER.pt: Cortar severamente ou ferir o corpo com instrumentos cortantes, causando lacerações. 1. Retalhar ou ferir gravemente a si mesmo ou a outros (Mc 5:5).

THAYER.en: The judicial verdict of guilt accompanied by the respective penalty or deserved condemnation. 1. The condemnatory sentence resulting from sin, from which believers are freed in Christ (Rom 5:18; 8:1).

THAYER.en: Signifies exercising absolute authority, dominating, or subjugating someone, often carrying the connotation of tyrannical or oppressive rule. 1. To dominate with tyranny or exercise oppressive power over others (Mt 20:25). | 2. To subjugate or exercise undue authority over God's flock (1Pe 5:3).

THAYER.en: To speak in a derogatory, injurious, or malicious manner about another person, denigrating their reputation. 1. To speak evil of, defame, or slander one's neighbor publicly or in secret (Jas 4:11).

THAYER.en: The act of speaking evil of someone behind their back, defaming or slandering another's reputation. 1. Defamatory speech, evil-speaking, or slander (2Co 12:20; 1Pe 2:1).

THAYER.en: One who speaks evil of others in an injurious way, defaming or slandering the reputation of others. 1. One who speaks evil of or slanders their neighbor (Ro 1:30).

THAYER.en: Means to leave something or someone in a place, whether through physical departure, abandonment, or as a remaining legacy. THAYER.en: Designates the re-establishment of a harmonious and friendly relationship after a period of enmity, rupture, or conflict, especially between God and humanity. 1. The restoration of communion and peace between God and human beings through Christ (Rom 5.11; 2Cor 5.18-19).

THAYER.en: Describes the exchange of hostility for a peaceful and friendly relationship. In Pauline theology, it primarily refers to the work of God in Christ, reconciling the world to Himself. 1. THAYER.en: A place intended for the rest and lodging of travelers or a reserved room in a residence. 1. An inn or lodging place for travelers (Lk 2.7). | 2. A guest room or chamber for meals and staying (Lk 22.11).

THAYER.en: To sail toward dry land or disembark coming from the open sea. 1. To put into port or sail toward the coast (Lk 8:26).

THAYER.en: To subject someone to intense physical or moral suffering, causing exhaustion or deep affliction. 1. To cause great affliction or torment through oppression (Acts 7:24; 2Pet 2:7).

DEFINITION: To throw someone or something into the depths of the water so that it sinks and drowns.
SENSES: 1. To sink or submerge in the waters (Mt 14:30; Mt 18:6).

THAYER.en: To throw someone or something into the depths of the water so that it sinks and drowns. 1. To sink or submerge in the waters (Mt 14:30; Mt 18:6).

2. The state of being under condemnation or judgment (Heb 6:8).

THAYER.pt: Indica uma declaração ou estado de maldição, frequentemente associada à invocação de dano ou ruína sobre alguém, ou ao juízo divino sobre o pecado. 1. Uma maldição ou palavra maléfica proferida (Tg 3.9; 2Pe 2.14). | 2. O estado de estar sob condenação ou juízo (Hb 6.8).
THAYER.en: Indicates a declaration or state of being cursed, frequently associated with the invocation of harm or ruin upon someone, or divine judgment upon sin. 1. A curse or malediction uttered (Jas 3:9; 2Pe 2:14). | 2. The state of being under condemnation or judgment (Heb 6:8).

Desejar ou proferir maldição contra alguém (Lc 6.28; Tg 3.9). | 2. Condenar ou decretar esterilidade sobre algo, como a figueira (Mc 11.21).
THAYER.en: Signifies invoking evil upon someone or pronouncing curses, often with the belief of possessing supernatural power to cause harm or to express extreme indignation. 1. To wish or utter a curse against someone (Lk 6:28; Jas 3:9). | 2. To condemn or decree sterility upon something, such as the fig tree (Mk 11:21).

DEFINITION: To render something ineffective, powerless, unproductive, or to annul its validity and legal or existential force.
SENSES: 1. To render unproductive or exhaust the utility of something (Lk 13:7).
2. To invalidate or annul the efficacy of a law or principle (Ro 3:3; Gal 3:17).
3. To annihilate or abolish the existence of something, such as death (1Co 15:24; 2Ti 1:10).

THAYER.pt: Tornar algo ineficaz, sem poder, improdutivo ou anular a sua validade e vigência jurídica ou existencial. 1. Tornar improdutivo ou esgotar a utilidade de algo (Lc 13.7). | 2. Invalidar ou anular a eficácia de uma lei ou princípio (Rm 3.3; Gl 3.17). | 3. Aniquilar ou abolir a existência de algo, como a morte (1Co 15.24; 2Tm 1.10). | 4. Desligar ou desobrigar alguém de um vínculo legal (Rm 7.2; Gl 5.4).
THAYER.en: To render something ineffective, powerless, unproductive, or to annul its validity and legal or existential force. 1. To render unproductive or exhaust the utility of something (Lk 13:7). | 2. To invalidate or annul the efficacy of a law or principle (Ro 3:3; Gal 3:17). | 3. To annihilate or abolish the existence of something, such as death (1Co 15:24; 2Ti 1:10). | 4. To release or discharge someone from a legal bond (Ro 7:2; Gal 5:4).

DEFINITION: To include and count someone as an integral part of a group or community.
SENSES: 1. To be counted or included in the number of a group (Ac 1:17).

THAYER.en: To include and count someone as an integral part of a group or community. 1. To be counted or included in the number of a group (Ac 1:17).

DEFINITION: Signifies putting something into proper working condition, repairing, equipping perfectly, or preparing for a purpose.
SENSES: 1. To restore, repair, or readjust something to its ideal state (Mt 4:21; Gal 6:1).
2. To perfect, equip, or fully empower for the work (Eph 4:12; Heb 13:21).

THAYER.pt: Significa colocar algo em condições adequadas de funcionamento, consertar, equipar perfeitamente ou preparar para um propósito. 1. Restaurar, consertar ou reajustar algo ao seu estado ideal (Mt 4.21; Gl 6.1). | 2. Aperfeiçoar, equipar ou capacitar plenamente para a obra (Ef 4.12; Hb 13.21).
THAYER.en: Signifies putting something into proper working condition, repairing, equipping perfectly, or preparing for a purpose. 1. To restore, repair, or readjust something to its ideal state (Mt 4:21; Gal 6:1). | 2. To perfect, equip, or fully empower for the work (Eph 4:12; Heb 13:21).

DEFINITION: The continuous process of restoring, equipping, or bringing something/someone to their full maturity and correctness.
SENSES: 1. The process of spiritual perfection or restoration (2Co 13:9).

THAYER.pt: O processo contínuo de restaurar, equipar ou levar algo/alguém à sua plena maturidade e correção. 1. O processo de aperfeiçoamento ou restauração espiritual (2Co 13:9).
THAYER.en: The continuous process of restoring, equipping, or bringing something/someone to their full maturity and correctness. 1. The process of spiritual perfection or restoration (2Co 13:9).

DEFINITION: The action of equipping, preparing, or training adequately for a function or service.
SENSES: 1. The training or preparation of the saints for ministry (Eph 4:12).

THAYER.pt: A ação de equipar, preparar ou capacitar adequadamente para uma função ou serviço. 1. A capacitação ou preparo dos santos para o ministério (Ef 4:12).
THAYER.en: The action of equipping, preparing, or training adequately for a function or service. 1. The training or preparation of the saints for ministry (Eph 4:12).

DEFINITION: Describes the act of making quick movements with the hand to call attention, make a signal, or request silence from a crowd.
SENSES: 1. To wave with the hand to request silence or indicate an instruction (Ac 12:17; 21:40).

THAYER.pt: Descreve o ato de fazer movimentos rápidos com a mão para chamar a atenção, fazer um sinal ou pedir silêncio a uma multidão. 1. Acenar com a mão para pedir silêncio ou indicar uma instrução (At 12.17; 21.40).
THAYER.en: Describes the act of making quick movements with the hand to call attention, make a signal, or request silence from a crowd. 1. To wave with the hand to request silence or indicate an instruction (Ac 12:17; 21:40).

DEFINITION: To raze or completely demolish a building or structure down to the foundations.
SENSES: 1. To demolish or destroy buildings and altars to the ground (Ac 15:16; Ro 11:3).

THAYER.pt: Arrasar ou demolir completamente uma construção ou estrutura até os fundamentos. 1. Demolir ou destruir edifícios e altares até o solo (At 15:16; Rm 11:3).
THAYER.en: To raze or completely demolish a building or structure down to the foundations. 1. To demolish or destroy buildings and altars to the ground (Ac 15:16; Ro 11:3).

DEFINITION: To erect a physical structure or to prepare something minutely to fulfill a specific purpose.
SENSES: 1. To prepare or arrange the way for someone (Mt 11:10; Lk 1:17).

THAYER.pt: Edificar uma estrutura física ou preparar minuciosamente algo para cumprir um propósito específico. 1. Preparar ou ajeitar o caminho para alguém (Mt 11:10; Lc 1:17). | 2. Construir, erguer ou criar edifícios e estruturas complexas (Hb 3:4; 11:7).
THAYER.en: To erect a physical structure or to prepare something minutely to fulfill a specific purpose. 1. To prepare or arrange the way for someone (Mt 11:10; Lk 1:17). | 2. To build, erect, or create complex buildings and structures (Heb 3:4; 11:7).

DEFINITION: Signifies fixing a residence, establishing a dwelling, or taking shelter in a place; often used for birds that make nests in trees.
SENSES: 1. To make a dwelling or to inhabit (Ac 2:26).
2. To find shelter or lodge, as birds in the branches of a tree (Mt 13:32).

THAYER.pt: Significa fixar residência, estabelecer moradia ou abrigar-se em um lugar, sendo frequentemente usado para aves que fazem ninhos em árvores. 1. Fazer morada ou habitar (At 2.26). | 2. Encontrar abrigo ou pousar, como pássaros nos ramos de uma árvore (Mt 13.32).
THAYER.en: Signifies fixing a residence, establishing a dwelling, or taking shelter in a place; often used for birds that make nests in trees. 1. To make a dwelling or to inhabit (Ac 2:26). | 2. To find shelter or lodge, as birds in the branches of a tree (Mt 13:32).

DEFINITION: A place provided for shelter, rest, or residence, such as a bird's nest or a place to rest.
SENSES: 1. A place of rest or shelter for animals or people (Mt 8:20; Lk 9:58).

THAYER.pt: Um lugar provido para abrigo, repouso ou residência, como o ninho de aves ou um lugar para descansar. 1. Lugar de repouso ou abrigo para animais ou pessoas (Mt 8:20; Lk 9:58).
THAYER.en: A place provided for shelter, rest, or residence, such as a bird's nest or a place to rest. 1. A place of rest or shelter for animals or people (Mt 8:20; Lk 9:58).

USAGE: to overshadow, to cover with shade

THAYER.en: To cover or protect by casting a shadow over something, interposing itself against the light. 1. To cover with shade or overshadow a sacred object (Heb 9:5).

SHORT_GLOSS: to spy, to lurk, to observe

SENSES: 1. To spy or furtively inspect with ulterior motives (Gal 2:4).
USAGE: to spy, to lurk, to observe

THAYER.pt: Observar ou espreitar secretamente, frequentemente com intenções hostis ou maliciosas. 1. Espionar ou inspecionar furtivamente com segundas intenções (Gl 2:4).
THAYER.en: To observe or lurk secretly, often with hostile or malicious intentions. 1. To spy or furtively inspect with ulterior motives (Gal 2:4).

THAYER.pt: Pessoa cuja tarefa é obter informações de forma secreta ou disfarçada sobre território ou planos alheios. 1. Espião ou agente secreto em missão de reconhecimento (Hb 11:31).
THAYER.en: A person whose task is to obtain information secretly or in disguise regarding the territory or plans of others. 1. A spy or secret agent on a reconnaissance mission (Heb 11:31).

THAYER.en: To overcome or take advantage of someone through cunning artifices, deception, or false arguments. 1. To use cunning to exploit or treat deceitfully (Acts 7:19).

DEFINITION: To bring an agitated group under control or to calm excited spirits.

THAYER.en: To bring an agitated group under control or to calm excited spirits. 1. To calm or quiet a rioting crowd (Acts 19:35, 36).

THAYER.en: The manner of carrying oneself, the outward behavior, or the moral posture of an individual. 1. Personal behavior, demeanor, or conduct (Tit 2:3).

THAYER.en: Refers to outer clothing or the manner of dressing, associated in the New Testament with moderation and decency in conduct. 1. Clothing or outer attire worn by people (1 Tim 2:9).

THAYER.en: The state of complete ruin or total subversion, whether physical or moral. 1. Total physical destruction or ruin (2 Pet 2:6). | 2. Moral or intellectual subversion leading to ruin (2 Tim 2:14).

THAYER.en: Literally means to stretch out on the ground; it can denote the slaughter of people in judgment or the striking down of individuals. 1. To strike down by death or judgment, slaughtering in mass (1 Cor 10:5).

THAYER.en: Refers to the act or right of taking possession of something or owning an inherited or conquered property. 1. The act of taking possession or receiving an inheritance or property (Acts 7:5, 45).

THAYER.en: Means to place something down, to deposit in a place, or to grant a favor to someone. 1. To place or deposit something, such as a body in a tomb (Mk 15:46). | 2. To grant a favor or gain to someone to obtain an advantage (Acts 24:27).

THAYER.en: A pejorative term used by the apostle Paul to describe physical circumcision when practiced without true spiritual meaning, equating it to mere bodily mutilation. 1. Ritualistic physical mutilation practiced by false teachers (Phil 3:2).

THAYER.en: To run hastily from a higher point to a lower one, usually in response to an emergency. 1. To run down quickly to intervene in a situation (Acts 21:32).

THAYER.en: To bring down, physically prostrate, or, in a legal sense, to bring formal accusations against someone. 1. To present formal accusations or cast an unfavorable vote against someone (Acts 25:7; 26:10). | 2. To be overcome by a deep sleep and fall (Acts 20:9).

THAYER.en: Describes the action of fleeing an area of danger with a specific destination in mind to find safety and shelter. 1. To flee a region to escape threats (Acts 14:6). | 2. To seek spiritual and secure refuge or help in the face of danger (Heb 6:18).

DEFINITION: Indicates total corruption or the profound destruction of something, whether in a moral (depravity) or physical aspect.

THAYER.en: Indicates total corruption or the profound destruction of something, whether in a moral (depravity) or physical aspect. 1. To cause the physical or moral ruin of someone or something (2Pet 2:12).

DEFINITION: Indicates the action of pouring or shedding a liquid over someone or something, covering it.
