THAYER.pt: Indica a ação de derramar ou verter um líquido sobre alguém ou alguma coisa, cobrindo-a. 1. Derramar um líquido, como perfume, sobre a cabeça de alguém (Mt 26.7; Mc 14.3).
THAYER.en: Indicates the action of pouring or shedding a liquid over someone or something, covering it. 1. To pour a liquid, such as perfume, upon someone's head (Matt 26:7; Mark 14:3).

DEFINITION: Belonging or relating to the region below the earth's surface, usually associated with the world of the dead or the lower regions of the cosmos.
SENSES: 1. Beings or entities that dwell beneath the earth (Phil 2:10).

THAYER.pt: Pertencente ou relativo à região abaixo da superfície da terra, habitualmente associado ao mundo dos mortos ou às regiões inferiores do cosmo. 1. Seres ou entidades que habitam debaixo da terra (Fp 2:10).
THAYER.en: Belonging or relating to the region below the earth's surface, usually associated with the world of the dead or the lower regions of the cosmos. 1. Beings or entities that dwell beneath the earth (Phil 2:10).

DEFINITION: Meaning to make full use of something or to employ resources and circumstances intensively.
SENSES: 1. To make full use of a right or privilege in ministry (1Cor 9:18).
2. To use the world or earthly things without being dominated by them (1Cor 7:31).

THAYER.pt: Significa fazer uso total de algo ou empregar recursos e circunstâncias de maneira intensa. 1. Fazer uso pleno de um direito ou privilégio no ministério (1Co 9.18). | 2. Usar o mundo ou as coisas terrenas sem se deixar dominar por elas (1Co 7.31).
THAYER.en: Meaning to make full use of something or to employ resources and circumstances intensively. 1. To make full use of a right or privilege in ministry (1Cor 9:18). | 2. To use the world or earthly things without being dominated by them (1Cor 7:31).

DEFINITION: The act of cooling or providing thermal relief to something that is hot or scorching.
SENSES: 1. To refresh or relieve intense heat (Luke 16:24).

THAYER.pt: O ato de resfriar ou proporcionar alívio térmico a algo que está quente ou abrasador. 1. Refrescar ou aliviar o calor intenso (Lc 16:24).
THAYER.en: The act of cooling or providing thermal relief to something that is hot or scorching. 1. To refresh or relieve intense heat (Luke 16:24).

DEFINITION: Describes a place or city completely filled with cultic images and pagan idols.
SENSES: 1. A city or environment dominated by idolatry (Acts 17:16).

THAYER.pt: Descreve um lugar ou cidade completamente repleta de imagens cultuais e ídolos pagãos. 1. Cidade ou ambiente dominado pela idolatria (At 17:16).
THAYER.en: Describes a place or city completely filled with cultic images and pagan idols. 1. A city or environment dominated by idolatry (Acts 17:16).

DEFINITION: Indicates position in front of something or someone's point of view, meaning 'in the presence of' or 'in front of'.
SENSES: 1. In the presence or visual field of someone, before (2Cor 2:17).
2. In front of or in the opposite direction of a physical place (Mark 13:3).

THAYER.pt: Indica posição em frente a algo ou o ponto de vista de alguém, significando 'na presença de' ou 'em frente de'. 1. Na presença ou no campo visual de alguém, perante (2Co 2.17). | 2. Em frente ou na direção oposta de um lugar físico (Mc 13.3).
THAYER.en: Indicates position in front of something or someone's point of view, meaning 'in the presence of' or 'in front of'. 1. In the presence or visual field of someone, before (2Cor 2:17). | 2. In front of or in the opposite direction of a physical place (Mark 13:3).

DEFINITION: Indicates a position directly in front of someone or in the presence and perspective of an authority.
SENSES: 1. Before or in the physical presence of someone (Jude 1:24).
2. Before the eyes, judgment, or trial of God (2Cor 2:17; Col 1:22).

THAYER.pt: Indica uma posição diretamente em frente a alguém ou na presença e perspectiva de uma autoridade. 1. Diante de ou na presença física de alguém (Jd 1.24). | 2. Perante os olhos, julgamento ou juízo de Deus (2Co 2.17; Cl 1.22).
THAYER.en: Indicates a position directly in front of someone or in the presence and perspective of an authority. 1. Before or in the physical presence of someone (Jude 1:24). | 2. Before the eyes, judgment, or trial of God (2Cor 2:17; Col 1:22).

DEFINITION: Describes the act of governing, exercising despotic power, or showing severe dominion over someone.
SENSES: 1. To exercise dominating or tyrannical authority over another (Matt 20:25; Mark 10:42).

THAYER.pt: Descreve o ato de governar, exercer poder despótico ou demonstrar domínio severo sobre alguém. 1. Exercer autoridade dominadora ou tirânica sobre outrem (Mt 20.25; Mc 10.42).
THAYER.en: Describes the act of governing, exercising despotic power, or showing severe dominion over someone. 1. To exercise dominating or tyrannical authority over another (Matt 20:25; Mark 10:42).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Middle deponent. Fut: κατεργάσομαι, Aor: κατειργασάμην
DEFINITION: To bring an action to completion with full success; to produce a concrete effect, fully accomplish, or operate effectively.
SENSES: 1. To produce, generate as a result (Rom 4:15; 2Cor 4:17; Jas 1:3).
2. To accomplish, consummate, effect a work or moral practice (Rom 2:9; Phil 2:12).
3. To repeatedly practice what is evil (Rom 1:27; 1Cor 5:3).

THAYER.pt: Levar uma ação a termo com pleno êxito; produzir um efeito concreto, realizar plenamente ou operar com eficácia. 1. Produzir, gerar como resultado (Rm 4.15; 2Co 4.17; Tg 1.3). | 2. Realizar, consumar, efetuar uma obra ou prática moral (Rm 2.9; Fp 2.12). | 3. Praticar reiteradamente o que é mau (Rm 1.27; 1Co 5.3).
THAYER.en: To bring an action to completion with full success; to produce a concrete effect, fully accomplish, or operate effectively. 1. To produce, generate as a result (Rom 4:15; 2Cor 4:17; Jas 1:3). | 2. To accomplish, consummate, effect a work or moral practice (Rom 2:9; Phil 2:12). | 3. To repeatedly practice what is evil (Rom 1:27; 1Cor 5:3).

DEFINITION: To move from a higher place to a lower one, or to travel toward the coast (nautical term for disembarking or putting into port).
SENSES: 1. To come down from an elevated place (Luke 9:37); 2. To arrive at a destination or put into port with a ship (Acts 18:22; 27:5).

THAYER.pt: Mover-se de um local mais alto para um mais baixo, ou viajar em direção à costa (termo náutico para desembarcar ou aportar). 1. Descer de um lugar elevado (Lc 9.37); 2. Chegar a um destino ou aportar com embarcação (At 18.22; 27.5).
THAYER.en: To move from a higher place to a lower one, or to travel toward the coast (nautical term for disembarking or putting into port). 1. To come down from an elevated place (Luke 9:37); 2. To arrive at a destination or put into port with a ship (Acts 18:22; 27:5).

DEFINITION: To eat greedily, devour voraciously, or completely destroy like fire or abusive exploitation.
SENSES: 1. To devour or eat with voracity (Luke 8:5); 2. To consume or totally destroy, like fire (Rev 11:5); 3. To exploit or waste the resources of others (Mark 12:40).

THAYER.pt: Comer com avidez, devorar vorazmente ou destruir completamente como o fogo ou a exploração abusiva. 1. Devorar ou comer com voracidade (Lc 8.5); 2. Consumir ou destruir totalmente, como o fogo (Ap 11.5); 3. Explorar ou desperdiçar recursos alheios (Mc 12.40).
THAYER.en: To eat greedily, devour voraciously, or completely destroy like fire or abusive exploitation. 1. To devour or eat with voracity (Luke 8:5); 2. To consume or totally destroy, like fire (Rev 11:5); 3. To exploit or waste the resources of others (Mark 12:40).

DEFINITION: To make the path straight, guide, or lead safely toward a destination or purpose.
SENSES: 1. To direct footsteps or guide the path in righteousness (Luke 1:79; 1Thess 3:11; 2Thess 3:5).

THAYER.pt: Tornar o caminho reto, guiar ou conduzir com segurança em direção a um destino ou propósito. 1. Dirigir os passos ou guiar o caminho em retidão (Lc 1.79; 1Ts 3.11; 2Ts 3.5).
THAYER.en: To make the path straight, guide, or lead safely toward a destination or purpose. 1. To direct footsteps or guide the path in righteousness (Luke 1:79; 1Thess 3:11; 2Thess 3:5).

DEFINITION: To catch by surprise or rise up in hostile opposition and revolt against someone.
SENSES: 1. To make an insurrection or make a hostile assault.

THAYER.pt: Apanhar de surpresa ou levantar-se em revolta e oposição hostil contra alguém. 1. Fazer insurreição ou assaltar hostilmente.
THAYER.en: To catch by surprise or rise up in hostile opposition and revolt against someone. 1. To make an insurrection or make a hostile assault.

DEFINITION: Has the basic sense of keeping under control, either by preventing something from happening, detaining a person, or holding firmly to convictions and teachings.
SENSES: 1. To hold back, restrain, or prevent the action of something or someone (Rom 1:18; 2Thess 2:6).
2. Firm retention of traditions, doctrines, or memories, to keep (1Cor 15:2; 1Thess 5:21).
3. To possess or keep in one's possession (2Cor 6:10).

THAYER.pt: Possui o sentido básico de manter sob controle, seja impedindo algo de acontecer, detendo uma pessoa, ou apegando-se firmemente a convicções e ensinamentos. 1. Reter, conter ou impedir a ação de algo ou alguém (Rm 1.18; 2Ts 2.6). | 2. Retenção firme de tradições, doutrinas ou memórias, guardar (1Co 15.2; 1Ts 5.21). | 3. Possuir ou manter sob sua posse (2Co 6.10).
THAYER.en: Has the basic sense of keeping under control, either by preventing something from happening, detaining a person, or holding firmly to convictions and teachings. 1. To hold back, restrain, or prevent the action of something or someone (Rom 1:18; 2Thess 2:6). | 2. Firm retention of traditions, doctrines, or memories, to keep (1Cor 15:2; 1Thess 5:21). | 3. To possess or keep in one's possession (2Cor 6:10).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: κατηγορήσω, Aor: κατηγόρησα, Aor. Pass: κατηγορήθην
DEFINITION: To bring formal accusations against someone, commonly in a court before human judges or before God. It can also mean to censure or speak against someone generally.
SENSES: 1. To present a legal accusation before a human court (Mark 15:3; Acts 22:30).
2. To accuse before the divine court (John 5:45).
3. To censure or reprove without formal legal proceedings (Rom 2:15).

THAYER.pt: Trazer acusações formais contra alguém, comumente em um tribunal perante juízes humanos ou diante de Deus. Pode também significar censurar ou falar contra alguém de modo geral. 1. Apresentar acusação legal perante um tribunal humano (Mc 15.3; At 22.30). | 2. Acusar perante o tribunal divino (Jo 5.45). | 3. Censurar ou reprovar sem formalidade jurídica (Rm 2.15).
THAYER.en: To bring formal accusations against someone, commonly in a court before human judges or before God. It can also mean to censure or speak against someone generally. 1. To present a legal accusation before a human court (Mark 15:3; Acts 22:30). | 2. To accuse before the divine court (John 5:45). | 3. To censure or reprove without formal legal proceedings (Rom 2:15).

DEFINITION: A formal accusation or denunciation brought against someone before a judicial or social authority.
SENSES: 1. A formal accusation of crime or fault (John 18:29; Titus 1:6).

THAYER.pt: Uma acusação formal ou denúncia apresentada contra alguém perante uma autoridade judicial ou social. 1. Acusação formal de crime ou falta (Jo 18.29; Tt 1.6).
THAYER.en: A formal accusation or denunciation brought against someone before a judicial or social authority. 1. A formal accusation of crime or fault (John 18:29; Titus 1:6).

DEFINITION: One who formally formulates accusations against someone before a judicial authority.
SENSES: 1. Legal party or accuser in a court (Acts 25:16).

THAYER.pt: Aquele que formula formalmente acusações contra alguém perante uma autoridade judicial. 1. Parte processual ou acusador em um tribunal (At 25.16).
THAYER.en: One who formally formulates accusations against someone before a judicial authority. 1. Legal party or accuser in a court (Acts 25:16).

DEFINITION: A state of spiritual dejection, lowering of the face, and deep sadness in the face of sin or misery.
SENSES: 1. Melancholy, dejection, or deep sorrow because of judgment (Jas 4:9).

THAYER.pt: Estado de abatimento espiritual, abatimento da face e tristeza profunda diante do pecado ou da miséria. 1. Melancolia, abatimento ou tristeza profunda por causa do juízo (Tg 4:9).
THAYER.en: A state of spiritual dejection, lowering of the face, and deep sadness in the face of sin or misery. 1. Melancholy, dejection, or deep sorrow because of judgment (Jas 4:9).

DEFINITION: To transmit oral instruction or report news and facts to someone, especially in the context of doctrinal teachings and basic Christian doctrine.
SENSES: 1. To inform or report news in a detailed manner (Acts 21:21).
2. To instruct in doctrine or catechize converts (Luke 1:4; Gal 6:6).

THAYER.pt: Transmitir instrução oral ou relatar notícias e fatos a alguém, especialmente no contexto de ensinamentos doutrinários e doutrina cristã básica. 1. Informar ou relatar notícias de maneira detalhada (At 21.21). | 2. Instruir na doutrina ou catequizar convertidos (Lc 1.4; Gl 6.6).
THAYER.en: To transmit oral instruction or report news and facts to someone, especially in the context of doctrinal teachings and basic Christian doctrine. 1. To inform or report news in a detailed manner (Acts 21:21). | 2. To instruct in doctrine or catechize converts (Luke 1:4; Gal 6:6).

DEFINITION: To become covered in rust or corrosion due to oxidation or disuse.
SENSES: 1. To become rusted or corroded by time and neglect (Jas 5:3).

THAYER.pt: Tornar-se coberto de ferrugem ou corrosão por causa da oxidação ou do desuso. 1. Ficar enferrujado ou corroído pelo tempo e pela negligência (Tg 5:3).
THAYER.en: To become covered in rust or corrosion due to oxidation or disuse. 1. To become rusted or corroded by time and neglect (Jas 5:3).

DEFINITION: To have superior strength to overcome opposition, dominate, or gain victory over someone.
SENSES: 1. To have sufficient strength to prevail or resist (Luke 21:36; 23:23).
2. To conquer or overpower with superior might (Matt 16:18).

THAYER.pt: Ter força superior para superar oposição, dominar ou obter a vitória sobre alguém. 1. Ter força suficiente para prevalecer ou resistir (Lc 21.36; 23.23). | 2. Vencer ou sobrepujar com poder superior (Mt 16.18).
THAYER.en: To have superior strength to overcome opposition, dominate, or gain victory over someone. 1. To have sufficient strength to prevail or resist (Luke 21:36; 23:23). | 2. To conquer or overpower with superior might (Matt 16:18).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: κατοικήσω, Aor: κατῴκησα, Perf: κατῴκηκα
DEFINITION: To fix one's domicile continuously, permanently, and stably in a region or house. Used theologically for the full dwelling of divinity in Christ or of the Spirit in the believer's soul.
SENSES: 1. To live, settle, and reside permanently in a city or land (Matt 2:23; Acts 1:19).
2. To make a spiritual or mystical dwelling in someone or something (Eph 3:17; Col 2:9).
3. In Revelation: the inhabitants or worshippers of the earthly system ('those who dwell on the earth') (Rev 3:10; 8:13).

THAYER.pt: Fixar domicílio de forma contínua, permanente e estável numa região ou casa. Usa-se teologicamente para a habitação plena da divindade em Cristo ou do Espírito na alma dos crentes. 1. Viver, estabelecer-se e residir permanentemente numa cidade ou terra (Mt 2.23; At 1.19). | 2. Fazer habitação espiritual ou mística em alguém ou algo (Ef 3.17; Cl 2.9). | 3. No Apocalipse: os habitantes ou adoradores do sistema terreno ('os que habitam na terra') (Ap 3.10; 8.13).
THAYER.en: To fix one's domicile continuously, permanently, and stably in a region or house. Used theologically for the full dwelling of divinity in Christ or of the Spirit in the believer's soul. 1. To live, settle, and reside permanently in a city or land (Matt 2:23; Acts 1:19). | 2. To make a spiritual or mystical dwelling in someone or something (Eph 3:17; Col 2:9). | 3. In Revelation: the inhabitants or worshippers of the earthly system ('those who dwell on the earth') (Rev 3:10; 8:13).

DEFINITION: The act of dwelling or the physical place designated for human or animal habitation.
SENSES: 1. Place of residence or dwelling (Mark 5:3).

THAYER.pt: O ato de morar ou o lugar físico designado para habitação humana ou animal. 1. Local de residência ou habitação (Mc 5:3).
THAYER.en: The act of dwelling or the physical place designated for human or animal habitation. 1. Place of residence or dwelling (Mark 5:3).

DEFINITION: Designates a place of permanent dwelling, especially the habitation of spiritual or divine beings.
SENSES: 1. Dwelling place or habitation of God in the Spirit (Eph 2:22).
2. Dwelling place of demons or corrupted spiritual forces (Rev 18:2).

THAYER.pt: Designa um lugar de moradia permanente, especialmente a habitação de seres espirituais ou divinos. 1. Habitação ou morada de Deus no Espírito (Ef 2.22). | 2. Morada de demônios ou forças espirituais corrompidas (Ap 18.2).
THAYER.en: Designates a place of permanent dwelling, especially the habitation of spiritual or divine beings. 1. Dwelling place or habitation of God in the Spirit (Eph 2:22). | 2. Dwelling place of demons or corrupted spiritual forces (Rev 18:2).

DEFINITION: A settlement, location, or dwelling where someone permanently resides.
SENSES: 1. An established dwelling or habitation.

THAYER.pt: Um assentamento, local ou habitação onde alguém reside permanentemente. 1. Morada ou habitação estabelecida.
THAYER.en: A settlement, location, or dwelling where someone permanently resides. 1. An established dwelling or habitation.

SHORT_GLOSS: reflect, see as in a mirror
DEFINITION: To reflect light like a mirror or contemplate something through a reflection.
SENSES: 1. To reflect glory as in a mirror or behold in reflection.
USAGE: reflect, see as in a mirror

THAYER.pt: Refletir luz como um espelho ou contemplar algo por meio de um reflexo. 1. Refletir a glória como em um espelho ou contemplar em reflexo.
THAYER.en: To reflect light like a mirror or contemplate something through a reflection. 1. To reflect glory as in a mirror or behold in reflection.

DEFINITION: The result of a successful enterprise or the maintenance of an orderly and just condition.
SENSES: 1. Prosperity and success in achievements.
2. The maintenance of a correct and proper order.

THAYER.pt: O resultado de um empreendimento bem-sucedido ou a manutenção de uma condição ordenada e justa. 1. Prosperidade e sucesso em realizações. | 2. A manutenção de uma ordem correta e adequada.
THAYER.en: The result of a successful enterprise or the maintenance of an orderly and just condition. 1. Prosperity and success in achievements. | 2. The maintenance of a correct and proper order.

DEFINITION: Indicates an inferior position or movement toward a lower point relative to a frame of reference.
SENSES: 1. In an inferior position or underneath something (Mk 14:66).
2. Toward the lower part, downward (Mt 4:6).

THAYER.pt: Indica uma posição inferior ou um movimento em direção a um ponto mais baixo em relação a um referencial. 1. Em posição inferior ou embaixo de algo (Mc 14.66). | 2. Em direção à parte inferior, para baixo (Mt 4.6).
THAYER.en: Indicates an inferior position or movement toward a lower point relative to a frame of reference. 1. In an inferior position or underneath something (Mk 14:66). | 2. Toward the lower part, downward (Mt 4:6).

DEFINITION: Situated in a lower position relative to a reference point.
SENSES: 1. Lower or more depressed regions, such as the earth (Eph 4:9).

THAYER.pt: Que está situado em uma posição mais baixa em relação a um ponto de referência. 1. Regiões inferiores ou mais baixas, como a terra (Ef 4:9).
THAYER.en: Situated in a lower position relative to a reference point. 1. Lower or more depressed regions, such as the earth (Eph 4:9).

DEFINITION: Refers to an intense and scorching heat capable of causing physical suffering or burning vegetation.
SENSES: 1. Strong and scorching heat coming from the sun or from eschatological judgments (Rev 16:9).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se a um calor intenso e abrasador, capaz de causar sofrimento físico ou queimar a vegetação. 1. Calor forte e abrasador proveniente do sol ou de juízos escatológicos (Ap 16.9).
THAYER.en: Refers to an intense and scorching heat capable of causing physical suffering or burning vegetation. 1. Strong and scorching heat coming from the sun or from eschatological judgments (Rev 16:9).

DEFINITION: Indicates the act of causing damage or intense suffering through excessive heat, burning or scorching vegetation or people.
SENSES: 1. To burn or wither plants due to intense heat from the sun (Mt 13:6).
2. To cause intense human suffering through scorching heat (Rev 16:8).

THAYER.pt: Indica o ato de causar danos ou sofrimento intenso por meio de calor excessivo, queimando ou abrasando vegetação ou pessoas. 1. Queimar ou secar plantas devido ao calor intenso do sol (Mt 13.6). | 2. Causar intenso sofrimento humano através do calor escaldante (Ap 16.8).
THAYER.en: Indicates the act of causing damage or intense suffering through excessive heat, burning or scorching vegetation or people. 1. To burn or wither plants due to intense heat from the sun (Mt 13:6). | 2. To cause intense human suffering through scorching heat (Rev 16:8).

DEFINITION: The process or act of burning or being consumed by fire.
SENSES: 1. Destruction by fire or burning (Heb 6:8).

THAYER.pt: O processo ou o ato de queimar ou ser consumido pelo fogo. 1. Destruição pelo fogo ou queima (Hb 6:8).
THAYER.en: The process or act of burning or being consumed by fire. 1. Destruction by fire or burning (Heb 6:8).

DEFINITION: Means to be consumed by extreme heat or to blaze intensely.
SENSES: 1. Incandescence or destruction of cosmic elements by intense heat at the final judgment (2 Pet 3:10).

THAYER.pt: Significa ser consumido por um calor extremo ou vir a arder intensamente. 1. Incandescência ou destruição de elementos cósmicos pelo calor intenso no juízo final (2Pe 3.10).
THAYER.en: Means to be consumed by extreme heat or to blaze intensely. 1. Incandescence or destruction of cosmic elements by intense heat at the final judgment (2 Pet 3:10).

DEFINITION: Intense and abrasive heat, frequently associated with the hot desert wind or the scorching sun.
SENSES: 1. Abrasive heat or hot desert wind that dries vegetation and causes fatigue (Mt 20:12; Lk 12:55; Jas 1:11).

THAYER.pt: Calor intenso e abrasivo, frequentemente associado ao vento quente do deserto ou ao sol causticante. 1. Calor abrasivo ou vento quente do sol que seca a vegetação e causa fadiga (Mt 20.12; Lc 12.55; Tg 1.11).
THAYER.en: Intense and abrasive heat, frequently associated with the hot desert wind or the scorching sun. 1. Abrasive heat or hot desert wind that dries vegetation and causes fatigue (Mt 20:12; Lk 12:55; Jas 1:11).

SHORT_GLOSS: to cauterize, to brand with iron
DEFINITION: To touch with a hot iron to mark or burn tissues, metaphorically applied to an insensitive conscience.
SENSES: 1. To cauterize or mark with a red-hot iron.
USAGE: to cauterize, to brand with iron

THAYER.pt: Tocar com ferro quente para marcar ou queimar tecidos, metaforicamente aplicado a uma consciência insensível. 1. Cauterizar ou marcar com ferro em brasa.
THAYER.en: To touch with a hot iron to mark or burn tissues, metaphorically applied to an insensitive conscience. 1. To cauterize or mark with a red-hot iron.

DEFINITION: To feel and express extreme pride or confidence in someone or some achievement, which can be reproved when in one's own strength or praised when in God.
SENSES: 1. To take pride, boast, or glory in something or someone (Rom 2:17; 1 Cor 1:31).
2. To exult or rejoice based on divine grace (Rom 5:11).

THAYER.pt: Sentir e expressar orgulho ou confiança extrema em alguém ou em alguma realização, podendo ser reprovado quando na própria força ou louvado quando em Deus. 1. Ter orgulho, vangloriar-se ou gloriar-se em algo ou alguém (Rm 2.17; 1Co 1.31). | 2. Exultar ou alegrar-se com base na graça divina (Rm 5.11).
THAYER.en: To feel and express extreme pride or confidence in someone or some achievement, which can be reproved when in one's own strength or praised when in God. 1. To take pride, boast, or glory in something or someone (Rom 2:17; 1 Cor 1:31). | 2. To exult or rejoice based on divine grace (Rom 5:11).

DEFINITION: The foundation, reason, or concrete object by which someone expresses legitimate pride or boasting.
SENSES: 1. The legitimate motive or basis for contentment and exultation (Rom 4:2; Phil 2:16).
2. Verbal expression of pride or boasting before others (2 Cor 9:3).

THAYER.pt: O fundamento, a razão ou o objeto concreto pelo qual alguém expressa orgulho legítimo ou vanglória. 1. O motivo ou base legítima de contentamento e exultação (Rm 4:2; Fp 2:16). | 2. Expressão verbal de orgulho ou jactância perante outros (2Co 9:3).
THAYER.en: The foundation, reason, or concrete object by which someone expresses legitimate pride or boasting. 1. The legitimate motive or basis for contentment and exultation (Rom 4:2; Phil 2:16). | 2. Verbal expression of pride or boasting before others (2 Cor 9:3).

DEFINITION: The action of glorying, boasting, or expressing strong confidence in achievements or privileges.
SENSES: 1. The active act of boasting or expressing pride (1 Thess 2:19).
2. The specific object or motive of exultation (2 Cor 1:12).

THAYER.pt: A ação de gloriar-se, vangloriar-se ou expressar forte confiança em conquistas ou privilégios. 1. O ato ativo de vangloriar-se ou expressar orgulho (1Ts 2:19). | 2. O objeto ou motivo específico de exultação (2Co 1:12).
THAYER.en: The action of glorying, boasting, or expressing strong confidence in achievements or privileges. 1. The active act of boasting or expressing pride (1 Thess 2:19). | 2. The specific object or motive of exultation (2 Cor 1:12).

DEFINITION: Name of an important eastern port of the city of Corinth, situated on the isthmus.
SENSES: 1. Cenchrea, a seaport associated with the early church in the region of Corinth (Acts 18:18; Rom 16:1).

THAYER.pt: Nome de um importante porto oriental da cidade de Corinto, situado no istmo. 1. Cencréia, porto marítimo associado à igreja primitiva na região de Corinto (At 18.18; Rm 16.1).
THAYER.en: Name of an important eastern port of the city of Corinth, situated on the isthmus. 1. Cenchrea, a seaport associated with the early church in the region of Corinth (Acts 18:18; Rom 16:1).

DEFINITION: Name of the valley located east of Jerusalem, between the city and the Mount of Olives, crossed by a stream.
SENSES: 1. The valley and brook of Kidron (Jn 18:1).

THAYER.pt: Nome do vale localizado a leste de Jerusalém, entre a cidade e o Monte das Oliveiras, atravessado por um ribeiro. 1. O vale e o ribeiro de Cedrom (Jo 18:1).
THAYER.en: Name of the valley located east of Jerusalem, between the city and the Mount of Olives, crossed by a stream. 1. The valley and brook of Kidron (Jn 18:1).

DEFINITION: Indicates a lying position or the state of being placed in a certain place. It is also used figuratively to express the establishment of laws, destinies, or realities.
SENSES: 1. To be in a horizontal position, lying or reclining (Lk 2:12).
2. To be located or situated in a physical space (Rev 21:16).
3. To be appointed, ordained, or established by decree or destiny (Phil 1:17; 1 Thess 3:3).

THAYER.pt: Indica uma posição deitada ou o estado de estar colocado em determinado lugar. Também é empregado figuradamente para expressar o estabelecimento de leis, destinos ou realidades. 1. Estar em posição horizontal, deitado ou reclinado (Lc 2.12). | 2. Estar localizado ou situado em um espaço físico (Ap 21.16). | 3. Estar apontado, ordenado ou estabelecido por decreto ou destino (Fp 1.17; 1Ts 3.3).
THAYER.en: Indicates a lying position or the state of being placed in a certain place. It is also used figuratively to express the establishment of laws, destinies, or realities. 1. To be in a horizontal position, lying or reclining (Lk 2:12). | 2. To be located or situated in a physical space (Rev 21:16). | 3. To be appointed, ordained, or established by decree or destiny (Phil 1:17; 1 Thess 3:3).

DEFINITION: Bands or strips of cloth used in the ancient world to wrap the body of a deceased person during burial.
SENSES: 1. Linen strips used to wrap the dead (Jn 11:44).

THAYER.pt: Faixas ou tiras de tecido utilizadas no mundo antigo para envolver o corpo de um falecido durante o sepultamento. 1. Faixas de linho usadas para enfaixar mortos (Jo 11:44).
THAYER.en: Bands or strips of cloth used in the ancient world to wrap the body of a deceased person during burial. 1. Linen strips used to wrap the dead (Jn 11:44).

DEFINITION: Means to cut the wool of animals or the hair of a person as part of a ritual, vow, or practical activity.
SENSES: 1. To shear sheep to remove wool (Acts 8:32).
2. To cut or shave one's own hair in fulfillment of a vow (Acts 18:18).

THAYER.pt: Significa cortar a lã de animais ou o cabelo de uma pessoa como parte de um ritual, voto ou atividade prática. 1. Tosquiar ovelhas para retirar a lã (At 8.32). | 2. Cortar ou rapar o próprio cabelo em cumprimento de um voto (At 18.18).
THAYER.en: Means to cut the wool of animals or the hair of a person as part of a ritual, vow, or practical activity. 1. To shear sheep to remove wool (Acts 8:32). | 2. To cut or shave one's own hair in fulfillment of a vow (Acts 18:18).

DEFINITION: A vocal signal of command or order issued by someone in authority to mobilize or direct.
SENSES: 1. A voice of command or authoritative call (1 Thess 4:16).

THAYER.pt: Um sinal vocal de comando ou ordem emitido por alguém em autoridade para mobilizar ou dirigir. 1. Voz de comando ou chamado com autoridade (1Ts 4:16).
THAYER.en: A vocal signal of command or order issued by someone in authority to mobilize or direct. 1. A voice of command or authoritative call (1 Thess 4:16).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: κελεύσω, Aor: ἐκέλευσα, Pass. Aor: ἐκελεύσθην
DEFINITION: Expresses the act of giving an order or instruction of an official nature or with authority, demanding obedience.
SENSES: 1. To give an official order or command (Mt 14:28; 18:25).

THAYER.pt: Expressa o ato de dar uma ordem ou instrução de natureza oficial ou com autoridade, exigindo obediência. 1. Dar uma ordem ou comando oficial (Mt 14.28; 18.25).
THAYER.en: Expresses the act of giving an order or instruction of an official nature or with authority, demanding obedience. 1. To give an official order or command (Mt 14:28; 18:25).

DEFINITION: Refers to an exaggerated self-evaluation without real basis, characterized by empty pride, presumption, or boasting in social interaction.
SENSES: 1. Vain glory or empty, unfounded pride (Phil 2:3).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se a uma avaliação exagerada de si mesmo sem base real, caracterizada por orgulho vazio, presunção ou vanglória no trato social. 1. Vã glória ou orgulho vazio e infundado (Fp 2.3).
THAYER.en: Refers to an exaggerated self-evaluation without real basis, characterized by empty pride, presumption, or boasting in social interaction. 1. Vain glory or empty, unfounded pride (Phil 2:3).

DEFINITION: Describes someone who holds an excessive and empty opinion of themselves, seeking vain glory or provoking others.
SENSES: 1. One who is presumptuous or desirous of vain glory (Gal 5:26).

THAYER.pt: Descreve alguém que possui uma opinião excessiva e vazia de si mesmo, buscando glória vã ou provocando os outros. 1. Aquele que é presunçoso ou cobiçoso de vã glória (Gl 5.26).
THAYER.en: Describes someone who holds an excessive and empty opinion of themselves, seeking vain glory or provoking others. 1. One who is presumptuous or desirous of vain glory (Gal 5:26).

DEFINITION: Refers to the absence of content, substance, moral value, or practical result. It can describe both a physically empty container and fruitless spiritual efforts.
SENSES: 1. Empty in the literal or material sense (Mk 12:3).
2. Void of moral value or spiritual truth, futile (Eph 5:6).
3. Without purpose or practical result, in vain (2 Cor 6:1).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se à ausência de conteúdo, substância, valor moral ou resultado prático. Pode descrever tanto um recipiente físico vazio quanto esforços espirituais infrutíferos. 1. Vazio no sentido literal ou material (Mc 12.3). | 2. Desprovido de valor moral ou verdade espiritual, fútil (Ef 5.6). | 3. Sem propósito ou sem resultado prático, em vão (2Co 6.1).
THAYER.en: Refers to the absence of content, substance, moral value, or practical result. It can describe both a physically empty container and fruitless spiritual efforts. 1. Empty in the literal or material sense (Mk 12:3). | 2. Void of moral value or spiritual truth, futile (Eph 5:6). | 3. Without purpose or practical result, in vain (2 Cor 6:1).

DEFINITION: Indicates empty conversations, chatter without spiritual content, or profane conversations lacking real value.
SENSES: 1. Futile discussions and empty chatter contrary to sound doctrine (1 Tim 6:20; 2 Tim 2:16).

THAYER.pt: Indica conversas vazias, tagarelice sem conteúdo espiritual ou conversas profanas que carecem de valor real. 1. Discussões fúteis e tagarelice vazia contrárias à sana doutrina (1Tm 6.20; 2Tm 2.16).
THAYER.en: Indicates empty conversations, chatter without spiritual content, or profane conversations lacking real value. 1. Futile discussions and empty chatter contrary to sound doctrine (1 Tim 6:20; 2 Tim 2:16).

DEFINITION: To make empty, empty of content, or strip of power and relevance, nullifying the efficacy of something.
SENSES: 1. To empty or strip of privileges and status, figuratively applied to Christ's humiliation (Phil 2:7).
2. To render void, without effect, or vain a promise, faith, or power (Rom 4:14; 1 Cor 1:17).

THAYER.pt: Tornar vazio, esvaziar de conteúdo ou despojar de poder e relevância, anulando a eficácia de algo. 1. Esvaziar ou despojar de privilégios e status, figuradamente aplicado à humilhação de Cristo (Fp 2.7). | 2. Tornar nulo, sem efeito ou vã uma promessa, fé ou poder (Rm 4.14; 1Co 1.17).
THAYER.en: To make empty, empty of content, or strip of power and relevance, nullifying the efficacy of something. 1. To empty or strip of privileges and status, figuratively applied to Christ's humiliation (Phil 2:7). | 2. To render void, without effect, or vain a promise, faith, or power (Rom 4:14; 1 Cor 1:17).

DEFINITION: A pointed tip used both as a venomous anatomical projection and as an agricultural instrument to guide animals.
SENSES: 1. The pointed sting of insects or venomous animals (1 Cor 15:55; Rev 9:10).
2. A goad, a pointed stick used to spur oxen and draft animals (Acts 9:4; 26:14).

THAYER.pt: Ponta afilada usada tanto como projeção anatômica peçonhenta quanto como instrumento agrícola para guiar animais. 1. O ferrão pontiagudo de insetos ou animais peçonhentos (1Co 15.55; Ap 9.10). | 2. Aguilhão, uma vara pontiaguda usada para estimular bois e animais de carga (At 9.4; 26.14).
THAYER.en: A pointed tip used both as a venomous anatomical projection and as an agricultural instrument to guide animals. 1. The pointed sting of insects or venomous animals (1 Cor 15:55; Rev 9:10). | 2. A goad, a pointed stick used to spur oxen and draft animals (Acts 9:4; 26:14).

DEFINITION: Designates a Roman army officer in charge of commanding approximately one hundred soldiers (a century).
SENSES: 1. A middle-ranking Roman military officer (Mk 15:39, 44-45).

THAYER.pt: Designa um oficial do exército romano encarregado do comando de aproximadamente cem soldados (uma centúria). 1. Oficial militar romano de alta patente intermédia (Mc 15.39, 44-45).
THAYER.en: Designates a Roman army officer in charge of commanding approximately one hundred soldiers (a century). 1. A middle-ranking Roman military officer (Mk 15:39, 44-45).

DEFINITION: Indicates an action or state that occurs without real effect, purpose, or result, being performed in vain.
SENSES: 1. In a vain manner or without practical effect (Jas 4:5).

THAYER.pt: Indica uma ação ou estado que ocorre sem efeito, propósito ou resultado real, sendo realizada em vão. 1. De maneira vã ou sem efeito prático (Tg 4.5).
THAYER.en: Indicates an action or state that occurs without real effect, purpose, or result, being performed in vain. 1. In a vain manner or without practical effect (Jas 4:5).

DEFINITION: Originally meaning 'horn', it denotes a small stroke, hook, or ornamental projection used in the letters of the Hebrew alphabet.
SENSES: 1. The smallest part or distinctive stroke of a letter in Scripture (Mt 5:18; Lk 16:17).

THAYER.pt: Originalmente significando 'chifre', denota um pequeno traço, gancho ou projeção ornamental usada em letras do alfabeto hebraico. 1. A menor parte ou traço distintivo de uma letra na Escritura (Mt 5.18; Lc 16.17).
THAYER.en: Originally meaning 'horn', it denotes a small stroke, hook, or ornamental projection used in the letters of the Hebrew alphabet. 1. The smallest part or distinctive stroke of a letter in Scripture (Mt 5:18; Lk 16:17).

DEFINITION: Refers to the craftsman who molds vessels and ceramic objects from clay or mud.
SENSES: 1. A maker of clay or ceramic vessels (Mt 27:7, 10);
2. A metaphor for God's creative sovereignty over humanity (Rom 9:21).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se ao artesão que molda vasilhas e objetos de cerâmica a partir do barro ou argila. 1. Fabricante de recipientes de barro ou cerâmica (Mt 27.7, 10); | 2. Metáfora da soberania criadora de Deus sobre a humanidade (Rm 9.21).
THAYER.en: Refers to the craftsman who molds vessels and ceramic objects from clay or mud. 1. A maker of clay or ceramic vessels (Mt 27:7, 10); | 2. A metaphor for God's creative sovereignty over humanity (Rom 9:21).

DEFINITION: Relating to the work of a potter or made of fired clay material.
SENSES: 1. Made of clay or ceramic, such as a potter's vessel (Rev 2:27).

THAYER.pt: Relativo ao trabalho de um oleiro ou feito de material de argila cozida. 1. Feito de barro ou cerâmica, como um vaso de oleiro (Ap 2.27).
THAYER.en: Relating to the work of a potter or made of fired clay material. 1. Made of clay or ceramic, such as a potter's vessel (Rev 2:27).

DEFINITION: Designates a container or vessel made of ceramic or clay intended for holding liquids.
SENSES: 1. An earthen pitcher or jar used for carrying water or liquids (Mk 14:13; Lk 22:10).

THAYER.pt: Designa um recipiente ou vaso feito de cerâmica ou barro destinado a guardar líquidos. 1. Cântaro ou jarro de barro usado para carregar água ou líquidos (Mc 14.13; Lc 22.10).
THAYER.en: Designates a container or vessel made of ceramic or clay intended for holding liquids. 1. An earthen pitcher or jar used for carrying water or liquids (Mk 14:13; Lk 22:10).

DEFINITION: Primarily designates clay or earthen material, later used to describe roof tiles made of this material.
SENSES: 1. An earthen tile used in the roofing of buildings (Lk 5:19).

THAYER.pt: Designa primordialmente a argila ou material de barro, passando a ser usado também para descrever telhas de telhado feitas desse material. 1. Telha de barro usada na cobertura de construções (Lc 5.19).
THAYER.en: Primarily designates clay or earthen material, later used to describe roof tiles made of this material. 1. An earthen tile used in the roofing of buildings (Lk 5:19).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: κεράσω, Aor: ἐκέρασα, Perf: κεκέραςμαι
DEFINITION: The act of mixing liquid components, traditionally mixing water with wine, or preparing a mixture of ingredients.
SENSES: 1. To mix liquid substances, especially pure wine with water (Rev 18:6).

THAYER.pt: Ato de misturar componentes líquidos, tradicionalmente misturando água ao vinho, ou preparar uma mistura de ingredientes. 1. Misturar substâncias líquidas, especialmente vinho puro com água (Ap 18.6).
THAYER.en: The act of mixing liquid components, traditionally mixing water with wine, or preparing a mixture of ingredients. 1. To mix liquid substances, especially pure wine with water (Rev 18:6).

DEFINITION: A bony projection on the head of animals, frequently used in Scripture as a metaphor for military power, sovereignty, or salvation.
SENSES: 1. The anatomical horn of animals (Rev 5:6; 12:3).
2. Horn-shaped projections on the corners of altars (Rev 9:13).
3. An Old Testament symbol of royal power, sovereignty, and saving strength (Lk 1:69).

THAYER.pt: Projeção óssea na cabeça de animais, frequentemente usada nas Escrituras como metáfora de poder militar, soberania ou salvação. 1. Chifre anatômico de animais (Ap 5:6; 12:3). | 2. Projeções em forma de chifre nos cantos de altares (Ap 9:13). | 3. Símbolo veterotestamentário de poder régio, soberania e força salvadora (Lc 1:69).
THAYER.en: A bony projection on the head of animals, frequently used in Scripture as a metaphor for military power, sovereignty, or salvation. 1. The anatomical horn of animals (Rev 5:6; 12:3). | 2. Horn-shaped projections on the corners of altars (Rev 9:13). | 3. An Old Testament symbol of royal power, sovereignty, and saving strength (Lk 1:69).

DEFINITION: A diminutive designating the pod of the carob tree, the shape of which resembles a small horn, used as food for animals and the poor.
SENSES: 1. A carob pod consumed by animals (Lk 15:16).

THAYER.pt: Diminutivo que designa a vagem da árvore da alfarroba, cujo formato lembra um pequeno chifre, usada como alimento para animais e pobres. 1. Vagem da alfarroba consumida por animais (Lc 15.16).
THAYER.en: A diminutive designating the pod of the carob tree, the shape of which resembles a small horn, used as food for animals and the poor. 1. A carob pod consumed by animals (Lk 15:16).

SHORT_GLOSS: to gain, to profit, to win
DEFINITION: To acquire profit, goods, or advantages through effort or commercial investment. In New Testament usage, it is often re-signified to indicate the spiritual winning of people for the Kingdom of God or the preservation of life.
SENSES: 1. To obtain profit or material gain through trade or investment (Mt 25:16).
2. Figuratively, to win or rescue a person for communion with God (Mt 18:15; 1 Cor 9:19).
3. To avoid damage or loss, resulting in a protective advantage (Acts 27:21).
USAGE: to gain, to profit, to win

THAYER.pt: Significa adquirir lucro, bens ou vantagens através de esforço ou investimento comercial. No uso neotestamentário, é frequentemente ressignificado para indicar a conquista espiritual de pessoas para o Reino de Deus ou a preservação da vida. 1. Obter lucro ou ganho material por meio de comércio ou investimento (Mt 25.16). | 2. Em sentido figurado, ganhar ou resgatar uma pessoa para a comunhão com Deus (Mt 18.15; 1Co 9.19). | 3. Evitar um dano ou prejuízo, resultando em vantagem protetiva (At 27.21).
THAYER.en: To acquire profit, goods, or advantages through effort or commercial investment. In New Testament usage, it is often re-signified to indicate the spiritual winning of people for the Kingdom of God or the preservation of life. 1. To obtain profit or material gain through trade or investment (Mt 25:16). | 2. Figuratively, to win or rescue a person for communion with God (Mt 18:15; 1 Cor 9:19). | 3. To avoid damage or loss, resulting in a protective advantage (Acts 27:21).

DEFINITION: That which is gained or acquired as financial profit or personal advantage.
SENSES: 1. An advantage or profit obtained, whether material or spiritual (Phil 1:21).

THAYER.pt: Aquilo que é ganho ou adquirido como proveito financeiro ou vantagem pessoal. 1. Vantagem ou proveito obtido, seja material ou espiritual (Fp 1.21).
THAYER.en: That which is gained or acquired as financial profit or personal advantage. 1. An advantage or profit obtained, whether material or spiritual (Phil 1:21).

DEFINITION: Refers to a small fractional coin or change of lesser nominal value in monetary circulation.
SENSES: 1. A coin of small value or small change (Jn 2:15).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se a uma pequena moeda fracionária ou troco de menor valor nominal em circulação monetária. 1. Moeda de pequeno valor ou troco (Jo 2.15).
THAYER.en: Refers to a small fractional coin or change of lesser nominal value in monetary circulation. 1. A coin of small value or small change (Jn 2:15).

DEFINITION: A professional whose occupation was to exchange coins of different mints or values in a commercial and religious context.
SENSES: 1. A money changer in the temple (Jn 2:14).

THAYER.pt: Profissional cuja ocupação era trocar moedas de diferentes cunhagens ou valores no contexto comercial e religioso. 1. Cambista de moedas no templo (Jo 2.14).
THAYER.en: A professional whose occupation was to exchange coins of different mints or values in a commercial and religious context. 1. A money changer in the temple (Jn 2:14).

DEFINITION: Refers to the central point of an argument, a synthesis, or the principal sum of money (capital).
SENSES: 1. The main point or summary of a discourse or teaching (Heb 8:1).
2. A total sum of money or invested capital (Acts 22:28).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se ao ponto central de um argumento, a uma síntese ou à soma principal de dinheiro (capital). 1. O ponto principal ou sumário de um discurso ou ensinamento (Hb 8.1). | 2. Uma soma total de dinheiro ou capital investido (At 22.28).
THAYER.en: Refers to the central point of an argument, a synthesis, or the principal sum of money (capital). 1. The main point or summary of a discourse or teaching (Heb 8:1). | 2. A total sum of money or invested capital (Acts 22:28).

SHORT_GLOSS: to summarize, to strike on the head
DEFINITION: From the basic sense of summarizing or accumulating, it can also denote physical violence directed at the head.
SENSES: 1. To summarize or accumulate the total measure.
2. To treat brutally or strike on the head (Mk 12:4 v.l.).
USAGE: to summarize, to strike on the head

THAYER.pt: Do sentido básico de resumir ou acumular, pode também denotar violência física direcionada à cabeça. 1. Resumir ou acumular a medida total. | 2. Tratar brutalmente ou golpear na cabeça (Mc 12.4 v.l.).
THAYER.en: From the basic sense of summarizing or accumulating, it can also denote physical violence directed at the head. 1. To summarize or accumulate the total measure. | 2. To treat brutally or strike on the head (Mk 12:4 v.l.).

DEFINITION: Refers primarily to the upper anatomical part of the human or animal body, but is widely used in the New Testament in a metaphorical sense to denote authority, supremacy, or origin.
SENSES: 1. The physical head of the body (Mt 5:36; 8:20).
2. Supreme authority or head in a figurative sense, especially applied to Christ over the church (Eph 1:22; Col 1:18).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se primeiramente à parte anatômica superior do corpo humano ou animal, mas é amplamente utilizada no Novo Testamento em sentido metafórico para denotar autoridade, supremacia ou origem. 1. A cabeça física do corpo (Mt 5.36; 8.20). | 2. Autoridade suprema ou cabeça em sentido figurado, especialmente aplicada a Cristo sobre a igreja (Ef 1.22; Cl 1.18).
THAYER.en: Refers primarily to the upper anatomical part of the human or animal body, but is widely used in the New Testament in a metaphorical sense to denote authority, supremacy, or origin. 1. The physical head of the body (Mt 5:36; 8:20). | 2. Supreme authority or head in a figurative sense, especially applied to Christ over the church (Eph 1:22; Col 1:18).

DEFINITION: Derived from 'head', it refers to the extremity of a manuscript scroll or a section of an ancient book.
SENSES: 1. The scroll or section of a book (Heb 10:7).

THAYER.pt: Derivado de cabeça, refere-se à extremidade de um rolo de manuscrito ou à seção de um livro antigo. 1. O rolo ou seção de um livro (Hb 10.7).
THAYER.en: Derived from 'head', it refers to the extremity of a manuscript scroll or a section of an ancient book. 1. The scroll or section of a book (Heb 10:7).

DEFINITION: A term of Latin origin designating the poll tax or tribute collected by Roman authority from the inhabitants of the provinces.
SENSES: 1. The tax or tribute paid to the Roman imperial authority (Mt 22:17).

THAYER.pt: Termo de origem latina que designa o imposto de cabeça ou tributo cobrado pela autoridade romana sobre os habitantes das províncias. 1. O imposto ou tributo pago à autoridade imperial romana (Mt 22.17).
THAYER.en: A term of Latin origin designating the poll tax or tribute collected by Roman authority from the inhabitants of the provinces. 1. The tax or tribute paid to the Roman imperial authority (Mt 22:17).

DEFINITION: An enclosed or cultivated piece of land dedicated to the planting of trees, flowers, herbs, or vegetables.
SENSES: 1. An area cultivated with plants and trees, such as the garden where Jesus was buried or where He prayed (Jn 18:1, 26).

THAYER.pt: Espaço de terra cercado ou cultivado dedicado ao plantio de árvores, flores, ervas ou vegetais. 1. Área cultivada com plantas e árvores, como o jardim onde Jesus foi sepultado ou onde orava (Jo 18.1, 26).
THAYER.en: An enclosed or cultivated piece of land dedicated to the planting of trees, flowers, herbs, or vegetables. 1. An area cultivated with plants and trees, such as the garden where Jesus was buried or where He prayed (Jn 18:1, 26).

DEFINITION: The person in charge of caring for, cultivating, and tending to a garden, orchard, or grove.
SENSES: 1. The gardener responsible for the cultivation of a garden (Jn 20:15).

THAYER.pt: A pessoa encarregada de cuidar, cultivar e zelar por um jardim, horto ou pomar. 1. O jardineiro responsável pelo cultivo de um jardim (Jo 20.15).
THAYER.en: The person in charge of caring for, cultivating, and tending to a garden, orchard, or grove. 1. The gardener responsible for the cultivation of a garden (Jn 20:15).

DEFINITION: A wax structure built by bees to store honey and raise their larvae, used as food.
SENSES: 1. A honeycomb consumed as food (Lk 24:42).

THAYER.pt: Estrutura de cera construída por abelhas para armazenar mel e criar suas larvas, usada como alimento. 1. Favo de mel consumido como alimento (Lc 24.42).
THAYER.en: A wax structure built by bees to store honey and raise their larvae, used as food. 1. A honeycomb consumed as food (Lk 24:42).

DEFINITION: The content of an official proclamation or the message publicly proclaimed by a herald with divine authority.
SENSES: 1. The message proclaimed in the preaching of the gospel (1 Cor 2:4; 2 Tim 4:17).

THAYER.pt: O conteúdo de uma proclamação oficial ou a mensagem proclamada publicamente por um arauto com autoridade divina. 1. A mensagem proclamada na pregação do evangelho (1Co 2.4; 2Tm 4.17).
THAYER.en: The content of an official proclamation or the message publicly proclaimed by a herald with divine authority. 1. The message proclaimed in the preaching of the gospel (1 Cor 2:4; 2 Tim 4:17).

DEFINITION: An official charged with making solemn public proclamations or an authorized messenger who conveys a transcendental message.
SENSES: 1. One who proclaims divine messages or transcendental truths (1 Tim 2:7; 2 Pet 2:5).

THAYER.pt: Oficial encarregado de fazer proclamações públicas solenes ou mensageiro autorizado que transmite uma mensagem transcendental. 1. Aquele que proclama mensagens divinas ou verdades transcendentais (1Tm 2.7; 2Pe 2.5).
THAYER.en: An official charged with making solemn public proclamations or an authorized messenger who conveys a transcendental message. 1. One who proclaims divine messages or transcendental truths (1 Tim 2:7; 2 Pet 2:5).

DEFINITION: To make an official, solemn, and public announcement in the capacity of a herald, proclaiming a message with authority and urgency.
SENSES: 1. To announce publicly in an official and solemn manner, to proclaim (Matt 3:1; Rom 10:14).

THAYER.pt: Significa fazer um anúncio oficial, solene e público na qualidade de arauto, proclamando uma mensagem com autoridade e urgência. 1. Anunciar publicamente em caráter oficial e solene, proclamar (Mt 3.1; Rm 10.14).
THAYER.en: To make an official, solemn, and public announcement in the capacity of a herald, proclaiming a message with authority and urgency. 1. To announce publicly in an official and solemn manner, to proclaim (Matt 3:1; Rom 10:14).

DEFINITION: Any large marine creature, sea monster, or colossal cetacean.
SENSES: 1. A large sea monster or huge fish (Matt 12:40).

THAYER.pt: Qualquer criatura marinha de grande porte, monstro do mar ou cetáceo colossal. 1. Grande monstro marinho ou peixe enorme (Mt 12.40).
THAYER.en: Any large marine creature, sea monster, or colossal cetacean. 1. A large sea monster or huge fish (Matt 12:40).

DEFINITION: Aramaic form of the surname given by Jesus to Simon, the Greek equivalent of which is Peter (rock).
SENSES: 1. Cephas, the Aramaic name for Peter (1 Cor 1:12; Gal 1:18).

THAYER.pt: Forma aramaica do sobrenome dado por Jesus a Simão, cujo equivalente grego é Pedro (rocha). 1. Cefas, o nome aramaico de Pedro (1Co 1.12; Gl 1.18).
THAYER.en: Aramaic form of the surname given by Jesus to Simon, the Greek equivalent of which is Peter (rock). 1. Cephas, the Aramaic name for Peter (1 Cor 1:12; Gal 1:18).

DEFINITION: Designates a box-shaped structure, whether a large floating vessel for saving lives or a sacred receptacle kept in the temple.
SENSES: 1. The large vessel built by Noah (Matt 24:38; Heb 11:7).
2. The Ark of the Covenant kept in the Holy of Holies (Heb 9:4).

THAYER.pt: Designa uma estrutura em formato de caixa, seja um grande vaso flutuante para salvar vidas ou um receptáculo sagrado guardado no templo. 1. A grande embarcação construída por Noé (Mt 24.38; Hb 11.7). | 2. A Arca da Aliança guardada no Santo dos Santos (Hb 9.4).
THAYER.en: Designates a box-shaped structure, whether a large floating vessel for saving lives or a sacred receptacle kept in the temple. 1. The large vessel built by Noah (Matt 24:38; Heb 11:7). | 2. The Ark of the Covenant kept in the Holy of Holies (Heb 9:4).

DEFINITION: A plucked string musical instrument, similar to a lyre or small harp, frequently associated with heavenly praise in the Apocalypse.
SENSES: 1. A musical instrument used for heavenly praise and worship (Rev 5:8; 14:2).

THAYER.pt: Instrumento musical de cordas dedilhadas, semelhante a uma lira ou harpa pequena, frequentemente associado ao louvor celestial no Apocalipse. 1. Instrumento musical usado para o louvor e adoração celestial (Ap 5.8; 14.2).
THAYER.en: A plucked string musical instrument, similar to a lyre or small harp, frequently associated with heavenly praise in the Apocalypse. 1. A musical instrument used for heavenly praise and worship (Rev 5:8; 14:2).

SHORT_GLOSS: to play the harp, play the lyre
DEFINITION: To play a stringed instrument, specifically the lyre or the harp.
SENSES: 1. To play the harp or a stringed instrument in contexts of worship or celebration (Rev 14:2).
USAGE: to play the harp, play the lyre

THAYER.pt: Significa tocar um instrumento de cordas, especificamente a lira ou a harpa. 1. Tocar harpa ou instrumento de cordas em contextos de adoração ou celebração (Ap 14.2).
THAYER.en: To play a stringed instrument, specifically the lyre or the harp. 1. To play the harp or a stringed instrument in contexts of worship or celebration (Rev 14:2).

DEFINITION: A musician who plays the harp or the lyre, often accompanying their own singing with the instrument.
SENSES: 1. An artist or musician who plays the harp or lyre (Rev 14:2; 18:22).

THAYER.pt: Músico que toca a harpa ou a lira, frequentemente acompanhando o próprio canto com o instrumento. 1. Artista ou músico que toca harpa ou lira (Ap 14.2; 18.22).
THAYER.en: A musician who plays the harp or the lyre, often accompanying their own singing with the instrument. 1. An artist or musician who plays the harp or lyre (Rev 14:2; 18:22).

DEFINITION: A Roman province situated in the southeastern corner of Asia Minor, whose principal city was Tarsus, the birthplace of the apostle Paul.
SENSES: 1. The geographical region and province of Cilicia (Acts 6:9; 15:23).

THAYER.pt: Província romana situada no canto sudeste da Ásia Menor, cuja principal cidade era Tarso, a cidade natal do apóstolo Paulo. 1. Região geográfica e província da Cilícia (At 6.9; 15.23).
THAYER.en: A Roman province situated in the southeastern corner of Asia Minor, whose principal city was Tarsus, the birthplace of the apostle Paul. 1. The geographical region and province of Cilicia (Acts 6:9; 15:23).

DEFINITION: A valuable aromatic spice derived from the bark of trees of the genus Cinnamomum.
SENSES: 1. The aromatic spice cinnamon (Rev 18:13).

THAYER.pt: Especiaria aromática valiosa derivada da casca de árvores do gênero Cinnamomum. 1. A especiaria aromática canela (Ap 18.13).
THAYER.en: A valuable aromatic spice derived from the bark of trees of the genus Cinnamomum. 1. The aromatic spice cinnamon (Rev 18:13).

SHORT_GLOSS: to be in danger, be at risk
DEFINITION: To be in dangerous circumstances, to run severe risks, or to face an imminent threat to physical integrity or life.
SENSES: 1. To be in a situation of great danger or imminent threat (Acts 19:40).
USAGE: to be in danger, be at risk

THAYER.pt: Significa estar em circunstâncias perigosas, correr riscos severos ou enfrentar iminente ameaça à integridade física ou à vida. 1. Estar em situação de grande perigo ou ameaça iminente (At 19.40).
THAYER.en: To be in dangerous circumstances, to run severe risks, or to face an imminent threat to physical integrity or life. 1. To be in a situation of great danger or imminent threat (Acts 19:40).

DEFINITION: A condition or circumstance marked by real threats, exposure to harm, and situations of severe risk.
SENSES: 1. Physical or situational danger or risk (Rom 8:35; 2 Cor 11:26).

THAYER.pt: Uma condição ou circunstância marcada por ameaças reais, exposição a danos e situações de risco severo. 1. Perigo ou risco físico ou situacional (Rm 8.35; 2Co 11.26).
THAYER.en: A condition or circumstance marked by real threats, exposure to harm, and situations of severe risk. 1. Physical or situational danger or risk (Rom 8:35; 2 Cor 11:26).

DEFINITION: To cause something to change place, to set in motion, to shake, or to provoke a reaction.
SENSES: 1. To move or remove something from its position (Rev 2:5).
2. To shake or wag, as the head in mockery (Matt 27:39).

THAYER.pt: Fazer com que algo mude de lugar, colocar em movimento, agitar ou provocar uma reação. 1. Mover ou remover algo de sua posição (Ap 2.5). | 2. Agitar ou balançar, como a cabeça em zombaria (Mt 27.39).
THAYER.en: To cause something to change place, to set in motion, to shake, or to provoke a reaction. 1. To move or remove something from its position (Rev 2:5). | 2. To shake or wag, as the head in mockery (Matt 27:39).

DEFINITION: The act or state of moving, physical agitation, or dynamic disturbance of a medium.
SENSES: 1. Movement or agitation of water (John 5:3 v.l.).

THAYER.pt: O ato ou estado de mover-se, agitação física ou perturbação dinâmica de um meio. 1. Movimento ou agitação de águas (Jo 5.3 v.l.).
THAYER.en: The act or state of moving, physical agitation, or dynamic disturbance of a medium. 1. Movement or agitation of water (John 5:3 v.l.).

DEFINITION: Proper name of an Old Testament character, the father of King Saul.
SENSES: 1. Kish, the father of King Saul (Acts 13:21).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio de um personagem do Antigo Testamento, pai do rei Saul. 1. Cis, pai do rei Saul (At 13.21).
THAYER.en: Proper name of an Old Testament character, the father of King Saul. 1. Kish, the father of King Saul (Acts 13:21).

DEFINITION: The secondary branch or bough that sprouts from the trunk of a tree or a woody shrub.
SENSES: 1. A branch or bough of a tree (Matt 21:8; Mark 4:32).
2. Metaphor for the branches of the natural olive tree in relation to the people of Israel (Rom 11:16).

THAYER.pt: O ramo ou galho secundário que brota do tronco de uma árvore ou de um arbusto lenhoso. 1. Galho ou ramo de árvore (Mt 21:8; Mc 4:32). | 2. Metáfora para os ramos da oliveira natural em relação ao povo de Israel (Rm 11:16).
THAYER.en: The secondary branch or bough that sprouts from the trunk of a tree or a woody shrub. 1. A branch or bough of a tree (Matt 21:8; Mark 4:32). | 2. Metaphor for the branches of the natural olive tree in relation to the people of Israel (Rom 11:16).

DEFINITION: To express pain, sadness, or despair through audible crying, wailing, or lamentation.
SENSES: 1. To shed tears, to weep or mourn (Matt 26:75).
2. To weep for someone, to lament death or loss (Matt 2:18).

THAYER.pt: Expressar dor, tristeza ou desespero através de choro audível, pranto ou lamentação. 1. Derramar lágrimas, chorar ou prantear (Mt 26.75). | 2. Chorar por alguém, lamentar a morte ou perda (Mt 2.18).
THAYER.en: To express pain, sadness, or despair through audible crying, wailing, or lamentation. 1. To shed tears, to weep or mourn (Matt 26:75). | 2. To weep for someone, to lament death or loss (Matt 2:18).

DEFINITION: The act of breaking or fragmenting a solid object, used in the New Testament almost exclusively in the context of breaking bread.
SENSES: 1. The ritual or communal act of breaking bread during a meal and in communion (Acts 2:42).

THAYER.pt: O ato de partir ou fragmentar um objeto sólido, usado no Novo Testamento quase exclusivamente no contexto de partir o pão. 1. O ato ritual ou comunitário de partir o pão na refeição e na comunhão (At 2.42).
THAYER.en: The act of breaking or fragmenting a solid object, used in the New Testament almost exclusively in the context of breaking bread. 1. The ritual or communal act of breaking bread during a meal and in communion (Acts 2:42).

DEFINITION: A fragment or piece resulting from the act of breaking something, especially leftovers of food or bread.
SENSES: 1. A fragment or piece collected after a meal (Matt 14:20; John 6:12).

THAYER.pt: Um fragmento ou pedaço resultante da ação de partir algo, especialmente restos de alimento ou pão. 1. Fragmento ou pedaço recolhido após a refeição (Mt 14.20; Jo 6.12).
THAYER.en: A fragment or piece resulting from the act of breaking something, especially leftovers of food or bread. 1. A fragment or piece collected after a meal (Matt 14:20; John 6:12).

DEFINITION: A small island located south of Crete, mentioned in the narrative of Paul's voyage.
SENSES: 1. The island of Cauda (Acts 27:16).

THAYER.pt: Pequena ilha situada ao sul de Creta, mencionada na narrativa da viagem de Paulo. 1. A ilha de Clauda (At 27.16).
THAYER.en: A small island located south of Crete, mentioned in the narrative of Paul's voyage. 1. The island of Cauda (Acts 27:16).

DEFINITION: The name of a Roman Christian woman who sent greetings to Timothy.
SENSES: 1. Claudia, a believer in the Roman community (2 Tim 4:21).

THAYER.pt: Nome de uma mulher cristã romana que enviou saudações a Timóteo. 1. Cláudia, crente da comunidade de Roma (2Tm 4.21).
THAYER.en: The name of a Roman Christian woman who sent greetings to Timothy. 1. Claudia, a believer in the Roman community (2 Tim 4:21).

DEFINITION: A masculine proper name used in the New Testament to refer to the Roman Emperor Claudius and the official Claudius Lysias.
SENSES: 1. Tiberius Claudius Caesar, Roman emperor (Acts 18:2);
2. Claudius Lysias, Roman military tribune in Jerusalem (Acts 23:26).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio masculino usado no Novo Testamento para se referir ao imperador romano Cláudio e ao oficial Cláudio Lísias. 1. Tibério Cláudio César, imperador romano (At 18.2); | 2. Cláudio Lísias, tribuno militar romano em Jerusalém (At 23.26).
THAYER.en: A masculine proper name used in the New Testament to refer to the Roman Emperor Claudius and the official Claudius Lysias. 1. Tiberius Claudius Caesar, Roman emperor (Acts 18:2); | 2. Claudius Lysias, Roman military tribune in Jerusalem (Acts 23:26).

DEFINITION: The act of weeping or lamenting audibly, emphasizing the sound and emotional intensity of the crying.
SENSES: 1. Loud weeping, wailing, or lamentation (Matt 8:12; Acts 20:37).

THAYER.pt: Ato de chorar ou lamentar-se audivelmente, enfatizando o som e a intensidade emocional do pranto. 1. Choro forte, pranto ou wailing acompanhado de lamentação (Mt 8.12; At 20.37).
THAYER.en: The act of weeping or lamenting audibly, emphasizing the sound and emotional intensity of the crying. 1. Loud weeping, wailing, or lamentation (Matt 8:12; Acts 20:37).

DEFINITION: To separate a solid object into parts; used in the New Testament almost exclusively in the context of breaking bread for meals or communion.
SENSES: 1. To break bread into pieces for distribution at meals or the Lord's Supper (Matt 14:19; Acts 2:46).

THAYER.pt: Separar um objeto sólido em partes, sendo usado no Novo Testamento quase exclusivamente no contexto de partir o pão para refeições ou comunhão. 1. Partir o pão em pedaços para distribuição em refeições ou na ceia (Mt 14.19; At 2.46).
THAYER.en: To separate a solid object into parts; used in the New Testament almost exclusively in the context of breaking bread for meals or communion. 1. To break bread into pieces for distribution at meals or the Lord's Supper (Matt 14:19; Acts 2:46).

DEFINITION: A mechanical instrument used to lock and unlock doors or gates. Figuratively, it represents authority or the means of access to something.
SENSES: 1. A literal key for opening doors or locks (Rev 3:7).
2. A symbol of spiritual authority or access to knowledge and the kingdom (Matt 16:19; Luke 11:52).

THAYER.pt: Instrumento mecânico usado para trancar e destrancar portas ou portões. Figurativamente, representa a autoridade ou o meio de acesso a algo. 1. Chave literal para abrir portas ou trancas (Ap 3.7). | 2. Símbolo de autoridade espiritual ou acesso ao conhecimento e ao reino (Mt 16.19; Lk 11.52).
THAYER.en: A mechanical instrument used to lock and unlock doors or gates. Figuratively, it represents authority or the means of access to something. 1. A literal key for opening doors or locks (Rev 3:7). | 2. A symbol of spiritual authority or access to knowledge and the kingdom (Matt 16:19; Luke 11:52).

SHORT_GLOSS: to close, to lock, to shut

Fechar fisicamente algo como portas, portões ou edifícios (Mt 25.10; Ap 3.7). | 2. Fechar o coração ou recusar compaixão a alguém necessitado (1Jo 3.17).
THAYER.en: To physically close a door, building, or object, preventing entry or exit, or figuratively to close one's heart by denying compassion. 1. To physically close something such as doors, gates, or buildings (Matt 25:10; Rev 3:7). | 2. To close one's heart or refuse compassion to someone in need (1 John 3:17).

DEFINITION: The act of taking goods belonging to another person secretly and without permission.
SENSES: 1. The act of stealing or theft committed (Rev 9:21).

THAYER.en: The act of taking goods belonging to another person secretly and without permission. 1. The act of stealing or theft committed (Rev 9:21).

DEFINITION: A disciple of Jesus who encountered the risen Lord on the road to Emmaus.
SENSES: 1. Cleopas, a disciple on the road to Emmaus (Luke 24:18).

THAYER.pt: Discípulo de Jesus que encontrou o Senhor ressuscitado no caminho para Emaús. 1. Cleopas, discípulo no caminho de Emaús (Lc 24.18).
THAYER.en: A disciple of Jesus who encountered the risen Lord on the road to Emmaus. 1. Cleopas, a disciple on the road to Emmaus (Luke 24:18).

DEFINITION: A good reputation, praise, or renown achieved because of meritorious actions.
SENSES: 1. Good fame or honor resulting from praiseworthy conduct (1 Pet 2:20).

THAYER.en: A good reputation, praise, or renown achieved because of meritorious actions. 1. Good fame or honor resulting from praiseworthy conduct (1 Pet 2:20).

THAYER.en: Describes a person who steals or robs the property of others, often acting in a hidden or unexpected manner. 1. One who commits theft or robbery of material goods (John 10:1; 1 Pet 4:15). | 2. A figure for the unexpected coming of the Day of the Lord (1 Thess 5:2; 2 Pet 3:10).

THAYER.pt: Ato de tomar para si, de maneira oculta e sem permissão, a propriedade alheia. 1. Praticar furto ou roubo de bens alheios (Mt 19.18; Ef 4.28).
THAYER.en: The act of taking for oneself, in a hidden manner and without permission, the property of another. 1. To practice theft or robbery of others' goods (Matt 19:18; Eph 4:28).

THAYER.en: Refers to a flexible and fruitful branch, especially the shoot of a vine, which depends directly on the trunk to bear fruit. 1. The branch or shoot of a vine that needs to be attached to the vine to bear fruit (John 15:2-6).

DEFINITION: A Christian associated with the apostle Paul in the work of the church in Philippi.
SENSES: 1. Clement, Paul's fellow worker in Philippi (Phil 4:3).

SENSES: 1. To be an heir of material or family assets.
2. To obtain or enter into possession of divine promises and salvation (Matt 5:5; 1 Cor 6:9).

Obter ou entrar na posse de promessas divinas e da salvação (Mt 5.5; 1Co 6.9).
THAYER.en: Describes the act of receiving an inheritance or entering into possession of an asset by right of filiation or promise. In the NT, it frequently refers to participating in the blessings of messianic salvation and the eternal Kingdom. 1. To be an heir of material or family assets. | 2. To obtain or enter into possession of divine promises and salvation (Matt 5:5; 1 Cor 6:9).

Bens ou propriedades recebidos por sucessão ou herança familiar (Lc 12.13). | 2. A posse da salvação eterna e das promessas escatológicas concedidas por Deus aos crentes (Cl 3.24; 1Pe 1.4).
THAYER.en: That which is inherited or received as a legitimate possession, encompassing both material goods and the promise of eternal salvation. 1. Goods or properties received by succession or family inheritance (Luke 12:13). | 2. The possession of eternal salvation and eschatological promises granted by God to believers (Col 3:24; 1 Pet 1:4).

SENSES: 1. The legitimate heir of goods or properties (Matt 21:38);
2. A spiritual beneficiary of divine promises (Rom 8:17; Heb 1:2).

THAYER.pt: Aquele que tem o direito legal de receber uma herança ou que se torna beneficiário de uma promessa e posse duradoura. 1. Herdeiro legítimo de bens ou propriedades (Mt 21.38); 2. Beneficiário espiritual das promessas divinas (Rm 8.17; Hb 1.2).
THAYER.en: One who has the legal right to receive an inheritance or who becomes a beneficiary of a promise and lasting possession. 1. The legitimate heir of goods or properties (Matt 21:38); | 2. A spiritual beneficiary of divine promises (Rom 8:17; Heb 1:2).

SENSES: 1. An object cast or drawn to make a decision (Matt 27:35).
2. A portion, share, or inheritance assigned to someone (Acts 1:17).

THAYER.pt: Objeto marcado usado para tirar a sorte em decisões, ou aquilo que é atribuído a alguém como porção, herança ou responsabilidade designada. 1. Objeto lançado ou sorteado para tomar uma decisão (Mt 27.35). | 2. Porção, parte ou herança atribuída a alguém (At 1.17).
THAYER.en: A marked object used to cast lots in decisions, or that which is assigned to someone as a portion, inheritance, or designated responsibility. 1. An object cast or drawn to make a decision (Matt 27:35). | 2. A portion, share, or inheritance assigned to someone (Acts 1:17).

SENSES: 1. To obtain an inheritance or portion by divine designation (Eph 1:11).
USAGE: to choose by lot, to obtain

THAYER.pt: Designar ou escolher por meio de sorteio; em sentido estendido no NT, receber uma porção ou herança conforme o propósito divino. 1. Obter uma herança ou porção por designação divina (Ef 1.11).
THAYER.en: To designate or choose by means of casting lots; in an extended sense in the NT, to receive a portion or inheritance according to the divine purpose. 1. To obtain an inheritance or portion by divine designation (Eph 1:11).

THAYER.pt: Um convite solene ou convocação divina para assumir uma responsabilidade espiritual ou posição específica. 1. O chamado divino e celeste que convida o crente à salvação (Fp 3:14; 2Ts 1:11). | 2. A condição ou estado social em que alguém se encontra quando é chamado (1Co 7:20).
THAYER.en: A solemn invitation or divine summons to assume a spiritual responsibility or specific position. 1. The divine and heavenly calling that invites the believer to salvation (Phil 3:14; 2 Thess 1:11). | 2. The social condition or state in which someone finds themselves when they are called (1 Cor 7:20).

DEFINITION: Describes someone who has received an invitation or a special vocation, being divinely called to a function or spiritual privilege.
SENSES: 1. One who has been called by God for salvation or apostleship (Rom 1:1, 6, 7).

THAYER.en: Describes someone who has received an invitation or a special vocation, being divinely called to a function or spiritual privilege. 1. One who has been called by God for salvation or apostleship (Rom 1:1, 6, 7).

THAYER.en: A portable oven or dome-shaped structure made of clay, used for baking bread. 1. Clay oven used for baking bread (Matt 6:30; Luke 12:28).

DEFINITION: Designates a geographical area, province, or district delimited in relation to a locality or group.

THAYER.en: Designates a geographical area, province, or district delimited in relation to a locality or group. 1. A specific geographical region or territory (2 Cor 11:10).

THAYER.en: Furniture or a bed used for resting, sleeping, accommodating the sick, or reclining during meals. 1. Bed, couch, or stretcher for the sick (Luke 5:18; Rev 2:22). | 2. Divan or couch used at banquets (Mark 7:4).

DEFINITION: Diminutive of bed, indicating a small, portable bed or a stretcher used to carry the sick.
SENSES: 1. Small bed or stretcher for transporting the sick (Luke 5:19).

THAYER.pt: Diminutivo de cama, indicando um leito pequeno, portátil ou uma padiola usada para carregar enfermos. 1. Pequena cama ou maca para transporte de doentes (Lc 5.19).
THAYER.en: Diminutive of bed, indicating a small, portable bed or a stretcher used to carry the sick. 1. Small bed or stretcher for transporting the sick (Luke 5:19).

DEFINITION: The act of causing something to incline, bowing down, lying down, or referring to the decline of the day.
SENSES: 1. To incline or bow the head or body (John 19:30; Luke 24:5).
2. To lie down or recline for rest (Matt 8:20).
3. The decline of the day at evening (Luke 9:12).

THAYER.pt: Ato de fazer algo inclinar-se, curvar para baixo, deitar ou referir-se ao declínio do dia. 1. Inclinar ou curvar a cabeça ou o corpo (Jo 19.30; Lc 24.5). | 2. Deitar ou reclinar para descanso (Mt 8.20). | 3. O declinar do dia ao entardecer (Lc 9.12).
THAYER.en: The act of causing something to incline, bowing down, lying down, or referring to the decline of the day. 1. To incline or bow the head or body (John 19:30; Luke 24:5). | 2. To lie down or recline for rest (Matt 8:20). | 3. The decline of the day at evening (Luke 9:12).

DEFINITION: A group of people arranged in rows or groups for a common meal.
SENSES: 1. A group of people reclining to eat together (Luke 9:14).

THAYER.pt: Grupo de pessoas dispostas em fileiras ou grupos para uma refeição em comum. 1. Grupo de pessoas reclinadas para comer juntas (Lc 9.14).
THAYER.en: A group of people arranged in rows or groups for a common meal. 1. A group of people reclining to eat together (Luke 9:14).

DEFINITION: The act of appropriating others' goods secretly, illegally, and without permission.
SENSES: 1. The sinful action of stealing or pilfering the property of others (Matt 15:19; Mark 7:22).

THAYER.pt: O ato de apropriar-se de bens alheios de forma secreta, ilegal e sem permissão. 1. Ação pecaminosa de roubar ou furtar propriedades de outrem (Mt 15.19; Mc 7.22).
THAYER.en: The act of appropriating others' goods secretly, illegally, and without permission. 1. The sinful action of stealing or pilfering the property of others (Matt 15:19; Mark 7:22).

DEFINITION: Designates a succession of violent waves or a turbulent and stormy sea.
SENSES: 1. Strong and turbulent waves in a body of water (Luke 8:24; Jas 1:6).

THAYER.pt: Designa uma sucessão de ondas violentas ou um mar revolto e tempestuoso. 1. Ondas fortes e turbulentas em um corpo d'água (Lc 8.24; Tg 1.6).
THAYER.en: Designates a succession of violent waves or a turbulent and stormy sea. 1. Strong and turbulent waves in a body of water (Luke 8:24; Jas 1:6).

SHORT_GLOSS: to be tossed, carried by waves
DEFINITION: To be violently tossed back and forth by the agitated movement of sea waves.
SENSES: 1. To be shaken or carried from one side to another like waves (Eph 4:14).
USAGE: to be tossed, carried by waves

THAYER.pt: Ser violentamente lançado para cá e para lá pelo movimento agitado das ondas do mar. 1. Ser sacudido ou levado de um lado para outro como ondas (Ef 4.14).
THAYER.en: To be violently tossed back and forth by the agitated movement of sea waves. 1. To be shaken or carried from one side to another like waves (Eph 4:14).

DEFINITION: Proper name of a man whose family members were present at the crucifixion of Jesus.
SENSES: 1. Cleopas, husband of one of the Marys present at the cross (John 19:25).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio de um homem cujos familiares estavam presentes na crucificação de Jesus. 1. Clopas, marido de uma das Marias presentes na cruz (Jo 19.25).
THAYER.en: Proper name of a man whose family members were present at the crucifixion of Jesus. 1. Cleopas, husband of one of the Marys present at the cross (John 19:25).

DEFINITION: Literally means to cause or feel an itch; in the New Testament, it is used figuratively to describe the desire to hear doctrines that are pleasing to one's own desires (itching ears).
SENSES: 1. To feel or provoke itching, used figuratively in relation to curiosity for pleasing teachings (2 Tim 4:3).

THAYER.pt: Significa literalmente causar ou sentir coceira; no Novo Testamento, é empregado figuradamente para descrever o desejo de ouvir doutrinas agradáveis aos próprios desejos (comichão nos ouvidos). 1. Sentir ou provocar comichão, usado figuradamente em relação à curiosidade por ensinos prazerosos (2Tm 4.3).
THAYER.en: Literally means to cause or feel an itch; in the New Testament, it is used figuratively to describe the desire to hear doctrines that are pleasing to one's own desires (itching ears). 1. To feel or provoke itching, used figuratively in relation to curiosity for pleasing teachings (2 Tim 4:3).

DEFINITION: Cnidus was an important port city and peninsula located in the southwest of Asia Minor, in the region of Caria, mentioned in Paul's sea voyage to Rome.
SENSES: 1. Coastal city in Asia Minor, near which Paul's ship sailed with difficulty (Acts 27:7).

THAYER.pt: Cnido era uma importante cidade portuária e península localizada no sudoeste da Ásia Menor, na região da Cária, mencionada na viagem de navio de Paulo para Roma. 1. Cidade costeira na Ásia Menor, próxima à qual a embarcação de Paulo navegou com dificuldade (At 27.7).
THAYER.en: Cnidus was an important port city and peninsula located in the southwest of Asia Minor, in the region of Caria, mentioned in Paul's sea voyage to Rome. 1. Coastal city in Asia Minor, near which Paul's ship sailed with difficulty (Acts 27:7).

DEFINITION: A small Roman copper coin of negligible value, equivalent to one-fourth of an 'assarion'.
SENSES: 1. Copper coin of the lowest value circulating in the Roman system (Matt 5:26; Mark 12:42).

THAYER.pt: Pequena moeda de cobre romana, de valor ínfimo, equivalente a um quarto de um 'assarion'. 1. Moeda de cobre de menor valor circulante no sistema romano (Mt 5.26; Mc 12.42).
THAYER.en: A small Roman copper coin of negligible value, equivalent to one-fourth of an 'assarion'. 1. Copper coin of the lowest value circulating in the Roman system (Matt 5:26; Mark 12:42).
