DEFINITION: Refers to the digestive tract, stomach, or abdominal cavity, as well as the maternal womb. Figuratively, it can represent the inner person, the seat of appetites or affections.
SENSES: 1. Stomach or digestive system (Luke 15:16; Rom 16:18).
2. Maternal womb (Matt 19:12; Luke 1:42).
3. The inner person, spiritual heart (John 7:38).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se ao trato digestivo, estômago ou cavidade abdominal, bem como ao ventre materno (útero). Figuradamente, pode representar o interior da pessoa humana, sede de apetites ou afetos. 1. Estômago ou aparelho digestivo (Lc 15.16; Rm 16.18). | 2. Ventre materno, útero (Mt 19.12; Lc 1.42). | 3. O íntimo da pessoa humana, coração espiritual (Jo 7.38).
THAYER.en: Refers to the digestive tract, stomach, or abdominal cavity, as well as the maternal womb. Figuratively, it can represent the inner person, the seat of appetites or affections. 1. Stomach or digestive system (Luke 15:16; Rom 16:18). | 2. Maternal womb (Matt 19:12; Luke 1:42). | 3. The inner person, spiritual heart (John 7:38).

DEFINITION: Originally refers to the natural act of sleeping or resting the body. In the New Testament, it is frequently used as a gracious euphemism for the physical death of believers, indicating that death is temporary.
SENSES: 1. To be in a state of physical sleep.
2. To sleep the sleep of death, to pass away (used for believers) (John 11:11; Acts 7:60).

THAYER.pt: Originalmente refere-se ao ato natural de dormir ou repousar o corpo. No Novo Testamento, é frequentemente empregado como um gracioso eufemismo para a morte física dos crentes, indicando que a morte é temporária. 1. Encontrar-se em estado de sono físico. | 2. Dormir o sono da morte, falecer (utilizado para crentes) (Jo 11.11; At 7.60).
THAYER.en: Originally refers to the natural act of sleeping or resting the body. In the New Testament, it is frequently used as a gracious euphemism for the physical death of believers, indicating that death is temporary. 1. To be in a state of physical sleep. | 2. To sleep the sleep of death, to pass away (used for believers) (John 11:11; Acts 7:60).

DEFINITION: Refers primarily to the act or state of sleeping, but in the Scriptures, it is also used metaphorically to describe the rest of death for believers.
SENSES: 1. The act or state of sleeping physically (John 11:13).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se primariamente ao ato ou estado de dormir, mas nas Escrituras também é usado metaforicamente para descrever o descanso da morte para os crentes. 1. O ato ou estado de dormir fisicamente (Jo 11.13).
THAYER.en: Refers primarily to the act or state of sleeping, but in the Scriptures, it is also used metaphorically to describe the rest of death for believers. 1. The act or state of sleeping physically (John 11:13).

DEFINITION: Refers to that which is shared collectively or, in the Jewish cultic context, to that which is considered unclean, profane, and ritually unacceptable.
SENSES: 1. That which belongs to everyone in common or is shared collectively (Acts 2:44; Tit 1:4).
2. That which is profane, common, or devoid of sacred value (Heb 10:29).
3. Ritually unclean, contaminated, or defiled before the ceremonial law (Acts 10:14; Rom 14:14).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se ao que é compartilhado coletivamente ou, no contexto cultual judaico, ao que é considerado impuro, profano e ritualmente inaceitável. 1. O que pertence a todos em comum ou é compartilhado coletivamente (At 2.44; Tt 1.4). | 2. O que é profano, comum ou destituído de valor sagrado (Hb 10.29). | 3. Ritualmente impuro, contaminado ou defumado perante a lei cerimonial (At 10.14; Rm 14.14).
THAYER.en: Refers to that which is shared collectively or, in the Jewish cultic context, to that which is considered unclean, profane, and ritually unacceptable. 1. That which belongs to everyone in common or is shared collectively (Acts 2:44; Tit 1:4). | 2. That which is profane, common, or devoid of sacred value (Heb 10:29). | 3. Ritually unclean, contaminated, or defiled before the ceremonial law (Acts 10:14; Rom 14:14).

DEFINITION: To make something unclean, contaminated, or profane, whether through ritual impurity or by considering it unsuitable for divine worship.
SENSES: 1. To make morally or ritually unclean; to contaminate and defile (Matt 15:11; Rev 21:27).
2. To consider, declare, or treat something as profane or common (Acts 10:15).

THAYER.pt: Tornar algo impuro, contaminado ou profano, seja por meio de impureza ritual ou considerando-o impróprio para o culto divino. 1. Tornar moral ou ritualmente impuro; contaminar e defilar (Mt 15.11; Ap 21.27). | 2. Considerar, declarar ou tratar algo como profano ou comum (At 10.15).
THAYER.en: To make something unclean, contaminated, or profane, whether through ritual impurity or by considering it unsuitable for divine worship. 1. To make morally or ritually unclean; to contaminate and defile (Matt 15:11; Rev 21:27). | 2. To consider, declare, or treat something as profane or common (Acts 10:15).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: κοινωνήσω, Aor: ἐκοινώνησα, Perf: κεκοινώνηκα
DEFINITION: To take part in something together with others, to share resources, experiences, or responsibilities in solidarity.
SENSES: 1. To have a part or participate in something common (Rom 15:27; Heb 2:14).
2. To contribute financially or share goods (Phil 4:15).

THAYER.pt: Tomar parte em algo junto com outros, partilhar de recursos, experiências ou responsabilidades em solidariedade. 1. Ter parte ou participar em algo comum (Rm 15.27; Hb 2.14). | 2. Contribuir financeiramente ou repartir bens (Fp 4.15).
THAYER.en: To take part in something together with others, to share resources, experiences, or responsibilities in solidarity. 1. To have a part or participate in something common (Rom 15:27; Heb 2:14). | 2. To contribute financially or share goods (Phil 4:15).

DEFINITION: Describes intimate association and mutual participation in common interests, experiences, or goods, grounded in spiritual union in Christ.
SENSES: 1. Deep fellowship and fraternal association among believers or with God (1 Cor 1:9; 2 Cor 13:13).
2. Material sharing demonstrated through generosity and offerings (Rom 15:26; 2 Cor 9:13).

THAYER.pt: Descreve a associação íntima e a participação mútua em interesses, experiências ou bens comuns, fundamentada na união espiritual em Cristo. 1. Comunhão profunda e associação fraternal entre crentes ou com Deus (1Co 1.9; 2Co 13.13). | 2. Partilha material demonstrada através de generosidade e ofertas (Rm 15.26; 2Co 9.13).
THAYER.en: Describes intimate association and mutual participation in common interests, experiences, or goods, grounded in spiritual union in Christ. 1. Deep fellowship and fraternal association among believers or with God (1 Cor 1:9; 2 Cor 13:13). | 2. Material sharing demonstrated through generosity and offerings (Rom 15:26; 2 Cor 9:13).

DEFINITION: Describes a person willing to share their possessions with others, characterized by generosity and practical fellowship in assisting the needy.
SENSES: 1. Disposed to share and be generous with one's own resources (1 Tim 6:18).

THAYER.pt: Descreve uma pessoa disposta a compartilhar seus bens com os outros, caracterizada pela generosidade e pela comunhão prática na assistência aos necessitados. 1. Disposto a repartir e a ser generoso com os próprios recursos (1Tm 6.18).
THAYER.en: Describes a person willing to share their possessions with others, characterized by generosity and practical fellowship in assisting the needy. 1. Disposed to share and be generous with one's own resources (1 Tim 6:18).

DEFINITION: One who takes part in some activity, enterprise, or fellowship together with others.
SENSES: 1. Partner in business or joint activity (Luke 5:10).
2. Participant in sufferings, blessings, or the Christian faith (1 Cor 10:18; Heb 10:33; 1 Pet 5:1).

THAYER.pt: Aquele que toma parte em alguma atividade, empreendimento ou comunhão juntamente com outros. 1. Parceiro em negócios ou atividade conjunta (Lc 5.10). | 2. Participante em sofrimentos, bênçãos ou na fé cristã (1Co 10.18; Hb 10.33; 1Pe 5.1).
THAYER.en: One who takes part in some activity, enterprise, or fellowship together with others. 1. Partner in business or joint activity (Luke 5:10). | 2. Participant in sufferings, blessings, or the Christian faith (1 Cor 10:18; Heb 10:33; 1 Pet 5:1).

DEFINITION: Designates a structure for lying down or sleeping, also used in the New Testament as a euphemism for sexual union or the marriage bed.
SENSES: 1. Physical bed or couch for rest (Luke 11:7).
2. The marriage bed and legitimate or illicit sexual union (Rom 13:13; Heb 13:4).

THAYER.pt: Designa uma estrutura para deitar-se ou dormir, sendo também usada no Novo Testamento como eufemismo para a união sexual ou o leito conjugal. 1. Cama ou leito físico para repouso (Lc 11.7). | 2. O leito matrimonial e a união sexual legítima ou licenciosa (Rm 13.13; Hb 13.4).
THAYER.en: Designates a structure for lying down or sleeping, also used in the New Testament as a euphemism for sexual union or the marriage bed. 1. Physical bed or couch for rest (Luke 11:7). | 2. The marriage bed and legitimate or illicit sexual union (Rom 13:13; Heb 13:4).

DEFINITION: Designates a room intended for rest or a dormitory. In the New Testament, it forms the title of a high-ranking royal official in charge of the bedchamber.
SENSES: 1. Sleeping room or private chamber (Acts 12:20).

THAYER.pt: Designa um aposento destinado ao repouso ou dormitório. No Novo Testamento, compõe o título de um oficial de alta confiança real encarregado do dormitório. 1. Quarto de dormir ou aposento privado (At 12.20).
THAYER.en: Designates a room intended for rest or a dormitory. In the New Testament, it forms the title of a high-ranking royal official in charge of the bedchamber. 1. Sleeping room or private chamber (Acts 12:20).

DEFINITION: Refers to the bright red color, specifically the scarlet shade, frequently associated with royal robes, luxurious garments, or rituals.
SENSES: 1. The vivid red or scarlet color (Matt 27:28; Heb 9:19).
2. Garment or fabric dyed scarlet (Rev 17:4).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se à cor vermelha brilhante, especificamente o tom escarlate, frequentemente associado a mantos reais, vestimentas luxuosas ou rituais. 1. A cor vermelha viva ou escarlate (Mt 27.28; Hb 9.19). | 2. Vestimenta ou tecido tingido de escarlate (Ap 17.4).
THAYER.en: Refers to the bright red color, specifically the scarlet shade, frequently associated with royal robes, luxurious garments, or rituals. 1. The vivid red or scarlet color (Matt 27:28; Heb 9:19). | 2. Garment or fabric dyed scarlet (Rev 17:4).

DEFINITION: The kernel or seed of various plants and fruits, frequently used in parables regarding growth and life.
SENSES: 1. Grain or seed of plants such as wheat or mustard (Matt 13:31; John 12:24).

THAYER.pt: O núcleo ou semente de várias plantas e frutos, usado frequentemente em parábolas sobre crescimento e vida. 1. Grão ou semente de plantas como o trigo ou a mostarda (Mt 13.31; Jo 12.24).
THAYER.en: The kernel or seed of various plants and fruits, frequently used in parables regarding growth and life. 1. Grain or seed of plants such as wheat or mustard (Matt 13:31; John 12:24).

DEFINITION: Means to inflict a penalty, severe correction, or punishment upon someone because of a committed offense.
SENSES: 1. To apply punishment or severe chastisement to wrongdoers (Acts 4:21; 2 Pet 2:9).

THAYER.pt: Significa infligir penalidade, correção severa ou castigo a alguém por causa de uma falta cometida. 1. Aplicar punição ou castigo severo a malfeitores (At 4.21; 2Pe 2.9).
THAYER.en: Means to inflict a penalty, severe correction, or punishment upon someone because of a committed offense. 1. To apply punishment or severe chastisement to wrongdoers (Acts 4:21; 2 Pet 2:9).

DEFINITION: Refers to the use of feigned or exaggerated praise with the goal of obtaining personal advantages or manipulating others.
SENSES: 1. Flattering speech or adulation motivated by ulterior motives (1 Thess 2:5).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se ao uso de elogios fingidos ou exagerados com o objetivo de obter vantagens pessoais ou manipular os outros. 1. Discurso lisonjeiro ou bajulação motivada por interesses escusos (1Ts 2.5).
THAYER.en: Refers to the use of feigned or exaggerated praise with the goal of obtaining personal advantages or manipulating others. 1. Flattering speech or adulation motivated by ulterior motives (1 Thess 2:5).

DEFINITION: The act or result of inflicting suffering as a penalty for transgressions, often with an eschatological sense.
SENSES: 1. Punishment or severe chastisement applied to transgressors (Matt 25:46; 1 John 4:18).

THAYER.pt: O ato ou o resultado de infligir sofrimento como penalidade por transgressões, muitas vezes com sentido escatológico. 1. Punição ou castigo severo aplicado a transgressores (Mt 25.46; 1Jo 4.18).
THAYER.en: The act or result of inflicting suffering as a penalty for transgressions, often with an eschatological sense. 1. Punishment or severe chastisement applied to transgressors (Matt 25:46; 1 John 4:18).

SHORT_GLOSS: to cuff, strike with fist, beat
DEFINITION: To strike violently with the hands or fists, inflicting physical pain and humiliation.
SENSES: 1. To deal blows with the fists or severely cuff someone (Matt 26:67; 1Pet 2:20).
2. To inflict physical torment or acute suffering (2Cor 12:7).
USAGE: to cuff, strike with fist, beat

THAYER.pt: Golpear violentamente com as mãos ou com punhos, infligindo dor física e humilhação. 1. Dar golpes com os punhos ou esbofetear severamente alguém (Mt 26.67; 1Pe 2.20). | 2. Infligir tormento físico ou sofrimento agudo (2Co 12.7).
THAYER.en: To strike violently with the hands or fists, inflicting physical pain and humiliation. 1. To deal blows with the fists or severely cuff someone (Matt 26:67; 1Pet 2:20). | 2. To inflict physical torment or acute suffering (2Cor 12:7).

DEFINITION: To firmly join two things as if glued together, or to establish an intimate association and fellowship with someone.
SENSES: 1. To closely join or unite firmly (Luke 10:11).
2. To cleave to someone or associate in an intimate manner (Acts 5:13).

THAYER.pt: Unir firmemente duas coisas como se estivessem coladas, ou estabelecer uma associação e comunhão íntima com alguém. 1. Juntar estreitamente ou unir com firmeza (Lc 10.11). | 2. Apegar-se a alguém ou associar-se de maneira íntima (At 5.13).
THAYER.en: To firmly join two things as if glued together, or to establish an intimate association and fellowship with someone. 1. To closely join or unite firmly (Luke 10:11). | 2. To cleave to someone or associate in an intimate manner (Acts 5:13).

DEFINITION: A small medicinal roll or paste used in antiquity for the treatment of ophthalmologic diseases.
SENSES: 1. A topical remedy applied to cure vision problems, used figuratively in the warning to the church of Laodicea (Rev 3:18).

THAYER.pt: Pequeno bolo ou pasta medicinal utilizado na antiguidade para o tratamento de enfermidades oftalmológicas. 1. Remédio tópico aplicado para curar problemas de visão, usado figuradamente na advertência à igreja de Laodicéia (Ap 3.18).
THAYER.en: A small medicinal roll or paste used in antiquity for the treatment of ophthalmologic diseases. 1. A topical remedy applied to cure vision problems, used figuratively in the warning to the church of Laodicea (Rev 3:18).

DEFINITION: A money-changer who exchanged different types of foreign or common currencies for the coinage accepted in the Jewish temple.
SENSES: 1. A currency money-changer operating in the temple courts (Matt 21:12).

THAYER.pt: Cambista que trocava diferentes tipos de moedas estrangeiras ou comuns pelas moedas aceitas no templo judaico. 1. Cambista de moedas atuando nos pátios do templo (Mt 21.12).
THAYER.en: A money-changer who exchanged different types of foreign or common currencies for the coinage accepted in the Jewish temple. 1. A currency money-changer operating in the temple courts (Matt 21:12).

DEFINITION: Means to reduce the length, extent, or duration of something, making it smaller than the original.
SENSES: 1. To reduce the duration of a period of time, such as the days of the great tribulation (Matt 24:22).

THAYER.pt: Significa reduzir o comprimento, a extensão ou a duração de algo, tornando-o menor do que o original. 1. Reduzir a duração de um período de tempo, como os dias da grande tribulação (Mt 24.22).
THAYER.en: Means to reduce the length, extent, or duration of something, making it smaller than the original. 1. To reduce the duration of a period of time, such as the days of the great tribulation (Matt 24:22).

DEFINITION: An ancient city of Phrygia, situated in Asia Minor, in the valley of the Lycus River. It was the destination of Paul's epistle to the Colossians.
SENSES: 1. A city in Phrygia where there was a Christian community that received an apostolic letter (Col 1:2).

THAYER.pt: Antiga cidade da Frígia, situada na Ásia Menor, no vale do rio Lico. Foi o destino da epístola paulina aos Colossenses. 1. Cidade na Frígia onde havia uma comunidade cristã destinatária de carta apostólica (Cl 1.2).
THAYER.en: An ancient city of Phrygia, situated in Asia Minor, in the valley of the Lycus River. It was the destination of Paul's epistle to the Colossians. 1. A city in Phrygia where there was a Christian community that received an apostolic letter (Col 1:2).

DEFINITION: An inhabitant or native of the city of Colossae in Phrygia.
SENSES: 1. A citizen or resident of the city of Colossae.

THAYER.pt: Habitante ou natural da cidade de Colossos, na Frígia. 1. Cidadão ou residente da cidade de Colossos.
THAYER.en: An inhabitant or native of the city of Colossae in Phrygia. 1. A citizen or resident of the city of Colossae.

DEFINITION: Originally refers to the human chest or bosom, but by extension also describes the fold of a garment used as a pocket or a geographical indentation in the sea.
SENSES: 1. The chest or lap region, indicating intimacy (John 13:23; Luke 16:23).
2. The fold of a garment that served as a pocket (Luke 6:38).
3. A coastal bay or inlet (Acts 27:39).

THAYER.pt: Originalmente refere-se ao peito ou seio humano, mas por extensão também descreve a dobra de uma vestimenta usada como bolso ou uma reentrância geográfica no mar. 1. O peito ou a região do colo, indicando intimateza (Jo 13.23; Lk 16.23). | 2. A dobra de uma veste que servia como bolso (Lk 6.38). | 3. Uma baía ou enseada costeira (At 27.39).
THAYER.en: Originally refers to the human chest or bosom, but by extension also describes the fold of a garment used as a pocket or a geographical indentation in the sea. 1. The chest or lap region, indicating intimacy (John 13:23; Luke 16:23). | 2. The fold of a garment that served as a pocket (Luke 6:38). | 3. A coastal bay or inlet (Acts 27:39).

DEFINITION: To move through water using the limbs of the body, either on the surface or by submerging.
SENSES: 1. To practice the act of swimming, moving along in the water (Acts 27:43).

THAYER.pt: Movimentar-se através da água utilizando os membros do corpo, seja na superfície ou submergindo. 1. Praticar o ato de nadar, deslocando-se na água (At 27.43).
THAYER.en: To move through water using the limbs of the body, either on the surface or by submerging. 1. To practice the act of swimming, moving along in the water (Acts 27:43).

DEFINITION: Designates a reservoir or tank built to hold water, frequently used for therapeutic or ritual baths.
SENSES: 1. A public pool or tank with therapeutic or religious properties (John 5:2; 9:7).

THAYER.pt: Designa um reservatório ou tanque construído para reter água, frequentemente utilizado para banhos terapêuticos ou rituais. 1. Tanque ou piscina pública com propriedades terapêuticas ou religiosas (Jo 5.2; 9.7).
THAYER.en: Designates a reservoir or tank built to hold water, frequently used for therapeutic or ritual baths. 1. A public pool or tank with therapeutic or religious properties (John 5:2; 9:7).

DEFINITION: A technical term designating a city outside of Rome whose inhabitants enjoyed special political privileges and Roman citizenship.
SENSES: 1. A city with political status and special privileges granted by Rome (Acts 16:12).

THAYER.pt: Termo técnico que designava uma cidade fora de Roma cujos habitantes gozavam de privilégios políticos especiais e cidadania romana. 1. Cidade com estatuto político e privilégios especiais concedidos por Roma (At 16.12).
THAYER.en: A technical term designating a city outside of Rome whose inhabitants enjoyed special political privileges and Roman citizenship. 1. A city with political status and special privileges granted by Rome (Acts 16:12).

DEFINITION: Indicates the custom or act of letting one's hair grow and wearing long hair.
SENSES: 1. To wear long hair as a physical or cultural characteristic (1Cor 11:14, 15).

THAYER.pt: Indica o costume ou o ato de deixar o cabelo crescer e usar os cabelos compridos. 1. Usar cabelo longo como característica física ou cultural (1Co 11.14, 15).
THAYER.en: Indicates the custom or act of letting one's hair grow and wearing long hair. 1. To wear long hair as a physical or cultural characteristic (1Cor 11:14, 15).

DEFINITION: Refers to the hair of the human head, especially long and abundant hair, frequently associated with natural appearance.
SENSES: 1. Long hair or a person's natural head of hair (1Cor 11:15).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se ao cabelo da cabeça humana, especialmente ao cabelo longo e abundante, frequentemente associado à aparência natural. 1. Cabelos compridos ou cabeleira natural de uma pessoa (1Co 11.15).
THAYER.en: Refers to the hair of the human head, especially long and abundant hair, frequently associated with natural appearance. 1. Long hair or a person's natural head of hair (1Cor 11:15).

DEFINITION: To carry or transport something to someone, or to receive back in retribution for past actions.
SENSES: 1. To transport or bring something to someone (Eph 6:22).
2. To receive back as a reward or retribution for deeds done (2Cor 5:10).

THAYER.pt: Llevar ou transportar algo para alguém, ou receber de volta em retribuição por ações passadas. 1. Transportar ou trazer algo para alguém (Ef 6.22). | 2. Receber de volta como recompensa ou retribuição por atos praticados (2Co 5.10).
THAYER.en: To carry or transport something to someone, or to receive back in retribution for past actions. 1. To transport or bring something to someone (Eph 6:22). | 2. To receive back as a reward or retribution for deeds done (2Cor 5:10).

DEFINITION: A comparative adverbial form indicating an improvement in the health state of an ill person.
SENSES: 1. To be in a better state of health or recovering (John 4:52).

THAYER.pt: Forma adverbial comparativa que indica uma melhora no estado de saúde de uma pessoa enferma. 1. Estar em melhor condição de saúde ou convalescendo (Jo 4.52).
THAYER.en: A comparative adverbial form indicating an improvement in the health state of an ill person. 1. To be in a better state of health or recovering (John 4:52).

DEFINITION: Means to cover a surface with lime, plaster, or white paint for cleaning or appearance purposes.
SENSES: 1. To whitewash or paint tombs white to make them visible or mask impurity (Matt 23:27; Acts 23:3).

THAYER.pt: Significa cobrir uma superfície com cal, gesso ou tinta branca para fins de limpeza ou aparência. 1. Caiar ou pintar sepulcros de branco para torná-los visíveis ou mascarar impureza (Mt 23.27; At 23.3).
THAYER.en: Means to cover a surface with lime, plaster, or white paint for cleaning or appearance purposes. 1. To whitewash or paint tombs white to make them visible or mask impurity (Matt 23:27; Acts 23:3).

DEFINITION: Small particles of dry earth and dust that accumulate on the ground or are lifted by the wind.
SENSES: 1. Accumulated earth dust or dirt, used even in symbolic acts of rejection (Matt 10:14; Acts 22:23).

THAYER.pt: Pequenas partículas de terra seca e poeira que se acumulam no chão ou se elevam pelo vento. 1. Pó ou poeira da terra acumulada, usada inclusive em atos simbólicos de rejeição (Mt 10.14; At 22.23).
THAYER.en: Small particles of dry earth and dust that accumulate on the ground or are lifted by the wind. 1. Accumulated earth dust or dirt, used even in symbolic acts of rejection (Matt 10:14; Acts 22:23).

DEFINITION: To calm down, abate, or cease, frequently used to describe the lessening of the intensity of winds, waves, or disturbances.
SENSES: 1. To calm down or cease, in reference to natural phenomena such as the wind (Matt 14:32).

THAYER.pt: Acalmar-se, abrandar ou cessar, frequentemente usado para descrever a diminuição da intensidade de ventos, ondas ou agitações. 1. Acalmar-se ou cessar, em referência a fenômenos naturais como o vento (Mt 14.32).
THAYER.en: To calm down, abate, or cease, frequently used to describe the lessening of the intensity of winds, waves, or disturbances. 1. To calm down or cease, in reference to natural phenomena such as the wind (Matt 14:32).

DEFINITION: Expression of deep grief and sorrow over someone's death, often accompanied by beating the chest and audible weeping.
SENSES: 1. The act of publicly wailing and lamenting the passing of a person (Acts 8:2).

THAYER.pt: Expressão de profunda dor e pesar pela morte de alguém, muitas vezes acompanhada de batidas no peito e choro audível. 1. Ato de prantear e lamentar publicamente o falecimento de uma pessoa (At 8.2).
THAYER.en: Expression of deep grief and sorrow over someone's death, often accompanied by beating the chest and audible weeping. 1. The act of publicly wailing and lamenting the passing of a person (Acts 8:2).

DEFINITION: Derived from cutting, it refers to violent and widespread slaughter, typically associated with the context of armed conflicts and battles.
SENSES: 1. Great slaughter or massacre inflicted in combat (Heb 7:1).

THAYER.pt: Derivado de cortar, refere-se à matança violenta e generalizada, tipicamente associada ao contexto de conflitos armados e batalhas. 1. Grande matança ou massacre infligido em combate (Hb 7.1).
THAYER.en: Derived from cutting, it refers to violent and widespread slaughter, typically associated with the context of armed conflicts and battles. 1. Great slaughter or massacre inflicted in combat (Heb 7:1).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: κοπιάσω, Aor: ἐκοπίασα, Perf: κεκοπίακα
DEFINITION: To engage in arduous and exhausting work, involving physical, mental, or spiritual effort. Can also refer to the resulting feeling of extreme fatigue and weariness.
SENSES: 1. To grow weary, become fatigued from physical effort (John 4:6).
2. To labor with toil, work hard in ministry or for one's own livelihood (Phil 2:16; 1Tim 4:10).
3. To strive zealously for the sake of the gospel (Rom 16:12).

THAYER.pt: Empenhar-se em trabalho árduo e desgastante, envolvendo esforço físico, mental ou espiritual. Pode também referir-se à sensação resultante de fadiga e cansaço extremo. 1. Cansar-se, ficar fatigado por esforço físico (Jo 4.6). | 2. Trabalhar com afã, labutar no ministério ou no sustento próprio (Fp 2.16; 1Tm 4.10). | 3. Esforçar-se zelosamente em favor do evangelho (Rm 16.12).
THAYER.en: To engage in arduous and exhausting work, involving physical, mental, or spiritual effort. Can also refer to the resulting feeling of extreme fatigue and weariness. 1. To grow weary, become fatigued from physical effort (John 4:6). | 2. To labor with toil, work hard in ministry or for one's own livelihood (Phil 2:16; 1Tim 4:10). | 3. To strive zealously for the sake of the gospel (Rom 16:12).

DEFINITION: Designates an extenuating physical or mental effort that causes weariness, fatigue, or affliction. Represents intense labor, especially in the service of the Kingdom of God.
SENSES: 1. Suffering, difficulty, or affliction resulting from harsh circumstances (Matt 26:10).
2. Hard work, fatigue, or exhaustive labor (1Thess 1:3).

THAYER.pt: Designa um esforço físico ou mental extenuante que causa desgaste, cansaço ou aflição. Representa o labor intenso, especialmente no serviço do Reino de Deus. 1. Sofrimento, dificuldade ou aflição decorrente de circunstâncias duras (Mt 26.10). | 2. Trabalho árduo, fadiga ou labor exaustivo (1Ts 1.3).
THAYER.en: Designates an extenuating physical or mental effort that causes weariness, fatigue, or affliction. Represents intense labor, especially in the service of the Kingdom of God. 1. Suffering, difficulty, or affliction resulting from harsh circumstances (Matt 26:10). | 2. Hard work, fatigue, or exhaustive labor (1Thess 1:3).

DEFINITION: Refers to a heap of manure, refuse, or accumulated garbage, frequently associated with places of extreme impurity or humiliation.
SENSES: 1. A heap of manure or garbage (Luke 14:35).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se a um monte de esterco, refugo ou lixo acumulado, frequentemente associado a lugares de extrema impureza ou humilhação. 1. Monte de esterco ou lixo (Lc 14.35).
THAYER.en: Refers to a heap of manure, refuse, or accumulated garbage, frequently associated with places of extreme impurity or humiliation. 1. A heap of manure or garbage (Luke 14:35).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Impf: ἔκοπτον, Aor: ἔκοψα, Pass: ἐκόπην
SHORT_GLOSS: to cut, lament, beat the breast
DEFINITION: To cut with a sharp instrument or, in the middle voice, beat one's own chest as a traditional expression of deep mourning and lamentation.
SENSES: 1. To cut branches or fell vegetation (Matt 21:8).
2. To beat the breast as a sign of deep mourning and grief (Luke 8:52).
USAGE: to cut, lament, beat the breast

THAYER.pt: Cortar com instrumento cortante ou, na voz média, bater no próprio peito como expressão tradicional de luto e lamentação profunda. 1. Cortar ramos ou abater vegetação (Mt 21.8). | 2. Bater no peito em sinal de profundo luto e pesar (Lc 8.52).
THAYER.en: To cut with a sharp instrument or, in the middle voice, beat one's own chest as a traditional expression of deep mourning and lamentation. 1. To cut branches or fell vegetation (Matt 21:8). | 2. To beat the breast as a sign of deep mourning and grief (Luke 8:52).

DEFINITION: A large bird of prey with dark plumage, known for its carnivorous habits and mentioned in creation as an object of God's providing care.
SENSES: 1. A bird of the corvid family, a symbol of divine providence in nature.

THAYER.pt: Ave de rapina de grande porte, plumagem escura, conhecida por seus hábitos carnívoros e mencionada na criação como objeto do cuidado provedor de Deus. 1. Ave da família dos corvídeos, símbolo da providência divina na natureza.
THAYER.en: A large bird of prey with dark plumage, known for its carnivorous habits and mentioned in creation as an object of God's providing care. 1. A bird of the corvid family, a symbol of divine providence in nature.

DEFINITION: A diminutive term for a young girl, maiden, or female child in the age range of puberty or youth.
SENSES: 1. A young girl or maiden (Matt 9:24; Mark 6:22).

THAYER.pt: Termo diminutivo para uma jovem, donzela ou menina na faixa etária da puberdade ou juventude. 1. Menina ou jovem donzela (Mt 9.24; Mc 6.22).
THAYER.en: A diminutive term for a young girl, maiden, or female child in the age range of puberty or youth. 1. A young girl or maiden (Matt 9:24; Mark 6:22).

DEFINITION: A transliterated Hebrew term designating something consecrated as an offering to God, sometimes used hypocritically to avoid supporting one's parents.
SENSES: 1. An offering or gift dedicated to the Lord (Mark 7:11).

THAYER.pt: Termo hebraico transliterado que designa algo consagrado como oferta a Deus, por vezes utilizado de forma hipócrita para evitar o sustento dos pais. 1. Oferta ou dom dedicado ao Senhor (Mc 7.11).
THAYER.en: A transliterated Hebrew term designating something consecrated as an offering to God, sometimes used hypocritically to avoid supporting one's parents. 1. An offering or gift dedicated to the Lord (Mark 7:11).

DEFINITION: A Levite leader who promoted a rebellion against the leadership of Moses and Aaron in the wilderness, being severely judged by God.
SENSES: 1. An Old Testament character known for his revolt against Moses.

THAYER.pt: Líder levita que promoveu uma rebelião contra a liderança de Moisés e Arão no deserto, sendo severamente julgado por Deus. 1. Personagem do Antigo Testamento conhecido por sua revolta contra Moisés.
THAYER.en: A Levite leader who promoted a rebellion against the leadership of Moses and Aaron in the wilderness, being severely judged by God. 1. An Old Testament character known for his revolt against Moses.

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: κορέσω, Aor: ἐκόρεσα, Pass. Aor: ἐκορέσθην
DEFINITION: Means to fully satisfy someone's hunger or need, achieving a state of plenty or contentment.
SENSES: 1. To satisfy or fill with food (Acts 27:38);
2. To be satisfied or full (1Cor 4:8).

THAYER.pt: Significa saciar a fome ou a necessidade de alguém plenamente, alcançando um estado de fartura ou contentamento. 1. Saciar ou fartar com alimento (At 27.38); | 2. Estar satisfeito ou pleno (1Co 4.8).
THAYER.en: Means to fully satisfy someone's hunger or need, achieving a state of plenty or contentment. 1. To satisfy or fill with food (Acts 27:38); | 2. To be satisfied or full (1Cor 4:8).

DEFINITION: Designates an inhabitant or native of the famous city of Corinth in Greece.
SENSES: 1. A native or inhabitant of Corinth (Acts 18:8).

THAYER.pt: Designa um habitante ou natural da célebre cidade de Corinto, na Grécia. 1. Natural ou habitante de Corinto (At 18.8).
THAYER.en: Designates an inhabitant or native of the famous city of Corinth in Greece. 1. A native or inhabitant of Corinth (Acts 18:8).

DEFINITION: An important and prosperous Greek city located on the isthmus connecting northern and southern Greece, famous for trade and immorality, where Paul founded a Christian community.
SENSES: 1. The city of Corinth in Achaia (Acts 18:1).

THAYER.pt: Importante e próspera cidade grega localizada no istmo que ligava o norte e o sul da Grécia, famosa pelo comércio e pela imoralidade, onde Paulo fundou uma comunidade cristã. 1. A cidade de Corinto na Acaia (At 18.1).
THAYER.en: An important and prosperous Greek city located on the isthmus connecting northern and southern Greece, famous for trade and immorality, where Paul founded a Christian community. 1. The city of Corinth in Achaia (Acts 18:1).

DEFINITION: A Roman centurion of the Italian cohort stationed in Caesarea, whose conversion to the gospel marked the opening of the faith to the Gentiles.
SENSES: 1. Cornelius, the Roman centurion (Acts 10:1).

THAYER.pt: Centurião romano da coorte Itálica estacionada em Cesareia, cuja conversão ao evangelho marcou a abertura da fé aos gentios. 1. Cornélio, o centurião romano (At 10.1).
THAYER.en: A Roman centurion of the Italian cohort stationed in Caesarea, whose conversion to the gospel marked the opening of the faith to the Gentiles. 1. Cornelius, the Roman centurion (Acts 10:1).

DEFINITION: An ancient Hebrew unit of dry measure, equivalent to a large quantity of grain or flour (about 390 liters).
SENSES: 1. A large unit of capacity for grain and provisions.

THAYER.pt: Antiga unidade de medida hebraica para secos, equivalente a uma grande quantidade de cereais ou farinha (cerca de 390 litros). 1. Grande medida de capacidade para grãos e mantimentos.
THAYER.en: An ancient Hebrew unit of dry measure, equivalent to a large quantity of grain or flour (about 390 liters). 1. A large unit of capacity for grain and provisions.

DEFINITION: To arrange, put in order, or beautify something through physical ornaments or moral virtues.
SENSES: 1. To put in order or prepare, such as lamps or rooms (Matt 25:7).
2. To adorn or beautify externally (Rev 21:2) or morally (Titus 2:10).

THAYER.pt: Arrumar, colocar em ordem ou embelezar algo através de ornamentos físicos ou virtudes morais. 1. Colocar em ordem ou preparar, como lâmpadas ou ambientes (Mt 25.7). | 2. Adornar ou embelezar externamente (Ap 21.2) ou moralmente (Tt 2.10).
THAYER.en: To arrange, put in order, or beautify something through physical ornaments or moral virtues. 1. To put in order or prepare, such as lamps or rooms (Matt 25:7). | 2. To adorn or beautify externally (Rev 21:2) or morally (Titus 2:10).

DEFINITION: Pertaining to the physical world or associated with the fallen value system of the present earthly age as opposed to the spiritual realm.
SENSES: 1. Pertaining to the earthly or material sanctuary (Heb 9:1);
2. Belonging to the standards and values of the fallen world (Titus 2:12).

THAYER.pt: Pertencente ao mundo físico ou associado ao sistema de valores decaído da presente era terrena em oposição ao reino espiritual. 1. Relativo ao santuário terrestre ou material (Hb 9.1); | 2. Pertencente aos padrões e valores do mundo decaído (Tt 2.12).
THAYER.en: Pertaining to the physical world or associated with the fallen value system of the present earthly age as opposed to the spiritual realm. 1. Pertaining to the earthly or material sanctuary (Heb 9:1); | 2. Belonging to the standards and values of the fallen world (Titus 2:12).

DEFINITION: Describes conduct or appearance that is exemplary, decorous, and worthy of admiration, reflecting order and moderation.
SENSES: 1. Respectable and worthy of a good reputation (1 Tim 3:2);
2. Modest and appropriate in behavior (1 Tim 2:9).

THAYER.pt: Descreve uma conduta ou aparência que é exemplar, decorosa e digna de admiração, refletindo ordem e moderação. 1. Respeitável e digno de boa reputação (1Tm 3.2); | 2. Modesto e adequado no comportamento (1Tm 2.9).
THAYER.en: Describes conduct or appearance that is exemplary, decorous, and worthy of admiration, reflecting order and moderation. 1. Respectable and worthy of a good reputation (1 Tim 3:2); | 2. Modest and appropriate in behavior (1 Tim 2:9).

DEFINITION: A title applied to the evil spiritual forces that exercise dominion and influence over the worldly system alienated from God.
SENSES: 1. Spiritual powers of darkness that govern this fallen world (Eph 6:12).

THAYER.pt: Título aplicado às forças espirituais malignas que exercem domínio e influência sobre o sistema mundano afastado de Deus. 1. Potestades espirituais das trevas que governam este mundo decaído (Ef 6.12).
THAYER.en: A title applied to the evil spiritual forces that exercise dominion and influence over the worldly system alienated from God. 1. Spiritual powers of darkness that govern this fallen world (Eph 6:12).

DEFINITION: Originally referred to harmonious arrangement or exterior beauty. In the New Testament it expands to mean the created totality (the universe), the inhabited earth, humanity in general, and, in a dense theological sense, the fallen order rebellious against God.
SENSES: 1. The created universe in harmony and order (Matt 13:35; John 17:5; Acts 17:24).
2. The inhabited earth and universal human population (Matt 26:13; John 3:16).
3. The morally fallen world system hostile to God (John 12:31; 1 John 2:15).
4. Aesthetic adornment or external personal decoration (1 Pet 3:3).

THAYER.pt: Originalmente referia-se a arranjo harmonioso ou beleza exterior. No Novo Testamento expande-se para significar a totalidade criada (o universo), a terra habitada, a humanidade em geral e, em sentido teológico denso, a ordem caída rebelde a Deus. 1. O universo criado em harmonia e ordem (Mt 13.35; Jo 17.5; At 17.24). | 2. A terra habitada e a população humana universal (Mt 26.13; Jo 3.16). | 3. O sistema mundial moralmente decaído e hostil a Deus (Jo 12.31; 1Jo 2.15). | 4. Adorno estético ou enfeite pessoal exterior (1Pe 3.3).
THAYER.en: Originally referred to harmonious arrangement or exterior beauty. In the New Testament it expands to mean the created totality (the universe), the inhabited earth, humanity in general, and, in a dense theological sense, the fallen order rebellious against God. 1. The created universe in harmony and order (Matt 13:35; John 17:5; Acts 17:24). | 2. The inhabited earth and universal human population (Matt 26:13; John 3:16). | 3. The morally fallen world system hostile to God (John 12:31; 1 John 2:15). | 4. Aesthetic adornment or external personal decoration (1 Pet 3:3).

DEFINITION: Name of an early Christian who sent greetings to the brothers of the church in Rome through Paul's letter.
SENSES: 1. Member of the Christian community associated with the church in Rome (Rom 16:23).

THAYER.pt: Nome de um cristão primitivo que enviou saudações aos irmãos da igreja em Roma através da carta de Paulo. 1. Membro da comunidade cristã associado à igreja em Roma (Rm 16.23).
THAYER.en: Name of an early Christian who sent greetings to the brothers of the church in Rome through Paul's letter. 1. Member of the Christian community associated with the church in Rome (Rom 16:23).

DEFINITION: A term of Aramaic origin preserved in the Gospels, translated as an imperative command to stand up.
SENSES: 1. Aramaic expression uttered by Jesus when raising Jairus's daughter (Mark 5:41).

THAYER.pt: Termo de origem aramaica preservado nos Evangelhos, traduzido como uma ordem imperativa para levantar-se. 1. Expressão aramaica proferida por Jesus ao ressuscitar a filha de Jairo (Mc 5.41).
THAYER.en: A term of Aramaic origin preserved in the Gospels, translated as an imperative command to stand up. 1. Aramaic expression uttered by Jesus when raising Jairus's daughter (Mark 5:41).

DEFINITION: A loanword from Latin designating a group of soldiers assigned to perform guard or watch duty.
SENSES: 1. A group of soldiers on guard duty (Matt 27:65).

THAYER.pt: Empréstimo do latim que designa um grupo de soldados designado para realizar o serviço de guarda ou vigilância. 1. Grupo de soldados em serviço de guarda (Mt 27.65).
THAYER.en: A loanword from Latin designating a group of soldiers assigned to perform guard or watch duty. 1. A group of soldiers on guard duty (Matt 27:65).

DEFINITION: Means to reduce the weight of something by discharging excesses to make it lighter.
SENSES: 1. To lighten the weight of a ship by throwing cargo into the sea (Acts 27:38).

THAYER.pt: Significa reduzir o peso de algo, descarregando excessos para torná-lo mais leve. 1. Aliviar o peso de uma embarcação lançando carga ao mar (At 27.38).
THAYER.en: Means to reduce the weight of something by discharging excesses to make it lighter. 1. To lighten the weight of a ship by throwing cargo into the sea (Acts 27:38).

DEFINITION: Designates a relatively large basket commonly used for transporting food, provisions, or leftovers.
SENSES: 1. Basket used to collect food fragments after the multiplication of the loaves (Matt 14:20).

THAYER.pt: Designa um cesto de tamanho relativamente grande, comumente utilizado para o transporte de alimentos, provisões ou sobras. 1. Cesta usada para recolher fragmentos de comida após a multiplicação dos pães (Mt 14.20).
THAYER.en: Designates a relatively large basket commonly used for transporting food, provisions, or leftovers. 1. Basket used to collect food fragments after the multiplication of the loaves (Matt 14:20).

DEFINITION: A rustic bed, mat, or rudimentary stretcher typically used by poor or sick people in the gospels.
SENSES: 1. A portable bed or paralytic's stretcher (Mark 2:9; John 5:8; Acts 9:33).

THAYER.pt: Uma cama rústica, colchonete ou maca rudimentar usada tipicamente por pessoas pobres ou doentes nos evangelhos. 1. Um leito portátil ou maca de paralítico (Mc 2.9; Jo 5.8; At 9.33).
THAYER.en: A rustic bed, mat, or rudimentary stretcher typically used by poor or sick people in the gospels. 1. A portable bed or paralytic's stretcher (Mark 2:9; John 5:8; Acts 9:33).

DEFINITION: To emit a loud cry or clamor vehemently, whether out of anguish, despair, or strong public expression.
SENSES: 1. To utter sharp cries or exclaim with strong vocal intensity (Matt 14:26; Rev 10:3).
2. To cry out in a loud voice conveying an intelligible message (Matt 15:23; Rom 8:15).

THAYER.pt: Emitir um grito forte ou clamor veementemente, seja por angústia, desespero ou forte expressão pública. 1. Dar gritos agudos ou exclamar com forte intensidade de voz (Mt 14.26; Ap 10.3). | 2. Clamar em alta voz transmitindo uma mensagem inteligível (Mt 15.23; Rm 8.15).
THAYER.en: To emit a loud cry or clamor vehemently, whether out of anguish, despair, or strong public expression. 1. To utter sharp cries or exclaim with strong vocal intensity (Matt 14:26; Rev 10:3). | 2. To cry out in a loud voice conveying an intelligible message (Matt 15:23; Rom 8:15).

DEFINITION: Refers to the state of dizziness, malaise, or unbridled behavior resulting from excesses with alcoholic beverages.
SENSES: 1. Drunkenness and dissipation resulting from wild parties (Luke 21:34).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se ao estado de tontura, mal-estar ou comportamento desenfreado decorrente de excessos com bebidas alcoólicas. 1. Embriaguez e dissipação resultante de festas desenfreadas (Lc 21.34).
THAYER.en: Refers to the state of dizziness, malaise, or unbridled behavior resulting from excesses with alcoholic beverages. 1. Drunkenness and dissipation resulting from wild parties (Luke 21:34).

DEFINITION: Refers to the bony structure surrounding the human head, giving its name to the hill where Jesus was crucified.
SENSES: 1. The bony part of the head, the skull (Matt 27:33; John 19:17).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se à estrutura óssea que envolve a cabeça humana, dando nome ao monte onde Jesus foi crucificado. 1. A parte óssea da cabeça, a caveira (Mt 27.33; Jo 19.17).
THAYER.en: Refers to the bony structure surrounding the human head, giving its name to the hill where Jesus was crucified. 1. The bony part of the head, the skull (Matt 27:33; John 19:17).

DEFINITION: The extremity, edge, or fringe of garments, including the ritual tassels required by Jewish law.
SENSES: 1. The hem or border of a garment (Matt 9:20; Luke 8:44).
2. The fringes or tassels that Israelites wore on the four corners of their garments according to the prescription of the Law (Matt 23:5).

THAYER.pt: A extremidade, borda ou franja das vestimentas, incluindo os tassel rituais exigidos pela lei judaica. 1. A orla ou bainha da borda de uma veste (Mt 9.20; Lc 8.44). | 2. As franjas ou borlas que os israelitas usavam nos quatro cantos das vestes conforme a prescrição da Lei (Mt 23.5).
THAYER.en: The extremity, edge, or fringe of garments, including the ritual tassels required by Jewish law. 1. The hem or border of a garment (Matt 9:20; Luke 8:44). | 2. The fringes or tassels that Israelites wore on the four corners of their garments according to the prescription of the Law (Matt 23:5).

DEFINITION: Describes someone or something endowed with great strength, authority, and irresistible power.
SENSES: 1. Endowed with grand power and supreme authority, especially in reference to God.

THAYER.pt: Descreve alguém ou algo dotado de grande força, autoridade e poder irresistível. 1. Dotado de poder grandioso e autoridade suprema, especialmente em referência a Deus.
THAYER.en: Describes someone or something endowed with great strength, authority, and irresistible power. 1. Endowed with grand power and supreme authority, especially in reference to God.

DEFINITION: Means to become strong, vigorous, or robust, both in the physical sense of bodily development and in spiritual and moral strengthening.
SENSES: 1. To grow and strengthen physically in human development (Luke 2:40).
2. To be strengthened spiritually by the power of God (Luke 1:80; Eph 3:16).

THAYER.pt: Significa tornar forte, vigoroso ou robusto, tanto no sentido físico do desenvolvimento corporal quanto no fortalecimento espiritual e moral. 1. Crescer e fortalecer-se fisicamente no desenvolvimento humano (Lc 2.40). | 2. Ser fortalecido espiritualmente pelo poder de Deus (Lc 1.80; Ef 3.16).
THAYER.en: Means to become strong, vigorous, or robust, both in the physical sense of bodily development and in spiritual and moral strengthening. 1. To grow and strengthen physically in human development (Luke 2:40). | 2. To be strengthened spiritually by the power of God (Luke 1:80; Eph 3:16).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: κρατήσω, Aor: ἐκράτησα, Perf: κεκράτηκα
DEFINITION: Expresses the idea of taking firm physical possession with the hands, arresting someone into custody, or holding with authority doctrines and traditions. Denotes the driving force of control and unwavering attachment.
SENSES: 1. To grasp with the hand, hold firmly (Matt 28:9; Mark 1:31; Rev 2:1).
2. To take into custody, arrest, or capture by the hands of authorities (Matt 14:3; Mark 14:44).
3. To hold fast to, keep with faithfulness traditions or teachings (Mark 7:3; 2 Thess 2:15).
4. To achieve success, restrain, or spiritually retain sins (John 20:23; Acts 27:13).

THAYER.pt: Expressa a ideia de tomar firme posse física com as mãos, prender alguém sob custódia, ou reter com autoridade doutrinas e tradições. Denota força motriz de controle e apego inabalável. 1. Agarrar com a mão, segurar firmemente (Mt 28.9; Mc 1.31; Ap 2.1). | 2. Tomar sob custódia, prender ou capturar pelas mãos de autoridades (Mt 14.3; Mc 14.44). | 3. Manter-se apegado a, guardar com fidelidade tradições ou ensinos (Mc 7.3; 2Ts 2.15). | 4. Alcançar êxito, conter ou reter espiritualmente pecados (Jo 20.23; At 27.13).
THAYER.en: Expresses the idea of taking firm physical possession with the hands, arresting someone into custody, or holding with authority doctrines and traditions. Denotes the driving force of control and unwavering attachment. 1. To grasp with the hand, hold firmly (Matt 28:9; Mark 1:31; Rev 2:1). | 2. To take into custody, arrest, or capture by the hands of authorities (Matt 14:3; Mark 14:44). | 3. To hold fast to, keep with faithfulness traditions or teachings (Mark 7:3; 2 Thess 2:15). | 4. To achieve success, restrain, or spiritually retain sins (John 20:23; Acts 27:13).

DEFINITION: An honorific title of respect and high distinction directed at civil authorities of elevated status in the Roman Empire.
SENSES: 1. Respectful and honorific address directed to officials and governors (Acts 23:26; 24:3; 26:25).

THAYER.pt: Um título honorífico de respeito e alta distinção direcionado a autoridades civis de elevado status no Império Romano. 1. Tratamento respeitoso e honorífico dirigido a oficiais e governadores (At 23.26; 24.3; 26.25).
THAYER.en: An honorific title of respect and high distinction directed at civil authorities of elevated status in the Roman Empire. 1. Respectful and honorific address directed to officials and governors (Acts 23:26; 24:3; 26:25).

DEFINITION: The inherent capacity to manifest strength, sovereign power, or governmental authority, especially in grand acts.
SENSES: 1. Vigorous power or strength in action (Eph 1:19; Col 1:11).
2. Act of sovereign power or regal dominion (Heb 2:14).

THAYER.pt: A capacidade inerente de manifestar força, poder soberano ou autoridade governamental, especialmente em atos grandiosos. 1. Poder ou força vigorosa em ação (Ef 1.19; Col 1.11). | 2. Ato de poder soberano ou domínio régio (Hb 2.14).
THAYER.en: The inherent capacity to manifest strength, sovereign power, or governmental authority, especially in grand acts. 1. Vigorous power or strength in action (Eph 1:19; Col 1:11). | 2. Act of sovereign power or regal dominion (Heb 2:14).

DEFINITION: To emit sound in a loud voice or shout, frequently denoting a cry for help, expression of strong emotion, or protest.
SENSES: 1. To shout or cry out loudly due to affliction or demand for help (Luke 4:41).
2. To raise the voice with intensity or public clamor (John 12:13).

THAYER.pt: Emitir som em voz alta ou gritar, frequentemente denotando clamor por socorro, expressão de forte emoção ou protesto. 1. Gritar ou clamar em voz alta devido a aflição ou exigência de socorro (Lc 4.41). | 2. Elevar a voz com intensidade ou clamor público (Jo 12.13).
THAYER.en: To emit sound in a loud voice or shout, frequently denoting a cry for help, expression of strong emotion, or protest. 1. To shout or cry out loudly due to affliction or demand for help (Luke 4:41). | 2. To raise the voice with intensity or public clamor (John 12:13).

DEFINITION: A loud and vehement sound produced by the human voice, expressing strong emotion such as excitement, anger, despair, or deep suffering.
SENSES: 1. A loud cry, call, or outcry (Acts 23:9; Heb 5:7).
2. Noisy lamentation associated with pain or anguish (Rev 21:4).

THAYER.pt: Som alto e veemente produzido pela voz humana, expressando forte emoção como excitação, raiva, desespero ou profundo sofrimento. 1. Um grito forte, chamado ou clamor (At 23.9; Hb 5.7). | 2. Lamento ruidoso associado à dor ou angústia (Ap 21.4).
THAYER.en: A loud and vehement sound produced by the human voice, expressing strong emotion such as excitement, anger, despair, or deep suffering. 1. A loud cry, call, or outcry (Acts 23:9; Heb 5:7). | 2. Noisy lamentation associated with pain or anguish (Rev 21:4).

DEFINITION: Refers to animal flesh, especially that used for human consumption.
SENSES: 1. Food meat fit for consumption (Rom 14:21).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se à carne animal, especialmente aquela utilizada para alimentação humana. 1. Carne própria para consumo (Rm 14.21).
THAYER.en: Refers to animal flesh, especially that used for human consumption. 1. Food meat fit for consumption (Rom 14:21).

DEFINITION: Used to express superiority in quality, value, or moral and spiritual condition compared to something else.
SENSES: 1. Denoting something that possesses greater value, excellence, or advantage (Heb 1:4; 7:7; 11:40).

THAYER.pt: Utilizado para expressar superioridade em qualidade, valor ou condição moral e espiritual em comparação a outra coisa. 1. Denotando algo que possui maior valor, excelência ou vantagem (Hb 1.4; 7.7; 11.40).
THAYER.en: Used to express superiority in quality, value, or moral and spiritual condition compared to something else. 1. Denoting something that possesses greater value, excellence, or advantage (Heb 1:4; 7:7; 11:40).

DEFINITION: Comparative adjective denoting superiority in status, value, rank, or utility relative to another thing.
SENSES: 1. Superior in rank or position (Heb 1:4); 2. More advantageous, useful, or excellent (Heb 6:9).

THAYER.pt: Adjetivo comparativo que denota superioridade em status, valor, rank ou utilidade em relação a outra coisa. 1. Superior em rank ou posição (Hb 1.4); 2. Mais vantajoso, útil ou excelente (Hb 6.9).
THAYER.en: Comparative adjective denoting superiority in status, value, rank, or utility relative to another thing. 1. Superior in rank or position (Heb 1:4); 2. More advantageous, useful, or excellent (Heb 6:9).

DEFINITION: Means to suspend something or someone, fix to a cross, or, figuratively, to have fundamental dependence.
SENSES: 1. To suspend or fix on a gallows, crucify (Acts 5:30).
2. To be suspended or hanging (Matt 18:6).
3. To depend on, be based upon (Matt 22:40).

THAYER.pt: Significa suspender algo ou alguém, fixar em uma cruz ou, figuradamente, ter dependência fundamental. 1. Suspender ou fixar em um patíbulo, crucificar (At 5.30). | 2. Estar suspenso ou pendurado (Mt 18.6). | 3. Depender de, fundamentar-se em (Mt 22.40).
THAYER.en: Means to suspend something or someone, fix to a cross, or, figuratively, to have fundamental dependence. 1. To suspend or fix on a gallows, crucify (Acts 5:30). | 2. To be suspended or hanging (Matt 18:6). | 3. To depend on, be based upon (Matt 22:40).

DEFINITION: A steep slope, bank, or rocky cliff with a sharp incline.
SENSES: 1. Steep bank or slope of a hill, precipice (Matt 8:32).

THAYER.pt: Encosta íngreme, barranco ou penhasco rochoso com declive acentuado. 1. Margem ou encosta íngreme de um monte, precipício (Mt 8.32).
THAYER.en: A steep slope, bank, or rocky cliff with a sharp incline. 1. Steep bank or slope of a hill, precipice (Matt 8:32).

DEFINITION: An inhabitant or native of the island of Crete in the Mediterranean Sea.
SENSES: 1. A native or inhabitant of Crete (Acts 2:11; Titus 1:12).

THAYER.pt: Habitante ou nativo da ilha de Creta, no mar Mediterrâneo. 1. Natural ou habitante de Creta (At 2.11; Tt 1.12).
THAYER.en: An inhabitant or native of the island of Crete in the Mediterranean Sea. 1. A native or inhabitant of Crete (Acts 2:11; Titus 1:12).

DEFINITION: The name of a coworker and traveling companion of the apostle Paul mentioned in the pastoral epistles.
SENSES: 1. A Christian coworker of Paul sent to Galatia (2 Tim 4:10).

THAYER.pt: Nome de um cooperador e companheiro de viagens do apóstolo Paulo mencionado nas epístolas pastorais. 1. Cristão colaborador de Paulo enviado à Galácia (2Tm 4.10).
THAYER.en: The name of a coworker and traveling companion of the apostle Paul mentioned in the pastoral epistles. 1. A Christian coworker of Paul sent to Galatia (2 Tim 4:10).

DEFINITION: A large island located in the eastern Mediterranean Sea, of significance in Paul's missionary journeys.
SENSES: 1. The island of Crete, where Paul visited and left Titus to organize the church (Acts 27:7; Titus 1:5).

THAYER.pt: Grande ilha localizada no mar Mediterrâneo oriental, de relevância nas viagens missionárias de Paulo. 1. A ilha de Creta, onde Paulo esteve e deixou Tito para organizar a igreja (At 27.7; Tt 1.5).
THAYER.en: A large island located in the eastern Mediterranean Sea, of significance in Paul's missionary journeys. 1. The island of Crete, where Paul visited and left Titus to organize the church (Acts 27:7; Titus 1:5).

DEFINITION: A cereal similar to wheat, yet considered of lesser nutritional and commercial value in antiquity, frequently used for the bread of the poorest.
SENSES: 1. Barley grain cultivated for basic food and fodder (Rev 6:6).

THAYER.pt: Cereal semelhante ao trigo, porém considerado de menor valor nutritivo e comercial na antiguidade, usado frequentemente para o pão dos mais pobres. 1. Grão de cevada cultivado para alimentação básica e ração (Ap 6.6).
THAYER.en: A cereal similar to wheat, yet considered of lesser nutritional and commercial value in antiquity, frequently used for the bread of the poorest. 1. Barley grain cultivated for basic food and fodder (Rev 6:6).

DEFINITION: Made of barley, qualifying foods prepared with this cereal, commonly associated with simple or popular breads.
SENSES: 1. Consisting of or made of barley (John 6:9, 13).

THAYER.pt: Feito de cevada, qualificando alimentos preparados com este cereal, comumente associado a pães simples ou populares. 1. Consistindo ou feito de cevada (Jo 6.9, 13).
THAYER.en: Made of barley, qualifying foods prepared with this cereal, commonly associated with simple or popular breads. 1. Consisting of or made of barley (John 6:9, 13).

DEFINITION: The result of a judicial process, comprising both the judge's decision and the resulting sentence or punishment.
SENSES: 1. Judicial action or litigation between parties (1 Cor 6:7).
2. Decision, decree, or verdict issued (Rom 11:33).
3. Unfavorable verdict of condemnation and punishment (Rom 2:2; Rev 20:4).

THAYER.pt: O resultado de um processo judicial, compreendendo tanto a decisão do juiz quanto a sentença ou punição decorrente. 1. Ação judicial ou litígio entre partes (1Co 6:7). | 2. Decisão, decreto ou veredito emitido (Rm 11:33). | 3. Veredito desfavorável de condenação e punição (Rm 2:2; Ap 20:4).
THAYER.en: The result of a judicial process, comprising both the judge's decision and the resulting sentence or punishment. 1. Judicial action or litigation between parties (1 Cor 6:7). | 2. Decision, decree, or verdict issued (Rom 11:33). | 3. Unfavorable verdict of condemnation and punishment (Rom 2:2; Rev 20:4).

DEFINITION: An herbaceous plant that produces showy flowers, used by Jesus in parables about divine providence and the beauty of the fields.
SENSES: 1. Wildflower or lily of the fields (Matt 6:28; Luke 12:27).

THAYER.pt: Planta herbácea que produz flores vistosas, usada por Jesus em parábolas sobre a providência divina e a beleza dos campos. 1. Flor silvestre ou lírio dos campos (Mt 6.28; Lc 12.27).
THAYER.en: An herbaceous plant that produces showy flowers, used by Jesus in parables about divine providence and the beauty of the fields. 1. Wildflower or lily of the fields (Matt 6:28; Luke 12:27).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: κρινῶ, Aor: ἔκρινα, Perf: κέκρικα, Pass: κέκριμαι
DEFINITION: To evaluate a matter with reflective discernment, deliberate, make a resolution, or pronounce a legal and judicial verdict of condemnation or acquittal.
SENSES: 1. To evaluate, judge according to ethical or moral criteria (John 7:24; Rom 14:3).
2. To decide formally, determine, conclude intellectually (Acts 16:4; 20:16; 1 Cor 2:2).
3. To pronounce a legal or eschatological sentence, condemn (Matt 19:28; John 12:48; Acts 26:6).

THAYER.pt: Avaliar uma questão com discernimento reflexivo, deliberar, tomar uma resolução ou pronunciar um veredito jurídico e judicial de condenação ou absolvição. 1. Avaliar, julgar segundo critérios éticos ou morais (Jo 7.24; Rm 14.3). | 2. Decidir formalmente, determinar, concluir intelectualmente (At 16.4; 20.16; 1Co 2.2). | 3. Pronunciar sentença jurídica ou escatológica, condenar (Mt 19.28; Jo 12.48; At 26.6).
THAYER.en: To evaluate a matter with reflective discernment, deliberate, make a resolution, or pronounce a legal and judicial verdict of condemnation or acquittal. 1. To evaluate, judge according to ethical or moral criteria (John 7:24; Rom 14:3). | 2. To decide formally, determine, conclude intellectually (Acts 16:4; 20:16; 1 Cor 2:2). | 3. To pronounce a legal or eschatological sentence, condemn (Matt 19:28; John 12:48; Acts 26:6).

DEFINITION: Refers to the process or formal act of evaluating, judging, and executing divine or human justice. In the New Testament theological context, it frequently points to the final, eschatological verdict of God against evil.
SENSES: 1. Judicial action or trial, especially that of God or the Messiah (John 5:27; Heb 9:27).
2. Adverse judgment, condemnatory verdict, or punishment (Matt 23:33; Rev 18:10).
3. Principle of righteousness, equity, and just application of the moral law (Matt 23:23; Luke 11:42).
4. Human tribunal or court of magistrates (Matt 5:21-22).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se ao processo ou ato formal de avaliar, julgar e executar a justiça divina ou humana. No contexto teológico neotestamentário, aponta frequentemente para o veredito final e escatológico de Deus contra o mal. 1. Ação ou processo judicial de julgamento, especialmente o de Deus ou do Messias (Jo 5.27; Hb 9.27). | 2. Julgamento adverso, veredito condenatório ou punição (Mt 23.33; Ap 18.10). | 3. Princípio de retidão, equidade e justa aplicação da lei moral (Mt 23.23; Lc 11.42). | 4. Tribunal humano ou corte de magistrados (Mt 5.21-22).
THAYER.en: Refers to the process or formal act of evaluating, judging, and executing divine or human justice. In the New Testament theological context, it frequently points to the final, eschatological verdict of God against evil. 1. Judicial action or trial, especially that of God or the Messiah (John 5:27; Heb 9:27). | 2. Adverse judgment, condemnatory verdict, or punishment (Matt 23:33; Rev 18:10). | 3. Principle of righteousness, equity, and just application of the moral law (Matt 23:23; Luke 11:42). | 4. Human tribunal or court of magistrates (Matt 5:21-22).

DEFINITION: The proper name of a synagogue leader in Corinth who believed in the Lord and was baptized by the apostle Paul.
SENSES: 1. Leader of the Jewish synagogue in Corinth (Acts 18:8).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio de um líder da sinagoga em Corinto que creu no Senhor e foi batizado pelo apóstolo Paulo. 1. Líder da sinagoga judaica em Corinto (At 18.8).
THAYER.en: The proper name of a synagogue leader in Corinth who believed in the Lord and was baptized by the apostle Paul. 1. Leader of the Jewish synagogue in Corinth (Acts 18:8).

DEFINITION: Place where justice is administered, judgment tribunal, or by extension, a legal proceeding.
SENSES: 1. Tribunal or forum for judgments and legal disputes (1 Cor 6:2).

THAYER.pt: Local onde se administra a justiça, tribunal de julgamento, ou por extensão, um processo judicial. 1. Tribunal ou fórum para julgamentos e disputas legais (1Co 6.2).
THAYER.en: Place where justice is administered, judgment tribunal, or by extension, a legal proceeding. 1. Tribunal or forum for judgments and legal disputes (1 Cor 6:2).

DEFINITION: One who possesses legal or moral authority to examine cases, issue decisions, judge, or rule.
SENSES: 1. Judge in human or divine courts, responsible for sentencing (Luke 18:6; Jas 5:9).
2. Ruler or leader of the theocratic period of Israel in the Old Testament (Acts 13:20).

THAYER.pt: Aquele que possui autoridade legal ou moral para examinar causas, emitir decisões, julgar ou governar. 1. Juiz em tribunais humanos ou divinos, responsável por sentenciar (Lc 18.6; Tg 5.9). | 2. Governante ou líder do período teocrático de Israel no Antigo Testamento (At 13.20).
THAYER.en: One who possesses legal or moral authority to examine cases, issue decisions, judge, or rule. 1. Judge in human or divine courts, responsible for sentencing (Luke 18:6; Jas 5:9). | 2. Ruler or leader of the theocratic period of Israel in the Old Testament (Acts 13:20).

DEFINITION: Describes someone or something that possesses the ability to evaluate, discern, or judge accurately.
SENSES: 1. Able to discern or judge thoughts and intentions, like the Word of God (Heb 4:12).

THAYER.pt: Descreve alguém ou algo que possui a capacidade de avaliar, discernir ou julgar com precisão. 1. Capaz de discernir ou julgar pensamentos e intenções, como a Palavra de Deus (Hb 4.12).
THAYER.en: Describes someone or something that possesses the ability to evaluate, discern, or judge accurately. 1. Able to discern or judge thoughts and intentions, like the Word of God (Heb 4:12).

DEFINITION: To deliver a blow against something, specifically used in the New Testament for the act of knocking on a door to ask for entry.
SENSES: 1. To physically knock on a door to signal presence and ask for admission (Luke 13:25; Rev 3:20).

THAYER.pt: Desferir um golpe contra algo, especificamente utilizado no Novo Testamento para o ato de bater a uma porta a fim de pedir entrada. 1. Bater fisicamente em uma porta para sinalizar presença e pedir admissão (Lc 13.25; Ap 3.20).
THAYER.en: To deliver a blow against something, specifically used in the New Testament for the act of knocking on a door to ask for entry. 1. To physically knock on a door to signal presence and ask for admission (Luke 13:25; Rev 3:20).

DEFINITION: Refers to a secret, dark, or underground place intended to store objects or hide something.
SENSES: 1. Hidden place or cellar where a lit lamp is not ordinarily placed (Luke 11:33).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se a um local secreto, escuro ou subterrâneo destinado a guardar objetos ou a esconder algo. 1. Lugar oculto ou porão onde não se costuma colocar uma candeia acesa (Lc 11.33).
THAYER.en: Refers to a secret, dark, or underground place intended to store objects or hide something. 1. Hidden place or cellar where a lit lamp is not ordinarily placed (Luke 11:33).

DEFINITION: Qualifies that which is covered, kept secret, or not perceptible to ordinary sight.
SENSES: 1. That which is kept secret or hidden from human eyes (1 Pet 3:4).
2. The innermost or secret place where actions are done without display (Matt 6:4).

THAYER.pt: Qualifica o que está encoberto, mantido em segredo ou que não é perceptível à vista comum. 1. Aquilo que é mantido em segredo ou oculto dos olhos humanos (1Pe 3.4). | 2. O recôndito ou o lugar secreto onde ações são feitas sem exibição (Mt 6.4).
THAYER.en: Qualifies that which is covered, kept secret, or not perceptible to ordinary sight. 1. That which is kept secret or hidden from human eyes (1 Pet 3:4). | 2. The innermost or secret place where actions are done without display (Matt 6:4).

DEFINITION: The act of putting something out of sight range, protecting it in a hiding place, or keeping a secret so it is not revealed.
SENSES: 1. To physically hide or cover something or someone (Rev 6:16).
2. To conceal information, intentions, or talents so they are not discovered (Matt 25:25).

THAYER.pt: O ato de colocar algo fora do alcance da vista, proteger em um esconderijo ou manter segredo para que não seja revelado. 1. Esconder ou encobrir fisicamente algo ou alguém (Ap 6.16). | 2. Ocultar informações, intenções ou talentos para que não sejam descobertos (Mt 25.25).
THAYER.en: The act of putting something out of sight range, protecting it in a hiding place, or keeping a secret so it is not revealed. 1. To physically hide or cover something or someone (Rev 6:16). | 2. To conceal information, intentions, or talents so they are not discovered (Matt 25:25).

DEFINITION: To shine or radiate with the transparency and brilliance characteristic of crystal.
SENSES: 1. To reflect light or shine like transparent crystal, describing heavenly glory (Rev 21:11).

THAYER.pt: Significa brilhar ou resplandecer com a transparência e o brilho característicos do cristal. 1. Refletir luz ou brilhar como cristal transparente, descrevendo a glória celestial (Ap 21.11).
THAYER.en: To shine or radiate with the transparency and brilliance characteristic of crystal. 1. To reflect light or shine like transparent crystal, describing heavenly glory (Rev 21:11).

DEFINITION: A solid, transparent substance, like pure quartz or ice, used in apocalyptic contexts to describe brilliance and purity.
SENSES: 1. Rock crystal or ice with a translucent shine (Rev 4:6; 22:1).

THAYER.pt: Substância sólida e transparente, como o quartzo puro ou o gelo, usada em contextos apocalípticos para descrever brilho e pureza. 1. Cristal de rocha ou gelo com brilho translúcido (Ap 4.6; 22.1).
THAYER.en: A solid, transparent substance, like pure quartz or ice, used in apocalyptic contexts to describe brilliance and purity. 1. Rock crystal or ice with a translucent shine (Rev 4:6; 22:1).

DEFINITION: Indicates that an action is performed in a hidden manner, away from public view.
SENSES: 1. To do something in secret or stealthily, in a shameful way (Eph 5:12).

THAYER.pt: Indica que uma ação é realizada de maneira oculta, longe dos olhares públicos. 1. Fazer algo em segredo ou ocultamente, de modo vergonhoso (Ef 5.12).
THAYER.en: Indicates that an action is performed in a hidden manner, away from public view. 1. To do something in secret or stealthily, in a shameful way (Eph 5:12).

DEFINITION: To gain possession of something for oneself, whether by purchase, effort, or conquest.
SENSES: 1. To acquire, obtain, or buy something for one's own use (Matt 10:9; Acts 8:20).
2. To keep as a possession.

THAYER.pt: Ganhar posse de algo para si mesmo, seja por compra, esforço ou conquista. 1. Adquirir, obter ou comprar algo para uso próprio (Mt 10.9; At 8.20). | 2. Manter como possessão.
THAYER.en: To gain possession of something for oneself, whether by purchase, effort, or conquest. 1. To acquire, obtain, or buy something for one's own use (Matt 10:9; Acts 8:20). | 2. To keep as a possession.

DEFINITION: Refers to any acquired material good, with special emphasis on real estate and lands.
SENSES: 1. Material goods or acquired properties in general (Matt 19:22; Acts 2:45).
2. Land property or cultivable field (Acts 5:1).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se a qualquer bem material adquirido, com destaque especial para propriedades imobiliárias e terras. 1. Bens materiais ou propriedades adquiridas em geral (Mt 19.22; At 2.45). | 2. Propriedade de terra ou campo cultivável (At 5.1).
THAYER.en: Refers to any acquired material good, with special emphasis on real estate and lands. 1. Material goods or acquired properties in general (Matt 19:22; Acts 2:45). | 2. Land property or cultivable field (Acts 5:1).

DEFINITION: Designates large domestic animals raised for heavy labor, cargo transport, or riding.
SENSES: 1. Beast of burden or mount used in travels and labor (Luke 10:34; Acts 23:24; Rev 18:13).

THAYER.pt: Designa animais domésticos de grande porte criados para o trabalho pesado, transporte de cargas ou montaria. 1. Animal de carga ou montaria utilizado em viagens e trabalhos (Lc 10.34; At 23.24; Ap 18.13).
THAYER.en: Designates large domestic animals raised for heavy labor, cargo transport, or riding. 1. Beast of burden or mount used in travels and labor (Luke 10:34; Acts 23:24; Rev 18:13).

DEFINITION: One who holds legal possession of goods, lands, or properties.
SENSES: 1. Owner of lands or houses who sells them to help the early Christian community (Acts 4:34).

THAYER.pt: Aquele que possui a posse legal de bens, terras ou propriedades. 1. Proprietário de terras ou casas que as vende para ajudar a comunidade cristã primitiva (At 4.34).
THAYER.en: One who holds legal possession of goods, lands, or properties. 1. Owner of lands or houses who sells them to help the early Christian community (Acts 4:34).

DEFINITION: To bring into existence something that did not exist before, an act attributed exclusively to God's creative activity in the New Testament.
SENSES: 1. To create the universe and bring beings into existence (Rev 10:6); 2. To perform a new spiritual creation within the believer (Eph 2:10).

THAYER.pt: Trazer à existência algo que antes não existia, ato atribuído exclusivamente à atividade criadora de Deus no Novo Testamento. 1. Criar o universo e trazer seres à existência (Ap 10.6); 2. Realizar uma nova criação espiritual no interior do crente (Ef 2.10).
THAYER.en: To bring into existence something that did not exist before, an act attributed exclusively to God's creative activity in the New Testament. 1. To create the universe and bring beings into existence (Rev 10:6); 2. To perform a new spiritual creation within the believer (Eph 2:10).

DEFINITION: Refers both to the divine act of creating and to the result of that action, encompassing the universe and created beings.
SENSES: 1. The act of creating or the universe created by God (Rom 1:20; Mark 13:19).
2. Each individual creature or being within the cosmos (Rom 8:39).
3. System of authority or established institution (1 Pet 2:13).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se tanto ao ato divino de criar quanto ao resultado dessa ação, abrangendo o universo e os seres criados. 1. A ação de criar ou o universo criado por Deus (Rm 1.20; Mc 13.19). | 2. Cada criatura ou ser individual dentro do cosmos (Rm 8.39). | 3. Sistema de autoridade ou instituição estabelecida (1Pe 2.13).
THAYER.en: Refers both to the divine act of creating and to the result of that action, encompassing the universe and created beings. 1. The act of creating or the universe created by God (Rom 1:20; Mark 13:19). | 2. Each individual creature or being within the cosmos (Rom 8:39). | 3. System of authority or established institution (1 Pet 2:13).

DEFINITION: The tangible result of divine creative action, encompassing everything brought into existence by God.
SENSES: 1. Any element or living being resulting from divine creation (1 Tim 4:4; Rev 5:13).

THAYER.pt: O resultado tangível da ação criadora divina, abrangendo tudo o que foi trazido à existência por Deus. 1. Qualquer elemento ou ser vivo resultante da criação divina (1Tm 4.4; Ap 5.13).
THAYER.en: The tangible result of divine creative action, encompassing everything brought into existence by God. 1. Any element or living being resulting from divine creation (1 Tim 4:4; Rev 5:13).

DEFINITION: One who brings into existence or founds something; in the New Testament, refers exclusively to God as the Creator of all things.
SENSES: 1. God as the Architect and Creator of the universe and humanity.

THAYER.pt: Aquele que traz à existência ou funda algo; no Novo Testamento, refere-se exclusivamente a Deus como o Criador de todas as coisas. 1. Deus como o Arquiteto e Criador do universo e da humanidade.
THAYER.en: One who brings into existence or founds something; in the New Testament, refers exclusively to God as the Creator of all things. 1. God as the Architect and Creator of the universe and humanity.

DEFINITION: Originally derived from dice playing, it came to denote the use of cunning and manipulation to deceive others.
SENSES: 1. Fraudulent artifice or cunning used to lead believers away from the truth (Eph 4:14).

THAYER.pt: Derivado originalmente do jogo de dados, passou a denotar o uso de astúcia e manipulação para enganar os outros. 1. Artifício ou astúcia fraudulenta usada para desviar os crentes da verdade (Ef 4.14).
THAYER.en: Originally derived from dice playing, it came to denote the use of cunning and manipulation to deceive others. 1. Fraudulent artifice or cunning used to lead believers away from the truth (Eph 4:14).

DEFINITION: Originally the art of piloting a ship, it refers to the ability to guide, administer, or lead with wisdom.
SENSES: 1. Gifts of administration or leadership exercised in the body of Christ (1 Cor 12:28).

THAYER.pt: Originalmente a arte de pilotar um navio, refere-se à habilidade de guiar, administrar ou liderar com sabedoria. 1. Dons de administração ou liderança exercidos no corpo de Cristo (1Co 12.28).
THAYER.en: Originally the art of piloting a ship, it refers to the ability to guide, administer, or lead with wisdom. 1. Gifts of administration or leadership exercised in the body of Christ (1 Cor 12:28).

DEFINITION: One who is in charge of navigating a ship, responsible for guiding the vessel safely.
SENSES: 1. Captain or helmsman of a ship (Acts 27:11).

THAYER.pt: Aquele que está no comando da navegação de um navio, responsável por guiar a embarcação com segurança. 1. Capitão ou timoneiro de um navio (At 27.11).
THAYER.en: One who is in charge of navigating a ship, responsible for guiding the vessel safely. 1. Captain or helmsman of a ship (Acts 27:11).

DEFINITION: Adverb that describes a position that completely surrounds an area, object, or surface.
SENSES: 1. Around a place, on all sides (Rev 4:8).

THAYER.pt: Advérbio que descreve uma posição que circunda completamente uma área, objeto ou superfície. 1. Ao redor de um lugar, de todos os lados (Ap 4.8).
THAYER.en: Adverb that describes a position that completely surrounds an area, object, or surface. 1. Around a place, on all sides (Rev 4:8).

DEFINITION: To move around something to form a circle, whether to surround with hostility or to encompass.
SENSES: 1. To encircle, besiege, or surround with hostile intent (Luke 21:20).
2. To make a full turn around an object or location (Heb 11:30).

THAYER.pt: Mover-se ao redor de algo para formar um círculo, seja para cercar com hostilidade ou para circundar. 1. Cercar, sitiar ou rodear com intenção hostil (Lc 21.20). | 2. Dar a volta completa em torno de um objeto ou local (Hb 11.30).
THAYER.en: To move around something to form a circle, whether to surround with hostility or to encompass. 1. To encircle, besiege, or surround with hostile intent (Luke 21:20). | 2. To make a full turn around an object or location (Heb 11:30).

DEFINITION: Denotes the space around a central point; frequently used in the adverbial form to indicate the surrounding region.
SENSES: 1. The surrounding area, the vicinity, or around (Rev 4:6).

THAYER.pt: Denota o espaço ao redor de um ponto central; frequentemente usado na forma adverbial para indicar a região circunvizinha. 1. A área circundante, os arredores ou ao redor (Ap 4.6).
THAYER.en: Denotes the space around a central point; frequently used in the adverbial form to indicate the surrounding region. 1. The surrounding area, the vicinity, or around (Rev 4:6).

DEFINITION: A place or act of wallowing in mud or filth.
SENSES: 1. The act or the place of wallowing in the mud.

THAYER.pt: Lugar ou ato de revolver-se na lama ou sujeira. 1. O ato ou o local de walling/revolcar-se na lama.
THAYER.en: A place or act of wallowing in mud or filth. 1. The act or the place of wallowing in the mud.

DEFINITION: To move an object by making it rotate on a surface or to wallow on the ground.
