SENSES: 1. To roll or push an object (such as a stone) (Luke 23:53).
2. To wallow from one side to the other.

THAYER.pt: Mover um objeto fazendo-o girar sobre uma superfície ou revolver-se no chão. 1. Rolar ou empurrar um objeto (como uma pedra) (Lc 23.53). | 2. Revolver-se de um lado para o outro.
THAYER.en: To move an object by making it rotate on a surface or to wallow on the ground. 1. To roll or push an object (such as a stone) (Luke 23:53). | 2. To wallow from one side to the other.

DEFINITION: Describes a person suffering from some disability, malformation, or paralysis in the limbs of the body.
SENSES: 1. Person with a disability or functional incapacity in one of the limbs (Matt 15:30; 18:8).

THAYER.pt: Descreve uma pessoa que sofre de alguma deficiência, má-formação ou paralisia nos membros do corpo. 1. Pessoa com deficiência ou incapacidade funcional em um dos membros (Mt 15.30; 18.8).
THAYER.en: Describes a person suffering from some disability, malformation, or paralysis in the limbs of the body. 1. Person with a disability or functional incapacity in one of the limbs (Matt 15:30; 18:8).

DEFINITION: Movement of elevation and crest on the surface of sea water, caused by wind or agitation.
SENSES: 1. Impetuous sea wave on the water's surface (Matt 8:24; Jas 1:6).
2. Metaphorical use for instability and agitation caused by false teachers (Jude 13).

THAYER.pt: Movimento de elevação e crista na superfície da água do mar, provocado pelo vento ou agitação. 1. Onda marítima impetuosa na superfície da água (Mt 8.24; Tg 1.6). | 2. Uso metafórico para instabilidade e agitação causada por falsos mestres (Jd 13).
THAYER.en: Movement of elevation and crest on the surface of sea water, caused by wind or agitation. 1. Impetuous sea wave on the water's surface (Matt 8:24; Jas 1:6). | 2. Metaphorical use for instability and agitation caused by false teachers (Jude 13).

DEFINITION: Percussion musical instrument made of metal discs that were struck against each other to produce a shrill sound.
SENSES: 1. Resounding cymbal, used metaphorically to describe speech without love (1 Cor 13:1).

THAYER.pt: Instrumento musical de percussão feito de discos de metal que eram batidos um contra o outro para produzir som estridente. 1. Cimbalo que ressoa, usado metaforicamente para descrever o discurso sem amor (1Co 13.1).
THAYER.en: Percussion musical instrument made of metal discs that were struck against each other to produce a shrill sound. 1. Resounding cymbal, used metaphorically to describe speech without love (1 Cor 13:1).

DEFINITION: Herbaceous plant whose small seeds were used as a spice and in ancient medicine.
SENSES: 1. The cumin seed, mentioned among the small items tithed by the Pharisees (Matt 23:23).

THAYER.pt: Planta herbácea cujas pequenas sementes eram usadas como tempero e na medicina antiga. 1. A semente de cominho, mencionada entre os pequenos itens taxados no dízimo pelos fariseus (Mt 23.23).
THAYER.en: Herbaceous plant whose small seeds were used as a spice and in ancient medicine. 1. The cumin seed, mentioned among the small items tithed by the Pharisees (Matt 23:23).

DEFINITION: A diminutive of dog, used to designate small domestic dogs that lived near the table or inside houses.
SENSES: 1. A small pet dog or domestic dog in contrast to street dogs (Mt 15:26, 27; Mk 7:27, 28).

THAYER.pt: Diminutivo de cão, usado para designar pequenos cães domésticos que viviam junto à mesa ou no interior das casas. 1. Pequeno cão de estimação ou cão doméstico em contraste com os cães de rua (Mt 15.26, 27; Mc 7.27, 28).
THAYER.en: A diminutive of dog, used to designate small domestic dogs that lived near the table or inside houses. 1. A small pet dog or domestic dog in contrast to street dogs (Mt 15:26, 27; Mk 7:27, 28).

DEFINITION: An inhabitant or native of the island of Cyprus.
SENSES: 1. A person native to Cyprus (Acts 21:16).

THAYER.pt: Habitante ou natural da ilha de Chipre. 1. Pessoa natural de Chipre (At 21.16).
THAYER.en: An inhabitant or native of the island of Cyprus. 1. A person native to Cyprus (Acts 21:16).

DEFINITION: An important island located in the northeast of the Mediterranean Sea, frequently visited and mentioned in the book of Acts.
SENSES: 1. The island of Cyprus, the homeland of Barnabas and a waypoint in Christian missionary expansion (Acts 13:4; 15:39).

THAYER.pt: Importante ilha situada no nordeste do mar Mediterrâneo, frequentemente visitada e mencionada no livro de Atos. 1. A ilha de Chipre, terra natal de Barnabé e ponto de passagem na expansão missionária cristã (At 13.4; 15.39).
THAYER.en: An important island located in the northeast of the Mediterranean Sea, frequently visited and mentioned in the book of Acts. 1. The island of Cyprus, the homeland of Barnabas and a waypoint in Christian missionary expansion (Acts 13:4; 15:39).

DEFINITION: To incline the body or head forward and downward, adopting a stooped posture.
SENSES: 1. To bow down or stoop (Jn 8:6, 8).

THAYER.pt: Inclinar o corpo ou a cabeça para a frente e para baixo, adotando uma postura curvada. 1. Inclinar-se ou curvar-se para baixo (Jo 8.6, 8).
THAYER.en: To incline the body or head forward and downward, adopting a stooped posture. 1. To bow down or stoop (Jn 8:6, 8).

DEFINITION: An ethnonym designating an inhabitant or native of Cyrene, a city located in North Africa (modern-day Libya).
SENSES: 1. A native of Cyrene, such as Simon who carried the cross (Mt 27:32; Acts 11:20).

THAYER.pt: Gentílico que designa um habitante ou natural de Cirene, cidade localizada no norte da África (atual Líbia). 1. Um nativo de Cirene, como Simão que carregou a cruz (Mt 27.32; At 11.20).
THAYER.en: An ethnonym designating an inhabitant or native of Cyrene, a city located in North Africa (modern-day Libya). 1. A native of Cyrene, such as Simon who carried the cross (Mt 27:32; Acts 11:20).

DEFINITION: An important Greek city on the north coast of Africa (modern-day Libya), with a significant Jewish community.
SENSES: 1. Cyrene, a city in the Cyrenaica region mentioned in the New Testament (Acts 2:10).

THAYER.pt: Importante cidade grega na costa norte da África (atual Líbia), com significativa comunidade judaica. 1. Cirene, cidade da região de Cirenaica mencionada no Novo Testamento (At 2.10).
THAYER.en: An important Greek city on the north coast of Africa (modern-day Libya), with a significant Jewish community. 1. Cyrene, a city in the Cyrenaica region mentioned in the New Testament (Acts 2:10).

DEFINITION: A Roman imperial administrator of Syria during the period of Jesus' birth.
SENSES: 1. Publius Sulpicius Quirinius, the Roman governor associated with the census of Judea (Lk 2:2).

THAYER.pt: Administrador imperial romano da Síria durante o período do nascimento de Jesus. 1. Públio Sulpício Quirino, governador romano associado ao recenseamento da Judeia (Lc 2.2).
THAYER.en: A Roman imperial administrator of Syria during the period of Jesus' birth. 1. Publius Sulpicius Quirinius, the Roman governor associated with the census of Judea (Lk 2:2).

DEFINITION: A title of respect and honor given to a woman, used in the New Testament in epistles to address an eminent believer.
SENSES: 1. Lady, an honorific title for a Christian woman (2 Jn 1, 5).

THAYER.pt: Título de respeito e honra dado a uma mulher, empregado no Novo Testamento em epístolas para se dirigir a uma crente eminente. 1. Senhora, título honorífico para uma mulher cristã (2Jo 1, 5).
THAYER.en: A title of respect and honor given to a woman, used in the New Testament in epistles to address an eminent believer. 1. Lady, an honorific title for a Christian woman (2 Jn 1, 5).

DEFINITION: Belonging exclusively to the Lord (Christ), characterizing that which is consecrated to His authority or day.
SENSES: 1. Pertaining to the Lord's Supper or table (1 Cor 11:20);
2. Relating to the Lord's Day (Rev 1:10).

THAYER.pt: Pertencente de forma exclusiva ao Senhor (Cristo), caracterizando o que é consagrado à sua autoridade ou dia. 1. Pertencente à ceia ou mesa do Senhor (1Co 11.20); | 2. Relativo ao Dia do Senhor (Ap 1.10).
THAYER.en: Belonging exclusively to the Lord (Christ), characterizing that which is consecrated to His authority or day. 1. Pertaining to the Lord's Supper or table (1 Cor 11:20); | 2. Relating to the Lord's Day (Rev 1:10).

SHORT_GLOSS: to rule, to dominate, to be lord
DEFINITION: To exercise sovereign authority, to rule as lord, or to be dominated by a controlling force.
SENSES: 1. To exercise dominion or reign over someone (Lk 22:25).
2. To be dominated or controlled by forces such as sin (Rom 6:14).
USAGE: to rule, to dominate, to be lord

THAYER.pt: Exercer autoridade soberana, governar como senhor ou ser dominado por uma força controladora. 1. Exercer domínio ou reinar sobre alguém (Lc 22.25). | 2. Ser dominado ou controlado por forças como o pecado (Rm 6.14).
THAYER.en: To exercise sovereign authority, to rule as lord, or to be dominated by a controlling force. 1. To exercise dominion or reign over someone (Lk 22:25). | 2. To be dominated or controlled by forces such as sin (Rom 6:14).

DEFINITION: A designation of legitimate authority, dominion, and possession. In the Septuagint, it translates the tetragrammaton YHWH, being applied in the New Testament to God the Father and to Jesus Christ in His full resurrected divine majesty.
SENSES: 1. Sovereign divine title conferred upon the resurrected and exalted Jesus Christ (Acts 2:36; Rom 10:9; Phil 2:11).
2. Old Testament translation and equivalent of the divine name YHWH (Mt 1:22; Mk 12:29).
3. Owner of property, master of slaves, or a polite address of respect ('sir') (Mt 13:27; Jn 4:11).

THAYER.pt: Designação de autoridade legítima, domínio e posse. Na Septuaginta traduz o tetragrama YHWH, sendo aplicada no Novo Testamento a Deus Pai e a Jesus Cristo em Sua plena majestade divina ressurreta. 1. Título divino soberano conferido a Jesus Cristo ressurreto e exaltado (At 2.36; Rm 10.9; Fp 2.11). | 2. Tradução e equivalência veterotestamentária do nome divino YHWH (Mt 1.22; Mc 12.29). | 3. Dono de propriedades, senhor de escravos ou tratamento cortês de respeito ('senhor') (Mt 13.27; Jo 4.11).
THAYER.en: A designation of legitimate authority, dominion, and possession. In the Septuagint, it translates the tetragrammaton YHWH, being applied in the New Testament to God the Father and to Jesus Christ in His full resurrected divine majesty. 1. Sovereign divine title conferred upon the resurrected and exalted Jesus Christ (Acts 2:36; Rom 10:9; Phil 2:11). | 2. Old Testament translation and equivalent of the divine name YHWH (Mt 1:22; Mk 12:29). | 3. Owner of property, master of slaves, or a polite address of respect ('sir') (Mt 13:27; Jn 4:11).

DEFINITION: Indicates supreme authority, the power of government, or the majesty inherent in lordship, also applied to spiritual hierarchies.
SENSES: 1. Sovereign authority or supreme power of government (2 Pet 2:10; Jude 8).
2. A class of spiritual beings or celestial powers (Eph 1:21; Col 1:16).

THAYER.pt: Indica a autoridade suprema, o poder de governo ou a majestade inerente ao senhorio, sendo também aplicada a hierarquias espirituais. 1. Autoridade soberana ou poder de governo supremo (2Pe 2.10; Jd 8). | 2. Classe de seres espirituais ou potestades celestes (Ef 1.21; Cl 1.16).
THAYER.en: Indicates supreme authority, the power of government, or the majesty inherent in lordship, also applied to spiritual hierarchies. 1. Sovereign authority or supreme power of government (2 Pet 2:10; Jude 8). | 2. A class of spiritual beings or celestial powers (Eph 1:21; Col 1:16).

SHORT_GLOSS: to confirm, to ratify, to validate
DEFINITION: To confer legal validity or binding force upon an agreement, pact, or decision made.
SENSES: 1. To ratify or make legally valid a covenant (Gal 3:15);
2. To confirm a decision or an attitude of love (2 Cor 2:8).
USAGE: to confirm, to ratify, to validate

THAYER.pt: Conferir validade legal ou força obrigatória a um acordo, pacto ou decisão tomada. 1. Ratificar ou tornar juridicamente válido um pacto (Gl 3.15); | 2. Confirmar uma decisão ou atitude de amor (2Co 2.8).
THAYER.en: To confer legal validity or binding force upon an agreement, pact, or decision made. 1. To ratify or make legally valid a covenant (Gal 3:15); | 2. To confirm a decision or an attitude of love (2 Cor 2:8).

DEFINITION: A quadruped canine animal that, in the ancient world, was often viewed as semi-wild and unclean, also serving as a pejorative term.
SENSES: 1. The canine animal, domestic or stray dog (Lk 16:21; 2 Pet 2:22).
2. Pejorative term applied to immoral, unclean people or opponents of the truth (Phil 3:2; Rev 22:15).

THAYER.pt: Animal quadrúpede canídeo que, no mundo antigo, era frequentemente visto como semisselvagem e impuro, servindo também como termo pejorativo. 1. O animal canino, cão doméstico ou errante (Lc 16.21; 2Pe 2.22). | 2. Termo pejorativo aplicado a pessoas imorais, impuras ou opositores da verdade (Fp 3.2; Ap 22.15).
THAYER.en: A quadruped canine animal that, in the ancient world, was often viewed as semi-wild and unclean, also serving as a pejorative term. 1. The canine animal, domestic or stray dog (Lk 16:21; 2 Pet 2:22). | 2. Pejorative term applied to immoral, unclean people or opponents of the truth (Phil 3:2; Rev 22:15).

DEFINITION: Designates the lifeless body of a person, especially an abandoned corpse.
SENSES: 1. Corpses that fell in the wilderness because of disobedience (Heb 3:17).

THAYER.pt: Designa o corpo sem vida de uma pessoa, especialmente um cadáver abandonado. 1. Cadáveres caídos no deserto por causa da desobediência (Hb 3.17).
THAYER.en: Designates the lifeless body of a person, especially an abandoned corpse. 1. Corpses that fell in the wilderness because of disobedience (Heb 3:17).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: κωλύσω, Aor: ἐκώλυσα, Aor. Pass: ἐκωλύθην
SHORT_GLOSS: to hinder, to forbid, to obstruct
DEFINITION: To interpose obstacles in order to prevent something from happening or someone from performing an action. It involves the act of blocking, forbidding, or withholding.
SENSES: 1. To hinder or restrain people from acting (Acts 8:36; Acts 27:43).
2. To forbid or obstruct things and doctrines (1 Tim 4:3; 2 Pet 2:16).
3. To refuse, withhold, or deny something (Lk 6:29; Acts 10:47).
USAGE: to hinder, to forbid, to obstruct

THAYER.pt: Interpor obstáculos a fim de evitar que algo aconteça ou que alguém realize uma ação. Envolve o ato de vedar, proibir ou reter. 1. Impedir ou conter pessoas de agir (At 8.36; At 27.43). | 2. Proibir ou estorvar coisas e doutrinas (1Tm 4.3; 2Pe 2.16). | 3. Recusar, reter ou negar algo (Lc 6.29; At 10.47).
THAYER.en: To interpose obstacles in order to prevent something from happening or someone from performing an action. It involves the act of blocking, forbidding, or withholding. 1. To hinder or restrain people from acting (Acts 8:36; Acts 27:43). | 2. To forbid or obstruct things and doctrines (1 Tim 4:3; 2 Pet 2:16). | 3. To refuse, withhold, or deny something (Lk 6:29; Acts 10:47).

DEFINITION: A community of dwellings smaller and less fortified than a city (πόλις).
SENSES: 1. A village or rural settlement (Mk 6:36; Lk 9:12).
2. The inhabitants of a village.

THAYER.pt: Uma comunidade de habitações menor e menos fortificada que uma cidade (πόλις). 1. Aldeia ou povoado rural (Mc 6:36; Lk 9:12). | 2. Os habitantes de um vilarejo.
THAYER.en: A community of dwellings smaller and less fortified than a city (πόλις). 1. A village or rural settlement (Mk 6:36; Lk 9:12). | 2. The inhabitants of a village.

DEFINITION: A locality larger than a simple village (κώμη), but with the administrative status of a rural settlement.
SENSES: 1. Towns or neighboring settlements where Jesus preached (Mk 1:38).

THAYER.pt: Uma localidade maior que uma simples aldeia (κώμη), mas com o estatuto administrativo de um povoado rural. 1. Vilas ou povoados vizinhos onde Jesus pregava (Mc 1.38).
THAYER.en: A locality larger than a simple village (κώμη), but with the administrative status of a rural settlement. 1. Towns or neighboring settlements where Jesus preached (Mk 1:38).

DEFINITION: Unrestrained partying, licentious festive processions, or nocturnal banquets accompanied by drunkenness and immorality.
SENSES: 1. Unrestrained revelry, carousing, and drunkenness (Rom 13:13; Gal 5:21).

THAYER.pt: Festa desregrada, procissão festiva licenciosa ou banquetes noturnos acompanhados de embriaguez e imoralidade. 1. Festança desenfreada, car Dazu e bebedeira (Rm 13.13; Gl 5.21).
THAYER.en: Unrestrained partying, licentious festive processions, or nocturnal banquets accompanied by drunkenness and immorality. 1. Unrestrained revelry, carousing, and drunkenness (Rom 13:13; Gal 5:21).

DEFINITION: A small flying insect, commonly associated with proverbs about straining out minute things.
SENSES: 1. The gnat, used by Jesus in the proverb about straining out a gnat and swallowing a camel (Mt 23:24).

THAYER.pt: Pequeno inseto voador, comumente associado a provérbios sobre filtrar coisas mínimas. 1. O mosquito, usado por Jesus no provérbio sobre coar o mosquito e engolir o camelo (Mt 23.24).
THAYER.en: A small flying insect, commonly associated with proverbs about straining out minute things. 1. The gnat, used by Jesus in the proverb about straining out a gnat and swallowing a camel (Mt 23:24).

DEFINITION: Island situated in the Aegean Sea, famous for its medical school and beautiful landscapes.
SENSES: 1. Cos, an island visited by Paul during his missionary journeys (Acts 21:1).

THAYER.pt: Ilha situada no mar Egeu, famosa por sua escola de medicina e belas paisagens. 1. Cós, ilha visitada por Paulo durante suas viagens missionárias (At 21.1).
THAYER.en: Island situated in the Aegean Sea, famous for its medical school and beautiful landscapes. 1. Cos, an island visited by Paul during his missionary journeys (Acts 21:1).

DEFINITION: Hebrew masculine proper name appearing in the ancestral lineage of Jesus.
SENSES: 1. Ancestor of Jesus in the genealogy according to the Gospel of Luke (Luke 3:28).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio masculino hebraico que aparece na linhagem ancestral de Jesus. 1. Ancestral de Jesus na genealogia segundo o Evangelho de Lucas (Lc 3.28).
THAYER.en: Hebrew masculine proper name appearing in the ancestral lineage of Jesus. 1. Ancestor of Jesus in the genealogy according to the Gospel of Luke (Luke 3:28).

DEFINITION: Describes the physical incapacity to hear (deafness) or to speak and articulate words (muteness).
SENSES: 1. Incapable of speaking, mute (Matt 9:33; Luke 1:22).
2. Incapable of hearing, deaf (Matt 11:5; Mark 9:25).

THAYER.pt: Descreve a incapacidade física de ouvir (surdez) ou de falar e articular palavras (mudez). 1. Incapaz de falar, mudo (Mt 9.33; Lc 1.22). | 2. Incapaz de ouvir, surdo (Mt 11.5; Mc 9.25).
THAYER.en: Describes the physical incapacity to hear (deafness) or to speak and articulate words (muteness). 1. Incapable of speaking, mute (Matt 9:33; Luke 1:22). | 2. Incapable of hearing, deaf (Matt 11:5; Mark 9:25).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: λήξομαι, Aor: ἔλαχον, Perf: εἴληχα
DEFINITION: To receive something by divine providence, by appointment, or through the casting of lots.
SENSES: 1. To obtain a portion, inheritance, or privilege by appointment or providence (Acts 1:17; 2Pet 1:1).
2. To be chosen or designated by means of a lot (Luke 1:9; John 19:24).

THAYER.pt: Receber algo por providência divina, por designação ou mediante o lançamento de sortes. 1. Obter uma porção, herança ou privilégio por designação ou providência (At 1.17; 2Pe 1.1). | 2. Ser escolhido ou designado por meio de sorteio (Lc 1.9; Jo 19.24).
THAYER.en: To receive something by divine providence, by appointment, or through the casting of lots. 1. To obtain a portion, inheritance, or privilege by appointment or providence (Acts 1:17; 2Pet 1:1). | 2. To be chosen or designated by means of a lot (Luke 1:9; John 19:24).

DEFINITION: Masculine proper name in the New Testament, applied to the brother of Martha and Mary raised by Jesus, and also to the beggar in the parable.
SENSES: 1. Lazarus of Bethany, brother of Martha and Mary (John 11:1); 2. The poor beggar in Jesus' parable (Luke 16:20).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio masculino no Novo Testamento, aplicado ao irmão de Marta e Maria ressuscitado por Jesus, e também ao mendigo da parábola. 1. Lázaro de Betânia, irmão de Marta e Maria (Jo 11.1); 2. O mendigo pobre da parábola de Jesus (Lc 16.20).
THAYER.en: Masculine proper name in the New Testament, applied to the brother of Martha and Mary raised by Jesus, and also to the beggar in the parable. 1. Lazarus of Bethany, brother of Martha and Mary (John 11:1); 2. The poor beggar in Jesus' parable (Luke 16:20).

DEFINITION: Indicates an action performed in a hidden manner, without the knowledge or perception of other people.
SENSES: 1. To act in a secret or covert way, far from public view (Matt 1:19; John 11:28; Acts 16:37).

THAYER.pt: Indica uma ação realizada de maneira oculta, sem o conhecimento ou a percepção de outras pessoas. 1. Agir de forma secreta ou encoberta, longe dos olhares públicos (Mt 1.19; Jo 11.28; At 16.37).
THAYER.en: Indicates an action performed in a hidden manner, without the knowledge or perception of other people. 1. To act in a secret or covert way, far from public view (Matt 1:19; John 11:28; Acts 16:37).

DEFINITION: A sudden, violent, and turbulent gust of wind, frequently accompanied by a storm at sea.
SENSES: 1. A violent gale or cyclonic storm (Mark 4:37; 2Pet 2:17).

THAYER.pt: Rajada de vento súbita, violenta e turbulenta, frequentemente acompanhada de tempestade em alto-mar. 1. Vendaval violento ou tempestade ciclônica (Mc 4.37; 2Pe 2.17).
THAYER.en: A sudden, violent, and turbulent gust of wind, frequently accompanied by a storm at sea. 1. A violent gale or cyclonic storm (Mark 4:37; 2Pet 2:17).

DEFINITION: To kick, as skittish animals do, figuratively representing rebellious and futile resistance against the divine will.
SENSES: 1. To kick against the goads, resisting authority (Acts 26:14).

THAYER.pt: Dar coices, como fazem animais ariscos, figuradamente representando a resistência rebelde e inútil contra a vontade divina. 1. Dar coices contra aguilhões, resistindo à autoridade (At 26.14).
THAYER.en: To kick, as skittish animals do, figuratively representing rebellious and futile resistance against the divine will. 1. To kick against the goads, resisting authority (Acts 26:14).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: λαλήσω, Aor: ἐλάλησα, Perf: λελάληκα
DEFINITION: Denotes the physical and articulated act of emitting intelligible vocal sounds or uttering words. In the New Testament setting, it rises to denote inspired apostolic preaching and the very revelation spoken by God.
SENSES: 1. To articulate sounds, utter human language, or use the faculty of speech (Mark 7:35; 1Cor 14:2).
2. To converse, converse with, or discourse with interlocutors (Matt 10:20; Luke 24:32).
3. To divinely reveal or proclaim the message of the gospel (Acts 4:20; Heb 1:1-2).

THAYER.pt: Denota o ato físico e articulado de emitir sons vocais inteligíveis ou proferir palavras. No ambiente do Novo Testamento, eleva-se para denotar a pregação apostólica inspirada e a própria revelação pronunciada por Deus. 1. Articular sons, proferir linguagem humana ou usar a faculdade da fala (Mc 7.35; 1Co 14.2). | 2. Conversar, expor ou discursar com interlocutores (Mt 10.20; Lc 24.32). | 3. Revelar divinamente ou proclamar a mensagem do evangelho (At 4.20; Hb 1.1-2).
THAYER.en: Denotes the physical and articulated act of emitting intelligible vocal sounds or uttering words. In the New Testament setting, it rises to denote inspired apostolic preaching and the very revelation spoken by God. 1. To articulate sounds, utter human language, or use the faculty of speech (Mark 7:35; 1Cor 14:2). | 2. To converse, converse with, or discourse with interlocutors (Matt 10:20; Luke 24:32). | 3. To divinely reveal or proclaim the message of the gospel (Acts 4:20; Heb 1:1-2).

DEFINITION: Refers both to the content of what is spoken and to the accent or peculiar mode of expression.
SENSES: 1. The substance or content of the spoken message (John 4:42).
2. The characteristic accent or particular manner of speaking (Matt 26:73).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se tanto ao conteúdo daquilo que é falado quanto ao sotaque ou modo peculiar de expressar-se. 1. A substância ou o conteúdo da mensagem falada (Jo 4.2.42). | 2. O sotaque característico ou a maneira particular de falar (Mt 26.73).
THAYER.en: Refers both to the content of what is spoken and to the accent or peculiar mode of expression. 1. The substance or content of the spoken message (John 4:42). | 2. The characteristic accent or particular manner of speaking (Matt 26:73).

DEFINITION: Transliterated Aramaic term meaning 'why', famous for being part of Christ's cry on the cross.
SENSES: 1. The interrogative expression 'why' (Matt 27:46; Mark 15:34).

THAYER.pt: Termo aramaico transliterado que significa 'por quê', célebre por fazer parte do clamor de Cristo na cruz. 1. Expressão interrogativa 'por quê' (Mt 27.46; Mc 15.34).
THAYER.en: Transliterated Aramaic term meaning 'why', famous for being part of Christ's cry on the cross. 1. The interrogative expression 'why' (Matt 27:46; Mark 15:34).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: λήμψομαι, Aor: ἔλαβον, Perf: εἴληφα
DEFINITION: The act of physically seizing something with the hand or taking into possession something granted by another. It communicates active appropriation as well as spiritual receptivity before the gifts of divine grace.
SENSES: 1. To take in the hands, to hold actively (Matt 26:26; Rev 5:8).
2. To receive what is offered, given, or promised (John 1:12; Jas 1:12).
3. To take upon oneself, assume responsibility, or endure a state (Matt 10:38; Phil 2:7).

THAYER.pt: Ação de apoderar-se fisicamente de algo com a mão ou admitir em posse algo que é concedido por outrem. Comunica apropriação ativa assim como receptividade espiritual diante das dádivas da graça divina. 1. Pegar nas mãos, segurar ativamente (Mt 26.26; Ap 5.8). | 2. Receber o que é oferecido, dado ou prometido (Jo 1.12; Tg 1.12). | 3. Tomar sobre si, assumir responsabilidade ou tolerar um estado (Mt 10.38; Fl 2.7).
THAYER.en: The act of physically seizing something with the hand or taking into possession something granted by another. It communicates active appropriation as well as spiritual receptivity before the gifts of divine grace. 1. To take in the hands, to hold actively (Matt 26:26; Rev 5:8). | 2. To receive what is offered, given, or promised (John 1:12; Jas 1:12). | 3. To take upon oneself, assume responsibility, or endure a state (Matt 10:38; Phil 2:7).

DEFINITION: Patriarchal Old Testament figure, father of Noah.
SENSES: 1. Lamech, cited in the earthly genealogy of Jesus (Luke 3:36).

THAYER.pt: Personagem patriarcal do Antigo Testamento, pai de Noé. 1. Lameque, citado na genealogia terrena de Jesus (Lc 3.36).
THAYER.en: Patriarchal Old Testament figure, father of Noah. 1. Lamech, cited in the earthly genealogy of Jesus (Luke 3:36).

DEFINITION: Portable instrument for illumination, which could be a torch made of bundles of twigs or a lamp fueled with oil.
SENSES: 1. A burning torch used in processions or night vigils (John 18:3).
2. A portable lamp with a wick fueled by olive oil (Matt 25:1; Acts 20:8).

THAYER.pt: Instrumento portátil para iluminação, podendo ser uma tocha feita de feixes de gravetos ou uma lâmpada abastecida com óleo. 1. Tocha acesa usada em procissões ou vigílias noturnas (Jo 18.3). | 2. Lâmpada portátil com pavio alimentado por azeite (Mt 25.1; At 20.8).
THAYER.en: Portable instrument for illumination, which could be a torch made of bundles of twigs or a lamp fueled with oil. 1. A burning torch used in processions or night vigils (John 18:3). | 2. A portable lamp with a wick fueled by olive oil (Matt 25:1; Acts 20:8).

DEFINITION: Emitting intense light or possessing a clean, resplendent, and glorious appearance, frequently applied to festive garments or heavenly visions.
SENSES: 1. Radiating vivid light or crystal clarity (Rev 22:1, 16).
2. Characterized by white and showy garments, a sign of celebration or distinction (Luke 23:11; Jas 2:2).

THAYER.pt: Que emite luz intensa ou possui aspecto limpo, resplandecente e glorioso, frequentemente aplicado a vestes festivas ou visões celestiais. 1. Que irradia luz viva ou clareza cristalina (Ap 22.1, 16). | 2. Caracterizado por vestes brancas e vistosas, sinal de festa ou distinção (Lc 23.11; Tg 2.2).
THAYER.en: Emitting intense light or possessing a clean, resplendent, and glorious appearance, frequently applied to festive garments or heavenly visions. 1. Radiating vivid light or crystal clarity (Rev 22:1, 16). | 2. Characterized by white and showy garments, a sign of celebration or distinction (Luke 23:11; Jas 2:2).

DEFINITION: The state or quality of emitting intense light, brightness, or visible splendor.
SENSES: 1. The blinding and celestial brilliance of the light that surrounded Paul on the road to Damascus (Acts 26:13).

THAYER.pt: O estado ou qualidade de emitir luz intensa, brilho ou esplendor visível. 1. O brilho ofuscante e celestial da luz que cercou a Paulo na estrada de Damasco (At 26.13).
THAYER.en: The state or quality of emitting intense light, brightness, or visible splendor. 1. The blinding and celestial brilliance of the light that surrounded Paul on the road to Damascus (Acts 26:13).

DEFINITION: Describes a lifestyle characterized by great ostentation, luxury, and sumptuous feasts.
SENSES: 1. To live in luxury and feast splendidly every day (Luke 16:19).

THAYER.pt: Descreve um estilo de vida caracterizado por grande ostentação, luxo e festas suntuosas. 1. Viver com luxo e banquetear-se esplendidamente todos os dias (Lc 16.19).
THAYER.en: Describes a lifestyle characterized by great ostentation, luxury, and sumptuous feasts. 1. To live in luxury and feast splendidly every day (Luke 16:19).

DEFINITION: To emit rays of light, resplendent or illuminate the surrounding environment.
SENSES: 1. To emit light or shine visibly (Matt 5:15; 17:2).
2. To resplendent or shine intensely outward (Matt 5:16).

THAYER.pt: Emitir raios de luz, resplandecer ou iluminar o ambiente ao redor. 1. Emitir luz ou brilhar visivelmente (Mt 5.15; 17.2). | 2. Resplandecer ou brilhar intensamente para fora (Mt 5.16).
THAYER.en: To emit rays of light, resplendent or illuminate the surrounding environment. 1. To emit light or shine visibly (Matt 5:15; 17:2). | 2. To resplendent or shine intensely outward (Matt 5:16).

DEFINITION: Means to escape someone's perception or attention, remaining hidden, ignored, or unnoticed.
SENSES: 1. To remain hidden or escape someone's knowledge (Mark 7:24; Acts 26:26).

THAYER.pt: Significa escapar à percepção ou atenção de alguém, mantendo-se oculto, ignorado ou sem ser notado. 1. Ficar oculto ou escapar ao conhecimento de alguém (Mc 7.24; At 26.26).
THAYER.en: Means to escape someone's perception or attention, remaining hidden, ignored, or unnoticed. 1. To remain hidden or escape someone's knowledge (Mark 7:24; Acts 26:26).

DEFINITION: Refers to something that has been dug, cut, or carved directly into solid rock or stone.
SENSES: 1. A tomb dug or carved out of the rock (Luke 23:53).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se a algo que foi cavado, cortado ou esculpido diretamente em uma rocha ou pedra maciça. 1. Sepulcro cavado ou talhado na rocha (Lc 23.53).
THAYER.en: Refers to something that has been dug, cut, or carved directly into solid rock or stone. 1. A tomb dug or carved out of the rock (Luke 23:53).

DEFINITION: Refers collectively to a group of individuals united by cultural and territorial bonds. It acquires a distinctive connotation in biblical Greek when designating the covenant people (Israel) and, in the New Covenant, the community of the Church as God's new elect lineage.
SENSES: 1. The covenant people of God, the nation of Israel (Matt 2:6; Luke 1:68).
2. The new community of believers under grace, the Church (Titus 2:14; 1Pet 2:9-10).
3. People in a general sense, population, common folk, or lay crowd (Matt 26:5; Luke 7:29).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se coletivamente a um grupo de indivíduos unidos por vínculos culturais e territoriais. Adquire conotação distintiva no grego bíblico ao designar o povo da aliança (Israel) e, na Nova Aliança, a comunidade da Igreja como nova linhagem eleita de Deus. 1. O povo da aliança com Deus, a nação de Israel (Mt 2.6; Lc 1.68). | 2. A nova comunidade dos crentes sob a graça, a Igreja (Tt 2.14; 1Pe 2.9-10). | 3. Povo em sentido geral, população, plebe ou multidão leiga (Mt 26.5; Lc 7.29).
THAYER.en: Refers collectively to a group of individuals united by cultural and territorial bonds. It acquires a distinctive connotation in biblical Greek when designating the covenant people (Israel) and, in the New Covenant, the community of the Church as God's new elect lineage. 1. The covenant people of God, the nation of Israel (Matt 2:6; Luke 1:68). | 2. The new community of believers under grace, the Church (Titus 2:14; 1Pet 2:9-10). | 3. People in a general sense, population, common folk, or lay crowd (Matt 26:5; Luke 7:29).

DEFINITION: Prosperous city of Phrygia, situated in the valley of the Lycus River in Asia Minor, known for its wealth and as the seat of one of the seven churches of Revelation.
SENSES: 1. The city of Laodicea (Col 2:1; Rev 3:14).

THAYER.pt: Próspera cidade da Frígia, situada no vale do rio Lico na Ásia Menor, conhecida por sua riqueza e sede de uma das sete igrejas do Apocalipse. 1. A cidade de Laodicéia (Cl 2.1; Ap 3.14).
THAYER.en: Prosperous city of Phrygia, situated in the valley of the Lycus River in Asia Minor, known for its wealth and as the seat of one of the seven churches of Revelation. 1. The city of Laodicea (Col 2:1; Rev 3:14).

DEFINITION: Inhabitant or native of the city of Laodicea in Phrygia.
SENSES: 1. The inhabitants or Christians belonging to the city of Laodicea (Col 4:16).

THAYER.pt: Habitante ou natural da cidade de Laodicéia, na Frígia. 1. Os habitantes ou cristãos pertencentes à cidade de Laodicéia (Cl 4.16).
THAYER.en: Inhabitant or native of the city of Laodicea in Phrygia. 1. The inhabitants or Christians belonging to the city of Laodicea (Col 4:16).

DEFINITION: Anatomically refers to the throat or the vocal tract through which one speaks and swallows.
SENSES: 1. The human throat used metaphorically to describe the malice or falsity of words (Rom 3:13).

THAYER.pt: Anatomicamente refere-se à garganta ou ao canal vocal através do qual se fala e engole. 1. A garganta humana usada metaforicamente para descrever a maldade ou falsidade de palavras (Rm 3.13).
THAYER.en: Anatomically refers to the throat or the vocal tract through which one speaks and swallows. 1. The human throat used metaphorically to describe the malice or falsity of words (Rom 3:13).

DEFINITION: Lasea is a coastal city located in the southern part of the island of Crete, mentioned in the account of Paul's journey to Rome.
SENSES: 1. A city situated on the southern coast of Crete (Acts 27:8).

THAYER.pt: Laseia é uma cidade costeira localizada na parte sul da ilha de Creta, mencionada no relato da viagem de Paulo a Roma. 1. Uma cidade situada na costa meridional de Creta (At 27.8).
THAYER.en: Lasea is a coastal city located in the southern part of the island of Crete, mentioned in the account of Paul's journey to Rome. 1. A city situated on the southern coast of Crete (Acts 27:8).

DEFINITION: Indicates an event of strong impact or destruction characterized by a fissure, rupture, or loud noise.
SENSES: 1. To rupture or split open with a loud noise or violence (Acts 1:18).

THAYER.pt: Indica um evento de forte impacto ou destruição caracterizado por fenda, rompimento ou estrondo. 1. Romper-se ou fender-se com estrondo ou violência (At 1.18).
THAYER.en: Indicates an event of strong impact or destruction characterized by a fissure, rupture, or loud noise. 1. To rupture or split open with a loud noise or violence (Acts 1:18).

DEFINITION: To cut, excavate, or open cavities and tombs directly into solid rock.
SENSES: 1. To excavate or hew out a tomb in the rock (Matt 27:60; Mark 15:46).

THAYER.pt: Cortar, escavar ou abrir cavidades e sepulcros diretamente na rocha sólida. 1. Escavar ou cavar um sepulcro na rocha (Mt 27.60; Mc 15.46).
THAYER.en: To cut, excavate, or open cavities and tombs directly into solid rock. 1. To excavate or hew out a tomb in the rock (Matt 27:60; Mark 15:46).

DEFINITION: The service or worship rendered to God in the religious sphere, comprising sacred rites or total devotional surrender.
SENSES: 1. Liturgical service or worship rendered to God (Rom 12:1; Heb 9:1).

THAYER.pt: O serviço ou culto prestado a Deus no âmbito religioso, compreendendo ritos sagrados ou a entrega devocional total. 1. Serviço litúrgico ou culto de adoração prestado a Deus (Rm 12.1; Hb 9.1).
THAYER.en: The service or worship rendered to God in the religious sphere, comprising sacred rites or total devotional surrender. 1. Liturgical service or worship rendered to God (Rom 12:1; Heb 9:1).

DEFINITION: To render sacred service or religious worship to God, denoting the reverent dedication of one's entire life to divine adoration.
SENSES: 1. To render religious worship and devotion to God (Matt 4:10; Rom 1:9).

THAYER.pt: Prestar serviço sagrado ou culto religioso a Deus, denotando a dedicação reverente de toda a vida à adoração divina. 1. Prestar culto religioso e devoção a Deus (Mt 4.10; Rm 1.9).
THAYER.en: To render sacred service or religious worship to God, denoting the reverent dedication of one's entire life to divine adoration. 1. To render religious worship and devotion to God (Matt 4:10; Rom 1:9).

DEFINITION: Designates plants cultivated in gardens for food purposes, such as vegetables and edible herbs.
SENSES: 1. Vegetables cultivated in gardens or plots for human consumption (Luke 11:42; Rom 14:2).

THAYER.pt: Designa plantas cultivadas em hortas para fins alimentares, como vegetais e ervas comestíveis. 1. Vegetal cultivado em jardins ou hortas para consumo humano (Lc 11.42; Rm 14.2).
THAYER.en: Designates plants cultivated in gardens for food purposes, such as vegetables and edible herbs. 1. Vegetables cultivated in gardens or plots for human consumption (Luke 11:42; Rom 14:2).

DEFINITION: Proper name of one of Jesus' apostles, frequently associated or identified with Thaddaeus.
SENSES: 1. One of the twelve apostles of the Lord (Matt 10:3).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio de um dos apóstolos de Jesus, frequentemente associado ou identificado com Tadeu. 1. Um dos doze apóstolos do Senhor (Mt 10.3).
THAYER.en: Proper name of one of Jesus' apostles, frequently associated or identified with Thaddaeus. 1. One of the twelve apostles of the Lord (Matt 10:3).

DEFINITION: A Roman military term designating a significant division of soldiers, used in the NT also to express a vast multitude of spirits.
SENSES: 1. A military unit of the Roman army composed of thousands of soldiers (Matt 26:53).
2. A great multitude or host of demons (Mark 5:9, 15; Luke 8:30).

THAYER.pt: Termo militar romano que designava uma divisão expressiva de soldados, usado no NT também para expressar uma vasta multidão de espíritos. 1. Unidade militar do exército romano composta por milhares de soldados (Mt 26.53). | 2. Grande multidão ou hoste de demônios (Mc 5.9, 15; Lc 8.30).
THAYER.en: A Roman military term designating a significant division of soldiers, used in the NT also to express a vast multitude of spirits. 1. A military unit of the Roman army composed of thousands of soldiers (Matt 26:53). | 2. A great multitude or host of demons (Mark 5:9, 15; Luke 8:30).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: ἐρῶ, Aor: εἶπον, Perf: εἴρηκα, Aor. Pass: ἐρρέθην
DEFINITION: The primary verb of verbal communication in the New Testament, focusing centrally on the intellectual content of what is transmitted. It uses suppletive roots in the future and aorist to structure dialogues and teachings.
SENSES: 1. To express verbally thoughts, commands, or statements ('to say', 'to speak') (Matt 5:2; John 8:45).
2. To designate by name or title ('to call', 'to name') (Matt 1:16; John 4:25).
3. To think inwardly ('to say to oneself') (Matt 3:9; Luke 7:39).

THAYER.pt: Verbo principal de comunicação verbal no Novo Testamento, com foco central no conteúdo intelectual daquilo que é transmitido. Emprega raízes supletivas no futuro e aoristo para estruturar diálogos e ensinos. 1. Expressar verbalmente pensamentos, ordens ou declarações ('dizer', 'falar') (Mt 5.2; Jo 8.45). | 2. Designar por nome ou intitular ('chamar', 'dar nome a') (Mt 1.16; Jo 4.25). | 3. Pensar intimamente ('dizer consigo mesmo') (Mt 3.9; Lk 7.39).
THAYER.en: The primary verb of verbal communication in the New Testament, focusing centrally on the intellectual content of what is transmitted. It uses suppletive roots in the future and aorist to structure dialogues and teachings. 1. To express verbally thoughts, commands, or statements ('to say', 'to speak') (Matt 5:2; John 8:45). | 2. To designate by name or title ('to call', 'to name') (Matt 1:16; John 4:25). | 3. To think inwardly ('to say to oneself') (Matt 3:9; Luke 7:39).

DEFINITION: Refers to a small portion that continues to exist or that remains from a larger whole.
SENSES: 1. A remnant or portion that remains faithful by divine grace (Rom 11:5).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se a uma pequena porção que continua a existir ou que sobra de um todo maior. 1. Um remanescente ou porção que permanece fiel por graça divina (Rm 11.5).
THAYER.en: Refers to a small portion that continues to exist or that remains from a larger whole. 1. A remnant or portion that remains faithful by divine grace (Rom 11:5).

DEFINITION: Describes something that has a smooth, flat surface or is without irregularities or obstacles.
SENSES: 1. A flat path or terrain without roughness (Luke 3:5).

THAYER.pt: Descreve algo que possui superfície lisa, plana ou sem irregularidades ou obstáculos. 1. Caminho ou terreno plano e sem asperezas (Lc 3.5).
THAYER.en: Describes something that has a smooth, flat surface or is without irregularities or obstacles. 1. A flat path or terrain without roughness (Luke 3:5).

DEFINITION: Means to leave behind or fall short in relation to something necessary; expresses the idea of lack or scarcity of provision or virtue.
SENSES: 1. To lack or be in need of something essential (Jas 1:4; Jas 1:5).
2. To be deficient in provisions or requirements (Titus 1:5; Luke 18:22).

THAYER.pt: Significa deixar para trás ou ficar deficiente em relação a algo necessário; expressa a ideia de falta ou escassez de provisão ou virtude. 1. Faltar ou ficar carente de algo essencial (Tg 1.4; Tg 1.5). | 2. Estar deficiente em provisões ou requisitos (Tt 1.5; Lk 18.22).
THAYER.en: Means to leave behind or fall short in relation to something necessary; expresses the idea of lack or scarcity of provision or virtue. 1. To lack or be in need of something essential (Jas 1:4; Jas 1:5). | 2. To be deficient in provisions or requirements (Titus 1:5; Luke 18:22).

DEFINITION: To perform sacred or official service, with a strong connotation of religious, priestly, or community duties.
SENSES: 1. To fulfill liturgical obligations or priestly duties (Acts 13:2);
2. To practice acts of assistance and sacramental beneficence.

THAYER.pt: Prestar serviço sagrado ou oficial, com forte conotação de deveres religiosos, sacerdotais ou comunitários. 1. Cumprir obrigações litúrgicas ou deveres sacerdotais (At 13.2); | 2. Praticar atos de assistência e beneficência sacramental.
THAYER.en: To perform sacred or official service, with a strong connotation of religious, priestly, or community duties. 1. To fulfill liturgical obligations or priestly duties (Acts 13:2); | 2. To practice acts of assistance and sacramental beneficence.

DEFINITION: Originally refers to public service rendered to the State, but in the biblical context it assumes the sense of cultic, priestly service or personal assistance rendered out of love.
SENSES: 1. Priestly or ritual service rendered to God (Luke 1:23; Heb 9:21).
2. Material help or assistance rendered to someone (Phil 2:30).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se originalmente ao serviço público prestado ao Estado, mas no contexto bíblico assume o sentido de serviço cultual, sacerdotal ou assistência pessoal prestada por amor. 1. Serviço sacerdotal ou ritual prestado a Deus (Lc 1.23; Hb 9.21). | 2. Ajuda ou assistência material prestada a alguém (Fp 2.30).
THAYER.en: Originally refers to public service rendered to the State, but in the biblical context it assumes the sense of cultic, priestly service or personal assistance rendered out of love. 1. Priestly or ritual service rendered to God (Luke 1:23; Heb 9:21). | 2. Material help or assistance rendered to someone (Phil 2:30).

DEFINITION: Pertaining or relating to the performance of a sacred, ministerial, or official service.
SENSES: 1. Engaged in special or ministerial service, applied to angels (Heb 1:14).

THAYER.pt: Pertencente ou relativo ao desempenho de um serviço sagrado, ministerial ou oficial. 1. Engajado em serviço especial ou ministerial, aplicado aos anjos (Hb 1.14).
THAYER.en: Pertaining or relating to the performance of a sacred, ministerial, or official service. 1. Engaged in special or ministerial service, applied to angels (Heb 1:14).

DEFINITION: One who performs a public, administrative, or sacred service, acting as a minister or assistant.
SENSES: 1. A servant or minister dedicated to sacred or administrative service (Rom 13:6; Heb 8:2).
2. An auxiliary or personal assistant in ministerial tasks (Phil 2:25).

THAYER.pt: Aquele que realiza um serviço público, administrativo ou sagrado, atuando como ministro ou assistente. 1. Servo ou ministro dedicado ao serviço sagrado ou administrativo (Rm 13.6; Hb 8.2). | 2. Auxiliar ou assistente pessoal em tarefas ministeriais (Fp 2.25).
THAYER.en: One who performs a public, administrative, or sacred service, acting as a minister or assistant. 1. A servant or minister dedicated to sacred or administrative service (Rom 13:6; Heb 8:2). | 2. An auxiliary or personal assistant in ministerial tasks (Phil 2:25).

DEFINITION: A piece of linen fabric used for wiping or as a service apron, marking Christ's humility in washing the disciples' feet.
SENSES: 1. A towel or linen apron used for service (John 13:4, 5).

THAYER.pt: Peça de tecido de linho usada para enxugar ou como avental de serviço, marcando a humildade de Cristo ao lavar os pés dos discípulos. 1. Toalha ou avental de linho usado para serviço (Jo 13.4, 5).
THAYER.en: A piece of linen fabric used for wiping or as a service apron, marking Christ's humility in washing the disciples' feet. 1. A towel or linen apron used for service (John 13:4, 5).

DEFINITION: Designates a thin layer or scaly plate, like fish skin or epidermal peeling.
SENSES: 1. A scale-like substance that fell from Saul's eyes upon his healing (Acts 9:18).

THAYER.pt: Designa uma camada fina ou placa escamosa, como a pele de peixes ou descamações epidérmicas. 1. Substância semelhante a escamas que caiu dos olhos de Saulo na sua cura (At 9.18).
THAYER.en: Designates a thin layer or scaly plate, like fish skin or epidermal peeling. 1. A scale-like substance that fell from Saul's eyes upon his healing (Acts 9:18).

DEFINITION: A severe and chronic skin disease in ancient times, associated with severe social and ritual restrictions.
SENSES: 1. A severe pathological condition of the skin, including biblical leprosy and other severe skin afflictions (Luke 5:13; 17:12).

THAYER.pt: Enfermidade cutânea grave e crônica nos tempos antigos, associada a severas restrições sociais e rituais. 1. Condição patológica grave da pele, incluindo a lepra bíblica e outras afecções cutâneas severas (Lc 5.13; 17.12).
THAYER.en: A severe and chronic skin disease in ancient times, associated with severe social and ritual restrictions. 1. A severe pathological condition of the skin, including biblical leprosy and other severe skin afflictions (Luke 5:13; 17:12).

DEFINITION: Suffering from a severe and debilitating skin disease, commonly translated as leprosy in the biblical context.
SENSES: 1. Afflicted with a severe skin disease (Luke 17:12).
2. As a noun, a person suffering from leprosy (Matt 8:2).

THAYER.pt: Que sofre de uma enfermidade cutânea grave e debilitante, comumente traduzida por lepra no contexto bíblico. 1. Acometido por uma doença grave de pele (Lc 17.12). | 2. Como substantivo, uma pessoa que sofre de lepra (Mt 8.2).
THAYER.en: Suffering from a severe and debilitating skin disease, commonly translated as leprosy in the biblical context. 1. Afflicted with a severe skin disease (Luke 17:12). | 2. As a noun, a person suffering from leprosy (Matt 8:2).

DEFINITION: The smallest and least valuable copper or bronze coin in circulation in Judaism during the New Testament era.
SENSES: 1. A copper coin of the very lowest value (Mark 12:42; Luke 21:2).

THAYER.pt: A menor e menos valiosa moeda de cobre ou bronze em circulação no judaísmo da época do Novo Testamento. 1. Moeda de cobre de altíssimo menor valor (Mc 12.42; Lc 21.2).
THAYER.en: The smallest and least valuable copper or bronze coin in circulation in Judaism during the New Testament era. 1. A copper coin of the very lowest value (Mark 12:42; Luke 21:2).

DEFINITION: Hebrew proper name corresponding to the patriarch of the priestly tribe and to a tax collector called by Jesus.
SENSES: 1. Levi, son of Jacob and ancestor of the priestly tribe (Heb 7:9).
2. Levi, the tax collector also known as the apostle Matthew (Luke 5:27).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio hebraico correspondente ao patriarca da tribo de sacerdotes e a um publicano chamado por Jesus. 1. Levi, filho de Jacó e ancestral da tribo sacerdotal (Hb 7.9). | 2. Levi, o publicano também conhecido como o apóstolo Mateus (Lc 5.27).
THAYER.en: Hebrew proper name corresponding to the patriarch of the priestly tribe and to a tax collector called by Jesus. 1. Levi, son of Jacob and ancestor of the priestly tribe (Heb 7:9). | 2. Levi, the tax collector also known as the apostle Matthew (Luke 5:27).

DEFINITION: Alternative form of the proper name Levi, used to refer to the tax collector called by Jesus.
SENSES: 1. Levi, also known as the apostle Matthew (Mark 2:14; Luke 5:27).

THAYER.pt: Forma alternativa do nome próprio Levi, usada para se referir ao cobrador de impostos chamado por Jesus. 1. Levi, também conhecido como o apóstolo Mateus (Mc 2.14; Lc 5.27).
THAYER.en: Alternative form of the proper name Levi, used to refer to the tax collector called by Jesus. 1. Levi, also known as the apostle Matthew (Mark 2:14; Luke 5:27).

DEFINITION: Member of the tribe of Levi dedicated to the auxiliary temple services and Levitical rituals in Israel.
SENSES: 1. A descendant of the tribe of Levi with auxiliary functions in the sanctuary (Luke 10:32; John 1:19).

THAYER.pt: Membro da tribo de Levi dedicado aos serviços auxiliares do templo e aos rituais levíticos em Israel. 1. Descendente da tribo de Levi com funções auxiliares no santuário (Lc 10.32; Jo 1.19).
THAYER.en: Member of the tribe of Levi dedicated to the auxiliary temple services and Levitical rituals in Israel. 1. A descendant of the tribe of Levi with auxiliary functions in the sanctuary (Luke 10:32; John 1:19).

DEFINITION: Pertaining to the tribe of Levi, especially the priests and the system of worship associated with the Mosaic law.
SENSES: 1. Belonging to the Levitical order or priesthood (Heb 7:11).

THAYER.pt: Relativo à tribo de Levi, especialmente aos sacerdotes e ao sistema de culto associado à lei mosaica. 1. Pertencente à ordem ou ao sacerdócio levítico (Hb 7.11).
THAYER.en: Pertaining to the tribe of Levi, especially the priests and the system of worship associated with the Mosaic law. 1. Belonging to the Levitical order or priesthood (Heb 7:11).

DEFINITION: To cause something to acquire a completely white color, symbolizing purity and heavenly glory.
SENSES: 1. To whiten garments or make something intensely white (Mark 9:3; Rev 7:14).

THAYER.pt: Causar que algo adquira uma cor totalmente branca, simbolizando pureza e glória celestial. 1. Branquear vestes ou tornar algo intensamente branco (Mc 9.3; Ap 7.14).
THAYER.en: To cause something to acquire a completely white color, symbolizing purity and heavenly glory. 1. To whiten garments or make something intensely white (Mark 9:3; Rev 7:14).

DEFINITION: Possessing a pure white color or emitting strong brightness and radiance.
SENSES: 1. Bright, resplendent like light (Matt 17:2).
2. Of white color (Matt 5:36; Rev 1:14).

THAYER.pt: Que possui cor branca pura ou que emite forte brilho e resplendor. 1. Brilhante, resplandecente como a luz (Mt 17.2). | 2. De cor branca (Mt 5.36; Ap 1.14).
THAYER.en: Possessing a pure white color or emitting strong brightness and radiance. 1. Bright, resplendent like light (Matt 17:2). | 2. Of white color (Matt 5:36; Rev 1:14).

DEFINITION: A large feline mammal, used in the New Testament both literally and in metaphors about danger, strength, and royalty.
SENSES: 1. The fierce animal in a literal sense (Heb 11:33).
2. Symbol of the devouring adversary, the devil (1 Pet 5:8).
3. Messianic title derived from the tribe of Judah (Rev 5:5).

THAYER.pt: Mamífero felino de grande porte, usado no Novo Testamento tanto de forma literal quanto em metáforas sobre perigo, força e realeza. 1. O animal feroz em sentido literal (Hb 11.33). | 2. Símbolo do adversário devorador, o diabo (1Pe 5.8). | 3. Título messiânico derivado da tribo de Judá (Ap 5.5).
THAYER.en: A large feline mammal, used in the New Testament both literally and in metaphors about danger, strength, and royalty. 1. The fierce animal in a literal sense (Heb 11:33). | 2. Symbol of the devouring adversary, the devil (1 Pet 5:8). | 3. Messianic title derived from the tribe of Judah (Rev 5:5).

DEFINITION: The state of not remembering important information or losing awareness of a vital meaning.
SENSES: 1. The forgetfulness or neglect of fundamental spiritual truths (2 Pet 1:9).

THAYER.pt: Estado de não se lembrar de informações importantes ou perder a consciência de um significado vital. 1. O esquecimento ou a negligência de verdades espirituais fundamentais (2Pe 1.9).
THAYER.en: The state of not remembering important information or losing awareness of a vital meaning. 1. The forgetfulness or neglect of fundamental spiritual truths (2 Pet 1:9).

DEFINITION: A cavity or tank carved into rock or constructed to crush grapes and extract juice for wine production.
SENSES: 1. A winepress for treading grapes and producing wine (Matt 21:33).
2. Apocalyptic symbol of divine judgment against the nations (Rev 14:19; 19:15).

THAYER.pt: Cavidade ou tanque escavado na rocha ou construído para esmagar uvas e extrair o suco para a produção de vinho. 1. Lagar para pisar uvas e produzir vinho (Mt 21.33). | 2. Símbolo apocalíptico do juízo divino contra as nações (Ap 14.19; 19.15).
THAYER.en: A cavity or tank carved into rock or constructed to crush grapes and extract juice for wine production. 1. A winepress for treading grapes and producing wine (Matt 21:33). | 2. Apocalyptic symbol of divine judgment against the nations (Rev 14:19; 19:15).

DEFINITION: Speech entirely devoid of value, meaning, or truth; chatter or absurdity.
SENSES: 1. Empty words or baseless idle talk (Luke 24:11).

THAYER.pt: Discurso totalmente desprovido de valor, sentido ou verdade; tagarelice ou absurdo. 1. Palavras vazias ou conversa fiada sem fundamento (Lc 24.11).
THAYER.en: Speech entirely devoid of value, meaning, or truth; chatter or absurdity. 1. Empty words or baseless idle talk (Luke 24:11).

DEFINITION: An individual who practices robbery and physical violence, frequently operating in bands on roads or participating in armed insurrections.
SENSES: 1. Roadside brigand, bandit, or violent robber (Matt 21:13; Luke 10:30).

THAYER.pt: Indivíduo que pratica roubos e violência física, frequentemente atuando em bandos nas estradas ou participando de insurreições armadas. 1. Salteador de estradas, bandido ou ladrão violento (Mt 21.13; Lc 10.30).
THAYER.en: An individual who practices robbery and physical violence, frequently operating in bands on roads or participating in armed insurrections. 1. Roadside brigand, bandit, or violent robber (Matt 21:13; Luke 10:30).

DEFINITION: The act or process of receiving something.
SENSES: 1. The act of receiving (a term attested in extra-biblical sources with a similar sense).

THAYER.pt: O ato ou processo de receber algo. 1. O ato de receber (termo atestado em fontes extrabíblicas com sentido similar).
THAYER.en: The act or process of receiving something. 1. The act of receiving (a term attested in extra-biblical sources with a similar sense).

DEFINITION: Indicator of a high degree or intensity, meaning very much or excessively.
SENSES: 1. In a high degree or very strong intensity (Matt 2:16; 2 Tim 4:15).

THAYER.pt: Indicador de alto grau ou intensidade, significando muito ou excessivamente. 1. Em grau elevado ou intensidade muito forte (Mt 2.16; 2Tm 4.15).
THAYER.en: Indicator of a high degree or intensity, meaning very much or excessively. 1. In a high degree or very strong intensity (Matt 2:16; 2 Tim 4:15).

DEFINITION: An aromatic resin extracted from certain trees, highly valued and used in sacred rituals and precious offerings.
SENSES: 1. Aromatic incense offered as a precious gift (Matt 2:11).

THAYER.pt: Resina aromática extraída de certas árvores, altamente valorizada e usada em rituais sagrados e ofertas preciosas. 1. Incenso aromático oferecido como presente precioso (Mt 2.11).
THAYER.en: An aromatic resin extracted from certain trees, highly valued and used in sacred rituals and precious offerings. 1. Aromatic incense offered as a precious gift (Matt 2:11).

DEFINITION: A liturgical container or vessel used for burning fragrant incense before the altar.
SENSES: 1. A censer used in heavenly worship (Rev 8:3, 5).

THAYER.pt: Recipiente ou vaso litúrgico próprio para queimar o incenso perfumado perante o altar. 1. Incensário usado no culto celestial (Ap 8.3, 5).
THAYER.en: A liturgical container or vessel used for burning fragrant incense before the altar. 1. A censer used in heavenly worship (Rev 8:3, 5).

DEFINITION: Designation given to freed Jewish people (former Roman slaves) who had their own synagogue in Jerusalem.
SENSES: 1. Member of the synagogue of the Freedmen (Acts 6:9).

THAYER.pt: Designação dada a judeus libertos (antigos escravos romanos) que possuíam sua própria sinagoga em Jerusalém. 1. Membro da sinagoga dos Libertos (At 6.9).
THAYER.en: Designation given to freed Jewish people (former Roman slaves) who had their own synagogue in Jerusalem. 1. Member of the synagogue of the Freedmen (Acts 6:9).

DEFINITION: Region of North Africa situated west of Egypt.
SENSES: 1. North African territory near Cyrene (Acts 2:10).

THAYER.pt: Região do norte da África situada a oeste do Egito. 1. Território norte-africano próximo a Cirene (At 2.10).
THAYER.en: Region of North Africa situated west of Egypt. 1. North African territory near Cyrene (Acts 2:10).

DEFINITION: To throw stones at someone with the purpose of causing death, a common practice as a form of capital execution or mob lynching.
SENSES: 1. To execute or attempt to kill someone by means of stoning (John 10:31; Acts 14:19).

THAYER.pt: Atirar pedras contra alguém com o propósito de causar a morte, prática comum como forma de execução capital ou linchamento por multidões. 1. Executar ou tentar matar alguém por meio de apedrejamento (Jo 10.31; At 14.19).
THAYER.en: To throw stones at someone with the purpose of causing death, a common practice as a form of capital execution or mob lynching. 1. To execute or attempt to kill someone by means of stoning (John 10:31; Acts 14:19).

DEFINITION: Adjective describing objects or structures built entirely of stone.
SENSES: 1. Made of stone or rock (John 2:6; 2 Cor 3:3).

THAYER.pt: Adjetivo que descreve objetos ou estruturas construídas inteiramente de pedra. 1. Feito de pedra ou rocha (Jo 2.6; 2Co 3.3).
THAYER.en: Adjective describing objects or structures built entirely of stone. 1. Made of stone or rock (John 2:6; 2 Cor 3:3).

DEFINITION: To throw stones at someone, either as a form of aggression by a mob or as the execution of a capital sentence.
SENSES: 1. To throw stones at someone (Acts 14:5).
2. To stone to death as an execution or martyrdom (Matt 23:37; Acts 7:58).

THAYER.pt: Atirar pedras em alguém, seja como forma de agressão por uma multidão ou como execução de pena capital. 1. Atirar pedras contra alguém (At 14.5). | 2. Apedrejar até a morte como execução ou martírio (Mt 23.37; At 7.58).
THAYER.en: To throw stones at someone, either as a form of aggression by a mob or as the execution of a capital sentence. 1. To throw stones at someone (Acts 14:5). | 2. To stone to death as an execution or martyrdom (Matt 23:37; Acts 7:58).

DEFINITION: Refers to stones in general, ranging from pebbles and building blocks to precious stones and heavy tomb slabs.
SENSES: 1. Stone as a natural substance or rock (Matt 3:9; John 8:7).
2. Building block of stone used in construction (Matt 24:2; 1 Pet 2:5).
3. Precious stone or gem used in ornaments (Rev 17:4; 21:19).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se a pedras em geral, podendo abranger desde calhaus e blocos de construção até pedras preciosas e pesadas lajes de sepulcros. 1. Pedra como substância natural ou rocha (Mt 3.9; Jo 8.7). | 2. Bloco de pedra utilizado na construção civil (Mt 24.2; 1Pe 2.5). | 3. Pedra preciosa ou gema usada em ornamentos (Ap 17.4; 21.19).
THAYER.en: Refers to stones in general, ranging from pebbles and building blocks to precious stones and heavy tomb slabs. 1. Stone as a natural substance or rock (Matt 3:9; John 8:7). | 2. Building block of stone used in construction (Matt 24:2; 1 Pet 2:5). | 3. Precious stone or gem used in ornaments (Rev 17:4; 21:19).

DEFINITION: Area or courtyard paved with polished stone blocks, known in the Roman praetorium.
SENSES: 1. The stone pavement, called in Hebrew Gabbatha (John 19:13).

THAYER.pt: Área ou pátio pavimentado com blocos de pedra polida, conhecido no pretório romano. 1. O pavimento de pedra, chamado em hebraico de Gabatá (Jo 19.13).
THAYER.en: Area or courtyard paved with polished stone blocks, known in the Roman praetorium. 1. The stone pavement, called in Hebrew Gabbatha (John 19:13).

DEFINITION: Originally meaning to winnow wheat, in the New Testament it takes on the sense of crushing completely or grinding to powder.
SENSES: 1. To crush or pulverize with severe judgment (Matt 21:44; Luke 20:18).

THAYER.pt: Originalmente significa joeirar o trigo, mas no Novo Testamento assume o sentido de esmagar completamente ou reduzir a pó. 1. Esmagar ou pulverizar com juízo severo (Mt 21.44; Lc 20.18).
THAYER.en: Originally meaning to winnow wheat, in the New Testament it takes on the sense of crushing completely or grinding to powder. 1. To crush or pulverize with severe judgment (Matt 21:44; Luke 20:18).

DEFINITION: Sheltered area of coastal water deep enough for anchoring and protecting watercraft.
SENSES: 1. Seaport for sheltering ships (Acts 27:12).

THAYER.pt: Área abrigada de água costeira profunda o suficiente para ancoragem e proteção de embarcações. 1. Porto marítimo para abrigo de navios (At 27.12).
THAYER.en: Sheltered area of coastal water deep enough for anchoring and protecting watercraft. 1. Seaport for sheltering ships (Acts 27:12).

DEFINITION: A body of fresh water surrounded by land, smaller than a sea; in the NT also used in an eschatological sense for the lake of fire.
SENSES: 1. An inland body of water, such as the Sea of Galilee (Luke 5:1).
2. An apocalyptic image of judgment, the lake of fire (Rev 20:14).

THAYER.pt: Um corpo de água doce cercado por terra, menor que um mar; no NT também usado em sentido escatológico para o lago de fogo. 1. Um corpo de água interior, como o mar da Galileia (Lc 5.1). | 2. Uma imagem apocalíptica de juízo, o lago de fogo (Ap 20.14).
THAYER.en: A body of fresh water surrounded by land, smaller than a sea; in the NT also used in an eschatological sense for the lake of fire. 1. An inland body of water, such as the Sea of Galilee (Luke 5:1). | 2. An apocalyptic image of judgment, the lake of fire (Rev 20:14).

DEFINITION: State of severe food shortage, which can refer to hunger felt by an individual or widespread famine resulting from crop failure.
SENSES: 1. Intense hunger or personal deprivation of food (Luke 15:17).
2. Widespread famine or shortage of provisions in a region (Acts 7:11; Rev 6:8).

THAYER.pt: Estado de severa carência de alimentos, podendo referir-se à fome sentida por um indivíduo ou a uma fome generalizada (famine) decorrente da falta de colheitas. 1. Fome intensa ou privação pessoal de alimento (Lc 15.17). | 2. Fome generalizada ou escassez de mantimentos em uma região (At 7.11; Ap 6.8).
THAYER.en: State of severe food shortage, which can refer to hunger felt by an individual or widespread famine resulting from crop failure. 1. Intense hunger or personal deprivation of food (Luke 15:17). | 2. Widespread famine or shortage of provisions in a region (Acts 7:11; Rev 6:8).

DEFINITION: Linen fiber or fabric, used for making garments, lamp wicks, or fishing nets.
SENSES: 1. Linen wick of a lamp (Matt 12:20);
2. Fine linen garment (Rev 15:6);
3. Fishing net made of plant fibers (Mark 1:18).

THAYER.pt: Fibra ou tecido de linho, empregado para confecção de vestes, pavios de lâmpadas ou redes de pesca. 1. Pavio de linho de uma lâmpada (Mt 12.20); | 2. Vestimenta de linho fino (Ap 15.6); | 3. Rede de pesca feita de fios vegetais (Mc 1.18).
THAYER.en: Linen fiber or fabric, used for making garments, lamp wicks, or fishing nets. 1. Linen wick of a lamp (Matt 12:20); | 2. Fine linen garment (Rev 15:6); | 3. Fishing net made of plant fibers (Mark 1:18).

DEFINITION: Roman Christian who sent greetings to Timothy.
SENSES: 1. A brother in the church at Rome mentioned in 2 Timothy 4:21.

THAYER.pt: Cristão romano que enviou saudações a Timóteo. 1. Um irmão na igreja de Roma mencionado em 2Timóteo 4.21.
THAYER.en: Roman Christian who sent greetings to Timothy. 1. A brother in the church at Rome mentioned in 2 Timothy 4:21.

DEFINITION: Originally oily or fat, it came to denote sumptiveness, brightness, or material wealth.
SENSES: 1. Luxurious, splendid, or worldly high-value things (Rev 18:14).

THAYER.pt: Originalmente oleoso ou gordo, passou a denotar suntuosidade, brilho ou riqueza material. 1. Coisas luxuosas, esplêndidas ou de grande valor mundano (Ap 18.14).
THAYER.en: Originally oily or fat, it came to denote sumptiveness, brightness, or material wealth. 1. Luxurious, splendid, or worldly high-value things (Rev 18:14).

DEFINITION: A Roman unit of weight measurement, corresponding to about 327 grams or twelve ounces, used in the context of weighing valuable substances.
SENSES: 1. A Roman pound in weight (John 12:3).

THAYER.pt: Uma unidade de medida de peso romana, correspondente a cerca de 327 gramas ou doze onças, usada no contexto de pesagem de substâncias valiosas. 1. Uma libra romana de peso (Jo 12.3).
THAYER.en: A Roman unit of weight measurement, corresponding to about 327 grams or twelve ounces, used in the context of weighing valuable substances. 1. A Roman pound in weight (John 12:3).

DEFINITION: Name given to the wind blowing from the southwest or the corresponding cardinal direction.
SENSES: 1. The southwest wind or the direction toward the southwest (Acts 27:12).

THAYER.pt: Nome dado ao vento que sopra do sudoeste ou à direção cardeal correspondente. 1. O vento sudoeste ou a direção para o sudoeste (At 27.12).
THAYER.en: Name given to the wind blowing from the southwest or the corresponding cardinal direction. 1. The southwest wind or the direction toward the southwest (Acts 27:12).

DEFINITION: A collection or gathering of funds and donations, especially that organized among Gentile churches to help needy Christians in Jerusalem.
SENSES: 1. A collection of financial contributions (1 Cor 16:1).

THAYER.pt: Uma arrecadação ou coleta de fundos e donativos, especialmente aquela organizada entre as igrejas gentílicas para o auxílio aos cristãos necessitados em Jerusalém. 1. Uma coleta de contribuições financeiras (1Co 16.1).
THAYER.en: A collection or gathering of funds and donations, especially that organized among Gentile churches to help needy Christians in Jerusalem. 1. A collection of financial contributions (1 Cor 16:1).

DEFINITION: To process mental data through logical calculation, careful evaluation, or attribution of responsibility and merit.
SENSES: 1. To calculate, compute, or take into account analytically (Phil 4:8).
2. To consider, estimate, or evaluate someone or something from a certain perspective (Rom 6:11; 2 Cor 12:6).
3. To attribute or reckon something to someone, such as righteousness or guilt (Rom 4:3; 2 Cor 5:19).

THAYER.pt: Processar dados mentais através de cálculo lógico, avaliação cuidadosa ou atribuição de responsabilidade e mérito. 1. Calcular, computar ou levar em conta de forma analítica (Fp 4.8). | 2. Considerar, estimar ou avaliar alguém ou algo sob certa perspectiva (Rm 6.11; 2Co 12.6). | 3. Atribuir ou imputar algo a alguém, como justiça ou culpa (Rm 4.3; 2Co 5.19).
THAYER.en: To process mental data through logical calculation, careful evaluation, or attribution of responsibility and merit. 1. To calculate, compute, or take into account analytically (Phil 4:8). | 2. To consider, estimate, or evaluate someone or something from a certain perspective (Rom 6:11; 2 Cor 12:6). | 3. To attribute or reckon something to someone, such as righteousness or guilt (Rom 4:3; 2 Cor 5:19).

DEFINITION: That which belongs to the sphere of reason, reflective thought, or possesses a spiritual and genuine nature in contrast to the material ritualistic.
SENSES: 1. Pertaining to the rational or spiritual service offered to God (Rom 12:1);
2. Pertaining to the genuine and unadulterated spiritual milk (1 Pet 2:2).

THAYER.pt: Aquilo que pertence à esfera da razão, do pensamento reflexivo ou que possui natureza espiritual e genuína em contraste com o ritualístico material. 1. Referente ao culto racional ou espiritual prestado a Deus (Rm 12.1); | 2. Pervencente ao leite espiritual genuíno e não adulterado (1Pe 2.2).
THAYER.en: That which belongs to the sphere of reason, reflective thought, or possesses a spiritual and genuine nature in contrast to the material ritualistic. 1. Pertaining to the rational or spiritual service offered to God (Rom 12:1); | 2. Pertaining to the genuine and unadulterated spiritual milk (1 Pet 2:2).

DEFINITION: Designates a sacred declaration or solemn revelation proceeding directly from God.
SENSES: 1. Inspired divine utterance or revelation communicated to the people (Acts 7:38; Rom 3:2; Heb 5:12).

THAYER.pt: Designa uma declaração sagrada ou revelação solene procedente diretamente de Deus. 1. Pronunciamento ou revelação divina inspirada comunicada ao povo (At 7.38; Rm 3.2; Hb 5.12).
THAYER.en: Designates a sacred declaration or solemn revelation proceeding directly from God. 1. Inspired divine utterance or revelation communicated to the people (Acts 7:38; Rom 3:2; Heb 5:12).

DEFINITION: Refers to a cultured person, well-versed in literary knowledge or endowed with great eloquence in speech.
SENSES: 1. A cultured, erudite man well-instructed in letters (Acts 18:24).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se a uma pessoa culta, versada no conhecimento literário ou dotada de grande eloquência na fala. 1. Homem culto, erudito e bem instruído nas letras (At 18.24).
THAYER.en: Refers to a cultured person, well-versed in literary knowledge or endowed with great eloquence in speech. 1. A cultured, erudite man well-instructed in letters (Acts 18:24).

DEFINITION: The product of a cognitive process, encompassing reasonings, reflections, mental calculations, or arguments generated by the human mind.
SENSES: 1. Reasonings and reflections that accuse or defend conscience (Rom 2:15);
2. Arrogant arguments and false reasonings that oppose the knowledge of God (2 Cor 10:4).

THAYER.pt: O produto de um processo cognitivo, abrangendo raciocínios, reflexões, cálculos mentais ou argumentos gerados pela mente humana. 1. Raciocínios e reflexões que acusam ou defendem a consciência (Rm 2.15); | 2. Argumentos altivos e falsos raciocínios que se opõem ao conhecimento de Deus (2Co 10.4).
THAYER.en: The product of a cognitive process, encompassing reasonings, reflections, mental calculations, or arguments generated by the human mind. 1. Reasonings and reflections that accuse or defend conscience (Rom 2:15); | 2. Arrogant arguments and false reasonings that oppose the knowledge of God (2 Cor 10:4).

DEFINITION: To engage in useless discussions and futile contentions about the meaning or use of words.
SENSES: 1. To dispute verbally over terms without spiritual profit (2 Tim 2:14).

THAYER.pt: Envolver-se em discussões inúteis e contendas fúteis sobre o significado ou uso de palavras. 1. Disputar verbalmente sobre termos sem proveito espiritual (2Tm 2.14).
THAYER.en: To engage in useless discussions and futile contentions about the meaning or use of words. 1. To dispute verbally over terms without spiritual profit (2 Tim 2:14).

DEFINITION: Verbal contention or useless discussion centered on vocabulary debates and empty opinions.
SENSES: 1. Battle of words and futile contentions in the community (1 Tim 6:4).

THAYER.pt: Contenda verbal ou discussão inútil centrada em debates de vocabulário e opiniões vazias. 1. Batalha de palavras e contendas fúteis na comunidade (1Tm 6.4).
THAYER.en: Verbal contention or useless discussion centered on vocabulary debates and empty opinions. 1. Battle of words and futile contentions in the community (1 Tim 6:4).

DEFINITION: Intelligible expression of thought through speech, encompassing everything from a simple statement to a structured discourse or preaching of the gospel. In the Johannine prologue, it assumes supreme theological character as the incarnate Word of God.
SENSES: 1. Speech, statement, spoken word, or administered teaching (Matt 7:24; Luke 24:19).
2. The message of the Christian gospel and divine proclamation (Acts 4:4; Gal 6:6).
3. The pre-existent and incarnate divine Word in Jesus Christ (John 1:1, 14; 1 John 1:1).
4. Accountability or rational reckoning (Rom 14:12; Heb 4:13).

THAYER.pt: Expressão inteligível do pensamento mediante a fala, abarcando desde um enunciado simples até um discurso estruturado ou pregação do evangelho. No prólogo joanino, assume caráter teológico supremo como a Palavra encarnada de Deus. 1. Fala, enunciado, palavra dita ou ensino ministrado (Mt 7.24; Lc 24.19). | 2. A mensagem do evangelho cristão e a proclamação divina (At 4.4; Gl 6.6). | 3. O Verbo divino preexistente e encarnado em Jesus Cristo (Jo 1.1, 14; 1Jo 1.1). | 4. Prestação de contas ou cômputo racional (Rm 14.12; Hb 4.13).
THAYER.en: Intelligible expression of thought through speech, encompassing everything from a simple statement to a structured discourse or preaching of the gospel. In the Johannine prologue, it assumes supreme theological character as the incarnate Word of God. 1. Speech, statement, spoken word, or administered teaching (Matt 7:24; Luke 24:19). | 2. The message of the Christian gospel and divine proclamation (Acts 4:4; Gal 6:6). | 3. The pre-existent and incarnate divine Word in Jesus Christ (John 1:1, 14; 1 John 1:1). | 4. Accountability or rational reckoning (Rom 14:12; Heb 4:13).

DEFINITION: A long-shafted weapon with a sharp metal point, used for piercing through thrusting or as a projectile.
SENSES: 1. The spear with which the Roman soldier pierced Jesus' side on the cross (John 19:34).

THAYER.pt: Uma arma de haste longa com uma ponta afiada de metal, usada para perfurar através de estocada ou como projétil. 1. A lança com a qual o soldado romano transpassou o lado de Jesus na cruz (Jo 19.34).
THAYER.en: A long-shafted weapon with a sharp metal point, used for piercing through thrusting or as a projectile. 1. The spear with which the Roman soldier pierced Jesus' side on the cross (John 19:34).

DEFINITION: To verbally attack someone with severe insults, taunts, or words of contempt and defamation.
SENSES: 1. To attack with verbal insults and outrageous words (John 9:28; Acts 23:4; 1 Cor 4:12).

THAYER.pt: Atacar verbalmente alguém com injúrias severas, insultos ou palavras de desprezo e difamação. 1. Atacar com insultos verbais e palavras ultrajantes (Jo 9.28; At 23.4; 1Co 4.12).
THAYER.en: To verbally attack someone with severe insults, taunts, or words of contempt and defamation. 1. To attack with verbal insults and outrageous words (John 9:28; Acts 23:4; 1 Cor 4:12).

DEFINITION: Use of severely insulting, defamatory, or injurious language against someone.
SENSES: 1. Word of insult, outrage, or verbal injury (1 Tim 5:14; 1 Pet 3:9).

THAYER.pt: Uso de linguagem severamente insultuosa, difamatória ou injuriosa contra alguém. 1. Palavra de insulto, ultraje ou injúria verbal (1Tm 5.14; 1Pe 3.9).
THAYER.en: Use of severely insulting, defamatory, or injurious language against someone. 1. Word of insult, outrage, or verbal injury (1 Tim 5:14; 1 Pet 3:9).

DEFINITION: Person who has the habit of reviling, insulting, or uttering defamatory and abusive words against others.
SENSES: 1. A defamer or reviler who will not inherit the kingdom of God if he persists in his practice (1 Cor 5:11; 6:10).

THAYER.pt: Pessoa que tem o hábito de injuriar, insultar ou proferir palavras difamadoras e abusivas contra os outros. 1. Um difamador ou injuriador que não herdará o reino de Deus se persistir em sua prática (1Co 5.11; 6.10).
THAYER.en: Person who has the habit of reviling, insulting, or uttering defamatory and abusive words against others. 1. A defamer or reviler who will not inherit the kingdom of God if he persists in his practice (1 Cor 5:11; 6:10).

DEFINITION: Designates both a widespread contagious disease (pestilence) and, by metaphorical extension, a person who causes severe social problems or sedition (a public pest or plague).
SENSES: 1. A destructive plague or pestilence;
2. A public agitator and cause of dissension (Acts 24:5).

THAYER.pt: Designa tanto uma doença contagiosa generalizada (peste) quanto, por extensão metafórica, uma pessoa que causa graves problemas sociais ou sedição (uma peste ou praga pública). 1. Uma praga ou peste destruidora; | 2. Um agitador público e causador de dissensão (At 24.5).
THAYER.en: Designates both a widespread contagious disease (pestilence) and, by metaphorical extension, a person who causes severe social problems or sedition (a public pest or plague). 1. A destructive plague or pestilence; | 2. A public agitator and cause of dissension (Acts 24:5).

DEFINITION: Refers to that which remains of a whole after the removal or action of a part, or designates the other members of a group.
SENSES: 1. That which remains or is left over, the rest (Rev 8:13).
2. The others, the remaining members of a group (Matt 25:11; Acts 2:37).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se àquilo que resta de um todo após a remoção ou ação de uma parte, ou designa os demais integrantes de um grupo. 1. O que permanece ou sobra, o restante (Ap 8.13). | 2. Os outros, os demais membros de um grupo (Mt 25.11; At 2:37).
THAYER.en: Refers to that which remains of a whole after the removal or action of a part, or designates the other members of a group. 1. That which remains or is left over, the rest (Rev 8:13). | 2. The others, the remaining members of a group (Matt 25:11; Acts 2:37).
