DEFINITION: Frequently used as an adverb or conjunction to introduce a conclusion, the remainder of a subject, or an additional argument.
SENSES: 1. Finally, in conclusion (Phil 3:1; 2 Thess 3:1).
2. Furthermore, moreover, consequently (1 Cor 7:29).

THAYER.pt: Usado frequentemente como advérbio ou conjunção para introduzir uma conclusão, o restante de um assunto ou um argumento adicional. 1. Por fim, finalmente, em conclusão (Fp 3.1; 2Ts 3.1). | 2. Ademais, além disso, por conseguinte (1Co 7.29).
THAYER.en: Frequently used as an adverb or conjunction to introduce a conclusion, the remainder of a subject, or an additional argument. 1. Finally, in conclusion (Phil 3:1; 2 Thess 3:1). | 2. Furthermore, moreover, consequently (1 Cor 7:29).

DEFINITION: A temporal expression indicating the remainder of time or the transition to the future from a given moment.
SENSES: 1. Henceforth, from now on.

THAYER.pt: Expressão temporal que indica o restante do tempo ou a transição para o futuro a partir de dado momento. 1. Doravante, de agora em diante.
THAYER.en: A temporal expression indicating the remainder of time or the transition to the future from a given moment. 1. Henceforth, from now on.

DEFINITION: A proper name designating Luke, a physician, companion, and co-worker of the apostle Paul, traditionally recognized as the author of the third Gospel and the book of Acts.
SENSES: 1. Traveling companion of Paul and collaborator in ministry (Col 4:14; Phlm 24; 2 Tim 4:11).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio que designa Lucas, médico, companheiro e cooperador do apóstolo Paulo, tradicionalmente reconhecido como o autor do terceiro evangelho e do livro de Atos. 1. Companheiro de viagens de Paulo e colaborador no ministério (Cl 4.14; Fm 24; 2Tm 4.11).
THAYER.en: A proper name designating Luke, a physician, companion, and co-worker of the apostle Paul, traditionally recognized as the author of the third Gospel and the book of Acts. 1. Traveling companion of Paul and collaborator in ministry (Col 4:14; Phlm 24; 2 Tim 4:11).

DEFINITION: A Roman man's proper name, applied to a prophet or teacher in the church at Antioch and to a Christian who sends greetings.
SENSES: 1. Lucius of Cyrene, a teacher and prophet in Antioch (Acts 13:1);
2. A Christian who sends greetings in the letter to the Romans (Rom 16:21).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio de homem romano, aplicado a um profeta ou mestre na igreja de Antioquia e a um cristão que envia saudações. 1. Lúcio de Cirene, mestre e profeta em Antioquia (At 13.1); | 2. Um cristão que envia saudações na carta aos Romanos (Rm 16.21).
THAYER.en: A Roman man's proper name, applied to a prophet or teacher in the church at Antioch and to a Christian who sends greetings. 1. Lucius of Cyrene, a teacher and prophet in Antioch (Acts 13:1); | 2. A Christian who sends greetings in the letter to the Romans (Rom 16:21).

DEFINITION: The act of bathing or washing, used in the New Testament as a metaphor or direct reference to the ceremonial act of Christian baptism and spiritual purification.
SENSES: 1. The washing of water by the word in the purification of the church (Eph 5:26);
2. The washing of regeneration and renewal of the Holy Spirit (Titus 3:5).

THAYER.pt: A ação de banhar ou lavar, usado no Novo Testamento como metáfora ou referência direta ao ato cerimonial do batismo cristão e à purificação espiritual. 1. O banho de água pela palavra na purificação da igreja (Ef 5.26); | 2. A lavagem da regeneração e renovação do Espírito Santo (Tt 3.5).
THAYER.en: The act of bathing or washing, used in the New Testament as a metaphor or direct reference to the ceremonial act of Christian baptism and spiritual purification. 1. The washing of water by the word in the purification of the church (Eph 5:26); | 2. The washing of regeneration and renewal of the Holy Spirit (Titus 3:5).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: lousō; Aor: elousa; Pass: elousthēs, lelumenos
DEFINITION: Means to use water to clean physical impurities from the body, to bathe or wash completely, also appearing in contexts of cultic and ritual purification.
SENSES: 1. To wash the body or bathe someone physically (Acts 16:33; 2 Pet 2:22).
2. To purify or wash in a cultic or ceremonial sense (John 13:10; Heb 10:22).

THAYER.pt: Significa usar água para limpar impurezas físicas do corpo, banhar ou lavar por completo, aparecendo também em contextos de purificação cultual e ritualística. 1. Lavar o corpo ou banhar alguém fisicamente (At 16.33; 2Pe 2.22). | 2. Purificar ou lavar em sentido cultual ou cerimonial (Jo 13.10; Hb 10.22).
THAYER.en: Means to use water to clean physical impurities from the body, to bathe or wash completely, also appearing in contexts of cultic and ritual purification. 1. To wash the body or bathe someone physically (Acts 16:33; 2 Pet 2:22). | 2. To purify or wash in a cultic or ceremonial sense (John 13:10; Heb 10:22).

DEFINITION: An ancient Palestinian city located southeast of Joppa, on the road to Jerusalem, where Peter healed the paralytic Aeneas.
SENSES: 1. A Jewish city where the apostle Peter performed a healing miracle (Acts 9:32, 35, 38).

THAYER.pt: Antiga cidade palestina localizada a sudeste de Jope, na estrada para Jerusalém, onde Pedro curou o paralítico Eneias. 1. Cidade judaica onde o apóstolo Pedro realizou um milagre de cura (At 9.32, 35, 38).
THAYER.en: An ancient Palestinian city located southeast of Joppa, on the road to Jerusalem, where Peter healed the paralytic Aeneas. 1. A Jewish city where the apostle Peter performed a healing miracle (Acts 9:32, 35, 38).

DEFINITION: A feminine proper name of a purple-dye merchant, originally from Thyatira, who was converted to the gospel by Paul in Philippi.
SENSES: 1. Lydia, the first European convert recorded in Paul's ministry (Acts 16:14).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio feminino de uma mulher comerciante de púrpura, originária de Tiatira, que foi convertida ao evangelismo por Paulo em Filipos. 1. Lídia, a primeira convertida europeia registrada no ministério de Paulo (At 16.14).
THAYER.en: A feminine proper name of a purple-dye merchant, originally from Thyatira, who was converted to the gospel by Paul in Philippi. 1. Lydia, the first European convert recorded in Paul's ministry (Acts 16:14).

DEFINITION: A province situated in the interior of Asia Minor, visited by Paul during his missionary journeys.
SENSES: 1. A region of Asia Minor that included cities such as Lystra and Derbe (Acts 14:6).

THAYER.pt: Província situada no interior da Ásia Menor, visitada por Paulo durante suas viagens missionárias. 1. Região da Ásia Menor que incluía cidades como Listra e Derbe (At 14.6).
THAYER.en: A province situated in the interior of Asia Minor, visited by Paul during his missionary journeys. 1. A region of Asia Minor that included cities such as Lystra and Derbe (Acts 14:6).

DEFINITION: According to the language or dialect spoken by the inhabitants of Lycaonia.
SENSES: 1. In the Lycaonian language, the native tongue of that region (Acts 14:11).

THAYER.pt: De acordo com o idioma ou dialeto falado pelos habitantes da Licaônia. 1. Na língua licaônica, o idioma nativo daquela região (At 14.11).
THAYER.en: According to the language or dialect spoken by the inhabitants of Lycaonia. 1. In the Lycaonian language, the native tongue of that region (Acts 14:11).

DEFINITION: A mountainous region located on the southwestern coast of Asia Minor.
SENSES: 1. A coastal province of Asia Minor where the port of Myra was located (Acts 27:5).

THAYER.pt: Região montanhosa localizada na costa sudoeste da Ásia Menor. 1. Província costeira da Ásia Menor onde ficava o porto de Mira (At 27.5).
THAYER.en: A mountainous region located on the southwestern coast of Asia Minor. 1. A coastal province of Asia Minor where the port of Myra was located (Acts 27:5).

DEFINITION: A carnivorous mammal known for its voracity and danger to flocks. In the New Testament, it is frequently used as a metaphor for false teachers or fierce persecutors.
SENSES: 1. The wild predatory animal (John 10:12).
2. A metaphor for cruel people, false teachers, or aggressors (Matt 7:15; Acts 20:29).

THAYER.pt: Animal mamífero carnívoro, conhecido por sua voracidade e perigo para os rebanhos. No Novo Testamento, é frequentemente usado como metáfora para falsos mestres ou perseguidores ferozes. 1. O animal selvagem e predador (Jo 10.12). | 2. Metáfora para pessoas cruéis, falsos mestres ou agressores (Mt 7.15; At 20.29).
THAYER.en: A carnivorous mammal known for its voracity and danger to flocks. In the New Testament, it is frequently used as a metaphor for false teachers or fierce persecutors. 1. The wild predatory animal (John 10:12). | 2. A metaphor for cruel people, false teachers, or aggressors (Matt 7:15; Acts 20:29).

DEFINITION: To cause severe destruction, damage, or ruin to people, institutions, or property.
SENSES: 1. To devastate, lay waste, or violently corrupt (attested in contexts of persecution).

THAYER.pt: Causar severa destruição, dano ou ruína a pessoas, instituições ou propriedades. 1. Devastar, assolar ou corromper violentamente (atestado em contextos de perseguição).
THAYER.en: To cause severe destruction, damage, or ruin to people, institutions, or property. 1. To devastate, lay waste, or violently corrupt (attested in contexts of persecution).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: lupēsō; Aor: elupēsa; Pass. Aor: elupēthēn
DEFINITION: Means to cause strong mental or emotional suffering, generating sadness, hurt, or deep affliction.
SENSES: 1. To cause affliction, hurt, or offend someone (Eph 4:30).
2. To experience sadness or be distressed (Matt 19:22; 2 Cor 7:9).

THAYER.pt: Significa causar forte sofrimento mental ou emocional, gerando tristeza, mágoa ou aflição profunda. 1. Causar aflição, magoar ou ofender alguém (Ef 4.30). | 2. Experimentar tristeza ou estar angustiado (Mt 19.22; 2Co 7.9).
THAYER.en: Means to cause strong mental or emotional suffering, generating sadness, hurt, or deep affliction. 1. To cause affliction, hurt, or offend someone (Eph 4:30). | 2. To experience sadness or be distressed (Matt 19:22; 2 Cor 7:9).

DEFINITION: Refers to a state of mental pain, affliction, or grief in the spirit, resulting from trials, losses, or repentance.
SENSES: 1. Mental pain, deep affliction, or emotional grief (John 16:21; 2 Cor 2:3).
2. Godly sorrow that leads to saving repentance (2 Cor 7:10).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se a um estado de dor mental, aflição ou pesar no espírito, resultante de provações, perdas ou arrependimento. 1. Dor mental, aflição profunda ou pesar emocional (Jo 16.21; 2Co 2.3). | 2. Tristeza piedosa que conduz ao arrependimento salvador (2Co 7.10).
THAYER.en: Refers to a state of mental pain, affliction, or grief in the spirit, resulting from trials, losses, or repentance. 1. Mental pain, deep affliction, or emotional grief (John 16:21; 2 Cor 2:3). | 2. Godly sorrow that leads to saving repentance (2 Cor 7:10).

DEFINITION: A historical political figure who ruled as tetrarch in the region of Abilene at the time of John the Baptist.
SENSES: 1. The tetrarch of Abilene mentioned in Luke's chronological summary (Luke 3:1).

THAYER.pt: Figura política histórica que governava como tetrarca na região de Abilene na época de João Batista. 1. O tetrarca de Abilene mencionado no sumário cronológico de Lucas (Lc 3.1).
THAYER.en: A historical political figure who ruled as tetrarch in the region of Abilene at the time of John the Baptist. 1. The tetrarch of Abilene mentioned in Luke's chronological summary (Luke 3:1).

DEFINITION: A proper name referring to Claudius Lysias, the Roman military officer (chiliarch) in Jerusalem who protected the apostle Paul from a riot.
SENSES: 1. The Roman military tribune who rescued Paul and wrote a letter to Felix (Acts 23:26).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio que se refere a Cláudio Lísias, o oficial militar romano (quiliarca) em Jerusalém que protegeu o apóstolo Paulo de um motim. 1. Tribuno militar romano que resgatou Paulo e escreveu uma carta a Félix (At 23.26).
THAYER.en: A proper name referring to Claudius Lysias, the Roman military officer (chiliarch) in Jerusalem who protected the apostle Paul from a riot. 1. The Roman military tribune who rescued Paul and wrote a letter to Felix (Acts 23:26).

DEFINITION: The act of untying, loosening, or dissolving a bond, specifically the matrimonial tie.
SENSES: 1. The dissolution of a marital bond or divorce (1 Cor 7:27).

THAYER.pt: Ato de desatar, soltar ou dissolver um vínculo, especificamente o laço matrimonial. 1. A dissolução de um vínculo conjugal ou divórcio (1Co 7.27).
THAYER.en: The act of untying, loosening, or dissolving a bond, specifically the matrimonial tie. 1. The dissolution of a marital bond or divorce (1 Cor 7:27).

DEFINITION: Means to be profitable, advantageous, or preferable. In the New Testament, it appears in the impersonal form to indicate that something is better or more useful than a bad alternative.
SENSES: 1. To be advantageous or to be better (Luke 17:2).

THAYER.pt: Significa ser proveitoso, vantajoso ou preferível. No Novo Testamento, aparece na forma impessoal para indicar que algo é melhor ou mais útil do que uma alternativa ruim. 1. Ser vantajoso ou ser melhor (Lc 17.2).
THAYER.en: Means to be profitable, advantageous, or preferable. In the New Testament, it appears in the impersonal form to indicate that something is better or more useful than a bad alternative. 1. To be advantageous or to be better (Luke 17:2).

DEFINITION: A city in Lycaonia, in the region of Asia Minor, where Paul was stoned during his first missionary journey and where Timothy resided.
SENSES: 1. The city of Lystra (Acts 14:6; Acts 16:1).

THAYER.pt: Cidade da Licaonia, na região da Ásia Menor, onde Paulo foi apedrejado em sua primeira viagem missionária e onde Timóteo residia. 1. A cidade de Listra (At 14.6; At 16.1).
THAYER.en: A city in Lycaonia, in the region of Asia Minor, where Paul was stoned during his first missionary journey and where Timothy resided. 1. The city of Lystra (Acts 14:6; Acts 16:1).

DEFINITION: The price paid to secure the release or liberation of prisoners, slaves, or captives.
SENSES: 1. The ransom given by Christ on behalf of many (Matt 20:28; Mark 10:45).

THAYER.pt: O preço pago para conseguir a soltura ou a libertação de prisioneiros, escravos ou cativos. 1. O resgate dado por Cristo em favor de muitos (Mt 20.28; Mc 10.45).
THAYER.en: The price paid to secure the release or liberation of prisoners, slaves, or captives. 1. The ransom given by Christ on behalf of many (Matt 20:28; Mark 10:45).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: λυτρώσομαι, Aor: ἐλυτρωσάμην, Perf: λελύτρωμαι
DEFINITION: To pay a ransom to free someone from slavery, captivity, or an oppressive situation; used in the NT with a profound soteriological sense.
SENSES: 1. To liberate through the payment of a ransom, especially from the slavery of sin (Titus 2:14; 1 Pet 1:18).
2. To redeem or rescue from a situation of oppression or perdition (Luke 24:21).

THAYER.pt: Significa pagar um resgate para libertar alguém da escravidão, do cativeiro ou de uma situação opressiva, sendo usado no NT com profundo sentido soteriológico. 1. Libertar mediante o pagamento de resgate, especialmente da escravidão do pecado (Tt 2.14; 1Pe 1.18). | 2. Redimir ou resgatar de uma situação de opressão ou perdição (Lc 24.21).
THAYER.en: To pay a ransom to free someone from slavery, captivity, or an oppressive situation; used in the NT with a profound soteriological sense. 1. To liberate through the payment of a ransom, especially from the slavery of sin (Titus 2:14; 1 Pet 1:18). | 2. To redeem or rescue from a situation of oppression or perdition (Luke 24:21).

DEFINITION: The act or experience of being freed from an oppressive condition or captivity, with the implicit analogy of release through a ransom.
SENSES: 1. Spiritual and eschatological liberation granted by God through Christ (Luke 1:68; Heb 9:12).
2. Rescue or relief from a difficult situation or messianic expectation (Luke 2:38).

THAYER.pt: O ato ou a experiência de ser libertado de uma condição opressiva ou de cativeiro, com a analogia implícita da soltura mediante resgate. 1. Libertação espiritual e escatológica concedida por Deus através de Cristo (Lc 1.68; Hb 9.12). | 2. Resgate ou alívio de uma situação difícil ou de expectativa messiânica (Lc 2.38).
THAYER.en: The act or experience of being freed from an oppressive condition or captivity, with the implicit analogy of release through a ransom. 1. Spiritual and eschatological liberation granted by God through Christ (Luke 1:68; Heb 9:12). | 2. Rescue or relief from a difficult situation or messianic expectation (Luke 2:38).

DEFINITION: One who performs an act of rescue, freeing captives or slaves through the payment of a price or a demonstration of power. It describes the figure of a savior or emancipator.
SENSES: 1. A liberator or redeemer in the context of the history of Israel (Acts 7:35).

THAYER.pt: Aquele que realiza um ato de resgate, libertando cativos ou escravos mediante o pagamento de um preço ou demonstração de poder. Descreve a figura de um salvador ou emancipador. 1. Libertador ou redentor no contexto da história de Israel (At 7.35).
THAYER.en: One who performs an act of rescue, freeing captives or slaves through the payment of a price or a demonstration of power. It describes the figure of a savior or emancipator. 1. A liberator or redeemer in the context of the history of Israel (Acts 7:35).

DEFINITION: A support, pedestal, or stand designed to hold a lamp or light, allowing the light to illuminate the environment.
SENSES: 1. A support or lampstand upon which a lamp was placed (Matt 5:15; Rev 2:5).

THAYER.pt: Suporte, pedestal ou estante projetada para sustentar uma lâmpada ou candeia, permitindo que a luz ilumine o ambiente. 1. Suporte ou candeeiro onde se apoiava a lâmpada (Mt 5.15; Ap 2.5).
THAYER.en: A support, pedestal, or stand designed to hold a lamp or light, allowing the light to illuminate the environment. 1. A support or lampstand upon which a lamp was placed (Matt 5:15; Rev 2:5).

DEFINITION: A small container filled with oil and a lit wick, used to illuminate domestic spaces.
SENSES: 1. An oil-fueled lamp or light for illumination (Matt 5:15; Luke 8:16).

THAYER.pt: Pequeno recipiente preenchido com azeite e um pavio acendido, usado para iluminar ambientes domésticos. 1. Lâmpada ou candeia alimentada a óleo para iluminação (Mt 5.15; Lc 8.16).
THAYER.en: A small container filled with oil and a lit wick, used to illuminate domestic spaces. 1. An oil-fueled lamp or light for illumination (Matt 5:15; Luke 8:16).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: λύσω; Aor: ἔλυσα; Pass: ἐλύθην
DEFINITION: To undo knots or bonds to free something or someone, or to disintegrate and annul structures and laws.
SENSES: 1. To untie or release knots, straps, sandals, or physical bonds (Mark 1:7; John 11:44).
2. To liberate prisoners or people under oppression (Luke 13:16; Rev 1:5).
3. To destroy, demolish, or annul commandments, laws, or structures (John 2:19; 5:18).

THAYER.pt: Desfazer nós ou amarras para liberar algo ou alguém, ou desintegrar e anular estruturas e leis. 1. Desatar ou soltar nós, correias, sandálias ou ataduras físicas (Mc 1.7; Jo 11.44). | 2. Libertar prisioneiros ou pessoas sob opressão (Lc 13.16; Ap 1.5). | 3. Destruir, demolir ou anular mandamentos, leis ou construções (Jo 2.19; 5.18).
THAYER.en: To undo knots or bonds to free something or someone, or to disintegrate and annul structures and laws. 1. To untie or release knots, straps, sandals, or physical bonds (Mark 1:7; John 11:44). | 2. To liberate prisoners or people under oppression (Luke 13:16; Rev 1:5). | 3. To destroy, demolish, or annul commandments, laws, or structures (John 2:19; 5:18).

DEFINITION: A feminine proper name of a pious woman of the first Christian generation. She is remembered for her sincere faith and for being the grandmother of Timothy.
SENSES: 1. Lois, the maternal grandmother of Timothy (2 Tim 1:5).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio feminino de uma mulher piedosa da primeira geração cristã. É lembrada por sua fé sincera e por ser avó de Timóteo. 1. Lóide, avó materna de Timóteo (2Tm 1.5).
THAYER.en: A feminine proper name of a pious woman of the first Christian generation. She is remembered for her sincere faith and for being the grandmother of Timothy. 1. Lois, the maternal grandmother of Timothy (2 Tim 1:5).

DEFINITION: A masculine proper name referring to the nephew of the patriarch Abraham, rescued from Sodom.
SENSES: 1. Old Testament character, nephew of Abraham (Luke 17:28, 29, 32; 2 Pet 2:7).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio masculino referente ao sobrinho de patriarca Abraão, resgatado de Sodoma. 1. Personagem veterotestamentário, sobrinho de Abraão (Lc 17.28, 29, 32; 2Pe 2.7).
THAYER.en: A masculine proper name referring to the nephew of the patriarch Abraham, rescued from Sodom. 1. Old Testament character, nephew of Abraham (Luke 17:28, 29, 32; 2 Pet 2:7).

DEFINITION: Hebrew male proper name included in the human genealogy of Jesus Christ recorded in the Gospel of Luke.
SENSES: 1. An ancestor in the genealogy of Jesus (Lk 3:26).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio masculino hebraico que integra a genealogia humana de Jesus Cristo registrada no Evangelho de Lucas. 1. Um ancestral na genealogia de Jesus (Lc 3.26).
THAYER.en: Hebrew male proper name included in the human genealogy of Jesus Christ recorded in the Gospel of Luke. 1. An ancestor in the genealogy of Jesus (Lk 3:26).

DEFINITION: Ancient locality situated on the western coast of the Sea of Galilee. It is widely known as the hometown of Mary Magdalene.
SENSES: 1. City on the western shore of Lake Galilee (Mt 15:39 var).

THAYER.pt: Antiga localidade situada na costa ocidental do Mar da Galileia. É amplamente conhecida por ser a terra natal de Maria Madalena. 1. Cidade na margem ocidental do Lago da Galileia (Mt 15.39 var).
THAYER.en: Ancient locality situated on the western coast of the Sea of Galilee. It is widely known as the hometown of Mary Magdalene. 1. City on the western shore of Lake Galilee (Mt 15:39 var).

DEFINITION: Epithet or surname of Mary, indicating her origin in the Galilean city of Magdala.
SENSES: 1. Mary Magdalene, a woman originally from Magdala (Mt 27:56).

THAYER.pt: Epíteto ou sobrenome de Maria, indicando sua origem na cidade galileia de Magdala. 1. Maria Madalena, mulher originária de Magdala (Mt 27.56).
THAYER.en: Epithet or surname of Mary, indicating her origin in the Galilean city of Magdala. 1. Mary Magdalene, a woman originally from Magdala (Mt 27:56).

DEFINITION: Practice of rites, incantations, or spells aimed at invoking and manipulating supernatural powers. Denotes hidden activities associated with illusion or spiritism.
SENSES: 1. The practice of magic or magical and occult arts (Ac 8:11 var).

THAYER.pt: Prática de ritos, encantamentos ou feitiços voltados para invocar e manipular poderes sobrenaturais. Denota atividades ocultas associadas à ilusão ou ao espiritismo. 1. A prática de magia ou artes mágicas e ocultistas (At 8.11 var).
THAYER.en: Practice of rites, incantations, or spells aimed at invoking and manipulating supernatural powers. Denotes hidden activities associated with illusion or spiritism. 1. The practice of magic or magical and occult arts (Ac 8:11 var).

DEFINITION: To practice sorcery or magical arts through the invocation of hidden powers. In the New Testament, it describes the activity of false prophets or magicians who amazed the people.
SENSES: 1. To practice magic or exercise sorcery (Ac 8:9).

THAYER.pt: Praticar feitiçaria ou artes mágicas através da invocação de poderes ocultos. No Novo Testamento, descreve a atuação de falsos profetas ou mágicos que impressionavam o povo. 1. Praticar magia ou exercer feitiçaria (At 8.9).
THAYER.en: To practice sorcery or magical arts through the invocation of hidden powers. In the New Testament, it describes the activity of false prophets or magicians who amazed the people. 1. To practice magic or exercise sorcery (Ac 8:9).

DEFINITION: Originally a Persian priest expert in astrology and dream interpretation; in the Greco-Roman world it also came to designate practitioners of magic arts and occultism.
SENSES: 1. Eastern wise man or astrologer who visited the child Jesus (Mt 2:1).
2. Practitioner of magic or sorcerer (Ac 13:6).

THAYER.pt: Originalmente um sacerdote persa especialista em astrologia e interpretação de sonhos; no mundo greco-romano passou a designar também praticantes de artes mágicas e ocultismo. 1. Sábio ou astrólogo oriental que visitou o menino Jesus (Mt 2.1). | 2. Praticante de magia ou feiticeiro (At 13.6).
THAYER.en: Originally a Persian priest expert in astrology and dream interpretation; in the Greco-Roman world it also came to designate practitioners of magic arts and occultism. 1. Eastern wise man or astrologer who visited the child Jesus (Mt 2:1). | 2. Practitioner of magic or sorcerer (Ac 13:6).

DEFINITION: Eschatological and symbolic term of Old Testament origin associated with Gog. Represents the nations enemies of God who rebel against Him at the end of times.
SENSES: 1. Symbolic name designating the adversaries of God in the final age (Rv 20:8).

THAYER.pt: Termo escatológico e simbólico de origem veterotestamentária associado a Gogue. Representa as nações inimigas de Deus que se rebelam contra Ele no final dos tempos. 1. Nome simbólico que designa os adversários de Deus na era final (Ap 20.8).
THAYER.en: Eschatological and symbolic term of Old Testament origin associated with Gog. Represents the nations enemies of God who rebel against Him at the end of times. 1. Symbolic name designating the adversaries of God in the final age (Rv 20:8).

DEFINITION: Geographical region in the Sinai Peninsula and parts of Arabia, inhabited by the Midianites. It was the place to which Moses fled after killing an Egyptian.
SENSES: 1. Region and settlement in the Arabian Peninsula or Sinai (Ac 7:29).

THAYER.pt: Região geográfica na península do Sinai e partes da Arábia, habitada pelos midianitas. Foi o lugar para onde Moisés fugiu após matar um egípcio. 1. Região e povoado na península arábica ou Sinai (At 7.29).
THAYER.en: Geographical region in the Sinai Peninsula and parts of Arabia, inhabited by the Midianites. It was the place to which Moses fled after killing an Egyptian. 1. Region and settlement in the Arabian Peninsula or Sinai (Ac 7:29).

DEFINITION: The act of instructing someone in the doctrine of a master, making them a dedicated follower and learner.
SENSES: 1. To become a disciple or follower of someone (Mt 27:57).
2. To teach and lead people to become disciples of Christ (Mt 28:19; Ac 14:21).

THAYER.pt: O ato de instruir alguém na doutrina de um mestre, tornando-o seu seguidor e aprendiz dedicado. 1. Tornar-se um discípulo ou seguidor de alguém (Mt 27.57). | 2. Ensinar e conduzir pessoas a se tornarem discípulas de Cristo (Mt 28.19; At 14.21).
THAYER.en: The act of instructing someone in the doctrine of a master, making them a dedicated follower and learner. 1. To become a disciple or follower of someone (Mt 27:57). | 2. To teach and lead people to become disciples of Christ (Mt 28:19; Ac 14:21).

DEFINITION: One who wholly adheres to the teaching, lifestyle, and discipline of a master through a committed relationship. In Jesus' ministry and the early church, defines one who professes living faith and follows the Savior's steps.
SENSES: 1. Learner or follower devoted to a philosopher or religious teacher (Mt 9:14; Jn 9:28).
2. Direct disciple of Jesus, especially the Twelve (Mt 10:1; 26:20).
3. General designation for any believer in Christ and member of the Church (Ac 6:1; 11:26).

THAYER.pt: Aquele que adere integralmente ao ensino, estilo de vida e disciplina de um mestre mediante relacionamento comprometido. No ministério de Jesus e nos primórdios da igreja, define quem professa fé viva e segue os passos do Salvador. 1. Aprendiz ou seguidor devotado a um filósofo ou mestre religioso (Mt 9.14; Jo 9.28). | 2. Discípulo direto de Jesus, em especial os Doze (Mt 10.1; 26.20). | 3. Designação geral para qualquer crente em Cristo e membro da Igreja (At 6.1; 11.26).
THAYER.en: One who wholly adheres to the teaching, lifestyle, and discipline of a master through a committed relationship. In Jesus' ministry and the early church, defines one who professes living faith and follows the Savior's steps. 1. Learner or follower devoted to a philosopher or religious teacher (Mt 9:14; Jn 9:28). | 2. Direct disciple of Jesus, especially the Twelve (Mt 10:1; 26:20). | 3. General designation for any believer in Christ and member of the Church (Ac 6:1; 11:26).

DEFINITION: Feminine form to designate a female disciple or follower of the teachings of Jesus Christ. Refers to women committed to the Christian faith and community service.
SENSES: 1. Woman who is a disciple or follower of Christ (Ac 9:36).

THAYER.pt: Forma feminina para designar uma discípula ou seguidora dos ensinamentos de Jesus Cristo. Refere-se a mulheres comprometidas com a fé cristã e o serviço comunitário. 1. Mulher que é discípula ou seguidora de Cristo (At 9.36).
THAYER.en: Feminine form to designate a female disciple or follower of the teachings of Jesus Christ. Refers to women committed to the Christian faith and community service. 1. Woman who is a disciple or follower of Christ (Ac 9:36).

DEFINITION: Male proper name of an antediluvian patriarch famous for his extreme longevity, son of Enoch. He is part of the ancestral line leading to Jesus.
SENSES: 1. Patriarch in the human genealogy of Jesus (Lk 3:37).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio masculino de um patriarca antediluviano famoso por sua longevidade extrema, filho de Enoque. Integra a linha ancestral que conduz a Jesus. 1. Patriarca na genealogia humana de Jesus (Lc 3.37).
THAYER.en: Male proper name of an antediluvian patriarch famous for his extreme longevity, son of Enoch. He is part of the ancestral line leading to Jesus. 1. Patriarch in the human genealogy of Jesus (Lk 3:37).

DEFINITION: Male proper name cited in the New Testament genealogical lists as one of the ancestors in the lineage of Jesus.
SENSES: 1. Ancestor in the human genealogy of Jesus (Lk 3:37 var).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio masculino citado nas listas genealógicas do Novo Testamento como um dos antepassados na linhagem de Jesus. 1. Ancestral na genealogia humana de Jesus (Lc 3.37 var).
THAYER.en: Male proper name cited in the New Testament genealogical lists as one of the ancestors in the lineage of Jesus. 1. Ancestor in the human genealogy of Jesus (Lk 3:37 var).

DEFINITION: Describes the state of someone who thinks or acts in a completely irrational manner, being beside themselves, frequently associated with delirium or demonic possession.
SENSES: 1. To be out of one's mind, mad, or raving (Jn 10:20; Ac 12:15; 1Co 14:23).

THAYER.pt: Descreve o estado de alguém que pensa ou age de maneira completamente irracional, estando fora de si, frequentemente associado ao delírio ou à possessão demoníaca. 1. Estar fora de si, louco ou delirando (Jo 10.20; At 12.15; 1Co 14.23).
THAYER.en: Describes the state of someone who thinks or acts in a completely irrational manner, being beside themselves, frequently associated with delirium or demonic possession. 1. To be out of one's mind, mad, or raving (Jn 10:20; Ac 12:15; 1Co 14:23).

DEFINITION: To attribute to someone the condition of being fortunate, happy, or greatly favored by God due to spiritual or providential circumstances.
SENSES: 1. To consider or acclaim someone as blessed (Lk 1:48; Jas 5:11).

THAYER.pt: Atribuir a alguém a condição de afortunado, feliz ou grandemente favorecido por Deus devido a circunstâncias espirituais ou providenciais. 1. Considerar ou aclamar alguém como bem-aventurado (Lc 1.48; Tg 5.11).
THAYER.en: To attribute to someone the condition of being fortunate, happy, or greatly favored by God due to spiritual or providential circumstances. 1. To consider or acclaim someone as blessed (Lk 1:48; Jas 5:11).

DEFINITION: Expresses the privileged condition of one who enjoys divine favor, approval, and grace. It goes beyond mere passing earthly happiness, indicating a spiritual fullness grounded in communion with God.
SENSES: 1. Blessed or favored by divine grace; blessed (Mt 5:3-11; Lk 1:45; Rv 14:13).
2. Fortunate, worthy of jubilation due to favorable circumstances (Ac 26:2; 1Co 7:40).
3. Attribute of God Himself as the source of all blessing and glory (1Tm 1:11; 1Tm 6:15).

THAYER.pt: Expressa a condição privilegiada de quem desfruta do favor, da aprovação e da graça divina. Vai além da mera felicidade terrena passageira, indicando uma plenitude espiritual fundamentada na comunhão com Deus. 1. Abençoado ou favorecido pela graça divina; bem-aventurado (Mt 5.3-11; Lc 1.45; Ap 14.13). | 2. Afortunado, digno de júbilo pelas circunstâncias favoráveis (At 26.2; 1Co 7.40). | 3. Atributo do próprio Deus como a fonte de toda a bênção e glória (1Tm 1.11; 1Tm 6.15).
THAYER.en: Expresses the privileged condition of one who enjoys divine favor, approval, and grace. It goes beyond mere passing earthly happiness, indicating a spiritual fullness grounded in communion with God. 1. Blessed or favored by divine grace; blessed (Mt 5:3-11; Lk 1:45; Rv 14:13). | 2. Fortunate, worthy of jubilation due to favorable circumstances (Ac 26:2; 1Co 7:40). | 3. Attribute of God Himself as the source of all blessing and glory (1Tm 1:11; 1Tm 6:15).

DEFINITION: The formal declaration or proclamation that someone is specially blessed, happy, and favored by God.
SENSES: 1. The proclamation of blessedness or declaration of divine favor upon someone (Rm 4:6, 9).
2. Feeling or expression of joy due to a circumstance of favor (Gl 4:15).

THAYER.pt: A declaração formal ou proclamação de que alguém é especialmente abençoado, feliz e favorecido por Deus. 1. A proclamação de bem-aventurança ou declaração de favor divino sobre alguém (Rm 4.6, 9). | 2. Sentimento ou expressão de alegria por uma circunstância de favor (Gl 4.15).
THAYER.en: The formal declaration or proclamation that someone is specially blessed, happy, and favored by God. 1. The proclamation of blessedness or declaration of divine favor upon someone (Rm 4:6, 9). | 2. Feeling or expression of joy due to a circumstance of favor (Gl 4:15).

DEFINITION: Important Roman province north of Greece, famous for the cities of Philippi, Thessalonica, and Berea, where Paul planted solid Christian communities.
SENSES: 1. Roman province of Macedonia (Ac 16:9; 1Co 16:5; 2Co 8:1).

THAYER.pt: Importante província romana ao norte da Grécia, célebre pelas cidades de Filipos, Tessalônica e Bereia, onde Paulo plantou sólidas comunidades cristãs. 1. Província romana da Macedônia (At 16.9; 1Co 16.5; 2Co 8.1).
THAYER.en: Important Roman province north of Greece, famous for the cities of Philippi, Thessalonica, and Berea, where Paul planted solid Christian communities. 1. Roman province of Macedonia (Ac 16:9; 1Co 16:5; 2Co 8:1).

DEFINITION: Designates an inhabitant or native of the region of Macedonia, a Roman province north of Greece visited by the apostle Paul.
SENSES: 1. A native or inhabitant of Macedonia (Ac 16:9).

THAYER.pt: Designa um habitante ou natural da região da Macedônia, província romana ao norte da Grécia visitada pelo apóstolo Paulo. 1. Um nativo ou habitante da Macedônia (At 16.9).
THAYER.en: Designates an inhabitant or native of the region of Macedonia, a Roman province north of Greece visited by the apostle Paul. 1. A native or inhabitant of Macedonia (Ac 16:9).

DEFINITION: Public market specialized in the sale of meat and other foodstuffs. In the Greco-Roman context, it was the place where meat sacrificed to idols was frequently commercialized.
SENSES: 1. Public market for meat and food provisions (1Co 10:25).

THAYER.pt: Mercado público especializado na venda de carne e outros gêneros alimentícios. No contexto greco-romano, era o local onde frequentemente se comercializava carne sacrificada a ídolos. 1. Mercado público de carne e provisões alimentícias (1Co 10.25).
THAYER.en: Public market specialized in the sale of meat and other foodstuffs. In the Greco-Roman context, it was the place where meat sacrificed to idols was frequently commercialized. 1. Public market for meat and food provisions (1Co 10:25).

DEFINITION: Indicates a great spatial or metaphorical distance in relation to a point of reference.
SENSES: 1. At a considerable physical distance, far away (Lk 15:20).
2. Spiritual or metaphorical distance in relation to God or the Kingdom (Eph 2:17).

THAYER.pt: Indica uma grande distância espacial ou metafórica em relação a um ponto de referência. 1. A uma distância física considerável, longe (Lc 15.20). | 2. Distância espiritual ou metafórica em relação a Deus ou ao Reino (Ef 2.17).
THAYER.en: Indicates a great spatial or metaphorical distance in relation to a point of reference. 1. At a considerable physical distance, far away (Lk 15:20). | 2. Spiritual or metaphorical distance in relation to God or the Kingdom (Eph 2:17).

DEFINITION: Indicates a spatial location situated at a considerable distance from the observer.
SENSES: 1. From a distant place or at a certain physical distance (Mt 26:58; Lk 17:12).

THAYER.pt: Indica uma localização espacial situada a uma distância considerável do observador. 1. A partir de um local distante ou a uma certa distância física (Mt 26.58; Lc 17.12).
THAYER.en: Indicates a spatial location situated at a considerable distance from the observer. 1. From a distant place or at a certain physical distance (Mt 26:58; Lk 17:12).

DEFINITION: To maintain serenity and patience while waiting or while enduring provocations and difficulties without retaliation.
SENSES: 1. To have patience and remain calm while waiting (Jas 5:7).
2. To be long-suffering and tolerant under provocation (1Th 5:14; 2Pe 3:9).

THAYER.pt: Manter a serenidade e a paciência ao esperar ou ao suportar provocações e dificuldades sem retaliação. 1. Ter paciência e manter-se tranquilo enquanto aguarda (Tg 5.7). | 2. Ser longânimo e tolerante sob provocação (1Ts 5.14; 2Pe 3.9).
THAYER.en: To maintain serenity and patience while waiting or while enduring provocations and difficulties without retaliation. 1. To have patience and remain calm while waiting (Jas 5:7). | 2. To be long-suffering and tolerant under provocation (1Th 5:14; 2Pe 3:9).

DEFINITION: Quality of maintaining calm and serenity in the face of trials, insults, or delays, without repaying with anger or impatience.
SENSES: 1. Persevering patience and firmness in the face of difficulties or sufferings (Heb 6:12; Jas 5:10).
2. Long-suffering and patient tolerance toward the faults and provocations of others (Eph 4:2; 2Tm 4:2).

THAYER.pt: Qualidade de manter a calma e a serenidade diante de provações, insultos ou demoras, sem retribuir com ira ou impaciência. 1. Paciência perseverante e firmeza diante de dificuldades ou sofrimentos (Hb 6.12; Tg 5.10). | 2. Longanimidade e tolerância paciente para com as falhas e provocações alheias (Ef 4.2; 2Tm 4.2).
THAYER.en: Quality of maintaining calm and serenity in the face of trials, insults, or delays, without repaying with anger or impatience. 1. Persevering patience and firmness in the face of difficulties or sufferings (Heb 6:12; Jas 5:10). | 2. Long-suffering and patient tolerance toward the faults and provocations of others (Eph 4:2; 2Tm 4:2).

DEFINITION: Manner of acting characterized by patience, long-suffering, and perseverance in the face of provocations or difficulties. Describes a calm and tolerant posture.
SENSES: 1. In a patient and long-suffering manner (Ac 26:3).

THAYER.pt: Modo de agir caracterizado pela paciência, longanimidade e perseverança diante de provocações ou dificuldades. Descreve uma postura calma e tolerante. 1. De maneira paciente e longânima (At 26.3).
THAYER.en: Manner of acting characterized by patience, long-suffering, and perseverance in the face of provocations or difficulties. Describes a calm and tolerant posture. 1. In a patient and long-suffering manner (Ac 26:3).

DEFINITION: Used to qualify a large spatial extent (distance) or prolonged temporal duration.
SENSES: 1. Referring to a long temporal extension or period (Mk 12:40; Lk 20:47).
2. Referring to a great spatial distance or far place (Lk 15:13; 19:12).

THAYER.pt: Empregado para qualificar grande extensão espacial (distância) ou prolongada duração temporal. 1. Referente a uma longa extensão temporal ou período (Mc 12.40; Lc 20.47). | 2. Referente a uma grande distância espacial ou lugar longínquo (Lc 15.13; 19.12).
THAYER.en: Used to qualify a large spatial extent (distance) or prolonged temporal duration. 1. Referring to a long temporal extension or period (Mk 12:40; Lk 20:47). | 2. Referring to a great spatial distance or far place (Lk 15:13; 19:12).

DEFINITION: That lasts a long time or possesses a long life. It is used in moral exhortations to promise a prolonged existence on earth.
SENSES: 1. Living a long time or prolonged (Eph 6:3).

THAYER.pt: Que dura muito tempo ou que possui uma vida longa. É utilizado em exortações morais para prometer uma existência prolongada na terra. 1. Que vive muito tempo ou prolongado (Ef 6.3).
THAYER.en: That lasts a long time or possesses a long life. It is used in moral exhortations to promise a prolonged existence on earth. 1. Living a long time or prolonged (Eph 6:3).

DEFINITION: State of physical weakness, debility, or bodily illness that affects human capacity.
SENSES: 1. Condition of physical debility or infirmity treated by Jesus (Mt 4:23; 9:35; 10:1).

THAYER.pt: Estado de fraqueza física, debilidade ou doença corpórea que afeta a capacidade humana. 1. Condição de debilidade física ou enfermidade tratada por Jesus (Mt 4.23; 9.35; 10.1).
THAYER.en: State of physical weakness, debility, or bodily illness that affects human capacity. 1. Condition of physical debility or infirmity treated by Jesus (Mt 4:23; 9:35; 10:1).

DEFINITION: Originally describes something soft to the touch; in the moral context, refers to softness of character or immoral behavior.
SENSES: 1. Possessing a soft and gentle texture, applied to fine garments (Mt 11:8; Lk 7:25).
2. Man who adopts a passive posture in immoral sexual practices (1Co 6:9).

THAYER.pt: Originalmente descreve algo macio ao tato; no contexto moral, refere-se à moleza de caráter ou comportamento imoral. 1. Que possui textura macia e suave, aplicado a vestimentas finas (Mt 11.8; Lc 7.25). | 2. Homem que adota postura passiva em práticas sexuais imorais (1Co 6.9).
THAYER.en: Originally describes something soft to the touch; in the moral context, refers to softness of character or immoral behavior. 1. Possessing a soft and gentle texture, applied to fine garments (Mt 11:8; Lk 7:25). | 2. Man who adopts a passive posture in immoral sexual practices (1Co 6:9).

DEFINITION: Proper name of a Hebrew patriarch listed among the ancestors in the human lineage of Jesus Christ.
SENSES: 1. Ancestor in the genealogy of Jesus (Lk 3:37).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio de um patriarca hebreu listado entre os antepassados na linhagem humana de Jesus Cristo. 1. Ancestral na genealogia de Jesus (Lc 3.37).
THAYER.en: Proper name of a Hebrew patriarch listed among the ancestors in the human lineage of Jesus Christ. 1. Ancestor in the genealogy of Jesus (Lk 3:37).

DEFINITION: A superlative degree marker that highlights something as the highest point on a scale, meaning especially or above all.
SENSES: 1. To the highest degree, especially or above all (Acts 20.38; Phil 4.22).

THAYER.pt: Marcador de grau superlativo que destaca algo como o ponto mais alto em uma escala, significando especialmente ou acima de tudo. 1. Em grau máximo, especialmente ou acima de tudo (At 20.38; Fp 4.22).
THAYER.en: A superlative degree marker that highlights something as the highest point on a scale, meaning especially or above all. 1. To the highest degree, especially or above all (Acts 20.38; Phil 4.22).

DEFINITION: A comparative adverb used to indicate a superior intensity of an action, deliberate personal preference, or corrective rectification in reasoning.
SENSES: 1. In a greater degree or measure: more, more intensely (Phil 1.12; 2Tm 3.9).
2. Preference or alternative choice: rather, preferably (Mt 10.6; Jn 3.19).
3. Expression of correction or precision: or rather, on the contrary (Rom 8.34; Gal 4.9).

THAYER.pt: Advérbio comparativo utilizado para indicar intensidade superior de uma ação, preferência pessoal deliberada ou retificação corretiva em um raciocínio. 1. Em maior grau ou medida: mais, mais intensamente (Fp 1.12; 2Tm 3.9). | 2. Preferência ou escolha alternativa: de preferência, antes (Mt 10.6; Jo 3.19). | 3. Expressão de retificação ou precisão: ou melhor, pelo contrário (Rm 8.34; Gl 4.9).
THAYER.en: A comparative adverb used to indicate a superior intensity of an action, deliberate personal preference, or corrective rectification in reasoning. 1. In a greater degree or measure: more, more intensely (Phil 1.12; 2Tm 3.9). | 2. Preference or alternative choice: rather, preferably (Mt 10.6; Jn 3.19). | 3. Expression of correction or precision: or rather, on the contrary (Rom 8.34; Gal 4.9).

DEFINITION: Masculine proper name of the high priest's servant whose ear was cut off by Peter during the arrest of Jesus in Gethsemane, and subsequently healed by Christ.
SENSES: 1. Servant of the high priest wounded by Peter and healed by Jesus (Jn 18.10).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio masculino do servo do sumo sacerdote cujo ouvido foi cortado por Pedro durante a prisão de Jesus no Getsêmani, e posteriormente curado por Cristo. 1. Servo do sumo sacerdote ferido por Pedro e curado por Jesus (Jo 18.10).
THAYER.en: Masculine proper name of the high priest's servant whose ear was cut off by Peter during the arrest of Jesus in Gethsemane, and subsequently healed by Christ. 1. Servant of the high priest wounded by Peter and healed by Jesus (Jn 18.10).

DEFINITION: An affectionate family term for grandmother, the mother of one's father or mother. In the New Testament, it highlights the fundamental role of older women in passing on the faith.
SENSES: 1. Maternal or paternal grandmother (2Tm 1.5).

THAYER.pt: Termo familiar carinhoso para avó, a mãe do pai ou da mãe. No Novo Testamento, destaca o papel fundamental de mulheres mais velhas na transmissão da fé. 1. Avó materna ou paterna (2Tm 1.5).
THAYER.en: An affectionate family term for grandmother, the mother of one's father or mother. In the New Testament, it highlights the fundamental role of older women in passing on the faith. 1. Maternal or paternal grandmother (2Tm 1.5).

DEFINITION: A term of Semitic origin for material riches and earthly goods, frequently personified as an idol rivaling God.
SENSES: 1. Material wealth and worldly goods set in contrast to service to God (Mt 6.24; Lk 16.9, 11, 13).

THAYER.pt: Termo de origem semítica para riquezas materiais e bens terrenos, frequentemente personificado como um ídolo rival a Deus. 1. Riqueza material e bens mundanos postos em contraste com o serviço a Deus (Mt 6.24; Lc 16.9, 11, 13).
THAYER.en: A term of Semitic origin for material riches and earthly goods, frequently personified as an idol rivaling God. 1. Material wealth and worldly goods set in contrast to service to God (Mt 6.24; Lk 16.9, 11, 13).

DEFINITION: Masculine proper name of a Christian associated with Herod Antipas in childhood, who served as a prophet and teacher in the church of Antioch in Syria.
SENSES: 1. Prophet and teacher in the early church of Antioch (Acts 13.1).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio masculino de um cristão associado a Herodes Antipas na infância, que serviu como profeta e mestre na igreja de Antioquia da Síria. 1. Profeta e mestre na igreja primitiva de Antioquia (At 13.1).
THAYER.en: Masculine proper name of a Christian associated with Herod Antipas in childhood, who served as a prophet and teacher in the church of Antioch in Syria. 1. Prophet and teacher in the early church of Antioch (Acts 13.1).

DEFINITION: Hebrew proper name designating Old Testament characters, including Joseph's eldest son and a king of Judah.
SENSES: 1. Firstborn of Joseph and ancestor of one of the tribes of Israel (Rev 7.6).
2. King of Judah mentioned in the genealogy of Jesus (Mt 1.10).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio hebraico que designa personagens do Antigo Testamento, incluindo o filho mais velho de José e um rei de Judá. 1. Primogênito de José e ancestral de uma das tribos de Israel (Ap 7.6). | 2. Rei de Judá mencionado na genealogia de Jesus (Mt 1.10).
THAYER.en: Hebrew proper name designating Old Testament characters, including Joseph's eldest son and a king of Judah. 1. Firstborn of Joseph and ancestor of one of the tribes of Israel (Rev 7.6). | 2. King of Judah mentioned in the genealogy of Jesus (Mt 1.10).

DEFINITION: To acquire knowledge, skill, or understanding through instruction, study, or practical experience.
SENSES: 1. To obtain instruction and knowledge (1Cor 14.31; 2Tm 3.7).
2. To come to a deep realization or learning through experience (Heb 5.8).

THAYER.pt: Adquirir conhecimento, habilidade ou compreensão por meio de instrução, estudo ou experiência prática. 1. Obter instrução e conhecimento (1Co 14.31; 2Tm 3.7). | 2. Chegar a uma profunda realização ou aprendizado pela experiência (Hb 5.8).
THAYER.en: To acquire knowledge, skill, or understanding through instruction, study, or practical experience. 1. To obtain instruction and knowledge (1Cor 14.31; 2Tm 3.7). | 2. To come to a deep realization or learning through experience (Heb 5.8).

DEFINITION: A state of mental disturbance, madness, or delirium in which a person loses logical reasoning or acts in an irrational and extreme way.
SENSES: 1. State of insanity, delirium, or extreme madness (Acts 26.24).

THAYER.pt: Estado de distúrbio mental, loucura ou delírio em que a pessoa perde o raciocínio lógico ou age de forma irracional e extrema. 1. Estado de insanidade, delírio ou loucura extrema (At 26.24).
THAYER.en: A state of mental disturbance, madness, or delirium in which a person loses logical reasoning or acts in an irrational and extreme way. 1. State of insanity, delirium, or extreme madness (Acts 26.24).

DEFINITION: The miraculous bread sent by God to sustain the Israelites during their journey in the wilderness.
SENSES: 1. The heavenly food granted by God to the people of Israel in the wilderness (Jn 6.31, 49; Heb 9.4; Rev 2.17).

THAYER.pt: O pão milagroso enviado por Deus para sustentar os israelitas durante a jornada no deserto. 1. O alimento celestial concedido por Deus ao povo de Israel no deserto (Jo 6.31, 49; Hb 9.4; Ap 2.17).
THAYER.en: The miraculous bread sent by God to sustain the Israelites during their journey in the wilderness. 1. The heavenly food granted by God to the people of Israel in the wilderness (Jn 6.31, 49; Heb 9.4; Rev 2.17).

DEFINITION: To practice divination, foretell the future, or act as an oracle, often in exchange for payment and through pagan or occult inspiration.
SENSES: 1. To practice divination or foretell the future professionally (Acts 16.16).

THAYER.pt: Praticar a adivinhação, prever o futuro ou atuar como oráculo, muitas vezes em troca de pagamento e por meio de inspiração pagã ou oculta. 1. Praticar adivinhação ou prever o futuro profissionalmente (At 16.16).
THAYER.en: To practice divination, foretell the future, or act as an oracle, often in exchange for payment and through pagan or occult inspiration. 1. To practice divination or foretell the future professionally (Acts 16.16).

DEFINITION: To describe the gradual process of withering, loss of vigor, or disappearance of plants, flowers, or of life itself and passing glory.
SENSES: 1. To lose vigor, wither, or fade over time (Jas 1.11).

THAYER.pt: Descrever o processo gradual de murchamento, perda de vigor ou desaparecimento de plantas, flores ou da própria vida e glória passageira. 1. Perder o vigor, murchar ou desvanecer com o tempo (Tg 1.11).
THAYER.en: To describe the gradual process of withering, loss of vigor, or disappearance of plants, flowers, or of life itself and passing glory. 1. To lose vigor, wither, or fade over time (Jas 1.11).

DEFINITION: An idiomatic expression in Aramaic that serves both as a solemn declaration of faith and as an urgent prayer for the return of the Lord.
SENSES: 1. 'Our Lord comes!' or 'O Lord, come!' (1Cor 16.22).

THAYER.pt: Uma expressão idiomática em aramaico que serve tanto como uma solene declaração de fé quanto como uma prece urgente pela volta do Senhor. 1. 'Nosso Senhor vem!' ou 'Ó Senhor, vem!' (1Co 16.22).
THAYER.en: An idiomatic expression in Aramaic that serves both as a solemn declaration of faith and as an urgent prayer for the return of the Lord. 1. 'Our Lord comes!' or 'O Lord, come!' (1Cor 16.22).

DEFINITION: A rounded precious gem formed inside mollusks and highly valued in the ancient world.
SENSES: 1. Precious jewelry used as a high-value ornament (1Tm 2.9; Rev 17.4).
2. Object of great spiritual value used in parables and proverbs (Mt 7.6; 13.45).

THAYER.pt: Gema preciosa de formato arredondado, formada no interior de moluscos e altamente valorizada no mundo antigo. 1. Jóia preciosa usada como ornamento de alto valor (1Tm 2.9; Ap 17.4). | 2. Objeto de grande valor espiritual empregado em parábolas e provérbios (Mt 7.6; 13.45).
THAYER.en: A rounded precious gem formed inside mollusks and highly valued in the ancient world. 1. Precious jewelry used as a high-value ornament (1Tm 2.9; Rev 17.4). | 2. Object of great spiritual value used in parables and proverbs (Mt 7.6; 13.45).

DEFINITION: Feminine proper name of a woman from Bethany, sister of Mary and Lazarus, known for her hospitality and closeness to Jesus.
SENSES: 1. Martha, sister of Lazarus and Mary (Lk 10.38; Jn 11.1).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio feminino de uma mulher de Betânia, irmã de Maria e Lázaro, conhecida por sua hospitalidade e proximidade com Jesus. 1. Marta, irmã de Lázaro e Maria (Lc 10.38; Jo 11.1).
THAYER.en: Feminine proper name of a woman from Bethany, sister of Mary and Lazarus, known for her hospitality and closeness to Jesus. 1. Martha, sister of Lazarus and Mary (Lk 10.38; Jn 11.1).

DEFINITION: A very common feminine proper name in the New Testament, belonging to several prominent women in early Christian history.
SENSES: 1. Mary, the mother of Jesus (Mt 1.16).
2. Mary Magdalene, faithful follower of Jesus (Mt 27.56).
3. Mary of Bethany, sister of Martha and Lazarus (Lk 10.39).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio feminino muito comum no Novo Testament, pertencendo a várias mulheres de destaque na história cristã primitiva. 1. Maria, a mãe de Jesus (Mt 1.16). | 2. Maria Madalena, seguidora fiel de Jesus (Mt 27.56). | 3. Maria de Betânia, irmã de Marta e Lázaro (Lc 10.39).
THAYER.en: A very common feminine proper name in the New Testament, belonging to several prominent women in early Christian history. 1. Mary, the mother of Jesus (Mt 1.16). | 2. Mary Magdalene, faithful follower of Jesus (Mt 27.56). | 3. Mary of Bethany, sister of Martha and Lazarus (Lk 10.39).

DEFINITION: Proper name of Latin origin (Marcus), referring to John Mark, companion on missionary journeys and author of the second Gospel.
SENSES: 1. Mark, the evangelist and companion of Barnabas and Paul (Acts 12.12; Col 4.10).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio de origem latina (Marcus), referente a João Marcos, companheiro de viagens missionárias e autor do segundo Evangelho. 1. Marcos, o evangelista e companheiro de Barnabé e Paulo (At 12.12; Cl 4.10).
THAYER.en: Proper name of Latin origin (Marcus), referring to John Mark, companion on missionary journeys and author of the second Gospel. 1. Mark, the evangelist and companion of Barnabas and Paul (Acts 12.12; Col 4.10).

DEFINITION: Compact limestone that can be polished to a lustrous shine. It was highly valued in Antiquity as a noble material for construction and sculpture.
SENSES: 1. Marble stone used as a precious material (Rev 18.12).

THAYER.pt: Rocha calcária compacta que pode ser polida até adquirir brilho lustroso. Era altamente valorizada na Antiguidade como material nobre de construção e escultura. 1. Pedra de mármore utilizada como material precioso (Ap 18.12).
THAYER.en: Compact limestone that can be polished to a lustrous shine. It was highly valued in Antiquity as a noble material for construction and sculpture. 1. Marble stone used as a precious material (Rev 18.12).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: μαρτυρήσω, Aor: ἐμαρτύρησα, Perf: μεμαρτύρηκα
DEFINITION: To attest or confirm a fact based on personal knowledge or intimate conviction, playing a crucial role in proclaiming Christian truth.
SENSES: 1. To give ocular or personal testimony of facts and truths (Jn 15.27; Acts 26.5).
2. To speak favorably of someone, approving their conduct (Acts 10.22; 3Jn 12).

THAYER.pt: Significa atestar ou confirmar um fato com base em conhecimento pessoal ou convicção íntima, desempenhando um papel crucial na proclamação da verdade cristã. 1. Dar testemunho ocular ou pessoal de fatos e verdades (Jo 15.27; At 26.5). | 2. Falar favoravelmente de alguém, aprovando sua conduta (At 10.22; 3Jo 12).
THAYER.en: To attest or confirm a fact based on personal knowledge or intimate conviction, playing a crucial role in proclaiming Christian truth. 1. To give ocular or personal testimony of facts and truths (Jn 15.27; Acts 26.5). | 2. To speak favorably of someone, approving their conduct (Acts 10.22; 3Jn 12).

DEFINITION: A statement or confirmation based on personal knowledge or conviction, attesting to a truth.
SENSES: 1. Solemn testimony or attestation concerning facts or divine truths (Jn 1.7; Rev 11.7).
2. Formal testimony given in a judicial context (Jn 8.17).
3. Good reputation or declaration of moral approval (1Tm 3.7).

THAYER.pt: Declaração ou confirmação baseada em conhecimento pessoal ou convicção, atestando uma verdade. 1. Testemunho ou atestação solene sobre fatos ou verdades divinas (Jo 1.7; Ap 11.7). | 2. Testemunho formal prestado em contexto judicial (Jo 8.17). | 3. Boa reputação ou declaração de aprovação moral (1Tm 3.7).
THAYER.en: A statement or confirmation based on personal knowledge or conviction, attesting to a truth. 1. Solemn testimony or attestation concerning facts or divine truths (Jn 1.7; Rev 11.7). | 2. Formal testimony given in a judicial context (Jn 8.17). | 3. Good reputation or declaration of moral approval (1Tm 3.7).

DEFINITION: That which serves as proof, evidence, or testimonial statement regarding a fact or person.
SENSES: 1. Evidentiary proof or testimony of a fact or truth (Mt 8.4; Jas 5.3).
2. Verbal testimony given concerning the Christian message (2Th 1.10; 1Tm 2.6).

THAYER.pt: Aquilo que serve como prova, evidência ou declaração testemunhal a respeito de um fato ou pessoa. 1. Evidência ou testemunho comprobatório de um fato ou verdade (Mt 8.4; Tg 5.3). | 2. O testemunho verbal dado sobre a mensagem cristã (2Ts 1.10; 1Tm 2.6).
THAYER.en: That which serves as proof, evidence, or testimonial statement regarding a fact or person. 1. Evidentiary proof or testimony of a fact or truth (Mt 8.4; Jas 5.3). | 2. Verbal testimony given concerning the Christian message (2Th 1.10; 1Tm 2.6).

DEFINITION: To make a serious and solemn declaration based on personal knowledge, or to exhort and vehemently insist on something of great importance.
SENSES: 1. To affirm solemnly or bear witness (Acts 20.26; Acts 26.22).
2. To exhort, insist, or implore emphatically (Eph 4.17; 1Th 2.12).

THAYER.pt: Fazer uma declaração séria e solene com base em conhecimento pessoal, ou exortar e insistir veementemente em algo de grande importância. 1. Afirmar com solenidade ou prestar testemunho (At 20.26; At 26.22). | 2. Exortar, insistir ou implorar enfaticamente (Ef 4.17; 1Ts 2.12).
THAYER.en: To make a serious and solemn declaration based on personal knowledge, or to exhort and vehemently insist on something of great importance. 1. To affirm solemnly or bear witness (Acts 20.26; Acts 26.22). | 2. To exhort, insist, or implore emphatically (Eph 4.17; 1Th 2.12).

DEFINITION: One who attests to a truth based on personal knowledge, potentially sealing their testimony with their own life.
SENSES: 1. Eyewitness or giver of deposition in court (Mt 26.65; Acts 6.13).
2. One who faithfully proclaims the divine message (Acts 1.8; 1Th 2.10).
3. Martyr, one who sacrifices their life for the sake of their faith (Acts 22.20; Rev 2.13).

THAYER.pt: Aquele que atesta uma verdade com base no conhecimento pessoal, podendo selar seu testemunho com a própria vida. 1. Testemunha ocular ou prestador de depoimento em tribunal (Mt 26.65; At 6.13). | 2. Aquele que proclama fielmente a mensagem divina (At 1.8; 1Ts 2.10). | 3. Mártir, aquele que sacrifica a vida por causa de sua fé (At 22.20; Ap 2.13).
THAYER.en: One who attests to a truth based on personal knowledge, potentially sealing their testimony with their own life. 1. Eyewitness or giver of deposition in court (Mt 26.65; Acts 6.13). | 2. One who faithfully proclaims the divine message (Acts 1.8; 1Th 2.10). | 3. Martyr, one who sacrifices their life for the sake of their faith (Acts 22.20; Rev 2.13).

DEFINITION: The act of crushing food with teeth or chewing something. Denotes the physical action of mastication.
SENSES: 1. To chew or grind with the teeth (Rev 16.10 var).

THAYER.pt: Ato de triturar alimentos com os dentes ou mastigar algo. Denota a ação física de mastigação. 1. Mastigar ou triturar com os dentes (Ap 16.10 var).
THAYER.en: The act of crushing food with teeth or chewing something. Denotes the physical action of mastication. 1. To chew or grind with the teeth (Rev 16.10 var).

DEFINITION: To whip with a lash or rod, whether as legal, religious punishment or as corrective discipline.
SENSES: 1. To scourge or severely flog as punishment (Mt 10.17; Jn 19.1).
2. To discipline or correctively chastise (Heb 12.6).

THAYER.pt: Açoitar com chicote ou vara, seja como punição legal, religiosa ou como disciplina corretiva. 1. Açoitar ou flagelar severamente como punição (Mt 10.17; Jo 19.1). | 2. Disciplinar ou castigar corretivamente (Hb 12.6).
THAYER.en: To whip with a lash or rod, whether as legal, religious punishment or as corrective discipline. 1. To scourge or severely flog as punishment (Mt 10.17; Jn 19.1). | 2. To discipline or correctively chastise (Heb 12.6).

DEFINITION: To strike severely with a whip or scourge. In the Roman context, it was frequently applied as punishment or torture during interrogations.
SENSES: 1. To flog or scourge with a whip (Acts 22.25).

THAYER.pt: Golpear severamente com um chicote ou vergalho. No contexto romano, era frequentemente aplicado como punição ou método de tortura durante interrogatórios. 1. Açoitar ou flagelar com um chicote (At 22.25).
THAYER.en: To strike severely with a whip or scourge. In the Roman context, it was frequently applied as punishment or torture during interrogations. 1. To flog or scourge with a whip (Acts 22.25).

DEFINITION: A flexible instrument of physical punishment (whip) or, by metaphorical extension, a condition of great suffering, torment, or physical affliction.
SENSES: 1. A physical whip or scourge (Acts 22.24).
2. Torment, severe illness, or severe affliction (Mk 3.10; Heb 11.36).

THAYER.pt: Instrumento flexível de punição física (chicote) ou, por extensão metafórica, uma condição de grande sofrimento, tormento ou aflição física. 1. Um chicote ou açoite físico (At 22.24). | 2. Tormento, doença grave ou aflição severa (Mc 3.10; Hb 11.36).
THAYER.en: A flexible instrument of physical punishment (whip) or, by metaphorical extension, a condition of great suffering, torment, or physical affliction. 1. A physical whip or scourge (Acts 22.24). | 2. Torment, severe illness, or severe affliction (Mk 3.10; Heb 11.36).

DEFINITION: The mammary gland or breast, of both men and women, frequently referring to nursing or descriptive anatomy.
SENSES: 1. The female breast or bosom, associated with motherhood and nourishment (Lk 11.27; 23.29).
2. The nipple or chest region in visual descriptions (Rev 1.13).

THAYER.pt: A glândula mamária ou o peito, tanto de homens quanto de mulheres, referindo-se frequentemente à amamentação ou à anatomia descritiva. 1. O peito ou mama feminina, associado à maternidade e nutrição (Lc 11.27; 23.29). | 2. O mamilo ou a região do peito em descrições visuais (Ap 1.13).
THAYER.en: The mammary gland or breast, of both men and women, frequently referring to nursing or descriptive anatomy. 1. The female breast or bosom, associated with motherhood and nourishment (Lk 11.27; 23.29). | 2. The nipple or chest region in visual descriptions (Rev 1.13).

DEFINITION: Refers to empty, sterile conversations or conversations without beneficial purpose, devoid of truth or spiritual value.
SENSES: 1. Futile and meaningless speech that does not edify (1Tm 1.6).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se a conversas vazias, estéreis ou sem propósito benéfico, desprovidas de verdade ou valor espiritual. 1. Discurso fútil e sem sentido que não edifica (1Tm 1.6).
THAYER.en: Refers to empty, sterile conversations or conversations without beneficial purpose, devoid of truth or spiritual value. 1. Futile and meaningless speech that does not edify (1Tm 1.6).

DEFINITION: Describes someone who engages in empty conversations, chattering, or useless speeches.
SENSES: 1. A person who utters idle and deceptive words (Tit 1.10).

THAYER.pt: Descreve alguém que se dedica a conversas vazias, tagarelice ou discursos inúteis. 1. Pessoa que profere palavras ociosas e enganosas (Tt 1.10).
THAYER.en: Describes someone who engages in empty conversations, chattering, or useless speeches. 1. A person who utters idle and deceptive words (Tit 1.10).

DEFINITION: Describes that which lacks real purpose, value, truth, or utility, resulting in sterile effort or futility.
SENSES: 1. Vain, without profit, or fruitless (Titus 3:9; James 1:26).

THAYER.pt: Descreve aquilo que carece de propósito real, valor, verdade ou utilidade, resultando em esforço estéril ou futilidade. 1. Vão, sem proveito ou infrutífero (Tt 3.9; Tg 1.26).
THAYER.en: Describes that which lacks real purpose, value, truth, or utility, resulting in sterile effort or futility. 1. Vain, without profit, or fruitless (Titus 3:9; James 1:26).

DEFINITION: The state of being devoid of utility, value, or real purpose; futility, emptiness, or transience.
SENSES: 1. The condition of uselessness and frustration inherent in the fallen creation (Rom 8:20).
2. The empty and morally purposeless way of life typical of the Gentiles (Eph 4:17).

THAYER.pt: O estado de ser destituído de utilidade, valor ou propósito real; futilidade, vazio ou transitoriedade. 1. A condição de inutilidade e frustração inerente à criação caída (Rm 8.20). | 2. O modo de vida vazio e sem propósito moral típico dos gentios (Ef 4.17).
THAYER.en: The state of being devoid of utility, value, or real purpose; futility, emptiness, or transience. 1. The condition of uselessness and frustration inherent in the fallen creation (Rom 8:20). | 2. The empty and morally purposeless way of life typical of the Gentiles (Eph 4:17).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: ματαιωθήσεται, Aor: ἐματαιώθην, Perf: μεματαίωμαι
DEFINITION: To make futile or fruitless; in the passive voice, to lose one's way in the mind, becoming foolish or corrupted in one's reasoning.
SENSES: 1. To become vain and senseless in one's way of thinking and worshiping (Rom 1:21).

THAYER.pt: Tornar fútil ou infrutífero; na voz passiva, perder o rumo na mente, tornando-se tolo ou corrompido em seus raciocínios. 1. Tornar-se vão e insensato no modo de pensar e adorar (Rm 1.21).
THAYER.en: To make futile or fruitless; in the passive voice, to lose one's way in the mind, becoming foolish or corrupted in one's reasoning. 1. To become vain and senseless in one's way of thinking and worshiping (Rom 1:21).

DEFINITION: Describes an action performed without effective purpose, without fruitful result, or in a totally fruitless manner.
SENSES: 1. In vain or without real profit (Matt 15:9; Mark 7:7).

THAYER.pt: Descreve uma ação realizada sem propósito eficaz, sem resultado frutífero ou de maneira totalmente infrutífera. 1. Em vão ou sem proveito real (Mt 15.9; Mc 7.7).
THAYER.en: Describes an action performed without effective purpose, without fruitful result, or in a totally fruitless manner. 1. In vain or without real profit (Matt 15:9; Mark 7:7).

DEFINITION: Proper name of one of the twelve apostles of Jesus, formerly a tax collector, and traditionally considered the author of the first gospel.
SENSES: 1. Matthew, the disciple and evangelist (Matt 9:9).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio de um dos doze apóstolos de Jesus, anteriormente cobrador de impostos, e tradicionalmente considerado o autor do primeiro evangelho. 1. Mateus, o discípulo e evangelista (Mt 9.9).
THAYER.en: Proper name of one of the twelve apostles of Jesus, formerly a tax collector, and traditionally considered the author of the first gospel. 1. Matthew, the disciple and evangelist (Matt 9:9).

DEFINITION: A masculine proper name of an ancestor in the genealogical lineage of Jesus recorded in the New Testament.
SENSES: 1. Matthat, ancestor of Jesus in the lineage of Matthew (Matt 1:15; Luke 3:23).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio masculino de um ancestral na linhagem genealógica de Jesus registrada no Novo Testamento. 1. Matã, ancestral de Jesus na linhagem de Mateus (Mt 1.15; Lc 3.23).
THAYER.en: A masculine proper name of an ancestor in the genealogical lineage of Jesus recorded in the New Testament. 1. Matthat, ancestor of Jesus in the lineage of Matthew (Matt 1:15; Luke 3:23).

DEFINITION: A proper name of a man listed in the genealogy of Jesus of Nazareth.
SENSES: 1. Mattatha, member of the ancestry of Jesus (Luke 3:24).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio de um homem listado na genealogia de Jesus de Nazaré. 1. Matatá, membro da ascendência de Jesus (Lc 3.24).
THAYER.en: A proper name of a man listed in the genealogy of Jesus of Nazareth. 1. Mattatha, member of the ancestry of Jesus (Luke 3:24).

DEFINITION: The disciple chosen by lot to fill the vacancy of Judas Iscariot in the apostolate after the ascension of Christ.
SENSES: 1. The apostle Matthias (Acts 1:23, 26).

THAYER.pt: O discípulo escolhido por sorteio para preencher a vaga de Judas Iscariotes no apostolado após a ascensão de Cristo. 1. O apóstolo Matias (At 1.23, 26).
THAYER.en: The disciple chosen by lot to fill the vacancy of Judas Iscariot in the apostolate after the ascension of Christ. 1. The apostle Matthias (Acts 1:23, 26).

DEFINITION: A masculine proper name present in the genealogical ancestry of Jesus recorded in the New Testament.
SENSES: 1. Descendant of David in the lineage of Jesus (Luke 3:31).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio masculino presente na ascendência genealógica de Jesus registrada no Novo Testamento. 1. Descendente de Davi na linhagem de Jesus (Lc 3.31).
THAYER.en: A masculine proper name present in the genealogical ancestry of Jesus recorded in the New Testament. 1. Descendant of David in the lineage of Jesus (Luke 3:31).

DEFINITION: A masculine proper name of ancestors in the genealogical tree of Jesus according to the account of Luke.
SENSES: 1. Ancestor of Jesus in the Lucan lineage (Luke 3:25, 26).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio masculino de ascendentes na árvore genealógica de Jesus segundo o relato de Lucas. 1. Antepassado de Jesus na linhagem lucana (Lc 3.25, 26).
THAYER.en: A masculine proper name of ancestors in the genealogical tree of Jesus according to the account of Luke. 1. Ancestor of Jesus in the Lucan lineage (Luke 3:25, 26).

DEFINITION: A sharp instrument used as a combat weapon or a symbol of punitive authority and judgment.
SENSES: 1. A short sword or dagger used for combat (Mt 26:47).
2. A symbol of violent death, war, or the judicial authority of the State (Mt 10:34; Rom 13:4).
3. A metaphor for the word of God as a spiritual instrument (Eph 6:17).

THAYER.pt: Instrumento cortante usado como arma de combate ou símbolo de autoridade punitiva e julgamento. 1. Espada curta ou adaga usada para combate (Mt 26:47). | 2. Símbolo de morte violenta, guerra ou da autoridade judicial do Estado (Mt 10:34; Rm 13:4). | 3. Metáfora para a palavra de Deus como instrumento espiritual (Ef 6:17).
THAYER.en: A sharp instrument used as a combat weapon or a symbol of punitive authority and judgment. 1. A short sword or dagger used for combat (Mt 26:47). | 2. A symbol of violent death, war, or the judicial authority of the State (Mt 10:34; Rom 13:4). | 3. A metaphor for the word of God as a spiritual instrument (Eph 6:17).

DEFINITION: Intense verbal or physical conflict, marked by heated arguments, disagreements, and rivalries.
SENSES: 1. Sharp arguments, verbal strife, or physical fights (2 Cor 7:5; Jas 4:1; 2 Tim 2:23).

THAYER.en: Intense verbal or physical conflict, marked by heated arguments, disagreements, and rivalries. 1. Sharp arguments, verbal strife, or physical fights (2 Cor 7:5; Jas 4:1; 2 Tim 2:23).

THAYER.pt: Envolver-se em combate físico ou em disputas verbais acaloradas e contenciosas. 1. Travar combate físico ou luta corporal (At 7.26). | 2. Envolver-se em disputas verbais, discussões e contendas (Jo 6.52; 2Tm 2.24).
THAYER.en: To engage in physical combat or in heated, contentious verbal disputes. 1. To engage in physical combat or bodily struggle (Acts 7:26). | 2. To engage in verbal disputes, arguments, and strife (John 6:52; 2 Tim 2:24).

DEFINITION: A first-person personal pronoun form in the accusative case, referring to the speaker as the object.

THAYER.en: A first-person personal pronoun form in the accusative case, referring to the speaker as the object. 1. To indicate the speaker as the direct object of a verbal action.

DEFINITION: To speak with arrogance or vainglory, displaying great pride through pretentious words.

THAYER.en: To speak with arrogance or vainglory, displaying great pride through pretentious words. 1. To make great boasts or to boast proudly (Jas 3:5).

DEFINITION: Possessing great splendor, magnificence, or notable importance; often used as a substantive plural to denote the powerful works of God.
SENSES: 1. Grand and wonderful deeds performed by divine power (Acts 2:11).

THAYER.pt: Que possui grande esplendor, magnificência ou importância notável, frequentemente usado no plural substantivado para denotar as obras poderosas de Deus. 1. Feitos grandiosos e maravilhosos realizados pelo poder divino (At 2.11).
THAYER.en: Possessing great splendor, magnificence, or notable importance; often used as a substantive plural to denote the powerful works of God. 1. Grand and wonderful deeds performed by divine power (Acts 2:11).

THAYER.en: The quality or state of possessing supreme greatness, imposing presence, sublimity, or a manifestation of admirable power. 1. The majesty and sublime glory of God revealed in Christ (Luke 9:43; 2 Pet 1:16). | 2. The greatness and prestige of pagan deities or temples (Acts 19:27).

DEFINITION: Distinguished by supreme majesty, imposing presence, or unusual beauty, associated with divine glory.
SENSES: 1. Referring to the manifestation of the supreme and majestic glory of God (2 Pet 1:17).

THAYER.pt: Que se destaca pela suprema majestade, imponência ou beleza incomum, associado à glória divina. 1. Referente à manifestação da suprema e majestosa glória de Deus (2Pe 1.17).
THAYER.en: Distinguished by supreme majesty, imposing presence, or unusual beauty, associated with divine glory. 1. Referring to the manifestation of the supreme and majestic glory of God (2 Pet 1:17).

DEFINITION: To make something larger in size or, figuratively, to exalt and praise someone, proclaiming their greatness.
SENSES: 1. To make something larger or ostentatious (Mt 23:5).
2. To magnify, praise, and exalt the greatness of God or people (Luke 1:46; Acts 10:46).

THAYER.pt: Tornar algo maior em tamanho ou, em sentido figurado, exaltar e enaltecer alguém por meio de louvor, proclamando sua grandeza. 1. Fazer algo maior ou ostensivo (Mt 23.5). | 2. Magnificar, louvar e exaltar a grandeza de Deus ou de pessoas (Lc 1.46; At 10.46).
THAYER.en: To make something larger in size or, figuratively, to exalt and praise someone, proclaiming their greatness. 1. To make something larger or ostentatious (Mt 23:5). | 2. To magnify, praise, and exalt the greatness of God or people (Luke 1:46; Acts 10:46).

DEFINITION: Indicates a high degree of intensity or extent in the performance of an action.
SENSES: 1. To experience great joy or express gratitude intensely (Phil 4:10).

THAYER.pt: Indica um alto grau de intensidade ou extensão na realização de uma ação. 1. Experimentar grande alegria ou expressar gratidão intensamente (Fp 4.10).
THAYER.en: Indicates a high degree of intensity or extent in the performance of an action. 1. To experience great joy or express gratitude intensely (Phil 4:10).

DEFINITION: A state of supreme greatness and preeminence, used exclusively in the New Testament as an attribute to exalt the majesty of God.

THAYER.pt: Estado de suprema grandeza e preeminência, usado exclusivamente no Novo Testamento como atributo para exaltar a majestade de Deus. 1. A sublime majestade de Deus nos mais altos céus (Hb 1.3; 8.1; Jd 25).
THAYER.en: A state of supreme greatness and preeminence, used exclusively in the New Testament as an attribute to exalt the majesty of God. 1. The sublime majesty of God in the highest heavens (Heb 1:3; 8:1; Jude 25).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Gen: μεγάλου, μεγάλης, μεγάλου; Superlative: μέγιστος
DEFINITION: Qualifies that which exceeds common parameters of physical measurement, sensory intensity, moral weight, or social authority. Frequently used to magnify the admirable attributes and portentous deeds of God.
SENSES: 1. Abundant or spacious physical spatial dimension (Mt 27:60; Mark 14:15).
2. High degree of intensity, force, or acoustic volume (Mt 28:2; Rev 1:10).
3. Spiritual, moral, historical prominence, or majestic status (Luke 1:32; Heb 4:14).

THAYER.pt: Qualifica o que ultrapassa os parâmetros comuns de mensuração física, intensidade sensorial, peso moral ou autoridade social. Emprega-se com frequência para engrandecer os atributos admiráveis e os feitos portentosos de Deus. 1. Dimensão física espacial abundante ou espaçosa (Mt 27.60; Mc 14.15). | 2. Elevado grau de intensidade, força ou volume acústico (Mt 28.2; Ap 1.10). | 3. Proeminência espiritual, moral, histórica ou de status majestoso (Lc 1.32; Hb 4.14).
THAYER.en: Qualifies that which exceeds common parameters of physical measurement, sensory intensity, moral weight, or social authority. Frequently used to magnify the admirable attributes and portentous deeds of God. 1. Abundant or spacious physical spatial dimension (Mt 27:60; Mark 14:15). | 2. High degree of intensity, force, or acoustic volume (Mt 28:2; Rev 1:10). | 3. Spiritual, moral, historical prominence, or majestic status (Luke 1:32; Heb 4:14).

DEFINITION: A quality that exceeds normal standards of measurement, expressing immensity or exalted magnitude.
SENSES: 1. The immense and immeasurable greatness of divine power operating in believers (Eph 1:19).

THAYER.pt: Qualidade que excede os padrões normais de medida, expressando imensidão ou magnitude excelcisa. 1. A imensa e incomensurável grandeza do poder divino operante nos crentes (Ef 1.19).
THAYER.en: A quality that exceeds normal standards of measurement, expressing immensity or exalted magnitude. 1. The immense and immeasurable greatness of divine power operating in believers (Eph 1:19).

DEFINITION: A person of high social standing, nobility, political authority, or great economic importance.
