THAYER.pt: Pessoa de alta posição social, nobreza, autoridade política ou grande importância econômica. 1. Homens de grande poder e prestígio, como governantes e magnatas mundiais (Ap 6.15; 18.23).
THAYER.en: A person of high social standing, nobility, political authority, or great economic importance. 1. Men of great power and prestige, such as rulers and world magnates (Rev 6:15; 18:23).

DEFINITION: A superlative degree denoting the maximum level of greatness, importance, or relevance.
SENSES: 1. Belonging to the highest degree of relevance or proportion.

THAYER.pt: Grau superlativo que denotam o nível máximo de grandeza, importância ou relevância. 1. Pertençente ao grau mais alto de relevância ou proporção.
THAYER.en: A superlative degree denoting the maximum level of greatness, importance, or relevance. 1. Belonging to the highest degree of relevance or proportion.

DEFINITION: To explain the meaning of an expression or term from one language to another, performing the act of literal or dynamic translation.
SENSES: 1. To translate from one language to another (Mt 1:23; John 1:42).

THAYER.pt: Explicar o significado de uma expressão ou termo de uma língua para outra, realizando o ato da tradução literal ou dinâmica. 1. Traduzir de um idioma para outro (Mt 1.23; Jo 1.42).
THAYER.en: To explain the meaning of an expression or term from one language to another, performing the act of literal or dynamic translation. 1. To translate from one language to another (Mt 1:23; John 1:42).

SENSES: 1. The act or state of drunkenness contrary to the sobriety required of believers (Luke 21:34; Rom 13:13; Gal 5:21).

THAYER.pt: O estado de intoxicação ou embriaguez resultante do consumo excessivo de bebidas alcoólicas, condenado na ética cristã. 1. O ato ou estado de embriaguez contrários à sobriedade exigida aos crentes (Lc 21.34; Rm 13.13; Gl 5.21).
THAYER.en: The state of intoxication resulting from the excessive consumption of alcoholic beverages, condemned in Christian ethics. 1. The act or state of drunkenness contrary to the sobriety required of believers (Luke 21:34; Rom 13:13; Gal 5:21).

SEMANTIC_FIELD: Linear Movement and Change of State

THAYER.en: To cause a change from one place to another, to transfer from one condition to another, or figuratively to divert someone from their beliefs or loyalties. 1. To transfer or remove from a place or position (Luke 16:4; Col 1:13). | 2. To divert, lead into error, or change someone's opinion (Acts 19:26).

DEFINITION: A cunning method of deceit, trickery, or malicious machination aimed at seducing or diverting someone from the truth.

THAYER.en: A cunning method of deceit, trickery, or malicious machination aimed at seducing or diverting someone from the truth. 1. The craftiness and machinations of human error (Eph 4:14); | 2. The traps of the devil (Eph 6:11).

DEFINITION: The dividing line between territories or the region extending along that border.

THAYER.en: The dividing line between territories or the region extending along that border. 1. Territorial limit or border region (Mark 7:24).

THAYER.en: To cause intoxication through the excessive consumption of alcoholic beverages, or, in the passive voice, to become drunk. 1. To become drunk or under the influence of excessive wine and alcoholic drink (Lk 21:34; Eph 5:18; 1Th 5:7).

That which surpasses another in degree, intensity, or quantity. | 3. That which possesses greater status, authority, or excellence.

DEFINITION: A noun used in the neuter to designate the dark liquid traditionally used for writing with a pen and papyrus.

THAYER.en: Having a dark or black color, whether as a natural physical characteristic or as a symbolic color in apocalyptic contexts. 1. The color black in objects or elements of nature (Mt 5:36; Rev 6:12).

THAYER.en: An island located in the Mediterranean Sea, south of Sicily, where the apostle Paul was shipwrecked. 1. The island of Malta, where Paul and the sailors landed safely (Ac 28:1).

SHORT_GLOSS: to be about to, to be destined to
DEFINITION: Indicates imminence, intention, or the inevitable design of a future event. It frequently expresses the unfolding of God's sovereign and eschatological plan.
SENSES: 1. Temporal imminence: to be about to, to be on the point of (Lk 7:2; Ac 12:6).
2. Prophetic certainty or providential necessity: to be destined to (Mt 17:12; Ro 8:18).
3. Substantive participle: that which is to come, future, coming (Mt 3:7; Heb 11:20).
USAGE: to be about to, to be destined to

THAYER.pt: Indica iminência, intenção ou desígnio inevitável de um acontecimento futuro. Com frequência expressa o desenrolar do plano soberano e escatológico de Deus. 1. Iminência temporal: estar prestes a, estar a ponto de (Lc 7.2; At 12.6). | 2. Certeza profética ou necessidade providencial: haver de (Mt 17.12; Rm 8.18). | 3. Particípio substantivado: o que há de vir, futuro, vindouro (Mt 3.7; Hb 11.20).
THAYER.en: Indicates imminence, intention, or the inevitable design of a future event. It frequently expresses the unfolding of God's sovereign and eschatological plan. 1. Temporal imminence: to be about to, to be on the point of (Lk 7:2; Ac 12:6). | 2. Prophetic certainty or providential necessity: to be destined to (Mt 17:12; Ro 8:18). | 3. Substantive participle: that which is to come, future, coming (Mt 3:7; Heb 11:20).

THAYER.en: A specific part of the human body or, by metaphorical extension, an integral member of a corporate whole. 1. Part of the human body, member, or physical organ (Ro 12:4; 1Co 12:12). | 2. Part as an integral member of a social or spiritual body (Ro 12:5).

THAYER.pt: Pessoa que reclama constantemente da própria sorte, insatisfeita com as circunstâncias da vida. 1. Indivíduo que murmura e reclama do seu destino ou provisão (Jd 16).
THAYER.en: A person who constantly complains about their own lot, dissatisfied with the circumstances of life. 1. An individual who murmurs and complains about their destiny or provision (Jude 16).

SHORT_GLOSS: on the one hand, indeed, certainly
DEFINITION: An assertive emphatic particle used to mark the first member of a correlation or sentence contrast, often followed by δέ ('on the other hand'). It prepares the reader's mind for an antithesis or a complement to the reasoning.
SENSES: 1. In direct correlation (μέν... δέ): 'on the one hand... on the other hand' (Mt 3:11; Mt 9:37).
2. Confirmatory isolated use: 'indeed', 'certainly', 'in truth' (Rom 1:8; 1 Cor 6:7).
USAGE: on the one hand, indeed, certainly

THAYER.pt: Partícula de ênfase asseverativa usada para assinalar o primeiro membro de uma correlação ou contraste oracional, frequentemente seguida por δέ ('por outro lado'). Prepara a mente do leitor para uma antítese ou complementação de raciocínio. 1. Em correlação direta (μέν... δέ): 'por um lado... por outro lado' (Mt 3.11; Mt 9.37). | 2. Uso isolado confirmatório: 'de fato', 'por certo', 'em verdade' (Rm 1.8; 1Co 6.7).
THAYER.en: An assertive emphatic particle used to mark the first member of a correlation or sentence contrast, often followed by δέ ('on the other hand'). It prepares the reader's mind for an antithesis or a complement to the reasoning. 1. In direct correlation (μέν... δέ): 'on the one hand... on the other hand' (Mt 3:11; Mt 9:37). | 2. Confirmatory isolated use: 'indeed', 'certainly', 'in truth' (Rom 1:8; 1 Cor 6:7).

DEFINITION: An emphatic compound particle that serves to correct, reinforce, or strongly counter a previous statement.
SENSES: 1. Expression of strong correction or affirmative emphasis ('rather', 'on the contrary', 'yes, certainly') (Lk 11:28; Rom 9:20; 10:18).

THAYER.pt: Partícula enfática combinada que serve para corrigir, reforçar ou contrapor fortemente uma afirmação anterior. 1. Expressão de forte correção ou ênfase afirmativa ("antes", "pelo contrário", "sim, com certeza") (Lc 11.28; Rm 9.20; 10.18).
THAYER.en: An emphatic compound particle that serves to correct, reinforce, or strongly counter a previous statement. 1. Expression of strong correction or affirmative emphasis ('rather', 'on the contrary', 'yes, certainly') (Lk 11:28; Rom 9:20; 10:18).

DEFINITION: An emphatic adversative particle that introduces a strong reservation, contrast, or confirmation to a previous idea.
SENSES: 1. Nevertheless, yet, however (Jn 4:27; 2 Tim 2:19).

THAYER.pt: Partícula adversativa enfática que introduz uma forte ressalva, contraste ou confirmação a uma ideia anterior. 1. Todavia, contudo, no entanto (Jo 4.27; 2Tm 2.19).
THAYER.en: An emphatic adversative particle that introduces a strong reservation, contrast, or confirmation to a previous idea. 1. Nevertheless, yet, however (Jn 4:27; 2 Tim 2:19).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: μενῶ, Aor: ἔμεινα, Perf: μεμένηκα
DEFINITION: To remain in a place or situation, to endure through time without changing; in the Johannine corpus, it expresses continuous and unshakable communion with Christ and His Word.
SENSES: 1. To stay in the same physical place, to dwell, to lodge (Lk 19:5; Jn 1:38).
2. To continue to exist, to subsist, to persevere without decline (1 Cor 13:13; Heb 13:14).
3. To dwell spiritually in constant relational union with Christ (Jn 15:4-7; 1 Jn 2:24).

THAYER.pt: Permanecer em um local ou situação, durar através do tempo sem se alterar; no corpus joanino, expressa a comunhão contínua e inabalável com Cristo e Sua Palavra. 1. Ficar no mesmo lugar físico, morar, hospedar-se (Lc 19.5; Jo 1.38). | 2. Continuar a existir, subsistir, perseverar sem declínio (1Co 13.13; Hb 13.14). | 3. Habitar espiritualmente em união relacional constante com Cristo (Jo 15.4-7; 1Jo 2.24).
THAYER.en: To remain in a place or situation, to endure through time without changing; in the Johannine corpus, it expresses continuous and unshakable communion with Christ and His Word. 1. To stay in the same physical place, to dwell, to lodge (Lk 19:5; Jn 1:38). | 2. To continue to exist, to subsist, to persevere without decline (1 Cor 13:13; Heb 13:14). | 3. To dwell spiritually in constant relational union with Christ (Jn 15:4-7; 1 Jn 2:24).

DEFINITION: To separate something into distinct parts, to distribute portions, or to assign specific functions and responsibilities.
SENSES: 1. To divide into parts or separate elements (Mt 12:25; 1 Cor 1:13).
2. To distribute, share, or designate portions and tasks (Lk 12:13; Heb 7:2).

THAYER.pt: Separar algo em partes distintas, distribuir porções ou atribuir funções e responsabilidades específicas. 1. Dividir em partes ou separar elementos (Mt 12.25; 1Co 1.13). | 2. Distribuir, repartir ou designar porções e tarefas (Lc 12.13; Hb 7.2).
THAYER.en: To separate something into distinct parts, to distribute portions, or to assign specific functions and responsibilities. 1. To divide into parts or separate elements (Mt 12:25; 1 Cor 1:13). | 2. To distribute, share, or designate portions and tasks (Lk 12:13; Heb 7:2).

DEFINITION: Refers to a feeling of apprehension, worry, or mental anguish generated by uncertainties, dangers, or the demands of daily life.
SENSES: 1. Anxiety or excessive worry about the things of life (Lk 8:14; 1 Pet 5:7).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se a um sentimento de apreensão, preocupação ou angústia mental gerado por incertezas, perigos ou pelas demandas da vida diária. 1. Ansiedade ou preocupação excessiva com as coisas da vida (Lc 8.14; 1Pe 5.7).
THAYER.en: Refers to a feeling of apprehension, worry, or mental anguish generated by uncertainties, dangers, or the demands of daily life. 1. Anxiety or excessive worry about the things of life (Lk 8:14; 1 Pet 5:7).

SHORT_GLOSS: to be anxious, worry, care for
DEFINITION: To experience deep mental anxiety or apprehensive worry in the face of life's uncertainties, or to show solicitous care for someone.
SENSES: 1. To be excessively anxious or worried about daily needs (Mt 6:25; Phil 4:6).
2. To care for something or demonstrate legitimate concern and interest for someone (1 Cor 7:32; Phil 2:20).
USAGE: to be anxious, worry, care for

THAYER.pt: Experimentar ansiedade mental profunda ou preocupação apreensiva diante das incertezas da vida, ou dedicar desvelo solícito a alguém. 1. Estar excessivamente ansioso ou preocupado com necessidades diárias (Mt 6.25; Fp 4.6). | 2. Cuidar de algo ou demonstrar desvelo e interesse legítimo por alguém (1Co 7.32; Fp 2.20).
THAYER.en: To experience deep mental anxiety or apprehensive worry in the face of life's uncertainties, or to show solicitous care for someone. 1. To be excessively anxious or worried about daily needs (Mt 6:25; Phil 4:6). | 2. To care for something or demonstrate legitimate concern and interest for someone (1 Cor 7:32; Phil 2:20).

DEFINITION: A portion of a divided whole, representing a physical part, an administrative region, or a spiritual participation.
SENSES: 1. Territorial part or portion (Acts 16:12).
2. Share, part, or spiritual participation (Lk 10:42; Acts 8:21; 2 Cor 6:15).

THAYER.pt: Uma porção de um todo dividido, representando uma parte física, uma região administrativa ou uma participação espiritual. 1. Parte ou porção territorial (At 16.12). | 2. Quinhão, parte ou participação espiritual (Lc 10.42; At 8.21; 2Co 6.15).
THAYER.en: A portion of a divided whole, representing a physical part, an administrative region, or a spiritual participation. 1. Territorial part or portion (Acts 16:12). | 2. Share, part, or spiritual participation (Lk 10:42; Acts 8:21; 2 Cor 6:15).

DEFINITION: The act of dividing, separating, or distributing gifts, portions, and functions in a specific manner.
SENSES: 1. Distribution or partition of gifts according to the will of God (Heb 2:4);
2. The deep separation or division operated by the word of God (Heb 4:12).

THAYER.pt: O ato de dividir, separar ou distribuir dons, porções e funções de maneira específica. 1. Distribuição ou repartição de dons segundo a vontade de Deus (Hb 2.4); | 2. A separação ou divisão profunda operada pela palavra de Deus (Hb 4.12).
THAYER.en: The act of dividing, separating, or distributing gifts, portions, and functions in a specific manner. 1. Distribution or partition of gifts according to the will of God (Heb 2:4); | 2. The deep separation or division operated by the word of God (Heb 4:12).

DEFINITION: One who performs divisions, partitions, or acts as a mediator and judge in inheritance disputes.
SENSES: 1. Arbiter or judge charged with dividing assets between parties (Lk 12:14).

THAYER.pt: Aquele que realiza divisões, partilhas ou atua como mediador e juiz em disputas de herança. 1. Árbitro ou juiz encarregado de dividir bens entre partes (Lc 12.14).
THAYER.en: One who performs divisions, partitions, or acts as a mediator and judge in inheritance disputes. 1. Arbiter or judge charged with dividing assets between parties (Lk 12:14).

DEFINITION: A fraction or specific portion in contrast to the totality of an object, group, or territory.
SENSES: 1. A part or portion of a whole (Lk 15:12; Rev 22:19).
2. A specific geographic region or district (Mt 2:22; 15:21).

THAYER.pt: Uma fração ou porção específica em contraste com a totalidade de um objeto, grupo ou território. 1. Uma parte ou porção de um todo (Lc 15.12; Ap 22.19). | 2. Uma região geográfica específica ou distrito (Mt 2.22; 15.21).
THAYER.en: A fraction or specific portion in contrast to the totality of an object, group, or territory. 1. A part or portion of a whole (Lk 15:12; Rev 22:19). | 2. A specific geographic region or district (Mt 2:22; 15:21).

DEFINITION: Indicates the central point of the day (noon) or, by geographic extension, the cardinal direction of south.
SENSES: 1. The moment of noon or the sun at its zenith (Acts 22:6).
2. The geographic direction of the south (Acts 8:26).

THAYER.pt: Indica o ponto central do dia (meio-dia) ou, por extensão de sentido geográfico, a direção cardeal sul. 1. O momento do meio-dia ou sol a pino (Ac 22:6). | 2. A direção geográfica do sul (Ac 8:26).
THAYER.en: Indicates the central point of the day (noon) or, by geographic extension, the cardinal direction of south. 1. The moment of noon or the sun at its zenith (Acts 22:6). | 2. The geographic direction of the south (Acts 8:26).

DEFINITION: To act as a guarantor or intermediary to ensure that an agreement or promise is fulfilled with certainty.
SENSES: 1. To formally guarantee an irrevocable promise or commitment (Heb 6:17).

THAYER.pt: Atuar como garantidor ou intermediário para assegurar que um acordo ou promessa seja cumprido com certeza. 1. Garantir formalmente uma promessa ou compromisso irrevogável (Hb 6.17).
THAYER.en: To act as a guarantor or intermediary to ensure that an agreement or promise is fulfilled with certainty. 1. To formally guarantee an irrevocable promise or commitment (Heb 6:17).

DEFINITION: Designates one who acts between two disunited parties to promote reconciliation, guarantee an agreement, or serve as a guarantor of a covenant.
SENSES: 1. One who intercedes between divergent parties to restore harmony (1 Tim 2:5).
2. Christ as the supreme guarantor of a new and superior covenant (Heb 8:6; 9:15).

THAYER.pt: Designa aquele que atua entre duas partes desunidas para promover a reconciliação, garantir um acordo ou servir como fiador de uma aliança. 1. Aquele que intercede entre partes divergentes para restaurar a harmonia (1Tm 2.5). | 2. Cristo como o supremo garantidor de uma nova e superior aliança (Hb 8.6; 9.15).
THAYER.en: Designates one who acts between two disunited parties to promote reconciliation, guarantee an agreement, or serve as a guarantor of a covenant. 1. One who intercedes between divergent parties to restore harmony (1 Tim 2:5). | 2. Christ as the supreme guarantor of a new and superior covenant (Heb 8:6; 9:15).

DEFINITION: The central point of the night, corresponding to the period around midnight, frequently used in narratives and parables to indicate unexpected moments.
SENSES: 1. The exact moment of midnight (Lk 11:5; Acts 16:25; Mk 13:35).

THAYER.pt: O ponto central da noite, correspondendo ao período por volta da meia-noite, frequentemente usado em narrativas e parábolas para indicar momentos inesperados. 1. O momento exato da meia-noite (Lc 11.5; At 16.25; Mc 13.35).
THAYER.en: The central point of the night, corresponding to the period around midnight, frequently used in narratives and parables to indicate unexpected moments. 1. The exact moment of midnight (Lk 11:5; Acts 16:25; Mk 13:35).

DEFINITION: Historical geographic region situated between the Tigris and Euphrates rivers, mentioned in New Testament accounts.
SENSES: 1. The province or river valley of Mesopotamia (Acts 2:9).

THAYER.pt: Região geográfica histórica situada entre os rios Tigre e Eufrates, mencionada nos relatos do Novo Testamento. 1. A província ou vale fluvial da Mesopotâmia (Ac 2:9).
THAYER.en: Historical geographic region situated between the Tigris and Euphrates rivers, mentioned in New Testament accounts. 1. The province or river valley of Mesopotamia (Acts 2:9).

DEFINITION: Describes a central position in space or time, or the location of someone inserted in the middle of a group.
SENSES: 1. In a central position, spatial or temporal (Mt 25:6; Rev 7:17).
2. In the midst of or between a group of people or things (Lk 22:55; Jn 1:26).

THAYER.pt: Descreve uma posição central no espaço ou no tempo, ou a localização de alguém inserido no meio de um grupo. 1. Em posição central, espacial ou temporal (Mt 25.6; Ap 7.17). | 2. No meio de ou entre um grupo de pessoas ou coisas (Lc 22.55; Jo 1.26).
THAYER.en: Describes a central position in space or time, or the location of someone inserted in the middle of a group. 1. In a central position, spatial or temporal (Mt 25:6; Rev 7:17). | 2. In the midst of or between a group of people or things (Lk 22:55; Jn 1:26).

DEFINITION: A wall or structural partition that separates two distinct spaces, preventing free movement.
SENSES: 1. The spiritual or ritual barrier that separated Jews and Gentiles, torn down by Christ (Eph 2:14).

THAYER.pt: Muro ou divisória estrutural que separa dois espaços distintos, impedindo a livre circulação. 1. A barreira espiritual ou ritual que separava judeus e gentios, derrubada por Cristo (Ef 2.14).
THAYER.en: A wall or structural partition that separates two distinct spaces, preventing free movement. 1. The spiritual or ritual barrier that separated Jews and Gentiles, torn down by Christ (Eph 2:14).

DEFINITION: The highest point in the sky, directly above the earth (the zenith), where celestial bodies or voices can be seen and heard by all.
SENSES: 1. The culminating point or the middle of the celestial vault (Rev 8:13; 14:6; 19:17).

THAYER.pt: O ponto mais alto do céu, diretamente acima da terra (o zênite), onde os corpos celestes ou vozes podem ser vistos e ouvidos por todos. 1. O ponto culminante ou o meio da abóbada celeste (Ap 8.13; 14.6; 19.17).
THAYER.en: The highest point in the sky, directly above the earth (the zenith), where celestial bodies or voices can be seen and heard by all. 1. The culminating point or the middle of the celestial vault (Rev 8:13; 14:6; 19:17).

SHORT_GLOSS: to be in the middle, to elapse
DEFINITION: To be situated exactly in the center of a period of time or to have something completed up to the halfway point.
SENSES: 1. To reach the middle or the central point of an event or period (John 7:14).
USAGE: to be in the middle, to elapse

THAYER.pt: Estar situado bem no centro de um período de tempo ou ter algo completado até a metade. 1. Atingir a metade ou o ponto central de um evento ou período (Jo 7.14).
THAYER.en: To be situated exactly in the center of a period of time or to have something completed up to the halfway point. 1. To reach the middle or the central point of an event or period (John 7:14).

DEFINITION: A Hebrew term transliterated into Greek meaning 'The Anointed One,' equivalent to Christ, designating the one promised by God.
SENSES: 1. The Messiah expected by the people of Israel (John 1:41).

THAYER.pt: Termo hebraico transliterado para o grego que significa 'O Ungido', equivalente a Cristo, designando o enviado prometido por Deus. 1. O Messias esperado pelo povo de Israel (Jo 1:41).
THAYER.en: A Hebrew term transliterated into Greek meaning 'The Anointed One,' equivalent to Christ, designating the one promised by God. 1. The Messiah expected by the people of Israel (John 1:41).

DEFINITION: That which completely fills a space or is entirely taken up by a characteristic, feeling, or condition.
SENSES: 1. Full in the literal sense, containing maximum volume (John 19:29; 21:11).
2. Filled with qualities, sins, or moral attitudes (Matt 23:28; Rom 1:29).

THAYER.pt: Que preenche totalmente um espaço ou que está completamente tomado por uma característica, sentimento ou condição. 1. Cheio no sentido literal, contendo volume máximo (Jo 19.29; 21.11). | 2. Repleto de qualidades, pecados ou atitudes morais (Mt 23.28; Rm 1.29).
THAYER.en: That which completely fills a space or is entirely taken up by a characteristic, feeling, or condition. 1. Full in the literal sense, containing maximum volume (John 19:29; 21:11). | 2. Filled with qualities, sins, or moral attitudes (Matt 23:28; Rom 1:29).

DEFINITION: To cause a space or container to be fully taken up by a content.
SENSES: 1. To be completely filled with a substance or influence (Acts 2:13).

THAYER.pt: Causar que um espaço ou recipiente fique plenamente tomado por um conteúdo. 1. Estar completamente cheio de uma substância ou influência (At 2.13).
THAYER.en: To cause a space or container to be fully taken up by a content. 1. To be completely filled with a substance or influence (Acts 2:13).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Governs genitive and accusative; elided to μετ’ or μεθ’
DEFINITION: A preposition denoting communion, association, and circumstance when governing the genitive, and temporal or spatial sequence when governing the accusative.
SENSES: 1. With genitive: in company with, together with, in communion with (Matt 1:23; John 6:66).
2. With genitive: accompanying circumstance or attitude with which something is done (Mark 10:30; 2 Cor 7:15).
3. With accusative: succession in time or space; after, following (Matt 26:2; Heb 9:3).

THAYER.pt: Preposição que denota comunhão, associação e circunstância quando rege genitivo, e sequência temporal ou espacial posterior quando rege acusativo. 1. Com genitivo: em companhia de, junto com, em comunhão com (Mt 1.23; Jo 6.66). | 2. Com genitivo: circunstância acompanhante ou atitude com que algo é feito (Mc 10.30; 2Co 7.15). | 3. Com acusativo: sucessão no tempo ou espaço; depois de, após (Mt 26.2; Hb 9.3).
THAYER.en: A preposition denoting communion, association, and circumstance when governing the genitive, and temporal or spatial sequence when governing the accusative. 1. With genitive: in company with, together with, in communion with (Matt 1:23; John 6:66). | 2. With genitive: accompanying circumstance or attitude with which something is done (Mark 10:30; 2 Cor 7:15). | 3. With accusative: succession in time or space; after, following (Matt 26:2; Heb 9:3).

SHORT_GLOSS: to pass, to move, to transfer
DEFINITION: To move or transfer oneself from one place to another, or to transition from one condition or state to another.
SENSES: 1. To move from one place to another, to physically transit (Matt 8:34; John 7:3).
2. To change from one condition or state to another (John 5:24).
USAGE: to pass, to move, to transfer

THAYER.pt: Mover-se ou transferir-se de um lugar para outro, ou transitar de uma condição ou estado para outro. 1. Mudar de um lugar para outro, transitar fisicamente (Mt 8.34; Jo 7.3). | 2. Mudar de uma condição ou estado para outro (Jo 5.24).
THAYER.en: To move or transfer oneself from one place to another, or to transition from one condition or state to another. 1. To move from one place to another, to physically transit (Matt 8:34; John 7:3). | 2. To change from one condition or state to another (John 5:24).

DEFINITION: To modify the direction, state, or manner of thinking and acting.
SENSES: 1. To change suddenly in opinion or attitude regarding a fact (Acts 28:6).

THAYER.pt: Modificar a direção, o estado ou a maneira de pensar e agir. 1. Mudar repentinamente de opinião ou de atitude diante de um fato (At 28.6).
THAYER.en: To modify the direction, state, or manner of thinking and acting. 1. To change suddenly in opinion or attitude regarding a fact (Acts 28:6).

SHORT_GLOSS: to lead, to guide, to move
DEFINITION: To change the direction or guide something from one place to another, exercising control over the movement.
SENSES: 1. To lead or guide in the correct direction (Jas 3:4).
USAGE: to lead, to guide, to move

THAYER.pt: Mudar a direção ou guiar algo de um lugar para outro, exercendo controle sobre o movimento. 1. Conduzir ou guiar na direção correta (Tg 3:4).
THAYER.en: To change the direction or guide something from one place to another, exercising control over the movement. 1. To lead or guide in the correct direction (Jas 3:4).

SHORT_GLOSS: to share, to give, to distribute
DEFINITION: To give someone a portion of what one possesses, participating with others in material or spiritual resources.
SENSES: 1. To share or distribute what one has with one's neighbor (Rom 1:11; 1 Thess 2:8).
USAGE: to share, to give, to distribute

THAYER.pt: Dar a alguém uma parte daquilo que se possui, participando com outros de recursos materiais ou espirituais. 1. Compartilhar ou repartir o que se tem com o próximo (Rm 1.11; 1Ts 2.8).
THAYER.en: To give someone a portion of what one possesses, participating with others in material or spiritual resources. 1. To share or distribute what one has with one's neighbor (Rom 1:11; 1 Thess 2:8).

DEFINITION: The action or process of changing something from one place to another, or of transforming a state, law, or institutional condition.
SENSES: 1. The removal or translation of a person to another place, as in the case of Enoch (Heb 11:5).
2. Structural change or alteration, such as the abrogation of the Levitical law (Heb 7:12).

THAYER.pt: A ação ou processo de mudar algo de um lugar para outro, ou de transformar um estado, lei ou condição institucional. 1. A remoção ou translação de uma pessoa para outro lugar, como no caso de Enoque (Hb 11.5). | 2. Mudança ou alteração estrutural, como a ab-rogação da lei levítica (Hb 7.12).
THAYER.en: The action or process of changing something from one place to another, or of transforming a state, law, or institutional condition. 1. The removal or translation of a person to another place, as in the case of Enoch (Heb 11:5). | 2. Structural change or alteration, such as the abrogation of the Levitical law (Heb 7:12).

SHORT_GLOSS: to depart, to move away, to remove
DEFINITION: To change place, break camp, or depart from one reference point to another.
SENSES: 1. To depart or remove oneself from a locality (Matt 13:53; 19:1).
USAGE: to depart, to move away, to remove

THAYER.pt: Mudar de lugar, levantar acampamento ou partir de um ponto de referência para outro. 1. Partir ou retirar-se de uma localidade (Mt 13:53; 19:1).
THAYER.en: To change place, break camp, or depart from one reference point to another. 1. To depart or remove oneself from a locality (Matt 13:53; 19:1).

DEFINITION: The act of calling someone to oneself, sending for, or summoning for a meeting or testimony.
SENSES: 1. To call someone to one's presence or to summon (Acts 7:14; Acts 20:17).

THAYER.pt: Ato de chamar alguém para junto de si, mandar vir ou convocar para uma reunião ou testemunho. 1. Chamar alguém à sua presença ou convocar (At 7.14; At 20.17).
THAYER.en: The act of calling someone to oneself, sending for, or summoning for a meeting or testimony. 1. To call someone to one's presence or to summon (Acts 7:14; Acts 20:17).

SHORT_GLOSS: to remove, to move away, to deviate
DEFINITION: To move something from its original position or to cause a fixed state to cease, often through pressure.
SENSES: 1. To be shaken or deviated from the hope and firmness of the faith (Col 1:23).
USAGE: to remove, to move away, to deviate

THAYER.pt: Mover algo de sua posição original ou fazer cessar um estado fixo, muitas vezes mediante pressão. 1. Ser abalado ou desviado da esperança e firmeza da fé (Cl 1.23).
THAYER.en: To move something from its original position or to cause a fixed state to cease, often through pressure. 1. To be shaken or deviated from the hope and firmness of the faith (Col 1:23).

SHORT_GLOSS: to participate, to share, to receive
DEFINITION: To share in something with others, to participate in an activity, or to receive a portion of something.
SENSES: 1. To have a part in, to participate or share in something (Acts 2:46; 2 Tim 2:6).
2. To receive as a possession or portion (Acts 24:25).
USAGE: to participate, to share, to receive

THAYER.pt: Compartilhar de algo com outros, participar de uma atividade ou receber uma porção de algo. 1. Ter parte em, participar ou compartilhar de algo (At 2.46; 2Tm 2.6). | 2. Receber como posse ou porção (At 24.25).
THAYER.en: To share in something with others, to participate in an activity, or to receive a portion of something. 1. To have a part in, to participate or share in something (Acts 2:46; 2 Tim 2:6). | 2. To receive as a possession or portion (Acts 24:25).

DEFINITION: The act of sharing, receiving, or enjoying something that is made available.
SENSES: 1. The act of receiving and enjoying with thanksgiving the provisions created by God (1 Tim 4:3).

THAYER.pt: O ato de partilhar, receber ou usufruir de algo que é disponibilizado. 1. O ato de receber e desfrutar com ações de graças dos mantimentos criados por Deus (1Tm 4.3).
THAYER.en: The act of sharing, receiving, or enjoying something that is made available. 1. The act of receiving and enjoying with thanksgiving the provisions created by God (1 Tim 4:3).

DEFINITION: To give one thing in exchange for another, to substitute one element for another, frequently used in a moral and idolatrous context.
SENSES: 1. To exchange the truth or honor for something inadequate (Rom 1:25, 26).

THAYER.pt: Dar uma coisa em troca de outra, substituir um elemento por outro, frequentemente usado no contexto moral e idolátrico. 1. Trocar a verdade ou a honra por algo inadequado (Rm 1:25, 26).
THAYER.en: To give one thing in exchange for another, to substitute one element for another, frequently used in a moral and idolatrous context. 1. To exchange the truth or honor for something inadequate (Rom 1:25, 26).

DEFINITION: Indicates the feeling of deep sorrow or remorse regarding past conduct, often accompanied by the desire that the facts could be undone.
SENSES: 1. To feel deep sorrow or remorse for a committed act (Matt 27:3; 2 Cor 7:8).
2. To change one's mind or disposition about something (Matt 21:29; Heb 7:21).

THAYER.pt: Indica o sentimento de pesar ou remorso profundo em relação a uma conduta passada, muitas vezes acompanhado pelo desejo de que os fatos pudessem ser desfeitos. 1. Sentir profundo pesar ou remorso por um ato cometido (Mt 27.3; 2Co 7.8). | 2. Mudar de ideia ou de disposição sobre algo (Mt 21.29; Hb 7.21).
THAYER.en: Indicates the feeling of deep sorrow or remorse regarding past conduct, often accompanied by the desire that the facts could be undone. 1. To feel deep sorrow or remorse for a committed act (Matt 27:3; 2 Cor 7:8). | 2. To change one's mind or disposition about something (Matt 21:29; Heb 7:21).

DEFINITION: To change the form or outward appearance of something or someone, or to describe a profound inner spiritual transformation.
SENSES: 1. To change the external appearance in a visible way, to transfigure (Matt 17:2; Mark 9:2).
2. To change the fundamental character or inner spiritual condition, to transform (Rom 12:2; 2 Cor 3:18).

THAYER.pt: Mudar a forma ou a aparência exterior de algo ou alguém, ou descrever uma profunda transformação espiritual interior. 1. Mudar a aparência externa de maneira visível, transfigurar (Mt 17.2; Mc 9.2). | 2. Mudar o caráter fundamental ou a condição espiritual interior, transformar (Rm 12.2; 2Co 3.18).
THAYER.en: To change the form or outward appearance of something or someone, or to describe a profound inner spiritual transformation. 1. To change the external appearance in a visible way, to transfigure (Matt 17:2; Mark 9:2). | 2. To change the fundamental character or inner spiritual condition, to transform (Rom 12:2; 2 Cor 3:18).

DEFINITION: To change radically one's mentality and attitude toward sin and righteousness, resulting in a new direction of life.
SENSES: 1. To change one's mind or opinion (Matt 12:41).
2. To feel remorse, to repent, and to convert (Matt 3:2; Acts 2:38).

THAYER.pt: Mudar radicalmente de mentalidade e atitude em relação ao pecado e à justiça, resultando em uma nova direção de vida. 1. Mudar de ideia ou de opinião (Mt 12.41). | 2. Sentir remorso, arrepender-se e converter-se (Mt 3.2; At 2.38).
THAYER.en: To change radically one's mentality and attitude toward sin and righteousness, resulting in a new direction of life. 1. To change one's mind or opinion (Matt 12:41). | 2. To feel remorse, to repent, and to convert (Matt 3:2; Acts 2:38).

DEFINITION: A profound inner transformation of the mind, disposition, and heart before sin and divine sovereignty, resulting in an ethical and moral reorientation of life.
SENSES: 1. Radical change of mind and life in abandonment of sin (Matt 3:8; Luke 3:3).
2. Conversion and sincere return to communion with God (Acts 20:21; Heb 6:1).

THAYER.pt: Transformação interior profunda da mente, disposição e coração perante o pecado e a soberania divina, resultando em reorientação ética e moral da vida. 1. Mudança radical de mente e vida em abandono ao pecado (Mt 3.8; Lc 3.3). | 2. Conversão e retorno sincero para comunhão com Deus (At 20.21; Hb 6.1).
THAYER.en: A profound inner transformation of the mind, disposition, and heart before sin and divine sovereignty, resulting in an ethical and moral reorientation of life. 1. Radical change of mind and life in abandonment of sin (Matt 3:8; Luke 3:3). | 2. Conversion and sincere return to communion with God (Acts 20:21; Heb 6:1).

DEFINITION: A term indicating an intermediate position in space or a temporal succession between two points.
SENSES: 1. In space, situated between two elements or places (Matt 23:35; Luke 16:26).
2. In time, indicating an interval or subsequent moment (John 4:31; Acts 13:42).

THAYER.pt: Termo que indica uma posição intermediária no espaço ou uma sucessão temporal entre dois pontos. 1. No espaço, situado entre dois elementos ou lugares (Mt 23.35; Lc 16.26). | 2. No tempo, indicando um intervalo ou momento subsequente (Jo 4.31; At 13.42).
THAYER.en: A term indicating an intermediate position in space or a temporal succession between two points. 1. In space, situated between two elements or places (Matt 23:35; Luke 16:26). | 2. In time, indicating an interval or subsequent moment (John 4:31; Acts 13:42).

DEFINITION: To send a message or messengers to request the presence of someone; to summon to oneself (used mainly in the middle voice).
SENSES: 1. To send messengers to call or summon someone to one's presence (Acts 10:5, 29).

THAYER.pt: Enviar recado ou mensageiros para solicitar a presença de alguém; convocar para si (usado principalmente na voz média). 1. Enviar mensageiros para chamar ou convocar alguém à sua presença (At 10.5, 29).
THAYER.en: To send a message or messengers to request the presence of someone; to summon to oneself (used mainly in the middle voice). 1. To send messengers to call or summon someone to one's presence (Acts 10:5, 29).

DEFINITION: To captivate or effect a radical change in the condition, state, or meaning of something, often with a connotation of distortion.
SENSES: 1. To transform or drastically alter appearance or condition (Acts 2:20).
2. To pervert, corrupt, or distort the true meaning of something, such as the gospel (Gal 1:7; Jas 4:9).

THAYER.pt: Cativar ou efetuar uma mudança radical na condição, estado ou sentido de algo, muitas vezes com conotação de distorção. 1. Transformar ou alterar drasticamente a aparência ou condição (At 2.20). | 2. Perverter, corromper ou distorcer o sentido verdadeiro de algo, como o evangelho (Gl 1.7; Tg 4.9).
THAYER.en: To captivate or effect a radical change in the condition, state, or meaning of something, often with a connotation of distortion. 1. To transform or drastically alter appearance or condition (Acts 2:20). | 2. To pervert, corrupt, or distort the true meaning of something, such as the gospel (Gal 1:7; Jas 4:9).

DEFINITION: To change the external form or appearance of something or someone, which may involve disguise or the figurative application of a principle to another situation.
SENSES: 1. To change form or transform outwardly (Phil 3:21).
2. To change appearance or disguise oneself (2 Cor 11:14).
3. To apply figuratively to oneself or another (1 Cor 4:6).

THAYER.pt: Mudar a forma ou aparência exterior de algo ou alguém, podendo envolver disfarce ou a aplicação figurada de um princípio a outra situação. 1. Mudar a forma ou transformar exteriormente (Fp 3.21). | 2. Mudar a aparência ou disfarçar a si mesmo (2Co 11.14). | 3. Aplicar figuradamente a si mesmo ou a outro (1Co 4.6).
THAYER.en: To change the external form or appearance of something or someone, which may involve disguise or the figurative application of a principle to another situation. 1. To change form or transform outwardly (Phil 3:21). | 2. To change appearance or disguise oneself (2 Cor 11:14). | 3. To apply figuratively to oneself or another (1 Cor 4:6).

DEFINITION: Means to move something or someone from one place to another, to alter a state or condition, or to turn away from a previous loyalty.
SENSES: 1. To physically transport or transfer from one place to another (Acts 7:16; Heb 11:5).
2. To alter or modify laws, states, or conditions (Heb 7:12).
3. To turn away or apostatize from a loyalty (Gal 1:6).

THAYER.pt: Significa mudar algo ou alguém de um lugar para outro, alterar um estado ou condição, ou ainda afastar-se de uma lealdade prévia. 1. Transportar ou transferir fisicamente de um lugar para outro (At 7.16; Hb 11.5). | 2. Alterar ou modificar leis, estados ou condições (Hb 7.12). | 3. Desviar-se ou apostatar de uma lealdade (Gl 1.6).
THAYER.en: Means to move something or someone from one place to another, to alter a state or condition, or to turn away from a previous loyalty. 1. To physically transport or transfer from one place to another (Acts 7:16; Heb 11:5). | 2. To alter or modify laws, states, or conditions (Heb 7:12). | 3. To turn away or apostatize from a loyalty (Gal 1:6).

DEFINITION: Indicates a point in time that chronologically follows another.
SENSES: 1. An event or consequence that occurs at a later time (Heb 12:17).

THAYER.pt: Indica um ponto no tempo que se sucede cronologicamente a outro. 1. Acontecimento ou consequência que se verifica em momento posterior (Hb 12.17).
THAYER.en: Indicates a point in time that chronologically follows another. 1. An event or consequence that occurs at a later time (Heb 12:17).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: μεθέξω, Aor: μετέσχον, Perf: μετέσχηκα
DEFINITION: To have a part in something along with others, to participate in an activity, condition, or to share food and drink.
SENSES: 1. To participate or have a part in something (1 Cor 9:12; Heb 2:14).
2. To share in food or drink (1 Cor 10:21; Heb 5:13).

THAYER.pt: Ter parte em algo juntamente com outros, participar de uma atividade, condição ou partilhar de alimentos e bebidas. 1. Participar ou ter parte em algo (1Co 9.12; Hb 2.14). | 2. Compartilhar de alimentos ou bebidas (1Co 10.21; Hb 5.13).
THAYER.en: To have a part in something along with others, to participate in an activity, condition, or to share food and drink. 1. To participate or have a part in something (1 Cor 9:12; Heb 2:14). | 2. To share in food or drink (1 Cor 10:21; Heb 5:13).

DEFINITION: To be excessively preoccupied, anxious, or have one's mind divided by uncertainties regarding the future.
SENSES: 1. To remain in a state of anxiety or excessive worry about material needs (Luke 12:29).

THAYER.pt: Estar excessivamente preocupado, ansioso ou com a mente dividida por incertezas quanto ao futuro. 1. Manter-se em estado de ansiedade ou preocupação excessiva com as necessidades materiais (Lc 12.29).
THAYER.en: To be excessively preoccupied, anxious, or have one's mind divided by uncertainties regarding the future. 1. To remain in a state of anxiety or excessive worry about material needs (Luke 12:29).

DEFINITION: The forced removal or migration of a people from their homeland to another place, specifically used in the context of Israel's history.
SENSES: 1. The historical event of deportation into exile (Matt 1:11).

THAYER.pt: A remoção forçada ou migração de um povo de sua terra natal para outro lugar, especificamente usada no contexto da história de Israel. 1. O evento histórico da deportação para o exílio (Mt 1.11).
THAYER.en: The forced removal or migration of a people from their homeland to another place, specifically used in the context of Israel's history. 1. The historical event of deportation into exile (Matt 1:11).

DEFINITION: To cause someone to change their place of dwelling, frequently associated with exile or forced deportation.
SENSES: 1. To transfer or deport populations to another region (Acts 7:4, 43).

THAYER.pt: Fazer com que alguém mude de local de habitação, frequentemente associado ao exílio ou deportação forçada. 1. Transferir ou deportar populações para outra região (Ac 7:4, 43).
THAYER.en: To cause someone to change their place of dwelling, frequently associated with exile or forced deportation. 1. To transfer or deport populations to another region (Acts 7:4, 43).

DEFINITION: A relationship involving the mutual sharing of purposes, activities, or nature.
SENSES: 1. Joint participation or close association between opposing realities (2 Cor 6:14).

THAYER.pt: Relação que envolve compartilhamento mútuo de propósitos, atividades ou natureza. 1. Participação conjunta ou associação estreita entre realidades opostas (2Co 6.14).
THAYER.en: A relationship involving the mutual sharing of purposes, activities, or nature. 1. Joint participation or close association between opposing realities (2 Cor 6:14).

DEFINITION: Describes one who shares something in common with others, participating in the same activity, privilege, or enterprise.
SENSES: 1. One who partakes in a spiritual gift or heavenly calling (Heb 3:1, 14).
2. Companion or partner in an enterprise or trade (Luke 5:7).

THAYER.pt: Descreve aquele que compartilha de algo em comum com outros, participando de uma mesma atividade, privilégio ou empreendimento. 1. Aquele que participa de uma dádiva espiritual ou chamada celestial (Hb 3.1, 14). | 2. Companheiro ou sócio em um empreendimento ou ofício (Lc 5.7).
THAYER.en: Describes one who shares something in common with others, participating in the same activity, privilege, or enterprise. 1. One who partakes in a spiritual gift or heavenly calling (Heb 3:1, 14). | 2. Companion or partner in an enterprise or trade (Luke 5:7).

DEFINITION: The act of determining the spatial dimensions of something or, figuratively, of evaluating and distributing portions.
SENSES: 1. To measure the physical dimensions of an object or place (Rev 11:1).
2. To distribute or apportion based on measure (Matt 7:2).

THAYER.pt: Ato de determinar as dimensões espaciais de algo ou, figuradamente, de avaliar e distribuir porções. 1. Medir as dimensões físicas de um objeto ou lugar (Ap 11.1). | 2. Distribuir ou repartir com base em medida (Mt 7.2).
THAYER.en: The act of determining the spatial dimensions of something or, figuratively, of evaluating and distributing portions. 1. To measure the physical dimensions of an object or place (Rev 11:1). | 2. To distribute or apportion based on measure (Matt 7:2).

DEFINITION: A unit of measure for liquids equivalent to approximately forty liters or nine gallons.
SENSES: 1. A standard measure used to evaluate the volume of liquids in jars (John 2:6).

THAYER.pt: Unidade de medida para líquidos equivalente a aproximadamente quarenta litros ou nove galões. 1. Medida padrão utilizada para avaliar volume de líquidos em talhas (Jo 2.6).
THAYER.en: A unit of measure for liquids equivalent to approximately forty liters or nine gallons. 1. A standard measure used to evaluate the volume of liquids in jars (John 2:6).

DEFINITION: Means to be moderate in feelings or to deal gently and patiently with the errors of others.
SENSES: 1. To be moderate regarding feelings and to treat the ignorant and wayward with compassion (Heb 5:2).

THAYER.pt: Significa ser moderado nos sentimentos ou lidar com brandura e paciência com os erros dos outros. 1. Ser moderado em relação aos sentimentos e tratar os ignorantes e errantes com compaixão (Hb 5.2).
THAYER.en: Means to be moderate in feelings or to deal gently and patiently with the errors of others. 1. To be moderate regarding feelings and to treat the ignorant and wayward with compassion (Heb 5:2).

DEFINITION: Indicates a moderate degree of an action or state, although it can acquire special emphasis when accompanied by negation.
SENSES: 1. In a moderate manner or to a considerable degree (Acts 20:12).

THAYER.pt: Indica um grau moderado de uma ação ou estado, embora possa adquirir ênfase especial quando acompanhado de negação. 1. De maneira moderada ou em grau considerável (At 20.12).
THAYER.en: Indicates a moderate degree of an action or state, although it can acquire special emphasis when accompanied by negation. 1. In a moderate manner or to a considerable degree (Acts 20:12).

DEFINITION: A measuring instrument or the exact quantity resulting from the measuring process, applying to both physical dimensions and spiritual proportions.
SENSES: 1. An instrument or standard used to measure dimensions or capacities (Matt 7:2; Rev 21:17).
2. Quantity, portion, or determined degree of something (Rom 12:3; Eph 4:7).

THAYER.pt: Instrumento de medição ou a quantidade exata resultante do processo de medir, aplicando-se tanto a dimensões físicas quanto a proporções espirituais. 1. Instrumento ou padrão utilizado para medir dimensões ou capacidades (Mt 7.2; Ap 21.17). | 2. Quantidade, porção ou grau determinado de algo (Rm 12.3; Ef 4.7).
THAYER.en: A measuring instrument or the exact quantity resulting from the measuring process, applying to both physical dimensions and spiritual proportions. 1. An instrument or standard used to measure dimensions or capacities (Matt 7:2; Rev 21:17). | 2. Quantity, portion, or determined degree of something (Rom 12:3; Eph 4:7).

DEFINITION: The upper front part of the human head, situated just above the eyes.
SENSES: 1. The human forehead or brow (Rev 7:3; 13:16).

THAYER.pt: A parte frontal superior da cabeça humana, situada logo acima dos olhos. 1. A testa ou fronte humana (Ap 7.3; 13.16).
THAYER.en: The upper front part of the human head, situated just above the eyes. 1. The human forehead or brow (Rev 7:3; 13:16).

SHORT_GLOSS: as far as, until, up to
DEFINITION: Functions as a limit marker indicating spatial extension, temporal continuity, or the maximum degree reached by an action or state.
SENSES: 1. Spatial extension up to a certain point (Acts 20:4).
2. Temporal continuity up to a specific moment, until (Matt 11:23).
3. Limit of degree or intensity, to the point of (Phil 2:8; Heb 12:4).
USAGE: as far as, until, up to

THAYER.pt: Funciona como um marcador de limite que indica extensão espacial, continuidade temporal ou grau máximo alcançado por uma ação ou estado. 1. Extensão espacial até determinado ponto (At 20.4). | 2. Continuidade temporal até um momento específico, até (Mt 11.23). | 3. Limite de grau ou intensidade, ao ponto de (Fp 2.8; Hb 12.4).
THAYER.en: Functions as a limit marker indicating spatial extension, temporal continuity, or the maximum degree reached by an action or state. 1. Spatial extension up to a certain point (Acts 20:4). | 2. Temporal continuity up to a specific moment, until (Matt 11:23). | 3. Limit of degree or intensity, to the point of (Phil 2:8; Heb 12:4).

DEFINITION: Subjective negative particle used with non-indicative moods (subjunctive, imperative, optative, infinitive, and participles). Denotes negation associated with will, hesitation, prohibition, doubt, or contingency.
SENSES: 1. Negation in prohibitions and negative commands with the subjunctive or imperative (Matt 6:19; John 14:1).
2. In conditional, concessive, and purpose clauses ('that not', 'lest') (Matt 7:1; Mark 13:5).
3. In questions cautiously expecting a negative answer ('surely not... ?') (Matt 7:9; John 7:47).

THAYER.pt: Partícula negativa subjetiva utilizada com modos não-indicativos (subjuntivo, imperativo, optativo, infinitivo e particípios). Denota negação associada à vontade, hesitação, proibição, dúvida ou contingência. 1. Negação em proibições e mandamentos negativos com subjuntivo ou imperativo (Mt 6.19; Jo 14.1). | 2. Em orações condicionais, concessivas e de finalidade ('para que não', 'a fim de não') (Mt 7.1; Mc 13.5). | 3. Em perguntas que esperam cautelosamente uma resposta negativa ('porventura...?') (Mt 7.9; Jo 7.47).
THAYER.en: Subjective negative particle used with non-indicative moods (subjunctive, imperative, optative, infinitive, and participles). Denotes negation associated with will, hesitation, prohibition, doubt, or contingency. 1. Negation in prohibitions and negative commands with the subjunctive or imperative (Matt 6:19; John 14:1). | 2. In conditional, concessive, and purpose clauses ('that not', 'lest') (Matt 7:1; Mark 13:5). | 3. In questions cautiously expecting a negative answer ('surely not... ?') (Matt 7:9; John 7:47).

DEFINITION: Negative conditional conjunctive locution that establishes a restriction or indispensable exception for an event to occur.
SENSES: 1. Marking a negative condition that prevents the main event from happening if not fulfilled (Matt 8:2; Luke 6:33).

THAYER.pt: Locução conjuntiva condicional negativa que estabelece uma restrição ou exceção indispensável para que um evento ocorra. 1. Marcar uma condição negativa que impede a realização do evento principal se não for cumprida (Mt 8.2; Lc 6.33).
THAYER.en: Negative conditional conjunctive locution that establishes a restriction or indispensable exception for an event to occur. 1. Marking a negative condition that prevents the main event from happening if not fulfilled (Matt 8:2; Luke 6:33).

DEFINITION: Negative final or consecutive conjunctive locution expressing the objective of avoiding a certain result or action.
SENSES: 1. Indicating the negative purpose of preventing something from happening (Luke 22:15; 2 Cor 2:4).

THAYER.pt: Locução conjuntiva final ou consecutiva negativa que expressa o objetivo de evitar um determinado resultado ou ação. 1. Indicar o propósito negativo de evitar que algo aconteça (Lk 22.15; 2Co 2.4).
THAYER.en: Negative final or consecutive conjunctive locution expressing the objective of avoiding a certain result or action. 1. Indicating the negative purpose of preventing something from happening (Luke 22:15; 2 Cor 2:4).

DEFINITION: Basic negative particle used to express an objective, direct, and factual negation of a statement or fact in the New Testament.
SENSES: 1. Indicator of factual or categorical negation (Matt 5:37; John 1:21).

THAYER.pt: Partícula negativa básica usada para expressar uma negação objetiva, direta e factual de uma declaração ou fato no Novo Testamento. 1. Indicador de negação factual ou categórica (Mt 5.37; Jo 1.21).
THAYER.en: Basic negative particle used to express an objective, direct, and factual negation of a statement or fact in the New Testament. 1. Indicator of factual or categorical negation (Matt 5:37; John 1:21).

DEFINITION: Emphatic negative particle used to express strong rejection or refusal of an idea.
SENSES: 1. By no means, in no way (Acts 10:14).

THAYER.pt: Partícula negativa enfática usada para expressar forte rejeição ou recusa a uma ideia. 1. De maneira nenhuma, de modo algum (Ac 10:14).
THAYER.en: Emphatic negative particle used to express strong rejection or refusal of an idea. 1. By no means, in no way (Acts 10:14).

DEFINITION: Copulative particle that extends a preceding negation or introduces an emphatic gradation of exclusion.
SENSES: 1. Continuing a previous negation by linking negative elements (1 Cor 6:9).
2. Not even, not even to a minimal degree (Mark 2:2; Acts 19:2).

THAYER.pt: Partícula copulativa que prolonga uma negação precedente ou introduz uma gradação enfática de exclusão. 1. Continuar uma negação anterior ligando elementos negativos (1Co 6.9). | 2. Nem sequer, nem mesmo em grau mínimo (Mc 2.2; At 19.2).
THAYER.en: Copulative particle that extends a preceding negation or introduces an emphatic gradation of exclusion. 1. Continuing a previous negation by linking negative elements (1 Cor 6:9). | 2. Not even, not even to a minimal degree (Mark 2:2; Acts 19:2).

DEFINITION: Emphatic pronominal or adjective that universally negates in the subjective mood (with imperative, subjunctive, or infinitive), indicating the total non-existence of a person, thing, or circumstance.
SENSES: 1. No one, no individual (Matt 8:4; Mark 5:43; Acts 10:20).
2. Nothing, anything whatever in the neuter gender (μηδέν) (Mark 6:8; Luke 3:13; 1 Tim 6:4).
3. As an adjective: no (Acts 13:28; 27:22).

THAYER.pt: Pronominal ou adjetivo enfático que nega universalmente no modo subjetivo (com imperativo, subjuntivo ou infinitivo), indicando a total inexistência de uma pessoa, coisa ou circunstância. 1. Ninguém, nenhum indivíduo (Mt 8.4; Mc 5.43; At 10.20). | 2. Nada, coisa alguma no gênero neutro (μηδέν) (Mc 6.8; Lc 3.13; 1Tm 6.4). | 3. Como adjetivo: nenhuma (At 13.28; 27.22).
THAYER.en: Emphatic pronominal or adjective that universally negates in the subjective mood (with imperative, subjunctive, or infinitive), indicating the total non-existence of a person, thing, or circumstance. 1. No one, no individual (Matt 8:4; Mark 5:43; Acts 10:20). | 2. Nothing, anything whatever in the neuter gender (μηδέν) (Mark 6:8; Luke 3:13; 1 Tim 6:4). | 3. As an adjective: no (Acts 13:28; 27:22).

DEFINITION: An adverb of time expressing absolute negation regarding any moment, past or future.
SENSES: 1. At no time or in no way (2 Tim 3:7).

THAYER.pt: Um advérbio de tempo que expressa negação absoluta em relação a qualquer momento, passado ou futuro. 1. Em nenhum momento ou de jeito nenhum (2Tm 3.7).
THAYER.en: An adverb of time expressing absolute negation regarding any moment, past or future. 1. At no time or in no way (2 Tim 3:7).

DEFINITION: Indicates the negation of the extension of time up to an expected point, meaning that something has not yet happened.
SENSES: 1. Not yet, up to the present moment not (Heb 11:7).

THAYER.pt: Indica a negação da extensão do tempo até um ponto esperado, significando que algo ainda não aconteceu. 1. Ainda não, até o momento presente não (Hb 11.7).
THAYER.en: Indicates the negation of the extension of time up to an expected point, meaning that something has not yet happened. 1. Not yet, up to the present moment not (Heb 11:7).

DEFINITION: Designates a native inhabitant of the region of Media, mentioned in the context of Pentecost.
SENSES: 1. A native or inhabitant of Media (Acts 2:9).

THAYER.pt: Designa um habitante nativo da região da Média, mencionado no contexto do Pentecoste. 1. Um nativo ou habitante da Média (At 2.9).
THAYER.en: Designates a native inhabitant of the region of Media, mentioned in the context of Pentecost. 1. A native or inhabitant of Media (Acts 2:9).

DEFINITION: Negative particle used in contexts of volition, prohibition, purpose, or hypothesis, indicating that a certain temporal action should no longer continue.
SENSES: 1. No more, never again, cessation of a prior action (Mark 1:45; John 5:14).
2. In final clauses of moral purpose (Eph 4:28; 2 Cor 5:15).

THAYER.pt: Partícula negativa empregada em contextos de volição, proibição, propósito ou hipótese, indicando que determinada ação temporal não deve mais continuar. 1. Não mais, nunca mais, cessação de uma ação prévia (Mc 1.45; Jo 5.14). | 2. Em orações finais de propósito moral (Ef 4.28; 2Co 5.15).
THAYER.en: Negative particle used in contexts of volition, prohibition, purpose, or hypothesis, indicating that a certain temporal action should no longer continue. 1. No more, never again, cessation of a prior action (Mark 1:45; John 5:14). | 2. In final clauses of moral purpose (Eph 4:28; 2 Cor 5:15).

DEFINITION: The linear measure of spatial extent of an object or space, whether in a literal or figurative sense.
SENSES: 1. Extent of length, used to describe spiritual or spatial dimensions (Eph 3:18; Rev 21:16).

THAYER.pt: A medida linear de extensão espacial de um objeto ou espaço, seja em sentido literal ou figurado. 1. Extensão de comprimento, usada para descrever as dimensões espirituais ou espaciais (Ef 3.18; Ap 21.16).
THAYER.en: The linear measure of spatial extent of an object or space, whether in a literal or figurative sense. 1. Extent of length, used to describe spiritual or spatial dimensions (Eph 3:18; Rev 21:16).

DEFINITION: Refers to the act of causing to grow or lengthen, often used for the development of plants.
SENSES: 1. To grow or sprout, extending in length (Mk 4:27).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se ao ato de fazer crescer ou alongar, sendo usado para o desenvolvimento de plantas. 1. Crescer ou brotar, estendendo-se em comprimento (Mc 4.27).
THAYER.en: Refers to the act of causing to grow or lengthen, often used for the development of plants. 1. To grow or sprout, extending in length (Mk 4:27).

DEFINITION: Refers to a sheepskin tanned with the wool, often associated with the austere clothing of prophets.
SENSES: 1. A garment made of sheepskin or ram skin (Heb 11:37).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se a uma pele de ovelha curtida com a lã, frequentemente associada ao vestuário austero de profetas. 1. Uma veste feita de pele de ovelha ou carneiro (Hb 11.37).
THAYER.en: Refers to a sheepskin tanned with the wool, often associated with the austere clothing of prophets. 1. A garment made of sheepskin or ram skin (Heb 11:37).

DEFINITION: A unit of time measured by the lunar cycle, or the festival associated with the new moon.
SENSES: 1. A period of time corresponding to a month (Lk 1:26); 2. The festival of the new moon (Gal 4:10).

THAYER.pt: Unidade de tempo medida pelo ciclo lunar, ou o festival associado à lua nova. 1. Um período de tempo correspondente a um mês (Lc 1.26); 2. A festa da lua nova (Gl 4.10).
THAYER.en: A unit of time measured by the lunar cycle, or the festival associated with the new moon. 1. A period of time corresponding to a month (Lk 1:26); 2. The festival of the new moon (Gal 4:10).

DEFINITION: A unit of temporal measurement based on the complete cycle of lunar phases, corresponding to a month in the calendar.
SENSES: 1. A period of time corresponding to a month (Lk 1:26).
2. Festivity or period associated with the new moon (Gal 4:10).

THAYER.pt: Unidade de medida temporal baseada no ciclo completo das fases lunares, correspondendo a um mês no calendário. 1. Um período de tempo correspondente a um mês (Lc 1.26). | 2. Festividade ou período associado à lua nova (Gl 4.10).
THAYER.en: A unit of temporal measurement based on the complete cycle of lunar phases, corresponding to a month in the calendar. 1. A period of time corresponding to a month (Lk 1:26). | 2. Festivity or period associated with the new moon (Gal 4:10).

DEFINITION: To provide information about something, especially with the emphasis on bringing to light facts that were unknown or kept secret.
SENSES: 1. To report or give official or confidential information (Lk 20:37; Acts 23:30).

THAYER.pt: Fornecer informações sobre algo, especialmente com a ênfase de trazer à luz fatos que eram desconhecidos ou mantidos em segredo. 1. Relatar ou dar informações oficiais ou confidenciais (Lc 20.37; At 23.30).
THAYER.en: To provide information about something, especially with the emphasis on bringing to light facts that were unknown or kept secret. 1. To report or give official or confidential information (Lk 20:37; Acts 23:30).

DEFINITION: A particle of subjective or hypothetical negation, frequently used in conditional, imperative, interrogative, and purpose clauses.
SENSES: 1. Indicator of hypothetical or conditional negation (Mt 5:20).
2. Conjunction indicating negative purpose or fear, translated as 'lest' or 'that not' (Mt 7:1; 24:4).

THAYER.pt: Partícula de negação subjetiva ou hipotética, usada frequentemente em orações condicionais, imperativas, interrogativas e de finalidade. 1. Indicador de negação hipotética ou condicional (Mt 5.20). | 2. Conjunção indicando propósito negativo ou receio, traduzida por 'para que não' ou 'lest' (Mt 7.1; 24.4).
THAYER.en: A particle of subjective or hypothetical negation, frequently used in conditional, imperative, interrogative, and purpose clauses. 1. Indicator of hypothetical or conditional negation (Mt 5:20). | 2. Conjunction indicating negative purpose or fear, translated as 'lest' or 'that not' (Mt 7:1; 24:4).

DEFINITION: A particle used to indicate negative purpose (that not) or to express uncertainty and possibility.
SENSES: 1. That not, in order that not (Lk 21:34); 2. Perhaps, by chance, if by chance (Heb 9:17).

THAYER.pt: Partícula usada para indicar finalidade negativa (para que não) ou para expressar incerteza e possibilidade. 1. Para que não, a fim de que não (Lc 21.34); 2. Porventura, acaso, se por acaso (Hb 9.17).
THAYER.en: A particle used to indicate negative purpose (that not) or to express uncertainty and possibility. 1. That not, in order that not (Lk 21:34); 2. Perhaps, by chance, if by chance (Heb 9:17).

DEFINITION: An adverb that denies the occurrence of an event or state up to a certain point in time.
SENSES: 1. To indicate that something has not yet happened or has not yet manifested (Heb 9:8).

THAYER.pt: Advérbio que nega a ocorrência de um evento ou estado até um determinado ponto no tempo. 1. Indicar que algo ainda não aconteceu ou não se manifestou (Hb 9:8).
THAYER.en: An adverb that denies the occurrence of an event or state up to a certain point in time. 1. To indicate that something has not yet happened or has not yet manifested (Heb 9:8).

DEFINITION: A subordinating conjunction that expresses apprehension or fear, meaning 'lest' or 'perhaps'.
SENSES: 1. Indicator of fear or undesirable possibility that something might occur (Gal 2:2; 1Th 3:5).

THAYER.pt: Conjunção subordinativa que expressa apreensão ou receio, significando 'para que porventura não' ou 'acaso'. 1. Indicador de receio ou possibilidade indesejada de que algo ocorra (Gl 2.2; 1Ts 3.5).
THAYER.en: A subordinating conjunction that expresses apprehension or fear, meaning 'lest' or 'perhaps'. 1. Indicator of fear or undesirable possibility that something might occur (Gal 2:2; 1Th 3:5).

DEFINITION: The upper part of the human leg, above the knee.
SENSES: 1. The human thigh, where swords or honorary titles were traditionally placed (Rev 19:16).

THAYER.pt: Parte superior da perna humana, acima do joelho. 1. A coxa humana, onde espadas ou títulos honoríficos eram tradicionalmente colocados (Ap 19.16).
THAYER.en: The upper part of the human leg, above the knee. 1. The human thigh, where swords or honorary titles were traditionally placed (Rev 19:16).

DEFINITION: A negative coordinating conjunction used to link elements that are equally negated, equivalent to 'neither... nor'.
SENSES: 1. And not, neither... nor, introducing coordinated negations (Lk 7:33).

THAYER.pt: Conjunção coordenativa negativa usada para ligar elementos que são igualmente negados, equivalente a 'nem... nem'. 1. E não, nem... nem, introduzindo negações coordenadas (Lc 7.33).
THAYER.en: A negative coordinating conjunction used to link elements that are equally negated, equivalent to 'neither... nor'. 1. And not, neither... nor, introducing coordinated negations (Lk 7:33).

DEFINITION: Biological or adoptive female parent of an individual; in a metaphorical sense, it indicates spiritual maternal origin or the archetypal city of the people of God.
SENSES: 1. Biological or adoptive mother (Mt 1:18; Jn 19:26).
2. A woman treated with due maternal affection or honor (Mt 12:49-50; Rom 16:13).
3. Figurative sense of the heavenly community as the origin of the believer (Gal 4:26; Rev 17:5).

THAYER.pt: Genitora biológica ou adotiva de um indivíduo; em sentido metafórico, indica origem maternal espiritual ou a cidade arquetípica do povo de Deus. 1. Mãe biológica ou adotiva (Mt 1.18; Jo 19.26). | 2. Mulher tratada com o devido afeto ou honra maternal (Mt 12.49-50; Rm 16.13). | 3. Sentido figurado da comunidade celestial como origem do fiel (Gl 4.26; Ap 17.5).
THAYER.en: Biological or adoptive female parent of an individual; in a metaphorical sense, it indicates spiritual maternal origin or the archetypal city of the people of God. 1. Biological or adoptive mother (Mt 1:18; Jn 19:26). | 2. A woman treated with due maternal affection or honor (Mt 12:49-50; Rom 16:13). | 3. Figurative sense of the heavenly community as the origin of the believer (Gal 4:26; Rev 17:5).

DEFINITION: An interrogative particle used in questions that logically expect a negative answer. It serves to introduce doubts or rhetorical questions with a tone of negation.
SENSES: 1. Marker in rhetorical questions that expect a negative answer (Mt 7:16; Jn 4:33).

THAYER.pt: Partícula interrogativa usada em perguntas que esperam logicamente uma resposta negativa. Serve para introduzir dúvidas ou questionamentos retóricos com tom de negação. 1. Marcador em perguntas retóricas que aguardam uma resposta negativa (Mt 7.16; Jo 4.33).
THAYER.en: An interrogative particle used in questions that logically expect a negative answer. It serves to introduce doubts or rhetorical questions with a tone of negation. 1. Marker in rhetorical questions that expect a negative answer (Mt 7:16; Jn 4:33).

DEFINITION: An emphatic expression that serves to highlight a contrast or an argument from the lesser to the greater.
SENSES: 1. How much more, with much more reason.

THAYER.pt: Expressão enfática que serve para realçar um contraste ou argumento do menor para o maior. 1. Quanto mais, com muito mais razão.
THAYER.en: An emphatic expression that serves to highlight a contrast or an argument from the lesser to the greater. 1. How much more, with much more reason.

DEFINITION: An interrogative pronoun that expects a negative answer, equivalent to 'perhaps anyone?' or 'could it be that someone?'.
SENSES: 1. Interrogative particle to introduce questions with an expectation of negation (Jn 4:33; 7:48).

THAYER.pt: Pronome interrogativo que espera uma resposta negativa, equivalente a 'porventura algum?' ou 'acaso alguém?'. 1. Partícula interrogativa para introduzir perguntas com expectativa de negação (Jo 4.33; 7.48).
THAYER.en: An interrogative pronoun that expects a negative answer, equivalent to 'perhaps anyone?' or 'could it be that someone?'. 1. Interrogative particle to introduce questions with an expectation of negation (Jn 4:33; 7:48).

DEFINITION: The internal female reproductive organ responsible for gestation, the womb or matrix.
SENSES: 1. The maternal womb or matrix (Lk 2:23; Rom 4:19).

THAYER.pt: Órgão reprodutor feminino interno responsável pela gestação, o ventre ou a matriz. 1. O ventre materno ou a matriz (Lc 2:23; Rm 4:19).
THAYER.en: The internal female reproductive organ responsible for gestation, the womb or matrix. 1. The maternal womb or matrix (Lk 2:23; Rom 4:19).

DEFINITION: A term designating one who commits the heinous crime of murdering their own mother.
SENSES: 1. One who kills their mother, a matricide.

THAYER.pt: Termo que designa aquele que comete o crime hediondo de assassinar a própria mãe. 1. Aquele que mata a mãe, matricida.
THAYER.en: A term designating one who commits the heinous crime of murdering their own mother. 1. One who kills their mother, a matricide.

DEFINITION: Designates the principal city or capital of a province or region.
SENSES: 1. Principal city or capital (Acts 21:39 - secondary textual sense/variant).

THAYER.pt: Designa a cidade principal ou capital de uma província ou região. 1. Cidade principal ou capital (At 21.39 - sentido textual secundário/variante).
THAYER.en: Designates the principal city or capital of a province or region. 1. Principal city or capital (Acts 21:39 - secondary textual sense/variant).

DEFINITION: The feminine form of the cardinal numeral 'one', used for counting or singular emphasis.
SENSES: 1. The cardinal number one in the feminine gender (Mt 5:18; Rev 17:12).

THAYER.pt: Forma feminina do numeral cardinal 'um', usada para contagem ou ênfase singular. 1. O número cardinal um no gênero feminino (Mt 5.18; Ap 17.12).
THAYER.en: The feminine form of the cardinal numeral 'one', used for counting or singular emphasis. 1. The cardinal number one in the feminine gender (Mt 5:18; Rev 17:12).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: μιανῶ; Aor: ἐμίανα; Pass: ἐμιάνθην
DEFINITION: To cause ritual or moral contamination, making someone or something impure, stained, or morally corrupted.
SENSES: 1. To make ceremonially impure or defile (John 18:28).
2. To morally corrupt or violate purity (Jude 1:8).

THAYER.pt: Causar contaminação ritual ou moral, tornando algo ou alguém impuro, manchado ou moralmente corrompido. 1. Tornar cerimonialmente impuro ou manchar (Jo 18.28). | 2. Corromper moralmente ou violar a pureza (Jd 1.8).
THAYER.en: To cause ritual or moral contamination, making someone or something impure, stained, or morally corrupted. 1. To make ceremonially impure or defile (John 18:28). | 2. To morally corrupt or violate purity (Jude 1:8).

DEFINITION: The state of moral and spiritual corruption or contamination resulting from sinful practices.
SENSES: 1. Moral or spiritual pollution resulting from sin (2 Peter 2:20).

THAYER.pt: Estado de corrupção ou contaminação moral e espiritual resultante de práticas pecaminosas. 1. Poluição moral ou espiritual decorrente do pecado (2Pe 2.20).
THAYER.en: The state of moral and spiritual corruption or contamination resulting from sinful practices. 1. Moral or spiritual pollution resulting from sin (2 Peter 2:20).

DEFINITION: The condition of being stained or defiled by evil and moral degradation.
SENSES: 1. Defilement or moral corruption associated with worldly desires (2 Peter 2:10).

THAYER.pt: A condição de estar manchado ou conspurcado pelo mal e pela degradação moral. 1. Defilement ou corrupção moral associada a desejos mundanos (2Pe 2.10).
THAYER.en: The condition of being stained or defiled by evil and moral degradation. 1. Defilement or moral corruption associated with worldly desires (2 Peter 2:10).

DEFINITION: That which results from the combination of different substances or elements.
SENSES: 1. A mixture or compound of substances (John 19:39).

THAYER.pt: Aquilo que resulta da combinação de diferentes substâncias ou elementos. 1. Uma mistura ou composto de substâncias (Jo 19.39).
THAYER.en: That which results from the combination of different substances or elements. 1. A mixture or compound of substances (John 19:39).

DEFINITION: To join or combine different substances, whether liquid or solid, creating a mixture.
SENSES: 1. To mix different elements or liquids (Matthew 27:34; Luke 13:1).

THAYER.pt: Juntar ou combinar diferentes substâncias, sejam líquidas ou sólidas, criando uma mistura. 1. Misturar elementos ou líquidos diferentes (Mt 27.34; Lc 13.1).
THAYER.en: To join or combine different substances, whether liquid or solid, creating a mixture. 1. To mix different elements or liquids (Matthew 27:34; Luke 13:1).

DEFINITION: An expression denoting a small amount of time or space, indicating brevity.
SENSES: 1. A short space of time, briefly (John 16:16; Acts 5:34).

THAYER.pt: Expressão que denota uma pequena quantidade de tempo ou espaço, indicando brevidade. 1. Um curto espaço de tempo, brevemente (Jo 16.16; At 5.34).
THAYER.en: An expression denoting a small amount of time or space, indicating brevity. 1. A short space of time, briefly (John 16:16; Acts 5:34).

DEFINITION: Applies to that which has reduced spatial dimensions, brief duration, or small quantity. In the social and spiritual sphere, it frequently refers to the humble, without prestige, or devoid of importance in the eyes of the world.
SENSES: 1. Diminutive in size, stature, or quantity (Matthew 13:32; Luke 19:3).
2. Brief in temporal duration (John 7:33; 16:16).
3. Of low social status, humble, devoid of earthly influence (Matthew 10:42; Acts 8:10; Revelation 11:18).

THAYER.pt: Aplica-se àquilo que tem dimensões espaciais reduzidas, duração breve ou pouca quantidade. No âmbito social e espiritual, refere-se com frequência aos humildes, sem prestígio ou desprovidos de importância aos olhos do mundo. 1. Diminuto em tamanho, estatura ou quantidade (Mt 13.32; Lc 19.3). | 2. Breve em duração temporal (Jo 7.33; 16.16). | 3. De baixo status social, humilde, desprovido de influência terrena (Mt 10.42; At 8.10; Ap 11.18).
THAYER.en: Applies to that which has reduced spatial dimensions, brief duration, or small quantity. In the social and spiritual sphere, it frequently refers to the humble, without prestige, or devoid of importance in the eyes of the world. 1. Diminutive in size, stature, or quantity (Matthew 13:32; Luke 19:3). | 2. Brief in temporal duration (John 7:33; 16:16). | 3. Of low social status, humble, devoid of earthly influence (Matthew 10:42; Acts 8:10; Revelation 11:18).

DEFINITION: An important port city situated on the western coast of Asia Minor, south of Ephesus, visited by Paul on his journeys.
SENSES: 1. City where Paul met with the elders of the church of Ephesus (Acts 20:15, 17; 2 Timothy 4:20).

THAYER.pt: Importante cidade portuária situada na costa ocidental da Ásia Menor, ao sul de Éfeso, visitada por Paulo em suas viagens. 1. Cidade onde Paulo encontrou-se com os presbíteros da igreja de Éfeso (At 20.15, 17; 2Tm 4.20).
THAYER.en: An important port city situated on the western coast of Asia Minor, south of Ephesus, visited by Paul on his journeys. 1. City where Paul met with the elders of the church of Ephesus (Acts 20:15, 17; 2 Timothy 4:20).

DEFINITION: A Roman unit of distance equivalent to one thousand paces, or about 1.48 kilometers.
SENSES: 1. A Roman mile, standard unit of distance (Matthew 5:41).

THAYER.pt: Medida de distância romana equivalente a mil passos, ou cerca de 1,48 quilômetros. 1. Uma milha romana, medida padrão de distância (Mt 5.41).
THAYER.en: A Roman unit of distance equivalent to one thousand paces, or about 1.48 kilometers. 1. A Roman mile, standard unit of distance (Matthew 5:41).

DEFINITION: To adopt the behavior, attitudes, or lifestyle of someone as a model to be followed.
SENSES: 1. To take someone as a model and imitate their actions or conduct (2 Thessalonians 3:7; Hebrews 13:7).

THAYER.pt: Adotar o comportamento, as atitudes ou o estilo de vida de alguém como modelo a ser seguido. 1. Tomar alguém como modelo e imitar suas ações ou conduta (2Ts 3.7; Hb 13.7).
THAYER.en: To adopt the behavior, attitudes, or lifestyle of someone as a model to be followed. 1. To take someone as a model and imitate their actions or conduct (2 Thessalonians 3:7; Hebrews 13:7).

DEFINITION: Refers to a person who reproduces in their own life the actions, attitudes, and character of another, taking them as a model to be followed.
SENSES: 1. One who imitates the moral and spiritual example of leaders or of God (1Th 1:6; 2:14).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se à pessoa que reproduz em sua própria vida as ações, atitudes e o caráter de outra, tendo-a como modelo a ser seguido. 1. Aquele que imita o exemplo moral e espiritual de líderes ou de Deus (1Ts 1.6; 2.14).
THAYER.en: Refers to a person who reproduces in their own life the actions, attitudes, and character of another, taking them as a model to be followed. 1. One who imitates the moral and spiritual example of leaders or of God (1Th 1:6; 2:14).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Deponent. Fut: μνησθήσομαι, Aor: ἐμνήσθην, Perf: μέμνημαι
DEFINITION: To bring facts, teachings, or persons to memory, often implying a corresponding action or attitude based on that recollection.
SENSES: 1. To recall facts, words, or predictions (Matt 26:75; Luke 24:8).
2. To remember persons with affection, appreciation, or prayer (1Cor 11:2; 2Tim 1:4).
3. For God to remember His covenant or human acts in order to intervene (Luke 1:54; Rev 16:19).

THAYER.pt: Trazer à memória fatos, ensinamentos ou pessoas, muitas vezes implicando uma ação ou atitude correspondente baseada nessa recordação. 1. Recordar fatos, palavras ou predições (Mt 26.75; Lc 24.8). | 2. Lembrar-se de pessoas com afeto, apreço ou oração (1Co 11.2; 2Tm 1.4). | 3. Deus recordar-se de sua aliança ou de atos humanos para intervir (Lc 1.54; Ap 16.19).
THAYER.en: To bring facts, teachings, or persons to memory, often implying a corresponding action or attitude based on that recollection. 1. To recall facts, words, or predictions (Matt 26:75; Luke 24:8). | 2. To remember persons with affection, appreciation, or prayer (1Cor 11:2; 2Tim 1:4). | 3. For God to remember His covenant or human acts in order to intervene (Luke 1:54; Rev 16:19).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: μισήσω, Aor: ἐμίσησα, Perf: μεμίσηκα
DEFINITION: Meaning to harbor strong ill will, aversion, or hostility against someone or something, and can also indicate disfavor in comparison to another affection.
SENSES: 1. To have a strong aversion to or hate persons or things (Matt 5:43; John 3:20).
2. To disfavor or neglect in contrast to preference given to another (Matt 6:24; Luke 16:13).
