THAYER.pt: Significa nutrir forte ojeriza, aversão ou hostilidade contra alguém ou algo, podendo também indicar desfavor em comparação a outro afeto. 1. Ter forte aversão ou odiar pessoas ou coisas (Mt 5.43; Jo 3.20). | 2. Desfavorecer ou negligenciar em contraste com a preferência dada a outro (Mt 6.24; Lc 16.13).
THAYER.en: Meaning to harbor strong ill will, aversion, or hostility against someone or something, and can also indicate disfavor in comparison to another affection. 1. To have a strong aversion to or hate persons or things (Matt 5:43; John 3:20). | 2. To disfavor or neglect in contrast to preference given to another (Matt 6:24; Luke 16:13).

DEFINITION: The payment of wages or due retribution, which can be understood both as a favorable reward for good deeds and as just punishment.
SENSES: 1. The generous reward granted by God to the faithful (Heb 10:35; 11:26).
2. Just retribution in the form of punishment or chastisement for transgressions (Heb 2:2).

THAYER.pt: O pagamento de salários ou a retribuição devida, podendo ser entendida tanto como recompensa favorável por boas obras quanto como punição justa. 1. A recompensa generosa concedida por Deus aos fiéis (Hb 10.35; 11.26). | 2. Retribuição justa na forma de punição ou castigo por transgressões (Hb 2.2).
THAYER.en: The payment of wages or due retribution, which can be understood both as a favorable reward for good deeds and as just punishment. 1. The generous reward granted by God to the faithful (Heb 10:35; 11:26). | 2. Just retribution in the form of punishment or chastisement for transgressions (Heb 2:2).

DEFINITION: One who pays wages or grants just rewards, applied to God in His care for the faithful.
SENSES: 1. One who rewards those who diligently seek Him (Heb 11:6).

THAYER.pt: Aquele que paga salários ou concede recompensas justas, aplicado a Deus em seu cuidado com os fiéis. 1. Aquele que recompensa os que o buscam diligentemente (Hb 11.6).
THAYER.en: One who pays wages or grants just rewards, applied to God in His care for the faithful. 1. One who rewards those who diligently seek Him (Heb 11:6).

DEFINITION: A worker hired to render services in exchange for a stipulated daily wage or salary.
SENSES: 1. An employee or wage-earning worker who performs manual labor (Luke 15:17, 19).

THAYER.pt: Trabalhador contratado para prestar serviços mediante pagamento de diária ou salário estipulado. 1. Empregado ou trabalhador assalariado que presta serviços braçais (Lc 15.17, 19).
THAYER.en: A worker hired to render services in exchange for a stipulated daily wage or salary. 1. An employee or wage-earning worker who performs manual labor (Luke 15:17, 19).

DEFINITION: Remuneration received for work performed or divine reward granted based on the moral quality of an action.
SENSES: 1. Payment or wages due for a service rendered (Matt 20:8; Jas 5:4).
2. Reward or recompense granted by God (Matt 6:2; 1Cor 3:8).

THAYER.pt: Remuneração recebida por um trabalho realizado ou recompensa divina concedida com base na qualidade moral de uma ação. 1. Pagamento ou salário devido por um serviço prestado (Mt 20:8; Tg 5:4). | 2. Recompensa ou galardão concedido por Deus (Mt 6:2; 1Co 3:8).
THAYER.en: Remuneration received for work performed or divine reward granted based on the moral quality of an action. 1. Payment or wages due for a service rendered (Matt 20:8; Jas 5:4). | 2. Reward or recompense granted by God (Matt 6:2; 1Cor 3:8).

DEFINITION: To hire the services of someone for payment or to rent something.
SENSES: 1. To hire workers for a job (Matt 20:1).

THAYER.pt: Contratar os serviços de alguém mediante pagamento ou alugar algo. 1. Contratar trabalhadores para um serviço (Mt 20:1).
THAYER.en: To hire the services of someone for payment or to rent something. 1. To hire workers for a job (Matt 20:1).

DEFINITION: Refers to a dwelling or place maintained by paying rent.
SENSES: 1. Rented lodging or temporary paid residence (Acts 28:30).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se a uma habitação ou local mantido mediante pagamento de aluguel. 1. Alojamento alugado ou residência temporária paga (At 28.30).
THAYER.en: Refers to a dwelling or place maintained by paying rent. 1. Rented lodging or temporary paid residence (Acts 28:30).

DEFINITION: A hired worker who fulfills duties strictly motivated by payment, in contrast to one who has a bond of genuine care.
SENSES: 1. A hired worker or mercenary who tends the flock only for wages, abandoning them in danger (John 10:12, 13).

THAYER.pt: Trabalhador contratado que cumpre suas funções motivado estritamente pelo pagamento, em contraste com quem possui vínculo de verdadeiro cuidado. 1. Trabalhador contratado ou mercenário que cuida do rebanho apenas por salário, abandonando-o no perigo (Jo 10.12, 13).
THAYER.en: A hired worker who fulfills duties strictly motivated by payment, in contrast to one who has a bond of genuine care. 1. A hired worker or mercenary who tends the flock only for wages, abandoning them in danger (John 10:12, 13).

DEFINITION: Principal city of the island of Lesbos in the Aegean Sea, visited by Paul on his journeys.
SENSES: 1. The port city of Mytilene (Acts 20:14).

THAYER.pt: Principal cidade da ilha de Lesbos, no mar Egeu, visitada por Paulo em suas viagens. 1. A cidade portuária de Mitilene (At 20.14).
THAYER.en: Principal city of the island of Lesbos in the Aegean Sea, visited by Paul on his journeys. 1. The port city of Mytilene (Acts 20:14).

DEFINITION: Proper name of Hebrew origin designating the chief archangel or leader of the angels.
SENSES: 1. The archangel Michael (Jude 9; Rev 12:7).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio de origem hebraica que designa o arcanjo principal ou chefe dos anjos. 1. O arcanjo Miguel (Jd 9; Ap 12:7).
THAYER.en: Proper name of Hebrew origin designating the chief archangel or leader of the angels. 1. The archangel Michael (Jude 9; Rev 12:7).

DEFINITION: A Greek monetary unit of great value, equivalent to one hundred drachmas or denarii.
SENSES: 1. A unit of weight and standard currency used in parabolic contexts (Luke 19:13).

THAYER.pt: Unidade monetária grega de grande valor, equivalente a cem dracmas ou denários. 1. Unidade de peso e moeda padrão empregada em contextos parabólicos (Lc 19.13).
THAYER.en: A Greek monetary unit of great value, equivalent to one hundred drachmas or denarii. 1. A unit of weight and standard currency used in parabolic contexts (Luke 19:13).

2. In the context of wooing or proposing marriage (Luke 1:27).
USAGE: to remember, recall, come to mind

THAYER.en: To bring to memory, remember something or someone, or be the object of divine remembrance. 1. To remember something or keep in mind (Matt 26:75; Luke 1:54). | 2. In the context of wooing or proposing marriage (Luke 1:27).

THAYER.en: Proper name of a Christian disciple originally from Cyprus who hosted Paul. 1. Mnason, an early disciple and Christian host (Acts 21:16).

THAYER.en: Refers to the act of recalling someone or something to memory, and can also express verbal mention made of someone in prayers or greetings. 1. Mental remembrance or recollection of someone (2Tim 1:3; Phil 1:3). | 2. Explicit mention or citation of persons, especially in prayers (Rom 1:9; Phlm 4).

SENSES: 1. A sepulcher, tomb, or grave for the dead (Luke 23:53; Rev 11:9).

THAYER.en: A monument or place built for the remembrance and burial of the deceased; a sepulcher or grave. 1. A sepulcher, tomb, or grave for the dead (Luke 23:53; Rev 11:9).

SENSES: 1. A commemorative monument or memorial (Luke 11:47).
2. A sepulcher, tomb, or hewn grave (Matt 27:60; Acts 13:29).

THAYER.pt: Construção destinada ao sepultamento de mortos ou monumento erguido em memória de alguém falecido. 1. Monumento comemorativo ou memorial (Lc 11.47). | 2. Sepulcro, tumba ou sepultura escavada (Mt 27.60; At 13.29).
THAYER.en: A construction intended for the burial of the dead or a monument erected in memory of someone deceased. 1. A commemorative monument or memorial (Luke 11:47). | 2. A sepulcher, tomb, or hewn grave (Matt 27:60; Acts 13:29).

DEFINITION: The mental faculty of retaining and recalling past information or events.
SENSES: 1. Remembrance or recollection kept in mind (2Pet 1:15).

THAYER.pt: A faculdade mental de reter e recordar informações ou eventos passados. 1. Lembrança ou recordação mantida na mente (2Pe 1.15).
THAYER.en: The mental faculty of retaining and recalling past information or events. 1. Remembrance or recollection kept in mind (2Pet 1:15).

SHORT_GLOSS: to remember, mention, keep in mind

SENSES: 1. To remember or keep someone or something in mind (Luke 17:32; Heb 13:7).
2. To make mention or remember expressly in words (Heb 11:22).

THAYER.pt: Trazer algo ou alguém à memória, mantendo presente no pensamento ou fazendo menção explícita em discurso. 1. Recordar-se ou manter na memória alguém ou algo (Lc 17.32; Hb 13.7). | 2. Fazer menção ou lembrar expressamente em palavras (Hb 11.22).
THAYER.en: To bring something or someone to memory, keeping it present in thought or making explicit mention in discourse. 1. To remember or keep someone or something in mind (Luke 17:32; Heb 13:7). | 2. To make mention or remember expressly in words (Heb 11:22).

THAYER.pt: Designa um memorial ou algo que serve para preservar a lembrança de alguém ou de um evento perante Deus e os homens. 1. Ato ou lembrança mantida em mente (Mt 26.13; Mc 14.9). | 2. Oferta ou ação que serve de memorial diante de Deus (At 10.4).
THAYER.en: Designates a memorial or something that serves to preserve the remembrance of someone or an event before God and humans. 1. An act or remembrance kept in mind (Matt 26:13; Mark 14:9). | 2. An offering or action that serves as a memorial before God (Acts 10:4).

DEFINITION: Meaning to promise in marriage, become engaged, or formally commit in matrimony.
SENSES: 1. To be promised in marriage or betrothed (Matt 1:18; Luke 1:27; Luke 2:5).

THAYER.en: Meaning to promise in marriage, become engaged, or formally commit in matrimony. 1. To be promised in marriage or betrothed (Matt 1:18; Luke 1:27; Luke 2:5).

DEFINITION: Describes someone who has a severe speech impediment, producing hoarse or confused sounds.
SENSES: 1. A person with a speech disability or a hoarse, halting speech (Mark 7:32).

THAYER.en: Describes someone who has a severe speech impediment, producing hoarse or confused sounds. 1. A person with a speech disability or a hoarse, halting speech (Mark 7:32).

THAYER.pt: Indica que uma ação foi realizada com muito esforço ou quase não pôde ser concretizada. 1. Com muita dificuldade, escassamente (Lc 9.39; At 14.18).
THAYER.en: Indicates that an action was performed with great effort or could hardly be accomplished. 1. With great difficulty, scarcely (Luke 9:39; Acts 14:18).

DEFINITION: A dry measure of capacity, equivalent to about 8.7 liters, frequently used in parables.
SENSES: 1. A container or grain measure used for crops (Matt 5:15; Mark 4:21; Luke 11:33).

THAYER.pt: Uma medida de capacidade para secos, equivalente a cerca de 8,7 litros, usada frequentemente em parábolas. 1. Recipiente ou medida para cereais usada para grãos (Mt 5.15; Mc 4.21; Lc 11.33).
THAYER.en: A dry measure of capacity, equivalent to about 8.7 liters, frequently used in parables. 1. A container or grain measure used for crops (Matt 5:15; Mark 4:21; Luke 11:33).

DEFINITION: Personal pronoun of the 1st person in the dative case, indicating the beneficiary or indirect object.
SENSES: 1. To me, for me, me (Matt 3:15; John 10:17).

THAYER.pt: Pronome pessoal de 1ª pessoa no caso dativo, indicando o beneficiário ou objeto indireto. 1. A mim, para mim, me (Mt 3.15; Jo 10.17).
THAYER.en: Personal pronoun of the 1st person in the dative case, indicating the beneficiary or indirect object. 1. To me, for me, me (Matt 3:15; John 10:17).

THAYER.pt: Designa literalmente a mulher que comete adultério, sendo também empregada no Novo Testamento em sentido figurado para descrever a infidelidade espiritual contra Deus. 1. Mulher que comete adultério (Rm 7:3; 2Pe 2:14). | 2. Criatura ou povo infiel a Deus, em linguagem figurada (Tg 4:4).
THAYER.en: Literally designates a woman who commits adultery, also used in the New Testament in a figurative sense to describe spiritual infidelity against God. 1. A woman who commits adultery (Rom 7:3; 2Pet 2:14). | 2. A creature or people unfaithful to God, in figurative language (Jas 4:4).

DEFINITION: To practice marital infidelity, engaging in sexual relations with a married person who is not one's own spouse.
SENSES: 1. To commit adultery or violate marital bonds (Matt 5:32; Mark 10:11).

THAYER.pt: Praticar infidelidade conjugal, mantendo relações sexuais com pessoa casada que não seja o próprio cônjuge. 1. Cometer adultério ou violar os laços matrimoniais (Mt 5.32; Mc 10.11).
THAYER.en: To practice marital infidelity, engaging in sexual relations with a married person who is not one's own spouse. 1. To commit adultery or violate marital bonds (Matt 5:32; Mark 10:11).

DEFINITION: Refers to the breaking of the marital covenant through sexual relations outside of marriage.
SENSES: 1. The act of marital infidelity or adultery (Matt 15:19).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se à quebra do pacto conjugal através de relações sexuais fora do casamento. 1. Ato de infidelidade conjugal ou adultério (Mt 15.19).
THAYER.en: Refers to the breaking of the marital covenant through sexual relations outside of marriage. 1. The act of marital infidelity or adultery (Matt 15:19).

DEFINITION: To practice illicit sexual relations with a married person who is not one's own spouse, violating the matrimonial covenant.
SENSES: 1. To commit an act of adultery (Matt 5:27; Jas 2:11).

THAYER.pt: Praticar relação sexual ilícita com pessoa casada que não seja o próprio cônjuge, violando o pacto matrimonial. 1. Cometer ato de adultério (Mt 5.27; Tg 2.11).
THAYER.en: To practice illicit sexual relations with a married person who is not one's own spouse, violating the matrimonial covenant. 1. To commit an act of adultery (Matt 5:27; Jas 2:11).

THAYER.pt: Pessoa que comete adultério, violando a fidelidade conjugal ou, figuradamente, a lealdade espiritual para com Deus. 1. Aquele que comete adultério com a esposa de outrem (Hb 13.4). | 2. Figuradamente, quem é espiritualmente infiel a Deus (Tg 4.4).
THAYER.en: A person who commits adultery, violating marital fidelity or, figuratively, spiritual loyalty toward God. 1. One who commits adultery with another's wife (Heb 13:4). | 2. Figuratively, one who is spiritually unfaithful to God (Jas 4:4).

THAYER.en: Indicates that an action or event was performed with great effort, requiring the overcoming of obstacles, or occurs rarely. 1. To accomplish something with much difficulty and effort (Acts 27:16). | 2. Rarely or only by a narrow margin (Rom 5:7).

THAYER.en: Phoenician and Ammonite deity associated with cruel child sacrifice cults. 1. The pagan god Moloch, mentioned in Old Testament citations (Acts 7:43).

Único em sua categoria, epíteto singular aplicado a Cristo em sua relação com Deus (Jo 3.16; 1Jo 4.9).

Unique in its category, a singular epithet applied to Christ in His relationship with God (John 3:16; 1 John 4:9).

Neuter adverbial use (μόνον): only, solely, merely (Matt 4:4; Gal 2:10).

Spiritually dead, alienated from divine fellowship because of sin (Lk 15:24; Eph 2:1). | 3. Ineffective, inert, devoid of vital value or works (Jas 2:17, 26).

SENSES: 1. To deprive of vitality or consider powerless (Rom 4:19; Heb 11:12).

THAYER.en: To cause the death of something, strip of vitality, or annul the power and influence of a sinful tendency or physical condition. 1. To deprive of vitality or consider powerless (Rom 4:19; Heb 11:12). | 2. To mortify or suppress sinful desires and passions (Col 3:5).

SENSES: 1. The condition of death or the process of yielding to death (2 Cor 4:10).

THAYER.pt: O processo ou o estado de morte, inatividade total ou cessação de vitalidade. 1. A condição de morte ou o processo de entrega à morte (2Co 4:10). | 2. A incapacidade biológica ou o fim da capacidade reprodutiva (Rm 4:19).
THAYER.en: The process or state of death, total inactivity, or cessation of vitality. 1. The condition of death or the process of yielding to death (2 Cor 4:10). | 2. Biological incapacity or the end of reproductive capability (Rom 4:19).

Que está no início da vida, jovem (Tt 2.4).
THAYER.en: Describes something that has existed for a short time, is fresh, or is at the beginning of life. In contrast to the term denoting qualitative newness, this emphasizes youth or chronological recency. 1. Existing for a short time or recent, fresh (Matt 9:17). | 2. At the beginning of life, young (Titus 2:4).

THAYER.en: A piece of metal minted with an officially recognized value for commercial transactions and public circulation. 1. Official currency used for the payment of taxes (Matt 22:19).

THAYER.en: A specialist in the teaching, interpretation, and application of Jewish law (the Torah). 1. A teacher or doctor versed in the Mosaic law (Luke 5:17; Acts 5:34; 1 Tim 1:7).

DEFINITION: The act of enacting laws or the body of laws established by a sovereign authority.

THAYER.en: The act of enacting laws or the body of laws established by a sovereign authority. 1. The divine giving of the law granted to Israel (Rom 9:4).

A Lei de Moisés ou Torá como instrução divina pactual (Mt 5.17; Lk 2.22; Jo 1.17). | 2. As Sagradas Escrituras do Antigo Testamento em sua totalidade (Jo 10.34; 1Co 14.21). | 3. Princípio diretor, força governante interna de ação (Rm 7.21; Rm 8.2).
THAYER.en: Designates a regulatory norm, rule of conduct, or mandatory legal statute. In biblical literature, it refers primarily to the Mosaic Pentateuch, the entire canon of Hebrew Scriptures, or a governing ethical principle. 1. The Law of Moses or Torah as divine covenantal instruction (Matt 5:17; Luke 2:22; John 1:17). | 2. The Holy Scriptures of the Old Testament in their entirety (John 10:34; 1 Cor 14:21). | 3. A guiding principle, an internal governing force of action (Rom 7:21; Rom 8:2).

THAYER.en: Literally to be sick, but used figuratively to denote an unhealthy obsession or morbid desire for controversies. 1. To have an unhealthy obsession or morbid desire for debates (1Tm 6.4).

DEFINITION: Marks the present temporal moment or the immediately current situation of the narrative discourse. In biblical theology, it frequently contrasts the former state of condemnation under the Law with the present era of salvation inaugurated by the Gospel.
SENSES: 1. Strict temporal: at the present moment, right now (Jn 16.32; Ac 12.11).
2. With the definite article: the present time, the present age (Rm 3.26; 8.18).
3. Discursive-logical: therefore, in the present state of affairs (Ac 15.10; 1Co 15.20).

THAYER.pt: Marca o momento temporal presente ou a situação imediatamente atual do discurso narrativo. Temporal estrito: no presente momento, logo agora (Jo 16.32; At 12.11). | 2. Com o artigo definido: o tempo presente, a presente época (Rm 3.26; 8.18). | 3. Discursivo-lógico: sendo assim, na presente situação dos fatos (At 15.10; 1Co 15.20).
THAYER.en: Marks the present temporal moment or the immediately current situation of the narrative discourse. In biblical theology, it frequently contrasts the former state of condemnation under the Law with the present era of salvation inaugurated by the Gospel. 1. Discursive-logical: therefore, in the present state of affairs (Ac 15.10; 1Co 15.20).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Nom. pl: οἱ, αἱ, τά; Gen. sg: τοῦ, τῆς, τοῦ
DEFINITION: The Greek definite article used to individualize, determine, or highlight persons, concepts, and objects. It can also function deictically or demonstratively, in addition to substantivizing adjectives, participles, and entire clauses.
SENSES: 1. Common definite article, determining individual or generic nouns (Matt 1:2; John 1:1).
2. Demonstrative or personal pronominal function, especially with particles (e.g., ὁ δὲ, 'but he') (Matt 13:57; Acts 17:28).
3. Substantivizing function for adjectives, participles, adverbs, or prepositional phrases (e.g., ὁ πιστεύων, 'the one who believes') (John 3:16; Matt 5:4).

THAYER.pt: Artigo definido grego empregado para individualizar, determinar ou destacar pessoas, conceitos e objetos. Pode também funcionar de modo dêitico ou demonstrativo, além de substantivar adjetivos, particípios e orações inteiras. 1. Artigo definido comum, determinando substantivos individuais ou genéricos (Mt 1.2; Jo 1.1). | 2. Função demonstrativa ou pronominal pessoal, especialmente com partículas (ex.: ὁ δὲ, 'mas ele') (Mt 13.57; At 17.28). | 3. Função substantivadora de adjetivos, particípios, advérbios ou frases preposicionadas (ex.: ὁ πιστεύων, 'o que crê') (Jo 3.16; Mt 5.4).
THAYER.en: The Greek definite article used to individualize, determine, or highlight persons, concepts, and objects. It can also function deictically or demonstratively, in addition to substantivizing adjectives, participles, and entire clauses. 1. Common definite article, determining individual or generic nouns (Matt 1:2; John 1:1). | 2. Demonstrative or personal pronominal function, especially with particles (e.g., ὁ δὲ, 'but he') (Matt 13:57; Acts 17:28). | 3. Substantivizing function for adjectives, participles, adverbs, or prepositional phrases (e.g., ὁ πιστεύων, 'the one who believes') (John 3:16; Matt 5:4).

THAYER.en: Ordinal number denoting the eighth position in a temporal, spatial, or hierarchical series. 1. The eighth element of a sequence (Luke 1:59; 2 Pet 2:5; Rev 17:11).

THAYER.en: That which possesses excessive volume or weight, serving as a burden or obstacle that hinders progress. 1. A moral or spiritual weight or burden that obstructs the race of faith (Heb 12:1).

Construir ou erigir uma estrutura física (Mt 7.24; Lc 6.48). | 2. Reconstruir ou restaurar algo (Mt 26.61). | 3. Edificar, fortalecer e edificar espiritualmente a igreja (Mt 16.18).
THAYER.en: Describes the literal action of building or erecting structures, as well as the metaphorical sense of edifying, strengthening, and promoting the spiritual growth of the Christian community. 1. To build or erect a physical structure (Matt 7:24; Luke 6:48). | 2. To rebuild or restore something (Matt 26:61). | 3. To edify, strengthen, and build up the church spiritually (Matt 16:18).

DEFINITION: Refers to the process of building or the resulting structure. In the NT, it is widely used in a metaphorical sense to describe spiritual strengthening, edification, and the growth of the Christian community.
SENSES: 1. The act or process of building physical structures (Matt 24:1).
2. Spiritual edification, strengthening, and mutual encouragement of the community (Rom 15:2; 1 Cor 14:12).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se ao processo de construir ou ao edifício resultante. No NT, é amplamente empregado em sentido metafórico para descrever o fortalecimento espiritual, a edificação e o crescimento da comunidade cristã. 1. O ato ou processo de construir edifícios físicos (Mt 24.1). | 2. Edificação espiritual, fortalecimento e encorajamento mútuo da comunidade (Rm 15.2; 1Co 14.12).
THAYER.en: Refers to the process of building or the resulting structure. In the NT, it is widely used in a metaphorical sense to describe spiritual strengthening, edification, and the growth of the Christian community. 1. The act or process of building physical structures (Matt 24:1). | 2. Spiritual edification, strengthening, and mutual encouragement of the community (Rom 15:2; 1 Cor 14:12).

DEFINITION: The process of building or the figurative result of spiritual edification and strengthening of the community.
SENSES: 1. Edification or construction in a spiritual sense (1 Tim 1:4).

THAYER.pt: O processo de construir ou o resultado figurado de edificação espiritual e fortalecimento da comunidade. 1. Edificação ou construção em sentido espiritual (1Tm 1.4).
THAYER.en: The process of building or the figurative result of spiritual edification and strengthening of the community. 1. Edification or construction in a spiritual sense (1 Tim 1:4).

DEFINITION: To perform the function of an administrator of a property or to manage the resources of others.
SENSES: 1. To act as a steward or manage the business of a house (Luke 16:2).

THAYER.pt: Desempenhar a função de administrador de uma propriedade ou gerenciar recursos alheios. 1. Atuar como despenseiro ou gerenciar os negócios de uma casa (Lc 16.2).
THAYER.en: To perform the function of an administrator of a property or to manage the resources of others. 1. To act as a steward or manage the business of a house (Luke 16:2).

DEFINITION: The management, direction, or arrangement of a house or responsibility, also referring to the salvific plan ordained by God.
SENSES: 1. The charge or responsibility of administering a house or office (1 Cor 9:17; Col 1:25).
2. The sovereign design or divine plan of salvation in history (Eph 1:10; 3:9).

THAYER.pt: A gestão, direção ou arranjo de uma casa ou responsabilidade, referindo-se também ao plano salvífico ordenado por Deus. 1. O encargo ou responsabilidade de administrar uma casa ou cargo (1Co 9.17; Cl 1.25). | 2. O desígnio soberano ou plano divino de salvação na história (Ef 1.10; 3.9).
THAYER.en: The management, direction, or arrangement of a house or responsibility, also referring to the salvific plan ordained by God. 1. The charge or responsibility of administering a house or office (1 Cor 9:17; Col 1:25). | 2. The sovereign design or divine plan of salvation in history (Eph 1:10; 3:9).

DEFINITION: One who has received authority and responsibility to manage a house, properties, finances, or spiritual matters.
SENSES: 1. Administrator or steward of a house or property (Luke 12:42; 1 Cor 4:2).
2. Public treasurer or administrator of spiritual matters and the church (Rom 16:23; 1 Pet 4:10).

THAYER.pt: Aquele que recebeu autoridade e responsabilidade para gerenciar uma casa, propriedades, finanças ou assuntos espirituais. 1. Administrador ou mordomo de uma casa ou propriedade (Lc 12.42; 1Co 4.2). | 2. Tesoureiro público ou administrador de assuntos espirituais e da igreja (Rm 16.23; 1Pe 4.10).
THAYER.en: One who has received authority and responsibility to manage a house, properties, finances, or spiritual matters. 1. Administrator or steward of a house or property (Luke 12:42; 1 Cor 4:2). | 2. Public treasurer or administrator of spiritual matters and the church (Rom 16:23; 1 Pet 4:10).

DEFINITION: A physical residential structure; by sociological and theological extension, the domestic unit, the family lineage, and the temple or redeemed people themselves as a divine dwelling.
SENSES: 1. Residential building, dwelling, material house (Matt 9:6; Mark 2:1).
2. The set of members of a family or the inhabitants of a home, household (Acts 11:14; 1 Cor 1:16).
3. Biological descent, clan, or nation (Matt 10:6; Luke 1:27; Heb 8:8).
4. Sacred sanctuary, temple, or the Church as the living dwelling of God (Matt 21:13; 1 Tim 3:15; 1 Pet 2:5).

THAYER.pt: Uma estrutura habitacional física; por extensão sociológica e teológica, a unidade doméstica, a linhagem familiar e o próprio templo ou povo redimido como habitação divina. 1. Edifício residencial, moradia, casa material (Mt 9.6; Mc 2.1). | 2. O conjunto dos membros de uma família ou os moradores de um lar, household (At 11.14; 1Co 1.16). | 3. Descendência biológica, clã ou nação (Mt 10.6; Lc 1.27; Hb 8.8). | 4. Santuário sagrado, templo ou a Igreja como morada viva de Deus (Mt 21.13; 1Tm 3.15; 1Pe 2.5).
THAYER.en: A physical residential structure; by sociological and theological extension, the domestic unit, the family lineage, and the temple or redeemed people themselves as a divine dwelling. 1. Residential building, dwelling, material house (Matt 9:6; Mark 2:1). | 2. The set of members of a family or the inhabitants of a home, household (Acts 11:14; 1 Cor 1:16). | 3. Biological descent, clan, or nation (Matt 10:6; Luke 1:27; Heb 8:8). | 4. Sacred sanctuary, temple, or the Church as the living dwelling of God (Matt 21:13; 1 Tim 3:15; 1 Pet 2:5).

DEFINITION: The surface of the earth inhabited by humanity, frequently associated with the known world or the Roman Empire.
SENSES: 1. The inhabited earth, the inhabited world (Matt 24:14); 2. The Roman Empire as a political-administrative unit (Luke 2:1); 3. Humanity in general (Rev 12:9).

THAYER.pt: A superfície da terra habitada pela humanidade, frequentemente associada ao mundo conhecido ou ao Império Romano. 1. A terra habitada, o mundo habitado (Mt 24.14); 2. O Império Romano como unidade político-administrativa (Lc 2.1); 3. A humanidade em geral (Ap 12.9).
THAYER.en: The surface of the earth inhabited by humanity, frequently associated with the known world or the Roman Empire. 1. The inhabited earth, the inhabited world (Matt 24:14); 2. The Roman Empire as a political-administrative unit (Luke 2:1); 3. Humanity in general (Rev 12:9).

DEFINITION: One who stays at home taking care of domestic chores and the guarding of the home.
SENSES: 1. Given to the care of the home, zealous for domestic tasks (Titus 2:5).

THAYER.en: One who stays at home taking care of domestic chores and the guarding of the home. 1. Given to the care of the home, zealous for domestic tasks (Titus 2:5).

DEFINITION: A verb that expresses deep compassion and mercy toward the needy or afflicted.
SENSES: 1. To have compassion or mercy on someone.

THAYER.en: A verb that expresses deep compassion and mercy toward the needy or afflicted. 1. To have compassion or mercy on someone.

DEFINITION: Deep demonstration of concern, sensitivity, and compassion in the face of misfortune or the suffering of others.
SENSES: 1. Deep compassion or mercy (Rom 12:1; Phil 2:1; Col 3:12).

THAYER.pt: Demonstração profunda de preocupação, sensibilidade e compaixão diante da infortuna ou sofrimento alheio. 1. Compaixão ou misericórdia profunda (Rm 12.1; Fp 2.1; Cl 3.12).
THAYER.en: Deep demonstration of concern, sensitivity, and compassion in the face of misfortune or the suffering of others. 1. Deep compassion or mercy (Rom 12:1; Phil 2:1; Col 3:12).

DEFINITION: One who possesses deep empathy and compassion in the face of the misery or suffering of others.
SENSES: 1. Compassionate and merciful toward the needy (Luke 6:36; James 5:11).

THAYER.en: One who possesses deep empathy and compassion in the face of the misery or suffering of others. 1. Compassionate and merciful toward the needy (Luke 6:36; James 5:11).

DEFINITION: A pejorative noun designating a person who consumes alcoholic beverages in excess, a drunkard.
SENSES: 1. Excessive consumer of wine, drunkard (Matt 11:19; Luke 7:34).

THAYER.en: A pejorative noun designating a person who consumes alcoholic beverages in excess, a drunkard. 1. Excessive consumer of wine, drunkard (Matt 11:19; Luke 7:34).

THAYER.en: Fermented beverage produced from grape juice, also possessing medicinal uses and apocalyptic symbolism. 1. Fermented grape beverage (John 2:3; Matt 27:34). | 2. Symbol of the judgment and wrath of God in apocalyptic language (Rev 14:10; 19:15).

THAYER.en: Excessive consumption of wine leading to intoxication and debauched behavior. 1. The practice of excessive drinking and dissolute intoxication (1 Pet 4:3).

SENSES: 1. When, at the exact moment that (Lk 6.3).

THAYER.pt: Partícula temporal que indica o momento exato ou a ocasião em que um evento ocorre. 1. Quando, no exato momento em que (Lc 6.3).
THAYER.en: Temporal particle indicating the exact moment or occasion when an event occurs. 1. When, at the exact moment that (Lk 6.3).

SHORT_GLOSS: where, where to, in which place
DEFINITION: Adverb introducing relative clauses indicating spatial position, circumstance, or sphere of action where something is located or happens.
SENSES: 1. Indicator of fixed spatial location: where, in the place where (Mt 6.19-20; Jn 12.26).
2. Indicator of direction toward which one goes: where to, whither (Jn 8.21; Heb 6.20).
3. Circumstantial or causal sense: seeing that, in the situation where (1Co 3.3; Col 3.11).
USAGE: where, where to, in which place

THAYER.pt: Advérbio que introduz orações relativas indicando a posição espacial, circunstância ou esfera de ação em que algo se localiza ou acontece. 1. Indicador de localização espacial fixa: onde, no lugar em que (Mt 6.19-20; Jo 12.26). | 2. Indicador de direção para onde se vai: para onde (Jo 8.21; Hb 6.20). | 3. Sentido circunstancial ou causal: visto que, na situação em que (1Co 3.3; Cl 3.11).
THAYER.en: Adverb introducing relative clauses indicating spatial position, circumstance, or sphere of action where something is located or happens. 1. Indicator of fixed spatial location: where, in the place where (Mt 6.19-20; Jn 12.26). | 2. Indicator of direction toward which one goes: where to, whither (Jn 8.21; Heb 6.20). | 3. Circumstantial or causal sense: seeing that, in the situation where (1Co 3.3; Col 3.11).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Present obsolete, forms based on aorist
DEFINITION: To be visible or manifest to someone's sight, becoming perceptible to the eyes.
SENSES: 1. To become visible or appear before someone (Ac 1.3).

THAYER.pt: Estar visível ou manifestar-se à visão de alguém, tornando-se perceptível aos olhos. 1. Tornar-se visível ou aparecer diante de alguém (At 1.3).
THAYER.en: To be visible or manifest to someone's sight, becoming perceptible to the eyes. 1. To become visible or appear before someone (Ac 1.3).

DEFINITION: An experience of a supernatural character in which a celestial reality or divinity is vividly visualized.
SENSES: 1. A vision or manifestation of divine origin (Lk 1.22; Ac 26.19; 2Co 12.1).

THAYER.pt: Uma experiência de caráter sobrenatural em que uma realidade celestial ou divindade é visualizada de forma vívida. 1. Visão ou manifestação de origem divina (Lc 1.22; At 26.19; 2Co 12.1).
THAYER.en: An experience of a supernatural character in which a celestial reality or divinity is vividly visualized. 1. A vision or manifestation of divine origin (Lk 1.22; Ac 26.19; 2Co 12.1).

DEFINITION: Food prepared by direct action of fire, such as roasted or grilled.
SENSES: 1. Food prepared over fire, such as roasted fish (Lk 24:42).

THAYER.pt: Alimento preparado por ação direta do fogo, como assado ou grelhado. 1. Alimento preparado ao fogo, como peixe assado (Lc 24.42).
THAYER.en: Food prepared by direct action of fire, such as roasted or grilled. 1. Food prepared over fire, such as roasted fish (Lk 24:42).

DEFINITION: The late summer season when fruits ripen, or the ripe fruits themselves ready for consumption.
SENSES: 1. Ripe fruits of the late summer harvest (Rev 18:14).

THAYER.pt: A estação do final do verão em que os frutos amadurecem, ou os próprios frutos maduros prontos para consumo. 1. Frutos maduros da colheita de fim de verão (Ap 18.14).
THAYER.en: The late summer season when fruits ripen, or the ripe fruits themselves ready for consumption. 1. Ripe fruits of the late summer harvest (Rev 18:14).

SHORT_GLOSS: so that, in order that, as
DEFINITION: Conjunction used mainly to introduce purpose clauses, expressing the goal or intent of an action, and less frequently as an adverb indicating manner.
SENSES: 1. Final conjunction: in order that, so that (Mt 2:23; Rom 3:4; Gal 1:4).
2. Adverb of manner: in what manner, as (Lk 24:20).
USAGE: so that, in order that, as

THAYER.pt: Conjunção utilizada principalmente para introduzir orações de finalidade, expressando o objetivo ou propósito de uma ação, e, com menor frequência, como advérbio indicando maneira. 1. Conjunção final: a fim de que, para que (Mt 2.23; Rm 3.4; Gl 1.4). | 2. Advérbio de modo: de que maneira, como (Lc 24.20).
THAYER.en: Conjunction used mainly to introduce purpose clauses, expressing the goal or intent of an action, and less frequently as an adverb indicating manner. 1. Final conjunction: in order that, so that (Mt 2:23; Rom 3:4; Gal 1:4). | 2. Adverb of manner: in what manner, as (Lk 24:20).

DEFINITION: Something vividly visualized, especially a revelation or supernatural manifestation perceived by someone in a visionary state.
SENSES: 1. Extraordinary visual phenomenon or vision received by divine revelation (Acts 7:31; 10:3).

THAYER.pt: Algo visualizado de forma vívida, especialmente uma revelação ou manifestação sobrenatural percebida por alguém em estado de visão. 1. Fenômeno visual extraordinário ou visão recebida por revelação divina (At 7.31; 10.3).
THAYER.en: Something vividly visualized, especially a revelation or supernatural manifestation perceived by someone in a visionary state. 1. Extraordinary visual phenomenon or vision received by divine revelation (Acts 7:31; 10:3).

DEFINITION: That which is seen with the eyes or perceived as a vision of a transcendent nature.
SENSES: 1. Visual appearance or aspect of someone or something (Rev 4:3).
2. Vision or revelation received in a trance or supernatural manner (Rev 9:17).

THAYER.pt: Aquilo que é visto com os olhos ou percebido como uma visão de natureza transcendente. 1. Aparência ou aspecto visual de alguém ou algo (Ap 4.3). | 2. Visão ou revelação recebida em transe ou modo sobrenatural (Ap 9.17).
THAYER.en: That which is seen with the eyes or perceived as a vision of a transcendent nature. 1. Visual appearance or aspect of someone or something (Rev 4:3). | 2. Vision or revelation received in a trance or supernatural manner (Rev 9:17).

DEFINITION: That which possesses the capacity of being seen by the sense of sight.
SENSES: 1. That which belongs to the physical world and can be seen (Col 1:16).

THAYER.pt: Aquilo que possui a capacidade de ser visto pelo sentido da visão. 1. O que pertence ao mundo físico e pode ser visto (Cl 1.16).
THAYER.en: That which possesses the capacity of being seen by the sense of sight. 1. That which belongs to the physical world and can be seen (Col 1:16).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Polyrrhizic verb. Fut: ὄψομαι, Aor: εἶδον, Perf: ἑώρακα, Aor Pass: ὤφθην
DEFINITION: A comprehensive verb ranging from the physical faculty of sight to the intuitive, spiritual, or cognitive perception of reality and divine revelation.
SENSES: 1. To see with physical eyes, catch sight of, witness visually (Mt 8:4; Jn 1:18).
2. To perceive mentally or spiritually; understand, discern (Jn 3:36; Acts 8:23).
3. In the middle/passive voice (ὤφθην): to be seen, appear, manifest in a teophany or revelation (Lk 24:34; 1 Cor 15:5).

THAYER.pt: Verbo abrangente que vai da faculdade física de enxergar à percepção intuitiva, espiritual ou cognitiva da realidade e revelação divina. 1. Enxergar com os olhos físicos, avistar, testemunhar visualmente (Mt 8.4; Jo 1.18). | 2. Perceber mental ou espiritualmente; compreender, discernir (Jo 3.36; At 8.23). | 3. Na voz média/passiva (ὤφθην): ser visto, aparecer, manifestar-se numa teofania ou revelação (Lc 24.34; 1Co 15.5).
THAYER.en: A comprehensive verb ranging from the physical faculty of sight to the intuitive, spiritual, or cognitive perception of reality and divine revelation. 1. To see with physical eyes, catch sight of, witness visually (Mt 8:4; Jn 1:18). | 2. To perceive mentally or spiritually; understand, discern (Jn 3:36; Acts 8:23). | 3. In the middle/passive voice (ὤφθην): to be seen, appear, manifest in a teophany or revelation (Lk 24:34; 1 Cor 15:5).

DEFINITION: A state of strong emotional displeasure or righteous indignation directed against sin and wickedness.
SENSES: 1. Anger or indignation as a human emotional reaction (Mk 3:5; Eph 4:31).
2. God's righteous anger and punitive judgment against sin (Rom 1:18; Col 3:6).

THAYER.pt: Estado de forte desprazer emocional ou indignação justa direcionada contra o pecado e a maldade. 1. Ira ou indignação como reação emocional humana (Mc 3.5; Ef 4.31). | 2. A ira justa e o juízo punitivo de Deus contra o pecado (Rm 1.18; Cl 3.6).
THAYER.en: A state of strong emotional displeasure or righteous indignation directed against sin and wickedness. 1. Anger or indignation as a human emotional reaction (Mk 3:5; Eph 4:31). | 2. God's righteous anger and punitive judgment against sin (Rom 1:18; Col 3:6).

DEFINITION: To cause anger or, more frequently in the New Testament in the passive voice, to become deeply angry, indignant, or enraged at a situation or offense.
SENSES: 1. To become irritated or deeply angry (Mt 5:22; Rev 12:17).

THAYER.pt: Causar ira ou, mais frequentemente no Novo Testamento na voz passiva, ficar profundamente irado, indignado ou encolerizado diante de uma situação ou ofensa. 1. Irritar-se ou ficar profundamente zangado (Mt 5:22; Ap 12:17).
THAYER.en: To cause anger or, more frequently in the New Testament in the passive voice, to become deeply angry, indignant, or enraged at a situation or offense. 1. To become irritated or deeply angry (Mt 5:22; Rev 12:17).

DEFINITION: Having a tendency to get irritated easily, choleric, or impetuous in anger.
SENSES: 1. A person of an irascible temper or given to anger (Tit 1:7).

THAYER.pt: Que tem tendência a irritar-se com facilidade, colérico ou impetuoso na ira. 1. Pessoa de gênio irascível ou dada à ira (Tt 1.7).
THAYER.en: Having a tendency to get irritated easily, choleric, or impetuous in anger. 1. A person of an irascible temper or given to anger (Tit 1:7).

DEFINITION: A unit of length equivalent to the distance between the tips of the middle fingers with arms outstretched horizontally (about 1.85 meters), used in ancient navigation.
SENSES: 1. The nautical unit of measure corresponding to a fathom, used to measure sea depth (Acts 27:28).

THAYER.pt: Medida de comprimento equivalente à distância entre as pontas dos dedos médios com os braços estendidos horizontalmente (cerca de 1,85 metros), usada na marinha antiga. 1. A unidade de medida náutica correspondente a uma braça, usada para medir a profundidade do mar (At 27.28).
THAYER.en: A unit of length equivalent to the distance between the tips of the middle fingers with arms outstretched horizontally (about 1.85 meters), used in ancient navigation. 1. The nautical unit of measure corresponding to a fathom, used to measure sea depth (Acts 27:28).

DEFINITION: To reach out toward something, yearn for a target, or seek a certain purpose. In the New Testament, it occurs frequently in the middle voice (ὀρέγομαι) denoting strong aspiration or deep desire.
SENSES: 1. To yearn to attain a goal or position, such as church leadership (1 Tim 3:1);
2. To desire earnestly something of moral or spiritual value (Heb 11:16).

THAYER.pt: Significa estender-se em direção a algo, ansiar por um alvo ou buscar determinado propósito. No Novo Testamento, ocorre frequentemente na voz média (ὀρέγομαι) denotando forte aspiração ou desejo profundo. 1. Ansiar por alcançar um objetivo ou posição, como a liderança na igreja (1Tm 3.1); | 2. Desejar ardentemente algo de valor moral ou espiritual (Hb 11.16).
THAYER.en: To reach out toward something, yearn for a target, or seek a certain purpose. In the New Testament, it occurs frequently in the middle voice (ὀρέγομαι) denoting strong aspiration or deep desire. 1. To yearn to attain a goal or position, such as church leadership (1 Tim 3:1); | 2. To desire earnestly something of moral or spiritual value (Heb 11:16).

DEFINITION: Relating to regions characterized by elevations, hills, or mountains, frequently used as a noun to designate the hill country.
SENSES: 1. The mountainous region or hill country of Judea (Lk 1:39, 65).

THAYER.pt: Relativo a regiões caracterizadas por elevações, montes ou montanhas, frequentemente empregado como substantivo para designar a região serrana. 1. A região montanhosa ou região serrana de Judéia (Lc 1.39, 65).
THAYER.en: Relating to regions characterized by elevations, hills, or mountains, frequently used as a noun to designate the hill country. 1. The mountainous region or hill country of Judea (Lk 1:39, 65).

DEFINITION: A state of strong desire, craving, or lust, often in an unfavorable sense.
SENSES: 1. Intense desire or disordered passion (Rom 1:27).

THAYER.pt: Um estado de forte desejo, ânsia ou concupiscência, muitas vezes em sentido desfavorável. 1. Desejo intenso ou paixão desordenada (Rm 1.27).
THAYER.en: A state of strong desire, craving, or lust, often in an unfavorable sense. 1. Intense desire or disordered passion (Rom 1:27).

DEFINITION: To live in accordance with moral rectitude, walking straightly and without deviation.
SENSES: 1. To proceed with moral rectitude and evangelical truth (Gal 2:14).

THAYER.pt: Viver de acordo com a retidão moral, caminhando com retidão e sem desvios. 1. Proceder com retidão moral e verdade evangélica (Gl 2.14).
THAYER.en: To live in accordance with moral rectitude, walking straightly and without deviation. 1. To proceed with moral rectitude and evangelical truth (Gal 2:14).

DEFINITION: Being in a straight line, without deviations or twists, applicable both to the physical sense (erect posture) and the figurative (moral or doctrinal correctness).
SENSES: 1. In an erect position or aligned in a straight line (Heb 12:13).

THAYER.pt: Que está em linha reta, sem desvios ou torções, podendo ser aplicado tanto ao sentido físico (postura ereta) quanto ao figurado (correção moral ou doutrinária). 1. Em posição ereta ou alinhada em linha reta (Hb 12.13).
THAYER.en: Being in a straight line, without deviations or twists, applicable both to the physical sense (erect posture) and the figurative (moral or doctrinal correctness). 1. In an erect position or aligned in a straight line (Heb 12:13).

DEFINITION: To conduct the word of truth in a straight and precise manner, without distortions or deviations.
SENSES: 1. To explain and teach the word of truth correctly (2 Tim 2:15).

THAYER.pt: Conduzir a palavra da verdade de maneira reta e precisa, sem distorções ou desvios. 1. Explicar e ensinar corretamente a palavra da verdade (2Tm 2.15).
THAYER.en: To conduct the word of truth in a straight and precise manner, without distortions or deviations. 1. To explain and teach the word of truth correctly (2 Tim 2:15).

DEFINITION: To wake up or stand up very early in the morning to perform some activity.
SENSES: 1. To get up very early in the morning (Lk 21:38).

THAYER.pt: Acordar ou colocar-se de pé bem cedo pela manhã para realizar alguma atividade. 1. Levantar-se muito cedo pela manhã (Lc 21.38).
THAYER.en: To wake up or stand up very early in the morning to perform some activity. 1. To get up very early in the morning (Lk 21:38).

DEFINITION: Relating to the early morning period or occurring right at dawn.
SENSES: 1. Happening very early in the morning (Lk 24:22 v.l.).

THAYER.pt: Relativo ao período inicial da manhã ou que ocorre logo ao amanhecer. 1. Que acontece bem cedo pela manhã (Lc 24.22 v.l.).
THAYER.en: Relating to the early morning period or occurring right at dawn. 1. Happening very early in the morning (Lk 24:22 v.l.).

DEFINITION: Pertaining to the beginning of the morning or daybreak.
SENSES: 1. Occurring early in the morning, rising early (Lk 24:22).

THAYER.pt: Pertencente ao início da manhã ou ao romper do dia. 1. Que ocorre de manhã cedo, madrugador (Lc 24.22).
THAYER.en: Pertaining to the beginning of the morning or daybreak. 1. Occurring early in the morning, rising early (Lk 24:22).

DEFINITION: Designates the initial period of the day, shortly before or just after sunrise, characterized by the end of night and the beginning of light. Commonly associated with moments of vigil and morning seeking.
SENSES: 1. The break of day or dawn (Lk 24:1; Jn 8:2).

THAYER.pt: Designa o período inicial do dia, pouco antes ou logo após o nascer do sol, caracterizado pelo fim da noite e início da claridade. É comumente associado a momentos de vigília e busca matutina. 1. O romper do dia ou o alvorecer (Lc 24.1; Jo 8.2).
THAYER.en: Designates the initial period of the day, shortly before or just after sunrise, characterized by the end of night and the beginning of light. Commonly associated with moments of vigil and morning seeking. 1. The break of day or dawn (Lk 24:1; Jn 8:2).

DEFINITION: In a correct manner, in conformity with an established norm, standard, or truth.
SENSES: 1. To act or speak in a correct and exact manner (Mk 7:35; Lk 7:43; Lk 10:28).

THAYER.pt: De maneira correta, em conformidade com uma norma, padrão ou verdade estabelecida. 1. Agir ou falar de modo correto e exato (Mc 7.35; Lc 7.43; Lc 10.28).
THAYER.en: In a correct manner, in conformity with an established norm, standard, or truth. 1. To act or speak in a correct and exact manner (Mk 7:35; Lk 7:43; Lk 10:28).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: ὁριῶ, Aor: ὥρισα, Perf: ὥρικα
DEFINITION: To set boundaries, establish fixedly, or decree a sovereign purpose and design, especially regarding divine plans.
SENSES: 1. To establish limits, define, or determine something (Acts 17:26; Heb 4:7).

THAYER.pt: Marcar limites, estabelecer de forma fixa ou decretar um propósito e desígnio soberano, especialmente no que tange aos planos divinos. 1. Estabelecer limites, definir ou determinar algo (At 17:26; Hb 4:7).
THAYER.en: To set boundaries, establish fixedly, or decree a sovereign purpose and design, especially regarding divine plans. 1. To establish limits, define, or determine something (Acts 17:26; Heb 4:7).

DEFINITION: Lines that delimit a territory or, in the plural, the regions, districts, and lands circumscribed by these borders.
SENSES: 1. Territorial limits, borders of a region (Mt 2:16).
2. Territory, district, or geographic region (Mt 4:13; 15:39).

THAYER.pt: Linhas que delimitam um território ou, no plural, as próprias regiões, distritos e terras circunscritas por essas fronteiras. 1. Limites territoriais, fronteiras de uma região (Mt 2.16). | 2. Território, distrito ou região geográfica (Mt 4.13; 15.39).
THAYER.en: Lines that delimit a territory or, in the plural, the regions, districts, and lands circumscribed by these borders. 1. Territorial limits, borders of a region (Mt 2:16). | 2. Territory, district, or geographic region (Mt 4:13; 15:39).

DEFINITION: The act of putting someone under a solemn oath or making an urgent appeal in the name of a superior authority. Requires truthfulness or strict submission to an order from the interlocutor.
SENSES: 1. To require or demand that someone swear or fulfill a solemn requirement (Mk 5:7; Acts 19:13).

THAYER.pt: O ato de colocar alguém sob juramento solene ou fazer um apelo premente em nome de uma autoridade superior. Exige do interlocutor veracidade ou submissão estricta a uma ordem. 1. Requerer ou exigir de alguém que jure ou cumpra uma exigência solene (Mc 5.7; At 19.13).
THAYER.en: The act of putting someone under a solemn oath or making an urgent appeal in the name of a superior authority. Requires truthfulness or strict submission to an order from the interlocutor. 1. To require or demand that someone swear or fulfill a solemn requirement (Mk 5:7; Acts 19:13).

DEFINITION: A solemn declaration or promise ratified by the invocation of God as witness and guarantor of truthfulness.
SENSES: 1. A solemn oath made before God (Mt 5:33; Heb 6:17).

THAYER.pt: Declaração solene ou promessa ratificada pela invocação de Deus como testemunha e fiador da veracidade. 1. Um juramento solene feito perante Deus (Mt 5.33; Hb 6.17).
THAYER.en: A solemn declaration or promise ratified by the invocation of God as witness and guarantor of truthfulness. 1. A solemn oath made before God (Mt 5:33; Heb 6:17).

DEFINITION: The solemn act of making or confirming a commitment under oath, invoking God as a witness.
SENSES: 1. The taking of a solemn oath (Heb 7:20, 28).

THAYER.pt: O ato solene de prestar ou confirmar um compromisso sob juramento, invocando a Deus como testemunha. 1. Prestação de juramento solene (Hb 7.20, 28).
THAYER.en: The solemn act of making or confirming a commitment under oath, invoking God as a witness. 1. The taking of a solemn oath (Heb 7:20, 28).

DEFINITION: To make a rapid and impetuous movement from one place to another, often in a violent or hasty manner.
SENSES: 1. To rush or run precipitately (Mt 8:32; Acts 19:29).

THAYER.pt: Realizar um movimento rápido e impetuoso de um lugar para outro, muitas vezes de forma violenta ou precipitada. 1. Precipitar-se ou correr precipitadamente (Mt 8.32; At 19.29).
THAYER.en: To make a rapid and impetuous movement from one place to another, often in a violent or hasty manner. 1. To rush or run precipitately (Mt 8:32; Acts 19:29).

DEFINITION: A psychological state of strong inclination, internal impulse, or impetus toward an action or decision.
SENSES: 1. A violent impulse or drive that moves the will to action (Jas 3:4).

THAYER.pt: Um estado psicológico de forte inclinação, impulso interno ou ímpeto em direção a uma ação ou decisão. 1. Um impulso violento ou ímpeto que move a vontade para uma ação (Tg 3.4).
THAYER.en: A psychological state of strong inclination, internal impulse, or impetus toward an action or decision. 1. A violent impulse or drive that moves the will to action (Jas 3:4).

DEFINITION: A sudden, impetuous, and violent movement, such as a downfall or attack.
SENSES: 1. Impetus or violent rush of destruction (Rev 18:21).

THAYER.pt: Um movimento súbito, impetuoso e violento, como uma derrocada ou ataque. 1. Ímpeto ou arranque violento de destruição (Ap 18.21).
THAYER.en: A sudden, impetuous, and violent movement, such as a downfall or attack. 1. Impetus or violent rush of destruction (Rev 18:21).

DEFINITION: General term designating any species of bird, whether wild or a bird of prey. In the eschatological context of Revelation, it refers to birds that feed on carrion.
SENSES: 1. A bird of prey or bird in general (Rev 19:17).

THAYER.pt: Termo geral que designa qualquer espécie de ave, seja ela selvagem ou de rapina. No contexto escatológico do Apocalipse, refere-se às aves que se alimentam de carniça. 1. Ave de rapina ou pássaro em geral (Ap 19.17).
THAYER.en: General term designating any species of bird, whether wild or a bird of prey. In the eschatological context of Revelation, it refers to birds that feed on carrion. 1. A bird of prey or bird in general (Rev 19:17).

DEFINITION: General term for any bird, but specifically applied in the New Testament to the hen and its protective instinct over its chicks.
SENSES: 1. The hen that welcomes and protects its brood under its wings, used as a metaphor for divine care (Matt 23:37; Luke 13:34).

THAYER.pt: Termo geral para designar qualquer ave, mas especificamente aplicado no Novo Testamento à galinha e ao seu instinto protetor sobre os pintinhos. 1. A galinha que acolhe e protege sua prole sob as asas, usada como metáfora do cuidado divino (Mt 23.37; Lc 13.34).
THAYER.en: General term for any bird, but specifically applied in the New Testament to the hen and its protective instinct over its chicks. 1. The hen that welcomes and protects its brood under its wings, used as a metaphor for divine care (Matt 23:37; Luke 13:34).

DEFINITION: The determination or fixing of borders, territorial or existential limits.
SENSES: 1. Established geographical or existential limits (Acts 17:26).

THAYER.pt: A determinação ou fixação de fronteiras, limites territoriais ou existenciais. 1. Limites geográficos ou existenciais estabelecidos (At 17.26).
THAYER.en: The determination or fixing of borders, territorial or existential limits. 1. Established geographical or existential limits (Acts 17:26).

DEFINITION: Indicates a large geographical elevation on the earth's surface, distinguished from smaller hills and possessing significant theological and narrative relevance in the New Testament.
SENSES: 1. A large elevation of land or mountain (Matt 5:1; Matt 17:1).

THAYER.pt: Indica uma elevação geográfica de grande porte na superfície da terra, distinguindo-se de colinas menores e possuindo relevância teológica e narrativa marcante no Novo Testamento. 1. Uma grande elevação de terra ou montanha (Mt 5.1; Mt 17.1).
THAYER.en: Indicates a large geographical elevation on the earth's surface, distinguished from smaller hills and possessing significant theological and narrative relevance in the New Testament. 1. A large elevation of land or mountain (Matt 5:1; Matt 17:1).

DEFINITION: To open furrows, holes, or cavities in the earth using tools such as shovels or hoes. It can describe both the preparation of agricultural structures and the hiding of valuables.
SENSES: 1. To excavate the earth for the construction of structures such as a winepress or wall (Matt 21:33).
2. To make a hole to bury or hide something (Matt 25:18).

THAYER.pt: Abrir sulcos, buracos ou cavidades na terra utilizando ferramentas como pás ou enxadas. Pode descrever tanto a preparação de estruturas agrícolas quanto a ocultação de valores. 1. Escavar a terra para a construção de estruturas como um lagar ou muralha (Mt 21.33); | 2. Fazer um buraco para enterrar ou ocultar algo (Mt 25.18).
THAYER.en: To open furrows, holes, or cavities in the earth using tools such as shovels or hoes. It can describe both the preparation of agricultural structures and the hiding of valuables. 1. To excavate the earth for the construction of structures such as a winepress or wall (Matt 21:33). | 2. To make a hole to bury or hide something (Matt 25:18).

DEFINITION: Deprived of parents (in the sense of an orphan) or, by extension, devoid of help, protection, and comfort from friends or protectors.
SENSES: 1. A child without parents, an orphan (Jas 1:27).
2. A helpless person, deprived of company or consolation (John 14:18).

THAYER.pt: Que foi privado de pais (no sentido de órfão) ou, por extensão, desprovido de auxílio, proteção e conforto de amigos ou protetores. 1. Criança sem pais, órfã (Tg 1.27). | 2. Pessoa desamparada, privada de companhia ou consolo (Jo 14.18).
THAYER.en: Deprived of parents (in the sense of an orphan) or, by extension, devoid of help, protection, and comfort from friends or protectors. 1. A child without parents, an orphan (Jas 1:27). | 2. A helpless person, deprived of company or consolation (John 14:18).

DEFINITION: To move the body in a rhythmic and patterned way, usually accompanied by music, in celebrations or festivities.
SENSES: 1. To perform dance steps (Matt 11:17; 14:6; Mark 6:22).

THAYER.pt: Movimentar o corpo de forma rítmica e padronizada, geralmente acompanhado por música, em celebrações ou festividades. 1. Executar passos de dança (Mt 11.17; 14.6; Mc 6.22).
THAYER.en: To move the body in a rhythmic and patterned way, usually accompanied by music, in celebrations or festivities. 1. To perform dance steps (Matt 11:17; 14:6; Mark 6:22).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Gen. οὗ, ἧς, οὗ; relative pronoun
DEFINITION: A relative pronoun that introduces adjective subordinate clauses, agreeing in gender and number with its antecedent and assuming the case required by its syntactic function in the subordinate clause.
SENSES: 1. Reference to persons or things previously mentioned ('which', 'that', 'who') (Matt 1:16; John 1:15).
2. Without an expressed antecedent, functioning as 'he who', 'who' (Matt 10:38; Rom 2:1).
3. Distributive idiomatic use in coordinated phrases (ὃς μὲν... ὃς δέ, 'one... another') (Matt 13:8; 1 Cor 11:21).

THAYER.pt: Pronome relativo que introduz orações subordinadas adjetivas, concordando em gênero e número com seu antecedente e assumindo o caso exigido por sua função sintática na oração subordinada. 1. Referência a pessoas ou coisas previamente mencionadas ('o qual', 'que', 'quem') (Mt 1.16; Jo 1.15). | 2. Sem antecedente expresso, funcionando como 'aquele que', 'quem' (Mt 10.38; Rm 2.1). | 3. Uso idiomático distributivo em frases coordenadas (ὃς μὲν... ὃς δέ, 'um... outro') (Mt 13.8; 1Co 11.21).
THAYER.en: A relative pronoun that introduces adjective subordinate clauses, agreeing in gender and number with its antecedent and assuming the case required by its syntactic function in the subordinate clause. 1. Reference to persons or things previously mentioned ('which', 'that', 'who') (Matt 1:16; John 1:15). | 2. Without an expressed antecedent, functioning as 'he who', 'who' (Matt 10:38; Rom 2:1). | 3. Distributive idiomatic use in coordinated phrases (ὃς μὲν... ὃς δέ, 'one... another') (Matt 13:8; 1 Cor 11:21).

DEFINITION: An adverb denoting indefinite repetition in accordance with another action, meaning 'every time that' or 'how often'.
SENSES: 1. Indication of simultaneity and temporal multiplicity of recurring actions (1 Cor 11:25-26; Rev 11:6).

THAYER.pt: Advérbio que denota repetição indefinida em consonância com outra ação, significando 'todas as vezes que' ou 'com que frequência'. 1. Indicação de simultaneidade e multiplicidade temporal de ações recorrentes (1Co 11.25-26; Ap 11.6).
THAYER.en: An adverb denoting indefinite repetition in accordance with another action, meaning 'every time that' or 'how often'. 1. Indication of simultaneity and temporal multiplicity of recurring actions (1 Cor 11:25-26; Rev 11:6).

DEFINITION: Belonging or dedicated to God, characterized by moral purity, exemplary piety, and irreproachable righteousness before divine standards.
SENSES: 1. Pious, devout, and morally irreproachable (1 Tim 2:8; Heb 7:26).
2. Attribute of holiness belonging to God Himself (Rev 15:4).

THAYER.pt: Pertencente ou dedicado a Deus, caracterizado por pureza moral, piedade exemplar e retidão irrepreensível perante os padrões divinos. 1. Piedoso, devoto e moralmente irrepreensível (1Tm 2:8; Hb 7:26). | 2. Atributo de santidade pertencente ao próprio Deus (Ap 15:4).
THAYER.en: Belonging or dedicated to God, characterized by moral purity, exemplary piety, and irreproachable righteousness before divine standards. 1. Pious, devout, and morally irreproachable (1 Tim 2:8; Heb 7:26). | 2. Attribute of holiness belonging to God Himself (Rev 15:4).

DEFINITION: The quality of reverence and proper devotion toward God, translated into a life of righteousness and moral holiness.
SENSES: 1. The attitude of religious devotion and piety manifested in holiness (Lk 1:75; Eph 4:24).

THAYER.pt: A qualidade de reverência e devoção correta para com Deus, traduzida em uma vida de retidão e santidade moral. 1. A atitude de devoção e piedade religiosa manifestada em santidade (Lc 1.75; Ef 4.24).
THAYER.en: The quality of reverence and proper devotion toward God, translated into a life of righteousness and moral holiness. 1. The attitude of religious devotion and piety manifested in holiness (Lk 1:75; Eph 4:24).

DEFINITION: In a holy, just, and pleasing manner to God in moral behavior.
SENSES: 1. In a holy, pure, and devout manner before God (1Th 2:10).

THAYER.pt: De maneira santa, justa e agradável a Deus no comportamento moral. 1. De maneira santa, pura e devota diante de Deus (1Ts 2.10).
THAYER.en: In a holy, just, and pleasing manner to God in moral behavior. 1. In a holy, pure, and devout manner before God (1Th 2:10).

DEFINITION: Olfactory quality emitted by substances, which can refer to pleasant aromas or foul odors, with literal and figurative uses.
SENSES: 1. Pleasant aroma or fragrance of perfume (Jn 12:3; Php 4:18).
2. The figurative effect of the Christian message as a scent of life or death (2Co 2:14).

THAYER.pt: Qualidade olfativa emitida por substâncias, podendo referir-se a aromas agradáveis ou a odores fétidos, com usos literais e figurados. 1. Aroma agradável ou fragrância de perfume (Jo 12.3; Fp 4.18). | 2. O efeito figurado da mensagem cristã como cheiro de vida ou de morte (2Co 2.14).
THAYER.en: Olfactory quality emitted by substances, which can refer to pleasant aromas or foul odors, with literal and figurative uses. 1. Pleasant aroma or fragrance of perfume (Jn 12:3; Php 4:18). | 2. The figurative effect of the Christian message as a scent of life or death (2Co 2:14).

SHORT_GLOSS: as much as, all who, as many as
DEFINITION: Indicates quantitative, spatial, temporal, or degree correlation, equivalent to 'as much as', 'everyone who', or 'as many as'. It establishes a comparison of measure or number with another referent.
SENSES: 1. Quantity or number: as many as, all those who (Jn 6:11; Ro 8:14).
2. Temporal duration or extent: while, during the time that (Ro 7:1).
3. Degree of proportion: how much more (Mk 7:36; Heb 1:4).
USAGE: as much as, all who, as many as

THAYER.pt: Indica correlação quantitativa, espacial, temporal ou de grau, equivalendo a 'quanto', 'todo aquele que' ou 'tanto quanto'. Estabelece comparação de medida ou número com outro referente. 1. Quantidade ou número: tantos quantos, todos os que (Jo 6.11; Rm 8.14). | 2. Duração temporal ou extensão: enquanto, durante o tempo em que (Rm 7.1). | 3. Grau de proporção: quanto mais (Mc 7.36; Hb 1.4).
THAYER.en: Indicates quantitative, spatial, temporal, or degree correlation, equivalent to 'as much as', 'everyone who', or 'as many as'. It establishes a comparison of measure or number with another referent. 1. Quantity or number: as many as, all those who (Jn 6:11; Ro 8:14). | 2. Temporal duration or extent: while, during the time that (Ro 7:1). | 3. Degree of proportion: how much more (Mk 7:36; Heb 1:4).

DEFINITION: An emphatic relative pronoun, meaning 'exactly the one who' or 'the very same'.
SENSES: 1. The very one, precisely who (Mk 15:24).

THAYER.pt: Pronome relativo enfático, significando 'exatamente aquele que' ou 'o qual mesmo'. 1. O exato qual, precisamente quem (Mc 15.24).
THAYER.en: An emphatic relative pronoun, meaning 'exactly the one who' or 'the very same'. 1. The very one, precisely who (Mk 15:24).

DEFINITION: Designates the rigid, mineralized structure of the skeleton that supports the human and animal body. In the New Testament, it appears in literal contexts regarding physical constitution and in prophetic citations.
SENSES: 1. Bony structure of the physical body (Lk 24:39).
2. The bones in the context of the messianic prophecy regarding the cross (Jn 19:36).

THAYER.pt: Designa a estrutura rígida e mineralizada do esqueleto que sustenta o corpo humano e animal. No Novo Testamento, aparece em contextos literais sobre a constituição física e em citações proféticas. 1. Estrutura óssea do corpo físico (Lc 24.39). | 2. Os ossos no contexto da profecia messiânica sobre a cruz (Jo 19.36).
THAYER.en: Designates the rigid, mineralized structure of the skeleton that supports the human and animal body. In the New Testament, it appears in literal contexts regarding physical constitution and in prophetic citations. 1. Bony structure of the physical body (Lk 24:39). | 2. The bones in the context of the messianic prophecy regarding the cross (Jn 19:36).

DEFINITION: A generalizing relative pronoun that emphasizes the inherent nature, function, or essential type of the antecedent ('whoever it may be'). It can act as an equivalent to the simple relative pronoun in the New Testament.
SENSES: 1. Indefinite generalizer: everyone who, anyone who (Mt 7:24; Gal 5:4).
2. Qualitative-causal: such a person who, one who is of the class of (Mt 13:52; Gal 4:24).

THAYER.pt: Pronome relativo generalizador que acentua a natureza inerente, função ou tipo essencial do antecedente ('qualquer um que seja'). Pode atuar como equivalente ao pronome relativo simples no Novo Testamento. 1. Generalizador indefinido: todo aquele que, qualquer pessoa que (Mt 7.24; Gl 5.4). | 2. Qualitativo-causal: tal pessoa que, aquele por ser da classe de (Mt 13.52; Gl 4.24).
THAYER.en: A generalizing relative pronoun that emphasizes the inherent nature, function, or essential type of the antecedent ('whoever it may be'). It can act as an equivalent to the simple relative pronoun in the New Testament. 1. Indefinite generalizer: everyone who, anyone who (Mt 7:24; Gal 5:4). | 2. Qualitative-causal: such a person who, one who is of the class of (Mt 13:52; Gal 4:24).

DEFINITION: Made of fired earth or clay; refers to ceramic or earthen objects, which are fragile and common.
SENSES: 1. Made of clay or ceramic, denoting fragility (2Co 4:7; 2Ti 2:20).

THAYER.pt: Feito de terra cozida ou argila; refere-se a objetos de cerâmica ou barro, que são frágeis e comuns. 1. Feito de barro ou cerâmica, denotando fragilidade (2Co 4.7; 2Tm 2.20).
THAYER.en: Made of fired earth or clay; refers to ceramic or earthen objects, which are fragile and common. 1. Made of clay or ceramic, denoting fragility (2Co 4:7; 2Ti 2:20).

DEFINITION: Refers to the capacity or sense of smelling, used in the New Testament to describe the sensory faculty of smell in the human body.
SENSES: 1. The faculty or sense of smell (1Co 12:17).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se à capacidade ou sentido de sentir odores, sendo utilizado no Novo Testamento para descrever a faculdade sensorial do olfato no corpo humano. 1. A faculdade ou sentido do olfato (1Co 12.17).
THAYER.en: Refers to the capacity or sense of smelling, used in the New Testament to describe the sensory faculty of smell in the human body. 1. The faculty or sense of smell (1Co 12:17).

DEFINITION: The part of the human body situated above the hips and below the ribs, a location traditionally girded by a belt, and by extension, the reproductive organs.
SENSES: 1. The region of the waist or loins where the belt is tied (Eph 6:14; 1Pe 1:13).
2. The generative origin or the loins as a source of descent (Ac 2:30; Heb 7:5).

THAYER.pt: A parte do corpo humano situada acima dos quadris e abaixo das costelas, local tradicionalmente cingido por um cinto, e por extensão os órgãos reprodutivos. 1. A região da cintura ou dos lombos onde se ata o cinto (Ef 6:14; 1Pe 1:13). | 2. A origem geradora ou os lombos como fonte de descendência (At 2:30; Hb 7:5).
THAYER.en: The part of the human body situated above the hips and below the ribs, a location traditionally girded by a belt, and by extension, the reproductive organs. 1. The region of the waist or loins where the belt is tied (Eph 6:14; 1Pe 1:13). | 2. The generative origin or the loins as a source of descent (Ac 2:30; Heb 7:5).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Composed of ὅτε and ἄν, governs subjunctive
DEFINITION: A conditional temporal conjunction used with the subjunctive mood to denote an indefinite, probable, repeated, or prospective point in time.
SENSES: 1. Introducing a future and contingent event: when, as soon as (Mt 5:11; Jn 14:29).
2. Indicating habitual or generalized action: every time that, whenever (Mt 6:2; 2Co 12:10).

THAYER.pt: Conjunção temporal condicional usada com o modo subjuntivo para denotar um ponto no tempo indefinido, provável, repetido ou prospectivo. 1. Introduzindo evento futuro e contingente: quando, logo que (Mt 5.11; Jo 14.29). | 2. Indicando ação habitual ou generalizada: toda vez que, sempre que (Mt 6.2; 2Co 12.10).
THAYER.en: A conditional temporal conjunction used with the subjunctive mood to denote an indefinite, probable, repeated, or prospective point in time. 1. Introducing a future and contingent event: when, as soon as (Mt 5:11; Jn 14:29). | 2. Indicating habitual or generalized action: every time that, whenever (Mt 6:2; 2Co 12:10).

DEFINITION: A temporal conjunction that introduces subordinate clauses marking temporal coincidence or simultaneity with the fact of the main clause.
SENSES: 1. Marking a specific moment in the past or present: when (Mt 7:28; Ro 7:5).
2. Introducing a future point in time: when, at the occasion that (Jn 4:21; 5:25).

THAYER.pt: Conjunção temporal que introduz orações subordinadas que marcam a coincidência ou simultaneidade temporal com o fato da oração principal. 1. Marcação de momento específico no passado ou presente: quando (Mt 7.28; Rm 7.5). | 2. Introduzindo ponto futuro no tempo: quando, na ocasião em que (Jo 4.21; 5.25).
THAYER.en: A temporal conjunction that introduces subordinate clauses marking temporal coincidence or simultaneity with the fact of the main clause. 1. Marking a specific moment in the past or present: when (Mt 7:28; Ro 7:5). | 2. Introducing a future point in time: when, at the occasion that (Jn 4:21; 5:25).

DEFINITION: A very versatile subordinating conjunction used to introduce substantive clauses after verbs of cognition and speech, direct quotations (recitative ὅτι), or causal subordinate clauses.
SENSES: 1. Integrative: introduces the content of indirect speech or thought ('that') (Mt 16:20; Jn 1:34).
2. Causal: expresses the cause, reason, or motive for something ('because', 'since') (Mt 5:3; Jn 20:29).
3. Recitative: introduces direct speech, functioning like modern quotation marks (Mt 7:23; Jn 1:20).

THAYER.pt: Conjunção subordinativa muito versátil utilizada para introduzir orações substantivas integrantes após verbos de cognição e elocução, citações diretas (ὅτι recitativo) ou orações subordinadas causais. 1. Integrante: introduz conteúdo do discurso ou pensamento indireto ('que') (Mt 16.20; Jo 1.34). | 2. Causal: expressa a causa, razão ou motivo de algo ('porque', 'visto que') (Mt 5.3; Jo 20.29). | 3. Recitativo: introduz discurso direto, funcionando como aspas modernas (Mt 7.23; Jo 1.20).
THAYER.en: A very versatile subordinating conjunction used to introduce substantive clauses after verbs of cognition and speech, direct quotations (recitative ὅτι), or causal subordinate clauses. 1. Integrative: introduces the content of indirect speech or thought ('that') (Mt 16:20; Jn 1:34). | 2. Causal: expresses the cause, reason, or motive for something ('because', 'since') (Mt 5:3; Jn 20:29). | 3. Recitative: introduces direct speech, functioning like modern quotation marks (Mt 7:23; Jn 1:20).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Gen. sing. masc./neut. of the relative pronoun ὅστις
DEFINITION: Genitive form of the relative pronoun, frequently used in temporal or genitive expressions in Koine Greek to indicate time ('while') or possession.
SENSES: 1. Relational particle or pronoun used in temporal or substantive constructions (Mt 5:25).

THAYER.pt: Forma genitiva do pronome relativo, frequentemente usada em expressões temporais ou genitivas no grego coinê para indicar tempo ('enquanto') ou posse. 1. Partícula ou pronome relacional empregado em construções temporais ou substantivas (Mt 5.25).
THAYER.en: Genitive form of the relative pronoun, frequently used in temporal or genitive expressions in Koine Greek to indicate time ('while') or possession. 1. Relational particle or pronoun used in temporal or substantive constructions (Mt 5:25).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Forms: οὐ before consonant, οὐκ before soft vowel, οὐχ before aspirated vowel
DEFINITION: Primary negative particle used in the indicative mood to directly and objectively negate facts, realities, or categorical statements. In questions, it anticipates an affirmative answer.
SENSES: 1. Objective and absolute negation of a fact or statement in the indicative mood (Mt 1:25; Jn 1:8).
2. In rhetorical questions expecting an affirmative answer ('is it not true that...?' ) (Mt 6:26; Mt 13:55).
3. Reinforcement of emphatic negation when combined with μή (οὐ μή, 'by no means') (Mt 24:35; Jn 10:28).

THAYER.pt: Partícula negativa primária usada no modo indicativo para negar de forma direta e objetiva fatos, realidades ou declarações categóricas. Em perguntas, antecipa uma resposta afirmativa. 1. Negação objetiva e absoluta de um fato ou afirmação no modo indicativo (Mt 1.25; Jo 1.8). | 2. Em perguntas retóricas que esperam resposta afirmativa ('não é verdade que...?') (Mt 6.26; Mt 13.55). | 3. Reforço de negação enfática quando combinada com μή (οὐ μή, 'de modo algum') (Mt 24.35; Jo 10.28).
THAYER.en: Primary negative particle used in the indicative mood to directly and objectively negate facts, realities, or categorical statements. In questions, it anticipates an affirmative answer. 1. Objective and absolute negation of a fact or statement in the indicative mood (Mt 1:25; Jn 1:8). | 2. In rhetorical questions expecting an affirmative answer ('is it not true that...?' ) (Mt 6:26; Mt 13:55). | 3. Reinforcement of emphatic negation when combined with μή (οὐ μή, 'by no means') (Mt 24:35; Jn 10:28).

DEFINITION: Adverb of place that indicates the location where an action occurs or where someone is present.
SENSES: 1. In the place where, where (Mt 2:9; Lk 4:16).

THAYER.pt: Advérbio de lugar que indica o local onde uma ação ocorre ou onde alguém está presente. 1. No lugar em que, onde (Mt 2.9; Lc 4.16).
THAYER.en: Adverb of place that indicates the location where an action occurs or where someone is present. 1. In the place where, where (Mt 2:9; Lk 4:16).

DEFINITION: An exclamatory interjection that expresses strong emotion, which can denote astonishment, mockery, or scorn depending on the context.
SENSES: 1. An exclamation of scorn and mockery (Mk 15:29).

THAYER.pt: Uma interjeição exclamativa que expressa forte emoção, podendo denotar espanto, zombaria ou escárnio dependendo do contexto. 1. Uma exclamação de escárnio e zombaria (Mc 15.29).
THAYER.en: An exclamatory interjection that expresses strong emotion, which can denote astonishment, mockery, or scorn depending on the context. 1. An exclamation of scorn and mockery (Mk 15:29).

DEFINITION: Onomatopoeic interjection of affliction, impending disaster, or prophetic lamentation of judgment. It also functions as a noun to categorize a catastrophe or apocalyptic plague.
SENSES: 1. Prophetic exclamation of judgment against obstinate sinners or cities (Mt 11:21; Lk 6:24-26).
2. Expression of deep sorrow and pain (Rev 18:10, 16).
3. Substantive: catastrophe, calamity, or terrible plague (1Co 9:16; Rev 9:12; 11:14).

THAYER.pt: Interjeição onomatopeica de aflição, desgraça iminente ou lamentação profética de juízo. Também funciona substantivada para categorizar uma catástrofe ou praga apocalíptica. 1. Exclamação profética de julgamento contra pecadores obstinados ou cidades (Mt 11.21; Lc 6.24-26). | 2. Expressão de pesar profundo e dor (Ap 18.10, 16). | 3. Substantivado: catástrofe, calamidade ou praga terrível (1Co 9.16; Ap 9.12; 11.14).
THAYER.en: Onomatopoeic interjection of affliction, impending disaster, or prophetic lamentation of judgment. It also functions as a noun to categorize a catastrophe or apocalyptic plague. 1. Prophetic exclamation of judgment against obstinate sinners or cities (Mt 11:21; Lk 6:24-26). | 2. Expression of deep sorrow and pain (Rev 18:10, 16). | 3. Substantive: catastrophe, calamity, or terrible plague (1Co 9:16; Rev 9:12; 11:14).

SHORT_GLOSS: by no means, not at all
DEFINITION: An adverb that functions as a marker of energetic negation, indicating that something is absolutely false or impossible.
SENSES: 1. By no means, not at all, certainly not (Mt 2:6).
USAGE: by no means, not at all

THAYER.pt: Um advérbio que funciona como um marcador de negação enérgica, indicando que algo é absolutamente falso ou impossível. 1. De maneira nenhuma, de modo algum, certamente não (Mt 2.6).
THAYER.en: An adverb that functions as a marker of energetic negation, indicating that something is absolutely false or impossible. 1. By no means, not at all, certainly not (Mt 2:6).

DEFINITION: A negative particle of strong intensity that connects two clauses of previous negative meaning or acts emphatically to categorically negate even a lesser possibility.
SENSES: 1. Copulative: and not, nor, neither (Mt 6:15; Jn 1:13).
2. Emphatic or adverbial: not even (Mt 6:29; 1Co 5:1).

THAYER.pt: Partícula negativa composta de forte intensidade que liga duas orações de sentido negativo prévio ou atua enfaticamente para negar categoricamente até mesmo uma menor possibilidade. 1. Copulativa: e não, nem, tampouco (Mt 6.15; Jo 1.13). | 2. Enfática ou adverbial: nem sequer, nem mesmo (Mt 6.29; 1Co 5.1).
THAYER.en: A negative particle of strong intensity that connects two clauses of previous negative meaning or acts emphatically to categorically negate even a lesser possibility. 1. Copulative: and not, nor, neither (Mt 6:15; Jn 1:13). | 2. Emphatic or adverbial: not even (Mt 6:29; 1Co 5:1).
