DEFINITION: An objective negative compound that forcefully nullifies any singular element of a category within the factual domain. It is used in both attributive and pronominal functions to denote the total and absolute absence of individuals or things.
SENSES: 1. Masculine pronominal function: 'no one' (Mt 6:24; Jn 1:18).
2. Substantivized neuter function: 'nothing', 'not anything' (Jn 15:5; 1Co 13:2).
3. Modifying adjective function: 'no', 'none' (Lk 4:24; Jn 19:41).

THAYER.pt: Composto negativo objetivo que anula de forma contundente qualquer elemento singular de uma categoria no domínio factual. Emprega-se tanto na função atributiva quanto na pronominal para denotar ausência total e absoluta de indivíduos ou coisas. 1. Função pronominal masculina: 'ninguém' (Mt 6.24; Jo 1.18). | 2. Função neutra substantivada: 'nada', 'coisa alguma' (Jo 15.5; 1Co 13.2). | 3. Função adjetiva modificadora: 'nenhum', 'nenhuma' (Lc 4.24; Jo 19.41).
THAYER.en: An objective negative compound that forcefully nullifies any singular element of a category within the factual domain. It is used in both attributive and pronominal functions to denote the total and absolute absence of individuals or things. 1. Masculine pronominal function: 'no one' (Mt 6:24; Jn 1:18). | 2. Substantivized neuter function: 'nothing', 'not anything' (Jn 15:5; 1Co 13:2). | 3. Modifying adjective function: 'no', 'none' (Lk 4:24; Jn 19:41).

DEFINITION: A negative temporal adverb indicating that an event or action did not occur at any point in the past or future.
SENSES: 1. Absolute negation of temporal occurrence, meaning never (Mt 7:23; 1Co 13:8).

THAYER.pt: Advérbio de tempo negativo que indica que um evento ou ação não ocorreu em nenhum momento do passado ou do futuro. 1. Negação absoluta de ocorrência temporal, significando nunca ou jamais (Mt 7.23; 1Co 13.8).
THAYER.en: A negative temporal adverb indicating that an event or action did not occur at any point in the past or future. 1. Absolute negation of temporal occurrence, meaning never (Mt 7:23; 1Co 13:8).

DEFINITION: A negation indicating that an expected event or state has not yet occurred up to the present moment.

THAYER.pt: Uma negação que indica que um evento ou estado esperado ainda não aconteceu até o momento presente. 1. Não ainda, ainda não (Lc 23.53; Jo 19.41).
THAYER.en: A negation indicating that an expected event or state has not yet occurred up to the present moment. 1. Not yet (Lk 23:53; Jn 19:41).

DEFINITION: An adverb marking the cessation of a continuous state or action, indicating that something that previously occurred has ceased from a certain point onward.
SENSES: 1. Temporal: no more, no longer, from now on not (Mt 19:6; Lk 15:19; Ro 6:9).
2. Inferential and logical: then no more, otherwise not (Ro 11:6; Ga 3:18).

THAYER.pt: Advérbio que marca a cessação de um estado ou ação contínua, indicando que algo que acontecia anteriormente deixou de ocorrer a partir de determinado momento. 1. Temporal: não mais, já não, daqui por diante não (Mt 19.6; Lc 15.19; Rm 6.9). | 2. Inferencial e lógico: então não mais, de outra forma não (Rm 11.6; Gl 3.18).
THAYER.en: An adverb marking the cessation of a continuous state or action, indicating that something that previously occurred has ceased from a certain point onward. 1. Temporal: no more, no longer, from now on not (Mt 19:6; Lk 15:19; Ro 6:9). | 2. Inferential and logical: then no more, otherwise not (Ro 11:6; Ga 3:18).

DEFINITION: A particle with inferential or interrogative force that introduces a logical conclusion based on previous premises.
SENSES: 1. Therefore, so, thus (Jn 18:37).

THAYER.pt: Partícula com força inferencial ou interrogativa que introduz uma conclusão lógica baseada em premissas anteriores. 1. Portanto, logo, assim sendo (Jo 18.37).
THAYER.en: A particle with inferential or interrogative force that introduces a logical conclusion based on previous premises. 1. Therefore, so, thus (Jn 18:37).

DEFINITION: An inferential conjunction that links a statement to what precedes it, indicating logical deduction, natural consequence, or continuous narrative transition.
SENSES: 1. Marker of logical deduction and consequence: therefore, consequently (Mt 6:9; Ro 5:1).
2. Marker of narrative resumption or continuity in discourses and historical accounts (Mt 22:21; Jn 18:16).
3. Practical conclusion of ethical admonition (1Co 10:31; Eph 4:1).

THAYER.pt: Conjunção inferencial que vincula uma declaração àquilo que a precede, indicando dedução lógica, consequência natural ou transição contínua da narrativa. 1. Marcador de dedução lógica e consequência: portanto, por conseguinte (Mt 6.9; Rm 5.1). | 2. Marcador de retomada ou continuidade narrativa em discursos e relatos históricos (Mt 22.21; Jo 18.16). | 3. Conclusão prática de admoestação ética (1Co 10.31; Ef 4.1).
THAYER.en: An inferential conjunction that links a statement to what precedes it, indicating logical deduction, natural consequence, or continuous narrative transition. 1. Marker of logical deduction and consequence: therefore, consequently (Mt 6:9; Ro 5:1). | 2. Marker of narrative resumption or continuity in discourses and historical accounts (Mt 22:21; Jn 18:16). | 3. Practical conclusion of ethical admonition (1Co 10:31; Eph 4:1).

DEFINITION: A negative particle used to indicate that an expected event or point in time has not yet occurred.
SENSES: 1. Negating that something has happened up to the present moment (Mt 24:6; Lk 22:15).

THAYER.pt: Partícula negativa usada para indicar que um evento ou ponto no tempo esperado ainda não ocorreu. 1. Negar que algo tenha acontecido até o momento presente (Mt 24.6; Lc 22.15).
THAYER.en: A negative particle used to indicate that an expected event or point in time has not yet occurred. 1. Negating that something has happened up to the present moment (Mt 24:6; Lk 22:15).

DEFINITION: Refers to the posterior extension of the spinal column of animals or insects. In the New Testament, it occurs in symbolic and apocalyptic descriptions.
SENSES: 1. The tail of creatures or animals in symbolic contexts of Revelation (Re 9:10).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se ao prolongamento posterior da coluna vertebral de animais ou insetos. No Novo Testamento, ocorre em descrições simbólicas e apocalípticas. 1. A cauda de criaturas ou animais em contextos simbólicos do Apocalipse (Ap 9.10).
THAYER.en: Refers to the posterior extension of the spinal column of animals or insects. In the New Testament, it occurs in symbolic and apocalyptic descriptions. 1. The tail of creatures or animals in symbolic contexts of Revelation (Re 9:10).

DEFINITION: Belonging to heaven, proceeding from the heavens, or dwelling in the divine sphere.
SENSES: 1. Belonging to heaven or originating from the dwelling place of God (Mt 5:48; Lk 2:13; Ac 26:19).

THAYER.pt: Que pertence ao céu, que procede dos céus ou que habita na esfera divina. 1. Pertencente ao céu ou originário da habitação de Deus (Mt 5.48; Lc 2.13; At 26.19).
THAYER.en: Belonging to heaven, proceeding from the heavens, or dwelling in the divine sphere. 1. Belonging to heaven or originating from the dwelling place of God (Mt 5:48; Lk 2:13; Ac 26:19).

DEFINITION: An adverb indicating spatial or transcendent origin from the heavens.
SENSES: 1. Movement or provenance coming directly from heaven (Ac 14:17).

THAYER.pt: Advérbio que indica procedência espacial ou transcendente a partir dos céus. 1. Movimento ou proveniência vinda diretamente do céu (At 14.17).
THAYER.en: An adverb indicating spatial or transcendent origin from the heavens. 1. Movement or provenance coming directly from heaven (Ac 14:17).

DEFINITION: Designates the visible vault of the firmament where stars and clouds dwell, as well as the invisible and transcendent dimension where God has established His throne. It can be used reverently by metonymy to allude to God Himself.
SENSES: 1. Visible firmament, atmosphere, and celestial vault (Mt 16:2-3; Jas 5:18).
2. Transcendent celestial dwelling of God and the angels (Mt 5:16; 6:9).
3. Reverent metonymy for the Deity: 'Heaven' (Mt 21:25; Lk 15:18).

THAYER.pt: Designa a abóbada visível do firmamento onde habitam astros e nuvens, assim como a dimensão invisível e transcendente onde Deus estabeleceu Seu trono. Pode ser empregado reverentemente por metonímia para aludir ao próprio Deus. 1. Firmamento visível, atmosfera e abóbada celeste (Mt 16.2-3; Tg 5.18). | 2. Habitação celestial transcendente de Deus e dos anjos (Mt 5.16; 6.9). | 3. Metonímia reverente para a Divindade: 'o Céu' (Mt 21.25; Lc 15.18).
THAYER.en: Designates the visible vault of the firmament where stars and clouds dwell, as well as the invisible and transcendent dimension where God has established His throne. It can be used reverently by metonymy to allude to God Himself. 1. Visible firmament, atmosphere, and celestial vault (Mt 16:2-3; Jas 5:18). | 2. Transcendent celestial dwelling of God and the angels (Mt 5:16; 6:9). | 3. Reverent metonymy for the Deity: 'Heaven' (Mt 21:25; Lk 15:18).

DEFINITION: A masculine proper name of a Christian in Rome to whom the apostle Paul sends personal greetings.
SENSES: 1. A Christian coworker in Rome greeted by Paul (Ro 16:9).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio masculino de um cristão em Roma a quem o apóstolo Paulo envia saudações pessoais. 1. Um cooperador cristão em Roma saudado por Paulo (Rm 16.9).
THAYER.en: A masculine proper name of a Christian in Rome to whom the apostle Paul sends personal greetings. 1. A Christian coworker in Rome greeted by Paul (Ro 16:9).

DEFINITION: A proper name designating Uriah the Hittite, husband of Bathsheba, mentioned in the genealogy of Jesus in the Gospel of Matthew.
SENSES: 1. Uriah, husband of Bathsheba in the ancestry of Jesus (Mt 1:6).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio que designa Urias, o heteu, marido de Bate-Seba, mencionado na genealogia de Jesus no Evangelho de Mateus. 1. Urias, marido de Bate-Seba na ancestralidade de Jesus (Mt 1.6).
THAYER.en: A proper name designating Uriah the Hittite, husband of Bathsheba, mentioned in the genealogy of Jesus in the Gospel of Matthew. 1. Uriah, husband of Bathsheba in the ancestry of Jesus (Mt 1:6).

DEFINITION: The anatomical organ of hearing, frequently used by extension to describe the faculty of spiritual perception.
SENSES: 1. The physical organ of hearing, the ear (Lk 22:50).
2. Capacity of mental and spiritual perception to understand the truth (Mt 13:15).

THAYER.pt: O órgão anatômico da audição, frequentemente usado por extensão para descrever a faculdade da percepção espiritual. 1. O órgão físico da audição, a orelha (Lc 22.50). | 2. Capacidade de percepção mental e espiritual para compreender a verdade (Mt 13.15).
THAYER.en: The anatomical organ of hearing, frequently used by extension to describe the faculty of spiritual perception. 1. The physical organ of hearing, the ear (Lk 22:50). | 2. Capacity of mental and spiritual perception to understand the truth (Mt 13:15).

DEFINITION: That which has material existence in the form of property, accumulated goods, or personal wealth.
SENSES: 1. The estate, goods, or inheritance of a person (Lk 15:13).

THAYER.pt: Aquilo que possui existência material sob a forma de propriedade, bens acumulados ou riqueza pessoal. 1. O patrimônio, os bens ou a herança de uma pessoa (Lc 15.13).
THAYER.en: That which has material existence in the form of property, accumulated goods, or personal wealth. 1. The estate, goods, or inheritance of a person (Lk 15:13).

DEFINITION: Connects negative elements in indicative sentences. When used in pairs (οὔτε... οὔτε), it translates correlatively as 'neither... nor', categorically excluding both presented options.
SENSES: 1. In correlation οὔτε... οὔτε: neither... nor (Mt 6:20; 12:32; Ro 8:38-39).
2. Connecting a singular sentence: and not, also not, neither (Lk 20:36; Re 5:3).

THAYER.pt: Conecta elementos negativos em sentenças de modo indicativo. Quando utilizada em pares (οὔτε... οὔτε), traduz-se correlativamente por 'nem... nem', excluindo categoricamente ambas as opções apresentadas. 1. Em correlação οὔτε... οὔτε: nem... nem (Mt 6.20; 12.32; Rm 8.38-39). | 2. Conectando sentença singular: e não, também não, tampouco (Lc 20.36; Ap 5.3).
THAYER.en: Connects negative elements in indicative sentences. When used in pairs (οὔτε... οὔτε), it translates correlatively as 'neither... nor', categorically excluding both presented options. 1. In correlation οὔτε... οὔτε: neither... nor (Mt 6:20; 12:32; Ro 8:38-39). | 2. Connecting a singular sentence: and not, also not, neither (Lk 20:36; Re 5:3).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Gen. τούτου, ταύτης, τούτου; demonstrative pronoun
DEFINITION: A proximal demonstrative pronoun used to point to people, facts, or ideas present or recently mentioned in the discourse. It may carry a laudatory tone of emphasis or, contextually, a pejorative nuance.
SENSES: 1. Demonstrative of physical, temporal, or contextual proximity ('this') (Mt 3:17; Jn 1:2).
2. Substantivized neuter pointing to facts or statements (τοῦτο, 'this') (Mt 26:26; Jn 6:6).
3. Emphatic or sometimes derogatory use in narrative ('this man', 'this individual') (Mt 13:55; Lk 15:2).

THAYER.pt: Pronome demonstrativo proximal empregado para apontar pessoas, fatos ou ideias presentes ou recém-mencionados no discurso. Pode carregar tom laudatório de destaque ou, contextualmente, matiz pejorativo. 1. Demonstrativo de proximidade física, temporal ou contextual ('este', 'esta', 'isto') (Mt 3.17; Jo 1.2). | 2. Substantivado neutro apontando para fatos ou declarações (τοῦτο, 'isto') (Mt 26.26; Jo 6.6). | 3. Uso enfático ou por vezes depreciativo na narrativa ('este homem', 'este indivíduo') (Mt 13.55; Lk 15.2).
THAYER.en: A proximal demonstrative pronoun used to point to people, facts, or ideas present or recently mentioned in the discourse. It may carry a laudatory tone of emphasis or, contextually, a pejorative nuance. 1. Demonstrative of physical, temporal, or contextual proximity ('this') (Mt 3:17; Jn 1:2). | 2. Substantivized neuter pointing to facts or statements (τοῦτο, 'this') (Mt 26:26; Jn 6:6). | 3. Emphatic or sometimes derogatory use in narrative ('this man', 'this individual') (Mt 13:55; Lk 15:2).

DEFINITION: A demonstrative adverb of manner that qualifies a fact by pointing to the preceding or following manner of the discourse. It can emphasize high intensity ('in such a way') or indicate functional conformity with an exposed model.
SENSES: 1. In this way, thus, so (referring to the previous or following context) (Mt 2:5; Mt 6:9).
2. In a high degree or intense proportion ('in such a way') (Jn 3:16; Re 16:18).

THAYER.pt: Advérbio demonstrativo de modo que qualifica um fato apontando para a maneira precedente ou subsequente do discurso. Pode enfatizar forte intensidade ('de tal forma') ou indicar conformidade funcional com um modelo exposto. 1. Desta forma, deste modo, assim (referindo-se ao contexto anterior ou seguinte) (Mt 2.5; Mt 6.9). | 2. Em grau elevado ou intensa proporção ('de tal maneira') (Jo 3.16; Ap 16.18).
THAYER.en: A demonstrative adverb of manner that qualifies a fact by pointing to the preceding or following manner of the discourse. It can emphasize high intensity ('in such a way') or indicate functional conformity with an exposed model. 1. In this way, thus, so (referring to the previous or following context) (Mt 2:5; Mt 6:9). | 2. In a high degree or intense proportion ('in such a way') (Jn 3:16; Re 16:18).

DEFINITION: An intensified form of the negative particle. In questions, it introduces rhetorical inquiries that mandatorily require an affirmative answer; in answers, it expresses a categorical negation.
SENSES: 1. Interrogative expecting a positive answer: is it not so?, not? (Mt 5:46; Lk 17:17; Ro 3:29).
2. Emphatic negation in direct response: absolutely not, by no means (Lk 1:60; Lk 12:51; Ro 3:27).
3. Emphatic negation in declarative propositions: indeed not (Jn 13:11; 1Co 10:18).

THAYER.pt: Forma intensificada da partícula negativa. Em perguntas, introduz questionamentos retóricos que demandam obrigatoriamente uma resposta afirmativa; em respostas, expressa uma negação categórica. 1. Interrogativo que espera resposta positiva: não é assim?, porventura não? (Mt 5.46; Lc 17.17; Rm 3.29). | 2. Negação enfática em resposta direta: absolutamente não, de modo nenhum (Lc 1.60; Lc 12.51; Rm 3.27). | 3. Negação enfática em proposições declarativas: de fato não (Jo 13.11; 1Co 10.18).
THAYER.en: An intensified form of the negative particle. In questions, it introduces rhetorical inquiries that mandatorily require an affirmative answer; in answers, it expresses a categorical negation. 1. Interrogative expecting a positive answer: is it not so?, not? (Mt 5:46; Lk 17:17; Ro 3:29). | 2. Emphatic negation in direct response: absolutely not, by no means (Lk 1:60; Lk 12:51; Ro 3:27). | 3. Emphatic negation in declarative propositions: indeed not (Jn 13:11; 1Co 10:18).

DEFINITION: One who has a financial debt or who is under a moral, social, or spiritual obligation.
SENSES: 1. Debtor in the financial sense (Mt 18:24).
2. One who is under moral or spiritual obligation (Ro 8:12).
3. Transgressor or sinner who has contracted a moral debt before God (Mt 6:12).

THAYER.pt: Aquele que tem uma dívida financeira ou que se encontra sob uma obrigação moral, social ou espiritual. 1. Devedor no sentido financeiro (Mt 18:24). | 2. Aquele que está sob obrigação moral ou espiritual (Rm 8:12). | 3. Transgressor ou pecador que contraiu uma dívida moral perante Deus (Mt 6:12).
THAYER.en: One who has a financial debt or who is under a moral, social, or spiritual obligation. 1. Debtor in the financial sense (Mt 18:24). | 2. One who is under moral or spiritual obligation (Ro 8:12). | 3. Transgressor or sinner who has contracted a moral debt before God (Mt 6:12).

DEFINITION: That which is owed to someone, whether in a strict financial sense (a borrowed sum) or in a moral and social sense (a marital or civic duty).
SENSES: 1. Financial debt or pecuniary obligation (Mt 18:32)
2. Mutual duty or responsibility in interpersonal relationships (1Co 7:3)

THAYER.pt: Aquilo que é devido a alguém, seja no sentido financeiro estrito (uma quantia emprestada) ou no sentido moral e social (um dever conjugal ou cívico). 1. Débito financeiro ou obrigação pecuniária (Mt 18.32); | 2. Dever ou responsabilidade mútua em relacionamentos interpessoais (1Co 7.3).
THAYER.en: That which is owed to someone, whether in a strict financial sense (a borrowed sum) or in a moral and social sense (a marital or civic duty). 1. Financial debt or pecuniary obligation (Mt 18:32) | 2. Mutual duty or responsibility in interpersonal relationships (1Co 7:3)

DEFINITION: That which is owed, whether on a literal financial level or on a moral and spiritual level as transgression and guilt.
SENSES: 1. A financial debt or obligation owed (Ro 4:4)
2. A moral debt, transgression, or sin before God (Mt 6:12)

THAYER.pt: Aquilo que é devido, seja no plano financeiro literal ou no plano moral e espiritual como transgressão e culpa. 1. Uma dívida financeira ou obrigação devida (Rm 4.4). | 2. Uma dívida moral, transgressão ou pecado perante Deus (Mt 6.12).
THAYER.en: That which is owed, whether on a literal financial level or on a moral and spiritual level as transgression and guilt. 1. A financial debt or obligation owed (Ro 4:4) | 2. A moral debt, transgression, or sin before God (Mt 6:12)

SHORT_GLOSS: to owe, be obligated, be fitting
DEFINITION: To be under a financial, moral, or social obligation to satisfy a debt or fulfill a duty.
SENSES: 1. To have a financial debt or material liability to someone (Mt 18:30; Lk 7:41)
2. To be morally or spiritually obligated to act in a certain way, to be bound (Jn 13:14; Ro 13:8)
USAGE: to owe, be obligated, be fitting

THAYER.pt: Estar sob obrigação financeira, moral ou social de satisfazer uma dívida ou cumprir um dever. 1. Ter uma dívida financeira ou débito material com alguém (Mt 18.30; Lc 7.41). | 2. Estar moral ou espiritualmente obrigado a agir de certa forma, dever (Jo 13.14; Rm 13.8).
THAYER.en: To be under a financial, moral, or social obligation to satisfy a debt or fulfill a duty. 1. To have a financial debt or material liability to someone (Mt 18:30; Lk 7:41) | 2. To be morally or spiritually obligated to act in a certain way, to be bound (Jn 13:14; Ro 13:8)

DEFINITION: A particle used to express a strong desire that something had happened or could happen.
SENSES: 1. Expression of strong desire or lament (1Co 4:8; 2Co 11:1; Ga 5:12)

THAYER.pt: Uma partícula usada para expressar um forte desejo de que algo tivesse acontecido ou pudesse acontecer. 1. Expressão de forte desejo ou lamento (1Co 4.8; 2Co 11.1; Gl 5.12).
THAYER.en: A particle used to express a strong desire that something had happened or could happen. 1. Expression of strong desire or lament (1Co 4:8; 2Co 11:1; Ga 5:12)

DEFINITION: Benefit or practical utility obtained from a situation, object, or action. In the New Testament, it commonly appears in rhetorical questions to challenge the efficacy of faith without works.
SENSES: 1. Profit or advantage resulting from conduct or a state (Jas 2:16)

THAYER.pt: Benefício ou utilidade prática obtida de uma situação, objeto ou ação. No Novo Testamento, aparece comumente em perguntas retóricas para questionar a eficácia de uma fé sem obras. 1. Proveito ou vantagem decorrente de uma conduta ou estado (Tg 2.16).
THAYER.en: Benefit or practical utility obtained from a situation, object, or action. In the New Testament, it commonly appears in rhetorical questions to challenge the efficacy of faith without works. 1. Profit or advantage resulting from conduct or a state (Jas 2:16)

DEFINITION: Work or service performed only when under the observation of superiors, characterized by falsity and lack of sincerity.
SENSES: 1. Simulated service done only to please humans when watched (Eph 6:6; Col 3:22)

THAYER.pt: Trabalho ou serviço prestado apenas quando se está sob a observação de superiores, caracterizado pela falsidade e falta de sinceridade. 1. Serviço simulado feito apenas para agradar a humanos quando vigiado (Ef 6.6; Cl 3.22).
THAYER.en: Work or service performed only when under the observation of superiors, characterized by falsity and lack of sincerity. 1. Simulated service done only to please humans when watched (Eph 6:6; Col 3:22)

DEFINITION: Anatomical organ of physical vision; metaphorically, it represents the inner faculty of moral perception, spiritual discernment, and the purity of the soul's intentions.
SENSES: 1. The eye as an organ of external visual perception (Mt 5:38; Rev 1:7)
2. Mental or spiritual vision; inner capacity to discern truth (Mt 6:22; Eph 1:18)
3. Figuratively: covetousness, envy, or generosity, expressed through the gaze (Mt 20:15; 1Jn 2:16)

THAYER.pt: Órgão anatômico da visão física; metaforicamente, representa a faculdade interior da percepção moral, do discernimento espiritual e da pureza de intenções da alma. 1. O olho como órgão da percepção visual externa (Mt 5.38; Ap 1.7). | 2. Visão mental ou espiritual; capacidade interior de discernir a verdade (Mt 6.22; Ef 1.18). | 3. Figurativamente: cobiça, inveja ou generosidade, expressas pelo olhar (Mt 20.15; 1Jo 2.16).
THAYER.en: Anatomical organ of physical vision; metaphorically, it represents the inner faculty of moral perception, spiritual discernment, and the purity of the soul's intentions. 1. The eye as an organ of external visual perception (Mt 5:38; Rev 1:7) | 2. Mental or spiritual vision; inner capacity to discern truth (Mt 6:22; Eph 1:18) | 3. Figuratively: covetousness, envy, or generosity, expressed through the gaze (Mt 20:15; 1Jn 2:16)

DEFINITION: Legless reptile (serpent), frequently used in biblical symbolism to denote cunning, danger, or to personify the Devil himself.
SENSES: 1. A serpent or snake as a literal animal (Lk 10:19; Jas 3:7)
2. Metaphorical designation for cunning or dangerous people (Mt 23:33)
3. Symbol of the Adversary or Devil in apocalyptic tradition (Rev 12:9; 20:2)

THAYER.pt: Réptil sem patas (serpente), frequentemente usado no simbolismo bíblico para denotar astúcia, perigo ou personificar o próprio Diabo. 1. Uma serpente ou cobra como animal literal (Lc 10.19; Tg 3.7). | 2. Designação metafórica para pessoas astutas ou perigosas (Mt 23.33). | 3. Símbolo do Adversário ou Diabo na tradição apocalíptica (Ap 12.9; 20.2).
THAYER.en: Legless reptile (serpent), frequently used in biblical symbolism to denote cunning, danger, or to personify the Devil himself. 1. A serpent or snake as a literal animal (Lk 10:19; Jas 3:7) | 2. Metaphorical designation for cunning or dangerous people (Mt 23:33) | 3. Symbol of the Adversary or Devil in apocalyptic tradition (Rev 12:9; 20:2)

DEFINITION: Originally meaning eyebrow, but by topographical extension it is used to describe the steep edge or cliff of a hill or mountain.
SENSES: 1. The edge or steep top of a hill or precipice (Lk 4:29)

THAYER.pt: Originalmente significa sobrancelha, mas por extensão topográfica é empregado para descrever a borda escarpada ou o penhasco de uma colina ou monte. 1. A borda ou o topo escarpado de um monte ou precipício (Lc 4.29).
THAYER.en: Originally meaning eyebrow, but by topographical extension it is used to describe the steep edge or cliff of a hill or mountain. 1. The edge or steep top of a hill or precipice (Lk 4:29)

DEFINITION: To cause continuous suffering, to molest, or to severely disturb someone, frequently used in the context of oppression by evil spirits.
SENSES: 1. To cause physical or spiritual affliction or torment (Lk 6:18; Ac 5:16)

THAYER.pt: Significa causar sofrimento contínuo, molestar ou perturbar gravemente alguém, frequentemente usado no contexto de opressão por espíritos malignos. 1. Causar aflição ou tormento físico ou espiritual (Lc 6.18; At 5.16).
THAYER.en: To cause continuous suffering, to molest, or to severely disturb someone, frequently used in the context of oppression by evil spirits. 1. To cause physical or spiritual affliction or torment (Lk 6:18; Ac 5:16)

DEFINITION: To gather people in a tumultuous way to form a crowd or a riot against someone.
SENSES: 1. To form a mob or agitate a crowd (Acts 17.5).

THAYER.pt: Agrupar pessoas de forma tumultuada para formar uma multidão ou um motín contra alguém. 1. Formar uma turba ou agitar uma multidão (At 17.5).
THAYER.en: To gather people in a tumultuous way to form a crowd or a riot against someone. 1. To form a mob or agitate a crowd (Acts 17.5).

DEFINITION: A large contingent gathering of individuals assembled without formal deliberate organization. In the Gospels, it represents the common people who surrounded Jesus to hear His teachings and receive healings, sometimes contrasted with the aristocratic religious leadership.
SENSES: 1. An expressive crowd of people gathered together, a popular assembly (Matt 9.23; Mark 4.1).
2. The common masses, in opposition to civil or religious authorities (John 7.49; Acts 24.12).
3. A considerable group or contingent of like-minded people (Luke 5.29; Acts 1.15).

THAYER.pt: Grande ajuntamento contingente de indivíduos reunidos sem uma organização formal deliberada. Nos Evangelhos, representa o povo comum que cercava Jesus para ouvir Seus ensinos e receber curas, por vezes contrastado com a liderança religiosa aristocrática. 1. Multidão expressiva de pessoas agrupadas, assembleia popular (Mt 9.23; Mc 4.1). | 2. A massa popular comum, em oposição às autoridades civis ou religiosas (Jo 7.49; At 24.12). | 3. Grupo considerável ou contingente de pessoas afins (Lc 5.29; At 1.15).
THAYER.en: A large contingent gathering of individuals assembled without formal deliberate organization. In the Gospels, it represents the common people who surrounded Jesus to hear His teachings and receive healings, sometimes contrasted with the aristocratic religious leadership. 1. An expressive crowd of people gathered together, a popular assembly (Matt 9.23; Mark 4.1). | 2. The common masses, in opposition to civil or religious authorities (John 7.49; Acts 24.12). | 3. A considerable group or contingent of like-minded people (Luke 5.29; Acts 1.15).

DEFINITION: A fortified military installation or defensive wall; used figuratively in the New Testament to describe arguments or mental strongholds that resist the truth.
SENSES: 1. A military fortification or defensive stronghold (2 Cor 10.4).

THAYER.pt: Instalação militar fortificada ou muralha defensiva; usado figuradamente no Novo Testamento para descrever argumentos ou fortalezas mentais que resistem à verdade. 1. Uma fortificação militar ou fortaleza defensiva (2Co 10.4).
THAYER.en: A fortified military installation or defensive wall; used figuratively in the New Testament to describe arguments or mental strongholds that resist the truth. 1. A military fortification or defensive stronghold (2 Cor 10.4).

DEFINITION: A diminutive that originally meant any accompaniment for bread, but in NT Greek came to specifically designate cooked or roasted fish.
SENSES: 1. Fish used as food or accompaniment (John 6.9; 21.9).

THAYER.pt: Diminutivo que originalmente significava qualquer acompanhamento para o pão, mas que no grego do NT passou a designar especificamente peixe cozido ou assado. 1. Peixe usado como alimento ou acompanhamento (Jo 6.9; 21.9).
THAYER.en: A diminutive that originally meant any accompaniment for bread, but in NT Greek came to specifically designate cooked or roasted fish. 1. Fish used as food or accompaniment (John 6.9; 21.9).

DEFINITION: Indicates an advanced point late in the day, near sunset or after the end of a period.
SENSES: 1. Late in the evening or toward evening (Mark 11.19).
2. In a later temporal sense, after (Matt 28.1).

THAYER.pt: Indica um ponto avançado no final do dia, próximo ao pôr do sol ou após o término de um período. 1. No final da tarde ou tardinha (Mc 11.19). | 2. Em sentido temporal posterior, após (Mt 28.1).
THAYER.en: Indicates an advanced point late in the day, near sunset or after the end of a period. 1. Late in the evening or toward evening (Mark 11.19). | 2. In a later temporal sense, after (Matt 28.1).

DEFINITION: Refers to a late period of time, specifically applied to the spring rains in Middle Eastern agriculture.
SENSES: 1. The latter or spring rain that occurs before the harvest (Jas 5.7).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se ao período de tempo tardio, especificamente aplicado às chuvas de primavera na agricultura do Oriente Médio. 1. A chuva tardia ou de primavera que ocorre antes da colheita (Tg 5.7).
THAYER.en: Refers to a late period of time, specifically applied to the spring rains in Middle Eastern agriculture. 1. The latter or spring rain that occurs before the harvest (Jas 5.7).

DEFINITION: Describes something that occurs late or at an advanced point in the day, also used as a feminine noun to designate the evening period.
SENSES: 1. Relative to an advanced moment of the day or a late hour (Mark 11.11).
2. As a noun (ἡ ὀψία), the period between late afternoon and nightfall, eventide (Matt 8.16; John 20.19).

THAYER.pt: Descreve algo que ocorre tarde ou em um ponto avançado do dia, sendo também empregado no substantivo feminino para designar o período do entardecer. 1. Relativo a um momento avançado do dia ou a uma hora tardia (Mc 11.11). | 2. Como substantivo (ἡ ὀψία), o período entre o fim da tarde e o anoitecer, a noitescer (Mt 8.16; Jo 20.19).
THAYER.en: Describes something that occurs late or at an advanced point in the day, also used as a feminine noun to designate the evening period. 1. Relative to an advanced moment of the day or a late hour (Mark 11.11). | 2. As a noun (ἡ ὀψία), the period between late afternoon and nightfall, eventide (Matt 8.16; John 20.19).

DEFINITION: Refers to the act of seeing, the external appearance of something, or the physiognomy of the human face. Emphasizes immediate visual perception or the outward aspect of things.
SENSES: 1. Outward appearance or visible aspect (John 7.24);
2. The face or countenance as the expression of a person.

THAYER.pt: Refere-se ao ato de ver, à aparência externa de algo ou à fisionomia do rosto humano. Enfatiza a percepção visual imediata ou o aspecto exterior das coisas. 1. Aparência exterior ou aspecto visível (Jo 7.24); | 2. O rosto ou a face como expressão da pessoa.
THAYER.en: Refers to the act of seeing, the external appearance of something, or the physiognomy of the human face. Emphasizes immediate visual perception or the outward aspect of things. 1. Outward appearance or visible aspect (John 7.24); | 2. The face or countenance as the expression of a person.

DEFINITION: Originally payment or monetary provision given to soldiers, extending figuratively to retribution or recompense for deeds or actions.
SENSES: 1. The payment or wages of soldiers (Luke 3.14; 1 Cor 9.7).
2. The retributive result of an activity, reward, or pay (Rom 6.23).

THAYER.pt: Originalmente o pagamento ou provisão em dinheiro dado a soldados, estendendo-se figurativamente para retribuição ou recompensa por obras ou ações. 1. O pagamento ou salário de soldados (Lc 3.14; 1Co 9.7). | 2. O resultado retribuído por uma atividade, recompensa ou paga (Rm 6.23).
THAYER.en: Originally payment or monetary provision given to soldiers, extending figuratively to retribution or recompense for deeds or actions. 1. The payment or wages of soldiers (Luke 3.14; 1 Cor 9.7). | 2. The retributive result of an activity, reward, or pay (Rom 6.23).

TRANSLITERATED_LEXICAL_FORM: ho ón kai ho én kai ho erchomenos
DEFINITION: The Greek definite article used to particularize nouns or substantivize other classes of words.
SENSES: 1. Masculine singular definite article (Matt 1.1).
2. In complex theological expressions as divine titles (Rev 1.4).

THAYER.pt: O artigo definido grego usado para particularizar substantivos ou substantivar outras classes de palavras. 1. Artigo definido singular masculino (Mt 1.1). | 2. Em expressões teológicas complexas como títulos divinos (Ap 1.4).
THAYER.en: The Greek definite article used to particularize nouns or substantivize other classes of words. 1. Masculine singular definite article (Matt 1.1). | 2. In complex theological expressions as divine titles (Rev 1.4).

DEFINITION: A term derived from hunting meaning to set a trap or snare to entangle someone and catch them unawares.
SENSES: 1. To trap or catch someone in a snare or error (Matt 22.15).

THAYER.pt: Termo derivado da caça que significa armar uma armadilha ou laço para enredar alguém e pegá-lo desprevenido. 1. Apurar ou pegar alguém em uma armadilha ou erro (Mt 22.15).
THAYER.en: A term derived from hunting meaning to set a trap or snare to entangle someone and catch them unawares. 1. To trap or catch someone in a snare or error (Matt 22.15).

DEFINITION: A mechanical instrument used to capture animals by surprise; figuratively, refers to any moral or spiritual situation that traps a person in sin or sudden ruin.
SENSES: 1. Physical trap for hunting (Rom 11.9).
2. Spiritual snare, temptation, or sudden moral danger (1 Tim 3.7; 6.9).

THAYER.pt: Instrumento mecânico usado para capturar animais de surpresa; figuradamente, refere-se a qualquer situação moral ou espiritual que prenda a pessoa em pecado ou ruína repentina. 1. Armadilha física para caça (Rm 11.9). | 2. Cilada espiritual, tentação ou perigo moral repentino (1Tm 3.7; 6.9).
THAYER.en: A mechanical instrument used to capture animals by surprise; figuratively, refers to any moral or spiritual situation that traps a person in sin or sudden ruin. 1. Physical trap for hunting (Rom 11.9). | 2. Spiritual snare, temptation, or sudden moral danger (1 Tim 3.7; 6.9).

DEFINITION: That which is suffered or endured, referring primarily to physical pains, afflictions, or, in specific contexts, passions and impulses of the flesh.
SENSES: 1. Experience of suffering, affliction, or adversity (Rom 8.18; Col 1.24).
2. Impulses or desires of fallen human nature (Rom 7.5; Gal 5.24).

THAYER.pt: Aquilo que é sofrido ou suportado, referindo-se principalmente a dores físicas, aflições ou, em contextos específicos, paixões e impulsos da carne. 1. Experiência de sofrimento, aflição ou adversidade (Rm 8.18; Cl 1.24). | 2. Impulsos ou desejos da natureza humana caída (Rm 7.5; Gl 5.24).
THAYER.en: That which is suffered or endured, referring primarily to physical pains, afflictions, or, in specific contexts, passions and impulses of the flesh. 1. Experience of suffering, affliction, or adversity (Rom 8.18; Col 1.24). | 2. Impulses or desires of fallen human nature (Rom 7.5; Gal 5.24).

DEFINITION: A verbal adjective describing someone or something that is subject to undergoing suffering or pain.
SENSES: 1. Subject to suffering or destined for suffering (Acts 26.23).

THAYER.pt: Adjetivo verbal que descreve alguém ou algo que está sujeito a passar por sofrimento ou dor. 1. Sujeito a sofrer ou destinado ao sofrimento (At 26.23).
THAYER.en: A verbal adjective describing someone or something that is subject to undergoing suffering or pain. 1. Subject to suffering or destined for suffering (Acts 26.23).

DEFINITION: Originally that which is experienced or suffered; in the New Testament, it comes to designate intense passional impulses, especially degrading passions or disordered sexual desires.
SENSES: 1. Overwhelming passion or corrupted fleshly desire (Rom 1.26; 1 Thess 4.5).

THAYER.pt: Originalmente aquilo que se experimenta ou sofre; no Novo Testamento, passa a designar impulsos passionais intensos, especialmente paixões degradantes ou desejos sexuais desordenados. 1. Paixão avassaladora ou desejo carnal corrompido (Rm 1.26; 1Ts 4.5).
THAYER.en: Originally that which is experienced or suffered; in the New Testament, it comes to designate intense passional impulses, especially degrading passions or disordered sexual desires. 1. Overwhelming passion or corrupted fleshly desire (Rom 1.26; 1 Thess 4.5).

DEFINITION: In the Greco-Roman world, a slave charged with accompanying his master's son to school, watching his behavior, and guarding his moral discipline, exercising a severe but temporary tutelage.
SENSES: 1. Tutor or guide responsible for the discipline and protection of minors (1 Cor 4.15; Gal 3.24).

THAYER.pt: No mundo greco-romano, era o escravo encarregado de acompanhar o filho de seu senhor à escola, vigiar seu comportamento e zelar por sua disciplina moral, exercendo uma tutela severa mas temporária. 1. Tutor ou guia responsável pela disciplina e proteção de menores (1Co 4.15; Gl 3.24).
THAYER.en: In the Greco-Roman world, a slave charged with accompanying his master's son to school, watching his behavior, and guarding his moral discipline, exercising a severe but temporary tutelage. 1. Tutor or guide responsible for the discipline and protection of minors (1 Cor 4.15; Gal 3.24).

DEFINITION: Designates a small child or young boy, often carrying a tone of affection or fondness.
SENSES: 1. A small child or boy (Matt 11.16); 2. A lad or youth (John 6.9).

THAYER.pt: Designa uma criança pequena ou um jovem rapaz, muitas vezes carregando um tom de afeto ou carinho. 1. Uma criança pequena ou menino (Mt 11.16); 2. Um rapaz ou jovem (Jo 6.9).
THAYER.en: Designates a small child or young boy, often carrying a tone of affection or fondness. 1. A small child or boy (Matt 11.16); 2. A lad or youth (John 6.9).

DEFINITION: Process of upbringing, training, and instruction aimed at moral and responsible development, frequently including disciplinary correction.
SENSES: 1. Education and proper moral instruction for life (Eph 6.4; 2 Tim 3.16).
2. Corrective and providential discipline applied by God (Heb 12.5, 11).

THAYER.pt: Processo de criação, treinamento e instrução voltado para o desenvolvimento moral e responsável, frequentemente incluindo correção disciplinar. 1. Educação e instrução moral adequada para a vida (Ef 6.4; 2Tm 3.16). | 2. Disciplina corretiva e providencial aplicada por Deus (Hb 12.5, 11).
THAYER.en: Process of upbringing, training, and instruction aimed at moral and responsible development, frequently including disciplinary correction. 1. Education and proper moral instruction for life (Eph 6.4; 2 Tim 3.16). | 2. Corrective and providential discipline applied by God (Heb 12.5, 11).

DEFINITION: One who administers instruction and teachings for moral formation, or who applies corrective discipline.
SENSES: 1. Teacher or instructor who teaches principles of conduct (Rom 2.20).
2. One who disciplines or corrects for pedagogical purposes (Heb 12.9).

THAYER.pt: Aquele que ministra instrução e ensinamentos para a formação moral, ou que aplica disciplina corretiva. 1. Professor ou instrutor que ensina princípios de conduta (Rm 2.20). | 2. Aquele que disciplina ou corrige com fins pedagógicos (Hb 12.9).
THAYER.en: One who administers instruction and teachings for moral formation, or who applies corrective discipline. 1. Teacher or instructor who teaches principles of conduct (Rom 2.20). | 2. One who disciplines or corrects for pedagogical purposes (Heb 12.9).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: παιδεύσω, Aor: ἐπαίδευσα, Pass: ἐπαιδεύθην
DEFINITION: Involves the process of instructing for a responsible life, training character, or correcting through discipline and trials.
SENSES: 1. To instruct, teach, or educate formally (Acts 7.22; 22.3).
2. To discipline, correct, or chastise for moral and spiritual growth (1 Cor 11.32; Heb 12.6).

THAYER.pt: Envolve o processo de instruir para a vida responsável, treinar o caráter ou corrigir por meio de disciplina e provações. 1. Instruir, ensinar ou educar formalmente (At 7.22; 22.3). | 2. Disciplinar, corrigir ou castigar para o crescimento moral e espiritual (1Co 11.32; Hb 12.6).
THAYER.en: Involves the process of instructing for a responsible life, training character, or correcting through discipline and trials. 1. To instruct, teach, or educate formally (Acts 7.22; 22.3). | 2. To discipline, correct, or chastise for moral and spiritual growth (1 Cor 11.32; Heb 12.6).

DEFINITION: Adverb indicating the temporal starting point from early years of life or childhood.
SENSES: 1. From childhood or tender age (Mark 9.21).

THAYER.pt: Advérbio que indica o ponto de partida temporal a partir dos primeiros anos de vida ou da infância. 1. Desde a infância ou tenra idade (Mc 9.21).
THAYER.en: Adverb indicating the temporal starting point from early years of life or childhood. 1. From childhood or tender age (Mark 9.21).

DEFINITION: Designates a small child or baby, often with a connotation of vulnerability or family affection, and used metaphorically to indicate immaturity or humility.
SENSES: 1. Newborn baby or infant at the breast (Luke 2.17; John 16.21).
2. Child in development or childhood (Matt 18.2; Mark 10.13; John 4.49).
3. Affectionate address to disciples or spiritual dependents (John 21.5; 1 John 2.18).
4. Metaphor for spiritual simplicity or cognitive immaturity (Matt 18.3; 1 Cor 14.20).

THAYER.pt: Designa uma criança pequena ou bebê, muitas vezes com conotação de vulnerabilidade ou afeto familiar, e usada metaforicamente para indicar imaturidade ou humildade. 1. Bebê recém-nascido ou criança de colo (Lc 2.17; Jo 16.21). | 2. Criança em fase de desenvolvimento ou infância (Mt 18.2; Mc 10.13; Jo 4.49). | 3. Tratamento afetuoso a discípulos ou dependentes espirituais (Jo 21.5; 1Jo 2.18). | 4. Metáfora de simplicidade espiritual ou imaturidade cognitiva (Mt 18.3; 1Co 14.20).
THAYER.en: Designates a small child or baby, often with a connotation of vulnerability or family affection, and used metaphorically to indicate immaturity or humility. 1. Newborn baby or infant at the breast (Luke 2.17; John 16.21). | 2. Child in development or childhood (Matt 18.2; Mark 10.13; John 4.49). | 3. Affectionate address to disciples or spiritual dependents (John 21.5; 1 John 2.18). | 4. Metaphor for spiritual simplicity or cognitive immaturity (Matt 18.3; 1 Cor 14.20).

DEFINITION: Designates a young maidservant, maid, or slave girl who performed domestic services in a household.
SENSES: 1. Maidservant, slave girl, or domestic maid (Matt 26.69; Luke 12.45).

THAYER.pt: Designa uma jovem serva, criada ou escrava que prestava serviços domésticos em uma residência. 1. Serva, escrava ou criada doméstica (Mt 26.69; Lc 12.45).
THAYER.en: Designates a young maidservant, maid, or slave girl who performed domestic services in a household. 1. Maidservant, slave girl, or domestic maid (Matt 26.69; Luke 12.45).

DEFINITION: To engage in playful activities, games, or dances for entertainment and amusement.
SENSES: 1. To participate in festivities, dances, or play (1 Cor 10.7).

THAYER.pt: Envolver-se em atividades lúdicas, jogos ou danças para entretenimento e divertimento. 1. Participar de festividades, danças ou brincadeiras (1Co 10.7).
THAYER.en: To engage in playful activities, games, or dances for entertainment and amusement. 1. To participate in festivities, dances, or play (1 Cor 10.7).

DEFINITION: Refers to a young person (child or youth) or a direct descendant. By social extension in the Greco-Roman world, it also designates a devoted servant or slave.
SENSES: 1. A child or youth before puberty (Matt 17.18).
2. A son or direct descendant (John 4.51).
3. A subordinate servant or slave (Luke 7.7).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se a uma pessoa jovem (criança ou jovem) ou a um descendente direto. Por extensão social no mundo greco-romano, também designa um servo ou escravo dedicado. 1. Uma criança ou jovem antes da puberdade (Mt 17.18). | 2. Um filho ou descendente direto (Jo 4.51). | 3. Um servo ou escravo em subordinação (Lc 7.7).
THAYER.en: Refers to a young person (child or youth) or a direct descendant. By social extension in the Greco-Roman world, it also designates a devoted servant or slave. 1. A child or youth before puberty (Matt 17.18). | 2. A son or direct descendant (John 4.51). | 3. A subordinate servant or slave (Luke 7.7).

DEFINITION: Describes the action of delivering a violent blow against someone or something, whether with the body, a weapon, or through the sting of venomous animals.
SENSES: 1. To deliver a physical blow or wound with an instrument (Mark 14.47).
2. To wound or sting, like the attack of a scorpion (Rev 9.5).

THAYER.pt: Descreve a ação de desferir um golpe violento contra alguém ou algo, seja com o corpo, uma arma ou através do ferrão de animais peçonhentos. 1. Desferir um golpe físico ou ferir com instrumento (Mc 14.47). | 2. Ferir ou picar, como o ataque de um escorpião (Ap 9.5).
THAYER.en: Describes the action of delivering a violent blow against someone or something, whether with the body, a weapon, or through the sting of venomous animals. 1. To deliver a physical blow or wound with an instrument (Mark 14.47). | 2. To wound or sting, like the attack of a scorpion (Rev 9.5).

DEFINITION: Designation of a Roman province in the region of Phrygia (Phrygia Pacatiana).
SENSES: 1. Region or province of Pacatiana in Asia Minor.

THAYER.pt: Designação de uma província romana na região da Frígia (Frígia Pacaciana). 1. Região ou província da Pacaciana na Ásia Menor.
THAYER.en: Designation of a Roman province in the region of Phrygia (Phrygia Pacatiana). 1. Region or province of Pacatiana in Asia Minor.

DEFINITION: Indicates a considerable point or period of time in the past, equivalent to 'a long time ago' or 'formerly'.
SENSES: 1. At a distant time in the past, of old (Matt 11.21).
2. For a long period of time (2 Cor 12.19).

THAYER.pt: Indica um ponto ou período considerável de tempo no passado, equivalendo a 'há muito tempo' ou 'antigamente'. 1. Em um tempo distante no passado, outrora (Mt 11:21). | 2. Por um longo período de tempo (2Co 12:19).
THAYER.en: Indicates a considerable point or period of time in the past, equivalent to 'a long time ago' or 'formerly'. 1. At a distant time in the past, of old (Matt 11.21). | 2. For a long period of time (2 Cor 12.19).

DEFINITION: That which has existed for a long time or has lost validity and efficacy by being superseded by something new.
SENSES: 1. Old in chronological terms or prolonged use (Matt 9.16).
2. Obsolete or morally corrupted, like the 'old man' before conversion (Rom 6.6).

THAYER.pt: Aquilo que existe há muito tempo ou que perdeu a validade e a eficácia por ter sido superado por algo novo. 1. Velho em termos cronológicos ou de uso prolongado (Mt 9.16). | 2. Obsoleto ou moralmente corrompido, como o 'velho homem' antes da conversão (Rm 6.6).
THAYER.en: That which has existed for a long time or has lost validity and efficacy by being superseded by something new. 1. Old in chronological terms or prolonged use (Matt 9.16). | 2. Obsolete or morally corrupted, like the 'old man' before conversion (Rom 6.6).

DEFINITION: The state or condition of that which is old, obsolete, and superseded, in contrast to the newness of the Spirit.
SENSES: 1. The state of old age or the obsolete regime of the law (Rom 7.6).

THAYER.pt: O estado ou condição daquilo que é antigo, obsoleto e superado, em contraste com a novidade do Espírito. 1. O estado de velhice ou o regime obsoleto da lei (Rm 7.6).
THAYER.en: The state or condition of that which is old, obsolete, and superseded, in contrast to the newness of the Spirit. 1. The state of old age or the obsolete regime of the law (Rom 7.6).

DEFINITION: Describes the action of making something old, outdated, or obsolete, losing validity over time.
SENSES: 1. To make something old or declare it obsolete (Heb 8:13)
2. To age or wear out with the passage of time (Heb 1:11; Lk 12:33)

THAYER.pt: Descreve a ação de tornar algo velho, ultrapassado ou obsoleto, perdendo a validade com o tempo. 1. Tornar algo velho ou declarar como obsoleto (Hb 8.13). | 2. Envelhecer ou desgastar-se com o passar do tempo (Hb 1.11; Lc 12.33).
THAYER.en: Describes the action of making something old, outdated, or obsolete, losing validity over time. 1. To make something old or declare it obsolete (Heb 8:13) | 2. To age or wear out with the passage of time (Heb 1:11; Lk 12:33)

DEFINITION: Describes a demanding hand-to-hand combat or struggle, used in the New Testament for the spiritual warfare of believers.
SENSES: 1. An intense struggle or conflict against spiritual forces (Eph 6:12)

THAYER.pt: Descreve um combate ou luta corpo a corpo exigente, usado no Novo Testamento para a guerra espiritual dos crentes. 1. Uma luta intensa ou conflito contra forças espirituais (Ef 6.12).
THAYER.en: Describes a demanding hand-to-hand combat or struggle, used in the New Testament for the spiritual warfare of believers. 1. An intense struggle or conflict against spiritual forces (Eph 6:12)

DEFINITION: The state of profound renewal, whether in a cosmic dimension (the restoration of all things) or a spiritual one (the salvation and new birth of the believer).
SENSES: 1. The cosmic renewal associated with the messianic age (Mt 19:28)
2. The spiritual regeneration and new birth of the believer in Christ (Tit 3:5)

THAYER.pt: O estado de renovação profunda, seja em dimensão cósmica (a restauração de todas as coisas) ou espiritual (a salvação e o novo nascimento do crente). 1. A renovação cósmica associada à era messiânica (Mt 19.28). | 2. A regeneração espiritual e o novo nascimento do crente em Cristo (Tt 3.5).
THAYER.en: The state of profound renewal, whether in a cosmic dimension (the restoration of all things) or a spiritual one (the salvation and new birth of the believer). 1. The cosmic renewal associated with the messianic age (Mt 19:28) | 2. The spiritual regeneration and new birth of the believer in Christ (Tit 3:5)

DEFINITION: Indicates temporal repetition of an action that has already occurred ('again'), a return to an original starting point, or serves as a discursive connective of addition ('furthermore') and antithesis ('on the other hand').
SENSES: 1. Repetition of an action: again, anew, once more (Mt 4:8; Jn 14:3)
2. Return to the initial point or state: back (Jn 11:7; Ac 18:21)
3. Additive or antithetical transition: furthermore, on the other hand (Mt 4:7; 1Co 3:20)

THAYER.pt: Indica repetição temporal de uma ação já ocorrida ('de novo'), retorno a um local original de partida ou serve como conectivo discursivo de acréscimo ('além disso') e antítese ('por outro lado'). 1. Repetição de uma ação: de novo, novamente, mais uma vez (Mt 4.8; Jo 14.3). | 2. Retorno ao ponto ou estado inicial: de volta (Jo 11.7; At 18.21). | 3. Transição aditiva ou antitética: além disso, por outro lado (Mt 4.7; 1Co 3.20).
THAYER.en: Indicates temporal repetition of an action that has already occurred ('again'), a return to an original starting point, or serves as a discursive connective of addition ('furthermore') and antithesis ('on the other hand'). 1. Repetition of an action: again, anew, once more (Mt 4:8; Jn 14:3) | 2. Return to the initial point or state: back (Jn 11:7; Ac 18:21) | 3. Additive or antithetical transition: furthermore, on the other hand (Mt 4:7; 1Co 3:20)

DEFINITION: Adverb denoting a multitude acting collectively and unanimously at the same instant.
SENSES: 1. All together or in unison (Lk 23:18)

THAYER.pt: Advérbio que denota uma multidão agindo coletivamente e de forma unânime no mesmo instante. 1. Todos juntos ou em uníssono (Lc 23.18).
THAYER.en: Adverb denoting a multitude acting collectively and unanimously at the same instant. 1. All together or in unison (Lk 23:18)

DEFINITION: Adjective denoting an extremely high or grand quantity.
SENSES: 1. In great quantity, very great, enormous multitude (Mk 8:1)

THAYER.pt: Adjetivo que denota uma quantidade extremamente elevada ou grandiosa. 1. Em grande quantidade, muitíssimo, enorme multidão (Mc 8.1).
THAYER.en: Adjective denoting an extremely high or grand quantity. 1. In great quantity, very great, enormous multitude (Mk 8:1)

DEFINITION: Ancient province located in the southern region of Asia Minor, bathed by the Mediterranean Sea, visited by Paul during his missionary journeys.
SENSES: 1. Roman province in Asia Minor (Ac 13:13)

THAYER.pt: Antiga província localizada na região sul da Ásia Menor, banhada pelo mar Mediterrâneo, visitada por Paulo durante suas viagens missionárias. 1. Província romana na Ásia Menor (At 13.13).
THAYER.en: Ancient province located in the southern region of Asia Minor, bathed by the Mediterranean Sea, visited by Paul during his missionary journeys. 1. Roman province in Asia Minor (Ac 13:13)

DEFINITION: A public establishment where travelers could find lodging, shelter, and rest during the night.
SENSES: 1. Inn or public lodging for travelers (Lk 10:34)

THAYER.pt: Um estabelecimento público onde viajantes podiam encontrar pousada, abrigo e descanso durante a noite. 1. Estalagem ou hospedaria pública para viajantes (Lc 10.34).
THAYER.en: A public establishment where travelers could find lodging, shelter, and rest during the night. 1. Inn or public lodging for travelers (Lk 10:34)

DEFINITION: The person responsible for managing an inn and caring for guests and travelers.
SENSES: 1. The innkeeper or manager of a lodging house (Lk 10:35)

THAYER.pt: A pessoa responsável por gerenciar uma estalagem e cuidar dos hóspedes e viajantes. 1. O estalajadeiro ou gerente de uma hospedaria (Lc 10.35).
THAYER.en: The person responsible for managing an inn and caring for guests and travelers. 1. The innkeeper or manager of a lodging house (Lk 10:35)

DEFINITION: A large assembly or congregation gathered for a joyful, solemn, or festive celebration.
SENSES: 1. Festive gathering or solemn assembly of the saved (Heb 12:22)

THAYER.pt: Uma grande assembleia ou congregação reunida para uma celebração alegre, solene ou festiva. 1. Reunião festiva ou assembleia solene dos salvos (Hb 12.22).
THAYER.en: A large assembly or congregation gathered for a joyful, solemn, or festive celebration. 1. Festive gathering or solemn assembly of the saved (Heb 12:22)

SHORT_GLOSS: with the whole house, whole family
DEFINITION: Indicates that an action or event involved all the people who make up a single family or household.
SENSES: 1. Together with the whole family or household (Acts 16:34).
USAGE: with the whole house, whole family

THAYER.pt: Indica que uma ação ou evento envolveu todas as pessoas que compõem uma mesma família ou residência. 1. Juntamente com toda a família ou casa (At 16.34).
THAYER.en: Indicates that an action or event involved all the people who make up a single family or household. 1. Together with the whole family or household (Acts 16:34).

DEFINITION: The complete set of defensive and offensive weapons of a fully equipped soldier. In New Testament literature, it acquired a profound metaphorical sense to describe the spiritual resources granted by God to the believer.
SENSES: 1. Complete military equipment of a soldier (Luke 11:22);
2. The spiritual armor of God for the battle against evil (Eph 6:11).

THAYER.pt: O conjunto completo de armas defensivas e ofensivas de um soldado totalmente equipado. Na literatura neotestamentária, adquiriu profundo sentido metafórico para descrever os recursos espirituais concedidos por Deus ao crente. 1. Equipamento militar completo de um soldado (Lc 11.22); | 2. A armadura espiritual de Deus para a batalha contra o mal (Ef 6.11).
THAYER.en: The complete set of defensive and offensive weapons of a fully equipped soldier. In New Testament literature, it acquired a profound metaphorical sense to describe the spiritual resources granted by God to the believer. 1. Complete military equipment of a soldier (Luke 11:22); | 2. The spiritual armor of God for the battle against evil (Eph 6:11).

DEFINITION: The quality of a person ready to do anything to achieve their ends, denoting malicious cunning, duplicity, or trickery.
SENSES: 1. Deceitful craftiness or calculated malice (Luke 20:23; 2 Cor 4:2).

THAYER.pt: Qualidade da pessoa pronta para fazer qualquer coisa para atingir seus fins, denotando astúcia maligna, duplicidade ou trapaça. 1. Astúcia enganosa ou malícia calculada (Lc 20.23; 2Co 4.2).
THAYER.en: The quality of a person ready to do anything to achieve their ends, denoting malicious cunning, duplicity, or trickery. 1. Deceitful craftiness or calculated malice (Luke 20:23; 2 Cor 4:2).

DEFINITION: Describes someone who is crafty, capable of anything to reach their goals, possessing a strong negative moral connotation in the New Testament.
SENSES: 1. Crafty, shrewd, or deceitful in an unfavorable sense (2 Cor 12:16).

THAYER.pt: Descreve alguém que é astuto, capaz de qualquer coisa para alcançar seus objetivos, possuindo forte conotação moral negativa no Novo Testamento. 1. Astuto, sagaz ou trapaceiro em sentido desfavorável (2Co 12.16).
THAYER.en: Describes someone who is crafty, capable of anything to reach their goals, possessing a strong negative moral connotation in the New Testament. 1. Crafty, shrewd, or deceitful in an unfavorable sense (2 Cor 12:16).

DEFINITION: Indicates movement or origin from all possible directions.
SENSES: 1. From all directions or from everywhere (Mark 1:45).

THAYER.pt: Indica movimento ou procedência a partir de todas as direções possíveis. 1. De todas as direções ou de toda parte (Mc 1.45).
THAYER.en: Indicates movement or origin from all possible directions. 1. From all directions or from everywhere (Mark 1:45).

DEFINITION: Adverb indicating presence or coverage in all possible directions or locations; everywhere.
SENSES: 1. In all places or anywhere (Mark 16:20; Acts 28:22).

THAYER.pt: Advérbio que indica presença ou abrangência em todas as direções ou locais possíveis; por toda parte. 1. Em todos os lugares ou em qualquer parte (Mc 16:20; At 28:22).
THAYER.en: Adverb indicating presence or coverage in all possible directions or locations; everywhere. 1. In all places or anywhere (Mark 16:20; Acts 28:22).

DEFINITION: That which reaches the maximum degree of totality, completeness, or perpetual duration.
SENSES: 1. In a complete, absolute, and perfect manner (Luke 13:11).
2. Forever, in perpetuity (Heb 7:25).

THAYER.pt: Que atinge o grau máximo de totalidade, completude ou duração perpétua. 1. De maneira completa, absoluta e perfeita (Lc 13.11). | 2. Para sempre, em perpetuidade (Hb 7.25).
THAYER.en: That which reaches the maximum degree of totality, completeness, or perpetual duration. 1. In a complete, absolute, and perfect manner (Luke 13:11). | 2. Forever, in perpetuity (Heb 7:25).

DEFINITION: Adverb denoting total coverage, applying to all possible directions, considerations, or circumstances.
SENSES: 1. In every way, in all senses or places (Acts 24:3).

THAYER.pt: Advérbio que denota abrangência total, aplicando-se a todas as direções, considerações ou circunstâncias possíveis. 1. De toda maneira, em todos os sentidos ou lugares (At 24.3).
THAYER.en: Adverb denoting total coverage, applying to all possible directions, considerations, or circumstances. 1. In every way, in all senses or places (Acts 24:3).

DEFINITION: Adverb denoting origin or extension from all possible directions, meaning 'from all sides' or 'completely around'.
SENSES: 1. Proceeding from or situated in all directions (Mark 1:45; Luke 19:43).

THAYER.pt: Advérbio que denotam origem ou extensão a partir de todas as direções possíveis, significando 'de todos os lados' ou 'em redor por completo'. 1. Procedente ou situado em todas as direções (Mc 1.45; Lc 19.43).
THAYER.en: Adverb denoting origin or extension from all possible directions, meaning 'from all sides' or 'completely around'. 1. Proceeding from or situated in all directions (Mark 1:45; Luke 19:43).

DEFINITION: Exclusive title for God that expresses His absolute sovereignty and unlimited power over the entire universe.
SENSES: 1. The Almighty, the God who governs all things (2 Cor 6:18; Rev 1:8).

THAYER.pt: Título exclusivo para Deus que expressa Sua soberania absoluta e poder ilimitado sobre todo o universo. 1. O Todo-Poderoso, o Deus que governa todas as coisas (2Co 6.18; Ap 1.8).
THAYER.en: Exclusive title for God that expresses His absolute sovereignty and unlimited power over the entire universe. 1. The Almighty, the God who governs all things (2 Cor 6:18; Rev 1:8).

DEFINITION: In a continuous and permanent manner, without interruption throughout all occasions.
SENSES: 1. At all times, continuously, always (Matt 26:11; Luke 15:31; 1 Thess 5:16).

THAYER.pt: De modo contínuo e permanente, sem interrupção ao longo de todas as ocasiões. 1. Em todo o tempo, continuamente, sempre (Mt 26.11; Lc 15.31; 1Ts 5.16).
THAYER.en: In a continuous and permanent manner, without interruption throughout all occasions. 1. At all times, continuously, always (Matt 26:11; Luke 15:31; 1 Thess 5:16).

SHORT_GLOSS: certainly, by all means, without fail
DEFINITION: Adverb expressing strong conviction, totality, or inevitable conclusion about a fact.
SENSES: 1. Certainly, without doubt, or in any way (Acts 28:4; 1 Cor 9:22).
USAGE: certainly, by all means, without fail

THAYER.pt: Advérbio que expressa forte convicção, totalidade ou conclusão inevitável sobre um fato. 1. Certamente, sem dúvida ou de qualquer maneira (At 28.4; 1Co 9.22).
THAYER.en: Adverb expressing strong conviction, totality, or inevitable conclusion about a fact. 1. Certainly, without doubt, or in any way (Acts 28:4; 1 Cor 9:22).

DEFINITION: Spatial preposition whose basic idea is proximity and lateral position ('beside', 'by'). With the genitive, it indicates origin from someone; with the dative, it indicates presence or association; with the accusative, it denotes movement toward, comparison, or transgression.
SENSES: 1. With genitive: from the side of, proceeding from someone (John 1:6; John 15:26).
2. With dative: beside, near, before, in the presence of (John 19:25; Rom 2:13).
3. With accusative: at the margin of, beyond, in comparison with, contrary to (Matt 13:4; Rom 1:25).

THAYER.pt: Preposição espacial cuja ideia básica é proximidade e lateralidade ('junto a', 'ao lado'). Com o genitivo indica proveniência da parte de alguém; com o dativo indica presença ou convívio; com acusativo denota movimento para perto, comparação ou transgressão. 1. Com genitivo: da parte de, procedente de alguém (Jo 1.6; Jo 15.26). | 2. Com dativo: ao lado de, junto a, diante de, na presença de (Jo 19.25; Rm 2.13). | 3. Com acusativo: à margem de, além de, em comparação com, contrário a (Mt 13.4; Rm 1.25).
THAYER.en: Spatial preposition whose basic idea is proximity and lateral position ('beside', 'by'). With the genitive, it indicates origin from someone; with the dative, it indicates presence or association; with the accusative, it denotes movement toward, comparison, or transgression. 1. With genitive: from the side of, proceeding from someone (John 1:6; John 15:26). | 2. With dative: beside, near, before, in the presence of (John 19:25; Rom 2:13). | 3. With accusative: at the margin of, beyond, in comparison with, contrary to (Matt 13:4; Rom 1:25).

DEFINITION: Literally means to 'go beyond' established limits and, by extension, to violate legal, moral, or religious precepts, acting contrary to an established norm.
SENSES: 1. To deviate from a path or abandon a function (Acts 1:25);
2. To transgress or break a law or commandment (Matt 15:2-3).

THAYER.pt: Significa literalmente 'passar além' de limites estabelecidos e, por extensão, violar preceitos legais, morais ou religiosos, agindo de forma contrária a uma norma estabelecida. 1. Desviar-se de um caminho ou abandonar uma função (At 1.25); | 2. Transgredir ou quebrar uma lei ou mandamento (Mt 15.2-3).
THAYER.en: Literally means to 'go beyond' established limits and, by extension, to violate legal, moral, or religious precepts, acting contrary to an established norm. 1. To deviate from a path or abandon a function (Acts 1:25); | 2. To transgress or break a law or commandment (Matt 15:2-3).

DEFINITION: Primarily means to place something alongside for comparison, to expose oneself to danger, or to approach a place by sea in the context of the New Testament.
SENSES: 1. To compare or place side by side (Mark 4:30 v.l.).
2. To approach or arrive at a place by ship (Acts 20:15).

THAYER.pt: Significa primariamente colocar algo ao lado para comparação, expor-se a perigos ou aproximar-se de um lugar por via marítima no contexto do Novo Testamento. 1. Comparar ou colocar lado a lado (Mc 4:30 v.l.). | 2. Aproximar-se ou chegar a um lugar por navio (At 20:15).
THAYER.en: Primarily means to place something alongside for comparison, to expose oneself to danger, or to approach a place by sea in the context of the New Testament. 1. To compare or place side by side (Mark 4:30 v.l.). | 2. To approach or arrive at a place by ship (Acts 20:15).

DEFINITION: The act of deviating from an established limit, norm, or law, constituting a conscious offense.
SENSES: 1. The transgression or deliberate violation of God's law (Rom 2:23; 5:14).

THAYER.pt: O ato de desviar-se de um limite estabelecido, norma ou lei, constituindo uma ofensa consciente. 1. A transgressão ou violação deliberada da lei de Deus (Rm 2:23; 5:14).
THAYER.en: The act of deviating from an established limit, norm, or law, constituting a conscious offense. 1. The transgression or deliberate violation of God's law (Rom 2:23; 5:14).

DEFINITION: One who deliberately violates an established law, precept, or commandment, becoming guilty before the competent authority.
SENSES: 1. Transgressor of the law or offender of divine commandments (Rom 2:25; James 2:11).

THAYER.pt: Aquele que viola deliberadamente uma lei, preceito ou mandamento estabelecido, tornando-se culpado perante a autoridade competente. 1. Transgressor da lei ou infrator de mandamentos divinos (Rm 2.25; Tg 2.11).
THAYER.en: One who deliberately violates an established law, precept, or commandment, becoming guilty before the competent authority. 1. Transgressor of the law or offender of divine commandments (Rom 2:25; James 2:11).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Pres. / Impf. pass. poetic or middle
DEFINITION: To make a strong insistence or exert persuasive pressure to convince someone to take a certain attitude.
SENSES: 1. Urgency or vehement insistence that someone accept an invitation or request (Luke 24:29; Acts 16:15).

THAYER.pt: Fazer forte insistência ou exercer pressão persuasiva para convencer alguém a tomar certa atitude. 1. Urgência ou insistência veemente para que alguém aceite um convite ou pedido (Lc 24.29; At 16.15).
THAYER.en: To make a strong insistence or exert persuasive pressure to convince someone to take a certain attitude. 1. Urgency or vehement insistence that someone accept an invitation or request (Luke 24:29; Acts 16:15).

DEFINITION: Illustrative narrative or figurative comparison that juxtaposes a common earthly experience with a spiritual reality for the purpose of clarifying the Kingdom of God or provoking moral reflection.
SENSES: 1. Parable or allegorical narrative with a spiritual lesson (Matt 13:3; Mark 4:2; Luke 8:4).
2. Proverb, maxim, or enigmatic saying (Luke 4:23; Matt 15:15).
3. Symbol, prophetic type, or prefigurative figure (Heb 9:9; Heb 11:19).

THAYER.pt: Narrativa ilustrativa ou comparação figurada que justapõe uma experiência terrena comum a uma realidade espiritual com o propósito de esclarecer o Reino de Deus ou provocar reflexão moral. 1. Parábola ou narrativa alegórica com lição espiritual (Mt 13.3; Mc 4.2; Lc 8.4). | 2. Provérbio, máxima ou dito enigmático (Lc 4.23; Mt 15.15). | 3. Símbolo, tipo profético ou figura prefigurativa (Hb 9.9; Hb 11.19).
THAYER.en: Illustrative narrative or figurative comparison that juxtaposes a common earthly experience with a spiritual reality for the purpose of clarifying the Kingdom of God or provoking moral reflection. 1. Parable or allegorical narrative with a spiritual lesson (Matt 13:3; Mark 4:2; Luke 8:4). | 2. Proverb, maxim, or enigmatic saying (Luke 4:23; Matt 15:15). | 3. Symbol, prophetic type, or prefigurative figure (Heb 9:9; Heb 11:19).

DEFINITION: Describes the attitude of risking one's life or demonstrating neglect regarding one's own safety for the sake of a cause or service.
SENSES: 1. To risk one's life or expose oneself to danger for Christian work (Phil 2:30 v.l.).

THAYER.pt: Descreve a atitude de arriscar a vida ou demonstrar descuido em relação à própria segurança por causa de uma causa ou serviço. 1. Arriscar a vida ou expor-se ao perigo pelo trabalho cristão (Fp 2:30 v.l.).
THAYER.en: Describes the attitude of risking one's life or demonstrating neglect regarding one's own safety for the sake of a cause or service. 1. To risk one's life or expose oneself to danger for Christian work (Phil 2:30 v.l.).

DEFINITION: An official announcement or formal instruction conveyed with authority regarding what must be done or fulfilled.
SENSES: 1. A formal order or instruction given with authority (Acts 5:28; 1 Thess 4:2).

THAYER.pt: Anúncio oficial ou instrução formal transmitida com autoridade sobre o que deve ser feito ou cumprido. 1. Ordem ou instrução formal dada com autoridade (At 5.28; 1Ts 4.2).
THAYER.en: An official announcement or formal instruction conveyed with authority regarding what must be done or fulfilled. 1. A formal order or instruction given with authority (Acts 5:28; 1 Thess 4:2).

DEFINITION: To convey official instructions, orders, or directives with authority regarding what must be done.
SENSES: 1. To give orders, instruct, or command with authority (1 Thess 4:11; 2 Thess 3:4).

THAYER.pt: Transmitir instruções oficiais, ordens ou diretrizes com autoridade a respeito do que deve ser feito. 1. Dar ordens, instruir ou mandar com autoridade (1Ts 4.11; 2Ts 3.4).
THAYER.en: To convey official instructions, orders, or directives with authority regarding what must be done. 1. To give orders, instruct, or command with authority (1 Thess 4:11; 2 Thess 3:4).

DEFINITION: To move in order to be present at a specific location, often for the purpose of providing assistance.
SENSES: 1. To arrive at a place or make oneself present (Matt 3:13; Luke 7:45).
2. To appear in order to provide aid or defense (2 Tim 4:16).

THAYER.pt: Movimentar-se para estar presente em um determinado local, muitas vezes com o propósito de auxiliar. 1. Chegar a um lugar ou fazer-se presente (Mt 3.13; Lc 7.45). | 2. Apresentar-se para prestar auxílio ou defesa (2Tm 4.16).
THAYER.en: To move in order to be present at a specific location, often for the purpose of providing assistance. 1. To arrive at a place or make oneself present (Matt 3:13; Luke 7:45). | 2. To appear in order to provide aid or defense (2 Tim 4:16).

DEFINITION: To move along a path leaving a position, or to pass from existence to cessation.
SENSES: 1. To go away or withdraw from a place (Matt 9:9; John 8:59).
2. To pass by a reference point (Mark 1:16).
3. To cease to exist, to pass away (1 Cor 7:31; 1 John 2:8).

THAYER.pt: Mover-se ao longo de um trajeto deixando uma posição, ou passar da existência para a cessação. 1. Ir embora ou retirar-se de um lugar (Mt 9.9; Jo 8.59). | 2. Passar por um ponto de referência (Mc 1.16). | 3. Deixar de existir, passar (1Co 7.31; 1Jo 2.8).
THAYER.en: To move along a path leaving a position, or to pass from existence to cessation. 1. To go away or withdraw from a place (Matt 9:9; John 8:59). | 2. To pass by a reference point (Mark 1:16). | 3. To cease to exist, to pass away (1 Cor 7:31; 1 John 2:8).

DEFINITION: Indicates the act of exposing someone to public dishonor or shame, making them a negative example before society.
SENSES: 1. To expose someone to public dishonor or humiliation (Matt 1:19).
2. To expose publicly to shame in a figurative sense (Heb 6:6).

THAYER.pt: Indica a ação de expor alguém à desonra ou vergonha pública, tornando-o um exemplo negativo perante a sociedade. 1. Expor alguém à desonra pública ou humilhação (Mt 1:19). | 2. Expor publicamente à vergonha em sentido figurado (Hb 6:6).
THAYER.en: Indicates the act of exposing someone to public dishonor or shame, making them a negative example before society. 1. To expose someone to public dishonor or humiliation (Matt 1:19). | 2. To expose publicly to shame in a figurative sense (Heb 6:6).

DEFINITION: Originates from a Persian term for an enclosed park or royal orchard. In the biblical context, it came to designate the Garden of Eden and, subsequently, the celestial sphere of blessedness reserved for the saved.
SENSES: 1. The Garden of Eden or the celestial state of dwelling with God (2 Cor 12:4; Rev 2:7).

THAYER.pt: Origina-se de um termo persa para parque fechado ou pomar real. No contexto bíblico, passou a designar o Jardim do Éden e, posteriormente, a esfera celestial de bem-aventurança reservada aos salvos. 1. O Jardim do Éden ou o estado celestial de habitação com Deus (2Co 12.4; Ap 2.7).
THAYER.en: Originates from a Persian term for an enclosed park or royal orchard. In the biblical context, it came to designate the Garden of Eden and, subsequently, the celestial sphere of blessedness reserved for the saved. 1. The Garden of Eden or the celestial state of dwelling with God (2 Cor 12:4; Rev 2:7).

DEFINITION: Means to welcome someone with hospitality or to agree with the truthfulness of a doctrine, teaching, or testimony.
SENSES: 1. To accept and recognize a teaching or testimony as true (Mark 4:20; Acts 22:18).
2. To receive a person with hospitality and friendship (Acts 16:21).

THAYER.pt: Significa acolher alguém com hospitalidade ou concordar com a veracidade de uma doutrina, ensino ou testemunho. 1. Aceitar e reconhecer um ensinamento ou testemunho como verdadeiro (Mc 4.20; At 22.18). | 2. Receber uma pessoa com hospitalidade e amizade (At 16.21).
THAYER.en: Means to welcome someone with hospitality or to agree with the truthfulness of a doctrine, teaching, or testimony. 1. To accept and recognize a teaching or testimony as true (Mark 4:20; Acts 22:18). | 2. To receive a person with hospitality and friendship (Acts 16:21).

DEFINITION: Refers to sterile discussions, continuous altercations, or wasting time with debates over irrelevant issues.
SENSES: 1. Useless discussions and verbal contentions motivated by mental depravity (1 Tim 6:5).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se a discussões estéreis, altercações contínuas ou perda de tempo com debates sobre questões irrelevantes. 1. Discussões inúteis e contendas verbais motivadas por depravação mental (1Tm 6:5).
THAYER.en: Refers to sterile discussions, continuous altercations, or wasting time with debates over irrelevant issues. 1. Useless discussions and verbal contentions motivated by mental depravity (1 Tim 6:5).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: παραδώσω, Aor: παρέδωκα, Perf: παραδέδωκα, Pass: παραδέδομαι
DEFINITION: To pass something or someone into the possession, power, or custody of another; includes premeditated betrayal, the commissioning of goods, and the transmission of Christian faith teaching.
SENSES: 1. To deliver into legal custody, prison, or judgment; to betray (Matt 26:15; Mark 15:1; John 18:2).
2. To entrust, to commit to someone's care (Matt 25:14; Acts 14:26).
3. To transmit doctrinal instructions, precepts, or traditions (1 Cor 11:2, 23; Jude 3).

THAYER.pt: Passar algo ou alguém para a posse, poder ou custódia de outrem; inclui a traição premeditada, a comissão de bens e a transmissão do ensino da fé cristã. 1. Entregar sob custódia legal, prisão ou julgamento; trair (Mt 26.15; Mc 15.1; Jo 18.2). | 2. Confiar, encomendar aos cuidados de alguém (Mt 25.14; At 14.26). | 3. Transmitir instruções doutrinárias, preceitos ou tradições (1Co 11.2, 23; Jd 3).
THAYER.en: To pass something or someone into the possession, power, or custody of another; includes premeditated betrayal, the commissioning of goods, and the transmission of Christian faith teaching. 1. To deliver into legal custody, prison, or judgment; to betray (Matt 26:15; Mark 15:1; John 18:2). | 2. To entrust, to commit to someone's care (Matt 25:14; Acts 14:26). | 3. To transmit doctrinal instructions, precepts, or traditions (1 Cor 11:2, 23; Jude 3).

DEFINITION: Describes something that exceeds normal expectations, being unusual, surprising, or difficult to believe.
SENSES: 1. Unusual, extraordinary, or wonderful things that cause surprise (Luke 5:26).

THAYER.pt: Descreve algo que ultrapassa as expectativas normais, sendo incomum, surpreendente ou difícil de acreditar. 1. Coisas incomuns, extraordinárias ou maravilhosas que surpreendem (Lc 5:26).
THAYER.en: Describes something that exceeds normal expectations, being unusual, surprising, or difficult to believe. 1. Unusual, extraordinary, or wonderful things that cause surprise (Luke 5:26).

DEFINITION: Refers to the content of teachings, doctrines, or practices transmitted orally or in writing from generation to generation.
SENSES: 1. Religious traditions or teachings transmitted by ancestors (Matt 15:2; Gal 1:14).
2. Apostolic doctrines transmitted to the Christian community (2 Thess 2:15; 3:6).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se ao conteúdo de ensinamentos, doutrinas ou práticas transmitidas oralmente ou por escrito de geração em geração. 1. Tradições religiosas ou ensinamentos transmitidos pelos antepassados (Mt 15.2; Gl 1.14). | 2. Doutrinas apostólicas transmitidas à comunidade cristã (2Ts 2.15; 3.6).
THAYER.en: Refers to the content of teachings, doctrines, or practices transmitted orally or in writing from generation to generation. 1. Religious traditions or teachings transmitted by ancestors (Matt 15:2; Gal 1:14). | 2. Apostolic doctrines transmitted to the Christian community (2 Thess 2:15; 3:6).

DEFINITION: Means to incite someone to feel jealousy, emulation, or resentment, frequently used in the NT to describe the divine strategy of awakening Israel.
SENSES: 1. To provoke jealousy or awaken envy in someone (Rom 10:19; 1 Cor 10:22).
