THAYER.pt: Significa incitar alguém a sentir ciúmes, emulação ou ressentimento, frequentemente usado no NT para descrever a estratégia divina de despertar Israel. 1. Provocar ciúme ou despertar inveja em alguém (Rm 10.19; 1Co 10.22).
THAYER.en: Means to incite someone to feel jealousy, emulation, or resentment, frequently used in the NT to describe the divine strategy of awakening Israel. 1. To provoke jealousy or awaken envy in someone (Rom 10:19; 1 Cor 10:22).

DEFINITION: Qualifies locations or geographical regions situated in the vicinity of the sea or a lake.
SENSES: 1. Located by the sea or lake (Matt 4:13).

THAYER.pt: Qualifica locais ou regiões geográficas situadas nas proximidades do mar ou de um lago. 1. Localizado à beira do mar ou do lago (Mt 4:13).
THAYER.en: Qualifies locations or geographical regions situated in the vicinity of the sea or a lake. 1. Located by the sea or lake (Matt 4:13).

DEFINITION: Means to pay insufficient attention to something or someone, resulting in omission, negligence, or exclusion.
SENSES: 1. To neglect or fail to attend to needs in daily care (Acts 6:1).

THAYER.pt: Significa prestar insuficiente atenção a algo ou alguém, resultando em omissão, negligência ou exclusão. 1. Negligenciar ou deixar de atender a necessidades no cuidado diário (At 6:1).
THAYER.en: Means to pay insufficient attention to something or someone, resulting in omission, negligence, or exclusion. 1. To neglect or fail to attend to needs in daily care (Acts 6:1).

DEFINITION: A valuable good or property entrusted to the care and custody of another person, requiring absolute fidelity in its preservation and return.
SENSES: 1. The sacred deposit of sound doctrine entrusted to the apostle and believers (1 Tim 6:20).

THAYER.pt: Valioso bem ou propriedade confiada aos cuidados e à guarda de outra pessoa, exigindo absoluta fidelidade na sua preservação e devolução. 1. O depósito sagrado da sã doutrina confiada ao apóstolo e aos crentes (1Tm 6.20).
THAYER.en: A valuable good or property entrusted to the care and custody of another person, requiring absolute fidelity in its preservation and return. 1. The sacred deposit of sound doctrine entrusted to the apostle and believers (1 Tim 6:20).

DEFINITION: To direct firm advice or recommendations to someone regarding the conduct they should follow.
SENSES: 1. To give energetic advice or practical exhortations (Acts 27:22).

THAYER.pt: Dirigir conselhos firmes ou recomendações a alguém sobre a conduta que deve seguir. 1. Dar conselhos enérgicos ou exortações práticas (At 27.22).
THAYER.en: To direct firm advice or recommendations to someone regarding the conduct they should follow. 1. To give energetic advice or practical exhortations (Acts 27:22).

DEFINITION: The act of asking to be excused from something, refusing an invitation, rejecting a proposal, or avoiding a responsibility.
SENSES: 1. To refuse, decline, or avoid an invitation or offer (Luke 14:18).
2. To reject or refuse to accept something or someone (Acts 25:11; 1 Tim 4:7).

THAYER.pt: Ato de pedir dispensa de algo, recusar um convite, rejeitar uma proposta ou esquivar-se de uma responsabilidade. 1. Recusar, declinar ou esquivar-se de um convite ou oferta (Lc 14.18). | 2. Rejeitar ou recusar acatar algo ou alguém (At 25.11; 1Tm 4.7).
THAYER.en: The act of asking to be excused from something, refusing an invitation, rejecting a proposal, or avoiding a responsibility. 1. To refuse, decline, or avoid an invitation or offer (Luke 14:18). | 2. To reject or refuse to accept something or someone (Acts 25:11; 1 Tim 4:7).

DEFINITION: Describes the physical act of taking a seat or sitting next to another person.
SENSES: 1. To sit beside someone.

THAYER.pt: Descreve o ato físico de tomar assento ou sentar-se junto a outra pessoa. 1. Sentar-se ao lado de alguém.
THAYER.en: Describes the physical act of taking a seat or sitting next to another person. 1. To sit beside someone.

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: παρακαλέσω, Aor: παρεκάλεσα, Perf Pass: παρακέκλημαι
DEFINITION: To call to one's side for the purpose of encouraging, admonishing, consoling, or interceding. It is a key theological term linked to the gracious consolation of God and mutual pastoral ministry.
SENSES: 1. To make an ardent plea, appeal, or beseech with insistence (Matt 8:5; Mark 1:40).
2. To exhort firmly, admonish, and encourage toward faithfulness (Acts 2:40; Rom 12:1).
3. To console, animate, and comfort the afflicted (2 Cor 1:4; 1 Thess 4:18).

THAYER.pt: Chamar para perto com o propósito de encorajar, admoestar, consolar ou interceder. É termo teológico-chave ligado ao consolo gracioso de Deus e ao ministério pastoral mútuo. 1. Fazer súplica ardente, apelar ou rogar com insistência (Mt 8.5; Mc 1.40). | 2. Exortar firmemente, admoestar e incentivar à fidelidade (At 2.40; Rm 12.1). | 3. Consolar, animar e confortar o aflito (2Co 1.4; 1Ts 4.18).
THAYER.en: To call to one's side for the purpose of encouraging, admonishing, consoling, or interceding. It is a key theological term linked to the gracious consolation of God and mutual pastoral ministry. 1. To make an ardent plea, appeal, or beseech with insistence (Matt 8:5; Mark 1:40). | 2. To exhort firmly, admonish, and encourage toward faithfulness (Acts 2:40; Rom 12:1). | 3. To console, animate, and comfort the afflicted (2 Cor 1:4; 1 Thess 4:18).

DEFINITION: Means to cover or hide something so that it remains unknown or difficult to understand.
SENSES: 1. To hide or keep something secret so that it is not understood (Luke 9:45).

THAYER.pt: Significa cobrir ou ocultar algo de modo que permaneça desconhecido ou de difícil compreensão. 1. Ocultar ou manter algo em segredo para que não seja compreendido (Lc 9:45).
THAYER.en: Means to cover or hide something so that it remains unknown or difficult to understand. 1. To hide or keep something secret so that it is not understood (Luke 9:45).

DEFINITION: Refers to something valuable entrusted to someone for safe-keeping and protection. In the New Testament, it is used metaphorically for the sound doctrine and the gospel entrusted to believers.
SENSES: 1. Something given in trust for safe-keeping and protection (1 Tim 6:20; 2 Tim 1:14).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se a algo valioso que é confiado a alguém para guarda e proteção segura. No Novo Testamento, é usado metaforicamente para a sã doutrina e o evangelho confiados aos crentes. 1. Algo dado em confiança para guarda e proteção (1Tm 6:20; 2Tm 1:14).
THAYER.en: Refers to something valuable entrusted to someone for safe-keeping and protection. In the New Testament, it is used metaphorically for the sound doctrine and the gospel entrusted to believers. 1. Something given in trust for safe-keeping and protection (1 Tim 6:20; 2 Tim 1:14).

SHORT_GLOSS: to be present, to be at hand
DEFINITION: To be physically present or readily available for use, or figuratively accessible at will.
SENSES: 1. To be present or accessible for the practice of something (Rom 7:18, 21).
USAGE: to be present, to be at hand

THAYER.pt: Estar fisicamente presente ou prontamente disponível para uso, ou figuradamente acessível à vontade. 1. Estar presente ou acessível para a prática de algo (Rm 7.18, 21).
THAYER.en: To be physically present or readily available for use, or figuratively accessible at will. 1. To be present or accessible for the practice of something (Rom 7:18, 21).

DEFINITION: The act of strengthening, comforting, or exhorting someone's spirit; it can also denote a vehement appeal.
SENSES: 1. Verbal encouragement or exhortation (1 Thess 2:3; Heb 13:22).
2. Strong appeal or entreaty (2 Cor 8:4).
3. Consolation and spiritual relief in times of affliction (Acts 9:31; 2 Thess 2:16).

THAYER.pt: Ato de fortalecer, consolar ou exortar o espírito de alguém, podendo também denotar um apelo veemente. 1. Encorajamento ou exortação verbal (1Ts 2:3; Hb 13:22). | 2. Apelo forte ou súplica (2Co 8:4). | 3. Consolação e alívio espiritual em tempos de aflição (At 9:31; 2Ts 2:16).
THAYER.en: The act of strengthening, comforting, or exhorting someone's spirit; it can also denote a vehement appeal. 1. Verbal encouragement or exhortation (1 Thess 2:3; Heb 13:22). | 2. Strong appeal or entreaty (2 Cor 8:4). | 3. Consolation and spiritual relief in times of affliction (Acts 9:31; 2 Thess 2:16).

DEFINITION: A title applied in the New Testament to the Holy Spirit and to Christ, denoting someone called to stand by another's side as a defender, counselor, or comforter.
SENSES: 1. Defense attorney or heavenly intercessor (1 John 2:1).
2. The divine Comforter or Helper, the Holy Spirit (John 14:16).

THAYER.pt: Título aplicado no Novo Testamento ao Espírito Santo e a Cristo, denotando alguém que é chamado para estar ao lado de outrem como defensor, conselheiro ou consolador. 1. Advogado de defesa ou intercessor celestial (1Jo 2.1). | 2. O Consolador ou Auxiliador divino, o Espírito Santo (Jo 14.16).
THAYER.en: A title applied in the New Testament to the Holy Spirit and to Christ, denoting someone called to stand by another's side as a defender, counselor, or comforter. 1. Defense attorney or heavenly intercessor (1 John 2:1). | 2. The divine Comforter or Helper, the Holy Spirit (John 14:16).

DEFINITION: The intentional refusal to hear and heed an instruction or commandment. It denotes the rebellious attitude of one who refuses to listen to the voice of legitimate authority.
SENSES: 1. Deliberate disobedience to the voice or law of God (Rom 5:19; 2 Cor 10:6).

THAYER.pt: A recusa intencional em ouvir e acatar uma instrução ou mandamento. Denota a atitude rebelde de quem se nega a dar ouvidos à voz da autoridade legítima. 1. Desobediência deliberada à voz ou à lei de Deus (Rm 5.19; 2Co 10.6).
THAYER.en: The intentional refusal to hear and heed an instruction or commandment. It denotes the rebellious attitude of one who refuses to listen to the voice of legitimate authority. 1. Deliberate disobedience to the voice or law of God (Rom 5:19; 2 Cor 10:6).

DEFINITION: To follow closely, either physically or in the sense of examining in detail and understanding with precision the development of facts and teachings.
SENSES: 1. To faithfully follow a teaching or teacher (1 Tim 4:6).
2. To investigate and follow the course of events with accuracy (Luke 1:3).

THAYER.pt: Seguir de perto, seja fisicamente ou no sentido de examinar detalhadamente e compreender com precisão o desenvolvimento de fatos e ensinamentos. 1. Acompanhar fielmente um ensinamento ou mestre (1Tm 4.6); | 2. Investigar e acompanhar com exatidão o curso de eventos (Lc 1.3).
THAYER.en: To follow closely, either physically or in the sense of examining in detail and understanding with precision the development of facts and teachings. 1. To faithfully follow a teaching or teacher (1 Tim 4:6). | 2. To investigate and follow the course of events with accuracy (Luke 1:3).

DEFINITION: To hear casually or, by extension, to deliberately neglect what has been heard, refusing to obey the instructions transmitted.
SENSES: 1. To hear casually or without direct intent (Mark 5:36).
2. To refuse to listen and disobey an order (Matt 18:17).

THAYER.pt: Ouvir de relance ou, por extensão de sentido, negligenciar deliberadamente o que foi ouvido, recusando-se a obedecer às instruções transmitidas. 1. Ouvir casualmente ou sem intenção direta (Mc 5.36); | 2. Recusar-se a ouvir e desobedecer a uma ordem (Mt 18.17).
THAYER.en: To hear casually or, by extension, to deliberately neglect what has been heard, refusing to obey the instructions transmitted. 1. To hear casually or without direct intent (Mark 5:36). | 2. To refuse to listen and disobey an order (Matt 18:17).

DEFINITION: The act of bending or leaning forward for the purpose of examining or seeing something more clearly, whether physically or spiritually.
SENSES: 1. To stoop down to look inside something (Luke 24:12; John 20:5).
2. To investigate with attention or peer into spiritual truths (Jas 1:25; 1 Pet 1:12).

THAYER.pt: O ato de curvar-se ou inclinar-se para a frente com o propósito de examinar ou enxergar algo com mais clareza, seja fisicamente ou espiritualmente. 1. Inclinar-se para olhar o interior de algo (Lc 24.12; Jo 20.5). | 2. Investigar com atenção ou perscrutar verdades espirituais (Tg 1.25; 1Pe 1.12).
THAYER.en: The act of bending or leaning forward for the purpose of examining or seeing something more clearly, whether physically or spiritually. 1. To stoop down to look inside something (Luke 24:12; John 20:5). | 2. To investigate with attention or peer into spiritual truths (Jas 1:25; 1 Pet 1:12).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: παραλήμψομαι, Aor: παρέλαβον, Perf: παρείληφα
DEFINITION: To take someone along as a companion, or to welcome and receive a tradition, teaching, office, or person with agreement and approval.
SENSES: 1. To take with one, to lead in one's company (Matt 2:14; Mark 9:2; John 14:3).
2. To welcome, to receive someone with favor (John 1:11).
3. To receive authoritative tradition or doctrinal instruction (1 Cor 11:23; 1 Cor 15:1; Gal 1:9).
4. To take possession of or receive a kingdom or function (Heb 12:28; Col 4:17).

THAYER.pt: Levar alguém consigo como companheiro, ou acolher e receber uma tradição, ensino, ofício ou pessoa com concordância e aprovação. 1. Tomar consigo, levar em sua companhia (Mt 2.14; Mc 9.2; Jo 14.3). | 2. Acolher, receber alguém com favor (Jo 1.11). | 3. Receber tradição ou instrução doutrinária autoritativa (1Co 11.23; 1Co 15.1; Gl 1.9). | 4. Tomar posse ou receber um reino ou função (Hb 12.28; Cl 4.17).
THAYER.en: To take someone along as a companion, or to welcome and receive a tradition, teaching, office, or person with agreement and approval. 1. To take with one, to lead in one's company (Matt 2:14; Mark 9:2; John 14:3). | 2. To welcome, to receive someone with favor (John 1:11). | 3. To receive authoritative tradition or doctrinal instruction (1 Cor 11:23; 1 Cor 15:1; Gal 1:9). | 4. To take possession of or receive a kingdom or function (Heb 12:28; Col 4:17).

DEFINITION: A nautical technical term describing navigation while remaining close to the coast or skirting the edges of a territory.
SENSES: 1. To sail along the coast or pass by the shore of a land (Acts 27:8, 13).

THAYER.pt: Termo técnico da náutica que descreve a navegação mantendo-se próxima à costa ou contornando as margens de um território. 1. Navegar costeando ou passando junto à margem de uma terra (At 27.8, 13).
THAYER.en: A nautical technical term describing navigation while remaining close to the coast or skirting the edges of a territory. 1. To sail along the coast or pass by the shore of a land (Acts 27:8, 13).

DEFINITION: Designates the territory or strip of land that borders the sea, the coastal region.
SENSES: 1. Coastal or seaside region adjacent to the sea (Luke 6:17).

THAYER.pt: Designa o território ou a faixa de terra que faz fronteira com o mar, a região litorânea. 1. Região costeira ou litorânea adjacente ao mar (Lc 6:17).
THAYER.en: Designates the territory or strip of land that borders the sea, the coastal region. 1. Coastal or seaside region adjacent to the sea (Luke 6:17).

DEFINITION: Indicates alteration, variation, or absence of constancy in the nature or character of something.
SENSES: 1. Variation or change, used to denote the absolute immutability of God (Jas 1:17).

THAYER.pt: Indica alteração, variação ou ausência de constância na natureza ou no caráter de algo. 1. Variação ou mudança, usada para denotar a imutabilidade absoluta de Deus (Tg 1:17).
THAYER.en: Indicates alteration, variation, or absence of constancy in the nature or character of something. 1. Variation or change, used to denote the absolute immutability of God (Jas 1:17).

DEFINITION: To lead someone into error through false arguments, captious reasoning, or sophistry.
SENSES: 1. To deceive oneself or another through fallacious reasoning (Jas 1:22; Col 2:4).

THAYER.pt: Induzir alguém ao erro através de falsos argumentos, raciocínios capciosos ou sofismas. 1. Enganar a si mesmo ou a outrem por raciocínios falaciosos (Tg 1.22; Cl 2.4).
THAYER.en: To lead someone into error through false arguments, captious reasoning, or sophistry. 1. To deceive oneself or another through fallacious reasoning (Jas 1:22; Col 2:4).

DEFINITION: One who suffers from paralysis or loss of bodily movement.
SENSES: 1. A person suffering from paralysis or disability in the limbs (Matt 4:24; 8:6).

THAYER.pt: Que sofre de paralisia ou perda dos movimentos corporais. 1. Pessoa que sofre de paralisia ou deficiência nos membros (Mt 4.24; 8.6).
THAYER.en: One who suffers from paralysis or loss of bodily movement. 1. A person suffering from paralysis or disability in the limbs (Matt 4:24; 8:6).

DEFINITION: To cause loss of physical strength, to weaken limbs, or to leave someone debilitated by paralysis or disease.
SENSES: 1. To leave debilitated or paralyzed by illness (Luke 5:18; Acts 9:33).
2. To weaken morally or spiritually, to discourage (Heb 12:12).

THAYER.pt: Causar perda de força física, enfraquecer membros ou deixar alguém debilitado por paralisia ou doença. 1. Deixar debilitado ou paralisado por enfermidade (Lc 5.18; At 9.33). | 2. Enfraquecer moral ou espiritualmente, desanimar (Hb 12.12).
THAYER.en: To cause loss of physical strength, to weaken limbs, or to leave someone debilitated by paralysis or disease. 1. To leave debilitated or paralyzed by illness (Luke 5:18; Acts 9:33). | 2. To weaken morally or spiritually, to discourage (Heb 12:12).

DEFINITION: Indicates the act of continuing in a state, situation, or location, or remaining with someone constantly.
SENSES: 1. To remain or continue in a place or state (Phil 1:25).
2. To continue in a function or office (Heb 7:23).

THAYER.pt: Indica o ato de continuar em um estado, situação ou local, ou de permanecer junto a alguém de forma constante. 1. Permanecer ou continuar em um lugar ou estado (Fp 1.25). | 2. Continuar em uma função ou ofício (Hb 7.23).
THAYER.en: Indicates the act of continuing in a state, situation, or location, or remaining with someone constantly. 1. To remain or continue in a place or state (Phil 1:25). | 2. To continue in a function or office (Heb 7:23).

DEFINITION: To speak in a way that brings spirit, comfort, and consolation to someone who is afflicted or in need of encouragement.
SENSES: 1. To console or comfort someone in moments of sadness (John 11:31).
2. To encourage and exhort in the Christian walk (1 Thess 2:12; 1 Thess 5:14).

THAYER.pt: Significa falar de maneira a trazer ânimo, conforto e consolo para alguém que está aflito ou necessitado de encorajamento. 1. Consolar ou confortar alguém em momentos de tristeza (Jo 11.31). | 2. Encorajar e exortar na caminhada cristã (1Ts 2.12; 1Ts 5.14).
THAYER.en: To speak in a way that brings spirit, comfort, and consolation to someone who is afflicted or in need of encouragement. 1. To console or comfort someone in moments of sadness (John 11:31). | 2. To encourage and exhort in the Christian walk (1 Thess 2:12; 1 Thess 5:14).

DEFINITION: Refers to the act or means of bringing spirit, refreshment, and spiritual comfort to someone who is afflicted or depressed.
SENSES: 1. Words or actions of encouragement and consolation for believers (1 Cor 14:3).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se ao ato ou meio de trazer ânimo, refrigério e conforto espiritual a alguém que se encontra aflito ou deprimido. 1. Palavras ou ações de encorajamento e consolação para os crentes (1Co 14:3).
THAYER.en: Refers to the act or means of bringing spirit, refreshment, and spiritual comfort to someone who is afflicted or depressed. 1. Words or actions of encouragement and consolation for believers (1 Cor 14:3).

DEFINITION: That which serves as a basis for the relief of emotional pain, offering peaceful exhortation and encouragement.
SENSES: 1. Consolation or stimulus derived from love and Christian fellowship (Phil 2:1).

THAYER.pt: Aquilo que serve de base para o alívio da dor emocional, oferecendo exortação pacífica e encorajamento. 1. Consolação ou estímulo derivado do amor e da comunhão cristã (Fp 2:1).
THAYER.en: That which serves as a basis for the relief of emotional pain, offering peaceful exhortation and encouragement. 1. Consolation or stimulus derived from love and Christian fellowship (Phil 2:1).

DEFINITION: To act in a manner contrary to established laws or prevailing moral precepts.
SENSES: 1. To violate the law or act contrary to prescribed justice (Acts 23:3).

THAYER.pt: Significa agir de maneira contrária às leis estabelecidas ou aos preceitos morais vigentes. 1. Violar a lei ou agir de forma contrária à justiça prescrita (At 23:3).
THAYER.en: To act in a manner contrary to established laws or prevailing moral precepts. 1. To violate the law or act contrary to prescribed justice (Acts 23:3).

DEFINITION: Conduct or an act characterized by contempt for and disobedience to legal and moral norms.
SENSES: 1. The practice of iniquity, transgression, or acts of illegality (2 Pet 2:16).

THAYER.pt: Conduta ou ato caracterizado pelo desprezo e desobediência às normas legais e morais. 1. Prática de iniquidade, transgressão ou atos de ilegalidade (2Pe 2:16).
THAYER.en: Conduct or an act characterized by contempt for and disobedience to legal and moral norms. 1. The practice of iniquity, transgression, or acts of illegality (2 Pet 2:16).

DEFINITION: Indicates the action of provoking someone to anger or stubbornly rebelling against divine authority.
SENSES: 1. To rebel against God and provoke His anger through disobedience (Heb 3:16).

THAYER.pt: Indica a ação de provocar alguém à ira ou de rebelar-se obstinadamente contra a autoridade divina. 1. Rebelar-se contra Deus e provocar a sua ira pela desobediência (Hb 3:16).
THAYER.en: Indicates the action of provoking someone to anger or stubbornly rebelling against divine authority. 1. To rebel against God and provoke His anger through disobedience (Heb 3:16).

DEFINITION: An attitude of rebellious bitterness, provocation, or open revolt against authority, especially against God.
SENSES: 1. The episode or state of rebellion and murmuring against God in the wilderness (Heb 3:8, 15).

THAYER.pt: Atitude de amargura rebelde, provocação ou revolta aberta contra a autoridade, especialmente contra Deus. 1. O episódio ou estado de rebelião e murmuração contra Deus no deserto (Hb 3.8, 15).
THAYER.en: An attitude of rebellious bitterness, provocation, or open revolt against authority, especially against God. 1. The episode or state of rebellion and murmuring against God in the wilderness (Heb 3:8, 15).

DEFINITION: Describes the act of abandoning a previous commitment, turning away from the professed faith, or falling into apostasy.
SENSES: 1. To deliberately turn away from the truth and commit apostasy (Heb 6:6).

THAYER.pt: Descreve o ato de abandonar um compromisso prévio, afastar-se da fé professada ou cair em apostasia. 1. Afastar-se deliberadamente da verdade e cometer apostasia (Hb 6:6).
THAYER.en: Describes the act of abandoning a previous commitment, turning away from the professed faith, or falling into apostasy. 1. To deliberately turn away from the truth and commit apostasy (Heb 6:6).

DEFINITION: A nautical term describing the action of sailing parallel to a coast or passing by a maritime point.
SENSES: 1. To sail along a coast or pass by a place while sailing (Acts 20:16).

THAYER.pt: Termo náutico que descreve a ação de navegar paralelamente à costa ou passar por um ponto marítimo. 1. Navegar ao longo de uma costa ou passar navegando por um lugar (At 20:16).
THAYER.en: A nautical term describing the action of sailing parallel to a coast or passing by a maritime point. 1. To sail along a coast or pass by a place while sailing (Acts 20:16).

DEFINITION: Indicates great proximity of state or condition, something very similar or nearly equivalent.
SENSES: 1. In a very similar or close manner.

THAYER.pt: Indica grande proximidade de estado ou condição, algo muito semelhante ou quase equivalente. 1. De maneira muito semelhante ou próxima.
THAYER.en: Indicates great proximity of state or condition, something very similar or nearly equivalent. 1. In a very similar or close manner.

DEFINITION: Describes an action or condition that greatly resembles another, establishing a strong parallel.
SENSES: 1. In a similar manner or in the same way (Heb 2:14).

THAYER.pt: Descreve uma ação ou condição que se assemelha grandemente a outra, estabelecendo forte paralelo. 1. De maneira similar ou da mesma forma (Hb 2:14).
THAYER.en: Describes an action or condition that greatly resembles another, establishing a strong parallel. 1. In a similar manner or in the same way (Heb 2:14).

DEFINITION: To move along a path, passing by a reference point or undertaking a journey in transit.
SENSES: 1. To pass by a place or walk alongside something (Mark 11:20; 15:29).
2. To undertake a journey or walk through a region (Mark 2:23).

THAYER.pt: Mover-se ao longo de um trajeto, passando por um ponto de referência ou realizando uma viagem de passagem. 1. Passar por um lugar ou caminhar ao lado de algo (Mc 11.20; 15.29). | 2. Empreender uma viagem ou caminhar através de uma região (Mc 2.23).
THAYER.en: To move along a path, passing by a reference point or undertaking a journey in transit. 1. To pass by a place or walk alongside something (Mark 11:20; 15:29). | 2. To undertake a journey or walk through a region (Mark 2:23).

DEFINITION: Literally a false step; denotes a violation of moral standards, a transgression, or an intentional deviation from the will of God.
SENSES: 1. An act of transgression, moral deviation, or sin against God (Rom 5:15; Eph 2:1).

THAYER.pt: Literalmente um passo em falso, denota uma violação dos padrões morais, uma transgressão ou desvio intencional da vontade de Deus. 1. Um ato de transgressão, desvio moral ou pecado contra Deus (Rm 5.15; Ef 2.1).
THAYER.en: Literally a false step; denotes a violation of moral standards, a transgression, or an intentional deviation from the will of God. 1. An act of transgression, moral deviation, or sin against God (Rom 5:15; Eph 2:1).

DEFINITION: Used metaphorically like water flowing away; describes the gradual deviation from and abandonment of truths heard.
SENSES: 1. To slip or drift away gradually from the truth due to spiritual negligence (Heb 2:1).

THAYER.pt: Usado metaforicamente como água que escoa, descreve o gradual desvio e abandono das verdades ouvidas. 1. Deslizar ou afastar-se gradualmente da verdade por negligência espiritual (Hb 2:1).
THAYER.en: Used metaphorically like water flowing away; describes the gradual deviation from and abandonment of truths heard. 1. To slip or drift away gradually from the truth due to spiritual negligence (Heb 2:1).

DEFINITION: Qualifies something or someone that possesses a mark, distinctive sign, or characteristic emblem.
SENSES: 1. Marked with an emblem or distinctive insignia (Acts 28:11).

THAYER.pt: Qualifica algo ou alguém que possui uma marca, sinal distintivo ou emblema característico. 1. Marcado com um emblema ou insígnia distintiva (At 28:11).
THAYER.en: Qualifies something or someone that possesses a mark, distinctive sign, or characteristic emblem. 1. Marked with an emblem or distinctive insignia (Acts 28:11).

DEFINITION: Refers to the action of putting something or someone into a state of readiness, making necessary preparations.
SENSES: 1. To make preparations or get something ready (Acts 10:10; 1 Pet 2:8).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se à ação de colocar algo ou alguém em estado de prontidão, fazendo os preparativos necessários. 1. Fazer preparativos ou aprontar algo (At 10.10; 1Pe 2.8).
THAYER.en: Refers to the action of putting something or someone into a state of readiness, making necessary preparations. 1. To make preparations or get something ready (Acts 10:10; 1 Pet 2:8).

DEFINITION: Designates the day of preparation for a festival or the weekly Sabbath, corresponding to the Jewish Friday, when urgent preparations were finalized.
SENSES: 1. The day of preparation that immediately precedes the Sabbath (Matt 27:62; John 19:31).

THAYER.pt: Designa o dia de preparação para um festival ou o sábado semanal, correspondendo à sexta-feira judaica, quando os preparativos urgentes eram finalizados. 1. O dia da preparação que antecede imediatamente o sábado (Mt 27.62; Jo 19.31).
THAYER.en: Designates the day of preparation for a festival or the weekly Sabbath, corresponding to the Jewish Friday, when urgent preparations were finalized. 1. The day of preparation that immediately precedes the Sabbath (Matt 27:62; John 19:31).

DEFINITION: Means to extend or prolong the duration of an action or event for a longer time.
SENSES: 1. To prolong or extend a speech or activity for a longer period (Acts 20:7).

THAYER.pt: Significa estender ou prolongar a duração de uma ação ou evento por mais tempo. 1. Prolongar ou estender um discurso ou atividade por um período maior (At 20:7).
THAYER.en: Means to extend or prolong the duration of an action or event for a longer time. 1. To prolong or extend a speech or activity for a longer period (Acts 20:7).

DEFINITION: Means to observe someone's behavior closely, often with critical or malicious intent, or to strictly keep precepts and traditions.
SENSES: 1. To watch closely with the intent to accuse or set traps (Mark 3:2; Luke 6:7).
2. To keep or observe laws, customs, or feast days scrupulously (Gal 4:10).

THAYER.pt: Significa observar atentamente o comportamento de alguém, muitas vezes com intenção crítica ou maliciosa, ou guardar estritamente preceitos e tradições. 1. Observar de perto com intenção de acusar ou armar ciladas (Mc 3.2; Lc 6.7). | 2. Guardar ou observar escrupulosamente leis, costumes ou dias festivos (Gl 4.10).
THAYER.en: Means to observe someone's behavior closely, often with critical or malicious intent, or to strictly keep precepts and traditions. 1. To watch closely with the intent to accuse or set traps (Mark 3:2; Luke 6:7). | 2. To keep or observe laws, customs, or feast days scrupulously (Gal 4:10).

DEFINITION: Refers to the act of observing closely, watching, or fulfilling precepts with visible rigor.
SENSES: 1. Close observation or external vigilance (Luke 17:20).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se ao ato de observar atentamente, vigiar ou cumprir preceitos com rigor visível. 1. Observação atenta ou vigilância externa (Lc 17:20).
THAYER.en: Refers to the act of observing closely, watching, or fulfilling precepts with visible rigor. 1. Close observation or external vigilance (Luke 17:20).

DEFINITION: To place something physically before someone, to expound a teaching, or to entrust something valuable to the care of another.
SENSES: 1. To serve or place food before people (Mark 6:41).
2. To expound, explain, or demonstrate a teaching (Acts 17:3).
3. To entrust or commit something or someone to the care and protection of God (Luke 12:48; 2 Tim 2:2).

THAYER.pt: Colocar algo fisicamente diante de alguém, expor um ensinamento ou confiar algo valioso aos cuidados de outrem. 1. Servir ou colocar comida diante de pessoas (Mc 6.41). | 2. Expor, explicar ou demonstrar um ensinamento (At 17.3). | 3. Confiar ou entregar algo ou alguém aos cuidados e proteção de Deus (Lc 12.48; 2Tm 2.2).
THAYER.en: To place something physically before someone, to expound a teaching, or to entrust something valuable to the care of another. 1. To serve or place food before people (Mark 6:41). | 2.
