2. Passive: to become deeply irritated or exasperated (1Co 13.5).

THAYER.pt: Significa causar excitação interna, estimulando emoções fortes, frequentemente resultando em irritação, ira ou exasperação. 1. Provocar ou irritar alguém intensamente (At 17.16). | 2. Passivo: ficar profundamente irritado ou exasperado (1Co 13.5).
THAYER.en: Means to cause internal excitement, stimulating strong emotions, frequently resulting in irritation, anger, or exasperation. 1. To intensely provoke or irritate someone (Ac 17.16). | 2. Passive: to become deeply irritated or exasperated (1Co 13.5).

DEFINITION: Refers to an act or state of strong stimulus, which can be positive (such as encouragement to love) or negative (such as a heated argument).
SENSES: 1. Mutual encouragement for the practice of good works (Heb 10:24).
2. Sharp disagreement or irritation expressed in debate (Acts 15:39).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se a um ato ou estado de forte estímulo, que pode ser positivo (como encorajamento ao amor) ou negativo (como uma discussão acalorada). 1. Estímulo mútuo para a prática de boas obras (Hb 10.24). | 2. Desacordo agudo ou irritação expressa em debate (At 15.39).
THAYER.en: Refers to an act or state of strong stimulus, which can be positive (such as encouragement to love) or negative (such as a heated argument). 1. Mutual encouragement for the practice of good works (Heb 10:24). | 2. Sharp disagreement or irritation expressed in debate (Acts 15:39).

DEFINITION: Indicates the action of causing great indignation or revolt in someone, leading the individual to a state of expressive anger.
SENSES: 1. To provoke someone to anger or enrage (Eph 6.4; Rom 10.19).

THAYER.pt: Indica a ação de causar grande indignação ou revolta em alguém, levando o indivíduo a um estado de ira expressiva. 1. Provocar alguém à ira ou enfurecer (Ef 6.4; Rm 10.19).
THAYER.en: Indicates the action of causing great indignation or revolt in someone, leading the individual to a state of expressive anger. 1. To provoke someone to anger or enrage (Eph 6.4; Rom 10.19).

DEFINITION: An emotional state of intense irritation, provocation, and strong indignation.
SENSES: 1. Exacerbated anger or bitterness that must not be kept until sunset (Eph 4:26).

THAYER.pt: Um estado emocional de intensa irritação, provocação e forte indignação. 1. A ira ou o rancor exacerbado que não deve ser mantido até o pôr do sol (Ef 4.26).
THAYER.en: An emotional state of intense irritation, provocation, and strong indignation. 1. Exacerbated anger or bitterness that must not be kept until sunset (Eph 4:26).

DEFINITION: To stimulate strong emotions or instigate opposition and hostility against someone.
SENSES: 1. To incite authorities or the crowd against the apostles (Ac 13.50).

THAYER.pt: Estimular emoções fortes ou instigar oposição e hostilidade contra alguém. 1. Incitar as autoridades ou a multidão contra os apóstolos (At 13.50).
THAYER.en: To stimulate strong emotions or instigate opposition and hostility against someone. 1. To incite authorities or the crowd against the apostles (Ac 13.50).

DEFINITION: Indicates the state of physical presence or the official arrival of someone. In the eschatological context of the New Testament, it is the technical term for the glorious Second Coming of Christ.
SENSES: 1. The state of being present or the physical presence of someone (2 Cor 10:10).
2. The arrival or advent of a person, especially the Parousia of Christ (1 Thess 4:15; 2 Pet 3:12).

THAYER.pt: Indica o estado de presença física ou a chegada oficial de alguém. No contexto escatológico do Novo Testamento, é o termo técnico para a gloriosa Segunda Vinda de Cristo. 1. O estado de estar presente ou a presença física de alguém (2Co 10.10). | 2. A chegada ou advento de uma pessoa, especialmente a Parusia de Cristo (1Ts 4.15; 2Pe 3.12).
THAYER.en: Indicates the state of physical presence or the official arrival of someone. In the eschatological context of the New Testament, it is the technical term for the glorious Second Coming of Christ. 1. The state of being present or the physical presence of someone (2 Cor 10:10). | 2. The arrival or advent of a person, especially the Parousia of Christ (1 Thess 4:15; 2 Pet 3:12).

DEFINITION: Designates a shallow container or dish used for serving food or condiments at the table.
SENSES: 1. Container or dish for food (Matt 23:25, 26).

THAYER.pt: Designa um recipiente raso ou prato usado para servir alimentos ou condimentos à mesa. 1. Recipiente ou prato para comida (Mt 23.25, 26).
THAYER.en: Designates a shallow container or dish used for serving food or condiments at the table. 1. Container or dish for food (Matt 23:25, 26).

DEFINITION: Freedom and fearless courage to speak with clarity, frankness, and without hiding anything, especially before authorities or dangers.
SENSES: 1. Frankness and clarity in speaking, without disguises or half-words (Mark 8:32; John 7:13).
2. Public openness and visibility of actions and words (John 7:26; 18:20).
3. Boldness and holy confidence before people and before God (Acts 4:13; Heb 4:16).

THAYER.pt: Liberdade e coragem destemida para falar com clareza, franqueza e sem ocultar nada, especialmente diante de autoridades ou perigos. 1. Franqueza e clareza no falar, sem disfarces ou meias-palavras (Mc 8.32; Jo 7.13). | 2. Abertura pública e visibilidade de ações e palavras (Jo 7.26; 18.20). | 3. Ousadia e santa confiança perante as pessoas e perante Deus (At 4.13; Hb 4.16).
THAYER.en: Freedom and fearless courage to speak with clarity, frankness, and without hiding anything, especially before authorities or dangers. 1. Frankness and clarity in speaking, without disguises or half-words (Mark 8:32; John 7:13). | 2. Public openness and visibility of actions and words (John 7:26; 18:20). | 3. Boldness and holy confidence before people and before God (Acts 4:13; Heb 4:16).

DEFINITION: To express oneself with total frankness, courage, and fearlessness, especially when proclaiming the gospel message in the face of opposition.
SENSES: 1. To speak with intrepidity and courage in the face of danger (Ac 9.27; 14.3; Eph 6.20).

THAYER.pt: Expressar-se com total franqueza, coragem e destemor, especialmente ao proclamar a mensagem do evangelho diante da oposição. 1. Falar com intrepidez e coragem diante do perigo (At 9.27; 14.3; Ef 6.20).
THAYER.en: To express oneself with total frankness, courage, and fearlessness, especially when proclaiming the gospel message in the face of opposition. 1. To speak with intrepidity and courage in the face of danger (Ac 9.27; 14.3; Eph 6.20).

DEFINITION: Universal adjective that expresses the sum total of items in a class, the integrity of a unit, or each member individually considered. Substantivized in the plural, it encompasses the totality of human beings.
SENSES: 1. Distributive without article: 'each', 'any' (Mt 3.10; Jn 1.9).
2. Collective with article: 'all', 'the totality of', 'whole' (Mt 2.3; Eph 4.16).
3. Substantivized plural: 'all', 'all people' or neuter 'everything' (Mt 11.27; Jn 1.3; Rom 3.23).

THAYER.pt: Adjetivo universal que expressa a soma total de itens de uma classe, a integridade de uma unidade ou cada membro individualmente considerado. Substantivado no plural, abrange a totalidade dos seres humanos. 1. Distributivo sem artigo: 'cada', 'qualquer' (Mt 3.10; Jo 1.9). | 2. Coletivo com artigo: 'todo o', 'a totalidade de', 'inteiro' (Mt 2.3; Ef 4.16). | 3. Substantivado plural: 'todos', 'todas as pessoas' ou neutro 'tudo' (Mt 11.27; Jo 1.3; Rm 3.23).
THAYER.en: Universal adjective that expresses the sum total of items in a class, the integrity of a unit, or each member individually considered. Substantivized in the plural, it encompasses the totality of human beings. 1. Distributive without article: 'each', 'any' (Mt 3.10; Jn 1.9). | 2. Collective with article: 'all', 'the totality of', 'whole' (Mt 2.3; Eph 4.16). | 3. Substantivized plural: 'all', 'all people' or neuter 'everything' (Mt 11.27; Jn 1.3; Rom 3.23).

DEFINITION: The principal Jewish festival commemorating the deliverance from Egypt, extending also to the sacrificial lamb and the commemorative meal.
SENSES: 1. The annual feast of the Jewish Passover (Matt 26:2).
2. The lamb sacrificed for the celebration of the Passover (Mark 14:12).
3. The paschal supper or meal (Matt 26:19).

THAYER.pt: A principal festa judaica que comemora a libertação do Egito, estendendo-se também ao cordrifício e à refeição comemorativa. 1. A festa anual da Páscoa judaica (Mt 26:2). | 2. O cordeiro sacrificado para a celebração da Páscoa (Mc 14:12). | 3. A ceia ou refeição pascal (Mt 26:19).
THAYER.en: The principal Jewish festival commemorating the deliverance from Egypt, extending also to the sacrificial lamb and the commemorative meal. 1. The annual feast of the Jewish Passover (Matt 26:2). | 2. The lamb sacrificed for the celebration of the Passover (Mark 14:12). | 3. The paschal supper or meal (Matt 26:19).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: παθεῖται; Aor: ἔπαθον; Perf: πέπονθα
DEFINITION: To experience an external condition or event, frequently implying physical pain or psychological affliction.
SENSES: 1. To undergo afflictions, tribulations, or physical pains, to suffer (Mt 17.15; Lk 24.46).
2. To experience or undergo something good or bad (Gal 3.4).

THAYER.pt: Experimentar uma condição ou evento externo, frequentemente implicando em dor física ou aflição psicológica. 1. Passar por aflições, tribulações ou dores físicas, sofrer (Mt 17.15; Lc 24.46). | 2. Vivenciar ou experimentar algo bom ou mau (Gl 3.4).
THAYER.en: To experience an external condition or event, frequently implying physical pain or psychological affliction. 1. To undergo afflictions, tribulations, or physical pains, to suffer (Mt 17.15; Lk 24.46). | 2. To experience or undergo something good or bad (Gal 3.4).

DEFINITION: Port city located on the southwestern coast of Asia Minor, in the region of Lycia, visited by Paul on his journeys.
SENSES: 1. Port in Lycia where Paul boarded a ship for Phoenicia (Ac 21.1).

THAYER.pt: Cidade portuária situada na costa sudoeste da Ásia Menor, na região da Lícia, visitada por Paulo em suas viagens. 1. Porto em Lícia onde Paulo embarcou em um navio para a Fenícia (At 21.1).
THAYER.en: Port city located on the southwestern coast of Asia Minor, in the region of Lycia, visited by Paul on his journeys. 1. Port in Lycia where Paul boarded a ship for Phoenicia (Ac 21.1).

DEFINITION: To deliver a physical blow against someone, whether as a touch, a severe wound, or mortal punishment.
SENSES: 1. To deliver a physical blow or strike (Ac 12.7; Mt 26.51).
2. To strike mortally or cause disaster by divine intervention (Ac 7.24; 12.23).

THAYER.pt: Desferir um golpe físico contra alguém, seja como um toque, um ferimento grave ou um castigo mortal. 1. Desferir um golpe ou pancada física (At 12.7; Mt 26.51). | 2. Ferir mortalmente ou causar desastre por intervenção divina (At 7.24; 12.23).
THAYER.en: To deliver a physical blow against someone, whether as a touch, a severe wound, or mortal punishment. 1. To deliver a physical blow or strike (Ac 12.7; Mt 26.51). | 2. To strike mortally or cause disaster by divine intervention (Ac 7.24; 12.23).

DEFINITION: To place feet upon something, walk, or exert pressure with feet with destructive intent or subjugation.
SENSES: 1. To walk or tread upon a place (Lk 10.19).
2. To trample or tread with contempt or hostile domination (Rev 11.2; 19.15).

THAYER.pt: Colocar os pés sobre algo, caminhar ou exercer pressão com os pés com intenção destrutiva ou de subjugação. 1. Caminhar ou pisar sobre um local (Lc 10.19). | 2. Pisotear ou calcar com desprezo ou domínio hostil (Ap 11.2; 19.15).
THAYER.en: To place feet upon something, walk, or exert pressure with feet with destructive intent or subjugation. 1. To walk or tread upon a place (Lk 10.19). | 2. To trample or tread with contempt or hostile domination (Rev 11.2; 19.15).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: third declension masculine with syncope (gen. πατρός, dat. pl. πατράσι)
DEFINITION: A person's biological male progenitor and foundational theological term expressing the intimate relationship of God with Jesus Christ and with believers.
SENSES: 1. Biological or legal male progenitor (Matt 2:22; Luke 15:20).
2. Divine title for God in His gracious and sovereign fatherhood (Matt 6:9; Rom 8:15).
3. Ancestor, patriarch, or founder of a lineage (Matt 3:9; John 8:56).

THAYER.pt: Progenitor biológico masculino de alguém e termo teológico basilar que expressa a relação íntima de Deus com Jesus Cristo e com os crentes. 1. Genitor masculino biológico ou legal (Mt 2.22; Lc 15.20). | 2. Título divino para Deus em Sua paternidade graciosa e soberana (Mt 6.9; Rm 8.15). | 3. Antepassado, patriarca ou fundador de uma linhagem (Mt 3.9; Jo 8.56).
THAYER.en: A person's biological male progenitor and foundational theological term expressing the intimate relationship of God with Jesus Christ and with believers. 1. Biological or legal male progenitor (Matt 2:22; Luke 15:20). | 2. Divine title for God in His gracious and sovereign fatherhood (Matt 6:9; Rom 8:15). | 3. Ancestor, patriarch, or founder of a lineage (Matt 3:9; John 8:56).

DEFINITION: A small rocky island located in the Aegean Sea, famous for being the place of exile where the apostle John received the Apocalypse.
SENSES: 1. The island where John was banished and received heavenly visions (Rev 1:9).

THAYER.pt: Pequena ilha rochosa localizada no mar Egeu, famosa por ser o local de exílio onde o apóstolo João recebeu o Apocalipse. 1. A ilha onde João foi banido e recebeu visões celestiais (Ap 1.9).
THAYER.en: A small rocky island located in the Aegean Sea, famous for being the place of exile where the apostle John received the Apocalypse. 1. The island where John was banished and received heavenly visions (Rev 1:9).

DEFINITION: An individual who commits the heinous crime of killing their own father.
SENSES: 1. One who assassinates their own father, listed among transgressors of the law (1 Tim 1:9).

THAYER.pt: Indivíduo que comete o crime hediondo de matar o próprio pai. 1. Aquele que assassina o próprio pai, listado entre os transgressores da lei (1Tm 1.9).
THAYER.en: An individual who commits the heinous crime of killing their own father. 1. One who assassinates their own father, listed among transgressors of the law (1 Tim 1:9).

DEFINITION: A group of people united by common ancestry, lineage, or tribal kinship. Derived from 'patēr' (father), it emphasizes the extended family or patriarchal clan.
SENSES: 1. Family lineage or clan derived from a common ancestor (Lk 2:4; Eph 3:15).

THAYER.pt: Grupo de pessoas unidas por ascendência comum, linhagem ou parentesco tribal. Derivado de 'patêr' (pai), enfatiza a grande família ou clã patriarcal. 1. Linhagem familiar ou clã derivado de um ancestral comum (Lc 2.4; Ef 3.15).
THAYER.en: A group of people united by common ancestry, lineage, or tribal kinship. Derived from 'patēr' (father), it emphasizes the extended family or patriarchal clan. 1. Family lineage or clan derived from a common ancestor (Lk 2:4; Eph 3:15).

DEFINITION: Designates a primary ancestor and founder of a nation or ethnic group, especially the founding fathers of the people of Israel.
SENSES: 1. Head of a family or prominent ancestral chief (Acts 7:8; Heb 7:4).

THAYER.pt: Designa um ancestral principal e fundador de uma nação ou grupo étnico, especialmente os pais fundadores do povo de Israel. 1. Pai de família ou chefe ancestral proeminente (At 7.8; Hb 7.4).
THAYER.en: Designates a primary ancestor and founder of a nation or ethnic group, especially the founding fathers of the people of Israel. 1. Head of a family or prominent ancestral chief (Acts 7:8; Heb 7:4).

DEFINITION: Relating to ancestors or traditions inherited from forebears and family predecessors.
SENSES: 1. Ancestral traditions transmitted by forebears (Gal 1.14).

THAYER.pt: Relativo aos ancestrais ou às tradições herdadas dos antepassados e antecessores familiares. 1. Tradições ancestrais transmitidas pelos antepassados (Gl 1.14).
THAYER.en: Relating to ancestors or traditions inherited from forebears and family predecessors. 1. Ancestral traditions transmitted by forebears (Gal 1.14).

DEFINITION: The geographic region or city associated with one's family origins, birth, and childhood; homeland or hometown.
SENSES: 1. The native land or country of origin (Jn 4:44; Heb 11:14).
2. The hometown or locality of ancestors and relatives (Mt 13:54).

THAYER.pt: A região geográfica ou cidade associada às origens familiares, ao nascimento e à infância de alguém; pátria ou cidade natal. 1. A terra natal ou o país de origem (Jo 4:44; Hb 11:14). | 2. A cidade natal ou localidade dos ancestrais e familiares (Mt 13:54).
THAYER.en: The geographic region or city associated with one's family origins, birth, and childhood; homeland or hometown. 1. The native land or country of origin (Jn 4:44; Heb 11:14). | 2. The hometown or locality of ancestors and relatives (Mt 13:54).

DEFINITION: Proper name of a Christian residing in Rome to whom the apostle Paul sends personal greetings.
SENSES: 1. A Christian greeted by Paul in the epistle to the Romans (Rom 16.14).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio de um cristão residente em Roma a quem o apóstolo Paulo envia saudações pessoais. 1. Um cristão saudado por Paulo na epístola aos Romanos (Rm 16.14).
THAYER.en: Proper name of a Christian residing in Rome to whom the apostle Paul sends personal greetings. 1. A Christian greeted by Paul in the epistle to the Romans (Rom 16.14).

DEFINITION: Refers to what is transmitted or inherited from fathers or ancestors, especially customs, teachings, and traditions passed from generation to generation.
SENSES: 1. Referring to practices or teachings received by tradition from ancestors (1Pe 1.18).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se ao que é transmitido ou herdado de pais ou antepassados, especialmente costumes, ensinamentos e tradições passadas de geração em geração. 1. Referente a práticas ou ensinamentos recebidos por tradição dos antepassados (1Pe 1.18).
THAYER.en: Refers to what is transmitted or inherited from fathers or ancestors, especially customs, teachings, and traditions passed from generation to generation. 1. Referring to practices or teachings received by tradition from ancestors (1Pe 1.18).

DEFINITION: Belonging or heritage transmitted by ancestors and fathers, referring to ancestral traditions, customs, and beliefs.
SENSES: 1. Heritage or tradition received from ancestors (Ac 22.3; Ac 24.14).

THAYER.pt: Pertença ou herança transmitida pelos antepassados e pais, referindo-se a tradições, costumes e crenças ancestrais. 1. Herança ou tradição recebida dos antepassados (At 22.3; At 24.14).
THAYER.en: Belonging or heritage transmitted by ancestors and fathers, referring to ancestral traditions, customs, and beliefs. 1. Heritage or tradition received from ancestors (Ac 22.3; Ac 24.14).

DEFINITION: Roman name (Latin cognomen meaning 'small') assumed by Saul of Tarsus, the apostle to the Gentiles, in the exercise of his apostolic mission. It also refers to the proconsul of Cyprus, Sergius Paulus.
SENSES: 1. Paul, the apostle of Jesus Christ to the Gentiles (Rom 1:1; Gal 1:1).
2. Sergius Paulus, Roman proconsul in Cyprus (Acts 13:7).

THAYER.pt: Nome romano (cognome latino que significa 'pequeno') assumido por Saulo de Tarso, o apóstolo dos gentios, no exercício de sua missão apostólica. Refere-se também ao procônsul de Chipre, Sérgio Paulo. 1. Paulo, o apóstolo de Jesus Cristo aos gentios (Rm 1.1; Gl 1.1). | 2. Sérgio Paulo, procônsul romano em Chipre (At 13.7).
THAYER.en: Roman name (Latin cognomen meaning 'small') assumed by Saul of Tarsus, the apostle to the Gentiles, in the exercise of his apostolic mission. It also refers to the proconsul of Cyprus, Sergius Paulus. 1. Paul, the apostle of Jesus Christ to the Gentiles (Rom 1:1; Gal 1:1). | 2. Sergius Paulus, Roman proconsul in Cyprus (Acts 13:7).

DEFINITION: To make something stop happening or cease an ongoing activity.
SENSES: 1. To cause the interruption of an action or state, calming or relieving (1Pet 3:10).
2. To stop performing an action by one's own initiative (Luke 5:4; Acts 21:32).

THAYER.pt: Fazer algo parar de acontecer ou cessar uma atividade em andamento. 1. Causar a interrupção de uma ação ou estado, acalmando ou aliviando (1Pe 3.10). | 2. Parar de realizar uma ação por iniciativa própria (Lc 5.4; At 21.32).
THAYER.en: To make something stop happening or cease an ongoing activity. 1. To cause the interruption of an action or state, calming or relieving (1Pet 3:10). | 2. To stop performing an action by one's own initiative (Luke 5:4; Acts 21:32).

DEFINITION: An important coastal city located in the southwestern sector of the island of Cyprus, visited by the apostle Paul during his first missionary journey.
SENSES: 1. A city of Cyprus where the apostle Paul confronted Bar-Jesus and met the proconsul Sergius Paulus (Acts 13:6, 13).

THAYER.pt: Importante cidade costeira localizada no setor sudoeste da ilha de Chipre, visitada pelo apóstolo Paulo durante sua primeira viagem missionária. 1. Cidade de Chipre onde o apóstolo Paulo confrontou Bar-Jesus e encontrou o procônsul Sérgio Paulo (At 13.6, 13).
THAYER.en: An important coastal city located in the southwestern sector of the island of Cyprus, visited by the apostle Paul during his first missionary journey. 1. A city of Cyprus where the apostle Paul confronted Bar-Jesus and met the proconsul Sergius Paulus (Acts 13:6, 13).

DEFINITION: Originally meaning to make fat or well-nourished; figuratively, it describes the hardening or spiritual insensitivity of the human heart.
SENSES: 1. Figurative: to make the heart insensitive or spiritually dulled (Matt 13:15; Acts 28:27).

THAYER.pt: Originalmente significa tornar gordo ou bem nutrido; figuradamente, descreve o endurecimento ou a insensibilidade espiritual do coração humano. 1. Figurado: tornar o coração insensível ou espiritualmente embotado (Mt 13.15; At 28.27).
THAYER.en: Originally meaning to make fat or well-nourished; figuratively, it describes the hardening or spiritual insensitivity of the human heart. 1. Figurative: to make the heart insensitive or spiritually dulled (Matt 13:15; Acts 28:27).

DEFINITION: Designates a metal shackle or handcuff used to bind the feet of prisoners or demon-possessed individuals.
SENSES: 1. A shackle or chain for the feet (Mark 5:4; Luke 8:29).

THAYER.pt: Designa um grilhão ou algema de metal usado para prender os pés de prisioneiros ou endemoninhados. 1. Grilhão ou corrente para os pés (Mc 5.4; Lc 8.29).
THAYER.en: Designates a metal shackle or handcuff used to bind the feet of prisoners or demon-possessed individuals. 1. A shackle or chain for the feet (Mark 5:4; Luke 8:29).

DEFINITION: Describes a surface that is flat and level, in contrast to mountainous, steep, or irregular terrain.
SENSES: 1. Pertaining to a flat place or plain (Luke 6:17).

THAYER.pt: Descreve uma superfície que é plana e nivelada, em contraste com terrenos montanhosos, íngremes ou irregulares. 1. Relativo a um lugar plano ou planície (Lc 6.17).
THAYER.en: Describes a surface that is flat and level, in contrast to mountainous, steep, or irregular terrain. 1. Pertaining to a flat place or plain (Luke 6:17).

SHORT_GLOSS: travel on foot, travel by land
DEFINITION: To travel by land on foot, as opposed to a journey made by sea (sailing).
SENSES: 1. To make an overland journey on foot (Acts 20:13).
USAGE: travel on foot, travel by land

THAYER.pt: Viajar por terra a pé, em oposição a uma viagem realizada pelo mar (navegando). 1. Fazer uma jornada terrestre a pé (At 20.13).
THAYER.en: To travel by land on foot, as opposed to a journey made by sea (sailing). 1. To make an overland journey on foot (Acts 20:13).

DEFINITION: Indicates the mode of terrestrial travel, either walking on foot or traveling by land as opposed to sea transport.
SENSES: 1. To travel by land or walk on foot (Matt 14:13; Mark 6:33).

THAYER.pt: Indica a modalidade de deslocamento terrestre, seja caminhando a pé ou viajando por terra em oposição ao transporte marítimo. 1. Viajar por terra ou caminhar a pé (Mt 14.13; Mk 6.33).
THAYER.en: Indicates the mode of terrestrial travel, either walking on foot or traveling by land as opposed to sea transport. 1. To travel by land or walk on foot (Matt 14:13; Mark 6:33).

DEFINITION: Means to submit to authority, counsel, or law, obeying superiors or God promptly.
SENSES: 1. To obey constituted authority or God (Acts 5:29; Acts 27:21).

THAYER.pt: Significa submeter-se à autoridade, conselho ou lei, obedecendo prontamente aos superiores ou a Deus. 1. Obedecer à autoridade constituída ou a Deus (At 5.29; At 27.21).
THAYER.en: Means to submit to authority, counsel, or law, obeying superiors or God promptly. 1. To obey constituted authority or God (Acts 5:29; Acts 27:21).

DEFINITION: Having the capacity to persuade, convince, or influence someone's thinking through arguments or appeals.
SENSES: 1. Possessing the power of persuasion or conviction (1Cor 2:4).

THAYER.pt: Que tem a capacidade de persuadir, convencer ou influenciar o pensamento de alguém através de argumentos ou apelos. 1. Que possui poder de persuasão ou convencimento (1Co 2.4).
THAYER.en: Having the capacity to persuade, convince, or influence someone's thinking through arguments or appeals. 1. Possessing the power of persuasion or conviction (1Cor 2:4).

DEFINITION: To lead someone to change their mind through arguments, or to be deeply convinced and trust in something.
SENSES: 1. To persuade or convince someone by means of argumentation (Acts 18:4; 28:23).
2. To win over or appease someone (Matt 28:14; Gal 1:10).
3. In the perfect participle, to be persuaded, place trust or faith (Phil 3:3; 2Tim 1:12).

THAYER.pt: Levar alguém a mudar de opinião por meio de argumentos, ou estar profundamente convencido e confiudes em algo. 1. Persuadir ou convencer alguém mediante argumentação (At 18.4; 28.23). | 2. Ganhar o favor ou apaziguar alguém (Mt 28.14; Gl 1.10). | 3. No particípio perfeito, estar persuadido, depositar confiança ou fé (Fp 3.3; 2Tm 1.12).
THAYER.en: To lead someone to change their mind through arguments, or to be deeply convinced and trust in something. 1. To persuade or convince someone by means of argumentation (Acts 18:4; 28:23). | 2. To win over or appease someone (Matt 28:14; Gal 1:10). | 3. In the perfect participle, to be persuaded, place trust or faith (Phil 3:3; 2Tim 1:12).

DEFINITION: To be in a state of nutritional need, feeling physical hunger. In a figurative sense, it expresses intense yearning or a deep search for something spiritual.
SENSES: 1. To feel a lack of bodily food, to hunger (Matt 4:2; Luke 1:53).
2. To yearn earnestly on a moral or spiritual level (Matt 5:6; John 6:35).

THAYER.pt: Estar em estado de necessidade alimentar, sentindo fome física. Em sentido figurado, expressa o anseio intenso ou busca profunda por algo espiritual. 1. Sentir carência de alimento corporal, passar fome (Mt 4.2; Lc 1.53). | 2. Desejar ardentemente em nível moral ou espiritual (Mt 5.6; Jo 6.35).
THAYER.en: To be in a state of nutritional need, feeling physical hunger. In a figurative sense, it expresses intense yearning or a deep search for something spiritual. 1. To feel a lack of bodily food, to hunger (Matt 4:2; Luke 1:53). | 2. To yearn earnestly on a moral or spiritual level (Matt 5:6; John 6:35).

DEFINITION: Refers to the attempt to accomplish something or to practical knowledge acquired through experiencing events and trials.
SENSES: 1. An attempt or effort to carry out an enterprise (Heb 11:29).
2. Practical experience gained through living through events (Heb 11:36).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se à tentativa de realizar algo ou ao conhecimento prático adquirido através da vivência de eventos e provações. 1. Tentativa ou esforço de realizar um empreendimento (Hb 11.29). | 2. Experiência prática obtida por vivência (Hb 11.36).
THAYER.en: Refers to the attempt to accomplish something or to practical knowledge acquired through experiencing events and trials. 1. An attempt or effort to carry out an enterprise (Heb 11:29). | 2. Practical experience gained through living through events (Heb 11:36).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: πειράσω, Aor: ἐπείρασα, Pass: ἐπειράσθην
DEFINITION: Describes the action of subjecting someone to a test to evaluate their fidelity and character, or attempting to incite them to sin and disobedience.
SENSES: 1. To attempt to do something, to make a try (Acts 9:26; 16:7).
2. To test, examine, or prove someone's character or fidelity (2Cor 13:5; Heb 11:17).
3. To tempt or entice to evil, laying traps to induce sin (Matt 4:1; Jas 1:13).

THAYER.pt: Descreve a ação de submeter alguém a um teste para avaliar sua fidelidade e caráter, ou tentar incitá-lo ao pecado e à desobediência. 1. Tentar fazer algo, fazer uma tentativa (At 9.26; 16.7). | 2. Testar, examinar ou provar o caráter ou a fidelidade de alguém (2Co 13.5; Hb 11.17). | 3. Tentar ou aliciar para o mal, armar ciladas para induzir ao pecado (Mt 4.1; Tg 1.13).
THAYER.en: Describes the action of subjecting someone to a test to evaluate their fidelity and character, or attempting to incite them to sin and disobedience. 1. To attempt to do something, to make a try (Acts 9:26; 16:7). | 2. To test, examine, or prove someone's character or fidelity (2Cor 13:5; Heb 11:17). | 3. To tempt or entice to evil, laying traps to induce sin (Matt 4:1; Jas 1:13).

DEFINITION: A situation of severe testing to examine character or, alternatively, an external solicitation or allure to sin.
SENSES: 1. A severe test or trial intended to evaluate fidelity (1Pet 4:12).
2. A temptation to commit evil or yield to sin (Matt 6:13; Luke 4:13).

THAYER.pt: Uma situação de teste severo para examinar o caráter ou, por outro lado, uma solicitação ou atração exterior para pecar. 1. Um teste ou provação severa destinada a avaliar a fidelidade (1Pe 4.12). | 2. Uma tentação para cometer o mal ou ceder ao pecado (Mt 6.13; Lc 4.13).
THAYER.en: A situation of severe testing to examine character or, alternatively, an external solicitation or allure to sin. 1. A severe test or trial intended to evaluate fidelity (1Pet 4:12). | 2. A temptation to commit evil or yield to sin (Matt 6:13; Luke 4:13).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: πειράσω, Aor: ἐπείρασα, Perf: πεπείραμαι
DEFINITION: To make an attempt to accomplish something, or to undergo the experience of an event or state.
SENSES: 1. To try or undertake the performance of some action (Acts 26:21).
2. To undergo an experience or test (Heb 4:15).

THAYER.pt: Fazer uma tentativa de realizar algo, ou passar pela experiência de um evento ou estado. 1. Tentar ou empreender a realização de alguma ação (At 26.21). | 2. Passar por uma experiência ou teste (Hb 4.15).
THAYER.en: To make an attempt to accomplish something, or to undergo the experience of an event or state. 1. To try or undertake the performance of some action (Acts 26:21). | 2. To undergo an experience or test (Heb 4:15).

DEFINITION: The means or process by which someone is persuaded or led to accept a belief or point of view.
SENSES: 1. The act or power of persuading and inducing belief (Gal 5:8).

THAYER.pt: O meio ou o processo pelo qual alguém é persuadido ou levado a aceitar uma crença ou ponto de vista. 1. O ato ou o poder de persuadir e induzir à crença (Gl 5.8).
THAYER.en: The means or process by which someone is persuaded or led to accept a belief or point of view. 1. The act or power of persuading and inducing belief (Gal 5:8).

DEFINITION: Designates the deep waters of the open sea, distant from the coast and away from land protection.
SENSES: 1. The deep waters of the open sea (Matt 18:6).
2. A specific maritime portion of an ocean or sea (Acts 27:5).

THAYER.pt: Designa as águas profundas do mar aberto, distantes da costa e fora da proteção terrestre. 1. As águas profundas do mar aberto (Mt 18.6). | 2. Porção marítima específica de um oceano ou mar (At 27.5).
THAYER.en: Designates the deep waters of the open sea, distant from the coast and away from land protection. 1. The deep waters of the open sea (Matt 18:6). | 2. A specific maritime portion of an ocean or sea (Acts 27:5).

DEFINITION: To execute capital punishment by cutting off someone's head with an axe.
SENSES: 1. To execute by decapitation with a cutting instrument (Rev 20:4).

THAYER.pt: Executar a pena capital cortando a cabeça de alguém com um machado. 1. Executar por decapitação com um instrumento cortante (Ap 20.4).
THAYER.en: To execute capital punishment by cutting off someone's head with an axe. 1. To execute by decapitation with a cutting instrument (Rev 20:4).

DEFINITION: Ordinal numeral indicating the number five in a sequential series of time, space, or order.
SENSES: 1. The fifth element in a sequence (Rev 6:9; Rev 9:1).

THAYER.pt: Numeral ordinal que indica o número cinco em uma série sequencial de tempo, espaço ou ordem. 1. O quinto elemento em uma sequência (Ap 6.9; Ap 9.1).
THAYER.en: Ordinal numeral indicating the number five in a sequential series of time, space, or order. 1. The fifth element in a sequence (Rev 6:9; Rev 9:1).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: πέμψω, Aor: ἔπεμψα, AorPass: ἐπέμφθην
DEFINITION: To cause a person or message to travel with a particular charge; a central term in Johannine theology for the divine mission of the Son and the Spirit.
SENSES: 1. To send or dispatch persons as emissaries on a mission (Matt 2:8; Luke 7:6).
2. Designation of the heavenly Father as the One who sent the Son to earth (John 4:34; John 5:24; John 14:26).
3. To send letters, gifts, or material aid (Acts 11:29; Phil 4:16).

THAYER.pt: Fazer com que uma pessoa ou mensagem se desloque com um encargo particular; termo fulcral na teologia joanina para a missão divina do Filho e do Espírito. 1. Enviar ou despachar pessoas como emissários com uma missão (Mt 2.8; Lk 7.6). | 2. Designação do Pai celestial como Aquele que enviou o Filho à terra (Jo 4.34; Jo 5.24; Jo 14.26). | 3. Enviar cartas, presentes ou auxílio material (At 11.29; Fp 4.16).
THAYER.en: To cause a person or message to travel with a particular charge; a central term in Johannine theology for the divine mission of the Son and the Spirit. 1. To send or dispatch persons as emissaries on a mission (Matt 2:8; Luke 7:6). | 2. Designation of the heavenly Father as the One who sent the Son to earth (John 4:34; John 5:24; John 14:26). | 3. To send letters, gifts, or material aid (Acts 11:29; Phil 4:16).

DEFINITION: A person who does not possess great resources and needs to work for their own sustenance, though not necessarily destitute to the point of begging.
SENSES: 1. An individual of meager resources who lives by their own labor (2Cor 9:9).

THAYER.pt: Uma pessoa que não possui grandes recursos e precisa trabalhar para o próprio sustento, embora não necessariamente destituída a ponto de mendigar. 1. Indivíduo de parcos recursos que vive do próprio trabalho (2Co 9.9).
THAYER.en: A person who does not possess great resources and needs to work for their own sustenance, though not necessarily destitute to the point of begging. 1. An individual of meager resources who lives by their own labor (2Cor 9:9).

DEFINITION: Kinship term designating the mother of one's spouse (husband or wife).
SENSES: 1. The mother of the wife or husband, mentioned in the healing of Peter's mother-in-law (Matt 8:14; Luke 4:38).

THAYER.pt: Termo de parentesco que designa a mãe do cônjuge (marido ou esposa). 1. A mãe da esposa ou do marido, mencionada na cura da sogra de Pedro (Mt 8.14; Lc 4.38).
THAYER.en: Kinship term designating the mother of one's spouse (husband or wife). 1. The mother of the wife or husband, mentioned in the healing of Peter's mother-in-law (Matt 8:14; Luke 4:38).

DEFINITION: The father of a person's spouse (husband or wife).
SENSES: 1. The father of the wife or husband (John 18:13).

THAYER.pt: O pai do cônjuge (marido ou esposa) de uma pessoa. 1. O pai da esposa ou do marido (Jo 18.13).
THAYER.en: The father of a person's spouse (husband or wife). 1. The father of the wife or husband (John 18:13).

DEFINITION: To experience deep sorrow, grief, or mourning due to losses, death, or sin.
SENSES: 1. To be sad and chant a lament for difficult circumstances (Matt 5:4).
2. To mourn someone's death or lament sin (2Cor 12:21).

THAYER.pt: Experimentar profundo pesar, tristeza ou luto devido a perdas, morte ou pecado. 1. Estar triste e entoar lamento por circunstâncias difíceis (Mt 5.4). | 2. Prantear a morte de alguém ou lamentar o pecado (2Co 12.21).
THAYER.en: To experience deep sorrow, grief, or mourning due to losses, death, or sin. 1. To be sad and chant a lament for difficult circumstances (Matt 5:4). | 2. To mourn someone's death or lament sin (2Cor 12:21).

DEFINITION: The experience of deep sorrow, grief, or mourning resulting from difficult circumstances, losses, or sin.
SENSES: 1. Mourning, sorrow, or deep lamentation (Jas 4:9; Rev 18:7).

THAYER.pt: Experiência de profundo pesar, tristeza ou luto resultante de circunstâncias difíceis, perdas ou pecado. 1. Luto, tristeza ou pranto profundo (Tg 4.9; Ap 18.7).
THAYER.en: The experience of deep sorrow, grief, or mourning resulting from difficult circumstances, losses, or sin. 1. Mourning, sorrow, or deep lamentation (Jas 4:9; Rev 18:7).

DEFINITION: Found in a situation of scarcity and lacking the essential means for daily subsistence.
SENSES: 1. Living in poverty or extreme necessity (Luke 21:2).

THAYER.pt: Que se encontra em situação de escassez e falta dos meios essenciais para a subsistência diária. 1. Que vive na pobreza ou extrema necessidade (Lc 21.2).
THAYER.en: Found in a situation of scarcity and lacking the essential means for daily subsistence. 1. Living in poverty or extreme necessity (Luke 21:2).

DEFINITION: Adverb indicating the occurrence of an action or event the number of five times.
SENSES: 1. To happen or repeat five times (2Cor 11:24).

THAYER.pt: Advérbio que indica a ocorrência de uma ação ou evento pelo número de cinco vezes. 1. Acontecer ou repetir-se cinco vezes (2Co 11.24).
THAYER.en: Adverb indicating the occurrence of an action or event the number of five times. 1. To happen or repeat five times (2Cor 11:24).

DEFINITION: Cardinal numeral representing the exact quantity of five thousand units, famous in the accounts of the multiplication of the loaves.
SENSES: 1. The group of five thousand men fed by Jesus in the wilderness (Matt 14:21; John 6:10).

THAYER.pt: Numeral cardinal que representa a quantidade exata de cinco mil unidades, célebre nos relatos da multiplicação dos pães. 1. O grupo de cinco mil homens alimentados por Jesus no deserto (Mt 14.21; Jo 6.10).
THAYER.en: Cardinal numeral representing the exact quantity of five thousand units, famous in the accounts of the multiplication of the loaves. 1. The group of five thousand men fed by Jesus in the wilderness (Matt 14:21; John 6:10).

DEFINITION: Cardinal numeral representing exactly the quantity of five hundred units.
SENSES: 1. The number five hundred (Luke 7:41; 1Cor 15:6).

THAYER.pt: Numeral cardinal que representa exatamente a quantidade de quinhentas unidades. 1. O número quinhentos (Lc 7.41; 1Co 15.6).
THAYER.en: Cardinal numeral representing exactly the quantity of five hundred units. 1. The number five hundred (Luke 7:41; 1Cor 15:6).

DEFINITION: Cardinal numeral representing the exact quantity of five units.
SENSES: 1. The number five in literal or symbolic contexts (Matt 14:17; Rev 9:5).

THAYER.pt: Numeral cardinal que representa a quantidade exata de cinco unidades. 1. O número cinco em contextos literais ou simbólicos (Mt 14.17; Ap 9.5).
THAYER.en: Cardinal numeral representing the exact quantity of five units. 1. The number five in literal or symbolic contexts (Matt 14:17; Rev 9:5).

DEFINITION: Ordinal numeral indicating the position of number fifteen in a sequential series, whether of time or space.
SENSES: 1. The fifteenth in an order or sequence (Luke 3:1).

THAYER.pt: Numeral ordinal que indica a posição de número quinze em uma série sequencial, seja de tempo ou espaço. 1. O décimo quinto em uma ordem ou sequência (Lc 3.1).
THAYER.en: Ordinal numeral indicating the position of number fifteen in a sequential series, whether of time or space. 1. The fifteenth in an order or sequence (Luke 3:1).

DEFINITION: The cardinal numeral representing the number fifty.
SENSES: 1. The exact quantity of fifty (Luke 16:6; John 8:57).

THAYER.pt: O numeral cardinal que representa o número cinquenta. 1. A quantidade exata de cinquenta (Lc 16:6; Jo 8:57).
THAYER.en: The cardinal numeral representing the number fifty. 1. The exact quantity of fifty (Luke 16:6; John 8:57).

DEFINITION: Refers to the Jewish harvest festival celebrated on the fiftieth day after Passover, marked in the NT by the outpouring of the Holy Spirit.
SENSES: 1. The Jewish feast of Pentecost (Acts 2:1; 1 Cor 16:8).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se ao festival judaico da colheita celebrado no quinquagésimo dia após a Páscoa, marcado no NT pelo derramamento do Espírito Santo. 1. A festa judaica de Pentecostes (At 2.1; 1Co 16.8).
THAYER.en: Refers to the Jewish harvest festival celebrated on the fiftieth day after Passover, marked in the NT by the outpouring of the Holy Spirit. 1. The Jewish feast of Pentecost (Acts 2:1; 1 Cor 16:8).

DEFINITION: Indicates a state of deep conviction or firm security concerning something, resulting in resolute trust and dependence, whether in people or in God.
SENSES: 1. Confidence or security placed in others or in circumstances (2 Cor 1:15).
2. Firm conviction and boldness based on God or oneself (2 Cor 10:2; Eph 3:12).

THAYER.pt: Indica um estado de convicção profunda ou firme segurança acerca de algo, resultando em firme confiança e dependência, seja em pessoas ou em Deus. 1. Confiança ou segurança depositada em outros ou em circunstâncias (2Co 1.15). | 2. Firme convicção e ousadia fundamentada em Deus ou em si mesmo (2Co 10.2; Ef 3.12).
THAYER.en: Indicates a state of deep conviction or firm security concerning something, resulting in resolute trust and dependence, whether in people or in God. 1. Confidence or security placed in others or in circumstances (2 Cor 1:15). | 2. Firm conviction and boldness based on God or oneself (2 Cor 10:2; Eph 3:12).

DEFINITION: An enclitic particle that serves to intensify or restrict the meaning of the word to which it is joined, indicating emphasis.
SENSES: 1. Intensifying particle used to give greater emphasis to pronouns or conjunctions.

THAYER.pt: Uma partícula enclítica que serve para intensificar ou restringir o significado da palavra à qual se junta, indicando ênfase. 1. Partícula intensificadora usada para dar maior ênfase a pronomes ou conjunções.
THAYER.en: An enclitic particle that serves to intensify or restrict the meaning of the word to which it is joined, indicating emphasis. 1. Intensifying particle used to give greater emphasis to pronouns or conjunctions.

DEFINITION: Functions as an adverb or preposition to indicate a position located on the other side of a geographical obstacle, such as a river or a lake.
SENSES: 1. On the opposite bank or on the other side of a body of water (Matt 8:18; John 6:1).

THAYER.pt: Funciona como advérbio ou preposição para indicar uma posição localizada do outro lado de um obstáculo geográfico, como um rio ou um lago. 1. Na margem oposta ou do outro lado de um corpo de água (Mt 8.18; Jo 6.1).
THAYER.en: Functions as an adverb or preposition to indicate a position located on the other side of a geographical obstacle, such as a river or a lake. 1. On the opposite bank or on the other side of a body of water (Matt 8:18; John 6:1).

DEFINITION: Indicates the final point, extreme limit of a geographical space, or the conclusion of a process.
SENSES: 1. Spatial limit or extremity, the ends of the earth (Matt 12:42).
2. The ending or conclusion of a process or agreement (Heb 6:16).

THAYER.pt: Indica o ponto final, limite extremo de um espaço geográfico ou a conclusão de um processo. 1. Limite ou extremidade espacial, os confins (Mt 12.42). | 2. O término ou conclusão de um processo ou acordo (Hb 6.16).
THAYER.en: Indicates the final point, extreme limit of a geographical space, or the conclusion of a process. 1. Spatial limit or extremity, the ends of the earth (Matt 12:42). | 2. The ending or conclusion of a process or agreement (Heb 6:16).

DEFINITION: Prominent city located in northwestern Asia Minor, known for its pagan temples and for housing one of the seven churches of Revelation.
SENSES: 1. City of Pergamum, seat of one of the seven churches of Asia (Rev 1:11; 2:12).

THAYER.pt: Proeminente cidade localizada no noroeste da Ásia Menor, conhecida por seus templos pagãos e por abrigar uma das sete igrejas do Apocalipse. 1. Cidade de Pérgamo, sede de uma das sete igrejas da Ásia (Ap 1.11; 2.12).
THAYER.en: Prominent city located in northwestern Asia Minor, known for its pagan temples and for housing one of the seven churches of Revelation. 1. City of Pergamum, seat of one of the seven churches of Asia (Rev 1:11; 2:12).

DEFINITION: Important city in the region of Pamphylia, in Asia Minor, visited by the apostle Paul during his missionary journeys.
SENSES: 1. Perga, city of Asia Minor (Acts 13:14; Acts 14:25).

THAYER.pt: Cidade importante na região da Panfília, na Ásia Menor, visitada pelo apóstolo Paulo durante suas viagens missionárias. 1. Perga, cidade da Ásia Menor (At 13.14; At 14.25).
THAYER.en: Important city in the region of Pamphylia, in Asia Minor, visited by the apostle Paul during his missionary journeys. 1. Perga, city of Asia Minor (Acts 13:14; Acts 14:25).

DEFINITION: Preposition expressing thematic reference when governing the genitive ('concerning') and spatial proximity or circumscription when governing the accusative ('around'). It has great weight in sacrificial mediation theological formulations.
SENSES: 1. With genitive: specification of subject or purpose: 'concerning', 'about', 'on behalf of' (Matt 2:8; 1 Cor 7:1; 1 Pet 3:18).
2. With accusative: spatial position or proximity: 'around', 'about' (Mark 9:42; Luke 10:40).
3. Temporal with accusative: 'around', 'approximately' (Matt 20:3).

THAYER.pt: Preposição que expressa referência temática quando governa o genitivo ('a respeito de') e proximidade ou circunscrição espacial quando governa o acusativo ('ao redor de'). Tem grande peso nas formulações teológicas de mediação sacrificial. 1. Com genitivo: especificação de assunto ou propósito: 'acerca de', 'sobre', 'em favor de' (Mt 2.8; 1Co 7.1; 1Pe 3.18). | 2. Com acusativo: posição espacial ou proximidade: 'ao redor de', 'em torno de' (Mc 9.42; Lk 10.40). | 3. Temporal com acusativo: 'por volta de', 'aproximadamente' (Mt 20.3).
THAYER.en: Preposition expressing thematic reference when governing the genitive ('concerning') and spatial proximity or circumscription when governing the accusative ('around'). It has great weight in sacrificial mediation theological formulations. 1. With genitive: specification of subject or purpose: 'concerning', 'about', 'on behalf of' (Matt 2:8; 1 Cor 7:1; 1 Pet 3:18). | 2. With accusative: spatial position or proximity: 'around', 'about' (Mark 9:42; Luke 10:40). | 3. Temporal with accusative: 'around', 'approximately' (Matt 20:3).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Impf: περιῆγον, Fut: περιάξω, Aor: περιήγαγον
DEFINITION: To move around a place, travel in various directions, or lead someone along with oneself constantly.
SENSES: 1. To take along or lead companions on journeys (1 Cor 9:5).
2. To travel or circulate through different regions preaching and teaching (Matt 4:23; Mark 6:6).

THAYER.pt: Significa mover-se ao redor de um lugar, viajar por várias direções ou conduzir alguém consigo constantemente. 1. Levar consigo ou conduzir companheiros em viagens (1Co 9.5). | 2. Viajar ou circular por diferentes regiões pregando e ensinando (Mt 4.23; Mc 6.6).
THAYER.en: To move around a place, travel in various directions, or lead someone along with oneself constantly. 1. To take along or lead companions on journeys (1 Cor 9:5). | 2. To travel or circulate through different regions preaching and teaching (Matt 4:23; Mark 6:6).

DEFINITION: To take off something that is around or covering an object, or to annul and eliminate an unwanted element.
SENSES: 1. To remove a covering or surrounding object (2 Cor 3:16; Acts 27:40).
2. To annul, abolish, or remove sin or burden (Heb 10:11).

THAYER.pt: Retirar algo que está ao redor ou cobrindo um objeto, ou anular e eliminar um elemento indesejado. 1. Retirar uma cobertura ou objeto envolvente (2Co 3.16; At 27.40). | 2. Anular, abolir ou remover o pecado ou fardo (Hb 10.11).
THAYER.en: To take off something that is around or covering an object, or to annul and eliminate an unwanted element. 1. To remove a covering or surrounding object (2 Cor 3:16; Acts 27:40). | 2. To annul, abolish, or remove sin or burden (Heb 10:11).

DEFINITION: Describes the action of emitting bright light that completely surrounds or envelops a person or place.
SENSES: 1. To flash around with resplendent light or shine all around (Acts 9:3; 22:6).

THAYER.pt: Descreve a ação de emitir luz brilhante que circunda ou envolve completamente uma pessoa ou lugar. 1. Cercar de luz resplandecente ou brilhar ao redor (At 9.3; 22.6).
THAYER.en: Describes the action of emitting bright light that completely surrounds or envelops a person or place. 1. To flash around with resplendent light or shine all around (Acts 9:3; 22:6).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: περιβαλῶ, Aor: περιέβαλον, Fut. Mid: περιβαλοῦμαι
DEFINITION: To put garments or coverings around oneself or someone else; to wrap. Occasionally used in the sense of surrounding militarily with trenches.
SENSES: 1. To dress, cover with clothes or cloaks (Matt 25:36; Mark 16:5).
2. To clothe oneself (Matt 6:31; Rev 3:5).
3. To erect a siege wall or earthwork around a city (Luke 19:43).

THAYER.pt: Colocar vestimentas ou coberturas ao redor de si ou de outrem; envolver. Ocasionalmente, é empregado no sentido de cercar militarmente com trincheiras. 1. Vestir, cobrir com roupas ou mantos (Mt 25.36; Mc 16.5). | 2. Vestir-se a si mesmo (Mt 6.31; Ap 3.5). | 3. Erguer circunvalação ou aterro ao redor de uma cidade (Lc 19.43).
THAYER.en: To put garments or coverings around oneself or someone else; to wrap. Occasionally used in the sense of surrounding militarily with trenches. 1. To dress, cover with clothes or cloaks (Matt 25:36; Mark 16:5). | 2. To clothe oneself (Matt 6:31; Rev 3:5). | 3. To erect a siege wall or earthwork around a city (Luke 19:43).

DEFINITION: To look around in various directions, usually with attention or expectation to observe the environment or people.
SENSES: 1. To look around to the sides (Mark 3:5; Luke 6:10).

THAYER.pt: Olhar ao redor em várias direções, geralmente com atenção ou expectativa para observar o ambiente ou as pessoas. 1. Olhar ao redor para os lados (Mc 3:5; Lc 6:10).
THAYER.en: To look around in various directions, usually with attention or expectation to observe the environment or people. 1. To look around to the sides (Mark 3:5; Luke 6:10).

DEFINITION: Refers to an outer garment, such as a cloak or veil, that wraps around and covers the body.
SENSES: 1. Outer garment or protective cloak (Heb 1:12).
2. Natural bodily covering or clothing such as a veil (1 Cor 11:15).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se a uma peça de vestuário externa, como um manto ou véu, que envolve e cobre o corpo. 1. Vestimenta externa ou capa de proteção (Hb 1.12). | 2. Cobertura corporal natural ou vestuário como o véu (1Co 11.15).
THAYER.en: Refers to an outer garment, such as a cloak or veil, that wraps around and covers the body. 1. Outer garment or protective cloak (Heb 1:12). | 2. Natural bodily covering or clothing such as a veil (1 Cor 11:15).

DEFINITION: To tie, fasten, or wind something around an object or person.
SENSES: 1. To wrap or tie something around someone (John 11:44).

THAYER.pt: Amarrar, prender ou enrolar algo ao redor de um objeto ou pessoa. 1. Envolver ou atar algo ao redor de alguém (Jo 11.44).
THAYER.en: To tie, fasten, or wind something around an object or person. 1. To wrap or tie something around someone (John 11:44).

DEFINITION: To interfere unduly in the affairs of others, demonstrating intrusiveness and lack of discretion.
SENSES: 1. To meddle excessively or intrusively in other people's business (2 Thess 3:11).

THAYER.pt: Interferir indevidamente nos assuntos dos outros, demonstrando intromissão e falta de discrição. 1. Envolver-se excessivamente ou de forma intrusiva nos negócios alheios (2Ts 3.11).
THAYER.en: To interfere unduly in the affairs of others, demonstrating intrusiveness and lack of discretion. 1. To meddle excessively or intrusively in other people's business (2 Thess 3:11).

DEFINITION: A mountainous region located in the central part of Asia Minor, traversed by Paul during his missionary journeys.
SENSES: 1. A province or geographical region of Asia Minor (Acts 13:14; 14:24).

THAYER.pt: Região montanhosa situada na região central da Ásia Menor, atravessada por Paulo em suas viagens missionárias. 1. Província ou região geográfica da Ásia Menor (At 13.14; 14.24).
THAYER.en: A mountainous region located in the central part of Asia Minor, traversed by Paul during his missionary journeys. 1. A province or geographical region of Asia Minor (Acts 13:14; 14:24).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: πιστεύσω, Aor: ἐπίστευσα, Perf: πεπίστευκα
DEFINITION: To consider a truth as reliable and embrace it with unreserved personal trust and moral dedication. In the apostolic corpus, it expresses the integral salvific response of surrendering one's life to Jesus Christ and the promise of the gospel.
SENSES: 1. To consider a statement as authentic and reliable (Luke 1:20; John 2:22).
2. To trust fully and surrender one's life salvifically to God or Christ (John 3:16; Rom 10:9).
3. To entrust something to someone, to place under custody (Luke 16:11; Rom 3:2).

THAYER.pt: Considerar uma verdade fidedigna e abraçá-la com confiança pessoal irrestrita e dedicação moral. No corpus apostólico, expressa a resposta salvífica integral de entrega da vida a Jesus Cristo e à promessa do evangelho. 1. Considerar uma afirmação como autêntica e confiável (Lc 1.20; Jo 2.22). | 2. Confiar plenamente e entregar a vida salvificamente a Deus ou a Cristo (Jo 3.16; Rm 10.9). | 3. Confiar algo a alguém, encarregar sob custódia (Lc 16.11; Rm 3.2).
THAYER.en: To consider a truth as reliable and embrace it with unreserved personal trust and moral dedication. In the apostolic corpus, it expresses the integral salvific response of surrendering one's life to Jesus Christ and the promise of the gospel. 1. To consider a statement as authentic and reliable (Luke 1:20; John 2:22). | 2. To trust fully and surrender one's life salvifically to God or Christ (John 3:16; Rom 10:9). | 3. To entrust something to someone, to place under custody (Luke 16:11; Rom 3:2).

DEFINITION: A term used in the New Testament to qualify substances of high quality, pure and unadulterated.
SENSES: 1. Pertaining to something genuine and pure, especially applied to the nard used to anoint Jesus (Mark 14:3; John 12:3).

THAYER.pt: Termo usado no Novo Testamento para qualificar substâncias de alta qualidade, puras e não adulteradas. 1. Pertainte a algo genuíno e puro, especialmente aplicado ao nardo usado para ungir Jesus (Mc 14.3; Jo 12.3).
THAYER.en: A term used in the New Testament to qualify substances of high quality, pure and unadulterated. 1. Pertaining to something genuine and pure, especially applied to the nard used to anoint Jesus (Mark 14:3; John 12:3).

DEFINITION: A posture of full dependent trust and unquestionable loyalty to the covenant with God and the person of Christ. It can signal both the subjective attitude of believing and the objective body of doctrines that ground the Christian faith.
SENSES: 1. Firm trust, dependence, and living hope in God and Christ (Rom 1:17; Heb 11:1).
2. Faithfulness, integrity, and moral firmness of character (Matt 23:23; Rom 3:3).
3. The objective content of evangelical doctrine: 'the faith' delivered to the saints (Gal 1:23; Jude 3).

THAYER.pt: Postura de plena confiança dependente e lealdade inconteste à aliança com Deus e com a pessoa de Cristo. Pode sinalizar tanto a atitude subjetiva de crer quanto o conjunto objetivo de doutrinas que fundamentam a fé cristã. 1. Confiança firme, dependência e esperança viva em Deus e em Cristo (Rm 1.17; Hb 11.1). | 2. Fidelidade, integridade e firmeza moral de caráter (Mt 23.23; Rm 3.3). | 3. O conteúdo objetivo da doutrina evangélica: 'a fé' transmitida aos santos (Gl 1.23; Jd 3).
THAYER.en: A posture of full dependent trust and unquestionable loyalty to the covenant with God and the person of Christ. It can signal both the subjective attitude of believing and the objective body of doctrines that ground the Christian faith. 1. Firm trust, dependence, and living hope in God and Christ (Rom 1:17; Heb 11:1). | 2. Faithfulness, integrity, and moral firmness of character (Matt 23:23; Rom 3:3). | 3. The objective content of evangelical doctrine: 'the faith' delivered to the saints (Gal 1:23; Jude 3).

DEFINITION: Describes someone who is worthy of faith and trust due to their unwavering loyalty, or, in an active sense, one who believes and trusts in God.
SENSES: 1. Worthy of trust, loyal, faithful in fulfilling duties (Matt 24:45; 1 Cor 4:2).
2. One who possesses faith, a believer, faithful in the sense of adhering to Christ (Acts 16:1; 2 Cor 6:15).

THAYER.pt: Descreve alguém que é digno de fé e confiança devido à sua lealdade inabalável, ou, em sentido ativo, aquele que crê e confia em Deus. 1. Digno de confiança, leal, fiel em cumprir deveres (Mt 24.45; 1Co 4.2). | 2. Aquele que possui fé, crente, fiel no sentido de aderir a Cristo (At 16.1; 2Co 6.15).
THAYER.en: Describes someone who is worthy of faith and trust due to their unwavering loyalty, or, in an active sense, one who believes and trusts in God. 1. Worthy of trust, loyal, faithful in fulfilling duties (Matt 24:45; 1 Cor 4:2). | 2. One who possesses faith, a believer, faithful in the sense of adhering to Christ (Acts 16:1; 2 Cor 6:15).

DEFINITION: To make someone fully convinced or confirmed in the truth due to the reliability of the teaching received.
SENSES: 1. To be fully convinced or persuaded of a truth (2 Tim 3:14).

THAYER.pt: Significa tornar alguém plenamente convencido ou confirmado na verdade devido à confiabilidade do ensino recebido. 1. Estar plenamente convencido ou persuadido de uma verdade (2Tm 3.14).
THAYER.en: To make someone fully convinced or confirmed in the truth due to the reliability of the teaching received. 1. To be fully convinced or persuaded of a truth (2 Tim 3:14).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: πλανήσω, Aor: ἐπλάνησα, Pass: ἐπλανήθην
DEFINITION: To cause someone to depart from the correct path, whether physical or moral, leading them into error, illusion, or doctrinal deception.
SENSES: 1. To cause to miss the way, to lead off the correct course (Heb 11:38; 1 Pet 2:25).
2. To deceive, seduce, or induce into a false belief or conduct (Matt 24:4; 1 John 1:8).

THAYER.pt: Significa afastar alguém do caminho correto, físico ou moral, levando-o ao erro, à ilusão ou ao engano doctrinal. 1. Fazer errar o caminho, desviar do rumo correto (Hb 11.38; 1Pe 2.25). | 2. Enganar, seduzir ou induzir a uma falsa crença ou conduta (Mt 24.4; 1Jo 1.8).
THAYER.en: To cause someone to depart from the correct path, whether physical or moral, leading them into error, illusion, or doctrinal deception. 1. To cause to miss the way, to lead off the correct course (Heb 11:38; 1 Pet 2:25). | 2. To deceive, seduce, or induce into a false belief or conduct (Matt 24:4; 1 John 1:8).

DEFINITION: A deviation from the path of truth, resulting in false beliefs, deception, or immoral behavior.
SENSES: 1. Doctrinal error or illusion that leads away from the truth (1 John 4:6).
2. Immoral conduct resulting from intentional deception (Jude 11).

THAYER.pt: Desvio do caminho da verdade, resultando em falsas crenças, engano ou comportamento imoral. 1. Erro doutrinário ou ilusão que afasta da verdade (1Jo 4.6). | 2. Conduta imoral decorrente de engano intencional (Jd 11).
THAYER.en: A deviation from the path of truth, resulting in false beliefs, deception, or immoral behavior. 1. Doctrinal error or illusion that leads away from the truth (1 John 4:6). | 2. Immoral conduct resulting from intentional deception (Jude 11).

DEFINITION: One who wanders or roams without a fixed course; applied in antiquity to celestial bodies whose movements differed from the fixed stars.
SENSES: 1. A wandering celestial body, a shooting or wandering star (Jude 13).

THAYER.pt: Aquele que erra ou vagueia sem rumo fixo; aplicado na Antiguidade aos astros cujos movimentos diferiam das estrelas fixas. 1. Corpo celeste errante, estrela cadente ou vagante (Jd 13).
THAYER.en: One who wanders or roams without a fixed course; applied in antiquity to celestial bodies whose movements differed from the fixed stars. 1. A wandering celestial body, a shooting or wandering star (Jude 13).

DEFINITION: That which leads others into error, falsehood, or deviation from the truth; also used as a noun to designate an impostor.
SENSES: 1. That which leads away from the truth or is deceptive (1 Tim 4:1).
2. A deceiver or impostor (2 Cor 6:8).

THAYER.pt: Que induz outros ao erro, à falsidade ou ao desvio da verdade; usado também como substantivo para designar um impostor. 1. Que desvia da verdade ou é enganoso (1Tm 4.1). | 2. Enganador ou impostor (2Co 6.8).
THAYER.en: That which leads others into error, falsehood, or deviation from the truth; also used as a noun to designate an impostor. 1. That which leads away from the truth or is deceptive (1 Tim 4:1). | 2. A deceiver or impostor (2 Cor 6:8).

DEFINITION: A flat surface of stone or other material used for inscriptions, such as the tablets of the Law.
SENSES: 1. A stone tablet for inscriptions (Heb 9:4);
2. A metaphorical tablet of the human heart (2 Cor 3:3).

THAYER.pt: Superfície plana de pedra ou outro material utilizada para inscrições, como as tábuas da Lei. 1. Tábua de pedra para inscrições (Hb 9.4); | 2. Tábua metafórica do coração humano (2Co 3.3).
THAYER.en: A flat surface of stone or other material used for inscriptions, such as the tablets of the Law. 1. A stone tablet for inscriptions (Heb 9:4); | 2. A metaphorical tablet of the human heart (2 Cor 3:3).

DEFINITION: Designates that which has been formed, modeled, or constructed by the hands of an artisan or creator.
SENSES: 1. The work created or modeled in relation to its Creator (Rom 9:20).

THAYER.pt: Designa aquilo que foi formado, modelado ou construído pelas mãos de um artífice ou criador. 1. A obra criada ou modelada em relação ao seu Criador (Rm 9.20).
THAYER.en: Designates that which has been formed, modeled, or constructed by the hands of an artisan or creator. 1. The work created or modeled in relation to its Creator (Rom 9:20).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: πλάσω, Aor: ἔπλασα, Pass: ἐπλάσθην
DEFINITION: To model or give form to a malleable substance, frequently used in the sense of the divine creation of humanity.
SENSES: 1. To mold or physically form an object from malleable material (Rom 9:20).
2. The creative activity of God in forming the human being (1 Tim 2:13).

THAYER.pt: Modelar ou dar forma a uma substância maleável, frequentemente usado no sentido da criação divina da humanidade. 1. Moldar ou formar fisicamente um objeto a partir de material maleável (Rm 9.20). | 2. A atividade criativa de Deus ao formar o ser humano (1Tm 2.13).
THAYER.en: To model or give form to a malleable substance, frequently used in the sense of the divine creation of humanity. 1. To mold or physically form an object from malleable material (Rom 9:20). | 2. The creative activity of God in forming the human being (1 Tim 2:13).

DEFINITION: Refers to something that has no basis in reality, being constructed artificially to deceive or simulate truth.
SENSES: 1. False, feigned, or fabricated with the intent of fraud (2 Pet 2:3).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se a algo que não tem base na realidade, sendo construído artificialmente para enganar ou simular verdade. 1. Falso, fingido ou fabricado com intenção de fraude (2Pe 2.3).
THAYER.en: Refers to something that has no basis in reality, being constructed artificially to deceive or simulate truth. 1. False, feigned, or fabricated with the intent of fraud (2 Pet 2:3).

DEFINITION: A wide and spacious public thoroughfare within a city, a plaza, or a main street.
SENSES: 1. A wide street or public plaza where people gather (Matt 6:5; Luke 14:21; Rev 21:21).

THAYER.pt: Via pública ampla e espaçosa no interior de uma cidade, praça ou rua principal. 1. Rua larga ou praça pública onde as pessoas se reúnem (Mt 6.5; Lc 14.21; Ap 21.21).
THAYER.en: A wide and spacious public thoroughfare within a city, a plaza, or a main street. 1. A wide street or public plaza where people gather (Matt 6:5; Luke 14:21; Rev 21:21).

DEFINITION: The measurement of the extent of an object or space from one side to the other, indicating its width.
SENSES: 1. The lateral extent or width of something (Eph 3:18; Rev 20:9).

THAYER.pt: Mmedida da extensão de um objeto ou espaço de um lado ao outro, indicando sua largura. 1. A extensão lateral ou largura de algo (Ef 3.18; Ap 20.9).
THAYER.en: The measurement of the extent of an object or space from one side to the other, indicating its width. 1. The lateral extent or width of something (Eph 3:18; Rev 20:9).

DEFINITION: To make something wider or broader; figuratively, to expand affection or open the heart to someone.
SENSES: 1. To widen or enlarge physically (Matt 23:5);
2. To open the heart or demonstrate deep affection (2 Cor 6:11).

THAYER.pt: Tornar algo mais largo ou amplo; figuradamente, expandir o afeto ou abrir o coração para alguém. 1. Alargar ou ampliar fisicamente (Mt 23.5); | 2. Abrir o coração ou demonstrar afeto profundo (2Co 6.11).
THAYER.en: To make something wider or broader; figuratively, to expand affection or open the heart to someone. 1. To widen or enlarge physically (Matt 23:5); | 2. To open the heart or demonstrate deep affection (2 Cor 6:11).

DEFINITION: That which possesses great extent from one side to the other, denoting physical and metaphorical amplitude or width.
SENSES: 1. Ample or wide, referring to the path that leads to destruction (Matt 7:13).

THAYER.pt: Que possui grande extensão de um lado a outro, denotando amplitude ou largura física e metafórica. 1. Amplo ou largo, referido ao caminho que conduz à perdição (Mt 7.13).
THAYER.en: That which possesses great extent from one side to the other, denoting physical and metaphorical amplitude or width. 1. Ample or wide, referring to the path that leads to destruction (Matt 7:13).

DEFINITION: Refers to intertwined or braided objects, specifically employed for elaborate hairstyles with braided hair.
SENSES: 1. An elaborate hairstyle with hair braids (1 Tim 2:9).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se a objetos entrelaçados ou trançados, sendo empregado especificamente para penteados elaborados com cabelos trançados. 1. Penteado elaborado com tranças de cabelo (1Tm 2.9).
THAYER.en: Refers to intertwined or braided objects, specifically employed for elaborate hairstyles with braided hair. 1. An elaborate hairstyle with hair braids (1 Tim 2:9).

DEFINITION: A superlative form that denotes the greatest possible quantity, the vast majority, or the maximum number.
SENSES: 1. The vast majority or a very large quantity of something (Matt 11:20).

THAYER.pt: Forma superlativa que denota a maior quantidade possível, a grande maioria ou o número máximo. 1. A grande maioria ou quantidade muito grande de algo (Mt 11.20).
THAYER.en: A superlative form that denotes the greatest possible quantity, the vast majority, or the maximum number. 1. The vast majority or a very large quantity of something (Matt 11:20).

DEFINITION: A comparative form denoting a greater quantity, extent, number, or degree in relation to a term of reference.
SENSES: 1. In greater quantity or number, many more (Acts 19:32; 27:20).
2. Greater in extent, importance, or degree (Lk 11:53; Heb 7:23).

THAYER.pt: Forma comparativa que denota maior quantidade, extensão, número ou grau em relação a um termo de referência. 1. Em maior quantidade ou número, muitos mais (At 19.32; 27.20). | 2. Maior em extensão, importância ou grau (Lc 11.53; Hb 7.23).
THAYER.en: A comparative form denoting a greater quantity, extent, number, or degree in relation to a term of reference. 1. In greater quantity or number, many more (Acts 19:32; 27:20). | 2. Greater in extent, importance, or degree (Lk 11:53; Heb 7:23).

DEFINITION: To interweave fibers, threads, or branches to form a braided object.
SENSES: 1. To braid or interweave branches to form a crown (Mt 27:29; Mk 15:17).

THAYER.pt: Entrelaçar fibras, fios ou ramos para formar um objeto trançado. 1. Trançar ou entrelaçar ramos para formar uma coroa (Mt 27.29; Mc 15.17).
THAYER.en: To interweave fibers, threads, or branches to form a braided object. 1. To braid or interweave branches to form a crown (Mt 27:29; Mk 15:17).

DEFINITION: To exist or multiply in great quantity; to become increasingly abundant in a state or action.
SENSES: 1. To multiply or become abundant (2 Cor 4:15; Phil 4:17).
2. To cause to increase or overflow in virtues and love (1 Thess 3:12; 2 Thess 1:3).

THAYER.pt: Existir ou multiplicar-se em grande quantidade; tornar-se cada vez mais abundante em um estado ou ação. 1. Multiplicar-se ou tornar-se abundante (2Co 4.15; Fp 4.17). | 2. Fazer crescer ou transbordar em virtudes e amor (1Ts 3.12; 2Ts 1.3).
THAYER.en: To exist or multiply in great quantity; to become increasingly abundant in a state or action. 1. To multiply or become abundant (2 Cor 4:15; Phil 4:17). | 2. To cause to increase or overflow in virtues and love (1 Thess 3:12; 2 Thess 1:3).

SEMANTIC_FIELD: Ethics and Morality, Greed and Exploitation
DEFINITION: Describes the act of taking undue advantage of someone, motivated by greed, selfishness, or exploitation in interpersonal relationships.
SENSES: 1. To take advantage of or exploit others financially and morally (2 Cor 2:11).

THAYER.pt: Descreve a ação de tirar vantagem indevida de alguém, motivada por ganância, egoísmo ou exploração nas relações interpessoais. 1. Tirar vantagem ou explorar financeiramente e moralmente a outrem (2Co 2:11).
THAYER.en: Describes the act of taking undue advantage of someone, motivated by greed, selfishness, or exploitation in interpersonal relationships. 1. To take advantage of or exploit others financially and morally (2 Cor 2:11).

DEFINITION: A person who insatiably desires to possess more than belongs to them, motivated by greed and avarice.
SENSES: 1. Someone greedy or dominated by avarice (1 Cor 5:11; Eph 5:5).

THAYER.pt: Pessoa que deseja insaciavelmente possuir mais do que lhe pertence, motivada pela ganância e avareza. 1. Alguém ganancioso ou dominado pela avareza (1Co 5.11; Ef 5.5).
THAYER.en: A person who insatiably desires to possess more than belongs to them, motivated by greed and avarice. 1. Someone greedy or dominated by avarice (1 Cor 5:11; Eph 5:5).

DEFINITION: The insatiable and selfish desire to possess more goods or advantages than is due.
SENSES: 1. Excessive greed and covetousness for material wealth (Lk 12:15).
2. A disposition to exploit others motivated by selfishness (Col 3:5).

THAYER.pt: O desejo insaciável e egoísta de possuir mais bens ou vantagens do que é devido. 1. Ganância excessiva e cobiça por riquezas materiais (Lc 12.15). | 2. Disposição para explorar os outros motivada pelo egoísmo (Cl 3.5).
THAYER.en: The insatiable and selfish desire to possess more goods or advantages than is due. 1. Excessive greed and covetousness for material wealth (Lk 12:15). | 2. A disposition to exploit others motivated by selfishness (Col 3:5).

DEFINITION: Designates the lateral part of the human torso.
SENSES: 1. The flank or side of the human body, specifically pierced on the cross (Jn 19:34).

THAYER.pt: Designa a parte lateral do tronco do corpo humano. 1. O flanco ou o costado do corpo humano, especificamente perfurado na cruz (Jo 19.34).
THAYER.en: Designates the lateral part of the human torso. 1. The flank or side of the human body, specifically pierced on the cross (Jn 19:34).

DEFINITION: Describes the act of moving over water in vessels propelled by oars or wind.
SENSES: 1. To travel by sea or navigate in vessels (Acts 21:3).

THAYER.pt: Descreve o ato de mover-se sobre a água em embarcações movidas a remo ou pelo vento. 1. Viajar por mar ou navegar em embarcações (At 21.3).
THAYER.en: Describes the act of moving over water in vessels propelled by oars or wind. 1. To travel by sea or navigate in vessels (Acts 21:3).

DEFINITION: Primarily indicates a physical blow or strike, which can extend to designate the resulting wound or a scourge/plague sent as a calamity or judgment.
SENSES: 1. A physical blow or strike delivered with an instrument or force (Acts 16:23).
2. A wound or contusion caused by an impact (Rev 13:14).
3. A severe calamity, plague, or punishment resulting in intense suffering (Rev 15:1).

THAYER.pt: Indica primariamente um golpe físico ou pancada desferida, podendo estender-se para designar a ferida resultante ou um flagelo/praga enviado como calamidade ou juízo. 1. Um golpe ou pancada física desferida com instrumento ou força (At 16.23). | 2. Uma ferida ou contusão causada por um impacto (Ap 13.14). | 3. Uma calamidade severa, praga ou castigo que resulta em intenso sofrimento (Ap 15.1).
THAYER.en: Primarily indicates a physical blow or strike, which can extend to designate the resulting wound or a scourge/plague sent as a calamity or judgment. 1. A physical blow or strike delivered with an instrument or force (Acts 16:23). | 2. A wound or contusion caused by an impact (Rev 13:14). | 3. A severe calamity, plague, or punishment resulting in intense suffering (Rev 15:1).

DEFINITION: A large quantity of countable elements, often referring to a large, unorganized crowd of people.
SENSES: 1. A large number or quantity of objects or living beings (Lk 5:6; Heb 11:12).
2. A crowded multitude of people or populace (Lk 6:17; Acts 14:1).

THAYER.pt: Uma grande quantidade de elementos contáveis, referindo-se frequentemente a uma grande multidão desorganizada de pessoas. 1. Um grande número ou quantidade de objetos ou seres vivos (Lc 5.6; Hb 11.12). | 2. Uma multidão aglomerada de pessoas ou povo (Lc 6.17; At 14.1).
THAYER.en: A large quantity of countable elements, often referring to a large, unorganized crowd of people. 1. A large number or quantity of objects or living beings (Lk 5:6; Heb 11:12). | 2. A crowded multitude of people or populace (Lk 6:17; Acts 14:1).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: πληθυνῶ, Aor: ἐπλήθυνα, Pass: πληθυνθήσομαι
DEFINITION: Indicates the act of causing to grow in quantity, number, or extent, occurring frequently in the NT in reference to the increase of disciples or divine blessings.
SENSES: 1. To cause to grow or become greater in number (2 Cor 9:10; Heb 6:14).
2. To multiply or grow in proportion (Acts 6:7; 12:24).

THAYER.pt: Indica o ato de fazer crescer em quantidade, número ou extensão, ocorrendo frequentemente no NT em referência ao aumento de discípulos ou bênçãos divinas. 1. Fazer crescer ou tornar maior em número (2Co 9.10; Hb 6.14). | 2. Multiplicar-se ou crescer em proporção (At 6.7; 12.24).
THAYER.en: Indicates the act of causing to grow in quantity, number, or extent, occurring frequently in the NT in reference to the increase of disciples or divine blessings. 1. To cause to grow or become greater in number (2 Cor 9:10; Heb 6:14). | 2. To multiply or grow in proportion (Acts 6:7; 12:24).

DEFINITION: Means to make full or completely fill a space or person. It is frequently used in the New Testament in passive constructions to describe people filled with the Holy Spirit or intense emotions.
SENSES: 1. To fill a space or object with something (Mt 22:10).
2. To be taken or filled by a spiritual force or feeling (Lk 4:28; Acts 2:4).

THAYER.pt: Significa tornar cheio ou preencher completamente um espaço ou pessoa. É frequentemente usado no Novo Testamento em conexões passivas para descrever pessoas tomadas pelo Espírito Santo ou por emoções intensas. 1. Encher um espaço ou objeto com algo (Mt 22.10). | 2. Ser tomado ou preenchido por uma força espiritual ou sentimento (Lc 4.28; At 2.4).
THAYER.en: Means to make full or completely fill a space or person. It is frequently used in the New Testament in passive constructions to describe people filled with the Holy Spirit or intense emotions. 1. To fill a space or object with something (Mt 22:10). | 2. To be taken or filled by a spiritual force or feeling (Lk 4:28; Acts 2:4).

DEFINITION: A quarrelsome individual, prone to physical violence or verbal aggression, unsuitable for Christian leadership.
SENSES: 1. A contentious person given to physical or verbal aggression (1 Tim 3:3; Tit 1:7).

THAYER.pt: Indivíduo briguento, propenso à violência física ou agressividade verbal, inadequado para a liderança cristã. 1. Pessoa contenciosa e dada a agressões físicas ou verbais (1Tm 3.3; Tt 1.7).
THAYER.en: A quarrelsome individual, prone to physical violence or verbal aggression, unsuitable for Christian leadership. 1. A contentious person given to physical or verbal aggression (1 Tim 3:3; Tit 1:7).

DEFINITION: Violent overflow of a body of water due to heavy rains or high tides, causing flooding.
SENSES: 1. A flood or impetuous torrent of a river (Lk 6:48).

THAYER.pt: Transbordo violento de um corpo d'água devido a fortes chuvas ou marés altas, causando inundação. 1. Inundação ou torrente impetuosa de rio (Lc 6.48).
THAYER.en: Violent overflow of a body of water due to heavy rains or high tides, causing flooding. 1. A flood or impetuous torrent of a river (Lk 6:48).

DEFINITION: An adversative particle or preposition used to introduce a reservation, contrast, or restriction to what has been said.
SENSES: 1. Contrast or adversative: but, however, yet (Mt 11:22; Lk 22:22).
2. Preposition with genitive: except, besides (Acts 20:23).

THAYER.pt: Partícula adversativa ou preposição usada para introduzir uma ressalva, contraste ou restrição ao que foi dito. 1. Contraste ou adversativa: mas, porém, contudo (Mt 11.22; Lc 22.22). | 2. Preposição com genitivo: exceto, além de (At 20.23).
THAYER.en: An adversative particle or preposition used to introduce a reservation, contrast, or restriction to what has been said. 1. Contrast or adversative: but, however, yet (Mt 11:22; Lk 22:22). | 2. Preposition with genitive: except, besides (Acts 20:23).

DEFINITION: Describes something that contains everything it can hold, being completely filled, replete, or without any lack.
SENSES: 1. Replete or full of something, whether literally or spiritually (Lk 4:1; Jn 1:14).
2. Complete, total, with nothing lacking (Mk 4:28; 2 Jn 8).

THAYER.pt: Descreve algo que contém tudo o que pode reter, estando completamente preenchido, repleto ou sem nenhuma falta. 1. Repleto ou cheio de algo, seja literal ou espiritualmente (Lc 4.1; Jo 1.14). | 2. Completo, total, sem nada faltar (Mc 4.28; 2Jo 8).
THAYER.en: Describes something that contains everything it can hold, being completely filled, replete, or without any lack. 1. Replete or full of something, whether literally or spiritually (Lk 4:1; Jn 1:14). | 2. Complete, total, with nothing lacking (Mk 4:28; 2 Jn 8).

DEFINITION: Means to carry out something completely or to persuade someone thoroughly, bringing full conviction and certainty.
SENSES: 1. To fulfill entirely a task, duty, or ministry (2 Tim 4:5).
