2. To be fully convinced or assured of a truth (Rom 4:21; 14:5).

THAYER.pt: Significa realizar algo por completo ou persuadir alguém de forma cabal, trazendo plena convicção e certeza. 1. Cumprir integralmente uma tarefa, dever ou ministério (2Tm 4.5). | 2. Estar plenamente convencido ou assegurado de uma verdade (Rm 4.21; 14.5).
THAYER.en: Means to carry out something completely or to persuade someone thoroughly, bringing full conviction and certainty. 1. To fulfill entirely a task, duty, or ministry (2 Tim 4:5). | 2. To be fully convinced or assured of a truth (Rom 4:21; 14:5).

DEFINITION: A state of full conviction and without doubts regarding a divine truth or promise.
SENSES: 1. Full assurance and unshakable conviction (1 Thess 1:5; Col 2:2; Heb 6:11).

THAYER.pt: Estado de convicção plena e sem dúvidas sobre uma verdade ou promessa divina. 1. Plena certeza e convicção inabalável (1Ts 1.5; Cl 2.2; Hb 6.11).
THAYER.en: A state of full conviction and without doubts regarding a divine truth or promise. 1. Full assurance and unshakable conviction (1 Thess 1:5; Col 2:2; Heb 6:11).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: πληρώσω, Aor: ἐπλήρωσα, Perf: πεπλήρωκα, Pass: πεπλήρωμαι
DEFINITION: To fill to the brim a material receptacle or spatial area; to bring a mission, a set time, or a prophetic promise to its expected consummation and full reality.
SENSES: 1. To fill completely a receptacle or physical enclosure (Mt 13:48; Jn 12:3; Acts 2:2).
2. To fulfill prophecies, scriptures, or Old Testament covenants (Mt 1:22; 5:17; Lk 24:44).
3. To complete fully a period, calling, virtue, or ethical duty (Acts 12:25; Rom 13:8; Col 4:17).

THAYER.pt: Encher até a borda um recipiente material ou espaço espacial; levar uma missão, tempo determinado ou promessa profética à sua consumação esperada e plena realidade. 1. Encher completamente um receptáculo ou recinto físico (Mt 13.48; Jo 12.3; At 2.2). | 2. Cumprir profecias, escrituras ou alianças do Antigo Testamento (Mt 1.22; 5.17; Lc 24.44). | 3. Completar plenamente um período, chamado, virtude ou dever ético (At 12.25; Rm 13.8; Cl 4.17).
THAYER.en: To fill to the brim a material receptacle or spatial area; to bring a mission, a set time, or a prophetic promise to its expected consummation and full reality. 1. To fill completely a receptacle or physical enclosure (Mt 13:48; Jn 12:3; Acts 2:2). | 2. To fulfill prophecies, scriptures, or Old Testament covenants (Mt 1:22; 5:17; Lk 24:44). | 3. To complete fully a period, calling, virtue, or ethical duty (Acts 12:25; Rom 13:8; Col 4:17).

DEFINITION: Designates that which fills a space, the content of a receptacle, or the totality and completeness of a number, period, or state.
SENSES: 1. The content of that which fills a space or receptacle (Mk 6:43; 1 Cor 10:26).
2. Fullness or complement that makes something complete.
3. The totality or complete number of a group (Rom 11:25).

THAYER.pt: Designa aquilo que enche um espaço, o conteúdo de um recipiente, ou a totalidade e completude de um número, período ou estado. 1. O conteúdo daquilo que preenche um espaço ou recipiente (Mc 6.43; 1Co 10.26). | 2. Plenitude ou complemento que torna algo completo. | 3. A totalidade ou número completo de um grupo (Rm 11.25).
THAYER.en: Designates that which fills a space, the content of a receptacle, or the totality and completeness of a number, period, or state. 1. The content of that which fills a space or receptacle (Mk 6:43; 1 Cor 10:26). | 2. Fullness or complement that makes something complete. | 3. The totality or complete number of a group (Rom 11:25).

DEFINITION: Originally an adverb indicating spatial proximity ('near', 'close by'), it evolved into a noun designating a 'neighbor', encompassing moral and social obligations toward others.
SENSES: 1. In a spatial sense, being located in a nearby or neighboring place (John 4:5).
2. As a noun (ὁ πλησίον), it refers to one's neighbor, a member of the community, or a fellow human in need of love and care (Matt 5:43; Luke 10:27).

THAYER.pt: Originalmente um advérbio que indica proximidade espacial («perto», «junto»), passou a funcionar como substantivo para designar o «próximo» ou o «vizinho», abrangendo as obrigações morais e sociais para com os outros. 1. Em sentido espacial, estar localizado em um lugar próximo ou vizinho (Jo 4.5). | 2. Como substantivo (ὁ πλησίον), refere-se ao próximo, ao membro da comunidade ou ao semelhante que necessita de amor e cuidado (Mt 5.43; Lc 10.27).
THAYER.en: Originally an adverb indicating spatial proximity ('near', 'close by'), it evolved into a noun designating a 'neighbor', encompassing moral and social obligations toward others. 1. In a spatial sense, being located in a nearby or neighboring place (John 4:5). | 2. As a noun (ὁ πλησίον), it refers to one's neighbor, a member of the community, or a fellow human in need of love and care (Matt 5:43; Luke 10:27).

DEFINITION: The process or state of full satisfaction of bodily and material needs, appetites, or desires.
SENSES: 1. Full satisfaction or indulgence of the appetites of the flesh (Col 2:23).

THAYER.pt: O processo ou estado de plena satisfação de necessidades, apetites ou desejos corporais e materiais. 1. Satisfação plena ou indulgência dos apetites da carne (Cl 2.23).
THAYER.en: The process or state of full satisfaction of bodily and material needs, appetites, or desires. 1. Full satisfaction or indulgence of the appetites of the flesh (Col 2:23).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Impf: ἔπλησσον, Fut: πλήξει, Aor: ἔπληξεν
DEFINITION: Describes the action of delivering a blow with physical force or the violent impact of natural elements.
SENSES: 1. To wound or strike with force, such as the impact upon celestial bodies (Rev 8:12).

THAYER.pt: Descreve a ação de desferir um golpe com força física ou o impacto violento de elementos da natureza. 1. Ferir ou golpear com força, como o impacto sobre corpos celestes (Ap 8.12).
THAYER.en: Describes the action of delivering a blow with physical force or the violent impact of natural elements. 1. To wound or strike with force, such as the impact upon celestial bodies (Rev 8:12).

DEFINITION: A diminutive form of πλοῖον, designating a small-sized vessel, such as a fishing boat used on the Sea of Galilee.
SENSES: 1. A small boat or skiff used for crossings and fishing (Mark 3:9; John 21:8).

THAYER.pt: Forma diminutiva de πλοῖον, designando uma embarcação de pequeno porte, como um barco de pesca usado no mar da Galileia. 1. Um barco pequeno ou skiff usado para travessias e pesca (Mc 3:9; Jo 21:8).
THAYER.en: A diminutive form of πλοῖον, designating a small-sized vessel, such as a fishing boat used on the Sea of Galilee. 1. A small boat or skiff used for crossings and fishing (Mark 3:9; John 21:8).

DEFINITION: Designates any type of vessel, from small fishing boats used on the Sea of Galilee to large ships for deep-sea navigation.
SENSES: 1. A large ship for maritime navigation (Acts 20:13).
2. A small vessel or fishing boat, common on the lakes of Palestine (Matt 9:1).

THAYER.pt: Designa qualquer tipo de embarcação, desde pequenos barcos de pesca utilizados no Mar da Galileia até navios de grande porte para navegação em alto-mar. 1. Navio de grande porte para navegação marítima (At 20.13). | 2. Pequena embarcação ou barco de pesca, comum nos lagos da Palestina (Mt 9.1).
THAYER.en: Designates any type of vessel, from small fishing boats used on the Sea of Galilee to large ships for deep-sea navigation. 1. A large ship for maritime navigation (Acts 20:13). | 2. A small vessel or fishing boat, common on the lakes of Palestine (Matt 9:1).

DEFINITION: The movement of a vessel through water, referring to a journey by sea.
SENSES: 1. A journey by ship or navigation (Acts 21:7; Acts 27:9).

THAYER.pt: O movimento de uma embarcação através da água, referindo-se a uma viagem pelo mar. 1. Viagem por navio ou navegação (At 21.7; At 27.9).
THAYER.en: The movement of a vessel through water, referring to a journey by sea. 1. A journey by ship or navigation (Acts 21:7; Acts 27:9).

DEFINITION: Describes someone who possesses a large quantity of material goods or financial resources, or something that overflows in spiritual and material abundance.
SENSES: 1. Fortunate with an abundance of earthly goods, rich (Matt 27:57).
2. Fully supplied or abundant in spiritual qualities (Eph 2:4; Jas 2:5).

THAYER.pt: Descreve alguém que possui grande quantidade de bens materiais ou recursos financeiros, ou algo que transborda em abundância espiritual e material. 1. Afortunado com abundância de bens terrenos, rico (Mt 27.57). | 2. Plenamente suprido ou abundante em qualidades espirituais (Ef 2.4; Tg 2.5).
THAYER.en: Describes someone who possesses a large quantity of material goods or financial resources, or something that overflows in spiritual and material abundance. 1. Fortunate with an abundance of earthly goods, rich (Matt 27:57). | 2. Fully supplied or abundant in spiritual qualities (Eph 2:4; Jas 2:5).

DEFINITION: Indicates an action performed with great generosity, plenty, or wealth of resources.
SENSES: 1. In a rich, abundant, and generous manner (Col 3:16; Titus 3:6).

THAYER.pt: Indica uma ação realizada com grande generosidade, fartura ou riqueza de recursos. 1. De maneira rica, abundante e generosa (Cl 3.16; Tt 3.6).
THAYER.en: Indicates an action performed with great generosity, plenty, or wealth of resources. 1. In a rich, abundant, and generous manner (Col 3:16; Titus 3:6).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: πλουτήσει, Aor: ἐπλούτησα, Perf: πεπλούτηκα
SHORT_GLOSS: to be rich, to become rich
DEFINITION: Describes the state of possessing an abundance of material goods or being cumulatively supplied with riches, both literal and spiritual.
SENSES: 1. To possess great opulence or to become rich (Rev 18:15).
2. To be richly supplied or to be abundant in spiritual values (Luke 12:21; 1 Tim 6:18).
USAGE: to be rich, to become rich

THAYER.pt: Descreve o estado de possuir abundância de bens materiais ou de estar cumulativamente suprido de riquezas, tanto literais quanto espirituais. 1. Possuir grande opulência ou tornar-se rico (Ap 18.15). | 2. Estar ricamente suprido ou ser abundante em valores espirituais (Lc 12.21; 1Tm 6.18).
THAYER.en: Describes the state of possessing an abundance of material goods or being cumulatively supplied with riches, both literal and spiritual. 1. To possess great opulence or to become rich (Rev 18:15). | 2. To be richly supplied or to be abundant in spiritual values (Luke 12:21; 1 Tim 6:18).

DEFINITION: To make someone rich in material goods or, figuratively, to grant an abundance of spiritual riches.
SENSES: 1. To enrich or grant spiritual abundance (1 Cor 1:5; 2 Cor 6:10).

THAYER.pt: Tornar alguém rico em bens materiais ou, figuradamente, conceder abundância de riquezas espirituais. 1. Enriquecer ou conceder abundância espiritual (1Co 1.5; 2Co 6.10).
THAYER.en: To make someone rich in material goods or, figuratively, to grant an abundance of spiritual riches. 1. To enrich or grant spiritual abundance (1 Cor 1:5; 2 Cor 6:10).

DEFINITION: Describes an abundance of material goods or resources, frequently used in the New Testament in a figurative and spiritual sense to denote inexhaustible divine grace and generosity.
SENSES: 1. Abundance of material goods, earthly wealth (2 Cor 8:2).
2. Fullness, abundant supply, or spiritual wealth (Rom 9:23; Eph 1:7).

THAYER.pt: Descreve uma abundância de bens materiais ou recursos, sendo frequentemente empregado no Novo Testamento em sentido figurado e espiritual para denotar a inexaurível graça e generosidade divina. 1. Abundância de bens materiais, riqueza terrena (2Co 8.2). | 2. Plenitude, suprimento abundante ou riqueza espiritual (Rm 9.23; Ef 1.7).
THAYER.en: Describes an abundance of material goods or resources, frequently used in the New Testament in a figurative and spiritual sense to denote inexhaustible divine grace and generosity. 1. Abundance of material goods, earthly wealth (2 Cor 8:2). | 2. Fullness, abundant supply, or spiritual wealth (Rom 9:23; Eph 1:7).

DEFINITION: To wash objects (such as nets or clothes), distinguished from the act of washing parts of the body.
SENSES: 1. To wash objects or garments (Luke 5:2; Rev 7:14).

THAYER.pt: Lavar objetos (como redes ou roupas), distinguindo-se do ato de lavar partes do corpo. 1. Lavar objetos ou vestimentas (Lc 5.2; Ap 7.14).
THAYER.en: To wash objects (such as nets or clothes), distinguished from the act of washing parts of the body. 1. To wash objects or garments (Luke 5:2; Rev 7:14).

DEFINITION: A breath of air in motion, the immaterial principle of life that animates beings, the third person of the Trinity, or incorporeal spiritual beings.
SENSES: 1. The Holy Spirit of God, the enabler and sanctifier (Matt 3:16; Rom 8:16).
2. The inner immaterial human dimension; soul, conscience, spiritual mind (Matt 26:41; 1 Cor 2:11).
3. An incorporeal spiritual entity, good or evil; angel, demon (Matt 8:16; Heb 1:14).

THAYER.pt: Sopro de ar em movimento, o princípio imaterial de vida que anima os seres, a terceira pessoa da Trindade ou seres espirituais incorpóreos. 1. O Espírito Santo de Deus, capacitador e santificador (Mt 3.16; Rm 8.16). | 2. A dimensão imaterial interior humana; alma, consciência, mente espiritual (Mt 26.41; 1Co 2.11). | 3. Entidade espiritual incorpórea boa ou maligna; anjo, demônio (Mt 8.16; Hb 1.14).
THAYER.en: A breath of air in motion, the immaterial principle of life that animates beings, the third person of the Trinity, or incorporeal spiritual beings. 1. The Holy Spirit of God, the enabler and sanctifier (Matt 3:16; Rom 8:16). | 2. The inner immaterial human dimension; soul, conscience, spiritual mind (Matt 26:41; 1 Cor 2:11). | 3. An incorporeal spiritual entity, good or evil; angel, demon (Matt 8:16; Heb 1:14).

DEFINITION: Belonging or related to the Spirit of God, or to the spiritual nature of the regenerated human being.
SENSES: 1. Related to the Holy Spirit or originated by Him (1 Cor 2:15; Eph 6:12).

THAYER.pt: Pertencente ou relacionado ao Espírito de Deus, ou à natureza espiritual do ser humano regenerado. 1. Relacionado ao Espírito Santo ou originado por Ele (1Co 2.15; Ef 6.12).
THAYER.en: Belonging or related to the Spirit of God, or to the spiritual nature of the regenerated human being. 1. Related to the Holy Spirit or originated by Him (1 Cor 2:15; Eph 6:12).

DEFINITION: In a spiritual manner, guided by the Spirit of God, or expressing truths through symbols and figures.
SENSES: 1. In a spiritual way, discerned or operated by the divine Spirit (1 Cor 2:14).
2. In a figurative or symbolic sense, beyond the literal (Rev 11:8).

THAYER.pt: De maneira espiritual, guiada pelo Espírito de Deus, ou expressando verdades por meio de símbolos e figuras. 1. De modo espiritual, discernido ou operado pelo Espírito divino (1Co 2.14). | 2. Em sentido figurado ou simbólico, além do literal (Ap 11.8).
THAYER.en: In a spiritual manner, guided by the Spirit of God, or expressing truths through symbols and figures. 1. In a spiritual way, discerned or operated by the divine Spirit (1 Cor 2:14). | 2. In a figurative or symbolic sense, beyond the literal (Rev 11:8).

DEFINITION: To move with a certain speed like atmospheric air, describing the action of the wind.
SENSES: 1. To blow, referring to the wind (Matt 7:25; John 3:8).

THAYER.pt: Movimentar-se com certa rapidez como o ar atmosférico, descrevendo a ação do vento. 1. Soprar, referindo-se ao vento (Mt 7:25; Jo 3:8).
THAYER.en: To move with a certain speed like atmospheric air, describing the action of the wind. 1. To blow, referring to the wind (Matt 7:25; John 3:8).

DEFINITION: To apply pressure around the neck to cause death or suffocation, or to stifle the growth of plants.
SENSES: 1. To strangle or choke someone (Matt 18:28).
2. To stifle or choke plants through the growth of thorns (Matt 13:7).

THAYER.pt: Aplicar pressão ao redor do pescoço para causar morte ou sufocamento, ou sufocar o crescimento de plantas. 1. Estrangular ou sufocar alguém (Mt 18.28); | 2. Abafar ou sufocar plantas pelo crescimento de espinhos (Mt 13.7).
THAYER.en: To apply pressure around the neck to cause death or suffocation, or to stifle the growth of plants. 1. To strangle or choke someone (Matt 18:28). | 2. To stifle or choke plants through the growth of thorns (Matt 13:7).

DEFINITION: Refers to animals killed by strangulation or suffocation, without the blood having been drained, the consumption of which was avoided by Jews.
SENSES: 1. A choked or strangled animal whose blood was not drained (Acts 15:20; Acts 21:25).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se a animais mortos por estrangulamento ou sufocamento, sem que o sangue tenha sido drenado, cujo consumo era evitado pelos judeus. 1. Animal sufocado ou estrangulado cujo sangue não foi drenado (At 15.20; At 21.25).
THAYER.en: Refers to animals killed by strangulation or suffocation, without the blood having been drained, the consumption of which was avoided by Jews. 1. A choked or strangled animal whose blood was not drained (Acts 15:20; Acts 21:25).

DEFINITION: A gentle movement of air or the physiological act of breathing, associated with life granted by God.
SENSES: 1. A rapid movement of air, a gust, or a breath of wind (Acts 2:2).
2. The act of breathing or breath as a principle of life (Acts 17:25).

THAYER.pt: Movimento de ar brando ou o ato fisiológico de respirar, associado à vida concedida por Deus. 1. Movimento rápido de ar, rajada ou sopro de vento (At 2.2). | 2. O ato de respirar ou a respiração como princípio de vida (At 17.25).
THAYER.en: A gentle movement of air or the physiological act of breathing, associated with life granted by God. 1. A rapid movement of air, a gust, or a breath of wind (Acts 2:2). | 2. The act of breathing or breath as a principle of life (Acts 17:25).

DEFINITION: Describes a garment or tunic that is long enough to cover the feet, worn in contexts of honor or priestly service.
SENSES: 1. Referring to a long tunic reaching to the feet, worn by the figure like the Son of Man in the apocalyptic vision (Rev 1:13).

THAYER.pt: Descreve uma vestimenta ou túnica comprida que se estende até cobrir os pés, usada em contextos de honra ou sacerdotal. 1. Referente a uma longa túnica que chega até os pés, usada pela figura semelhante ao Filho do Homem na visão apocalíptica (Ap 1.13).
THAYER.en: Describes a garment or tunic that is long enough to cover the feet, worn in contexts of honor or priestly service. 1. Referring to a long tunic reaching to the feet, worn by the figure like the Son of Man in the apocalyptic vision (Rev 1:13).

DEFINITION: An interrogative pronoun or adverb that inquires about the physical origin, causal source, or the mode of realization of something.
SENSES: 1. Indication of local provenance: from where? (Mt 15:33).
2. Indication of causal or personal origin: from what source? by whom? (Mt 13:27, 54).
3. Indication of motive or manner: for what reason? how? (Lk 1:43; Jn 6:5).

THAYER.pt: Pronome ou advérbio interrogativo que inquire sobre a origem física, a fonte causal ou o modo de realização de algo. 1. Indicação de procedência local: de onde? (Mt 15:33). | 2. Indicação de origem causal ou pessoal: de que fonte? por quem? (Mt 13:27,54). | 3. Indicação de motivo ou maneira: por que razão? como? (Lc 1:43; Jo 6:5).
THAYER.en: An interrogative pronoun or adverb that inquires about the physical origin, causal source, or the mode of realization of something. 1. Indication of local provenance: from where? (Mt 15:33). | 2. Indication of causal or personal origin: from what source? by whom? (Mt 13:27, 54). | 3. Indication of motive or manner: for what reason? how? (Lk 1:43; Jn 6:5).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: regular contract verb in -έω. Fut: ποιήσω, Aor: ἐποίησα, Perf: πεποίηκα
DEFINITION: A general term for productive, creative, or behavioral activity, encompassing everything from material manufacturing to the moral practice of actions.
SENSES: 1. To create, constitute, form, or produce something material or natural (Mt 7:17; Acts 17:24).
2. To practice, execute, or commit acts, works, or ethical precepts (Mt 7:21; Jn 8:39).
3. To cause an effect, perform miracles, or bring about a new condition (Jn 2:11; Eph 2:15).

THAYER.pt: Termo geral para atividade produtiva, criativa ou comportamental, englobando desde a fabricação material até a prática moral de ações. 1. Criar, constituir, formar ou produzir algo material ou natural (Mt 7.17; At 17.24). | 2. Praticar, executar ou cometer atos, obras ou preceitos éticos (Mt 7.21; Jo 8.39). | 3. Causar um efeito, realizar milagres ou suscitar uma nova condição (Jo 2.11; Ef 2.15).
THAYER.en: A general term for productive, creative, or behavioral activity, encompassing everything from material manufacturing to the moral practice of actions. 1. To create, constitute, form, or produce something material or natural (Mt 7:17; Acts 17:24). | 2. To practice, execute, or commit acts, works, or ethical precepts (Mt 7:21; Jn 8:39). | 3. To cause an effect, perform miracles, or bring about a new condition (Jn 2:11; Eph 2:15).

DEFINITION: That which has been manufactured, created, or produced, highlighting the skill and purpose of the artisan.
SENSES: 1. A work created by God, referring to the universe or the new human creation (Rom 1:20; Eph 2:10).

THAYER.pt: Aquilo que foi fabricado, criado ou produzido, destacando a habilidade e o propósito do artífice. 1. Obra criada por Deus, referindo-se ao universo ou à nova criação humana (Rm 1.20; Ef 2.10).
THAYER.en: That which has been manufactured, created, or produced, highlighting the skill and purpose of the artisan. 1. A work created by God, referring to the universe or the new human creation (Rom 1:20; Eph 2:10).

DEFINITION: Indicates the act of performing, doing, or putting into practice an activity, or the product resulting from that execution.
SENSES: 1. The practical realization or fulfillment of commandments and actions (Jas 1:25).

THAYER.pt: Indica o ato de realizar, fazer ou colocar em prática uma atividade ou o produto resultante dessa execução. 1. A realização prática ou cumprimento de mandamentos e ações (Tg 1.25).
THAYER.en: Indicates the act of performing, doing, or putting into practice an activity, or the product resulting from that execution. 1. The practical realization or fulfillment of commandments and actions (Jas 1:25).

DEFINITION: One who performs a work, manufactures something, produces literary texts, or puts precepts into practice.
SENSES: 1. Creator, author, or literary poet (Acts 17:28).
2. One who actively practices a law or commandment (Jas 1:22; Rom 2:13).

THAYER.pt: Aquele que realiza uma obra, fabrica algo, produz textos literários ou coloca preceitos em prática. 1. Criador, autor ou poeta literário (At 17.28). | 2. Aquele que pratica ativamente uma lei ou mandamento (Tg 1.22; Rm 2.13).
THAYER.en: One who performs a work, manufactures something, produces literary texts, or puts precepts into practice. 1. Creator, author, or literary poet (Acts 17:28). | 2. One who actively practices a law or commandment (Jas 1:22; Rom 2:13).

DEFINITION: That which manifests in many different forms, varieties, or colors.
SENSES: 1. Existing in great variety or diversity (Mt 4:24; 1 Pet 4:10).

THAYER.pt: Que se manifesta em muitas formas diferentes, variedades ou cores. 1. Que existe em grande variedade ou diversidade (Mt 4.24; 1Pe 4.10).
THAYER.en: That which manifests in many different forms, varieties, or colors. 1. Existing in great variety or diversity (Mt 4:24; 1 Pet 4:10).

DEFINITION: To act as a shepherd of sheep, caring for, feeding, and guiding, with metaphorical applications for leadership and government.
SENSES: 1. To tend or care for flocks (Lk 17:7; 1 Cor 9:7).
2. To govern, lead, and protect the people of God (Jn 21:16; Acts 20:28; 1 Pet 5:2).

THAYER.pt: Atuar como pastor de ovelhas, cuidando, alimentando e guiando, com aplicações metafóricas para liderança e governo. 1. Apascentar ou cuidar de rebanhos (Lc 17.7; 1Co 9.7). | 2. Governar, liderar e proteger o povo de Deus (Jo 21.16; At 20.28; 1Pe 5.2).
THAYER.en: To act as a shepherd of sheep, caring for, feeding, and guiding, with metaphorical applications for leadership and government. 1. To tend or care for flocks (Lk 17:7; 1 Cor 9:7). | 2. To govern, lead, and protect the people of God (Jn 21:16; Acts 20:28; 1 Pet 5:2).

DEFINITION: Literally one who cares for, guides, and protects flocks of sheep. In the NT, it is applied to Christ as the great Shepherd and, by extension, to spiritual leaders tasked with caring for the church.
SENSES: 1. Shepherd of sheep or animals (Mt 26:31; Jn 10:11).
2. Spiritual leader responsible for the care and guidance of the Christian community (Eph 4:11).

THAYER.pt: Literalmente aquele que cuida, guia e protege rebanhos de ovelhas. No NT, é aplicado a Cristo como o grande Pastor e, por extensão, aos líderes espirituais encarregados de cuidar da igreja. 1. Pastor de ovelhas ou animais (Mt 26.31; Jo 10.11). | 2. Líder espiritual responsável pelo cuidado e orientação da comunidade cristã (Ef 4.11).
THAYER.en: Literally one who cares for, guides, and protects flocks of sheep. In the NT, it is applied to Christ as the great Shepherd and, by extension, to spiritual leaders tasked with caring for the church. 1. Shepherd of sheep or animals (Mt 26:31; Jn 10:11). | 2. Spiritual leader responsible for the care and guidance of the Christian community (Eph 4:11).

DEFINITION: Refers to a flock of animals, specifically sheep or goats, under the care of a shepherd.
SENSES: 1. Literal flock of animals kept by shepherds (Lk 2:8).
2. The people of God as a flock under the guard of the Good Shepherd (Jn 10:16).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se a um rebanho de animais, especificamente ovelhas ou cabras, sob os cuidados de um pastor. 1. Rebanho literal de animais mantido por pastores (Lc 2:8); | 2. O povo de Deus como rebanho sob a guarda do Bom Pastor (Jo 10:16).
THAYER.en: Refers to a flock of animals, specifically sheep or goats, under the care of a shepherd. 1. Literal flock of animals kept by shepherds (Lk 2:8). | 2. The people of God as a flock under the guard of the Good Shepherd (Jn 10:16).

DEFINITION: A flock of animals, frequently used in the New Testament as a metaphor for the community of Christ's disciples under pastoral leadership.
SENSES: 1. The Christian community viewed as the spiritual flock of God (1 Pet 5:3; Lk 12:32).

THAYER.pt: Um rebanho de animais, frequentemente empregado no Novo Testamento como metáfora para a comunidade dos discípulos de Cristo sob liderança pastoral. 1. A comunidade cristã vista como o rebanho espiritual de Deus (1Pe 5:3; Lc 12:32).
THAYER.en: A flock of animals, frequently used in the New Testament as a metaphor for the community of Christ's disciples under pastoral leadership. 1. The Christian community viewed as the spiritual flock of God (1 Pet 5:3; Lk 12:32).

DEFINITION: An interrogative pronoun used to inquire about the class, type, quality, or identity of something.
SENSES: 1. Inquiring about class or quality: of what type?, what kind? (1 Pet 1:11).
2. Asking which among several elements: which?, what? (Mt 22:36).

THAYER.pt: Pronome interrogativo usado para indagar sobre a classe, o tipo, a qualidade ou a identidade de algo. 1. Indagar sobre a classe ou qualidade: de que tipo?, qual espécie? (1Pe 1.11). | 2. Perguntar qual entre vários elementos: qual?, o quê? (Mt 22.36).
THAYER.en: An interrogative pronoun used to inquire about the class, type, quality, or identity of something. 1. Inquiring about class or quality: of what type?, what kind? (1 Pet 1:11). | 2. Asking which among several elements: which?, what? (Mt 22:36).

DEFINITION: To engage in military operations, armed combat, or prolonged hostile conflict.
SENSES: 1. To wage war or fight militarily (Rev 17:14).
2. To be in hostile opposition, in a figurative sense (Gal 1:13).

THAYER.pt: Envolver-se em operações militares, combate armado ou conflito hostil prolongado. 1. Travar guerra ou combater militarmente (Ap 17:14). | 2. Estar em oposição hostil, em sentido figurado (Gl 1:13).
THAYER.en: To engage in military operations, armed combat, or prolonged hostile conflict. 1. To wage war or fight militarily (Rev 17:14). | 2. To be in hostile opposition, in a figurative sense (Gal 1:13).

DEFINITION: Refers to armed conflicts, large-scale wars, or specific battles, and is also used metaphorically to describe contentions and spiritual or interpersonal struggles.
SENSES: 1. Military conflict of large proportion, war (Mt 24:6).
2. Particular battle or combat (1 Cor 14:8).
3. Conflict, contention, or enmity (Jas 4:1).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se a conflitos armados, guerras em larga escala ou batalhas específicas, além de ser usado metaforicamente para descrever contendas e lutas espirituais ou interpessoais. 1. Conflito militar de grande proporção, guerra (Mt 24.6). | 2. Batalha ou combate particular (1Co 14.8). | 3. Conflito, contenda ou inimizade (Tg 4.1).
THAYER.en: Refers to armed conflicts, large-scale wars, or specific battles, and is also used metaphorically to describe contentions and spiritual or interpersonal struggles. 1. Military conflict of large proportion, war (Mt 24:6). | 2. Particular battle or combat (1 Cor 14:8). | 3. Conflict, contention, or enmity (Jas 4:1).

DEFINITION: An urban population center endowed with walls, political autonomy, or regional prominence, distinguished from smaller open villages. In biblical vocabulary, it applies to earthly capitals, their inhabitants, and the eschatological dwelling of the redeemed people.
SENSES: 1. City or organized urban center (Mt 5:14; Lk 2:4).
2. The inhabitants of a municipality as a whole (Mt 8:34; Mk 1:33).
3. The eschatological and celestial metropolis of God (New Jerusalem) (Heb 11:10; Rev 21:2).

THAYER.pt: Centro urbano populacional dotado de muralhas, autonomia política ou destaque regional, distinguindo-se das aldeias menores abertas. No vocabulário bíblico, aplica-se a capitais terrestres, aos seus habitantes e à habitação escatológica do povo remido. 1. Cidade ou centro urbano organizado (Mt 5.14; Lc 2.4). | 2. Os habitantes de um município como um todo (Mt 8.34; Mc 1.33). | 3. A metrópole escatológica e celestial de Deus (Nova Jerusalém) (Hb 11.10; Ap 21.2).
THAYER.en: An urban population center endowed with walls, political autonomy, or regional prominence, distinguished from smaller open villages. In biblical vocabulary, it applies to earthly capitals, their inhabitants, and the eschatological dwelling of the redeemed people. 1. City or organized urban center (Mt 5:14; Lk 2:4). | 2. The inhabitants of a municipality as a whole (Mt 8:34; Mk 1:33). | 3. The eschatological and celestial metropolis of God (New Jerusalem) (Heb 11:10; Rev 21:2).

DEFINITION: A public official or municipal magistrate responsible for administration and order in a Greek city.
SENSES: 1. Municipal civil authority or magistrate (Acts 17:8).

THAYER.pt: Oficial público ou magistrado municipal responsável pela administração e ordem em uma cidade grega. 1. Autoridade ou magistrado civil municipal (At 17.8).
THAYER.en: A public official or municipal magistrate responsible for administration and order in a Greek city. 1. Municipal civil authority or magistrate (Acts 17:8).

DEFINITION: The status of a citizen with their political rights, or the corporate way of life regulated by the laws of a society.
SENSES: 1. The right to be a citizen of a political community (Acts 22:28).
2. Community of citizens or the state/political community (Eph 2:12).

THAYER.pt: O status de cidadão com seus direitos políticos, ou o modo de vida corporativo regulado por leis de uma sociedade. 1. O direito de ser cidadão de uma comunidade política (At 22.28). | 2. Comunidade de cidadãos ou o estado/comunidade política (Ef 2.12).
THAYER.en: The status of a citizen with their political rights, or the corporate way of life regulated by the laws of a society. 1. The right to be a citizen of a political community (Acts 22:28). | 2. Community of citizens or the state/political community (Eph 2:12).

DEFINITION: Refers to the sphere of civic loyalty, political community, or the condition of belonging to a State whose celestial capital determines the believer's values.
SENSES: 1. Heavenly citizenship or the colony of the citizens of the Kingdom of heaven whose definitive homeland is above (Phil 3:20).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se à esfera de lealdade cívica, comunidade política ou à condição de pertencer a um Estado cuja capital celeste determina os valores do crente. 1. A cidadania celestial ou a colônia dos cidadãos do Reino dos céus cuja pátria definitiva é o alto (Fp 3.20).
THAYER.en: Refers to the sphere of civic loyalty, political community, or the condition of belonging to a State whose celestial capital determines the believer's values. 1. Heavenly citizenship or the colony of the citizens of the Kingdom of heaven whose definitive homeland is above (Phil 3:20).

DEFINITION: To conduct one's life in a dignified and responsible manner, fulfilling obligations as a citizen of a community or of the Kingdom.
SENSES: 1. To conduct one's life in accordance with moral or civil principles (Acts 23:1; Phil 1:27).

THAYER.pt: Conduzir a vida de maneira digna e responsável, cumprindo as obrigações como cidadão de uma comunidade ou do Reino. 1. Conduzir a própria vida de acordo com princípios morais ou civis (At 23.1; Fp 1.27).
THAYER.en: To conduct one's life in a dignified and responsible manner, fulfilling obligations as a citizen of a community or of the Kingdom. 1. To conduct one's life in accordance with moral or civil principles (Acts 23:1; Phil 1:27).

DEFINITION: A person who possesses full civil rights as a member of a city, state, or sociopolitical community.
SENSES: 1. Citizen of a specific locality (Acts 21:39; Lk 15:15).
2. Compatriot or fellow citizen (Heb 8:11).

THAYER.pt: Pessoa que possui plenos direitos civis como membro de uma cidade, estado ou comunidade sociopolítica. 1. Cidadão de uma localidade específica (At 21.39; Lc 15.15). | 2. Compatriota ou concidadão (Hb 8.11).
THAYER.en: A person who possesses full civil rights as a member of a city, state, or sociopolitical community. 1. Citizen of a specific locality (Acts 21:39; Lk 15:15). | 2. Compatriot or fellow citizen (Heb 8:11).

DEFINITION: Indicates the repeated occurrence of an event or action at multiple moments throughout time.
SENSES: 1. In a frequent manner or on many occasions, frequently (Mt 17:15; Mk 5:4).

THAYER.pt: Indica a ocorrência repetida de um evento ou ação em múltiplos momentos ao longo do tempo. 1. De maneira frequente ou em muitas ocasiões, frequentemente (Mt 17.15; Mc 5.4).
THAYER.en: Indicates the repeated occurrence of an event or action at multiple moments throughout time. 1. In a frequent manner or on many occasions, frequently (Mt 17:15; Mk 5:4).

DEFINITION: Signifies a greatly multiplied quantity, exceeding by far what was expected or invested.
SENSES: 1. A retribution or reward much greater in quantity than what was sacrificed for the sake of the Kingdom of God (Mt 19:29; Lk 18:30).

THAYER.pt: Significa uma quantidade grandemente multiplicada, excedendo em muito o esperado ou o que foi investido. 1. Retribuição ou recompensa muito maior em quantidade do que o que foi sacrificado por causa do Reino de Deus (Mt 19.29; Lc 18.30).
THAYER.en: Signifies a greatly multiplied quantity, exceeding by far what was expected or invested. 1. A retribution or reward much greater in quantity than what was sacrificed for the sake of the Kingdom of God (Mt 19:29; Lk 18:30).

DEFINITION: Describes the excessive and tedious use of words, especially in mechanical prayers or empty speeches.
SENSES: 1. Excessive speaking or vain repetition in prayers, assuming one is heard by the quantity of words (Mt 6:7).

THAYER.pt: Descreve o uso excessivo e enfadonho de palavras, especialmente em orações mecânicas ou discursos vazios. 1. O falar excessivo ou vã repetição em orações que supõe ser ouvido pela quantidade de palavras (Mt 6.7).
THAYER.en: Describes the excessive and tedious use of words, especially in mechanical prayers or empty speeches. 1. Excessive speaking or vain repetition in prayers, assuming one is heard by the quantity of words (Mt 6:7).

SHORT_GLOSS: in many ways, in many parts
DEFINITION: A term denoting the diversity of modes or successive stages through which God communicated His revelation in the past.
SENSES: 1. In a fragmented manner or in many distinct parts and occasions through the prophets (Heb 1:1).
USAGE: in many ways, in many parts

THAYER.pt: Termo que denota a diversidade de modos ou estágios sucessivos pelos quais Deus comunicou a sua revelação no passado. 1. De maneira fragmentada ou em muitas partes e ocasiões distintas através dos profetas (Hb 1.1).
THAYER.en: A term denoting the diversity of modes or successive stages through which God communicated His revelation in the past. 1. In a fragmented manner or in many distinct parts and occasions through the prophets (Heb 1:1).

DEFINITION: Describes something extremely varied, complex, or possessing multiple facets and shades of wisdom.
SENSES: 1. The infinitely manifold wisdom of God manifested through the Church (Eph 3:10).

THAYER.pt: Descreve algo extremamente variado, complexo ou que possui múltiplas facetas e matizes de sabedoria. 1. A sabedoria infinitamente multifacetada de Deus manifestada por meio da Igreja (Ef 3.10).
THAYER.en: Describes something extremely varied, complex, or possessing multiple facets and shades of wisdom. 1. The infinitely manifold wisdom of God manifested through the Church (Eph 3:10).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Irregular mixed declension. Gen: πολλοῦ, πολλῆς, πολλοῦ
DEFINITION: Adjective qualifying beings or substances in a high degree, expressing multiplicity in countable number or great extent in continuous quantity.
SENSES: 1. In the plural: numerous, copious, in great countable quantity (Matt 7:22; Mark 12:41).
2. In the singular: of great amount, extensive, abundant in degree and measure (Matt 13:5; Eph 2:4).
3. Neuter use as an adverb (πολύ / πολλά): greatly, frequently, much (Mark 5:23; 1 Cor 16:19).

THAYER.pt: Adjetivo que qualifica seres ou substâncias em alto grau, expressando multiplicidade em número contável ou grande extensão em quantidade contínua. 1. No plural: numeroso, copioso, em grande quantidade contável (Mt 7.22; Mc 12.41). | 2. No singular: de grande monta, extenso, abundante em grau e medida (Mt 13.5; Ef 2.4). | 3. Uso neutro como advérbio (πολύ / πολλά): grandemente, frequentemente, muito (Mc 5.23; 1Co 16.19).
THAYER.en: Adjective qualifying beings or substances in a high degree, expressing multiplicity in countable number or great extent in continuous quantity. 1. In the plural: numerous, copious, in great countable quantity (Matt 7:22; Mark 12:41). | 2. In the singular: of great amount, extensive, abundant in degree and measure (Matt 13:5; Eph 2:4). | 3. Neuter use as an adverb (πολύ / πολλά): greatly, frequently, much (Mark 5:23; 1 Cor 16:19).

DEFINITION: Quality of one who possesses deep depths of mercy, demonstrating intense compassion and tender affection.
SENSES: 1. Attribute describing the immense compassion and mercy of the Lord toward believers (Jas 5:11).

THAYER.pt: Qualidade daquele que possui entranhas de misericórdia profundas, demonstrando intensa compaixão e terna afeição. 1. Atributo que descreve a imensa compaixão e misericórdia do Senhor para com os crentes (Tg 5.11).
THAYER.en: Quality of one who possesses deep depths of mercy, demonstrating intense compassion and tender affection. 1. Attribute describing the immense compassion and mercy of the Lord toward believers (Jas 5:11).

DEFINITION: Possessing high monetary value or an elevated price; precious and luxurious.
SENSES: 1. Very costly or of high financial value (Mark 14:3; 1 Tim 2:2).

THAYER.pt: Que possui alto valor monetário ou preço elevado; precioso e luxuoso. 1. Muito custoso ou de alto valor financeiro (Mc 14.3; 1Tm 2.2).
THAYER.en: Possessing high monetary value or an elevated price; precious and luxurious. 1. Very costly or of high financial value (Mark 14:3; 1 Tim 2:2).

SHORT_GLOSS: precious, very costly, of great value
DEFINITION: Having a very high price or inestimable market value.
SENSES: 1. Very precious or of high commercial value (Matt 13:46).
USAGE: precious, very costly, of great value

THAYER.pt: Que tem um preço altíssimo ou valor inestimável no mercado. 1. Muito precioso ou de alto valor comercial (Mt 13.46).
THAYER.en: Having a very high price or inestimable market value. 1. Very precious or of high commercial value (Matt 13:46).

SHORT_GLOSS: in various ways, in many forms
DEFINITION: Indicates the variety of methods, forms, and styles used in transmitting a divine message throughout history.
SENSES: 1. In many and varied ways by which God spoke to the fathers through the prophets (Heb 1:1).
USAGE: in various ways, in many forms

THAYER.pt: Indica a variedade de métodos, formas e estilos utilizados na transmissão de uma mensagem divina ao longo da história. 1. De muitas e variadas maneiras pelas quais Deus falou aos pais pelos profetas (Hb 1.1).
THAYER.en: Indicates the variety of methods, forms, and styles used in transmitting a divine message throughout history. 1. In many and varied ways by which God spoke to the fathers through the prophets (Heb 1:1).

DEFINITION: Any liquid suitable for consumption that quenches thirst or is used in rituals.
SENSES: 1. Liquid consumed to quench thirst or in ritual contexts (Heb 9:10).

THAYER.pt: Qualquer líquido próprio para consumo que satisfaça a sede ou seja usado em rituais. 1. Líquido consumido para saciar a sede ou em contextos rituais (Hb 9.10).
THAYER.en: Any liquid suitable for consumption that quenches thirst or is used in rituals. 1. Liquid consumed to quench thirst or in ritual contexts (Heb 9:10).

DEFINITION: The state or condition of moral depravity, characterized by the absence of righteousness and an inclination toward evil.
SENSES: 1. Intrinsic wickedness or perverse disposition (Matt 22:18; Eph 6:12).

THAYER.pt: O estado ou condição de depravação moral, caracterizado pela ausência de retidão e inclinação para o mal. 1. Maldade intrínseca ou disposição perversa (Mt 22:18; Ef 6:12).
THAYER.en: The state or condition of moral depravity, characterized by the absence of righteousness and an inclination toward evil. 1. Intrinsic wickedness or perverse disposition (Matt 22:18; Eph 6:12).

DEFINITION: Qualifies what is morally depraved, harmful, malevolent, or of very poor quality; in the masculine used substantively, it refers emphatically to the Devil.
SENSES: 1. Morally corrupt, malicious, or iniquitous (Matt 12:35; Luke 11:13; Col 1:21).
2. The Evil One, personal designation of Satan (ὁ πονηρός) (Matt 13:19; Eph 6:16; 1 John 5:18).
3. Of poor quality, unfruitful, or physically harmful (Matt 7:17-18; Rev 16:2).

THAYER.pt: Qualifica o que é moralmente depravado, danoso, malévolo ou de péssima qualidade; no masculino substantivado, refere-se enfaticamente ao Diabo. 1. Moralmente corrupto, malicioso ou iníquo (Mt 12.35; Lk 11.13; Cl 1.21). | 2. O Maligno, designação pessoal de Satanás (ὁ πονηρός) (Mt 13.19; Ef 6.16; 1Jo 5.18). | 3. De má qualidade, infrutífero ou nocivo fisicamente (Mt 7.17-18; Ap 16.2).
THAYER.en: Qualifies what is morally depraved, harmful, malevolent, or of very poor quality; in the masculine used substantively, it refers emphatically to the Devil. 1. Morally corrupt, malicious, or iniquitous (Matt 12:35; Luke 11:13; Col 1:21). | 2. The Evil One, personal designation of Satan (ὁ πονηρός) (Matt 13:19; Eph 6:16; 1 John 5:18). | 3. Of poor quality, unfruitful, or physically harmful (Matt 7:17-18; Rev 16:2).

DEFINITION: Comparative form of the adjective qualifying someone or something as morally worse, more corrupted, or more perverse than another reference point.
SENSES: 1. Exhibiting a greater degree of wickedness or moral corruption.

THAYER.pt: Forma comparativa do adjetivo que qualifica algo ou alguém como moralmente pior, mais corrompido ou perverso do que outro ponto de referência. 1. Que exibe maior grau de maldade ou corrupção moral.
THAYER.en: Comparative form of the adjective qualifying someone or something as morally worse, more corrupted, or more perverse than another reference point. 1. Exhibiting a greater degree of wickedness or moral corruption.

DEFINITION: Designates both the strenuous effort associated with labor and deep physical pain and suffering.
SENSES: 1. Hard work or painful labor (Col 4:13).
2. Intense pain, suffering, and affliction (Rev 16:10; Rev 21:4).

THAYER.pt: Designa tanto o esforço extenuante associado ao trabalho quanto a dor física e o sofrimento profundo. 1. Trabalho árduo ou labor penoso (Cl 4.13). | 2. Dor intensa, sofrimento e aflição (Ap 16.10; Ap 21.4).
THAYER.en: Designates both the strenuous effort associated with labor and deep physical pain and suffering. 1. Hard work or painful labor (Col 4:13). | 2. Intense pain, suffering, and affliction (Rev 16:10; Rev 21:4).

DEFINITION: Gentilic adjective indicating someone's origin from the region of Pontus in Asia Minor.
SENSES: 1. Pertaining to Aquila, originating from the Roman province of Pontus (Acts 18:2).

THAYER.pt: Adjetivo gentílico que indica a origem de alguém procedente da região do Ponto, na Ásia Menor. 1. Relativo a Áquila, originário da província romana do Ponto (At 18.2).
THAYER.en: Gentilic adjective indicating someone's origin from the region of Pontus in Asia Minor. 1. Pertaining to Aquila, originating from the Roman province of Pontus (Acts 18:2).

DEFINITION: Roman family name used by Pontius Pilate, the Roman governor of Judea.
SENSES: 1. Pontius, praenomen of Pilate (Luke 3:1; Acts 4:27).

THAYER.pt: Nome de família romano utilizado por Pôncio Pilatos, o governador romano da Judeia. 1. Pôncio, prenome de Pilatos (Lc 3.1; At 4.27).
THAYER.en: Roman family name used by Pontius Pilate, the Roman governor of Judea. 1. Pontius, praenomen of Pilate (Luke 3:1; Acts 4:27).

DEFINITION: Region located in northeastern Asia Minor, bordered by the Black Sea, mentioned in the New Testament.
SENSES: 1. Region and Roman province in northeastern Asia Minor (Acts 2:9; 1 Pet 1:1).

THAYER.pt: Região localizada no nordeste da Ásia Menor, banhada pelo Mar Negro, mencionada no Novo Testamento. 1. Região e província romana no nordeste da Ásia Menor (At 2.9; 1Pe 1.1).
THAYER.en: Region located in northeastern Asia Minor, bordered by the Black Sea, mentioned in the New Testament. 1. Region and Roman province in northeastern Asia Minor (Acts 2:9; 1 Pet 1:1).

DEFINITION: Roman proper name, specifically the chief Roman official on the island of Malta at the time of Paul's shipwreck.
SENSES: 1. Chief Roman official on the island of Malta (Acts 28:7).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio romano, especificamente o principal oficial romano na ilha de Malta na época do naufrágio de Paulo. 1. Oficial romano principal na ilha de Malta (At 28.7).
THAYER.en: Roman proper name, specifically the chief Roman official on the island of Malta at the time of Paul's shipwreck. 1. Chief Roman official on the island of Malta (Acts 28:7).

DEFINITION: Planned movement or physical displacement over a considerable distance.
SENSES: 1. Journey or trip made from one place to another (Luke 13:22; Jas 1:11).

THAYER.pt: Movimento planejado ou deslocamento físico ao longo de uma distância considerável. 1. Viagem ou percurso realizado de um lugar a outro (Lc 13.22; Tg 1.11).
THAYER.en: Planned movement or physical displacement over a considerable distance. 1. Journey or trip made from one place to another (Luke 13:22; Jas 1:11).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Deponent. Fut: πορεύσομαι, Aor: ἐπορεύθην, Perf: πεπόρευμαι
DEFINITION: Indicates displacement in space from one point to another, frequently with the idea of a journey or continuous travel. Also used in an ethical and metaphorical sense to refer to personal conduct and way of living.
SENSES: 1. Move physically, go, travel, depart on a journey (Matt 2:20; Luke 4:42).
2. Conduct oneself, live according to a certain moral or religious standard (Luke 1:6; 1 Pet 4:3).
3. Euphemism for dying or departing this life (Luke 22:22).

THAYER.pt: Indica deslocamento no espaço de um ponto a outro, frequentemente com ideia de jornada ou viagem contínua. Emprega-se também em sentido ético e metafórico para referir-se à conduta pessoal e ao modo de viver. 1. Deslocar-se fisicamente, ir, viajar, partir em jornada (Mt 2.20; Lc 4.42). | 2. Conduzir-se, viver segundo determinado padrão moral ou religioso (Lc 1.6; 1Pe 4.3). | 3. Eufemismo para morrer ou partir desta vida (Lc 22.22).
THAYER.en: Indicates displacement in space from one point to another, frequently with the idea of a journey or continuous travel. Also used in an ethical and metaphorical sense to refer to personal conduct and way of living. 1. Move physically, go, travel, depart on a journey (Matt 2:20; Luke 4:42). | 2. Conduct oneself, live according to a certain moral or religious standard (Luke 1:6; 1 Pet 4:3). | 3. Euphemism for dying or departing this life (Luke 22:22).

DEFINITION: To attack with violence with the intent of causing total destruction, pillaging, or devastating.
SENSES: 1. Devastate or violently persecute a community or church (Acts 9:21; Gal 1:13).

THAYER.pt: Atacar com violência com a intenção de causar destruição total, pilhar ou devastar. 1. Devastar ou perseguir violentamente uma comunidade ou igreja (At 9.21; Gl 1.13).
THAYER.en: To attack with violence with the intent of causing total destruction, pillaging, or devastating. 1. Devastate or violently persecute a community or church (Acts 9:21; Gal 1:13).

DEFINITION: Means or activity aimed at obtaining financial profit or material advantage.
SENSES: 1. Means of obtaining profit or material gain (1 Tim 6:5).

THAYER.pt: Meio ou atividade voltada para a obtenção de lucro financeiro ou vantagem material. 1. Means de obtenção de lucro ou ganho material (1Tm 6.5).
THAYER.en: Means or activity aimed at obtaining financial profit or material advantage. 1. Means of obtaining profit or material gain (1 Tim 6:5).

DEFINITION: Roman family name (gens Porcia) associated with the Roman procurator who succeeded Felix in Judea.
SENSES: 1. Porcius Festus, the Roman governor of Judea who succeeded Antonius Felix (Acts 24:27).

THAYER.pt: Nome de família romana (gens Porcia) associado ao procurador romano que sucedeu a Félix na Judeia. 1. Pórcio Festo, o governador romano da Judeia que sucedeu a Antônio Félix (At 24.27).
THAYER.en: Roman family name (gens Porcia) associated with the Roman procurator who succeeded Felix in Judea. 1. Porcius Festus, the Roman governor of Judea who succeeded Antonius Felix (Acts 24:27).

DEFINITION: Any practice of illicit sexual relations, outside of legitimate marriage, encompassing immorality and spiritual idolatry.
SENSES: 1. Illicit sexual relation or prostitution (1 Cor 6:18; Eph 5:3).
2. Figuratively, spiritual infidelity or idolatry (Rev 14:8; 19:2).

THAYER.pt: Qualquer prática de relação sexual ilícita, fora do casamento legítimo, abrangendo a imoralidade e a idolatria espiritual. 1. Relação sexual ilícita ou prostituição (1Co 6.18; Ef 5.3). | 2. Figuradamente, infidelidade espiritual ou idolatria (Ap 14.8; 19.2).
THAYER.en: Any practice of illicit sexual relations, outside of legitimate marriage, encompassing immorality and spiritual idolatry. 1. Illicit sexual relation or prostitution (1 Cor 6:18; Eph 5:3). | 2. Figuratively, spiritual infidelity or idolatry (Rev 14:8; 19:2).

DEFINITION: To practice sexual immorality, engage in illicit sexual relations or, in a figurative sense in prophetic writings, to commit idolatry and spiritual infidelity.
SENSES: 1. Practice sexual immorality or fornication (1 Cor 6:18; 10:8).
2. Commit idolatry or spiritual infidelity against God (Rev 17:2; 18:3).

THAYER.pt: Praticar imoralidade sexual, envolver-se em relações sexuais ilícitas ou, em sentido figurado nos escritos proféticos, cometer idolatria e infidelidade espiritual. 1. Praticar imoralidade sexual ou fornicação (1Co 6:18; 10:8). | 2. Cometer idolatria ou infidelidade espiritual contra Deus (Ap 17:2; 18:3).
THAYER.en: To practice sexual immorality, engage in illicit sexual relations or, in a figurative sense in prophetic writings, to commit idolatry and spiritual infidelity. 1. Practice sexual immorality or fornication (1 Cor 6:18; 10:8). | 2. Commit idolatry or spiritual infidelity against God (Rev 17:2; 18:3).

DEFINITION: Refers to a woman who engages in sexual acts in exchange for financial remuneration; also used figuratively for spiritual infidelity.
SENSES: 1. Woman who practices prostitution for payment (Luke 15:30; 1 Cor 6:15).
2. Apostate entity or system hostile to God (Rev 17:1, 15).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se a uma mulher que pratica atos sexuais em troca de remuneração financeira; também usado figuradamente para infidelidade espiritual. 1. Mulher que exerce prostituição por pagamento (Lc 15.30; 1Co 6.15). | 2. Entidade ou sistema apóstata hostil a Deus (Ap 17.1, 15).
THAYER.en: Refers to a woman who engages in sexual acts in exchange for financial remuneration; also used figuratively for spiritual infidelity. 1. Woman who practices prostitution for payment (Luke 15:30; 1 Cor 6:15). | 2. Apostate entity or system hostile to God (Rev 17:1, 15).

DEFINITION: Person who practices sexual immorality outside the boundaries of matrimony.
SENSES: 1. Individual who commits sexual sins or fornication (1 Cor 5:9; Rev 21:8).

THAYER.pt: Pessoa que pratica imoralidade sexual fora dos limites do matrimônio. 1. Indivíduo que comete pecados sexuais ou fornicação (1Co 5.9; Ap 21.8).
THAYER.en: Person who practices sexual immorality outside the boundaries of matrimony. 1. Individual who commits sexual sins or fornication (1 Cor 5:9; Rev 21:8).

DEFINITION: Indicates a position that is at a relatively great distance, either literally or figuratively.
SENSES: 1. In a distant or far-off place (Luke 14:32).
2. In a temporal or figurative sense, advanced (Luke 24:28).

THAYER.pt: Indica uma posição que se encontra a uma distância relativamente grande, seja em sentido literal ou figurado. 1. Em um lugar distante ou afastado (Lc 14.32). | 2. Em sentido temporal ou figurado, avançado (Lc 24.28).
THAYER.en: Indicates a position that is at a relatively great distance, either literally or figuratively. 1. In a distant or far-off place (Luke 14:32). | 2. In a temporal or figurative sense, advanced (Luke 24:28).

DEFINITION: Indicates a spatial or temporal position or perspective situated at a great distance.
SENSES: 1. At a considerable distance in space (Luke 17:12).
2. Metaphorically, at a great temporal distance (Heb 11:13).

THAYER.pt: Indica uma posição ou perspectiva espacial ou temporal situada a grande distância. 1. A uma distância considerável no espaço (Lc 17.12). | 2. Metaforicamente, a uma grande distância temporal (Hb 11.13).
THAYER.en: Indicates a spatial or temporal position or perspective situated at a great distance. 1. At a considerable distance in space (Luke 17:12). | 2. Metaphorically, at a great temporal distance (Heb 11:13).

DEFINITION: Comparative form indicating a location or movement at a greater distance.
SENSES: 1. At a greater distance or further ahead in space.

THAYER.pt: Forma de comparativo que indica uma localização ou movimento a uma distância maior. 1. A uma distância maior ou mais adiante no espaço.
THAYER.en: Comparative form indicating a location or movement at a greater distance. 1. At a greater distance or further ahead in space.

DEFINITION: Refers to the marine mollusk from which purple dye was extracted, as well as the fabrics and garments dyed with this noble color.
SENSES: 1. Fabric or garment of purple color, associated with royalty and wealth (Mark 15:17; Rev 18:12).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se ao molusco marinho do qual se extraía o corante púrpura, bem como aos tecidos e vestimentas tingidos com essa cor nobre. 1. Tecido ou vestimenta de cor púrpura, associada à realeza e riqueza (Mc 15.17; Ap 18.12).
THAYER.en: Refers to the marine mollusk from which purple dye was extracted, as well as the fabrics and garments dyed with this noble color. 1. Fabric or garment of purple color, associated with royalty and wealth (Mark 15:17; Rev 18:12).

DEFINITION: Describes the purple or dark-red color, frequently used to denote royal status or sumptuary.
SENSES: 1. Having the purple color (John 19:2; Rev 17:4).

THAYER.pt: Descreve a cor púrpura ou vermelho-escura, frequentemente usada para denotar status real ou suntuosidade. 1. Que tem a cor púrpura (Jo 19.2; Ap 17.4).
THAYER.en: Describes the purple or dark-red color, frequently used to denote royal status or sumptuary. 1. Having the purple color (John 19:2; Rev 17:4).

DEFINITION: Female merchant specializing in the sale of fabrics or clothes dyed with the valuable purple color.
SENSES: 1. Lydia, a merchant of purple fabrics from the city of Thyatira, residing in Philippi (Acts 16:14).

THAYER.pt: Mulher comerciante especializada na venda de tecidos ou roupas tingidas com a valiosa cor púrpura. 1. Lídia, comerciante de tecidos de púrpura da cidade de Tiatira, residente em Filipos (At 16.14).
THAYER.en: Female merchant specializing in the sale of fabrics or clothes dyed with the valuable purple color. 1. Lydia, a merchant of purple fabrics from the city of Thyatira, residing in Philippi (Acts 16:14).

DEFINITION: An interrogative or exclamatory adverb that questions or denotes the frequency of an event's occurrence.
SENSES: 1. How many times? or how frequently? (Mt 18:21; Mt 23:37).

THAYER.pt: Advérbio interrogativo ou exclamativo que questiona ou denota a frequência de ocorrência de um evento. 1. Quantas vezes? Ou quão frequentemente? (Mt 18.21; Mt 23.37).
THAYER.en: An interrogative or exclamatory adverb that questions or denotes the frequency of an event's occurrence. 1. How many times? or how frequently? (Mt 18:21; Mt 23:37).

DEFINITION: The act of consuming liquids or the beverage itself used to quench thirst.
SENSES: 1. The act of drinking (Rom 14:17);
2. That which is drunk, a beverage (Jn 6:55).

THAYER.pt: O ato de consumir líquidos ou a própria bebida utilizada para saciar a sede. 1. O ato de beber (Rm 14.17); | 2. Aquilo que se bebe, bebida (Jo 6.55).
THAYER.en: The act of consuming liquids or the beverage itself used to quench thirst. 1. The act of drinking (Rom 14:17); | 2. That which is drunk, a beverage (Jn 6:55).

DEFINITION: A correlative or interrogative pronoun that questions or emphasizes the exact quantity or magnitude of something.
SENSES: 1. Interrogative regarding quantity, 'how many?' or 'how much?' (Mt 15:34).
2. Exclamatory regarding degree or magnitude, 'how great!' or 'how much!' (Mt 12:12; 2 Cor 7:11).

THAYER.pt: Pronome correlativo ou interrogativo que questiona ou enfatiza a quantidade exata ou a magnitude de algo. 1. Interrogativo sobre a quantidade, 'quantos?' ou 'quanto?' (Mt 15.34). | 2. Exclamativo sobre o grau ou magnitude, 'quão grande!' ou 'quanto!' (Mt 12.12; 2Co 7.11).
THAYER.en: A correlative or interrogative pronoun that questions or emphasizes the exact quantity or magnitude of something. 1. Interrogative regarding quantity, 'how many?' or 'how much?' (Mt 15:34). | 2. Exclamatory regarding degree or magnitude, 'how great!' or 'how much!' (Mt 12:12; 2 Cor 7:11).

DEFINITION: A noun designating a body of running water that flows continuously and abundantly. In the New Testament, it appears in geographical narratives (such as the Jordan River) and in apocalyptic imagery.
SENSES: 1. A natural watercourse or river that flows continuously (Mt 3:6; Rev 8:10).

THAYER.pt: Substantivo que designa um corpo de água corrente que flui continuamente de forma abundante. No Novo Testamento, aparece em narrativas geográficas (como o rio Jordão) e em imagens apocalípticas. 1. Um curso de água natural ou rio que flui de maneira contínua (Mt 3.6; Ap 8.10).
THAYER.en: A noun designating a body of running water that flows continuously and abundantly. In the New Testament, it appears in geographical narratives (such as the Jordan River) and in apocalyptic imagery. 1. A natural watercourse or river that flows continuously (Mt 3:6; Rev 8:10).

DEFINITION: Describes something or someone violently carried, snatched away, or flooded by the force of a water current.
SENSES: 1. Referring to the woman (or symbol) about to be swallowed and swept away by the torrent of water expelled by the dragon (Rev 12:15).

THAYER.pt: Descreve algo ou alguém que é violentamente carregado, arrebatado ou inundado pela força de uma corrente de água. 1. Referente à mulher (ou símbolo) prestes a ser tragada e arrastada pela torrente de água expelida pelo dragão (Ap 12.15).
THAYER.en: Describes something or someone violently carried, snatched away, or flooded by the force of a water current. 1. Referring to the woman (or symbol) about to be swallowed and swept away by the torrent of water expelled by the dragon (Rev 12:15).

DEFINITION: An interrogative pronoun that inquires about the nature, quality, class, or origin of something or someone.
SENSES: 1. Of what kind or extraordinary type? (Mt 8:27; Lk 7:39).

THAYER.pt: Pronome interrogativo que indaga sobre a natureza, qualidade, classe ou procedência de algo ou alguém. 1. De que espécie ou tipo extraordinário? (Mt 8:27; Lc 7:39).
THAYER.en: An interrogative pronoun that inquires about the nature, quality, class, or origin of something or someone. 1. Of what kind or extraordinary type? (Mt 8:27; Lk 7:39).

DEFINITION: A particle indicating an indefinite moment in the past or a general circumstance in time.
SENSES: 1. At some time in the past, formerly, once (Eph 2:2; Tit 3:3).
2. On any occasion or at some time (Phil 4:10).

THAYER.pt: Partícula que indica um momento indefinido no passado ou uma circunstância geral no tempo. 1. Em algum momento do passado, outrora, antigamente (Ef 2.2; Tt 3.3). | 2. Em qualquer ocasião ou alguma vez (Fp 4.10).
THAYER.en: A particle indicating an indefinite moment in the past or a general circumstance in time. 1. At some time in the past, formerly, once (Eph 2:2; Tit 3:3). | 2. On any occasion or at some time (Phil 4:10).

DEFINITION: An interrogative or indefinite particle relating to a specific or indefinite point in time.
SENSES: 1. In direct or indirect questions, indicating the moment, when (Mt 24:3; Lk 17:20).
2. In an indefinite temporal sense, formerly or once (Eph 2:2).

THAYER.pt: Partícula interrogativa ou indefinida relativa a um ponto específico ou indefinido no tempo. 1. Em perguntas diretas ou indiretas, indicando o momento, quando (Mt 24.3; Lc 17.20). | 2. Em sentido temporal indefinido, antigamente ou outrora (Ef 2.2).
THAYER.en: An interrogative or indefinite particle relating to a specific or indefinite point in time. 1. In direct or indirect questions, indicating the moment, when (Mt 24:3; Lk 17:20). | 2. In an indefinite temporal sense, formerly or once (Eph 2:2).

DEFINITION: An interrogative particle used to introduce a disjunctive question or a conditional inquiry between two alternatives.
SENSES: 1. Used to inquire about the veracity or origin of a teaching or doctrine (Jn 7:17).

THAYER.pt: Partícula interrogativa usada para introduzir uma pergunta disjuntiva ou um questionamento condicional entre duas alternativas. 1. Usado para indagar sobre a veracidade ou origem de um ensinamento ou doutrina (Jo 7.17).
THAYER.en: An interrogative particle used to introduce a disjunctive question or a conditional inquiry between two alternatives. 1. Used to inquire about the veracity or origin of a teaching or doctrine (Jn 7:17).

DEFINITION: A container used for drinking liquids, also used metaphorically to designate destiny, suffering, or wrath.
SENSES: 1. A container or cup for drinking liquids (Mk 9:41; 1 Cor 11:25).
2. A metaphorical symbol of a designated portion of suffering or judgment (Mt 26:39; Jn 18:11).

THAYER.pt: Recipiente usado para beber líquidos, empregado também metaforicamente para designar o destino, o sofrimento ou a ira. 1. Recipiente ou cálice para beber líquidos (Mc 9.41; 1Co 11.25). | 2. Símbolo metafórico de uma porção designada de sofrimento ou julgamento (Mt 26.39; Jo 18.11).
THAYER.en: A container used for drinking liquids, also used metaphorically to designate destiny, suffering, or wrath. 1. A container or cup for drinking liquids (Mk 9:41; 1 Cor 11:25). | 2. A metaphorical symbol of a designated portion of suffering or judgment (Mt 26:39; Jn 18:11).

SHORT_GLOSS: to give to drink, to water
DEFINITION: To provide liquid so that people, animals, or plants can drink or be irrigated.
SENSES: 1. To give drink to human beings as an act of hospitality or necessity (Mt 25:35).
2. To provide water for animals or to irrigate plants and crops (Lk 13:15; 1 Cor 3:6).
USAGE: to give to drink, to water

THAYER.pt: Fornecer líquido para que pessoas, animais ou plantas possam beber ou ser irrigados. 1. Dar de beber a seres humanos como ato de hospitalidade ou necessidade (Mt 25.35). | 2. Fornecer água para animais ou irrigar plantas e lavouras (Lc 13.15; 1Co 3.6).
THAYER.en: To provide liquid so that people, animals, or plants can drink or be irrigated. 1. To give drink to human beings as an act of hospitality or necessity (Mt 25:35). | 2. To provide water for animals or to irrigate plants and crops (Lk 13:15; 1 Cor 3:6).

DEFINITION: An important port city located in the Gulf of Naples, Italy, where merchant ships frequently docked.
SENSES: 1. An Italian coastal city where the apostle Paul disembarked on his way to Rome (Acts 28:13).

THAYER.pt: Importante cidade portuária situada no golfo de Nápoles, na Itália, onde navios mercantes frequentemente aportavam. 1. Cidade costeira italiana onde o apóstolo Paulo desembarcou a caminho de Roma (At 28.13).
THAYER.en: An important port city located in the Gulf of Naples, Italy, where merchant ships frequently docked. 1. An Italian coastal city where the apostle Paul disembarked on his way to Rome (Acts 28:13).

DEFINITION: A social gathering focused on the excessive ingestion of alcoholic beverages, commonly associated with moral excesses and debauchery.
SENSES: 1. Banquets of drunkenness and excesses condemned by Christian ethics (1 Pet 4:3).

THAYER.pt: Reunião social voltada para a ingestão excessiva de bebidas alcoólicas, comumente associada a excessos morais e libertinagem. 1. Banquetes de bebedice e excessos condenados pela ética cristã (1Pe 4.3).
THAYER.en: A social gathering focused on the excessive ingestion of alcoholic beverages, commonly associated with moral excesses and debauchery. 1. Banquets of drunkenness and excesses condemned by Christian ethics (1 Pet 4:3).

DEFINITION: Indicates an uncertain or imprecise position in space, or serves as a marker of numerical approximation.
SENSES: 1. In some indefinite place, where (Heb 2:6).
2. Approximately, about (Rom 4:19).

THAYER.pt: Indica uma posição incerta ou imprecisa no espaço, ou serve como marcador de aproximação numérica. 1. Em algum lugar indefinido, onde (Hb 2:6). | 2. Aproximadamente, cerca de (Rm 4:19).
THAYER.en: Indicates an uncertain or imprecise position in space, or serves as a marker of numerical approximation. 1. In some indefinite place, where (Heb 2:6). | 2. Approximately, about (Rom 4:19).

DEFINITION: An adverb used primarily in direct or indirect questions to inquire about the whereabouts, destination, or spatial reference point of something or someone.
SENSES: 1. Direct interrogation regarding place: where? in what place? (Mt 2:2; Jn 1:38; 9:12).
2. Interrogation regarding destination or direction: whither? where to? (Jn 3:8; 8:14; Heb 11:8).
3. Challenging rhetorical use, implying complete absence (1 Cor 1:20; 1 Pet 4:18).

THAYER.pt: Advérbio utilizado primariamente em perguntas diretas ou indiretas a fim de indagar sobre o paradeiro, destino ou ponto de referência espacial de algo ou alguém. 1. Interrogação direta sobre lugar: onde? em que lugar? (Mt 2.2; Jo 1.38; 9.12). | 2. Interrogação sobre destino ou direção: para onde? aonde? (Jo 3.8; 8.14; Hb 11.8). | 3. Emprego retórico desafiador, insinuando ausência completa (1Co 1.20; 1Pe 4.18).
THAYER.en: An adverb used primarily in direct or indirect questions to inquire about the whereabouts, destination, or spatial reference point of something or someone. 1. Direct interrogation regarding place: where? in what place? (Mt 2:2; Jn 1:38; 9:12). | 2. Interrogation regarding destination or direction: whither? where to? (Jn 3:8; 8:14; Heb 11:8). | 3. Challenging rhetorical use, implying complete absence (1 Cor 1:20; 1 Pet 4:18).

DEFINITION: The proper name of a Roman Christian who sent greetings in the pastoral epistles.
SENSES: 1. A Roman Christian mentioned in the final greetings to Timothy (2 Tim 4:21).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio de um cristão romano que enviava saudações nas epístolas pastorais. 1. Cristão romano mencionado nas saudações finais a Timóteo (2Tm 4.21).
THAYER.en: The proper name of a Roman Christian who sent greetings in the pastoral epistles. 1. A Roman Christian mentioned in the final greetings to Timothy (2 Tim 4:21).

DEFINITION: The lower terminal part of the human or animal locomotor limb. It is frequently used in contexts of walking, the humble posture of discipleship (at someone's feet), or the cosmic triumph of submission at Christ's feet.
SENSES: 1. The physical foot of people or animals (Mt 4:6; Lk 7:38; Jn 13:5).
2. In figurative expressions of submission, reverence, or learning (Lk 10:39; 1 Cor 15:25; Heb 2:8).

THAYER.pt: Parte terminal inferior do membro locomotor humano ou animal. Emprega-se com frequência em contextos de caminhada, postura humilde de discipulado (aos pés de alguém) ou triunfo cósmico de submissão aos pés de Cristo. 1. Pé físico de pessoas ou animais (Mt 4.6; Lc 7.38; Jo 13.5). | 2. Em expressões figuradas de submissão, reverência ou aprendizado (Lc 10.39; 1Co 15.25; Hb 2.8).
THAYER.en: The lower terminal part of the human or animal locomotor limb. It is frequently used in contexts of walking, the humble posture of discipleship (at someone's feet), or the cosmic triumph of submission at Christ's feet. 1. The physical foot of people or animals (Mt 4:6; Lk 7:38; Jn 13:5). | 2. In figurative expressions of submission, reverence, or learning (Lk 10:39; 1 Cor 15:25; Heb 2:8).

DEFINITION: That which is done or happens; an event, undertaking, business, or legal process.
SENSES: 1. An act, occurrence, or fact that has taken place (Lk 1:1; Acts 5:4).
2. An occupation, task, or business (Rom 16:2).
3. A legal dispute or judicial process (1 Cor 6:1).

THAYER.pt: Aquilo que é feito ou acontece; um evento, empreendimento, negócio ou processo legal. 1. Um ato, acontecimento ou fato ocorrido (Lc 1.1; At 5.4). | 2. Uma ocupação, tarefa ou negócio (Rm 16.2). | 3. Uma contenda judicial ou processo legal (1Co 6.1).
THAYER.en: That which is done or happens; an event, undertaking, business, or legal process. 1. An act, occurrence, or fact that has taken place (Lk 1:1; Acts 5:4). | 2. An occupation, task, or business (Rom 16:2). | 3. A legal dispute or judicial process (1 Cor 6:1).

DEFINITION: Refers to commercial enterprises, secular business, or daily activities that occupy one's attention.
SENSES: 1. Affairs, businesses, or secular occupations that may distract a soldier of Christ (2 Tim 2:4).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se a empreendimentos comerciais, negócios seculares ou atividades cotidianas que ocupam a atenção de alguém. 1. Assuntos, negócios ou ocupações seculares que podem distrair o soldado de Cristo (2Tm 2.4).
THAYER.en: Refers to commercial enterprises, secular business, or daily activities that occupy one's attention. 1. Affairs, businesses, or secular occupations that may distract a soldier of Christ (2 Tim 2:4).

DEFINITION: To engage in commercial transactions, trading with another's capital for profit or return.
SENSES: 1. To engage in trade and investment with the minas entrusted by the master (Lk 19:13).

THAYER.pt: Ocupar-se em transações comerciais, negociar com capital alheio visando lucro ou rendimento. 1. Envolver-se em transações de comércio e investimento com as minas confiadas pelo senhor (Lc 19.13).
THAYER.en: To engage in commercial transactions, trading with another's capital for profit or return. 1. To engage in trade and investment with the minas entrusted by the master (Lk 19:13).

DEFINITION: A term designating the official residence of a Roman governor or the camp and barracks of the Praetorian Guard.
SENSES: 1. The official residence of the Roman governor (Mt 27:27; Acts 23:35).
2. The Praetorian Guard or the soldiers' barracks in Rome (Phil 1:13).

THAYER.pt: Termo que designava a residência oficial de um governador romano ou o acampamento e quartel da guarda pretoriana. 1. A residência oficial do governador romano (Mt 27:27; At 23:35). | 2. A guarda pretoriana ou o quartel dos soldados em Roma (Fp 1:13).
THAYER.en: A term designating the official residence of a Roman governor or the camp and barracks of the Praetorian Guard. 1. The official residence of the Roman governor (Mt 27:27; Acts 23:35). | 2. The Praetorian Guard or the soldiers' barracks in Rome (Phil 1:13).

DEFINITION: A judicial official charged with executing a judge's orders or collecting debts and fines.
SENSES: 1. A court officer, collector, or executor of legal penalties (Lk 12:58).

THAYER.pt: Funcionário judicial encarregado de executar as ordens de um juiz ou cobrar dívidas e multas. 1. Oficial de justiça, cobrador ou executor de penalidades legais (Lc 12.58).
THAYER.en: A judicial official charged with executing a judge's orders or collecting debts and fines. 1. A court officer, collector, or executor of legal penalties (Lk 12:58).

DEFINITION: Denotes a continuous activity, function, conduct, or the concrete realization of an act or undertaking.
SENSES: 1. Function, task, or assigned duty held (Rom 12:4).
2. Act, action, or work performed by someone (Mt 16:27; Acts 19:18).

THAYER.pt: Denota uma atividade contínua, função, conduta ou a realização concreta de um ato ou empreendimento. 1. Função, tarefa ou atribuição mantida (Rm 12.4). | 2. Ato, ação ou obra realizada por alguém (Mt 16.27; At 19.18).
THAYER.en: Denotes a continuous activity, function, conduct, or the concrete realization of an act or undertaking. 1. Function, task, or assigned duty held (Rom 12:4). | 2. Act, action, or work performed by someone (Mt 16:27; Acts 19:18).

DEFINITION: Describes a gentle disposition of spirit, which is neither aggressive nor demanding, demonstrating mildness and emotional control.
SENSES: 1. One who possesses a meek, humble, and non-violent attitude.

THAYER.pt: Descreve uma disposição de espírito gentil, que não é agressiva nem reivindicativa, demonstrando brandura e controle emocional. 1. Que possui uma atitude mansa, humilde e não violenta.
THAYER.en: Describes a gentle disposition of spirit, which is neither aggressive nor demanding, demonstrating mildness and emotional control. 1. One who possesses a meek, humble, and non-violent attitude.

DEFINITION: The quality of being meek and gentle; a Christian virtue that combines strength with moderation and the absence of pride.
SENSES: 1. The virtue of meekness and gentleness in conduct.

THAYER.pt: A qualidade de ser manso e brando; uma virtude cristã que combina força com moderação e ausência de soberba. 1. A virtude da mansidão e da suavidade no trato.
THAYER.en: The quality of being meek and gentle; a Christian virtue that combines strength with moderation and the absence of pride. 1. The virtue of meekness and gentleness in conduct.

DEFINITION: People arranged in orderly groups or regular rows, resembling garden beds.
SENSES: 1. Organized groups or orderly rows of people (Mk 6:40).

THAYER.pt: Pessoas dispostas em grupos ordenados ou fileiras regulares, assemelhando-se a canteiros de hortas. 1. Grupos organizados ou fileiras ordenadas de pessoas (Mc 6.40).
THAYER.en: People arranged in orderly groups or regular rows, resembling garden beds. 1. Organized groups or orderly rows of people (Mk 6:40).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Future: πράξω, Aorist: ἔπραξα, Perfect: πέπραχα
SHORT_GLOSS: to practice, to do, to commit
DEFINITION: Indicates the persistent execution or performance of an action, act, or habitual behavior.
SENSES: 1. To perform, fulfill, or carry out a task or act (Acts 5:35).
2. To practice actions, behave, or act in a certain way (Acts 3:17; Rom 2:25).
USAGE: to practice, to do, to commit

THAYER.pt: Indica a execução persistente ou realização de uma ação, ato ou comportamento habitual. 1. Realizar, cumprir ou efetuar uma tarefa ou ato (At 5.35). | 2. Praticar ações, comportar-se ou agir de determinada forma (At 3.17; Rm 2.25).
THAYER.en: Indicates the persistent execution or performance of an action, act, or habitual behavior. 1. To perform, fulfill, or carry out a task or act (Acts 5:35). | 2. To practice actions, behave, or act in a certain way (Acts 3:17; Rom 2:25).

DEFINITION: Characterizes a person who is not dominated by self-importance, expressing meekness, gentleness, and consideration for others.
SENSES: 1. One who is meek and gentle, without arrogance (Mt 5:5; 21:5).

THAYER.pt: Caracteriza uma pessoa que não é dominada pela autoimportância, expressando mansidão, gentileza e consideração pelos outros. 1. Aquele que é manso e gentil, sem arrogância (Mt 5.5; 21.5).
THAYER.en: Characterizes a person who is not dominated by self-importance, expressing meekness, gentleness, and consideration for others. 1. One who is meek and gentle, without arrogance (Mt 5:5; 21:5).

DEFINITION: A moral quality characterized by the absence of presumption, manifesting in courtesy, consideration, and mildness in dealing with others.
SENSES: 1. An attitude of meekness and gentleness of spirit (1 Cor 4:21; Jas 3:13).

THAYER.pt: Qualidade moral caracterizada pela ausência de presunção, manifestando-se em cortesia, consideração e brandura no trato com os outros. 1. Atitude de mansidão e brandura de espírito (1Co 4.21; Tg 3.13).
THAYER.en: A moral quality characterized by the absence of presumption, manifesting in courtesy, consideration, and mildness in dealing with others. 1. An attitude of meekness and gentleness of spirit (1 Cor 4:21; Jas 3:13).

DEFINITION: Describes that which is convenient, appropriate, or compatible with a given standard, office, or character.
SENSES: 1. To be convenient, suitable, or appropriate (Heb 7:26; Eph 5:3).

THAYER.pt: Descreve aquilo que é conveniente, apropriado ou compatível com uma determinada norma, cargo ou caráter. 1. Ser conveniente, adequado ou apropriado (Hb 7:26; Ef 5:3).
THAYER.en: Describes that which is convenient, appropriate, or compatible with a given standard, office, or character. 1. To be convenient, suitable, or appropriate (Heb 7:26; Eph 5:3).

DEFINITION: A group of ambassadors or the office of representing a sovereign authority before another.
SENSES: 1. A delegation of ambassadors sent on a diplomatic mission (Lk 14:32).

THAYER.pt: Grupo de embaixadores ou o ofício de representar uma autoridade soberana perante outra. 1. Delegação de embaixadores enviada em missão diplomática (Lc 14.32).
THAYER.en: A group of ambassadors or the office of representing a sovereign authority before another. 1. A delegation of ambassadors sent on a diplomatic mission (Lk 14:32).

DEFINITION: To act as an official representative or ambassador of a governing authority.
SENSES: 1. To exercise the role of an ambassador or official representative (2 Cor 5:20; Eph 6:20).

THAYER.pt: Atuar como representante oficial ou embaixador de uma autoridade governante. 1. Exercer o papel de embaixador ou representante oficial (2Co 5.20; Ef 6.20).
