THAYER.en: To act as an official representative or ambassador of a governing authority. 1. To exercise the role of an ambassador or official representative (2 Cor 5:20; Eph 6:20).

DEFINITION: A council or assembly composed of mature leaders, elders, or religious authorities.
SENSES: 1. The council of elders or religious leaders (Lk 22:66; Acts 22:5).

THAYER.pt: Um conselho ou assembleia composta por líderes maduros, anciãos ou autoridades religiosas. 1. O conselho de anciãos ou líderes religiosos (Lc 22.66; At 22.5).
THAYER.en: A council or assembly composed of mature leaders, elders, or religious authorities. 1. The council of elders or religious leaders (Lk 22:66; Acts 22:5).

DEFINITION: Describes someone advanced in age (older) or, in a technical and official sense, a person who exercises authority and leadership responsibility in Jewish or Christian communities.
SENSES: 1. A person of more advanced age, an elderly man (Lk 15:25).
2. An official or religious leader with authority in the Jewish or Christian community, the presbyter (Acts 11:30).

THAYER.pt: Descreve alguém avançado em idade (mais velho) ou, em um sentido técnico e oficial, uma pessoa que exerce autoridade e responsabilidade de liderança em comunidades judaicas ou cristãs. 1. Pessoa de idade mais avançada, homem idoso (Lc 15.25). | 2. Oficial ou líder religioso com autoridade na comunidade judaica ou cristã, o presbítero (At 11.30).
THAYER.en: Describes someone advanced in age (older) or, in a technical and official sense, a person who exercises authority and leadership responsibility in Jewish or Christian communities. 1. A person of more advanced age, an elderly man (Lk 15:25). | 2. An official or religious leader with authority in the Jewish or Christian community, the presbyter (Acts 11:30).

DEFINITION: An adult man advanced in age, characterized by maturity.
SENSES: 1. An elderly man or elder (Lk 1:18; Tit 2:2; Phlm 9).

THAYER.pt: Um homem adulto avançado em idade, caracterizado pela maturidade. 1. Homem idoso ou ancião (Lc 1.18; Tt 2.2; Fm 9).
THAYER.en: An adult man advanced in age, characterized by maturity. 1. An elderly man or elder (Lk 1:18; Tit 2:2; Phlm 9).

DEFINITION: Designates a woman of advanced age, worthy of respect in the community and with an instructional role in Christian behavior.
SENSES: 1. An elderly woman or matron who should exhibit behavior consistent with holiness (Tit 2:3).

THAYER.pt: Designa uma mulher em idade avançada, digna de respeito na comunidade e com papel instrutivo no comportamento cristão. 1. Mulher idosa ou senhora que deve exibir comportamento condizente com a santidade (Tt 2.3).
THAYER.en: Designates a woman of advanced age, worthy of respect in the community and with an instructional role in Christian behavior. 1. An elderly woman or matron who should exhibit behavior consistent with holiness (Tit 2:3).

DEFINITION: Describes a bodily position inclined forward, with the face turned toward the ground or falling headfirst.
SENSES: 1. Referring to the violent and fatal fall of Judas, falling face down (Acts 1:18).

THAYER.pt: Descreve uma posição corporal inclinada para a frente, com o rosto voltado para o chão ou caindo de cabeça. 1. Referente à queda violenta e fatal de Judas, caindo de bruços (At 1.18).
THAYER.en: Describes a bodily position inclined forward, with the face turned toward the ground or falling headfirst. 1. Referring to the violent and fatal fall of Judas, falling face down (Acts 1:18).

SHORT_GLOSS: to saw, to cut in two
DEFINITION: To cut an object or human body in two using a saw, used as a cruel method of execution.
SENSES: 1. Torture and cruel death inflicted upon martyrs of the faith in antiquity (Heb 11:37).
USAGE: to saw, to cut in two

THAYER.pt: Cortar um objeto ou corpo humano ao meio utilizando uma serra, empregado como método cruel de execução. 1. Suplicío e morte cruel infligida a mártires da fé na antiguidade (Hb 11.37).
THAYER.en: To cut an object or human body in two using a saw, used as a cruel method of execution. 1. Torture and cruel death inflicted upon martyrs of the faith in antiquity (Heb 11:37).

DEFINITION: A temporal adverb or conjunction denoting a point in time prior to another event.
SENSES: 1. Before a specific occurrence or temporal moment (Matt 26:34; John 8:58).

THAYER.pt: Advérbiou ou conjunção temporal que denota um ponto no tempo anterior a outro evento. 1. Antes de um determinado acontecimento ou momento temporal (Mt 26.34; Jo 8.58).
THAYER.en: A temporal adverb or conjunction denoting a point in time prior to another event. 1. Before a specific occurrence or temporal moment (Matt 26:34; John 8:58).

DEFINITION: The name of a hardworking Christian woman, wife of Aquila, and coworker of the apostle Paul.
SENSES: 1. Prisca or Priscilla, wife of Aquila (Acts 18:2; Rom 16:3).

THAYER.pt: Nome de uma mulher cristã laboriosa, esposa de Áqila, cooperadora do apóstolo Paulo. 1. Prisca ou Priscila, esposa de Áqila (At 18.2; Rm 16.3).
THAYER.en: The name of a hardworking Christian woman, wife of Aquila, and coworker of the apostle Paul. 1. Prisca or Priscilla, wife of Aquila (Acts 18:2; Rom 16:3).

DEFINITION: A feminine proper noun designating Priscilla, a distinguished Christian collaborator and wife of Aquila, frequently mentioned in the Pauline epistles and the book of Acts.
SENSES: 1. Priscilla, a Christian coworker alongside her husband Aquila (Acts 18:2; Rom 16:3; 2 Tim 4:19).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio feminino que designa Priscila, distinta colaboradora cristã e esposa de Áqila, frequentemente mencionada nas cartas paulinas e no livro de Atos. 1. Priscila, co-obreira cristã ao lado de seu marido Áqila (At 18.2; Rm 16.3; 2Tm 4.19).
THAYER.en: A feminine proper noun designating Priscilla, a distinguished Christian collaborator and wife of Aquila, frequently mentioned in the Pauline epistles and the book of Acts. 1. Priscilla, a Christian coworker alongside her husband Aquila (Acts 18:2; Rom 16:3; 2 Tim 4:19).

SHORT_GLOSS: before, in front of, ahead of
DEFINITION: A preposition indicating temporal anteriority or location immediately preceding something or someone. Occasionally expresses axiological precedence or superiority in importance.
SENSES: 1. Temporal: before, prior to a specific event or era (Matt 8:29; John 17:24; Gal 2:12).
2. Spatial or local: in front of, before, at the door of (Acts 12:6, 14; Jas 5:9).
3. Hierarchical or comparative: above, especially (Jas 5:12; 1 Pet 4:8).
USAGE: before, in front of, ahead of

THAYER.pt: Preposição que indica anterioridade temporal ou localização imediatamente anterior a algo ou alguém. Esporadicamente expressa precedência axiológica ou superioridade em importância. 1. Temporal: antes de, anterior a determinado evento ou época (Mt 8.29; Jo 17.24; Gl 2.12). | 2. Espacial ou local: diante de, perante, à porta de (At 12.6, 14; Tg 5.9). | 3. Hierárquico ou comparativo: acima de, sobretudo (Tg 5.12; 1Pe 4.8).
THAYER.en: A preposition indicating temporal anteriority or location immediately preceding something or someone. Occasionally expresses axiological precedence or superiority in importance. 1. Temporal: before, prior to a specific event or era (Matt 8:29; John 17:24; Gal 2:12). | 2. Spatial or local: in front of, before, at the door of (Acts 12:6, 14; Jas 5:9). | 3. Hierarchical or comparative: above, especially (Jas 5:12; 1 Pet 4:8).

DEFINITION: To move in front of someone in terms of space or to walk before in terms of time and leadership.
SENSES: 1. To go ahead or precede someone on the way (Matt 2:9; Mark 14:28).
2. To lead or bring out (Acts 16:30).

THAYER.pt: Mover-se na frente de alguém em termos de espaço ou caminhar antes em termos de tempo e liderança. 1. Ir adiante ou preceder alguém no caminho (Mt 2.9; Mc 14.28). | 2. Conduzir ou trazer para fora (At 16.30).
THAYER.en: To move in front of someone in terms of space or to walk before in terms of time and leadership. 1. To go ahead or precede someone on the way (Matt 2:9; Mark 14:28). | 2. To lead or bring out (Acts 16:30).

DEFINITION: To make a deliberate decision in advance, determining a preference or personal purpose.
SENSES: 1. To decide voluntarily in the heart to give an offering with joy and purpose (2 Cor 9:7).

THAYER.pt: Tomar uma decisão deliberada antecipadamente, determinando uma preferência ou propósito pessoal. 1. Decidir voluntariamente no coração dar uma oferta com alegria e propósito (2Co 9.7).
THAYER.en: To make a deliberate decision in advance, determining a preference or personal purpose. 1. To decide voluntarily in the heart to give an offering with joy and purpose (2 Cor 9:7).

DEFINITION: To attribute guilt or present formal accusations against someone before a specific moment or judgment.
SENSES: 1. The act of demonstrating and accusing beforehand that both Jews and Greeks are under sin (Rom 3:9).

THAYER.pt: Atribuir culpa ou apresentar acusações formais contra alguém antes de um momento ou julgamento específico. 1. O ato de demonstrar e acusar previamente que tanto judeus quanto gregos estão sob o pecado (Rm 3.9).
THAYER.en: To attribute guilt or present formal accusations against someone before a specific moment or judgment. 1. The act of demonstrating and accusing beforehand that both Jews and Greeks are under sin (Rom 3:9).

DEFINITION: To receive information or hear a message before it spreads widely or before a related event.
SENSES: 1. To hear in advance the message of the truth of the gospel (Col 1:5).

THAYER.pt: Receber uma informação ou ouvir uma mensagem antes de que ela se espalhe amplamente ou antes de um evento correlato. 1. Ouvir antecipadamente a mensagem da verdade do evangelho (Cl 1.5).
THAYER.en: To receive information or hear a message before it spreads widely or before a related event. 1. To hear in advance the message of the truth of the gospel (Col 1:5).

SHORT_GLOSS: to sin before, have already sinned
DEFINITION: To commit sins before a certain point in time or before a warning.
SENSES: 1. To practice sin previously or before an earlier period (2 Cor 12:21; 13:2).
USAGE: to sin before, have already sinned

THAYER.pt: Cometer pecados antes de um determinado ponto no tempo ou antes de uma advertência. 1. Praticar o pecado previamente ou antes de um período anterior (2Co 12.21; 13.2).
THAYER.en: To commit sins before a certain point in time or before a warning. 1. To practice sin previously or before an earlier period (2 Cor 12:21; 13:2).

DEFINITION: An area or space situated immediately in front of the entrance of a house or building, functioning as a courtyard or outer vestibule.
SENSES: 1. Courtyard or space in front of a residence (Mark 14:68).

THAYER.pt: Área ou espaço situado imediatamente em frente à entrada de uma casa ou edifício, funcionando como um pátio ou vestíbulo exterior. 1. Pátio ou espaço em frente a uma residência (Mc 14.68).
THAYER.en: An area or space situated immediately in front of the entrance of a house or building, functioning as a courtyard or outer vestibule. 1. Courtyard or space in front of a residence (Mark 14:68).

DEFINITION: To advance physically forward or to progress in the course of time, especially regarding human aging.
SENSES: 1. To walk forward or advance spatially (Mark 1:19);
2. To advance in age or advance in the days of life (Luke 1:7).

THAYER.pt: Avançar fisicamente para a frente ou progredir no curso do tempo, especialmente no que tange ao envelhecimento humano. 1. Caminhar para a frente ou avançar espacialmente (Mc 1:19); | 2. Avançar em idade ou avançar nos dias de vida (Lc 1:7).
THAYER.en: To advance physically forward or to progress in the course of time, especially regarding human aging. 1. To walk forward or advance spatially (Mark 1:19); | 2. To advance in age or advance in the days of life (Luke 1:7).

DEFINITION: To throw forward, present publicly, or cause to sprout new branches and leaves.
SENSES: 1. To present, propose, or push forward (Acts 19:33).
2. To emit new shoots or foliage in vegetation (Luke 21:30).

THAYER.pt: Lançar para a frente, apresentar publicamente ou fazer brotar novos ramos e folhas. 1. Apresentar, propor ou empurrar para a frente (At 19.33). | 2. Emitir novos brotos ou folhagem na vegetação (Lc 21.30).
THAYER.en: To throw forward, present publicly, or cause to sprout new branches and leaves. 1. To present, propose, or push forward (Acts 19:33). | 2. To emit new shoots or foliage in vegetation (Luke 21:30).

DEFINITION: An adjective qualifying something belonging to or related to sheep, famous in the New Testament for designating the 'Sheep Gate' in Jerusalem.
SENSES: 1. Relating to sheep, particularly associated with the gate of Jerusalem through which cattle passed (John 5:2).

THAYER.pt: Adjetivo que qualifica algo pertencente ou relacionado a ovelhas, sendo famoso no Novo Testamento por designar a 'Porta das Ovelhas' em Jerusalém. 1. Relativo a ovelhas, particularmente associado à porta de Jerusalém por onde o gado passava (Jo 5.2).
THAYER.en: An adjective qualifying something belonging to or related to sheep, famous in the New Testament for designating the 'Sheep Gate' in Jerusalem. 1. Relating to sheep, particularly associated with the gate of Jerusalem through which cattle passed (John 5:2).

DEFINITION: Designates the ovine animal and, by metaphorical extension in the New Testament, the followers of Christ as a flock under the care of the Good Shepherd.
SENSES: 1. The sheep animal in a literal sense (Matt 12:11; John 2:14).
2. Metaphor for the people of God or disciples of Christ who need guidance (Matt 10:6; John 10:11; Heb 13:20).

THAYER.pt: Designa o animal ovino e, por extensão metafórica no Novo Testamento, os seguidores de Cristo como rebanho sob os cuidados do Bom Pastor. 1. O animal ovelha em sentido literal (Mt 12.11; Jo 2.14). | 2. Metáfora para o povo de Deus ou discípulos de Cristo que necessitam de orientação (Mt 10.6; Jo 10.11; Hb 13.20).
THAYER.en: Designates the ovine animal and, by metaphorical extension in the New Testament, the followers of Christ as a flock under the care of the Good Shepherd. 1. The sheep animal in a literal sense (Matt 12:11; John 2:14). | 2. Metaphor for the people of God or disciples of Christ who need guidance (Matt 10:6; John 10:11; Heb 13:20).

DEFINITION: To cause to advance, incite, or persuade someone to adopt a certain behavior or to perform a specific action.
SENSES: 1. To incite or persuade someone through prior instruction (Matt 14:8);
2. To cause to advance or present (Acts 19:33).

THAYER.pt: Fazer avançar, incitar ou persuadir alguém a adotar um determinado comportamento ou a realizar uma ação específica. 1. Incitar ou persuadir alguém por meio de instrução prévia (Mt 14.8); | 2. Fazer avançar ou apresentar (At 19.33).
THAYER.en: To cause to advance, incite, or persuade someone to adopt a certain behavior or to perform a specific action. 1. To incite or persuade someone through prior instruction (Matt 14:8); | 2. To cause to advance or present (Acts 19:33).

DEFINITION: To visualize, plan, or provide in advance to meet a future need or established purpose.
SENSES: 1. To choose or select in advance;
2. To provide for the needs of others in advance.

THAYER.pt: Visualizar, planejar ou prover antecipadamente para atender a uma necessidade futura ou propósito estabelecido. 1. Escolher ou selecionar antecipadamente; | 2. Prover para as necessidades de outros com antecipação.
THAYER.en: To visualize, plan, or provide in advance to meet a future need or established purpose. 1. To choose or select in advance; | 2. To provide for the needs of others in advance.

DEFINITION: To happen or originate at a time prior to the established reference point.
SENSES: 1. To occur or take place previously in time (Rom 3:25).

THAYER.pt: Acontecer ou ter origem em um momento anterior ao ponto de referência estabelecido. 1. Ocorrer ou realizar-se anteriormente no tempo (Rm 3.25).
THAYER.en: To happen or originate at a time prior to the established reference point. 1. To occur or take place previously in time (Rom 3:25).

DEFINITION: To have prior knowledge about an event or person before it manifests historically.
SENSES: 1. To possess foreknowledge or prior knowledge of something (2 Pet 3:17);
2. To know and elect in advance in the divine salvific plan (1 Pet 1:20).

THAYER.pt: Ter conhecimento prévio sobre um evento ou pessoa antes que este se manifeste historicamente. 1. Possuir presciência ou conhecimento antecipado de algo (2Pe 3:17); | 2. Conhecer e eleger antecipadamente no plano salvífico divino (1Pe 1:20).
THAYER.en: To have prior knowledge about an event or person before it manifests historically. 1. To possess foreknowledge or prior knowledge of something (2 Pet 3:17); | 2. To know and elect in advance in the divine salvific plan (1 Pet 1:20).

DEFINITION: Prior knowledge of future events, associated with the sovereign and omniscient plan of God.
SENSES: 1. Divine prior knowledge or foreknowledge (Acts 2:23; 1 Pet 1:2).

THAYER.pt: Conhecimento antecipado de eventos futuros, associado ao plano soberano e onisciente de Deus. 1. Conhecimento prévio ou presciência divina (At 2.23; 1Pe 1.2).
THAYER.en: Prior knowledge of future events, associated with the sovereign and omniscient plan of God. 1. Divine prior knowledge or foreknowledge (Acts 2:23; 1 Pet 1:2).

DEFINITION: Previous generations that preceded a person, including parents, grandparents, and distant ancestors.
SENSES: 1. Ancestors, forefathers, or parents of past generations (2 Tim 1:3).

THAYER.pt: Gerações anteriores que precederam uma pessoa, incluindo pais, avós e ancestrais distantes. 1. Ancestrais, antepassados ou pais de gerações passadas (2Tm 1.3).
THAYER.en: Previous generations that preceded a person, including parents, grandparents, and distant ancestors. 1. Ancestors, forefathers, or parents of past generations (2 Tim 1:3).

DEFINITION: To write something in advance or to display publicly on posters or notices for all to see.
SENSES: 1. To write beforehand or prophetically (Eph 3:3; Rom 15:4).
2. To publicly display or portray clearly before all (Gal 3:1).

THAYER.pt: Significa escrever algo com antecedência ou expor publicamente em cartazes ou avisos para que todos vejam. 1. Escrever antecipadamente ou profeticamente (Ef 3.3; Rm 15.4). | 2. Expor publicamente ou retratar com clareza perante todos (Gl 3.1).
THAYER.en: To write something in advance or to display publicly on posters or notices for all to see. 1. To write beforehand or prophetically (Eph 3:3; Rom 15:4). | 2. To publicly display or portray clearly before all (Gal 3:1).

DEFINITION: Describes something that is fully visible, clear, or manifest to all, leaving no room for doubt.
SENSES: 1. That which is overly evident or publicly known (1 Tim 5:24; Heb 7:14).

THAYER.pt: Descreve algo que é plenamente visível, claro ou manifesto para todos, sem deixar margem para dúvidas. 1. Aquilo que é por demais evidente ou conhecido publicamente (1Tm 5.24; Hb 7.14).
THAYER.en: Describes something that is fully visible, clear, or manifest to all, leaving no room for doubt. 1. That which is overly evident or publicly known (1 Tim 5:24; Heb 7:14).

DEFINITION: To give something in anticipation to someone or, in a negative sense, to betray someone.
SENSES: 1. To give first or beforehand to someone (Rom 11:35);
2. To hand over treacherously, betray (Mark 14:10).

THAYER.pt: Dar algo em antecipação a outrem ou, em sentido negativo, entregar alguém de maneira traiçoeira. 1. Dar primeiro ou antecipadamente a alguém (Rm 11.35); | 2. Entregar traiçoeiramente, trair (Mk 14.10).
THAYER.en: To give something in anticipation to someone or, in a negative sense, to betray someone. 1. To give first or beforehand to someone (Rom 11:35); | 2. To hand over treacherously, betray (Mark 14:10).

DEFINITION: Refers to a person who unjustifiably hands someone over to the power of enemies or who betrays placed trust.
SENSES: 1. One who betrays or hands over another (Acts 7:52; 2 Tim 3:4).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se à pessoa que entrega injustificadamente alguém ao poder de inimigos ou que trai a confiança depositada. 1. Aquele que trai ou entrega outrem (At 7.52; 2Tm 3.4).
THAYER.en: Refers to a person who unjustifiably hands someone over to the power of enemies or who betrays placed trust. 1. One who betrays or hands over another (Acts 7:52; 2 Tim 3:4).

DEFINITION: One who runs or goes ahead to prepare the way, serving as a forerunner or pioneer of someone or something.
SENSES: 1. Forerunner or one who enters first into a place on behalf of others (Heb 6:20).

THAYER.pt: Aquele que corre ou vai adiante para preparar o caminho, servindo como precursor ou pioneiro de algo ou alguém. 1. Precursor ou aquele que entra primeiro em um lugar em favor de outros (Hb 6.20).
THAYER.en: One who runs or goes ahead to prepare the way, serving as a forerunner or pioneer of someone or something. 1. Forerunner or one who enters first into a place on behalf of others (Heb 6:20).

DEFINITION: A verb meaning to perceive or contemplate something before it happens, whether by divine foreknowledge or human foresight.
SENSES: 1. To have advance knowledge of a future event.

THAYER.pt: Verbo que significa perceber ou contemplar algo antes que aconteça, seja por presciência divina ou previsão humana. 1. Ter conhecimento antecipado de um evento futuro.
THAYER.en: A verb meaning to perceive or contemplate something before it happens, whether by divine foreknowledge or human foresight. 1. To have advance knowledge of a future event.

DEFINITION: To place hope in someone or something before others or in an anticipatory manner.
SENSES: 1. To be the first to hope or have prior hope in Christ (Eph 1:12).

THAYER.pt: Colocar a esperança em algo ou alguém antes de outros ou de forma antecipada. 1. Ser o primeiro a esperar ou ter esperança antecipada em Cristo (Ef 1.12).
THAYER.en: To place hope in someone or something before others or in an anticipatory manner. 1. To be the first to hope or have prior hope in Christ (Eph 1:12).

DEFINITION: To say or declare something beforehand, serving as a warning or prophecy.
SENSES: 1. To speak or warn beforehand about an event.

THAYER.pt: Dizer ou declarar algo de antemão, servindo como advertência ou profecia. 1. Falar ou avisar antecipadamente sobre um evento.
THAYER.en: To say or declare something beforehand, serving as a warning or prophecy. 1. To speak or warn beforehand about an event.

DEFINITION: Means to initiate or begin something in advance, so that the beginning belongs to the past in contrast to the present.
SENSES: 1. To begin an activity or work in advance (2 Cor 8:10).

THAYER.pt: Significa iniciar ou começar algo com antecedência, de modo que o início pertença ao passado em contraste com o presente. 1. Começar uma atividade ou obra com antecedência (2Co 8.10).
THAYER.en: Means to initiate or begin something in advance, so that the beginning belongs to the past in contrast to the present. 1. To begin an activity or work in advance (2 Cor 8:10).

DEFINITION: Indicates the action of promising or announcing with certainty and in advance what is planned to be done.
SENSES: 1. To make a prior promise or announcement of something (2 Cor 9:5).

THAYER.pt: Indica a ação de prometer ou anunciar com certeza e antecedência o que se planeja realizar. 1. Fazer uma promessa ou anúncio prévio de algo (2Co 9.5).
THAYER.en: Indicates the action of promising or announcing with certainty and in advance what is planned to be done. 1. To make a prior promise or announcement of something (2 Cor 9:5).

DEFINITION: To say or declare something beforehand, often with the sense of prophesying or warning before the fact occurs.
SENSES: 1. To communicate or prophesy something beforehand.

THAYER.pt: Dizer ou declarar algo de antemão, frequentemente com o sentido de profetizar ou advertir antes que o fato ocorra. 1. Comunicar ou profetizar algo previamente.
THAYER.en: To say or declare something beforehand, often with the sense of prophesying or warning before the fact occurs. 1. To communicate or prophesy something beforehand.

DEFINITION: Means to move forward, advance in time or space, or go ahead of someone as a guide or forerunner.
SENSES: 1. To advance or proceed on a journey or path (Matt 26:39; Acts 20:5);
2. To go ahead or precede someone as a leader or guide (Luke 22:47).

THAYER.pt: Significa mover-se para a frente, avançar no tempo ou no espaço, ou ir na frente de alguém como guia ou precursor. 1. Avançar ou prosseguir em uma jornada ou caminho (Mt 26.39; At 20.5). | 2. Ir na frente ou preceder alguém como líder ou guia (Lc 22.47).
THAYER.en: Means to move forward, advance in time or space, or go ahead of someone as a guide or forerunner. 1. To advance or proceed on a journey or path (Matt 26:39; Acts 20:5); | 2. To go ahead or precede someone as a leader or guide (Luke 22:47).

DEFINITION: Describes the action of preparing or providing something beforehand, frequently used in the New Testament for the sovereign purpose of God.
SENSES: 1. To prepare or ordain something beforehand by divine design (Rom 9:23; Eph 2:10).

THAYER.pt: Descreve a ação de preparar ou providenciar algo antecipadamente, sendo frequentemente utilizado no Novo Testamento para o propósito soberano de Deus. 1. Preparar ou ordenar algo de antemão por desígnio divino (Rm 9.23; Ef 2.10).
THAYER.en: Describes the action of preparing or providing something beforehand, frequently used in the New Testament for the sovereign purpose of God. 1. To prepare or ordain something beforehand by divine design (Rom 9:23; Eph 2:10).

DEFINITION: To announce the good news of salvation in Christ before the main event fully occurs.
SENSES: 1. To proclaim the gospel beforehand, as in the announcement made to Abraham (Gal 3:8).

THAYER.pt: Anunciar as boas-novas de salvação em Cristo antes que o evento principal ocorra plenamente. 1. Proclamar o evangelho antecipadamente, como no anúncio feito a Abraão (Gl 3.8).

DEFINITION: Refers to the act of disbursing money or spending additional amounts beyond an initial sum.
SENSES: 1. To pay or spend an additional sum to cover extra costs (Lk 10.35).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se ao ato de desembolsar dinheiro ou gastar valores adicionais além de uma quantia inicial. 1. Pagar ou gastar uma quantia adicional para cobrir custos extras (Lc 10.35).
THAYER.en: Refers to the act of disbursing money or spending additional amounts beyond an initial sum. 1. To pay or spend an additional sum to cover extra costs (Lk 10.35).

DEFINITION: Indicates the condition of having an additional need for something, lacking some supplementary element or resource.
SENSES: 1. To have need of something beyond what one already possesses or of additional help (Acts 17.25).

THAYER.pt: Indica a condição de ter necessidade adicional de algo, faltando algum elemento ou recurso suplementar. 1. Ter necessidade de algo além do que já se possui ou de auxílio adicional (At 17.25).
THAYER.en: Indicates the condition of having an additional need for something, lacking some supplementary element or resource. 1. To have need of something beyond what one already possesses or of additional help (Acts 17.25).

DEFINITION: Indicates the action of receiving someone warmly or of waiting with expectation for the fulfillment of a promise or future event.
SENSES: 1. To welcome or receive someone in a friendly and hospitable manner (Phil 2.29; Phlm 16).
2. To wait for or look forward to with expectation for something or someone (Lk 2.38; Jude 21).

THAYER.pt: Indica a ação de receber alguém com cordialidade ou de aguardar com expectativa o cumprimento de uma promessa ou evento futuro. 1. Acolher ou receber alguém de forma amigável e hospitaleira (Fp 2.29; Fm 16). | 2. Esperar ou aguardar com expectativa por algo ou alguém (Lc 2.38; Jd 21).
THAYER.en: Indicates the action of receiving someone warmly or of waiting with expectation for the fulfillment of a promise or future event. 1. To welcome or receive someone in a friendly and hospitable manner (Phil 2.29; Phlm 16). | 2. To wait for or look forward to with expectation for something or someone (Lk 2.38; Jude 21).

DEFINITION: To turn the mind toward the future with expectation, waiting anxiously or confidently for the occurrence of an event or the arrival of someone.
SENSES: 1. To wait for or look to the future with expectation (Lk 3.15; Acts 3.5).
2. To anticipate the coming of future events, such as the fulfillment of divine promises (2Pet 3.13).

THAYER.pt: Voltar a mente para o futuro com expectativa, aguardando ansiosa ou confiantemente a ocorrência de um evento ou a chegada de alguém. 1. Aguardar ou olhar para o futuro com expectativa (Lc 3.15; At 3.5). | 2. Antecipar a vinda de eventos futuros, como o cumprimento das promessas divinas (2Pe 3.13).
THAYER.en: To turn the mind toward the future with expectation, waiting anxiously or confidently for the occurrence of an event or the arrival of someone. 1. To wait for or look to the future with expectation (Lk 3.15; Acts 3.5). | 2. To anticipate the coming of future events, such as the fulfillment of divine promises (2Pet 3.13).

DEFINITION: Refers to the state of expectation or waiting for something that is about to happen, which may be favorable or unfavorable.
SENSES: 1. Expectation or dread in the face of future events (Lk 21.26; Acts 12.11).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se ao estado de expectativa ou aguardo por algo que está prestes a acontecer, podendo ser favorável ou desfavorável. 1. Expectativa ou temor diante de eventos futuros (Lc 21.26; At 12.11).
THAYER.en: Refers to the state of expectation or waiting for something that is about to happen, which may be favorable or unfavorable. 1. Expectation or dread in the face of future events (Lk 21.26; Acts 12.11).

DEFINITION: Means to allow someone or something to continue moving forward or follow its course without immediate impediments.
SENSES: 1. To allow a ship or traveler to proceed on their route (Acts 27.7).

THAYER.pt: Significa permitir que alguém ou algo continue a avançar ou siga seu curso sem impedimentos imediatos. 1. Permitir que um navio ou viajante prossiga em sua rota (At 27.7).
THAYER.en: Means to allow someone or something to continue moving forward or follow its course without immediate impediments. 1. To allow a ship or traveler to proceed on their route (Acts 27.7).

DEFINITION: To move in the direction of a reference point or person, reducing physical distance.
SENSES: 1. To approach physically someone or some place (Acts 10.25).

THAYER.pt: Mover-se na direção de um ponto de referência ou de uma pessoa, diminuindo a distância física. 1. Aproximar-se fisicamente de alguém ou de algum lugar (At 10:25).
THAYER.en: To move in the direction of a reference point or person, reducing physical distance. 1. To approach physically someone or some place (Acts 10.25).

DEFINITION: Describes constant dedication to the service of someone or a sacred function, remaining close by to attend to needs.
SENSES: 1. To be in the service of something or someone in a dedicated and constant manner, as in altar duties (1Cor 9.13).

THAYER.pt: Descreve a dedicação constante ao serviço de alguém ou de uma função sagrada, permanecendo junto para atender às necessidades. 1. Estar a serviço de algo ou alguém de forma dedicada e constante, como nos deveres do altar (1Co 9.13).
THAYER.en: Describes constant dedication to the service of someone or a sacred function, remaining close by to attend to needs. 1. To be in the service of something or someone in a dedicated and constant manner, as in altar duties (1Cor 9.13).

DEFINITION: Means to obtain additional gains, profit, or income through work or investment.
SENSES: 1. To earn or produce additional profits through trade or effort (Lk 19.16).

THAYER.pt: Significa obter ganhos, lucro ou rendimento adicional por meio de trabalho ou investimento. 1. Ganhar ou produzir lucros adicionais através de comércio ou esforço (Lc 19.16).
THAYER.en: Means to obtain additional gains, profit, or income through work or investment. 1. To earn or produce additional profits through trade or effort (Lk 19.16).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: προσελεύσομαι, Aor2: προσῆλθον, Perf: προσελήλυθα
SHORT_GLOSS: to approach, come to, draw near
DEFINITION: To move toward something or someone, approaching physically or respectfully entering the divine presence in worship and supplication.
SENSES: 1. To approach physically or address someone (Mt 5.1; Mt 8.5).
2. To draw near to the presence of God in worship, prayer, or devotion (Heb 4.16; Heb 7.25; Heb 11.6).
3. To agree with or devote oneself to a doctrinal teaching (1Tim 6.3).
USAGE: to approach, come to, draw near

THAYER.pt: Movimentar-se em direção a algo ou alguém, aproximando-se fisicamente ou dirigindo-se respeitosamente à presença divina em adoração e súplica. 1. Aproximar-se fisicamente ou dirigir-se a alguém (Mt 5.1; Mt 8.5). | 2. Achegar-se à presença de Deus em culto, oração ou devoção (Hb 4.16; Hb 7.25; Hb 11.6). | 3. Concordar com ou dedicar-se a um ensino doutrinário (1Tm 6.3).
THAYER.en: To move toward something or someone, approaching physically or respectfully entering the divine presence in worship and supplication. 1. To approach physically or address someone (Mt 5.1; Mt 8.5). | 2. To draw near to the presence of God in worship, prayer, or devotion (Heb 4.16; Heb 7.25; Heb 11.6). | 3. To agree with or devote oneself to a doctrinal teaching (1Tim 6.3).

DEFINITION: Devotional communication with God, expressing petitions, praise, or gratitude, or the place dedicated to this purpose.
SENSES: 1. The act or content of prayer directed to God (Mt 21.13; Rev 5.8).
2. A specific place designated for prayer (Acts 16.13).

THAYER.pt: Comunicação devocional com Deus, expressando petições, louvor ou gratidão, ou o local dedicado a esse fim. 1. O ato ou conteúdo da oração dirigida a Deus (Mt 21.13; Ap 5.8). | 2. Um local específico designado para a oração (At 16.13).
THAYER.en: Devotional communication with God, expressing petitions, praise, or gratitude, or the place dedicated to this purpose. 1. The act or content of prayer directed to God (Mt 21.13; Rev 5.8). | 2. A specific place designated for prayer (Acts 16.13).

DEFINITION: The act of directing the mind and heart to God, involving petitions, thanksgiving, praise, and intimate communion. It is the most frequent and distinctive New Testament term for the practice of Christian prayer.
SENSES: 1. To pray to God on one's own behalf or with personal petitions (Mt 6.5-9; 26.39; Lk 18.1).
2. To intercede on behalf of others, persecutors, or the church (Mt 5.44; Rom 8.26; Jas 5.16).

THAYER.pt: Ato de dirigir a mente e o coração a Deus, envolvendo petições, ações de graças, louvor e comunhão íntima. É o termo neotestamentário mais frequente e distintivo para o exercício da oração cristã. 1. Orar a Deus em favor próprio ou com petições pessoais (Mt 6.5-9; 26.39; Lc 18.1). | 2. Interceder em benefício do próximo, de perseguidores ou da igreja (Mt 5.44; Rm 8.26; Tg 5.16).
THAYER.en: The act of directing the mind and heart to God, involving petitions, thanksgiving, praise, and intimate communion. It is the most frequent and distinctive New Testament term for the practice of Christian prayer. 1. To pray to God on one's own behalf or with personal petitions (Mt 6.5-9; 26.39; Lk 18.1). | 2. To intercede on behalf of others, persecutors, or the church (Mt 5.44; Rom 8.26; Jas 5.16).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Compound of πρός and ἔχω; Impf: προσεῖχον
DEFINITION: Means to turn the mind or attention to something, implying vigilance against dangers or zealous dedication to an activity and teaching.
SENSES: 1. To pay attention, to give heed to a teaching (Acts 8.6).
2. To be on alert, to beware of dangers or false teachers (Mt 7.15; Acts 20.28).

THAYER.pt: Significa voltar a mente ou a atenção para algo, implicando vigilância contra perigos ou dedicação zelosa a uma atividade e ensino. 1. Prestar atenção, dar ouvidos a um ensinamento (At 8.6). | 2. Estar em alerta, acautelar-se contra perigos ou falsos mestres (Mt 7.15; At 20.28).
THAYER.en: Means to turn the mind or attention to something, implying vigilance against dangers or zealous dedication to an activity and teaching. 1. To pay attention, to give heed to a teaching (Acts 8.6). | 2. To be on alert, to beware of dangers or false teachers (Mt 7.15; Acts 20.28).

DEFINITION: Indicates the physical action of firmly fixing one object to another using nails or spikes.
SENSES: 1. To fasten something with nails, used metaphorically for the removal of the legal debt on the cross (Col 2.14).

THAYER.pt: Indica a ação física de fixar firmemente um objeto a outro utilizando pregos ou cravos. 1. Fixar algo com pregos, usado metaforicamente para a remoção da dívida legal na cruz (Cl 2.14).
THAYER.en: Indicates the physical action of firmly fixing one object to another using nails or spikes. 1. To fasten something with nails, used metaphorically for the removal of the legal debt on the cross (Col 2.14).

DEFINITION: Designates a Gentile who has abandoned paganism and converted to the Jewish religion, accepting its laws and practices.
SENSES: 1. A foreigner converted to Judaism (Acts 2:11).

THAYER.pt: Designa um gentio que abandonou o paganismo e converteu-se à religião judaica, aceitando suas leis e práticas. 1. Um estrangeiro convertido ao judaísmo (At 2.11).
THAYER.en: Designates a Gentile who has abandoned paganism and converted to the Jewish religion, accepting its laws and practices. 1. A foreigner converted to Judaism (Acts 2:11).

DEFINITION: Refers to that which lasts only for a brief period, being transitory and limited to the present time.
SENSES: 1. Lasting for a short time, fleeting or transitory (Matt 13:21; 2 Cor 4:18).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se ao que dura apenas por um breve período, sendo transitório e limitado ao tempo presente. 1. Que dura pouco tempo, passageiro ou transitório (Mt 13.21; 2Co 4.18).
THAYER.en: Refers to that which lasts only for a brief period, being transitory and limited to the present time. 1. Lasting for a short time, fleeting or transitory (Matt 13:21; 2 Cor 4:18).

DEFINITION: To call someone to oneself for a specific purpose, whether summoning for a task or inviting to fellowship.
SENSES: 1. To call someone to one's presence or summon for a task (Matt 10:1; Acts 13:2).
2. The divine call to participate in salvation (Acts 2:39).

THAYER.pt: Chamar alguém para perto de si com um propósito específico, seja convocando para uma tarefa ou convidando para a comunhão. 1. Chamar alguém à sua presença ou convocar para uma tarefa (Mt 10:1; At 13:2). | 2. O chamado divino para participar da salvação (At 2:39).
THAYER.en: To call someone to oneself for a specific purpose, whether summoning for a task or inviting to fellowship. 1. To call someone to one's presence or summon for a task (Matt 10:1; Acts 13:2). | 2. The divine call to participate in salvation (Acts 2:39).

DEFINITION: To adhere firmly to someone or to dedicate oneself with constancy and effort to an activity or duty.
SENSES: 1. To remain faithful and closely associated with someone (Acts 8:13).
2. To persevere with dedication and constancy in prayer or teaching (Acts 1:14; 2:42).

THAYER.pt: Aderir firmemente a alguém ou dedicar-se com constância e esforço a uma atividade ou dever. 1. Manter-se fiel e associado de perto a alguém (At 8.13). | 2. Perseverar com dedicação e constância na oração ou no ensino (At 1.14; 2.42).
THAYER.en: To adhere firmly to someone or to dedicate oneself with constancy and effort to an activity or duty. 1. To remain faithful and closely associated with someone (Acts 8:13). | 2. To persevere with dedication and constancy in prayer or teaching (Acts 1:14; 2:42).

DEFINITION: Denotes a firm constancy and unwavering dedication in the fulfillment of a task or purpose, despite difficulties.
SENSES: 1. Firm persistence and constant dedication in prayer and watchfulness (Eph 6:18).

THAYER.pt: Denota uma firme constância e dedicação inabalável na realização de uma tarefa ou propósito, apesar das dificuldades. 1. Persistência firme e dedicação constante na oração e vigilância (Ef 6.18).
THAYER.en: Denotes a firm constancy and unwavering dedication in the fulfillment of a task or purpose, despite difficulties. 1. Firm persistence and constant dedication in prayer and watchfulness (Eph 6:18).

DEFINITION: An upholstered or soft object used to support the head while lying down or resting.
SENSES: 1. A pillow or cushion for personal use, mentioned in the scene where Jesus sleeps in the boat (Mark 4:38).

THAYER.pt: Objeto estofado ou macio utilizado para apoiar a cabeça ao deitar ou descansar. 1. Travesseiro ou almofada de uso pessoal, mencionado na cena em que Jesus dorme no barco (Mc 4.38).
THAYER.en: An upholstered or soft object used to support the head while lying down or resting. 1. A pillow or cushion for personal use, mentioned in the scene where Jesus sleeps in the boat (Mark 4:38).

DEFINITION: Means to be added to a group, to associate closely, or to unite through communal bonds.
SENSES: 1. To become associated or to join a group of people by conviction (Acts 17:4).

THAYER.pt: Significa ser agregado a um grupo, associar-se intimamente ou unir-se por laços comunitários. 1. Tornar-se associado ou juntar-se a um grupo de pessoas por convicção (At 17.4).
THAYER.en: Means to be added to a group, to associate closely, or to unite through communal bonds. 1. To become associated or to join a group of people by conviction (Acts 17:4).

DEFINITION: Indication of favoritism or partial inclination toward certain people to the detriment of others.
SENSES: 1. Demonstration of partiality or favoritism.

THAYER.pt: Indicação de favoritismo ou inclinação parcial em direção a certas pessoas em detrimento de outras. 1. Demonstração de parcialidade ou favoritismo.
THAYER.en: Indication of favoritism or partial inclination toward certain people to the detriment of others. 1. Demonstration of partiality or favoritism.

DEFINITION: Means to glue oneself firmly to something or to unite with dedication to a person or cause.
SENSES: 1. To unite intimately or cling to someone (Mark 10:7).

THAYER.pt: Significa colar-se firmemente a algo ou unir-se com dedicação a uma pessoa ou causa. 1. Unir-se intimamente ou apegar-se a alguém (Mc 10.7).
THAYER.en: Means to glue oneself firmly to something or to unite with dedication to a person or cause. 1. To unite intimately or cling to someone (Mark 10:7).

DEFINITION: That which causes a fall, a physical obstacle, or a motive that induces someone to sin or retreat spiritually.
SENSES: 1. A stone or rock that causes stumbling or falling (Rom 9:33).
2. An occasion of scandal, offense, or moral obstacle to one's neighbor (Rom 14:13).

THAYER.pt: Aquilo que causa uma queda, obstáculo físico ou motivo que induz alguém a pecar ou recuar espiritualmente. 1. Pedra ou rocha que provoca tropeço ou queda (Rm 9.33). | 2. Ocasião de escândalo, ofensa ou obstáculo moral ao próximo (Rm 14.13).
THAYER.en: That which causes a fall, a physical obstacle, or a motive that induces someone to sin or retreat spiritually. 1. A stone or rock that causes stumbling or falling (Rom 9:33). | 2. An occasion of scandal, offense, or moral obstacle to one's neighbor (Rom 14:13).

DEFINITION: That which serves as an occasion for moral stumbling, provoking offense or leading someone to sin.
SENSES: 1. A cause of stumbling, scandal, or action that causes offense to others in Christian conduct (2 Cor 6:3).

THAYER.pt: Aquilo que serve de ocasião para o tropeço moral, provocando a ofensa ou levando alguém a pecar. 1. Motivo de tropeço, escândalo ou ação que cause ofensa a outros na conduta cristã (2Co 6.3).
THAYER.en: That which serves as an occasion for moral stumbling, provoking offense or leading someone to sin. 1. A cause of stumbling, scandal, or action that causes offense to others in Christian conduct (2 Cor 6:3).

DEFINITION: To strike the foot against an obstacle, stumbling, or in a figurative sense, to be scandalized, to stumble spiritually, or to reject the truth.
SENSES: 1. To strike the foot against a stone or stumble physically (Matt 4:6; John 11:9).
2. To be scandalized, to stumble, or to reject the spiritual message (Rom 9:32; 1 Pet 2:8).

THAYER.pt: Bater o pé contra um obstáculo tropeçando, ou em sentido figurado, escandalizar-se, tropeçar espiritualmente ou rejeitar a verdade. 1. Bater o pé contra uma pedra ou tropeçar fisicamente (Mt 4:6; Jo 11:9). | 2. Escandalizar-se, tropeçar ou rejeitar a mensagem espiritual (Rm 9:32; 1Pe 2:8).
THAYER.en: To strike the foot against an obstacle, stumbling, or in a figurative sense, to be scandalized, to stumble spiritually, or to reject the truth. 1. To strike the foot against a stone or stumble physically (Matt 4:6; John 11:9). | 2. To be scandalized, to stumble, or to reject the spiritual message (Rom 9:32; 1 Pet 2:8).

DEFINITION: Describes the action of rolling a heavy object until it touches something.
SENSES: 1. To roll a stone against the entrance of a tomb (Matt 27:60).

THAYER.pt: Descreve a ação de rolar um objeto pesado até encostá-lo em algum lugar. 1. Rolar uma pedra contra a entrada de um sepulcro (Mt 27.60).
THAYER.en: Describes the action of rolling a heavy object until it touches something. 1. To roll a stone against the entrance of a tomb (Matt 27:60).

DEFINITION: Expresses the action of prostrating or bowing in a sign of deep submission, respect, or religious worship rendered to God, spiritual beings, or authorities.
SENSES: 1. To prostrate in religious worship to God or Christ (Matt 4:10; 1 Cor 14:25).
2. To show reverence or submission to human authorities (Matt 18:26; Rev 3:9).
3. To render improper worship to demonic powers or idols (Rev 13:4).

THAYER.pt: Expressa a ação de prostrar-se ou curvar-se em sinal de profunda submissão, respeito ou adoração religiosa prestada a Deus, a seres espirituais ou a autoridades. 1. Prostrar-se em adoração religiosa a Deus ou a Cristo (Mt 4.10; 1Co 14.25). | 2. Prestar reverência ou submissão a autoridades humanas (Mt 18.26; Ap 3.9). | 3. Render culto indevido a potestades demoníacas ou ídolos (Ap 13.4).
THAYER.en: Expresses the action of prostrating or bowing in a sign of deep submission, respect, or religious worship rendered to God, spiritual beings, or authorities. 1. To prostrate in religious worship to God or Christ (Matt 4:10; 1 Cor 14:25). | 2. To show reverence or submission to human authorities (Matt 18:26; Rev 3:9). | 3. To render improper worship to demonic powers or idols (Rev 13:4).

DEFINITION: One who renders worship, adoration, and deep reverence to the divinity.
SENSES: 1. A person who worships God in spirit and in truth (John 4:23).

THAYER.pt: Aquele que presta culto, adoração e profunda reverência à divindade. 1. Pessoa que adora a Deus em espírito e em verdade (Jo 4.23).
THAYER.en: One who renders worship, adoration, and deep reverence to the divinity. 1. A person who worships God in spirit and in truth (John 4:23).

DEFINITION: Means to converse orally with someone, addressing them in a sign of exhortation or teaching.
SENSES: 1. To address or converse with someone (Acts 13:43).

THAYER.pt: Significa conversar oralmente com alguém, dirigindo-lhe a palavra em sinal de exortação ou ensino. 1. Dirigir a palavra ou conversar com alguém (At 13.43).
THAYER.en: Means to converse orally with someone, addressing them in a sign of exhortation or teaching. 1. To address or converse with someone (Acts 13:43).

DEFINITION: Means to admit someone into one's circle of fellowship, to receive with benevolence, or to take for oneself for a specific purpose.
SENSES: 1. To take food to satisfy a need (Acts 27:33).
2. To welcome someone warmly into one's home or community (Rom 14:1).

THAYER.pt: Significa admitir alguém em seu círculo de comunhão, receber com benevolência ou tomar para si com um propósito específico. 1. Tomar alimento para satisfazer uma necessidade (At 27.33). | 2. Acolher calorosamente alguém em casa ou na comunidade (Rm 14.1).
THAYER.en: Means to admit someone into one's circle of fellowship, to receive with benevolence, or to take for oneself for a specific purpose. 1. To take food to satisfy a need (Acts 27:33). | 2. To welcome someone warmly into one's home or community (Rom 14:1).

DEFINITION: The act of receiving, accepting, or admitting someone into fellowship or relationship.
SENSES: 1. The welcoming or reintegration of someone in the context of the fellowship of faith.

THAYER.pt: O ato de receber, aceitar ou admitir alguém em comunhão ou relacionamento. 1. Acolhimento ou reintegração de alguém no contexto da comunhão da fé.
THAYER.en: The act of receiving, accepting, or admitting someone into fellowship or relationship. 1. The welcoming or reintegration of someone in the context of the fellowship of faith.

DEFINITION: To continue to reside in a location or to remain firm in an association, loyalty, or activity.
SENSES: 1. To remain or continue with someone (Matt 15:32).
2. To remain firm or loyal to something (Acts 11:23).

THAYER.pt: Continuar a residir em um local ou manter-se firme em uma associação, lealdade ou atividade. 1. Permanecer ou continuar junto a alguém (Mt 15:32). | 2. Permanecer firme ou leal a algo (At 11:23).
THAYER.en: To continue to reside in a location or to remain firm in an association, loyalty, or activity. 1. To remain or continue with someone (Matt 15:32). | 2. To remain firm or loyal to something (Acts 11:23).

DEFINITION: To steer a vessel toward the coast to dock or anchor it in the harbor.
SENSES: 1. To lead a boat to the shore or harbor for anchoring (Mark 6:53).

THAYER.pt: Dirigir uma embarcação em direção à costa para atracá-la ou ancorá-la no porto. 1. Conduzir um barco até a margem ou porto para ancoragem (Mc 6.53).
THAYER.en: To steer a vessel toward the coast to dock or anchor it in the harbor. 1. To lead a boat to the shore or harbor for anchoring (Mark 6:53).

SHORT_GLOSS: to owe more, to owe additionally
DEFINITION: Indicates an additional debt or obligation owed to someone, beyond others already existing.
SENSES: 1. To be in additional debt or to owe something more as an obligation (Phlm 19).
USAGE: to owe more, to owe additionally

THAYER.pt: Indica uma dívida ou obrigação adicional que se tem para com alguém, além de outras já existentes. 1. Estar em dívida adicional ou dever algo a mais como obrigação (Fm 19).
THAYER.en: Indicates an additional debt or obligation owed to someone, beyond others already existing. 1. To be in additional debt or to owe something more as an obligation (Phlm 19).

SHORT_GLOSS: to be irritated with, to loathe
DEFINITION: Expresses strong irritation, displeasure, or deep indignation provoked by someone's actions.
SENSES: 1. To be irritated or indignant against someone (Heb 3:10, 17).
USAGE: to be irritated with, to loathe

THAYER.pt: Expressa forte irritação, desgosto ou indignação profunda provocada pelas ações de alguém. 1. Irritar-se ou indignar-se contra alguém (Hb 3.10, 17).
THAYER.en: Expresses strong irritation, displeasure, or deep indignation provoked by someone's actions. 1. To be irritated or indignant against someone (Heb 3:10, 17).

DEFINITION: Describes a physical state of strong need for food, intense hunger.
SENSES: 1. To be very hungry or famished (Acts 10:10).

THAYER.pt: Descreve um estado físico de forte necessidade de alimento, fome intensa. 1. Estar com muita fome ou faminto (At 10.10).
THAYER.en: Describes a physical state of strong need for food, intense hunger. 1. To be very hungry or famished (Acts 10:10).

DEFINITION: To fix something by nailing it firmly, specifically referring to the torture of crucifixion.
SENSES: 1. To nail or fix to a cross for execution (Acts 2:23).

THAYER.pt: Fixar algo cravando-o de modo firme, especificamente referido ao suplício da crucificação. 1. Pregar ou fixar a uma cruz para execução (At 2.23).
THAYER.en: To fix something by nailing it firmly, specifically referring to the torture of crucifixion. 1. To nail or fix to a cross for execution (Acts 2:23).

SHORT_GLOSS: to prostrate, to fall, to throw
DEFINITION: To prostrate oneself at someone's feet as a sign of deep reverence, supplication, or worship, or to collide violently against something.
SENSES: 1. To prostrate oneself or fall at someone's feet as a sign of supplication or worship (Mark 3:11; Luke 8:28).
2. To burst or collide with force against an object (Matt 7:25).
USAGE: to prostrate, to fall, to throw

THAYER.pt: Prostrar-se aos pés de alguém em sinal de profunda reverência, súplica ou adoração, ou chocar-se violentamente contra algo. 1. Prostrar-se ou cair aos pés de alguém em sinal de súplica ou adoração (Mc 3:11; Lk 8:28). | 2. Irromper ou chocar-se com força contra um objeto (Mt 7:25).
THAYER.en: To prostrate oneself at someone's feet as a sign of deep reverence, supplication, or worship, or to collide violently against something. 1. To prostrate oneself or fall at someone's feet as a sign of supplication or worship (Mark 3:11; Luke 8:28). | 2. To burst or collide with force against an object (Matt 7:25).

SHORT_GLOSS: to pretend, to feign, to simulate
DEFINITION: To act in a way that gives a false impression about one's own intention or to simulate a situation.
SENSES: 1. To pretend or feign intentions different from reality (Luke 24:28).
USAGE: to pretend, to feign, to simulate

THAYER.pt: Agir de maneira a dar uma falsa impressão sobre a própria intenção ou simular uma situação. 1. Fingir ou aparentar intenções diferentes da realidade (Lc 24.28).
THAYER.en: To act in a way that gives a false impression about one's own intention or to simulate a situation. 1. To pretend or feign intentions different from reality (Luke 24:28).

DEFINITION: To move toward a reference point or to draw near to someone.
SENSES: 1. To approach someone with a specific purpose (Mark 10:35).

THAYER.pt: Mover-se em direção a um ponto de referência ou aproximar-se de alguém. 1. Aproximar-se de alguém com um propósito específico (Mc 10.35).
THAYER.en: To move toward a reference point or to draw near to someone. 1. To approach someone with a specific purpose (Mark 10:35).

SHORT_GLOSS: to beat against, to collide, to strike
DEFINITION: Indicates the action of striking or colliding with force against an obstacle, such as waves beating against a building.
SENSES: 1. To beat or collide with violence against something (Luke 6:48, 49).
USAGE: to beat against, to collide, to strike

THAYER.pt: Indica a ação de golpear ou chocar-se com força contra um obstáculo, como ondas batendo em uma construção. 1. Bater ou chocar-se com violência contra algo (Lc 6.48, 49).
THAYER.en: Indicates the action of striking or colliding with force against an obstacle, such as waves beating against a building. 1. To beat or collide with violence against something (Luke 6:48, 49).

SHORT_GLOSS: to order, to command, to prescribe
DEFINITION: To issue an official directive, order, or detailed instruction regarding what must be done.
SENSES: 1. To give orders or instructions authoritatively (Matt 1:24; Acts 10:33).
USAGE: to order, to command, to prescribe

THAYER.pt: Emitir uma diretriz oficial, ordem ou instrução detalhada sobre o que deve ser feito. 1. Dar ordens ou instruções de forma autoritativa (Mt 1:24; At 10:33).
THAYER.en: To issue an official directive, order, or detailed instruction regarding what must be done. 1. To give orders or instructions authoritatively (Matt 1:24; Acts 10:33).

DEFINITION: A woman who plays a role of support, aid, or patronage on behalf of individuals or a community.
SENSES: 1. A benefactor, protector, or helper of many in the Christian community (Rom 16:2).

THAYER.pt: Mulher que exerce um papel de amparo, auxílio ou patrocínio em favor de indivíduos ou de uma comunidade. 1. Benfeitora, protetora ou auxiliadora de muitos na comunidade cristã (Rm 16.2).
THAYER.en: A woman who plays a role of support, aid, or patronage on behalf of individuals or a community. 1. A benefactor, protector, or helper of many in the Christian community (Rom 16:2).

SHORT_GLOSS: to add, to increase, to give more
DEFINITION: To join something to an already existing element, to increase a quantity, or to associate people with a group. Under strong Semitic influence, it is also used with an infinitive to indicate the repetition of an action ("to do again").
SENSES: 1. To add or append something to a pre-existing quantity (Gal 3:19).
2. To join or associate people with an already formed group (Acts 2:47).
3. To provide, grant, or give additional benefits (Luke 17:5).
USAGE: to add, to increase, to give more

THAYER.pt: Significa juntar algo a um elemento já existente, aumentar uma quantidade ou associar pessoas a um grupo. Sob forte influência semítica, também é usado com um infinitivo para indicar a repetição de uma ação ("fazer novamente"). 1. Adicionar ou acrescentar algo a uma quantidade pré-existente (Gl 3.19). | 2. Juntar ou associar pessoas a um grupo já formado (At 2.47). | 3. Prover, conceder ou dar benefícios adicionais (Lc 17.5).
THAYER.en: To join something to an already existing element, to increase a quantity, or to associate people with a group. Under strong Semitic influence, it is also used with an infinitive to indicate the repetition of an action ("to do again"). 1. To add or append something to a pre-existing quantity (Gal 3:19). | 2. To join or associate people with an already formed group (Acts 2:47). | 3. To provide, grant, or give additional benefits (Luke 17:5).

DEFINITION: To move quickly by running in the direction of someone to approach them.
SENSES: 1. To run to someone or go hurriedly to meet them (Mark 9:15; 10:17; Acts 8:30).

THAYER.pt: Significa mover-se rapidamente correndo na direção de alguém para se aproximar. 1. Correr para junto de alguém ou ir apressadamente ao seu encontro (Mc 9.15; 10.17; At 8.30).
THAYER.en: To move quickly by running in the direction of someone to approach them. 1. To run to someone or go hurriedly to meet them (Mark 9:15; 10:17; Acts 8:30).

DEFINITION: A term designating food consumed along with bread, specifically fish.
SENSES: 1. Food consumed with bread, specifically fish (John 21:5).

THAYER.pt: Termo que designa o alimento consumido junto com o pão, especificamente peixe. 1. Alimento consumido com o pão, especificamente peixe (Jo 21.5).
THAYER.en: A term designating food consumed along with bread, specifically fish. 1. Food consumed with bread, specifically fish (John 21:5).

DEFINITION: Belonging to what is recent, new, or that did not previously exist in such a way.
SENSES: 1. New, recent, or not previously existing, such as the spiritual way inaugurated by Christ (Heb 10:20).

THAYER.pt: Pertencente ao que é recente, novo ou que não existia anteriormente de tal forma. 1. Novo, recente ou não existente previamente, como o caminho espiritual inaugurado por Cristo (Hb 10.20).
THAYER.en: Belonging to what is recent, new, or that did not previously exist in such a way. 1. New, recent, or not previously existing, such as the spiritual way inaugurated by Christ (Heb 10:20).

DEFINITION: Indicates that an event occurred at a point in time very close to the present or to another event.
SENSES: 1. Recently or a short time ago (Acts 18:2).

THAYER.pt: Indica que um evento ocorreu em um ponto do tempo muito próximo ao presente ou a outro evento. 1. Recentemente ou há pouco tempo (At 18.2).
THAYER.en: Indicates that an event occurred at a point in time very close to the present or to another event. 1. Recently or a short time ago (Acts 18:2).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: προσοίσω, Aor: προσήνεγκον/προσήνεγκα, Perf: προσενήνοχα
SHORT_GLOSS: to offer, to present, to bring
DEFINITION: To lead or bring something into someone's presence, standing out in biblical literature as the solemn act of presenting offerings, gifts, and ritual sacrifices to God.
SENSES: 1. To bring, lead, or conduct sick people or children to someone (Matt 4:24; 19:13).
2. To formally offer gifts, tributes, and presents (Matt 2:11; 22:19).
3. To present cultic sacrifices to God in a priestly context (Heb 9:14; 10:1; 11:4).
4. In the middle voice: to behave, treat, or deal with someone (Heb 12:7).
USAGE: to offer, to present, to bring

THAYER.pt: Conduzir ou levar algo até a presença de alguém, destacando-se na literatura bíblica como o ato solene de apresentar ofertas, dádivas e sacrifícios rituais a Deus. 1. Trazer, levar ou conduzir pessoas enfermas ou crianças a alguém (Mt 4.24; 19.13). | 2. Oferecer formalmente dádivas, tributos e presentes (Mt 2.11; 22.19). | 3. Apresentar sacrifícios cultuais a Deus no contexto sacerdotal (Hb 9.14; 10.1; 11.4). | 4. Na voz média: portar-se, tratar ou lidar com alguém (Hb 12.7).
THAYER.en: To lead or bring something into someone's presence, standing out in biblical literature as the solemn act of presenting offerings, gifts, and ritual sacrifices to God. 1. To bring, lead, or conduct sick people or children to someone (Matt 4:24; 19:13). | 2. To formally offer gifts, tributes, and presents (Matt 2:11; 22:19). | 3. To present cultic sacrifices to God in a priestly context (Heb 9:14; 10:1; 11:4). | 4. In the middle voice: to behave, treat, or deal with someone (Heb 12:7).

DEFINITION: Describes that which awakens affection, pleasure, or delight, being morally beautiful or estimable.
SENSES: 1. That which is lovely, pleasant, or worthy of moral appreciation (Phil 4:8).

THAYER.pt: Descreve aquilo que desperta afeição, agrado ou prazer, sendo moralmente belo ou estimável. 1. Aquilo que é amável, agradável ou digno de apreço moral (Fp 4.8).
THAYER.en: Describes that which awakens affection, pleasure, or delight, being morally beautiful or estimable. 1. That which is lovely, pleasant, or worthy of moral appreciation (Phil 4:8).

DEFINITION: Refers to the act of presenting something to God as an expression of devotion, as well as the object or sacrifice offered.
SENSES: 1. The act of presenting an offering or sacrifice to God (Heb 10:10; Acts 24:17).
2. The sacrifice or gift that is offered (Eph 5:2; Heb 10:5).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se ao ato de apresentar algo a Deus como expressão de devoção, bem como ao objeto ou sacrifício oferecido. 1. O ato de apresentar uma oferta ou sacrifício a Deus (Hb 10.10; At 24.17). | 2. O sacrifício ou dádiva que é ofertado (Ef 5.2; Hb 10.5).
THAYER.en: Refers to the act of presenting something to God as an expression of devotion, as well as the object or sacrifice offered. 1. The act of presenting an offering or sacrifice to God (Heb 10:10; Acts 24:17). | 2. The sacrifice or gift that is offered (Eph 5:2; Heb 10:5).

DEFINITION: To address someone in a loud voice, seeking to call attention or establish verbal contact.
SENSES: 1. To call or speak directly to someone (Acts 22:2).
2. To call to oneself, to summon (Luke 6:13).

THAYER.pt: Dirigir a palavra a alguém em voz alta, buscando chamar a atenção ou estabelecer contato verbal. 1. Chamar ou falar diretamente a alguém (At 22:2). | 2. Chamar para perto de si, convocar (Lc 6:13).
THAYER.en: To address someone in a loud voice, seeking to call attention or establish verbal contact. 1. To call or speak directly to someone (Acts 22:2). | 2. To call to oneself, to summon (Luke 6:13).

DEFINITION: Refers to the act of sprinkling or pouring a liquid over something, especially in ritual contexts of purification.
SENSES: 1. The action of sprinkling blood or liquid in a sacred rite (Heb 11:28).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se ao ato de aspergir ou derramar um líquido sobre algo, especialmente em contextos rituais de purificação. 1. A ação de aspergir sangue ou líquido em um rito sagrado (Hb 11.28).
THAYER.en: Refers to the act of sprinkling or pouring a liquid over something, especially in ritual contexts of purification. 1. The action of sprinkling blood or liquid in a sacred rite (Heb 11:28).

DEFINITION: To touch lightly upon something, generally making contact with the fingers or hands.
SENSES: 1. To touch slightly or lightly someone or something (Lk 11.46).

THAYER.pt: Significa tocar levemente em algo, geralmente fazendo contato com os dedos ou com as mãos. 1. Tocar levemente ou de leve em alguém ou algo (Lc 11.46).
THAYER.en: To touch lightly upon something, generally making contact with the fingers or hands. 1. To touch slightly or lightly someone or something (Lk 11.46).

DEFINITION: Indicates the attitude of unjustly favoring someone based on appearance, status, or partiality.
SENSES: 1. To treat people with partiality or unjust favoritism.

THAYER.pt: Indica a atitude de favorecer injustamente alguém com base em aparência, status ou parcialidade. 1. Tratar pessoas com parcialidade ou favoritismo injusto.
THAYER.en: Indicates the attitude of unjustly favoring someone based on appearance, status, or partiality. 1. To treat people with partiality or unjust favoritism.

DEFINITION: One who judges or treats people based on external appearances, status, or favoritism.
SENSES: 1. A person who shows partiality or demonstrates favoritism.

THAYER.pt: Aquele que julga ou trata as pessoas com base em aparências externas, status ou favoritismo. 1. Pessoa que faz acepção de pessoas ou demonstra parcialidade.
THAYER.en: One who judges or treats people based on external appearances, status, or favoritism. 1. A person who shows partiality or demonstrates favoritism.

DEFINITION: The attitude of judging or treating people with favoritism based on their appearance, status, or origin, rather than their true worth.
SENSES: 1. Partiality or unjust favoritism in dealing with people (Jas 2.1).

THAYER.pt: Atitude de julgar ou tratar as pessoas com favoritismo com base em sua aparência, status ou origem, em vez de seu verdadeiro valor. 1. Partialidade ou favoritismo injusto no trato com as pessoas (Tg 2.1).
THAYER.en: The attitude of judging or treating people with favoritism based on their appearance, status, or origin, rather than their true worth. 1. Partiality or unjust favoritism in dealing with people (Jas 2.1).

DEFINITION: The visible human face or facial expression; by extension, denotes direct personal presence, outward appearance, and the surface of created things.
SENSES: 1. Human face or countenance (Mt 6.17; Mt 17.2; 2Co 3.13).
2. Direct physical presence of a person: face to face (Acts 20.25; 1Th 2.17).
3. Outward appearance or superficial partiality (Mt 22.16; Lk 20.21; 2Co 10.7).
4. Surface of the earth or heaven (Lk 12.56; Lk 21.35).

THAYER.pt: A face visível humana ou expressão fisionômica; por extensão, denota a presença pessoal direta, aparência exterior e a superfície de coisas criadas. 1. Rosto humano ou semblante (Mt 6.17; Mt 17.2; 2Co 3.13). | 2. Presença física direta de uma pessoa: face a face (At 20.25; 1Ts 2.17). | 3. Aparência exterior ou parcialidade superficial (Mt 22.16; Lk 20.21; 2Co 10.7). | 4. Superfície da terra ou do céu (Lc 12.56; Lc 21.35).
THAYER.en: The visible human face or facial expression; by extension, denotes direct personal presence, outward appearance, and the surface of created things. 1. Human face or countenance (Mt 6.17; Mt 17.2; 2Co 3.13). | 2. Direct physical presence of a person: face to face (Acts 20.25; 1Th 2.17). | 3. Outward appearance or superficial partiality (Mt 22.16; Lk 20.21; 2Co 10.7). | 4. Surface of the earth or heaven (Lk 12.56; Lk 21.35).

DEFINITION: To arrange, fix, or determine beforehand times, orders, or circumstances.
SENSES: 1. To establish or stipulate beforehand.

THAYER.pt: Arrumar, fixar ou determinar antecipadamente prazos, ordens ou circunstâncias. 1. Estabelecer ou estipular de antemão.
THAYER.en: To arrange, fix, or determine beforehand times, orders, or circumstances. 1. To establish or stipulate beforehand.

DEFINITION: To extend or project something forward, such as body parts or ropes.
SENSES: 1. To stretch out or extend forward (Acts 22.25).

THAYER.pt: Significa estender ou projetar algo para a frente, como os membros do corpo ou cordas. 1. Estender ou esticar para a frente (At 22.25).
THAYER.en: To extend or project something forward, such as body parts or ropes. 1. To stretch out or extend forward (Acts 22.25).

DEFINITION: Denotes a point in time prior to a sequence of events or present situation.
SENSES: 1. At an earlier time, formerly, before (Jn 7.51; 2Co 1.15).

THAYER.pt: Denota um ponto no tempo anterior a uma sequência de eventos ou situação presente. 1. Em tempo anterior, antigamente, antes (Jo 7.51; 2Co 1.15).
THAYER.en: Denotes a point in time prior to a sequence of events or present situation. 1. At an earlier time, formerly, before (Jn 7.51; 2Co 1.15).

DEFINITION: Preceding in time or order; that which came before another event or period.
SENSES: 1. Pertaining to an earlier period in time (Eph 4.22).
2. The use of the neuter (πρότερον) as an adverb indicating 'previously' or 'before' (Jn 6.62).

THAYER.pt: Que precede no tempo ou na ordem; aquilo que veio antes de outro evento ou período. 1. Relativo a um período anterior no tempo (Ef 4:22). | 2. O uso do neutro (πρότερον) como advérbio indicando 'anteriormente' ou 'antes' (Jo 6:62).
THAYER.en: Preceding in time or order; that which came before another event or period. 1. Pertaining to an earlier period in time (Eph 4.22). | 2. The use of the neuter (πρότερον) as an adverb indicating 'previously' or 'before' (Jn 6.62).

DEFINITION: To formulate a purpose, plan, or intention beforehand, or to set forth publicly.
SENSES: 1. To establish a plan or purpose within oneself (Rom 1.13; Eph 1.9).

THAYER.pt: Formular um propósito, plano ou intenção com antecedência, ou apresentar publicamente. 1. Estabelecer um plano ou propósito em si mesmo (Rm 1.13; Ef 1.9).
THAYER.en: To formulate a purpose, plan, or intention beforehand, or to set forth publicly. 1. To establish a plan or purpose within oneself (Rom 1.13; Eph 1.9).

DEFINITION: To stimulate someone to follow a certain course of action through encouragement or persuasion.
SENSES: 1. To urge or encourage someone to perform an action.

THAYER.pt: Estimular alguém a seguir um determinado curso de ação por meio de encorajamento ou persuasão. 1. Instigar ou encorajar alguém a realizar uma ação.
THAYER.en: To stimulate someone to follow a certain course of action through encouragement or persuasion. 1. To urge or encourage someone to perform an action.

DEFINITION: To run ahead of others in order to arrive first at a destination.
SENSES: 1. To run on ahead or outrun by running (Jn 20.4).

THAYER.pt: Significa correr na frente de outros para chegar primeiro a um destino. 1. Correr adiante ou ultrapassar correndo (Jo 20.4).
THAYER.en: To run ahead of others in order to arrive first at a destination. 1. To run on ahead or outrun by running (Jn 20.4).

DEFINITION: Describes previous existence or the fact that something or someone already existed prior to a temporal point of reference.
SENSES: 1. To exist previously or before other events (Lk 23.12; Acts 8.9).

THAYER.pt: Descreve a existência prévia ou o fato de algo ou alguém já existir antes de um ponto temporal de referência. 1. Existir previamente ou antes de outros acontecimentos (Lc 23.12; At 8.9).
THAYER.en: Describes previous existence or the fact that something or someone already existed prior to a temporal point of reference. 1. To exist previously or before other events (Lk 23.12; Acts 8.9).

DEFINITION: The reason presented to justify an action, which may be a true motive or a false pretense to conceal the real intention.
SENSES: 1. Legitimate motive or real justification (Jn 15.22).
2. False pretense or outward excuse (Phil 1.18; Mk 12.40).

THAYER.pt: A razão apresentada para justificar uma ação, podendo ser um motivo verdadeiro ou um pretexto falso para ocultar a verdadeira intenção. 1. Motivo legítimo ou justificativa real (Jo 15:22). | 2. Pretexto falso ou desculpa ostensiva (Fp 1:18; Mc 12:40).
THAYER.en: The reason presented to justify an action, which may be a true motive or a false pretense to conceal the real intention. 1. Legitimate motive or real justification (Jn 15.22). | 2. False pretense or outward excuse (Phil 1.18; Mk 12.40).

DEFINITION: To bring something out, whether by producing fruit or expressing what is stored within.
SENSES: 1. To produce or bring to light good or bad things from the heart (Lk 6.45).

THAYER.pt: Significa trazer algo para fora, seja produzindo frutos ou expressando o que está armazenado no interior. 1. Produzir ou trazer à tona coisas boas ou más do coração (Lc 6.45).
THAYER.en: To bring something out, whether by producing fruit or expressing what is stored within. 1. To produce or bring to light good or bad things from the heart (Lk 6.45).

DEFINITION: The inspired proclamation or revelation of God's will and purposes communicated to human beings.
SENSES: 1. The activity or gift of interpreting and transmitting the divine message (1Th 5.20; Rev 11.6).
2. The specific prophetic message uttered under inspiration (Mt 13.14; 1Co 14.6).

THAYER.pt: A proclamação ou revelação inspirada da vontade e dos propósitos de Deus comunicada aos seres humanos. 1. A atividade ou o dom de interpretar e transmitir a mensagem divina (1Ts 5.20; Ap 11.6). | 2. A mensagem profética específica proferida sob inspiração (Mt 13.14; 1Co 14.6).
THAYER.en: The inspired proclamation or revelation of God's will and purposes communicated to human beings. 1. The activity or gift of interpreting and transmitting the divine message (1Th 5.20; Rev 11.6). | 2. The specific prophetic message uttered under inspiration (Mt 13.14; 1Co 14.6).

DEFINITION: To speak under the direct influence of divine inspiration, conveying spiritual revelations, exhortations, or revealing future events.
SENSES: 1. To proclaim a revelation inspired by God, to prophesy (Mt 7.22; Acts 2.17).
2. To reveal something hidden from human perception (Mt 26.68).
3. To predict future events (Mt 15.7).

THAYER.pt: Falar sob a direta influência da inspiração divina, transmitindo revelações espirituais, exortações ou revelando eventos futuros. 1. Proclamar uma revelação inspirada por Deus, profetizar (Mt 7.22; At 2.17). | 2. Revelar algo oculto à percepção humana (Mt 26.68). | 3. Predizer acontecimentos futuros (Mt 15.7).
THAYER.en: To speak under the direct influence of divine inspiration, conveying spiritual revelations, exhortations, or revealing future events. 1. To proclaim a revelation inspired by God, to prophesy (Mt 7.22; Acts 2.17). | 2. To reveal something hidden from human perception (Mt 26.68). | 3. To predict future events (Mt 15.7).

DEFINITION: An inspired proclaimer and spokesperson for the will and sovereign purposes of God. It encompasses Old Testament spokespersons, inaugural figures like John the Baptist and Jesus, the authors of the sacred books, and charismatic leaders of the early church.
SENSES: 1. Inspired spokesperson and messenger of God (Mt 1.22; Lk 1.70).
2. John the Baptist and Jesus Himself in His prophetic office (Mt 21.11; Lk 7.16).
3. Early church minister empowered by the Holy Spirit (Acts 11.27; 1Co 12.28).
4. Metonymy for the prophetic section of the Old Testament canon (Mt 5.17; Lk 24.27).

THAYER.pt: Proclamador inspirado e porta-voz da vontade e dos desígnios soberanos de Deus. Abrange os porta-vozes do Antigo Testamento, figuras inaugurais como João Batista e Jesus, os autores dos livros sagrados e líderes carismáticos da Igreja primitiva. 1. Porta-voz inspirado e mensageiro de Deus (Mt 1.22; Lc 1.70). | 2. João Batista e o próprio Jesus em seu ofício profético (Mt 21.11; Lc 7.16). | 3. Ministro da igreja primitiva capacitado pelo Espírito Santo (At 11.27; 1Co 12.28). | 4. Metonímia para a seção profética do cânon veterotestamentário (Mt 5.17; Lc 24.27).
THAYER.en: An inspired proclaimer and spokesperson for the will and sovereign purposes of God. It encompasses Old Testament spokespersons, inaugural figures like John the Baptist and Jesus, the authors of the sacred books, and charismatic leaders of the early church. 1. Inspired spokesperson and messenger of God (Mt 1.22; Lk 1.70). | 2. John the Baptist and Jesus Himself in His prophetic office (Mt 21.11; Lk 7.16). | 3. Early church minister empowered by the Holy Spirit (Acts 11.27; 1Co 12.28). | 4. Metonymy for the prophetic section of the Old Testament canon (Mt 5.17; Lk 24.27).

DEFINITION: Pertaining to divine inspiration and the communication of God's will transmitted by the prophets.
SENSES: 1. Pertaining to the writings or inspired message of the prophets (Rom 16.26; 2Pet 1.19).

THAYER.pt: Pertinente à inspiração divina e à comunicação da vontade de Deus transmitida pelos profetas. 1. Relativo aos escritos ou à mensagem inspirada dos profetas (Rm 16.26; 2Pe 1.19).
THAYER.en: Pertaining to divine inspiration and the communication of God's will transmitted by the prophets. 1. Pertaining to the writings or inspired message of the prophets (Rom 16.26; 2Pet 1.19).

DEFINITION: A woman who proclaims messages inspired by God or acts as a spokesperson for divine revelation.
SENSES: 1. A woman endowed with divine inspiration to prophesy (Lk 2.36; Rev 2.20).

THAYER.pt: Mulher que proclama mensagens inspiradas por Deus ou atua como porta-voz da revelação divina. 1. Uma mulher dotada de inspiração divina para profetizar (Lc 2.36; Ap 2.20).
THAYER.en: A woman who proclaims messages inspired by God or acts as a spokesperson for divine revelation. 1. A woman endowed with divine inspiration to prophesy (Lk 2.36; Rev 2.20).

DEFINITION: To arrive earlier or act before someone else, taking the temporal initiative.
SENSES: 1. To get ahead of someone or act beforehand (Matt 17:25).

THAYER.pt: Chegar antes ou agir antes de outra pessoa, tomando a iniciativa temporal. 1. Estar à frente de alguém ou agir antes (Mt 17.25).
THAYER.en: To arrive earlier or act before someone else, taking the temporal initiative. 1. To get ahead of someone or act beforehand (Matt 17:25).

DEFINITION: To choose or select someone in advance for a specific role or purpose.
SENSES: 1. To designate or choose beforehand for a special task (Acts 3:20; 22:14).

THAYER.pt: Escolher ou selecionar antecipadamente alguém para uma função ou propósito específico. 1. Designar ou escolher com antecedência para uma tarefa especial (At 3.20; 22.14).
THAYER.en: To choose or select someone in advance for a specific role or purpose. 1. To designate or choose beforehand for a special task (Acts 3:20; 22:14).

DEFINITION: To designate or choose previously someone for a specific role or purpose.
SENSES: 1. To choose or point out beforehand (Acts 10:41).

THAYER.pt: Designar ou escolher previamente alguém para uma função ou propósito específico. 1. Escolher ou apontar de antemão (At 10.41).
THAYER.en: To designate or choose previously someone for a specific role or purpose. 1. To choose or point out beforehand (Acts 10:41).

DEFINITION: Proper name of a man, one of the seven deacons chosen by the church in Jerusalem.
SENSES: 1. Prochorus, one of the seven helpers of the early church in Jerusalem (Acts 6:5).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio de um homem, um dos sete diáconos escolhidos pela igreja em Jerusalém. 1. Prócoro, um dos sete auxiliares da igreja primitiva em Jerusalém (At 6.5).
THAYER.en: Proper name of a man, one of the seven deacons chosen by the church in Jerusalem. 1. Prochorus, one of the seven helpers of the early church in Jerusalem (Acts 6:5).

DEFINITION: The rear part or stern of a vessel.
SENSES: 1. The stern of a boat (Mark 4:38; Acts 27:29).

THAYER.pt: A parte traseira ou popa de uma embarcação. 1. A popa de um barco (Mc 4.38; At 27.29).
THAYER.en: The rear part or stern of a vessel. 1. The stern of a boat (Mark 4:38; Acts 27:29).

DEFINITION: Adverb denoting the initial period of the day, corresponding to the early morning hours.
SENSES: 1. At the beginning of the daytime period, in the early hours of the morning (Matt 16:3; Mark 15:1).
