THAYER.pt: Advérbio que denota o período inicial do dia, correspondendo às primeiras horas da manhã. 1. No início do período diurno, nas primeiras horas da manhã (Mt 16.3; Mc 15.1).
THAYER.en: Adverb denoting the initial period of the day, corresponding to the early morning hours. 1. At the beginning of the daytime period, in the early hours of the morning (Matt 16:3; Mark 15:1).

DEFINITION: Designates the initial period of the day, corresponding to the early morning hours.
SENSES: 1. The beginning of the day or dawn (Matt 21:18; 27:1).

THAYER.pt: Designa o período inicial do dia, correspondente às primeiras horas da manhã. 1. O início do dia ou a madrugada (Mt 21.18; 27.1).
THAYER.en: Designates the initial period of the day, corresponding to the early morning hours. 1. The beginning of the day or dawn (Matt 21:18; 27:1).

DEFINITION: Refers to what occurs at the beginning of the appropriate season, especially the early rains.
SENSES: 1. Pertaining to the first rain of the agricultural season.

THAYER.pt: Refere-se ao que ocorre no início da estação apropriada, especialmente às chuvas temporãs. 1. Relativo à primeira chuva da estação agrícola.
THAYER.en: Refers to what occurs at the beginning of the appropriate season, especially the early rains. 1. Pertaining to the first rain of the agricultural season.

DEFINITION: Belonging or pertaining to the early morning.
SENSES: 1. Pertaining to the morning or dawn period (Rev 2:28).

THAYER.pt: Pertencente ou relativo ao início da manhã. 1. Que pertence ao período da manhã ou alvorada (Ap 2.28).
THAYER.en: Belonging or pertaining to the early morning. 1. Pertaining to the morning or dawn period (Rev 2:28).

DEFINITION: The front or forward part of a vessel.
SENSES: 1. The bow or front of a ship (Acts 27:30).

THAYER.pt: A parte dianteira ou frontal de uma embarcação. 1. A proa ou frente de um navio (At 27.30).
THAYER.en: The front or forward part of a vessel. 1. The bow or front of a ship (Acts 27:30).

DEFINITION: To occupy the highest position of honor, authority, or prominence in a group.
SENSES: 1. To hold first place or supreme authority (Col 1:18).

THAYER.pt: Ocupar a mais alta posição de honra, autoridade ou destaque em um grupo. 1. Deter o primeiro lugar ou a suprema autoridade (Cl 1.18).
THAYER.en: To occupy the highest position of honor, authority, or prominence in a group. 1. To hold first place or supreme authority (Col 1:18).

DEFINITION: The occupation of the most prominent or honorable seat in assemblies, indicating high social or religious status.
SENSES: 1. The place of honor or the principal seat reserved for authorities (Matt 23:6).

THAYER.pt: Ocupação do assento mais proeminente ou honroso em assembleias, indicando alto status social ou religioso. 1. O lugar de honra ou o assento principal reservado a autoridades (Mt 23.6).
THAYER.en: The occupation of the most prominent or honorable seat in assemblies, indicating high social or religious status. 1. The place of honor or the principal seat reserved for authorities (Matt 23:6).

DEFINITION: The place or seat of greatest honor and prestige at table during banquets, reserved for the most important guests.
SENSES: 1. The principal seat of honor beside the host at banquets (Matt 23:6; Luke 14:7).

THAYER.pt: O lugar ou assento de maior honra e prestígio à mesa em banquetes, reservado aos convidados mais importantes. 1. O assento principal de honra ao lado do anfitrião em banquetes (Mt 23:6; Lc 14:7).
THAYER.en: The place or seat of greatest honor and prestige at table during banquets, reserved for the most important guests. 1. The principal seat of honor beside the host at banquets (Matt 23:6; Luke 14:7).

DEFINITION: Indicates temporal, positional, or importance priority in a sequence of events or actions.
SENSES: 1. First in time or in an order of succession (Matt 6:33; 8:21).
2. Previously, formerly (John 12:16).

THAYER.pt: Indica prioridade temporal, posicional ou de importância em uma sequência de eventos ou ações. 1. Em primeiro lugar no tempo ou em uma ordem de sucessão (Mt 6.33; 8.21). | 2. Anteriormente, outrora (Jo 12.16).
THAYER.en: Indicates temporal, positional, or importance priority in a sequence of events or actions. 1. First in time or in an order of succession (Matt 6:33; 8:21). | 2. Previously, formerly (John 12:16).

DEFINITION: Indicates priority in a numerical, temporal, or spatial sequence; in a comparative and qualitative sense, denotes primacy of hierarchy, importance, or dignity.
SENSES: 1. First in temporal succession, numerical or chronological series (Acts 1:1; 1 Cor 15:45).
2. First in honor, degree of prominence, nobility, or influence (Matt 20:27; Mark 12:28).
3. Neuter adverbial (πρῶτον): primarily, first of all, before everything else (Matt 6:33; Rom 1:16).

THAYER.pt: Indica anterioridade em uma sequência numérica, temporal ou espacial; em sentido comparativo e qualitativo, denota primazia de hierarquia, importância ou dignidade. 1. Primeiro em sucessão temporal, série numérica ou cronológica (At 1.1; 1Co 15.45). | 2. Primeiro em honra, grau de preeminência, nobreza ou influência (Mt 20.27; Mc 12.28). | 3. Adverbial neutro (πρῶτον): primariamente, primeiramente, antes de tudo (Mt 6.33; Rm 1.16).
THAYER.en: Indicates priority in a numerical, temporal, or spatial sequence; in a comparative and qualitative sense, denotes primacy of hierarchy, importance, or dignity. 1. First in temporal succession, numerical or chronological series (Acts 1:1; 1 Cor 15:45). | 2. First in honor, degree of prominence, nobility, or influence (Matt 20:27; Mark 12:28). | 3. Neuter adverbial (πρῶτον): primarily, first of all, before everything else (Matt 6:33; Rom 1:16).

DEFINITION: One who occupies the position of vanguard or leadership, often with the meaning of leader of a group or movement.
SENSES: 1. Chief, leader, or main instigator of a group (Acts 24:5).

THAYER.pt: Aquele que ocupa a posição de vanguarda ou liderança, muitas vezes com acepção de líder de um grupo ou movimento. 1. Chefe, líder ou principal instigador de um grupo (At 24.5).
THAYER.en: One who occupies the position of vanguard or leadership, often with the meaning of leader of a group or movement. 1. Chief, leader, or main instigator of a group (Acts 24:5).

DEFINITION: The special privileges and rights reserved for the eldest son in the ancient family structure.
SENSES: 1. The legal and social rights inherent to birthright (Heb 12:16).

THAYER.pt: Os privilégios e direitos especiais reservados ao filho mais velho na estrutura familiar antiga. 1. Os direitos legais e sociais inerentes à primogenitura (Hb 12.16).
THAYER.en: The special privileges and rights reserved for the eldest son in the ancient family structure. 1. The legal and social rights inherent to birthright (Heb 12:16).

DEFINITION: The first child born in a family, possessing by extension special rights, privileges, and prominence of status or temporal precedence.
SENSES: 1. The firstborn son in birth order (Luke 2:7).
2. He who possesses supreme preeminence, supremacy, and exalted status, applied to Christ (Col 1:15, 18; Rom 8:29).

THAYER.pt: O primeiro filho a nascer em uma família, possuindo por extensão direitos, privilégios especiais e proeminência de status ou precedência temporal. 1. O filho primogênito em ordem de nascimento (Lc 2:7). | 2. Aquele que possui preeminência suprema, supremacia e status exaltado, aplicado a Cristo (Cl 1:15,18; Rm 8:29).
THAYER.en: The first child born in a family, possessing by extension special rights, privileges, and prominence of status or temporal precedence. 1. The firstborn son in birth order (Luke 2:7). | 2. He who possesses supreme preeminence, supremacy, and exalted status, applied to Christ (Col 1:15, 18; Rom 8:29).

SEMANTIC_FIELD: Ethics and Morality, Flaw and Sin
DEFINITION: To lose physical balance or, metaphorically, to commit a moral failure, transgress a norm, or sin.
SENSES: 1. To stumble physically or lose one's footing;
2. To fail morally, commit an error, or transgress the divine law (Jas 3:2; Rom 11:11).

THAYER.pt: Perder o equilíbrio físico ou, em sentido figurado, cometer uma falha moral, transgredir uma norma ou pecar. 1. Tropeçar fisicamente ou perder o passo; | 2. Falhar moralmente, cometer erro ou transgredir a lei divina (Tg 3:2; Rm 11:11).
THAYER.en: To lose physical balance or, metaphorically, to commit a moral failure, transgress a norm, or sin. 1. To stumble physically or lose one's footing; | 2. To fail morally, commit an error, or transgress the divine law (Jas 3:2; Rom 11:11).

DEFINITION: The rear part of the human foot.
SENSES: 1. The heel of the foot (John 13:18).

THAYER.pt: A parte posterior do pé humano. 1. O calcanhar do pé (Jo 13.18).
THAYER.en: The rear part of the human foot. 1. The heel of the foot (John 13:18).

DEFINITION: A diminutive designating the tip, extremity, or highest point of an architectural structure.
SENSES: 1. The highest point or pinnacle of a building, such as the temple (Matt 4:5; Luke 4:9).

THAYER.pt: Diminutivo que designa a ponta, a extremidade ou o ponto mais alto de uma estrutura arquitetônica. 1. O ponto mais alto ou pináculo de um edifício, como o templo (Mt 4.5; Lc 4.9).
THAYER.en: A diminutive designating the tip, extremity, or highest point of an architectural structure. 1. The highest point or pinnacle of a building, such as the temple (Matt 4:5; Luke 4:9).

DEFINITION: A feathered organ of aerial locomotion found in birds and other flying creatures.
SENSES: 1. The wing of a bird or flying being (Matt 23:37; Rev 12:14).

THAYER.pt: Órgão de locomoção aérea emplumado encontrado em aves e outras criaturas voadoras. 1. A asa de uma ave ou ser voador (Mt 23:37; Ap 12:14).
THAYER.en: A feathered organ of aerial locomotion found in birds and other flying creatures. 1. The wing of a bird or flying being (Matt 23:37; Rev 12:14).

DEFINITION: Possessing wings or feathers; used substantively to designate birds.
SENSES: 1. Creatures endowed with wings, birds (1 Cor 15:39).

THAYER.pt: Que possui asas ou penas; usado substantivamente para designar as aves. 1. Criaturas dotadas de asas, aves (1Co 15.39).
THAYER.en: Possessing wings or feathers; used substantively to designate birds. 1. Creatures endowed with wings, birds (1 Cor 15:39).

DEFINITION: Describes the action of causing deep dread or astonishment in someone, generating a state of sudden alarm or excessive fear.
SENSES: 1. To terrify or frighten someone suddenly (Lk 12:4; 21:9).
2. To be seized with panic or startle (Lk 24:37).

THAYER.pt: Descreve a ação de causar profundo pavor ou espanto em alguém, gerando um estado de alarme repentino ou medo desmedido. 1. Aterrorizar ou amedrontar alguém de forma súbita (Lc 12.4; 21.9). | 2. Ficar tomado de pânico ou sobressalto (Lc 24.37).
THAYER.en: Describes the action of causing deep dread or astonishment in someone, generating a state of sudden alarm or excessive fear. 1. To terrify or frighten someone suddenly (Lk 12:4; 21:9). | 2. To be seized with panic or startle (Lk 24:37).

DEFINITION: A state of strong emotional disturbance, intense fear, or dread in the face of a threat.
SENSES: 1. Sudden fear or paralyzing terror (1Pe 3:6).

THAYER.pt: Estado de forte perturbação emocional, medo intenso ou pavor diante de uma ameaça. 1. Medo repentino ou terror paralisante (1Pe 3.6).
THAYER.en: A state of strong emotional disturbance, intense fear, or dread in the face of a threat. 1. Sudden fear or paralyzing terror (1Pe 3:6).

DEFINITION: Ancient port city on the coast of Phoenicia, known in the Old Testament as Acco.
SENSES: 1. The port city of Ptolemais (Ac 21:7).

THAYER.pt: Antiga cidade portuária na costa da Fenícia, conhecida no Antigo Testamento como Aco. 1. A cidade portuária de Ptolemaida (At 21.7).
THAYER.en: Ancient port city on the coast of Phoenicia, known in the Old Testament as Acco. 1. The port city of Ptolemais (Ac 21:7).

DEFINITION: An agricultural instrument shaped like a shovel or fork used to toss threshed grain up against the wind, thus separating the cereal from the chaff.
SENSES: 1. Winnowing shovel or fork (Mt 3:12; Lk 3:17).

THAYER.pt: Instrumento agrícola em forma de pá ou forquilha usado para jogar o grão malhado ao alto contra o vento, separando assim o cereal da palha. 1. Pá de joeirar ou winnowing (Mt 3.12; Lc 3.17).
THAYER.en: An agricultural instrument shaped like a shovel or fork used to toss threshed grain up against the wind, thus separating the cereal from the chaff. 1. Winnowing shovel or fork (Mt 3:12; Lk 3:17).

DEFINITION: To cause intense dread or to make someone feel intimidated and frightened.
SENSES: 1. To be terribly frightened or intimidated (Php 1:28).

THAYER.pt: Causar intenso pavor ou fazer com que alguém se sinta intimidado e amedrontado. 1. Ficar terrivelmente amedrontado ou intimidado (Fp 1.28).
THAYER.en: To cause intense dread or to make someone feel intimidated and frightened. 1. To be terribly frightened or intimidated (Php 1:28).

DEFINITION: The aqueous fluid secreted by the glands of the mouth.
SENSES: 1. Saliva or spit expelled from the mouth (Jn 9:6).

THAYER.pt: O fluido aquoso secretado pelas glândulas da boca. 1. Saliva ou cuspe expelido pela boca (Jo 9.6).
THAYER.en: The aqueous fluid secreted by the glands of the mouth. 1. Saliva or spit expelled from the mouth (Jn 9:6).

DEFINITION: The act of folding or rolling up a flexible object, such as a scroll of parchment or an ancient book.
SENSES: 1. To roll up or close a manuscript scroll (Lk 4:20).

THAYER.pt: O ato de dobrar ou enrolar um objeto flexível, como um rolo de pergaminho ou livro antigo. 1. Enrolar ou fechar um rolo de manuscrito (Lc 4.20).
THAYER.en: The act of folding or rolling up a flexible object, such as a scroll of parchment or an ancient book. 1. To roll up or close a manuscript scroll (Lk 4:20).

DEFINITION: To expel saliva from the mouth, either as a common physical act or in contexts of healing and rejection in the Gospels.
SENSES: 1. To spit on the ground or upon someone (Mk 7:33; 8:23; Jn 9:6).

THAYER.pt: Eliminar saliva da boca, seja como ato físico comum ou em contextos de cura e rejeição nos Evangelhos. 1. Cuspir no chão ou sobre alguém (Mc 7.33; 8.23; Jo 9.6).
THAYER.en: To expel saliva from the mouth, either as a common physical act or in contexts of healing and rejection in the Gospels. 1. To spit on the ground or upon someone (Mk 7:33; 8:23; Jn 9:6).

DEFINITION: Refers to the lifeless body of a human being or an animal, frequently after a violent death.
SENSES: 1. Corpse or lifeless body (Mt 14:12; Rev 11:8).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se ao corpo sem vida de um ser humano ou de um animal, frequentemente após uma morte violenta. 1. Cadáver ou corpo sem vida (Mt 14:12; Ap 11:8).
THAYER.en: Refers to the lifeless body of a human being or an animal, frequently after a violent death. 1. Corpse or lifeless body (Mt 14:12; Rev 11:8).

DEFINITION: The act or state of falling, which can refer either to the physical collapse of a structure or to the downfall or ruin of a prominent position.
SENSES: 1. Structural fall or collapse, such as that of a house (Mt 7:27).
2. Metaphorical fall in the sense of ruin or political/spiritual downfall (Lk 2:34).

THAYER.pt: O ato ou estado de cair, podendo referir-se tanto ao desabamento físico de uma estrutura quanto à derrocada ou ruína de uma posição de destaque. 1. Queda ou colapso estrutural, como o de uma casa (Mt 7.27). | 2. Queda metafórica no sentido de ruína ou ruína política/espiritual (Lc 2.34).
THAYER.en: The act or state of falling, which can refer either to the physical collapse of a structure or to the downfall or ruin of a prominent position. 1. Structural fall or collapse, such as that of a house (Mt 7:27). | 2. Metaphorical fall in the sense of ruin or political/spiritual downfall (Lk 2:34).

DEFINITION: The state of extreme material lack and absence of resources for subsistence.
SENSES: 1. Poverty or destitution of material goods (2Co 8:2, 9; Rev 2:9).

THAYER.pt: O estado de extrema carência material e falta de recursos de subsistência. 1. Pobreza ou destituição de bens materiais (2Co 8.2, 9; Ap 2.9).
THAYER.en: The state of extreme material lack and absence of resources for subsistence. 1. Poverty or destitution of material goods (2Co 8:2, 9; Rev 2:9).

DEFINITION: To be reduced to a condition of extreme poverty, living as a beggar.
SENSES: 1. To become poor or suffer extreme need (2Co 8:9).

THAYER.pt: Reduzir-se a uma condição de extrema pobreza, vivendo como um mendigo. 1. Tornar-se pobre ou passar necessidade extrema (2Co 8.9).
THAYER.en: To be reduced to a condition of extreme poverty, living as a beggar. 1. To become poor or suffer extreme need (2Co 8:9).

DEFINITION: A person at an extreme economic disadvantage, dependent on the help of others, or spiritually humble before God.
SENSES: 1. Economically disadvantaged, beggar, or extremely poor (Mk 12:42; Lk 6:20).
2. Humble person who trusts entirely in divine resources (Mt 11:5; Lk 4:18).

THAYER.pt: Pessoa em extrema desvantagem econômica, dependente de auxílio alheio, ou espiritualmente humilde diante de Deus. 1. Desfavorecido economicamente, mendigo ou extremamente pobre (Mc 12.42; Lc 6.20). | 2. Humilde que confia inteiramente nos recursos divinos (Mt 11.5; Lc 4.18).
THAYER.en: A person at an extreme economic disadvantage, dependent on the help of others, or spiritually humble before God. 1. Economically disadvantaged, beggar, or extremely poor (Mk 12:42; Lk 6:20). | 2. Humble person who trusts entirely in divine resources (Mt 11:5; Lk 4:18).

DEFINITION: The firmly closed hand; also used in antiquity to indicate a measure of depth in the washing of hands.
SENSES: 1. The closed fist (Mk 7:3).

THAYER.pt: A mão firmemente fechada; também usada na Antiguidade para indicar a medida de profundidade na lavagem das mãos. 1. O punho fechado (Mc 7.3).
THAYER.en: The firmly closed hand; also used in antiquity to indicate a measure of depth in the washing of hands. 1. The closed fist (Mk 7:3).

DEFINITION: Mythological name associated with a serpent and, by extension, an evil spirit of divination and prophecy.
SENSES: 1. Spirit associated with pagan divination or clairvoyance (Ac 16:16).

THAYER.pt: Nome mitológico associado a uma serpente e, por extensão, a um espírito maligno de adivinhação e profecia. 1. Espírito associado à adivinhação ou clarividência pagã (At 16.16).
THAYER.en: Mythological name associated with a serpent and, by extension, an evil spirit of divination and prophecy. 1. Spirit associated with pagan divination or clairvoyance (Ac 16:16).

DEFINITION: Qualifies events or actions that occur repeatedly at short intervals.
SENSES: 1. Frequent or happening many times (1Tm 5:23).

THAYER.pt: Qualifica eventos ou ações que ocorrem repetidamente em intervalos curtos. 1. Frequente ou que acontece muitas vezes (1Tm 5.23).
THAYER.en: Qualifies events or actions that occur repeatedly at short intervals. 1. Frequent or happening many times (1Tm 5:23).

DEFINITION: To practice pugilism, striking blows with the fists in an athletic competition.
SENSES: 1. To fight with the fists or practice boxing (1Co 9:26).

THAYER.pt: Praticar o pugilismo, desferindo golpes com os punhos em uma competição atlética. 1. Lutar com os punhos ou praticar boxe (1Co 9.26).
THAYER.en: To practice pugilism, striking blows with the fists in an athletic competition. 1. To fight with the fists or practice boxing (1Co 9:26).

DEFINITION: Large door or portal used to close and control access to cities, palaces, or properties.
SENSES: 1. Portal or gate of a city or building (Lk 7:12; Ac 9:24).

THAYER.pt: Grande porta ou portal utilizado para fechar e controlar o acesso a cidades, palácios ou propriedades. 1. Portal ou portão de uma cidade ou edifício (Lc 7.12; At 9.24).
THAYER.en: Large door or portal used to close and control access to cities, palaces, or properties. 1. Portal or gate of a city or building (Lk 7:12; Ac 9:24).

DEFINITION: Designates a monumental entrance, gate, or large porch, typically found in palaces, temples, or wealthy residences.
SENSES: 1. Large gate or imposing entrance of a building or city (Ac 14:13; Rev 21:25).
2. Porch or entrance atrium of a house (Mt 26:71).

THAYER.pt: Designa uma entrada monumental, portão ou pórtico de grande porte, tipicamente encontrado em palácios, templos ou residências ricas. 1. Grande portão ou entrada imponente de um edifício ou cidade (At 14.13; Ap 21.25). | 2. Pórtico ou átrio de entrada de uma casa (Mt 26.71).
THAYER.en: Designates a monumental entrance, gate, or large porch, typically found in palaces, temples, or wealthy residences. 1. Large gate or imposing entrance of a building or city (Ac 14:13; Rev 21:25). | 2. Porch or entrance atrium of a house (Mt 26:71).

DEFINITION: The act of seeking to acquire knowledge or clarification through direct questions and investigations.
SENSES: 1. To ask questions to obtain information or clarification (Jn 4:52; Ac 23:20).
2. To determine a fact through investigation (Ac 23:34).

THAYER.pt: O ato de buscar adquirir conhecimento ou esclarecimento por meio de perguntas e investigações diretas. 1. Fazer perguntas para obter informações ou esclarecimentos (Jo 4.52; At 23.20). | 2. Determinar um fato por meio de averiguação (At 23.34).
THAYER.en: The act of seeking to acquire knowledge or clarification through direct questions and investigations. 1. To ask questions to obtain information or clarification (Jn 4:52; Ac 23:20). | 2. To determine a fact through investigation (Ac 23:34).

DEFINITION: Indicates physical fire used for heating, cooking, or destruction, frequently functioning as a symbol of divine presence, purification, or eschatological judgment.
SENSES: 1. Literal fire or physical flames (Mt 17:15; Lk 22:55).
2. Symbol of divine judgment, eternal torment, or spiritual testing (Mt 3:11; 1Co 3:13).

THAYER.pt: Indica o fogo físico utilizado para aquecimento, culinária ou destruição, funcionando frequentemente como símbolo da presença divina, purificação ou juízo escatológico. 1. Fogo literal ou chamas físicas (Mt 17.15; Lc 22.55). | 2. Símbolo do juízo divino, do tormento eterno ou da provação espiritual (Mt 3.11; 1Co 3.13).
THAYER.en: Indicates physical fire used for heating, cooking, or destruction, frequently functioning as a symbol of divine presence, purification, or eschatological judgment. 1. Literal fire or physical flames (Mt 17:15; Lk 22:55). | 2. Symbol of divine judgment, eternal torment, or spiritual testing (Mt 3:11; 1Co 3:13).

DEFINITION: A pile of combustible material gathered to form a bonfire, frequently used for heating or sacrifice.
SENSES: 1. A bonfire or heap of burning materials (Ac 28:2, 3).

THAYER.pt: Uma pilha de material combustível reunida para formar uma fogueira, frequentemente utilizada para aquecimento ou sacrifício. 1. Uma fogueira ou monte de materiais ardentes (At 28.2, 3).
THAYER.en: A pile of combustible material gathered to form a bonfire, frequently used for heating or sacrifice. 1. A bonfire or heap of burning materials (Ac 28:2, 3).

DEFINITION: Tall structure erected for purposes of watch, military defense, or protection of agricultural crops.
SENSES: 1. Tall watchtower or fortification (Mt 21:33; Lk 13:4).

THAYER.pt: Estrutura alta erguida para fins de vigilância, defesa militar ou proteção de plantações agrícolas. 1. Torre alta de vigia ou de fortificação (Mt 21.33; Lc 13.4).
THAYER.en: Tall structure erected for purposes of watch, military defense, or protection of agricultural crops. 1. Tall watchtower or fortification (Mt 21:33; Lk 13:4).

DEFINITION: To be ill or stricken with a febrile state, suffering from high fever.
SENSES: 1. To suffer from a fever or be bedridden with fever (Mt 8:14; Mk 1:30).

THAYER.pt: Estar enfermo ou acometido por um estado febril, sofrendo de febre alta. 1. Sofrer de febre ou estar acamado com febre (Mt 8.14; Mc 1.30).
THAYER.en: To be ill or stricken with a febrile state, suffering from high fever. 1. To suffer from a fever or be bedridden with fever (Mt 8:14; Mk 1:30).

DEFINITION: Pathological condition characterized by elevation of body temperature and physical malaise.
SENSES: 1. Febrile illness or state of acute fever (Mt 8:15; Lk 4:39).

THAYER.pt: Condição patológica caracterizada por elevação da temperatura corporal e mal-estar físico. 1. Doença febril ou estado de febre aguda (Mt 8.15; Lc 4.39).
THAYER.en: Pathological condition characterized by elevation of body temperature and physical malaise. 1. Febrile illness or state of acute fever (Mt 8:15; Lk 4:39).

DEFINITION: Adjective describing something with the color or nature of fire, bright and reddish like flames.
SENSES: 1. Fire-colored or flaming in appearance (Rev 9:17).

THAYER.pt: Adjetivo que descreve algo com a cor ou a natureza do fogo, brilhante e avermelhado como labaredas. 1. De cor semelhante ao fogo ou flamejante (Ap 9.17).
THAYER.en: Adjective describing something with the color or nature of fire, bright and reddish like flames. 1. Fire-colored or flaming in appearance (Rev 9:17).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: πυρώσω, Aor: ἐπύρωσα, Pass: ἐπυρώθην
DEFINITION: To cause combustion, heat intensely to the point of glowing metal, or inflame passions and desires.
SENSES: 1. To burn with fire or destroy by heat in eschatological judgments (Eph 6:16; 2Pe 3:12).
2. To burn with intense desires, passion, or temptation (1Co 7:9; 2Co 11:29).

THAYER.pt: Causar combustão, aquecer intensamente ao ponto de ruborizar o metal ou inflamar paixões e desejos. 1. Queimar com fogo ou destruir pelo calor nos juízos escatológicos (Ef 6.16; 2Pe 3.12). | 2. Incendiar-se com desejos intensos, paixão ou tentação (1Co 7.9; 2Co 11.29).
THAYER.en: To cause combustion, heat intensely to the point of glowing metal, or inflame passions and desires. 1. To burn with fire or destroy by heat in eschatological judgments (Eph 6:16; 2Pe 3:12). | 2. To burn with intense desires, passion, or temptation (1Co 7:9; 2Co 11:29).

DEFINITION: To present a reddish or fire-like coloration, commonly referring to the appearance of the sky at dawn or dusk.
SENSES: 1. To have a reddish or fire-like tone in the sky (Mt 16:2).

THAYER.pt: Apresentar uma coloração avermelhada ou cor de fogo, referindo-se comumente ao aspecto do céu ao amanhecer ou ao entardecer. 1. Estar com tom avermelhado ou cor de fogo no céu (Mt 16.2).
THAYER.en: To present a reddish or fire-like coloration, commonly referring to the appearance of the sky at dawn or dusk. 1. To have a reddish or fire-like tone in the sky (Mt 16:2).

DEFINITION: Term designating the cereal wheat, a plant cultivated for the production of bread.
SENSES: 1. The grain or plant of wheat (Mt 13:25; Jn 12:24; Rev 18:13).

THAYER.pt: Termo que designa o cereal do trigo, planta cultivada para a produção de pão. 1. O grão ou a planta de trigo (Mt 13.25; Jo 12.24; Ap 18.13).
THAYER.en: Term designating the cereal wheat, a plant cultivated for the production of bread. 1. The grain or plant of wheat (Mt 13:25; Jn 12:24; Rev 18:13).

DEFINITION: The process of burning by fire or, figuratively, a severe and painful test that refines the believer.
SENSES: 1. Process of burning or conflagration (Rev 18:9, 18).
2. Severe testing or intense suffering (1Pe 4:12).

THAYER.pt: O processo de queima pelo fogo ou, figuradamente, uma prova severa e dolorosa que refina o crente. 1. Processo de queima ou incêndio (Ap 18.9, 18). | 2. Provação severa ou sofrimento intenso (1Pe 4.12).
THAYER.en: The process of burning by fire or, figuratively, a severe and painful test that refines the believer. 1. Process of burning or conflagration (Rev 18:9, 18). | 2. Severe testing or intense suffering (1Pe 4:12).

DEFINITION: An enclitic temporal particle that occurs combined with other words (such as οὔπω or οὐδέπω) to indicate that an event has not yet happened.
SENSES: 1. An indicator of temporality referring to something that has not yet taken place.

THAYER.pt: Partícula temporal enclítica que ocorre combinada com outras palavras (como οὔπω ou οὐδέπω) para indicar que um evento ainda não aconteceu. 1. Indicador de temporalidade referente a algo que ainda não se realizou.
THAYER.en: An enclitic temporal particle that occurs combined with other words (such as οὔπω or οὐδέπω) to indicate that an event has not yet happened. 1. An indicator of temporality referring to something that has not yet taken place.

DEFINITION: Meaning to dispose of properties, merchandise, or goods in exchange for money or an equivalent value, an act frequently mentioned in the Gospels in commercial or renunciation contexts.
SENSES: 1. To sell goods, properties, or merchandise (Mt 13.44; 19.21).

THAYER.pt: Significa dispor de propriedades, mercadorias ou bens em troca de dinheiro ou valor equivalente, ato frequentemente mencionado nos Evangelhos em contextos comerciais ou de renúncia. 1. Vender bens, propriedades ou mercadorias (Mt 13.44; 19.21).
THAYER.en: Meaning to dispose of properties, merchandise, or goods in exchange for money or an equivalent value, an act frequently mentioned in the Gospels in commercial or renunciation contexts. 1. To sell goods, properties, or merchandise (Mt 13.44; 19.21).

DEFINITION: Designates the young offspring of a beast of burden, especially a young donkey or horse.
SENSES: 1. The offspring of a donkey, commonly associated with the triumphal entry (Mt 21.2; Jn 12.15).

THAYER.pt: Designa a cria jovem de um animal de carga, especialmente o jumento ou o cavalo jovem. 1. O filho de um jumento, comumente associado à entrada triunfal (Mt 21.2; Jo 12.15).
THAYER.en: Designates the young offspring of a beast of burden, especially a young donkey or horse. 1. The offspring of a donkey, commonly associated with the triumphal entry (Mt 21.2; Jn 12.15).

DEFINITION: An adverb denoting an indefinite point in the past or in time, frequently accompanied by negation to mean 'never before'.
SENSES: 1. At some time or ever in history (Lk 19.30).
2. Never ever, at any time (Jn 1.18; 1Jn 4.12).

THAYER.pt: Advérbio que denota um ponto indefinido no passado ou no tempo, frequentemente acompanhado de negação para significar 'nunca antes'. 1. Em algum momento ou alguma vez na história (Lc 19.30). | 2. Nunca jamais, em tempo algum (Jo 1.18; 1Jo 4.12).
THAYER.en: An adverb denoting an indefinite point in the past or in time, frequently accompanied by negation to mean 'never before'. 1. At some time or ever in history (Lk 19.30). | 2. Never ever, at any time (Jn 1.18; 1Jn 4.12).

DEFINITION: To cause spiritual insensitivity or loss of discernment, making the mind or heart callous.
SENSES: 1. To harden perception and blind spiritual understanding (Jn 12:40; 2Co 3:14).

THAYER.pt: Causar insensibilidade espiritual ou perda de discernimento, tornando a mente ou o coração empedernido. 1. Endurecer a percepção e cegar o entendimento espiritual (Jo 12:40; 2Co 3:14).
THAYER.en: To cause spiritual insensitivity or loss of discernment, making the mind or heart callous. 1. To harden perception and blind spiritual understanding (Jn 12:40; 2Co 3:14).

DEFINITION: A condition of moral insensitivity or mental obstinacy that hinders spiritual comprehension.
SENSES: 1. Hardening or obstinacy of the heart and mind (Mk 3.5; Rom 11.25; Eph 4.18).

THAYER.pt: Condição de insensibilidade moral ou obstinação mental que impede a compreensão espiritual. 1. Endurecimento ou obstinação do coração e da mente (Mc 3.5; Rm 11.25; Ef 4.18).
THAYER.en: A condition of moral insensitivity or mental obstinacy that hinders spiritual comprehension. 1. Hardening or obstinacy of the heart and mind (Mk 3.5; Rom 11.25; Eph 4.18).

DEFINITION: An enclitic particle expressing indefiniteness as to the means or way something happens, equivalent to 'somehow' or 'perchance'.
SENSES: 1. A marker of uncertain or conditional manner (perchance, somehow).

THAYER.pt: Partícula enclítica que expressa indefinição quanto ao meio ou modo de algo acontecer, equivalendo a 'de algum modo' ou 'porventura'. 1. Marcador de modo incerto ou condicional (porventura, de algum modo).
THAYER.en: An enclitic particle expressing indefiniteness as to the means or way something happens, equivalent to 'somehow' or 'perchance'. 1. A marker of uncertain or conditional manner (perchance, somehow).

DEFINITION: A direct and indirect interrogative adverb used to inquire about the manner, form, causes, or circumstances in which something happens.
SENSES: 1. In direct questions: in what way?, how? (Lk 1.34; Jn 3.4).
2. In indirect questions: the manner by which, how (Mt 10.19; Acts 11.13).

THAYER.pt: Advérbio interrogativo direto e indireto utilizado para indagar sobre o modo, a forma, as causas ou as circunstâncias em que algo acontece. 1. Em perguntas diretas: de que modo?, de que forma?, como? (Lc 1.34; Jo 3.4). | 2. Em perguntas indiretas: a maneira pela qual, o modo como (Mt 10.19; At 11.13).
THAYER.en: A direct and indirect interrogative adverb used to inquire about the manner, form, causes, or circumstances in which something happens. 1. In direct questions: in what way?, how? (Lk 1.34; Jn 3.4). | 2. In indirect questions: the manner by which, how (Mt 10.19; Acts 11.13).

DEFINITION: A woman of Jericho who welcomed and protected the Israelite spies sent by Joshua, later remembered for her faith.
SENSES: 1. Rahab, the inhabitant of Jericho and ancestor in the lineage of faith (Heb 11.31; Jas 2.25).

THAYER.pt: Mulher de Jericó que acolheu e protegeu os espias israelitas enviados por Josué, sendo posteriormente lembrada por sua fé. 1. Raabe, a moradora de Jericó e ancestral na linhagem da fé (Hb 11.31; Tg 2.25).
THAYER.en: A woman of Jericho who welcomed and protected the Israelite spies sent by Joshua, later remembered for her faith. 1. Rahab, the inhabitant of Jericho and ancestor in the lineage of faith (Heb 11.31; Jas 2.25).

DEFINITION: A Hebrew honorary title meaning 'my master', attributed to doctors of the law and religious teachers.
SENSES: 1. A respectful address given to religious teachers and to Jesus by His disciples (Mt 23.7; Jn 3.26).

THAYER.pt: Título honorífico hebraico que significa 'meu mestre', atribuído a doutores da lei e professores religiosos. 1. Tratamento respeitoso dado a mestres religiosos e a Jesus por seus discípulos (Mt 23.7; Jo 3.26).
THAYER.en: A Hebrew honorary title meaning 'my master', attributed to doctors of the law and religious teachers. 1. A respectful address given to religious teachers and to Jesus by His disciples (Mt 23.7; Jn 3.26).

DEFINITION: An honorary title of extreme respect addressed to a teacher or rabbi, derived from Aramaic and meaning 'my great master' or 'my lord'.
SENSES: 1. A reverent expression of address to a teacher or to the Lord Jesus Himself (Mk 10.51; Jn 20.16).

THAYER.pt: Título honorífico de respeito extremo dirigido a um mestre ou rabi, derivado do aramaico e significando 'meu grande mestre' ou 'meu senhor'. 1. Expressão reverente de endereço a um mestre ou ao próprio Senhor Jesus (Mc 10.51; Jo 20.16).
THAYER.en: An honorary title of extreme respect addressed to a teacher or rabbi, derived from Aramaic and meaning 'my great master' or 'my lord'. 1. A reverent expression of address to a teacher or to the Lord Jesus Himself (Mk 10.51; Jn 20.16).

DEFINITION: To strike or beat someone repeatedly with a stick, rod, or switch, generally as physical punishment.
SENSES: 1. To inflict physical punishment with rods (Acts 16.22; 2Co 11.25).

THAYER.pt: Golpear ou bater repetidamente em alguém com um bastão, vara ou vergôntea, geralmente como punição física. 1. Aplicar castigo físico com varas (At 16.22; 2Co 11.25).
THAYER.en: To strike or beat someone repeatedly with a stick, rod, or switch, generally as physical punishment. 1. To inflict physical punishment with rods (Acts 16.22; 2Co 11.25).

DEFINITION: A slender, long piece of wood used by shepherds to guide flocks, as an instrument of discipline, or as a symbol of governmental authority.
SENSES: 1. A shepherd's or traveler's staff or rod (Mt 10.10; Heb 9.4).
2. A scepter or symbol of rule and authority (Heb 1.8; Rev 12.5).

THAYER.pt: Peça de madeira delgada e longa usada por pastores para guiar rebanhos, como instrumento de disciplina ou como símbolo de autoridade governamental. 1. Cajado ou vara de pastor ou viajante (Mt 10.10; Hb 9.4). | 2. Cetro ou símbolo de governo e autoridade (Hb 1.8; Ap 12.5).
THAYER.en: A slender, long piece of wood used by shepherds to guide flocks, as an instrument of discipline, or as a symbol of governmental authority. 1. A shepherd's or traveler's staff or rod (Mt 10.10; Heb 9.4). | 2. A scepter or symbol of rule and authority (Heb 1.8; Rev 12.5).

DEFINITION: A Roman official charged with carrying the bundle of rods (fasces) and executing the orders of magistrates, acting as a guard or public servant.
SENSES: 1. A lictor or court officer charged with maintaining order (Acts 16.35).

THAYER.pt: Oficial romano encarregado de carregar o feixe de varas (fasces) e executar ordens de magistrados, funcionando como guarda ou funcionário público. 1. Lictor ou oficial de justiça encarregado de manter a ordem (At 16.35).
THAYER.en: A Roman official charged with carrying the bundle of rods (fasces) and executing the orders of magistrates, acting as a guard or public servant. 1. A lictor or court officer charged with maintaining order (Acts 16.35).

DEFINITION: A masculine proper name designating a patriarch in the ancestral lineage of Jesus, according to Luke's genealogy.
SENSES: 1. Reu, son of Peleg and ancestor of Abraham (Lk 3.35).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio masculino que designa um patriarca na linhagem ancestral de Jesus, conforme a genealogia de Lucas. 1. Reu, filho de Pelegue e ancestral de Abraão (Lc 3.35).
THAYER.en: A masculine proper name designating a patriarch in the ancestral lineage of Jesus, according to Luke's genealogy. 1. Reu, son of Peleg and ancestor of Abraham (Lk 3.35).

DEFINITION: A noun denoting a gravely criminal action or an act of perversity against morality.
SENSES: 1. An unscrupulous act, crime, or serious villainy (Acts 18.14).

THAYER.pt: Substantivo que denota uma ação gravemente criminosa ou um ato de perversidade contra a moralidade. 1. Um ato inescrupuloso, crime ou vilania grave (At 18.14).
THAYER.en: A noun denoting a gravely criminal action or an act of perversity against morality. 1. An unscrupulous act, crime, or serious villainy (Acts 18.14).

DEFINITION: The practice of cunning tricks or fraudulent machinations to achieve selfish goals through wickedness.
SENSES: 1. Crafty, fraudulent, or perverse behavior (Acts 13.10).

THAYER.pt: Prática de artimanhas ou maquinações fraudulentas para alcançar objetivos egoístas através da maldade. 1. Comportamento astuto, fraudulento ou perverso (At 13.10).
THAYER.en: The practice of cunning tricks or fraudulent machinations to achieve selfish goals through wickedness. 1. Crafty, fraudulent, or perverse behavior (Acts 13.10).

DEFINITION: A term of Aramaic origin used as a derogatory insult to express contempt for someone's intelligence or worth.
SENSES: 1. An expression of verbal contempt meaning empty-headed or foolish (Mt 5.22).

THAYER.pt: Termo de origem aramaica usado como insulto depreciativo para expressar desprezo pela inteligência ou valor de alguém. 1. Expressão de desprezo verbal que significa tolo ou vazio de mente (Mt 5.22).
THAYER.en: A term of Aramaic origin used as a derogatory insult to express contempt for someone's intelligence or worth. 1. An expression of verbal contempt meaning empty-headed or foolish (Mt 5.22).

DEFINITION: A piece of fabric, scrap, or torn cloth, especially unfulled cloth used to mend old clothes.
SENSES: 1. A piece of raw fabric or patch used as a mend (Mt 9.16; Mk 2.21).

THAYER.pt: Pedaço de tecido, retalho ou pano rasgado, especialmente o tecido não remendado utilizado para consertar roupas velhas. 1. Um pedaço de tecido cru ou retalho usado como remendo (Mt 9.16; Mc 2.21).
THAYER.en: A piece of fabric, scrap, or torn cloth, especially unfulled cloth used to mend old clothes. 1. A piece of raw fabric or patch used as a mend (Mt 9.16; Mk 2.21).

DEFINITION: The name of an ancient city located in the territory of the tribe of Benjamin, north of Jerusalem.
SENSES: 1. The city of Ramah, associated with Rachel's mourning in prophecies (Mt 2.18).

THAYER.pt: Nome de uma antiga cidade localizada no território da tribo de Benjamim, ao norte de Jerusalém. 1. Cidade de Ramá, associada ao luto de Raquel nas profecias (Mt 2.18).
THAYER.en: The name of an ancient city located in the territory of the tribe of Benjamin, north of Jerusalem. 1. The city of Ramah, associated with Rachel's mourning in prophecies (Mt 2.18).

DEFINITION: The act of splashing or sprinkling a liquid (such as water or blood) on someone or something, generally in the context of purification rituals.
SENSES: 1. To sprinkle liquid for ritual purification purposes (Heb 9.19; 10.22).

THAYER.pt: O ato de salpicar ou aspergir um líquido (como água ou sangue) sobre alguém ou algo, geralmente no contexto de rituais de purificação. 1. Aspergir líquido para fins de purificação ritual (Hb 9.19; 10.22).
THAYER.en: The act of splashing or sprinkling a liquid (such as water or blood) on someone or something, generally in the context of purification rituals. 1. To sprinkle liquid for ritual purification purposes (Heb 9.19; 10.22).

DEFINITION: The action of sprinkling or spraying liquids, especially sacrificial blood used for ceremonial purification and atonement for sins.
SENSES: 1. The act of sprinkling blood for purification and covenant (1Pet 1.2; Heb 12.24).

THAYER.pt: A ação de aspergir ou borrifar líquidos, especialmente o sangue sacrificial usado para a purificação cerimonial e expiação de pecados. 1. O ato de aspergir sangue para purificação e aliança (1Pe 1.2; Hb 12.24).
THAYER.en: The action of sprinkling or spraying liquids, especially sacrificial blood used for ceremonial purification and atonement for sins. 1. The act of sprinkling blood for purification and covenant (1Pet 1.2; Heb 12.24).

SHORT_GLOSS: to strike with the palm, slap
DEFINITION: To strike someone with the open palm of the hand, usually on the face, as a sign of insult, outrage, or punishment.
SENSES: 1. To give a slap or blow to the face (Mt 5.39; 26.67; Lk 6.29).
USAGE: to strike with the palm, slap

THAYER.pt: Golpear alguém com a palma da mão aberta, usualmente no rosto, como sinal de insulto, ultraje ou punição. 1. Dar uma bofetada ou tapa na face (Mt 5.39; 26.67; Lc 6.29).
THAYER.en: To strike someone with the open palm of the hand, usually on the face, as a sign of insult, outrage, or punishment. 1. To give a slap or blow to the face (Mt 5.39; 26.67; Lk 6.29).

DEFINITION: A blow delivered with the open hand, generally on the face, or with a stick.
SENSES: 1. A slap or blow to the face (Mk 14.65; Jn 18.22; 19.3).

THAYER.pt: Um golpe desferido com a mão aberta, geralmente no rosto, ou com um bastão. 1. Uma bofetada ou golpe no rosto (Mc 14.65; Jo 18.22; 19.3).
THAYER.en: A blow delivered with the open hand, generally on the face, or with a stick. 1. A slap or blow to the face (Mk 14.65; Jn 18.22; 19.3).

DEFINITION: A small pointed instrument with an eye (hole) for threading, used in sewing clothes.
SENSES: 1. A sewing needle (Mt 19.24; Mk 10.25).

THAYER.pt: Pequeno instrumento pontiagudo com um orifício (fundo) para enfiar a linha, empregado na costura de roupas. 1. Agulha de costura (Mt 19.24; Mc 10.25).
THAYER.en: A small pointed instrument with an eye (hole) for threading, used in sewing clothes. 1. A sewing needle (Mt 19.24; Mk 10.25).

DEFINITION: The woman of Jericho whose faith and welcoming of the Hebrew spies inserted her into the messianic genealogical lineage.
SENSES: 1. Rahab, the woman of Jericho, ancestor of David and Jesus (Mt 1.5).

THAYER.pt: Mulher de Jericó cuja fé e acolhimento dos espias hebreus a inseriram na linhagem genealógica messiânica. 1. Raabe, a mulher de Jericó antepassada de Davi e de Jesus (Mt 1.5).
THAYER.en: The woman of Jericho whose faith and welcoming of the Hebrew spies inserted her into the messianic genealogical lineage. 1. Rahab, the woman of Jericho, ancestor of David and Jesus (Mt 1.5).

DEFINITION: An Old Testament patriarchal figure, wife of Jacob and symbolic mother of the tribes of Israel.
SENSES: 1. Rachel, wife of Jacob mentioned in the context of weeping for her children (Mt 2.18).

THAYER.pt: Figura patriarcal do Antigo Testamento, esposa de Jacó e mãe simbólica das tribos de Israel. 1. Raquel, esposa de Jacó mencionada no contexto do choro pelos filhos (Mt 2.18).
THAYER.en: An Old Testament patriarchal figure, wife of Jacob and symbolic mother of the tribes of Israel. 1. Rachel, wife of Jacob mentioned in the context of weeping for her children (Mt 2.18).

DEFINITION: An Old Testament matriarch, wife of Isaac and mother of Jacob and Esau.
SENSES: 1. Rebekah, wife of Isaac cited in the discussion about divine election (Rom 9.10).

THAYER.pt: Matriarca do Antigo Testamento, esposa de Isaque e mãe de Jacó e Esaú. 1. Rebeca, esposa de Isaque citada na discussão sobre a eleição divina (Rm 9.10).
THAYER.en: An Old Testament matriarch, wife of Isaac and mother of Jacob and Esau. 1. Rebekah, wife of Isaac cited in the discussion about divine election (Rom 9.10).

DEFINITION: A term designating a four-wheeled vehicle used for transporting passengers or cargo.
SENSES: 1. A type of carriage or land transport vehicle.

THAYER.pt: Termo que designa um veículo de quatro rodas usado para transporte de passageiros ou carga. 1. Tipo de carruagem ou veículo de transporte terrestre.
THAYER.en: A term designating a four-wheeled vehicle used for transporting passengers or cargo. 1. A type of carriage or land transport vehicle.

DEFINITION: The name of a pagan deity or star worshipped by the Israelites during the apostasy in the wilderness.
SENSES: 1. Rephan, idol or star worshipped by the people in the wilderness (Acts 7.43).

THAYER.pt: Nome de uma divindade pagã ou estrela cultuada pelos israelitas durante a apostasia no deserto. 1. Renfã, ídolo ou estrela adorada pelo povo no deserto (At 7.43).
THAYER.en: The name of a pagan deity or star worshipped by the Israelites during the apostasy in the wilderness. 1. Rephan, idol or star worshipped by the people in the wilderness (Acts 7.43).

DEFINITION: To describe the continuous movement of a liquid in a specific direction, also used metaphorically in the NT for spiritual blessings.
SENSES: 1. To flow or run like living water from a spring (John 7:38).

THAYER.pt: Descrever o movimento contínuo de um líquido em direção específica, usado também no NT em sentido metafórico de bênçãos espirituais. 1. Fluir ou correr como água viva de um manancial (Jo 7.38).
THAYER.en: To describe the continuous movement of a liquid in a specific direction, also used metaphorically in the NT for spiritual blessings. 1. To flow or run like living water from a spring (John 7:38).

DEFINITION: The movement of liquids running in one direction; used metaphorically in the New Testament for rivers of living water flowing from the believer.
SENSES: 1. To move in the form of a liquid current (John 7:38).

THAYER.pt: O movimento de líquidos que correm em uma direção; usado metaforicamente no Novo Testamento para rios de água viva fluindo do crente. 1. Movimentar-se na forma de corrente líquida (Jo 7:38).
THAYER.en: The movement of liquids running in one direction; used metaphorically in the New Testament for rivers of living water flowing from the believer. 1. To move in the form of a liquid current (John 7:38).

DEFINITION: A port city located at the southwestern tip of the Italian peninsula, through which Paul passed on his journey to Rome.
SENSES: 1. The city of Rhegium in southern Italy (Acts 28:13).

THAYER.pt: Cidade portuária situada na ponta sudoeste da península Itálica, por onde Paulo passou em sua viagem a Roma. 1. A cidade de Régio na Itália meridional (At 28.13).
THAYER.en: A port city located at the southwestern tip of the Italian peninsula, through which Paul passed on his journey to Rome. 1. The city of Rhegium in southern Italy (Acts 28:13).

DEFINITION: A noun indicating the physical result of a structure breaking, collapsing, or suffering total destruction.
SENSES: 1. The ruin or catastrophic collapse of a building (Luke 6:49).

THAYER.pt: Substantivo que indica o resultado físico de uma estrutura que se rompe, desaba ou sofre total destruição. 1. Ruína ou colapso catastrófico de uma construção (Lc 6.49).
THAYER.en: A noun indicating the physical result of a structure breaking, collapsing, or suffering total destruction. 1. The ruin or catastrophic collapse of a building (Luke 6:49).

DEFINITION: To cause something to rupture through internal or external force, tearing or bursting it open.
SENSES: 1. To break or burst vessels or garments (Matt 9:17; Mark 2:22).
2. To tear to pieces with violence, in the case of ferocious animals (Matt 7:6).

THAYER.pt: Causar a ruptura de algo por meio de força interna ou externa, rasgando ou fazendo estourar. 1. Romper ou fazer rebentar vasilhas ou tecidos (Mt 9:17; Mc 2:22). | 2. Despedaçar com violência, no caso de animais ferozes (Mt 7:6).
THAYER.en: To cause something to rupture through internal or external force, tearing or bursting it open. 1. To break or burst vessels or garments (Matt 9:17; Mark 2:22). | 2. To tear to pieces with violence, in the case of ferocious animals (Matt 7:6).

DEFINITION: That which is spoken, comprising anything from a single word to a complete statement or uttered message, and sometimes denoting an event.
SENSES: 1. A spoken word, specific commandment, or declaration (Matt 18:16; Luke 2:15).
2. An event, matter, or fact that has occurred, under Semitic influence (Luke 1:37; Acts 5:32).

THAYER.pt: Aquilo que é falado, compreendendo desde uma única palavra até uma declaração completa ou mensagem proferida, e por vezes denotando um acontecimento. 1. Uma palavra pronunciada, mandamento ou declaração específica (Mt 18.16; Lc 2.15). | 2. Um evento, assunto ou fato ocorrido, por influência semítica (Lc 1.37; At 5.32).
THAYER.en: That which is spoken, comprising anything from a single word to a complete statement or uttered message, and sometimes denoting an event. 1. A spoken word, specific commandment, or declaration (Matt 18:16; Luke 2:15). | 2. An event, matter, or fact that has occurred, under Semitic influence (Luke 1:37; Acts 5:32).

DEFINITION: A male character mentioned in the genealogy of Jesus according to the account in the Gospel of Luke.
SENSES: 1. Resa, an ancestor of Jesus in the Lucan lineage (Luke 3:27).

THAYER.pt: Personagem masculino mencionado na genealogia de Jesus segundo o relato do Evangelho de Lucas. 1. Resa, ancestral de Jesus na linhagem lucana (Lc 3.27).
THAYER.en: A male character mentioned in the genealogy of Jesus according to the account in the Gospel of Luke. 1. Resa, an ancestor of Jesus in the Lucan lineage (Luke 3:27).

DEFINITION: A professional skilled in the art of rhetoric who acts as an advocate or spokesperson in courts of law.
SENSES: 1. An attorney or public orator in legal proceedings (Acts 24:1).

THAYER.pt: Profissional especializado na arte da retórica que atua como advogado ou porta-voz em tribunais. 1. Advogado ou orador público em processos judiciais (At 24.1).
THAYER.en: A professional skilled in the art of rhetoric who acts as an advocate or spokesperson in courts of law. 1. An attorney or public orator in legal proceedings (Acts 24:1).

DEFINITION: An adverb that qualifies something stated clearly, explicitly, and without room for ambiguities.
SENSES: 1. In an express manner or explicitly (1 Tim 4:1).

THAYER.pt: Advérbio que qualifica algo declarado de forma clara, explícita e sem margem para ambiguidades. 1. De maneira expressa ou explicitamente (1Tm 4.1).
THAYER.en: An adverb that qualifies something stated clearly, explicitly, and without room for ambiguities. 1. In an express manner or explicitly (1 Tim 4:1).

DEFINITION: The underground part of a plant that absorbs water and nutrients. In a metaphorical and theological sense in the New Testament, it refers to the origin, fundamental cause of something, or the messianic lineage of descent.
SENSES: 1. The physical root of a tree or plant (Matt 3:10; Mark 11:20).
2. Figuratively, the source, cause, or origin of an attitude or behavior (1 Tim 6:10; Heb 12:15).
3. Origin or genealogical descent, especially applied to Christ as the root of David (Rom 15:12; Rev 5:5).

THAYER.pt: A parte subterrânea de uma planta que absorve água e nutrientes. Em sentido metafórico e teológico no Novo Testamento, refere-se à origem, causa fundamental de algo ou à linhagem messiana de descendência. 1. A raiz física de uma árvore ou planta (Mt 3.10; Mc 11.20). | 2. Em sentido figurado, a fonte, causa ou origem de uma atitude ou comportamento (1Tm 6.10; Hb 12.15). | 3. Origem ou descendência genealógica, especialmente aplicada a Cristo como a raiz de Davi (Rm 15.12; Ap 5.5).
THAYER.en: The underground part of a plant that absorbs water and nutrients. In a metaphorical and theological sense in the New Testament, it refers to the origin, fundamental cause of something, or the messianic lineage of descent. 1. The physical root of a tree or plant (Matt 3:10; Mark 11:20). | 2. Figuratively, the source, cause, or origin of an attitude or behavior (1 Tim 6:10; Heb 12:15). | 3. Origin or genealogical descent, especially applied to Christ as the root of David (Rom 15:12; Rev 5:5).

DEFINITION: To cause the development of roots or, figuratively, to establish firmly on solid and secure bases.
SENSES: 1. To be deeply rooted and spiritually grounded (Eph 3:17; Col 2:7).

THAYER.pt: Causar o desenvolvimento de raízes ou, figuradamente, estabelecer firmemente sobre bases sólidas e seguras. 1. Estar profundamente enraizado e fundamentado espiritualmente (Ef 3.17; Cl 2.7).
THAYER.en: To cause the development of roots or, figuratively, to establish firmly on solid and secure bases. 1. To be deeply rooted and spiritually grounded (Eph 3:17; Col 2:7).

DEFINITION: An extremely rapid movement, like the blinking of an eye, denoting a minimal interval of time.
SENSES: 1. A fleeting instant or twinkling of an eye (1 Cor 15:52).

THAYER.pt: Movimento extremamente rápido, como o piscar de olhos, denotando um intervalo de tempo mínimo. 1. Instante fugaz ou piscar de olhos (1Co 15.52).
THAYER.en: An extremely rapid movement, like the blinking of an eye, denoting a minimal interval of time. 1. A fleeting instant or twinkling of an eye (1 Cor 15:52).

DEFINITION: To move violently from side to side, like the wind that stirs the waters or a fire that is fanned.
SENSES: 1. To be shaken or tossed to and fro (James 1:6).

THAYER.pt: Movimentar violentamente de um lado para o outro, como o vento que agita as águas ou o fogo que é soprado. 1. Ser sacudido ou agitado de um lado para o outro (Tg 1.6).
THAYER.en: To move violently from side to side, like the wind that stirs the waters or a fire that is fanned. 1. To be shaken or tossed to and fro (James 1:6).

DEFINITION: To throw or hurl something with force, frequently discarding or abandoning an object.
SENSES: 1. To throw or hurl with momentum.

THAYER.pt: Atirar ou lançar algo com força, frequentemente descartando ou abandonando um objeto. 1. Lançar ou arremessar com ímpeto.
THAYER.en: To throw or hurl something with force, frequently discarding or abandoning an object. 1. To throw or hurl with momentum.

DEFINITION: To propel something with an energetic movement or simply to lay something down quickly.
SENSES: 1. To throw or hurl with force (Matt 27:5; Luke 4:35).
2. To place or deposit quickly (Matt 15:30).

THAYER.pt: Propulsar algo com movimento enérgico ou simplesmente depor algo com rapidez. 1. Lançar ou arremessar com força (Mt 27:5; Lc 4:35). | 2. Colocar ou depositar rapidamente (Mt 15:30).
THAYER.en: To propel something with an energetic movement or simply to lay something down quickly. 1. To throw or hurl with force (Matt 27:5; Luke 4:35). | 2. To place or deposit quickly (Matt 15:30).

DEFINITION: Son and successor of King Solomon, whose reign marked the division of the kingdom of Israel.
SENSES: 1. Rehoboam, king of Judah in Christ's genealogy (Matt 1:7).

THAYER.pt: Filho e sucessor do rei Salomão, cujo reinado marcou a divisão do reino de Israel. 1. Reoboão, rei de Judá na genealogia de Cristo (Mt 1.7).
THAYER.en: Son and successor of King Solomon, whose reign marked the division of the kingdom of Israel. 1. Rehoboam, king of Judah in Christ's genealogy (Matt 1:7).

DEFINITION: Name of a servant or maid in the house of Mary, the mother of John Mark, in Jerusalem.
SENSES: 1. Rhoda, the young maid who answered the door when Peter was released (Acts 12:13).

THAYER.pt: Nome de uma serva ou criada na casa de Maria, mãe de João Marcos, em Jerusalém. 1. Rode, a jovem empregada que atendeu à porta quando Pedro foi libertado (At 12.13).
THAYER.en: Name of a servant or maid in the house of Mary, the mother of John Mark, in Jerusalem. 1. Rhoda, the young maid who answered the door when Peter was released (Acts 12:13).

DEFINITION: A famous island located in the Aegean Sea, near the southwestern coast of Asia Minor, visited by Paul.
SENSES: 1. The island of Rhodes in the eastern Mediterranean (Acts 21:1).

THAYER.pt: Ilha célebre situada no mar Egeu, próxima à costa sudoeste da Ásia Menor, visitada por Paulo. 1. A ilha de Rodes no Mediterrâneo oriental (At 21.1).
THAYER.en: A famous island located in the Aegean Sea, near the southwestern coast of Asia Minor, visited by Paul. 1. The island of Rhodes in the eastern Mediterranean (Acts 21:1).

SHORT_GLOSS: with a roar, with a rushing sound
DEFINITION: An adverb that describes the characteristic sound produced by a body moving swiftly through the air.
SENSES: 1. With a roaring or rushing sound of a strong wind (2 Pet 3:10).
USAGE: with a roar, with a rushing sound

THAYER.pt: Advérbio que descreve o som característico produzido por um corpo que se move velozmente pelo ar. 1. Com um som estrondoso ou ruidoso de forte vento (2Pe 3.10).
THAYER.en: An adverb that describes the characteristic sound produced by a body moving swiftly through the air. 1. With a roaring or rushing sound of a strong wind (2 Pet 3:10).

DEFINITION: Designates a long and broad sword used for combat, also employed in metaphors for deep pain or divine judgment.
SENSES: 1. A large and broad sword (Rev 2:12).
2. Metaphor for deep pain or anguish in the soul (Luke 2:35).

THAYER.pt: Designa uma espada longa e larga usada para combate, empregada também em metáforas para dor profunda ou juízo divino. 1. Espada grande e larga (Ap 2:12). | 2. Metáfora para profunda dor ou angústia na alma (Lc 2:35).
THAYER.en: Designates a long and broad sword used for combat, also employed in metaphors for deep pain or divine judgment. 1. A large and broad sword (Rev 2:12). | 2. Metaphor for deep pain or anguish in the soul (Luke 2:35).

DEFINITION: The firstborn son of Jacob by Leah, patriarch of one of the twelve tribes of Israel.
SENSES: 1. Reuben, patriarch and representative of the tribe of the same name.

THAYER.pt: O primeiro filho de Jacó com Lia, patriarca de uma das doze tribos de Israel. 1. Rúben, patriarca e representante da tribo homônima.
THAYER.en: The firstborn son of Jacob by Leah, patriarch of one of the twelve tribes of Israel. 1. Reuben, patriarch and representative of the tribe of the same name.

DEFINITION: A Moabite woman whose loyalty to her mother-in-law Naomi led her to join the lineage of King David and Jesus.
SENSES: 1. Ruth, the Moabite ancestress in Christ's genealogy (Matt 1:5).

THAYER.pt: Mulher moabita cuja lealdade à sua sogra Noemi a levou a integrar a linhagem do rei Davi e de Jesus. 1. Rute, a moabita antepassada na genealogia de Cristo (Mt 1.5).
THAYER.en: A Moabite woman whose loyalty to her mother-in-law Naomi led her to join the lineage of King David and Jesus. 1. Ruth, the Moabite ancestress in Christ's genealogy (Matt 1:5).

DEFINITION: A man's proper name, mentioned in the New Testament as the son of Simon of Cyrene and also as a Christian greeted in Rome.
SENSES: 1. Rufus, son of Simon of Cyrene (Mark 15:21).
2. A Roman Christian mentioned in Paul's greetings (Rom 16:13).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio de homem, mencionado no Novo Testamento como filho de Simão de Cirene e também como cristão saudado em Roma. 1. Rufo, filho de Simão de Cirene (Mc 15.21). | 2. Cristão romano mencionado nas saudações de Paulo (Rm 16.13).
THAYER.en: A man's proper name, mentioned in the New Testament as the son of Simon of Cyrene and also as a Christian greeted in Rome. 1. Rufus, son of Simon of Cyrene (Mark 15:21). | 2. A Roman Christian mentioned in Paul's greetings (Rom 16:13).

DEFINITION: An urban public way characterized by being narrow, like an alley or lane within a city.
SENSES: 1. A narrow street or alley in an urban location (Matt 6:2; Luke 14:21).

THAYER.pt: Via pública urbana caracterizada por ser estreita, como um beco ou ruela dentro de uma cidade. 1. Rua estreita ou beco em uma localidade urbana (Mt 6.2; Lc 14.21).
THAYER.en: An urban public way characterized by being narrow, like an alley or lane within a city. 1. A narrow street or alley in an urban location (Matt 6:2; Luke 14:21).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Middle deponent, Fut: ῥύσομαι, Aor: ἐρρυσάμην
DEFINITION: Describes the act of rescuing someone from grave or imminent danger, preserving their life or integrity. It is a central term in biblical soteriology to express divine deliverance from evil and perdition.
SENSES: 1. To rescue or save someone from severe dangers or oppression (Matt 6:13; 2 Pet 2:7).

THAYER.pt: Descreve o ato de resgatar alguém de um perigo grave ou iminente, preservando sua vida ou integridade. É um termo central na soteriologia bíblica para expressar o livramento divino do mal e da perdição. 1. Resgatar ou salvar alguém de perigos severos ou opressão (Mt 6.13; 2Pe 2.7).
THAYER.en: Describes the act of rescuing someone from grave or imminent danger, preserving their life or integrity. It is a central term in biblical soteriology to express divine deliverance from evil and perdition. 1. To rescue or save someone from severe dangers or oppression (Matt 6:13; 2 Pet 2:7).

DEFINITION: Refers literally or figuratively to dirt, denoting in the New Testament moral impurity, corruption, and vice that stain character.
SENSES: 1. Moral filth or spiritual impurity that must be removed from the believer's life (James 1:21).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se literal ou figuradamente à sujeira, denotando no Novo Testamento a impureza moral, a corrupção e o vício que mancham o caráter. 1. Imundície moral ou sujeira espiritual que deve ser removida da vida do crente (Tg 1.21).
THAYER.en: Refers literally or figuratively to dirt, denoting in the New Testament moral impurity, corruption, and vice that stain character. 1. Moral filth or spiritual impurity that must be removed from the believer's life (James 1:21).

DEFINITION: Possessing physical dirt or, in a moral and spiritual sense, being impure, corrupted, or stained by sin.
SENSES: 1. Physically dirty, dressed in filthy rags (James 2:2).
2. Morally corrupted, impure, or debauched (Rev 22:11).

THAYER.pt: Que possui sujeira física ou, em sentido moral e espiritual, que se encontra impuro, corrompido ou manchado pelo pecado. 1. Físicamente sujo, vestido com trapos imundos (Tg 2.2). | 2. Moralmente corrompido, impuro ou devasso (Ap 22.11).
THAYER.en: Possessing physical dirt or, in a moral and spiritual sense, being impure, corrupted, or stained by sin. 1. Physically dirty, dressed in filthy rags (James 2:2). | 2. Morally corrupted, impure, or debauched (Rev 22:11).

DEFINITION: Designates physical dirt, residue, or waste, also used to describe impurity in a metaphorical sense.
SENSES: 1. Physical dirt or impurity removed by water in the context of baptism (1 Pet 3:21).

THAYER.pt: Designa sujeira física, resíduos ou detritos, sendo empregado também para descrever a impureza em sentido metafórico. 1. Sujeira ou impureza física removida pela água no contexto do batismo (1Pe 3.21).
THAYER.en: Designates physical dirt, residue, or waste, also used to describe impurity in a metaphorical sense. 1. Physical dirt or impurity removed by water in the context of baptism (1 Pet 3:21).

DEFINITION: Indicates the action of becoming dirty or morally corrupted, sinking into sinful practices.
SENSES: 1. To continue in a state of moral impurity or corruption (Rev 22:11).

THAYER.pt: Indica a ação de tornar-se sujo ou moralmente corrompido, afundando em práticas pecaminosas. 1. Continuar em estado de impureza moral ou corrupção (Ap 22.11).
THAYER.en: Indicates the action of becoming dirty or morally corrupted, sinking into sinful practices. 1. To continue in a state of moral impurity or corruption (Rev 22:11).

DEFINITION: The continuous secretion or abnormal loss of bodily fluids.
SENSES: 1. A continuous flow or hemorrhage (Mark 5:25; Luke 8:43).

THAYER.pt: A secreção contínua ou perda anormal de fluidos corporais. 1. Fluxo contínuo ou hemorragia (Mc 5.25; Lc 8.43).
THAYER.en: The continuous secretion or abnormal loss of bodily fluids. 1. A continuous flow or hemorrhage (Mark 5:25; Luke 8:43).

DEFINITION: A noun describing folds or wrinkles formed in the skin due to aging, used metaphorically in ecclesiology.
SENSES: 1. Wrinkles on the skin, used figuratively to denote spiritual defect or imperfection in the Church (Eph 5:27).

THAYER.pt: Substantivo que descreve as dobras ou rugas formadas na pele devido ao envelhecimento, usado metaforicamente na eclesiologia. 1. Rugas na pele, empregadas figuradamente para denotar defeito ou imperfeição espiritual na Igreja (Ef 5.27).
THAYER.en: A noun describing folds or wrinkles formed in the skin due to aging, used metaphorically in ecclesiology. 1. Wrinkles on the skin, used figuratively to denote spiritual defect or imperfection in the Church (Eph 5:27).

DEFINITION: An adjective qualifying that which belongs to Rome or to its culture and language.
SENSES: 1. Belonging to the Romans or written in Latin (Luke 23:38).

THAYER.pt: Adjetivo que qualifica aquilo que pertence a Roma ou à sua cultura e língua. 1. Pertençente aos romanos ou redigido em latim (Lc 23.38).
THAYER.en: An adjective qualifying that which belongs to Rome or to its culture and language. 1. Belonging to the Romans or written in Latin (Luke 23:38).

DEFINITION: Belonging or relating to the city of Rome or the citizens of the Roman Empire.
SENSES: 1. Inhabitant, native, or citizen of Rome (Acts 2:10; 16:21).

THAYER.pt: Pertencente ou relativo à cidade de Roma ou aos cidadãos do Império Romano. 1. Habitante, nativo ou cidadão de Roma (At 2.10; 16.21).
THAYER.en: Belonging or relating to the city of Rome or the citizens of the Roman Empire. 1. Inhabitant, native, or citizen of Rome (Acts 2:10; 16:21).

DEFINITION: An adverb indicating the use of the Latin language, the official idiom of the Roman Empire.
SENSES: 1. In the Latin language or in Latin (John 19:20).

THAYER.pt: Advérbio que indica o uso da língua latina, o idioma oficial do Império Romano. 1. Na língua latina ou em latim (Jo 19.20).
THAYER.en: An adverb indicating the use of the Latin language, the official idiom of the Roman Empire. 1. In the Latin language or in Latin (John 19:20).

DEFINITION: The capital of the Roman Empire, political and cultural center of antiquity, mentioned in apostolic journeys and Pauline epistles.
SENSES: 1. The city of Rome, capital of the Roman Empire (Acts 19:21; Rom 1:7).

THAYER.pt: A capital do Império Romano, centro político e cultural da Antiguidade, mencionada nas viagens apostólicas e nas epístolas paulinas. 1. A cidade de Roma, capital do Império Romano (At 19:21; Rm 1:7).
THAYER.en: The capital of the Roman Empire, political and cultural center of antiquity, mentioned in apostolic journeys and Pauline epistles. 1. The city of Rome, capital of the Roman Empire (Acts 19:21; Rom 1:7).

DEFINITION: Originally meaning to strengthen, but appears in the passive participle or imperative in epistolary greetings.
SENSES: 1. An expression of farewell in letters, meaning 'fare well' or 'goodbye' (Acts 15:29).

THAYER.pt: Significa originalmente fortalecer, mas aparece no particípio ou imperativo passivo em saudações epistolares. 1. Expressão de despedida em cartas, significando 'passai bem' ou 'adeus' (At 15.29).
THAYER.en: Originally meaning to strengthen, but appears in the passive participle or imperative in epistolary greetings. 1. An expression of farewell in letters, meaning 'fare well' or 'goodbye' (Acts 15:29).

DEFINITION: A word of Aramaic origin exclaimed by Jesus on the cross, translated as 'why have you forsaken me?'.
SENSES: 1. The expression of abandonment cited in the cry from the cross (Matt 27:46; Mark 15:34).

THAYER.pt: Palavra de origem aramaica exclamada por Jesus na cruz, traduzida como 'por que me abandonaste?'. 1. A expressão de abandono citada no grito da cruz (Mt 27.46; Mc 15.34).
THAYER.en: A word of Aramaic origin exclaimed by Jesus on the cross, translated as 'why have you forsaken me?'. 1. The expression of abandonment cited in the cry from the cross (Matt 27:46; Mark 15:34).

DEFINITION: Transliteration of the Hebrew word for 'armies' or 'hosts', used in the divine title denoting the God sovereign over all heavenly forces.
SENSES: 1. Part of the title 'Lord of Hosts' (Rom 9:29; Jas 5:4).

THAYER.pt: Transliteração da palavra hebraica para 'exércitos' ou 'hostes', empregada no título divino que denota o Deus soberano sobre todas as forças celestiais. 1. Parte do título 'Senhor dos Exércitos' (Rm 9.29; Tg 5.4).
THAYER.en: Transliteration of the Hebrew word for 'armies' or 'hosts', used in the divine title denoting the God sovereign over all heavenly forces. 1. Part of the title 'Lord of Hosts' (Rom 9:29; Jas 5:4).

DEFINITION: Denotes a special period of solemn and sabbath rest, reserved by God for his people.
SENSES: 1. The eschatological and sabbath rest promised to the people of God (Heb 4:9).

THAYER.pt: Denota um período especial de descanso solene e sabático, reservado por Deus para o seu povo. 1. O repouso escatológico e sabático prometido ao povo de Deus (Hb 4.9).
THAYER.en: Denotes a special period of solemn and sabbath rest, reserved by God for his people. 1. The eschatological and sabbath rest promised to the people of God (Heb 4:9).

DEFINITION: The seventh day of the Jewish week, consecrated to rest and sacred worship, which by extension can also designate a complete period of seven days.
SENSES: 1. The sabbath day, day of sabbath rest under the Mosaic law (Matt 12:1; Luke 6:7).
2. A period of seven days or a whole week (Luke 18:12; Acts 20:7).

THAYER.pt: O sétimo dia da semana judaica, consagrado ao repouso e culto sagrado, podendo também designar por extensão o período completo de sete dias. 1. O dia de sábado, dia de descanso sabático na lei mosaica (Mt 12.1; Lc 6.7). | 2. Um período de sete dias ou uma semana inteira (Lc 18.12; At 20.7).
THAYER.en: The seventh day of the Jewish week, consecrated to rest and sacred worship, which by extension can also designate a complete period of seven days. 1. The sabbath day, day of sabbath rest under the Mosaic law (Matt 12:1; Luke 6:7). | 2. A period of seven days or a whole week (Luke 18:12; Acts 20:7).

DEFINITION: A long, vertical fishing net, equipped with floats and weights, used to encircle and drag large quantities of fish.
SENSES: 1. A large drag net cast into the sea to catch every kind of fish (Matt 13:47).

THAYER.pt: Uma rede de pesca longa e vertical, equipada com flutuadores e pesos, usada para cercar e arrastar grandes quantidades de peixes. 1. Grande rede de arrasto lançada ao mar para apanhar toda espécie de peixes (Mt 13.47).
THAYER.en: A long, vertical fishing net, equipped with floats and weights, used to encircle and drag large quantities of fish. 1. A large drag net cast into the sea to catch every kind of fish (Matt 13:47).

DEFINITION: Member of an influential Jewish religious and political party in the New Testament period, characterized by denying the resurrection and the existence of angels.
SENSES: 1. Member of the Jewish sect of the Sadducees (Matt 3:7; Acts 5:17).

THAYER.pt: Membro de um influente partido religioso e político judaico no período do Novo Testamento, caracterizado por negar a ressurreição e a existência de anjos. 1. Integrante da seita judaica dos saduceus (Mt 3.7; At 5.17).
THAYER.en: Member of an influential Jewish religious and political party in the New Testament period, characterized by denying the resurrection and the existence of angels. 1. Member of the Jewish sect of the Sadducees (Matt 3:7; Acts 5:17).

DEFINITION: Proper name of Hebrew origin belonging to a high priest and ancestor in the earthly lineage of Jesus.
SENSES: 1. Zadok, ancestor in the genealogy of Christ (Matt 1:14; Luke 3:23).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio de origem hebraica pertencente a um sumo sacerdote e ancestral na linhagem terrena de Jesus. 1. Zadoque, ancestral na genealogia de Cristo (Mt 1.14; Lc 3.23).
THAYER.en: Proper name of Hebrew origin belonging to a high priest and ancestor in the earthly lineage of Jesus. 1. Zadok, ancestor in the genealogy of Christ (Matt 1:14; Luke 3:23).

DEFINITION: Derived from the tail-wagging of dogs to fawn, it came to mean flattering or causing instability and emotional shaking.
SENSES: 1. To be moved, shaken, or perturbed by trials and afflictions (1 Thess 3:3).

THAYER.pt: Derivado do balançar de cauda dos cães para adular, passou a significar bajular ou causar instabilidade e abalo emocional. 1. Ser movido, abalado ou perturbado por provações e aflições (1Ts 3.3).
THAYER.en: Derived from the tail-wagging of dogs to fawn, it came to mean flattering or causing instability and emotional shaking. 1. To be moved, shaken, or perturbed by trials and afflictions (1 Thess 3:3).

DEFINITION: Rough and coarse fabric made of goat or camel hair, traditionally used as mourning attire or a sign of repentance.
SENSES: 1. Sackcloth or cilicium used in demonstrations of repentance and grief (Matt 11:21; Rev 11:3).

THAYER.pt: Tecido áspero e grosseiro feito de pelo de cabra ou camelo, tradicionalmente usado como vestimenta de luto ou sinal de arrependimento. 1. Pano de saco ou cilício usado em demonstrações de arrependimento e dor (Mt 11.21; Ap 11.3).
THAYER.en: Rough and coarse fabric made of goat or camel hair, traditionally used as mourning attire or a sign of repentance. 1. Sackcloth or cilicium used in demonstrations of repentance and grief (Matt 11:21; Rev 11:3).

DEFINITION: Patriarchal character listed in the genealogies of the Old and New Testaments.
SENSES: 1. Salah, ancestor in the human lineage of Jesus (Luke 3:32, 35).

THAYER.pt: Personagem patriarcal listado nas genealogias do Antigo e do Novo Testamento. 1. Salá, ancestral na linhagem humana de Jesus (Lc 3.32, 35).
THAYER.en: Patriarchal character listed in the genealogies of the Old and New Testaments. 1. Salah, ancestor in the human lineage of Jesus (Luke 3:32, 35).

DEFINITION: Proper name of an ancestor in the genealogy of Jesus in the New Testament.
SENSES: 1. Salathiel, father of Zerubbabel in the messianic lineage (Matt 1:12; Luke 3:27).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio de um ancestral na genealogia de Jesus no Novo Testamento. 1. Salatiel, pai de Zorobabel na linhagem messiânica (Mt 1.12; Lc 3.27).
THAYER.en: Proper name of an ancestor in the genealogy of Jesus in the New Testament. 1. Salathiel, father of Zerubbabel in the messianic lineage (Matt 1:12; Luke 3:27).

DEFINITION: An important port city located on the eastern coast of the island of Cyprus.
SENSES: 1. A city in Cyprus where Paul and Barnabas preached the word of God (Acts 13:5).

THAYER.pt: Importante cidade portuária situada na costa oriental da ilha de Chipre. 1. Cidade em Chipre onde Paulo e Barnabé pregaram a palavra de Deus (At 13.5).
THAYER.en: An important port city located on the eastern coast of the island of Cyprus. 1. A city in Cyprus where Paul and Barnabas preached the word of God (Acts 13:5).

DEFINITION: The name of a locality whose exact location is debated, associated with the baptismal ministry of John the Baptist.
SENSES: 1. A place near Aenon where John was baptizing because of the abundance of water (John 3:23).

THAYER.pt: Nome de uma localidade cuja localização exata é debatida, associada ao ministério de batismo de João Batista. 1. Local próximo a Enom onde João batizava devido à abundância de águas (Jo 3.23).
THAYER.en: The name of a locality whose exact location is debated, associated with the baptismal ministry of John the Baptist. 1. A place near Aenon where John was baptizing because of the abundance of water (John 3:23).

DEFINITION: To cause to move rapidly back and forth, to physically agitate, or to disturb inner stability.
SENSES: 1. To violently shake or agitate physical structures or the natural order (Luke 6:48; Heb 12:26).
2. To cause emotional or mental instability or disturbance (Acts 2:25).

THAYER.pt: Fazer mover rapidamente para frente e para trás, agitar fisicamente ou perturbar a estabilidade interior. 1. Agitar ou sacudir violentamente estruturas físicas ou a ordem natural (Lc 6.48; Hb 12.26). | 2. Causar instabilidade ou perturbação emocional e mental (At 2.25).
THAYER.en: To cause to move rapidly back and forth, to physically agitate, or to disturb inner stability. 1. To violently shake or agitate physical structures or the natural order (Luke 6:48; Heb 12:26). | 2. To cause emotional or mental instability or disturbance (Acts 2:25).

DEFINITION: An ancient locality associated with King Melchizedek, generally identified with Jerusalem or a nearby region.
SENSES: 1. Salem, the city whose king was Melchizedek (Heb 7:1).

THAYER.pt: Antiga localidade associada ao rei Melquisedeque, geralmente identificada com Jerusalém ou região próxima. 1. Salém, cidade cujo rei era Melquisedeque (Hb 7.1).
THAYER.en: An ancient locality associated with King Melchizedek, generally identified with Jerusalem or a nearby region. 1. Salem, the city whose king was Melchizedek (Heb 7:1).

DEFINITION: A person from the lineage of Judah who appears in the genealogies of the Messiah.
SENSES: 1. Salmon, the father of Boaz in the genealogy of Jesus (Matt 1:4).

THAYER.pt: Pessoa da linhagem de Judá que figura nas genealogias do Messias. 1. Salmom, pai de Boaz na genealogia de Jesus (Mt 1.4).
THAYER.en: A person from the lineage of Judah who appears in the genealogies of the Messiah. 1. Salmon, the father of Boaz in the genealogy of Jesus (Matt 1:4).

DEFINITION: A promontory located at the northeastern extremity of the island of Crete.
SENSES: 1. A Cretan cape or promontory sailed past during Paul's sea voyage to Rome (Acts 27:7).

THAYER.pt: Promontório localizado na extremidade nordeste da ilha de Creta. 1. Cabo ou promontório cretense contornado durante a viagem marítima de Paulo para Roma (At 27.7).
THAYER.en: A promontory located at the northeastern extremity of the island of Crete. 1. A Cretan cape or promontory sailed past during Paul's sea voyage to Rome (Acts 27:7).

DEFINITION: The violent and agitated movement of crested waves in a body of water.
SENSES: 1. The heavy rolling or agitation of waves in a stormy sea.

THAYER.pt: Movimento violento e agitado de ondas encrespadas em um corpo de água. 1. O forte balanço ou agitação das ondas em mar tempestuoso.
THAYER.en: The violent and agitated movement of crested waves in a body of water. 1. The heavy rolling or agitation of waves in a stormy sea.

DEFINITION: A metallic wind instrument historically used to emit warning signals, military calls, or eschatological announcements.
SENSES: 1. A musical wind instrument, a trumpet (1 Cor 14:8).
