2. The sound or blast of a trumpet in apocalyptic contexts (Matt 24:31; 1 Cor 15:52).

THAYER.pt: Instrumento de sopro metálico utilizado historicamente para emitir sinais de alerta, convocações militares ou anúncios escatológicos. 1. Instrumento musical de sopro, trombeta (1Co 14.8). | 2. O som ou toque de trombeta em contextos apocalípticos (Mt 24.31; 1Co 15.52).
THAYER.en: A metallic wind instrument historically used to emit warning signals, military calls, or eschatological announcements. 1. A musical wind instrument, a trumpet (1 Cor 14:8). | 2. The sound or blast of a trumpet in apocalyptic contexts (Matt 24:31; 1 Cor 15:52).

SHORT_GLOSS: to blow a trumpet, to sound
DEFINITION: To produce musical sound through a trumpet, whether to signal eschatological events or to publicly proclaim actions.
SENSES: 1. To blow or sound a trumpet (1 Cor 15:52; Rev 8:6).
2. To proclaim something with fanfare or ostentation (Matt 6:2).
USAGE: to blow a trumpet, to sound

THAYER.pt: Produzir som musical através de uma trombeta, seja para sinalizar eventos escatológicos ou para alardear ações publicamente. 1. Tocar ou soar uma trombeta (1Co 15.52; Ap 8.6). | 2. Divulgar algo com fanfarra ou ostentação (Mt 6.2).
THAYER.en: To produce musical sound through a trumpet, whether to signal eschatological events or to publicly proclaim actions. 1. To blow or sound a trumpet (1 Cor 15:52; Rev 8:6). | 2. To proclaim something with fanfare or ostentation (Matt 6:2).

DEFINITION: One who plays the trumpet or bugle in military, civil, or ritual contexts.
SENSES: 1. A musician or official charged with playing the trumpet (Rev 18:22).

THAYER.pt: Aquele que toca a trombeta ou o clarim em contextos militares, civis ou rituais. 1. Músico ou oficial encarregado de tocar a trombeta (Ap 18.22).
THAYER.en: One who plays the trumpet or bugle in military, civil, or ritual contexts. 1. A musician or official charged with playing the trumpet (Rev 18:22).

DEFINITION: A Galilean woman who followed Jesus, present at the crucifixion and the visit to the empty tomb.
SENSES: 1. Salome, a Galilean follower of Jesus (Mark 15:40).

THAYER.pt: Mulher galileia seguidora de Jesus, presente na crucificação e na visita ao sepulcro vazio. 1. Salome, seguidora galileia de Jesus (Mc 15.40).
THAYER.en: A Galilean woman who followed Jesus, present at the crucifixion and the visit to the empty tomb. 1. Salome, a Galilean follower of Jesus (Mark 15:40).

DEFINITION: The central region of Palestine situated between Judea and Galilee, and also the name of its main historical city.
SENSES: 1. The region or city of Samaria (Luke 17:11; John 4:4; Acts 8:5).

THAYER.pt: Região central da Palestina situada entre a Judeia e a Galileia, e também o nome da sua principal cidade histórica. 1. A região ou a cidade de Samaria (Lc 17.11; Jo 4.4; At 8.5).
THAYER.en: The central region of Palestine situated between Judea and Galilee, and also the name of its main historical city. 1. The region or city of Samaria (Luke 17:11; John 4:4; Acts 8:5).

DEFINITION: Designates an inhabitant or native of the region of Samaria, a people who had tense relations and cultural/religious separation from the Jews.
SENSES: 1. An inhabitant of the region of Samaria (Luke 17:16; John 4:9).

THAYER.pt: Designa um habitante ou nativo da região de Samaria, povo que possuía relações tensas e separação cultural/religiosa em relação aos judeus. 1. Habitante da região de Samaria (Lc 17.16; Jo 4.9).
THAYER.en: Designates an inhabitant or native of the region of Samaria, a people who had tense relations and cultural/religious separation from the Jews. 1. An inhabitant of the region of Samaria (Luke 17:16; John 4:9).

DEFINITION: Designates a woman originating from the region or city of Samaria. In the New Testament, it is associated with Jesus' historic encounter with the woman at Jacob's well.
SENSES: 1. A native or inhabitant woman of Samaria (Jn 4:9).

THAYER.pt: Designa uma mulher originária da região ou da cidade de Samaria. No Novo Testamento, aparece associada ao histórico encontro de Jesus com a mulher junto ao poço de Jacó. 1. Mulher nativa ou habitante de Samaria (Jo 4.9).
THAYER.en: Designates a woman originating from the region or city of Samaria. In the New Testament, it is associated with Jesus' historic encounter with the woman at Jacob's well. 1. A native or inhabitant woman of Samaria (Jn 4:9).

DEFINITION: A mountainous island situated in the northern region of the Aegean Sea.
SENSES: 1. An island where Paul's ship stopped on the journey toward Macedonia (Ac 16:11).

THAYER.pt: Ilha montanhosa situada na região norte do Mar Egeu. 1. Ilha onde a embarcação de Paulo fez escala na viagem rumo à Macedônia (At 16.11).
THAYER.en: A mountainous island situated in the northern region of the Aegean Sea. 1. An island where Paul's ship stopped on the journey toward Macedonia (Ac 16:11).

DEFINITION: A Greek island located in the Aegean Sea, near the western coast of Asia Minor.
SENSES: 1. A Greek island visited by the apostolic company on their return journey (Ac 20:15).

THAYER.pt: Ilha grega localizada no mar Egeu, próxima à costa ocidental da Ásia Menor. 1. Ilha grega visitada pela comitiva apostólica em sua viagem de retorno (At 20.15).
THAYER.en: A Greek island located in the Aegean Sea, near the western coast of Asia Minor. 1. A Greek island visited by the apostolic company on their return journey (Ac 20:15).

DEFINITION: Proper name of the great prophet and judge of the Old Testament.
SENSES: 1. Samuel, a prominent prophetic figure of Israel (Ac 13:20; Heb 11:32).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio do grande profeta e juiz do Antigo Testamento. 1. Samuel, figura profética proeminente de Israel (At 13.20; Hb 11.32).
THAYER.en: Proper name of the great prophet and judge of the Old Testament. 1. Samuel, a prominent prophetic figure of Israel (Ac 13:20; Heb 11:32).

DEFINITION: Famous judge and Nazirite of Israel known for his extraordinary physical strength and struggles against the Philistines.
SENSES: 1. An Old Testament historical figure cited as an example of faith (Heb 11:32).

THAYER.pt: Famoso juiz e nazireu de Israel conhecido por sua extraordinária força física e lutas contra os filisteus. 1. Personagem histórico do Antigo Testamento citado como exemplo de fé (Hb 11.32).
THAYER.en: Famous judge and Nazirite of Israel known for his extraordinary physical strength and struggles against the Philistines. 1. An Old Testament historical figure cited as an example of faith (Heb 11:32).

DEFINITION: A basic type of footwear in antiquity, consisting of a leather or other material sole fastened to the foot by straps or thongs.
SENSES: 1. Light footwear worn on the feet, secured by straps (Mk 6:9; Ac 12:8).

THAYER.pt: Tipo de calçado básico da antiguidade, consistindo de uma sola de couro ou outro material presa ao pé por tiras ou correias. 1. Calçado leve usado nos pés, preso por correias (Mc 6.9; At 12.8).
THAYER.en: A basic type of footwear in antiquity, consisting of a leather or other material sole fastened to the foot by straps or thongs. 1. Light footwear worn on the feet, secured by straps (Mk 6:9; Ac 12:8).

DEFINITION: A sawn, thin, and flat piece of wood, used in construction or as a floating element.
SENSES: 1. A wooden board or plank used by shipwreck survivors to save themselves (Ac 27:44).

THAYER.pt: Peça de madeira serrada, delgada e plana, usada em construções ou como elemento flutuante. 1. Tábua ou prancha de madeira utilizada pelos náufragos para se salvarem (At 27.44).
THAYER.en: A sawn, thin, and flat piece of wood, used in construction or as a floating element. 1. A wooden board or plank used by shipwreck survivors to save themselves (Ac 27:44).

DEFINITION: Hebrew name used in the New Testament to refer to the first king of Israel and also to the apostle Paul before his mission to the Gentiles.
SENSES: 1. Saul, the first king of Israel, son of Kish (Ac 13:21).
2. Saul of Tarsus, the Jewish name of the apostle Paul (Ac 9:4).

THAYER.pt: Nome hebraico utilizado no Novo Testamentto para se referir ao primeiro rei de Israel e também ao apóstolo Paulo antes de sua missão aos gentios. 1. Saul, o primeiro rei de Israel, filho de Kis (At 13.21). | 2. Saulo de Tarso, nome judaico do apóstolo Paulo (At 9.4).
THAYER.en: Hebrew name used in the New Testament to refer to the first king of Israel and also to the apostle Paul before his mission to the Gentiles. 1. Saul, the first king of Israel, son of Kish (Ac 13:21). | 2. Saul of Tarsus, the Jewish name of the apostle Paul (Ac 9:4).

DEFINITION: Said of something that is rotted, spoiled, or of such low quality that it becomes useless, worthless, or morally harmful.
SENSES: 1. Rotten, deteriorated, or of worthless quality (Mt 7:17; 13:48).
2. Morally corrupt, improper, or harmful, referring to speech (Eph 4:29).

THAYER.pt: Diz-se de algo que está apodrecido, estragado ou de tão baixa qualidade que se torna inútil, imprestável ou moralmente prejudicial. 1. Podre, deteriorado ou de qualidade imprestável (Mt 7:17; 13:48). | 2. Moralmente corrupto, impróprio ou prejudicial, referido ao discurso (Ef 4:29).
THAYER.en: Said of something that is rotted, spoiled, or of such low quality that it becomes useless, worthless, or morally harmful. 1. Rotten, deteriorated, or of worthless quality (Mt 7:17; 13:48). | 2. Morally corrupt, improper, or harmful, referring to speech (Eph 4:29).

DEFINITION: Female proper name of a woman in the early church in Jerusalem.
SENSES: 1. Wife of Ananias who died after lying to the Holy Spirit about the sale of a property.

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio feminino de uma mulher da igreja primitiva em Jerusalém. 1. Esposa de Ananias que morreu após mentir ao Espírito Santo sobre a venda de uma propriedade.
THAYER.en: Female proper name of a woman in the early church in Jerusalem. 1. Wife of Ananias who died after lying to the Holy Spirit about the sale of a property.

DEFINITION: A precious mineral gemstone with a bluish coloration, of great value in Antiquity.
SENSES: 1. Precious stone mentioned in descriptive and apocalyptic contexts.

THAYER.pt: Preciosa gema mineral de coloração azulada, de grande valor na Antiguidade. 1. Pedra preciosa mencionada em contextos descritivos e apocalípticos.
THAYER.en: A precious mineral gemstone with a bluish coloration, of great value in Antiquity. 1. Precious stone mentioned in descriptive and apocalyptic contexts.

DEFINITION: A woven basket made of ropes or rushes, sturdy and flexible.
SENSES: 1. A rope basket used to let the apostle Paul down through the wall of Damascus (2Co 11:33).

THAYER.pt: Um cesto trançado feito de cordas ou juncos, resistente e flexível. 1. Cesto de corda utilizado para descer o apóstolo Paulo pela muralha de Damasco (2Co 11.33).
THAYER.en: A woven basket made of ropes or rushes, sturdy and flexible. 1. A rope basket used to let the apostle Paul down through the wall of Damascus (2Co 11:33).

DEFINITION: Ancient capital of Lydia, in Asia Minor, where one of the seven churches of the Apocalypse was located.
SENSES: 1. The city of Sardis (Rev 1:11; 3:1, 4).

THAYER.pt: Antiga capital da Lídia, na Ásia Menor, onde se situava uma das sete igrejas do Apocalipse. 1. A cidade de Sardes (Ap 1.11; 3.1, 4).
THAYER.en: Ancient capital of Lydia, in Asia Minor, where one of the seven churches of the Apocalypse was located. 1. The city of Sardis (Rev 1:11; 3:1, 4).

DEFINITION: A reddish-colored gemstone, frequently associated with jasper and carnelian in apocalyptic descriptions.
SENSES: 1. A translucent red gemstone variety (Rev 4:3).

THAYER.pt: Uma pedra preciosa de coloração avermelhada, frequentemente associada ao jaspe e à cornalina nas descrições apocalípticas. 1. Variedade de gema translúcida de cor vermelha (Ap 4:3).
THAYER.en: A reddish-colored gemstone, frequently associated with jasper and carnelian in apocalyptic descriptions. 1. A translucent red gemstone variety (Rev 4:3).

DEFINITION: A reddish-colored gemstone, frequently identified as carnelian. It is mentioned in New Testament apocalyptic literature as part of the heavenly description.
SENSES: 1. A red-toned gemstone used in adornments and visual descriptions (Rev 21:20).

THAYER.pt: Pedra preciosa de coloração avermelhada, frequentemente identificada como a cornalina. É mencionada na apocalíptica neotestamentária como parte da descrição celestial. 1. Pedra preciosa de tom vermelho usada em adornos e descrições visuais (Ap 21.20).
THAYER.en: A reddish-colored gemstone, frequently identified as carnelian. It is mentioned in New Testament apocalyptic literature as part of the heavenly description. 1. A red-toned gemstone used in adornments and visual descriptions (Rev 21:20).

DEFINITION: A variety of agate or gemstone characterized by parallel layers of distinct colors (sard and onyx).
SENSES: 1. A striped precious gemstone that forms one of the foundation stones of the New Jerusalem wall (Rev 21:20).

THAYER.pt: Variedade de ágata ou pedra preciosa caracterizada por camadas paralelas de cores distintas (sardônio e ônix). 1. Gema preciosa listrada que compõe um dos fundamentos da muralha da Nova Jerusalém (Ap 21.20).
THAYER.en: A variety of agate or gemstone characterized by parallel layers of distinct colors (sard and onyx). 1. A striped precious gemstone that forms one of the foundation stones of the New Jerusalem wall (Rev 21:20).

DEFINITION: Ancient Phoenician coastal city situated between Tyre and Sidon.
SENSES: 1. Phoenician city where the prophet Elijah stayed in the house of a widow during the famine (Lk 4:26).

THAYER.pt: Antiga cidade fenícia costeira situada entre Tiro e Sidom. 1. Cidade fenícia onde o profeta Elias hospedou-se na casa de uma viúva durante a fome (Lc 4.26).
THAYER.en: Ancient Phoenician coastal city situated between Tyre and Sidon. 1. Phoenician city where the prophet Elijah stayed in the house of a widow during the famine (Lk 4:26).

DEFINITION: Pertaining to the material or physical sphere, or to human nature in its fragility and worldly inclination.
SENSES: 1. Pertaining to the material or physical realm (Rom 15:27).
2. Characteristic of natural or spiritually immature humanity (1Co 3:3).

THAYER.pt: Pertencente à esfera material, física ou à natureza humana em sua fragilidade e inclinação mundana. 1. Pertencente ao âmbito material ou físico (Rm 15:27). | 2. Característico da humanidade natural ou imatura espiritualmente (1Co 3:3).
THAYER.en: Pertaining to the material or physical sphere, or to human nature in its fragility and worldly inclination. 1. Pertaining to the material or physical realm (Rom 15:27). | 2. Characteristic of natural or spiritually immature humanity (1Co 3:3).

DEFINITION: Pertaining to the material and physical realm, or characterized by the fragility and limitations of human nature.
SENSES: 1. Made of flesh or physical matter, human (2Co 3:3; Heb 7:16).

THAYER.pt: Pertencente ao reino material e físico, ou caracterizado pela fragilidade e limitações da natureza humana. 1. Feito de carne ou matéria física, humano (2Co 3.3; Hb 7.16).
THAYER.en: Pertaining to the material and physical realm, or characterized by the fragility and limitations of human nature. 1. Made of flesh or physical matter, human (2Co 3:3; Heb 7:16).

DEFINITION: Originally designates the physical substance of the body of humans and animals. In the Pauline corpus, it acquires heavy theological weight to denote human fragility and, frequently, the fallen, rebellious nature inclined to sin.
SENSES: 1. The bodily substance covering bones; the physical body (1Co 15:39; Lk 24:39).
2. The fragile, mortal, earthly human condition (Jn 1:14; Gal 2:20).
3. The fallen and rebellious human nature in opposition to the Holy Spirit (Rom 8:4-7; Gal 5:16-19).
4. Natural lineage, genealogical kinship, or earthly descent (Rom 1:3; 9:3).

THAYER.pt: Designa originariamente a substância física do corpo de homens e animais. No corpus paulino, adquire forte peso teológico para denotar a fragilidade humana e, com frequência, a natureza caída e rebelde inclinada ao pecado. 1. A substância corporal que recobre os ossos; o corpo físico (1Co 15.39; Lc 24.39). | 2. A condição humana frágil, mortal e terrena (Jo 1.14; Gl 2.20). | 3. A natureza humana caída e rebelde em oposição ao Espírito Santo (Rm 8.4-7; Gl 5.16-19). | 4. Linhagem natural, parentesco genealógico ou descendência terrena (Rm 1.3; 9.3).
THAYER.en: Originally designates the physical substance of the body of humans and animals. In the Pauline corpus, it acquires heavy theological weight to denote human fragility and, frequently, the fallen, rebellious nature inclined to sin. 1. The bodily substance covering bones; the physical body (1Co 15:39; Lk 24:39). | 2. The fragile, mortal, earthly human condition (Jn 1:14; Gal 2:20). | 3. The fallen and rebellious human nature in opposition to the Holy Spirit (Rom 8:4-7; Gal 5:16-19). | 4. Natural lineage, genealogical kinship, or earthly descent (Rom 1:3; 9:3).

DEFINITION: Patriarchal ancestor in the genealogical lineage leading to Abraham and Jesus.
SENSES: 1. Descendant of Reu and ancestor of Abraham in the earthly genealogy of Christ (Lk 3:35).

THAYER.pt: Antepassado patriarcal na linhagem genealógica que conduz a Abraão e a Jesus. 1. Descendente de Reú e ancestral de Abraão na genealogia terrena de Cristo (Lc 3.35).
THAYER.en: Patriarchal ancestor in the genealogical lineage leading to Abraham and Jesus. 1. Descendant of Reu and ancestor of Abraham in the earthly genealogy of Christ (Lk 3:35).

DEFINITION: The act of cleaning the floor or removing dirt using a broom.
SENSES: 1. To sweep a house or surface (Mt 12:44; Lk 15:8).

THAYER.pt: O ato de limpar o chão ou remover a sujeira utilizando uma vassoura. 1. Varrer a casa ou uma superfície (Mt 12.44; Lc 15.8).
THAYER.en: The act of cleaning the floor or removing dirt using a broom. 1. To sweep a house or surface (Mt 12:44; Lk 15:8).

DEFINITION: Wife of Abraham and mother of Isaac in the biblical narrative of the Old and New Testaments.
SENSES: 1. Sarah, wife of Abraham (Rom 4:19; Heb 11:11).

THAYER.pt: Esposa de Abraão e mãe de Isaque na narrativa bíblica do Antigo e Novo Testamentos. 1. Sara, esposa de Abraão (Rm 4.19; Hb 11.11).
THAYER.en: Wife of Abraham and mother of Isaac in the biblical narrative of the Old and New Testaments. 1. Sarah, wife of Abraham (Rom 4:19; Heb 11:11).

DEFINITION: Sharon refers to a fertile coastal plain in Palestine, known for its beauty and pastures, mentioned in the New Testament in the context of conversions in the region.
SENSES: 1. A coastal plain situated between Joppa and Caesarea (Ac 9:35).

THAYER.pt: Saron refere-se a uma planície costeira fértil na Palestina, conhecida por sua beleza e pastagens, mencionada no Novo Testamento no contexto de conversões na região. 1. Planície costeira situada entre Jope e Cesareia (At 9.35).
THAYER.en: Sharon refers to a fertile coastal plain in Palestine, known for its beauty and pastures, mentioned in the New Testament in the context of conversions in the region. 1. A coastal plain situated between Joppa and Caesarea (Ac 9:35).

DEFINITION: Title or proper name of the principal evil spiritual being, opposer of God and enemy of humanity and the divine work.
SENSES: 1. The Adversary, the Devil, the supreme enemy of God (Mt 4:10; Mk 1:13).

THAYER.pt: Título ou nome próprio do principal ser espiritual maligno, opositor de Deus e inimigo da humanidade e da obra divina. 1. O Adversário, o Diabo, o inimigo supremo de Deus (Mt 4:10; Mc 1:13).
THAYER.en: Title or proper name of the principal evil spiritual being, opposer of God and enemy of humanity and the divine work. 1. The Adversary, the Devil, the supreme enemy of God (Mt 4:10; Mk 1:13).

DEFINITION: Proper name designating God's chief arch-enemy and leader of the spiritual forces of evil.
SENSES: 1. Satan, the Adversary and leader of demonic powers (Mt 4:10; Rev 20:2).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio que designa o principal arqui-inimigo de Deus e líder das forças espirituais do mal. 1. Satanás, o Adversário e líder dos poderes demoníacos (Mt 4.10; Ap 20.2).
THAYER.en: Proper name designating God's chief arch-enemy and leader of the spiritual forces of evil. 1. Satan, the Adversary and leader of demonic powers (Mt 4:10; Rev 20:2).

DEFINITION: An ancient Hebrew dry capacity measure (the seah), equivalent to approximately thirteen liters.
SENSES: 1. A unit of measure for grain and flour used in parabolic contexts (Mt 13:33; Lk 13:21).

THAYER.pt: Antiga medida de capacidade para secos de origem hebraica (o seah), equivalente a aproximadamente treze litros. 1. Unidade de medida de grãos e farinha usada em contextos parabólicos (Mt 13.33; Lc 13.21).
THAYER.en: An ancient Hebrew dry capacity measure (the seah), equivalent to approximately thirteen liters. 1. A unit of measure for grain and flour used in parabolic contexts (Mt 13:33; Lk 13:21).

DEFINITION: Original Hebrew name of the apostle Paul, widely used in accounts of his conversion and early ministry years.
SENSES: 1. The Jewish name of the apostle Paul (Ac 7:58; 8:1).

THAYER.pt: Nome hebraico original do apóstolo Paulo, amplamente utilizado nos relatos de sua conversão e primeiros anos ministeriais. 1. O nome judaico do apóstolo Paulo (At 7.58; 8.1).
THAYER.en: Original Hebrew name of the apostle Paul, widely used in accounts of his conversion and early ministry years. 1. The Jewish name of the apostle Paul (Ac 7:58; 8:1).

DEFINITION: To cause the combustion of a fire to cease or, in a metaphorical sense, to quench, repress, or extinguish the ardor of spiritual impulses.
SENSES: 1. To put out or extinguish literal fire or flames (Mt 12:20; Heb 11:34).
2. To suppress, quench, or stifle the working of the Holy Spirit (1Th 5:19).

THAYER.pt: Fazer cessar a combustão de um fogo ou, em sentido metafórico, apagar, reprimir ou extinguir o ardor de impulsos espirituais. 1. Apagar ou extinguir o fogo ou chamas literais (Mt 12:20; Hb 11:34). | 2. Suprimir, apagar ou sufocar a atuação do Espírito Santo (1Ts 5:19).
THAYER.en: To cause the combustion of a fire to cease or, in a metaphorical sense, to quench, repress, or extinguish the ardor of spiritual impulses. 1. To put out or extinguish literal fire or flames (Mt 12:20; Heb 11:34). | 2. To suppress, quench, or stifle the working of the Holy Spirit (1Th 5:19).

DEFINITION: Accusative form of the second-person singular personal pronoun, referring directly to the person being spoken to.
SENSES: 1. Pronoun indicating the direct object of a verbal action (you).

THAYER.pt: Forma de acusativo do pronome pessoal de segunda pessoa do singular, referindo-se diretamente à pessoa com quem se fala. 1. Pronome que indica o objeto direto da ação verbal (tu/ti/te).
THAYER.en: Accusative form of the second-person singular personal pronoun, referring directly to the person being spoken to. 1. Pronoun indicating the direct object of a verbal action (you).

DEFINITION: A second-person singular reflexive pronoun, used when the subject and the object of the action coincide.
SENSES: 1. Reflexive reference to the interlocutor themselves, yourself (Matt 4:6; John 8:13).

THAYER.pt: Pronome reflexivo de segunda pessoa do singular, usado quando o sujeito e o objeto da ação coincidem. 1. Referência reflexiva ao próprio interlocutor, a ti mesmo (Mt 4.6; Jo 8.13).
THAYER.en: A second-person singular reflexive pronoun, used when the subject and the object of the action coincide. 1. Reflexive reference to the interlocutor themselves, yourself (Matt 4:6; John 8:13).

DEFINITION: To demonstrate deep reverence, religious fear, or worship, frequently directed toward deities or icons.
SENSES: 1. To render religious worship or reverence to deities or to the creation rather than the Creator (Rom 1:25).

THAYER.pt: Demonstrar profunda reverência, temor religioso ou adoração, frequentemente direcionada a divindades ou ícones. 1. Prestar culto ou reverência religiosa a divindades ou à criação em detrimento do Criador (Rm 1.25).
THAYER.en: To demonstrate deep reverence, religious fear, or worship, frequently directed toward deities or icons. 1. To render religious worship or reverence to deities or to the creation rather than the Creator (Rom 1:25).

DEFINITION: Any object, idol, or place dedicated to devout worship and religious reverence. In the New Testament, it refers to the altars or deities worshipped by pagans.
SENSES: 1. An object or deity that is the target of religious worship (Acts 17:23).

THAYER.pt: Qualquer objeto, ídolo ou lugar dedicado à devota adoração e reverência religiosa. No Novo Testamento, refere-se aos altares ou divindidades cultuadas pelos pagãos. 1. Objeto ou divindade alvo de adoração religiosa (At 17.23).
THAYER.en: Any object, idol, or place dedicated to devout worship and religious reverence. In the New Testament, it refers to the altars or deities worshipped by pagans. 1. An object or deity that is the target of religious worship (Acts 17:23).

DEFINITION: A Greek term that translates the Latin title 'Augustus', used to designate the Roman emperor and his status of political or semi-divine reverence.
SENSES: 1. Reference to the official title of the Roman emperor (Acts 25:21).

THAYER.pt: Termo grego que traduz o título latino 'Augustus', empregado para designar o imperador romano e o seu status de reverência política ou semidivina. 1. Referência ao título oficial do imperador romano (At 25.21).
THAYER.en: A Greek term that translates the Latin title 'Augustus', used to designate the Roman emperor and his status of political or semi-divine reverence. 1. Reference to the official title of the Roman emperor (Acts 25:21).

DEFINITION: To express reverence, deep respect, and religious worship toward the deity.
SENSES: 1. To render religious worship and veneration to God (Matt 15:9; Acts 16:14).

THAYER.pt: Expressar reverência, respeito profundo e adoração religiosa para com a divindade. 1. Prestar culto e veneração religiosa a Deus (Mt 15.9; At 16.14).
THAYER.en: To express reverence, deep respect, and religious worship toward the deity. 1. To render religious worship and veneration to God (Matt 15:9; Acts 16:14).

DEFINITION: A flexible instrument used to bind, secure, or chain prisoners, indicating imprisonment or severe restriction.
SENSES: 1. Chains or ropes used figuratively to imprison spiritual beings in darkness (2 Pet 2:4).

THAYER.pt: Um instrumento flexível usado para amarrar, prender ou acorrentar prisioneiros, indicando aprisionamento ou restrição severa. 1. Cadeias ou cordas usadas figurativamente para aprisionar seres espirituais em trevas (2Pe 2.4).
THAYER.en: A flexible instrument used to bind, secure, or chain prisoners, indicating imprisonment or severe restriction. 1. Chains or ropes used figuratively to imprison spiritual beings in darkness (2 Pet 2:4).

DEFINITION: Refers to a violent agitation, whether of the earth in the form of an earthquake, or of the waters in the form of a maritime storm.
SENSES: 1. A violent and sudden movement of the earth's crust, an earthquake (Matt 27:54; Rev 6:12).
2. A great disturbance or violent storm on the waters (Matt 8:24).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se a uma agitação violenta, seja da terra na forma de um terremoto, seja das águas na forma de uma tempestade marítima. 1. Movimento violento e súbito da crosta terrestre, terremoto (Mt 27.54; Ap 6.12). | 2. Grande perturbação ou tempestade violenta nas águas (Mt 8.24).
THAYER.en: Refers to a violent agitation, whether of the earth in the form of an earthquake, or of the waters in the form of a maritime storm. 1. A violent and sudden movement of the earth's crust, an earthquake (Matt 27:54; Rev 6:12). | 2. A great disturbance or violent storm on the waters (Matt 8:24).

DEFINITION: To move something back and forth with violence, causing physical trembling or profound commotion.
SENSES: 1. To shake or cause the earth or structures to tremble (Heb 12:26);
2. To provoke strong trembling or fear in people (Mt 28:4).

THAYER.pt: Movimentar algo de um lado para o outro com violência, gerando tremor físico ou comoção profunda. 1. Agitar ou fazer tremer a terra ou estruturas (Hb 12:26); | 2. Provocar forte tremor ou temor em pessoas (Mt 28:4).
THAYER.en: To move something back and forth with violence, causing physical trembling or profound commotion. 1. To shake or cause the earth or structures to tremble (Heb 12:26); | 2. To provoke strong trembling or fear in people (Mt 28:4).

DEFINITION: A masculine proper name referring to a Thessalonian Christian who accompanied the apostle Paul during part of his travels.
SENSES: 1. A Christian from Thessalonica who accompanied Paul (Acts 20:4).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio masculino referente a um cristão tessalonicense que acompanhou o apóstolo Paulo em parte de suas viagens. 1. Cristiano natural de Tessalônica que acompanhou Paulo (At 20.4).
THAYER.en: A masculine proper name referring to a Thessalonian Christian who accompanied the apostle Paul during part of his travels. 1. A Christian from Thessalonica who accompanied Paul (Acts 20:4).

DEFINITION: A port city situated at the mouth of the Orontes River, serving as the seaport for the city of Antioch in Syria.
SENSES: 1. The port of Antioch in Syria from which Paul and Barnabas sailed (Acts 13:4).

THAYER.pt: Cidade portuária situada na foz do rio Orontes, servindo como o porto marítimo da cidade de Antioquia da Síria. 1. Porto de Antioquia na Síria de onde Paulo e Barnabé navegaram (At 13.4).
THAYER.en: A port city situated at the mouth of the Orontes River, serving as the seaport for the city of Antioch in Syria. 1. The port of Antioch in Syria from which Paul and Barnabas sailed (Acts 13:4).

DEFINITION: The natural satellite of the Earth, frequently mentioned in cosmological, prophetic, or eschatological contexts in the New Testament.
SENSES: 1. The celestial body that shines at night, the moon (Lk 21:25; Rev 6:12).

THAYER.pt: O satélite natural da Terra, frequentemente mencionado em contextos cosmológicos, proféticos ou escatológicos no Novo Testamento. 1. O corpo celeste que brilha à noite, a lua (Lc 21.25; Ap 6.12).
THAYER.en: The natural satellite of the Earth, frequently mentioned in cosmological, prophetic, or eschatological contexts in the New Testament. 1. The celestial body that shines at night, the moon (Lk 21:25; Rev 6:12).

DEFINITION: To be subject to seizures or epileptic attacks, the occurrence of which was popularly associated in antiquity with the phases or influences of the moon.
SENSES: 1. To suffer from epileptic seizures or periodic convulsive disorders (Mt 17:15).

THAYER.pt: Ficar sujeito a convulsões ou ataques epiléticos, cuja ocorrência era popularmente associada na antiguidade às fases ou influências da lua. 1. Sofrer de crises epiléticas ou distúrbios convulsivos periódicos (Mt 17.15).
THAYER.en: To be subject to seizures or epileptic attacks, the occurrence of which was popularly associated in antiquity with the phases or influences of the moon. 1. To suffer from epileptic seizures or periodic convulsive disorders (Mt 17:15).

DEFINITION: A masculine proper name found in the genealogy of Jesus according to the account in the Gospel of Luke.
SENSES: 1. An ancestor in the human lineage of Jesus (Lk 3:26, according to manuscripts).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio masculino encontrado na genealogia de Jesus segundo o relato do Evangelho de Lucas. 1. Ancestral na linhagem humana de Jesus (Lc 3.26, conforme manuscritos).
THAYER.en: A masculine proper name found in the genealogy of Jesus according to the account in the Gospel of Luke. 1. An ancestor in the human lineage of Jesus (Lk 3:26, according to manuscripts).

DEFINITION: Wheat flour of the highest quality and purity, generally used in special religious offerings or fine culinary arts.
SENSES: 1. First-quality wheat flour traded in large cities (Rev 18:13).

THAYER.pt: Farinha de trigo de altíssima qualidade e pureza, geralmente utilizada em ofertas religiosas especiais ou na culinária fina. 1. Farinha de trigo de primeira qualidade comercializada em grandes cidades (Ap 18.13).
THAYER.en: Wheat flour of the highest quality and purity, generally used in special religious offerings or fine culinary arts. 1. First-quality wheat flour traded in large cities (Rev 18:13).

DEFINITION: That which inspires respect and admiration due to dignified, noble, and morally serious conduct.
SENSES: 1. Worthy of respect, honorable, and of irreproachable character (1Tm 3:8; Phil 4:8).

THAYER.pt: Que inspira respeito e admiração devido a uma conduta digna, nobre e moralmente séria. 1. Digno de respeito, honrado e de caráter irrepreensível (1Tm 3.8; Fp 4.8).
THAYER.en: That which inspires respect and admiration due to dignified, noble, and morally serious conduct. 1. Worthy of respect, honorable, and of irreproachable character (1Tm 3:8; Phil 4:8).

DEFINITION: Behavior or posture that denotes dignity, seriousness, and honor, making a person deserving of respect and moral appreciation.
SENSES: 1. A posture of dignity and seriousness in Christian conduct (1Tm 3:4).

THAYER.pt: Comportamento ou postura que denota dignidade, seriedade e honra, tornando a pessoa merecedora de respeito e apreço moral. 1. Postura de dignidade e seriedade na conduta cristã (1Tm 3.4).
THAYER.en: Behavior or posture that denotes dignity, seriousness, and honor, making a person deserving of respect and moral appreciation. 1. A posture of dignity and seriousness in Christian conduct (1Tm 3:4).

DEFINITION: The name of a Roman gens, specifically associated with the Roman proconsul of the island of Cyprus who heard Paul's preaching.
SENSES: 1. Sergius Paulus, Roman proconsul of Cyprus (Acts 13:7).

THAYER.pt: Nome de uma gens romana, especificamente associado ao procônsul romano da ilha de Chipre que ouviu a pregação de Paulo. 1. Sérgio Paulo, procônsul romano de Chipre (At 13.7).
THAYER.en: The name of a Roman gens, specifically associated with the Roman proconsul of the island of Cyprus who heard Paul's preaching. 1. Sergius Paulus, Roman proconsul of Cyprus (Acts 13:7).

DEFINITION: The third son of Adam and Eve, born after the death of Abel, included in the biblical genealogies that trace back to Jesus.
SENSES: 1. Son of Adam and ancestor in the genealogy of Christ (Lk 3:38).

THAYER.pt: Terceiro filho de Adão e Eva, nascido após a morte de Abel, incluído nas genealogias bíblicas que remontam até Jesus. 1. Filho de Adão e ancestral na genealogia de Cristo (Lc 3.38).
THAYER.en: The third son of Adam and Eve, born after the death of Abel, included in the biblical genealogies that trace back to Jesus. 1. Son of Adam and ancestor in the genealogy of Christ (Lk 3:38).

DEFINITION: The eldest son of Noah, a biblical patriarch and ancestor of the Semitic peoples, present in the lineage of human descent up to the Messiah.
SENSES: 1. Son of Noah and ancestor of Jesus in the lineage of Luke (Lk 3:36).

THAYER.pt: Filho mais velho de Noé, patriarca bíblico e ancestral dos povos semitas, presente na linhagem de descendência humana até o Messias. 1. Filho de Noé e ancestral de Jesus na linhagem de Lucas (Lc 3.36).
THAYER.en: The eldest son of Noah, a biblical patriarch and ancestor of the Semitic peoples, present in the lineage of human descent up to the Messiah. 1. Son of Noah and ancestor of Jesus in the lineage of Luke (Lk 3:36).

DEFINITION: To make something clear and understandable by means of words, signs, reports, or prophecies.
SENSES: 1. To communicate, report, or transmit specific information (Acts 25:27).
2. To indicate prophetically or signal future events (Acts 11:28; Rev 1:1).

THAYER.pt: Tornar algo claro e compreensível por meio de palavras, sinais, relatórios ou profecias. 1. Comunicar, relatar ou transmitir uma informação específica (At 25.27). | 2. Indicar profeticamente ou sinalizar eventos futuros (At 11.28; Ap 1.1).
THAYER.en: To make something clear and understandable by means of words, signs, reports, or prophecies. 1. To communicate, report, or transmit specific information (Acts 25:27). | 2. To indicate prophetically or signal future events (Acts 11:28; Rev 1:1).

DEFINITION: A distinctive mark, indicator, or miraculous event that points beyond itself, authenticating a prophetic message or divine messianic authority.
SENSES: 1. A distinctive sign of recognition or confirmation (Mt 26:48; Lk 2:12; Rom 4:11).
2. A portentous miracle performed by divine power with spiritual significance (Jn 2:11; Acts 4:30; 2Cor 12:12).
3. A celestial portent or prophetic event that anticipates the end of times (Mt 24:3; Lk 21:11; Rev 12:1).

THAYER.pt: Marca distintiva, indicador ou evento milagroso que aponta para além de si mesmo, autenticando uma mensagem profética ou a autoridade messiânica divina. 1. Sinal distintivo de reconhecimento ou confirmação (Mt 26.48; Lc 2.12; Rm 4.11). | 2. Milagre portentoso operado pelo poder divino com significado espiritual (Jo 2.11; At 4.30; 2Co 12.12). | 3. Portento celestial ou acontecimento profético que antecipa o fim dos tempos (Mt 24.3; Lk 21.11; Ap 12.1).
THAYER.en: A distinctive mark, indicator, or miraculous event that points beyond itself, authenticating a prophetic message or divine messianic authority. 1. A distinctive sign of recognition or confirmation (Mt 26:48; Lk 2:12; Rom 4:11). | 2. A portentous miracle performed by divine power with spiritual significance (Jn 2:11; Acts 4:30; 2Cor 12:12). | 3. A celestial portent or prophetic event that anticipates the end of times (Mt 24:3; Lk 21:11; Rev 12:1).

DEFINITION: To pay special attention to something or someone, generally with the goal of registering, remembering, or taking future precautions.
SENSES: 1. To mark or take note of someone to avoid association (2Th 3:14).

THAYER.pt: Prestar especial atenção a algo ou alguém, geralmente com o objetivo de registrar, lembrar ou tomar precauções futuras. 1. Marcar ou tomar nota de alguém para evitar associação (2Ts 3.14).
THAYER.en: To pay special attention to something or someone, generally with the goal of registering, remembering, or taking future precautions. 1. To mark or take note of someone to avoid association (2Th 3:14).

DEFINITION: An adverb denoting the same day in which the discourse or narrated action occurs, emphasizing the present moment.
SENSES: 1. On this day, in the present time (Mt 6:11; 16:3).

THAYER.pt: Advérbio que denota o mesmo dia em que corre o discurso ou a ação narrada, enfatizando o momento presente. 1. No dia de hoje, no tempo presente (Mt 6.11; 16.3).
THAYER.en: An adverb denoting the same day in which the discourse or narrated action occurs, emphasizing the present moment. 1. On this day, in the present time (Mt 6:11; 16:3).

DEFINITION: To cause rotting or deterioration in organic matter, or to undergo the process of decomposition and ruin.
SENSES: 1. To rot or deteriorate organically (Jas 5:2).

THAYER.pt: Causar apodrecimento ou deterioração em matéria orgânica, ou sofrer o processo de decomposição e ruína. 1. Apodrecer ou deteriorar-se organicamente (Tg 5.2).
THAYER.en: To cause rotting or deterioration in organic matter, or to undergo the process of decomposition and ruin. 1. To rot or deteriorate organically (Jas 5:2).

DEFINITION: Pertaining or relating to silk, a luxurious fabric derived from the cocoons of silkworms.
SENSES: 1. Fine fabric made of silk, associated with luxury garments (Rev 18:12).

THAYER.pt: Pertencente ou relativo à seda, tecido luxuoso derivado dos casulos do bicho-da-seda. 1. Tecido fino feito de seda, associado a vestimentas de luxo (Ap 18.12).
THAYER.en: Pertaining or relating to silk, a luxurious fabric derived from the cocoons of silkworms. 1. Fine fabric made of silk, associated with luxury garments (Rev 18:12).

DEFINITION: An insect whose larvae feed on fabrics and clothing, frequently used in the Scriptures as a symbol of destruction and the transience of material goods.
SENSES: 1. The moth as an agent of destruction for garments (Mt 6:19; Lk 12:33).

THAYER.pt: Inseto cujas larvas se alimentam de tecidos e roupas, frequentemente usado nas Escrituras como símbolo de destruição e transitoriedade dos bens materiais. 1. A traça como agente destruidor de vestimentas (Mt 6.19; Lc 12.33).
THAYER.en: An insect whose larvae feed on fabrics and clothing, frequently used in the Scriptures as a symbol of destruction and the transience of material goods. 1. The moth as an agent of destruction for garments (Mt 6:19; Lk 12:33).

DEFINITION: Refers to clothes, fabrics, or materials that have been damaged, holed, or consumed by moth larvae.
SENSES: 1. Damaged or destroyed by moths (Jas 5:2).

THAYER.pt: Diz respeito a roupas, tecidos ou materiais que foram danificados, furados ou consumidos pelas larvas de traças. 1. Danificado ou destruído por traças (Tg 5.2).
THAYER.en: Refers to clothes, fabrics, or materials that have been damaged, holed, or consumed by moth larvae. 1. Damaged or destroyed by moths (Jas 5:2).

DEFINITION: To confer strength, vigor, or capacity upon someone, opposing spiritual or physical weakness.
SENSES: 1. To strengthen spiritually and confirm the believer in grace (1 Pet 5:10).

THAYER.pt: Conferir força, vigor ou capacidade a alguém, opondo-se à fraqueza espiritual ou física. 1. Fortalecer espiritualmente e firmar o crente na graça (1Pe 5.10).
THAYER.en: To confer strength, vigor, or capacity upon someone, opposing spiritual or physical weakness. 1. To strengthen spiritually and confirm the believer in grace (1 Pet 5:10).

DEFINITION: The fleshy part on both sides of the human face, or the jawbone. In New Testament context, it appears in teachings regarding non-retaliation.
SENSES: 1. The region of the cheek or the lower jaw (Matt 5:39; Luke 6:29).

THAYER.pt: A parte carnuda de ambos os lados da face humana, ou o osso da mandíbula. Em contexto neotestamentário, aparece em ensinamentos sobre a não-retaliação. 1. A região da bochecha ou o maxilar inferior (Mt 5.39; Lc 6.29).
THAYER.en: The fleshy part on both sides of the human face, or the jawbone. In New Testament context, it appears in teachings regarding non-retaliation. 1. The region of the cheek or the lower jaw (Matt 5:39; Luke 6:29).

SHORT_GLOSS: to be silent, to keep secret
DEFINITION: To refrain from speaking, maintaining silence or concealing something so that it does not become known.
SENSES: 1. To remain silent or say nothing in a specific situation (Acts 12:17; 1 Cor 14:28).
2. To keep something secret or hide a mystery (Rom 16:25).
USAGE: to be silent, to keep secret

THAYER.pt: Significa abster-se de falar, mantendo silêncio ou ocultando algo para que não seja conhecido. 1. Ficar em silêncio ou não dizer nada em uma situação específica (Ac 12.17; 1Co 14.28). | 2. Manter algo em segredo ou ocultar um mistério (Rm 16.25).
THAYER.en: To refrain from speaking, maintaining silence or concealing something so that it does not become known. 1. To remain silent or say nothing in a specific situation (Acts 12:17; 1 Cor 14:28). | 2. To keep something secret or hide a mystery (Rom 16:25).

DEFINITION: The complete absence of noise, sound, or speech. In narrative contexts, it indicates moments of profound quietness before an audience or situation.
SENSES: 1. Absolute silence or cessation of noises and words (Acts 21:40).

THAYER.pt: A completa ausência de ruído, som ou fala. No contexto narrativo, indica momentos de profunda quietude diante de uma plateia ou situação. 1. Silêncio absoluto ou cessação de ruídos e palavras (At 21.40).
THAYER.en: The complete absence of noise, sound, or speech. In narrative contexts, it indicates moments of profound quietness before an audience or situation. 1. Absolute silence or cessation of noises and words (Acts 21:40).

DEFINITION: Made of the metal iron, denoting extreme hardness, resistance, or utensils manufactured from this material.
SENSES: 1. Composed of iron or made entirely of iron.

THAYER.pt: Feito do metal ferro, denotando extrema dureza, resistência ou utensílios fabricados com este material. 1. Composto de ferro ou feito inteiramente de ferro.
THAYER.en: Made of the metal iron, denoting extreme hardness, resistance, or utensils manufactured from this material. 1. Composed of iron or made entirely of iron.

DEFINITION: Hard and resistant metal widely used in antiquity for the manufacture of tools, weapons, and heavy utensils.
SENSES: 1. The metal iron as a material of goods and commerce (Rev 18:12).

THAYER.pt: Metal duro e resistente amplamente utilizado na antiguidade para a fabricação de ferramentas, armas e utensílios pesados. 1. O metal ferro como material de bens e comércio (Ap 18.12).
THAYER.en: Hard and resistant metal widely used in antiquity for the manufacture of tools, weapons, and heavy utensils. 1. The metal iron as a material of goods and commerce (Rev 18:12).

DEFINITION: Ancient and important Phoenician city located on the Mediterranean coast, frequently associated with Tyre in the Gospels.
SENSES: 1. The coastal city of Sidon (Matt 11:21; Acts 27:3).

THAYER.pt: Antiga e importante cidade fenícia localizada na costa do Mar Mediterrâneo, frequentemente associada a Tiro nos evangelhos. 1. A cidade costeira de Sidom (Mt 11.21; Ac 27.3).
THAYER.en: Ancient and important Phoenician city located on the Mediterranean coast, frequently associated with Tyre in the Gospels. 1. The coastal city of Sidon (Matt 11:21; Acts 27:3).

DEFINITION: Relating to the Phoenician city of Sidon, or applicable to its native inhabitants.
SENSES: 1. Pertaining or relating to the city of Sidon (Acts 12:20).

THAYER.pt: Relativo à cidade fenícia de Sidom, ou aplicável aos seus habitantes nativos. 1. Pertencente ou relativo à cidade de Sidom (At 12.20).
THAYER.en: Relating to the Phoenician city of Sidon, or applicable to its native inhabitants. 1. Pertaining or relating to the city of Sidon (Acts 12:20).

DEFINITION: Member of a Jewish extremist Zealot group who used hidden daggers to assassinate political opponents during Roman rule.
SENSES: 1. Political assassin or terrorist armed with a dagger (Acts 21:38).

THAYER.pt: Membro de um grupo extremista judeu zelote que usava adagas escondidas para assassinar opositores políticos durante a dominação romana. 1. Assassino político ou terrorista armado com uma adaga (At 21.38).
THAYER.en: Member of a Jewish extremist Zealot group who used hidden daggers to assassinate political opponents during Roman rule. 1. Political assassin or terrorist armed with a dagger (Acts 21:38).

DEFINITION: Any fermented alcoholic drink not exclusively derived from grapes, commonly made from grain or fruit.
SENSES: 1. Intoxicating or strong fermented drink (Luke 1:15).

THAYER.pt: Qualquer bebida alcoólica fermentada que não seja derivada exclusivamente da uva, comumente feita de grãos ou frutas. 1. Bebida inebriante ou fermentada forte (Lc 1.15).
THAYER.en: Any fermented alcoholic drink not exclusively derived from grapes, commonly made from grain or fruit. 1. Intoxicating or strong fermented drink (Luke 1:15).

DEFINITION: Respected leader in the Jerusalem church, endowed with the prophetic gift and Paul's main companion in his missionary journeys.
SENSES: 1. Silas, co-worker of the apostle Paul on missionary journeys (Acts 15:22; 1 Thess 1:1).

THAYER.pt: Líder respeitado na igreja de Jerusalém, dotado de dom profético e principal companheiro de Paulo em suas viagens missionárias. 1. Silas, cooperador do apóstolo Paulo nas viagens missionárias (At 15.22; 1Ts 1.1).
THAYER.en: Respected leader in the Jerusalem church, endowed with the prophetic gift and Paul's main companion in his missionary journeys. 1. Silas, co-worker of the apostle Paul on missionary journeys (Acts 15:22; 1 Thess 1:1).

DEFINITION: Apostolic collaborator, widely identified with Silas in the accounts of the book of Acts and in the Pauline epistles.
SENSES: 1. Silvanus, companion of Paul and co-author of epistles (2 Cor 1:19; 1 Pet 5:12).

THAYER.pt: Colaborador apostólico, amplamente identificado com Silas nos relatos do livro de Atos e nas epístolas paulinas. 1. Silvano, companheiro de Paulo e coautor de epístolas (2Co 1.19; 1Pe 5.12).
THAYER.en: Apostolic collaborator, widely identified with Silas in the accounts of the book of Acts and in the Pauline epistles. 1. Silvanus, companion of Paul and co-author of epistles (2 Cor 1:19; 1 Pet 5:12).

DEFINITION: Name of a water supply system and the famous pool located in Jerusalem, associated with miracles and episodes narrated in the New Testament.
SENSES: 1. The pool or tank of Siloam (John 9:7; Luke 13:4).

THAYER.pt: Nome de um sistema de abastecimento de água e do famoso tanque localizado em Jerusalém, associado a milagres e episódios narrados no Novo Testamento. 1. O tanque ou piscina de Siloé (Jo 9.7; Lc 13.4).
THAYER.en: Name of a water supply system and the famous pool located in Jerusalem, associated with miracles and episodes narrated in the New Testament. 1. The pool or tank of Siloam (John 9:7; Luke 13:4).

DEFINITION: An apron or rudimentary piece of cloth worn by workers and artisans to protect clothing during physical labor.
SENSES: 1. Working apron worn by artisans (Acts 19:12).

THAYER.pt: Um avental ou peça de pano rudimentar usada por trabalhadores e artesãos para proteger a roupa durante o trabalho físico. 1. Avental de trabalho usado por artífices (At 19.12).
THAYER.en: An apron or rudimentary piece of cloth worn by workers and artisans to protect clothing during physical labor. 1. Working apron worn by artisans (Acts 19:12).

DEFINITION: Very common Greek proper name in first-century Judaism, borne by several prominent figures in the New Testament, notably Simon Peter.
SENSES: 1. Simon Peter, the chief apostle among the Twelve (Matt 4:18; John 1:42).
2. Other characters named Simon, such as the Zealot, the brother of Jesus, and Simon of Cyrene (Matt 10:4; 13:55; 27:32).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio grego muito comum no judaísmo do primeiro século, portado por várias figuras proeminentes do Novo Testamento, com destaque para Simão Pedro. 1. Simão Pedro, o principal apóstolo entre os Doze (Mt 4.18; Jo 1.42). | 2. Outros personagens chamados Simão, como o Zelote, o irmão de Jesus e Simão de Cirene (Mt 10.4; 13.55; 27.32).
THAYER.en: Very common Greek proper name in first-century Judaism, borne by several prominent figures in the New Testament, notably Simon Peter. 1. Simon Peter, the chief apostle among the Twelve (Matt 4:18; John 1:42). | 2. Other characters named Simon, such as the Zealot, the brother of Jesus, and Simon of Cyrene (Matt 10:4; 13:55; 27:32).

DEFINITION: Rocky mountain located on the peninsula of the same name, famous for being the place where the Law was given to Moses.
SENSES: 1. Mount Sinai (Acts 7:30; Gal 4:24).

THAYER.pt: Monte rochoso localizado na península homônima, célebre por ter sido o local onde a Lei foi dada a Moisés. 1. O Monte Sinai (At 7.30; Gl 4.24).
THAYER.en: Rocky mountain located on the peninsula of the same name, famous for being the place where the Law was given to Moses. 1. Mount Sinai (Acts 7:30; Gal 4:24).

DEFINITION: Herbaceous plant notable for producing an extremely small seed that develops into a large bush.
SENSES: 1. The mustard plant and its proverbial seed (Matt 13:31).

THAYER.pt: Planta herbácea notável por produzir uma semente extremamente pequena que se desenvolve em um arbusto de grande porte. 1. A planta de mostarda e sua semente proverbial (Mt 13:31).
THAYER.en: Herbaceous plant notable for producing an extremely small seed that develops into a large bush. 1. The mustard plant and its proverbial seed (Matt 13:31).

DEFINITION: Fine high-quality linen fabric used for light garments or for wrapping buried bodies.
SENSES: 1. Linen sheet or fine fabric used in burial (Matt 27:59; Mark 15:46).
2. Light linen garment worn on the body (Mark 14:51).

THAYER.pt: Tecido fino de linho de alta qualidade utilizado para vestimentas leves ou para envolver corpos sepultados. 1. Lençol ou tecido fino de linho usado no sepultamento (Mt 27.59; Mc 15.46). | 2. Peça de roupa leve de linho usada sobre o corpo (Mc 14.51).
THAYER.en: Fine high-quality linen fabric used for light garments or for wrapping buried bodies. 1. Linen sheet or fine fabric used in burial (Matt 27:59; Mark 15:46). | 2. Light linen garment worn on the body (Mark 14:51).

DEFINITION: To agitate grain in a sieve to separate chaff or impurities, used metaphorically for severe tests of faith and trials.
SENSES: 1. To sift grain literally or test someone through great tribulation (Luke 22:31).

THAYER.pt: Agitar grãos em uma peneira para separar o joio ou impurezas, usado metaforicamente para testes severos de fé e provações. 1. Peneirar grãos literalmente ou provar alguém através de grande tribulação (Lc 22.31).
THAYER.en: To agitate grain in a sieve to separate chaff or impurities, used metaphorically for severe tests of faith and trials. 1. To sift grain literally or test someone through great tribulation (Luke 22:31).

DEFINITION: Quality of animals that have been well-fed with grain for slaughter, indicating high value or preparation for an important feast.
SENSES: 1. The fatted calf prepared for a great celebration (Luke 15:23).

THAYER.pt: Qualidade de animais que foram bem alimentados com grãos para o abate, indicando alto valor ou preparação para uma festa importante. 1. O bezerro cevado preparado para uma grande celebração (Lc 15.23).
THAYER.en: Quality of animals that have been well-fed with grain for slaughter, indicating high value or preparation for an important feast. 1. The fatted calf prepared for a great celebration (Luke 15:23).

DEFINITION: Refers to animals that have been fed high-quality grain to become fat, suitable for banquets.
SENSES: 1. Fattened animals prepared for great feasts (Matt 22:4).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se a animais que foram alimentados com grãos de alta qualidade para ficarem gordos, próprios para banquetes. 1. Animais cevados e preparados para grandes festas (Mt 22.4).
THAYER.en: Refers to animals that have been fed high-quality grain to become fat, suitable for banquets. 1. Fattened animals prepared for great feasts (Matt 22:4).

DEFINITION: A measured portion or regular ration of grain or food distributed to servants or subordinates.
SENSES: 1. The due food ration distributed at the proper time (Luke 12:42).

THAYER.pt: Uma porção medida ou ração regular de grãos ou alimentos distribuída a servos ou subordinados. 1. A ração de comida devida e distribuída na época certa (Lc 12.42).
THAYER.en: A measured portion or regular ration of grain or food distributed to servants or subordinates. 1. The due food ration distributed at the proper time (Luke 12:42).

DEFINITION: Widely cultivated cereal used to produce flour and bread, representing grain par excellence.
SENSES: 1. The wheat plant or harvested grain for food (Matt 13:25; Luke 16:7).

THAYER.pt: Cereal cultivado amplamente utilizado para produzir farinha e pão, representando o grão por excelência. 1. A planta do trigo ou os grãos colhidos para alimentação (Mt 13.25; Lk 16.7).
THAYER.en: Widely cultivated cereal used to produce flour and bread, representing grain par excellence. 1. The wheat plant or harvested grain for food (Matt 13:25; Luke 16:7).

DEFINITION: Original name of a hill in Jerusalem, used extensively to designate the holy city and the people of God.
SENSES: 1. Mount Zion, a hill in Jerusalem (Heb 12:22).
2. The city of Jerusalem (Matt 21:5).
3. The people of God or spiritual Israel (Rom 9:33).

THAYER.pt: Nome original de uma colina de Jerusalém, usada extensivamente para designar a cidade sagrada e o povo de Deus. 1. O Monte Sião, colina em Jerusalém (Hb 12:22). | 2. A cidade de Jerusalém (Mt 21:5). | 3. O povo de Deus ou Israel espiritual (Rm 9:33).
THAYER.en: Original name of a hill in Jerusalem, used extensively to designate the holy city and the people of God. 1. Mount Zion, a hill in Jerusalem (Heb 12:22). | 2. The city of Jerusalem (Matt 21:5). | 3. The people of God or spiritual Israel (Rom 9:33).

DEFINITION: Describes the act of refraining the voice, ceasing speech, or making silence, and can also describe calm after a storm.
SENSES: 1. To abstain from speaking or making noise, to keep silence (Matt 26:63; Mark 3:4).
2. To stop speaking or become calm, to quiet down (Mark 4:39).

THAYER.pt: Descreve o ato de refrear a voz, cessar a fala ou fazer silêncio, podendo também descrever a calmaria após uma tempestade. 1. Abster-se de falar ou fazer barulho, guardar silêncio (Mt 26.63; Mc 3.4). | 2. Parar de falar ou tornar-se calmo, acalmar-se (Mc 4.39).
THAYER.en: Describes the act of refraining the voice, ceasing speech, or making silence, and can also describe calm after a storm. 1. To abstain from speaking or making noise, to keep silence (Matt 26:63; Mark 3:4). | 2. To stop speaking or become calm, to quiet down (Mark 4:39).

DEFINITION: To place a moral obstacle that induces someone to sin, or to cause deep indignation, shock, and repulsion.
SENSES: 1. To cause someone to stumble spiritually or fall into sin (Matt 5:29; 18:6).
2. To offend, cause scandal, or evoke repulsion through words or actions (Matt 11:6; 13:57).

THAYER.pt: Colocar um obstáculo moral que induza alguém ao pecado, ou causar profunda indignação, choque e repulsa. 1. Fazer alguém tropeçar espiritualmente ou cair em pecado (Mt 5.29; 18.6). | 2. Ofender, escandalizar ou causar repulsa por meio de palavras ou ações (Mt 11.6; 13.57).
THAYER.en: To place a moral obstacle that induces someone to sin, or to cause deep indignation, shock, and repulsion. 1. To cause someone to stumble spiritually or fall into sin (Matt 5:29; 18:6). | 2. To offend, cause scandal, or evoke repulsion through words or actions (Matt 11:6; 13:57).

DEFINITION: Originally a trap spring, it came to designate that which causes moral downfall, spiritual stumbling, or strong opposition.
SENSES: 1. Occasion or temptation that leads someone to sin or apostatize (Matt 18:7; Luke 17:1).
2. Reason for scandal, offense, or rejection of the Christian message (Gal 5:11).

THAYER.pt: Originalmente a armadilha de uma armadilha, passou a designar aquilo que causa queda moral, tropeço espiritual ou forte oposição. 1. Ocasião ou tentação que leva alguém a pecar ou apostatar (Mt 18.7; Lk 17.1). | 2. Motivo de escândalo, ofensa ou rejeição à mensagem cristã (Gl 5.11).
THAYER.en: Originally a trap spring, it came to designate that which causes moral downfall, spiritual stumbling, or strong opposition. 1. Occasion or temptation that leads someone to sin or apostatize (Matt 18:7; Luke 17:1). | 2. Reason for scandal, offense, or rejection of the Christian message (Gal 5:11).

DEFINITION: To open a hole in the earth or turn over soil using agricultural tools, with the purpose of digging foundations or cultivating the land.
SENSES: 1. To excavate the earth for buildings or deep foundations (Luke 6:48).
2. To dig around plants for agricultural cultivation (Luke 13:8; 16:3).

THAYER.pt: Abrir um buraco na terra ou revirar o solo utilizando ferramentas agrícolas, com o propósito de cavar fundações ou cultivar a terra. 1. Escavar a terra para construções ou fundações profundas (Lc 6.48). | 2. Cavar ao redor de plantas para cultivo agrícola (Lc 13.8; 16.3).
THAYER.en: To open a hole in the earth or turn over soil using agricultural tools, with the purpose of digging foundations or cultivating the land. 1. To excavate the earth for buildings or deep foundations (Luke 6:48). | 2. To dig around plants for agricultural cultivation (Luke 13:8; 16:3).

DEFINITION: Hollow object, generally used as a concave vessel or as a small auxiliary boat kept aboard a larger vessel.
SENSES: 1. Small boat or life raft of a ship (Acts 27:16).

THAYER.pt: Objeto oco, geralmente empregado como recipiente côncavo ou como um pequeno bote auxiliar mantido a bordo de uma embarcação maior. 1. Pequeno barco ou bote salva-vidas de um navio (At 27.16).
THAYER.en: Hollow object, generally used as a concave vessel or as a small auxiliary boat kept aboard a larger vessel. 1. Small boat or life raft of a ship (Acts 27:16).

DEFINITION: Lower limb of the human body, used for locomotion and support.
SENSES: 1. The legs of the human body (John 19:31).

THAYER.pt: Membro inferior do corpo humano, utilizado para locomoção e sustentação. 1. As pernas do corpo humano (Jo 19.31).
THAYER.en: Lower limb of the human body, used for locomotion and support. 1. The legs of the human body (John 19:31).

DEFINITION: That which serves to cover and protect the body, including clothes or essential shelter for life.
SENSES: 1. Basic clothes and garments as necessary provision (1 Tim 6:8).

THAYER.pt: Aquilo que serve para cobrir e proteger o corpo, compreendendo roupas ou abrigos essenciais para a vida. 1. Roupas e vestimentas básicas como provisão necessária (1Tm 6.8).
THAYER.en: That which serves to cover and protect the body, including clothes or essential shelter for life. 1. Basic clothes and garments as necessary provision (1 Tim 6:8).

DEFINITION: Name of a Jewish religious leader or chief priest in Ephesus whose sons tried to exorcise evil spirits.
SENSES: 1. Jew described as a high priest or chief priest in Ephesus (Acts 19:14).

THAYER.pt: Nome de um líder religioso judaico ou chefe de sacerdotes em Éfeso cujos filhos tentaram exorcizar espíritos malignos. 1. Judeu qualificado como sumo sacerdote ou chefe sacerdotal em Éfeso (At 19.14).
THAYER.en: Name of a Jewish religious leader or chief priest in Ephesus whose sons tried to exorcise evil spirits. 1. Jew described as a high priest or chief priest in Ephesus (Acts 19:14).

DEFINITION: Collective term encompassing equipment, gear, or nautical tackle necessary for the operation of a vessel.
SENSES: 1. Apparatus, utensils, or rigging of a ship (Acts 27:19).

THAYER.pt: Termo coletivo que engloba equipamentos, apetrechos ou apetrechos náuticos necessários para o funcionamento de uma embarcação. 1. Aparelho, utensílios ou mastreação de um navio (At 27.19).
THAYER.en: Collective term encompassing equipment, gear, or nautical tackle necessary for the operation of a vessel. 1. Apparatus, utensils, or rigging of a ship (Acts 27:19).

DEFINITION: Any material object used for daily tasks, such as containers, tools, or ship cargo. Figuratively, it applies to the human body or to people as instruments in the hands of God.
SENSES: 1. Vessel, container, receptacle (Luke 8:16; John 19:29).
2. Goods, belongings, instruments in general (Matt 12:29; Acts 27:17).
3. The human body or the person as an instrument (Acts 9:15; 2 Cor 4:7; 1 Thess 4:4).

THAYER.pt: Qualquer objeto material usado para tarefas cotidianas, como recipientes, ferramentas ou carga naval. Figuradamente, aplica-se ao corpo humano ou a pessoas como instrumentos nas mãos de Deus. 1. Vaso, recipiente, vasilha (Lc 8.16; Jo 19.29). | 2. Bens, pertences, instrumentos em geral (Mt 12.29; At 27.17). | 3. O corpo humano ou a pessoa como instrumento (At 9.15; 2Co 4.7; 1Ts 4.4).
THAYER.en: Any material object used for daily tasks, such as containers, tools, or ship cargo. Figuratively, it applies to the human body or to people as instruments in the hands of God. 1. Vessel, container, receptacle (Luke 8:16; John 19:29). | 2. Goods, belongings, instruments in general (Matt 12:29; Acts 27:17). | 3. The human body or the person as an instrument (Acts 9:15; 2 Cor 4:7; 1 Thess 4:4).

DEFINITION: A temporary shelter structure made of fabric or skins, frequently used in the Old Testament for the sacred Tabernacle.
SENSES: 1. Tent or temporary dwelling (Heb 11:9).
2. The Tabernacle sanctuary of the wilderness (Acts 7:44; Heb 9:2).

THAYER.pt: Estrutura temporária de abrigo feita de tecido ou peles, frequentemente usada no Antigo Testamento para o Tabernáculo sagrado. 1. Tenda ou habitação temporária (Hb 11.9). | 2. O Tabernáculo santuário do deserto (At 7.44; Hb 9.2).
THAYER.en: A temporary shelter structure made of fabric or skins, frequently used in the Old Testament for the sacred Tabernacle. 1. Tent or temporary dwelling (Heb 11:9). | 2. The Tabernacle sanctuary of the wilderness (Acts 7:44; Heb 9:2).

DEFINITION: Refers specifically to the Feast of Tabernacles or Feast of Booths, one of the main Jewish celebrations that commemorated divine care during the wilderness journey.
SENSES: 1. The Feast of Tabernacles or Feast of Booths celebrated by the Jews (John 7:2).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se especificamente à Festa dos Tabernáculos ou Festa das Cabanas, uma das principais celebrações judaicas que rememorava o cuidado divino durante a jornada no deserto. 1. A Festa dos Tabernáculos ou Festa das Cabanas celebrada pelos judeus (Jo 7.2).
THAYER.en: Refers specifically to the Feast of Tabernacles or Feast of Booths, one of the main Jewish celebrations that commemorated divine care during the wilderness journey. 1. The Feast of Tabernacles or Feast of Booths celebrated by the Jews (John 7:2).

DEFINITION: Indicates an artisan whose trade consisted of manufacturing tents, usually made of goat hair or leather, a profession practiced by the apostle Paul.
SENSES: 1. Manufacturer or builder of tents as a professional occupation (Acts 18:3).

THAYER.pt: Indica um artesão cujo ofício consistia na fabricação de tendas, geralmente feitas de pelo de cabra ou couro, profissão exercida pelo apóstolo Paulo. 1. Fabricante ou construtor de tendas como ocupação profissional (At 18.3).
THAYER.en: Indicates an artisan whose trade consisted of manufacturing tents, usually made of goat hair or leather, a profession practiced by the apostle Paul. 1. Manufacturer or builder of tents as a professional occupation (Acts 18:3).

DEFINITION: Originally a temporary dwelling or tent; in New Testament metaphorical usage, it designates the physical human body as a transient abode of the soul.
SENSES: 1. The human body viewed as a temporary and earthly dwelling (2 Cor 5:1, 4).

THAYER.pt: Originalmente uma habitação temporária ou tenda; no uso metafórico neotestamentário, designa o corpo físico humano como morada passageira da alma. 1. O corpo humano visto como moradia temporária e terrena (2Co 5.1, 4).
THAYER.en: Originally a temporary dwelling or tent; in New Testament metaphorical usage, it designates the physical human body as a transient abode of the soul. 1. The human body viewed as a temporary and earthly dwelling (2 Cor 5:1, 4).

SHORT_GLOSS: to dwell, to tabernacle, to reside
DEFINITION: To pitch a tent or fix a temporary or permanent residence, used in the NT to describe divine dwelling among men.
SENSES: 1. To make a dwelling or tabernacle among men (John 1:14; Rev 21:3).
USAGE: to dwell, to tabernacle, to reside

THAYER.pt: Armar tenda ou fixar residência temporária ou permanente, usado no NT para descrever a habitação divina entre os homens. 1. Fazer habitação ou tabernáculo entre os homens (Jo 1:14; Ap 21:3).
THAYER.en: To pitch a tent or fix a temporary or permanent residence, used in the NT to describe divine dwelling among men. 1. To make a dwelling or tabernacle among men (John 1:14; Rev 21:3).

DEFINITION: A temporary dwelling structure or tent; in the New Testament, it is frequently used as a metaphor for the mortal human body.
SENSES: 1. Provisional dwelling or tent (Acts 7:46).
2. Metaphor for the physical human body as a temporary abode (2 Pet 1:13).

THAYER.pt: Estrutura temporária de habitação ou tenda; no Novo Testamento, é frequentemente usado como metáfora para o corpo humano mortal. 1. Habitação provisória ou tenda (At 7.46). | 2. Metáfora para o corpo físico humano como morada temporária (2Pe 1.13).
THAYER.en: A temporary dwelling structure or tent; in the New Testament, it is frequently used as a metaphor for the mortal human body. 1. Provisional dwelling or tent (Acts 7:46). | 2. Metaphor for the physical human body as a temporary abode (2 Pet 1:13).

DEFINITION: Primarily indicates the projection of a shadow caused by the interposition of an object before light, and can also denote a preliminary representation or fleeting reflection of a greater reality.
SENSES: 1. Physical shadow cast by an object or cover against heat (Matt 4:16; Acts 5:15).
2. Shadow or prophetic type that points to a future reality in Christ (Col 2:17; Heb 8:5).

THAYER.pt: Indica primariamente a projeção de sombra causada pela interposição de um objeto diante da luz, podendo também denotar uma representação preliminar ou reflexo fugaz de uma realidade maior. 1. Sombra física projetada por um objeto ou cobertura contra o calor (Mt 4.16; At 5.15). | 2. Sombra ou tipo profético que aponta para uma realidade futura em Cristo (Cl 2.17; Hb 8.5).
THAYER.en: Primarily indicates the projection of a shadow caused by the interposition of an object before light, and can also denote a preliminary representation or fleeting reflection of a greater reality. 1. Physical shadow cast by an object or cover against heat (Matt 4:16; Acts 5:15). | 2. Shadow or prophetic type that points to a future reality in Christ (Col 2:17; Heb 8:5).

SHORT_GLOSS: to leap, to jump for joy
DEFINITION: To perform effusive movements of leaping or jumping, manifesting great joy, exultation, or overflowing enthusiasm.
SENSES: 1. The leaping of babies in the womb or people in a state of jubilation (Luke 1:41; 6:23).
USAGE: to leap, to jump for joy

THAYER.pt: Realizar movimentos efusivos de salto ou pulo, manifestando grande alegria, exultação ou entusiasmo transbordante. 1. O saltar de bebês no ventre ou pessoas em estado de júbilo (Lc 1.41; 6.23).
THAYER.en: To perform effusive movements of leaping or jumping, manifesting great joy, exultation, or overflowing enthusiasm. 1. The leaping of babies in the womb or people in a state of jubilation (Luke 1:41; 6:23).

DEFINITION: An inflexible, cold, and obstinate mental condition, characterized by the refusal to yield to the divine will or moral sensitivity.
SENSES: 1. The hardness or stubbornness of the human heart against God (Matt 19:8; Mark 10:5).

THAYER.pt: Condição mental inflexível, fria e obstinada, caracterizada pela recusa em ceder à vontade divina ou à sensibilidade moral. 1. A dureza ou teimosia do coração humano contra Deus (Mt 19.8; Mc 10.5).
THAYER.en: An inflexible, cold, and obstinate mental condition, characterized by the refusal to yield to the divine will or moral sensitivity. 1. The hardness or stubbornness of the human heart against God (Matt 19:8; Mark 10:5).

DEFINITION: That which is stiff to the touch, difficult to bear, severe in treatment, or inflexible in attitudes and words.
SENSES: 1. Difficult to accept or hard to hear, rough to the spirit (John 6:60).
2. Severe, rigorous, implacable in behavior (Matt 25:24; Acts 26:14).

THAYER.pt: Aquilo que é rijo ao toque, difícil de suportar, severo no trato ou inflexível em atitudes e palavras. 1. Difícil de aceitar ou duro de ouvir, áspero ao espírito (Jo 6.60). | 2. Severo, rigoroso, implacável em comportamento (Mt 25.24; At 26.14).
THAYER.en: That which is stiff to the touch, difficult to bear, severe in treatment, or inflexible in attitudes and words. 1. Difficult to accept or hard to hear, rough to the spirit (John 6:60). | 2. Severe, rigorous, implacable in behavior (Matt 25:24; Acts 26:14).

DEFINITION: Describes the condition of insensitivity or moral resistance, especially the hardness of heart that refuses to repent before God.
SENSES: 1. Hardness of heart and moral obstinacy against the divine will (Rom 2:5).

THAYER.pt: Descreve a condição de insensibilidade ou resistência moral, especialmente a dureza de coração que se recusa a arrepender-se diante de Deus. 1. Dureza de coração e obstinação moral contra a vontade divina (Rm 2.5).
THAYER.en: Describes the condition of insensitivity or moral resistance, especially the hardness of heart that refuses to repent before God. 1. Hardness of heart and moral obstinacy against the divine will (Rom 2:5).

DEFINITION: Figurative term that literally means 'stiff-necked', used to describe people who are obstinate, rebellious, and irreducible to divine correction.
SENSES: 1. Obstinate, rebellious, and resistant to the direction of the Holy Spirit (Acts 7:51).

THAYER.pt: Termo figurado que literalmente significa 'de pescoço duro', usado para descrever pessoas obstinadas, rebeldes e irredutíveis à correção divina. 1. Obstinado, rebelde e resistente à direção do Espírito Santo (At 7.51).
THAYER.en: Figurative term that literally means 'stiff-necked', used to describe people who are obstinate, rebellious, and irreducible to divine correction. 1. Obstinate, rebellious, and resistant to the direction of the Holy Spirit (Acts 7:51).

DEFINITION: To make hard or obstinate, generating stubborn resistance to the truth, instruction, or divine direction.
SENSES: 1. To harden the heart or become rebellious and insensitive to the voice of God (Heb 3:8; Acts 19:9).

THAYER.pt: Tornar duro ou obstinado, gerando resistência teimosa à verdade, à instrução ou à direção divina. 1. Endurecer o coração ou tornar-se rebelde e insensível à voz de Deus (Hb 3.8; At 19.9).
THAYER.en: To make hard or obstinate, generating stubborn resistance to the truth, instruction, or divine direction. 1. To harden the heart or become rebellious and insensitive to the voice of God (Heb 3:8; Acts 19:9).

DEFINITION: Literally curved or sinuous; figuratively used to describe a twisted, dishonest, or perverse moral conduct.
SENSES: 1. Tortuous or sinuous in physical terms (Luke 3:5).
2. Perverse, dishonest, or of corrupted character (Phil 2:15; 1 Pet 2:18).

THAYER.pt: Literalmente curvado ou sinuoso; figuradamente usado para descrever uma conduta moral torcida, desonesta ou perversa. 1. Tortuoso ou sinuoso em termos físicos (Lc 3.5). | 2. Perverso, desonesto ou de caráter corrompido (Fp 2.15; 1Pe 2.18).
THAYER.en: Literally curved or sinuous; figuratively used to describe a twisted, dishonest, or perverse moral conduct. 1. Tortuous or sinuous in physical terms (Luke 3:5). | 2. Perverse, dishonest, or of corrupted character (Phil 2:15; 1 Pet 2:18).

DEFINITION: Designates a pointed stake, thorn, or splinter that causes agonizing physical pain or persistent suffering, used metaphorically for severe trials.
SENSES: 1. Thorn or pointed splinter that causes injury and physical discomfort (2 Cor 12:7).
2. Metaphorically, a source of intense suffering or trial (2 Cor 12:7).

THAYER.pt: Designa uma estaca pontiaguda, espinho ou farpa que causa dor física agônica ou sofrimento persistente, usado metaforicamente para provações severas. 1. Espinho ou farpa pontiaguda que causa ferimento e incômodo físico (2Co 12.7). | 2. Metaphoricamente, fonte de sofrimento ou provação intensa (2Co 12.7).
THAYER.en: Designates a pointed stake, thorn, or splinter that causes agonizing physical pain or persistent suffering, used metaphorically for severe trials. 1. Thorn or pointed splinter that causes injury and physical discomfort (2 Cor 12:7). | 2. Metaphorically, a source of intense suffering or trial (2 Cor 12:7).

SHORT_GLOSS: to observe, to heed, to consider
DEFINITION: To direct attention closely toward something or someone, watching with care or pondering purposes.
SENSES: 1. To pay close attention, to watch, or to observe with care (Phil 3:17; Rom 16:17).
2. To fix the mental gaze on invisible and lasting realities (2 Cor 4:18).
USAGE: to observe, to heed, to consider

THAYER.pt: Dirigir a atenção detidamente para algo ou alguém, vigiando com cuidado ou ponderando propósitos. 1. Prestar muita atenção, vigiar ou observar com cuidado (Fp 3.17; Rm 16.17). | 2. Fixar o olhar mental em realidades invisíveis e duradouras (2Co 4.18).
THAYER.en: To direct attention closely toward something or someone, watching with care or pondering purposes. 1. To pay close attention, to watch, or to observe with care (Phil 3:17; Rom 16:17). | 2. To fix the mental gaze on invisible and lasting realities (2 Cor 4:18).

DEFINITION: Describes the final point toward which attention or effort is directed, such as an archer's target or the finish line of a race.
SENSES: 1. The target or supreme goal toward which the believer presses in the Christian race (Phil 3:14).

THAYER.pt: Descreve o ponto final para o qual se direciona a atenção ou o esforço, como o alvo de um arqueiro ou a linha de chegada de uma corrida. 1. O alvo ou objetivo supremo para o qual o crente avança na carreira cristã (Fp 3.14).
THAYER.en: Describes the final point toward which attention or effort is directed, such as an archer's target or the finish line of a race. 1. The target or supreme goal toward which the believer presses in the Christian race (Phil 3:14).

DEFINITION: To spread a crowd or group of people and objects in various directions, causing them to move away.
SENSES: 1. To disperse a flock or group of people (Matt 12:30; John 16:32);
2. To distribute goods generously to the needy (2 Cor 9:9).

THAYER.pt: Espalhar uma multidão ou grupo de pessoas e objetos em direções variadas, fazendo-os afastar-se. 1. Dispersar um rebanho ou grupo de pessoas (Mt 12:30; Jo 16:32); | 2. Distribuir generosamente bens aos necessitados (2Co 9:9).
THAYER.en: To spread a crowd or group of people and objects in various directions, causing them to move away. 1. To disperse a flock or group of people (Matt 12:30; John 16:32); | 2. To distribute goods generously to the needy (2 Cor 9:9).

DEFINITION: A small arachnid equipped with a venomous stinger in its tail, feared in the ancient world for its painful sting.
SENSES: 1. The scorpion as a venomous animal (Rev 9:3).

THAYER.pt: Pequeno aracnídeo dotado de um ferrão venenoso na cauda, temido por sua picada dolorosa no mundo antigo. 1. O escorpião como animal peçonhento (Ap 9:3).
THAYER.en: A small arachnid equipped with a venomous stinger in its tail, feared in the ancient world for its painful sting. 1. The scorpion as a venomous animal (Rev 9:3).

DEFINITION: Being in a state of darkness, without the presence or reach of light.
SENSES: 1. A place or environment devoid of light (Luke 11:36).

THAYER.pt: Que se encontra em estado de escuridão, sem a presença ou o alcance da luz. 1. Local ou ambiente destituído de luz (Lc 11.36).
THAYER.en: Being in a state of darkness, without the presence or reach of light. 1. A place or environment devoid of light (Luke 11:36).

DEFINITION: The condition of total or partial absence of light. In Johannine literary style, it is strongly used as a theological and moral symbol to designate the realm of sin, spiritual ignorance, and opposition to God.
SENSES: 1. Physical absence of light, darkness, or gloom (John 20:1).
2. In a moral and spiritual sense, the realm of darkness, lies, ignorance, and opposition to God (John 8:12; 1 John 2:11).

THAYER.pt: Condição de ausência total ou parcial de luz. No estilo literário de João, é fortemente empregada como símbolo teológico e moral para designar o reino do pecado, da ignorância espiritual e da oposição a Deus. 1. Ausência física de luz, escuridão ou penumbra (Jo 20.1). | 2. Em sentido moral e espiritual, o reino das trevas, da mentira, da ignorância e da oposição a Deus (Jo 8.12; 1Jo 2.11).
THAYER.en: The condition of total or partial absence of light. In Johannine literary style, it is strongly used as a theological and moral symbol to designate the realm of sin, spiritual ignorance, and opposition to God. 1. Physical absence of light, darkness, or gloom (John 20:1). | 2. In a moral and spiritual sense, the realm of darkness, lies, ignorance, and opposition to God (John 8:12; 1 John 2:11).

DEFINITION: To make dark or deprive of light, whether in the physical aspect of celestial bodies or in the moral and spiritual capacity for discernment.
SENSES: 1. To obscure natural or celestial light (Rev 9:2);
2. To darken the human mind or heart to divine truths (Rom 1:21).
