THAYER.pt: Tornar escuro ou privado de luz, seja no aspecto físico dos astros ou na capacidade moral e espiritual de discernimento. 1. Obscurecer a luz natural ou celeste (Ap 9:2); | 2. Enteobrescer a mente ou o coração humano para as verdades divinas (Rm 1:21).
THAYER.en: To make dark or deprive of light, whether in the physical aspect of celestial bodies or in the moral and spiritual capacity for discernment. 1. To obscure natural or celestial light (Rev 9:2); | 2. To darken the human mind or heart to divine truths (Rom 1:21).

DEFINITION: Total or partial absence of physical light, or, figuratively, the spiritual realm of ignorance, sin, and opposition to God.
SENSES: 1. Physical darkness or gloom in nature (Matt 8:12; 27:45).
2. Moral and spiritual darkness, the domain of sin and unbelievers (Rom 13:12; Eph 5:8).

THAYER.pt: Ausência total ou parcial de luz física, ou, em sentido figurado, o reino espiritual da ignorância, do pecado e da oposição a Deus. 1. Escuridão física ou trevas na natureza (Mt 8.12; 27.45). | 2. Trevas morais e espirituais, o domínio do pecado e dos descrentes (Rm 13.12; Ef 5.8).
THAYER.en: Total or partial absence of physical light, or, figuratively, the spiritual realm of ignorance, sin, and opposition to God. 1. Physical darkness or gloom in nature (Matt 8:12; 27:45). | 2. Moral and spiritual darkness, the domain of sin and unbelievers (Rom 13:12; Eph 5:8).

DEFINITION: To make dark in a physical sense or, metaphorically, to obscure the mind and spiritual understanding.
SENSES: 1. To physically darken the environment (Rev 9:2).
2. The mental and moral darkening of understanding (Eph 4:18).

THAYER.pt: Tornar escuro no sentido físico ou, metaforicamente, obscurecer a mente e o entendimento espiritual. 1. Escurecer fisicamente o ambiente (Ap 9.2). | 2. O obscurecimento mental e moral da compreensão (Ef 4.18).
THAYER.en: To make dark in a physical sense or, metaphorically, to obscure the mind and spiritual understanding. 1. To physically darken the environment (Rev 9:2). | 2. The mental and moral darkening of understanding (Eph 4:18).

DEFINITION: Designates worthless material, refuse, trash, or dung that is rejected and discarded for having no value.
SENSES: 1. Refuse, trash, or that which is discarded for being totally useless (Phil 3:8).

THAYER.pt: Designa material imprestável, refugo, lixo ou esterco que é rejeitado e descartado por não ter nenhum valor. 1. Refugo, lixo ou aquilo que é descartado por ser totalmente inútil (Fp 3.8).
THAYER.en: Designates worthless material, refuse, trash, or dung that is rejected and discarded for having no value. 1. Refuse, trash, or that which is discarded for being totally useless (Phil 3:8).

DEFINITION: Designates an inhabitant of Scythia, a region north of the Black Sea, frequently stereotyped in the Greco-Roman world as uncultured or barbarian.
SENSES: 1. A member of the Scythian people, representing the extreme of lack of cultural refinement in the ancient world (Col 3:11).

THAYER.pt: Designa um habitante da Cítia, região ao norte do Mar Negro, frequentemente estereotipado no mundo greco-romano como inculto ou bárbaro. 1. Um membro do povo cita, representando o extremo da falta de refinamento cultural no mundo antigo (Cl 3.11).
THAYER.en: Designates an inhabitant of Scythia, a region north of the Black Sea, frequently stereotyped in the Greco-Roman world as uncultured or barbarian. 1. A member of the Scythian people, representing the extreme of lack of cultural refinement in the ancient world (Col 3:11).

DEFINITION: Having a countenance burdened with visible sadness, discouragement, or melancholy.
SENSES: 1. Of a gloomy, burdened, or saddened appearance (Matt 6:16; Luke 24:17).

THAYER.pt: Que apresenta um semblante carregado de tristeza, desânimo ou melancolia visível no rosto. 1. De aparência sombria, carregada ou entristecida (Mt 6.16; Lc 24.17).
THAYER.en: Having a countenance burdened with visible sadness, discouragement, or melancholy. 1. Of a gloomy, burdened, or saddened appearance (Matt 6:16; Luke 24:17).

DEFINITION: To cause fatigue, physical weariness, or disturbance to someone through demands or worries.
SENSES: 1. To tire, exhaust, or afflict someone (Matt 9:36).
2. To bother or cause unnecessary trouble (Mark 5:35).

THAYER.pt: Causar fadiga, desgaste físico ou perturbação a alguém por meio de demandas ou preocupações. 1. Fatigar, exaurir ou afligir alguém (Mt 9.36). | 2. Incomodar ou causar trabalho desnecessário (Mc 5.35).
THAYER.en: To cause fatigue, physical weariness, or disturbance to someone through demands or worries. 1. To tire, exhaust, or afflict someone (Matt 9:36). | 2. To bother or cause unnecessary trouble (Mark 5:35).

DEFINITION: Refers to the spoils of war, weapons, or goods taken by force from a defeated enemy in combat.
SENSES: 1. Spoils, booty, or goods conquered from an adversary (Luke 11:22).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se aos despojos de guerra, armas ou bens tomados à força de um inimigo derrotado em combate. 1. Espólios, despojos ou bens conquistados de um adversário (Lc 11.22).
THAYER.en: Refers to the spoils of war, weapons, or goods taken by force from a defeated enemy in combat. 1. Spoils, booty, or goods conquered from an adversary (Luke 11:22).

DEFINITION: A compound word describing a body or organism being consumed or infested by worms and larvae.
SENSES: 1. Attacked, infested, or consumed by worms (Acts 12:23).

THAYER.pt: Composto que descreve um corpo ou organismo que está sendo consumido ou infestado por vermes e larvas. 1. Atacado, infestado ou consumido por vermes (At 12.23).
THAYER.en: A compound word describing a body or organism being consumed or infested by worms and larvae. 1. Attacked, infested, or consumed by worms (Acts 12:23).

DEFINITION: A small worm-like organism that feeds on decaying matter, associated in biblical tradition with imagery of judgment and corruption.
SENSES: 1. A worm associated with punishment and decomposition (Mark 9:48).

THAYER.pt: Pequeno organismo vermiforme que se alimenta de matéria em decomposição, associado na tradição bíblica a imagens de juízo e corrupção. 1. Verme associado à punição e à decomposição (Mc 9.48).
THAYER.en: A small worm-like organism that feeds on decaying matter, associated in biblical tradition with imagery of judgment and corruption. 1. A worm associated with punishment and decomposition (Mark 9:48).

DEFINITION: An adjective describing something made of emerald or possessing the bright, transparent green color of this gemstone.
SENSES: 1. Made of emerald or resembling the brilliance of emerald (Rev 4:3).

THAYER.pt: Poresta forma adjetiva, descreve algo feito de esmeralda ou que possui a cor verde brilhante e transparente desta gema. 1. Feito de esmeralda ou semelhante ao brilho da esmeralda (Ap 4.3).
THAYER.en: An adjective describing something made of emerald or possessing the bright, transparent green color of this gemstone. 1. Made of emerald or resembling the brilliance of emerald (Rev 4:3).

DEFINITION: A precious stone of vivid and transparent green coloration, highly valued in antiquity.
SENSES: 1. The emerald, a precious gemstone of bright green tone (Rev 21:19).

THAYER.pt: Pedra preciosa de coloração verde viva e transparente, altamente valorizada na antiguidade. 1. A esmeralda, gema preciosa de tom verde brilhante (Ap 21.19).
THAYER.en: A precious stone of vivid and transparent green coloration, highly valued in antiquity. 1. The emerald, a precious gemstone of bright green tone (Rev 21:19).

DEFINITION: An aromatic resin extracted from certain shrubs of the East, highly valued in antiquity for perfumery, incense, embalming, and medicinal uses.
SENSES: 1. An aromatic gum used in oils, perfumes, and funeral rites (Matt 2:11; John 19:39).

THAYER.pt: Resina aromática extraída de certos arbustos do Oriente, muito valorizada na Antiguidade para perfumaria, incenso, embalsamamento e usos medicinais. 1. Goma aromática utilizada em óleos, perfumes e ritos fúnebres (Mt 2.11; Jo 19.39).
THAYER.en: An aromatic resin extracted from certain shrubs of the East, highly valued in antiquity for perfumery, incense, embalming, and medicinal uses. 1. An aromatic gum used in oils, perfumes, and funeral rites (Matt 2:11; John 19:39).

DEFINITION: An important port city located on the western coast of Asia Minor, seat of one of the seven churches of the Apocalypse.
SENSES: 1. The city of Smyrna, in the Roman province of Asia (Rev 1:11; 2:8).

THAYER.pt: Importante cidade portuária localizada na costa ocidental da Ásia Menor, sede de uma das sete igrejas do Apocalipse. 1. Cidade de Esmirna, na província romana da Ásia (Ap 1.11; 2.8).
THAYER.en: An important port city located on the western coast of Asia Minor, seat of one of the seven churches of the Apocalypse. 1. The city of Smyrna, in the Roman province of Asia (Rev 1:11; 2:8).

DEFINITION: Relating to the city of Smyrna, an inhabitant or native of this locality in Asia Minor.
SENSES: 1. Belonging or referring to the city of Smyrna.

THAYER.pt: Relativo à cidade de Esmirna, habitante ou procedente dessa localidade da Ásia Menor. 1. Que pertence ou se refere à cidade de Esmirna.
THAYER.en: Relating to the city of Smyrna, an inhabitant or native of this locality in Asia Minor. 1. Belonging or referring to the city of Smyrna.

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: -, Aor: -, Perf. pass. ptc: ἐσμυρνισμένος
DEFINITION: To treat, aromatize, or mix a substance with myrrh, usually for medicinal or narcotic purposes.
SENSES: 1. To mix or treat with myrrh (Mark 15:23).

THAYER.pt: Significa tratar, aromatizar ou misturar uma substância com mirra, geralmente com propósitos medicinais ou entorpecentes. 1. Misturar ou tratar com mirra (Mc 15.23).
THAYER.en: To treat, aromatize, or mix a substance with myrrh, usually for medicinal or narcotic purposes. 1. To mix or treat with myrrh (Mark 15:23).

DEFINITION: An ancient city located in the Dead Sea region, destroyed by God with fire and sulfur due to the severity of its inhabitants' sins.
SENSES: 1. The city of Sodom as a symbol of divine judgment and moral corruption (Luke 17:29).

THAYER.pt: Antiga cidade localizada na região do Mar Morto, destruída por Deus com fogo e enxofre devido à gravidade dos pecados de seus habitantes. 1. A cidade de Sodoma como símbolo de juízo divino e corrupção moral (Lc 17.29).
THAYER.en: An ancient city located in the Dead Sea region, destroyed by God with fire and sulfur due to the severity of its inhabitants' sins. 1. The city of Sodom as a symbol of divine judgment and moral corruption (Luke 17:29).

DEFINITION: Dative form of the second-person singular personal pronoun, indicating the beneficiary or indirect target.
SENSES: 1. Pronoun in the dative case (to you, for you).

THAYER.pt: Forma de dativo do pronome pessoal de segunda pessoa do singular, indicando o beneficiário ou o alvo indireto. 1. Pronome no caso dativo (a ti, para ti).
THAYER.en: Dative form of the second-person singular personal pronoun, indicating the beneficiary or indirect target. 1. Pronoun in the dative case (to you, for you).

DEFINITION: Name of the celebrated king of Israel, son of David and Bathsheba, known for his wisdom and the building of the first temple.
SENSES: 1. Solomon, king of Israel (Matt 1:6; John 10:23).

THAYER.pt: Nome do célebre rei de Israel, filho de Davi e Bate-Seba, conhecido por sua sabedoria e pela construção do primeiro templo. 1. Salomão, rei de Israel (Mt 1.6; Jo 10.23).
THAYER.en: Name of the celebrated king of Israel, son of David and Bathsheba, known for his wisdom and the building of the first temple. 1. Solomon, king of Israel (Matt 1:6; John 10:23).

DEFINITION: Designates an open stretcher, cot, or coffin used to transport a corpse to the burial site.
SENSES: 1. A bier or open coffin used in funeral processions (Luke 7:14).

THAYER.pt: Designa um esquife, maca ou caixão aberto utilizado para transportar um cadáver até o local do sepultamento. 1. Esquife ou caixão aberto usado em procissões fúnebres (Lc 7.14).
THAYER.en: Designates an open stretcher, cot, or coffin used to transport a corpse to the burial site. 1. A bier or open coffin used in funeral processions (Luke 7:14).

DEFINITION: Second-person singular possessive pronoun, indicating what belongs to the interlocutor.
SENSES: 1. Indicating possession belonging to the person being spoken to (Matt 7:3; 20:14).

THAYER.pt: Pronome possessivo da segunda pessoa do singular, indicando aquilo que pertence ao interlocutor. 1. Indicando posse pertencente à pessoa com quem se fala (Mt 7.3; 20.14).
THAYER.en: Second-person singular possessive pronoun, indicating what belongs to the interlocutor. 1. Indicating possession belonging to the person being spoken to (Matt 7:3; 20:14).

DEFINITION: Genitive form of the second-person singular personal pronoun, expressing possession or origin related to the person being spoken to.
SENSES: 1. Possessive or genitive pronoun (your, of you).

THAYER.pt: Forma de genitivo do pronome pessoal de segunda pessoa do singular, expressando posse ou procedência relacionada à pessoa com quem se fala. 1. Pronome possessivo ou genitivo (teu, tua, de ti).
THAYER.en: Genitive form of the second-person singular personal pronoun, expressing possession or origin related to the person being spoken to. 1. Possessive or genitive pronoun (your, of you).

DEFINITION: A small piece of fabric used to wipe sweat from the face or cover the face of a deceased person.
SENSES: 1. A handkerchief or cloth to wipe the face or wrap the head of the dead (Luke 19:20; John 11:44).

THAYER.pt: Pequeno pedaço de tecido usado para enxugar o suor do rosto ou cobrir a face de uma pessoa falecida. 1. Lenço ou pano para enxugar o rosto ou envolver a cabeça de mortos (Lc 19.20; Jo 11.44).
THAYER.en: A small piece of fabric used to wipe sweat from the face or cover the face of a deceased person. 1. A handkerchief or cloth to wipe the face or wrap the head of the dead (Luke 19:20; John 11:44).

DEFINITION: Female proper name of a pious woman who was part of the group of followers who supported Jesus and the disciples with their belongings.
SENSES: 1. Susanna, a disciple who served Jesus with her resources (Luke 8:3).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio feminino de uma mulher piedosa que integrava o grupo de seguidoras que auxiliava Jesus e os discípulos com seus bens. 1. Susana, discípula que servia a Jesus com seus recursos (Lc 8.3).
THAYER.en: Female proper name of a pious woman who was part of the group of followers who supported Jesus and the disciples with their belongings. 1. Susanna, a disciple who served Jesus with her resources (Luke 8:3).

DEFINITION: Superior capacity for ethical, practical, and spiritual discernment. In the New Testament, merely human and philosophical wisdom is contrasted with the revealed wisdom of God embodied in Christ.
SENSES: 1. Divine wisdom manifested in creation and the redemptive plan of the gospel (1 Cor 1:24; Rom 11:33; Eph 3:10).
2. Spiritual discernment granted by the Holy Spirit to the believer (Jas 1:5; Col 1:9; Acts 6:3).
3. Intellectual ability or mundane philosophical speculation (1 Cor 1:19; 1 Cor 3:19).
4. The personification of God's wisdom (Matt 11:19; Luke 11:49).

THAYER.pt: Capacidade superior de discernimento ético, prático e espiritual. No Novo Testamento, contrasta-se a sabedoria meramente humana e filosófica com a sabedoria revelada de Deus corporificada em Cristo. 1. Sabedoria divina manifesta na criação e no plano redentor do evangelho (1Co 1.24; Rm 11.33; Ef 3.10). | 2. Discernimento espiritual concedido pelo Espírito Santo ao crente (Tg 1.5; Cl 1.9; At 6.3). | 3. Habilidade intelectual ou especulação filosófica mundana (1Co 1.19; 1Co 3.19). | 4. A personificação da sabedoria de Deus (Mt 11.19; Lc 11.49).
THAYER.en: Superior capacity for ethical, practical, and spiritual discernment. In the New Testament, merely human and philosophical wisdom is contrasted with the revealed wisdom of God embodied in Christ. 1. Divine wisdom manifested in creation and the redemptive plan of the gospel (1 Cor 1:24; Rom 11:33; Eph 3:10). | 2. Spiritual discernment granted by the Holy Spirit to the believer (Jas 1:5; Col 1:9; Acts 6:3). | 3. Intellectual ability or mundane philosophical speculation (1 Cor 1:19; 1 Cor 3:19). | 4. The personification of God's wisdom (Matt 11:19; Luke 11:49).

DEFINITION: To cause someone to progress in understanding and wisdom, or, in a pejorative sense, to plot and craft something cunningly.
SENSES: 1. To make wise or instruct in the Scriptures and the truth (2 Tim 3:15).
2. To concoct or invent cunning stratagems (2 Pet 1:16).

THAYER.pt: Fazer alguém progredir em entendimento e sabedoria, ou, em sentido pejorativo, tramar e arquitetar algo de forma astuta. 1. Tornar sábio ou instruir nas Escrituras e na verdade (2Tm 3.15). | 2. Concoctar ou inventar artimanhas de forma astuta (2Pe 1.16).
THAYER.en: To cause someone to progress in understanding and wisdom, or, in a pejorative sense, to plot and craft something cunningly. 1. To make wise or instruct in the Scriptures and the truth (2 Tim 3:15). | 2. To concoct or invent cunning stratagems (2 Pet 1:16).

DEFINITION: The quality of one who possesses technical skill, practical discernment, or deep wisdom originating from God.
SENSES: 1. Skilled or expert in some task (1 Cor 3:10).
2. Wise, endowed with moral and spiritual discernment (Matt 11:25; 1 Cor 1:26).

THAYER.pt: Qualidade daquele que possui habilidade técnica, discernimento prático ou sabedoria profunda originada de Deus. 1. Habilidoso ou perito em alguma tarefa (1Co 3.10). | 2. Sábio, dotado de discernimento moral e espiritual (Mt 11.25; 1Co 1.26).
THAYER.en: The quality of one who possesses technical skill, practical discernment, or deep wisdom originating from God. 1. Skilled or expert in some task (1 Cor 3:10). | 2. Wise, endowed with moral and spiritual discernment (Matt 11:25; 1 Cor 1:26).

DEFINITION: Region and Roman province situated at the western extremity of the Mediterranean Sea, whose reach was the target of the apostle Paul's missionary plans.
SENSES: 1. The geographical region of Spain (Rom 15:24, 28).

THAYER.pt: Região e província romana situada na extremidade ocidental do mar Mediterrâneo, cujo alcance era alvo dos planos missionários do apóstolo Paulo. 1. A região geográfica da Espanha (Rm 15.24, 28).
THAYER.en: Region and Roman province situated at the western extremity of the Mediterranean Sea, whose reach was the target of the apostle Paul's missionary plans. 1. The geographical region of Spain (Rom 15:24, 28).

DEFINITION: To shake violently or provoke intense spasms and convulsions in the body, frequently associated with epileptic seizures or demonic possessions.
SENSES: 1. To cause violent convulsions in someone under spiritual oppression (Mark 1:26; Luke 9:39).

THAYER.pt: Agitar com violência ou provocar espasmos e convulsões intensas no corpo, frequentemente associado a ataques epiléticos ou possessões demoníacas. 1. Causar convulsões violentas em alguém sob opressão espiritual (Mc 1.26; Lc 9.39).
THAYER.en: To shake violently or provoke intense spasms and convulsions in the body, frequently associated with epileptic seizures or demonic possessions. 1. To cause violent convulsions in someone under spiritual oppression (Mark 1:26; Luke 9:39).

DEFINITION: To wrap a newborn in cloths or long strips of fabric, an ancient custom to keep limbs straight and warm the baby.
SENSES: 1. To wrap a newborn in strips of fabric (Luke 2:7, 12).

THAYER.pt: Envolver um recém-nascido em panos ou faixas longas de tecido, costume antigo para manter os membros esticados e aquecer o bebê. 1. Envolver o recém-nascido em faixas de tecido (Lc 2.7, 12).
THAYER.en: To wrap a newborn in cloths or long strips of fabric, an ancient custom to keep limbs straight and warm the baby. 1. To wrap a newborn in strips of fabric (Luke 2:7, 12).

DEFINITION: To surrender to a life of excess, unrestrained luxury, and immoderate satisfaction of personal pleasures and material appetites.
SENSES: 1. To live self-indulgently, luxuriously, and dissolutely (1 Tim 5:6; Jas 5:5).

THAYER.pt: Entregar-se a uma vida de excessos, luxo desenfreado e satisfação imoderada de prazeres pessoais e apetites materiais. 1. Viver de forma autoindulgente, luxuosa e dissoluta (1Tm 5.6; Tg 5.5).
THAYER.en: To surrender to a life of excess, unrestrained luxury, and immoderate satisfaction of personal pleasures and material appetites. 1. To live self-indulgently, luxuriously, and dissolutely (1 Tim 5:6; Jas 5:5).

DEFINITION: To exert force to pull or withdraw something, with particular emphasis on the act of unsheathing a sword.
SENSES: 1. To pull or draw a melee weapon, such as a sword (Mark 14:7; Acts 16:27).

THAYER.pt: Exercer força para puxar ou retirar algo, com destaque particular para o ato de desembainhar uma espada. 1. Puxar ou sacar uma arma branca, como uma espada (Mc 14.7; At 16.27).
THAYER.en: To exert force to pull or withdraw something, with particular emphasis on the act of unsheathing a sword. 1. To pull or draw a melee weapon, such as a sword (Mark 14:7; Acts 16:27).

DEFINITION: Refers to a military unit, specifically the Roman cohort corresponding to a fraction of a legion, or any detachment of soldiers gathered for an operation.
SENSES: 1. A cohort or detachment of Roman soldiers (Matt 27:27; John 18:3).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se a uma unidade militar, especificamente a coorte romana correspondente a uma fração de uma legião, ou a qualquer destacamento de soldados reunido para uma operação. 1. Uma coorte ou destacamento de soldados romanos (Mt 27.27; Jo 18.3).
THAYER.en: Refers to a military unit, specifically the Roman cohort corresponding to a fraction of a legion, or any detachment of soldiers gathered for an operation. 1. A cohort or detachment of Roman soldiers (Matt 27:27; John 18:3).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: σπερῶ, Aor: ἔσπειρα, Perf. Pass: ἔσπαρμαι, Aor. Pass: ἐσπάρην
DEFINITION: The act of throwing or dispersing seeds over plowed earth. Frequently used in parables and metaphorically to describe the proclamation of the word, human actions, and bodily resurrection.
SENSES: 1. To sow seeds in the soil (literal sense) (Matt 13:3; Mark 4:3; Luke 8:5).
2. To proclaim or transmit the message of the gospel (Matt 13:19; 1 Cor 9:11).
3. To practice actions that will generate moral or spiritual consequences (Gal 6:7-8; 2 Cor 9:6).
4. To bury the perishable body in the hope of resurrection (1 Cor 15:42-44).

THAYER.pt: Ato de lançar ou dispersar sementes sobre a terra arada. Frequentemente empregado nas parábolas e de modo metafórico para descrever a proclamação da palavra, os atos humanos e a ressurreição corporal. 1. Semear sementes no solo (sentido literal) (Mt 13.3; Mc 4.3; Lc 8.5). | 2. Proclamar ou transmitir a mensagem do evangelho (Mt 13.19; 1Co 9.11). | 3. Praticar ações que gerarão consequências morais ou espirituais (Gl 6.7-8; 2Co 9.6). | 4. Sepultar o corpo perecível na esperança da ressurreição (1Co 15.42-44).
THAYER.en: The act of throwing or dispersing seeds over plowed earth. Frequently used in parables and metaphorically to describe the proclamation of the word, human actions, and bodily resurrection. 1. To sow seeds in the soil (literal sense) (Matt 13:3; Mark 4:3; Luke 8:5). | 2. To proclaim or transmit the message of the gospel (Matt 13:19; 1 Cor 9:11). | 3. To practice actions that will generate moral or spiritual consequences (Gal 6:7-8; 2 Cor 9:6). | 4. To bury the perishable body in the hope of resurrection (1 Cor 15:42-44).

DEFINITION: A term of Latin origin (speculator) that initially denoted a scout or spy, later designating an imperial bodyguard or an executioner of sentences.
SENSES: 1. A guard soldier tasked with executing death sentences, an executioner (Mark 6:27).

THAYER.pt: Termo de origem latina (speculator) que denotava inicialmente um batedor ou espião, passando a designar um guarda da escolta imperial ou um executor de sentenças (carrasco). 1. Soldado da guarda encarregado de executar sentenças de morte, carrasco (Mc 6.27).
THAYER.en: A term of Latin origin (speculator) that initially denoted a scout or spy, later designating an imperial bodyguard or an executioner of sentences. 1. A guard soldier tasked with executing death sentences, an executioner (Mark 6:27).

DEFINITION: To pour a liquid offering in a sacred ritual; in the New Testament, it is used metaphorically for the pouring out of blood or the sacrifice of life for the sake of the gospel.
SENSES: 1. To offer life or blood as a sacrificial offering (Phil 2:17; 2 Tim 4:6).

THAYER.pt: Derramar uma oferta líquida em ritual sagrado; no Novo Testamento, é empregado metaforicamente para o derramamento do sangue ou sacrifício da vida em prol do evangelho. 1. Oferecer a vida ou o sangue como um sacrifício sacrificial (Fp 2.17; 2Tm 4.6).
THAYER.en: To pour a liquid offering in a sacred ritual; in the New Testament, it is used metaphorically for the pouring out of blood or the sacrifice of life for the sake of the gospel. 1. To offer life or blood as a sacrificial offering (Phil 2:17; 2 Tim 4:6).

DEFINITION: The biological or generative source from which plants, animals, or humans are propagated and continue their lineage.
SENSES: 1. Plant seeds or grains used for planting (Matt 13:32; 1 Cor 15:38).
2. Descendants, posterity, or heirs of a person or people (Luke 1:55; Rom 9:7).
3. Spiritual nature or character generated by God (1 John 3:9).

THAYER.pt: A fonte biológica ou geradora a partir da qual plantas, animais ou seres humanos são propagados e continuam sua linhagem. 1. Semente de plantas ou grãos usados para o plantio (Mt 13.32; 1Co 15.38). | 2. Descendência, posteridade ou herdeiros de uma pessoa ou povo (Lc 1.55; Rm 9.7). | 3. Natureza ou caráter espiritual gerado por Deus (1Jo 3.9).
THAYER.en: The biological or generative source from which plants, animals, or humans are propagated and continue their lineage. 1. Plant seeds or grains used for planting (Matt 13:32; 1 Cor 15:38). | 2. Descendants, posterity, or heirs of a person or people (Luke 1:55; Rom 9:7). | 3. Spiritual nature or character generated by God (1 John 3:9).

DEFINITION: Originally applied to birds that pick up seeds, it came to be used pejoratively to designate a person who gathers fragmented information and propagates it uselessly.
SENSES: 1. An individual who gathers rumors and superficial information to speak without depth, a babbler (Acts 17:18).

THAYER.pt: Originalmente aplicado a pássaros que catam sementes, passou a designar pejorativamente uma pessoa que recolhe informações fragmentadas e as propaga inutilmente. 1. Indivíduo que recolhe boatos e informações superficiais para falar sem profundidade, tagarela (At 17.18).
THAYER.en: Originally applied to birds that pick up seeds, it came to be used pejoratively to designate a person who gathers fragmented information and propagates it uselessly. 1. An individual who gathers rumors and superficial information to speak without depth, a babbler (Acts 17:18).

DEFINITION: To act with speed and urgency, demonstrating great interest, zeal, and dedication in accomplishing something.
SENSES: 1. To go in haste, to hurry to reach a destination (Lk 2:16; Acts 20:16).
2. To eagerly desire and work toward the fulfillment of a future event (2Pet 3:12).

THAYER.pt: Agir com rapidez e urgência, demonstrando grande interesse, zelo e dedicação em realizar algo. 1. Ir com pressa, apressar-se para chegar a um destino (Lc 2.16; At 20.16). | 2. Desejar ardentemente e trabalhar pelo cumprimento de um evento futuro (2Pe 3.12).
THAYER.en: To act with speed and urgency, demonstrating great interest, zeal, and dedication in accomplishing something. 1. To go in haste, to hurry to reach a destination (Lk 2:16; Acts 20:16). | 2. To eagerly desire and work toward the fulfillment of a future event (2Pet 3:12).

DEFINITION: A large natural cavity in rocks or hills, frequently used as a shelter, refuge, or tomb.
SENSES: 1. A natural cave or grotto in the mountains (Heb 11:38; Rev 6:15).
2. A place used as a hiding place by robbers (Matt 21:13).

THAYER.pt: Cavidade natural grande em rochas ou montes, usada frequentemente como abrigo, refúgio ou cova. 1. Caverna ou gruta natural nas montanhas (Hb 11.38; Ap 6.15). | 2. Local usado como esconderijo por salteadores (Mt 21.13).
THAYER.en: A large natural cavity in rocks or hills, frequently used as a shelter, refuge, or tomb. 1. A natural cave or grotto in the mountains (Heb 11:38; Rev 6:15). | 2. A place used as a hiding place by robbers (Matt 21:13).

DEFINITION: Designates a dangerous rock covered by sea waves, invisible to sailors and representing a grave risk of shipwreck.
SENSES: 1. A submerged, hidden reef that threatens vessels (Jude 12).

THAYER.pt: Designa um rochedo perigoso coberto pelas ondas do mar, invisível aos navegantes e que representa um grave risco de naufrágio. 1. Recife submerso e oculto que ameaça as embarcações (Jd 12).
THAYER.en: Designates a dangerous rock covered by sea waves, invisible to sailors and representing a grave risk of shipwreck. 1. A submerged, hidden reef that threatens vessels (Jude 12).

DEFINITION: To cause a physical stain or, in a figurative and ethical sense, to corrupt and morally maculate someone's purity.
SENSES: 1. To stain or corrupt someone's conduct and morals (Jude 23).

THAYER.pt: Causar uma mancha física ou, em sentido figurado e ético, corromper e moralmente macular a pureza de alguém. 1. Manchar ou corromper a conduta e a moral de alguém (Jd 23).
THAYER.en: To cause a physical stain or, in a figurative and ethical sense, to corrupt and morally maculate someone's purity. 1. To stain or corrupt someone's conduct and morals (Jude 23).

DEFINITION: An unwanted mark or stain on a surface, used figuratively to indicate moral or spiritual defects in the community of faith.
SENSES: 1. A physical and moral spot or blemish (Eph 5:27; 2Pet 2:13).

THAYER.pt: Uma marca ou mancha indesejada sobre uma superfície, usada figuradamente para indicar defeitos morais ou espirituais na comunidade de fé. 1. Mancha ou defeito físico e moral (Ef 5.27; 2Pe 2.13).
THAYER.en: An unwanted mark or stain on a surface, used figuratively to indicate moral or spiritual defects in the community of faith. 1. A physical and moral spot or blemish (Eph 5:27; 2Pet 2:13).

DEFINITION: To feel deep visceral commotion and empathy in the face of another's suffering, motivating love and rescue action.
SENSES: 1. To experience intense compassion and mercy for the needy (Matt 14:14; 18:27).

THAYER.pt: Sentir profunda comoção visceral e empatia diante do sofrimento alheio, motivando o amor e a ação socorrista. 1. Experimentar intensa compaixão e misericórdia pelos necessitados (Mt 14.14; 18.27).
THAYER.en: To feel deep visceral commotion and empathy in the face of another's suffering, motivating love and rescue action. 1. To experience intense compassion and mercy for the needy (Matt 14:14; 18:27).

DEFINITION: Originally the internal viscera of the body, it came to designate in biblical language the seat of deep emotions, such as compassion and affection.
SENSES: 1. The bowels or internal organs (Acts 1:18).
2. The seat of deep feelings, compassion, and sincere affection (2Cor 6:12; Phil 1:8).

THAYER.pt: Originalmente as vísceras internas do corpo, passou a designar na linguagem bíblica a sede das emoções profundas, como a compaixão e o afeto. 1. As entranhas ou órgãos internos (At 1.18). | 2. A sede dos sentimentos profundos, compaixão e afeto sincero (2Co 6.12; Fp 1.8).
THAYER.en: Originally the internal viscera of the body, it came to designate in biblical language the seat of deep emotions, such as compassion and affection. 1. The bowels or internal organs (Acts 1:18). | 2. The seat of deep feelings, compassion, and sincere affection (2Cor 6:12; Phil 1:8).

DEFINITION: A porous and absorbent marine organism or its skeleton used to retain and apply liquids.
SENSES: 1. The sponge soaked in vinegar offered to Jesus on the cross (Matt 27:48).

THAYER.pt: Organismo marinho poroso e absorvente ou seu esqueleto usado para reter e aplicar líquidos. 1. A esponja embebida em vinagre oferecida a Jesus na cruz (Mt 27.48).
THAYER.en: A porous and absorbent marine organism or its skeleton used to retain and apply liquids. 1. The sponge soaked in vinegar offered to Jesus on the cross (Matt 27:48).

DEFINITION: The dusty residue resulting from the complete burning of a substance or organic matter.
SENSES: 1. Ashes used in ceremonial purification rituals (Heb 9:13).

THAYER.pt: Resíduo empoeirado resultante da queima completa de uma substância ou matéria orgânica. 1. Cinzas usadas em rituais de purificação cerimonial (Hb 9.13).
THAYER.en: The dusty residue resulting from the complete burning of a substance or organic matter. 1. Ashes used in ceremonial purification rituals (Heb 9:13).

DEFINITION: Refers to the act of sowing, the planted seed, or, by metaphorical extension, lineage and generational origin.
SENSES: 1. Seed or spiritual generating principle (1Pet 1:23).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se ao ato de semear, à semente plantada ou, por extensão metafórica, à linhagem e origem geracional. 1. Semente ou princípio gerador espiritual (1Pe 1.23).
THAYER.en: Refers to the act of sowing, the planted seed, or, by metaphorical extension, lineage and generational origin. 1. Seed or spiritual generating principle (1Pet 1:23).

DEFINITION: Pertaining to seeds or cultivated fields; used substantively in the plural to designate growing cereal crops.
SENSES: 1. Grain plantations or standing grain (Matt 12:1; Lk 6:1).

THAYER.pt: Pertecente a sementes ou campos cultivados; substantivado no plural para designar plantações de cereais em crescimento. 1. Plantações de grãos ou searas (Mt 12.1; Lc 6.1).
THAYER.en: Pertaining to seeds or cultivated fields; used substantively in the plural to designate growing cereal crops. 1. Grain plantations or standing grain (Matt 12:1; Lk 6:1).

DEFINITION: Refers both to the act of sowing and to the seed itself intended for planting and agricultural reproduction.
SENSES: 1. The grain or seed cast into the earth (Lk 8:11).
2. The process or time of agricultural sowing.

THAYER.pt: Refere-se tanto ao ato de semear quanto à própria semente destinada ao plantio e reprodução agrícola. 1. O grão ou semente lançado à terra (Lc 8.11). | 2. O processo ou tempo da semeadura agrícola.
THAYER.en: Refers both to the act of sowing and to the seed itself intended for planting and agricultural reproduction. 1. The grain or seed cast into the earth (Lk 8:11). | 2. The process or time of agricultural sowing.

DEFINITION: To act with great zeal, speed, and commitment to accomplish a task or fulfill a responsibility.
SENSES: 1. To be zealous, make every effort, or endeavor (Gal 2:10; Eph 4:3).
2. To make haste or proceed quickly to accomplish something (2Tim 4:9).

THAYER.pt: Agir com grande zelo, rapidez e empenho para realizar uma tarefa ou cumprir uma responsabilidade. 1. Ser zeloso, esforçar-se ao máximo ou empenhar-se (Gl 2.10; Ef 4.3). | 2. Apressar-se ou proceder rapidamente para realizar algo (2Tm 4.9).
THAYER.en: To act with great zeal, speed, and commitment to accomplish a task or fulfill a responsibility. 1. To be zealous, make every effort, or endeavor (Gal 2:10; Eph 4:3). | 2. To make haste or proceed quickly to accomplish something (2Tim 4:9).

DEFINITION: Demonstrating conscious commitment, seriousness, and diligent dedication in fulfilling a task or duty.
SENSES: 1. A person diligent and zealous in their obligations (2Cor 8:22).

THAYER.pt: Que demonstra empenho consciente, seriedade e dedicação diligente no cumprimento de uma tarefa ou dever. 1. Pessoa diligente e zelosa em suas obrigações (2Co 8.22).
THAYER.en: Demonstrating conscious commitment, seriousness, and diligent dedication in fulfilling a task or duty. 1. A person diligent and zealous in their obligations (2Cor 8:22).

DEFINITION: Comparative adverbial form expressing a greater degree of zeal, haste, dedication, or commitment in accomplishing something.
SENSES: 1. With greater commitment, zeal, or diligence.

THAYER.pt: Forma adverbial comparativa que expressa um grau maior de zelo, pressa, dedicação ou empenho na realização de algo. 1. Com maior empenho, zelo ou diligência.
THAYER.en: Comparative adverbial form expressing a greater degree of zeal, haste, dedication, or commitment in accomplishing something. 1. With greater commitment, zeal, or diligence.

DEFINITION: Comparative adjective describing someone who demonstrates more zeal, haste, or committed dedication to a task.
SENSES: 1. One who demonstrates greater dedication and zeal than another.

THAYER.pt: Adjetivo no comparativo que descreve alguém que demonstra mais zelo, pressa ou dedicação empenhada em alguma tarefa. 1. Que demonstra maior dedicação e zelo do que outro.
THAYER.en: Comparative adjective describing someone who demonstrates more zeal, haste, or committed dedication to a task. 1. One who demonstrates greater dedication and zeal than another.

DEFINITION: Comparative adverbial form denoting an action performed with greater commitment, urgency, care, or diligence.
SENSES: 1. In a more diligent manner, with greater commitment or zeal.

THAYER.pt: Forma comparativa de advérbio que denota uma ação realizada com maior empenho, urgência, cuidado ou diligência. 1. De maneira mais diligente, com maior empenho ou zelo.
THAYER.en: Comparative adverbial form denoting an action performed with greater commitment, urgency, care, or diligence. 1. In a more diligent manner, with greater commitment or zeal.

DEFINITION: In an energetic, rapid, and extremely diligent manner in the performance of an activity or duty.
SENSES: 1. To act with readiness and intense zeal (Phil 2:28; Tit 3:13).

THAYER.pt: De maneira enérgica, rápida e extremamente diligente na realização de uma atividade ou dever. 1. Agir com prontidão e zelo intenso (Fp 2.28; Tt 3.13).
THAYER.en: In an energetic, rapid, and extremely diligent manner in the performance of an activity or duty. 1. To act with readiness and intense zeal (Phil 2:28; Tit 3:13).

DEFINITION: Attitude combining intense motivational effort, zealous dedication, or promptness in executing a task.
SENSES: 1. Speed or haste in movements and actions (Mk 6:25; Lk 1:39).
2. Diligent endeavor, zeal, and sincere dedication (Rom 12:11; 2Cor 8:7).

THAYER.pt: Atitude que combina intenso esforço motivacional, dedicação zelosa ou presteza na execução de uma tarefa. 1. Velocidade ou pressa em movimentos e ações (Mc 6.25; Lc 1.39). | 2. Empenho diligente, zelo e dedicação sincera (Rm 12.11; 2Co 8.7).
THAYER.en: Attitude combining intense motivational effort, zealous dedication, or promptness in executing a task. 1. Speed or haste in movements and actions (Mk 6:25; Lk 1:39). | 2. Diligent endeavor, zeal, and sincere dedication (Rom 12:11; 2Cor 8:7).

DEFINITION: A large basket, generally made of braided ropes or rushes, used for carrying heavy provisions.
SENSES: 1. A large basket used for gathering food leftovers or for transport (Matt 15:37; Acts 9:25).

THAYER.pt: Um cesto grande, geralmente feito de cordas trançadas ou junco, usado para carregar provisões pesadas. 1. Grande cesto usado para recolher sobras de alimentos ou para transporte (Mt 15:37; At 9:25).
THAYER.en: A large basket, generally made of braided ropes or rushes, used for carrying heavy provisions. 1. A large basket used for gathering food leftovers or for transport (Matt 15:37; Acts 9:25).

DEFINITION: Designates both a standard unit of distance measurement (about 192 meters or one-eighth of a mile) and the enclosed venue destined for athletic competitions and public spectacles.
SENSES: 1. A unit of distance equivalent to a stadion or 192 meters (Lk 24:13; Jn 11:18).
2. An arena or racecourse for competitions (1Cor 9:24).

THAYER.pt: Designa tanto uma unidade padrão de medida de distância (cerca de 192 metros ou um oitavo de milha) quanto o recinto fechado destinado a competições atléticas e espetáculos públicos. 1. Medida de distância equivalente a um estádio ou 192 metros (Lc 24.13; Jo 11.18). | 2. Arena ou pista de corrida para competições (1Co 9.24).
THAYER.en: Designates both a standard unit of distance measurement (about 192 meters or one-eighth of a mile) and the enclosed venue destined for athletic competitions and public spectacles. 1. A unit of distance equivalent to a stadion or 192 meters (Lk 24:13; Jn 11:18). | 2. An arena or racecourse for competitions (1Cor 9:24).

DEFINITION: A clay or ceramic vessel used to store liquids or provisions, such as the jar that contained the manna in the sanctuary.
SENSES: 1. A storage jar or vessel, specifically the one that held the manna (Heb 9:4).

THAYER.pt: Recipiente de barro ou cerâmica usado para armazenar líquidos ou mantimentos, como o jarro que continha o manna no santuário. 1. Jarro ou vaso de armazenamento, especificamente o que guardava o manna (Hb 9.4).
THAYER.en: A clay or ceramic vessel used to store liquids or provisions, such as the jar that contained the manna in the sanctuary. 1. A storage jar or vessel, specifically the one that held the manna (Heb 9:4).

DEFINITION: Indicates a state of social unrest, rebellion against authority, or deep division of opinions that generates conflict.
SENSES: 1. A public uprising, revolt, or tumult (Mk 15:7; Acts 24:5).
2. Dissension, division, or strong disagreement between groups (Acts 23:7).

THAYER.pt: Indica um estado de agitação social, rebelião contra a autoridade ou divisão profunda de opiniões que gera conflito. 1. Um levante público, revolta ou tumulto (Mc 15.7; At 24.5). | 2. Dissensão, divisão ou forte desacordo entre grupos (At 23.7).
THAYER.en: Indicates a state of social unrest, rebellion against authority, or deep division of opinions that generates conflict. 1. A public uprising, revolt, or tumult (Mk 15:7; Acts 24:5). | 2. Dissension, division, or strong disagreement between groups (Acts 23:7).

DEFINITION: Ancient Greek silver coin, equivalent to four drachmas or two didrachms, sufficient to pay the temple tax for two people.
SENSES: 1. A high-value silver coin circulating in the Greco-Roman world (Matt 17:27).

THAYER.pt: Antiga moeda de prata grega, equivalente a quatro dracmas ou dois didracmas, suficiente para pagar o imposto do templo para duas pessoas. 1. Moeda de prata de alto valor circulante no mundo greco-romano (Mt 17.27).
THAYER.en: Ancient Greek silver coin, equivalent to four drachmas or two didrachms, sufficient to pay the temple tax for two people. 1. A high-value silver coin circulating in the Greco-Roman world (Matt 17:27).

DEFINITION: Roman capital punishment instrument composed of a vertical stake and a crossbeam, centrally associated with Christ's sacrifice.
SENSES: 1. The cross or stake used as a Roman execution instrument (Matt 27:40; Jn 19:17).
2. Christ's cross as a symbol of redemption and vicarious sacrifice (1Cor 1:18; Eph 2:16).

THAYER.pt: Instrumento de execução capital romano composto por uma estaca vertical e uma travessa, associado de forma central ao sacrifício de Cristo. 1. A cruz ou estaca usada como instrumento de execução romana (Mt 27.40; Jo 19.17). | 2. A cruz de Cristo como símbolo da redenção e do sacrifício vicário (1Co 1.18; Ef 2.16).
THAYER.en: Roman capital punishment instrument composed of a vertical stake and a crossbeam, centrally associated with Christ's sacrifice. 1. The cross or stake used as a Roman execution instrument (Matt 27:40; Jn 19:17). | 2. Christ's cross as a symbol of redemption and vicarious sacrifice (1Cor 1:18; Eph 2:16).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: σταυρώσω, Aor: ἐσταύρωσα, PerfPass: ἐσταύρωμαι
SHORT_GLOSS: to crucify, nail to a cross
DEFINITION: To fix or nail to a cross to suffer capital execution by the Roman method. In Pauline theology, it acquires a deep salvific and spiritual dimension regarding Christ's vicarious death and the mortification of the old man.
SENSES: 1. To execute by Roman crucifixion (Matt 20:19; 27:22; Mk 15:24).
2. Doctrinal proclamation of the crucified and redeeming Christ (1Cor 1:23; 2:2).
3. Figurative: to mortify and spiritually renounce fleshly desires or the worldly system (Gal 5:24; 6:14).
USAGE: to crucify, nail to a cross

THAYER.pt: Fixar ou pregar numa cruz para sofrer execução capital pelo método romano. Na teologia paulina, adquire uma dimensão salvífica e espiritual profunda com respeito à morte vicária de Cristo e à mortificação do velho homem. 1. Executar pela crucificação romana (Mt 20.19; 27.22; Mc 15.24). | 2. Proclamação doutrinária do Cristo crucificado e redentor (1Co 1.23; 2.2). | 3. Figurado: mortificar e renunciar espiritualmente aos desejos da carne ou ao sistema mundano (Gl 5.24; 6.14).
THAYER.en: To fix or nail to a cross to suffer capital execution by the Roman method. In Pauline theology, it acquires a deep salvific and spiritual dimension regarding Christ's vicarious death and the mortification of the old man. 1. To execute by Roman crucifixion (Matt 20:19; 27:22; Mk 15:24). | 2. Doctrinal proclamation of the crucified and redeeming Christ (1Cor 1:23; 2:2). | 3. Figurative: to mortify and spiritually renounce fleshly desires or the worldly system (Gal 5:24; 6:14).

DEFINITION: The edible fruit of the grapevine, generally grouped in clusters.
SENSES: 1. A cluster of grapes harvested from the grapevine (Matt 7:16).

THAYER.pt: O fruto comestível da videira, geralmente agrupado em cachos. 1. O cacho de uvas colhido da videira (Mt 7.16).
THAYER.en: The edible fruit of the grapevine, generally grouped in clusters. 1. A cluster of grapes harvested from the grapevine (Matt 7:16).

DEFINITION: The dense spike where grains of cereals like wheat and barley form and cluster; also the proper name of a Christian in Rome.
SENSES: 1. A ripe ear of wheat or barley (Matt 12:1).
2. Stachys, a brother greeted by the apostle Paul (Rom 16:9).

THAYER.pt: A espiga densa onde se formam e se agrupam os grãos de cereais como trigo e cevada; também nome próprio de um cristão em Roma. 1. A espiga madura de trigo ou cevada (Mt 12:1); | 2. Estáquis, irmão saudado pelo apóstolo Paulo (Rm 16:9).
THAYER.en: The dense spike where grains of cereals like wheat and barley form and cluster; also the proper name of a Christian in Rome. 1. A ripe ear of wheat or barley (Matt 12:1). | 2. Stachys, a brother greeted by the apostle Paul (Rom 16:9).

DEFINITION: Masculine proper name of a Roman Christian to whom the apostle Paul sends special greetings.
SENSES: 1. Stachys, a brother in the faith greeted by Paul in his letter to the Romans (Rom 16:9).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio masculino de um cristão romano a quem o apóstolo Paulo envia saudações especiais. 1. Stachys, irmão na fé saudado por Paulo em sua carta aos Romanos (Rm 16.9).
THAYER.en: Masculine proper name of a Roman Christian to whom the apostle Paul sends special greetings. 1. Stachys, a brother in the faith greeted by Paul in his letter to the Romans (Rom 16:9).

DEFINITION: The upper covering of a dwelling or building that protects the interior against weather elements.
SENSES: 1. The roof of a house (Matt 8:8; Mk 2:4).

THAYER.pt: A cobertura superior de uma habitação ou construção que protege o interior contra intempéries. 1. O telhado de uma casa (Mt 8.8; Mc 2.4).
THAYER.en: The upper covering of a dwelling or building that protects the interior against weather elements. 1. The roof of a house (Matt 8:8; Mk 2:4).

DEFINITION: To endure pressures or difficulties with firmness, or to keep something in secrecy and confidentiality.
SENSES: 1. To keep secret, protect by silence (1Co 13.7).
2. To patiently endure afflictions or difficulties (1Co 9.12; 1Ts 3.5).

THAYER.pt: Suportar pressões ou dificuldades com firmeza, ou manter algo em segredo e confidencialidade. 1. Guardar em segredo, proteger pelo silêncio (1Co 13.7). | 2. Suportar pacientemente aflições ou dificuldades (1Co 9.12; 1Ts 3.5).
THAYER.en: To endure pressures or difficulties with firmness, or to keep something in secrecy and confidentiality. 1. To keep secret, protect by silence (1Co 13.7). | 2. To patiently endure afflictions or difficulties (1Co 9.12; 1Ts 3.5).

DEFINITION: Lacking the capacity to generate children or bear fruit; applied to women or animals incapable of reproduction.
SENSES: 1. Woman or female incapable of conceiving children, barren (Lk 1:7, 36).

THAYER.pt: Que não tem capacidade de gerar filhos ou dar frutos; aplicado a mulheres ou animais incapazes de reprodução. 1. Mulher ou fêmea incapaz de conceber filhos, estéril (Lc 1:7, 36).
THAYER.en: Lacking the capacity to generate children or bear fruit; applied to women or animals incapable of reproduction. 1. Woman or female incapable of conceiving children, barren (Lk 1:7, 36).

DEFINITION: To keep a prudent distance, abstain from certain companies, or avoid involvement with disorderly practices.
SENSES: 1. To keep a distance or withdraw from inappropriate behavior (2Ts 3.6; 2Co 8.20).

THAYER.pt: Manter distância prudente, abster-se de certas companhias ou evitar o envolvimento com práticas desordenadas. 1. Manter distância ou afastar-se de comportamentos inadequados (2Ts 3.6; 2Co 8.20).
THAYER.en: To keep a prudent distance, abstain from certain companies, or avoid involvement with disorderly practices. 1. To keep a distance or withdraw from inappropriate behavior (2Ts 3.6; 2Co 8.20).

DEFINITION: A crown or garland made of intertwined flowers, leaves, or branches, used in religious rituals, festivals, or to crown victors.
SENSES: 1. A festive garland or flower crown used in sacrifices or celebrations (Ac 14.13).

THAYER.pt: Coroa ou grinalda feita de flores, folhas ou ramos entrelaçados, utilizada em rituais religiosos, festivais ou para coroar vencedores. 1. Grinalda ou coroa festiva de flores usada em sacrifícios ou celebrações (At 14.13).
THAYER.en: A crown or garland made of intertwined flowers, leaves, or branches, used in religious rituals, festivals, or to crown victors. 1. A festive garland or flower crown used in sacrifices or celebrations (Ac 14.13).

DEFINITION: An involuntary vocal expression of deep suffering, anguish, oppression, or strong inner yearning.
SENSES: 1. A sigh or groan resulting from great distress or affliction (Ac 7.34; Ro 8.26).

THAYER.pt: Expressão sonora involuntária de profundo sofrimento, angústia, opressão ou forte anseio interior. 1. Suspiro ou gemido resultante de grande aperto ou aflição (At 7.34; Rm 8.26).
THAYER.en: An involuntary vocal expression of deep suffering, anguish, oppression, or strong inner yearning. 1. A sigh or groan resulting from great distress or affliction (Ac 7.34; Ro 8.26).

DEFINITION: To utter involuntary sighs or groans caused by strong suffering, oppression, affliction, or deep expectation.
SENSES: 1. To groan or sigh under the weight of earthly trials and afflictions (Ro 8.23; 2Co 5.2).
2. To express discontent or lamentation (Jas 5.9).

THAYER.pt: Emitir suspiros ou gemidos involuntários causados por forte sofrimento, opressão, aflição ou profunda expectativa. 1. Gemer ou suspirar sob o peso de provações e aflições terrenas (Rm 8.23; 2Co 5.2). | 2. Expressar descontentamento ou lamentação (Tg 5.9).
THAYER.en: To utter involuntary sighs or groans caused by strong suffering, oppression, affliction, or deep expectation. 1. To groan or sigh under the weight of earthly trials and afflictions (Ro 8.23; 2Co 5.2). | 2. To express discontent or lamentation (Jas 5.9).

DEFINITION: Having reduced dimensions in width or passage space, demanding restriction.
SENSES: 1. A narrow road or gate in a literal or metaphorical sense (Mt 7.13).

THAYER.pt: Que possui dimensões reduzidas em largura ou espaço de passagem, exigindo restrição. 1. Caminho ou porta estreita em sentido literal ou metafórico (Mt 7.13).
THAYER.en: Having reduced dimensions in width or passage space, demanding restriction. 1. A narrow road or gate in a literal or metaphorical sense (Mt 7.13).

DEFINITION: To confine to a very restricted space or, figuratively, to place someone in a situation of distress and tight corner with no apparent way out.
SENSES: 1. To be under severe distress or agonizing restriction (2Co 4.8; 6.12).

THAYER.pt: Confinar a um espaço muito restrito ou, em sentido figurado, colocar alguém em situação de angústia e aperto sem saída aparente. 1. Estar sob forte aperto ou restrição angustiante (2Co 4.8; 6.12).
THAYER.en: To confine to a very restricted space or, figuratively, to place someone in a situation of distress and tight corner with no apparent way out. 1. To be under severe distress or agonizing restriction (2Co 4.8; 6.12).

DEFINITION: A state of oppression resulting from difficult and restrictive circumstances, causing deep mental or emotional suffering.
SENSES: 1. A situation of intense anguish, distress, or tribulation (Ro 2.9; 2Co 6.4).

THAYER.pt: Estado de opressão resultante de circunstâncias difíceis e restritivas, causando sofrimento mental ou emocional profundo. 1. Situação de intensa angústia, aperto ou tribulação (Rm 2.9; 2Co 6.4).
THAYER.en: A state of oppression resulting from difficult and restrictive circumstances, causing deep mental or emotional suffering. 1. A situation of intense anguish, distress, or tribulation (Ro 2.9; 2Co 6.4).

DEFINITION: Describes that which is solid, firm, or consistent, whether in a literal sense (solid food) or figurative, denoting firmness of character and conviction in the Christian faith.
SENSES: 1. Firm or solid in contrast to what is soft or liquid (Heb 5.12);
2. Firm and unshakable in attitudes, beliefs, or spiritual character (1Pe 5.9).

THAYER.pt: Descreve aquilo que é sólido, firme ou consistente, seja em sentido literal (alimento sólido) ou figurado, denotando firmeza de caráter e convicção na fé cristã. 1. Firme ou sólido em contraste com o que é mole ou líquido (Hb 5.12); | 2. Firme e inabalável em atitudes, crenças ou caráter espiritual (1Pe 5.9).
THAYER.en: Describes that which is solid, firm, or consistent, whether in a literal sense (solid food) or figurative, denoting firmness of character and conviction in the Christian faith. 1. Firm or solid in contrast to what is soft or liquid (Heb 5.12); | 2. Firm and unshakable in attitudes, beliefs, or spiritual character (1Pe 5.9).

DEFINITION: To make physically firm or strong, or to consolidate spiritual and moral convictions and postures.
SENSES: 1. To restore physical firmness and strength to limbs (Ac 3.7).
2. To strengthen the faith and conviction of the community (Ac 16.5).

THAYER.pt: Tornar fisicamente firme ou forte, ou consolidar convicções e posturas espirituais e morais. 1. Restaurar a firmeza física e a força dos membros (At 3.7). | 2. Fortalecer a fé e convicção da comunidade (At 16.5).
THAYER.en: To make physically firm or strong, or to consolidate spiritual and moral convictions and postures. 1. To restore physical firmness and strength to limbs (Ac 3.7). | 2. To strengthen the faith and conviction of the community (Ac 16.5).

DEFINITION: Indicates a solid base, firmament, or the condition of unshakable firmness and perseverance in moral or spiritual convictions.
SENSES: 1. Firmness, solidity, and stability in the Christian faith (Col 2.5).

THAYER.pt: Indica uma base sólida, firmamento ou a condição de firmeza inabalável e perseverança em convicções morais ou espirituais. 1. Firmeza, solidez e estabilidade na fé cristã (Cl 2.5).
THAYER.en: Indicates a solid base, firmament, or the condition of unshakable firmness and perseverance in moral or spiritual convictions. 1. Firmness, solidity, and stability in the Christian faith (Col 2.5).

DEFINITION: Stephanas was a Corinthian Christian whose household was baptized by the apostle Paul, being considered one of the first fruits of preaching in Achaia.
SENSES: 1. Prominent member of the church in Corinth whose household was baptized by Paul (1Co 1.16).

THAYER.pt: Estéfanas foi um cristão corinto cuja família foi batizada pelo apóstolo Paulo, sendo considerado um dos primeiros frutos da pregação na Acaia. 1. Membro proeminente da igreja em Corinto cuja casa foi batizada por Paulo (1Co 1.16).
THAYER.en: Stephanas was a Corinthian Christian whose household was baptized by the apostle Paul, being considered one of the first fruits of preaching in Achaia. 1. Prominent member of the church in Corinth whose household was baptized by Paul (1Co 1.16).

DEFINITION: Refers to a crown or wreath made of foliage or metal, used as a symbol of honor, athletic victory, or high distinction. In the NT, it is used metaphorically for the eschatological reward of the faithful.
SENSES: 1. Crown or wreath of foliage or honor (Mt 27.29).
2. Reason for pride or honor for someone (Php 4.1).
3. Prize or reward granted for faithfulness in the Christian race (2Tm 4.8; Jas 1.25).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se a uma coroa ou grinalda feita de folhagem ou metal, usada como símbolo de honra, vitória atlética ou alta distinção. No NT, é usado metaforicamente para a recompensa escatológica dos fiéis. 1. Coroa ou grinalda de folhagem ou honraria (Mt 27.29). | 2. Motivo de orgulho ou honra para alguém (Fp 4.1). | 3. Prêmio ou recompensa concedida pela fidelidade na carreira cristã (2Tm 4.8; Tg 1.25).
THAYER.en: Refers to a crown or wreath made of foliage or metal, used as a symbol of honor, athletic victory, or high distinction. In the NT, it is used metaphorically for the eschatological reward of the faithful. 1. Crown or wreath of foliage or honor (Mt 27.29). | 2. Reason for pride or honor for someone (Php 4.1). | 3. Prize or reward granted for faithfulness in the Christian race (2Tm 4.8; Jas 1.25).

DEFINITION: Proper name of Stephen, the first Christian martyr, and substantively the crown or wreath granted as a symbol of honor, athletic victory, or spiritual reward.
SENSES: 1. Stephen, the deacon and martyr of the early church (Ac 6.5).
2. Crown or wreath of victory given as a prize or honor (2Tm 4.8; Jas 1.12).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio de Estêvão, o primeiro mártir cristão, e substantivamente a coroa ou grinalda concedida como símbolo de honra, vitória atlética ou recompensa espiritual. 1. Estêvão, o diácono e mártir da igreja primitiva (At 6.5). | 2. Coroa ou grinalda de vitória dada como prêmio ou honraria (2Tm 4.8; Tg 1.12).
THAYER.en: Proper name of Stephen, the first Christian martyr, and substantively the crown or wreath granted as a symbol of honor, athletic victory, or spiritual reward. 1. Stephen, the deacon and martyr of the early church (Ac 6.5). | 2. Crown or wreath of victory given as a prize or honor (2Tm 4.8; Jas 1.12).

DEFINITION: To crown literally or figuratively, either by placing a victory wreath on someone or conferring honor and distinction for a meritorious act.
SENSES: 1. To place a crown or wreath as a symbol of athletic or military victory (2Tm 2.5).
2. To grant supreme honor and glory to someone as a reward (Heb 2.7).

THAYER.pt: Coroar literal ou figuradamente, seja colocando uma grinalda de vitória sobre alguém ou conferindo honra e distinção por um ato meritório. 1. Colocar uma coroa ou grinalda como símbolo de vitória atlética ou militar (2Tm 2.5). | 2. Conceder honra e glória suprema a alguém como galardão (Hb 2.7).
THAYER.en: To crown literally or figuratively, either by placing a victory wreath on someone or conferring honor and distinction for a meritorious act. 1. To place a crown or wreath as a symbol of athletic or military victory (2Tm 2.5). | 2. To grant supreme honor and glory to someone as a reward (Heb 2.7).

DEFINITION: The front part of the human torso extending from the neck to the abdomen, where the heart is housed.
SENSES: 1. The human chest or thorax (Jn 13:25; Lk 18:13).

THAYER.pt: A parte anterior do tronco humano que vai desde o pescoço até o abdome, onde se aloja o coração. 1. O peito ou tórax humano (Jo 13:25; Lc 18:13).
THAYER.en: The front part of the human torso extending from the neck to the abdomen, where the heart is housed. 1. The human chest or thorax (Jn 13:25; Lk 18:13).

DEFINITION: To stand in an upright position or, figuratively, to remain firm and unshakable in convictions, faith, or doctrine.
SENSES: 1. To stand in an upright position (Mk 11.25).
2. To be firmly committed to convictions or faith, to be steadfast (1Co 16.13; Php 4.1).

THAYER.pt: Estar em uma posição ereta ou, figurativamente, manter-se firme e inabalável em convicções, fé ou doutrina. 1. Estar em posição ereta, em pé (Mc 11.25). | 2. Estar firmemente comprometido com convicções ou fé, ser steadfast (1Co 16.13; Fp 4.1).
THAYER.en: To stand in an upright position or, figuratively, to remain firm and unshakable in convictions, faith, or doctrine. 1. To stand in an upright position (Mk 11.25). | 2. To be firmly committed to convictions or faith, to be steadfast (1Co 16.13; Php 4.1).

DEFINITION: Indicates a state of firmness, spiritual stability, or unshakable conviction against error.
SENSES: 1. Firmness and constancy in the Christian faith in the face of doctrinal deviations (2Pe 3.17).

THAYER.pt: Indica um estado de firmeza, estabilidade espiritual ou convicção inabalável contra o erro. 1. Firmeza e constância na fé cristã diante de desvios doutrinários (2Pe 3.17).
THAYER.en: Indicates a state of firmness, spiritual stability, or unshakable conviction against error. 1. Firmness and constancy in the Christian faith in the face of doctrinal deviations (2Pe 3.17).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: στηρίξω, Aor: ἐστήριξα, Perf: ἐστήριγμαι
DEFINITION: Means to fix firmly in a place or to strengthen the courage, making someone spiritually resolute and unshakable.
SENSES: 1. To fix or place firmly in a position (Lk 16.26).
2. To strengthen, confirm, and consolidate in faith and courage (1Ts 3.13; 1Pe 5.10).

THAYER.pt: Significa fixar firmemente em um lugar ou fortalecer o ânimo, tornando alguém espiritualmente resoluto e inabalável. 1. Fixar ou colocar firmemente em uma posição (Lc 16.26). | 2. Fortalecer, confirmar e consolidar na fé e no ânimo (1Ts 3.13; 1Pe 5.10).
THAYER.en: Means to fix firmly in a place or to strengthen the courage, making someone spiritually resolute and unshakable. 1. To fix or place firmly in a position (Lk 16.26). | 2. To strengthen, confirm, and consolidate in faith and courage (1Ts 3.13; 1Pe 5.10).

DEFINITION: Refers to a permanent mark or scar on the body, frequently associated with battle wounds or marks of slavery.
SENSES: 1. Physical marks of suffering and persecution endured for Christ's sake (Gal 6.17).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se a uma marca ou cicatriz permanente no corpo, frequentemente associada a feridas de batalha ou marcas de escravidão. 1. Marcas físicas de sofrimento e perseguição suportadas por causa de Cristo (Gl 6.17).
THAYER.en: Refers to a permanent mark or scar on the body, frequently associated with battle wounds or marks of slavery. 1. Physical marks of suffering and persecution endured for Christ's sake (Gal 6.17).

DEFINITION: Designates an extremely short unit of time, a fleeting moment or instant.
SENSES: 1. A very brief moment of time (Lk 4.5).

THAYER.pt: Designa uma unidade de tempo extremamente curta, um momento ou instante fugaz. 1. Um momento brevíssimo de tempo (Lc 4.5).
THAYER.en: Designates an extremely short unit of time, a fleeting moment or instant. 1. A very brief moment of time (Lk 4.5).

DEFINITION: Means to emit rays of light, gleam, or shine with intensity.
SENSES: 1. To shine or be radiant in appearance (Mk 9.3).

THAYER.pt: Significa emitir raios de luz, reluzir ou resplandecer com intensidade. 1. Brilhar ou resplandecer com aspecto radiante (Mc 9.3).
THAYER.en: Means to emit rays of light, gleam, or shine with intensity. 1. To shine or be radiant in appearance (Mk 9.3).

DEFINITION: Refers to a covered gallery supported by columns, generally open on one side, used as shelter from the sun and weather, where people gathered.
SENSES: 1. A covered portico or colonnade in public buildings and temples (Jn 5.2; Jn 10.23; Ac 3.11).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se a uma galeria coberta sustentada por colunas, geralmente aberta em um dos lados, usada como abrigo contra o sol e o clima, onde as pessoas se reuniam. 1. Um pórtico ou colunata coberta em edifícios públicos e templos (Jo 5.2; Jo 10.23; At 3.11).
THAYER.en: Refers to a covered gallery supported by columns, generally open on one side, used as shelter from the sun and weather, where people gathered. 1. A covered portico or colonnade in public buildings and temples (Jn 5.2; Jn 10.23; Ac 3.11).

DEFINITION: Refers to cut branches, foliage, or reeds strewn to form an improvised bed.
SENSES: 1. Tree branches cut and strewn about (Mk 11.8).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se a ramos cortados, folhagem ou juncos espalhados para formar um leito improvisado. 1. Ramos de árvores cortados e espalhados (Mc 11.8).
THAYER.en: Refers to cut branches, foliage, or reeds strewn to form an improvised bed. 1. Tree branches cut and strewn about (Mk 11.8).

DEFINITION: Means the fundamental components of which the physical world is composed, extending to basic rudiments of learning or elemental spiritual forces.
SENSES: 1. The basic rudiments or fundamental principles of a teaching (Heb 5.12).
2. The material elements of the cosmos or elemental spiritual powers (Gal 4.3; Col 2.8).

THAYER.pt: Significa os componentes fundamentais dos quais o mundo físico é composto, estendendo-se aos rudimentos básicos do aprendizado ou às forças espirituais elementares. 1. Os rudimentos básicos ou princípios fundamentais de um ensino (Hb 5.12). | 2. Os elementos materiais do cosmos ou poderes espirituais elementares (Gl 4.3; Cl 2.8).
THAYER.en: Means the fundamental components of which the physical world is composed, extending to basic rudiments of learning or elemental spiritual forces. 1. The basic rudiments or fundamental principles of a teaching (Heb 5.12). | 2. The material elements of the cosmos or elemental spiritual powers (Gal 4.3; Col 2.8).

DEFINITION: To walk in orderly file or, figuratively, to conduct life according to an established moral, ethical, or spiritual standard.
SENSES: 1. To live and behave in strict conformity with a norm or standard (Gal 5:25; 6:16).

THAYER.pt: Caminhar em fileira ordenada ou, figurativamente, conduzir a vida de acordo com um padrão moral, ético ou espiritual estabelecido. 1. Viver e comportar-se em estrita conformidade com uma norma ou padrão (Gl 5:25; 6:16).
THAYER.en: To walk in orderly file or, figuratively, to conduct life according to an established moral, ethical, or spiritual standard. 1. To live and behave in strict conformity with a norm or standard (Gal 5:25; 6:16).

DEFINITION: Refers to a long, flowing garment, generally worn by prominent people, authorities, or associated with celestial vestments.
SENSES: 1. A long tunic or solemn garment (Mk 12.38; Rev 7.14).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se a uma vestimenta longa e fluida, geralmente usada por pessoas de destaque, autoridades ou associada a vestes celestiais. 1. Uma túnica longa ou veste solene (Mc 12.38; Ap 7.14).
THAYER.en: Refers to a long, flowing garment, generally worn by prominent people, authorities, or associated with celestial vestments. 1. A long tunic or solemn garment (Mk 12.38; Rev 7.14).

DEFINITION: The anatomical organ of speech and food ingestion; by metonymy it indicates speech itself, and by a Hebrew idiom, the sharp blade of weapons.
SENSES: 1. The physical human or animal mouth (Mt 15.11; Mt 17.27; Jas 3.3).
2. Metonymy for speaking, declaration, testimony, or speech (Mt 18.16; Lk 21.15; Ro 10.10).
3. Edge or blade of a sword (Hebrew idiom: mouth of the sword) (Lk 21.24; Heb 11.34).

THAYER.pt: Órgão anatômico da fala e da ingestão alimentar; por metonímia indica o próprio discurso proferido, e por figura hebraica, a lâmina cortante de armas. 1. A boca física humana ou animal (Mt 15.11; Mt 17.27; Tg 3.3). | 2. Metonímia para o falar, declaração, testemunho ou discurso (Mt 18.16; Lk 21.15; Rm 10.10). | 3. Fio ou gume de espada (expressão hebraica: boca da espada) (Lc 21.24; Hb 11.34).
THAYER.en: The anatomical organ of speech and food ingestion; by metonymy it indicates speech itself, and by a Hebrew idiom, the sharp blade of weapons. 1. The physical human or animal mouth (Mt 15.11; Mt 17.27; Jas 3.3). | 2. Metonymy for speaking, declaration, testimony, or speech (Mt 18.16; Lk 21.15; Ro 10.10). | 3. Edge or blade of a sword (Hebrew idiom: mouth of the sword) (Lk 21.24; Heb 11.34).

DEFINITION: Designates the upper part of the digestive tract, specifically the stomach.
SENSES: 1. The stomach organ and its digestive health (1Tm 5.23).

THAYER.pt: Designa a parte superior do trato digestivo, especificamente o estômago. 1. O órgão do estômago e sua saúde digestiva (1Tm 5.23).
THAYER.en: Designates the upper part of the digestive tract, specifically the stomach. 1. The stomach organ and its digestive health (1Tm 5.23).

DEFINITION: Military service or campaign. In the New Testament, it is used metaphorically to describe spiritual labor and the Christian combat against opposing forces.
SENSES: 1. Conflict or campaign in the context of spiritual warfare (2 Cor 10:4; 1 Tim 1:18).

THAYER.pt: Serviço ou campanha militar. No Novo Testamento, é usado metaforicamente para descrever o labor espiritual e o combate cristão contra forças opositoras. 1. Conflito ou campanha no contexto da guerra espiritual (2Co 10.4; 1Tm 1.18).
THAYER.en: Military service or campaign. In the New Testament, it is used metaphorically to describe spiritual labor and the Christian combat against opposing forces. 1. Conflict or campaign in the context of spiritual warfare (2 Cor 10:4; 1 Tim 1:18).

DEFINITION: A contingent or military force organized for combat, comprising armies or detachments of soldiers.
SENSES: 1. An army or armed military force (Matt 22:7; Rev 19:19).
2. A detachment or group of soldiers (Acts 23:10).

THAYER.pt: Um contingente ou força militar organizada para o combate, compreendendo exércitos ou destacamentos de soldados. 1. Um exército ou força militar armada (Mt 22:7; Ap 19:19). | 2. Um destacamento ou grupo de soldados (At 23:10).
THAYER.en: A contingent or military force organized for combat, comprising armies or detachments of soldiers. 1. An army or armed military force (Matt 22:7; Rev 19:19). | 2. A detachment or group of soldiers (Acts 23:10).

DEFINITION: To engage in military campaigns, serve as a soldier, or engage in conflicts and struggles of a physical or spiritual nature.
SENSES: 1. To serve as a soldier in military activity (1 Cor 9:7).
2. To engage in spiritual warfare or inner conflict (2 Cor 10:3; Jas 4:1).

THAYER.pt: Envolver-se em campanhas militares, servir como soldado ou engajar-se em conflitos e lutas de natureza física ou espiritual. 1. Servir como soldado em atividade militar (1Co 9.7). | 2. Engajar-se em guerra espiritual ou conflito interior (2Co 10.3; Tg 4.1).
THAYER.en: To engage in military campaigns, serve as a soldier, or engage in conflicts and struggles of a physical or spiritual nature. 1. To serve as a soldier in military activity (1 Cor 9:7). | 2. To engage in spiritual warfare or inner conflict (2 Cor 10:3; Jas 4:1).

DEFINITION: Designates a high-ranking civil authority in Greco-Roman cities or the officer in charge of the Jewish temple guard.
SENSES: 1. The magistrate or chief civil official of a Roman colony (Acts 16:20).
2. The captain of the temple guard in Jerusalem (Luke 22:4; Acts 4:1).

THAYER.pt: Designa uma autoridade civil de alto escalão em cidades greco-romanas ou o oficial encarregado da guarda do templo judaico. 1. O magistrado ou principal oficial civil de uma colônia romana (Ac 16.20). | 2. O capitão da guarda do templo em Jerusalém (Lc 22.4; Ac 4.1).
THAYER.en: Designates a high-ranking civil authority in Greco-Roman cities or the officer in charge of the Jewish temple guard. 1. The magistrate or chief civil official of a Roman colony (Acts 16:20). | 2. The captain of the temple guard in Jerusalem (Luke 22:4; Acts 4:1).

DEFINITION: A troop or army organized for war; by extension, multitudes of celestial beings or organized stellar bodies.
SENSES: 1. Host or multitude of angels in the heavens (Luke 2:13; Acts 7:42).

THAYER.pt: Uma tropa ou exército organizado para a guerra; por extensão, multidões de seres celestiais ou corpos estelares organizados. 1. Hoste ou multidão de anjos nos céus (Lc 2.13; At 7.42).
THAYER.en: A troop or army organized for war; by extension, multitudes of celestial beings or organized stellar bodies. 1. Host or multitude of angels in the heavens (Luke 2:13; Acts 7:42).

DEFINITION: Designates a member of common rank in an army, or figuratively, one who serves with faithfulness to a commander.
SENSES: 1. Soldier or military personnel in active service (Matt 8:9; Acts 10:7).
2. Figuratively, a faithful follower engaged in the cause of Christ (2 Tim 2:3).

THAYER.pt: Designa um membro de patente comum em um exército, ou figuradamente aquele que serve com fidelidade a um comandante. 1. Soldado ou militar em serviço ativo (Mt 8.9; At 10.7). | 2. Figuradamente, seguidor fiel empenhado na causa de Cristo (2Tm 2.3).
THAYER.en: Designates a member of common rank in an army, or figuratively, one who serves with faithfulness to a commander. 1. Soldier or military personnel in active service (Matt 8:9; Acts 10:7). | 2. Figuratively, a faithful follower engaged in the cause of Christ (2 Tim 2:3).

DEFINITION: Means to recruit, enlist, or gather soldiers for military service.
SENSES: 1. The act of enlisting someone as a soldier (2 Tim 2:4).

THAYER.pt: Significa recrutar, alistar ou reunir soldados para o serviço militar. 1. O ato de alistar alguém como soldado (2Tm 2.4).
THAYER.en: Means to recruit, enlist, or gather soldiers for military service. 1. The act of enlisting someone as a soldier (2 Tim 2:4).

DEFINITION: A title designating a senior military officer, specifically the commander of the camp or the Praetorian guard.
SENSES: 1. Commander or senior officer responsible for the imperial guard (Acts 28:16).

THAYER.pt: Título que designa um oficial militar superior, especificamente o comandante do acampamento ou da guarda pretoriana. 1. Comandante ou oficial superior responsável pela guarda imperial (At 28.16).
THAYER.en: A title designating a senior military officer, specifically the commander of the camp or the Praetorian guard. 1. Commander or senior officer responsible for the imperial guard (Acts 28:16).

DEFINITION: Originally a military camp, it also came to designate an organized body of troops or an army.
SENSES: 1. An encamped army or military forces surrounding a location (Luke 21:20).

THAYER.pt: Originalmente um acampamento militar, passa a designar também um corpo de tropas ou exército organizado. 1. Um exército acampado ou forças militares cercando um local (Lc 21.20).
THAYER.en: Originally a military camp, it also came to designate an organized body of troops or an army. 1. An encamped army or military forces surrounding a location (Luke 21:20).

DEFINITION: Originally meaning to torture, in the New Testament it denotes the intentional distortion of the meaning of statements or texts.
SENSES: 1. To distort or pervert the meaning of written statements (2 Pet 3:16).

THAYER.pt: Significa originalmente torturar, mas no Novo Testamento denota a distorção intencional do sentido de declarações ou textos. 1. Distorcer ou perverter o sentido de declarações escritas (2Pe 3.16).
THAYER.en: Originally meaning to torture, in the New Testament it denotes the intentional distortion of the meaning of statements or texts. 1. To distort or pervert the meaning of written statements (2 Pet 3:16).

DEFINITION: To change the physical position of someone or something by turning, or figuratively to convert and radically change moral and spiritual direction.
SENSES: 1. To change physical position by turning the body or face (Matt 5:39; 16:23).
2. In a figurative sense, to convert, to change spiritual direction (Acts 7:42).

THAYER.pt: Mudar a posição física de algo ou alguém virando-se, ou figuradamente converter-se e mudar radicalmente de direção moral e espiritual. 1. Mudar a posição física virando o corpo ou o rosto (Mt 5.39; 16.23). | 2. Em sentido figurado, converter-se, mudar de rumo espiritual (At 7.42).
THAYER.en: To change the physical position of someone or something by turning, or figuratively to convert and radically change moral and spiritual direction. 1. To change physical position by turning the body or face (Matt 5:39; 16:23). | 2. In a figurative sense, to convert, to change spiritual direction (Acts 7:42).

DEFINITION: To live in excessive luxury, seeking sensual pleasures and unrestrained carnal satisfaction.
SENSES: 1. To live in luxury and sensuality, giving oneself over to hedonism (Rev 18:7).

THAYER.pt: Viver em luxo excessivo, buscando prazeres sensuais e satisfação carnal desenfreada. 1. Viver em luxo e sensualidade, entregando-se ao hedonismo (Ap 18:7).
THAYER.en: To live in excessive luxury, seeking sensual pleasures and unrestrained carnal satisfaction. 1. To live in luxury and sensuality, giving oneself over to hedonism (Rev 18:7).

DEFINITION: Designates an excessively luxurious, insolent, sensual, and dissolute lifestyle.
SENSES: 1. Arrogant luxury and dissolute living linked to the worldly system (Rev 18:3).

THAYER.pt: Designa um estilo de vida excessivamente luxuoso, insolente, sensual e devasso. 1. Luxúria arrogante e vida dissoluta ligada ao sistema mundano (Ap 18.3).
THAYER.en: Designates an excessively luxurious, insolent, sensual, and dissolute lifestyle. 1. Arrogant luxury and dissolute living linked to the worldly system (Rev 18:3).

DEFINITION: A diminutive of bird, specifically used to designate small birds such as sparrows, frequently traded for a trivial value for sacrifices or consumption.
SENSES: 1. Small bird or sparrow, a symbol of God's providential care over human life (Matt 10:29; Luke 12:6).

THAYER.pt: Diminutivo de pássaro, especificamente usado para designar aves pequenas, como pardais, frequentemente comercializados por ínfimo valor para sacrifícios ou consumo. 1. Pequena ave ou pardal, símbolo do cuidado providencial de Deus sobre a vida humana (Mt 10.29; Lc 12.6).
THAYER.en: A diminutive of bird, specifically used to designate small birds such as sparrows, frequently traded for a trivial value for sacrifices or consumption. 1. Small bird or sparrow, a symbol of God's providential care over human life (Matt 10:29; Luke 12:6).

DEFINITION: Meaning to spread or strew something over a surface, such as beds or garments, preparing it for use or reception.
SENSES: 1. To spread garments or branches on the ground or road (Matt 21:8; Mark 11:8).
2. To prepare or make a bed (Acts 9:34).

THAYER.pt: Significa estender ou espalhar algo sobre uma superfície, como camas ou vestes, preparando-a para uso ou recepção. 1. Estender roupas ou ramos no chão ou caminho (Mt 21:8; Mc 11:8). | 2. Preparar ou forrar uma cama (At 9:34).
THAYER.en: Meaning to spread or strew something over a surface, such as beds or garments, preparing it for use or reception. 1. To spread garments or branches on the ground or road (Matt 21:8; Mark 11:8). | 2. To prepare or make a bed (Acts 9:34).

DEFINITION: Describes someone or something that is worthy of hatred, despicable, or detestable.
SENSES: 1. Deserving to be hated or rejected because of wickedness (Titus 3:3).

THAYER.pt: Descreve algo ou alguém que é digno de ódio, desprezível ou detestável. 1. Que merece ser odiado ou rejeitado por sua maldade (Tt 3.3).
THAYER.en: Describes someone or something that is worthy of hatred, despicable, or detestable. 1. Deserving to be hated or rejected because of wickedness (Titus 3:3).

DEFINITION: To be in a state of deep dismay or to present a gloomy and heavy appearance, whether in one's countenance or the sky.
SENSES: 1. To be shocked or deeply saddened in the face of a situation (Mark 10:22);
