2. To take on a gloomy or cloudy appearance, referring to the aspect of the sky (Matt 16:3).

THAYER.pt: Estar em estado de profunda consternação ou apresentar uma aparência sombria e carregada, seja no semblante ou no céu. 1. Ficar chocado ou profundamente entristecido diante de uma situação (Mc 10:22); | 2. Ficar com aparência sombria ou nublada, referindo-se ao aspecto do céu (Mt 16:3).
THAYER.en: To be in a state of deep dismay or to present a gloomy and heavy appearance, whether in one's countenance or the sky. 1. To be shocked or deeply saddened in the face of a situation (Mark 10:22); | 2. To take on a gloomy or cloudy appearance, referring to the aspect of the sky (Matt 16:3).

DEFINITION: Designates a cylindrical vertical support structure in buildings, used metaphorically to describe leaders or communities that sustain the truth and stability of the church.
SENSES: 1. An architectural support column or pillar (Rev 10:1);
2. Metaphorically, a person or community of recognized leadership and spiritual firmness (Gal 2:9; 1 Tim 3:15).

THAYER.pt: Designa uma estrutura vertical cilíndrica de sustentação em construções, sendo empregado metaforicamente para descrever líderes ou comunidades que sustentam a verdade e a estabilidade da igreja. 1. Uma coluna ou pilar arquitetônico de suporte (Ap 10.1); | 2. Metaphoricamente, uma pessoa ou comunidade de reconhecida liderança e firmeza espiritual (Gl 2.9; 1Tm 3.15).
THAYER.en: Designates a cylindrical vertical support structure in buildings, used metaphorically to describe leaders or communities that sustain the truth and stability of the church. 1. An architectural support column or pillar (Rev 10:1); | 2. Metaphorically, a person or community of recognized leadership and spiritual firmness (Gal 2:9; 1 Tim 3:15).

DEFINITION: Relating to the followers of the philosophical school founded by Zeno, who emphasized self-sufficiency and universal reason.
SENSES: 1. A philosopher belonging to the Stoic school (Acts 17:18).

THAYER.pt: Relativo aos seguidores da escola filosófica fundada por Zenão, que enfatizavam a autossuficiência e a razão universal. 1. Filósofo pertencente à escola estoica (At 17.18).
THAYER.en: Relating to the followers of the philosophical school founded by Zeno, who emphasized self-sufficiency and universal reason. 1. A philosopher belonging to the Stoic school (Acts 17:18).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Genitive: σοῦ/σου, Dative: σοί/σοι, Accusative: σέ/σε; Plural: ὑμεῖς
DEFINITION: Second-person singular personal pronoun (and plural in the declined form). The use of the nominative form expresses particular emphasis on the interlocutor in narrative or theological discourse.
SENSES: 1. Direct reference to the interlocutor, frequently emphatic in the nominative (Matt 16:16; John 1:19).
2. Use in rhetorical or antithetical contrast (Matt 6:6; Jas 2:18).
3. Plural (ὑμεῖς) indicating the community or group addressed (Matt 5:13; 1 Pet 2:9).

THAYER.pt: Pronome pessoal de segunda pessoa singular (e plural na forma declinada). O uso da forma nominativa expressa ênfase particular do interlocutor na narrativa ou no discurso teológico. 1. Referência direta ao interlocutor, frequentemente enfática no nominativo (Mt 16.16; Jo 1.19). | 2. Uso em contraste retórico ou antitético (Mt 6.6; Tg 2.18). | 3. Plural (ὑμεῖς) indicando a comunidade ou grupo endereçado (Mt 5.13; 1Pe 2.9).
THAYER.en: Second-person singular personal pronoun (and plural in the declined form). The use of the nominative form expresses particular emphasis on the interlocutor in narrative or theological discourse. 1. Direct reference to the interlocutor, frequently emphatic in the nominative (Matt 16:16; John 1:19). | 2. Use in rhetorical or antithetical contrast (Matt 6:6; Jas 2:18). | 3. Plural (ὑμεῖς) indicating the community or group addressed (Matt 5:13; 1 Pet 2:9).

DEFINITION: The group of people united by blood ties or extended kinship, referring both to the family relationship system and to relatives themselves.
SENSES: 1. A group of relatives or members of the extended family (Luke 1:61; Acts 7:3, 14).

THAYER.pt: O grupo de pessoas unidas por laços de sangue ou parentesco estendido, referindo-se tanto ao sistema de relação familiar quanto aos próprios parentes. 1. Conjunto de parentes ou membros da família extensa (Lc 1.61; At 7.3, 14).
THAYER.en: The group of people united by blood ties or extended kinship, referring both to the family relationship system and to relatives themselves. 1. A group of relatives or members of the extended family (Luke 1:61; Acts 7:3, 14).

DEFINITION: Belonging to the same extended family, clan, or bloodline.
SENSES: 1. A member of the same family or a close relative (Luke 1:36; John 18:26).

THAYER.pt: Que pertence à mesma família estendida, clã ou linhagem sanguínea. 1. Membro da mesma família ou parente próximo (Lc 1.36; Jo 18.26).
THAYER.en: Belonging to the same extended family, clan, or bloodline. 1. A member of the same family or a close relative (Luke 1:36; John 18:26).

DEFINITION: Indicates permission or concession granted with understanding, equivalent to an indulgence or favorable opinion.
SENSES: 1. A concession or permission given rather than a rigid imposition (1 Cor 7:6).

THAYER.pt: Indica permissão ou concessão concedida com compreensão, equivalendo a uma indulgência ou parecer favorável. 1. Concessão ou permissão dada em detrimento de uma imposição rígida (1Co 7.6).
THAYER.en: Indicates permission or concession granted with understanding, equivalent to an indulgence or favorable opinion. 1. A concession or permission given rather than a rigid imposition (1 Cor 7:6).

DEFINITION: To sit alongside other people or share the same place while sitting.
SENSES: 1. To sit down next to someone in a given environment (Mark 14:54; Acts 26:30).

THAYER.pt: Assentar-se junto a outras pessoas ou compartilhar do mesmo lugar ao sentar-se. 1. Sentar-se junto a alguém em um determinado ambiente (Mc 14:54; At 26:30).
THAYER.en: To sit alongside other people or share the same place while sitting. 1. To sit down next to someone in a given environment (Mark 14:54; Acts 26:30).

DEFINITION: To cause someone to sit together with others, or to sit in the company of someone.
SENSES: 1. To cause to sit together, in a figurative or exalted sense (Eph 2:6);
2. To sit together with others (Luke 22:55).

THAYER.pt: Fazer alguém assentar-se junto com outros, ou sentar-se em companhia de alguém. 1. Fazer assentar junto, em sentido figurado ou exaltado (Ef 2:6); | 2. Sentar-se junto com outros (Lc 22:55).
THAYER.en: To cause someone to sit together with others, or to sit in the company of someone. 1. To cause to sit together, in a figurative or exalted sense (Eph 2:6); | 2. To sit together with others (Luke 22:55).

DEFINITION: To share in the same afflictions and endure hardships in solidarity with another.
SENSES: 1. To suffer together with someone for the sake of the gospel (2 Tim 1:8; 2:3).

THAYER.pt: Participar das mesmas aflições e suportar dificuldades em solidariedade a outrem. 1. Sofrer juntamente com alguém por causa do evangelho (2Tm 1:8; 2:3).
THAYER.en: To share in the same afflictions and endure hardships in solidarity with another. 1. To suffer together with someone for the sake of the gospel (2 Tim 1:8; 2:3).

DEFINITION: To endure afflictions or mistreatment in solidarity with other people.
SENSES: 1. To voluntarily share in mistreatment and sufferings with the people of God (Heb 11:25).

THAYER.pt: Significa suportar aflições ou maus-tratos em solidariedade a outras pessoas. 1. Compartilhar voluntariamente de maus-tratos e sofrimentos com o povo de Deus (Hb 11.25).
THAYER.en: To endure afflictions or mistreatment in solidarity with other people. 1. To voluntarily share in mistreatment and sufferings with the people of God (Heb 11:25).

DEFINITION: To summon or call people to gather in one place for a specific purpose.
SENSES: 1. To summon or gather people into an assembly or group (Mk 15:16; Lk 9:1; Acts 5:21).

THAYER.pt: Convocar ou chamar pessoas para se reunirem em um mesmo lugar com um propósito específico. 1. Convocar ou reunir pessoas em assembleia ou grupo (Mc 15:16; Lk 9:1; At 5:21).
THAYER.en: To summon or call people to gather in one place for a specific purpose. 1. To summon or gather people into an assembly or group (Mk 15:16; Lk 9:1; Acts 5:21).

DEFINITION: To keep something covered so that it is not known, concealing it entirely.
SENSES: 1. To hide or cover something so that it remains a secret (Lk 12:2).

THAYER.pt: Significa manter algo encoberto para que não seja conhecido, ocultando-o totalmente. 1. Ocultar ou encobrir algo para que permaneça em segredo (Lc 12.2).
THAYER.en: To keep something covered so that it is not known, concealing it entirely. 1. To hide or cover something so that it remains a secret (Lk 12:2).

DEFINITION: To bend or bow together, which may express fatigue or the weight of a great oppression.
SENSES: 1. Figuratively, to bend or bow under the weight of great difficulty or judgment (Rom 11:10).

THAYER.pt: Significa curvar ou dobrar conjuntamente, podendo expressar a fadiga ou o peso de uma grande opressão. 1. Figurativamente, curvar ou dobrar sob o peso de grande dificuldade ou juízo (Rm 11.10).
THAYER.en: To bend or bow together, which may express fatigue or the weight of a great oppression. 1. Figuratively, to bend or bow under the weight of great difficulty or judgment (Rom 11:10).

DEFINITION: To accompany someone while descending from a higher place to a lower one.
SENSES: 1. To accompany someone on a journey of descent (Acts 25:5).

THAYER.pt: Significa acompanhar alguém ao descer de um lugar mais alto para um mais baixo. 1. Acompanhar alguém em uma viagem de descida (At 25.5).
THAYER.en: To accompany someone while descending from a higher place to a lower one. 1. To accompany someone on a journey of descent (Acts 25:5).

DEFINITION: Designates the harmony or mutual agreement between distinct parties.
SENSES: 1. Agreement or mutual harmony between opposing realities (2 Cor 6:16).

THAYER.pt: Designa a harmonia ou o acordo mútuo entre partes distintas. 1. Acordo ou harmonia mútua entre realidades opostas (2Co 6.16).
THAYER.en: Designates the harmony or mutual agreement between distinct parties. 1. Agreement or mutual harmony between opposing realities (2 Cor 6:16).

DEFINITION: To be in agreement with a proposal or decision, giving consent to it.
SENSES: 1. To give consent or agree with a decision or plan (Lk 23:51).

THAYER.pt: Significa estar de acordo com uma proposta ou decisão, dando consentimento a ela. 1. Dar consentimento ou concordar com uma decisão ou plano (Lc 23.51).
THAYER.en: To be in agreement with a proposal or decision, giving consent to it. 1. To give consent or agree with a decision or plan (Lk 23:51).

SENSES: 1. To be counted and included in an official group of people (Acts 1:26).
USAGE: count with, include in the number

THAYER.en: To compute or include someone in the number of a group by vote or joint decision. 1. To be counted and included in an official group of people (Acts 1:26).

DEFINITION: To combine different elements to form a harmonious unit, or to mix substances.
SENSES: 1. To mix or unite parts to form a cohesive whole (1 Cor 12:24);
2. To blend the heard word with personal faith (Heb 4:2).

THAYER.pt: Combinar diferentes elementos para formar uma unidade harmoniosa, ou misturar substâncias. 1. Misturar ou unir partes para formar um todo coeso (1Co 12:24); | 2. Mesclar a palavra ouvida com a fé pessoal (Hb 4:2).
THAYER.en: To combine different elements to form a harmonious unit, or to mix substances. 1. To mix or unite parts to form a cohesive whole (1 Cor 12:24); | 2. To blend the heard word with personal faith (Heb 4:2).

DEFINITION: To agitate strongly or incite restlessness and revolt in a group.
SENSES: 1. To agitate or incite tumult and opposition against someone (Acts 6:12).

THAYER.pt: Significa agitar fortemente ou incitar inquietação e revolta em um grupo. 1. Agitar ou incitar tumulto e oposição contra alguém (At 6.12).
THAYER.en: To agitate strongly or incite restlessness and revolt in a group. 1. To agitate or incite tumult and opposition against someone (Acts 6:12).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: συγκλείσω; Aor: συνέκλεισα; Perf: συγκέκλικα
DEFINITION: To surround on all sides, retain within restricted limits, or deliver someone to a condition from which they cannot escape, whether physically or spiritually.
SENSES: 1. To surround or catch in large quantity, like fish in a net (Lk 5:6);
2. To confine under the dominion of sin or disobedience under divine sovereignty (Rom 11:32; Gal 3:22).

THAYER.pt: Significa cercar por todos os lados, reter em limites restritos ou entregar alguém a uma condição da qual não pode escapar, seja no sentido físico ou espiritual. 1. Cercar ou apanhar em grande quantidade, como peixes em uma rede (Lc 5.6); | 2. Confinar sob o domínio do pecado ou da desobediência sob a soberania divina (Rm 11.32; Gl 3.22).
THAYER.en: To surround on all sides, retain within restricted limits, or deliver someone to a condition from which they cannot escape, whether physically or spiritually. 1. To surround or catch in large quantity, like fish in a net (Lk 5:6); | 2. To confine under the dominion of sin or disobedience under divine sovereignty (Rom 11:32; Gal 3:22).

DEFINITION: Indicates someone who participates jointly in an inheritance with another person, enjoying the same privileges and hereditary rights.

THAYER.en: Indicates someone who participates jointly in an inheritance with another person, enjoying the same privileges and hereditary rights. 1. Co-heir of divine promises and eternal life in Christ (Rom 8:17; Eph 3:6).

THAYER.pt: Estar associado a alguém em alguma atividade ou empreendimento conjunto, implicando comunhão de interesses ou participação mútua. 1. Tomar parte ativa em obras ou práticas infrutuosas ou solidárias (Ef 5.11; Fp 4.14).
THAYER.en: To be associated with someone in some joint activity or enterprise, implying communion of interests or mutual participation. 1. To take active part in fruitless or supportive works or practices (Eph 5:11; Phil 4:14).

THAYER.pt: Aquele que compartilha com outros em uma empresa, privilégio, sofrimento ou empreendimento comum, denotando profunda comunhão e cooperação. 1. Participante ou associado em bênçãos espirituais, tribulações ou ministério (Rm 11.17; 1Co 9.23).
THAYER.en: One who shares with others in a business, privilege, suffering, or common enterprise, denoting deep communion and cooperation. 1. Participant or associate in spiritual blessings, tribulations, or ministry (Rom 11:17; 1 Cor 9:23).

DEFINITION: Originally means to gather the harvest, but in a funeral context, it denotes performing the preparations for burial.
SENSES: 1. To perform the solemn acts of preparation and burial of a body (Acts 8:2).

2. To evaluate or judge oneself by comparing with others (2 Cor 10:12).

THAYER.pt: Ajustar, juntar ideias ou coisas para formar um todo compreensível, ou estabelecer uma comparação para avaliar semelhanças e diferenças. 1. Explicar ou interpretar verdades espirituais combinando conceitos espirituais com palavras espirituais (1Co 2.13). | 2. Avaliar ou julgar a si mesmo mediante a comparação com outros (2Co 10.12).
THAYER.en: To adjust, join ideas or things to form an understandable whole, or to establish a comparison to evaluate similarities and differences. 1. To explain or interpret spiritual truths by combining spiritual concepts with spiritual words (1 Cor 2:13). | 2. To evaluate or judge oneself by comparing with others (2 Cor 10:12).

DEFINITION: Describes the condition of being physically stooped or with the spine bent forward.
SENSES: 1. To be bent forward and unable to straighten up (Lk 13:11).

DEFINITION: Refers to an unexpected conjunction of circumstances or fortuitous events.

THAYER.en: Refers to an unexpected conjunction of circumstances or fortuitous events. 1. An occurrence by coincidence or fortuitous circumstance (Lk 10:31).

THAYER.pt: Experimentar alegria ou regozijo em comunhão com outra pessoa, compartilhando de sua felicidade ou boa fortuna. 1. Regozixar-se junto com outros, partilhando da mesma alegria (Lc 1.58; 1Co 12.26). | 2. Congratular alguém por um evento propício (1Co 13.6).
THAYER.en: To experience joy or rejoicing in communion with another person, sharing in their happiness or good fortune. 1. To rejoice together with others, sharing the same joy (Lk 1:58; 1 Cor 12:26). | 2. To congratulate someone for a favorable event (1 Cor 13:6).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: συγχεῶ, Aor: συνέχεα, Pass: συνεχύθην
DEFINITION: To pour together or, figuratively, to cause deep confusion, consternation, or uproar in a crowd.

THAYER.en: To pour together or, figuratively, to cause deep confusion, consternation, or uproar in a crowd. 1. To cause tumult, confusion, and uproar in a group (Acts 21:27, 31).

DEFINITION: Describes the action of maintaining social relations or interacting amicably with other people, often implying proximity or cultural ties.

THAYER.en: Describes the action of maintaining social relations or interacting amicably with other people, often implying proximity or cultural ties. 1. To have relations or associate with someone in a friendly or habitual way (Jn 4:9).

THAYER.en: Indicates a state of great disorder, collective agitation, or public confusion, frequently associated with revolts or popular uprisings. 1. Tumultuous agitation and disorder generated by a crowd (Acts 19:29).

SENSES: 1. To live together with Christ in resurrection and eternal communion (Rom 6:8; 2 Cor 7:3; 2 Tim 2:11).

THAYER.en: Refers to a debate or exchange of arguments in which different points of view are defended with persistence, sometimes in a conflictual manner. 1. Intense discussion or heated debate regarding doctrines or points of view (Acts 28:29).

DEFINITION: Designates a person skilled or inclined toward argumentation and intellectual debate, typical of philosophical or rhetorical circles.

THAYER.en: Designates a person skilled or inclined toward argumentation and intellectual debate, typical of philosophical or rhetorical circles. 1. A debater or disputer involved in intellectual or rhetorical discussions (1 Cor 1:20).

Bond that restricts or imprisons, chains or iniquity (Acts 8:23).

DEFINITION: To unite by means of bonds or to share the same captivity and restrictions with someone.
SENSES: 1. To share in prisons or chains with others, showing solidarity in suffering (Heb 13:3).

THAYER.pt: Significa unir por meio de amarras ou partilhar o mesmo cativeiro e restrições com alguém. 1. Compartilhar de prisões ou correntes com outros, solidarizando-se no sofrimento (Hb 13.3).
THAYER.en: To unite by means of bonds or to share the same captivity and restrictions with someone. 1. To share in prisons or chains with others, showing solidarity in suffering (Heb 13:3).

DEFINITION: To participate jointly in the glory, honor, and exaltation conferred by God.

THAYER.en: To participate jointly in the glory, honor, and exaltation conferred by God. 1. To be glorified together with Christ, sharing in His heavenly glory (Rom 8:17).

THAYER.en: Someone who shares with others the condition of being a servant or slave under the authority of the same master. 1. A servant or slave who serves the same master alongside others (Mt 24:49). | 2. A companion in faith and service to God, indicating equality before the Lord (Col 1:7; Rev 19:10).

DEFINITION: Describes the action of several people running rapidly to the same place, forming a gathering or a tumult.
SENSES: 1. A rapid influx of people forming a crowd or a riot (Acts 21:30).

THAYER.en: Describes the action of several people running rapidly to the same place, forming a gathering or a tumult. 1. A rapid influx of people forming a crowd or a riot (Acts 21:30).

THAYER.pt: Despertar ou levantar conjuntamente da morte ou de um estado de inatividade espiritual para uma nova vida. 1. Participar espiritualmente da ressurreição de Cristo, sendo ressuscitado para uma nova vida com Ele (Ef 2.6; Cl 2.12; 3.1).
THAYER.en: To awaken or lift up together from death or from a state of spiritual inactivity to a new life. 1. To participate spiritually in the resurrection of Christ, being raised to a new life with Him (Eph 2:6; Col 2:12; 3:1).

THAYER.en: Refers to a deliberative assembly or council of judges, with special emphasis on the Sanhedrin, the supreme Jewish court in Jerusalem with religious and civil jurisdiction. 1. A local council of elders or a court of judgment (Mt 10:17; Mk 13:9). | 2. The supreme Sanhedrin in Jerusalem (Mt 26:59; Jn 11:47).

Consciência ou percepção íntima de fatos e estados morais (1Co 8.7; Hb 10.2). | 2. A faculdade interna que julga o comportamento segundo padrões morais, acusando ou desculpando (At 23.1; Hb 10.22).
THAYER.en: The innate moral faculty of the human being that evaluates one's own thoughts and actions, distinguishing good from evil. 1. Conscience or intimate perception of facts and moral states (1 Cor 8:7; Heb 10:2). | 2. The internal faculty that judges behavior according to moral standards, accusing or excusing (Acts 23:1; Heb 10:22).

THAYER.en: To share internal knowledge about a fact, especially to be conscious of guilt or innocence before one's own conscience. 1. To be aware of complicity or to share secret information (Acts 5:2). | 2. To be conscious of something in relation to oneself, to have a clear or burdened conscience (1 Cor 4:4).

THAYER.en: To be in the company of someone or to dwell in the same space. 1. To be present with someone, to maintain company (Lk 9:18; Acts 22:11).

THAYER.en: To add one's own testimony to that of others to confirm the veracity of something. 1. To assist with one's own testimony, confirming together (Heb 2:4).

USAGE: to seal, to mark, to confirm

THAYER.pt: Aplicar um selo para garantir segurança, autenticidade, fechar firmemente ou marcar propriedade e identidade. 1. Fechar e garantir a segurança de algo com um selo oficial (Mt 27.66; Ap 20.3). | 2. Marcar com um selo para indicar propriedade, proteção divina ou autenticidade espiritual (Ef 1.3; Ap 7.3).
THAYER.en: To apply a seal to ensure security, authenticity, to close firmly, or to mark ownership and identity. 1. To close and ensure the security of something with an official seal (Matt 27:66; Rev 20:3). | 2. To mark with a seal to indicate ownership, divine protection, or spiritual authenticity (Eph 1:13; Rev 7:3).

DEFINITION: An instrument or signet used to mark documents or objects with wax, denoting ownership, authenticity, security, or closure.
SENSES: 1. The physical seal or signet used to close and authenticate (Rev 5:2; 7:2).
2. The mark or impression left by the seal, symbolizing a guarantee or protection (2 Tim 2:19).
3. Figurative: spiritual authentication or confirmation of a work or ministry (Rom 4:11; 1 Cor 9:2).

THAYER.pt: Instrumento ou sinete usado para marcar documentos ou objetos com cera, denotando propriedade, autenticidade, segurança ou fechamento. 1. O selo ou sinete físico usado para fechar e autenticar (Ap 5.2; 7.2). | 2. A marca ou impressão deixada pelo selo, simbolizando garantia ou proteção (2Tm 2.19). | 3. Figurado: autenticação ou confirmação espiritual de uma obra ou ministério (Rm 4.11; 1Co 9.2).
THAYER.en: An instrument or signet used to mark documents or objects with wax, denoting ownership, authenticity, security, or closure. 1. The physical seal or signet used to close and authenticate (Rev 5:2; 7:2). | 2. The mark or impression left by the seal, symbolizing a guarantee or protection (2 Tim 2:19). | 3. Figurative: spiritual authentication or confirmation of a work or ministry (Rom 4:11; 1 Cor 9:2).

DEFINITION: Designates the anatomical joint that connects the foot to the leg, responsible for support and mobility.
SENSES: 1. The human ankle joint (Acts 3:7).

THAYER.pt: Designa a articulação anatômica que conecta o pé à perna, responsável pela sustentação e mobilidade. 1. A articulação do tornozelo humano (At 3.7).
THAYER.en: Designates the anatomical joint that connects the foot to the leg, responsible for support and mobility. 1. The human ankle joint (Acts 3:7).

DEFINITION: Indicates a degree that falls slightly short of fully reaching a specific point of extent or totality.
SENSES: 1. Almost the entirety or nearly reaching a certain state (Acts 13:44; 19:26; Heb 9:22).

THAYER.pt: Indica um grau que fica ligeiramente aquém de alcançar totalmente um ponto específico de extensão ou totalidade. 1. Quase a totalidade ou por pouco não alcança determinado estado (At 13.44; 19.26; Hb 9.22).
THAYER.en: Indicates a degree that falls slightly short of fully reaching a specific point of extent or totality. 1. Almost the entirety or nearly reaching a certain state (Acts 13:44; 19:26; Heb 9:22).

DEFINITION: Refers to the external form, the visible aspect, or the manner in which something or someone presents themselves.
SENSES: 1. Exterior appearance or visible shape (Phil 2:7); 2. The present form or condition of the world (1 Cor 7:31).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se à forma externa, ao aspecto visível ou à maneira como algo ou alguém se apresenta. 1. Aparência exterior ou formato visível (Fp 2.7); 2. A forma ou condição presente do mundo (1Co 7.31).
THAYER.en: Refers to the external form, the visible aspect, or the manner in which something or someone presents themselves. 1. Exterior appearance or visible shape (Phil 2:7); 2. The present form or condition of the world (1 Cor 7:31).

SHORT_GLOSS: to split, to tear, to divide
DEFINITION: To separate an object violently into parts, tearing it, or to cause division and contention among people.
SENSES: 1. To physically tear or split an object (Matt 27:51; Luke 5:36).
2. To cause division or schism in a group (Acts 14:4).
USAGE: to split, to tear, to divide

THAYER.pt: Separar violentamente um objeto em partes, rasgando-o, ou causar divisão e contenda entre pessoas. 1. Rasgar ou fender fisicamente um objeto (Mt 27.51; Lc 5.36). | 2. Causar divisão ou cisão em um grupo (At 14.4).
THAYER.en: To separate an object violently into parts, tearing it, or to cause division and contention among people. 1. To physically tear or split an object (Matt 27:51; Luke 5:36). | 2. To cause division or schism in a group (Acts 14:4).

DEFINITION: Originally denotes a split or tear in a physical object, coming to describe in the New Testament the division, schism, or dissension among people in the community of faith.
SENSES: 1. A tear or split in a material object (Matt 9:16).
2. Ideological and relational division or schism among people (1 Cor 1:10; John 7:43).

THAYER.pt: Denota originalmente uma fenda ou rasgão em um objeto físico, passando a descrever no Novo Testamento a divisão, cisma ou dissensão entre pessoas na comunidade de fé. 1. Rasgão ou fenda em um objeto material (Mt 9.16). | 2. Divisão ou cisma ideológico e relacional entre pessoas (1Co 1.10; Jo 7.43).
THAYER.en: Originally denotes a split or tear in a physical object, coming to describe in the New Testament the division, schism, or dissension among people in the community of faith. 1. A tear or split in a material object (Matt 9:16). | 2. Ideological and relational division or schism among people (1 Cor 1:10; John 7:43).

DEFINITION: Designates a rope or cable made of vegetable fibers used for tying, binding, or pulling.
SENSES: 1. Rope or braided cable (Acts 27:32).

THAYER.pt: Designa uma corda ou cabo feito de fibras vegetais utilizado para amarrar, prender ou puxar. 1. Corda ou cabo trançado (At 27.32).
THAYER.en: Designates a rope or cable made of vegetable fibers used for tying, binding, or pulling. 1. Rope or braided cable (Acts 27:32).

SHORT_GLOSS: to devote oneself, to be at leisure
DEFINITION: To have free time to devote oneself entirely to an activity or occupation, or to remain unoccupied and empty.
SENSES: 1. To devote time and exclusive attention to an activity or purpose (1 Cor 7:5).
2. To be unoccupied or empty, without a resident or occupant (Matt 12:44).
USAGE: to devote oneself, to be at leisure

THAYER.pt: Ter tempo livre para dedicar-se inteiramente a uma atividade ou ocupação, ou permanecer desocupado e vazio. 1. Devotar tempo e atenção exclusiva a uma atividade ou propósito (1Co 7.5). | 2. Estar desocupado ou vazio, sem morador ou ocupante (Mt 12.44).
THAYER.en: To have free time to devote oneself entirely to an activity or occupation, or to remain unoccupied and empty. 1. To devote time and exclusive attention to an activity or purpose (1 Cor 7:5). | 2. To be unoccupied or empty, without a resident or occupant (Matt 12:44).

DEFINITION: Originally meant free time or leisure, later designating the place where lectures, debates, and teaching occurred.
SENSES: 1. Auditorium or lecture hall where teachings were imparted (Acts 19:9).

THAYER.pt: Originalmente significava tempo livre ou de lazer, passando a designar o local onde ocorriam palestras, debates e ensino. 1. Auditório ou sala de aula onde se ministravam ensinamentos (At 19.9).
THAYER.en: Originally meant free time or leisure, later designating the place where lectures, debates, and teaching occurred. 1. Auditorium or lecture hall where teachings were imparted (Acts 19:9).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Future: σώσω, Aorist: ἔσωσα, Perfect: σέσωκα, Aorist Passive: ἐσώθην
DEFINITION: To deliver from mortal danger, preserving physical life, or to free from the judgment and condemnation of sin by granting eternal life. It encompasses both the rescue from temporal afflictions and illnesses and definitive spiritual redemption.
SENSES: 1. To save from divine condemnation, sin, and eternal death (Rom 5:9; Eph 2:8).
2. To preserve or rescue from imminent danger, ruin, or shipwreck (Matt 8:25; 14:30).
3. To heal from physical diseases or deliver from demonic afflictions (Matt 9:22; Mark 5:34).

THAYER.pt: Livrar de perigo mortal, preservando a vida física, ou libertar do julgamento e da condenação do pecado concedendo a vida eterna. Abrange tanto o resgate de aflições e enfermidades temporais quanto a redenção espiritual definitiva. 1. Salvar da condenação divina, do pecado e da morte eterna (Rm 5.9; Ef 2.8). | 2. Preservar ou resgatar de perigo iminente, ruína ou naufrágio (Mt 8.25; 14.30). | 3. Curar de doenças físicas ou libertar de aflições demoníacas (Mt 9.22; Mc 5.34).
THAYER.en: To deliver from mortal danger, preserving physical life, or to free from the judgment and condemnation of sin by granting eternal life. It encompasses both the rescue from temporal afflictions and illnesses and definitive spiritual redemption. 1. To save from divine condemnation, sin, and eternal death (Rom 5:9; Eph 2:8). | 2. To preserve or rescue from imminent danger, ruin, or shipwreck (Matt 8:25; 14:30). | 3. To heal from physical diseases or deliver from demonic afflictions (Matt 9:22; Mark 5:34).

DEFINITION: Denotes the integral physical organism of a human or animal, living or dead. Theologically, it assumes foundational importance in the doctrine of the incarnation, Christ's vicarious sacrifice, the resurrection, and the metaphor of the Church as the organic Body of Christ.
SENSES: 1. The living physical body of a person or animal (Matt 6:22; Rom 12:1).
2. The dead body, corpse (Matt 27:58; Luke 24:3).
3. Ecclesiological metaphor: the unified Church as the mystical Body of Christ (1 Cor 12:27; Eph 1:23).
4. The concrete substance and reality of things in contrast to typological shadows (Col 2:17).

THAYER.pt: Denota o organismo físico integral do ser humano ou animal, vivo ou morto. Teologicamente, assume importância basilar na doutrina da encarnação, no sacrifício vicário de Cristo, na ressurreição e na metáfora da Igreja como Corpo orgânico de Cristo. 1. O corpo físico vivo de uma pessoa ou animal (Mt 6.22; Rm 12.1). | 2. O corpo morto, cadáver (Mt 27.58; Lc 24.3). | 3. Metáfora eclesiológica: a Igreja unificada como o Corpo místico de Cristo (1Co 12.27; Ef 1.23). | 4. A substância concreta e realidade das coisas em contraste com sombras tipológicas (Cl 2.17).
THAYER.en: Denotes the integral physical organism of a human or animal, living or dead. Theologically, it assumes foundational importance in the doctrine of the incarnation, Christ's vicarious sacrifice, the resurrection, and the metaphor of the Church as the organic Body of Christ. 1. The living physical body of a person or animal (Matt 6:22; Rom 12:1). | 2. The dead body, corpse (Matt 27:58; Luke 24:3). | 3. Ecclesiological metaphor: the unified Church as the mystical Body of Christ (1 Cor 12:27; Eph 1:23). | 4. The concrete substance and reality of things in contrast to typological shadows (Col 2:17).

DEFINITION: Belonging or relating to the physical and material body, as opposed to that which is purely spiritual.
SENSES: 1. Relating to the physical body or bodily manifestation (Luke 3:22; 1 Tim 4:8).

THAYER.pt: Pertençente ou relativo ao corpo físico e material, em oposição ao que é puramente espiritual. 1. Relativo ao corpo físico ou à manifestação corpórea (Lc 3.22; 1Tm 4.8).
THAYER.en: Belonging or relating to the physical and material body, as opposed to that which is purely spiritual. 1. Relating to the physical body or bodily manifestation (Luke 3:22; 1 Tim 4:8).

DEFINITION: Pertaining to the physical or material reality of the body, in contrast to that which is merely abstract or spiritual.
SENSES: 1. In a bodily or physical manner, referring to the full indwelling of the deity in Christ (Col 2:9).

THAYER.pt: Pertinente à realidade física ou material do corpo, em contraste com o que é meramente abstrato ou espiritual. 1. De maneira corpórea ou física, referindo-se à habitação plena da divindade em Cristo (Cl 2.9).
THAYER.en: Pertaining to the physical or material reality of the body, in contrast to that which is merely abstract or spiritual. 1. In a bodily or physical manner, referring to the full indwelling of the deity in Christ (Col 2:9).

DEFINITION: Male proper name of a Christian from Berea, son of Pyrrhus, who accompanied the apostle Paul on his journey.
SENSES: 1. Berean Christian and travel companion of Paul (Acts 20:4).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio masculino de um cristão de Beréia, filho de Pirro, que acompanhou o apóstolo Paulo em sua viagem. 1. Cristão bereano companheiro de viagem de Paulo (At 20.4).
THAYER.en: Male proper name of a Christian from Berea, son of Pyrrhus, who accompanied the apostle Paul on his journey. 1. Berean Christian and travel companion of Paul (Acts 20:4).

DEFINITION: Means to accumulate by placing one thing upon another, heaping up or overloading.
SENSES: 1. To heap burning coals upon someone's head as a metaphor for generosity (Rom 12:20); 2. To accumulate sins or overload people (2 Tim 3:6).

THAYER.pt: Significa acumular colocando uma coisa sobre a outra, amontoando ou sobrecarregando. 1. Amontoar brasas sobre a cabeça de alguém como metáfora de generosidade (Rm 12.20); 2. Acumular pecados ou sobrecarregar pessoas (2Tm 3.6).
THAYER.en: Means to accumulate by placing one thing upon another, heaping up or overloading. 1. To heap burning coals upon someone's head as a metaphor for generosity (Rom 12:20); 2. To accumulate sins or overload people (2 Tim 3:6).

DEFINITION: Name of a synagogue leader in Corinth and later of a Christian associated with the apostle Paul.
SENSES: 1. Leader of the Jewish synagogue in Corinth (Acts 18:17); 2. Brother in the faith associated with Paul (1 Cor 1:1).

THAYER.pt: Nome de um líder da sinagoga em Corinto e posteriormente de um cristão associado ao apóstolo Paulo. 1. Líder da sinagoga judaica em Corinto (At 18.17); 2. Irmão na fé associado a Paulo (1Co 1.1).
THAYER.en: Name of a synagogue leader in Corinth and later of a Christian associated with the apostle Paul. 1. Leader of the Jewish synagogue in Corinth (Acts 18:17); 2. Brother in the faith associated with Paul (1 Cor 1:1).

DEFINITION: Name of a Christian associated with Paul, mentioned among those who send greetings in the epistle to the Romans.
SENSES: 1. Member of the Christian community cited by Paul in Rom 16:21.

THAYER.pt: Nome de um cristão associado a Paulo, mencionado entre aqueles que enviam saudações na epístola aos Romanos. 1. Membro da comunidade cristã citado por Paulo em Rm 16.21.
THAYER.en: Name of a Christian associated with Paul, mentioned among those who send greetings in the epistle to the Romans. 1. Member of the Christian community cited by Paul in Rom 16:21.

DEFINITION: One who rescues from danger, protects, or brings definitive deliverance. In the New Testament, it is the supreme title applied to both God the Father and Jesus Christ as the only Redeemer.
SENSES: 1. One who delivers from danger or brings salvation, applied to God (Luke 1:47).
2. The messianic deliverer and Savior of humanity, Jesus Christ (Phil 3:20; Titus 1:4).

THAYER.pt: Aquele que resgata do perigo, protege ou traz libertação definitiva. No Novo Testamento, é o título supremo aplicado tanto a Deus Pai quanto a Jesus Cristo como o único Redentor. 1. Aquele que livra do perigo ou traz salvação, aplicado a Deus (Lc 1.47). | 2. O Messias libertador e Salvador da humanidade, Jesus Cristo (Fp 3.20; Tt 1.4).
THAYER.en: One who rescues from danger, protects, or brings definitive deliverance. In the New Testament, it is the supreme title applied to both God the Father and Jesus Christ as the only Redeemer. 1. One who delivers from danger or brings salvation, applied to God (Luke 1:47). | 2. The messianic deliverer and Savior of humanity, Jesus Christ (Phil 3:20; Titus 1:4).

DEFINITION: Represents the state or act of deliverance from mortal dangers on the physical plane, but biblically culminates in the eschatological liberation from the power and condemnation of sin granted through faith in Jesus Christ.
SENSES: 1. Deliverance or physical preservation from imminent danger of death (Acts 27:34; Heb 11:7).
2. Spiritual and messianic salvation of divine order from sin and condemnation (Luke 1:77; Rom 1:16; Eph 1:13).
3. The fullness of the final glorified redemption reserved for the last day (Rom 13:11; 1 Pet 1:5; Rev 7:10).

THAYER.pt: Representa o estado ou ato de livramento de perigos mortais no plano físico, mas culmina biblicamente na libertação escatológica do poder e condenação do pecado concedida mediante a fé em Jesus Cristo. 1. Livramento ou preservação física de perigo iminente de morte (At 27.34; Hb 11.7). | 2. Salvação espiritual e messiânica de ordem divina do pecado e condenação (Lc 1.77; Rm 1.16; Ef 1.13). | 3. A plenitude da redenção glorificada final reservada para o último dia (Rm 13.11; 1Pe 1.5; Ap 7.10).
THAYER.en: Represents the state or act of deliverance from mortal dangers on the physical plane, but biblically culminates in the eschatological liberation from the power and condemnation of sin granted through faith in Jesus Christ. 1. Deliverance or physical preservation from imminent danger of death (Acts 27:34; Heb 11:7). | 2. Spiritual and messianic salvation of divine order from sin and condemnation (Luke 1:77; Rom 1:16; Eph 1:13). | 3. The fullness of the final glorified redemption reserved for the last day (Rom 13:11; 1 Pet 1:5; Rev 7:10).

DEFINITION: Describes that which possesses a salvific character, which delivers, preserves, or brings divine salvation to human beings.
SENSES: 1. Referring to the salvation provided by God (Titus 2:11).
2. As a neuter noun, the means of deliverance or salvation itself (Luke 3:6).

THAYER.pt: Descreve aquilo que possui caráter salvífico, que liberta, preserva ou traz a salvação divina aos seres humanos. 1. Referente à salvação proporcionada por Deus (Tt 2.11). | 2. Como substantivo neutro, o meio de livramento ou a própria salvação (Lc 3.6).
THAYER.en: Describes that which possesses a salvific character, which delivers, preserves, or brings divine salvation to human beings. 1. Referring to the salvation provided by God (Titus 2:11). | 2. As a neuter noun, the means of deliverance or salvation itself (Luke 3:6).

SHORT_GLOSS: to be sober, to have good sense
DEFINITION: Indicates the possession of mental sanity, emotional balance, or prudence in one's manner of acting.
SENSES: 1. To be in one's right mind or sound conscience (Mark 5:15).
2. To be prudent and exercise self-control (Titus 2:6).
USAGE: to be sober, to have good sense

THAYER.pt: Indica a posse de sanidade mental, equilíbrio emocional ou prudência no modo de agir. 1. Estar em perfeito juízo ou sã consciência (Mc 5:15). | 2. Ser prudente e exercitar o autocontrole (Tt 2:6).
THAYER.en: Indicates the possession of mental sanity, emotional balance, or prudence in one's manner of acting. 1. To be in one's right mind or sound conscience (Mark 5:15). | 2. To be prudent and exercise self-control (Titus 2:6).

DEFINITION: To instruct someone to act with good sense, moderation, and prudence, correcting inappropriate behavior.
SENSES: 1. To teach to have good sense and prudence, instructing morally (Titus 2:4).

THAYER.pt: Instruir alguém a agir com bom senso, moderação e prudência, corrigindo o comportamento inadequado. 1. Ensinar a ter bom senso e prudência, instruindo moralmente (Tt 2.4).
THAYER.en: To instruct someone to act with good sense, moderation, and prudence, correcting inappropriate behavior. 1. To teach to have good sense and prudence, instructing morally (Titus 2:4).

DEFINITION: The exercise of self-control, moderation, and mental sensibility in practical actions and decisions.
SENSES: 1. Spirit of sensibility, moderation, or self-discipline granted by God (2 Tim 1:7).

THAYER.pt: O exercício do autocontrole, da moderação e da sensatez mental nas ações e decisões práticas. 1. Espírito de sensatez, moderação ou autodisciplina concedido por Deus (2Tm 1.7).
THAYER.en: The exercise of self-control, moderation, and mental sensibility in practical actions and decisions. 1. Spirit of sensibility, moderation, or self-discipline granted by God (2 Tim 1:7).

DEFINITION: In a sensible, prudent manner, demonstrating self-control in daily attitudes.
SENSES: 1. To live with moderation, sensibility, and self-control (Titus 2:12).

THAYER.pt: De maneira sensata, prudente e demonstrando autocontrole nas atitudes cotidianas. 1. Viver com moderação, sensatez e domínio próprio (Tt 2.12).
THAYER.en: In a sensible, prudent manner, demonstrating self-control in daily attitudes. 1. To live with moderation, sensibility, and self-control (Titus 2:12).

DEFINITION: Mental quality characterized by good sense, emotional balance, moderation, and self-control in attitudes.
SENSES: 1. Sound conscience, mental balance, and rationality (Acts 26:25).
2. Practice of moderation, discretion, and self-control in the face of circumstances (1 Tim 2:9).

THAYER.pt: Qualidade mental caracterizada pelo bom senso, equilíbrio emocional, moderação e domínio próprio nas atitudes. 1. Sã consciência, equilíbrio mental e racionalidade (At 26.25). | 2. Prática da moderação, discrição e autocontrole diante das circunstâncias (1Tm 2.9).
THAYER.en: Mental quality characterized by good sense, emotional balance, moderation, and self-control in attitudes. 1. Sound conscience, mental balance, and rationality (Acts 26:25). | 2. Practice of moderation, discretion, and self-control in the face of circumstances (1 Tim 2:9).

DEFINITION: One who exercises control over oneself, characterized by emotional balance, sensibility, and moderate conduct.
SENSES: 1. Endowed with self-control, prudent and sensible in one's actions and thoughts (1 Tim 3:2; Titus 1:8).

THAYER.pt: Que exerce domínio sobre si mesmo, caracterizado pelo equilíbrio emocional, sensatez e conduta moderada. 1. Dotado de autocontrole, prudente e sensato em suas ações e pensamentos (1Tm 3.2; Tt 1.8).
THAYER.en: One who exercises control over oneself, characterized by emotional balance, sensibility, and moderate conduct. 1. Endowed with self-control, prudent and sensible in one's actions and thoughts (1 Tim 3:2; Titus 1:8).

DEFINITION: A Roman toponym derived from Latin to designate a locality with inns on the Appian Way.
SENSES: 1. Name of a waystation on the route to Rome (Acts 28:15).

THAYER.pt: Topônimo romano derivado do latim para designar uma localidade com estalagens na Via Ápia. 1. Nome de uma estação de pouso na rota para Roma (At 28.15).
THAYER.en: A Roman toponym derived from Latin to designate a locality with inns on the Appian Way. 1. Name of a waystation on the route to Rome (Acts 28:15).

DEFINITION: An Aramaic proper name of a disciple in Joppa, whose Greek equivalent is Dorcas, known for her good works.
SENSES: 1. Aramaic name of the disciple Tabitha raised by Peter (Acts 9:36).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio aramaico de uma discípula em Jope, cujo equivalente grego é Dorcas, conhecida pelas suas boas obras. 1. Nome aramaico da discípula Tabita ressuscitada por Pedro (At 9.36).
THAYER.en: An Aramaic proper name of a disciple in Joppa, whose Greek equivalent is Dorcas, known for her good works. 1. Aramaic name of the disciple Tabitha raised by Peter (Acts 9:36).

DEFINITION: An organized group of people arranged in a specific order, whether military or hierarchical.
SENSES: 1. A specific order or group in a sequence (1 Cor 15:23).

THAYER.pt: Um grupo organizado de pessoas dispostas em ordem específica, seja militar ou hierarquicamente. 1. Ordem ou grupo específico em uma sequência (1Co 15.23).
THAYER.en: An organized group of people arranged in a specific order, whether military or hierarchical. 1. A specific order or group in a sequence (1 Cor 15:23).

DEFINITION: Refers to something that has been previously established, marked, or determined by agreement or authority.
SENSES: 1. A date or occasion fixed in advance (Acts 12:21).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se a algo que foi previamente estabelecido, marcado ou determinado por acordo ou autoridade. 1. Data ou ocasião fixada antecipadamente (At 12.21).
THAYER.en: Refers to something that has been previously established, marked, or determined by agreement or authority. 1. A date or occasion fixed in advance (Acts 12:21).

SHORT_GLOSS: to be afflicted, to be miserable
DEFINITION: To experience deep suffering, affliction, or physical and emotional misery.
SENSES: 1. To undergo great anguish or misery, lamenting difficult circumstances (Jas 4:9).
USAGE: to be afflicted, to be miserable

THAYER.pt: Experimentar profundo sofrimento, aflição ou miséria física e emocional. 1. Passar por grande angústia ou miséria, lamentando circunstâncias difíceis (Tg 4.9).
THAYER.en: To experience deep suffering, affliction, or physical and emotional misery. 1. To undergo great anguish or misery, lamenting difficult circumstances (Jas 4:9).

DEFINITION: Indicates a deep state of misery, intense suffering, and physical or moral affliction.
SENSES: 1. A state of extreme misery, affliction, and anguish (Rom 3:16; Jas 5:1).

THAYER.pt: Indica um estado profundo de miséria, sofrimento intenso e aflição física ou moral. 1. Estado de extrema miséria, aflição e angústia (Rm 3.16; Tg 5.1).
THAYER.en: Indicates a deep state of misery, intense suffering, and physical or moral affliction. 1. A state of extreme misery, affliction, and anguish (Rom 3:16; Jas 5:1).

DEFINITION: Describes someone who is in a condition of deep disgrace, misery, or helplessness.
SENSES: 1. Miserable or afflicted due to difficult circumstances or the weight of sin (Rom 7:24; Rev 3:17).

THAYER.pt: Descreve alguém que se encontra em condição de profunda desgraça, miséria ou desamparo. 1. Miserável ou aflito devido a circunstâncias difíceis ou ao peso do pecado (Rm 7.24; Ap 3.17).
THAYER.en: Describes someone who is in a condition of deep disgrace, misery, or helplessness. 1. Miserable or afflicted due to difficult circumstances or the weight of sin (Rom 7:24; Rev 3:17).

DEFINITION: Possessing a weight equivalent to a talent (an ancient unit of weight of great value).
SENSES: 1. Weighing approximately one talent, used to describe heavy hailstones (Rev 16:21).

THAYER.pt: Que possui o peso equivalente a um talento (unidade de peso antiga de grande valor). 1. Que pesa aproximadamente um talento, usado para descrever saraivadas pesadas (Ap 16.21).
THAYER.en: Possessing a weight equivalent to a talent (an ancient unit of weight of great value). 1. Weighing approximately one talent, used to describe heavy hailstones (Rev 16:21).

DEFINITION: A unit of weight and currency of very high value in the Greco-Roman world, frequently used in parables to represent resources entrusted by God.
SENSES: 1. A large sum of money or a weight unit of silver or gold (Matt 18:24; 25:15).

THAYER.pt: Unidade de peso e moeda de altíssimo valor no mundo greco-romano, frequentemente utilizada em parábolas para representar recursos confiados por Deus. 1. Grande quantia em dinheiro ou unidade ponderal de prata ou ouro (Mt 18.24; 25.15).
THAYER.en: A unit of weight and currency of very high value in the Greco-Roman world, frequently used in parables to represent resources entrusted by God. 1. A large sum of money or a weight unit of silver or gold (Matt 18:24; 25:15).

THAYER.en: A transliterated Aramaic term used to address a girl or young woman affectionately. 1. An affectionate Aramaic expression for "little girl" (Mark 5:41).

THAYER.pt: Cômodo interno de uma casa, geralmente sem janelas para o exterior, usado para armazenar provas, objetos de valor ou para recolhimento em oração privada. 1. Despensa ou local de armazenamento de provisões (Lc 12.24); | 2. Quarto interior e privado de uma residência (Mt 6.6; Mt 24.26).
THAYER.en: An interior room of a house, usually without windows to the outside, used for storing provisions, valuables, or for private prayer. 1. A storeroom or place for storing provisions (Luke 12:24); | 2. An interior and private room of a residence (Matt 6:6; Matt 24:26).

THAYER.en: Describes the organized arrangement of things or people in a sequence, series, or established hierarchy. 1. A fixed order or regular succession of events or turns (Luke 1:8). | 2. A state of good organization and proper procedure (1 Cor 14:40). | 3. An order or hierarchical category (Heb 5:6).

DEFINITION: Describes someone of low social status, but also the state of mind of one who is unpretentious, humble, and free from pride.
SENSES: 1. Of low social position or lacking prominence (Jas 1:9; 2 Cor 7:6).

THAYER.pt: Descreve alguém de condição social baixa, mas também o estado de espírito daquele que é despretensioso, humilde e livre de orgulho. 1. De posição social baixa ou desprovido de destaque (Tg 1.9; 2Co 7.6). | 2. Caracterizado pela humildade e brandura de espírito (Mt 11.29).
THAYER.en: Describes someone of low social status, but also the state of mind of one who is unpretentious, humble, and free from pride. 1. Of low social position or lacking prominence (Jas 1:9; 2 Cor 7:6). | 2. Characterized by humility and gentleness of spirit (Matt 11:29).

DEFINITION: A moral quality consisting of the absence of arrogance or pride, manifesting in modesty and an unpretentious attitude in relationships.
SENSES: 1. The Christian virtue of genuine humility and modesty (Phil 2:3; Acts 20:19).

THAYER.pt: Qualidade moral que consiste na ausência de arrogância ou orgulho, manifestando-se em modéstia e atitude despretensiosa nas relações. 1. A virtude cristã da humildade genuína e modéstia (Fp 2.3; At 20.19).
THAYER.en: A moral quality consisting of the absence of arrogance or pride, manifesting in modesty and an unpretentious attitude in relationships. 1. The Christian virtue of genuine humility and modesty (Phil 2:3; Acts 20:19).

THAYER.pt: Causar a diminuição do status, posição ou atitude de alguém, levando-o à humildade ou ao rebaixamento. 1. Reduzir a altura ou aplainar um obstáculo físico (Lc 3.5). | 2. Humilhar ou abasear alguém, diminuindo seu prestígio (Fp 2.8). | 3. Adotar uma atitude de humildade perante Deus ou os outros (Tg 4.10).
THAYER.en: To cause a decrease in someone's status, position, or attitude, leading them to humility or degradation. 1. To reduce height or level a physical obstacle (Luke 3:5). | 2. To humble or abase someone, diminishing their prestige (Phil 2:8). | 3. To adopt an attitude of humility before God or others (Jas 4:10).

DEFINITION: A state of dejection, circumstantial humiliation, or the inner attitude of modesty and lack of presumption.

THAYER.en: A state of dejection, circumstantial humiliation, or the inner attitude of modesty and lack of presumption. 1. The experience of a reversal of fortune or deep humiliation (Acts 8:33); | 2. A humble and unpretentious social condition (Luke 1:48).

USAGE: to disturb, to agitate, to unsettle

THAYER.pt: Significa agitar um líquido ou causar turbulência física. Em sentido figurado, descreve a agitação interior, a ansiedade profunda, o medo ou a confusão mental e espiritual. 1. Agitar ou mover a água de um reservatório (Jo 5.4). | 2. Causar turbulência interior, perturbar, inquietar ou encher de ansiedade (Jo 11.33; At 17.8).
THAYER.en: Means to agitate a liquid or cause physical turbulence. Figuratively, it describes inner agitation, deep anxiety, fear, or mental and spiritual confusion. 1. To agitate or move the water of a reservoir (John 5:4). | 2. To cause inner turbulence, to disturb, to unsettle, or to fill with anxiety (John 11:33; Acts 17:8).

DEFINITION: Describes a state of physical agitation, civil turbulence, or emotional disturbance and perplexity.
SENSES: 1. Social tumult or public agitation (Mark 13:8).

THAYER.en: Describes a state of physical agitation, civil turbulence, or emotional disturbance and perplexity. 1. Social tumult or public agitation (Mark 13:8).

DEFINITION: Designates a state of great mental agitation or a tumult and social disorder.

THAYER.pt: Designa um estado de grande agitação mental ou um tumulto e desordem social. 1. Estado de intensa agitação ou confusão mental (At 12.18); 2. Tumulto ou distúrbio civil (At 19.23).
THAYER.en: Designates a state of great mental agitation or a tumult and social disorder. 1. A state of intense agitation or mental confusion (Acts 12:18); 2. A tumult or civil disturbance (Acts 19:23).

DEFINITION: Designates an inhabitant or native of the city of Tarsus, in Cilicia, applying to the apostle Paul.

THAYER.en: Designates an inhabitant or native of the city of Tarsus, in Cilicia, applying to the apostle Paul. 1. A native or inhabitant of the city of Tarsus (Acts 9:11; Acts 21:39).

SENSES: 1. The city of Tarsus in Cilicia, the place of origin of the apostle Paul (Acts 9:30; 11:25; 22:3).

THAYER.pt: Importante cidade e capital da província romana da Cilícia, no sudeste da Ásia Menor, célebre por ser a cidade natal do apóstolo Paulo. 1. Cidade de Tarso na Cilícia, local de origem do apóstolo Paulo (At 9.30; 11.25; 22.3).
THAYER.en: An important city and capital of the Roman province of Cilicia, in southeastern Asia Minor, famous for being the birthplace of the apostle Paul. 1. The city of Tarsus in Cilicia, the place of origin of the apostle Paul (Acts 9:30; 11:25; 22:3).

SENSES: 1. To confine fallen angels in dark imprisonment for judgment (2 Pet 2:4).

THAYER.en: To throw or keep imprisoned in the lower regions of Tartarus (the abyss of divine punishment). 1. To confine fallen angels in dark imprisonment for judgment (2 Pet 2:4).

THAYER.pt: Significa organizar, fixar, determinar ou designar alguém a uma posição, função ou instrução específica. 1. Colocar em ordem ou estabelecer uma estrutura de autoridade (Rm 13.1). | 2. Designar ou apontar alguém para uma função ou destino (At 13.48; 28.23).
THAYER.en: To organize, fix, determine, or designate someone to a specific position, function, or instruction. 1. To put in order or establish a structure of authority (Rom 13:1). | 2. To designate or appoint someone to a function or destiny (Acts 13:48; 28:23).

DEFINITION: Bull or ox, frequently used in the context of the Old Testament and Judaism as a large animal for ritual sacrifices.

THAYER.en: Bull or ox, frequently used in the context of the Old Testament and Judaism as a large animal for ritual sacrifices. 1. Bull or ox destined for religious sacrifices (Acts 14:13; Heb 9:13).

THAYER.en: Neuter plural form of the demonstrative pronoun, indicating previously mentioned objects, facts, or ideas. 1. Plural reference to nearby things, facts, or teachings.

DEFINITION: Feminine plural form of the demonstrative pronoun, used to point to nearby persons, things, or circumstances.

THAYER.en: The act of burying a corpse or the place specifically intended for burial. 1. The act or place of burying a body (Matt 27:7).

THAYER.pt: Local ou estrutura física construída para o sepultamento e guarda de pessoas mortas. 1. Sepulcro ou sepultura onde se enterram os mortos (Mt 23.27, 29). | 2. Em sentido figurado, cova aberta na oratória maledicente (Rm 3.13).
THAYER.en: Physical location or structure built for the burial and keeping of dead persons. 1. Sepulchre or grave where the dead are buried (Matt 23:27, 29). | 2. Figuratively, an open grave in slanderous speech (Rom 3:13).

THAYER.en: Particle expressing contingency, indicating the possibility or probability of something occurring. 1. Perhaps or possibly, expressing a probable supposition (Rom 5:7; Phlm 15).

THAYER.en: Indicates promptness in carrying out an action or a very short time interval until something happens. 1. Quickly or without delay, promptly (Luke 14:21). | 2. In the sense of excessively fast or hastily (Gal 1:6). | 3. Soon, in the near future (1Cor 4:19).

THAYER.en: Refers to something that happens quickly or is about to happen soon. 1. Happening soon or imminently (2Pet 1:14; 2Pet 2:1).

THAYER.en: Pertaining to an agile, swift action or one that occurs in a very short space of time. 1. Swift or ready to hear and act with promptness (Jas 1:19); 2. Without delay, readily (Matt 28:8).

SENSES: 1. Additive connector of interdependent elements ('and', 'also') (Acts 2:40; Heb 6:5).
2. Correlative construction with καί: 'both... and', 'not only... but also' (Acts 26:16; Rom 1:14).

THAYER.pt: Partícula enclítica que estabelece uma vinculação coordenada mais íntima e orgânica entre termos ou orações do que a conjunção comum. Quando usada em pares (τέ... καί), coordena ideias correlatas expressando totalidade. 1. Conector aditivo de elementos interdependentes ('e', 'também') (At 2.40; Hb 6.5). | 2. Construção correlativa com καί: 'tanto... como', 'não só... mas também' (At 26.16; Rm 1.14).
THAYER.en: Enclitic particle that establishes a closer and more organic coordinated link between terms or clauses than the common conjunction. When used in pairs (τέ... καί), it coordinates correlative ideas expressing totality. 1. Additive connector of interdependent elements ('and', 'also') (Acts 2:40; Heb 6:5). | 2. Correlative construction with καί: 'both... and', 'not only... but also' (Acts 26:16; Rom 1:14).

THAYER.en: Consanguineous descendant without distinction of gender; widely used in a spiritual sense to designate the faithful as children of God or converts in relation to their apostolic teachers. 1.
