THAYER.pt: Descreve aquilo que atingiu o seu propósito final, alcançou a maturidade plena ou atende ao mais alto padrão de integridade. 1. Perfeito no sentido de integridade moral ou padrão supremo (Tg 1.4; 1Jo 4.18). | 2. Maduro ou plenamente crescido em contraste com a infância espiritual (Ef 4.13).
THAYER.en: Describes that which has attained its final purpose, reached full maturity, or meets the highest standard of integrity. 1. Perfect in the sense of moral integrity or supreme standard (Jas 1:4; 1John 4:18). | 2. Mature or fully grown in contrast to spiritual infancy (Eph 4:13).

DEFINITION: State or condition of complete development, spiritual maturity, or moral perfection.
SENSES: 1. Spiritual and moral perfection or fullness (Col 3:14); 2. Maturity in faith and conduct (Heb 6:1).

THAYER.pt: Estado ou condição de completo desenvolvimento, maturidade espiritual ou perfeição moral. 1. Perfeição ou plenitude espiritual e moral (Cl 3.14); 2. Maturidade na fé e na conduta (Hb 6.1).
THAYER.en: State or condition of complete development, spiritual maturity, or moral perfection. 1. Spiritual and moral perfection or fullness (Col 3:14); 2. Maturity in faith and conduct (Heb 6:1).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: τελειώσω, Aor: ἐτελείωσα, Perf: τετελείωκα
DEFINITION: To bring an activity, purpose, or state to its full conclusion, intended goal, or ideal maturity; to perfect, consummate.
SENSES: 1. Complete, finish a task or course (John 4:34; Acts 20:24).
2. Perfect, lead to the full moral or spiritual target (Heb 2:10; 1John 4:18).
3. Fully fulfill a prophecy or scripture (John 19:28).

THAYER.pt: Levar uma atividade, propósito ou estado à sua conclusão plena, meta pretendida ou maturidade ideal; aperfeiçoar, consumar. 1. Completar, terminar uma tarefa ou carreira (Jo 4.34; At 20.24). | 2. Aperfeiçoar, conduzir ao alvo moral ou espiritual pleno (Hb 2.10; 1Jo 4.18). | 3. Cumprir integralmente uma profecia ou escritura (Jo 19.28).
THAYER.en: To bring an activity, purpose, or state to its full conclusion, intended goal, or ideal maturity; to perfect, consummate. 1. Complete, finish a task or course (John 4:34; Acts 20:24). | 2. Perfect, lead to the full moral or spiritual target (Heb 2:10; 1John 4:18). | 3. Fully fulfill a prophecy or scripture (John 19:28).

DEFINITION: In a full, total, or perfect manner, without restrictions or flaws.
SENSES: 1. In a complete and perfect manner, totally (1Pet 1:13).

THAYER.pt: De modo pleno, total ou perfeito, sem restrições ou falhas. 1. De maneira completa e perfeita, totalmente (1Pe 1:13).
THAYER.en: In a full, total, or perfect manner, without restrictions or flaws. 1. In a complete and perfect manner, totally (1Pet 1:13).

DEFINITION: Indicates the process or state of attaining moral or spiritual perfection or the full fulfillment of a promise.
SENSES: 1. Ritual and spiritual perfection or consummation (Heb 7:11).
2. Fulfillment or realization of a divine promise (Luke 1:45).

THAYER.pt: Indica o processo ou o estado de alcançar a perfeição moral, espiritual ou o pleno cumprimento de uma promessa. 1. Perfeição ou consumação ritual e espiritual (Hb 7.11). | 2. Cumprimento ou realização de uma promessa divina (Lc 1.45).
THAYER.en: Indicates the process or state of attaining moral or spiritual perfection or the full fulfillment of a promise. 1. Ritual and spiritual perfection or consummation (Heb 7:11). | 2. Fulfillment or realization of a divine promise (Luke 1:45).

DEFINITION: One who brings something to its successful conclusion or to its state of full perfection.
SENSES: 1. The one who perfects or consummates, a title applied to Christ regarding faith (Heb 12:2).

THAYER.pt: Aquele que leva algo à sua conclusão bem-sucedida ou ao seu estado de plena perfeição. 1. Aquele que aperfeiçoa ou consuma, título aplicado a Cristo em relação à fé (Hb 12:2).
THAYER.en: One who brings something to its successful conclusion or to its state of full perfection. 1. The one who perfects or consummates, a title applied to Christ regarding faith (Heb 12:2).

DEFINITION: To bring fruit to full maturity or complete development.
SENSES: 1. To produce mature and complete fruit, bringing to full realization (Lk 8:14).

THAYER.pt: Levar o fruto à plena maturidade ou desenvolvimento completo. 1. Produzir fruto maduro e completo, trazendo à plena realização (Lc 8:14).
THAYER.en: To bring fruit to full maturity or complete development. 1. To produce mature and complete fruit, bringing to full realization (Lk 8:14).

DEFINITION: Signifies coming to the end of earthly life, that is, passing away or dying.
SENSES: 1. To cease physical life, to die (Mt 2.19; 9.18).

THAYER.pt: Significa chegar ao fim da vida terrena, ou seja, falecer ou morrer. 1. Cessar a vida física, morrer (Mt 2.19; 9.18).
THAYER.en: Signifies coming to the end of earthly life, that is, passing away or dying. 1. To cease physical life, to die (Mt 2.19; 9.18).

DEFINITION: The point at which earthly existence ceases; a euphemistic or common term for death.
SENSES: 1. The end of earthly life, death (Mt 2:15).

THAYER.pt: O ponto em que a existência terrena cessa; um termo eufemístico ou comum para a morte. 1. O fim da vida terrena, a morte (Mt 2:15).
THAYER.en: The point at which earthly existence ceases; a euphemistic or common term for death. 1. The end of earthly life, death (Mt 2:15).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: τελέσω, Aor: ἐτέλεσα, Perf: τετέλεκα
DEFINITION: Brings an action, duty, or process to its successful end, fully fulfilling an obligation or requirement.
SENSES: 1. To complete an activity or process, finish, conclude (Mt 7.28; 2Tm 4.7).
2. To fulfill an obligation, commandment, or moral requirement (Rom 2.27).
3. To pay what is due, such as taxes or duties (Rom 13.6).

THAYER.pt: Leva uma ação, dever ou processo ao seu término bem-sucedido, cumprindo plenamente uma obrigação ou exigência. 1. Completar uma atividade ou processo, terminar, finalizar (Mt 7.28; 2Tm 4.7). | 2. Cumprir uma obrigação, mandamento ou exigência moral (Rm 2.27). | 3. Pagar o que é devido, como tributos ou impostos (Rm 13.6).
THAYER.en: Brings an action, duty, or process to its successful end, fully fulfilling an obligation or requirement. 1. To complete an activity or process, finish, conclude (Mt 7.28; 2Tm 4.7). | 2. To fulfill an obligation, commandment, or moral requirement (Rom 2.27). | 3. To pay what is due, such as taxes or duties (Rom 13.6).

DEFINITION: The final point of a process or temporal duration, or the supreme purpose toward which something is directed.
SENSES: 1. The termination or conclusion of an event or period of time (Lk 1.33; 1Co 15.24).
2. The ultimate goal, target, or result of an action (1Tm 1.5; Jas 5.11).
3. Tax or tribute owed to governmental authority (Rom 13.7).

THAYER.pt: O ponto final de um processo ou duração temporal, ou o propósito supremo para o qual algo é direcionado. 1. O término ou conclusão de um evento ou período de tempo (Lc 1.33; 1Co 15.24). | 2. O objetivo final, alvo ou resultado de uma ação (1Tm 1.5; Tg 5.11). | 3. Imposto ou tributo devido à autoridade governamental (Rm 13.7).
THAYER.en: The final point of a process or temporal duration, or the supreme purpose toward which something is directed. 1. The termination or conclusion of an event or period of time (Lk 1.33; 1Co 15.24). | 2. The ultimate goal, target, or result of an action (1Tm 1.5; Jas 5.11). | 3. Tax or tribute owed to governmental authority (Rom 13.7).

DEFINITION: An official charged with collecting taxes and fees, often despised in Jewish society for collaborating with the Roman occupation and extorting the people.
SENSES: 1. A tax collector in the service of the Roman government or Herod (Mt 9.10; 18.17).

THAYER.pt: Funcionário encarregado de recolher impostos e taxas, frequentemente desprezado na sociedade judaica por colaborar com a ocupação romana e extorquir o povo. 1. Cobrador de impostos a serviço do governo romano ou de Herodes (Mt 9.10; 18.17).
THAYER.en: An official charged with collecting taxes and fees, often despised in Jewish society for collaborating with the Roman occupation and extorting the people. 1. A tax collector in the service of the Roman government or Herod (Mt 9.10; 18.17).

DEFINITION: Designates the place or post where taxes, customs, and duties were collected, often associated with tax collectors (publicans).
SENSES: 1. A tax collection post or customs house (Mt 9.9; Mk 2.14; Lk 5.27).

THAYER.pt: Designa o local ou posto onde taxas, alfândegas e impostos eram arrecadados, frequentemente associado aos coletores de impostos (publicanos). 1. Posto de arrecadação de impostos ou alfândega (Mt 9.9; Mc 2.14; Lc 5.27).
THAYER.en: Designates the place or post where taxes, customs, and duties were collected, often associated with tax collectors (publicans). 1. A tax collection post or customs house (Mt 9.9; Mk 2.14; Lk 5.27).

DEFINITION: Extraordinary or portentous event that causes astonishment and profound admiration, almost always associated with miracles or divine manifestations.
SENSES: 1. A supernatural prodigy or wonder that arouses astonishment (Ac 2.19; 2Th 2.9).

THAYER.pt: Evento extraordinário ou portentoso que causa assombro e admiração profunda, quase sempre associado a milagres ou manifestações divinas. 1. Prodígio ou maravilha sobrenatural que desperta espanto (At 2.19; 2Ts 2.9).
THAYER.en: Extraordinary or portentous event that causes astonishment and profound admiration, almost always associated with miracles or divine manifestations. 1. A supernatural prodigy or wonder that arouses astonishment (Ac 2.19; 2Th 2.9).

DEFINITION: Name of a Christian who served as an amanuensis (scribe) for the apostle Paul in the letter to the Romans.
SENSES: 1. Tertius, the amanuensis who recorded the epistle to the Romans (Rom 16:22).

THAYER.pt: Nome de um cristão que atuou como amanuense (escrevente) do apóstolo Paulo na carta aos Romanos. 1. Tércio, o amanuense que registrou a epístola aos Romanos (Rm 16:22).
THAYER.en: Name of a Christian who served as an amanuensis (scribe) for the apostle Paul in the letter to the Romans. 1. Tertius, the amanuensis who recorded the epistle to the Romans (Rom 16:22).

DEFINITION: Proper name of a Roman orator or lawyer who represented the Jewish leaders accusing the apostle Paul before Governor Felix.
SENSES: 1. Tertullus, the prosecuting attorney against Paul (Ac 24.1).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio de um orador ou advogado romano que representou os líderes judeus acusando o apóstolo Paulo perante o governador Félix. 1. Tértulo, o advogado de acusação contra Paulo (At 24.1).
THAYER.en: Proper name of a Roman orator or lawyer who represented the Jewish leaders accusing the apostle Paul before Governor Felix. 1. Tertullus, the prosecuting attorney against Paul (Ac 24.1).

DEFINITION: Cardinal numeral representing the exact quantity of forty, frequently associated in biblical context with periods of trial, testing, or preparation.
SENSES: 1. The number forty in temporal or quantitative contexts (Mt 4.2; Ac 1.3).

THAYER.pt: Numeral cardinal que representa a quantidade exata de quarenta, frequentemente associado no contexto bíblico a períodos de provação, teste ou preparação. 1. O número quarenta em contextos temporais ou quantitativos (Mt 4.2; At 1.3).
THAYER.en: Cardinal numeral representing the exact quantity of forty, frequently associated in biblical context with periods of trial, testing, or preparation. 1. The number forty in temporal or quantitative contexts (Mt 4.2; Ac 1.3).

DEFINITION: Adjective qualifying a period of duration exactly equal to forty years.
SENSES: 1. Having a duration of forty years (Ac 7.23; 13.18).

THAYER.pt: Adjetivo que qualifica um período de duração exatamente igual a quarenta anos. 1. Com a duração de quarenta anos (At 7.23; 13.18).
THAYER.en: Adjective qualifying a period of duration exactly equal to forty years. 1. Having a duration of forty years (Ac 7.23; 13.18).

DEFINITION: Cardinal numeral representing the exact quantity of four units.
SENSES: 1. The number four in literal or countable contexts (Mt 24.31; Mk 2.3).

THAYER.pt: Numeral cardinal que representa a quantidade exata de quatro unidades. 1. O número quatro em contextos literais ou contáveis (Mt 24.31; Mc 2.3).
THAYER.en: Cardinal numeral representing the exact quantity of four units. 1. The number four in literal or countable contexts (Mt 24.31; Mk 2.3).

DEFINITION: Ordinal numeral indicating the position number fourteen in a sequential series, especially of time.
SENSES: 1. The fourteenth in a series or count (Ac 27.27).

THAYER.pt: Numeral ordinal que indica a posição número catorze em uma série sequencial, especialmente de tempo. 1. O décimo quarto em uma série ou contagem (At 27.27).
THAYER.en: Ordinal numeral indicating the position number fourteen in a sequential series, especially of time. 1. The fourteenth in a series or count (Ac 27.27).

DEFINITION: Occurring or having passed on the fourth day, frequently used in burial contexts.
SENSES: 1. Being on the fourth day since death or burial (Jn 11:39).

THAYER.pt: Que ocorre ou já se passou no quarto dia, frequentemente usado em contextos de sepultamento. 1. Estando no quarto dia desde a morte ou sepultamento (Jo 11:39).
THAYER.en: Occurring or having passed on the fourth day, frequently used in burial contexts. 1. Being on the fourth day since death or burial (Jn 11:39).

DEFINITION: Ordinal numeral indicating the position immediately following the third in a series, or a fraction equivalent to one-fourth.
SENSES: 1. The fourth in a series of time, order, or space (Mt 14.25).
2. The fourth part, one-fourth (Rev 6.8).

THAYER.pt: Numeral ordinal que indica a posição imediatamente após a terceira em uma série, ou uma fração equivalente a um quarto. 1. O quarto em uma série de tempo, ordem ou espaço (Mt 14.25). | 2. A quarta parte, um quarto (Ap 6.8).
THAYER.en: Ordinal numeral indicating the position immediately following the third in a series, or a fraction equivalent to one-fourth. 1. The fourth in a series of time, order, or space (Mt 14.25). | 2. The fourth part, one-fourth (Rev 6.8).

DEFINITION: Having four equal sides and four right angles, forming a square figure.
SENSES: 1. Having a square shape, with four equal sides (Rev 21:16).

THAYER.pt: Que possui quatro lados iguais e quatro ângulos retos, formando uma figura quadrada. 1. Que tem formato quadrado, com quatro lados iguais (Ap 21:16).
THAYER.en: Having four equal sides and four right angles, forming a square figure. 1. Having a square shape, with four equal sides (Rev 21:16).

DEFINITION: A military detachment or group composed of four soldiers.
SENSES: 1. A picket or squad of four soldiers assigned for guard duty (Ac 12:4).

THAYER.pt: Um destacamento ou grupo militar composto por quatro soldados. 1. Um piquete ou esquadrão de quatro soldados designado para a guarda (At 12:4).
THAYER.en: A military detachment or group composed of four soldiers. 1. A picket or squad of four soldiers assigned for guard duty (Ac 12:4).

DEFINITION: Cardinal numeral representing exactly the quantity of four thousand.
SENSES: 1. The number four thousand, applied in accounts of crowds fed by Jesus (Mt 15.38).

THAYER.pt: Numeral cardinal que representa exatamente a quantidade de quatro mil. 1. O número quatro mil, aplicado em relatos de multidões alimentadas por Jesus (Mt 15.38).
THAYER.en: Cardinal numeral representing exactly the quantity of four thousand. 1. The number four thousand, applied in accounts of crowds fed by Jesus (Mt 15.38).

DEFINITION: Cardinal numeral representing the exact quantity of four hundred units.
SENSES: 1. The number four hundred (Ac 5.36; Ac 7.6).

THAYER.pt: Numeral cardinal que representa a quantidade exata de quatrocentas unidades. 1. O número quatrocentos (At 5.36; At 7.6).
THAYER.en: Cardinal numeral representing the exact quantity of four hundred units. 1. The number four hundred (Ac 5.36; Ac 7.6).

DEFINITION: Having a duration of four months or occurring after a period of four months.
SENSES: 1. A period or term of four months (Jn 4:35).

THAYER.pt: Que tem a duração de quatro meses ou ocorre após um período de quatro meses. 1. Um período ou prazo de quatro meses (Jo 4:35).
THAYER.en: Having a duration of four months or occurring after a period of four months. 1. A period or term of four months (Jn 4:35).

DEFINITION: Multiplied by four; four times the original quantity.
SENSES: 1. In a quantity four times greater, fourfold (Lk 19:8).

THAYER.pt: Multiplicado por quatro; quatro vezes a quantidade original. 1. Em quantidade quatro vezes maior, quádruplo (Lc 19:8).
THAYER.en: Multiplied by four; four times the original quantity. 1. In a quantity four times greater, fourfold (Lk 19:8).

DEFINITION: Adjective or noun qualifying living beings that have four feet, commonly used in the New Testament to refer to land animals.
SENSES: 1. A four-footed animal or quadruped (Ac 10.12; Ac 11.6; Rom 1.23).

THAYER.pt: Adjetivo ou substantivo que qualifica seres vivos que possuem quatro patas, comumente usado no Novo Testamento para se referir a animais terrestres. 1. Animal quadrúpede ou de quatro patas (At 10.12; At 11.6; Rm 1.23).
THAYER.en: Adjective or noun qualifying living beings that have four feet, commonly used in the New Testament to refer to land animals. 1. A four-footed animal or quadruped (Ac 10.12; Ac 11.6; Rom 1.23).

DEFINITION: Signifies exercising government as a tetrarch, that is, ruling the fourth part of a province or a territory under Roman jurisdiction.
SENSES: 1. To rule as tetrarch over a region (Lk 3.1).

THAYER.pt: Significa exercer o governo como um tetrarca, ou seja, governar a quarta parte de uma província ou um território sob jurisdição romana. 1. Governar como tetrarca sobre uma região (Lc 3.1).
THAYER.en: Signifies exercising government as a tetrarch, that is, ruling the fourth part of a province or a territory under Roman jurisdiction. 1. To rule as tetrarch over a region (Lk 3.1).

DEFINITION: Governor of a fourth part of a province or region under Roman rule, a title applicable to local rulers such as Herod Antipas.
SENSES: 1. A territorial governor of a tetrarchy (Mt 14.1; Lk 3.1; Lk 3.19).

THAYER.pt: Governador de uma quarta parte de uma província ou região sob domínio romano, título aplicável a governantes locais como Herodes Antipas. 1. Governador territorial de uma tetrarquia (Mt 14.1; Lc 3.1; Lc 3.19).
THAYER.en: Governor of a fourth part of a province or region under Roman rule, a title applicable to local rulers such as Herod Antipas. 1. A territorial governor of a tetrarchy (Mt 14.1; Lk 3.1; Lk 3.19).

DEFINITION: To completely destroy by fire, reducing something to ashes.
SENSES: 1. To reduce to ashes or consume totally by fire as judgment (2Pe 2:6).

THAYER.pt: Destruir completamente pelo fogo, reduzindo algo a cinzas. 1. Reduzir a cinzas ou consumir totalmente pelo fogo como julgamento (2Pe 2:6).
THAYER.en: To completely destroy by fire, reducing something to ashes. 1. To reduce to ashes or consume totally by fire as judgment (2Pe 2:6).

DEFINITION: Refers to a practical skill, trade, or activity that requires specialized training and technical expertise.
SENSES: 1. Trade, profession, or specialized manual activity (Ac 18.3; Rev 18.22).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se a uma habilidade prática, ofício ou atividade que requer treinamento especializado e perícia técnica. 1. Ofício, profissão ou atividade manual especializada (At 18.3; Ap 18.22).
THAYER.en: Refers to a practical skill, trade, or activity that requires specialized training and technical expertise. 1. Trade, profession, or specialized manual activity (Ac 18.3; Rev 18.22).

DEFINITION: A person who skillfully practices a specific manual trade, or the supreme architect/builder of a grand work.
SENSES: 1. Craftsman or artisan in manual trades (Ac 19.24);
2. The divine architect and builder of the heavenly city (Heb 11.10).

THAYER.pt: Pessoa que exerce com habilidade um ofício manual específico, ou o arquiteto/construtor supremo de uma obra grandiosa. 1. Artesão ou artífice em ofícios manuais (At 19.24); | 2. O arquiteto e construtor divino da cidade celestial (Hb 11.10).
THAYER.en: A person who skillfully practices a specific manual trade, or the supreme architect/builder of a grand work. 1. Craftsman or artisan in manual trades (Ac 19.24); | 2. The divine architect and builder of the heavenly city (Heb 11.10).

DEFINITION: To cause solid substances to fuse or dissolve through heat.
SENSES: 1. To melt or dissolve physical elements under intense heat (2Pe 3:12).

THAYER.pt: Fazer fundir ou dissolver substâncias sólidas através do calor. 1. Derreter ou dissolver elementos físicos sob intenso calor (2Pe 3:12).
THAYER.en: To cause solid substances to fuse or dissolve through heat. 1. To melt or dissolve physical elements under intense heat (2Pe 3:12).

DEFINITION: In a very sharp, clear, and easily visible manner from a distance.

THAYER.pt: De maneira muito nítida, clara e facilmente visível à distância.
THAYER.en: In a very sharp, clear, and easily visible manner from a distance.

DEFINITION: Demonstrative pronoun pointing to an extraordinary magnitude, greatness, or degree of something.
SENSES: 1. In reference to size or degree of extreme importance (Jas 3:4; Heb 2:3).

THAYER.pt: Pronome demonstrativo que aponta para uma magnitude, grandeza ou grau extraordinário de algo. 1. Em referência a tamanho ou grau de extrema importância (Tg 3.4; Hb 2.3).
THAYER.en: Demonstrative pronoun pointing to an extraordinary magnitude, greatness, or degree of something. 1. In reference to size or degree of extreme importance (Jas 3:4; Heb 2:3).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: τηρήσω, Aor: ἐτήρησα, Perf: τετήρηκα
DEFINITION: Means to keep under guard, watch carefully, or faithfully observe commandments and moral precepts.
SENSES: 1. To keep under custody or guard someone (Acts 12:5; 16:23).
2. To preserve, keep something in good condition (Jn 2:10; Jas 1:27).
3. To fulfill or obey precepts and commandments (Jn 14:15; Rev 1:3).

THAYER.pt: Significa manter sob vigilância, guardar com cuidado ou observar fielmente mandamentos e preceitos morais. 1. Guardar sob custódia ou vigiar alguém (At 12.5; 16.23). | 2. Preservar, conservar algo em bom estado (Jo 2.10; Tg 1.27). | 3. Cumprir ou obedecer a preceitos e mandamentos (Jo 14.15; Ap 1.3).
THAYER.en: Means to keep under guard, watch carefully, or faithfully observe commandments and moral precepts. 1. To keep under custody or guard someone (Acts 12:5; 16:23). | 2. To preserve, keep something in good condition (Jn 2:10; Jas 1:27). | 3. To fulfill or obey precepts and commandments (Jn 14:15; Rev 1:3).

DEFINITION: Denotes the act of guarding, holding in custody (prison), or maintaining and fulfilling precepts and commandments.
SENSES: 1. Physical prison or custody (Acts 4:3; Acts 5:18);
2. Observance or fulfillment of commandments (1Cor 7:19).

THAYER.pt: Denota o ato de guardar, reter em custódia (prisão) ou manter e cumprir preceitos e mandamentos. 1. Prisão ou custódia física (At 4.3; At 5.18); | 2. Observância ou cumprimento de mandamentos (1Co 7.19).
THAYER.en: Denotes the act of guarding, holding in custody (prison), or maintaining and fulfilling precepts and commandments. 1. Physical prison or custody (Acts 4:3; Acts 5:18); | 2. Observance or fulfillment of commandments (1Cor 7:19).

DEFINITION: Name of a city on the western shore of the Sea of Galilee, built by Herod Antipas and named in honor of the Roman Emperor Tiberius.
SENSES: 1. The city of Tiberias or the Sea/Lake of Tiberias (Jn 6:23; Jn 21:1).

THAYER.pt: Nome de cidade na margem ocidental do Mar da Galileia, construída por Herodes Antipas e batizada em honra ao imperador romano Tibério. 1. A cidade de Tiberíades ou o mar/lago de Tiberíades (Jo 6.23; Jo 21.1).
THAYER.en: Name of a city on the western shore of the Sea of Galilee, built by Herod Antipas and named in honor of the Roman Emperor Tiberius. 1. The city of Tiberias or the Sea/Lake of Tiberias (Jn 6:23; Jn 21:1).

DEFINITION: Tiberius Claudius Nero Caesar, the second emperor of the Roman Empire.
SENSES: 1. Tiberius Caesar, Roman emperor mentioned in the chronology of John the Baptist's ministry (Lk 3:1).

THAYER.pt: Tibério Cláudio Nero César, o segundo imperador do Império Romano. 1. Tibério César, imperador romano mencionado na cronologia do ministério de João Batista (Lc 3:1).
THAYER.en: Tiberius Claudius Nero Caesar, the second emperor of the Roman Empire. 1. Tiberius Caesar, Roman emperor mentioned in the chronology of John the Baptist's ministry (Lk 3:1).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: θήσω, Aor: ἔθηκα, Perf: τέθεικα, Aor Pass: ἐτέθην
DEFINITION: To put or set something in a certain physical place; transferred to institutional or theological relations, it denotes establishing decrees, fixing purposes, or commissioning someone for a sacred function.
SENSES: 1. Position in space: to put, arrange, set, or bury (Mt 27:60; Mk 6:56).
2. Designate, constitute, or commission for an office or ministry (Acts 20:28; 1Tm 1:12).
3. Idiomatic: to voluntarily lay down one's life (Jn 10:11; 1Jn 3:16); to kneel down (Lk 22:41).

THAYER.pt: Pôr ou assentar algo em determinado lugar físico; transferido para relações institucionais ou teológicas, denota estabelecer decretos, fixar propósitos ou comissionar alguém para uma função sagrada. 1. Posicionar no espaço: pôr, dispor, assentar ou sepultar (Mt 27.60; Mc 6.56). | 2. Designar, constituir ou comissionar para um cargo ou ministério (At 20.28; 1Tm 1.12). | 3. Idiomático: entregar voluntariamente a própria vida (Jo 10.11; 1Jo 3.16); pôr-se de joelhos (Lc 22.41).
THAYER.en: To put or set something in a certain physical place; transferred to institutional or theological relations, it denotes establishing decrees, fixing purposes, or commissioning someone for a sacred function. 1. Position in space: to put, arrange, set, or bury (Mt 27:60; Mk 6:56). | 2. Designate, constitute, or commission for an office or ministry (Acts 20:28; 1Tm 1:12). | 3. Idiomatic: to voluntarily lay down one's life (Jn 10:11; 1Jn 3:16); to kneel down (Lk 22:41).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: τέξομαι, 2 Aor: ἔτεκον, Perf: τέτοκα
DEFINITION: Describes the biological act of giving birth to a child or the production of fruits and vegetation by the earth. Figuratively, it expresses the generation of concepts or consequences (such as sin giving birth to death).
SENSES: 1. To give birth or bring a child into the world, beget (Mt 1:21; Jn 16:21).
2. To produce, bear fruit, or give rise to something (Heb 6:7; Jas 1:15).

THAYER.pt: Descreve o ato biológico de dar à luz uma criança ou a produção de frutos e vegetação pela terra. Em sentido figurado, expressa a geração de conceitos ou consequências (como o pecado gerando a morte). 1. Dar à luz ou trazer uma criança ao mundo, gerar (Mt 1.21; Jo 16.21). | 2. Produzir, frutificar ou dar origem a algo (Hb 6.7; Tg 1.15).
THAYER.en: Describes the biological act of giving birth to a child or the production of fruits and vegetation by the earth. Figuratively, it expresses the generation of concepts or consequences (such as sin giving birth to death). 1. To give birth or bring a child into the world, beget (Mt 1:21; Jn 16:21). | 2. To produce, bear fruit, or give rise to something (Heb 6:7; Jas 1:15).

DEFINITION: Means to pluck, harvest, or pull something with the fingers, such as heads of grain or hair.
SENSES: 1. To pluck or harvest heads of grain with the hands (Mt 12:1; Mk 2:23; Lk 6:1).

THAYER.pt: Significa arrancar, colher ou puxar algo com os dedos, como espigas de grãos ou pelos. 1. Arrancar ou colher espigas com as mãos (Mt 12.1; Mc 2.23; Lc 6.1).
THAYER.en: Means to pluck, harvest, or pull something with the fingers, such as heads of grain or hair. 1. To pluck or harvest heads of grain with the hands (Mt 12:1; Mk 2:23; Lk 6:1).

DEFINITION: Proper name of a man, known in the New Testament as the father of Bartimaeus.
SENSES: 1. Timaeus, father of the blind Bartimaeus (Mk 10:46).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio de um homem, conhecido no Novo Testamento como o pai de Bartimeu. 1. Timeu, pai do cego Bartimeu (Mc 10:46).
THAYER.en: Proper name of a man, known in the New Testament as the father of Bartimaeus. 1. Timaeus, father of the blind Bartimaeus (Mk 10:46).

DEFINITION: To ascribe high value, honor, or respect to someone, demonstrating appreciation through reverent attitudes or adequate financial support.
SENSES: 1. To assign value or price to something (Mt 27:9).
2. To demonstrate deep respect, honor, and venerate someone (Mt 15:8; Jn 5:23).

THAYER.pt: Atribuir alto valor, honra ou respeito a alguém, demonstrando apreço através de atitudes reverentes ou suporte financeiro adequado. 1. Atribuir valor ou preço a algo (Mt 27.9). | 2. Demonstrar profundo respeito, honrar e venerar a alguém (Mt 15.8; Jo 5.23).
THAYER.en: To ascribe high value, honor, or respect to someone, demonstrating appreciation through reverent attitudes or adequate financial support. 1. To assign value or price to something (Mt 27:9). | 2. To demonstrate deep respect, honor, and venerate someone (Mt 15:8; Jn 5:23).

DEFINITION: The monetary value attributed to something, or the consideration of respect and distinction granted to a person.
SENSES: 1. The price or financial value paid for a good (Acts 5:2; 19:19).
2. Honor, respect, reverence, or position of prestige conferred on someone (Rom 12:10; 1Pet 3:7).

THAYER.pt: O valor monetário atribuído a algo, ou a consideração de respeito e distinção concedida a uma pessoa. 1. O preço ou valor financeiro pago por um bem (At 5.2; 19.19). | 2. Honra, respeito, reverência ou posição de prestígio conferida a alguém (Rm 12.10; 1Pe 3.7).
THAYER.en: The monetary value attributed to something, or the consideration of respect and distinction granted to a person. 1. The price or financial value paid for a good (Acts 5:2; 19:19). | 2. Honor, respect, reverence, or position of prestige conferred on someone (Rom 12:10; 1Pet 3:7).

DEFINITION: Describes something or someone of high value, esteemed for its rarity or importance, or worthy of deep respect and honor.
SENSES: 1. Belonging to something of exceptional value or costly (1Pet 1:19).
2. Worthy of honor, respect, and high esteem (Heb 13:4; Acts 5:34).

THAYER.pt: Descreve algo ou alguém de alto valor, estimado por sua raridade ou importância, ou digno de profundo respeito e honra. 1. Pertençente a algo de valor excepcional ou custoso (1Pe 1.19). | 2. Digno de honra, respeito e alta estima (Hb 13.4; At 5.34).
THAYER.en: Describes something or someone of high value, esteemed for its rarity or importance, or worthy of deep respect and honor. 1. Belonging to something of exceptional value or costly (1Pet 1:19). | 2. Worthy of honor, respect, and high esteem (Heb 13:4; Acts 5:34).

DEFINITION: Abundance of precious goods, opulence, or the high value of material possessions.
SENSES: 1. A great quantity of high-value goods and material wealth (Rev 18:19).

THAYER.pt: Abundância de bens preciosos, opulência ou o alto valor de posses materiais. 1. Grande quantidade de bens de alto valor e riqueza material (Ap 18:19).
THAYER.en: Abundance of precious goods, opulence, or the high value of material possessions. 1. A great quantity of high-value goods and material wealth (Rev 18:19).

DEFINITION: Proper name of a young disciple from Lystra, beloved traveling companion and co-worker of the apostle Paulo, to whom two New Testament epistles were addressed.
SENSES: 1. Timothy, the faithful Pauline co-worker (Acts 16:1; 1Tm 1:2).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio de um jovem discípulo de Listra, amado companheiro de viagens e cooperador do apóstolo Paulo, a quem foram endereçadas duas epístolas do Novo Testamento. 1. Timóteo, o fiel colaborador paulino (At 16.1; 1Tm 1.2).
THAYER.en: Proper name of a young disciple from Lystra, beloved traveling companion and co-worker of the apostle Paulo, to whom two New Testament epistles were addressed. 1. Timothy, the faithful Pauline co-worker (Acts 16:1; 1Tm 1:2).

DEFINITION: Name of one of the seven men chosen in Jerusalem to assist in the daily administration of the early church.
SENSES: 1. Timon, one of the seven deacons or administrators of the early church (Acts 6:5).

THAYER.pt: Nome de um dos sete homens escolhidos em Jerusalém para auxiliar na administração diária da igreja primitiva. 1. Timon, um dos sete diáconos ou administradores da igreja primitiva (At 6:5).
THAYER.en: Name of one of the seven men chosen in Jerusalem to assist in the daily administration of the early church. 1. Timon, one of the seven deacons or administrators of the early church (Acts 6:5).

DEFINITION: To inflict punishment or chastisement on someone based on their guilt or desert for wrong behavior.
SENSES: 1. To punish or inflict judicial chastisement on someone (Acts 26:11).

THAYER.pt: Infligir punição ou castigo a alguém com base em sua culpa ou merecimento por uma conduta errada. 1. Punir ou infligir castigo judicial a alguém (At 26.11).
THAYER.en: To inflict punishment or chastisement on someone based on their guilt or desert for wrong behavior. 1. To punish or inflict judicial chastisement on someone (Acts 26:11).

DEFINITION: The act of inflicting a penalty or suffering as just retribution for a fault or crime.
SENSES: 1. Punishment or severe chastisement applied for transgression (Heb 10:29).

THAYER.pt: Ação de infligir penalidade ou sofrimento como retribuição justa por uma falta ou crime. 1. Punição ou castigo severo aplicado por transgressão (Hb 10:29).
THAYER.en: The act of inflicting a penalty or suffering as just retribution for a fault or crime. 1. Punishment or severe chastisement applied for transgression (Heb 10:29).

DEFINITION: To experience the consequences of a wrong act, suffering due punishment or penalty.
SENSES: 1. To suffer the deserved punishment or retribution for an action (2Th 1:9).

THAYER.pt: Experimentar as consequências de um ato errado, sofrendo a devida punição ou penalidade. 1. Sofrer a punição ou retribuição merecida por uma ação (2Ts 1:9).
THAYER.en: To experience the consequences of a wrong act, suffering due punishment or penalty. 1. To suffer the deserved punishment or retribution for an action (2Th 1:9).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Indefinite enclitic pronoun. Gen: τινός, Dat: τινί
DEFINITION: Indefinite enclitic pronoun and adjective alluding to an unidentified or intentionally generic individual, entity, or fraction.
SENSES: 1. Substantive masculine/feminine: someone, a certain person (Lk 7:36; 8:46).
2. Substantive neuter: something, a certain thing (Acts 17:21; Gal 6:3).
3. Adjective attached to a noun: a certain, some (Lk 10:25; Acts 5:1).

THAYER.pt: Pronome e adjetivo indefinido enclítico que alude a um indivíduo, entidade ou fração não identificada ou intencionalmente genérica. 1. Substantivado masculino/feminino: alguém, certa pessoa (Lc 7.36; 8.46). | 2. Substantivado neutro: algo, alguma coisa (At 17.21; Gl 6.3). | 3. Adjetivo ligado a substantivo: certo, determinado, algum (Lc 10.25; At 5.1).
THAYER.en: Indefinite enclitic pronoun and adjective alluding to an unidentified or intentionally generic individual, entity, or fraction. 1. Substantive masculine/feminine: someone, a certain person (Lk 7:36; 8:46). | 2. Substantive neuter: something, a certain thing (Acts 17:21; Gal 6:3). | 3. Adjective attached to a noun: a certain, some (Lk 10:25; Acts 5:1).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Interrogative pronoun. Gen: τίνος, Dat: τίνι, always with acute accent
DEFINITION: Direct or indirect interrogative pronoun used to question the identity of persons or the nature and property of things.
SENSES: 1. Personal interrogative referring to human or divine beings: who? (Mt 16:13; Rom 8:31).
2. Neuter interrogative relating to things or facts: what?, what thing? (Mt 6:31; Jn 18:38).
3. Neuter adverbial use asking the reason: why?, for what reason? (Mt 9:4; Acts 7:26).

THAYER.pt: Pronome interrogativo direto ou indireto utilizado para questionar a identidade de pessoas ou a natureza e propriedade de coisas. 1. Interrogativo pessoal referente a seres humanos ou divinos: quem? (Mt 16.13; Rm 8.31). | 2. Interrogativo neutro relativo a coisas ou fatos: o que?, que coisa? (Mt 6.31; Jo 18.38). | 3. Emprego neutro adverbial interrogando a razão: por que?, com que motivo? (Mt 9.4; At 7.26).
THAYER.en: Direct or indirect interrogative pronoun used to question the identity of persons or the nature and property of things. 1. Personal interrogative referring to human or divine beings: who? (Mt 16:13; Rom 8:31). | 2. Neuter interrogative relating to things or facts: what?, what thing? (Mt 6:31; Jn 18:38). | 3. Neuter adverbial use asking the reason: why?, for what reason? (Mt 9:4; Acts 7:26).

DEFINITION: A plaque, notice, or official inscription containing the identification of the crime or the reason for a condemnation.
SENSES: 1. The plaque with the inscription affixed to the cross of Jesus (Jn 19:19).

THAYER.pt: Uma placa, aviso ou inscrição oficial contendo a identificação do crime ou a razão de uma condenação. 1. A placa com a inscrição afixada na cruz de Jesus (Jo 19.19).
THAYER.en: A plaque, notice, or official inscription containing the identification of the crime or the reason for a condemnation. 1. The plaque with the inscription affixed to the cross of Jesus (Jn 19:19).

DEFINITION: Gentile collaborator and companion of the apostle Paul in the ministry, recipient of one of the pastoral epistles.
SENSES: 1. The disciple and Pauline work companion (2Cor 2:13; Tit 1:4).

THAYER.pt: Colaborador e companheiro gentio do apóstolo Paulo no ministério, destinatário de uma das epístolas pastorais. 1. O discípulo e companheiro de trabalho paulino (2Co 2.13; Tt 1.4).
THAYER.en: Gentile collaborator and companion of the apostle Paul in the ministry, recipient of one of the pastoral epistles. 1. The disciple and Pauline work companion (2Cor 2:13; Tit 1:4).

DEFINITION: Enclitic particle serving to emphasize the veracity or certainty of a statement.
SENSES: 1. Marker of emphasis on the reliability of an affirmation.

THAYER.pt: Partícula enclítica que serve para dar ênfase à veracidade ou certeza de uma declaração. 1. Marcador de ênfase na confiabilidade de uma afirmação.
THAYER.en: Enclitic particle serving to emphasize the veracity or certainty of a statement. 1. Marker of emphasis on the reliability of an affirmation.

DEFINITION: Conclusive emphatic particle introducing a logical consequence, frequently linked to exhortations.
SENSES: 1. For this exact reason, therefore, then (1Th 4:8; Heb 12:1).

THAYER.pt: Partícula enfática conclusiva que introduz uma consequência lógica, frequentemente ligada a exortações. 1. Por essa exata razão, portanto, logo (1Ts 4.8; Hb 12.1).
THAYER.en: Conclusive emphatic particle introducing a logical consequence, frequently linked to exhortations. 1. For this exact reason, therefore, then (1Th 4:8; Heb 12:1).

DEFINITION: Emphatic particle introducing a logical inference or consequence from previous premises.
SENSES: 1. Therefore, consequently, well then (Lk 20:25; 1Cor 9:26; Heb 13:13).

THAYER.en: Emphatic particle introducing a logical inference or consequence from previous premises. 1. Therefore, consequently, well then (Lk 20:25; 1Cor 9:26; Heb 13:13).

DEFINITION: Demonstrative pronoun pointing to something specific or of a singular nature.
SENSES: 1. A particular and distinct type or kind, such as this (2Pet 1:17).

THAYER.pt: Pronome demonstrativo que aponta para algo específico ou de natureza singular. 1. Um tipo ou espécie particular e distinta, tal como este (2Pe 1:17).
THAYER.en: Demonstrative pronoun pointing to something specific or of a singular nature. 1. A particular and distinct type or kind, such as this (2Pet 1:17).

DEFINITION: Correlative demonstrative pronoun pointing to a quality, species, or category previously mentioned.
SENSES: 1. Possessing such a nature or characteristic, similar to this (Mt 9:8; 2Cor 12:3).

THAYER.pt: Pronome demonstrativo correlativo que aponta para uma qualidade, espécie ou categoria previamente mencionada. 1. Que possui tal natureza ou característica, semelhante a isso (Mt 9.8; 2Co 12.3).
THAYER.en: Correlative demonstrative pronoun pointing to a quality, species, or category previously mentioned. 1. Possessing such a nature or characteristic, similar to this (Mt 9:8; 2Cor 12:3).

DEFINITION: The structural wall of a building or enclosure.
SENSES: 1. Wall of a building or enclosure (Acts 23:3).

THAYER.en: The structural wall of a building or enclosure. 1. Wall of a building or enclosure (Acts 23:3).

DEFINITION: The financial return or increase charged on the loan of money.
SENSES: 1. Interest charged on loaned capital (Mt 25:27).

THAYER.pt: O rendimento financeiro ou acréscimo cobrado sobre o empréstimo de dinheiro. 1. Juros cobrados sobre o capital emprestado (Mt 25.27).
THAYER.en: The financial return or increase charged on the loan of money. 1. Interest charged on loaned capital (Mt 25:27).

THAYER.en: To show boldness, courage, or resolution in the face of danger, opposition, or challenges, having the audacity to accomplish something. 1. To have courage or boldness to face dangers or opposition (Mt 22:46; Rom 5:7). | 2. To dare or presume to do something before authorities or norms (1Cor 6:1).

DEFINITION: Comparative form indicating a greater degree of boldness, courage, or frankness in action.
SENSES: 1. More boldly or with greater frankness (Rom 15:15).

THAYER.en: Comparative form indicating a greater degree of boldness, courage, or frankness in action. 1. More boldly or with greater frankness (Rom 15:15).

DEFINITION: An individual characterized by excessive boldness or presumption, acting without proper fear or caution regarding norms or authorities.
SENSES: 1. An audacious or daring person who acts presumptuously (2 Pet 2:10).

THAYER.pt: Indivíduo caracterizado por uma ousadia excessiva ou presunção, agindo sem o devido temor ou cautela em relação a normas ou autoridades. 1. Pessoa audaciosa ou atrevida que age com presunção (2Pe 2.10).
THAYER.en: An individual characterized by excessive boldness or presumption, acting without proper fear or caution regarding norms or authorities. 1. An audacious or daring person who acts presumptuously (2 Pet 2:10).

DEFINITION: Term denoting greater cutting or penetrating capacity, frequently used in a figurative sense to describe the incisive precision of something.

THAYER.en: A weapon or hunting instrument composed of a flexible shaft and a string, used to propel arrows at a distance. 1. Bow as a combat weapon or symbol of conquest (Rev 6:2).

DEFINITION: A precious stone known for its brilliant coloring, predominantly yellow or translucent, of great value in antiquity.

THAYER.en: A precious stone known for its brilliant coloring, predominantly yellow or translucent, of great value in antiquity. 1. Topaz, a precious gem used in the foundations of the New Jerusalem (Rev 21:20).

Lugar físico, sítio, região ou povoado (Mt 14.15; Lc 10.32; Jo 14.2). | 2. Seção ou trecho de um escrito bíblico (Lc 4.17). | 3. Posição, ofício ou responsabilidade (At 1.25). | 4. Oportunidade, espaço ou ocasião favorável (Rm 12.19; Ef 4.27; Hb 12.17).
THAYER.en: Indicates a delimited portion of space, a geographical locality, a textual excerpt of a written work, or, figuratively, a functional position or opportunity to act. 1. DEFINITION: Demonstrative pronoun expressing a great quantity, degree, or considerable extent.
SENSES: 1. So great in quantity or measure, so many (Matt 15:33; John 12:37).

THAYER.en: Demonstrative pronoun expressing a great quantity, degree, or considerable extent. 1. So great in quantity or measure, so many (Matt 15:33; John 12:37). | 2. Of such magnitude or intense degree (Matt 8:10; Heb 12:1).

SHORT_GLOSS: then, at that time, soon after
DEFINITION: Adverb marking a definite temporal reference. Can locate specific past or future events or serve as a sequential transition narrative connective that drives the successive historical plot to the next stage (especially frequent in Matthew).
SENSES: 1. At that moment, in past times ('at that time') (Matt 2:17; Gal 4:8).
2. At that specific future time (Matt 13:43; 1 Cor 13:12).
3. Immediate narrative connective: 'then', 'after this', 'thereupon' (Matt 4:1; Matt 26:14).
USAGE: then, at that time, soon after

THAYER.pt: Advérbio que marca uma referência temporal definida. Pode localizar fatos passados ou futuros específicos ou servir como conectivo narrativo de transição sequencial que impulsiona o enredo histórico sucessivo para a próxima etapa (especialmente frequente em Mateus). 1. Naquele momento, em tempos pretéritos ('naquela época') (Mt 2.17; Gl 4.8). | 2. Naquele tempo futuro específico (Mt 13.43; 1Co 13.12). | 3. Conectivo narrativo imediato: 'então', 'depois disso', 'em seguida' (Mt 4.1; Mt 26.14).
THAYER.en: Adverb marking a definite temporal reference. Can locate specific past or future events or serve as a sequential transition narrative connective that drives the successive historical plot to the next stage (especially frequent in Matthew). 1. At that moment, in past times ('at that time') (Matt 2:17; Gal 4:8). | 2. At that specific future time (Matt 13:43; 1 Cor 13:12). | 3. Immediate narrative connective: 'then', 'after this', 'thereupon' (Matt 4:1; Matt 26:14).

DEFINITION: Definite article in the genitive masculine or neuter singular, used to specify nouns.

DEFINITION: Adverb expressing strong contrast or opposition regarding a previous statement or situation.

THAYER.en: Adverb expressing strong contrast or opposition regarding a previous statement or situation. 1. On the contrary, rather, instead of this (2 Cor 2:7; Gal 2:7; 1 Pet 3:9).

DEFINITION: Crasis expression literally meaning 'the name', used adverbially to introduce someone's designation or name.
SENSES: 1. Specifying a designation or proper name (Matt 27:57).

THAYER.en: Crasis expression literally meaning 'the name', used adverbially to introduce someone's designation or name. 1. Specifying a designation or proper name (Matt 27:57).

DEFINITION: Conjunctive expression used to introduce an explanation, equivalence, or clarification of a previous statement.
SENSES: 1. Introduction of an explanatory definition or equivalence.

THAYER.en: Neuter singular demonstrative pronoun, frequently employed to point out an essential concept, fact, or word in context. 1. Pointing to a specific element of the discourse or situation.

DEFINITION: Dative plural form (masculine or neuter) of the demonstrative pronoun, indicating circumstances or beneficiaries.

DEFINITION: Designates a he-goat, a ruminant animal frequently used in the Old Testament and New Testament context as a sacrificial victim.
SENSES: 1. Male goat offered in ritual sacrifice (Heb 9:12, 13, 19).

THAYER.en: Furniture used for meals, sacred offerings, or financial transactions. 1. Table where meals or food itself are served (Matt 15:27; Luke 16:21). | 2. Counter or money-changer's table, associated with financial and banking operations (Matt 21:12).

SENSES: 1. Money-changer or banker who deals with money and financial operations (Matt 25:27).

THAYER.pt: Profissional que operava mesas de câmbio, transacionando moedas estrangeiras, guardando depósitos e movimentando recursos financeiros a juros. 1. Cambista ou banqueiro que lida com o dinheiro e operações financeiras (Mt 25.27).
THAYER.en: Professional who operated exchange tables, trading foreign currencies, holding deposits, and moving financial resources at interest. 1. Money-changer or banker who deals with money and financial operations (Matt 25:27).

DEFINITION: Bodily lesion or physical injury resulting from violence, accident, or aggression.

THAYER.pt: Lesão corporal ou ferimento físico resultante de violência, acidente ou agressão. 1. Ferida física decorrente de agressão ou acidente (Lc 10.34).
THAYER.en: Bodily lesion or physical injury resulting from violence, accident, or aggression. 1. Physical wound resulting from aggression or accident (Luke 10:34).

DEFINITION: To cause physical lesion, injury, or blow to someone's body, generally leaving marks.

THAYER.pt: Causar lesão física, ferimento ou golpe no corpo de alguém, geralmente deixando marcas. 1. Ferir fisicamente alguém (Lc 20.12; At 19.16).
THAYER.en: To cause physical lesion, injury, or blow to someone's body, generally leaving marks. 1. To physically wound someone (Luke 20:12; Acts 19:16).

DEFINITION: To bend the neck back exposing the throat, or, figuratively, to strip of disguises, leaving something completely uncovered and manifest to view.
SENSES: 1. To expose completely or leave uncovered and patent to the sight of all (Heb 4:13).

THAYER.pt: Curvar o pescoço para trás expondo a garganta, ou, em sentido figurado, despir de disfarces, deixando algo totalmente descoberto e manifesto à vista. 1. Expor completamente ou deixar descoberto e patente à visão de todos (Hb 4.13).
THAYER.en: To bend the neck back exposing the throat, or, figuratively, to strip of disguises, leaving something completely uncovered and manifest to view. 1. To expose completely or leave uncovered and patent to the sight of all (Heb 4:13).

DEFINITION: The anatomical part joining the head to the human torso.
SENSES: 1. The physical human or animal neck (Matt 18:6; Luke 15:20).
2. Used in idiomatic expressions about affectionate embraces or yokes (Acts 20:37).

THAYER.pt: A parte anatômica que une a cabeça ao tronco humano. 1. O pescoço físico humano ou animal (Mt 18.6; Lc 15.20). | 2. Usado em expressões idiomáticas sobre abraços afetuosos ou jugo (At 20.37).
THAYER.en: The anatomical part joining the head to the human torso. 1. The physical human or animal neck (Matt 18:6; Luke 15:20). | 2. Used in idiomatic expressions about affectionate embraces or yokes (Acts 20:37).

DEFINITION: Presenting irregularities on the surface; uneven, mountainous, or rocky.
SENSES: 1. Rugged, rough, or rocky terrain (Luke 3:5; Acts 27:29).

THAYER.en: Presenting irregularities on the surface; uneven, mountainous, or rocky. 1. Rugged, rough, or rocky terrain (Luke 3:5; Acts 27:29).

DEFINITION: Rugged and stony volcanic region situated southeast of Damascus and east of Galilee, mentioned in the geographical context of John the Baptist's ministry.

THAYER.pt: Região vulcânica acidentada e pedregosa situada a sudeste de Damasco e a leste da Galileia, mencionada no contexto geográfico do ministério de João Batista. 1. O distrito ou região de Traconites (Lc 3.1).
THAYER.en: Rugged and stony volcanic region situated southeast of Damascus and east of Galilee, mentioned in the geographical context of John the Baptist's ministry. 1. The district or region of Trachonitis (Luke 3:1).

DEFINITION: Cardinal numeral indicating the quantity three, with strong relevance in narrative and theological contexts of the New Testament, such as the resurrection on the third day.
SENSES: 1. The exact quantity of three units (Matt 12:40; Rev 16:13).

THAYER.en: Cardinal numeral indicating the quantity three, with strong relevance in narrative and theological contexts of the New Testament, such as the resurrection on the third day. 1. The exact quantity of three units (Matt 12:40; Rev 16:13).

THAYER.en: Indicates the action of physically trembling due to fear, cold, or before a manifestation of a transcendent and divine character. 1. To tremble with fear or physical astonishment (Mark 5:33; Luke 8:47). | 2. To shudder with reverence or profound fear before the sacred (Acts 9:6; 2 Pet 2:10).

DEFINITION: To nourish, provide physical sustenance, or raise and educate children until maturity.
SENSES: 1. To provide food and nourish (Matt 6:26; Luke 12:24).
2. To raise, educate, or care for the development of children (Luke 4:16).

THAYER.pt: Significa nutrir, fornecer sustento físico ou criar e educar os filhos até a maturidade. 1. Fornecer alimento e nutrir (Mt 6.26; Lc 12.24). | 2. Criar, educar ou cuidar do desenvolvimento de crianças (Lc 4.16).
THAYER.en: To nourish, provide physical sustenance, or raise and educate children until maturity. 1. To provide food and nourish (Matt 6:26; Luke 12:24). | 2. To raise, educate, or care for the development of children (Luke 4:16).

DEFINITION: To move rapidly with the feet or, figuratively, to strive with dedication in a spiritual career.
SENSES: 1. To run physically in a rapid manner (John 20:4; Luke 15:20).
2. Figuratively, to strive in spiritual or ministerial progress (Gal 2:2; 2 Thess 3:1).

THAYER.pt: Movimentar-se rapidamente com os pés ou, figuradamente, empenhar-se com dedicação em uma carreira espiritual. 1. Correr fisicamente de forma rápida (Jo 20.4; Lc 15.20). | 2. Figuradamente, esforçar-se no progresso espiritual ou ministerial (Gl 2.2; 2Ts 3.1).
THAYER.en: To move rapidly with the feet or, figuratively, to strive with dedication in a spiritual career. 1. To run physically in a rapid manner (John 20:4; Luke 15:20). | 2. Figuratively, to strive in spiritual or ministerial progress (Gal 2:2; 2 Thess 3:1).

DEFINITION: Cardinal numeral representing the exact value of three hundred.
SENSES: 1. The number three hundred (Mark 14:5; John 12:5).

THAYER.pt: Numeral cardinal que representa o valor exato de trezentos. 1. O número trezentos (Mc 14.5; Jo 12.5).
THAYER.en: Cardinal numeral representing the exact value of three hundred. 1. The number three hundred (Mark 14:5; John 12:5).

DEFINITION: A thorny weed or thistle that causes annoyance and unproductivity in the land.

SENSES: 1. A path, way, or beaten trail (Matt 3:3; Mark 1:3; Luke 3:4).

THAYER.en: Refers to a beaten path, trail, or narrow road formed by frequent use. 1. A path, way, or beaten trail (Matt 3:3; Mark 1:3; Luke 3:4).

DEFINITION: A continuous interval of time that spans exactly three successive years.
SENSES: 1. A prolonged period of three years (Acts 20:31).

THAYER.pt: Um intervalo de tempo contínuo que abrange exatamente três anos sucessivos. 1. Um período prolongado de três anos (At 20.31).
THAYER.en: A continuous interval of time that spans exactly three successive years. 1. A prolonged period of three years (Acts 20:31).

DEFINITION: To emit a harsh sound through friction, especially the gnashing or grinding of teeth due to intense pain, suffering, or strong emotion.

THAYER.en: To emit a harsh sound through friction, especially the gnashing or grinding of teeth due to intense pain, suffering, or strong emotion. 1. To gnash or grind the teeth due to affliction or possession (Mark 9:18).

DEFINITION: Belonging or relating to a span of time lasting three months.

THAYER.en: Indicates a physical trembling or shaking, often associated with deep fear, reverence, or anxiety in the face of solemn circumstances. 1. Trembling or shaking with fear before situations of great spiritual responsibility (Phil 2:12).
