SENSES: 1. A life of luxury and unbridled pleasures (2 Pet 2:13).
2. Excessive material comfort and splendor (Luke 7:25).

THAYER.pt: Estilo de vida caracterizado pelo excesso, busca por prazeres refinados, luxo ou festança desregrada. 1. Vida de luxúria e prazeres desenfreados (2Pe 2.13). | 2. Conforto e esplendor material excessivo (Lc 7.25).
THAYER.en: A lifestyle characterized by excess, the pursuit of refined pleasures, luxury, or unbridled revelry. 1. A life of luxury and unbridled pleasures (2 Pet 2:13). | 2. Excessive material comfort and splendor (Luke 7:25).

DEFINITION: A female proper name referring to a Christian woman dedicated to the work of the Lord in the Roman community.
SENSES: 1. Tryphosa, a Christian woman greeted by Paul for her ministerial labor (Rom 16:12).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio feminino referente a uma mulher cristã dedicada ao trabalho do Senhor na comunidade romana. 1. Trifosa, mulher cristã saudada por Paulo por seu labor ministerial (Rm 16.12).
THAYER.en: A female proper name referring to a Christian woman dedicated to the work of the Lord in the Roman community. 1. Tryphosa, a Christian woman greeted by Paul for her ministerial labor (Rom 16:12).

DEFINITION: The name of an important region and port city located in the northwest corner of Asia Minor.
SENSES: 1. The region or city of Troas visited by the apostle Paul (Acts 16:8; 2 Cor 2:12).

THAYER.pt: Nome de uma importante região e cidade portuária localizada no canto noroeste da Ásia Menor. 1. A região ou cidade de Trôade visitada pelo apóstolo Paulo (At 16:8; 2Co 2:12).
THAYER.en: The name of an important region and port city located in the northwest corner of Asia Minor. 1. The region or city of Troas visited by the apostle Paul (Acts 16:8; 2 Cor 2:12).

DEFINITION: The name of a promontory and coastal city located south of Ephesus, in the region of Asia Minor.
SENSES: 1. A geographical location mentioned in the missionary journeys (Acts 20:15).

THAYER.pt: Nome de um promontório e cidade costeira localizada ao sul de Éfeso, na região da Ásia Menor. 1. Localidade geográfica mencionada nas viagens missionárias (At 20:15).
THAYER.en: The name of a promontory and coastal city located south of Ephesus, in the region of Asia Minor. 1. A geographical location mentioned in the missionary journeys (Acts 20:15).

DEFINITION: Refers to the physical act of chewing and consuming solid food.
SENSES: 1. To chew or consume food (Matt 24:38; John 6:54).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se ao ato físico de mastigar e consumir alimentos sólidos. 1. Mastigar ou consumir alimentos (Mt 24:38; Jo 6:54).
THAYER.en: Refers to the physical act of chewing and consuming solid food. 1. To chew or consume food (Matt 24:38; John 6:54).

DEFINITION: To experience some event, reach a goal, or encounter something by circumstance.
SENSES: 1. To obtain, reach, or enjoy something (Luke 20:35; Acts 27:3).

THAYER.pt: Experimentar algum acontecimento, atingir um objetivo ou deparar-se com algo por circunstância. 1. Obter, alcançar ou desfrutar de algo (Lc 20.35; At 27.3).
THAYER.en: To experience some event, reach a goal, or encounter something by circumstance. 1. To obtain, reach, or enjoy something (Luke 20:35; Acts 27:3).

DEFINITION: The verb describes the act of subjecting someone to severe physical torment or torture, associated in the Old Testament context (cited in Hebrews) with martyrs who refused release in exchange for apostasy.
SENSES: 1. To punish or torture physically with severity (Heb 11:35).

THAYER.pt: O verbo descreve a ação de submeter alguém a severos tormentos físicos ou tortura, associada no contexto veterotestamentário (citado em Hebreus) aos mártires que recusaram a libertação em troca da apostasia. 1. Castigar ou torturar fisicamente com severidade (Hb 11.35).
THAYER.en: The verb describes the act of subjecting someone to severe physical torment or torture, associated in the Old Testament context (cited in Hebrews) with martyrs who refused release in exchange for apostasy. 1. To punish or torture physically with severity (Heb 11:35).

DEFINITION: An impression left by a blow, a pattern or model to be followed, serving as a figure, prototype, or moral example.
SENSES: 1. Physical mark left by an object, such as the scars of nails (John 20:25).
2. Model, pattern, or example of conduct to be imitated (Phil 3:17; 1 Thess 1:7).
3. Prophetic type or prefigurative figure from the Old Testament (Rom 5:14).

THAYER.pt: Impressão deixada por um golpe, padrão ou modelo a ser seguido, servindo como figura, protótipo ou exemplo moral. 1. Marca física deixada por um objeto, como as cicatrizes de pregos (Jo 20.25). | 2. Modelo, padrão ou exemplo de conduta a ser imitado (Fp 3.17; 1Ts 1.7). | 3. Tipo profético ou figura prefigurativa do Antigo Testamento (Rm 5.14).
THAYER.en: An impression left by a blow, a pattern or model to be followed, serving as a figure, prototype, or moral example. 1. Physical mark left by an object, such as the scars of nails (John 20:25). | 2. Model, pattern, or example of conduct to be imitated (Phil 3:17; 1 Thess 1:7). | 3. Prophetic type or prefigurative figure from the Old Testament (Rom 5:14).

SHORT_GLOSS: to strike, to beat, to hit
DEFINITION: To inflict physical blows on someone, whether through direct aggression or by causing bodily harm.
SENSES: 1. To strike or beat a person physically (Matt 24:49; Acts 23:2).
2. Figurative: to wound the conscience or commit a moral offense (1 Cor 8:12).
USAGE: to strike, to beat, to hit

THAYER.pt: Infligir golpes físicos em alguém, seja por meio de agressão direta ou causando dano corporal. 1. Golpear ou espancar fisicamente uma pessoa (Mt 24.49; At 23.2). | 2. Figurado: ferir a consciência ou cometer ofensa moral (1Co 8.12).
THAYER.en: To inflict physical blows on someone, whether through direct aggression or by causing bodily harm. 1. To strike or beat a person physically (Matt 24:49; Acts 23:2). | 2. Figurative: to wound the conscience or commit a moral offense (1 Cor 8:12).

DEFINITION: Proper name of a man in Ephesus, owner of a school or lecture hall (σχολή) where the apostle Paul debated and taught daily after separating from the synagogue.
SENSES: 1. Tyrannus, an inhabitant of Ephesus in whose school Paul taught (Acts 19:9).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio de um homem em Éfeso, dono de uma escola ou auditório (σχολή) onde o apóstolo Paulo debateu e ensinou diariamente após a separação da sinagoga. 1. Tirano, habitante de Éfeso em cuja escola Paulo ensinava (At 19.9).
THAYER.en: Proper name of a man in Ephesus, owner of a school or lecture hall (σχολή) where the apostle Paul debated and taught daily after separating from the synagogue. 1. Tyrannus, an inhabitant of Ephesus in whose school Paul taught (Acts 19:9).

SHORT_GLOSS: to be troubled, to be anxious
DEFINITION: To agitate, disturb, or cause mental or emotional restlessness, frequently as a reflection of anxiety.
SENSES: 1. To be excessively worried or agitated about many things (Luke 10:41).
USAGE: to be troubled, to be anxious

THAYER.pt: Agitar, perturbar ou causar inquietação mental ou emocional, frequentemente sob reflexo de ansiedade. 1. Estar excessivamente preocupado ou agitado com muitas coisas (Lc 10:41).
THAYER.en: To agitate, disturb, or cause mental or emotional restlessness, frequently as a reflection of anxiety. 1. To be excessively worried or agitated about many things (Luke 10:41).

DEFINITION: Gentilic term or adjective designating an inhabitant or native of the Phoenician city of Tyre, an important commercial port of the Mediterranean.
SENSES: 1. Relating or belonging to Tyre; used as a noun for a Tyrian, a native of that city (Acts 12:20).

THAYER.pt: Termo gentílico ou adjetivo que designa um habitante ou natural da cidade fenícia de Tiro, importante porto comercial do Mediterrâneo. 1. Relativo ou pertencente a Tiro; substantivado como tírio, nativo daquela cidade (At 12.20).
THAYER.en: Gentilic term or adjective designating an inhabitant or native of the Phoenician city of Tyre, an important commercial port of the Mediterranean. 1. Relating or belonging to Tyre; used as a noun for a Tyrian, a native of that city (Acts 12:20).

DEFINITION: Ancient and important Phoenician city located on the coast of the Mediterranean Sea, frequently mentioned alongside Sidon.
SENSES: 1. The coastal city of Tyre (Matt 11:21; Acts 21:3).

THAYER.pt: Antiga e importante cidade fenícia localizada na costa do Mar Mediterrâneo, frequentemente mencionada junto com Sidom. 1. A cidade costeira de Tiro (Mt 11.21; At 21.3).
THAYER.en: Ancient and important Phoenician city located on the coast of the Mediterranean Sea, frequently mentioned alongside Sidon. 1. The coastal city of Tyre (Matt 11:21; Acts 21:3).

DEFINITION: Deprived of physical sight. It is applied profusely in miracle narratives and extended metaphorically to point to the spiritual and cognitive inability to grasp the truth of God.
SENSES: 1. Blind in the physical sense (Matt 9:27; Mark 8:22; John 9:1).
2. Spiritually blind; unable to discern revealed truth (Matt 15:14; John 9:39-41; Rev 3:17).

THAYER.pt: Privado da visão física. É aplicado profusamente nas narrativas de milagres e ampliado metaforicamente para apontar a incapacidade espiritual e cognitiva de apreender a verdade de Deus. 1. Cego no sentido físico (Mt 9.27; Mc 8.22; Jo 9.1). | 2. Cego espiritualmente; incapaz de discernir a verdade revelada (Mt 15.14; Jo 9.39-41; Ap 3.17).
THAYER.en: Deprived of physical sight. It is applied profusely in miracle narratives and extended metaphorically to point to the spiritual and cognitive inability to grasp the truth of God. 1. Blind in the physical sense (Matt 9:27; Mark 8:22; John 9:1). | 2. Spiritually blind; unable to discern revealed truth (Matt 15:14; John 9:39-41; Rev 3:17).

SHORT_GLOSS: to blind, to dull, to harden
DEFINITION: Means to deprive of physical sight or, figuratively, to incapacitate someone from understanding spiritual truth.
SENSES: 1. To literally blind sight (John 12:40);
2. To blind the mind or spiritual understanding (2 Cor 4:4; 1 John 2:11).
USAGE: to blind, to dull, to harden

THAYER.pt: Significa privar da visão física ou, figuradamente, incapacitar alguém de compreender a verdade espiritual. 1. Cegar literalmente a visão (Jo 12.40); | 2. Cegar a mente ou o entendimento espiritual (2Co 4.4; 1Jo 2.11).
THAYER.en: Means to deprive of physical sight or, figuratively, to incapacitate someone from understanding spiritual truth. 1. To literally blind sight (John 12:40); | 2. To blind the mind or spiritual understanding (2 Cor 4:4; 1 John 2:11).

SHORT_GLOSS: to be puffed up, to be conceited
DEFINITION: Means to fill with pride, arrogance, or presumption, figuratively like smoke that blinds and inflates the ego.
SENSES: 1. To be puffed up with pride, to become arrogant or vain (1 Tim 3:6; 1 Tim 6:4; 2 Tim 3:4).
USAGE: to be puffed up, to be conceited

THAYER.pt: Significa encher de orgulho, soberba ou presunção, figuradamente como fumaça que cega e incha o ego. 1. Ensoberbecer-se, tornar-se orgulhoso ou vaidoso (1Tm 3.6; 1Tm 6.4; 2Tm 3.4).
THAYER.en: Means to fill with pride, arrogance, or presumption, figuratively like smoke that blinds and inflates the ego. 1. To be puffed up with pride, to become arrogant or vain (1 Tim 3:6; 1 Tim 6:4; 2 Tim 3:4).

DEFINITION: Indicates the emission of smoke without a living flame, denoting a state of weak combustion, smoldering, or the dying glow of a wick that has not yet completely extinguished.
SENSES: 1. To emit smoke, to smolder, or to burn weakly like a wick (Matt 12:20).

THAYER.pt: Indica a emissão de fumaça sem chama viva, denotando um estado de combustão fraca, fumegante ou o brilho moribundo de um pavio que ainda não se apagou completamente. 1. Emitir fumaça, fumegar ou arder debilmente como um pavio (Mt 12.20).
THAYER.en: Indicates the emission of smoke without a living flame, denoting a state of weak combustion, smoldering, or the dying glow of a wick that has not yet completely extinguished. 1. To emit smoke, to smolder, or to burn weakly like a wick (Matt 12:20).

DEFINITION: Adjective that qualifies a wind of extraordinary and violent force, similar to a typhoon, hurricane, or cyclonic storm that threatens ships.
SENSES: 1. Similar to a typhoon or hurricane, violent and tempestuous (Acts 27:14).

THAYER.pt: Adjetivo que qualifica um vento de força extraordinária e violenta, semelhante a um tufão, furacão ou tempestade ciclônica que ameaça embarcações. 1. Semelhante a um tufão ou furacão, violento e tempestuoso (At 27.14).
THAYER.en: Adjective that qualifies a wind of extraordinary and violent force, similar to a typhoon, hurricane, or cyclonic storm that threatens ships. 1. Similar to a typhoon or hurricane, violent and tempestuous (Acts 27:14).

DEFINITION: Name of a Christian from the province of Asia who was a traveling companion of the apostle Paul and a bearer of apostolic letters.
SENSES: 1. Tychicus, a collaborator of Paul and a reliable messenger (Eph 6:21; Col 4:7).

THAYER.pt: Nome de um cristão da província da Ásia que foi companheiro de viagens do apóstolo Paulo e portador de cartas apostólicas. 1. Tíquico, colaborador de Paulo e mensageiro confiável (Ef 6.21; Cl 4.7).
THAYER.en: Name of a Christian from the province of Asia who was a traveling companion of the apostle Paul and a bearer of apostolic letters. 1. Tychicus, a collaborator of Paul and a reliable messenger (Eph 6:21; Col 4:7).

DEFINITION: Describes the color of the hyacinth flower, associated in biblical literature with a dark, predominantly bluish tone, used to qualify breastplates in eschatological visions.
SENSES: 1. Of the color of the hyacinth, dark blue (Rev 9:17).

THAYER.pt: Descreve a cor da flor do jacinto, associada na literatura bíblica a um tom escuro, predominantemente azulado, usado para qualificar couraças visões escatológicas. 1. Da cor do jacinto, azul-escuro (Ap 9.17).
THAYER.en: Describes the color of the hyacinth flower, associated in biblical literature with a dark, predominantly bluish tone, used to qualify breastplates in eschatological visions. 1. Of the color of the hyacinth, dark blue (Rev 9:17).

DEFINITION: Designates both the hyacinth flower and a precious gem of bluish coloration, mentioned as an ornamental element in the foundations of the New Jerusalem.
SENSES: 1. Hyacinth, a precious stone of a bluish tone (Rev 21:20).

THAYER.pt: Designa tanto a flor de jacinto quanto uma gema preciosa de coloração azulada, mencionada como elemento ornamental nas fundações da Nova Jerusalém. 1. Jacinto, pedra preciosa de tom azulado (Ap 21.20).
THAYER.en: Designates both the hyacinth flower and a precious gem of bluish coloration, mentioned as an ornamental element in the foundations of the New Jerusalem. 1. Hyacinth, a precious stone of a bluish tone (Rev 21:20).

DEFINITION: That which is made of glass or possesses the clear and crystalline transparency characteristic of glass.
SENSES: 1. Made of glass or transparent like glass (Rev 4:6; Rev 15:2).

THAYER.pt: Que é feito de vidro ou possui a transparência límpida e cristalina característica do vidro. 1. Feito de vidro ou transparente como o vidro (Ap 4.6; Ap 15.2).
THAYER.en: That which is made of glass or possesses the clear and crystalline transparency characteristic of glass. 1. Made of glass or transparent like glass (Rev 4:6; Rev 15:2).

DEFINITION: Transparent or translucent substance, whether manufactured glass or pure crystalline quartz.
SENSES: 1. Transparent crystal or translucent precious stone (Rev 21:18).
2. Glass material (Rev 21:21).

THAYER.pt: Substância transparente ou translúcida, seja vidro fabricado ou quartzo cristalino puro. 1. Cristal transparente ou pedra preciosa translúcida (Ap 21.18). | 2. Material de vidro (Ap 21.21).
THAYER.en: Transparent or translucent substance, whether manufactured glass or pure crystalline quartz. 1. Transparent crystal or translucent precious stone (Rev 21:18). | 2. Glass material (Rev 21:21).

SHORT_GLOSS: to mistreat, to insult, to abuse
DEFINITION: To treat someone with insolence, contempt, mockery, or verbal and physical violence, wounding their dignity.
SENSES: 1. To offend, insult, or mistreat someone in an insolent manner (Matt 22:6; Luke 18:32).
USAGE: to mistreat, to insult, to abuse

THAYER.pt: Tratar alguém com insolência, desprezo, escárnio ou violência verbal e física, ferindo sua dignidade. 1. Ofender, injuriar ou maltratar alguém de forma insolente (Mt 22.6; Lc 18.32).
THAYER.en: To treat someone with insolence, contempt, mockery, or verbal and physical violence, wounding their dignity. 1. To offend, insult, or mistreat someone in an insolent manner (Matt 22:6; Luke 18:32).

DEFINITION: Describes arrogant insolence, outrageous treatment, or the severe damage resulting from violence or storms.
SENSES: 1. Injury, outrage, or shameful treatment (2 Cor 12:10);
2. Damage, loss, or disaster caused by bad weather (Acts 27:10, 21).

THAYER.pt: Descreve insolência arrogante, tratamento ultrajante ou o dano severo resultante de violência ou tempestades. 1. Injúria, ultraje ou tratamento vergonhoso (2Co 12.10); | 2. Dano, prejuízo ou desastre causado por intempéries (At 27.10,21).
THAYER.en: Describes arrogant insolence, outrageous treatment, or the severe damage resulting from violence or storms. 1. Injury, outrage, or shameful treatment (2 Cor 12:10); | 2. Damage, loss, or disaster caused by bad weather (Acts 27:10, 21).

DEFINITION: Individual who treats others with extreme arrogance, verbal insults, and physical violence.
SENSES: 1. An insolent, overbearing, and violent person (Rom 1:30; 1 Tim 1:13).

THAYER.pt: Indivíduo que trata os outros com extrema arrogância, insultos verbais e violência física. 1. Pessoa insolente, prepotente e violenta (Rm 1.30; 1Tm 1.13).
THAYER.en: Individual who treats others with extreme arrogance, verbal insults, and physical violence. 1. An insolent, overbearing, and violent person (Rom 1:30; 1 Tim 1:13).

SHORT_GLOSS: to be healthy, to be sound
DEFINITION: To be in good physical condition or to remain free from doctrinal corruption, expressing soundness and correctness.
SENSES: 1. To enjoy good physical health (Lk 5:31; 3 Jn 1:2).
2. To be spiritually sound or correct in doctrine (1 Tm 1:10; Ti 1:9).
USAGE: to be healthy, to be sound

THAYER.pt: Estar em boas condições físicas ou manter-se livre de corrupção doutrinária, expressando solidez e correção. 1. Desfrutar de boa saúde física (Lc 5.31; 3Jo 1.2). | 2. Estar espiritualmente são ou correto na doutrina (1Tm 1.10; Tt 1.9).
THAYER.en: To be in good physical condition or to remain free from doctrinal corruption, expressing soundness and correctness. 1. To enjoy good physical health (Lk 5:31; 3 Jn 1:2). | 2. To be spiritually sound or correct in doctrine (1 Tm 1:10; Ti 1:9).

DEFINITION: Describes someone who is physically whole and healthy, or a doctrine that is perfectly correct and sound.
SENSES: 1. Physically healed, healthy, or in good health (Mt 15:31; Jn 5:11).
2. Correct, pure, and free from error (Ti 2:8).

THAYER.pt: Descreve alguém que está fisicamente íntegro e saudável, ou uma doutrina que é perfeitamente correta e sã. 1. Fisicamente curado, sadio ou bem de saúde (Mt 15.31; Jo 5.11). | 2. Correto, puro e livre de erros (Tt 2.8).
THAYER.en: Describes someone who is physically whole and healthy, or a doctrine that is perfectly correct and sound. 1. Physically healed, healthy, or in good health (Mt 15:31; Jn 5:11). | 2. Correct, pure, and free from error (Ti 2:8).

DEFINITION: Refers to the state of moisture, freshness, or flexibility, used specifically for freshly cut wood full of sap, in contrast to dry wood.
SENSES: 1. Moist, fresh, or green, applied to flexible wood full of sap (Lk 23:31).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se ao estado de umidade, frescor ou flexibilidade, sendo usado especificamente para madeira recém-cortada e cheia de seiva, em contraste com a madeira seca. 1. Úmido, fresco ou verde, aplicado a madeira flexível e cheia de seiva (Lc 23.31).
THAYER.en: Refers to the state of moisture, freshness, or flexibility, used specifically for freshly cut wood full of sap, in contrast to dry wood. 1. Moist, fresh, or green, applied to flexible wood full of sap (Lk 23:31).

DEFINITION: A large earthenware vessel or jar used for carrying, storing, or serving water.
SENSES: 1. A large pot or jar for water (Jn 2:6, 7; Jn 4:28).

THAYER.pt: Grande vaso ou jarro de barro utilizado para carregar, armazenar ou servir água. 1. Pote ou jarro grande para água (Jo 2.6,7; Jo 4.28).
THAYER.en: A large earthenware vessel or jar used for carrying, storing, or serving water. 1. A large pot or jar for water (Jn 2:6, 7; Jn 4:28).

DEFINITION: Verb meaning to abstain from wine or other fermented drinks for health or ascetic reasons, strictly limiting oneself to water consumption.
SENSES: 1. Drink only water, adopt an abstemious diet (1Tm 5.23).

THAYER.pt: Verbo que significa abster-se de vinho ou outras bebidas fermentadas por razões de saúde ou ascetismo, limitando-se estritamente ao consumo de água. 1. Beber apenas água, adotar uma dieta abstêmia (1Tm 5.23).
THAYER.en: Verb meaning to abstain from wine or other fermented drinks for health or ascetic reasons, strictly limiting oneself to water consumption. 1. Drink only water, adopt an abstemious diet (1Tm 5.23).

DEFINITION: Medical term qualifying the pathological condition of an individual suffering from dropsy, characterized by abnormal accumulation of fluids in body tissues.
SENSES: 1. Afflicted with dropsy, with swelling from fluid retention (Lc 14.2).

THAYER.pt: Termo médico que qualifica a condição patológica de um indivíduo que sofre de hidropisia, caracterizada pelo acúmulo anormal de líquidos nos tecidos do corpo. 1. Acometido por hidropisia, com inchaço por retenção de líquidos (Lc 14.2).
THAYER.en: Medical term qualifying the pathological condition of an individual suffering from dropsy, characterized by abnormal accumulation of fluids in body tissues. 1. Afflicted with dropsy, with swelling from fluid retention (Lc 14.2).

DEFINITION: The liquid element essential to physical life; used literally as drink and baptismal agent, as well as a metaphor for regeneration and the Spirit of God.
SENSES: 1. Natural substance of lakes, seas, springs, or rain (Mt 8.32; Tg 3.12).
2. Material element used in the ritual of baptism (Mt 3.11; At 8.36; 1Pe 3.20).
3. Metaphor for spiritual life, inner renewal, and grace granted by the Holy Spirit (Jo 4.10; Jo 7.38; Ap 22.1).

THAYER.pt: O elemento líquido essencial à vida física; usado literalmente como bebida e agente de batismo, bem como metáfora da regeneração e do Espírito de Deus. 1. Substância natural de lagos, mares, fontes ou chuva (Mt 8.32; Tg 3.12). | 2. Elemento material empregado no ritual do batismo (Mt 3.11; At 8.36; 1Pe 3.20). | 3. Metáfora de vida espiritual, renovação interior e graça concedida pelo Espírito Santo (Jo 4.10; Jo 7.38; Ap 22.1).
THAYER.en: The liquid element essential to physical life; used literally as drink and baptismal agent, as well as a metaphor for regeneration and the Spirit of God. 1. Natural substance of lakes, seas, springs, or rain (Mt 8.32; Tg 3.12). | 2. Material element used in the ritual of baptism (Mt 3.11; At 8.36; 1Pe 3.20). | 3. Metaphor for spiritual life, inner renewal, and grace granted by the Holy Spirit (Jo 4.10; Jo 7.38; Ap 22.1).

DEFINITION: Designates the precipitation of water from the atmosphere, the rain that waters the earth and makes agriculture and plant life possible.
SENSES: 1. Rain as a gift of divine providence in nature (At 14.17; Hb 6.7).

THAYER.pt: Designa a precipitação de água da atmosfera, a chuva que rega a terra e possibilita a agricultura e a vida vegetal. 1. Chuva como dádiva da providência divina na natureza (At 14.17; Hb 6.7).
THAYER.en: Designates the precipitation of water from the atmosphere, the rain that waters the earth and makes agriculture and plant life possible. 1. Rain as a gift of divine providence in nature (At 14.17; Hb 6.7).

DEFINITION: Legal term denoting the act of legally adopting someone as a son, conferring upon them all the rights, privileges, and inheritance of the family.
SENSES: 1. The spiritual adoption of believers as children of God through Christ (Rm 8.15; Gl 4.5).

THAYER.pt: Termo jurídico que denota o ato de adotar legalmente alguém como filho, conferindo-lhe todos os direitos, privilégios e herança da família. 1. A adoção espiritual dos crentes como filhos de Deus por meio de Cristo (Rm 8.15; Gl 4.5).
THAYER.en: Legal term denoting the act of legally adopting someone as a son, conferring upon them all the rights, privileges, and inheritance of the family. 1. The spiritual adoption of believers as children of God through Christ (Rm 8.15; Gl 4.5).

DEFINITION: Direct or remote male descendant of a person, as well as an individual who exhibits the character and nature of a moral father; christological title par excellence.
SENSES: 1. Son in the strict biological or legal sense of kinship (Mt 1.21; Lc 15.11).
2. Descendant in a continuous line of genealogy (Mt 1.1; 9.27).
3. Messianic and divine title attributed to Jesus: Son of God or Son of Man (Mt 16.16; Jo 5.19).

THAYER.pt: Descendente masculino direto ou remoto de uma pessoa, bem como indivíduo que exibe o caráter e natureza de um pai moral; título cristológico por excelência. 1. Filho no sentido biológico ou legal estrito de parentesco (Mt 1.21; Lc 15.11). | 2. Descendente em linha contínua de genealogia (Mt 1.1; 9.27). | 3. Título messiânico e divino atribuído a Jesus: Filho de Deus ou Filho do Homem (Mt 16.16; Jo 5.19).
THAYER.en: Direct or remote male descendant of a person, as well as an individual who exhibits the character and nature of a moral father; christological title par excellence. 1. Son in the strict biological or legal sense of kinship (Mt 1.21; Lc 15.11). | 2. Descendant in a continuous line of genealogy (Mt 1.1; 9.27). | 3. Messianic and divine title attributed to Jesus: Son of God or Son of Man (Mt 16.16; Jo 5.19).

DEFINITION: Originally denotes a dense grove, thicket, or pile of firewood, and can also mean the raw material from which something is made.
SENSES: 1. Large quantity of bushes or dense forest (Tg 3.5).

THAYER.en: Originally denotes a dense grove, thicket, or pile of firewood, and can also mean the raw material from which something is made. 1. Large quantity of bushes or dense forest (Tg 3.5).

THAYER.en: Proper name of a false teacher in the early church who deviated from doctrinal truth. 1. Hymenaeus, the man handed over to Satan because of his doctrinal deviation (1Tm 1.20; 2Tm 2.17).

THAYER.en: Possessive pronoun indicating belonging or relation to the listeners or readers. 1. Belonging to you, your (Lc 6.20; Jo 8.17; 1Co 15.31).

DEFINITION: Personal pronoun of the 2nd person plural in the dative case, indicating benefit, possession, or indirect recipient.

THAYER.en: Personal pronoun of the 2nd person plural in the dative case, indicating benefit, possession, or indirect recipient. 1. Indirect object or dative of advantage/disadvantage for the listeners.

DEFINITION: Means to chant a song of praise and adoration, whether in liturgical, worship, or thanksgiving contexts to God.

THAYER.pt: Significa entoar um cântico de louvor e adoração, seja em contextos litúrgicos, de culto ou de ação de graças a Deus. 1. Cantar hinos de louvor a Deus (Mt 26.30; At 16.25).
THAYER.en: Means to chant a song of praise and adoration, whether in liturgical, worship, or thanksgiving contexts to God. 1. Sing hymns of praise to God (Mt 26.30; At 16.25).

SENSES: 1. Sacred song of praise and adoration (Ef 5.19; Cl 3.16).

THAYER.pt: Cântico ou composição poética com conteúdo religioso dedicado ao louvor de Deus. 1. Cântico sagrado de louvor e adoração (Ef 5.19; Cl 3.16).
THAYER.en: Song or poetic composition with religious content dedicated to the praise of God. 1. Sacred song of praise and adoration (Ef 5.19; Cl 3.16).

DEFINITION: Personal pronoun of the 2nd person plural in the genitive case, indicating a relation of belonging or origin.
SENSES: 1. Relation of possession or source associated with the listeners (your).

THAYER.pt: Pronome pessoal da 2ª pessoa do plural no caso genitivo, indicando relação de pertencimento ou origem. 1. Relação de posse ou fonte associada aos ouvintes (vosso).
THAYER.en: Personal pronoun of the 2nd person plural in the genitive case, indicating a relation of belonging or origin. 1. Relation of possession or source associated with the listeners (your).

THAYER.pt: Afastar-se ou retirar-se da presença de alguém, caminhar em direção a um destino específico; no Quarto Evangelho expressa o retorno soberano de Jesus ao Pai. 1. Partir, ir embora ou retirar-se (Mt 4.10; Mc 6.31). | 2. Prosseguir a caminhada ou seguir um caminho específico (Mt 8.13; Jo 21.3). | 3. Euphemismo para a morte e o retorno de Jesus ao Pai celestial (Jo 8.14; Jo 13.3; Jo 16.5).
THAYER.en: To move away or withdraw from someone's presence, to walk toward a specific destination; in the Fourth Gospel it expresses Jesus' sovereign return to the Father. 1. Depart, go away, or withdraw (Mt 4.10; Mc 6.31). | 2. Continue walking or follow a specific path (Mt 8.13; Jo 21.3). | 3. Euphemism for death and Jesus' return to the heavenly Father (Jo 8.14; Jo 13.3; Jo 16.5).

DEFINITION: Attitude of submitting to an authority or instruction after listening to it attentively.
SENSES: 1. The state or act of obeying God, His word, or moral precepts (Rm 6.16; 10.2).

THAYER.en: Attitude of submitting to an authority or instruction after listening to it attentively. 1. The state or act of obeying God, His word, or moral precepts (Rm 6.16; 10.2).

THAYER.pt: Ouir com atenção para acatar ordens ou instruções, submetendo-se à autoridade legítima de quem fala. 1. Obedecer a ordens, instruções ou autoridades (Ef 6.1; Fp 2.12). | 2. Atender a uma chamada ou porta (At 12.13).
THAYER.en: To listen attentively to heed orders or instructions, submitting to the legitimate authority of the speaker. 1. Obey orders, instructions, or authorities (Ef 6.1; Fp 2.12). | 2. Answer a call or a door (At 12.13).

THAYER.en: Adjective describing a woman who is legally and institutionally bound to a husband by the matrimonial covenant. 1. Married, legally bound to a husband (Rm 7.2).

THAYER.pt: Ir ao encontro de alguém para se aproximar, podendo ocorrer em um contexto amigável ou de oposição. 1. Ir ao encontro de alguém de maneira amigável ou receptiva (Mt 8.28). | 2. Encontrar-se com alguém em sentido hostil, opor-se (Lc 14.31).
THAYER.en: To go to meet someone in order to approach, which can occur in a friendly or oppositional context. 1. Go to meet someone in a friendly or receptive manner (Mt 8.28). | 2. Meet someone in a hostile sense, oppose (Lc 14.31).

THAYER.en: The act of going to meet someone to receive them, whether in a peaceful and hospitable or hostile context. 1. Act of coming to meet someone (Mt 8.34; Jo 12.13).

DEFINITION: The set of possessions, riches, or material goods that someone owns.

THAYER.en: The set of possessions, riches, or material goods that someone owns. 1. Material goods, properties, and possessions (At 2.45; Hb 10.34).

THAYER.en: That which belongs to someone, encompassing properties, wealth, and material goods owned. 1. Material goods and wealth that a person possesses (At 4:32; Lc 8:3).

THAYER.en: Indicates the real existence of something or someone, often emphasizing a prior state, persistent condition, or possession. 1. Exist or be present in a given situation (At 19.40; 1Co 11.18). | 2. Be in a condition or be inherently of a certain way (Lc 8.41; 16.14).

THAYER.en: Means to yield before a legitimate authority, recognize someone's leadership, and willingly subordinate oneself to established guidelines. 1. Submit to authority, yield, or obey leaders (Hb 13.17).

DEFINITION: Versatile preposition expressing representation, benefit, cause, or superiority. With genitive indicates vicarious action or interest of another; with accusative denotes exceeding a measure or standard.

2. With genitive: concerning, about (2Co 1.8; 2Ts 2.1).

Com genitivo: em favor de, em benefício de, em lugar de (Rm 5.8; 2Co 5.14). | 2. Com genitivo: a respeito de, concernente a (2Co 1.8; 2Ts 2.1). | 3. Com acusativo: acima de, além de, superior a (Mt 10.37; Ef 1.22). | 4. Uso adverbial: excessivamente, muito mais (2Co 11.23).
THAYER.en: Versatile preposition expressing representation, benefit, cause, or superiority. With genitive indicates vicarious action or interest of another; with accusative denotes exceeding a measure or standard. 1. With genitive: on behalf of, in favor of, in place of (Rm 5.8; 2Co 5.14). | 2. With genitive: concerning, about (2Co 1.8; 2Ts 2.1). | 3. With accusative: above, beyond, superior to (Mt 10.37; Ef 1.22). | 4. Adverbial use: excessively, much more (2Co 11.23).
