DEFINITION: An adverb expressing a superlative degree of intensity, denoting something that vastly exceeds all ordinary measure.
SENSES: 1. Extremely, exceedingly, beyond all common measure (Mk 7.37).

THAYER.pt: Advérbio que expressa um grau superlativo de intensidade, denotando algo que excede amplamente toda medida ordinária. 1. Extremamente, sobremaneira, além de toda medida comum (Mc 7.37).
THAYER.en: An adverb expressing a superlative degree of intensity, denoting something that vastly exceeds all ordinary measure. 1. Extremely, exceedingly, beyond all common measure (Mk 7.37).

DEFINITION: Meaning to be extremely abundant or to overflow to a great degree, indicating an amount or degree that goes far beyond normal.
SENSES: 1. To be superabundant or overflow in grace and faith (1Tm 1.14).

THAYER.pt: Significa ser extremamente abundante ou transbordar em grande medida, indicando uma quantidade ou grau que vai muito além do normal. 1. Ser superabundante ou transbordar em graça e fé (1Tm 1.14).
THAYER.en: Meaning to be extremely abundant or to overflow to a great degree, indicating an amount or degree that goes far beyond normal. 1. To be superabundant or overflow in grace and faith (1Tm 1.14).

DEFINITION: Describes the action of elevating someone to the highest position of honor, dignity, and authority.
SENSES: 1. To raise to the highest point of honor and glory, applied to Christ after his exaltation (Php 2.9).

THAYER.pt: Descreve a ação de elevar alguém à mais alta posição de honra, dignidade e autoridade. 1. Elevar ao mais alto ponto de honra e glória, aplicado a Cristo após sua exaltação (Fp 2.9).
THAYER.en: Describes the action of elevating someone to the highest position of honor, dignity, and authority. 1. To raise to the highest point of honor and glory, applied to Christ after his exaltation (Php 2.9).

DEFINITION: To have an excessively high opinion of oneself, acting with presumption, haughtiness, or arrogance.
SENSES: 1. To think of oneself beyond what is proper, to harbor haughtiness (Rom 12.3).

THAYER.pt: Ter uma opinião excessivamente elevada de si mesmo, agindo com presunção, soberba ou arrogância. 1. Pensar de si mesmo além do que convém, nutrir soberba (Rm 12.3).
THAYER.en: To have an excessively high opinion of oneself, acting with presumption, haughtiness, or arrogance. 1. To think of oneself beyond what is proper, to harbor haughtiness (Rom 12.3).

DEFINITION: Refers to a room located on the upper floor of a residence, often used for meetings, prayers, and lodging.
SENSES: 1. A room or apartment on the upper floor of a house (Ac 1.13).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se a um cômodo localizado no andar superior de uma residência, muitas vezes utilizado para reuniões, orações e hospedagem. 1. Sala ou aposento no andar superior de uma casa (At 1.13).
THAYER.en: Refers to a room located on the upper floor of a residence, often used for meetings, prayers, and lodging. 1. A room or apartment on the upper floor of a house (Ac 1.13).

DEFINITION: To experience or endure something to which someone is subject, especially to bear penalties or punishments.
SENSES: 1. To suffer judicial penalty or punishment (Jud 7).

THAYER.pt: Experimentar ou suportar algo a que alguém está sujeito, especialmente arcar com penalidades ou punições. 1. Sofrer penalidade ou castigo judicial (Jd 7).
THAYER.en: To experience or endure something to which someone is subject, especially to bear penalties or punishments. 1. To suffer judicial penalty or punishment (Jud 7).

DEFINITION: Refers to someone who attentively and readily fulfills orders or is under legitimate submission.
SENSES: 1. Obedient, ready to obey authority (Ac 7.39; 2Co 2.9; Php 2.8).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se a alguém que ouve atentamente e prontamente cumpre ordens ou está sob submissão legítima. 1. Obediente, pronto a obedecer à autoridade (At 7.39; 2Co 2.9; Fp 2.8).
THAYER.en: Refers to someone who attentively and readily fulfills orders or is under legitimate submission. 1. Obedient, ready to obey authority (Ac 7.39; 2Co 2.9; Php 2.8).

DEFINITION: To render assistance, help, or service to someone, often performing practical or ministerial tasks.
SENSES: 1. To serve, render aid, or minister to someone (Ac 13.36; Ac 20.34; Ac 24.23).

THAYER.pt: Prestar assistência, ajuda ou serviço a alguém, muitas vezes desempenhando tarefas práticas ou ministeriais. 1. Servir, prestar auxílio ou ministrar a alguém (At 13.36; At 20.34; At 24.23).
THAYER.en: To render assistance, help, or service to someone, often performing practical or ministerial tasks. 1. To serve, render aid, or minister to someone (Ac 13.36; Ac 20.34; Ac 24.23).

DEFINITION: One who acts as an assistant or subordinate rendering services to another, whether in the civil, religious, or ministerial sphere.
SENSES: 1. Helper, servant, or minister of the word (Lk 1.2; Ac 13.5).
2. Court officer, guard, or subordinate of authorities (Mt 5.25; Jn 18.3).

THAYER.pt: Aquele que atua como assistente ou subordinado prestando serviços a outrem, seja no âmbito civil, religioso ou ministerial. 1. Auxiliar, servo ou ministro da palavra (Lc 1.2; At 13.5). | 2. Oficial de justiça, guarda ou subalterno de autoridades (Mt 5.25; Jo 18.3).
THAYER.en: One who acts as an assistant or subordinate rendering services to another, whether in the civil, religious, or ministerial sphere. 1. Helper, servant, or minister of the word (Lk 1.2; Ac 13.5). | 2. Court officer, guard, or subordinate of authorities (Mt 5.25; Jn 18.3).

DEFINITION: Describes the natural state of physical rest in which the senses are inactive, which can also be used metaphorically.
SENSES: 1. Literal physical sleep (Ac 20.9).
2. Metaphor for spiritual torpor (Rom 13.11).

THAYER.pt: Descreve o estado natural de repouso físico em que os sentidos estão inativos, podendo também ser usado metaphoricamente. 1. O sono físico literal (At 20:9). | 2. Metáfora para o torpor espiritual (Rm 13:11).
THAYER.en: Describes the natural state of physical rest in which the senses are inactive, which can also be used metaphorically. 1. Literal physical sleep (Ac 20.9). | 2. Metaphor for spiritual torpor (Rom 13.11).

DEFINITION: A preposition expressing subordination and causality. When governing the genitive case with passive verbs, it indicates the direct personal agent causing the action; with the accusative, it points to inferior position or legal subjection to authorities.
SENSES: 1. With genitive: marker of the passive agent: 'by', 'through' (Mt 1.22; Lk 2.18).
2. With spatial accusative: 'under', 'beneath' (Mt 8.8; Mk 4.21).
3. With accusative of jurisdiction: under the domain, tutelage, or authority of someone (Rom 6.14; Gal 3.25).

THAYER.pt: Preposição que expressa subordinação e causalidade. Quando governa o caso genitivo com verbos passivos, indica o agente pessoal causador direto da ação; com o acusativo, assinala posição inferior ou sujeição legal a autoridades. 1. Com genitivo: marcador do agente da passiva: 'por', 'por meio de' (Mt 1.22; Lc 2.18). | 2. Com acusativo espacial: 'debaixo de', 'sob' (Mt 8.8; Mc 4.21). | 3. Com acusativo de jurisdição: sob o domínio, tutela ou autoridade de alguém (Rm 6.14; Gl 3.25).
THAYER.en: A preposition expressing subordination and causality. When governing the genitive case with passive verbs, it indicates the direct personal agent causing the action; with the accusative, it points to inferior position or legal subjection to authorities. 1. With genitive: marker of the passive agent: 'by', 'through' (Mt 1.22; Lk 2.18). | 2. With spatial accusative: 'under', 'beneath' (Mt 8.8; Mk 4.21). | 3. With accusative of jurisdiction: under the domain, tutelage, or authority of someone (Rom 6.14; Gal 3.25).

DEFINITION: To suborn or secretly instigate someone to act dishonestly or utter false accusations.
SENSES: 1. To secretly instigate or suborn false witnesses (Ac 6.11).

THAYER.pt: Subornar ou instigar secretamente alguém a agir de maneira desonesta ou a proferir falsas acusações. 1. Instigar secretamente ou subornar falsas testemunhas (At 6.11).
THAYER.en: To suborn or secretly instigate someone to act dishonestly or utter false accusations. 1. To secretly instigate or suborn false witnesses (Ac 6.11).

DEFINITION: A visual form or pattern of conduct designed to be imitated or copied.
SENSES: 1. Example or model of behavior to be followed (1Pe 2.21).

THAYER.pt: Uma forma visual ou padrão de conduta desenhado para ser imitado ou copiado. 1. Exemplo ou modelo de comportamento a ser seguido (1Pe 2.21).
THAYER.en: A visual form or pattern of conduct designed to be imitated or copied. 1. Example or model of behavior to be followed (1Pe 2.21).

DEFINITION: A pattern of behavior or visual representation intended for moral instruction or copying.
SENSES: 1. A moral example to be imitated (Jn 13:15).
2. A symbol or copy of a heavenly reality (Heb 8:5).

THAYER.pt: Um padrão de comportamento ou representação visual destinada à instrução moral ou cópia. 1. Exemplo moral a ser imitado (Jo 13:15). | 2. Símbolo ou cópia de uma realidade celestial (Hb 8:5).
THAYER.en: A pattern of behavior or visual representation intended for moral instruction or copying. 1. A moral example to be imitated (Jn 13:15). | 2. A symbol or copy of a heavenly reality (Heb 8:5).

DEFINITION: Means to clearly indicate something through instruction, explanation, or practical demonstration.
SENSES: 1. To give a clear warning or moral instruction (Lk 12:5).

THAYER.pt: Significa indicar claramente algo por meio de instruções, explicações ou demonstrações práticas. 1. Dar advertência ou instrução moral clara (Lc 12:5).
THAYER.en: Means to clearly indicate something through instruction, explanation, or practical demonstration. 1. To give a clear warning or moral instruction (Lk 12:5).

DEFINITION: Describes the act of receiving someone with hospitality and friendship into one's home or presence.
SENSES: 1. To welcome or host someone as a guest (Lk 10:38).

THAYER.pt: Descreve o ato de receber alguém com hospitalidade e amizade em sua própria casa ou presença. 1. Acolher ou hospedar alguém como hóspede (Lc 10.38).
THAYER.en: Describes the act of receiving someone with hospitality and friendship into one's home or presence. 1. To welcome or host someone as a guest (Lk 10:38).

DEFINITION: Means to tie or put footwear or sandals on the feet.
SENSES: 1. To put on sandals or shoes (Acts 12:8; Eph 6:15).

THAYER.pt: Significa atar ou colocar calçados ou sandálias nos pés. 1. Calçar sandálias ou sapatos (At 12.8; Ef 6.15).
THAYER.en: Means to tie or put footwear or sandals on the feet. 1. To put on sandals or shoes (Acts 12:8; Eph 6:15).

DEFINITION: A basic type of footwear in the ancient world, consisting of a leather sole fastened to the feet by straps.
SENSES: 1. A sandal or footwear used to protect the feet (Mt 3:11; Acts 13:25).

THAYER.pt: Tipo básico de calçado do mundo antigo, consistindo em uma sola de couro presa aos pés por correias. 1. Sandália ou calçado usado para proteger os pés (Mt 3.11; Ac 13.25).
THAYER.en: A basic type of footwear in the ancient world, consisting of a leather sole fastened to the feet by straps. 1. A sandal or footwear used to protect the feet (Mt 3:11; Acts 13:25).

DEFINITION: Pertaining to the condition of being subject to judgment, responsibility, or punishment before a court.
SENSES: 1. Being subject to judgment or responsibility before God (Rom 3:19).

THAYER.pt: Pertencente à condição de estar sujeito a julgamento, responsabilidade ou punição perante um tribunal. 1. Estar sujeito ao julgamento ou responsabilidade perante Deus (Rm 3.19).
THAYER.en: Pertaining to the condition of being subject to judgment, responsibility, or punishment before a court. 1. Being subject to judgment or responsibility before God (Rom 3:19).

DEFINITION: Any domesticated animal used to carry heavy burdens or serve as a mount, such as a donkey.
SENSES: 1. A pack animal or mount, especially a donkey (Mt 21:5; 2Pet 2:16).

THAYER.pt: Qualquer animal domesticado usado para carregar fardos pesados ou servir de montaria, como o jumento. 1. Animal de carga ou montaria, especialmente um jumento (Mt 21.5; 2Pe 2.16).
THAYER.en: Any domesticated animal used to carry heavy burdens or serve as a mount, such as a donkey. 1. A pack animal or mount, especially a donkey (Mt 21:5; 2Pet 2:16).

DEFINITION: A nautical technical term for passing cables or ropes around the hull of a ship to reinforce it during storms.
SENSES: 1. To pass reinforcing cables under the ship (Acts 27:17).

THAYER.pt: Termo técnico náutico para passar cabos ou amarras ao redor do casco de um navio para reforçá-lo em tempestades. 1. Passar cabos de reforço por baixo do navio (At 27.17).
THAYER.en: A nautical technical term for passing cables or ropes around the hull of a ship to reinforce it during storms. 1. To pass reinforcing cables under the ship (Acts 27:17).

DEFINITION: Indicates a spatial position located strictly on the lower part or underside of another object.
SENSES: 1. Under, beneath, on the lower part (Mt 22:44; Mk 6:11; Heb 2:8).

THAYER.pt: Indica uma posição espacial localizada estritamente na parte inferior ou na superfície inferior de outro objeto. 1. Debaixo de, sob, na parte inferior (Mt 22.44; Mc 6.11; Hb 2.8).
THAYER.en: Indicates a spatial position located strictly on the lower part or underside of another object. 1. Under, beneath, on the lower part (Mt 22:44; Mk 6:11; Heb 2:8).

DEFINITION: To give the impression of having noble purposes or motivations while actually concealing different intentions; to pretend.
SENSES: 1. To pretend to be what one is not or to act with hypocrisy (Lk 20:20).

THAYER.pt: Dar a impressão de ter propósitos ou motivações nobres, enquanto na realidade oculta intenções diferentes; fingir. 1. Fingir ser o que não é ou agir com hipocrisia (Lc 20.20).
THAYER.en: To give the impression of having noble purposes or motivations while actually concealing different intentions; to pretend. 1. To pretend to be what one is not or to act with hypocrisy (Lk 20:20).

DEFINITION: The act of feigning intentions or virtues one does not possess, creating a public appearance contrary to inner reality.
SENSES: 1. Pretense or hypocritical acting (Mt 23:28).

THAYER.pt: Ato de fingir intenções ou virtudes que não se possui, criando uma aparência pública contrária à realidade interior. 1. Fingimento ou atuação hipócrita (Mt 23:28).
THAYER.en: The act of feigning intentions or virtues one does not possess, creating a public appearance contrary to inner reality. 1. Pretense or hypocritical acting (Mt 23:28).

DEFINITION: Originally designated a theater actor who played a role wearing a mask. In the New Testament, it acquired a strong negative moral connotation to describe someone who pretends to be pious or virtuous, but whose real intentions are false.
SENSES: 1. One who pretends to be what they are not, a simulator or hypocrite (Mt 6:2).

THAYER.pt: Originalmente designava um ator de teatro que representava um papel com máscara. No Novo Testamento, adquiriu forte conotação moral negativa para descrever alguém que finge ser piedoso ou virtuoso, mas cujas intenções reais são falsas. 1. Aquele que finge ser o que não é, simulador ou hipócrita (Mt 6.2).
THAYER.en: Originally designated a theater actor who played a role wearing a mask. In the New Testament, it acquired a strong negative moral connotation to describe someone who pretends to be pious or virtuous, but whose real intentions are false. 1. One who pretends to be what they are not, a simulator or hypocrite (Mt 6:2).

DEFINITION: To bear multiple meanings such as to welcome, sustain, take up the word to answer, or formulate a mental supposition.
SENSES: 1. To welcome or receive someone under one's protection (3 Jn 8).
2. To take up the word to answer a question or argument (Lk 10:30).
3. To suppose, presume, or imagine something as probable (Acts 2:15).

THAYER.pt: Averbar significados múltiplos como acolher, sustentar, tomar a palavra para responder ou formular uma suposição mental. 1. Acolher ou receber alguém sob sua proteção (3Jo 8). | 2. Tomar a palavra para responder a uma pergunta ou argumento (Lc 10.30). | 3. Supor, presumir ou imaginar algo como provável (At 2.15).
THAYER.en: To bear multiple meanings such as to welcome, sustain, take up the word to answer, or formulate a mental supposition. 1. To welcome or receive someone under one's protection (3 Jn 8). | 2. To take up the word to answer a question or argument (Lk 10:30). | 3. To suppose, presume, or imagine something as probable (Acts 2:15).

DEFINITION: Means to leave behind or cause something to remain, frequently employed in the passive voice to indicate what stays or is left over from a group or totality.
SENSES: 1. To leave remaining or preserve a remnant (Rom 11:3).

THAYER.pt: Significa deixar para trás ou fazer restar algo, sendo frequentemente empregado na voz passiva para indicar o que permanece ou sobra de um grupo ou totalidade. 1. Deixar restante ou preservar um remanescente (Rm 11.3).
THAYER.en: Means to leave behind or cause something to remain, frequently employed in the passive voice to indicate what stays or is left over from a group or totality. 1. To leave remaining or preserve a remnant (Rom 11:3).

DEFINITION: The cavity or tank excavated below the upper winepress to receive the juice of the crushed grapes.
SENSES: 1. The lower tank or receptacle of the winepress (Mk 12:1).

THAYER.pt: A cavidade ou tanque escavado abaixo do lagar superior para receber o suco das uvas esmagadas. 1. Tanque inferior ou receptáculo do lagar de uvas (Mc 12.1).
THAYER.en: The cavity or tank excavated below the upper winepress to receive the juice of the crushed grapes. 1. The lower tank or receptacle of the winepress (Mk 12:1).

DEFINITION: To cause something to remain or continue to exist after a temporal reference point; to leave behind.
SENSES: 1. To leave an example or legacy behind (1 Pet 2:21).

THAYER.pt: Fazer com que algo permaneça ou continue a existir após um ponto de referência temporal; deixar para trás. 1. Deixar um exemplo ou legado para trás (1Pe 2.21).
THAYER.en: To cause something to remain or continue to exist after a temporal reference point; to leave behind. 1. To leave an example or legacy behind (1 Pet 2:21).

DEFINITION: Means to stand firm in the face of opposition, pressures, or sufferings, demonstrating perseverance and patience without yielding.
SENSES: 1. To remain in a place longer than expected, to wait (Lk 2:43).
2. To endure firmly and persevere in the face of opposition or trial (Mt 10:22; Rom 12:12).

THAYER.pt: Significa manter-se firme diante de oposições, pressões ou sofrimentos, demonstrando perseverança e paciência sem ceder. 1. Permanecer em um lugar após o esperado, aguardar (Lc 2.43). | 2. Suportar firme e perseverar diante da oposição ou provação (Mt 10.22; Rm 12.12).
THAYER.en: Means to stand firm in the face of opposition, pressures, or sufferings, demonstrating perseverance and patience without yielding. 1. To remain in a place longer than expected, to wait (Lk 2:43). | 2. To endure firmly and persevere in the face of opposition or trial (Mt 10:22; Rom 12:12).

DEFINITION: To cause someone to bring to memory or think again about something previously learned or experienced.
SENSES: 1. To remind or bring to someone's memory a teaching or fact (Jn 14:26; 2 Tim 2:14).
2. To remember something by oneself, to recall (Lk 22:61).

THAYER.pt: Fazer com que alguém traga à memória ou volte a pensar em algo previamente aprendido ou vivenciado. 1. Fazer lembrar ou trazer à memória de alguém algum ensinamento ou fato (Jo 14.26; 2Tm 2.14). | 2. Lembrar-se de algo por si mesmo, recordar (Lc 22.61).
THAYER.en: To cause someone to bring to memory or think again about something previously learned or experienced. 1. To remind or bring to someone's memory a teaching or fact (Jn 14:26; 2 Tim 2:14). | 2. To remember something by oneself, to recall (Lk 22:61).

DEFINITION: The act of bringing something back to the mind, recalling previous truths or teachings.
SENSES: 1. Recollection, remembrance, or the act of reminiscing (2 Tim 1:5; 2 Pet 1:13; 2 Pet 3:1).

THAYER.pt: O ato de trazer algo de volta à mente, recordando verdades ou ensinamentos anteriores. 1. Recordação, lembrança ou ato de rememorar (2Tm 1.5; 2Pe 1.13; 2Pe 3.1).
THAYER.en: The act of bringing something back to the mind, recalling previous truths or teachings. 1. Recollection, remembrance, or the act of reminiscing (2 Tim 1:5; 2 Pet 1:13; 2 Pet 3:1).

DEFINITION: The ability to remain firm or endure courageously under difficult circumstances, trials, or pressures without fainting.
SENSES: 1. The Christian virtue of perseverance and steadfastness in the face of afflictions (Lk 21:19; Rom 8:25).
2. Patient and confident expectation in the fulfillment of divine promises (2 Thess 3:5).

THAYER.pt: A capacidade de permanecer firme ou suportar corajosamente sob circunstâncias difíceis, provações ou pressões sem desfalecer. 1. A virtude cristã da perseverança e constância diante das aflições (Lc 21.19; Rm 8.25). | 2. A expectativa paciente e confiante na concretização das promessas divinas (2Ts 3.5).
THAYER.en: The ability to remain firm or endure courageously under difficult circumstances, trials, or pressures without fainting. 1. The Christian virtue of perseverance and steadfastness in the face of afflictions (Lk 21:19; Rom 8:25). | 2. Patient and confident expectation in the fulfillment of divine promises (2 Thess 3:5).

DEFINITION: To form an opinion or guess based on slight indications, to suspect something or conjecture.
SENSES: 1. To suspect, suppose, or conjecture a situation (Acts 13:25; Acts 27:27).

THAYER.pt: Formar uma opinião ou palpite baseando-se em indícios leves, suspeitar de algo ou conjecturar. 1. Suspeitar, supor ou conjecturar uma situação (At 13.25; At 27.27).
THAYER.en: To form an opinion or guess based on slight indications, to suspect something or conjecture. 1. To suspect, suppose, or conjecture a situation (Acts 13:25; Acts 27:27).

DEFINITION: An opinion or conjecture formed on the basis of scant evidence, often carrying a sense of false suspicion.
SENSES: 1. An unfounded suspicion or malicious conjecture (1 Tim 6:4).

THAYER.pt: Opinião ou conjectura formada com base em evidências escassas, carregando frequentemente um sentido de falsa suspeita. 1. Suspeita infundada ou conjectura maliciosa (1Tm 6.4).
THAYER.en: An opinion or conjecture formed on the basis of scant evidence, often carrying a sense of false suspicion. 1. An unfounded suspicion or malicious conjecture (1 Tim 6:4).

DEFINITION: Describes the action of sailing under or along the protection of an island or coast to shelter from strong winds and storms at sea.
SENSES: 1. To sail under the protection or shelter of a coast or island (Acts 27:4).

THAYER.pt: Descreve a ação de navegar por baixo ou ao longo da proteção de uma ilha ou costa para se abrigar de ventos fortes e tempestades no mar. 1. Navegar sob a proteção ou abrigo de uma costa ou ilha (At 27.4).
THAYER.en: Describes the action of sailing under or along the protection of an island or coast to shelter from strong winds and storms at sea. 1. To sail under the protection or shelter of a coast or island (Acts 27:4).

DEFINITION: To blow softly and mildly, describing a light breeze.
SENSES: 1. To blow gently, referring to a light breeze (Acts 27:13).

THAYER.pt: Soprar de forma suave e branda, descrevendo uma brisa leve. 1. Soprar suavemente, referindo-se a uma brisa leve (At 27.13).
THAYER.en: To blow softly and mildly, describing a light breeze. 1. To blow gently, referring to a light breeze (Acts 27:13).

DEFINITION: A low piece of furniture where feet are rested when sitting, also used biblically as a metaphor for total subjection.
SENSES: 1. A footstool for the feet (Jas 2:3).
2. An eschatological metaphor of the complete submission of enemies (Acts 2:35; Heb 1:13).

THAYER.pt: Móvel baixo onde se apoiam os pés ao sentar-se, usado também biblicamente como metáfora de sujeição total. 1. Estrado ou escabelo para os pés (Tg 2.3). | 2. Metáfora escatológica da submissão completa dos inimigos (At 2.35; Hb 1.13).
THAYER.en: A low piece of furniture where feet are rested when sitting, also used biblically as a metaphor for total subjection. 1. A footstool for the feet (Jas 2:3). | 2. An eschatological metaphor of the complete submission of enemies (Acts 2:35; Heb 1:13).

DEFINITION: The essential reality or firm foundation that supports something, expressing guarantee, solid confidence, or the real nature of an entity.
SENSES: 1. The essence or real nature of an entity (Heb 1:3).
2. Firmness of confidence, guarantee, or spiritual security (Heb 11:1).

THAYER.pt: A realidade essencial ou a base firme que sustenta algo, expressando garantia, confiança sólida ou a natureza real de uma entidade. 1. A essência ou natureza real de uma entidade (Hb 1.3). | 2. Firmeza de confiança, garantia ou segurança espiritual (Hb 11.1).
THAYER.en: The essential reality or firm foundation that supports something, expressing guarantee, solid confidence, or the real nature of an entity. 1. The essence or real nature of an entity (Heb 1:3). | 2. Firmness of confidence, guarantee, or spiritual security (Heb 11:1).

DEFINITION: Means to recoil, withdraw, or hesitate to accomplish something, often out of fear, dread, or the desire to avoid adverse consequences.
SENSES: 1. To shrink back or withdraw out of fear or convenience (Gal 2:12).
2. To hesitate to declare or omit something out of fear (Acts 20:20, 27).

THAYER.pt: Significa recuar, retirar-se ou hesitar em realizar algo, muitas vezes por receio, temor ou o desejo de evitar consequências adversas. 1. Retrair-se ou recuar por medo ou conveniência (Gl 2.12). | 2. Hesitar em declarar ou omitir algo por temor (At 20.20, 27).
THAYER.en: Means to recoil, withdraw, or hesitate to accomplish something, often out of fear, dread, or the desire to avoid adverse consequences. 1. To shrink back or withdraw out of fear or convenience (Gal 2:12). | 2. To hesitate to declare or omit something out of fear (Acts 20:20, 27).

DEFINITION: The state of drawing back, hesitating, or showing timidity out of fear or in the face of adverse circumstances.
SENSES: 1. Withdrawal, shrinking back, or timidity that leads to perdition (Heb 10:39).

THAYER.pt: O estado de recuar, hesitar ou demonstrar timidez por medo ou diante de circunstâncias adversas. 1. Retração, recuo ou timidez que leva à perdição (Hb 10.39).
THAYER.en: The state of drawing back, hesitating, or showing timidity out of fear or in the face of adverse circumstances. 1. Withdrawal, shrinking back, or timidity that leads to perdition (Heb 10:39).

DEFINITION: To move back to the starting point or place of origin.
SENSES: 1. To return or go back home or to the place from which one set out (Lk 1:56; 2:45; Acts 8:25).

THAYER.pt: Mover-se de volta para o ponto de partida ou lugar de origem. 1. Retornar ou voltar para casa ou para o lugar de onde se partiu (Lc 1.56; 2.45; At 8.25).
THAYER.en: To move back to the starting point or place of origin. 1. To return or go back home or to the place from which one set out (Lk 1:56; 2:45; Acts 8:25).

DEFINITION: To spread or scatter garments, branches, or coverings underneath something or someone.
SENSES: 1. To spread garments or cloaks on the ground as a sign of honor (Lk 19:36).

THAYER.pt: Estender ou espalhar vestes, ramos ou coberturas por baixo de algo ou alguém. 1. Estender vestes ou mantos no chão como sinal de honra (Lc 19.36).
THAYER.en: To spread or scatter garments, branches, or coverings underneath something or someone. 1. To spread garments or cloaks on the ground as a sign of honor (Lk 19:36).

DEFINITION: Denotes the state or attitude of submission to the authority, orders, or directives of another.
SENSES: 1. A state of voluntary submission or subordination (2 Co 9:13; 1 Tm 2:11; 3:4).

THAYER.pt: Denota o estado ou atitude de submissão à autoridade, ordens ou diretrizes de outrem. 1. Estado de submissão voluntária ou subordinação (2Co 9.13; 1Tm 2.11; 3.4).
THAYER.en: Denotes the state or attitude of submission to the authority, orders, or directives of another. 1. A state of voluntary submission or subordination (2 Co 9:13; 1 Tm 2:11; 3:4).

DEFINITION: Means to place under the authority or control of someone, or to voluntarily place oneself in a position of submission and obedience.
SENSES: 1. To subject, subordinate, or place under the dominion of another (1 Co 15:27; Eph 1:22).
2. To submit oneself voluntarily to authority, to obey (1 Pe 5:5).

THAYER.pt: Significa colocar sob a autoridade ou o controle de alguém, ou voluntariamente colocar-se em posição de submissão e obediência. 1. Sujeitar, subordinar ou colocar sob o domínio de outrem (1Co 15.27; Ef 1.22). | 2. Submeter-se voluntariamente à autoridade, obedecer (1Pe 5.5).
THAYER.en: Means to place under the authority or control of someone, or to voluntarily place oneself in a position of submission and obedience. 1. To subject, subordinate, or place under the dominion of another (1 Co 15:27; Eph 1:22). | 2. To submit oneself voluntarily to authority, to obey (1 Pe 5:5).

DEFINITION: Literally to place under; it can denote risking one's own life for someone, or, in the middle voice, to instruct, teach, and remind others of vital truths.
SENSES: 1. To risk or expose one's life for someone (Ro 16:4).
2. To instruct, teach, or remind others of teachings (1 Tm 4:6).

THAYER.pt: Literalmente colocar sob, pode denotar o arriscar da própria vida em favor de alguém ou, na voz média, instruir, ensinar e lembrar os outros de verdades vitais. 1. Arriscar ou expor a vida por alguém (Rm 16.4). | 2. Instruir, ensinar ou recordar ensinamentos a outros (1Tm 4.6).
THAYER.en: Literally to place under; it can denote risking one's own life for someone, or, in the middle voice, to instruct, teach, and remind others of vital truths. 1. To risk or expose one's life for someone (Ro 16:4). | 2. To instruct, teach, or remind others of teachings (1 Tm 4:6).

DEFINITION: A nautical term for sailing under the protection or shelter of a coast or island in relation to the winds.
SENSES: 1. To sail under the protection of the shelter of a coast (Ac 27:16).

THAYER.pt: Termo náutico para navegar sob a proteção ou abrigo de uma costa ou ilha em relação aos ventos. 1. Navegar sob a proteção do abrigo de uma costa (At 27.16).
THAYER.en: A nautical term for sailing under the protection or shelter of a coast or island in relation to the winds. 1. To sail under the protection of the shelter of a coast (Ac 27:16).

DEFINITION: Refers to a sketch, visual pattern, or normative model that serves as an example to be followed and imitated in conduct or doctrine.
SENSES: 1. A pattern or exemplary model to be followed (1 Tm 1:16).
2. A guideline or standard of teaching and conduct (2 Tm 1:13).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se a um esboço, padrão visual ou modelo normativo que serve de exemplo a ser seguido e imitado na conduta ou na doutrina. 1. Um padrão ou modelo exemplar para ser seguido (1Tm 1.16). | 2. Uma diretriz ou norma de ensino e conduta (2Tm 1.13).
THAYER.en: Refers to a sketch, visual pattern, or normative model that serves as an example to be followed and imitated in conduct or doctrine. 1. A pattern or exemplary model to be followed (1 Tm 1:16). | 2. A guideline or standard of teaching and conduct (2 Tm 1:13).

DEFINITION: Means to passively endure or tolerate a difficult situation, affliction, or persecution without yielding.
SENSES: 1. To endure trials or difficulties with patience and perseverance (1 Pe 2:19; 2 Tm 3:11).

THAYER.pt: Significa suportar ou tolerar passivamente uma situação difícil, aflição ou perseguição sem ceder. 1. Suportar provações ou dificuldades com paciência e perseverança (1Pe 2.19; 2Tm 3.11).
THAYER.en: Means to passively endure or tolerate a difficult situation, affliction, or persecution without yielding. 1. To endure trials or difficulties with patience and perseverance (1 Pe 2:19; 2 Tm 3:11).

DEFINITION: Means to withdraw from a physical place, to move away to a more reserved or isolated location, seeking tranquility or privacy.
SENSES: 1. To withdraw from a crowd or locality to an isolated place (Lk 9:10).

THAYER.pt: Significa retirar-se de um lugar físico, afastar-se para um local mais reservado ou isolado, buscando tranquilidade ou privacidade. 1. Retirar-se de uma multidão ou localidade para um lugar isolado (Lc 9.10).
THAYER.en: Means to withdraw from a physical place, to move away to a more reserved or isolated location, seeking tranquility or privacy. 1. To withdraw from a crowd or locality to an isolated place (Lk 9:10).

DEFINITION: Originally meaning to strike in the face or leave a black eye, it came to figuratively denote the act of wearying someone by constant insistence or rigorously disciplining one's own body.
SENSES: 1. To strike in the face or beat literally.
2. To weary or exhaust someone by constant insistence and pestering (Lk 18:5).
3. To discipline severely or subdue one's own body (1 Co 9:27).

THAYER.pt: Originalmente significando golpear no rosto ou deixar o olho roxo, passou a denotar figuradamente o ato de fatigar alguém por insistência constante ou disciplinar rigorosamente o próprio corpo. 1. Dar um golpe no rosto ou esmurrar literalmente. | 2. Fatigar ou esgotar alguém por insistência e importunação contínua (Lc 18.5). | 3. Disciplinar severamente ou subjugar o próprio corpo (1Co 9.27).
THAYER.en: Originally meaning to strike in the face or leave a black eye, it came to figuratively denote the act of wearying someone by constant insistence or rigorously disciplining one's own body. 1. To strike in the face or beat literally. | 2. To weary or exhaust someone by constant insistence and pestering (Lk 18:5). | 3. To discipline severely or subdue one's own body (1 Co 9:27).

DEFINITION: The female animal of the swine family.
SENSES: 1. A sow, the female swine animal (2 Pe 2:22).

THAYER.pt: O animal fêmea da família dos suínos. 1. Uma porca, o animal suíno fêmea (2Pe 2.22).
THAYER.en: The female animal of the swine family. 1. A sow, the female swine animal (2 Pe 2:22).

DEFINITION: Designates an aromatic shrub whose branches were commonly used in Jewish ritual ceremonies for the sprinkling of liquids and purification.
SENSES: 1. The hyssop plant used in purification and sprinkling rituals (Heb 9:19).

THAYER.pt: Designa uma planta arbustiva aromática cujos ramos eram comumente empregados nas cerimônias rituais judaicas para a aspersão de líquidos e purificação. 1. A planta do hissopo usada em rituais de purificação e aspersão (Hb 9.19).
THAYER.en: Designates an aromatic shrub whose branches were commonly used in Jewish ritual ceremonies for the sprinkling of liquids and purification. 1. The hyssop plant used in purification and sprinkling rituals (Heb 9:19).

DEFINITION: To be in lack, to fall behind, to be in need of something essential, or to fail to reach an expected target or standard.
SENSES: 1. To be in lack or fail to reach a goal, promise, or standard (Heb 4:1; 12:15).
2. To be in need, suffer deprivation, or lack resources (Lk 22:35; Ph 4:12).

THAYER.pt: Estar em falta, ficar atrás, carecer de algo essencial ou não alcançar um alvo ou padrão esperado. 1. Ficar em falta ou não alcançar uma meta, promessa ou padrão (Hb 4.1; 12.15). | 2. Estar necessitado, passar privação ou carecer de recursos (Lc 22.35; Fp 4.12).
THAYER.en: To be in lack, to fall behind, to be in need of something essential, or to fail to reach an expected target or standard. 1. To be in lack or fail to reach a goal, promise, or standard (Heb 4:1; 12:15). | 2. To be in need, suffer deprivation, or lack resources (Lk 22:35; Ph 4:12).

DEFINITION: Indicates the absence or scarcity of that which is essential, necessary, or desirable.
SENSES: 1. Lack of material resources, deficiency, or need (Lk 21:4; 2 Co 8:14).
2. Deficiency or that which is still lacking for perfection (1 Th 3:10).

THAYER.pt: Indica a ausência ou escassez daquilo que é essencial, necessário ou desejável. 1. Falta de recursos materiais, carência ou necessidade (Lc 21.4; 2Co 8.14). | 2. Deficiência ou aquilo que ainda falta para a perfeição (1Ts 3.10).
THAYER.en: Indicates the absence or scarcity of that which is essential, necessary, or desirable. 1. Lack of material resources, deficiency, or need (Lk 21:4; 2 Co 8:14). | 2. Deficiency or that which is still lacking for perfection (1 Th 3:10).

DEFINITION: Describes the condition of acute lack, scarcity, or absence of that which is essential for human subsistence.
SENSES: 1. A state of material need, want, or extreme poverty (Mk 12:44; Ph 4:11).

THAYER.pt: Descreve a condição de carência aguda, escassez ou falta daquilo que é essencial para a subsistência humana. 1. Estado de necessidade material, carência ou pobreza extrema (Mc 12.44; Fp 4.11).
THAYER.en: Describes the condition of acute lack, scarcity, or absence of that which is essential for human subsistence. 1. A state of material need, want, or extreme poverty (Mk 12:44; Ph 4:11).

DEFINITION: Denotes an event or action that occurs at a later moment in a temporal sequence.
SENSES: 1. Subsequently, later, afterwards (Mt 21:29, 37; Heb 12:11).

THAYER.pt: Denota um evento ou ação que ocorre em momento posterior numa sequência temporal. 1. Posteriormente, mais tarde, depois (Mt 21.29, 37; Hb 12.11).
THAYER.en: Denotes an event or action that occurs at a later moment in a temporal sequence. 1. Subsequently, later, afterwards (Mt 21:29, 37; Heb 12:11).

DEFINITION: Belonging to a subsequent position in a series or to a later point in time.
SENSES: 1. The second in an order or series (Mt 21:31); 2. Subsequently, later (Mt 4:2).

THAYER.pt: Pertencente a uma posição subsequente em uma série ou a um ponto posterior no tempo. 1. O segundo em uma ordem ou série (Mt 21.31); 2. Posteriormente, mais tarde (Mt 4.2).
THAYER.en: Belonging to a subsequent position in a series or to a later point in time. 1. The second in an order or series (Mt 21:31); 2. Subsequently, later (Mt 4:2).

DEFINITION: Referring to something that has been produced by means of weaving threads.
SENSES: 1. Woven, made on a loom (Jn 19:23).

THAYER.pt: Referente a algo que foi produzido por meio da tecelagem de fios. 1. Tecido, feito em tear (Jo 19.23).
THAYER.en: Referring to something that has been produced by means of weaving threads. 1. Woven, made on a loom (Jn 19:23).

DEFINITION: Possessing great vertical extension upward, or figuratively something exalted, haughty, or of sublime value.
SENSES: 1. Rising high above the ground level, high (Mt 4:8; Acts 13:17).
2. Elevated in status, proud, or of sublime value (Lk 16:15; Rom 12:16).

THAYER.pt: Que possui grande extensão vertical para cima, ou figuradamente algo que é exaltado, soberbo ou de sublime valor. 1. Que se eleva muito acima do nível do solo, alto (Mt 4.8; At 13.17). | 2. Elevado em status, orgulhoso ou de sublime valor (Lc 16.15; Rm 12.16).
THAYER.en: Possessing great vertical extension upward, or figuratively something exalted, haughty, or of sublime value. 1. Rising high above the ground level, high (Mt 4:8; Acts 13:17). | 2. Elevated in status, proud, or of sublime value (Lk 16:15; Rom 12:16).

DEFINITION: To harbor a haughty, proud, or arrogant attitude toward others.
SENSES: 1. To have an arrogant or haughty mindset (Rom 11:20).

THAYER.pt: Nutrir uma atitude soberba, orgulhosa ou arrogante perante os outros. 1. Ter uma mentalidade arrogante ou soberba (Rm 11.20).
THAYER.en: To harbor a haughty, proud, or arrogant attitude toward others. 1. To have an arrogant or haughty mindset (Rom 11:20).

DEFINITION: A superlative indicating the highest degree, whether in a spatial sense (the highest) or in reference to supreme status, applied to God as the Most High.
SENSES: 1. Located in the highest position in a spatial or celestial sense (Mt 21:9).
2. A title applied to God to denote His supreme sovereignty, the Most High (Lk 1:32).

THAYER.pt: Superlativo que indica o grau mais elevado, seja em sentido espacial (o mais alto) ou em referência a status supremo, sendo aplicado a Deus como o Altíssimo. 1. Localizado na posição mais alta no sentido espacial ou celeste (Mt 21.9). | 2. Título aplicado a Deus para denotar Sua soberania suprema, o Altíssimo (Lc 1.32).
THAYER.en: A superlative indicating the highest degree, whether in a spatial sense (the highest) or in reference to supreme status, applied to God as the Most High. 1. Located in the highest position in a spatial or celestial sense (Mt 21:9). | 2. A title applied to God to denote His supreme sovereignty, the Most High (Lk 1:32).

DEFINITION: Indicates the vertical dimension upward, referring to celestial locations or positions of elevated prestige.
SENSES: 1. The measure of physical height (Eph 3:18).
2. Heaven or the celestial heights (Lk 1:78).

THAYER.pt: Indica a dimensão vertical para cima, podendo referir-se a locais celestiais ou a posições de elevado prestígio. 1. A medida de altura física (Ef 3:18). | 2. O céu ou as alturas celestiais (Lc 1:78).
THAYER.en: Indicates the vertical dimension upward, referring to celestial locations or positions of elevated prestige. 1. The measure of physical height (Eph 3:18). | 2. Heaven or the celestial heights (Lk 1:78).

DEFINITION: To lift physically upward or to confer honor, glory, and a superior status upon someone.
SENSES: 1. To lift or raise physically upward (Jn 3:14).
2. To exalt, conferring a high position of honor and glory (Mt 11:23; Acts 5:31).

THAYER.pt: Elevar fisicamente para o alto ou conferir honra, glória e status superior a alguém. 1. Levantar ou erguer fisicamente para o alto (Jo 3.14). | 2. Exaltar, conferindo alta posição de honra e glória (Mt 11.23; At 5.31).
THAYER.en: To lift physically upward or to confer honor, glory, and a superior status upon someone. 1. To lift or raise physically upward (Jn 3:14). | 2. To exalt, conferring a high position of honor and glory (Mt 11:23; Acts 5:31).

DEFINITION: Indicates both a physical or celestial elevation and, in a figurative sense, the haughtiness, pride, or arrogant presumption that rises against the knowledge of God.
SENSES: 1. The space elevated above the horizon or the celestial world (Rom 8:39).
2. Haughtiness, pride, or arrogant pretension (2 Cor 10:5).

THAYER.pt: Indica tanto uma elevação física ou celeste quanto, em sentido figurado, a altivez, o orgulho ou a presunção arrogante que se levanta contra o conhecimento de Deus. 1. O espaço elevado acima do horizonte ou o mundo celeste (Rm 8.39). | 2. Altivez, orgulho ou pretensão arrogante (2Co 10.5).
THAYER.en: Indicates both a physical or celestial elevation and, in a figurative sense, the haughtiness, pride, or arrogant presumption that rises against the knowledge of God. 1. The space elevated above the horizon or the celestial world (Rom 8:39). | 2. Haughtiness, pride, or arrogant pretension (2 Cor 10:5).

DEFINITION: A pejorative term applied to a person who habitually consumes food in excess, a glutton.
SENSES: 1. A glutton or heavy eater, a drunkard (Mt 11:19; Lk 7:34).

THAYER.pt: Termo pejorativo aplicado a uma pessoa que consome alimentos em excesso de maneira habitual, comilão. 1. Um comilão ou guloso, bebedor (Mt 11.19; Lc 7.34).
THAYER.en: A pejorative term applied to a person who habitually consumes food in excess, a glutton. 1. A glutton or heavy eater, a drunkard (Mt 11:19; Lk 7:34).

DEFINITION: The act of consuming solid food through the mouth. Beyond the physical sense essential for life, it is used in narratives of table fellowship, the Paschal and sacramental Supper, and metaphorically regarding spiritually appropriating the life of Christ.
SENSES: 1. To feed, to ingest human food (Mt 6:25; 14:20; Lk 15:23).
2. To participate in communal meals or rituals of the Lord's Supper (Mt 26:26; 1 Cor 11:20-24).
3. Metaphorical use: to appropriate spiritually (Jn 6:51-58) or to consume with violence (Jas 5:3).

THAYER.pt: Ato de consumir alimento sólido pela boca. Além do sentido físico indispensável à vida, é empregado nas narrativas de comunhão à mesa, na Ceia Pascal e sacramental, e de forma metafórica sobre apropriar-se espiritualmente da vida de Cristo. 1. Alimentar-se, ingerir alimento humano (Mt 6.25; 14.20; Lc 15.23). | 2. Participar de refeições comunitárias ou rituais da Ceia do Senhor (Mt 26.26; 1Co 11.20-24). | 3. Uso metafórico: apropriar-se espiritualmente (Jo 6.51-58) ou consumir com violência (Tg 5.3).
THAYER.en: The act of consuming solid food through the mouth. Beyond the physical sense essential for life, it is used in narratives of table fellowship, the Paschal and sacramental Supper, and metaphorically regarding spiritually appropriating the life of Christ. 1. To feed, to ingest human food (Mt 6:25; 14:20; Lk 15:23). | 2. To participate in communal meals or rituals of the Lord's Supper (Mt 26:26; 1 Cor 11:20-24). | 3. Metaphorical use: to appropriate spiritually (Jn 6:51-58) or to consume with violence (Jas 5:3).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: φανοῦσιν, Aor: ἔφανα, Perf: πέφηνα
DEFINITION: To emit light to illuminate or to make something visible and manifest to the senses or mental perception.
SENSES: 1. To emit light or shine in the dark (Rev 1:16; 2 Pet 1:19).
2. To become visible, stand out, or manifest (Mt 2:7; Rev 8:12).
3. To present an external appearance that may differ from internal reality (Mt 23:27; Phil 2:15).

THAYER.pt: Emitir luz para iluminar ou tornar algo visível e manifesto aos sentidos ou à percepção mental. 1. Emitir luz ou brilhar no escuro (Ap 1.16; 2Pt 1.19). | 2. Tornar-se visível, sobressair ou manifestar-se (Mt 2.7; Ap 8.12). | 3. Apresentar uma aparência externa que pode diferir da realidade interna (Mt 23.27; Fp 2.15).
THAYER.en: To emit light to illuminate or to make something visible and manifest to the senses or mental perception. 1. To emit light or shine in the dark (Rev 1:16; 2 Pet 1:19). | 2. To become visible, stand out, or manifest (Mt 2:7; Rev 8:12). | 3. To present an external appearance that may differ from internal reality (Mt 23:27; Phil 2:15).

DEFINITION: Proper name of a Hebrew patriarch descended from Shem and ancestor of Abraham.
SENSES: 1. Peleg, son of Eber in the genealogy of Jesus (Lk 3:35).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio de um patriarca hebreu descendente de Sem e ancestral de Abraão. 1. Pelegue, filho de Éber na genealogia de Jesus (Lc 3.35).
THAYER.en: Proper name of a Hebrew patriarch descended from Shem and ancestor of Abraham. 1. Peleg, son of Eber in the genealogy of Jesus (Lk 3:35).

DEFINITION: Describes that which is clearly visible, evident, or publicly known, without concealment. In the New Testament, it frequently refers to the manifestation of spiritual truths, intentions of the heart, or the revelation of Christ.
SENSES: 1. That which is visible, evident, or clearly perceived (Rom 1:19; 1 Cor 3:13).
2. That which is exposed to the sight of all or publicly known (Mk 4:22; Acts 4:16).

THAYER.pt: Descreve aquilo que é claramente visível, evidente ou publicamente conhecido, sem ocultação. No Novo Testamento, refere-se frequentemente à manifestação de verdades espirituais, intenções do coração ou à revelação de Cristo. 1. Aquilo que é visível, evidente ou claramente percebido (Rm 1.19; 1Co 3.13). | 2. Aquilo que é exposto à vista de todos ou publicamente conhecido (Mc 4.22; At 4.16).
THAYER.en: Describes that which is clearly visible, evident, or publicly known, without concealment. In the New Testament, it frequently refers to the manifestation of spiritual truths, intentions of the heart, or the revelation of Christ. 1. That which is visible, evident, or clearly perceived (Rom 1:19; 1 Cor 3:13). | 2. That which is exposed to the sight of all or publicly known (Mk 4:22; Acts 4:16).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: φανερώσω, Aor: ἐφανέρωσα, Perf: πεφανέρωκα, Aor. Pass: ἐφανερώθην
DEFINITION: To cause something hidden or unknown to come to light and become fully evident, visible, and understandable to others.
SENSES: 1. To make publicly visible, to cause to appear (Jn 2:11; 1 Tim 3:16; Jn 21:14).
2. To reveal or declare a truth previously hidden (Rom 1:19; Rom 16:26; Col 1:26).
3. To expose openly the actions or thoughts in judgment (2 Cor 5:10; 1 Cor 4:5).

THAYER.pt: Fazer com que algo oculto ou desconhecido venha à luz e se torne plenamente evidente, visível e compreensível a outros. 1. Tornar visível publicamente, fazer aparecer (Jo 2.11; 1Tm 3.16; Jo 21.14). | 2. Revelar ou declarar uma verdade antes oculta (Rm 1.19; Rm 16.26; Cl 1.26). | 3. Expor abertamente as ações ou pensamentos no juízo (2Co 5.10; 1Co 4.5).
THAYER.en: To cause something hidden or unknown to come to light and become fully evident, visible, and understandable to others. 1. To make publicly visible, to cause to appear (Jn 2:11; 1 Tim 3:16; Jn 21:14). | 2. To reveal or declare a truth previously hidden (Rom 1:19; Rom 16:26; Col 1:26). | 3. To expose openly the actions or thoughts in judgment (2 Cor 5:10; 1 Cor 4:5).

DEFINITION: Describes an action or event that occurs in a visible, clear, and evident manner to all, without concealment.
SENSES: 1. In a public and open manner, in the sight of all (Mk 1:45; Jn 7:10).
2. In a clearly perceptible or distinct way (Acts 10:3).

THAYER.pt: Descreve uma ação ou evento que ocorre de maneira visível, clara e evidente a todos, sem ocultação. 1. De maneira pública e aberta, à vista de todos (Mc 1.45; Jo 7.10); | 2. De modo claramente perceptível ou distinto (At 10.3).
THAYER.en: Describes an action or event that occurs in a visible, clear, and evident manner to all, without concealment. 1. In a public and open manner, in the sight of all (Mk 1:45; Jn 7:10). | 2. In a clearly perceptible or distinct way (Acts 10:3).

DEFINITION: The act of making visible, clear, and fully known that which was previously hidden or secret.
SENSES: 1. The revelation or public manifestation of spiritual truths or capabilities (2 Cor 4:2; 1 Cor 12:7).

THAYER.pt: O ato de tornar visível, claro e plenamente conhecido aquilo que antes estava oculto ou secreto. 1. A revelação ou manifestação pública de verdades ou capacidades espirituais (2Co 4.2; 1Co 12.7).
THAYER.en: The act of making visible, clear, and fully known that which was previously hidden or secret. 1. The revelation or public manifestation of spiritual truths or capabilities (2 Cor 4:2; 1 Cor 12:7).

DEFINITION: A portable lighting device, originally a torch or a lantern protected against the wind.
SENSES: 1. Lantern or portable light used at night (Jn 18:3).

THAYER.pt: Um dispositivo de iluminação portátil, originalmente uma tocha ou uma lanterna protegida contra o vento. 1. Lanterna ou luz portátil usada à noite (Jo 18.3).
THAYER.en: A portable lighting device, originally a torch or a lantern protected against the wind. 1. Lantern or portable light used at night (Jn 18:3).

DEFINITION: Masculine proper name of an Israelite, father of the prophetess Anna.
SENSES: 1. Phanuel, father of the prophetess Anna of the tribe of Asher (Lk 2:36).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio masculino de um israelita, pai da profetisa Ana. 1. Fanuel, pai da profetisa Ana da tribo de Aser (Lc 2.36).
THAYER.en: Masculine proper name of an Israelite, father of the prophetess Anna. 1. Phanuel, father of the prophetess Anna of the tribe of Asher (Lk 2:36).

DEFINITION: To become visible or manifest in an extraordinary way, causing astonishment.
SENSES: 1. To become visible or manifest a frightening apparition (Heb 12:21).

THAYER.pt: Tornar-se visível ou manifestar-se de maneira extraordinária, causando espanto. 1. Tornar-se visível ou manifestar uma aparição assustadora (Hb 12.21).
THAYER.en: To become visible or manifest in an extraordinary way, causing astonishment. 1. To become visible or manifest a frightening apparition (Heb 12:21).

DEFINITION: Grandiose and ceremonial display of status, often associated with a pompous demonstration of power.
SENSES: 1. Great pomp, ostentation, or ceremonial parade (Ac 25:23).

THAYER.pt: Exibição grandiosa e cerimonial de status, muitas vezes associada a uma demonstração pomposa de poder. 1. Grande pompa, ostentação ou desfile cerimonial (At 25.23).
THAYER.en: Grandiose and ceremonial display of status, often associated with a pompous demonstration of power. 1. Great pomp, ostentation, or ceremonial parade (Ac 25:23).

SENSES: 1. Part of the geographical name Forum of Appius (see Ἀππίου Φόρον).

THAYER.pt: Elemento de topônimo romano associado a praças públicas ou locais de mercado, como no nome 'Fórum de Ápio'. 1. Parte do nome geográfico Fórum de Ápio (ver Ἀππίου Φόρον).
THAYER.en: An element of a Roman toponym associated with public squares or market places, as in the name 'Forum of Appius'. 1. Part of the geographical name Forum of Appius (see Ἀππίου Φόρον).

DEFINITION: A regular payment in money required by a state or governmental authority, symbolizing political submission and dependence.
SENSES: 1. Tribute or tax paid to civil rulers (Luke 20:22; Rom 13:7).

THAYER.pt: Pagamento regular em dinheiro exigido por um estado ou autoridade governamental, simbolizando submissão política e dependência. 1. Tributo ou imposto pago a governantes civis (Lc 20.22; Rm 13.7).
THAYER.en: A regular payment in money required by a state or governmental authority, symbolizing political submission and dependence. 1. Tribute or tax paid to civil rulers (Luke 20:22; Rom 13:7).

DEFINITION: To load with heavy burdens, imposing a physical or spiritual load upon someone.
SENSES: 1. To overload with heavy burdens or weariness (Matt 11:28; Luke 11:46).

THAYER.pt: Carregar com fardos pesados, impondo uma carga física ou espiritual sobre alguém. 1. Sobrecarregar com fardos pesados ou canseira (Mt 11.28; Lc 11.46).
THAYER.en: To load with heavy burdens, imposing a physical or spiritual load upon someone. 1. To overload with heavy burdens or weariness (Matt 11:28; Luke 11:46).

DEFINITION: A heavy load intended for transport or, in a figurative sense, obligations and responsibilities imposed.
SENSES: 1. Physical load or ship's cargo (Acts 27:10).
2. Spiritual or moral burden (Matt 23:4; Gal 6:5).

THAYER.pt: Uma carga pesada destinada ao transporte ou, em sentido figurado, obrigações e responsabilidades impostas. 1. Carga física ou de navio (At 27:10). | 2. Fardo espiritual ou moral (Mt 23:4; Gl 6:5).
THAYER.en: A heavy load intended for transport or, in a figurative sense, obligations and responsibilities imposed. 1. Physical load or ship's cargo (Acts 27:10). | 2. Spiritual or moral burden (Matt 23:4; Gal 6:5).

DEFINITION: The weight or load carried by a means of transport, especially the commercial cargo of a ship.
SENSES: 1. The cargo or merchandise transported in a vessel (Acts 27:10).

THAYER.pt: O peso ou a carga transportada por um meio de transporte, especialmente a carga comercial de um navio. 1. A carga ou mercadoria transportada em uma embarcação (At 27:10).
THAYER.en: The weight or load carried by a means of transport, especially the commercial cargo of a ship. 1. The cargo or merchandise transported in a vessel (Acts 27:10).

SEMANTIC_FIELD: Names of People and Places - People
DEFINITION: A masculine proper name of a Corinthian Christian who visited the apostle Paul.
SENSES: 1. Fortunatus, a member of the Christian community of Corinth (1 Cor 16:17).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio masculino de um cristão coríntio que visitou o apóstolo Paulo. 1. Fortunato, membro da comunidade cristã de Corinto (1Co 16.17).
THAYER.en: A masculine proper name of a Corinthian Christian who visited the apostle Paul. 1. Fortunatus, a member of the Christian community of Corinth (1 Cor 16:17).

DEFINITION: An instrument of punishment made of ropes or leather strips used to lash or whip.
SENSES: 1. A whip or scourge used by Jesus to drive the sellers out of the temple (John 2:15).

THAYER.pt: Instrumento de castigo feito de cordas ou tiras de couro usado para chibatear ou açoitar. 1. Chicote ou azorrague usado por Jesus para expulsar os vendedores do templo (Jo 2.15).
THAYER.en: An instrument of punishment made of ropes or leather strips used to lash or whip. 1. A whip or scourge used by Jesus to drive the sellers out of the temple (John 2:15).

DEFINITION: To punish severely using a whip or scourge, a Roman punishment inflicted on criminals and the condemned.
SENSES: 1. To whip or scourge severely with a lash (Matt 27:26; Mark 15:15).

THAYER.pt: Castigar severamente utilizando um chicote ou flagelo, punição romana infligida a criminosos e condenados. 1. Açoitar ou flagelar severamente com um chicote (Mt 27.26; Mc 15.15).
THAYER.en: To punish severely using a whip or scourge, a Roman punishment inflicted on criminals and the condemned. 1. To whip or scourge severely with a lash (Matt 27:26; Mark 15:15).

DEFINITION: Physical structure used to enclose, delimit, or separate areas, which may be a living hedge, wall, or partition.
SENSES: 1. A fence or hedge around a property (Matt 21:33; Mark 12:1).
2. A dividing wall or figurative separation (Eph 2:14).

THAYER.pt: Estrutura física utilizada para cercar, delimitar ou separar áreas, podendo ser uma cerca viva, muro ou divisória. 1. Cerca ou sebe ao redor de uma propriedade (Mt 21.33; Mc 12.1). | 2. Muro divisório ou separação figurada (Ef 2.14).
THAYER.en: Physical structure used to enclose, delimit, or separate areas, which may be a living hedge, wall, or partition. 1. A fence or hedge around a property (Matt 21:33; Mark 12:1). | 2. A dividing wall or figurative separation (Eph 2:14).

DEFINITION: To explain or make clear the meaning of something obscure, mysterious, or parabolic.
SENSES: 1. To explain the meaning of a parable or enigmatic teaching (Matt 15:15).

THAYER.pt: Explicar ou tornar claro o significado de algo obscuro, misterioso ou parabólico. 1. Explicar o sentido de uma parábola ou ensinamento enigmático (Mt 15.15).
THAYER.en: To explain or make clear the meaning of something obscure, mysterious, or parabolic. 1. To explain the meaning of a parable or enigmatic teaching (Matt 15:15).

DEFINITION: To block, close an opening, or prevent something from proceeding, either physically or figuratively.
SENSES: 1. To physically close or stop up, such as the mouths of wild beasts (Heb 11:33);
2. Figurative: To silence or shut the mouth to prevent justifications (Rom 3:19).

THAYER.pt: Bloquear, fechar uma abertura ou impedir que algo prossiga, seja fisicamente ou de forma figurada. 1. Fechar ou tapar fisicamente, como a boca de feras (Hb 11.33); | 2. Figurado: Silenciar ou fechar a boca para impedir justificativas (Rm 3.19).
THAYER.en: To block, close an opening, or prevent something from proceeding, either physically or figuratively. 1. To physically close or stop up, such as the mouths of wild beasts (Heb 11:33); | 2. Figurative: To silence or shut the mouth to prevent justifications (Rom 3:19).

DEFINITION: A cavity excavated vertically in the ground for capturing underground water or a deep opening leading to the abyss.
SENSES: 1. A deep lined well for obtaining water (John 4:11).
2. A dark pit or abyss leading to the underworld (Rev 9:1).

THAYER.pt: Cavidade escavada verticalmente no solo para captação de água subterrânea ou abertura profunda que conduz ao abismo. 1. Poço profundo revestido para obtenção de água (Jo 4.11). | 2. Poço ou abismo escuro que conduz ao mundo subterrâneo (Ap 9.1).
THAYER.en: A cavity excavated vertically in the ground for capturing underground water or a deep opening leading to the abyss. 1. A deep lined well for obtaining water (John 4:11). | 2. A dark pit or abyss leading to the underworld (Rev 9:1).

SEMANTIC_FIELD: Deception and Error - Deceiving the Mind
DEFINITION: To lead someone into error through false reasoning, deceiving their mind and understanding.
SENSES: 1. To delude oneself or others by means of false premises and mental deception (Gal 6:3).

THAYER.pt: Induzir alguém ao erro através de falsos raciocínios, enganando a sua mente e o seu entendimento. 1. Iludir a si mesmo ou a outros por meio de falsas premissas e enganos mentais (Gl 6.3).
THAYER.en: To lead someone into error through false reasoning, deceiving their mind and understanding. 1. To delude oneself or others by means of false premises and mental deception (Gal 6:3).

DEFINITION: An individual who turns others away from the truth through sophistry, lies, and false teachings.
SENSES: 1. One who deceives the minds of others, referring to false teachers (Titus 1:10).

THAYER.pt: Indivíduo que desvia os outros da verdade por meio de sofismas, mentiras e falsos ensinamentos. 1. Aquele que engana a mente alheia, referindo-se a falsos mestres (Tt 1.10).
THAYER.en: An individual who turns others away from the truth through sophistry, lies, and false teachings. 1. One who deceives the minds of others, referring to false teachers (Titus 1:10).

DEFINITION: Refers to the mental faculty of reflection, comprehension, and prudent planning.
SENSES: 1. The faculty of mature thought, discernment, and understanding (1 Cor 14:20).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se à faculdade mental de reflexão, compreensão e planejamento prudente. 1. A faculdade do pensamento maduro, discernimento e entendimento (1Co 14.20).
THAYER.en: Refers to the mental faculty of reflection, comprehension, and prudent planning. 1. The faculty of mature thought, discernment, and understanding (1 Cor 14:20).

SEMANTIC_FIELD: Feelings and Emotions - Fear and Trembling
DEFINITION: To feel a physical shiver or tremor in the body, usually caused by intense fear or reverence.
SENSES: 1. To tremble with dread or horror in the presence of a spiritual reality (Jas 2:19).

THAYER.pt: Sentir um arrepio ou tremor físico no corpo, geralmente provocado por medo intenso ou reverência. 1. Tremer de pavor ou horror diante de uma realidade espiritual (Tg 2.19).
THAYER.en: To feel a physical shiver or tremor in the body, usually caused by intense fear or reverence. 1. To tremble with dread or horror in the presence of a spiritual reality (Jas 2:19).

DEFINITION: To employ the mental faculty with a focus on an attitude, inner disposition, or thought orientation.
SENSES: 1. To have an opinion or way of judging (1 Cor 13:11).
2. To fix one's attention or incline the mind to something (Phil 3:19; Col 3:2).
3. To possess a specific mental disposition or attitude (Phil 2:5).

THAYER.pt: Empregar a faculdade mental com foco em uma atitude, disposição interior ou orientação de pensamento. 1. Ter uma opinião ou modo de julgar (1Co 13:11). | 2. Fixar a atenção ou inclinar a mente a algo (Fp 3:19; Cl 3:2). | 3. Possuir uma disposição ou atitude mental específica (Fp 2:5).
THAYER.en: To employ the mental faculty with a focus on an attitude, inner disposition, or thought orientation. 1. To have an opinion or way of judging (1 Cor 13:11). | 2. To fix one's attention or incline the mind to something (Phil 3:19; Col 3:2). | 3. To possess a specific mental disposition or attitude (Phil 2:5).

DEFINITION: Refers to the mental disposition, the inclination of thought, or the intentional focus that guides one's perspective.
SENSES: 1. A way of thinking or mentality oriented toward a specific direction (Rom 8:6).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se à disposição mental, à inclinação do pensamento ou ao foco intencional que orienta a perspectiva de alguém. 1. Modo de pensar ou mentalidade voltada para uma direção específica (Rm 8.6).
THAYER.en: Refers to the mental disposition, the inclination of thought, or the intentional focus that guides one's perspective. 1. A way of thinking or mentality oriented toward a specific direction (Rom 8:6).

DEFINITION: Denotes the mental capacity for discernment, deep comprehension, and sensible planning, frequently associated with spiritual insight in the New Testament.
SENSES: 1. Exercising thought and sensible planning (Luke 1:17).
2. The capacity to comprehend and possess spiritual discernment (Eph 1:8).

THAYER.pt: Indica a capacidade mental de discernimento, compreensão profunda e planejamento sensato, frequentemente associada à perspicácia espiritual no Novo Testamento. 1. Manejar o pensamento e o planejamento sensato (Lc 1.17). | 2. Capacidade de compreender e ter discernimento espiritual (Ef 1.8).
THAYER.en: Denotes the mental capacity for discernment, deep comprehension, and sensible planning, frequently associated with spiritual insight in the New Testament. 1. Exercising thought and sensible planning (Luke 1:17). | 2. The capacity to comprehend and possess spiritual discernment (Eph 1:8).

DEFINITION: Characterizes one who possesses practical discernment, insight, and prudence to act correctly in various life situations.
SENSES: 1. Endowed with sensible understanding, prudence, and discernment (Matt 25:2; Rom 11:25).

THAYER.pt: Caracteriza quem possui discernimento prático, perspicácia e prudência para agir corretamente nas diversas situações da vida. 1. Dotado de compreensão sensata, prudência e discernimento (Mt 25.2; Rm 11.25).
THAYER.en: Characterizes one who possesses practical discernment, insight, and prudence to act correctly in various life situations. 1. Endowed with sensible understanding, prudence, and discernment (Matt 25:2; Rom 11:25).

SEMANTIC_FIELD: Thought and Comprehension - Wisdom and Prudence
DEFINITION: In a prudent manner, demonstrating discernment, insight, and practical common sense.
SENSES: 1. Acting with prudent shrewdness or practical discernment in a given situation (Luke 16:8).

THAYER.pt: De maneira prudente, demonstrando discernimento, perspicácia e bom senso prático. 1. Agir com astúcia prudente ou discernimento prático numa situação dada (Lc 16.8).
THAYER.en: In a prudent manner, demonstrating discernment, insight, and practical common sense. 1. Acting with prudent shrewdness or practical discernment in a given situation (Luke 16:8).

SEMANTIC_FIELD: Thought and Consideration - Caring and Worrying
DEFINITION: To dedicate serious and continuous attention to something, striving to carry out or consider a purpose.
SENSES: 1. To be diligently devoted to good works or important purposes (Titus 3:8).

THAYER.pt: Dedicar atenção séria e contínua a algo, empenhando-se em realizar ou considerar um propósito. 1. Dedicar-se diligentemente a boas obras ou propósitos importantes (Tt 3.8).
THAYER.en: To dedicate serious and continuous attention to something, striving to carry out or consider a purpose. 1. To be diligently devoted to good works or important purposes (Titus 3:8).

DEFINITION: Means to keep under military surveillance, guard, or provide security and protection against external dangers.
SENSES: 1. To watch or keep under guard (2 Cor 11:32).
2. To confine or retain in custody (Gal 3:23).
3. To protect, guard, and provide divine security (Phil 4:7; 1 Pet 1:5).

THAYER.pt: Significa manter sob vigilância militar, custodiar ou prover segurança e proteção contra perigos externos. 1. Vigiar ou manter sob guarda (2Co 11.32). | 2. Confinar ou reter sob custódia (Gl 3.23). | 3. Proteger, guardar e prover segurança divina (Fp 4.7; 1Pe 1.5).
THAYER.en: Means to keep under military surveillance, guard, or provide security and protection against external dangers. 1. To watch or keep under guard (2 Cor 11:32). | 2. To confine or retain in custody (Gal 3:23). | 3. To protect, guard, and provide divine security (Phil 4:7; 1 Pet 1:5).

DEFINITION: To act with insolence, arrogance, or proud rebellion against authorities or against God.
SENSES: 1. To tumultuously rage with insolence and arrogant rebellion against the Lord and his Anointed (Acts 4:25).

THAYER.pt: Agir com insolência, arrogância ou revolta orgulhosa contra autoridades ou contra Deus. 1. Tumultuar com insolência e rebeldia arrogante contra o Senhor e seu Ungido (At 4.25).
THAYER.en: To act with insolence, arrogance, or proud rebellion against authorities or against God. 1. To tumultuously rage with insolence and arrogant rebellion against the Lord and his Anointed (Acts 4:25).

DEFINITION: Small dry branches or pieces of wood gathered to feed a fire.
SENSES: 1. A bundle of twigs or dry branches used to kindle bonfires (Acts 28:3).

THAYER.pt: Pequenos ramos secos ou pedaços de madeira recolhidos para alimentar o fogo. 1. Feixe de gravetos ou galhos secos usados para acender fogueiras (At 28.3).
THAYER.en: Small dry branches or pieces of wood gathered to feed a fire. 1. A bundle of twigs or dry branches used to kindle bonfires (Acts 28:3).

DEFINITION: A large inland region situated in the center of Asia Minor, visited by Paul on his missionary journeys.
SENSES: 1. The territory and district of Phrygia (Acts 16:6).

THAYER.pt: Grande região interior situada no centro da Ásia Menor, visitada por Paulo em suas viagens missionárias. 1. O território e distrito da Frígia (At 16.6).
THAYER.en: A large inland region situated in the center of Asia Minor, visited by Paul on his missionary journeys. 1. The territory and district of Phrygia (Acts 16:6).

SEMANTIC_FIELD: Names of People and Places - People
DEFINITION: The proper masculine name of a Christian in Asia who abandoned the apostle Paul in a time of tribulation.
SENSES: 1. Phygellus, an Asian Christian who turned away from Paul (2 Tim 1:15).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio masculino de um cristão na Ásia que abandonou o apóstolo Paulo em momento de tribulação. 1. Figele, cristão asiático que se afastou de Paulo (2Tm 1.15).
THAYER.en: The proper masculine name of a Christian in Asia who abandoned the apostle Paul in a time of tribulation. 1. Phygellus, an Asian Christian who turned away from Paul (2 Tim 1:15).

DEFINITION: The act of moving away rapidly from imminent danger in order to escape harm.
SENSES: 1. The act of fleeing to escape imminent dangers or calamities (Matt 24:20).

THAYER.pt: Ação de afastar-se rapidamente de um perigo iminente para escapar de um dano. 1. Ato de fugir para escapar de perigos ou calamidades iminentes (Mt 24.20).
THAYER.en: The act of moving away rapidly from imminent danger in order to escape harm. 1. The act of fleeing to escape imminent dangers or calamities (Matt 24:20).

DEFINITION: Primarily indicates the act or task of watching and protecting. By extension, it refers to the military detachment of sentinels itself, the prison where detainees are held, and the temporal division of the night period.
SENSES: 1. Prison, dungeon, or place of penal confinement (Matt 18:30; Acts 12:5; 16:27).
2. The act of guarding or patrolling; a guard post (Luke 2:8).
3. A military guard, patrol, or sentinel (Acts 12:10).
4. A division of the four watches of the Greco-Roman night (Matt 14:25; Mark 6:48).

THAYER.pt: Indica primariamente o ato ou tarefa de vigiar e proteger. Por extensão, refere-se ao próprio destacamento militar de sentinelas, à prisão onde os detidos são mantidos e à divisão temporal do período noturno. 1. Prisão, cárcere ou local de confinamento penal (Mt 18.30; At 12.5; 16.27). | 2. Ato de guardar ou patrulhar; posto de vigilância (Lc 2.8). | 3. Guarda, patrulha ou sentinela militar (At 12.10). | 4. Divisão das quatro vigílias da noite judaico-romana (Mt 14.25; Mc 6.48).
THAYER.en: Primarily indicates the act or task of watching and protecting. By extension, it refers to the military detachment of sentinels itself, the prison where detainees are held, and the temporal division of the night period. 1. Prison, dungeon, or place of penal confinement (Matt 18:30; Acts 12:5; 16:27). | 2. The act of guarding or patrolling; a guard post (Luke 2:8). | 3. A military guard, patrol, or sentinel (Acts 12:10). | 4. A division of the four watches of the Greco-Roman night (Matt 14:25; Mark 6:48).

DEFINITION: To confine someone in a prison or enclosure of custody.
SENSES: 1. To put persons under arrest or restrictive custody (Acts 22:19).

THAYER.pt: Confinar alguém em uma prisão ou recinto de custódia. 1. Colocar pessoas sob prisão ou custódia restritiva (At 22.19).
THAYER.en: To confine someone in a prison or enclosure of custody. 1. To put persons under arrest or restrictive custody (Acts 22:19).

DEFINITION: A small leather box containing passages of the Law, worn by Jews on the arm and forehead during prayer.
SENSES: 1. A phylactery or prayer box worn ostentatiously by Pharisees (Matt 23:5).

THAYER.pt: Pequena caixa de couro contendo trechos da Lei, usada por judeus no braço e na testa durante a oração. 1. Filactério ou caixinha de oração usada ostensivamente por fariseus (Mt 23.5).
THAYER.en: A small leather box containing passages of the Law, worn by Jews on the arm and forehead during prayer. 1. A phylactery or prayer box worn ostentatiously by Pharisees (Matt 23:5).

DEFINITION: Indicates the person in charge of watching, protecting, or guarding a place, object, or prisoner.
SENSES: 1. A guard or sentinel responsible for surveillance (Acts 5:23; Matt 27:65).

THAYER.pt: Indica a pessoa encarregada de vigiar, proteger ou custodiar um local, objeto ou prisioneiro. 1. Guarda ou sentinela responsável pela vigilância (At 5.23; Mt 27.65).
THAYER.en: Indicates the person in charge of watching, protecting, or guarding a place, object, or prisoner. 1. A guard or sentinel responsible for surveillance (Acts 5:23; Matt 27:65).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: φυλάξω, Aor: ἐφύλαξα, Pass: ἐφυλάχθην
DEFINITION: To keep close watch over someone or something in order to protect it from harm, carry out orders, or avoid dangers.
SENSES: 1. To exercise the function of a sentinel, watch, or keep under custody (Acts 12:4).
2. To protect and carefully guard against dangers (John 17:12; 2 Thess 3:3).
3. To keep, observe, or obey commandments and laws (Luke 18:21; Rom 2:26).

THAYER.pt: Manter vigilância atenta sobre alguém ou algo para protegê-lo de danos, cumprir ordens ou evitar perigos. 1. Exercer função de sentinela, vigiar ou manter sob custódia (At 12.4). | 2. Proteger e guardar cuidadosamente contra perigos (Jo 17.12; 2Ts 3.3). | 3. Guardar, observar ou obedecer a mandamentos e leis (Lc 18.21; Rm 2.26).
THAYER.en: To keep close watch over someone or something in order to protect it from harm, carry out orders, or avoid dangers. 1. To exercise the function of a sentinel, watch, or keep under custody (Acts 12:4). | 2. To protect and carefully guard against dangers (John 17:12; 2 Thess 3:3). | 3. To keep, observe, or obey commandments and laws (Luke 18:21; Rom 2:26).

DEFINITION: A subgroup of a nation or ethnic group united by common ancestral ties of blood and family lineage.
SENSES: 1. A specific tribe within the people of Israel (Luke 2:36; Heb 7:13).
2. An ethnic group or nation making up the human race in a broad sense (Matt 24:30; Rev 5:9).

THAYER.pt: Subgrupo de uma nação ou grupo étnico unido por laços ancestrais comuns de sangue e linhagem familiar. 1. Uma tribo específica dentro do povo de Israel (Lc 2.36; Hb 7.13). | 2. Um grupo étnico ou nação que compõe a raça humana em sentido amplo (Mt 24.30; Ap 5.9).
THAYER.en: A subgroup of a nation or ethnic group united by common ancestral ties of blood and family lineage. 1. A specific tribe within the people of Israel (Luke 2:36; Heb 7:13). | 2. An ethnic group or nation making up the human race in a broad sense (Matt 24:30; Rev 5:9).

DEFINITION: The green, flat part of a plant or tree responsible for photosynthesis.
SENSES: 1. The leaf of a tree (Matt 21:19).

THAYER.pt: A parte verde e plana de uma planta ou árvore, responsável pela fotossíntese. 1. Folha de árvore (Mt 21:19).
THAYER.en: The green, flat part of a plant or tree responsible for photosynthesis. 1. The leaf of a tree (Matt 21:19).

DEFINITION: Refers to a mixture of kneaded substances, especially flour dough prepared for making bread or clay molded by the potter.
SENSES: 1. Fermented bread dough used as a metaphor for spiritual influence (1 Cor 5:6).
2. A portion of clay or mass set aside for the potter's work (Rom 9:21).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se a uma mistura de substâncias amassadas, especialmente a massa de farinha preparada para fazer pão ou a argila modelada pelo oleiro. 1. Massa de pão fermentada usada como metáfora de influência espiritual (1Co 5.6). | 2. Porção de argila ou massa disposta para o trabalho do oleiro (Rm 9.21).
THAYER.en: Refers to a mixture of kneaded substances, especially flour dough prepared for making bread or clay molded by the potter. 1. Fermented bread dough used as a metaphor for spiritual influence (1 Cor 5:6). | 2. A portion of clay or mass set aside for the potter's work (Rom 9:21).

DEFINITION: Being in accordance with the inherent order of creation or the fundamental instincts established in nature.
SENSES: 1. Corresponding to the natural order of things and innate behavior (Rom 1:26; 2 Pet 2:12).

THAYER.pt: Que está de acordo com a ordem inerente à criação ou aos instintos fundamentais estabelecidos na natureza. 1. Correspondente à ordem natural das coisas e ao comportamento inato (Rm 1.26; 2Pe 2.12).
THAYER.en: Being in accordance with the inherent order of creation or the fundamental instincts established in nature. 1. Corresponding to the natural order of things and innate behavior (Rom 1:26; 2 Pet 2:12).

DEFINITION: According to the natural order of things or driven by innate biological instinct.
SENSES: 1. Acting by natural instinct, inherent to creation itself (Jude 10).

THAYER.pt: Conforme a ordem natural das coisas ou impelido pelo instinto biológico inato. 1. Agindo por instinto natural, inerente à própria criação (Jd 10).
THAYER.en: According to the natural order of things or driven by innate biological instinct. 1. Acting by natural instinct, inherent to creation itself (Jude 10).

DEFINITION: Literally to inflate or blow air, but used metaphorically to describe pride that fills someone with arrogance and presumption.
SENSES: 1. To make arrogant, to fill with intellectual or moral pride and conceit (1 Cor 4:6, 18; 8:1).

THAYER.pt: Literalmente inflar ou soprar ar, mas usado metaforicamente para descrever o orgulho que enche alguém de soberba e presunção. 1. Ensoberbecer, encher de orgulho e arrogância intelectual ou moral (1Co 4.6, 18; 8.1).
THAYER.en: Literally to inflate or blow air, but used metaphorically to describe pride that fills someone with arrogance and presumption. 1. To make arrogant, to fill with intellectual or moral pride and conceit (1 Cor 4:6, 18; 8:1).

DEFINITION: The inherent condition, constitution, or natural order of things determined by origin, birth, or creation.
SENSES: 1. Innate condition or inherited status by birth (Gal 2:15; Eph 2:3).
2. The established and regular order of the universe (Rom 1:26; 1 Cor 11:14).

THAYER.pt: A condição inerente, constituição ou ordem natural das coisas, determinada por origem, nascimento ou criação. 1. Condição inata ou herdada por nascimento (Gl 2.15; Ef 2.3). | 2. A ordem estabelecida e regular do universo (Rm 1.26; 1Co 11.14).
THAYER.en: The inherent condition, constitution, or natural order of things determined by origin, birth, or creation. 1. Innate condition or inherited status by birth (Gal 2:15; Eph 2:3). | 2. The established and regular order of the universe (Rom 1:26; 1 Cor 11:14).

DEFINITION: A state of arrogance, haughtiness, or inflated pride regarding one's own worth or knowledge.
SENSES: 1. An attitude of inflated presumption and arrogant vanity (2 Cor 12:20).

THAYER.pt: Estado de soberba, arrogância ou orgulho inflado em relação ao próprio valor ou conhecimento. 1. Atitude de presunção inflada e vaidade arrogante (2Co 12.20).
THAYER.en: A state of arrogance, haughtiness, or inflated pride regarding one's own worth or knowledge. 1. An attitude of inflated presumption and arrogant vanity (2 Cor 12:20).

DEFINITION: That which has been planted or cultivated, and can be used in a literal or figurative sense.
SENSES: 1. A plantation or planted sapling, referring figuratively to false teachings (Matt 15:13).
