THAYER.pt: Aquilo que foi plantado ou cultivado, podendo ser usado em sentido literal ou figurado. 1. Plantação ou muda plantada, referindo-se figuradamente a ensinamentos falsos (Mt 15.13).
THAYER.en: That which has been planted or cultivated, and can be used in a literal or figurative sense. 1. A plantation or planted sapling, referring figuratively to false teachings (Matt 15:13).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: φυτεύσω, Aor: ἐφύτευσα, Pass: ἐφυτεύθην
DEFINITION: Signifies the act of placing seeds, saplings, or trees in the ground so that they grow, frequently used both in the literal agricultural sense and in spiritual metaphors.
SENSES: 1. To plant trees, vines, or seeds in the ground (Luke 17:6; Matt 21:33).

THAYER.pt: Significa o ato de colocar sementes, mudas ou árvores na terra para que cresçam, sendo frequentemente usado tanto no sentido literal da agricultura quanto em metáforas espirituais. 1. Plantar árvores, videiras ou sementes na terra (Lc 17.6; Mt 21.33).
THAYER.en: Signifies the act of placing seeds, saplings, or trees in the ground so that they grow, frequently used both in the literal agricultural sense and in spiritual metaphors. 1. To plant trees, vines, or seeds in the ground (Luke 17:6; Matt 21:33).

DEFINITION: Describes the process of growth or emergence of plants, shoots, or roots from the ground.
SENSES: 1. To grow or sprout from the soil, referring to plants or roots (Luke 8:8; Heb 12:15).

THAYER.pt: Descreve o processo de crescimento ou surgimento de plantas, brotos ou raízes a partir da terra. 1. Crescer ou brotar do solo, referindo-se a plantas ou raízes (Lc 8.8; Hb 12.15).
THAYER.en: Describes the process of growth or emergence of plants, shoots, or roots from the ground. 1. To grow or sprout from the soil, referring to plants or roots (Luke 8:8; Heb 12:15).

DEFINITION: Refers to a cavity or hole in the ground that serves as a dwelling or refuge for wild animals.
SENSES: 1. A den or lair used by animals as shelter (Matt 8:20).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se a uma cavidade ou buraco na terra que serve como habitação ou refúgio para animais selvagens. 1. Toca ou covil utilizado por animais como abrigo (Mt 8.20).
THAYER.en: Refers to a cavity or hole in the ground that serves as a dwelling or refuge for wild animals. 1. A den or lair used by animals as shelter (Matt 8:20).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: φωνήσω; Aor: ἐφώνησα; Pass: ἐφωνήθην
DEFINITION: To emit an audible vocal sound, frequently with high intensity, in order to call, summon, or communicate with someone.
SENSES: 1. To utter a voice or characteristic sound, whether by humans or animals (Luke 23:46; John 13:38).
2. To call or summon someone in a loud voice to approach (Matt 20:32; John 11:28).

THAYER.pt: Emitir um som vocal audível, frequentemente com intensidade elevada, para chamar, convocar ou se comunicar com alguém. 1. Emitir voz ou som característico, seja por humanos ou animais (Lc 23.46; Jo 13.38). | 2. Chamar ou convocar alguém em voz alta para que se aproxime (Mt 20.32; Jo 11.28).
THAYER.en: To emit an audible vocal sound, frequently with high intensity, in order to call, summon, or communicate with someone. 1. To utter a voice or characteristic sound, whether by humans or animals (Luke 23:46; John 13:38). | 2. To call or summon someone in a loud voice to approach (Matt 20:32; John 11:28).

DEFINITION: Any articulated vocal emission or audible noise produced in the environment. It is commonly applied to human speech, the cry of angels, the sound of musical instruments or thunder, and prominently to the authoritative voice of God in revelation.
SENSES: 1. Human voice, the faculty of speech, and articulated sound emission (Matt 3:3; Luke 1:44).
2. The sound of natural phenomena or instruments, a trumpet, a noise (Matt 24:31; John 3:8).
3. The audible manifestation of God or divine declaration from heaven (Matt 3:17; John 12:28).
4. Tongue, language proper to a people or nation (1 Cor 14:10).

THAYER.pt: Qualquer emissão vocal articulada ou ruído audível produzido no meio ambiente. É comumente aplicada à fala humana, ao brado de anjos, ao som de instrumentos musicais ou trovões, e de modo proeminente à voz autoral de Deus na revelação. 1. Voz humana, faculdade da fala e emissão sonora articulada (Mt 3.3; Lc 1.44). | 2. Som de fenômenos naturais ou instrumentos, trombeta, ruído (Mt 24.31; Jo 3.8). | 3. A manifestação audível de Deus ou declaração divina do céu (Mt 3.17; Jo 12.28). | 4. Idioma, linguagem própria de um povo ou nação (1Co 14.10).
THAYER.en: Any articulated vocal emission or audible noise produced in the environment. It is commonly applied to human speech, the cry of angels, the sound of musical instruments or thunder, and prominently to the authoritative voice of God in revelation. 1. Human voice, the faculty of speech, and articulated sound emission (Matt 3:3; Luke 1:44). | 2. The sound of natural phenomena or instruments, a trumpet, a noise (Matt 24:31; John 3:8). | 3. The audible manifestation of God or divine declaration from heaven (Matt 3:17; John 12:28). | 4. Tongue, language proper to a people or nation (1 Cor 14:10).

DEFINITION: Describes physical radiation that dispels darkness, widely used in Johannine and Pauline theology as a symbol of divine truth, purity, and revelation.
SENSES: 1. Physical light as opposed to darkness (Matt 17:2; Acts 9:3).
2. The sphere of holiness and divine revelation in the person of Christ (John 1:4; 1 John 1:5).

THAYER.pt: Descreve a radiação física que dissipa a escuridão, amplamente utilizada na teologia joanina e paulina como símbolo da verdade divina, pureza e revelação. 1. Luz física em oposição às trevas (Mt 17.2; At 9.3). | 2. A esfera da santidade e da revelação divina na pessoa de Cristo (Jo 1.4; 1Jo 1.5).
THAYER.en: Describes physical radiation that dispels darkness, widely used in Johannine and Pauline theology as a symbol of divine truth, purity, and revelation. 1. Physical light as opposed to darkness (Matt 17:2; Acts 9:3). | 2. The sphere of holiness and divine revelation in the person of Christ (John 1:4; 1 John 1:5).

DEFINITION: Designates a celestial body or source that emits light, used both in a literal sense for stars and in a figurative sense to describe witnesses of the truth.
SENSES: 1. A celestial body that emits light or a star (Phil 2:15).
2. A state of brightness, splendor, or radiation (Rev 21:11).

THAYER.pt: Designa um corpo celeste ou fonte que emite luz, sendo empregado tanto no sentido literal para astros quanto no figurativo para descrever testemunhas da verdade. 1. Corpo celeste que emite luz ou estrela (Fp 2.15). | 2. Estado de brilho, esplendor ou radiação (Ap 21.11).
THAYER.en: Designates a celestial body or source that emits light, used both in a literal sense for stars and in a figurative sense to describe witnesses of the truth. 1. A celestial body that emits light or a star (Phil 2:15). | 2. A state of brightness, splendor, or radiation (Rev 21:11).

DEFINITION: A term that literally means 'light-bearing' or 'bringing light,' used in the New Testament as a reference to the morning star.
SENSES: 1. The morning star or the planet Venus, used metaphorically for the light that shines in the hearts of believers (2 Pet 1:19).

THAYER.pt: Termo que significa literalmente 'portador de luz' ou 'que traz a luz', sendo empregado no Novo Testamento como referência à estrela da manhã. 1. A estrela da manhã ou o planeta Vênus, usado metaforicamente para a luz que brilha nos corações dos crentes (2Pe 1.19).
THAYER.en: A term that literally means 'light-bearing' or 'bringing light,' used in the New Testament as a reference to the morning star. 1. The morning star or the planet Venus, used metaphorically for the light that shines in the hearts of believers (2 Pet 1:19).

DEFINITION: That which emits its own light or reflects intense clarity, being bright, resplendent, or well-lit.
SENSES: 1. Bright and radiant, like a luminous cloud (Matt 17:5).
2. Illuminated or full of light (Matt 6:22).

THAYER.pt: Que emite luz própria ou reflete intensa claridade, sendo brilhante, resplandecente ou bem iluminado. 1. Brilhante e radiante, como uma nuvem luminosa (Mt 17.5). | 2. Iluminado ou cheio de luz (Mt 6.22).
THAYER.en: That which emits its own light or reflects intense clarity, being bright, resplendent, or well-lit. 1. Bright and radiant, like a luminous cloud (Matt 17:5). | 2. Illuminated or full of light (Matt 6:22).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: φωτίσω, Aor: ἐφώτισα, Pass: ἐφωτίσθην
SHORT_GLOSS: to illuminate, light up, bring to ligh
DEFINITION: Indicates the action of emitting light upon something or someone, illuminating physically, but also describing spiritual illumination and the revelation of divine truths to the mind and heart.
SENSES: 1. To emit light or shine upon a space (Rev 22:5; Luke 11:36).
2. To illuminate spiritually or grant understanding (Eph 1:18; John 1:9).
3. To bring to light or reveal hidden things (1 Cor 4:5; 2 Tim 1:10).
USAGE: to illuminate, light up, bring to ligh

THAYER.pt: Indica a ação de emitir luz sobre algo ou alguém, iluminando fisicamente, mas também descrevendo a iluminação espiritual e a revelação de verdades divinas à mente e ao coração. 1. Emitir luz ou brilhar sobre um espaço (Ap 22.5; Lc 11.36). | 2. Iluminar espiritualmente ou conceder entendimento (Ef 1.18; Jo 1.9). | 3. Trazer à luz ou revelar coisas ocultas (1Co 4.5; 2Tm 1.10).
THAYER.en: Indicates the action of emitting light upon something or someone, illuminating physically, but also describing spiritual illumination and the revelation of divine truths to the mind and heart. 1. To emit light or shine upon a space (Rev 22:5; Luke 11:36). | 2. To illuminate spiritually or grant understanding (Eph 1:18; John 1:9). | 3. To bring to light or reveal hidden things (1 Cor 4:5; 2 Tim 1:10).

DEFINITION: Describes the act of illuminating, especially the spiritual illumination of the mind or the revelation of divine truth.
SENSES: 1. Interior illumination or spiritual enlightenment (2 Cor 4:4).
2. The act of bringing to light or revealing the truth (2 Cor 4:6).

THAYER.pt: Descreve o ato de iluminar, especialmente a iluminação espiritual da mente ou a revelação da verdade divina. 1. Iluminação interior ou esclarecimento espiritual (2Co 4.4). | 2. Ato de trazer à luz ou revelar a verdade (2Co 4.6).
THAYER.en: Describes the act of illuminating, especially the spiritual illumination of the mind or the revelation of divine truth. 1. Interior illumination or spiritual enlightenment (2 Cor 4:4). | 2. The act of bringing to light or revealing the truth (2 Cor 4:6).

DEFINITION: Describes a state of inner well-being, happiness, and jubilation, and is also used as a common epistolary greeting formula.
SENSES: 1. To be in a state of great joy or rejoicing (Matt 2:10; Phil 4:4).
2. To greet someone, serving as a salutation (Matt 26:49; Acts 15:23).

THAYER.pt: Descreve um estado de bem-estar interior, felicidade e júbilo, além de ser empregado como uma fórmula comum de saudação epistolar. 1. Estar em estado de grande alegria ou regozijo (Mt 2.10; Fp 4.4). | 2. Cumprimentar alguém, servindo como saudação (Mt 26.49; At 15.23).
THAYER.en: Describes a state of inner well-being, happiness, and jubilation, and is also used as a common epistolary greeting formula. 1. To be in a state of great joy or rejoicing (Matt 2:10; Phil 4:4). | 2. To greet someone, serving as a salutation (Matt 26:49; Acts 15:23).

DEFINITION: A meteorological phenomenon consisting of the precipitation of ice stones or frozen rain.
SENSES: 1. A hailstorm associated with apocalyptic judgments (Rev 8:7; 11:19; 16:21).

THAYER.pt: Fenômeno meteorológico que consiste na precipitação de pedras de gelo ou chuva congelada. 1. Chuva de granizo associada a juízos apocalípticos (Ap 8.7; 11.19; 16.21).
THAYER.en: A meteorological phenomenon consisting of the precipitation of ice stones or frozen rain. 1. A hailstorm associated with apocalyptic judgments (Rev 8:7; 11:19; 16:21).

DEFINITION: To loosen ropes or moorings to allow something to descend gradually from a higher level to a lower one.
SENSES: 1. To lower, let down, or release something with ropes (Mark 2:4; Luke 5:4; Acts 27:17).

THAYER.pt: Afrouxar cordas ou amarras para permitir que algo desça gradualmente de um nível superior para um inferior. 1. Arriar, descer ou soltar algo com cordas (Mc 2.4; Lc 5.4; At 27.17).
THAYER.en: To loosen ropes or moorings to allow something to descend gradually from a higher level to a lower one. 1. To lower, let down, or release something with ropes (Mark 2:4; Luke 5:4; Acts 27:17).

DEFINITION: Designates an inhabitant of Chaldea, a region historically associated with Babylon and known in antiquity for its wise men, astrologers, and interpreters of dreams.
SENSES: 1. An inhabitant of the land of the Chaldeans, referring to Abraham's origin before his journey to Haran (Acts 7:4).

THAYER.pt: Designa um habitante da Caldeia, região associada historicamente à Babilônia e conhecida na antiguidade pelos seus sábios, astrólogos e intérpretes de sonhos. 1. Habitante da terra dos caldeus, referindo-se à origem de Abraão antes de sua jornada para Harã (At 7.4).
THAYER.en: Designates an inhabitant of Chaldea, a region historically associated with Babylon and known in antiquity for its wise men, astrologers, and interpreters of dreams. 1. An inhabitant of the land of the Chaldeans, referring to Abraham's origin before his journey to Haran (Acts 7:4).

DEFINITION: Qualifies that which is hard, painful, difficult to endure, or which manifests in an aggressive and violent manner.
SENSES: 1. Difficult times full of danger (2 Tim 3:1).
2. Fierce, violent, or dangerous behavior (Matt 8:28).

THAYER.pt: Qualifica aquilo que é duro, penoso, difícil de suportar ou que se manifesta de forma agressiva e violenta. 1. Períodos ou tempos difíceis e cheios de perigo (2Tm 3.1). | 2. Comportamento feroz, violento ou perigoso (Mt 8.28).
THAYER.en: Qualifies that which is hard, painful, difficult to endure, or which manifests in an aggressive and violent manner. 1. Difficult times full of danger (2 Tim 3:1). | 2. Fierce, violent, or dangerous behavior (Matt 8:28).

DEFINITION: Literally means to bridle, to control rigorously, or to exercise strict dominion over some bodily function, especially the tongue.
SENSES: 1. To exercise strong control or restrain one's own behavior (Jas 1:26; 3:2).

THAYER.pt: Significa literalmente enfrear, controlar rigorosamente ou exercer domínio estrito sobre alguma função corporal, especialmente a língua. 1. Exercer forte controle ou refrear o próprio comportamento (Tg 1.26; 3.2).
THAYER.en: Literally means to bridle, to control rigorously, or to exercise strict dominion over some bodily function, especially the tongue. 1. To exercise strong control or restrain one's own behavior (Jas 1:26; 3:2).

DEFINITION: A metal device placed in the mouth of an animal (such as a horse) coupled with reins to guide and control its movements.
SENSES: 1. A bridle or rein for animals (Jas 3:3).
2. Metaphorically, an instrument of restraint or direction (Rev 14:20).

THAYER.pt: Dispositivo metálico colocado na boca de um animal (como o cavalo) acoplado a rédeas para guiar e controlar seus movimentos. 1. Freio ou rédea de animais (Tg 3.3). | 2. Metaforicamente, instrumento de contenção ou direção (Ap 14.20).
THAYER.en: A metal device placed in the mouth of an animal (such as a horse) coupled with reins to guide and control its movements. 1. A bridle or rein for animals (Jas 3:3). | 2. Metaphorically, an instrument of restraint or direction (Rev 14:20).

DEFINITION: An adjective describing objects made of metals such as copper, bronze, or brass, common in the manufacture of utensils and idols.
SENSES: 1. Made of metal such as bronze, copper, or brass, used to describe inanimate pagan idols (Rev 9:20).

THAYER.pt: Adjetivo que descreve objetos feitos de metais como cobre, bronze ou latão, comuns na fabricação de utensílios e ídolos. 1. Feito de metal como bronze, cobre ou latão, usado para descrever ídolos pagãos inanimados (Ap 9.20).
THAYER.en: An adjective describing objects made of metals such as copper, bronze, or brass, common in the manufacture of utensils and idols. 1. Made of metal such as bronze, copper, or brass, used to describe inanimate pagan idols (Rev 9:20).

DEFINITION: A professional specialized in working with metals, originally focused on copper and bronze, but extended to blacksmiths and craftsmen in general.
SENSES: 1. A craftsman or worker who manipulates metals, a blacksmith or founder (2 Tim 4:14).

THAYER.pt: Profissional especializado no trabalho com metais, originalmente focado no cobre e bronze, mas estendido a ferreiros e artífices em geral. 1. Artífice ou trabalhador que manipula metais, ferreiro ou fundidor (2Tm 4.14).
THAYER.en: A professional specialized in working with metals, originally focused on copper and bronze, but extended to blacksmiths and craftsmen in general. 1. A craftsman or worker who manipulates metals, a blacksmith or founder (2 Tim 4:14).

DEFINITION: A precious stone of a generally bluish or greenish hue, mentioned in the eschatological descriptions of the New Testament.
SENSES: 1. A precious gem used as the third foundation of the wall of the New Jerusalem (Rev 21:19).

THAYER.pt: Pedra preciosa de tonalidade geralmente azulada ou esverdeada, mencionada nas descrições escatológicas do Novo Testamento. 1. Uma gema preciosa usada como o terceiro fundamento do muro da Nova Jerusalém (Ap 21.19).
THAYER.en: A precious stone of a generally bluish or greenish hue, mentioned in the eschatological descriptions of the New Testament. 1. A precious gem used as the third foundation of the wall of the New Jerusalem (Rev 21:19).

DEFINITION: A domestic or utilitarian container made of metal, such as copper or bronze, used for culinary or hygienic purposes.
SENSES: 1. A vessel, cauldron, or basin made of metal for domestic and ritual uses (Mark 7:4).

THAYER.pt: Recipiente doméstico ou utilitário fabricado em metal, como cobre ou bronze, usado para fins culinários ou de higienização. 1. Vaso, caldeirão ou bacia feita de metal para usos domésticos e rituais (Mc 7.4).
THAYER.en: A domestic or utilitarian container made of metal, such as copper or bronze, used for culinary or hygienic purposes. 1. A vessel, cauldron, or basin made of metal for domestic and ritual uses (Mark 7:4).

DEFINITION: Designates a metal or metal alloy of extremely high quality and exceptional brightness, the exact identification of which is debated but associated with polished bronze.
SENSES: 1. A precious and refined metal, used in apocalyptic descriptions (Rev 1:15; 2:18).

THAYER.pt: Designa um metal ou liga metálica de altíssima qualidade e brilho excepcional, de identificação exata debatida mas associada ao bronze polido. 1. Metal precioso e refinado, usado em descrições apocalípticas (Ap 1.15; 2.18).
THAYER.en: Designates a metal or metal alloy of extremely high quality and exceptional brightness, the exact identification of which is debated but associated with polished bronze. 1. A precious and refined metal, used in apocalyptic descriptions (Rev 1:15; 2:18).

DEFINITION: Designates the metal copper, bronze, or brass, as well as utilitarian objects, musical instruments, or coins minted with this metal.
SENSES: 1. The metal bronze or copper (Rev 18:12).
2. A musical instrument made of metal, such as a gong (1 Cor 13:1).
3. Copper coin or small savings in money (Matt 10:9; Mark 12:41).

THAYER.pt: Designa o metal de cobre, bronze ou latão, bem como objetos utilitários, instrumentos musicais ou moedas cunhadas com esse metal. 1. O metal bronze ou cobre (Ap 18.12). | 2. Instrumento musical feito de metal, como um gongo (1Co 13.1). | 3. Moeda de cobre ou pequenas economias em dinheiro (Mt 10.9; Mc 12.41).
THAYER.en: Designates the metal copper, bronze, or brass, as well as utilitarian objects, musical instruments, or coins minted with this metal. 1. The metal bronze or copper (Rev 18:12). | 2. A musical instrument made of metal, such as a gong (1 Cor 13:1). | 3. Copper coin or small savings in money (Matt 10:9; Mark 12:41).

SHORT_GLOSS: to the ground, on the ground
DEFINITION: An adverb that denotes position or movement toward the surface of the earth or the ground.
SENSES: 1. To be located on the surface of the ground (John 9:6).
2. To fall or move toward the ground (John 18:6).
USAGE: to the ground, on the ground

THAYER.pt: Advérbio que denota posição ou movimento em direção à superfície da terra ou ao solo. 1. Estar localizado na superfície do solo (Jo 9.6). | 2. Cair ou mover-se em direção ao chão (Jo 18.6).
THAYER.en: An adverb that denotes position or movement toward the surface of the earth or the ground. 1. To be located on the surface of the ground (John 9:6). | 2. To fall or move toward the ground (John 18:6).

DEFINITION: A historical geographical name that designates the land situated west of the Jordan River, inhabited by the patriarchs and conquered by the Israelites.
SENSES: 1. The land of Canaan as a historical region (Acts 7:11; 13:19).

THAYER.pt: Nome geográfico histórico que designa a terra situada a oeste do rio Jordão, habitada pelos patriarcas e conquistada pelos israelitas. 1. A terra de Canaã como região histórica (At 7.11; 13.19).
THAYER.en: A historical geographical name that designates the land situated west of the Jordan River, inhabited by the patriarchs and conquered by the Israelites. 1. The land of Canaan as a historical region (Acts 7:11; 13:19).

DEFINITION: Pertaining to the land of Canaan or its original inhabitants, maintaining ethnic and geographical relevance in the context of the Gospels.
SENSES: 1. Native or originating from the region of Canaan, used to identify the Syrophoenician woman who sought help from Jesus (Mt 15:22).

THAYER.pt: Pertencente à terra de Canaã ou aos seus habitantes originais, mantendo relevância étnica e geográfica no contexto dos Evangelhos. 1. Nativo ou originário da região de Canaã, usado para identificar a mulher siro-fenícia que buscou socorro em Jesus (Mt 15.22).
THAYER.en: Pertaining to the land of Canaan or its original inhabitants, maintaining ethnic and geographical relevance in the context of the Gospels. 1. Native or originating from the region of Canaan, used to identify the Syrophoenician woman who sought help from Jesus (Mt 15:22).

DEFINITION: Describes the inner state of contentment and jubilation, frequently associated with the work of the Holy Spirit and salvation.
SENSES: 1. The inner experience of joy and contentment (Gal 5:22; Jn 16:20).
2. A person or reason that causes rejoicing and pride (Phil 4:1; 1 Thess 2:19).

THAYER.pt: Descreve o estado íntimo de contentamento e júbilo, sendo frequentemente associada à obra do Espírito Santo e à salvação. 1. A experiência interior de alegria e contentamento (Gl 5.22; Jo 16.20). | 2. Pessoa ou motivo que causa regozijo e orgulho (Fp 4.1; 1Ts 2.19).
THAYER.en: Describes the inner state of contentment and jubilation, frequently associated with the work of the Holy Spirit and salvation. 1. The inner experience of joy and contentment (Gal 5:22; Jn 16:20). | 2. A person or reason that causes rejoicing and pride (Phil 4:1; 1 Thess 2:19).

DEFINITION: A mark engraved, printed, or stamped on surfaces or skin, also designating sculptures or artistic representations.
SENSES: 1. A mark or sign stamped, engraved, or tattooed (Rev 13:16; 14:9).
2. A sculpted image or artistic representation (Acts 17:29).

THAYER.pt: Marca gravada, impressa ou estampada em superfícies ou na pele, além de designar esculturas ou representações artísticas. 1. Marca ou sinal estampado, gravado ou tatuado (Ap 13.16; 14.9). | 2. Imagem esculpida ou representação artística (At 17.29).
THAYER.en: A mark engraved, printed, or stamped on surfaces or skin, also designating sculptures or artistic representations. 1. A mark or sign stamped, engraved, or tattooed (Rev 13:16; 14:9). | 2. A sculpted image or artistic representation (Acts 17:29).

DEFINITION: A mark impressed by a signet or die, denoting the exact and perfect reproduction of the essential characteristics of an original.
SENSES: 1. Exact expression, seal, or faithful representation of the essence and glory of God personified in Christ (Heb 1:3).

THAYER.pt: Marca impressa por um sinete ou cunho, denotando a reprodução exata e perfeita das características essenciais de um original. 1. Expressão exata, selo ou representação fiel da essência e da glória de Deus personificada em Cristo (Hb 1.3).
THAYER.en: A mark impressed by a signet or die, denoting the exact and perfect reproduction of the essential characteristics of an original. 1. Exact expression, seal, or faithful representation of the essence and glory of God personified in Christ (Heb 1:3).

DEFINITION: A pointed stake used in fences or the set of stakes employed by armies to fortify camps and besiege cities.
SENSES: 1. A fortified trench with a military palisade built around a besieged city (Lk 19:43).

THAYER.pt: Estaca pontiaguda usada em cercas ou o conjunto de estacas empregadas por exércitos para fortificar acampamentos e cercar cidades. 1. Trincheira fortificada com paliçada militar construída ao redor de uma cidade sitiada (Lc 19.43).
THAYER.en: A pointed stake used in fences or the set of stakes employed by armies to fortify camps and besiege cities. 1. A fortified trench with a military palisade built around a besieged city (Lk 19:43).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Deponent. Fut: χαρίσομαι, Aor: ἐχαρισάμην, Perf: κεχάρισμαι
DEFINITION: To give generously without demanding payment, acting out of grace or favor. Includes the gracious act of forgiving moral offenses or canceling financial debts.
SENSES: 1. To give graciously, to grant freely (Lk 7:21; Rom 8:32).
2. To forgive sins or offenses out of benevolence (2 Cor 2:7; Col 2:13).
3. To cancel a monetary debt (Lk 7:42-43).

THAYER.pt: Dar generosamente sem exigir pagamento, agindo por graça ou favor. Inclui o ato gracioso de perdoar ofensas morais ou cancelar dívidas financeiras. 1. Dar graciosamente, conceder livremente (Lc 7.21; Rm 8.32). | 2. Perdoar pecados ou ofensas por benevolência (2Co 2.7; Cl 2.13). | 3. Cancelar uma dívida monetária (Lc 7.42-43).
THAYER.en: To give generously without demanding payment, acting out of grace or favor. Includes the gracious act of forgiving moral offenses or canceling financial debts. 1. To give graciously, to grant freely (Lk 7:21; Rom 8:32). | 2. To forgive sins or offenses out of benevolence (2 Cor 2:7; Col 2:13). | 3. To cancel a monetary debt (Lk 7:42-43).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Accusative form used as a preposition
SHORT_GLOSS: because of, for the sake of
DEFINITION: Used to indicate the cause, motive, or purpose for which something is done.
SENSES: 1. Because of, due to (Gal 3:19; Tit 1:5).
2. For the purpose of, in favor of (1 Jn 3:12).
USAGE: because of, for the sake of

THAYER.pt: Utilizada para indicar a causa, o motivo ou o propósito pelo qual algo é feito. 1. Por causa de, devido a (Gl 3.19; Tt 1.5). | 2. Para o propósito de, em favor de (1Jo 3.12).
THAYER.en: Used to indicate the cause, motive, or purpose for which something is done. 1. Because of, due to (Gal 3:19; Tit 1:5). | 2. For the purpose of, in favor of (1 Jn 3:12).

DEFINITION: Primarily expresses the sovereign benevolence, unmerited favor, and active generosity of God toward humanity in Christ. Secondarily, it encompasses gratitude, beauty in speech, or concrete gifts of mutual aid.
SENSES: 1. Unmerited favor, redeeming benevolence, and the operative power of God (Rom 3:24; Eph 2:8).
2. Gratitude or thanksgiving expressed to God or others (1 Cor 15:57; 2 Cor 9:15).
3. A practical gift, donation, or tangible manifestation of generosity (1 Cor 16:3; 2 Cor 8:4).
4. Attractiveness, pleasantness, or charm in words (Lk 4:22; Col 4:6).

THAYER.pt: Expressa primariamente a benevolência soberana, favor imerecido e generosidade ativa de Deus para com a humanidade em Cristo. Secundariamente, abrange gratidão, beleza no falar ou dádivas concretas de ajuda mútua. 1. Favor imerecido, benevolência redentora e poder operante de Deus (Rm 3.24; Ef 2.8). | 2. Gratidão ou ação de graças expressa a Deus ou a outrem (1Co 15.57; 2Co 9.15). | 3. Dádiva prática, donativo ou manifestação tangível de generosidade (1Co 16.3; 2Co 8.4). | 4. Atratividade, agradabilidade ou encanto nas palavras (Lc 4.22; Cl 4.6).
THAYER.en: Primarily expresses the sovereign benevolence, unmerited favor, and active generosity of God toward humanity in Christ. Secondarily, it encompasses gratitude, beauty in speech, or concrete gifts of mutual aid. 1. Unmerited favor, redeeming benevolence, and the operative power of God (Rom 3:24; Eph 2:8). | 2. Gratitude or thanksgiving expressed to God or others (1 Cor 15:57; 2 Cor 9:15). | 3. A practical gift, donation, or tangible manifestation of generosity (1 Cor 16:3; 2 Cor 8:4). | 4. Attractiveness, pleasantness, or charm in words (Lk 4:22; Col 4:6).

DEFINITION: Refers to something given freely and graciously by God, encompassing both salvation and spiritual capacities granted to believers.
SENSES: 1. A gift granted freely by divine generosity, such as salvation (Rom 6:23).
2. A spiritual gift or special capacity distributed by the Holy Spirit to the church (1 Cor 12:4; 1 Tim 4:14).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se a algo dado de forma livre e graciosa por Deus, abrangendo tanto a salvação quanto capacidades espirituais concedidas aos crentes. 1. Um presente concedido gratuitamente por generosidade divina, como a salvação (Rm 6.23). | 2. Dom ou capacidade espiritual especial distribuída pelo Espírito Santo à igreja (1Co 12.4; 1Tm 4.14).
THAYER.en: Refers to something given freely and graciously by God, encompassing both salvation and spiritual capacities granted to believers. 1. A gift granted freely by divine generosity, such as salvation (Rom 6:23). | 2. A spiritual gift or special capacity distributed by the Holy Spirit to the church (1 Cor 12:4; 1 Tim 4:14).

SHORT_GLOSS: to favor, bless, endue with grace
DEFINITION: To confer unmerited favor, to cover with grace, or to make someone the object of special favor and divine benevolence.
SENSES: 1. To grant great favor or to bless richly (Eph 1:6; Lk 1:28).
USAGE: to favor, bless, endue with grace

THAYER.pt: Conferir favor imerecido, cobrir de graças ou tornar alguém objeto de favor especial e benevolência divina. 1. Conceder grande favor ou abençoar ricamente (Ef 1.6; Lc 1.28).
THAYER.en: To confer unmerited favor, to cover with grace, or to make someone the object of special favor and divine benevolence. 1. To grant great favor or to bless richly (Eph 1:6; Lk 1:28).

DEFINITION: Ancient city located in Mesopotamia where Abraham and his family lived temporarily.
SENSES: 1. The city of Haran in Mesopotamia (Acts 7:2, 4).

THAYER.pt: Antiga cidade localizada na Mesopotâmia onde Abraão e sua família habitaram temporariamente. 1. A cidade de Haran na Mesopotâmia (At 7.2, 4).
THAYER.en: Ancient city located in Mesopotamia where Abraham and his family lived temporarily. 1. The city of Haran in Mesopotamia (Acts 7:2, 4).

DEFINITION: A sheet or scroll made of papyrus plant material, widely used in the Greco-Roman world for correspondence and written records.
SENSES: 1. A sheet or scroll of papyrus prepared for epistolary writing (2 Jn 12).

THAYER.pt: Folha ou rolo feito de material vegetal de papiro, amplamente utilizado no mundo greco-romano para a correspondência e registros escritos. 1. Folha ou rolo de papiro preparado para a escrita epistolar (2Jo 12).
THAYER.en: A sheet or scroll made of papyrus plant material, widely used in the Greco-Roman world for correspondence and written records. 1. A sheet or scroll of papyrus prepared for epistolary writing (2 Jn 12).

DEFINITION: A deep opening, fissure, or large impassable gap that separates two distinct regions or realities.
SENSES: 1. An impassable chasm that separates the place of the dead and the abode of the righteous (Lk 16:26).

THAYER.pt: Abertura profunda, fenda ou grande vão intransponível que separa duas regiões ou realidades distintas. 1. Abismo intransponível que separa o lugar dos mortos e a morada dos justos (Lc 16.26).
THAYER.en: A deep opening, fissure, or large impassable gap that separates two distinct regions or realities. 1. An impassable chasm that separates the place of the dead and the abode of the righteous (Lk 16:26).

DEFINITION: Anatomically refers to the lips of the human mouth, and by geographical extension designates the edge or margin of bodies of water.
SENSES: 1. Human lips, associated with speech and verbal expression (Mt 15:8; 1 Cor 14:21).
2. Margin, beach, or coast of a body of water (Heb 11:12).

THAYER.pt: Anatomicamente refere-se aos lábios da boca humana, e por extensão geográfica designa a borda ou margem de massas de água. 1. Os lábios humanos, associados à fala e à expressão verbal (Mt 15.8; 1Co 14.21). | 2. Margem, praia ou costa de um corpo d'água (Hb 11.12).
THAYER.en: Anatomically refers to the lips of the human mouth, and by geographical extension designates the edge or margin of bodies of water. 1. Human lips, associated with speech and verbal expression (Mt 15:8; 1 Cor 14:21). | 2. Margin, beach, or coast of a body of water (Heb 11:12).

SHORT_GLOSS: to be lashed by a storm
DEFINITION: To undergo severe weather, to be buffeted by strong winds and storms at sea or on land.
SENSES: 1. To be in a severe sea storm, being lashed by waves and winds (Acts 27:18).
USAGE: to be lashed by a storm

THAYER.pt: Passar por intempéries severas, ser fustigado por ventos fortes e tempestades no mar ou em terra. 1. Estar sob forte tempestade marítima, sendo açoitado por ondas e ventos (At 27.18).
THAYER.en: To undergo severe weather, to be buffeted by strong winds and storms at sea or on land. 1. To be in a severe sea storm, being lashed by waves and winds (Acts 27:18).

DEFINITION: A riverbed or dry valley that fills powerfully with winter rainwater, but typically dries up in the summer.
SENSES: 1. A seasonal stream or torrent of water that flows in the winter or rainy season (Jn 18:1).

THAYER.pt: Leito de rio ou vale seco que se enche caudalosamente com as águas das chuvas de inverno, mas que costuma secar no verão. 1. Ribeiro ou torrente sazonal de água que corre no inverno ou período chuvoso (Jo 18.1).
THAYER.en: A riverbed or dry valley that fills powerfully with winter rainwater, but typically dries up in the summer. 1. A seasonal stream or torrent of water that flows in the winter or rainy season (Jn 18:1).

DEFINITION: Designates both the coldest season of the year and adverse weather conditions with storms.
SENSES: 1. A storm or bad weather (Acts 27:20).
2. The winter season (Jn 10:22).

THAYER.pt: Designa tanto a estação mais fria do ano quanto condições meteorológicas adversas com tempestades. 1. Tempestade ou mau tempo (At 27:20). | 2. A estação do inverno (Jo 10:22).
THAYER.en: Designates both the coldest season of the year and adverse weather conditions with storms. 1. A storm or bad weather (Acts 27:20). | 2. The winter season (Jn 10:22).

DEFINITION: Superior anatomical limb that performs work or physical touch. Biblically, it frequently functions as a metonymy and Hebraism to express power of intervention, sovereign control, possession, or human and divine agency in action.
SENSES: 1. The physical human hand itself (Mt 12:10; Jn 20:27).
2. Metonymy for strength, protective control, or judging authority ('the hand of God') (Lk 1:66; Acts 4:28).
3. Instrument or agency of an action ('by the hands of someone') (Acts 2:23; Gal 3:19).

THAYER.pt: Membro anatômico superior que executa o trabalho ou toque físico. Biblicamente, funciona com frequência como metonímia e hebraísmo para expressar poder de intervenção, controle soberano, posse, ou a agência humana e divina em ação. 1. A mão humana física propriamente dita (Mt 12.10; Jo 20.27). | 2. Metonímia de força, controle protetor ou autoridade julgadora ('a mão de Deus') (Lc 1.66; At 4.28). | 3. Instrumento ou agência de uma ação ('pelas mãos de alguém') (At 2.23; Gl 3.19).
THAYER.en: Superior anatomical limb that performs work or physical touch. Biblically, it frequently functions as a metonymy and Hebraism to express power of intervention, sovereign control, possession, or human and divine agency in action. 1. The physical human hand itself (Mt 12:10; Jn 20:27). | 2. Metonymy for strength, protective control, or judging authority ('the hand of God') (Lk 1:66; Acts 4:28). | 3. Instrument or agency of an action ('by the hands of someone') (Acts 2:23; Gal 3:19).

SHORT_GLOSS: to lead by the hand, to guide
DEFINITION: To lead or guide someone physically, holding their hand, typically necessary in cases of blindness or weakness.
SENSES: 1. To guide a blind or debilitated person by holding them by the hand (Acts 9:8).
USAGE: to lead by the hand, to guide

THAYER.pt: Conduzir ou guiar alguém fisicamente, segurando-lhe a mão, tipicamente necessário no caso de cegueira ou fraqueza. 1. Guiar uma pessoa cega ou debilitada segurando-a pela mão (At 9.8).
THAYER.en: To lead or guide someone physically, holding their hand, typically necessary in cases of blindness or weakness. 1. To guide a blind or debilitated person by holding them by the hand (Acts 9:8).

DEFINITION: One who leads another person by holding their hand, providing assistance to the blind or debilitated who are unable to walk alone.
SENSES: 1. A guide who leads someone by the hand due to blindness or temporary physical incapacity (Acts 13:11).

THAYER.pt: Aquele que conduz outra pessoa segurando-a pela mão, prestando auxílio a cegos ou debilitados incapazes de caminhar sozinhos. 1. Guia que conduz alguém pela mão devido à cegueira ou incapacidade física temporária (At 13.11).
THAYER.en: One who leads another person by holding their hand, providing assistance to the blind or debilitated who are unable to walk alone. 1. A guide who leads someone by the hand due to blindness or temporary physical incapacity (Acts 13:11).

DEFINITION: A handwritten document attesting to a financial obligation, specifically a legal record of debts incurred.
SENSES: 1. A bond or handwritten record of debts and legal charges cancelled by Christ on the cross (Col 2:14).

THAYER.pt: Documento manuscrito que atesta uma obrigação financeira, especificamente um registro legal de dívidas contraídas. 1. Cédula ou registro manuscrito de dívidas e acusações legais cancelado por Cristo na cruz (Cl 2.14).
THAYER.en: A handwritten document attesting to a financial obligation, specifically a legal record of debts incurred. 1. A bond or handwritten record of debts and legal charges cancelled by Christ on the cross (Col 2:14).

DEFINITION: Refers to anything that has been manufactured, constructed, or molded by human hands, in contrast to the divine.
SENSES: 1. Constructed by human hands, such as temples (Acts 7:48).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se a tudo aquilo que foi fabricado, construído ou moldado por mãos humanas, em contraste com o divino. 1. Construído por mãos humanas, como templos (At 7:48).
THAYER.en: Refers to anything that has been manufactured, constructed, or molded by human hands, in contrast to the divine. 1. Constructed by human hands, such as temples (Acts 7:48).

DEFINITION: Derived from the gesture of extending the hand to vote, it means to choose, designate, or formally appoint someone to a function or office.
SENSES: 1. To elect or formally appoint leaders to a task in the church (Acts 14:23).

THAYER.pt: Derivado do gesto de estender a mão para votar, significa escolher, designar ou apontar formalmente alguém para uma função ou cargo. 1. Eleger ou apontar formalmente líderes para um encargo na igreja (At 14.23).
THAYER.en: Derived from the gesture of extending the hand to vote, it means to choose, designate, or formally appoint someone to a function or office. 1. To elect or formally appoint leaders to a task in the church (Acts 14:23).

DEFINITION: A comparative term indicating something or someone that is inferior, more severe, or more harmful in quality or condition relative to another.
SENSES: 1. To be worse or more severe in gravity or condition (Matt 9:16; John 5:14).
2. To denote more severe punishment or consequences (Heb 10:29).

THAYER.pt: Termo comparativo que indica algo ou alguém que é inferior, mais grave ou mais prejudicial em qualidade ou condição em relação a outro. 1. Ser pior ou mais severo em gravidade ou condição (Mt 9.16; Jo 5.14). | 2. Denotar punição ou consequências mais severas (Hb 10.29).
THAYER.en: A comparative term indicating something or someone that is inferior, more severe, or more harmful in quality or condition relative to another. 1. To be worse or more severe in gravity or condition (Matt 9:16; John 5:14). | 2. To denote more severe punishment or consequences (Heb 10:29).

DEFINITION: Transliterated Hebrew term designating an order of celestial beings associated with the divine presence and glory.
SENSES: 1. Cherubim of glory that covered the ark of the covenant in the earthly sanctuary (Heb 9.5).

THAYER.pt: Termo hebraico transliterado que designa uma ordem de seres celestiais celestes associados à presença e à glória divina. 1. Querubins da glória que cobriam a arca da aliança no santuário terrestre (Hb 9.5).
THAYER.en: Transliterated Hebrew term designating an order of celestial beings associated with the divine presence and glory. 1. Cherubim of glory that covered the ark of the covenant in the earthly sanctuary (Heb 9.5).

DEFINITION: A woman whose husband has died, who in the biblical context often represents a vulnerable class targeted for solidarity and pastoral care.
SENSES: 1. A woman whose husband has died, widow (Lk 4.26; 1Tm 5.3).

THAYER.pt: Mulher cujo marido faleceu e que, no contexto bíblico, frequentemente representa uma classe vulnerável alvo da solidariedade e do cuidado pastoral. 1. Mulher cujo marido faleceu, viúva (Lc 4.26; 1Tm 5.3).
THAYER.en: A woman whose husband has died, who in the biblical context often represents a vulnerable class targeted for solidarity and pastoral care. 1. A woman whose husband has died, widow (Lk 4.26; 1Tm 5.3).

DEFINITION: Adverb of time denoting the day immediately preceding the current one.
SENSES: 1. On the previous day, yesterday (Jn 4.52; Acts 7.28; Heb 13.8).

THAYER.pt: Advérbio de tempo que denota o dia imediatamente anterior ao atual. 1. No dia anterior, ontem (Jo 4.52; At 7.28; Hb 13.8).
THAYER.en: Adverb of time denoting the day immediately preceding the current one. 1. On the previous day, yesterday (Jn 4.52; Acts 7.28; Heb 13.8).

DEFINITION: A group or collective formed by a thousand units. Used to denote population counts, military groups, or magnitudes in apocalyptic language.
SENSES: 1. A numbered group of a thousand people or things (Acts 4.4; 1Co 10.8).
2. Plural to express myriads or incalculable multitudes (Rev 5.11; Rev 7.4).

THAYER.pt: Grupo ou coletivo formado por mil unidades. Usado para denotar contagens populacionais, militares ou grandezas em linguagem apocalíptica. 1. Grupo numerado de mil pessoas ou coisas (At 4.4; 1Co 10.8). | 2. Plural para expressar miríades ou multidões incalculáveis (Ap 5.11; Ap 7.4).
THAYER.en: A group or collective formed by a thousand units. Used to denote population counts, military groups, or magnitudes in apocalyptic language. 1. A numbered group of a thousand people or things (Acts 4.4; 1Co 10.8). | 2. Plural to express myriads or incalculable multitudes (Rev 5.11; Rev 7.4).

DEFINITION: Literally commander of a thousand soldiers, the term describes in the Roman context the military tribune who headed a cohort (about six hundred soldiers).
SENSES: 1. High-ranking Roman military officer, cohort commander (Jn 18.12; Acts 21.31).

THAYER.pt: Literalmente comandante de mil soldados, o termo descreve no contexto romano o tribuno militar que chefiava uma coorte (cerca de seiscentos soldados). 1. Oficial militar romano de alta patente, comandante de coorte (Jo 18.12; At 21.31).
THAYER.en: Literally commander of a thousand soldiers, the term describes in the Roman context the military tribune who headed a cohort (about six hundred soldiers). 1. High-ranking Roman military officer, cohort commander (Jn 18.12; Acts 21.31).

DEFINITION: Numeral representing the exact quantity of one thousand, used in both literal contexts and apocalyptic or temporal constructions.
SENSES: 1. The number thousand, referring to a counted quantity or prophetic periods (2Pe 3.8).

THAYER.pt: Numeral que representa a quantidade exata de mil, sendo empregado tanto em contextos literais quanto em construções apocalípticas e temporais. 1. O número mil, referente a uma quantidade contada ou a períodos proféticos (2Pe 3.8).
THAYER.en: Numeral representing the exact quantity of one thousand, used in both literal contexts and apocalyptic or temporal constructions. 1. The number thousand, referring to a counted quantity or prophetic periods (2Pe 3.8).

DEFINITION: Island situated in the Aegean Sea, near the western coast of Asia Minor, traveled by ships on ancient Mediterranean routes.
SENSES: 1. Greek island situated in the Aegean Sea touched by Paul's missionary journeys (Acts 20.15).

THAYER.pt: Ilha situada no mar Egeu, próxima à costa ocidental da Ásia Menor, percorrida por embarcações nas rotas do Mediterrâneo antigo. 1. Ilha grega situada no mar Egeu tocada pelas viagens missionárias de Paulo (At 20.15).
THAYER.en: Island situated in the Aegean Sea, near the western coast of Asia Minor, traveled by ships on ancient Mediterranean routes. 1. Greek island situated in the Aegean Sea touched by Paul's missionary journeys (Acts 20.15).

DEFINITION: Designates the inner tunic or garment of linen or wool worn directly against the skin by both men and women in antiquity.
SENSES: 1. Inner garment or tunic worn close to the body (Mt 10.10; Mk 14.63).

THAYER.pt: Designa a túnica ou veste interna de linho ou lã que era usada diretamente sobre a pele, tanto por homens quanto por mulheres na antiguidade. 1. Vestimenta interna ou túnica usada rente ao corpo (Mt 10.10; Mc 14.63).
THAYER.en: Designates the inner tunic or garment of linen or wool worn directly against the skin by both men and women in antiquity. 1. Inner garment or tunic worn close to the body (Mt 10.10; Mk 14.63).

DEFINITION: Frozen atmospheric precipitation, frequently used in the Scriptures as the supreme symbol of whiteness and purity.
SENSES: 1. Literal snow, used as a symbol of brightness and immaculate whiteness (Mt 28.3).

THAYER.pt: Precipitação atmosférica congelada, usada frequentemente nas Escrituras como símbolo supremo de alvura e pureza. 1. Neve literal, usada como símbolo de brilho e brancura imaculada (Mt 28.3).
THAYER.en: Frozen atmospheric precipitation, frequently used in the Scriptures as the supreme symbol of whiteness and purity. 1. Literal snow, used as a symbol of brightness and immaculate whiteness (Mt 28.3).

DEFINITION: Short cloak or loose mantle traditionally worn by men, travelers, and Roman soldiers.
SENSES: 1. Military and travel cloak or mantle (Mt 27.28).

THAYER.pt: Capa curta ou manto solto usado tradicionalmente por homens, viajantes e soldados romanos. 1. Capa ou manto militar e de viagem (Mt 27.28).
THAYER.en: Short cloak or loose mantle traditionally worn by men, travelers, and Roman soldiers. 1. Military and travel cloak or mantle (Mt 27.28).

DEFINITION: To make fun of maliciously, scoff at, or verbally ridicule someone.
SENSES: 1. To mock, jest at, or sneer at beliefs or people (Acts 17.32).

THAYER.pt: Fazer graça de forma maliciosa, escarnecer ou ridicularizar verbalmente alguém. 1. Zombar, caçoar ou escarnecer de crenças ou pessoas (At 17.32).
THAYER.en: To make fun of maliciously, scoff at, or verbally ridicule someone. 1. To mock, jest at, or sneer at beliefs or people (Acts 17.32).

DEFINITION: A temperature state between hot and cold, frequently used in metaphors about spiritual fervor.
SENSES: 1. Lukewarm, neither hot nor cold, applied figuratively to the spiritual apathy of the church of Laodicea (Rev 3.16).

THAYER.pt: Estado de temperatura que se situa entre o quente e o frio, frequentemente usado em metáforas sobre o fervor espiritual. 1. Morno, nem quente nem frio, aplicado figuradamente à apatia espiritual da igreja de Laodiceia (Ap 3.16).
THAYER.en: A temperature state between hot and cold, frequently used in metaphors about spiritual fervor. 1. Lukewarm, neither hot nor cold, applied figuratively to the spiritual apathy of the church of Laodicea (Rev 3.16).

DEFINITION: Name of a Christian woman or resident of Corinth whose household served as a source of news regarding conflicts in the local community.
SENSES: 1. Believing woman whose messengers informed the apostle Paul about divisions in the church at Corinth (1Co 1.11).

THAYER.pt: Nome de mulher cristã ou residente em Corinto cuja casa serviu de fonte de notícias sobre os conflitos na comunidade local. 1. Mulher crente cujos mensageiros informaram o apóstolo Paulo sobre as divisões na igreja de Corinto (1Co 1.11).
THAYER.en: Name of a Christian woman or resident of Corinth whose household served as a source of news regarding conflicts in the local community. 1. Believing woman whose messengers informed the apostle Paul about divisions in the church at Corinth (1Co 1.11).

DEFINITION: Describes the bright green color of vegetation or, by extension, the pale or greenish hue associated with disease or fear.
SENSES: 1. Green or yellowish-green, characteristic of vegetation (Mk 6.39; Rev 9.4).
2. Pale or greenish, indicating deadly paleness (Rev 6.8).

THAYER.pt: Descreve a cor verde viva da vegetação ou, por extensão, a tonalidade pálida ou esverdeada associada à doença ou ao medo. 1. Verde ou verde-amarelado, próprio da vegetação (Mc 6.39; Ap 9.4). | 2. Pálido ou esverdeado, indicando palidez mortal (Ap 6.8).
THAYER.en: Describes the bright green color of vegetation or, by extension, the pale or greenish hue associated with disease or fear. 1. Green or yellowish-green, characteristic of vegetation (Mk 6.39; Rev 9.4). | 2. Pale or greenish, indicating deadly paleness (Rev 6.8).

DEFINITION: Numeral representing the number 666, mentioned in Revelation as the number of the beast.
SENSES: 1. The number that identifies the beast in Revelation (Rev 13.18).

THAYER.pt: Numeral que representa o número 666, mencionado no Apocalipse como o número da besta. 1. O número que identifica a besta no Apocalipse (Ap 13.18).
THAYER.en: Numeral representing the number 666, mentioned in Revelation as the number of the beast. 1. The number that identifies the beast in Revelation (Rev 13.18).

DEFINITION: Belonging to the earth or made of dust, characterizing the fragility of earthly human existence in contrast to the celestial.
SENSES: 1. Made of earth or dust, relating to the earthly human condition (1Co 15.47).

THAYER.pt: Pertencente à terra ou feito de pó, caracterizando a fragilidade da existência humana terrena em contraste com o celestial. 1. Feito de terra ou pó, relativo à condição humana terrena (1Co 15.47).
THAYER.en: Belonging to the earth or made of dust, characterizing the fragility of earthly human existence in contrast to the celestial. 1. Made of earth or dust, relating to the earthly human condition (1Co 15.47).

DEFINITION: An ancient dry capacity measure (especially for grain), roughly equivalent to a liter or a worker's daily subsistence ration.
SENSES: 1. Standard measure for grain equivalent to about a liter (Rev 6.6).

THAYER.pt: Antiga medida de capacidade para secos (especialmente grãos), equivalente aproximadamente a um litro ou à ração diária de subsistência de um trabalhador. 1. Medida padrão para grãos equivalente a cerca de um litro (Ap 6.6).
THAYER.en: An ancient dry capacity measure (especially for grain), roughly equivalent to a liter or a worker's daily subsistence ration. 1. Standard measure for grain equivalent to about a liter (Rev 6.6).

DEFINITION: Designates a swine mammal, considered unclean under the Mosaic law and commonly associated with herds raised in Gentile regions in the New Testament.
SENSES: 1. A pig or swine animal (Mt 8.30; Mk 5.12).
2. In a figurative sense, animals or people who do not appreciate sacred spiritual things (Mt 7.6).

THAYER.pt: Designa um mamífero suíno, considerado impuro sob a lei mosaica e comumente associado a manadas criadas em regiões gentílicas no Novo Testamento. 1. Um porco ou animal suíno (Mt 8.30; Mc 5.12). | 2. Em sentido figurado, animais ou pessoas que não apreciam coisas espirituais sagradas (Mt 7.6).
THAYER.en: Designates a swine mammal, considered unclean under the Mosaic law and commonly associated with herds raised in Gentile regions in the New Testament. 1. A pig or swine animal (Mt 8.30; Mk 5.12). | 2. In a figurative sense, animals or people who do not appreciate sacred spiritual things (Mt 7.6).

DEFINITION: To experience a strong feeling of anger, irritation, or deep indignation against someone.
SENSES: 1. To be extremely irritated or indignant against someone for real or imagined reasons (Jn 7.23).

THAYER.pt: Experimentar forte sentimento de ira, irritação ou indignação profunda contra alguém. 1. Estar extremamente irritado ou indignado contra alguém por motivos reais ou imaginários (Jo 7.23).
THAYER.en: To experience a strong feeling of anger, irritation, or deep indignation against someone. 1. To be extremely irritated or indignant against someone for real or imagined reasons (Jn 7.23).

DEFINITION: A bitter liquid substance secreted by the liver (bile), used figuratively to denote extreme bitterness or poison.
SENSES: 1. Bitter substance, gall mixed with narcotics (Mt 27.34).
2. Figurative sense of inner bitterness and spiritual corruption (Acts 8.23).

THAYER.pt: Substância líquida amarga segregada pelo fígado (bile), usada figurativamente para denotar extrema amargura ou veneno. 1. Substância amarga, fel misturado a entorpecentes (Mt 27.34). | 2. Sentido figurado de amargura interior e corrupção espiritual (At 8.23).
THAYER.en: A bitter liquid substance secreted by the liver (bile), used figuratively to denote extreme bitterness or poison. 1. Bitter substance, gall mixed with narcotics (Mt 27.34). | 2. Figurative sense of inner bitterness and spiritual corruption (Acts 8.23).

DEFINITION: Loose soil, fine earth, or dust raised from the ground, associated with human fragility.
SENSES: 1. Earth or road dust (Mk 6.11).
2. Accumulated dust or ground (Rev 18.19).

THAYER.pt: Solo solto, terra fina ou pó levantado do chão, associado à fragilidade humana. 1. Terra ou pó da estrada (Mc 6.11). | 2. Poeira ou solo acumulado (Ap 18.19).
THAYER.en: Loose soil, fine earth, or dust raised from the ground, associated with human fragility. 1. Earth or road dust (Mk 6.11). | 2. Accumulated dust or ground (Rev 18.19).

DEFINITION: City of Galilee rebuked by Jesus due to its impenitence despite the miracles performed there.
SENSES: 1. The Galilean city of Chorazin (Mt 11.21; Lk 10.13).

THAYER.pt: Cidade da Galileia repreendida por Jesus devido à sua impenitência apesar dos milagres realizados ali. 1. A cidade galileia de Corazim (Mt 11.21; Lc 10.13).
THAYER.en: City of Galilee rebuked by Jesus due to its impenitence despite the miracles performed there. 1. The Galilean city of Chorazin (Mt 11.21; Lk 10.13).

DEFINITION: Originally to sponsor a chorus, it came to mean the generous supply of resources, providing everything necessary.
SENSES: 1. To provide abundantly, supply the needs of the community (2Co 9.10; 1Pe 4.11).

THAYER.pt: Originalmente patrocinar um coro, passou a significar o suprimento generoso de recursos, provendo tudo o que é necessário. 1. Prover com abundância, suprir as necessidades da comunidade (2Co 9.10; 1Pe 4.11).
THAYER.en: Originally to sponsor a chorus, it came to mean the generous supply of resources, providing everything necessary. 1. To provide abundantly, supply the needs of the community (2Co 9.10; 1Pe 4.11).

DEFINITION: Rhythmic bodily movement performed with musical accompaniment in festivities, celebrations, or worship.
SENSES: 1. Festive dance accompanied by music and popular jubilee (Lk 15.25).

THAYER.pt: Movimento rítmico corporal executado com acompanhamento musical em festividades, celebrações ou cultos. 1. Dança festiva acompanhada por música e júbilo popular (Lc 15.25).
THAYER.en: Rhythmic bodily movement performed with musical accompaniment in festivities, celebrations, or worship. 1. Festive dance accompanied by music and popular jubilee (Lk 15.25).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Fut: χορτάσω, Aor: ἐχόρτασα, Pass: ἐχορτάσθην
DEFINITION: To feed fully until there is complete physical or spiritual satiety.
SENSES: 1. To satisfy the hunger of people or animals with abundant food (Mt 14.20; 15.33).
2. To find full spiritual satisfaction and soul desires (Mt 5.6).

THAYER.pt: Alimentar plenamente até que haja completa saciedade física ou espiritual. 1. Saciar a fome de pessoas ou animais com alimento abundante (Mt 14.20; 15.33). | 2. Encontrar plena satisfação espiritual e anseios da alma (Mt 5.6).
THAYER.en: To feed fully until there is complete physical or spiritual satiety. 1. To satisfy the hunger of people or animals with abundant food (Mt 14.20; 15.33). | 2. To find full spiritual satisfaction and soul desires (Mt 5.6).

DEFINITION: Any kind of sustenance or food provision intended to supply physical survival needs.
SENSES: 1. Provision of food or food supply for human subsistence in difficult times (Acts 7.11).

THAYER.pt: Qualquer tipo de sustento ou provisão alimentícia destinada a suprir as necessidades físicas de sobrevivência. 1. Provisão de alimentos ou suprimento de comida para subsistência humana em tempos difíceis (At 7.11).
THAYER.en: Any kind of sustenance or food provision intended to supply physical survival needs. 1. Provision of food or food supply for human subsistence in difficult times (Acts 7.11).

DEFINITION: Small green plants covering the field or meadows, frequently used as a metaphor for the fragility of human life.
SENSES: 1. Green grass or hay in the fields, subject to drying up quickly (Rev 9.4).

THAYER.pt: Pequenas plantas verdes que cobrem o campo ou prados, usadas frequentemente como metáfora para a fragilidade da vida humana. 1. Relva verde ou capim nos campos, sujeito a secar rapidamente (Ap 9.4).
THAYER.en: Small green plants covering the field or meadows, frequently used as a metaphor for the fragility of human life. 1. Green grass or hay in the fields, subject to drying up quickly (Rev 9.4).

DEFINITION: Steward or trusted official in the court of Herod Antipas, whose marriage involved ties with Jesus' followers.
SENSES: 1. Royal steward or administrator of Herod Antipas, husband of Joanna, follower of Jesus (Lk 8.3).

THAYER.pt: Administrador ou oficial de confiança na corte de Herodes Antipas, cujo casamento envolvia laços com os seguidores de Jesus. 1. Mordomo ou administrador real de Herodes Antipas, marido de Joana, seguidora de Jesus (Lc 8.3).
THAYER.en: Steward or trusted official in the court of Herod Antipas, whose marriage involved ties with Jesus' followers. 1. Royal steward or administrator of Herod Antipas, husband of Joanna, follower of Jesus (Lk 8.3).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: Pres. deponent, Fut: χρήσομαι, Aor: ἐχρησάμην
DEFINITION: Indicates the action of making use of some resource, tool, or means, as well as the manner of conducting oneself or treating a person.
SENSES: 1. To make use of something, employ, or avail oneself of a resource (Acts 27.17; 1Co 7.31).
2. To treat or behave toward someone in a certain way (Acts 27.3).

THAYER.pt: Indica a ação de fazer uso de algum recurso, ferramenta ou meio, bem como a maneira de se conduzir ou tratar uma pessoa. 1. Fazer uso de algo, empregar ou valer-se de um recurso (At 27.17; 1Co 7.31). | 2. Tratar ou comportar-se em relação a alguém de certa maneira (At 27.3).
THAYER.en: Indicates the action of making use of some resource, tool, or means, as well as the manner of conducting oneself or treating a person. 1. To make use of something, employ, or avail oneself of a resource (Acts 27.17; 1Co 7.31). | 2. To treat or behave toward someone in a certain way (Acts 27.3).

DEFINITION: To grant something as a loan or to avail oneself of resources and facilities for a specific purpose.
SENSES: 1. To provide a loan or make instrumental use of something.

THAYER.pt: Conceder algo em empréstimo ou valer-se de recursos e facilidades para determinado propósito. 1. Fornecer empréstimo ou fazer uso instrumental de algo.
THAYER.en: To grant something as a loan or to avail oneself of resources and facilities for a specific purpose. 1. To provide a loan or make instrumental use of something.

DEFINITION: Condition of lacking what is essential or required by life's circumstances; can also refer to a practical occupation or duty that must be fulfilled.
SENSES: 1. Lack, need of supply or resources (Mk 2.25; Phil 4.19; 1Jn 3.17).
2. Necessity or usefulness of something in a given circumstance (Lk 10.42; Heb 7.11; Mt 6.8).
3. Indispensable task, charge, or administrative responsibility (Ac 6.3).

THAYER.pt: Condição de carência daquilo que é essencial ou exigido pelas circunstâncias da vida; pode referir-se também a uma ocupação ou ofício prático que deve ser desempenhado. 1. Falta, carência de suprimento ou recursos (Mc 2.25; Fp 4.19; 1Jo 3.17). | 2. Necessidade ou utilidade de algo em dada circunstância (Lc 10.42; Hb 7.11; Mt 6.8). | 3. Tarefa indispensável, encargo ou responsabilidade administrativa (At 6.3).
THAYER.en: Condition of lacking what is essential or required by life's circumstances; can also refer to a practical occupation or duty that must be fulfilled. 1. Lack, need of supply or resources (Mk 2.25; Phil 4.19; 1Jn 3.17). | 2. Necessity or usefulness of something in a given circumstance (Lk 10.42; Heb 7.11; Mt 6.8). | 3. Indispensable task, charge, or administrative responsibility (Ac 6.3).

DEFINITION: One who has contracted a financial debt and has the legal obligation to repay it to the creditor.
SENSES: 1. A person who owes money to another, also used in parables about forgiveness (Lk 7.41; 16.5).

THAYER.pt: Aquele que contraiu uma dívida financeira e tem a obrigação legal de restituí-la ao credor. 1. Pessoa que deve dinheiro a outra, usado também em parábolas sobre o perdão (Lc 7.41; 16.5).
THAYER.en: One who has contracted a financial debt and has the legal obligation to repay it to the creditor. 1. A person who owes money to another, also used in parables about forgiveness (Lk 7.41; 16.5).

SHORT_GLOSS: it is necessary, it is fitting
DEFINITION: Impersonal Greek verb denoting moral obligation, convenience, or the absolute necessity for something to happen.
SENSES: 1. It is necessary, fitting, or one ought to do something by demand of decency or the moral order (Jas 3.10).
USAGE: it is necessary, it is fitting

THAYER.pt: Verbo impessoal grego que denota obrigação moral, conveniência ou absoluta necessidade de que algo aconteça. 1. É necessário, convém ou deve-se fazer algo por exigência da decência ou da ordem moral (Tg 3.10).
THAYER.en: Impersonal Greek verb denoting moral obligation, convenience, or the absolute necessity for something to happen. 1. It is necessary, fitting, or one ought to do something by demand of decency or the moral order (Jas 3.10).

SHORT_GLOSS: to have need, to be in need
DEFINITION: Indicates the condition of lacking something essential and necessary, having a deep need for supply.
SENSES: 1. To have need of something indispensable for life or sustenance (Mt 6.32; Lk 12.30).
USAGE: to have need, to be in need

THAYER.pt: Indica a condição de faltar algo essencial e necessário, tendo profunda necessidade de suprimento. 1. Ter necessidade de algo indispensável para a vida ou sustento (Mt 6.32; Lc 12.30).
THAYER.en: Indicates the condition of lacking something essential and necessary, having a deep need for supply. 1. To have need of something indispensable for life or sustenance (Mt 6.32; Lk 12.30).

DEFINITION: Generic term for financial resources, material goods, or circulating currency accumulated as wealth.
SENSES: 1. Riches, material goods, and properties in general (Mk 10.23).
2. Cash or currency (Ac 4.37; 8.18).

THAYER.pt: Termo genérico para recursos financeiros, bens materiais ou moeda corrente acumulada como riqueza. 1. Riquezas, bens materiais e propriedades em geral (Mc 10.23). | 2. Dinheiro em espécie ou moeda (At 4.37; 8.18).
THAYER.en: Generic term for financial resources, material goods, or circulating currency accumulated as wealth. 1. Riches, material goods, and properties in general (Mk 10.23). | 2. Cash or currency (Ac 4.37; 8.18).

DEFINITION: Meaning to transmit a revelation or warning of divine origin, or to be called by a certain name or title.
SENSES: 1. To receive or transmit a divine warning or message (Mt 2.22; Heb 12.25).
2. To be called or identified by a name or title (Ac 11.26; Rom 7.3).

THAYER.pt: Significa transmitir uma revelação ou aviso de origem divina, ou ser chamado por um determinado nome ou título. 1. Receber ou transmitir uma advertência ou mensagem divina (Mt 2.22; Hb 12.25). | 2. Ser chamado ou identificado por um nome ou título (At 11.26; Rm 7.3).
THAYER.en: Meaning to transmit a revelation or warning of divine origin, or to be called by a certain name or title. 1. To receive or transmit a divine warning or message (Mt 2.22; Heb 12.25). | 2. To be called or identified by a name or title (Ac 11.26; Rom 7.3).

DEFINITION: Refers to a declaration, response, or revelation of divine origin communicated to human beings.
SENSES: 1. A response or declaration of a divine character (Rom 11.4).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se a uma declaração, resposta ou revelação de origem divina comunicada aos seres humanos. 1. Uma resposta ou declaração de caráter divino (Rm 11.4).
THAYER.en: Refers to a declaration, response, or revelation of divine origin communicated to human beings. 1. A response or declaration of a divine character (Rom 11.4).

DEFINITION: Describes something or someone possessing practical value, usefulness, or bringing benefits.
SENSES: 1. That which is useful, advantageous, or profitable for the common good or conduct (Eph 4.29; 2Tim 2.14).

THAYER.pt: Descreve algo ou alguém que possui valor prático, utilidade ou que traz benefícios. 1. O que é útil, vantajoso ou proveitoso para o bem comum ou conduta (Ef 4.29; 2Tm 2.14).
THAYER.en: Describes something or someone possessing practical value, usefulness, or bringing benefits. 1. That which is useful, advantageous, or profitable for the common good or conduct (Eph 4.29; 2Tim 2.14).

DEFINITION: The act of using something, usefulness, or the mode of functioning and practice of social and bodily relations.
SENSES: 1. Natural use or function in sexual relations (Rom 1.26).

THAYER.pt: O ato de usar algo, utilidade ou o modo de funcionamento e prática de relações sociais e corporais. 1. O uso natural ou função nas relações sexuais (Rm 1.26).
THAYER.en: The act of using something, usefulness, or the mode of functioning and practice of social and bodily relations. 1. Natural use or function in sexual relations (Rom 1.26).

SHORT_GLOSS: to be kind, to show goodness
DEFINITION: To act with kindness, benevolence, or mercy toward one's neighbor.
SENSES: 1. To practice kind actions and demonstrate benevolence (1Co 13.4; Lk 6.35).
USAGE: to be kind, to show goodness

THAYER.pt: Agir com bondade, benevolência ou misericórdia para com o próximo. 1. Praticar ações bondosas e demonstrar benevolência (1Co 13.4; Lc 6.35).
THAYER.en: To act with kindness, benevolence, or mercy toward one's neighbor. 1. To practice kind actions and demonstrate benevolence (1Co 13.4; Lk 6.35).

DEFINITION: Use of soft, flattering words or persuasive speeches that may conceal ulterior motives.
SENSES: 1. Flattering or persuasive language used to deceive (Rom 16.18).

THAYER.pt: Uso de palavras suaves, bajuladoras ou discursos persuasivos que podem ocultar segundas intenções. 1. Linguagem lisonjeira ou persuasiva usada para enganar (Rm 16.18).
THAYER.en: Use of soft, flattering words or persuasive speeches that may conceal ulterior motives. 1. Flattering or persuasive language used to deceive (Rom 16.18).

DEFINITION: Possessing excellent utility, intrinsic goodness, or causing well-being without harshness, manifesting benignity and gentleness.
SENSES: 1. Gentle, light, or pleasant in practice (Mt 11.30).
2. Good, benevolent, and compassionate in interpersonal relations (Eph 4.32; 1Pe 2.3).

THAYER.pt: Que possui utilidade excelente, bondade intrínseca ou que causa bem-estar sem aspereza, manifestando benignidade e brandura. 1. Suave, leve ou agradável na prática (Mt 11.30). | 2. Bom, benévolo e compassivo nas relações interpessoais (Ef 4.32; 1Pe 2.3).
THAYER.en: Possessing excellent utility, intrinsic goodness, or causing well-being without harshness, manifesting benignity and gentleness. 1. Gentle, light, or pleasant in practice (Mt 11.30). | 2. Good, benevolent, and compassionate in interpersonal relations (Eph 4.32; 1Pe 2.3).

DEFINITION: The quality of being morally upright, useful, kind, and benevolent in relations with others.
SENSES: 1. Uprightness or integrity in human relations (Rom 3.12).
2. Kindness, generosity, and willingness to help demonstrated by God or human beings (Rom 2.4; Col 3.12).

THAYER.pt: A qualidade de ser moralmente íntegro, útil, bondoso e benevolente nas relações com o próximo. 1. Retidão ou integridade nas relações humanas (Rm 3.12). | 2. Bondade, generosidade e disposição para ajudar demonstrada por Deus ou pelos seres humanos (Rm 2.4; Cl 3.12).
THAYER.en: The quality of being morally upright, useful, kind, and benevolent in relations with others. 1. Uprightness or integrity in human relations (Rom 3.12). | 2. Kindness, generosity, and willingness to help demonstrated by God or human beings (Rom 2.4; Col 3.12).

DEFINITION: Substance used for anointing, figuratively associated in the New Testament with the endowment of the Holy Spirit.
SENSES: 1. The anointing or spiritual gift granted to believers by the Holy Spirit (1Jn 2.20).

THAYER.pt: Substância usada para ungir, figuradamente associada no Novo Testamento à dotação do Espírito Santo. 1. A unção ou dom espiritual concedido aos crentes pelo Espírito Santo (1Jo 2.20).
THAYER.en: Substance used for anointing, figuratively associated in the New Testament with the endowment of the Holy Spirit. 1. The anointing or spiritual gift granted to believers by the Holy Spirit (1Jn 2.20).

DEFINITION: Designation given to followers and disciples of Jesus Christ, initially coined in the city of Antioch.
SENSES: 1. Disciple or follower of Christ (Ac 11.26; 1Pe 4.16).

THAYER.pt: Designação dada aos seguidores e discípulos de Jesus Cristo, inicialmente cunhada na cidade de Antioquia. 1. Discípulo ou seguidor de Cristo (At 11.26; 1Pe 4.16).
THAYER.en: Designation given to followers and disciples of Jesus Christ, initially coined in the city of Antioch. 1. Disciple or follower of Christ (Ac 11.26; 1Pe 4.16).

MORPHOLOGY_INFO: 2nd decl. masculine; derived from the verb χρίω (to anoint)
DEFINITION: Royal-priestly title translating the Hebrew Mashiach ('the Anointed One'), identifying Jesus as the eschatological liberator promised to Israel, also becoming His proper name.
SENSES: 1. The Messiah promised in the Scriptures of Israel and anointed by God (Mt 16.16; Jn 4.25).
2. Title and personal name of Jesus of Nazareth (Rom 1.1; 1Co 1.1).
3. Corporate representation of the ecclesial body or life 'in Christ' (1Co 12.12; Gal 3.27).

THAYER.pt: Título régio-sacerdotal que traduz o hebraico Mashiach ('o Ungido'), identificando Jesus como o libertador escatológico prometido a Israel, tornando-se também Seu nome próprio. 1. O Messias prometido nas Escrituras de Israel e Ungido por Deus (Mt 16.16; Jo 4.25). | 2. Título e nome pessoal de Jesus de Nazaré (Rm 1.1; 1Co 1.1). | 3. Representação corporativa do corpo eclesial ou vida 'em Cristo' (1Co 12.12; Gl 3.27).
THAYER.en: Royal-priestly title translating the Hebrew Mashiach ('the Anointed One'), identifying Jesus as the eschatological liberator promised to Israel, also becoming His proper name. 1. The Messiah promised in the Scriptures of Israel and anointed by God (Mt 16.16; Jn 4.25). | 2. Title and personal name of Jesus of Nazareth (Rom 1.1; 1Co 1.1). | 3. Corporate representation of the ecclesial body or life 'in Christ' (1Co 12.12; Gal 3.27).

DEFINITION: To apply sacred oil to someone to set them apart and designate them for a special function under divine direction and authority.
SENSES: 1. To anoint prophetically or messianically, setting apart for the service of God, applied to Christ and believers (Lk 4.18; Ac 10.38; 2Co 1.21).

THAYER.pt: Aplicar óleo sagrado em alguém para separá-lo e designá-lo para uma função especial sob a direção e autoridade divina. 1. Ungir profeticamente ou messianicamente, separando para o serviço de Deus, aplicado a Cristo e aos crentes (Lc 4.18; At 10.38; 2Co 1.21).
THAYER.en: To apply sacred oil to someone to set them apart and designate them for a special function under divine direction and authority. 1. To anoint prophetically or messianically, setting apart for the service of God, applied to Christ and believers (Lk 4.18; Ac 10.38; 2Co 1.21).

DEFINITION: To remain in a place or extend an activity beyond the expected time, resulting in delay or lateness.
SENSES: 1. To remain or tarry in some place for a period (Lk 1.21).
2. To delay in coming or postpone the execution of a task (Mt 24.48; Lk 12.45).

THAYER.pt: Permanecer em um lugar ou estender uma atividade além do tempo esperado, resultando em demora ou atraso. 1. Permanecer ou demorar-se em algum lugar por um período (Lc 1.21). | 2. Tardar na vinda ou atrasar a execução de uma tarefa (Mt 24.48; Lc 12.45).
THAYER.en: To remain in a place or extend an activity beyond the expected time, resulting in delay or lateness. 1. To remain or tarry in some place for a period (Lk 1.21). | 2. To delay in coming or postpone the execution of a task (Mt 24.48; Lk 12.45).

DEFINITION: Designates the continuous extension or duration of time, an indefinite period, or an epoch during which events occur. Often differs from καιρός, which points more to opportunity or opportune time.
SENSES: 1. Period or continuous extension of time (Mt 25.19; Ac 18.20; Lk 8.27).
2. Determined moment or occasion in which something occurs (Ac 7.17; Mt 2.7).
3. Delay, postponement, or granted interval (Rev 2.21; Rev 10.6).

THAYER.pt: Designa a extensão ou duração contínua do tempo, um período indeterminado ou uma época durante a qual ocorrem eventos. Difere frequentemente de καιρός, que aponta mais para a oportunidade ou tempo oportuno. 1. Período ou extensão contínua de tempo (Mt 25.19; At 18.20; Lc 8.27). | 2. Momento ou ocasião determinada em que algo ocorre (At 7.17; Mt 2.7). | 3. Demora, adiamento ou intervalo concedido (Ap 2.21; Ap 10.6).
THAYER.en: Designates the continuous extension or duration of time, an indefinite period, or an epoch during which events occur. Often differs from καιρός, which points more to opportunity or opportune time. 1. Period or continuous extension of time (Mt 25.19; Ac 18.20; Lk 8.27). | 2. Determined moment or occasion in which something occurs (Ac 7.17; Mt 2.7). | 3. Delay, postponement, or granted interval (Rev 2.21; Rev 10.6).

DEFINITION: To spend or delay a certain period of time in some place or activity.
SENSES: 1. To delay or spend time (Ac 20.16).

THAYER.pt: Gastar ou demorar certo período de tempo em algum lugar ou atividade. 1. Demorar-se ou passar o tempo (At 20.16).
THAYER.en: To spend or delay a certain period of time in some place or activity. 1. To delay or spend time (Ac 20.16).

DEFINITION: Adjective qualifying objects made of gold or adorned with this precious metal. In the New Testament, it frequently appears in liturgical, eschatological, and symbolic contexts, such as temple utensils and Revelation visions.
SENSES: 1. Made of gold material or overlaid with gold (Heb 9.4; Rev 1.12).
2. In a figurative or metaphorical sense, representing purity or spiritual value (2Tim 2.20; Rev 4.4).

THAYER.pt: Adjetivo que qualifica objetos feitos de ouro ou adornados com este metal precioso. No Novo Testamento, aparece frequentemente em contextos litúrgicos, escatológicos e simbólicos, como nos utensílios do templo e nas visões do Apocalipse. 1. Feito de material de ouro ou revestido com ouro (Hb 9.4; Ap 1.12). | 2. Em sentido figurado ou metafórico, representando pureza ou valor espiritual (2Tm 2.20; Ap 4.4).
THAYER.en: Adjective qualifying objects made of gold or adorned with this precious metal. In the New Testament, it frequently appears in liturgical, eschatological, and symbolic contexts, such as temple utensils and Revelation visions. 1. Made of gold material or overlaid with gold (Heb 9.4; Rev 1.12). | 2. In a figurative or metaphorical sense, representing purity or spiritual value (2Tim 2.20; Rev 4.4).

DEFINITION: Refers to gold as a precious metal in its pure form or worked in the manufacture of artifacts, coins, and ornaments.
SENSES: 1. The precious metal gold as raw material (Heb 9.4; Rev 21.18).
2. Objects, jewelry, or ornaments made of gold (1Tim 2.9; Rev 17.4).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se ao ouro como metal precioso em sua forma pura ou trabalhada na fabricação de artefatos, moedas e ornamentos. 1. O metal precioso ouro como matéria-prima (Hb 9.4; Ap 21.18). | 2. Objetos, joias ou ornamentos feitos de ouro (1Tm 2.9; Ap 17.4).
THAYER.en: Refers to gold as a precious metal in its pure form or worked in the manufacture of artifacts, coins, and ornaments. 1. The precious metal gold as raw material (Heb 9.4; Rev 21.18). | 2. Objects, jewelry, or ornaments made of gold (1Tim 2.9; Rev 17.4).

DEFINITION: Wearing or displaying a gold ring or rings on the fingers, denoting wealth or status.
SENSES: 1. An individual who wears a gold ring (Jas 2.2).

THAYER.pt: Que usa ou ostenta anel ou anéis de ouro nos dedos, denotando riqueza ou status. 1. Indivíduo que usa anel de ouro (Tg 2.2).
THAYER.en: Wearing or displaying a gold ring or rings on the fingers, denoting wealth or status. 1. An individual who wears a gold ring (Jas 2.2).

DEFINITION: Yellowish gemstone, commonly associated with yellow topaz or chrysolite.
SENSES: 1. A yellowish precious stone that makes up the foundations of the New Jerusalem (Rev 21.20).

THAYER.pt: Pedra preciosa de coloração amarelada, comumente associada ao topázio amarelo ou crisólito. 1. Uma pedra preciosa amarelada que compõe os fundamentos da Nova Jerusalém (Ap 21.20).
THAYER.en: Yellowish gemstone, commonly associated with yellow topaz or chrysolite. 1. A yellowish precious stone that makes up the foundations of the New Jerusalem (Rev 21.20).

DEFINITION: Precious gemstone of a yellowish-green or golden-green hue.
SENSES: 1. A precious gem used in the ornamentation of heavenly foundations (Rev 21.20).

THAYER.pt: Pedra preciosa de tom verde-amarelado ou verde-dourado. 1. Uma gema preciosa usada na ornamentação dos fundamentos celestiais (Ap 21.20).
THAYER.en: Precious gemstone of a yellowish-green or golden-green hue. 1. A precious gem used in the ornamentation of heavenly foundations (Rev 21.20).

DEFINITION: Precious metal of great value, used both as raw material in the manufacture of ornaments and idols and in its minted form as currency.
SENSES: 1. The metal gold, in raw or worked state (Mt 2.11).
2. Ornaments, jewelry, or objects made of gold (Ac 17.29).
3. Gold coin or money (Mt 10.9).

THAYER.pt: Metal precioso de grande valor, empregado tanto como matéria-prima na fabricação de adornos e ídolos quanto em sua forma cunhada como moeda. 1.
