O metal ouro, em estado bruto ou trabalhado (Mt 2.11). | 2. Ornamentos, joias ou objetos feitos de ouro (Ac 17.29). | 3. Moeda ou dinheiro de ouro (Mt 10.9).
THAYER.en: Precious metal of great value, used both as raw material in the manufacture of ornaments and idols and in its minted form as currency. 1. The metal gold, in raw or worked state (Mt 2.11). | 2. Ornaments, jewelry, or objects made of gold (Ac 17.29). | 3. Gold coin or money (Mt 10.9).

DEFINITION: To cover, coat, or adorn with gold or golden elements.
SENSES: 1. To adorn or overlay with gold (Rev 17.4).

THAYER.pt: Cobrir, revestir ou enfeitar com ouro ou elementos dourados. 1. Adornar ou revestir com ouro (Ap 17.4).
THAYER.en: To cover, coat, or adorn with gold or golden elements. 1. To adorn or overlay with gold (Rev 17.4).

DEFINITION: The outer layer that covers the human body; the skin.
SENSES: 1. The surface of human skin (Ac 19.12).

THAYER.pt: A camada exterior que reveste o corpo humano; a pele. 1. A superfície da pele humana (At 19.12).
THAYER.en: The outer layer that covers the human body; the skin. 1. The surface of human skin (Ac 19.12).

DEFINITION: Person suffering from some disability in the lower limbs, resulting in difficulty or inability to walk normally.
SENSES: 1. Incapacitated from walking correctly, lame or crippled (Mt 11.5; Ac 3.2).

THAYER.pt: Pessoa que sofre de alguma deficiência nos membros inferiores, resultando em dificuldade ou incapacidade de caminhar normalmente. 1. Incapacitado de andar corretamente, coxo ou aleijado (Mt 11.5; At 3.2).
THAYER.en: Person suffering from some disability in the lower limbs, resulting in difficulty or inability to walk normally. 1. Incapacitated from walking correctly, lame or crippled (Mt 11.5; Ac 3.2).

DEFINITION: Designates an expanse of land, whether a specific geographic region, the countryside in contrast to the city, or arable areas.
SENSES: 1. Firm land in contrast to the sea (Ac 27.27).
2. A wide region, district, or geographic area (Lk 2.8; Jn 4.35).
3. The countryside or rural area as opposed to urban centers (Jn 11.55).

THAYER.pt: Designa uma extensão de terra, seja uma região geográfica específica, o campo em oposição à cidade, ou áreas agriculturáveis. 1. Terra firme em contraste com o mar (At 27.27). | 2. Uma região, distrito ou área geográfica ampla (Lc 2.8; Jo 4.35). | 3. O campo ou zona rural em oposição aos centros urbanos (Jo 11.55).
THAYER.en: Designates an expanse of land, whether a specific geographic region, the countryside in contrast to the city, or arable areas. 1. Firm land in contrast to the sea (Ac 27.27). | 2. A wide region, district, or geographic area (Lk 2.8; Jn 4.35). | 3. The countryside or rural area as opposed to urban centers (Jn 11.55).

DEFINITION: To move from one place to another, to advance, or to have the spatial and mental capacity to contain or accept something.
SENSES: 1. To move from one place to another, to go or advance (Matt 15:17; John 8:37).
2. To have the capacity to contain or hold something, to fit (John 2:6; Mark 2:2).
3. Figurative: to have the mental or spiritual capacity to accept a truth or open one's heart (2 Cor 7:2).

THAYER.pt: Movimentar-se de um lugar para outro, avançar, ou ter capacidade espacial e mental para conter ou aceitar algo. 1. Mudar-se de um lugar para outro, ir ou avançar (Mt 15.17; Jo 8.37). | 2. Ter capacidade para conter ou guardar algo, caber (Jo 2.6; Mc 2.2). | 3. Figurado: ter capacidade mental ou espiritual para aceitar uma verdade ou abrir o coração (2Co 7.2).
THAYER.en: To move from one place to another, to advance, or to have the spatial and mental capacity to contain or accept something. 1. To move from one place to another, to go or advance (Matt 15:17; John 8:37). | 2. To have the capacity to contain or hold something, to fit (John 2:6; Mark 2:2). | 3. Figurative: to have the mental or spiritual capacity to accept a truth or open one's heart (2 Cor 7:2).

DEFINITION: To cause physical separation between entities, whether by introducing space between them or through voluntary departure or the breaking of bonds.
SENSES: 1. To physically separate or divide, breaking a union (Matt 19:6; Rom 8:35).
2. To depart or leave someone (1 Cor 7:10; Acts 1:4).

THAYER.pt: Causar separação física entre entidades, seja introduzindo espaço entre elas ou por meio de partida voluntária ou rompimento de laços. 1. Separar ou dividir fisicamente, rompendo uma união (Mt 19.6; Rm 8.35). | 2. Afastar-se ou partir de alguém (1Co 7.10; At 1.4).
THAYER.en: To cause physical separation between entities, whether by introducing space between them or through voluntary departure or the breaking of bonds. 1. To physically separate or divide, breaking a union (Matt 19:6; Rom 8:35). | 2. To depart or leave someone (1 Cor 7:10; Acts 1:4).

DEFINITION: An expanse of land or field outside densely populated areas, which may be cultivated or serve as private property.
SENSES: 1. A piece of land, field, or rural property (Matt 26:36; John 4:5).

THAYER.pt: Uma extensão de terra ou campo fora de áreas densamente povoadas, podendo ser cultivada ou servir de propriedade particular. 1. Um pedaço de terra, campo ou propriedade rural (Mt 26.36; Jo 4.5).
THAYER.en: An expanse of land or field outside densely populated areas, which may be cultivated or serve as private property. 1. A piece of land, field, or rural property (Matt 26:36; John 4:5).

DEFINITION: Functioning as an adverb or preposition, it indicates the absence, separation, or lack of something or someone.
SENSES: 1. In a state of separation or isolation, apart (John 20:7).
2. In the absence or lack of something or someone, without (John 15:5; Eph 2:12).

THAYER.pt: Funcionando como advérbio ou preposição, indica a ausência, a separação ou a falta de algo ou alguém. 1. Em estado de separação ou isolamento, à parte (Jo 20.7). | 2. Na ausência ou falta de algo ou alguém, sem (Jo 15.5; Ef 2.12).
THAYER.en: Functioning as an adverb or preposition, it indicates the absence, separation, or lack of something or someone. 1. In a state of separation or isolation, apart (John 20:7). | 2. In the absence or lack of something or someone, without (John 15:5; Eph 2:12).

DEFINITION: A geographical and meteorological term designating the cardinal point or the northwest wind.
SENSES: 1. The direction or wind of the northwest.

THAYER.pt: Termo geográfico e meteorológico que designa o ponto cardeal ou o vento noroeste. 1. A direção ou o vento do noroeste.
THAYER.en: A geographical and meteorological term designating the cardinal point or the northwest wind. 1. The direction or wind of the northwest.

DEFINITION: To sing hymns of praise or psalms to God, often with the sense of expressing adoration with joy and spiritual devotion, potentially including the use of musical instruments.
SENSES: 1. To sing hymns of praise to God in the context of communal worship (Eph 5:19; Rom 15:9).
2. To express spiritual and conscious praise (1 Cor 14:15).
3. To chant a song of joy in a general sense (Jas 5:13).

THAYER.pt: Significa cantar hinos de louvor ou salmos a Deus, frequentemente com o sentido de expressar adoração com alegria e devoção espiritual, podendo incluir o uso de instrumentos musicais. 1. Cantar hinos de louvor a Deus no contexto de adoração comunitária (Ef 5.19; Rm 15.9). | 2. Expressar louvor espiritual e consciente (1Co 14.15). | 3. Entoar um cântico de alegria de forma geral (Tg 5.13).
THAYER.en: To sing hymns of praise or psalms to God, often with the sense of expressing adoration with joy and spiritual devotion, potentially including the use of musical instruments. 1. To sing hymns of praise to God in the context of communal worship (Eph 5:19; Rom 15:9). | 2. To express spiritual and conscious praise (1 Cor 14:15). | 3. To chant a song of joy in a general sense (Jas 5:13).

DEFINITION: Designates a song of praise or psalm, encompassing both the Psalms of the Old Testament and the spiritual songs chanted by the early Christian community.
SENSES: 1. A psalm or portion of the Old Testament psalter (Luke 20:42; Acts 1:20).
2. A spiritual song or hymn of praise in the Christian community (1 Cor 14:26; Eph 5:19).

THAYER.pt: Designa um canto de louvor ou salmo, abrangendo tanto os Salmos do Antigo Testamento quanto os cânticos espirituais entoados pela comunidade cristã primitiva. 1. Um salmo ou porção do saltério do Antigo Testamento (Lc 20.42; At 1.20). | 2. Um cântico ou hino de louvor espiritual na comunidade cristã (1Co 14.26; Ef 5.19).
THAYER.en: Designates a song of praise or psalm, encompassing both the Psalms of the Old Testament and the spiritual songs chanted by the early Christian community. 1. A psalm or portion of the Old Testament psalter (Luke 20:42; Acts 1:20). | 2. A spiritual song or hymn of praise in the Christian community (1 Cor 14:26; Eph 5:19).

DEFINITION: An individual who pretends to be a member of the faith community, but whose conduct or loyalty belies such a claim. In the New Testament, it refers to infiltrated opponents who threaten Christian freedom.
SENSES: 1. A false brother infiltrated into Christian communities (2 Cor 11:26; Gal 2:4).

THAYER.pt: Indivíduo que finge ser membro da comunidade de fé, mas cuja conduta ou lealdade desmente tal pretensão. No Novo Testamento, refere-se a opositores infiltrados que ameaçam a liberdade cristã. 1. Falso irmão infiltrado nas comunidades cristãs (2Co 11:26; Gl 2:4).
THAYER.en: An individual who pretends to be a member of the faith community, but whose conduct or loyalty belies such a claim. In the New Testament, it refers to infiltrated opponents who threaten Christian freedom. 1. A false brother infiltrated into Christian communities (2 Cor 11:26; Gal 2:4).

DEFINITION: An individual who falsely claims apostolic authority and commission without having been sent by Christ.
SENSES: 1. A fraudulent worker who pretends to be an apostle of Christ (2 Cor 11:13).

THAYER.pt: Indivíduo que falsamente reivindica a autoridade e a comissão apostólica sem ter sido enviado por Cristo. 1. Obreiro fraudulento que finge ser apóstolo de Cristo (2Co 11.13).
THAYER.en: An individual who falsely claims apostolic authority and commission without having been sent by Christ. 1. A fraudulent worker who pretends to be an apostle of Christ (2 Cor 11:13).

DEFINITION: Refers to that which or the one who opposes the truth, uttering untruths or feigning falsehood.
SENSES: 1. A person or testimony that lies or gives false testimony (Acts 6:13; Rev 2:2; 21:8).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se àquilo ou àquele que se opõe à verdade, proferindo inverdades ou fingindo falsidade. 1. Pessoa ou testemunho que mente ou presta falso testemunho (At 6.13; Ap 2.2; 21.8).
THAYER.en: Refers to that which or the one who opposes the truth, uttering untruths or feigning falsehood. 1. A person or testimony that lies or gives false testimony (Acts 6:13; Rev 2:2; 21:8).

DEFINITION: A person within the Christian community who teaches false or heretical doctrines, contrary to sound doctrine.
SENSES: 1. An instructor who propagates false and destructive teachings (2 Pet 2:1).

THAYER.pt: Pessoa dentro da comunidade cristã que ensina doutrinas falsas ou heréticas, contrárias à sã doutrina. 1. Instrutor que propaga ensinamentos falsos e destrutivos (2Pe 2.1).
THAYER.en: A person within the Christian community who teaches false or heretical doctrines, contrary to sound doctrine. 1. An instructor who propagates false and destructive teachings (2 Pet 2:1).

DEFINITION: One who utters falsehoods or has the habit of lying.
SENSES: 1. One who speaks lies or deceives with falsehoods (1 Tim 4:2).

THAYER.pt: Que profere falsidades ou que tem o hábito de mentir. 1. Aquele que fala mentiras ou engana com falsidades (1Tm 4.2).
THAYER.en: One who utters falsehoods or has the habit of lying. 1. One who speaks lies or deceives with falsehoods (1 Tim 4:2).

SHORT_GLOSS: I lie, deceive, bear false witness
DEFINITION: To communicate something false with the clear intention to deceive, to bear false witness, or to act with falsehood against someone.
SENSES: 1. To tell a falsehood or lie consciously (Acts 5:3; Col 3:9).
2. To bear false witness or lie against the truth (Jas 3:14; 1 John 1:6).
USAGE: I lie, deceive, bear false witness

THAYER.pt: Comunicar algo falso com a clara intenção de enganar, prestar falso testemunho ou agir com falsidade contra alguém. 1. Dizer uma falsidade ou mentir conscientemente (At 5.3; Cl 3.9). | 2. Prestar falso testemunho ou mentir contra a verdade (Tg 3.14; 1Jo 1.6).
THAYER.en: To communicate something false with the clear intention to deceive, to bear false witness, or to act with falsehood against someone. 1. To tell a falsehood or lie consciously (Acts 5:3; Col 3:9). | 2. To bear false witness or lie against the truth (Jas 3:14; 1 John 1:6).

DEFINITION: A person who provides false, lying, or deceptive testimony, especially in legal or accusatory contexts against the truth.
SENSES: 1. Someone who utters false or deceptive testimony (Matt 26:60; 1 Cor 15:15).

THAYER.pt: Pessoa que presta um testemunho falso, mentiroso ou enganoso, especialmente em contextos legais ou acusatórios contra a verdade. 1. Alguém que profere testemunho falso ou enganoso (Mt 26:60; 1Co 15:15).
THAYER.en: A person who provides false, lying, or deceptive testimony, especially in legal or accusatory contexts against the truth. 1. Someone who utters false or deceptive testimony (Matt 26:60; 1 Cor 15:15).

DEFINITION: Describes the action of providing false, lying, or deceptive testimony in a judicial process or in any situation of public declaration.
SENSES: 1. To make a false declaration or raise false testimony against someone (Matt 19:18; Mark 10:19; Luke 18:20).

THAYER.pt: Descreve a ação de prestar um testemunho falso, mentiroso ou enganoso em um processo judicial ou em qualquer situação de declaração pública. 1. Fazer uma declaração falsa ou levantar falso testemunho contra alguém (Mt 19.18; Mc 10.19; Lc 18.20).
THAYER.en: Describes the action of providing false, lying, or deceptive testimony in a judicial process or in any situation of public declaration. 1. To make a false declaration or raise false testimony against someone (Matt 19:18; Mark 10:19; Luke 18:20).

DEFINITION: The act or content of a false, lying, or slanderous testimony uttered against someone.
SENSES: 1. A false and lying declaration or accusation (Matt 15:19; Matt 26:59).

THAYER.pt: O ato ou o conteúdo de um testemunho falso, mentiroso ou calunioso proferido contra alguém. 1. Declaração ou acusação falsa e mentirosa (Mt 15:19; Mt 26:59).
THAYER.en: The act or content of a false, lying, or slanderous testimony uttered against someone. 1. A false and lying declaration or accusation (Matt 15:19; Matt 26:59).

DEFINITION: Refers to someone who falsely presents themselves as a spokesperson for God, proclaiming deceptive revelations, erroneous doctrines, or lying prophecies.
SENSES: 1. An individual who feigns divine inspiration but deceives with false teachings (Mt 24.11; Rev 16.13).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se a alguém que falsamente se apresenta como porta-voz de Deus, proclamando revelações enganosas, doutrinas errôneas ou profecias mentirosas. 1. Indivíduo que finge ter inspiração divina mas engana com falsos ensinamentos (Mt 24.11; Ap 16.13).
THAYER.en: Refers to someone who falsely presents themselves as a spokesperson for God, proclaiming deceptive revelations, erroneous doctrines, or lying prophecies. 1. An individual who feigns divine inspiration but deceives with false teachings (Mt 24.11; Rev 16.13).

DEFINITION: The content of a false statement, contrary to truth, intended to deceive or distort reality.
SENSES: 1. A lie or falsehood in words and actions (Eph 4.25; Rev 21.27).

THAYER.pt: O conteúdo de uma declaração falsa, contrária à verdade, que visa enganar ou distorcer a realidade. 1. Mentira ou falsidade em palavras e ações (Ef 4.25; Ap 21.27).
THAYER.en: The content of a false statement, contrary to truth, intended to deceive or distort reality. 1. A lie or falsehood in words and actions (Eph 4.25; Rev 21.27).

DEFINITION: An impostor who falsely claims to be the Christ or the promised Messiah, deceiving many with false signs.
SENSES: 1. A false Messiah or eschatological deceiver (Mt 24:24; Mk 13:22).

THAYER.pt: Impostor que falsamente afirma ser o Cristo ou o Messias prometido, enganando muitos com falsos sinais. 1. Messias falso ou enganador escatológico (Mt 24:24; Mc 13:22).
THAYER.en: An impostor who falsely claims to be the Christ or the promised Messiah, deceiving many with false signs. 1. A false Messiah or eschatological deceiver (Mt 24:24; Mk 13:22).

DEFINITION: Bearing a name in an incorrect, deceptive, or illegitimate manner.
SENSES: 1. That which carries a false name or undue pretension (1Tm 6.20).

THAYER.pt: Que porta um nome de forma incorreta, enganosa ou ilegítima. 1. O que carrega um nome falso ou pretensão indevida (1Tm 6.20).
THAYER.en: Bearing a name in an incorrect, deceptive, or illegitimate manner. 1. That which carries a false name or undue pretension (1Tm 6.20).

DEFINITION: The content of a false statement; an act of lying or verbal deception.

THAYER.pt: O conteúdo de uma declaração falsa; um ato de mentir ou engano verbal.
THAYER.en: The content of a false statement; an act of lying or verbal deception.

DEFINITION: An individual who utters untruths, deliberately deceives, or does not practice what they profess to believe.
SENSES: 1. Someone who lies habitually or who denies fundamental truths of the faith (Jn 8.55; 1Jn 2.4).

THAYER.pt: Indivíduo que profere inverdades, engana deliberadamente ou não pratica o que professa crer. 1. Alguém que mente habitualmente ou que nega verdades fundamentais da fé (Jo 8.55; 1Jo 2.4).
THAYER.en: An individual who utters untruths, deliberately deceives, or does not practice what they profess to believe. 1. Someone who lies habitually or who denies fundamental truths of the faith (Jn 8.55; 1Jn 2.4).

DEFINITION: Describes the action of examining, touching, or groping something physically with the hands to verify its reality or seek guidance.
SENSES: 1. To touch, handle, or physically manipulate (Lk 24.39; Heb 12.18).
2. To grope or seek something blindly in the dark (Acts 17.27).

THAYER.pt: Descreve a ação de examinar, tocar ou tatear algo fisicamente com as mãos para verificar sua realidade ou buscar orientação. 1. Tocar, apalpar ou manusear fisicamente (Lc 24.39; Hb 12.18). | 2. Tatear ou buscar algo às cegas no escuro (At 17.27).
THAYER.en: Describes the action of examining, touching, or groping something physically with the hands to verify its reality or seek guidance. 1. To touch, handle, or physically manipulate (Lk 24.39; Heb 12.18). | 2. To grope or seek something blindly in the dark (Acts 17.27).

DEFINITION: The act of adding numbers to obtain a total or of deciphering and interpreting the deep meaning of something.
SENSES: 1. To calculate or count a total (Lk 14:28).
2. To interpret or decipher the meaning of a number (Rev 13:18).

THAYER.pt: O ato de somar números para obter um total ou de decifrar e interpretar o significado profundo de algo. 1. Calcular ou contar um total (Lc 14:28). | 2. Interpretar ou decifrar o sentido de um número (Ap 13:18).
THAYER.en: The act of adding numbers to obtain a total or of deciphering and interpreting the deep meaning of something. 1. To calculate or count a total (Lk 14:28). | 2. To interpret or decipher the meaning of a number (Rev 13:18).

DEFINITION: A small stone used in ancient times in legal voting processes or as an amulet and badge.
SENSES: 1. A vote or judicial decision expressed by means of a stone (Acts 26.10);
2. A small white stone with symbolic or votive meaning (Rev 2.17).

THAYER.pt: Pequena pedra usada antigamente em processos de votação jurídica ou como amuleto e distintivo. 1. Voto ou decisão judicial expressa por meio de uma pedra (At 26.10); | 2. Pequena pedra branca com significado simbólico ou votivo (Ap 2.17).
THAYER.en: A small stone used in ancient times in legal voting processes or as an amulet and badge. 1. A vote or judicial decision expressed by means of a stone (Acts 26.10); | 2. A small white stone with symbolic or votive meaning (Rev 2.17).

DEFINITION: Secret or confidential defamatory speech spread through whispers.
SENSES: 1. Defamatory information spread in a secret manner or in a whispering tone (2Co 12.20).

THAYER.pt: Discurso difamatório secreto ou confidencial espalhado por meio de sussurros. 1. Informação difamatória divulgada de forma secreta ou em tom de sussurro (2Co 12.20).
THAYER.en: Secret or confidential defamatory speech spread through whispers. 1. Defamatory information spread in a secret manner or in a whispering tone (2Co 12.20).

DEFINITION: One who spreads rumors or slanders in secret about other people.
SENSES: 1. A person who habitually slanders others through murmuring and gossip (Rom 1.29).

THAYER.pt: Aquele que espalha boatos ou difamações em segredo sobre outras pessoas. 1. Pessoa que habita em difamar os outros por meio de murmurações e fofocas (Rm 1.29).
THAYER.en: One who spreads rumors or slanders in secret about other people. 1. A person who habitually slanders others through murmuring and gossip (Rom 1.29).

DEFINITION: A very small piece or fragment of food, usually leftovers of bread that fall from the table.
SENSES: 1. A crumb or small fragment of bread (Mt 15:27; Mk 7:28).

THAYER.pt: Um pedaço muito pequeno ou fragmento de alimento, normalmente restos de pão que caem da mesa. 1. Migalha ou pequeno fragmento de pão (Mt 15:27; Mc 7:28).
THAYER.en: A very small piece or fragment of food, usually leftovers of bread that fall from the table. 1. A crumb or small fragment of bread (Mt 15:27; Mk 7:28).

DEFINITION: Designates the breath of animated physical life, the integral human being (often translated as 'person'), or the center of human emotions, desires, thoughts, and spiritual affections.
SENSES: 1. Biological vital principle, physical life in its earthly fragility (Mt 2.20; Mk 10.45).
2. The immaterial core of the human being; seat of the will, affections, and morality (Mt 10.28; Lk 1.46).
3. By synecdoche: living being, creature, human individual, person (Acts 2.41; Rom 13.1).

THAYER.pt: Designa o sopro de vida física animada, o ser humano integral (frequentemente traduzido por 'pessoa') ou o centro das emoções, desejos, pensamentos e afeições espirituais do homem. 1. Princípio vital biológico, vida física em sua fragilidade terrena (Mt 2.20; Mc 10.45). | 2. O âmago imaterial do ser humano; sede da vontade, afeições e moralidade (Mt 10.28; Lc 1.46). | 3. Por sinédoque: ser vivo, criatura, indivíduo humano, pessoa (At 2.41; Rm 13.1).
THAYER.en: Designates the breath of animated physical life, the integral human being (often translated as 'person'), or the center of human emotions, desires, thoughts, and spiritual affections. 1. Biological vital principle, physical life in its earthly fragility (Mt 2.20; Mk 10.45). | 2. The immaterial core of the human being; seat of the will, affections, and morality (Mt 10.28; Lk 1.46). | 3. By synecdoche: living being, creature, human individual, person (Acts 2.41; Rom 13.1).

DEFINITION: Describes the human being guided only by physical and instinctive nature, devoid of the direction of the Spirit of God.
SENSES: 1. Natural or non-spiritual, characteristic of human life without the Spirit (1Co 2:14; Jude 19).

THAYER.pt: Descreve o ser humano guiado apenas pela natureza física e instintiva, destituído da direção do Espírito de Deus. 1. Natural ou não espiritual, característico da vida humana sem o Espírito (1Co 2:14; Jd 19).
THAYER.en: Describes the human being guided only by physical and instinctive nature, devoid of the direction of the Spirit of God. 1. Natural or non-spiritual, characteristic of human life without the Spirit (1Co 2:14; Jude 19).

DEFINITION: Atmospheric or environmental state of low temperature, the opposite of heat.
SENSES: 1. Climatic or environmental condition of cold (Jn 18.18; Ac 28.2; 2Co 11.27).

THAYER.pt: Estado atmosférico ou ambiental de baixa temperatura, o oposto do calor. 1. Condição climática ou ambiental de frio (Jo 18.18; At 28.2; 2Co 11.27).
THAYER.en: Atmospheric or environmental state of low temperature, the opposite of heat. 1. Climatic or environmental condition of cold (Jn 18.18; Ac 28.2; 2Co 11.27).

DEFINITION: Qualifies that which possesses low physical temperature or, figuratively, the condition of spiritual coldness and lack of enthusiasm.
SENSES: 1. Physically cold or freezing (Mt 10.42).
2. Figuratively cold, without spiritual fervor or enthusiasm (Re 3.15).

THAYER.pt: Qualifica o que possui baixa temperatura física ou, figuradamente, a condição de frieza espiritual e falta de entusiasmo. 1. Fisicamente frio ou gelado (Mt 10.42). | 2. Figuradamente frio, sem fervor espiritual ou entusiasmo (Ap 3.15).
THAYER.en: Qualifies that which possesses low physical temperature or, figuratively, the condition of spiritual coldness and lack of enthusiasm. 1. Physically cold or freezing (Mt 10.42). | 2. Figuratively cold, without spiritual fervor or enthusiasm (Re 3.15).

SHORT_GLOSS: to cool, to grow cold, to quench
DEFINITION: To make cold or lose heat; figuratively, describes the cooling of love or spiritual fervor.
SENSES: 1. To grow cold or be extinguished, especially love (Mt 24.12).
USAGE: to cool, to grow cold, to quench

THAYER.pt: Tornar frio ou perder o calor; figuradamente, descreve o arrefecimento do amor ou fervor espiritual. 1. Esfriar ou extinguir-se, especialmente o amor (Mt 24.12).
THAYER.en: To make cold or lose heat; figuratively, describes the cooling of love or spiritual fervor. 1. To grow cold or be extinguished, especially love (Mt 24.12).

SHORT_GLOSS: to feed, to give to eat, to distribute
DEFINITION: To feed someone by putting food in the mouth or, by extension, to distribute all goods as an act of charity.
SENSES: 1. To feed or give food to someone (Ro 12:20).
2. To distribute goods in pieces or donate them entirely (1Co 13:3).
USAGE: to feed, to give to eat, to distribute

THAYER.pt: Alimentar alguém colocando comida na boca ou, por extensão, distribuir todos os bens como ato de caridade. 1. Dar de comer ou alimentar alguém (Rm 12:20). | 2. Distribuir bens em pedaços ou doá-los totalmente (1Co 13:3).
THAYER.en: To feed someone by putting food in the mouth or, by extension, to distribute all goods as an act of charity. 1. To feed or give food to someone (Ro 12:20). | 2. To distribute goods in pieces or donate them entirely (1Co 13:3).

DEFINITION: A small morsel or piece of bread, usually dipped in sauce or wine during a meal.
SENSES: 1. A small morsel or piece of bread (Jn 13.26).

THAYER.pt: Pequeno bocado ou pedaço de pão, geralmente embebido em molho ou vinho durante uma refeição. 1. Um pequeno bocado ou pedaço de pão (Jo 13.26).
THAYER.en: A small morsel or piece of bread, usually dipped in sauce or wine during a meal. 1. A small morsel or piece of bread (Jn 13.26).

DEFINITION: To rub something under pressure to separate parts, such as cereal grains from their ears.
SENSES: 1. To rub grain heads with the hands to obtain the kernels (Lk 6.1).

THAYER.pt: Esfregar algo sob pressão para separar partes, como os grãos de cereal de suas espigas. 1. Esfregar espigas com as mãos para obter os grãos (Lc 6.1).
THAYER.en: To rub something under pressure to separate parts, such as cereal grains from their ears. 1. To rub grain heads with the hands to obtain the kernels (Lk 6.1).

DEFINITION: Interjection used to mark the vocative in direct addresses, expressing intense emotion, admiration, or exhortation.
SENSES: 1. Vocative particle or emotional exclamation (Mt 15.28; Ro 11.33).

THAYER.pt: Interjeição usada para marcar o vocativo em endereços diretos, expressando emoção intensa, admiração ou exortação. 1. Partícula de vocativo ou exclamação emocional (Mt 15.28; Rm 11.33).
THAYER.en: Interjection used to mark the vocative in direct addresses, expressing intense emotion, admiration, or exhortation. 1. Vocative particle or emotional exclamation (Mt 15.28; Ro 11.33).

DEFINITION: Particle used to mark direct address or exclamation, often expressing intense emotion such as surprise, lament, or fervor.
SENSES: 1. Marker of direct address to persons, equivalent to the vocative (Ac 1.1).
2. Expression of exclamation and intense emotion (Mt 15.28; Ro 11.33).

THAYER.pt: Partícula usada para marcar vocação direta ou exclamação, frequentemente expressando emoção intensa como surpresa, lamento ou fervor. 1. Marcador de endereço direto a pessoas, equivalente ao vocativo (At 1.1). | 2. Expressão de exclamação e emoção intensa (Mt 15.28; Rm 11.33).
THAYER.en: Particle used to mark direct address or exclamation, often expressing intense emotion such as surprise, lament, or fervor. 1. Marker of direct address to persons, equivalent to the vocative (Ac 1.1). | 2. Expression of exclamation and intense emotion (Mt 15.28; Ro 11.33).

DEFINITION: Interjectional particle used for direct address to a person or to express intense emotion.
SENSES: 1. Vocative marker to call or address someone (Ac 1.1).
2. Expression of strong emotion, admiration, or lament (Mt 15.28; Ro 11.33).

THAYER.pt: Partícula interjetiva usada para endereçamento direto a uma pessoa ou para expressar emoção intensa. 1. Marcador de vocativo para chamar ou dirigir-se a alguém (At 1.1). | 2. Expressão de forte emoção, admiração ou lamento (Mt 15.28; Rm 11.33).
THAYER.en: Interjectional particle used for direct address to a person or to express intense emotion. 1. Vocative marker to call or address someone (Ac 1.1). | 2. Expression of strong emotion, admiration, or lament (Mt 15.28; Ro 11.33).

DEFINITION: Hebrew proper name referring to Obed, son of Boaz and Ruth, grandfather of King David.
SENSES: 1. Obed, a character in the genealogy of David and Jesus (Mt 1.5; Lk 3.32).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio hebraico referente a Obede, filho de Boaz e Rute, avô do rei Davi. 1. Obede, personagem da genealogia de Davi e de Jesus (Mt 1.5; Lc 3.32).
THAYER.en: Hebrew proper name referring to Obed, son of Boaz and Ruth, grandfather of King David. 1. Obed, a character in the genealogy of David and Jesus (Mt 1.5; Lk 3.32).

DEFINITION: Indicates a location relatively close to the speaker or a circumstance present in the context of discourse.
SENSES: 1. In a physically close location to the speaker, here (Mt 12.6; Lk 9.13).
2. In reference to a situation, case, or specific point of discourse, in this case (1Co 4.2).

THAYER.pt: Indica um local relativamente próximo ao falante ou uma circunstância presente no contexto do discurso. 1. Em um local fisicamente próximo ao falante, aqui (Mt 12.6; Lc 9.13). | 2. Em referência a uma situação, caso ou ponto específico do discurso, neste caso (1Co 4.2).
THAYER.en: Indicates a location relatively close to the speaker or a circumstance present in the context of discourse. 1. In a physically close location to the speaker, here (Mt 12.6; Lk 9.13). | 2. In reference to a situation, case, or specific point of discourse, in this case (1Co 4.2).

DEFINITION: Refers to a poetic or melodic composition with verbal content, specifically a sacred song of praise directed to God or Christ in the New Testament.
SENSES: 1. A spiritual song or hymn of worship to God and Christ (Eph 5.19; Re 15.3).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se a uma composição poética ou melódica com conteúdo verbal, especificamente um cântico sagrado de louvor dirigido a Deus ou a Cristo no Novo Testamento. 1. Um cântico espiritual ou hino de adoração a Deus e a Cristo (Ef 5.19; Ap 15.3).
THAYER.en: Refers to a poetic or melodic composition with verbal content, specifically a sacred song of praise directed to God or Christ in the New Testament. 1. A spiritual song or hymn of worship to God and Christ (Eph 5.19; Re 15.3).

DEFINITION: Originally designates the sharp pains of childbirth and, by metaphorical extension, any intense suffering or the eschatological pains preceding the new age.
SENSES: 1. Acute birth pangs (1Th 5.3).
2. Intense pains or preliminary eschatological tribulations (Mt 24.8; Mk 13.8).

THAYER.pt: Designa originariamente as dores agudas do parto e, por extensão metafórica, qualquer sofrimento intenso ou as dores escatológicas que precedem a nova era. 1. Dores agudas de parto (1Ts 5.3). | 2. Dores intensas ou tribulações escatológicas preliminares (Mt 24.8; Mc 13.8).
THAYER.en: Originally designates the sharp pains of childbirth and, by metaphorical extension, any intense suffering or the eschatological pains preceding the new age. 1. Acute birth pangs (1Th 5.3). | 2. Intense pains or preliminary eschatological tribulations (Mt 24.8; Mk 13.8).

SHORT_GLOSS: to give birth, to suffer pains, to groan
DEFINITION: To experience the intense pains of childbirth or, in a figurative sense, to suffer deep anguish.
SENSES: 1. To feel birth pangs or be in labor (Re 12.2; Gal 4.27);
2. Figurative: To suffer great spiritual or emotional anguish (Gal 4.19).
USAGE: to give birth, to suffer pains, to groan

THAYER.pt: Experimentar as dores intensas do parto ou, em sentido figurado, sofrer angústia profunda. 1. Sentir dores de parto ou estar em labor de parto (Ap 12.2; Gl 4.27); | 2. Figurado: Sofrer grande angústia espiritual ou emocional (Gl 4.19).
THAYER.en: To experience the intense pains of childbirth or, in a figurative sense, to suffer deep anguish. 1. To feel birth pangs or be in labor (Re 12.2; Gal 4.27); | 2. Figurative: To suffer great spiritual or emotional anguish (Gal 4.19).

DEFINITION: The upper part of the human body joining the arm to the trunk, frequently used in the NT to illustrate carried burdens.
SENSES: 1. Physical shoulder, used for carrying loads or burdens (Mt 23:4; Lk 15:5).

THAYER.pt: A parte superior do corpo humano que une o braço ao tronco, frequentemente usada no NT para ilustrar fardos carregados. 1. Ombro físico, usado para carregar cargas ou fardos (Mt 23:4; Lc 15:5).
THAYER.en: The upper part of the human body joining the arm to the trunk, frequently used in the NT to illustrate carried burdens. 1. Physical shoulder, used for carrying loads or burdens (Mt 23:4; Lk 15:5).

DEFINITION: Present participle of the verb to be, indicating continuous existence or current state.
SENSES: 1. The action of existing or being in a certain state (Jn 1.48; Ac 5.17).

THAYER.pt: Particípio presente do verbo ser, indicando existência contínua ou estado atual. 1. Ação de existir ou estar em um determinado estado (Jo 1.48; At 5.17).
THAYER.en: Present participle of the verb to be, indicating continuous existence or current state. 1. The action of existing or being in a certain state (Jn 1.48; Ac 5.17).

DEFINITION: To acquire possession of something through the payment of a price in money.
SENSES: 1. To buy or acquire goods through a financial transaction (Ac 7.16).

THAYER.pt: Adquirir a posse de algo mediante o pagamento de um preço em dinheiro. 1. Comprar ou adquirir bens por transação financeira (At 7.16).
THAYER.en: To acquire possession of something through the payment of a price in money. 1. To buy or acquire goods through a financial transaction (Ac 7.16).

DEFINITION: Bird's egg, typically of a chicken, used as food.
SENSES: 1. An egg (Lk 11.12).

THAYER.pt: Ovo de ave, tipicamente de galinha, usado como alimento. 1. Um ovo (Lc 11.12).
THAYER.en: Bird's egg, typically of a chicken, used as food. 1. An egg (Lk 11.12).

DEFINITION: Refers both to the astronomical subdivision of the twelve-hour day and to the exact, appropriate, or divine providence-determined moment for a specific purpose.
SENSES: 1. The twelfth part of the daylight period; a clock hour (Mt 20.3; Jn 11.9).
2. Opportune moment, decisive hour, or determined moment in God's plans (Jn 2.4; 17.1).
3. A relatively brief period or time interval (2Co 7.8; 1Jn 2.18).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se tanto à subdivisão astronômica do dia de doze horas quanto ao momento exato, apropriado ou determinado pela providência divina para a realização de um propósito específico. 1. A décima segunda parte do período diurno; uma hora de relógio (Mt 20.3; Jo 11.9). | 2. Momento oportuno, hora decisiva ou momento determinado nos planos de Deus (Jo 2.4; 17.1). | 3. Período ou intervalo temporal relativamente breve (2Co 7.8; 1Jo 2.18).
THAYER.en: Refers both to the astronomical subdivision of the twelve-hour day and to the exact, appropriate, or divine providence-determined moment for a specific purpose. 1. The twelfth part of the daylight period; a clock hour (Mt 20.3; Jn 11.9). | 2. Opportune moment, decisive hour, or determined moment in God's plans (Jn 2.4; 17.1). | 3. A relatively brief period or time interval (2Co 7.8; 1Jn 2.18).

DEFINITION: Qualifies that which occurs at the right and opportune moment, or that which possesses beauty, comeliness, and visual attractiveness.
SENSES: 1. Opportune or happening at the right time (Ro 10.15).
2. Beautiful, comely, or attractive in appearance (Ac 3.2).

THAYER.pt: Qualifica o que ocorre no momento certo e oportuno, ou o que possui beleza, formosura e atratividade visual. 1. Oportuno ou que acontece no tempo certo (Rm 10.15). | 2. Belo, formoso ou atraente na aparência (At 3.2).
THAYER.en: Qualifies that which occurs at the right and opportune moment, or that which possesses beauty, comeliness, and visual attractiveness. 1. Opportune or happening at the right time (Ro 10.15). | 2. Beautiful, comely, or attractive in appearance (Ac 3.2).

DEFINITION: To emit a loud and fierce sound, characteristic of wild animals like lions or wolves.
SENSES: 1. To roar or howl fiercely (1Pe 5.8).

THAYER.pt: Emitir um som alto e feroz, característico de animais selvagens como leões ou lobos. 1. Rugir ou bramar ferozmente (1Pe 5.8).
THAYER.en: To emit a loud and fierce sound, characteristic of wild animals like lions or wolves. 1. To roar or howl fiercely (1Pe 5.8).

DEFINITION: Polyvalent particle employed primarily to establish qualitative comparisons and correspondences, alongside temporal clauses and expressions of quantitative approximation.
SENSES: 1. Marker of comparison or likeness: as, just as (Mt 6.10; 10.16).
2. Temporal conjunction of simultaneity: when, as soon as (Lk 1.23; Jn 4.1).
3. Use with numbers to denote approximate quantity: about, approximately (Mk 5.13; Jn 6.19).

THAYER.pt: Partícula polivalente empregada primariamente para estabelecer comparações e correspondências qualitativas, além de orações temporais e expressões de aproximação quantitativa. 1. Marcador de comparação ou semelhança: como, tal como (Mt 6.10; 10.16). | 2. Conjunção temporal de concomitância: quando, logo que (Lc 1.23; Jo 4.1). | 3. Uso com números para denotar quantidade aproximada: cerca de, aproximadamente (Mc 5.13; Jo 6.19).
THAYER.en: Polyvalent particle employed primarily to establish qualitative comparisons and correspondences, alongside temporal clauses and expressions of quantitative approximation. 1. Marker of comparison or likeness: as, just as (Mt 6.10; 10.16). | 2. Temporal conjunction of simultaneity: when, as soon as (Lk 1.23; Jn 4.1). | 3. Use with numbers to denote approximate quantity: about, approximately (Mk 5.13; Jn 6.19).

DEFINITION: A liturgical exclamation of praise and supplication meaning literally 'save, I pray' or 'salvation now', used to acclaim God and the Messiah.
SENSES: 1. A shout of messianic praise and adoration (Mt 21.9; Jn 12.13).

THAYER.pt: Uma exclamação litúrgica de louvor e súplica que significa literalmente 'salvai, rogo-vos' ou 'salvação agora', usada para aclamar a Deus e ao Messias. 1. Um grito de louvor e adoração messiânica (Mt 21.9; Jo 12.13).
THAYER.en: A liturgical exclamation of praise and supplication meaning literally 'save, I pray' or 'salvation now', used to acclaim God and the Messiah. 1. A shout of messianic praise and adoration (Mt 21.9; Jn 12.13).

DEFINITION: Term indicating strong similarity or identity of action or manner between two or more situations.
SENSES: 1. Doing something in the same way or very similarly; likewise (Mt 20.5; Lk 20.31).

THAYER.pt: Termo que indica forte semelhança ou identidade de ação ou modo entre duas ou mais situações. 1. Fazer algo da mesma maneira ou de forma muito semelhante; igualmente (Mt 20.5; Lc 20.31).
THAYER.en: Term indicating strong similarity or identity of action or manner between two or more situations. 1. Doing something in the same way or very similarly; likewise (Mt 20.5; Lk 20.31).

DEFINITION: Particle used to denote approximate similarity between things or to indicate numerical and temporal estimates.
SENSES: 1. Indicator of comparison, meaning 'as' or 'similar to' (Mt 3.16).
2. Indicator of approximation with numbers or measures, 'about' (Mt 14.21).

THAYER.pt: Partícula usada para denotar semelhança aproximada entre coisas ou para indicar estimativas numéricas e temporais. 1. Indicador de comparação, significando 'como' ou 'semelhante a' (Mt 3.16). | 2. Indicador de aproximação com números ou medidas, 'cerca de' (Mt 14.21).
THAYER.en: Particle used to denote approximate similarity between things or to indicate numerical and temporal estimates. 1. Indicator of comparison, meaning 'as' or 'similar to' (Mt 3.16). | 2. Indicator of approximation with numbers or measures, 'about' (Mt 14.21).

DEFINITION: Hebrew proper name designating the prophet Hosea or the prophetic book written by him.
SENSES: 1. The prophet Hosea (Ro 9.25).

THAYER.pt: Nome próprio hebraico que designa o profeta Oseias ou o livro profético por ele escrito. 1. O profeta Oseias (Rm 9.25).
THAYER.en: Hebrew proper name designating the prophet Hosea or the prophetic book written by him. 1. The prophet Hosea (Ro 9.25).

DEFINITION: Emphatic particle establishing a clear comparison or similarity between two actions or states.
SENSES: 1. Just as, exactly the way that, introducing a comparison (Mt 12.40; Ro 5.12).

THAYER.pt: Partícula enfática que estabelece uma clara comparação ou semelhança entre duas ações ou estados. 1. Assim como, exatamente da maneira que, introduzindo uma comparação (Mt 12.40; Rm 5.12).
THAYER.en: Emphatic particle establishing a clear comparison or similarity between two actions or states. 1. Just as, exactly the way that, introducing a comparison (Mt 12.40; Ro 5.12).

DEFINITION: Particle used to express an approximate comparison or analogy.
SENSES: 1. In the same way that, as if it were (1Co 15.8).

THAYER.pt: Partícula usada para expressar uma comparação aproximada ou analogia. 1. Da mesma forma que, como se fosse (1Co 15.8).
THAYER.en: Particle used to express an approximate comparison or analogy. 1. In the same way that, as if it were (1Co 15.8).

SHORT_GLOSS: so that, therefore, in order to
DEFINITION: Conjunction employed to introduce clauses expressing the actual result of an action, its purpose, or a practical conclusion in independent clauses.
SENSES: 1. Indicator of actual result or consequence: so that, in such a way that (Mt 8.24; Gal 2.13).
2. Concluding connector at the beginning of sentences: therefore, consequently (Mt 12.12; Ro 7.12; 1Co 15.58).
3. Indicator of intended purpose or goal: in order that (Mt 27.1).
USAGE: so that, therefore, in order to

THAYER.pt: Conjunção empregada para introduzir orações que expressam o resultado real de uma ação, seu propósito, ou uma conclusão prática em orações independentes. 1. Indicador de resultado ou consequência efetiva: de modo que, de maneira que (Mt 8.24; Gl 2.13). | 2. Conector conclusivo no início de frases: portanto, por conseguinte (Mt 12.12; Rm 7.12; 1Co 15.58). | 3. Indicador de finalidade ou intenção pretendida: a fim de que (Mt 27.1).
THAYER.en: Conjunction employed to introduce clauses expressing the actual result of an action, its purpose, or a practical conclusion in independent clauses. 1. Indicator of actual result or consequence: so that, in such a way that (Mt 8.24; Gal 2.13). | 2. Concluding connector at the beginning of sentences: therefore, consequently (Mt 12.12; Ro 7.12; 1Co 15.58). | 3. Indicator of intended purpose or goal: in order that (Mt 27.1).

DEFINITION: Refers to the organ of hearing, specifically the external ear of humans or animals, appearing in gospel accounts of healings and episodes of violence.
SENSES: 1. The physical ear as part of the body (Mt 26.51; Lk 22.50; Jn 18.10).

THAYER.pt: Refere-se ao órgão da audição, especificamente à orelha externa de seres humanos ou animais, aparecendo em relatos evangélicos de curas e episódios de violência. 1. A orelha física como parte do corpo (Mt 26.51; Lc 22.50; Jo 18.10).
THAYER.en: Refers to the organ of hearing, specifically the external ear of humans or animals, appearing in gospel accounts of healings and episodes of violence. 1. The physical ear as part of the body (Mt 26.51; Lk 22.50; Jn 18.10).

DEFINITION: The state or condition of gaining a useful advantage, profit, or benefit.
SENSES: 1. Spiritual or material advantage or profit (Rom 3:1; Jude 16).

THAYER.pt: O estado ou condição de obter uma vantagem, lucro ou benefício útil. 1. Vantagem ou proveito espiritual ou material (Rm 3:1; Jd 16).
THAYER.en: The state or condition of gaining a useful advantage, profit, or benefit. 1. Spiritual or material advantage or profit (Rom 3:1; Jude 16).

DEFINITION: To render useful assistance, bring advantages, or be profitable to someone.
SENSES: 1. To bring benefit, assist, or be of practical use (Heb 4:2).
2. To achieve success or profit in accomplishing a goal (Matt 27:24).

THAYER.pt: Prestar assistência útil, trazer vantagens ou ser proveitoso para alguém. 1. Trazer benefício, auxiliar ou ser de utilidade prática (Hb 4.2). | 2. Alcançar sucesso ou proveito em realizar um objetivo (Mt 27.24).
THAYER.en: To render useful assistance, bring advantages, or be profitable to someone. 1. To bring benefit, assist, or be of practical use (Heb 4:2). | 2. To achieve success or profit in accomplishing a goal (Matt 27:24).

DEFINITION: Indicates that which brings benefit, usefulness, or practical advantage to moral and spiritual life.
SENSES: 1. Useful, profitable, or beneficial for Christian life and conduct (1 Tim 4:8; Titus 3:8).

THAYER.pt: Indica aquilo que traz benefício, utilidade ou vantagem prática para a vida moral e espiritual. 1. Útil, proveitoso ou benéfico para a vida e conduta cristã (1Tm 4.8; Tt 3.8).
THAYER.en: Indicates that which brings benefit, usefulness, or practical advantage to moral and spiritual life. 1. Useful, profitable, or beneficial for Christian life and conduct (1 Tim 4:8; Titus 3:8).
